native: レフィーヤ・ウィリディス
description:
__Race:__ Elf
__Height:__ 156 cm (5'1")
__Affiliation:__ Loki Familia
__Level:__ 4
__Skills:__ Fairy Canon • Double Canon
__Magic:__ Arcs Ray • Fusillade Fallarica • Elf Ring
__Weapon:__ Forest's Teardrop

Lefiya Viridis is a second class adventurer and a member of the Loki Familia. She is a mage training to succeed Riveria Ljos Alf. She has a magic that allows her to use any Elf Magic, hence the alias Thousand Elf. Sometime in the past, Lefiya was an honor student at the School, leveling up after three years at eleven years of age. After graduating, she joined the Loki Familia at Level 2 and leveled up a year later. 

Lefiya is clumsy, but hard working. She occasionally zones out as her imagination runs rampant. She has a deep admiration for Ais and through her admiration, aims to become stronger so that she can stand next to Ais as an equal. She is often jealous of Bell due to his interactions with Ais. Lefiya maintains her elven pride, but is more open than normal Elves due to her own kind nature and growing up surrounded by people from other races. Lefiya struggled with her own worth as a member of the Loki Familia, having low confidence, self doubt, and other problems that began to get better once she befriended Filvis and learned concurrent chanting. Having a fear of being left completely alone due to her ineptitude, she highly valued her relationships, especially with Ais and Filvis.

appearsIn.title: Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon?
Sword Oratoria: Is it Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? On the Side

name: Chloe Rollo
description:
__Race:__ Cat People
__Height:__ 158 cm (5'2")
__Affiliation:__ Hostess of Fertility • Njord Familia
__Level:__ 4
__Magic:__ Pheles Cruz
__Weapon:__ Violetta

Chloe Rollo is a waitress at the Hostess of Fertility pub and a former assassin known as Rollo as a member of the Njord Familia. Chloe was born to parents who were members of a Familia that acted as a criminal organization. From the moment she was born, she was taught different methods of assassination, and was praised when she properly utilized them. However, she began to dislike her Familia after her mother died while protecting her. Her Goddess agreed to let her leave, though she was ordered to carry out a number of tasks before leaving, including assassinating a Level 3 knight of the empire using only a knife. Despite the extreme difficulty of her tasks, she was successful, leveling up in the process. After leaving her Familia, she traveled around for a while, until she came to Orario around nine years before the story. While there, she failed her first mission, which was to assassinate Shakti Varma, barely escaping with her life, and began refusing jobs to kill first class adventurers. Eventually, after failing to kill a wanted Ryuu, she joined the Hostess of Fertility.

Chloe is known to have a crafty side and often gambles, which her fellow employees give a cold shoulder to. She is loyal to her fellow Hostess of Fertility coworkers, such as when she was openly hostile to Hermes for mentioning Ryuu's past.

appearsIn.title: Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon?

name: Lunoire Faust
description:
__Race:__ Human
__Height:__ 161 cm (5'3")

Lunoire Faust is a waitress at the Hostess of Fertility and a former bounty hunter known as Faust as a member of the Demeter Familia. Lunoire was born to parents that lived in a territory of the empire. However, her parents soon died because of a war, and she was forced to live her life as one of the street children. After living for some time in harsh conditions, she heard about the falna and joined a Familia, but later began traveling on her own a while later once her Goddess was forced back to heaven. After a while, she arrived at Orario nine years before the story and failed her first mission of killing the Gulliver Brothers, barely escaping with her life, and began refusing jobs to kill first class adventurers. Eventually, after failing to kill a wanted Ryuu, she joined the Hostess of Fertility. 

Lunoire has a straightforward and caring personality, as shown when she tried to distance herself from her own Familia in order to protect them. She once considered finding a husband that didn't need to be cool as long as he would care for her and let her laze around in a small house.

appearsIn.title: Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon?
Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? IV Part 2

name: Canoe Belway
description:
__Race:__ Raccoon
__Height:__ 155 cm (5'1")
__Affiliation:__ Soma Familia
__Level:__ 1
__Weapon:__ Magic Sword

An adventurer from the Soma Familia. Canoe was crafty and greedy. He often beat Lili and stole the money and items that she had collected. He also betrayed Ged Raish after they ambushed Lili in the Dungeon, causing his death when he tried to escape, only to be killed by the approaching Killer Ants. His greed ultimately led to his demise as he let loose the Minotaur Ottar had tamed. 

(Source: Danmachi Wiki)

appearsIn.title: Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon?

name: Satan Jacob
description:
Satan Jacob is the main protagonist of the series. He was once the Demon King who declared war on Ente Isla in an attempt to annex the four continents. However, due to the actions of the Hero [Emilia Justina](https://anilist.co/character/70735) and her companions, he was forced to retreat to Earth, causing him to lose almost all of his powers.

Satan was well-known throughout Ente Isla as the great overlord of his people, his name synonymous with the terror and cruelty his army brought to those unfortunate enough to fall victim. He allowed his minions the right to perform any heinous acts they deemed fit, showing immense cruelty through the slaughter of many innocent humans in his conquest. By contrast, on Earth Sadao Maou is shown to be a diligent and proactive employee, instead applying his strong drive and determination to better himself in his new life. Forced to spend time living as a human and interacting with those he previously considered to be lesser beings, he has since developed a kindhearted and cheerful disposition making him popular among both his colleagues and neighbors. He now strives to climb the corporate ladder at MgRonald's.

appearsIn.title: The Devil is a Part-Timer! Season 2

name: Emilia Justina
native: エミリア・ユスティーナ
description:
Emilia is the main female protagonist and the Hero who defeated the [Demon King Satan](https://anilist.co/character/70733). After forcing the Demon King to retreat from Ente Isla, she followed him to modern day Japan to ensure his destruction. However, just like the Demon Lord, she lost most of her powers upon her arrival and was forced to assume a Japanese name. She was also forced to find employment, and so became a call center agent. She is a half human and half angel.

Overall, Emi is a strong-willed and determined hero, displaying many admirable qualities befitting of one in her position; among which are a pure heart, boundless courage, unwavering loyalty to those closest to her, and a deep-seated desire to protect the innocent. Moreover, she lacks self-confidence and gets angry/frustrated easily. While initially hesitant to become the great hero of Ente Isla, the death of her father at the hands of [Lucifer](https://anilist.co/character/83103)'s Army ignited a fire in the heart of the young hero, giving her a motivation to train harder and strike down those who destroyed her village. Due to her personal losses, she sees all demons as her enemy, most of all their leader, Satan Jacob.

appearsIn.title: The Devil is a Part-Timer! Season 2

name: Chiho Sasaki
description:
Chiho is Maou's friend and a fellow employee at MgRonald's. She has a crush on Maou. She can hear and understand the language of Ente Isla, after receiving feedback from a hypnosis spell that Maou cast on her father, Inspector Sasaki.

She has a strong will and a polite, friendly, pleasant all around personality. She is head over heels for Maou, and sometimes gets jealous when she sees Emi and Maou together.

She is a part-time employee at MgRonald's along with Maou. Maou had met her father when he first landed on Earth, as her father is a policeman and caught him and Ashiya loitering around. Chiho attends school at Sasahata North High School.

appearsIn.title: The Devil is a Part-Timer! Season 2

name: Crestia Bell
description: She is the chief interrogator and executioner for the Church Investigation Commission, who came into the human realm from Ente Isla to check on reports about Emi's alliance with Maou. Unknown to Maou who she is, she becomes his next door neighbor and eventually became close, being a good cook she would drop by in Maou's apartment to  prepare meals for everyone. She knows little about the human realm especially in Tokyo that she is having difficulty going around the city and understanding people's sense of fashion.     (Source:  Animefreak)

appearsIn.title: The Devil is a Part-Timer! Season 2

name: Alciel
description:
Alciel is one of Satan's Demon Generals and was also transported to modern day Japan with him. Extremely loyal to Maou, he takes care of the domestic duties at home and goes to the library to research ways for Maou and himself to regain their powers.

Back in Ente Isla, Alciel was known widely as the right hand of King Satan and a master strategist, making him both a trusted adviser and top military commander to the ruler of the Demon Realm. However, he shared his leader's belief that humans lives are meaningless and expendable, considering demonkind to be superior beings and showing a strong sense of pride bordering on extreme arrogance. 

While living in Japan, Ashiya has come to accept his rather mundane life, though he still openly laments how low they have fallen since arriving on Earth, and still tends to consider humans as beneath him. Due to their lack of sufficient funds and personal comforts, Ashiya has become incredibly tightfisted and strict about the household budget. One part of him that has not changed, though, is his extreme dedication and loyalty to the Demon King.

(Source: Hataraku Maou-sama Wikia, edited)

appearsIn.title: The Devil is a Part-Timer! Season 2

name: Albert Ende
description: One of the comrades of Yusa, Emi on attacking the Dark Lord's castle.

name: Lucifer
description:
Lucifer is a fallen angel and one of the Demon King's generals. After his defeat at the hands of Hero Emilia, he was secretly rescued by Olba Meyer, who promised to return Lucifer to heaven if they became allies in defeating the Demon Lord. After being defeated by the Demon Lord, Urushihara moved in with Sadao Maou and Ashiya.

Lucifer is shown to be cunning and sneaky as well as a childish, preferring to surf the internet and play video games rather than help Ashiya with the housework. Due to his attitude, everyone tends to treat him lightly and pay no mind to many of his protests at being excluded from things. Lucifer is also self-proclaimed socially awkward, lazy to an extent, and has a short temper. However, it seems he has hidden feelings beneath his seemingly irresponsible and carefree attitude, and shows his serious side from time to time. To his irritation, Lucifer is usually referred to as a hikikomori even when among company.



(Source: Hataraku Maou-sama Wikia, edited)

appearsIn.title: The Devil is a Part-Timer! Season 2

name: Olba Meyer
description: (Source: ANN)

name: Kaori Shouji
description: Chiho's classmate, who seemly has an affinity for boy's love.

name: Yuki Mizushima
description: **First appearance:** Episode 10 as the Manager of MgRonalds at the Fushima Park branch.

name: Jinta Yadomi
description:
__Height:__ 165cm

Jinta is the main character of the series. In the past, Jinta was an energetic, young boy and the leader of his group, the Super Peace Busters. When Naruko asked him if he had a crush on Menma, he said, "Why would I be in love with such an ugly—?" He had plans to apologize to her the next day, but she died later that night in a drowning accident.

Unable to forgive himself, Jinta spent the next years of his life in a constant state of gloominess. He became withdrawn and eventually became a hikikomori, or a shut-in. He currently lives with his father. While he is enrolled at the same high school as Naruko, he stopped attending.

appearsIn.title: Anohana: The Flower We Saw That Day

name: Meiko Honma
description:
__Height:__ 147cm

Menma is a ghost girl who suddenly appears several years after her death to Jinta and asks him to reunite their group of friends so her wish can be granted. Yet, she does not seem to remember what is her wish, but she knows she has to reunite her friends in order to remember. Despite being "dead", she is a very positive, energetic and lively person. According to Jinta, she is quite selfless and cries very often for others when they are hurt or upset, but not for herself.  Jinta calls her "the beast of the summer" as he relates her to being a manifestation of his stress instead of a ghost girl.

appearsIn.title: Anohana: The Flower We Saw That Day

name: Naruko Anjou
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm (5'5")

Naruko is a childhood friend of Jinta and Menma. While she displays a cold attitude towards Jinta, she is secretly concerned for him. She is perhaps the closest to him at present and is enrolled the same school (although Jinta stopped attending school). Chiriko comments that Naruko has not changed over the years: she is still easily persuaded by everyone around her. Naruko seems to be popular in high school and gets along well with girls that Chiriko deems "sluts."   While they have grown apart, Naruko seems cares deeply about her childhood friends. She works at a video game store and has a large collection of manga and video games herself. Because of this collection, she started reconnecting with Jinta and Poppo. Naruko Anjou is left handed

appearsIn.title: Anohana: The Flower We Saw That Day

name: Atsumu Matsuyuki
description:
__Height:__ 181 cm (5' 11")

Atsumu is a childhood friend of Jinta and Menma. In the present, Atsumu holds a condescending attitude towards Jinta. He becomes agitated when Menma is mentioned and is still distraught over her death. He, together with Chiriko, attend the same high school, which Jinta failed the entrance exams to enter. Atsumu and Chiriko were once mistaken as a pair.

appearsIn.title: Anohana: The Flower We Saw That Day

name: Chiriko Tsurumi
description: As a child, Chiriko was a shy girl and a member of the Super Peace Busters. Now, she is enrolled at an elite school with Matsuyuki. Currently, she is ranked fourth in her class. She is serious, stoic, and cocky. Upon meeting with Naruko, Chiriko insults both her and her friends; however, she has since made amends with Naruko. While the other members of the Super Peace Busters have fallen apart, Chiriko and Matsuyuki have remained friends after Menma's death.

appearsIn.title: Anohana: The Flower We Saw That Day

name: Tetsudo Hisakawa
description: Poppo is the first friend that Jinta reconnects with. As a child, Poppo was uncontrollably energetic and friendly and was always loyal to Jinta recognizing him as the leader of the group. These  traits have not changed. Presently, Jinta reunited with him when he was searching for Menma. He visited their old clubhouse and found that Poppo was living there. Poppo explains that he works part-time jobs to earn money. When he makes enough, he goes on trips around the world. Because of this, Poppo has not attended school in several years.  Poppo seems to have questionable interests: Jinta found several pornographic magazines upon entering the clubhouse. Poppo also seems to have an obsession for foreign girls, especially Vietnamese girls. Overall, he has a lewd personality.

appearsIn.title: Anohana: The Flower We Saw That Day

name: Haruna
description: A friend and classmate of Naruko.

appearsIn.title: Anohana: The Flower We Saw That Day

name: Aki
description: One of the two friends that Naruko hangs out with at school.

appearsIn.title: Anohana: The Flower We Saw That Day

name: Irene Honma
description: Meiko Honma's mother.   In the story, she has hatred towards Yadomi group, the "Super Peace Busters".

appearsIn.title: Anohana: The Flower We Saw That Day

name: Black☆Star
description: A shadow weapon meister and the last survivor of the infamous Star Clan, taken into the DWMA and raised by [Sid Barrett](https://anilist.co/character/16582/Sid-Barrett). His weapon partner is [Tsubaki Nakatsukasa](https://anilist.co/character/8443/Tsubaki-Nakatsukasa). He is known as one of the toughest students in the academy, being quite self-centered with a desire to always be in the spotlight.

name: Death the Kid
description: The son of [Death](https://anilist.co/character/8457/Shinigami) himself and the Meister of the Demon Twin Guns, [Liz Thompson](https://anilist.co/character/8445/Elizabeth-Thompson) and [Patty Thompson](https://anilist.co/character/8444/Patricia-Thompson). Created from a piece of Death's soul, Death the Kid is known to be one of the top 3 students in the DWMA, albeit with a confounding obsession when it comes to symmetry.

name: Maka Albarn
description:
[Soul](https://anilist.co/character/8456/Soul-Eater-Evans)'s partner and the female protagonist of the series.

Known to be cheerful, direct, confident, smart and hardworking, in stark contrast to Soul who is much more laid-back in comparison. Despite this, Maka has been noted by her partner to be stubborn and sometimes prone to making decisions without regarding others' feelings if she feels justified enough. Due to their differences, Maka often bickers with him and they tend to argue with one another, but despite all this they remain loyal partners and close friends.

name: Soul Eater Evans
native: ソウル・イーター・エヴァンス
description: [Maka](https://anilist.co/character/8439/Maka-Albarn)'s partner and the male protagonist of the series. Soul is a demon weapon who was born into a family of famous musicians. After discovering his weapon abilities as a Demon Weapon Soul joined the DWMA, where he partnered up with Maka. They often bicker and don't always see eye-to-eye, but in the end they remain partners and close friends.

name: Tsubaki Nakatsukasa
description:
A demon weapon partnered with [Black Star](https://anilist.co/character/8464/BlackStar) hailing from the Nakatsukasa Clan, a special weapons clan who are direct descendants of demon weapons created by the mother of magic weapons, Arachne Gorgon. Having inherited the unique Multi-Form Ability of her clan, she joined the DWMA to stop her brother from becoming a kishin, becoming fast friends with [Black Star](https://anilist.co/character/8464/BlackStar) in the process.

Tsubaki is known to be very patient and forgiving, with a polite and gentle personality that often leads to her helping or comforting her friends when they are in need.

name: Elizabeth Thompson
native: エリザベス・トンプソン
description: A demon weapon and the older sister of [Patricia Thompson](https://anilist.co/character/8444/Patricia-Thompson). Formerly a thuggish ruffian alongside her sister raised in the streets of New York, both her own and sister's life turn for the better when they encountered their future meister, Death the Kid. Eventually becoming Kid's weapon partner alongside her sister, she became a student of Death Weapon Meister Academy enrolled in the E.A.T Class.

name: Patricia Thompson
native: パトリシア・トンプソン
description:
A Demon Weapon and the younger sister of [Elizabeth Thompson](https://anilist.co/character/8445/Elizabeth-Thompson).

Known as one of the "Demon Twin Guns", both her and her sister were known as the "Brooklyn Devils" and were petty thugs until being found by their current Meister, [Death the Kid](https://anilist.co/character/8455). Overtime, she reformed from her thieving and ruffian ways along with Liz and became Kid's weapon, later becoming DWMA students within the E.A.T Class.

name: Kilik Rung
description: A popular EAT-Class Meister partnered with twin weapons, Fire and Thunder. He is considered one of the top three student fighters in the DWMA, and is good friends with [Ox](https://anilist.co/character/14062/Ox-Ford) and [Kim](https://anilist.co/character/14063/Kim-Diehl). Rather hot blooded and direct, with a fiery soul and enough compassion to put his own life on the line for his friends.

name: Excalibur
description: The legendary sword used by heroes and kings. It has a great power that is unmatched by any other weapon. It turns out that anyone can use Excalibur. However, no one can put up with its personality (it has a bigger ego than Black Star). The only reason that those who use it are called heroes is that they can put up with its annoying habits, such as a list of one-thousand things he demands to be completed, such as daily five-hour reading sessions. Excalibur was first introduced when Kid and Black Star found a book about him and thus sought him out, only to discover that the book had in fact been written by Excalibur himself. They quickly ditched him due to his personality. His other form is completely the opposite given his elegant weapon form, looking like a cartoon-ish gentlemen with an outrageous mustache and no pants. On the other hand, his legendary powers have been proven by a fellow Shibusen student who found completing the appointed tasks easy. Excalibur can grant great power, light speed and teleportation, and the wielder can easily defeat three of Shibusen's strongest combined. In the end, Excalibur was put back again because the student could not put up with his annoying sneeze. His existence throughout the story is purely comical, with the exception of the fact of how he informed Kid, the Thompsons, Buttataki, and Blair about the story of Eibon, backed by Shinigami.   (From Wikipedia)

name: Justin Law
description: The Death Scythe in charge of Europe. Dressed in a priestly garb and earphones, Justin is devout in his services to the Shinigami. Justin is the youngest in the DWMA's history to become a Death Scythe at the age of thirteen, all without the aid of a partner. His weapon form, the guillotine, fits his title of "executioner". Justin has the ability to read lips but due to his constant use of earphones and the fact that the Shinigami wears a mask, he cannot understand the Shinigami. He tends to pray and give thanks to God for everything, and also tends to speak loudly due to his constant use of headphones. He travels by means of a dune buggy with a coffin on wheels connected to it. In the manga, he is colored with blonde hair and his hairstyle is a tonsure cut, usually worn by monks from European temples.

name: David Martinez
native: デイビッド・マルティネズ
description:
David is a street kid from Arroyo, Santo Domingo in Night City, who is enrolled into Arasaka's educational system at Arasaka Academy. He lives with his mother Gloria in an apartment of Megabuilding H4.

After experiencing a personal tragedy, David has the powerful Sandevistan speedware installed in his body and becomes one of Night City's edgerunners. He also becomes acquainted with [Lucy](https://anilist.co/character/284157/Lucy), who leads him into the city's criminal underworld, and chooses to join the gang of edgerunners she is a part of, led by [Maine](https://anilist.co/character/284159/Maine).

name: Lucy
description:
Lucy is a mysterious netrunner from Night City. She is quite introverted and doesn't like to talk much about her past. Although she looks innocent, she won't hesitate to kill a person in a heartbeat if they tick her off. Lucy also considers Night City a prison and dreams of one day leaving it for the moon.

Lucy is a part of [Maine](https://anilist.co/character/284159)'s crew of edgerunners. One of its members, a netrunner named [Kiwi](https://anilist.co/character/284161), is her mentor. She also becomes acquainted with [David](https://anilist.co/character/284158) and takes him on a tour through Night City's criminal underworld, leading the two of them to become partners in Maine's crew.

name: Maine
description: Maine used to be a military soldier before he became a mercenary. Now a veteran edgerunner in Night City, Maine dreams of "making it big", although he values his friendships with his crew more than his own glory.

name: Dorio
description: Dorio is a veteran edgerunner and Maine's right-hand. She's jacked and strong, but despite her tough exterior, Dorio has a soft side that she only shows to the people she trusts.

name: Kiwi
description: A member of Maine's crew of mercenaries, Kiwi is an enigmatic and snarky netrunner with a detachable cybernetic jaw. She also acts as a mentor to Lucy.

name: Pilar
description: Pilar is an edgerunner of Night City, known to be a comical and crude techie who loves to show off. He and his sister, [Rebecca](https://anilist.co/character/284163/Rebecca), often team up with [Maine](https://anilist.co/character/284159/Maine) and his crew to conduct mercenary jobs.

name: Rebecca
description: Rebecca is an edgerunner of Night City, and is described as a short, spunky, trigger-happy solo who is always fighting with her brother [Pilar](https://anilist.co/character/284162/Pilar). The two siblings often team up with [Maine](https://anilist.co/character/284159/Maine) and his crew to conduct mercenary jobs.

name: Faraday
description: Faraday is a ruthless fixer with ties to Militech and a distinctive optic cyberware that gives him four eyes. He is based in Santo Domingo and often employs Maine to conduct jobs.

name: Gloria Martinez
native: グロリア・マルティネズ
description: Both Gloria and her son David live in an apartment of Megabuilding H4 in Santo Domingo, Night City. She is an emergency medical technician (EMT).

name: Ken Takakura
description: He is a young male student with a firm belief that UFOs and aliens exist. Upon meeting [Momo Ayase](https://anilist.co/character/222594/Ayase-Momo) and taking up on her challenge to see if ghosts were real, Okarun became cursed by a yokai known as the [Turbo-Granny](https://anilist.co/character/239956/Turbo-Babaa) and seeks to return to normal.

name: Momo Ayase
description: After making friends with [Ken Takakura](https://anilist.co/character/222593), who she calls "Okarun" (due to refusing to call him by the same name as the actor she idolizes), Momo wishes to help restore his body back to normal after being cursed by a yokai and must overcome other paranormal activities that are involved.

name: Aira Shiratori
description:
__Relatives:__ [Father](https://anilist.co/character/349655/Aira-no-Chichi)

After becoming aware of the existence of the supernatural after collecting a mysterious golden ball, Aira proclaims herself as the "chosen one" that is on a mission to protect the world from evil and directs her attention towards [Momo Ayase](https://anilist.co/character/222594/Momo-Ayase), believing that she is a demon that has to be stopped after seeing her use her psychic powers. Aira revels in her social status as the popular girl at Kami High and strives to maintain her reputation. Outwardly, she appears sweet, innocent, and somewhat air headed. However, internally, she is far more vain and prideful, a side she only shows to people she becomes close with. Whilst antagonistic towards Momo, she harbors feelings towards her close friend [Okarun](https://anilist.co/character/222593/Ken-Takakura).

name: Jin Enjouji
description:
Jin Enjouji is [Momo Ayase](https://anilist.co/character/222594/Momo-Ayase)'s childhood friend and first crush. After his parents were hospitalized as a result of his house being haunted, Enjouji moved in with Momo and [Seiko](https://anilist.co/character/234824/Seiko-Ayase) and transferred over to Momo's school. 

Jiji comes off as being a very hyper-active young man who likes to express himself with dramatic mannerisms and expressions. He also has a habit of usually ending his sentences with strange verbal tics and is known to be very athletic and enjoy sports, primarily soccer. Past his initial over-the-top presentation, Jiji is a good-natured guy who deeply values his friendships and is committed to protecting those close to him, striving to improve himself and act as a reliable ally in moments of danger. Despite his immaturity, Jiji demonstrates a strong sense of accountability and empathy.

name: Seiko Ayase
description: [Momo Ayase](https://anilist.co/character/222594/Ayase-Momo)'s grandmother. Despite being a grandmother, Seiko possesses a youthful appearance that does not match her age and is recognized as being quite beautiful.

name: Turbo Babaa
description: The yokai took on the form of a very elderly woman with long white shaggy hair and eyes that were stuck looking to the sides. When possessing her targets, she has her victims transform into a mirror image of herself, albeit with a large mouth with teeth that is capable of biting off body parts.

name: Acrobatic Sarasara
native: アクロバティックさらさら
description: Acrobatic Silky took on the form of a tall woman with long silky black hair. She had a narrow face with hollowed eyes, wrinkles on the upper half of her face, and a permanent lipstick smile that exposes her teeth. She walked around barefooted while wearing a red wide brimmed hat and a red dress.

name: Serpo Seijin
description: Serupo Seijin are an entirely male alien race who come from Planet Serpo.

name: Penny Chinkosu
aliases: Dover Demon (ドーバーデーモン)
description: Peeny-Weeny, also known as the Dover Demon, is a Dover Demon's Race, he works for the Serpo in order to earn money for [his son's](https://anilist.co/character/270706/) blood transfusion.

name: Flatwoods Monster
native: フラットウッズ・モンスター
description: Furattouzzu Monsutaa was an alien that was first sighted in the American town of Flatwoods.

name: Mei Misaki
description:
**Occupation**: Middle School Student
**Grade**: 3rd year
**Height**: 152 cm (5'0'')

A mysterious, cute and isolated girl in Yomiyama North Middle School's third year's third class. Her left eye is covered by an eye patch. The girl with a mysterious presence and is always sketching alone. She is labelled as the one that "does not exist".

name: Kouichi Sakakibara
description:
__Occupation__: Middle School Student
__Grade__: 3rd year, 3rd class
__Height__: 167 cm (5'6")

The new transfer student into Yomiyama North Middle School's third year's third class (in May, 1998). He is 15 years old and the only son in the Sakakibara family. His mother supposedly passed away 15 years ago after giving birth to him. He becomes very interested and curious about Mei Misaki and attempts to pursue a friendship with her, but little does he know of the trouble this is going to cause...

name: Yukari Sakuragi
description: Yukari Sakuragi is one the class officers, the other being Kazami, of Yomiyama North Middle School's 9th grade class.

name: Kubodera-sensei
description: 3-3 homeroom teacher.

name: Ryouhei Mikami
description: Kouichi's maternal grandfather.

name: Shouko Arita
description:
Occupation: Middle School Student 
Grade: 3rd year, 3rd class Attendance Number: 3. Height: 160 cm.  

A girl with a bob cut, turned down eyes and a baby face, which makes her look a bit younger. She is quite lucky and has many friends.

name: Tomoko Inose
description: She is Yuuya's older half-sister. A waitress at Inoya cafe, she attended Yomiyama North Middle School during 1983. Although aware of the rumors about class 3-3, she didn't believe them until her brother, fearing for her life, explained the situation to her. Katsumi Matsunaga is a regular at the cafe where she works.

name: Tatsuji Chibiki
description: Librarian in charge of the No. 2 library room.

name: Ikuo Takabayashi
description: A student from Class 3-3.

name: Sanae Mizuno
description: Sanae Mizuno is a nurse at Yomiyama Hospital. She is first seen at Kouichi's ward. She has a brother named Mizuno Takeru who went to the class 3-3 at Yomiyama North Middle School.

name: Hachiman Hikigaya
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm (5'9")

Hachiman is an isolated, friendless boy who is pragmatic to a fault. His most prominent feature is his set of "dead fish-eyes." He firmly believes that "youth" is simply an illusion created by hypocrites, for hypocrites, born from the ashes of past failures. In this state of apparent corruption, he is coerced into joining the Service Club by his futures advisor in the hopes that exposing him to the world will change his personality, and ultimately make him a "better person." He is called "Hikki" affectionately by [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/67069).

appearsIn.title: My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU TOO!
My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU Climax!
My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU OVA
My Youth Romantic Comedy Is Wrong, As I Expected

name: Yui Yuigahama
description: Yui is a cheerful, outgoing girl who becomes the Service Club's first "customer", asking them to help her bake cookies for "a certain someone". Her problems lie not with her personality, but with her inability to deal with issues by herself. She believes that talent is inborn, and often aspired to be like others until [Yukino](https://anilist.co/character/67067) changed her way of thinking. Following her experience with the Service Club, Yui begins to attend Service Club sessions after school as well, despite Yukino's objections early on.

appearsIn.title: My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU TOO!
My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU Climax!
My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU OVA
My Youth Romantic Comedy Is Wrong, As I Expected

name: Yukino Yukinoshita
description: Yukino is the leader of the Service Club, of which she is the sole member until [Hachiman](https://anilist.co/character/67065) joins her. She is smart, beautiful, and is nicknamed the "Ice-cold Beauty" for her icy demeanor. She has a twisted sense of "noblesse oblige", and believes that it is the duty of the exceptional (in other words, herself) to help the "lost lambs" of the world. Her personality often leads her to be disgusted at the naivete of others, particularly [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/67069)'s, and she does not hesitate to show it. Despite this, Yui still affectionally calls her "Yukinon." She is a student of Class 2J (The academic standards of Class J are 2 to 3 points higher than the regular classes on the bell curve.)

appearsIn.title: My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU TOO!
My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU Climax!
My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU OVA
My Youth Romantic Comedy Is Wrong, As I Expected

name: Hina Ebina
description: Hina is a classmate of [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/67069) and [Hachiman](https://anilist.co/character/67065), who is a quiet girl and hangs around [Yumiko](https://anilist.co/character/79593/). She is a fujoshi, which is why other boys from her class are always avoiding her.

appearsIn.title: My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU Climax!
My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU OVA
My Youth Romantic Comedy Is Wrong, As I Expected

name: Haruno Yukinoshita
description: [Yukino](https://anilist.co/character/67067)'s elder sister who is even more outstanding than Yukino. However, unlike Yukino, she shows a good attitude towards other people, even if she has to lie about her true feelings most of the time. As the eldest sister she has to maintain a cheerful facade when representing the family for either their father's political events or mother's business meetings.

appearsIn.title: My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU Climax!

name: Atsugi
description: Atsugi is a physical education teacher in Sōbu High School.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Saki Kawasaki
description: [Hachiman Hikigaya](https://anilist.co/character/67065/Hikigaya-Hachiman)'s classmate who seems like a delinquent, but wants to make friends. She cares deeply for her brother as she hid her name and age to work in night-shift part-time jobs in order to pay school fees and reduce her family's load. After her brother asked help from the service club, the service club eventually followed her to her workplace and found out her motives behind working night-shifts, she stopped working after the service club suggested her to aim for a scholarship instead.

appearsIn.title: My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU Climax!
My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU OVA

name: Rumi Tsurumi
description: Rumi is a lonely primary school student who is openly despised by her peers. Hayato at first tried to resolve the situation through talking to her in front of her classmates, which instead attracted more hateful attention to her. After much discussion, Hachiman and company decided that the only way out is to destroy the trust between her peers, through having Hayato and Kakeru acting as bullies threatening Rumi's group-mates during treasure hunt and exposing their selfish nature to each other, thus preventing further organized acts of teasing on Rumi. However, in exchange, she would hardly have any friends after this.  (Source:Wikipedia)

name: Shizuka Hiratsuka
description: Shizuka is [Hachiman](https://anilist.co/character/67065)'s teacher, a language teacher who serves as his futures advisor/counselor. She is aware of Hachiman's supposed "problems", and takes steps to ensure he is freed from them, her first move being to force him into joining the Service Club. However, she appears to have some quirks of her own: she is a young smoker, she is very sensitive about her age, and she is often prone to quoting or copying scenes from popular shounen manga. She also never remembers to knock before entering the Service Club's classroom, much to [Yukino](https://anilist.co/character/67067)'s chagrin.

appearsIn.title: My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU OVA

name: Taishi Kawasaki
description: Saki's younger brother who requested the group's help as to find out about his sister's nightly activities. Which he later found out that her sister is working as a bar tender under a false name and age to support his cram school tuition.  (Source: ANN)

name: Natsu Dragneel
description:
A mage from the Fairy Tail Guild who wields fire dragon slayer magic.

Natsu has a carefree and reckless nature and, despite his constant brawls with the other members of the guild, is a fiercely loyal and protective friend. He has a particularly close and competitive relationship with [Gray Fullbuster](https://anilist.co/character/4839/Fullbuster-Gray) and [Erza Scarlet](https://anilist.co/character/5189/Scarlet-Erza). With the former, he has had a constant rivalry from a young age and although they often denounce each other as not being friends, they regularly watch each others' back even when they are enraged with one another. He has had the same sort of relationship with Erza - the two both being scared of her since a young age - and they seemed to have a fairly good relationship in the past as, according to Erza, they used to shower together. He befriends people rather quickly too, considering [Lucy](https://anilist.co/character/5186/Heartfilia-Lucy) a friend and willing to team up with her only after a few days of knowing her.

[Igneel](https://anilist.co/character/40157/Igneel), a dragon, found him in the forest and ended up taking care of him. He taught Natsu how to speak, read, and use magic. But one day Igneel disappeared without a trace. Because of this, Natsu's goal in life is to find him.

name: Lucy Heartfilia
native: ルーシィ・ハートフィリア
description:
A mage from the Fairy Tail guild who wields Celestial Spirit magic.

Lucy is cheerful, clever, and often gets swept along by her disruptive guildmates when they go overboard. Empathetic, caring, and more likely to write novels than wage battles, Lucy becomes most emboldened to challenge enemies when she needs to fight for her friends. She is said to be a noisy and somewhat fussy person, and there are times when she can be naive and too easily forgiving, greedy for validation as well as overly confident at inopportune moments. However, despite any failings and instances of self-doubt, she doesn't allow herself to feel down for too long - her optimism is boundless.

In July of Earth Land year X784, Lucy is a normal 17-year-old Fioran who wishes to join the infamous mage guild, Fairy Tail - although they have a reputation for being thoroughly destructive, she admires their strength and numbers. After a fateful meeting with two members of the guild in the town of Hargeon, [Natsu Dragneel](https://anilist.co/character/5187/Dragneel-Natsu) and his flying blue cat, [Happy](https://anilist.co/character/5188/Happy), she travels with them back to Fairy Tail, located in Magnolia, to begin the adventure of a lifetime.

name: Happy
description: Happy is a cat with some magical power, which may be the reason for his ability to speak. He can temporarily grow wings on his back and fly, and is capable of carrying only one person in this form. Happy apparently can fly at incredible speed (As it took Eligor less than a hour to reach Clover when Happy caught up with him in mere seconds with Natsu in tow) This is also the only kind of transportation that does not make Natsu sick. When asked why, Natsu got angry and exclaimed that Happy was a friend, not a means of transportation, ironically Natsu later gets sick when Gray gives him a piggyback ride when he's injured. He's very close to Natsu and becomes friends with Lucy quickly. The three form a team at the start of the manga. Happy is a full-fledged member of Fairy Tail, and has a member stamp on his back. It's also unknown if Happy even though being a mage and a member of Fairy Tail, can use his magic offensively or not.  Happy has a very cheerful nature. Even when facing danger, he maintains a smile. Along with Lucy, he is one of the saner members of Fairy Tail and often acts as the mediator between Natsu and Gray.  Happy's original name was going to be named Freyr, after a Norse god. But Hiro Mashima felt it didn't fit him, so he change the name to Happy to fit the character.

name: Gray Fullbuster
native: グレイ・フルバスター
description:
__Occupation:__ Mage 
__Affiliation:__ Fairy Tail Guild 
__Team:__ Team Natsu 
__Magic:__ Ice-Make, Ice Magic, 

Gray Fullbuster is a member of the Fairy Tail guild. He is an 18 year-old ice mage, practicing ice alchemy, the art of molding ice. Due to his training history, he is most comfortable in little clothing and often forgets to wear clothes or quickly takes it off, thus often being accused of being an exhibitionist. He and [Natsu](https://anilist.co/character/5187) have a friendly rivalry, and can often be seen fighting one another. [Lucy](https://anilist.co/character/5186) believes the nature of his magic is the reason that he and Natsu constantly bicker. His member stamp is on the right side of his chest.   

  

In certain panels, Gray's necklaces looks quite similar to the Rave Stone which is a crucial part of another one of [Mashima](https://anilist.co/staff/96882)'s stories, "Rave Master." Mashima has stated he doesn't remember the name. He takes off his clothes because [Ul](https://anilist.co/character/8293) made him do it as one of her teachings and now it's a force of habit.

name: Erza Scarlet
native: エルザ・スカーレツト
description:
An S-class mage from the Fairy Tail Guild who uses requip magic, which allows her to summon weapons and equip armor stored in another dimension. She is the strongest active female member.

Erza is a very strict, intimidating, and impatient person with a strong sense of justice. She has been a member of Fairy Tail since she was a kid, and shows great loyalty and dedication to [Makarov](https://anilist.co/character/5333) and the guild.

name: Charlés
description:
Charlés is an Exceed with the same type of magic as Happy.  Wendy found her as an egg and they have been together ever since. They are very close, and Charlés sees it as her duty to protect Wendy from danger.

Charlés is strict and uptight. She disapproves of fooling around.

name: Wendy Marvell
description: Wendy is the sky dragon slayer. She has the ability to heal and manipulate air.

name: Mirajane Strauss
native: ミラジェーン・ストラウス
description:
__Title:__ The Demon
__Occupation:__ Mage
__Known relatives:__ [Elfman Strauss](https://anilist.co/character/5334); [Lisanna Strauss](https://anilist.co/character/30225).

She is a former S-class mage and the older sister of Elfman. When Mirajane was an S-class mage, she was known as "The Demon." However, due to a past incident involving the death of her younger sister, Lisanna, Mirajane somehow lost much of her magical ability and her will to fight. Given the recent event of Elfman regaining his lost abilities and Mirajane's increased confidence, Mirajane may someday regain her abilities and move forward with her life.

Mirajane plays a motherly role within the guild, and is often seen running the bar at the guild hall. She has rarely been shown to be in a bad mood, and can tolerate all of the guild's eccentricities. However, there have been a couple events that have disturbed Mirajane, including her discovery of the stealing of an S-Class job by [Natsu](https://anilist.co/character/5187), [Happy](https://anilist.co/character/5188) and [Lucy](https://anilist.co/character/5186), and her later disappointment with [Laxus](https://anilist.co/character/8294) following the destruction of the guild building.

name: Juvia Lockser
description: Juvia made up 1/4th of the Phantom Lord's elite group, Element 4. She was sent by the guild master [Jose](https://anilist.co/character/23844), along with [Sol](https://anilist.co/character/9717), to go and capture [Lucy](https://anilist.co/character/5186) and bring her back to him safely. Her magic seems to deal with water as she is able to control rain and other large bodies of water. In addition, her body seems to be formed from the rain that surrounds her, leaving her intact and able to reform herself after attacks. Her nickname is also Juvia of the Sea, which correlates with her water controlling magic. When angry she can also control hot water. Juvia also often refers to herself in the 3rd person. Juvia has developed a crush on [Gray](https://anilist.co/character/4839), and due to a misunderstanding, views Lucy as her rival in love. After being defeated by Gray, the rain above her finally clears up which she thought was beautiful. After the fight, her deep infatuation with Gray continues, secretly following him wherever he goes. In the Tower of Heaven arc, she mentions to Gray that she is now an independent mage once more, but Gray notes that she has probably has her eyes set on Fairy Tail. She is quite willing to do anything for him.  She is the only member of the Element 4 to be shown after the Phantom Guild arc. The Spanish word "lluvia", which is pronounced like her name, means rain.

name: Gajeel Redfox
native: ガジル レッドフォックス
description: Gajeel is an Iron Dragon Slayer. He's short-tempered, tenacious, and fiercely loyal and dedicated to his guild. Despite saying that he doesn't want to make friends, he tries in his own way to do so. Behind Gajeel's tough exterior is an emotional guy with a sense of humor and a love for music.

name: Simon
description:
**Height:** 156 cm (5`1")

Simon is the protagonist of the story, a short and un-intimidating fourteen year old boy at the beginning of this tale. He was born in Jiiha Village and was raised by his parents until the age of seven, when his parents were killed in an underground avalanche caused by an earthquake.

name: Youko Littner
description:
**Height:** 160 cm    


Yoko is a girl from Jeeha's neighboring village Littner, who had been chasing the Gunmen which entered Jeeha village. She wields an extensive range of firearms which include a long range sniper rifle (which she uses most frequently) modeled after the Barrett M82 and hand guns (which can be assumed is used for midrange or close combat) and has previous experience fighting Gunmen. Although she is of the same age group as [Simon](https://anilist.co/character/2257), she is mature and one of the most rational of the group.

name: Kamina
description:
__Height:__ 184 cm

Kamina is a young man from Jiiha village who dreams of leaving the village and going to the surface, which he saw as a kid. He's very passionate about his goals, expressing his wishes through energetic speeches, which seems to affect all those who hear him. He convinces [Simon](https://anilist.co/character/2257) to help him with his plan to drill through the roof of the village and get to the world above, but the plan failed and he was put in prison. He left the village shortly thereafter with the help of Simon and a young girl named [Yoko](https://anilist.co/character/2063), as a result of fighting a Gunmen, who broke into the village from the surface.  After he, Simon, and Yoko breakthrough, they meet many enemies and friends as they go, to the point of building up a resistance force, the Gurren Brigade to fight in their war against the Beastmen Empire who hunt on human beings who live on the surface​ and becoming their leader.

name: Nia Teppelin
description:
**Age:** 14-21
**Height:** 158-162 cm

Nia Teppelin is a mysterious young girl found sleeping in a capsule in the middle of a dump site by [Simon](https://anilist.co/character/2257). She had no prior contact with humans, except her father, who is also the sovereign of the Beastmen, the [Spiral King](https://anilist.co/character/5118). She is very curious, pure and innocent, due to growing up sheltered in a peaceful environment, away from all the battles occurring in the outside world. Despite early misgivings, she is quickly accepted by Team Dai-Gurren, much to the (initial) irking of [Yoko](https://anilist.co/character/2063).

name: Leeron Littner
native: リーロン・リットナー
description: Leeron, or "Ron," is the flamboyant village mechanic of Littner Village. After taking an interest in Simon's mech they join Simon, Kamina and Yoko in their quest to defeat the Beastmen.

name: Rossiu Adai
description: A boy from Adai village, an underground village where the people worship Gunmen as Gods. When [Gimmy](https://anilist.co/character/3432/Adai-Gimmy) and [Darry](https://anilist.co/character/3433/Adai-Darry) are chosen to leave the village, Rossiu decides to go with them and they join the Gurren-dan.

name: Viral
description:
__Species:__ Shark/Cat Beastmen 
__Occupation:__ Vice Commander/Warrior/Team Dai-Gurren Member 
__Relationships:__ [Kamina](https://anilist.co/character/2075/Kamina) (rival), [Simon](https://anilist.co/character/2257/Simon) (rival/ally), [Thymilph](https://anilist.co/character/13598/Thymilph) (superior officer), [Adiane](https://anilist.co/character/3404/Adiane) (superior officer), [Cytomander](https://anilist.co/character/3430/Cytomander) (superior officer), [Lord Genome](https://anilist.co/character/5118/Lordgenome) (king)
 __Gunmen:__ Enki, Enkidu, Dai-Gunkai (temporarily), Enkidudu, Gurren, Tengen Toppa Gurren-Lagann, Enkidududu (drama cd), Enkidudududu (drama cd), Dai-Gunzankai (drama cd), Tengen Toppa Enki Dulga (Lagann-hen) 

Viral is a recurring enemy and later an important ally to Team Dai-Gurren. He is a shark-type Beastman with feline genetics. He is skilled in piloting Gunmen, as well as in unarmed combat.

name: Adiane
description: Adiane the Elegant is the second of the Spiral King's Four Supreme Generals, and the only female general among their number. She is good friends with her fellow General, Thymilph, though Guame jokes that they had a closer relationship. She implies this friendship was strong because both Guame and General Cytomander treat her as an inferior because of her gender, while Thymilph respected her as a warrior.     After Thymilph's death, Adiane is stunned and vows revenge, volunteering to attack the Team Dai-Gurren when given the opportunity by Lordgenome. Though she refused his aid as she blamed him for Thymilph's death, Adiane recruits Viral after he saved her from being crushed by the Dai-Gurren after an attempt to execute Nia once she learns Lordgenome abandoned her. But because of her boasting and staking of her pride on the task, Adiane refuses to return to Teppelin until she destroys Team Dai-Gurren, using the sea to her advantage when the Dai-Gurren crosses it on its way to Teppelin.    Having Viral pilot her Dai-Gunkai to drag the Dai-Gurren into the cold depths, Adiane engages in personal combat with the Gurren-Lagann in her Sayrune to ensure no interference. But the plan fails and Adiane attempts to take Nia hostage until Yoko disables the Sayrune's shoulder, leaving it opened to close-range fire from the Dai-Gurren's artillery cannons and killing Adiane instantly in the explosion.

name: Cytomander
description: Cytomander the Swift is one of the Spiral King's Four Divine Generals and the commander of Teppelin's aerial forces and owner of the flying battleship, the Dai-Gunten. As General Adiane only gets along with General Thymilph, it seems that Cytomander only gets along with General Guame, just like cytosine and guanine only bond with each other in the double helix of DNA. Cytomander attacked the Great Gurren Brigade twice, losing his life the second time, when the Dai-Gunten exploded.    Cytomander's name is based on the DNA chemical cytosine and the elemental Salamander. His Gunmen, Shuzack, is based on the mythical Vermilion Bird, Suzaku

name: Guame
description: Guame the Steady (グァーム, Gwāmu?) is one of the Spiral King's Four Divine Generals, who specialises in ground combat. His appearance is like that of a crocodile and armadillo and he looks the oldest of the four generals. In episode nine, he, along with the two other generals, reported the death of Divine General Thymilph to the Spiral King. He gives off the impression of one with a perverted mind and showed why when he made snide comments about the relationship between Thymilph and General Adiane. Guame appears to merely respect the Spiral King, unlike the other Beastmen, who worship him as a god. Cytomander makes an interesting statement in episode nine, saying that it was only Guame that could oppose the king. Guame merely said that he and the King had known each other for a long time, which gives off the impression that he has lived as long as or almost as long as the Spiral King has (he later referred to General Cytomander as a "two-hundred-years-younger upstart", implying that he is 200 years older than Cytomander). It was Guame who later made it known why Nia was abandoned and that she was not the first princess to be abandoned.  Guame reappears, along with his flagship, the Dai-Gundo.

name: Echidna
description: Echidna is one of the Witches of Sin, being the Witch of Greed. She has a strong thirst for knowledge along with a curiosity for the unknown, which defines her behavior. Echidna is described as black hearted, being unable to empathize with others and their feelings due to a lack of understanding. She will do anything to gain knowledge, be it deceit or employed sophistry.

appearsIn.title: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 2
Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 2 Part 2

name: Carmilla
description: Carmilla is one of the Witches of Sin, being the Witch of Lust. She has no self confidence, being timid, and tends to have downcast eyes. Despite this, others find her similar to a scared animal, making them attracted to her.

appearsIn.title: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 2

name: Garfiel Tinsel
native: ガーフィール・ティンゼル
description: Garfiel Tinsel is the former guardian of the Sanctuary and a member of the Emilia Camp. Introduced during Arc 4, he became one of the main supporting characters of the season. He's a half-beast human and [Frederica Baumann's](https://anilist.co/character/143378/Baumann-Frederica) half-brother. He can transform himself in a giant golden tiger that can deal powerful attacks but with a cost of losing his reason, so he uses this ability when he's pushed to the limit.

appearsIn.title: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 2
Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 2 Part 2

name: Otto Suwen
native: オットー・スーウェン
description:
Otto Suwen is a merchant appearing in  Re:Zero. His remarkable misfortune always takes him to dangerous situations, from which he escapes thanks to his wit.
Otto has gray hair that is mentioned to be as long as a gal game protagonist. He is said to be somewhat handsome if he has a serious expression. However, he is usually either retorting, shouting, or panicking, ruining his looks. He has a medium build, but has trained himself since he used to work as a merchant.

Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 2 Part 2

name: Frederica Baumann
native: フレデリカ・バウマン
description: Frederica Baumann is a maid working for [Roswaal L. Mathers](https://anilist.co/character/90182/Mathers-Roswaal) and a member of the Emilia Camp. She quit her job as a maid a few months before [Subaru's](https://anilist.co/character/88573/Natsuki-Subaru) appearance, but returned after [Ram](https://anilist.co/character/88576/Ram) couldn't manage the mansion

description: [Subaru](https://anilist.co/character/88573/Natsuki-Subaru)'s mother.

appearsIn.title: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 2

description: Satella is one of the Witches of Sin, being the Witch of Envy.

native: エルザ・グランヒルテ
description: An assassin-for-hire from the Northernmost nation, the Holy Kingdom of Gusteko, known as "The Bowel Hunter". Elsa wishes to make a trade for an insignia, as her client's wishes.

description: Was a former Arch Wizard who later became a Lich to save his love.

description: Demon King's army ex-general.

KONOSUBA -God's blessing on this wonderful world!- Legend of Crimson

name: Hyakkimaru
description: Hyakkimaru is the central character of Tezuka's best-known samurai story, Dororo. A powerful warrior, Hyakkimaru is traveling on a long quest to retrieve 48 parts of his body which were sold to demons by his father at his birth. This is a very dramatic adventure series, with a great variety of unusual mythological creatures and demons, as well as bandits and other fierce foes. Gradually the grim experiences of his travels make Hyakkimaru more and more distant and grim, so as he recovers more and more of his human body he becomes at the same time less and less human.

name: Dororo
description: After seeing his swordsmanship, Dororo decides to follow Hyakkimaru. Dororo was a thief before meeting Hyakkimaru.

name: Itachi
description: A bandit who betrayed Dororo's father Hibukuro and sided with the authorities.

name: Oume
description: She is a kind woman who takes care of an orphan boy called Saru after she found him alone in the mountains.

name: Munetsuna
description: He is the father of Okowa and is known as the best swordmaker in the region. Although he makes a living by making swords, he has expressed discontent with the products he has made and wishes that he would make a sword for peace and not bloodshed. He fix up and sharpen Hyakkimaru's blades.

name: Mio
description: Mio is a young girl who lived in an abandoned temple with orphans who lost their parents in the war. She is kind and caring as she tends to put others in priority instead of herself.

name: Ojiya
description: She is a bandit along with her husband, Hibukuro. She is the mother of Dororo.

name: Sukeroku
description: He is the orphan that separates​ from his mother during the land split by the Banmon.

name: Okowa
description:
She is the daughter of Munetsuna. She is the second love interest of Hyakkimaru after Mio.
Okowa is a cheerful girl, but with childish attitude.

name: Haruki Shiga
description: A guy who incidentally found a book in the hospital titled "Disease Coexistence Journal" which is owned by his classmate [Sakura Yamauchi](https://anilist.co/character/127118/Yamauchi-Sakura).

appearsIn.title: I Want to Eat Your Pancreas
I Want to Eat Your Pancreas

name: Sakura Yamauchi
description:
A high school student who suffers a pancreatic disease, having her lifespan cut in half. She has a diary called "Living with Dying" where she writes about her daily experiences, since her illness was first diagnosed. 

Despite her situation, she keeps her smile and even makes jokes about it.

appearsIn.title: I Want to Eat Your Pancreas
I Want to Eat Your Pancreas

name: Issei Miyata
description: A classmate who started talking to Haruki, since meeting Haruki and Sakura. For some reason, he offers a piece of gum to Haruki whenever they talk.

appearsIn.title: I Want to Eat Your Pancreas
I Want to Eat Your Pancreas

name: Kyouko Takimoto
description: Sakura’s best friend since they were little. She is protective of Sakura and will not let anyone who may be harmful near her. Very assertive.

appearsIn.title: I Want to Eat Your Pancreas
I Want to Eat Your Pancreas

name: Haruki no Chichi
description: A humble and genuinely nice father, whose relationship with Haruki is neither good nor bad. Has a good relationship with his wife.

appearsIn.title: I Want to Eat Your Pancreas
I Want to Eat Your Pancreas

description: As his mother, she quietly and protectively watches over Haruki. Though she rarely intervenes, she has very good instincts.

description: Class representative who is in love with Sakura. He is very obstinate and gets jealous easily yet hides it to keep face with his classmates.

I Want to Eat Your Pancreas

name: Sakura no Haha
description: A very kind hearted woman, who strives to grant all of Sakura’s wishes since her daughter’s diagnosis.
