name: Mitsuri Kanroji
description:
__Height:__ 167 cm (5'5")
__Combat Style:__ Love Breathing

Demon Hunter and the Love Pillar of the Demon Killing Corps. Mitsuri is a soft and kind person. She is very emotional and passionate, constantly complimenting people in her head, which probably contributes to her nickname of "the Hashira of Love". Although she is rather shy and is easily flustered, she is always kind to others, most notably towards [Obanai](https://anilist.co/character/137777), whom she appears to share a strong bond with. Besides her rather emotional personality, she can also come off as somewhat childish at times.

appearsIn.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Swordsmith Village Arc

name: Genya Shinazugawa
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm (5'11")

Genya Is a Demon Hunter of the Demon Killing Corps. He is also the younger brother of the Wind Pillar [Sanemi Shinazugawa](https://anilist.co/character/137774).

appearsIn.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Swordsmith Village Arc

name: Sanemi Shinazugawa
description:
__Height:__ 179cm (5'10½")

Demon Hunter and the Wind Pillar of the Demon Killing Corps. He is the older brother of [Genya Shinazugawa](https://anilist.co/character/137776).

Sanemi specializes in Wind Breathing, which has 9 forms. The technique consists of drawing the air from around the user to create whirlwind attacks that follow the user's movements. Form names include Dust Whirlwind Cutter, Claws-Purifying Wind, Clean Storm Wind Tree, Rising Dust Storm, Cold Mountain Wind, Black Wind Mountain Mist, Gale - Sudden Gusts, Primary Gale Slash, and Idaten Typhoon.

appearsIn.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Swordsmith Village Arc
Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Hashira Training Arc

name: Obanai Iguro
description:
__Height:__ 162 cm (5'3")

Obanai is a Demon Slayer and the Snake Pillar of the Demon Slayer Corps.

A young man of short stature and a pale complexion. He has straight-edged black hair of varying lengths, the longest reaching down to his shoulders and the shortest stopping at his cheekbones, which he wears down with two shorter strands hanging between his eyes. He wears a navy blue version of the standard Demon Slayer uniform, along with a black and white pinstriped haori, the hem and cuffs of which are striped lengthways rather than vertically, which covers his hands. Obanai also sports bandages in place of the leg-wraps around his calves, as well as another set of bandages that cover his mouth, and blue-strapped zori on his feet.

He is also always seen with his white snake, Kaburamaru, wrapped around his shoulders.

appearsIn.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Swordsmith Village Arc
Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Hashira Training Arc

name: Gakushuu Asano
description: A student in class 3-A in Kunugigaoka Junior High School. He is the student council president and the son of the Board Chairman, Gakuhou Asano. He is a genius student who, like many main building students, look down upon class 3-E.

name: Lovro Brovski
description: Lovro is a hitman dealer who was once a talented assassin. He is the Japanese government's only link with the world of hitmen.

name: Howl
description: Wizard Howl is a mysterious, reclusive wizard. He is twenty-seven years old and known for being very flamboyant and wicked. His notorious moving castle has recently been spotted near Market Chipping and rumours have begun to spread that he is searching for beautiful young women whose hearts he may steal. He comes from Wales, a country unknown to most in the book, where his family still remain unaware of his activities in [Sophie](https://anilist.co/character/508)'s world or of its existence.    Despite his reputation, Howl is in reality an endearing, charming man who is intelligent and considerate, if somewhat self-appreciative and stubborn at times. He enjoys "slithering out" of uncomfortable situations, often in comical ways.    Howl is described as being tall and suave, fond of dyeing his hair and wearing impressive suits. However, he is described by Calcifer as "very vain for a plain man with mud-coloured hair" - Howl is not naturally handsome, but he has "charm", both literally and figuratively.

name: Sophie Hatter
description: She is a plain looking 18-year-old young adult, who passes all of her time working in a hat shop. She has big brown eyes and matching hair, tied with two pink ribbons, in a long braid. She has thick eyebrows, and Howl says that her smile is beautiful. She wears a cerulean dress with a white neck and black buttons. Sophie is a gentle, quiet young woman who doesn't like being in the spotlight. She is mature, and wears clothes meant for women older than her, despite her sister, Lettie's, protests. Sophie also initiates cleaning the massive castle. After getting cursed by the Witch of the Waste, she gains the appearance of a 90-year-old woman (with a similar appearance to Yubaba or Zeniba) with wrinkled skin and pain on her spine. According to her, she becomes more cunning as she has grown older. She still wears her dress, and now wears her straw hat adorned with a red ribbon. Due to her love for Howl, Sophie de-ages depending on her emotional state.

name: Kakashi no Kabu
description: Sophie rescues him from the wasteland, and now he follows her around.

name: Markl
description: Howl's apprentice. He is an orphan who lives in Howl's castle. His apprenticeship in magic largely consists of running errands and doing the shopping. In the book he is a fifteen year old boy named Michael Fisher, in love with Sophie's half-sister, Martha.

name: Suliman
description: Madame Suliman serves as the king's royal sorcerer and is Howl's former mentor in magic.

name: Calcifer
description: Calcifer is a fallen star who was caught by Howl. He didn't want to die, so he struck a deal with the wizard. Calcifer got Howl's heart and a prolonged life, and Howl received full access to all of Calcifer's considerable powers.  As it turns out, neither of them liked it after a while, but it couldn't be broken by people who were part of the contract. When Sophie Hatter comes to Howl's moving castle, Calcifer recognizes that she is under a curse thanks to the Witch of Waste and that Sophie has considerable powers of her own of which she is unaware. To break his own curse, Calcifer offers to lift the curse placed on Sophie once she manages to break Calcifer's contract with Howl.

name: Arechi no Majo
description: A terrifying witch who doggedly chases after Howl. She is a master of magic, and dispatches her magical creations, the spooky blob men.

name: Villetta Nu
description: An elite Knightmare Frame pilot and a Purist, who appears to be more collected than [Jeremiah](https://anilist.co/character/1113/Gottwald-Jeremiah) in battle. She was one of the first to have been under the power of Geass' influence and is one of the few still loyal to Jeremiah even after his fall in disgrace.

appearsIn.title: Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion R2

name: Tsutomu Goshiki
description:
__Height:__ 181 cm (5'11")
__Hometown:__ Miyagi Prefecture

Tsutomu Goshiki is a first year wing spiker in Shiratorizawa Academy. Goshiki appears to have been a capable volleyball player even before entering Shiratorizawa Academy. In one of his recollections, he is seen being praised by an elderly lady while showing off a volleyball related trophy. He is also frequently acknowledged for his height and reliability as an ace.

name: Taichi Kawanishi
description:
__Height:__ 188.3 cm (6' 2.1")
__Hometown:__ Miyagi Prefecture

__Introduction:__
Taichi Kawanishi is a second year middle blocker at Shiratorizawa Academy.

__Personality:__
He doesn't talk to his teammates very often, and appears mostly emotionless, only looking annoyed on occasion. He has been seen crying once. He doesn't seem to put much effort into his playing and sometimes accidentally lets a ball in; however, since he's a starting member in Shiratorizawa, his abilities shouldn't be too low. Tendō has noted that Kawanishi has an eclectic and more analytical blocking style, which the third year's a little annoyed by; Kawanishi would use guess blocking on occasions and switch back to read blocking when needed. He also won't fight any uncertain battles.

(Source: Haikyuu!! Fandom Wikia)

name: Ikkei Ukai
description: Ikkei is the former coach of Karasuno High's Boys' Volleyball Club. He once led the team to nationals and was well-known. After being hospitalized, he resigned from coaching the team.

name: Minaho Ono
description: Teacher at Karasuno High School. She is often seen teaching [Hinata](https://anilist.co/character/64769/Shouyou-Hinata)'s classes, overseeing tests, and working in the staff room. She supervises Hinata and [Kageyama](https://anilist.co/character/64771/Tobio-Kageyama) while they took their make-up exams and encourages them to do well afterward. When the Karasuno boys' team won an important match, she joined the students in opening the windows and cheering to welcome them back. She attends the Karasuno vs. Shiratorizawa match and tells the [Vice Principal](https://anilist.co/character/290203/Kyoutou) that their hastily-assembled cheering section had not been practiced enough.

name: Wakatoshi Ushijima
description:
__Height:__ 189.5 cm (6' 2.6")
__Team:__ Shiratorizawa Academy
__Number:__ 1
__Position:__ Wing Spiker

Wakatoshi Ushijima is a third year at Shiratorizawa Academy and the captain and ace of the school's boys' volleyball team. Currently, he is the number one ace in Miyagi Prefecture and one of the country's top three aces, along with [Sakusa](https://anilist.co/character/139475/Sakusa-Kiyoomi) and [Kiryuu](https://anilist.co/character/139506/Kiryuu-Wakatsu). Left handed. His favourite food is hayashi rice.

name: Saeko Tanaka
description:
Saeko Tanaka is a former student of Karasuno High and the older sister of Ryuunosuke Tanaka. She was also a classmate of the Small Giant during her high school years.

The second years of the volleyball team views her as a cool older sister, especially Nishinoya, but Tanaka thinks of her as a nuisance whenever she bothers his study sessions. Like her brother, she's loud and outspoken.

Her driving has been described by her brother as dangerous as he had once stated to Hinata and Kageyama that he can't guarantee their safety in her car.

name: Gabimaru
aliases: Garan no Gabimaru (がらんの画眉丸)
description:
__Race:__ Human
__Tao Attribute:__ Fire
__Occupation:__ Shinobi
__Affiliation:__ Iwagakure (Formerly)

Gabimaru is an elite shinobi assassin formerly from Iwagakure. He is the husband of [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/151771/Yui) and the son-in-law to the [chief of Iwagakure](https://anilist.co/character/301607/Osa).

Gabimaru is calm, level-headed and rarely shows any emotions. He is calm to the point where he is unfazed by any sort of crisis, such as being executed or when he is confronted and attacked by a strong enemy. As noted by [Sagiri](https://anilist.co/character/137263/Sagiri), once Gabimaru calms down he tends to complain. He prefers to stick with his main objective at hand and not get tangled with anything else that doesn't involve his goals. Although he is viewed as being obnoxious (mainly by Sagiri), he can also be respectful and polite at times.



He served as Iwagakure's most infamous shinobi until he was betrayed by his village for wanting to abandon his role as a murderer and live a peaceful life with his wife, resulting in him being handed over to the authorities to be executed. However, after the shogun calls for convict criminals to acquire the Elixir of Life from the dangerous island known as Kotaku, in exchange for a pardon for their past crimes, Gabimaru accepts the invitation to be a part of the competition mission in order to reunite with Yui and live the life he so desired.

name: Sagiri
aliases: Yamada Asaemon Sagiri (山田浅ェ門佐切)
description:
__Race:__ Human
__Tao Attribute:__ Wood
__Occupation:__ Asaemon
__Affiliation:__ Yamada Clan
__Rank:__ 12th
__Relative:__ [Kichiji](https://anilist.co/character/302527/Kichiji) (Father)

Yamada Asaemon Sagiri is the 12th rank Asaemon in the Yamada Clan. After the shogun sent criminals to Kotaku to find the Elixir of Life, she was tasked with being [Gabimaru](https://anilist.co/character/137260/Gabimaru)'s executioner.

Sagiri generally displays a calm demeanor when taking on her role as an executioner. However, after landing on Kotaku, she allowed herself to act casual around others as long as she continued to do her job. She is very polite and caring towards her fellow Asaemon members, despite the fact that she is aware that some view her as being unworthy of becoming a samurai. However, she is not afraid to speak her mind and to stand up for herself. Though she takes matters seriously, Sagiri does possess a sense of humor, often laughing at [Shion](https://anilist.co/character/137267/Shion)'s jokes. 



When she was young, Sagiri watched as her father skillfully decapitated a condemned performer with a single swing of his sword. From that day she became inspired to walk the path of an executioner and achieve the same level of skill as her father. As she began her training on how to wield a sword, Sagiri was looked down on by her fellow Yamada members, as well as her father, for being a female following the path of a samurai.

name: Touma
aliases: Yamada Asaemon Touma (山田浅ェ門桐馬)
description:
__Race:__ Human
__Tao Attribute:__ Earth
__Occupation:__ Asaemon (Unofficial)
__Affiliation:__ Yamada Clan

Toma is a relatively new member of the Yamada clan trying to rise in their ranks and is the assigned monitor of [Chobe Aza](https://anilist.co/character/137269/Chobe-Aza).



Toma believes that the key to surviving in life is adapting to ones environment. Toma tends to act rather unfriendly when someone tries to communicate with him on friendly terms. He also displays a cocky attitude.

name: Choubei Aza
description:
__Tao Attribute:__ Metal
__Occupation:__ Bandit
__Race:__ Human (Formerly), 

Aza Chobe also known as the Bandit King, is a well-known bandit leader in Iyo that is responsible for multiple crimes committed.

Chobe is an extremely barbaric individual who attacks anyone or anything that poses as a threat to him. He prefers to do things of his own accord and would rather resort to violence than talk things through. Chobe is also very sadistic whenever he engages in fights with his enemies, Chobe always stuck to taking on the role of the villain, and holds grudges to those that have bested him. Although he tends to act like a brute, Chobe is a rationale thinker that knows what is the best course of action in a serious situation.

name: Yuzuriha
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm
__Race:__ Human
__Age:__ Unknown
__Tao Attribute:__ Earth
__Occupation:__ Kunoichi

Yuzuriha also known as Yuzuriha of the Keishu, is a kunoichi and one of the few criminals recruited to acquire the Elixir of Life.

Yuzuriha is friendly and cheerful around others with a typical teenage girl personality. She is shown to be carefree and prefers to do things at her own pace. Because of her reputation as a criminal, Yuzuriha has no problems when it comes to killing or who she has to sacrifice to achieve a goal. Underneath her friendly attitude, Yuzuriha's true nature is that of a complete narcissist, only focusing on her own well-being and shows little concern for others. This attitude stemmed from her past vow to her little sister to live only for the both of them. As a kunoichi, Yuzuriha uses her charms to get what she wants, but despite that she is shown to be a terrible liar after trying to make up her backstory.





Yuzuriha grew up in a shinobi village living with her little sister, [Saya](https://anilist.co/character/306735/Saya), who was suffering from an incurable disease and eventually died. From then on, Yuzuriha swore to live her life for the both of them and started her career as a kunoichi. Sometime ago, Yuzuriha raided the Sagiwa Castle and defeated the retainers defending it.

name: Nurugai
description:
__Height:__ 138 cm
__Race:__ Human
__Tao Attribute:__ Water

Nurugai is the last remaining member of the Sanka and a wrongly convicted death-row criminal. Her assigned monitor is [Tenza](https://anilist.co/character/137265/Tenza).

Nurugai looks down on samurai, viewing them as stupid. Her disdain for them stems from the fact that they were partially responsible for killing her people. Because of this incident, Nurugai feels a strong guilt for leading her village's extermination, even believed that the reason why she is on a dangerous mission is because she was receiving divine punishment for her actions and accepted death. 

Nurugai was raised with the Sanka Mountain People in a village where she had lived with her grandfather. Nurugai and her grandfather were in a friendly, familial relationship where she would learn off her grandfather's wisdom. Her village however were considered rebels against the current shogunate, refusing to submit to [Tokugawa](https://anilist.co/character/301606/Nariyoshi-Tokugawa). Because of this, samurai were sent to locate the hillside tribes they defined as Emishis. One day, Nurugai crossed paths with a party of lost men, encouraging Nurugai to offer her help by seeking rest in the security of her village. Nurugai recognized her mistake when she realised that these men were samurai under the order of Tokugawa, who began a mass killing of her village that would leave her as the sole survivor.

name: Gantetsusai Tamiya
description:
__Race:__ Human
__Age:__ Unknown
__Tao Attribute:__ Fire

Tamiya Gantetsusai formerly known as Tetsunosuke is a renown master swordsman known throughout as the Blade Dragon and Eight Provinces Unparalleled.

He considers fighting to be fun and lives to seek out and battle strong opponents that can make him feel a thrill whenever he has to draw his blade. Even when critically injured, Gantetsusai's carries a satisfied smile from the adrenaline he gets from fighting and feels as though as he is becoming stronger with each injury. However, he is not very disciplined, preferring to recklessly fight his opponents head on without thinking of a clear strategy, or listen to his allies, and hates it when others try to interfere in his enjoyment. Gantetsusai also has a perverted side as he took note and commented on [Yuzuriha](https://anilist.co/character/137270/Yuzuriha)'s physique during the selection process. Despite his perverted behavior, Gantetsusai has morals as he felt disgusted of the thought of the Dōshi using [Mei](https://anilist.co/character/148755/Mei) for sexual intercourse to complete their Tao training.



At a young age, Tetsunosuke was trained in the art of swordsmanship. After being defeated by his master, Tetsunosuke asked how he was able to despite his old age. He explains to Tetsunosuke that he has become greedy with wanting to become stronger and says that he must throw away his strength in order to see everything in what he has left.

name: Tenza
aliases: Yamada Asaemon Tenza (山田浅ェ門典坐)
description:
__Height:__ 176 cm (5'9")

Tenza is the 10th rank Asaemon in the Yamada Clan. After [the shogun](https://anilist.co/character/301606/Tokugawa-Nariyoshi) sent criminals to Kotaku to find the Elixir of Life, he was chosen as [Nurugai's](https://anilist.co/character/137262/Nurugai) assigned monitor. From youth, Tenza started off on the streets but was eventually picked up by [Shion](https://anilist.co/character/137267/Shion) and made into his apprentice in the Yamada Clan. 

Tenza is energetic and confident. He is a practitioner of bushido, taking in the lesson of continuing on forward no matter what is blocking his way. Tenza is also extremely righteous and does not let his duties as an Asaemon get in the way of doing what is right. He believes that Nurugai is innocent and does not deserve to die on the island. Although righteous he is, Tenza does not think things through, believing that without the elixir he would be able to convince his superiors to turn a blind eye. Tenza has a strong will to protect the people he cares about.

name: Shion
aliases: Yamada Asaemon Shion (山田浅ェ門士遠)
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm
__Race:__ Human 
__Tao Attribute:__ Wood

Shion is the 4th rank Asaemon of the Yamada clan and is the one chosen to be [Akaginu](https://anilist.co/character/302523/Akaginu)'s monitor. 

Shion is a strict but kind man. He is well aware of the brutal nature of his work as an executioner, opting to spend the rest of his time helping others. Like the other Asaemon, he possesses a strong loyalty to the Yamada clan. Shion also has a witty sense of humor, often making puns and jokes regarding his eyesight, which has become a major part of his character to the people around him. Shion is shown to be fearless, showing no fear or hesitation when facing extremely strong enemies.

name: Senta
aliases: Yamada Asaemon Senta (山田浅ェ門仙汰)
description:
__Race:__ Human

Yamada Asaemon Senta is the 5th rank Asaemon in the Yamada Clan. After the shogun sent criminals to Kotaku to find the Elixir of Life, he was tasked with being [Yuzuriha's](https://anilist.co/character/137270/Yuzuriha) executioner.

Senta is very nervous around others and tends to frequently sweat. He usually remains in the background and goes along with whatever is happening around him but will speak up when he feels that whatever he has to say would be helpful. Senta is capable of assessing the situation and makes good judgements as to how to approach them. He dislikes his role of killing people but feels that he has no choice in the matter and chooses to abandon his dream of becoming an artist. After observing Yuzuriha, he becomes envious and enchanted by her innate freedom. Despite his nervous demeanor, Senta is fearless and stands his ground no matter who he is up against.

name: Shigeru Kamado
description: Shigeru was Tanjiro's second youngest brother.

He is a Demon Slayer and the Stone Hashira of the Demon Slayer Corps. Gyomei also serves as the mentor of [Genya Shinazugawa](https://anilist.co/character/137776/Shinazugawa-Genya).

name: Reita Toritsuka
description: Another psychic and one of two people outside of [Saiki](https://anilist.co/character/90107/Saiki-Kusuo)'s family to know of his abilities. He has the ability to see spirits and is haunted by the ghost of [Nendou](https://anilist.co/character/90108/Nendou-Riki)'s late father, but is only interested in using his ability to attract girls.

appearsIn.title: The Disastrous Life of Saiki K.

name: Kusuo Saiki
description:
**Height:** 167 cm

Kusuo Saiki has an extremely uncaring, neutral personality. As a gifted psychic that can do anything he wants, he has long stopped caring about the world; however, he has shown to be extremely cautious, as he often runs from [Nendou](https://anilist.co/character/90108), the only person he fears and is prone to immediately teleporting to faraway places upon spotting an insect. Saiki has a sweet tooth, so he loves sweets, especially Coffee Jelly.

Fourteen days after his birth, Kusuo uttered his first word without moving his mouth and 1 month after birth he took his first step in midair. At the age of 1 was the first time Kusuo has voluntarily used his abilities, when his mother said they were out of mirin, Kusuo teleported away and returned with several bottles of mirin.

Kusuo Saiki is a gifted psychic. Having obtained his powers since birth, the first signs of Saiki's powers came from when he was able to hear the voices of his parents and he subsequently telepathically spoke back to them. Two months later, he demonstrated the ability to walk in the air. Saiki has stated that in three days, he can wipe out humanity. The full extent of all of his abilities is unknown.

The Disastrous Life of Saiki K. Season 2

name: Riki Nendou
description:
Nendo has a simple way of thinking, but because of it, [Saiki](https://anilist.co/character/90107/Saiki-Kusuo) is unable to read his mind. Because Saiki is unable to detect Nendo's presence, Nendo is the only person who is able to sneak up on Saiki and making him think he will someday be a dangerous foe.

Nendo believes he is a friend of Saiki, but this is definitely not the case as Saiki despises Nendo. Saiki would often compare Nendo to a bug, as bugs are one of the few animals that Saiki cannot read the minds of.

description: Shun is a young man who considers himself to be the "Jet-Black Wing", a lone hero fighting against the evil organization Dark Reunion. He also believes his powers stem from a dark being living within his arm. To his friends and peers, including [Saiki](https://anilist.co/character/90107/Saiki-Kusuo), he's simply an immature kid playing a game that only he understands.

name: Aren Kuboyasu
description: Kuboyasu in his previous school wore the typical delinquent clothes. He sported a pompadour hairstyle, and wore a modified school uniform with his pants looking more like an over-sized skirt. After moving to PK Academy, Kuboyasu changed his looks into more of a normal student like wearing glasses and dyeing his hair dark violet. In school, he wears the standard uniform of male students in PK Academy while in days off, he wears long sleeves; possibly to hide his scars which were first seen by Kaidou.

name: Chiyo Yumehara
description: A romantic and dreamy girl who easily falls in love with boys. She originally has a crush on Kusuo and tried her best to appeal to Kusuo. Kusuo in turn rejected her as hard as he could with his PSI powers. Kusuo even went as far as hooking her up with someone else but the relationship abruptly failed. She later develops a crush on Kaidou after he saved her from the unwanted attention of some guys at the beach.

appearsIn.title: The Disastrous Life of Saiki K.
The Disastrous Life of Saiki K.: Reawakened
The Disastrous Life of Saiki K. Season 3

name: Shinya Kougami
description:
Shinya Kougami is an enforcement officer who is tasked with managing crime. Shinya has a high criminal mentality, but because of his skills as a detective, he was released under the condition that he becomes an Enforcer for the Public Safety Bureau, Unit 1.

Despite his natural grudge towards [Makishima](https://anilist.co/character/69725/Makishima-Shougo), they are actually somewhat alike, as shown in Shinya's ability to foresee Makishima's actions.

name: Akane Tsunemori
description: The main female protagonist and the newly assigned Inspector of Unit 1. Considered a model citizen due to her ever calm demeanor and for passing the exams with the highest score for employment on several public sectors and private corporations. She decided to join the police due to being the only place where no one obtained a score as high as hers, thus she believes to be able to do something there that no one else can. She has a unique quirk in which it's hard to cloud her Pyscho-Pass Hues, making her a perfect fit for the job as Inspector.

name: Shougo Makishima
description: A humanist on the dark side who is hopelessly in love with cruelty, savagery, and all the worst aspects of human nature. A born evangelist, he possesses both uncommon charisma and a true gift for narrative. Makishima has quite a unique personality. He likes books a lot, as shown in his tendency to quote from famous literature.

name: Shion Karanomori
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm (5'6")

An analyst in the Public Safety Bureau's General Analysis Division and a latent criminal as well. She provides backup to the Enforcers and Inspectors in their investigation by analyzing the data and evidence sent by them.

She is in a relationship with [Yayoi Kunizuka](https://anilist.co/character/69059/Kunizuka-Yayoi) who is one of the enforcers of Unit 1.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Kaori Minase
description: Akane's friend. She works as a system engineer.

name: Shuusei Kagari
description: Shuusei is the jokester of the group and likes to make fun of people on a regular basis. He enjoys portable video games and spends most of his free time playing them. However, he is more serious when he's on the job. He hates people who take the freedom they have for granted, because of the fact that he's been excluded from society since he was five years old.

name: Kimihiko Hayama
description: He is single and unemployed.

name: Hina Amano
description:
__Height:__ > 160 cm

Hina is a young and cheerful girl with long black-blue hair tied into twin ponytails and large blue eyes. She wears a blue stone necklace and often wears a grey hoodie over a sleeveless dress. Hina takes in many jobs in other to support her younger brother who is still in elementary school. She possesses the ability to clear the weather for a short period of time in a desired area by praying to the sky which she obtained after praying and walking through a Torii (traditional Japanese gate) on the roof of an abandoned building.

Hina is a cheerful, energetic, and strong-willed teen. She is also a caring and kind individual as seen when she gives [Hodoka](https://anilist.co/character/139709/Morishima-Hodaka) a free burger when she noticed he looked lost. She uses her power to clear the weather to brighten people's days and see the smiles on their face.

name: Hodaka Morishima
description:
__Height__: >173 cm

Hodaka is a high school student of average build with medium length black hair and light brown eyes. He is often seen wearing a plain black t-shirt and jeans along with his yellow knapsack that he carries along everywhere he goes. Hodoka ran away from his parents and home to live a new life in Tokyo as his previous life was too "suffocating" for him. However, after arriving in Tokyo, he struggled to live the new life he was hoping for and was forced to live in manga cafes and in the streets. Fortunately, he met [Keisuke Suga](https://anilist.co/character/139707/Keisuke-Suga), a writer for a small editing company, who took him in as an employee and gave Hodoka a roof over his head.

Hodoka is a courageous boy as he was able to leave his home by himself and start a new life in Tokyo. Accompanying his courageous trait however is an impulsive nature which often leads him to make irrational choices that cause many misunderstandings.

name: Kannushi
description: He is the caretaker of the Meteorological Shrine.

name: Nagi Amano
description:
He is [Hina](https://anilist.co/character/139710)'s younger brother who is an elementary student. Despite being young, he is popular with the girls due to his "mature behavior".

(Source: Tenki no Ko Wikia, edited)

name: Keisuke Suga
description: He is a writer from a small editing studio.

name: Fumi Tachibana
description: Taki Tachibana's paternal grandmother.

name: Yuuta Togashi
aliases: Dark Flame Master (ダークフレイムマスター)
description: A high school boy who used to be a delusional teen, believing himself to be the Dark Flame Master and becoming alienated from everyone as a result. Finding this to be embarrassing, he attempts to erase this past from existence, even choosing to go to a separate high school from all of his junior high school classmates. However, after encountering [Rikka](https://anilist.co/character/65865), his past delusions come back to haunt him.

name: Rikka Takanashi
aliases: Jaou Shingan no Tsukaite (邪王真眼の使い手)
description:
__Height:__ 150 cm (4'11")

Rikka Takanashi is an active Chuunibyou, who still has the syndrome. Her delusional syndrome involves her right eye which she calls her "Wicked Eye," which, according to her, wields darkness tamed by the power of a pure heart. In reality, her so-called "Wicked Eye" is nothing more than a colored contact lens which she conceals underneath an eyepatch. Despite being quite attached to [Yuuta](https://anilist.co/character/65863/Togashi-Yuuta), she is cautious of strangers and adopts a battle pose whenever she meets someone for the first time. She is also rather clumsy, often tripping over and forgetting things. She also doesn't have many friends, as shown that in her mobile phone only has her sister's email.

name: Shinka Nibutani
description: A beautiful girl in [Yuuta](https://anilist.co/character/65863/Togashi-Yuuta)'s class. Shinka is Yuuta's classmate and class representative, who is also a cheerleader. One of the most popular girls in the class due to her looks, she is generally thought of a kind and gentle girl.

name: Sanae Dekomori
description:
Sanae is an underclassman to the rest of the club members. She, like [Rikka](https://anilist.co/character/65865/Takanashi-Rikka), is a Chuunibyou. She claims that she is Rikka's servant and wants to take her master's place. Her "power" is Mjolnir, a pair of hair nunchucks. Despite being a Chuunibyou, she is top in her class. Little was known about her relatives but it's implied that she is from a rich family.  


(Source: Anime News Network)

name: Kumin Tsuyuri
description: Kumin is [Yuuta](https://anilist.co/character/65863)'s chill and carefree senpai who loves adventures, cats, and pillows. Spends most of the time in the club room napping. She adores any chuunibyous and once said that it would've been fun to have some delusions herself.

name: Makoto Isshiki
description: Yuuta's classmate and friend. He created a "cutie poll" which ranked all the girls in class in terms of cuteness. However, because of this, his head was shaved into a crew cut. Later on he joins Rikka's club and develops a crush on Kumin.

name: Kuzuha Togashi
description:
Kuzuha is [Yuuta Togashi](https://anilist.co/character/65863/Togashi-Yuuta)'s younger sister who is in the first year of junior high school.

She knows Yuuta very well, especially how he acted during his Chuunibyou days in middle school as Dark Flame Master, though she always considered him embarrassing. Kuzuha got used to her older brother's delusions since she was young. Every once in a while she would ponder if her brother's acts were actually cool before immediately dismissing the thought as Yuuta would spectacularly embarrass himself yet again.

name: Ryo Asuka
description:
The best friend of Akira Fudo, the main character of Nagai Go's classical horror manga Devilman. 

As Akira is the strength, Ryo is the brain. His father discovered the existence of demons in our world and decided to fight them. He asked his friend Akira for help. Ryo knew that to be able to beat a demon, one had to become a demon. He and Akira went through a ritual to fuse with demons, but in the end, only Akira was able to do so and became Devilman, leaving Ryo remain as a normal human.

name: Akira Fudou
description:
__Height:__ 182 cm

Akira is a shy, soft spoken, and somewhat cowardly teen. His father has recently went to work in America so he is currently living with his friend Miki's family. He hasn't seen his best friend Ryo in over a month since moving in with Miki's family. When they reunite he is in for a big surprise that will forever change him, his life, and all of mankind.

name: Jinmen
description: Jinmen is a devil with a shell like turtle. However, the shell has the faces of all the humans he's ever consumed. Instead of killing them, they remain alive as a part of him. In the manga, Sachiko, who used to be Akira's neighbor, falls victim to Jinmen. In the OAV, it is Akira's mother.

name: Zenon
description:
Zennon is among the most powerful of the demon kind, and Satan's second-in-command alongside Psycho Jenny. While Satan was away, he assumed the role of the leader of the demon race. Zennon is highly respected and feared among his people, with most referring to him as Lord Zennon.

(Source: Devilman Wiki)

name: Professor Fikira
description: Professor Fikira was a Russian scientist who had discovered evidence of demon kind. He replaces Professor Asuka (Ryo's father in the manga) within the anime.

name: Kouzou Rainuma
description: Dr. Rainuma is a famous research biologist. After the attacks across the world by the Demon menace he became devoted to finding a way to combat the Demons and set up the Demon Busters.

name: Houtarou Oreki
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm (5'8")

Oreki is a high-schooler with messy brown hair and green eyes. Due to his very lazy lifestyle, he almost always has a tired or bored look on his face. His hair is especially very messy when he wakes up. 

He is shown to be a quiet student, and never concerned about things that happens around him. Despite being shown as an average high school student, he is quite intelligent and perceptive. The reason for his usual laziness is because he wishes to "save energy". Even though he is shown to be quite lazy, he never leaves his homework undone, as pointed out by [Satoshi](https://anilist.co/character/55135). He's considered lazy and apathetic, always living on the "gray" side, and is not interested in any activities that might waste his time and energy. He actually never intended to join any club, but [his sister](https://anilist.co/character/56161) ordered him to join the Classics Club to save it from being disbanded. Even though he might not seem it, he's unbelievably good at solving mysteries and seems to be able to always find a solution if he gives it a thought. He has a habit of holding his bangs whenever he's thinking about a mystery.

name: Satoshi Fukube
description:
__Height:__ 160cm (5'3")

 Satoshi went to the same middle school as Houtarou and Mayaka. He knows many things, but most of them are trivial. He's cheerful and a great match to befriend the apathetic Houtarou. He is active, already being a part of the Student Council and Handicraft Club before joining the Classics Club. He is the "database" of the club and has a very good memory.

name: Eru Chitanda
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3")

Chitanda is a calm and happy person but can become very excited when new or interesting things happen, especially when it involves her club. She is described as a beautiful 16 year old girl with long black hair and purple eyes. She usually sports a cheerful expression as well as seen in her uniform.  

Eru is the single daughter of the Chitanda Family, one of the four remaining wealthy farming families in the area, according to [Satoshi](https://anilist.co/character/55135/Fukube-Satoshi). She joined the Classics Club due to "personal reasons", and is the president of the club due to it not retaining any members from the previous year. She likes mysteries and has a great curiosity, which often drags [Houtarou](https://anilist.co/character/55131/Oreki-Houtarou) into solving them. 

She often expresses her curiosity with the phrase "私気になります！" ("watashi kininarimasu"), often translated as "I'm curious!".

name: Mayaka Ibara
description:
__Height:__ 148 cm (4'10")

An inseparable friend who's been in the same class with [Houtarou](https://anilist.co/character/55131/Oreki-Houtarou) since their first grade in elementary school. She is interested in [Satoshi](https://anilist.co/character/55135/Fukube-Satoshi), which leads her to join the classic literature club. She is also a member of the Library and Manga Society. She has a blunt and frank personality and usually makes nicknames for some of her friends (i.e: Fuku-chan, Chi-chan).

description: Appears in episode 14.

description: He is the Executive Committee President.

name: Kiritsugu Emiya
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm
__Sidearm:__ Thompson contender in conjunction with his Mystic Code Origin Bullets

[Shirou](https://anilist.co/character/496)'s foster father and his savior from the aftermath of the massive Fuyuki fire.

During his lifetime, Kiritsugu was disillusioned with becoming a Hero of Justice, a defender of humanity who could save everyone. Although he feels he failed to do so, his efforts were a source of inspiration for Shirou.

Prior to his fateful meeting with Shirou, Kiritsugu was notorious as the "Magus Killer," a freelancer who would hunt down heretical magi. Although he was a magus with Magic Circuits and abilities he was considered unorthodox in that he would utilize modern technology and weaponry along with his magecraft to track down and kill magi.

Although mentioned and seen in flashbacks in Fate/stay night, Kiritsugu is one of the main protagonists in its prequel Fate/Zero.

name: Irisviel von Einzbern
native: アイリスフィール・フォン・アインツベルン
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm  

Irisviel von Einzbern is the partner of [Saber](https://anilist.co/character/497/Pendragon-Artoria) as well as the intended vessel for the Holy Grail. She is the mother of [Illyasviel von Einzbern](https://anilist.co/character/503/von-Einzbern-Illyasviel). Like her daughter, Irisviel is a homunculus, an artificial being created by the Einzbern. She was raised to be a puppet with no desires, but found happiness in her existence when she gave birth to Illyasviel. She is married to [Kiritsugu Emiya](https://anilist.co/character/10010/Emiya-Kiritsugu), the biological father of her daughter.

name: Artoria Pendragon
native: アルトリア・ペンドラゴン
description:
__Height:__ 154 cm (5'1)

Artoria Pendragon, better known as Arthur Pendragon and King Arthur, is regarded as a male in history but is actually female. She is the "Once and Future King" and a legendary hero of Britain known as the King of Knights. She used to wield the sword from the stone, Caliburn, but it was eventually destroyed and the Lady of the Lake gifted her with Excalibur and Avalon.

name: Gilgamesh
description:
__Height:__ 182 cm

Gilgamesh is the King of Uruk, said to have reigned during the Sumer Dynasty in Mesopotamia 5000 years ago. He's the namesake Hero described in the Epic of Gilgamesh, making him the most ancient Hero on which all the others legends were modeled. This grants him the title of King of Heroes and, within his Gates of Babylon, the prototypes of all the Noble Phantasms of the Heroes yet to come. 

Born from the human Lugalbanda, the King of Uruk, and the goddess Rimat-Ninsun, he was a being so perfect and transcendent to the point that he was two-thirds deity and one-third human. He was the chosen one that would guide humanity on the earth that was slowly abandoning the Age of Gods, but instead he grew up to be a selfish and arrogant despot.

His only friend and being he considered his equal was [Enkidu](https://anilist.co/character/60059).

name: Tokiomi Toosaka
description:
__Height:__ 177cm

The father of [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/498/) and [Sakura](https://anilist.co/character/500/), two of the heroines from Fate/stay night. 

As a member of the Tohsaka family, he entered the Fourth Holy Grail War as the Master of Archer ([Gilgamesh](https://anilist.co/character/2514/)). [Kiritsugu Emiya](https://anilist.co/character/10010/) identifies Tokiomi as one of the two most threatening magi involved in the war after assessing all the Masters involved. 

Tokiomi is an arrogant and manipulative man who strives, as all-powerful magi do, to reach Akasha, or "the root of all knowledge". Although he cares for his daughters and his wife, he appears to be oblivious to the problems and pain they face due to his decisions.

name: Waver Velvet
native: ウェイバー・ベルベット
aliases: Sir Great Big Ben London Star
description:
__Height:__ 157 cm


Waver Velvet is a nineteen year old student at Clock Tower, an institute of the Magus Association, and mage with a recognized magical lineage of three generations. While he is talented, he is not recognized by his peers or lecturers.

An intelligent young man, Waver came up with the revolutionary concept that a mage's power could be increased through effort, experience, and knowledge rather than increasing magical potential through that of a mage's heirs. His idea is dismissed by his lecturer, the nobleman [Kayneth Archibald El-Melloi](https://anilist.co/character/16028), who tears up Waver's manuscript without another thought.

name: Ryuunosuke Uryuu
description:
__Height:__ 174 cm
__Weight:__ 65 kg

The master of Caster, Ryuunosuke is a serial killer who summons Caster after murdering a family and using their blood as a component in the summoning ritual. Though he is not a magus, he was selected by the Holy Grail to fulfill the war's requirement of seven Masters and seven Servants. Ryuunosuke knows nothing about magic or the fourth Holy Grail War; his involvement in the war is simply to watch Caster kill people in unique and thrilling ways to relieve boredom.  (source: Type-Moon Wiki)

name: Joutarou Kuujou
description:
__Height:__ 195 cm (6'5")
__Occupation:__ Student, Marine Explorer, Oceanographer
__Nationality:__ Japanese 

Joutarou is Holly Kujo's son and [Joseph Joestar](https://anilist.co/character/6356)'s grandson. In Part 3, he has a recognizable attire of a blue trenchcoat-length school uniform jacket with yellow chains on the collar. He also wears a trademark hat which, while torn in the back, often seems to blend with his hair. When Joutarou first appears, he turned himself in to the police because he believes his Stand is an evil spirit possessing him. After he is released from jail, and learns what his Stand is, Joutarou gets used to Star Platinum -- a fierce, muscular, vaguely Aztec-looking spirit with "the precision of a machine" and the ability to destroy virtually anything with a sledgehammer barrage of fists. He has a very tough exterior, and is even rather rough and delinquent, but he also is very dedicated, intense, and loyal. He is very intelligent, but usually lets his (or Star Platinum's) fists do the talking with the enemy, even though he often has to rely on his wits to deal with stand users' attacks. He is also known for a quick and short temper. His catchphrase is "Yare yare daze." It generally relates of being bored or exasperation. In Part 3, he is the main target of [Dio](https://anilist.co/character/4004), who realizes that Joutarou is his greatest threat.

name: Mohammed Avdol
native: モハメド・アヴドゥル
description:
__Height:__ 188 cm (6'2")
__Stand:__ Magician's Red

Avdol is a fortune teller and friend of [Joseph Joestar](https://anilist.co/character/6356/Joestar-Joseph). They met three years before the events of the story. He was born with a stand, Magician’s Red, which controls fire. This stand’s abilities include Crossfire Hurricane, which shoots fire in the shape of an Ankh, and Crossfire Hurricane Special, which splits into multiple Ankh-shaped flames. He can also create flame tracker that detects a person’s energy.

Avdol presents himself as a serious person but can sometimes let his emotions get the best of him. He often acts as the voice of reason among the Joestar group and exhibits strong loyalty by frequently placing himself in danger to protect his friends. He is knowledgeable about geography and stands, enjoys India’s chaotic atmosphere, and respects [Polnareff](https://anilist.co/character/4368/Polnareff-JeanPierre)'s chivalrous attitude that he displayed when they first met. Avdol gives [Jotaro](https://anilist.co/character/4003/Kuujou-Joutarou)'s stand its name. 





He is named after Paula Abdul.

appearsIn.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Stardust Crusaders - Battle in Egypt
JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Part 3: Stardust Crusaders

name: Noriaki Kakyouin
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm (5'10")
__Stand:__ Hierophant Green

Kakyoin is a high school student and user of the stand Hierophant Green. Unlike most stand users, Kakyoin was born with his stand, though it caused him to feel like an outsider for most of his life due to not knowing any other stand users. Until meeting the rest of the main characters, Hierophant was Kakyoin’s only real friend.

Hierophant is not physically strong, but is elastic and can able to unravel into tentacles which can capture opponents. It can also enter an enemy’s body to possess them, though Kakyoin rarely uses this ability. Hierophant’s signature power is emerald splash, which hurls emeralds that slice opponents.

Kakyoin remains calm and collected even in dangerous situations, and is good at seeing through opponents’ strategies. 

During a trip to Egypt with his family, he encountered [Dio](https://anilist.co/character/4004/Brando-Dio), who controlled him using a flesh bud. It was later removed by [Jotaro](https://anilist.co/character/4003/Kuujou-Joutarou) and Kakyoin joined the Joestar group.

JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Part 3: Stardust Crusaders

name: Jean-Pierre Polnareff
native: ジャン＝ピエール・ポルナレフ
description:
__Height:__ 185 cm (6'1")

Jean-Pierre Polnareff is a Frenchman who joins the Joestar group on their journey to Egypt after being freed from Dio's control by the group. He aims to avenge the murder of his sister. His brash nature and overconfidence combined with his general tomfoolery is often the source of trouble throughout the journey, and other members of the group often remark on his tendency to endanger himself and others.



He also serves as the inspiration for many characters in other franchises such as [Guile](https://anilist.co/character/9312/Guile) (Street Fighter), [Paul](https://anilist.co/character/285435/Phoenix-Paul) (Tekken), [Benimaru Nikaido](https://anilist.co/character/61203/Nikaido-Benimaru) (King of Fighters).
