JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Part 3: Stardust Crusaders

name: Hol Horse
description:
**Height**: 188cm *(anime)*

Hol Horse is a minor antagonist in JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Stardust Crusaders (first seen in Chapter 141 and Episode 10), as well as one of the main characters of Crazy Diamond's Demonic Heartbreak. He is a tall, blonde-haired cowboy-themed mercenary, serving under Dio and his army of other Stand Users. He considers himself "The #2", preferring to work as support with a partner due to his cowardice and caution. He also respects women, no matter how pretty, or how ugly, as seen with his ex, Nena. 

His Stand is Emperor, named after the Tarot Card of the same name. It manifests itself as a retro-futuristic pistol, which functions as a normal firearm, although the bullets are able to change their trajectory to Hol Horse's command.

appearsIn.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Stardust Crusaders - Battle in Egypt

name: Suzie Q
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm 

The female assistant to Lisa Lisa. Suzie Q is a slightly ditzy girl who worries for her friends. Evidently this carefree personality has not diminished even in the events of Stardust Crusaders, when she is shown enthusiastically recording her sightings in Japan on a camcorder when on a trip to see her daughter.

name: J. Geil
description:
J. Geil is the man responsible for the murder of Polnareff's sister, earning him Polnareff's desire for revenge.    

J. Geil expend most of his time hiding from plain view, preferring to have a partner in which to rely on. This made him a perfect candidate for Hol Horse who like him believe working in pairs. He would hide in the shadows while Hol Horse broke the glass needed for his stand to work and sometimes they would do combination attack, such as Hal Horse breaking glass and J. Geil attacking while Hol Horse shot a bullet from his Stand, the Emperor, locking the enemy in a mortal circle.    

Like his mother he had a deformity that give him two right hands.     

(Source: JJBA Wikia)

name: Koyomi Araragi
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm   

A third year high school student who is close to failing every class except math. He is a laid-back person whose only real friend at school is [Tsubasa Hanekawa](https://anilist.co/character/22055/Tsubasa-Hanekawa). Due to events prior to Kizumonogatari and Bakemonogatari, Koyomi avoided having friends and seemed to have lost faith and trust in people and himself.

name: Tsubasa Hanekawa
description:
__Height__: 158 cm

She styles her hair into two braids and ties them with a hair ribbon that has a cat design. She is always seen dressed in the uniform of Naoetsu Private High School, even outside of school days, and is rarely seen on any other type of clothing, except for a set of sleepwear which she wore during Tsubasa Cat Arc.  Hanekawa Tsubasa is [Araragi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi)'s classmate and the class president. Araragi describes her as "the class president of all class presidents". Her catchphrase is "I don’t know everything, I just know what I know". Hanekawa currently lives with her stepfather and stepmother.

Hanekawa Family's Past:    Hanekawa Story's overview in Nekomonogatari/Bakemonogatari:

name: Meme Oshino
description: Meme is a middle-aged man who lives in an abandoned building. Being an expert in apparitions field, he solves [Koyomi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi) and others' problems. Although he sometimes expects compensation, he does not require it always and seems to help those in need from good nature. Due to his vast knowledge of supernatural studies and general oddities, he serves as Araragi's informant during his stay in the city. Meme is a graduate of Shinto studies in college, although he never pursued the career of being a Shinto priest. Despite that, he is perfectly capable to accomplish spiritual works of a Shinto priest, such as exorcising entities and solving paranormal mysteries. He occasionally wears a Priest's outfit, as seen with the session with [Senjougahara](https://anilist.co/character/22037/Hitagi-Senjougahara) and the heavy crab. Meme's other notable accessories include an earring on his right ear and a necklace, both consisting of an inverted cross.

name: Mayoi Hachikuji
description: Mayoi is a fifth-grade elementary school girl. She always carries a big backpack, wears a hairband, and sports ponytails.

name: Hitagi Senjougahara
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm

Hitagi, the main female character, is a weak-looking girl with an "incurable disease". She is in the same class as [Koyomi Araragi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi), but he has almost never heard her speak. When she was in the first year of high school, she encountered a mysterious crab, after which she became weightless. Ever since, she has avoided contact with everyone else, threatening everyone who discovers her secret. She called herself a tsundere and always speaks in an abusive style.

name: Shinobu Oshino
aliases: Kiss-Shot Acerola-Orion Heart-Under-Blade (キスショット・アセロラオリオン・ハートアンダーブレード)
Tekketsu ni shite Nekketsu ni shite Reiketsu no Kyuuketsuki (鉄血にして熱血にして冷血の吸血鬼)
description: A girl who lives with [Oshino Meme](https://anilist.co/character/22552/Meme-Oshino) in an abandoned building. She loves donuts from the Mister Donut chain. At the beginning of Hitagi Crab, she was renamed "Shinobu" by Meme, who suggested that the name Shinobu (忍), comprised of a heart (心) under a blade (刃), matched her original persona.

name: Nadeko Sengoku
description:
__Height:__ 153 cm 

Nadeko, the main character of Nadeko Snake, is [Tsukihi](https://anilist.co/character/24195/Tsukihi-Araragi)’s friend back in elementary school. She always wears a waist pouch, always casts her eyes downward, has her bangs covering her eyes, has a shy personality, and can be easily amused. [Koyomi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi) played with her a lot whenever she visited his house after being invited by his sisters. She refers to Koyomi as Koyomi onii-chan and appears to have feelings for him.    She's quite protective of her hair (particularly her forelocks) thinking that it's her place to guard more than her panties. When she finally combed her forelocks aside in Nisemonogatari, Koyomi commented that she has a glare just like a serpent, probably foreshadowing the story of Nadeko Medusa.

In Nademonogatari,

name: Karen Araragi
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm 
 
Karen, the main character of Karen Bee, is one of [Koyomi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi)'s sisters. She is older than [Tsukihi](https://anilist.co/character/24195/Tsukihi-Araragi) and always doing outdoor activities. Despite being younger, Karen is taller than Koyomi, much to Koyomi's dismay.

name: Tsukihi Araragi
description:
__Height:__ 156 cm   

Tsukihi, the main character of Tsukihi Phoenix, is one of [Koyomi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi)'s sisters. She's the youngest of Araragi family. Unlike her sister, [Karen](https://anilist.co/character/24194/Karen-Araragi), she is always doing indoor activities. Contrary to her personality, she constantly changes her hair style and is short-tempered to the point that Koyomi describes her as having hysteria.

name: Suruga Kanbaru
description:
Suruga, the main character of Suruga Monkey, is [Koyomi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi)'s underclassman, ace of the school's basketball team and one of [Hitagi](https://anilist.co/character/22037/Hitagi-Senjougahara)'s acquaintances from back in junior high school. Immediately after she entered senior high school, she became aware of Hitagi's secret and was threatened by her, just like Koyomi was. She's an admitted lesbian, fujoshi, lolicon and masochist. 

 She also has been growing her hair longer since. Her next story was revealed to be Suruga Devil.

name: Eva Heinemann
description:
Eva Heinemann is [Doctor Tenma](https://anilist.co/character/718/Tenma-Kenzou)'s fiancée and the daughter of the Director of Eisler Memorial Hospital. She leaves Doctor Tenma after he is demoted by the Director for disobeying his orders. After Director Heinemann is murdered by [Johan](https://anilist.co/character/719/Liebert-Johan), she tries to return to Tenma, then recently promoted Chief of Surgery due to holes created in the staff by the murder. After being rejected by Doctor Tenma, she later becomes an extremely embittered alcoholic, a three time divorcee who uses the money from divorce settlements to finance her lavish lifestyle. After burning her house down in a drunken rage, she wanders throughout Germany and is also caught up in the investigation of the Monster.

Although she does not personally suspect Dr. Tenma as having caused her father's death, one of the things she lives for is to see him suffer in prison in retribution for his rejection of her, as she had previously turned over evidence incriminating Dr. Tenma to [Inspector Runge](https://anilist.co/character/721/Runge-Heinrich). Her relationship with Tenma can be characterized as obsessive.

During the series, she becomes a main target of [Roberto](https://anilist.co/character/8611/Roberto).

name: Anna Liebert
aliases: Nina Fortner (ニナ・フォルトナー)
description:
[Johan](https://anilist.co/character/719/Liebert-Johan)'s twin sister and the only unharmed survivor of the night when both her parents and her brother were shot in what appeared to be a botched burglary. At first she showed signs of amnesia due to the psychological trauma of the incident. After she and her brother disappeared, she was adopted by the Fortner family from Heidelberg, who were unaware of her previous identity as Anna Liebert. 

As Nina Fortner, she was a hardworking law student at an unnamed university (likely the University of Heidelberg), as well as an adept practitioner of Aikido. She lived her life in peace until Johan made contact with her on her twentieth birthday. She comes to pursue Johan, albeit by different methods and for a different reason than [Tenma](https://anilist.co/character/718/Tenma-Kenzou).

name: Johan Liebert
description:
Johan Liebert is the older twin son of the Lieberts, whose father Michael was an East German trade advisor who defected to the West. He is the titular "monster" and the main antagonist of the series. The mystery of his past is the focus of the plot. He is called a monster, the next Adolf Hitler and the devil himself.

Johan was shot in the head as a child when his parents were killed in their home, but saved from death by [Dr. Tenma](https://anilist.co/character/718). Because of this, he regards Dr. Tenma almost as though he was his father. He claims to love his twin sister [Anna](https://anilist.co/character/720), and has some loyalty to her. Johan has spent parts of his life in different places under different names. He possesses charisma and intelligence but is also cunning, manipulative and deceitful; while he is seemingly kind, compassionate and loving to children, he is actually cold, cruel and fundamentally incapable of empathy. He uses his talents to manipulate and corrupt others, often with no apparent end than to cause suffering and destruction.

His goal, as he stated when he was young, is to kill everyone that knows of his existence, and be the last one standing at the end of the world. He identifies with other killers, discovering their secrets. One of the themes of Monster is how individuals are capable of transforming into monsters; Johan often acts as both a direct and indirect catalyst for this transformation.

name: Heinrich Runge
native: ハインリッヒ・ルンゲ
description: Inspector Runge is a dedicated detective belonging to the BKA, which is like the FBI of Germany. When [Dr. Tenma](https://anilist.co/character/718/Tenma-Kenzou) is accused of murder in Düsseldorf, Inspector Runge is assigned to Tenma's case. Runge moves his hand to "store" information from his cases. He has such a successful track record for solving his cases that he believes that he can't be wrong.

name: Kenzou Tenma
description: Doctor Kenzo Tenma is a Japanese neurosurgeon working at the Eisler Memorial Hospital in Düsseldorf. At the beginning of Monster he is favored by the department director for his prodigious surgical skill. After a crisis of conscience, he chooses to save the life of a young boy instead of the city's mayor, and is unjustly demoted as a result; he then becomes suspect for murder when the department director and several prominent doctors are killed weeks later. It is only after nine years that Dr. Tenma learns the perpetrator of the hospital murders is none other than the boy he saved years before, [Johan Liebert](https://anilist.co/character/719). Plagued by guilt, he resolves to find Johan and end the life of this "monster" he feels responsible for creating. Despite his mission, Dr. Tenma is a humanitarian who genuinely cares about the lives of others. These acts of kindness make him very influential with the people he meets.

name: Dieter
description:
Dieter is a young boy when found by [Tenma](https://anilist.co/character/718/Tenma-Kenzou) to be under the care of a man named [Hartmann](https://anilist.co/character/166955/Hartmann). Upon meeting Dieter, Tenma notices that the young boy is covered in bruises. It turns out that Hartmann was trying to make Dieter into another [Johan](https://anilist.co/character/719/Liebert-Johan), a kind of leader that had not been produced from 511 Kinderheim before.

Dieter later becomes more optimistic after being saved by Doctor Tenma from Hartmann's physical and mental abuse. He follows Doctor Tenma in his search for Johan, partially to prevent Tenma from becoming a murderer, but also because he is fond of Tenma.

He later teams up with [Nina](https://anilist.co/character/720/Liebert-Anna), to give her moral support whenever her traumatic memories resurface as he was also subjected to similar abuse.

name: Wolfgang Grimmer
native: ヴォルフガング・グリマー
description: A freelance journalist who is researching Kinderheim 511; he is also soon drawn into the search for [Johan](https://anilist.co/character/719), as he decides to help [Tenma](https://anilist.co/character/718).

name: Roberto
description: A big, burly man and one of the many people from the orphanage 511 Kinderheim that [Johan](https://anilist.co/character/719/Liebert-Johan) controls. He admires Johan very much, and often acts as Johan's bodyguard and henchman. He is also a professional hitman with substantial proficiency.

name: Akanbou
description:
First mentioned in Chapter 25, the "Baby" is a short, elderly man, and an infamous Neo-Nazi leader. He worships Johan as an ideal Aryan leader who would be able to become the next Hitler to lead Germany into prominence. He also works for the four individuals who would gladly welcome Johan as a political leader. To this end, he hoped to use Nina as bait to coerce Johan, but also as a precautionary measure to protect him (and the other group members) from Johan. 

The characteristics of the "Baby" is heavily influenced by the character "[The Man from Another Place](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Man_from_Another_Place)" from [Twin Peaks](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Twin_Peaks). His first appearance, in Chapter 26/Episode 15, is also nearly identical, appearing to Nina Fortner from behind a red curtain (akin to the Black Lodge's waiting room) while dancing to the tune "Be My Baby".

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Helmut Wolf
native: ヘルムート・ヴォルフ
description: A very old soldier who was the first one to find the twins, he is the second of the four individuals behind the organization. He gave Johan his name, the name from the boy in the picture book called "The Monster without a Name". General Wolf is actually the only one of four individuals that did not want to make Johan a new Fuhrer. Wolf's family and acquaintances have all been killed by Johan, thus teaching him true loneliness as seen through Johan's eyes. He dies of natural causes, before he dies he begs Dr. Tenma to yell out his name as proof that he existed. First mentioned in Chapter 27, first seen in Chapter 29.    *Wikipedia

name: Aguero Agnis Khun
aliases: クン · アゲロ · アグネス
description:
__Species:__ Human
__Height:__ 170 cm
__Rank:__ Regular
__Position:__ Light Bearer

Khun Aguero Agnis is a E-Rank Regular from Khun Family, and is often referred to simply as "Khun". He is a best friend of [Twenty-Fifth Bam](https://anilist.co/character/84769/TwentyFifth-Bam), one of the main protagonists of Tower of God.

Khun relies heavily on his master intellect, however, this is not his only strong field. He also has exceptional physical attributes and is a skilled Light Bearer. His powers in combat cannot be denied.

name: Twenty-Fifth Baam
description:
__Species:__ Human
__Height:__ 168 cm (Part 1), 180 cm (Part II)
__Rank:__ Irregular
__Position:__ Wave Controller
__Born:__  __Occupation:__  

Twenty-Fifth Baam is an Irregular and one of the main protagonists of Tower of God. Bam entered in search of his best friend [Rachel](https://anilist.co/character/135466/Rachel), and after passing Headon's test he was deemed worthy to climb the Tower.

In Part I, he is a highly empathetic and caring young man, understanding little of life, having had virtually no contact with people before meeting Rachel and later entering the Tower. He hates loneliness and other people's loneliness. He is considered very naive and knows little about the Tower. During Part I, his only reason for climbing the Tower is to be with Rachel.

In Part II:



In Part III:

name: Rachel
description:
__Species:__ Human
__Rank:__ Extra

Rachel, also known as Michelle Light was Baam's best and only friend as she was the only one to visit him in his "cave". She longs to see the stars which is one of the fabled rewards waiting at the top of the Tower, because she "fears the Night".

name: Rak Wraithraiser
aliases: ラーク・レクレイシャー
description:
__Species:__ Wraithraiser, 
__Height:__ 3m (Decompressed)
__Rank:__ Regular C-Rank
__Position:__ Spear Bearer

Rak Wraithraiser is a Regular. He unwillingly teamed up with [Baam](https://anilist.co/character/84769/TwentyFifth-Baam) and [Khun](https://anilist.co/character/84781/Khun-Aguero-Agnis) during the first test on the Second Floor and passed other tests with them. He was selected for the Spear Bearer position. He is a large and powerful warrior and a very confident individual.
Rak is originally a 3 meter tall creature, but after he mocked the Ranker [Yu Han Sung](https://anilist.co/character/141286/Sung-Yu-Han), the Second Floor Test Director, his body was shrunken by them. He eventually found out how to get back to his original size. As a being who can control their body size, he is a Compression Licenser.He is a direct descendant of the Native One, a type of being that is able to rule over the elements in the Tower. 

Rak doesn't come off as particularly smart; he thinks he's superior to almost everyone else and so refers to other people as "turtles". He occasionally calls himself "Rakleader" when he is feeling particularly full of himself, although Khun may be to blame for indulging him. He tries to make himself appear tough, although he's actually a bit of a baby sometimes. However, he does seem to have a little of a caring side in him.

name: Shibisu
description: Shibisu is a D-rank Regular. He is relatively weak, yet possesses a great ability to deduce and an intellect on par with Khun's. Nonetheless, he made it past all of the tests on the Second Floor, where he was assigned the Scout position and is now climbing the Tower as the leader of his team.

name: Catan
description: Catan is a Regular assigned to the Scout Position.

name: Hyun Seung
description: Hyun Seung is a Regular who was assigned to the Spear Bearer position.

name: Baunian
description: Baunian is a Regular assigned to the Light Bearer position.

name: Kukaku Rakukakuka
description: Kukaku Rakukakuka is a Regular who participated on the 2nd Floor tests. He was one of the people who were "stored" in Khun's bag throughout the first "Deathmatch" Test. He participated in the Crown Game with his teammates Blarouse and Grey, and helped Khun by attacking the other Regulars. He was then assigned to the Light Bearer position.

name: Yu Han Sung
description: Yu Han Sung is an Advanced Ranker and the former Test Director of the Second Floor. Notably, he is a key member of FUG in taking Viole to the top. He is the main antagonist of Part I. He is a well known ranker partly because he rejected becoming a High Ranker.

name: Kinrou
description:
Kinrou is the elder brother of [Ginrou](https://anilist.co/character/143270/Ginrou) and the son of Tetsuken and Shirogane. Originally having served as one of the guards of Ishigami Village alongside Ginrou, he quickly joined [Senku](https://anilist.co/character/124142/Ishigami-Senkuu) as a member of the Kingdom of Science. 

Kinrou is a muscular young man of average height, with a scar on the right side of his face and a cluster of hair hanging in between his eyes. He wears a sleeveless karate gi-like uniform with a belt and a buckler with a star pattern on his back. After the Grand Bout, Kinrou begins wearing a pair of glasses to correct his nearsightedness.

name: Hyouga
description:
__Height:__ 189cm (6'2")

Hyoga is a survivor who was revived by Tsukasa Shishio. Initially, he was an elite member of the Tsukasa Empire since he was depetrified by Tsukasa.



Hyoga has an easy going attitude towards everything. Even in situation that do not work in his favour, he still remains calm. While he claims to share the same values as Tsukasa when it comes to only reviving the young and creating a community where no one takes from others, Hyoga himself is an elitist who believes in social darwinism. He categorizes humans as either enlightened (or strong) and unenlightened (or weak). He believes that the "brainless incompetent masses" should not be allowed to live and that only those who excel should be allowed to live. While he does follow a form of social darwinism, he does not believe it is only the physically strong who should survive, as he wanted Senku to join him in his endeavors and become the strongest duo, indicating he respected Senku's intelligence and understood his capabilities. He is very manipulative and cunning, seems to be observant, and can often be cruel, merciless, and uncaring. He tends to refer to things as being done "properly" or not.

name: Tetsuya Kinomoto
description:
__Height:__ 155 cm

A modern member of the Kingdom of Science. He was a manga artist prior to the Petrification. He was revived to test the feasibility of reviving a broken statue, and was later tasked with helping bring back entertainment to the Stone World.

name: Ukyou Saionji
description:
__Height:__ 173 cm (5'8")

Ukyou is a survivor that was revived by [Tsukasa Shishiou](https://anilist.co/character/124144/Tsukasa-Shishiou). He is pacifistic and dislikes needless bloodshed.

name: Homura Momiji
description:
__Height:__ 145 cm (4'9")

Homura acts as the right-hand man of [Hyouga](https://anilist.co/character/145062/Hyouga) in [Tsukasa](https://anilist.co/character/124144/Tsukasa-Shishiou)'s army. She was a competitive gymnast before the petrification.

name: Asa Mitaka
description:
Asa Mitaka is an antisocial student. She isn't seen having interest in making friends nor talking to many people during school hours. She struggles to do the right thing, constantly weighing the circumstances and her own morals to decide the “right” choice, often figuratively and literally tripping over herself in situations. She wishes to live more selfishly. 

She has a hate for the infamous [Chainsaw Man](https://anilist.co/character/130102/Denji) and [Kokepii (Bucky, Chicken Devil)](https://anilist.co/character/282388/Kokepii) that is loved by mostly everyone around her, which had put her at odds with her peers.

name: Yoru
description:
Yoru is the War Devil and a member of the Four Horsemen, who now occupies [Asa Mitaka](https://anilist.co/character/282389/Asa-Mitaka). Before inhabiting Asa's body, her appearance was that of a bird, largely resembling a potoo.

Yoru is first seen on top of a traffic light a few seconds prior to Asa Mitaka's death by the [Class President](https://anilist.co/character/282391/Gakkyuu-Iinchou)'s Justice Devil Form. She resurrects Asa in exchange for inhabiting her body, leaving half her brain intact to keep her alive.

name: Kusakabe
description:
__Devil Contract:__ Stone Devil

Kusakabe is a Devil Hunter from Miyagi Public Safety Devil Extermination Division 2.

name: Nyaako
description: [Power](https://anilist.co/character/137079/Power)'s cat.

name: Kanna Kamui
description: [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970)'s friend from the dragon realm who got exiled from her world and wound up living with [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969) as well. She is very young by dragon standards, equivalent to a primary school student, which she attends as a third-year student bearing Kobayashi's surname later in the series. She initially assumes that Kobayashi seduced Tohru into staying and wanted her to return to their original world.  Kanna's basis and tribal attire are inspired by the culture of the indigenous natives of Hokkaido and claims to be from Ushishir. She bears feather-like horns and a thin tail ending in a bulb, and is capable of charging with electricity.

appearsIn.title: Miss Kobayashi's Dragon Maid: Valentines and Hot Springs! (Please Don't Get Your Hopes Up)

name: Tohru
description:
__Faction__: Chaos
__Relatives__: [Damocles](https://anilist.co/character/172721/Damocles) (father)

Tohru is a female dragon with the ability to transform into a human girl. After [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969/Kobayashi) rescues her, she falls in love with her and decides to work for her as a maid.

As a Chaos Dragon, Tohru was raised to hate humans and was supposed to be a fierce and dangerous force of evil with nothing other than destruction in mind. However, this all changed when she met Kobayashi. She is now cheerful and kind to every human she meets, except for those who are real, or as it is in most cases, imaginary, threats to her love interest Kobayashi (such as [Makoto Takiya](https://anilist.co/character/120976/Makoto-Takiya)). She is also quickly influenced by what she sees on television or the internet and shares a fiery relationship with her rival, [Elma](https://anilist.co/character/120977/Elma).

As Kobayashi's maid, Tohru is a hard worker and cares deeply for the household, tending to all aspects of daily life, although this will often lead to trouble, such as when Tohru tries to feed her tail to Kobayashi, or when she molests Kobayashi's dirty laundry. Still, Kobayashi always shows her appreciation for Tohru's efforts and does her best to guide Tohru in the ways of modern life and human culture on Earth.

appearsIn.title: Miss Kobayashi's Dragon Maid: Valentines and Hot Springs! (Please Don't Get Your Hopes Up)

name: Kobayashi
description:
Kobayashi is a computer programmer and office worker. She finds herself living with a dragon named [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970/Tohru).

Even though Kobayashi maintains a cool demeanor, she has been regarded as kind-hearted and reliable among her friends and colleagues. Level-headed and pragmatic, she stands as the source of reason when dealing with her dragon friends. However, when intoxicated, she tends to become rowdy and aggressive, especially in her interests in maids, and is not above subjecting Tohru to her drunken whims.

Before meeting Tohru, Kobayashi would don a stoic expression on her face. Now, she is more approachable and open to others, often seen smiling contentedly. Kobayashi often chastised Tohru for her lack of propriety on human standards. However, as time passes by, she grows accustomed to Tohru's quirks and would sometimes show small signs of affection and gratitude for the dragon, such as holding Tohru's hand or going out of her way to fulfill some of Tohru's wishes to ease her troubles.

appearsIn.title: Miss Kobayashi's Dragon Maid: Valentines and Hot Springs! (Please Don't Get Your Hopes Up)

name: Georgie Saikawa
description:
**Relatives**: [Riko Saikawa](https://anilist.co/character/120972/Riko-Saikawa) (younger sister), unnamed parents

Georgie Saikawa is the older sister of Riko Saikawa. Her real name is Nae Saikawa (才川苗). She likes to pretend to be a housemaid.

Georgie wears an orange polka-dot maid outfit with a white apron. She also has a white cap and has her red hair in twin-pigtails. Her stockings are black striped.

Georgie is a sweet and gentle lady. She always supports Riko and her family. She seems to know a lot about maids and has a huge passion for them. She mentions that she's wanted to be one since she was a kid when she read a book about maids, but no one accepted her job offers, so decided to be one for her family.

Georgie and [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969/Kobayashi) automatically have a close bond as they both share an interest in maids. [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970/Tohru) isn't fond of her and shows jealousy as she sees her as a rival through impersonating as a maid to win over Kobayashi.

(Source: Miss Kobayashi's Dragon Maid Wiki, edited)

name: Shouta Magatsuchi
description:
__Relatives:__ [Mr. Magatsuchi](https://anilist.co/character/248474) (father), Saori Magatsuchi (mother)

Shouta Magatsuchi is a young boy born into a family of mages in the modern world. He has shown to possess enough knowledge on the arcane arts to attempt summoning a demon. [Lucoa](https://anilist.co/character/120975) came out of a summoning portal Shouta created and starts living with him.

Shouta is an elementary school boy in 5th grade with both purple hair and eyes. His bangs reach well below his eyebrows. His appearance looks partly androgynous.

Shouta is quiet and shy most of the time when seen with Lucoa. When Lucoa attempts to seduce Shouta, he would run away with embarrassment and accuse Lucoa of being a demon.

As his father is [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969)'s manager, she's asked to look after Shouta at times.

appearsIn.title: Miss Kobayashi's Dragon Maid: Valentines and Hot Springs! (Please Don't Get Your Hopes Up)

name: Fafnir
description: An old friend of [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970/Tohru), he is a male dragon with a strong distrust for humans which leads to him questioning much of Tohru's actions and ideals in his earlier appearances. He shares some resemblance to the traits of his namesake, such as his cold demeanour and disdainful mentality. He appears as a refined young man with long black hair and red eyes in his human form.

appearsIn.title: Miss Kobayashi's Dragon Maid: Valentines and Hot Springs! (Please Don't Get Your Hopes Up)

name: Riko Saikawa
description:
**Relatives**: [Georgie Saikawa](https://anilist.co/character/120978/Georgie-Saikawa) (older sister)

Riko Saikawa is [Kanna's](https://anilist.co/character/120974/Kanna-Kamui) friend and classmate in elementary school. A running gag involves her becoming overwhelmingly flushed with bliss every time she and Kanna make physical contact, along with her shiny forehead.

At first glance, Riko seems bossy and mean, but over time, she seems nicer as shown with Kanna, and very polite around people like [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969/Kobayashi), although she originally mistook Kobayashi for Kanna's mother. She has a crush on Kanna and enjoys being around her. When being touched by Kanna or when she receives praise from her, she tends to grin goofily and get red in the face, becoming overwhelmed with excitement.

Though she initially tries to pick a fight with Kanna for her sudden popularity on the first day of her transfer to the school, she quickly becomes good friends with her. They often spend time with each other, walking home together from school and picking the other as their partner during school activities.

appearsIn.title: Miss Kobayashi's Dragon Maid: Valentines and Hot Springs! (Please Don't Get Your Hopes Up)

name: Damocles
description:
Damocles is the father of Tohru and is known as the Emperor of Demise and is considered one of the strongest dragons shown.
Damocles is callous and stern, hating humans and viewing them as inferior and evil - a belief he tried to impart on Tohru. However, unlike other Chaos Dragons, he respects the non-interference laws preventing dragons from killing humans of Earth, although when angered, he attacks Kobayashi and threatens to leave her at the brink of death. Despite this, he cares for his daughter and is concerned for her safety and happiness.

description: Yana is one of Kobayashi's neighbors.

[Ai Hoshino's](https://anilist.co/character/172759/Ai-Hoshino) son. He is the twin big brother of [Ruby Hoshino](https://anilist.co/character/183884/Ruby-Hoshino).

name: Ruby Hoshino
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm (5'2")

[Ai Hoshino's](https://anilist.co/character/172759/Ai-Hoshino) daughter, and the younger twin sister of [Aquamarine Hoshino](https://anilist.co/character/183885).

name: Kana Arima
description:
__Height:__ 150 cm (4'11")

An actress who was called a prodigy child. She has a rather stubborn personality yet an empathic side to her. She easily succumbs to pressure and while she does put up a front to others, she has very self-deprecating thoughts when it comes to her abilities. She's an honest and earnest person, who is very diligent and persistent even in the roughest of times. Also, she tends to place all responsibility on herself when it comes to others as she is the one who has the most experience in the show business world. She also hates bell peppers.

name: Akane Kurokawa
description:
__Height:__ 163 cm (5'4")

Akane Kurokawa is a rising star actress from the Lalalie Theatrical Company. Although a shy and quiet person, she is very serious when it comes to creating a good performance. She does a deep examination of each role she is given, allowing her to perfectly portray the character's personality and motivations. Akane is introduced to [Aqua](https://anilist.co/character/183885) as a fellow cast member on the set of the reality dating show *The Beginning of My Love With An Idol*.

name: Ai Hoshino
description:
__Height__: 151 cm (4'11")

She's an idol and lead of B-Komachi, an idol group affiliated with Strawberry Productions. Her life took a turn when through an undetermined amount of time, she became pregnant with twins. Not wanting to squander her reputation, she and her team decide to hide this fact; having to play the role of idol and mother.

name: MEM-cho
description:
__Height:__ 155 cm (5'1")

A girl who strived to become an idol at a young age, but due to her family situation, made sacrifices that ultimately ended with her becoming too old to become one. She is a YouTuber.

name: Miyako Saitou
description: Miyako is married to [the president](https://anilist.co/character/245521) of Ichigo Productions and is [Ai's](https://anilist.co/character/172759) manager. She is a shallow woman who appears to have only married her husband due to the prospect of working with hot guys. She is also a babysitter to the twins.

name: Frill Shiranui
description: Frill Shiranui is a student in Ruby Hoshino's class. She is a multi-talented performer who can sing, dance, and act. At first, Ruby is in awe of her, yet they eventually become friends.

name: Taishi Gotanda
description: Taishi Gotanda is a movie director, and the "mentor" of [Aquamarine Hoshino](https://anilist.co/character/183885/Aquamarine-Hoshino). He still lives with his [mother](https://anilist.co/character/302910).

name: Ichigo Saitou
description: Ichigo Saitou is the director of the agency Ichigo Production. He is the one who scouted [Ai](https://anilist.co/character/172759/Ai-Hoshino) and made her a star.

name: Bond
description: Bond is the recently adopted pet of the Forger Family. Formally known as Subject 8, Bond has been used for experiments that resulted in the dog gaining precognition abilities.

name: Becky Blackbell
native: ベッキー・ブラックベル
description:
__Affiliation:__ Blackbell Family, Blackbell Heavy Industries, Eden Academy, Cecile Hall
__Occupation:__ Student

The daughter of the CEO of Blackbell, a major military manufacturer. Attends Eden Academy as part of Cecil House, Group 3. Best friends with [Anya Forger](https://anilist.co/character/138100/Forger-Anya).

Becky is a very kind child but with her being the daughter of a major military manufacturer, she is shown to be somewhat prideful and tries to be mature, attempting to take Anya under her wing as an act of benevolence when she views Anya as a brat. She does not attempt to get close to [Damian Desmond](https://anilist.co/character/150424/Desmond-Damian) despite his social position, even looking down on their classmates who try to befriend Damian and Anya who is initially bullied by Damian's group. Anya's confident smile later wins over Becky's admiration.

name: Damian Desmond
native: ダミアン・デズモンド
description:
__Height:__ 110 cm (3′7″)
__Affiliation:__ Desmond Family, Eden Academy, Cecile Hall
__Occupation:__ Student

The second son of [Donovan Desmond](https://anilist.co/character/180192/Desmond-Donovan) and attends Eden Academy as part of Cecile House, Group 3.  

A young child with an arrogant and rude personality, caused by him being the second son of Donovan Desmond, the leader of the National Unity Party, a group important and powerful enough to threaten the peace between the East and the West. This has caused Damian to gain a highly respected status among his peers and making him incredibly arrogant, assuming [Anya](https://anilist.co/character/138100/Forger-Anya) gained a crush on him when she stared at him. He is shown to prefer being called Lord Damian when spoken to. He gets angry when he is looked down upon by Anya's smile, quickly resorting to insulting her with his limited vocabulary and harassing Anya.

name: Sylvia Sherwood
native: シルヴィア・シャーウッド
description:
__Height:__ 173 cm

She is [Twilight](https://anilist.co/character/138101/Forger-Loid)'s main contact at WISE.

name: Franky Franklin
native: フランキー・フランクリン
description:
__Height:__ 166 cm (5′5")
__Affiliation:__ Ostania
__Occupation:__ Tobacco Store Clerk (False Front), Informant, Soldier (formerly)

Franky is an informant who seemingly works at a tobacco store and presumably works for Loid Forger's agency. He gets information regarding Eden Academy's exam and Anya Forger's past records for Loid Forger.

Franky is a kind person willing to help Loid out when he's in a pinch even though the danger is high. He frequently warns Loid Forger not to get too close to other people in their line of work.

He frequently falls in love with other women but his love life typically fails due to lack of mutual interest or they are already with someone else.

name: Henry Henderson
native: ヘンリー・ヘンダーソン
description:
__Affiliation:__ Eden Academy
__Occupation:__ History Teacher, Housemaster of Cecile Hall

Henry is a mature and noble person, who places a high importance on "elegance". To him, elegance seems to be the way a person conducts themselves, and is not afraid to correct inelegant behavior in others.

name: Shinoa Hiiragi
description:
__Height:__ 150 cm (4'11")

Shinoa Hiiragi is Guren's sergeant and one of the squad leaders of the Moon Demon Company. She is appointed to supervise [Yuuichirou](https://anilist.co/character/83015/Hyakuya-Yuuichirou) during his suspension from the Japanese Imperial Demon Army for his reckless behavior. She is sarcastic and enjoys teasing others, especially Yuuichirou. 

Her Demon Weapon is Shikama Douji (Four-Scythe Child), a manifestation-type demon weapon which takes the form of a large scythe, but can be condensed into a pen-like object. She can call out the demon, which she fondly addresses as "Shi," inhabiting it out of the weapon to attack an enemy. Her primary ability is to detect anything that comes within the attack radius of her scythe.

Despite being a member of the distinguished Hiiragi family, Shinoa is uninterested in their internal power struggle. Moreover, due to her sister's legacy, she is generally shunned by the upper echelon of the army. However, she is loyal to Guren and to the members of her squad. 

A childhood lacking in familial warmth left Shinoa with little understanding of the importance of friendship and camaraderie. She is moved by Yuuichirou's unwavering loyalty to the members of his squad, who he considers his family, and wants to foster the same feelings for them herself.

He is a Lieutenant Colonel of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army and the commanding officer of the Vampire Extermination Unit, Moon Demon Company.

Guren would become a wise leader who values teamwork, co-operation and friends, and determined those were necessary to ensure the survival of the human race from demons and vampires. Sometimes pretending to be lazy, in truth, he really works hard. He keeps many secrets to himself, and has no difficulty lying about them. When enduring hardships in battle, he will focus on winning and take the most direct path to that.

Mitsuba is shown to be a serious and by-the-book soldier, who dislikes those who break the formation and commit to individual action. In reality, she is a talkative, selfish girl. Despite this, she gets jealous easily. Mitsuba appears to be the most talkative girl in her group.

He, along with [Yuuichirou Hyakuya](https://anilist.co/character/83015/Hyakuya-Yuuichirou), possesses the "Seraph" gene, which is relevant to the forbidden taboo and the focal point of the story, "Seraph of the End."

description:
__Height:__ 177 cm (5'9")
__Race__: Human

Kimizuki is a serious and diligent person. He is competitive against Yuuichirou Hyakuya. He earned the highest test scores in their class, and he is angry when Yuuichirou appears out of nowhere and may earn Cursed Gear before him. He is hot-headed and tends to get in fights with both Mitsuba and Yuuichirou.

He is tidy and skilled at cooking. When his friends are unconscious or injured, he is the first to take care of them, whether it be nursing them or giving them his jacket to keep them warm.

Although the other members of his squad quickly refer to each other on a first-name basis, he is the only member the others address with his surname. Kimizuki has very high intelligence and was at the top of his class in all subjects, and regularly earned perfect scores. He earned 100s on each of his Latin, English, and Japanese spellcraft exams. He is on par with Yuichiro on skills of swordsmanship.

He is a member of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army and Shinoa Hīragi's squad in the Moon Demon Company.

Yoichi has an equilibrium of kindness and altruism, giving him an optimistic and sweet personality. This gives him a strong mental balance against his demon, who takes the form of his sister. He lacked passion to kill vampires and fight and avenge his sister originally, but as he got to know his new "family", he began to see the reason that he was there. Yoichi does dislike conflict amongst friends, but conflict on the battle field doesn't bother him anymore. As time passed, Yoichi is shown to be much more confident with his skills, sniping down three Horsemen at ease by himself.

Yoichi is usually the peace maker around Shinoa's Squad. Yuichiro and Kimizuki are usually fighting, and Yoichi often ends up in the middle of it. He has developed a love for his "family" that impacted his personality greatly. He used to get very nervous and stutter a lot, but the closer he got to the Squad, the more confident he got. He doesn't question his self-worth as much as before, and instead focuses more on protecting his new "family".

description:
He is a familiar who can grant any wish to a certain girl, on the condition that she becomes a Puella Magi and fights against witches. 


__Major Spoiler:__

appearsIn.title: Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie -Rebellion-

name: Homura Akemi
description:
__Height:__ 155 - 158 cm

Homura is a magical girl who first appears in an apocalyptic nightmare of [Madoka](https://anilist.co/character/37832)'s. She transfers into her school the day after the dream. She is a beautiful, mysterious individual that performs exceptionally well in academics and athletics. This makes her instantly popular even though she is cold to others. She seems to know Madoka well and wishes to prevent her from becoming a magical girl. She attacks [Kyuubey](https://anilist.co/character/38566) in the first episode, only to be stopped by [Mami](https://anilist.co/character/38194).



Homura's prominently black design is sinister and mysterious, fitting with how the series is slow at revealing her motives. Her ambiguity is further amplified by her dull, purple eyes. Whereas the rest of the cast had vibrant, same-color eyes, Homura's show internal conflict (purple is a mix of red and blue) and trauma. She has a cold design and personality, with her monotone voice and dark color palette. Her eyes are similar to Mami's, which hints towards Homura putting up a facade when she's actually quite fragile, hinting towards a past event that turned Homura into who she is.

appearsIn.title: Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie -Rebellion-

name: Madoka Kaname
description:
__Height:__ 152 cm (5'0")

A 14-year-old girl whose life changes when she encounters the Puella Magi Homura and the familiar Kyuubey, who offers to transform her into a Puella Magi herself. She sees herself as a person without special qualities or talents, and after seeing Mami fighting against witches, wants to be a wonderful and cool Puella Magi like her. She is a rather selfless girl who wishes to be a magical girl simply so that she can help others. She allegedly has a large amount of magical potential within her. 

Madoka's heavily pink character design evokes a sense of child-like innocence and femininity. Her age and naive attitude is further implied with her pigtail haircut. Her immaturity is exemplified with props several times, such as when she brought an impractical sketchbook to a witch hunt, which is something you'd expect a child to do.

appearsIn.title: Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie -Rebellion-

name: Sayaka Miki
description:
__Height:__ 158-160 cm
__Weapon:__ Cutlass

[Madoka](https://anilist.co/character/37832/Kaname-Madoka)'s classmate who, after helping Madoka rescue [Kyuubey](https://anilist.co/character/38566/Kyuubey), ends up getting an offer to become a Puella Magi herself. She cares deeply for her friends, and wants to help an ill boy named [Kyousuke Kamijou](https://anilist.co/character/39835/Kamijou-Kyousuke), whom she has a crush on. Before becoming a Puella Magi, Sayaka wields a baseball bat that [Mami](https://anilist.co/character/38194/Tomoe-Mami) can enhance with magic to defend herself with while on witch hunts.



Sayaka's design is prominently blue, which makes her appear heroic and 'just', further reinforced by her wearing a white cape, symbolic for goodness and purity. Aside from her color scheme conveying her being a hero who fights for justice, it also foreshadows  Sayaka also noticeably differs from the rest of the cast with her short hair. Again amplified with traditionally male aspects of her design, Sayaka is a tomboy. She would, for instance, bring a baseball bat on the girls' first hunt, whereas the traditionally feminine Madoka brought a notebook. 

Sayaka has tareme eyes, symbolizing fragility and sadness. Although this might look like it contradicts Sayaka's personality, it foreshadows

appearsIn.title: Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie -Rebellion-

name: Kyouko Sakura
description:
__Height:__ 156-158 cm
__Weapon:__ Spear

Kyouko is a veteran magical girl who comes to the city later in the story. Amusingly, she is always seen eating something, even while she is battling. 
 
Having grown up in a poor family, she often has to steal food and hates people who waste it, a logic she also applies to Grief Seeds, as she only goes after fully grown witches. Kyouko has been a Puella Magi much longer than the others, and thus is more skillful; she wields a spear which can extend itself, split into multiple sections, and produce a ball at the end of a chain, which can constrict and hit others at the same time. She also has the ability to put up barriers to protect others or keep them from interfering. She initially clashes with Sayaka, but after learning the truth about Soul Gems, she sympathizes with her and tries to help her.

appearsIn.title: Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie -Rebellion-

name: Mami Tomoe
description:
__Height:__ 156-159 cm 

Mami Tomoe is a veteran magical girl and a third-year student at Madoka's school. She lives alone in a penthouse after her parents were killed in a car crash, which Mami survived after contracting with Kyuubey. Mami is particularly focused on saving, guiding, and protecting those around her, which is a traditionally selfless perspective on the role of magical girl. She is much like a maternal figure to Madoka and Sayaka, being the eldest among them. Her name could be considered a play on the word 'mommy', further supported in the third film, where she has a companion named "Bebe". Though Mami's outward disposition is cheery and confident, Mami feels deeply alone as she has no friends to confide in as she fights.

She and Madoka are close, and she cares for her daughter very much, but ultimately lets her go when she tells her there's something she has to do on Walpurgis Nacht.
