name: Yoichi Isagi
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm (5'9")

Second-year high school student at Ichinan High School in Saitama. Isagi grew up watching soccer and aspiring to be like [Noel Noa](https://anilist.co/character/268966), a forward for France's National Team. Due to this, he dreams of becoming the best striker in the world. In turn, Isagi played striker for his school soccer team, who was defeated in the Prefectural Finals by Matsukaze Kokou High. After this loss, Isagi is invited to participate in the Blue Lock Project, ranked 299th of 300 strikers, and is assigned to Team Z.

Isagi is easygoing and has a generally friendly, cheery personality, but his simple and innocent habits often get on the nerves of the people around him. As time goes on, Isagi develops a more assertive presence on and off the field, becoming the foundation for Team Z and garnering the respect of some of the best players in Blue Lock.

name: Seishirou Nagi
description:
__Height:__ 190 cm (6'3")

Contender for the Blue Lock Project. He attends Hakuho High School alongside [Reo Mikage](https://anilist.co/character/169394/Mikage-Reo). As a striker, Nagi's perfect ball control, flexible movements, and technical ability allow him to breathe life into even the most difficult or hopeless plays.

Nagi is a very lazy and unmotivated person with an outstanding aptitude for football. He's unnaturally talented, with amazing reflexes, good speed, and jumping skills. He has no interest in going pro or even playing at all at first. As long as he can get a decent job and keep living a lax life, he is content with doing nothing forever and often appears lethargic in his speech and body language. Introverted to a fault, he lives by himself in an apartment his parents pay for with only a pet cactus for company.

name: Rin Itoshi
description:
__Height:__ 186 cm (6'1")

First-year high school student and contender for the Blue Lock Project. He is the younger brother of [Sae Itoshi](https://anilist.co/character/169397/Itoshi-Sae), a prodigy considered one of the best youth soccer players in the world. Rin once had the aspiration of being the greatest in the world alongside his brother, but after a disagreement, he became obsessed with beating his brother in football to demonstrate he can succeed without him.

Rin is a player who loves to play perfectly efficient football but isn’t hesitant to be daring and take surprising risks to fully embrace the live-or-die attitude he has grown fond of and appreciates. Whether on offense or defense, Rin's play style consists of him grasping the abilities of both his teammates and his opponents and forcing out their best plays and abilities. He either manipulates them in his efforts to score goals for himself or aims to crush them at their strongest.

name: Jinpachi Ego
description:
__Height:__ 189 cm (6'2")

General Director/Manager of the Blue Lock Project, handpicked to lead the project by [Anri Teieri](https://anilist.co/character/169405). Ego is introduced as a man who radiates ambition and confidence. His egotistical nature is undeniable, especially given his belief that only his methods can lead to Japan's victory in the World Cup.

Ego used to play football in his earlier career, with Noel Noa being his rival and former teammate.

name: Hyouma Chigiri
description:
__Height:__ 177cm (5'10")

Hyoma Chigiri is a contender for the Blue Lock Project and member of Team Z. 

As a young child, he was thought of as a prodigy due to his incredible speed. However, he is now psychologically scarred by a life-changing injury during his first year of high school.

name: Meguru Bachira
description:
__Birthplace:__ Chiba
__Height:__ 176 cm (5'9")

Meguru Bachira is a contender in the Blue Lock Project who currently plays as a center forward for Spain’s FC Barcha during the Neo Egoist League. Bachira is a whimsical forward who plays instinctively.

name: Rensuke Kunigami
description:
__Height:__ 188 cm
__Team:__ Team Z

Rensuke Kunigami is very serious about his football career and training; he's always the first in the training room in the morning and the last to leave at night. Kunigami tends to get into arguments with [Raichi](https://anilist.co/character/169402/Raichi-Jingo), but is also the one who restrains him the most when he picks a fight with someone.

name: Reo Mikage
description:
**Height:** 185 cm

Reo Mikage is the heir of the Mikage Corporation. Prior to entering Blue Lock, he was a student at an elite high school, the same school as [Seishiro Nagi](https://anilist.co/character/162969/Nagi-Seishirou).

name: Shouei Barou
description: __Height:__ 187 cm

name: Anri Teieri
description:
__Height:__ 157cm (5'2")

Anri is a new member of the Japan Football Association. Sometime after the defeat of the Japanese National Team in the 2018 World Cup, Anri proposes the Blue Lock plan to the executives of the Japan Football Union to help Japan win the World Cup.

name: Maomao
description:
Maomao works as an apothecary in the red light district, helping her mentor and father [Luomen](https://anilist.co/character/261968) in caring for its residents, with special attention given to the Verdigris Hall brothel, where she was born and was initially raised.

One day, while gathering herbs, she gets kidnapped and sold to be a common servant in the inner court of the imperial palace, where only the Emperor's consorts and their servants reside. Not allowed to leave, her curious personality and skills begin to rope her into mysterious problems that can affect the whole country.

name: Jinshi
description: Jinshi is the eunuch in charge of the affairs of the inner palace. He is described as having a face capable even of outshining the consorts in beauty, amazing women and men alike. He is constantly accompanied by his attendant [Gaoshun](https://anilist.co/character/244317/Gaoshun) and has taken an interest to [Maomao](https://anilist.co/character/126824/Maomao)'s intelligence and active demeanor.

name: Riishu
description: The Virtuous consort, residing in the Diamond Palace within the inner court. She was sent to be a high consort on the inner court as a young child because her prominent family was aware of the previous Emperor's pedophilic tendencies. When he died, she was allowed to leave as she was never visited by him, but her family arranged for her to return to her high consort position. Due to how young she is, she doesn't get any interest from the current Emperor, commands no respect, nor does she have any influence. She's very naive and gets bullied even by her own attendants.

name: Aaduo
description:
The Pure consort, residing in the Garner Palace within the inner court. She was the current Emperor's milk sibling and childhood crush, being just a year older than him. She became the previous Emperor's consort and gave birth to his child at 18, who was stillborn. The ordeal made her infertile, but circumstances between her and the royal family allowed her to keep her position as a High Consort.

She is very spartan on the outside yet has a motherly side to her.

name: Rifa
description: The Able consort, residing in the Crystal Palace within the inner court. The second most favoured consort of the Emperor, said to be so in big part due to her voluptuous chest. She gave birth to a boy who succumbed for unknown reasons and she herself is in grave health condition at the start of the story.

name: Gyokuyou
description: The Noble consort, residing in the Jade Palace within the inner court. Her red hair and green eyes distinguish her from the other consorts, that being part of the reasons she became the Emperor's favoured consort, having already given birth to a girl of his. Despite these circumstances, she is very careful of whom she keeps around so she has the smallest retinue of all the high consorts.

name: Gaoshun
description: Gaoshun is [Jinshi](https://anilist.co/character/127278/Jinshi)'s attendant. He's shown to be extremely dependable. A stern believer in deference to authority and proper etiquette, his disapproval is often splattered in his transparent facial expressions, even if he says nothing.

name: Meimei
description: Meimei is one of the Three Princesses of Verdigris Hall. She started as Fenshen's apprentice and, being somewhat cunning herself, inherited Fenshen's taste for strategy board games. She is the most attached to the brothel and the people within.

name: Hongniang
description: Lady Gyokuyou's head lady-in-waiting.

name: Pairin
description: Pairin is the oldest of the Three Princesses of Verdigris Hall. She loves men's bodies and dreams of being taken away by a muscular prince.

name: Shinei Nouzen
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm

Shinei Nouzen is the field commander of Spearhead Squadron. His Personal Name is Undertaker.
Having survived five years on the Eastern Front and the Special Reconnaissance Mission, he is considered one of the most elite Processors alive. Among the Eighty-Six, he is known as the Reaper of the Eastern Front. His ability to hear the voices of the Legion allows him to locate the Legion without the use of detection systems like radar.

Born on May 19th in Republic Year 351, Shin lived with his family in the First Sector of the Republic before the war with the Giadian Empire began. It is implied he lived a sheltered life, surrounded by "only kindness and affection". He also appeared to have developed his extrasensory ability early on, hearing "voices that spoke without words" from his family.

name: Vladilena Milizé
native: ヴラディレーナ・ミリーゼ
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm

Vladilena Milizé, more commonly known as Lena by her friends and as Handler One to her subordinates, is an elite Republic commissioned officer who rose to the rank of Major at the young age of 16. She is the commander of [Shinei Nouzen](https://anilist.co/character/141060/Nouzen-Shinei) and the Spearhead Squadron, whom she communicates with via the long-distance communication device known as the Para-RAID.

name: Haruto Keats
description: Haruto is the morale booster of the squadron, often times cheerful and joking.

name: Daiya Irma
description: Daiya is the leader of the fifth platoon. As an elite four-year veteran of the Eastern Battlefront, he has earned the personal name Black Dog. He and Anju have been in the same squadron since they were conscripted and are close friends.

name: Jerome Karlsthal
native: ジェローム・カールシュタール
description: He was Lena's superior in the Republic Armed Forces. Due to his close relationship with Lena's father, she thought of him as her uncle.

name: Lev Aldrecht
description: The chief mechanic of the Spearhead Squadron.

name: Raiden Shuga
description:
__Height:__ 185 cm

Raiden Shuga is the vice captain of Spearhead Squadron. As a First Lieutenant, he holds the position of operations commander of the Eighty-Sixth Strike Package and its 1st Armored Division should [Shin](https://anilist.co/character/141060/Nouzen-Shinei) be deemed unfit to command. His Personal Name is Wehrwolf. Having survived four years on the Eastern Front and the Special Reconnaissance Mission, he is considered one of the most elite Processors alive. As he spent three years with Shin prior to joining Spearhead Squadron, Raiden is the closest person to him in the squadron.

name: Kurena Kukumila
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm

Kurena Kukumila is a platoon leader of Eighty-Sixth Strike Package's Spearhead Squadron. She is the squadron's long-range specialist. Her Personal Name is Gunslinger. Having survived four years on the Eastern Front and the Special Reconnaissance Mission, she is considered one of the most elite Processors alive.

name: Fuutarou Uesugi
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm  (5'10'')

Fuutarou is the main protagonist of the 5-toubun no Hanayome series.

He is a student of the Asahiyama High School. He lives with his father, Isanari Uesugi, and younger sister, Raiha Uesugi, in a small apartment. He is a serious and hardworking high school student and a prodigy at the top of his grade. Because of his family's perpetual poverty, he takes up the offer to tutor the Nakano quintuplets.

Fuutarou is noted to have a big ego and high confidence. He is straightforward, tactless, and rude; but is actually capable of holding back his emotions. Despite that, Fuutarou could momentarily lose his composure when agitated and faced with unfavorable circumstances. He also initially did not like getting involved with other people's problems, finding them to be troublesome. Despite his tactlessness and crudeness, he is knowledgeable enough in knowing what to say in specific situations when thrown at him; rarely giving up when trying to achieve a specific objective.

Despite his egotistical nature, Fuutarou is very hardworking and has a very high amount of patience; especially when getting the attention of the quintuplets and tutoring them despite various amounts of failures and setbacks. He later on shows a sense of duty strong enough to help the quintuplets in their studies despite them not paying him immediately, even though the money that came with tutoring was the initial reason he accepted the job.

name: Ichika Nakano
description:
__Height__: 159 cm (5'2")

First sister of the Nakano Quintuplets. Despite the negligible age difference among them, she took the role of the eldest sister properly. She is also trusted enough to act as their confidant and leader. Ichika aspires to become an actress. She likes to tease [Fuutarou](https://anilist.co/character/128063).

name: Nino Nakano
description:
**Height:** 159 cm (5'2")

Second sister of the Nakano quintuplets. She usually acts as the mother of the family, she cooks for them and takes care of their medical needs. Among the five sisters, she is the one who has the highest hostility towards [Fuutarou](https://anilist.co/character/128063/Uesugi-Fuutarou) and often rebels against him.

Nino has a sharp tongue and talks bluntly when confronting the others, even if the other party is her sister. She has an outgoing attitude and is socially aware, resulting in her having many friends. She is a scheming person and doesn't hesitate to use underhanded methods to achieve her goals.

name: Miku Nakano
description:
__Height:__ 159 cm (5'2")

Third sister of the Nakano Quintuplets. She is a silent and reserved girl. Miku tends to have a pessimistic attitude and little confidence regarding herself. Due to [Fuutarou](https://anilist.co/character/128063/Uesugi-Fuutarou)'s influence, she's the first among the sisters who open up to him.

Miku likes Japanese History (especially Generals from Sengoku Period) and greatly influenced by their philosophies, to the point of affecting her real-life behavior.

name: Yotsuba Nakano
description:
**Height:** 159 cm (5'2")

She is the fourth sister of the Nakano Quintuplets, and one of the main characters of the Quintessential Quintuplets series. Having a cheerful and energetic personality, she has a strong tendency of helping people out. Yotsuba is an active and easygoing girl. She is a type of person who can't say no to people who need help. She is also very physically fit, and is capable of tasks that her sisters can not do. She has excellent endurance and is great at sports. She's the only sister with excellent eyesight. She has a good sense of smell and a green thumb. Though she's great at physical activities, she has the lowest score out of all of her sisters.

Yotsuba is the only sister who accepts [Fuutarou](https://anilist.co/character/128063) since the beginning and wholeheartedly supports him in everything.

name: Itsuki Nakano
description:
**Height:** 159 cm (5'2")

Fifth sister of the Nakano Quintuplets. Itsuki is a serious and earnest girl. Her speech is formal and polite. She is also someone who can't be honest with herself and having difficulty to be more straightforward.

Among the sisters, Itsuki is the most familiar with [Uesugi](https://anilist.co/character/128063)'s family members and circumstances.

Note: Based on the character file in volume 14, Itsuki’s actual birthday is on May 6th as she was born at midnight. She celebrates her birthday on May 5th and prevents others from looking into it too deeply.

name: Raiha Uesugi
description: Fuutarou's cheerful younger sister. Being the only female and the most family-conscious she is effectively the head of the small household. Her cute facial expressions will often sway others' hearts. Appreciating the hard work Fuutarou does for their family, she sometimes delays the supper until his late return home so she can prepare his favourite meal.

name: Isanari Uesugi
description: Father of [Fuutarou](https://anilist.co/character/128063/Fuutarou-Uesugi) and [Raiha](https://anilist.co/character/130111/Raiha-Uesugi).

name: Maruo Nakano
description: Stepfather of the Nakano Quintuplets after their mother remarried, several years before the series begins. He runs a large hospital and is also a doctor.

name: Maeda
description:
Student of the Asahiyama High School.
Before the school camping trip, Maeda asked Ichika Nakano to see him in a class where he would ask her to dance with him at the bonfire dance.

name: Mujika
description: Mujika (or Musica) is a demon descent traveling in the forest outside the Grace Field House.

name: Jemima
description:
__Age (2045):__ 5 yo
__Farm Identifier:__ 31394 (Grace Field House)
__Height (2045-2049):__ 107 - 134 cm 

Jemima is cheerful and well-behaved. Though, she can display acts of mischievousness. She is seen to have a strong bond with [Alicia](https://anilist.co/character/199115).

name: Sobo
description: Grandmother is a high-ranking human and once worked as [Isabella's](https://anilist.co/character/121701/Isabella) Mama although she treated her more as a pawn than a human.

name: Cislo
description: Cislo is a former Lambda 7214 (aka Λ7214) experiment. His hobby is weight training, despite his looks he is easily moved to tears and he loves boss(Norman) . He was shipped to Lambda at age 12/13 from Goodwill Ridge, along with his close friend Barbara. Goodwill is one of the four premium farms.

name: Dominic
description:
__Farm Identifier:__ 07294 (Grace Field House)
__Height (2045-2049):__ 119 - 147 cm 

Dominic is an energetic and rather muscular young boy. He is very brave as well as caring towards others, and is willing to risk much to make sure everyone is safe.

name: Vylk
description: A blind demon.

name: Hakurou
description: Hakurou is a Fair Oni and is a loyal follower of Rimuru Tempest. He was one of the survivors of the Orc attack. He was also the teacher of the Dwarven King.

appearsIn.title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime Season 2
That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime Season 3
That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime Season 4

name: Suphia
description: Suphia, known as the White Tiger Claw, is one of Beast Kingdom Eurazania's Three Beastketeers. She is described as having a ferocious aura that has been likened to a "battle-hardened leader".

appearsIn.title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime Season 2

name: Souka
description: Gabil's younger sister, and the daughter of Abil. After the Orc Lord incident, she swears her allegeiance to Rimuru. She attends to Souei as a spy.

appearsIn.title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime Season 2
That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime the Movie: Scarlet Bond

name: Koby
description: A Dog Merchant

appearsIn.title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime Season 2

name: Edmaris Falmuth
native: エドマリス・ファルムス
description: The former king of the Kingdom of Falmuth.

appearsIn.title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime Season 2

name: Hinata Sakaguchi
description: Hinata Sakaguchi is an otherworlder and the leader of the Imperial Guards under the Pope's direct command. Along with Yuuki and Class S, she's a former student of Shizue Izawa.

appearsIn.title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime Season 2
That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime Season 4

name: Shouko Komi
description:
**Height**: 168 cm (later 169 cm)
**Position:** Goddess
**Relatives**: [Shousuke Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130870/Shousuke-Komi) (younger brother), [Shuuko Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130867/Shuuko-Komi) (mother), [Masayoshi Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130865/Masayoshi-Komi) (father), [Yuiko Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130875/Yuiko-Komi) (grandmother), [Akira Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130876/Akira-Komi) (cousin), [Sadayoshi Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130873/Sadayoshi-Komi) (uncle)

Shouko Komi is the main character of the series. Though she's regarded as the *Madonna* of their school, she's incapable of socializing with others to such a level where it can be called a communication disorder.

Shouko is described by her admirers as a girl with glossy dark purple/black hair that flows to her lower back, a slender body, and an incredibly beautiful face. She is usually seen wearing her school uniform.

Shouko hardly talks with people. She is unable to utter a word nor sound in her daily life due to her crippling anxiety and fear of rejection by her peers. She often writes whenever she can on her notebook and to the blackboard in class to answer people. She dreams of overcoming her adversity and desires to build friendly relationships with others and make 100 friends.

Shouko's first friend was [Hitohito Tadano](https://anilist.co/character/78093/Hitohito-Tadano). He was the first to discover her bad communication.

name: Hitohito Tadano
description:
**Height**: 168 cm (170.2 cm later)
**Position:** President
**Relatives**: [Hitomi Tadano](https://anilist.co/character/130878/Hitomi-Tadano) (younger sister)

Hitohito Tadano is a person average in almost every way. His name means, *just some guy*. He is the first to befriend [Shouko Komi](https://anilist.co/character/121956/Shouko-Komi).

Tadano is often described as an ordinary student with normal looks and average height and weight. His style of clothing is also considered to be relatively typical. His lone stand-out feature is the white cowlick in his black hair. When he was forced to cross-dress during the Cultural Festival, he was admired implicitly by the boys and Komi. His cross-dressing incorporates a short, red-haired girl's wig with pigtails.

Tadano suffered from chuunibyou in his second year of middle school. After confessing to a girl who immediately rejected him, he began to be self-conscious of his identity and drastically altered his style and outlook on life, making himself less noticeable to others. Almost everything about him - height, weight, appearance, academic achievements, athletic abilities, ice skating skills - is perfectly average. Despite his lack of talents, he's been shown to be good at observing and buying gifts for people.

On his first day of high school, he met Komi and was seated next to her. He later deduced that she had a communication disorder and became invested in helping her make 100 friends.

name: Himiko Agari
description: Himiko Agari is introduced as a shy insecure girl. She also runs a ramen shop review blog and considers herself a "ramen expert."

name: Najimi Osana
description:
**Position:** Vice President

Najimi is a mysterious student whose gender is unknown. They are talented enough at communicating to easily befriend someone within minutes of meeting them.

Growing up, Najimi was constantly transferring from one school to another, allowing them to make millions of friends.

name: Omoharu Nakanaka
description: A student who usually speaks in dubious speech as a result of being a chuunibyou. She states that she was Arsot Les Primavera and that [Shouko Komi](https://anilist.co/character/121956/) is Princess Komilia.

name: Ren Yamai
description: Ren Yamai is one of Komi Shouko's classmates from Class 1-1.

name: Makeru Yadano
description: Makeru Yadano is a competitive girl who likes to compete herself to Shouko.

name: Masayoshi Komi
description:
**Relatives**: [Yuiko Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130875) (mother), [Sadayoshi Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130873/Sadayoshi-Komi) (brother), [Shuuko Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130867/Shuuko-Komi) (wife), [Shouko Komi](https://anilist.co/character/121956) (daughter), [Shousuke Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130870/Shousuke-Komi) (son), [Akira Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130876/Akira-Komi) (niece)

Masayoshi Komi is Shouko's and Shousuke's father. He is seen as a dandy middle-aged man. Masayoshi rarely speaks and sometimes struggles to express himself verbally and can, at times, be easily flustered.

Complementary to his wife's youthful attitude, Masayoshi often appears mature and stoic. While he may come across as stern, he is often shown to be kind, considerate, and supportive.

Like his son, Masayoshi tends to make up for his lack of communication with strong actions and is generally talented in a variety of skills, including baking, woodworking, motorcycle riding, and sandcastle construction. Despite his stoic expression, he is adept at non-verbal communication and often holds silent conversations with his children, much to Shuuko's amusement.

name: Shuuko Komi
description:
**Relatives**: [Yuiko Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130875) (mother-in-law), [Masayoshi Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130865) (husband), [Sadayoshi Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130873/Sadayoshi-Komi) (brother-in-law), [Shouko Komi](https://anilist.co/character/121956) (daughter), [Shousuke Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130870/Shousuke-Komi) (son), [Akira Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130876/Akira-Komi) (niece)

Shuuko Komi, formerly known as Shuuko Nimi, is Shouko and Shousuke's mother. She looks like her daughter, but her personality is that of a teenager, claiming to be forever 17 years old. When despaired, she ages into *forever 18*

Corresponding to her son and daughter, Shuuko is considered beautiful. In contrast, she's very communicative and wonders how her family gets along despite not talking.

When young, she was bored of school and did not think much of Masayoshi until seeing him do various things on par with professionals. She slowly fell in love with him, despite his deadpan and silent demeanor.

(Source: Komi-san Wiki, edited)

name: Shousuke Komi
description:
**Relatives**: [Yuiko Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130875) (grandmother), [Masayoshi Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130865) (father), [Shuuko Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130867) (mother), [Sadayoshi Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130873/Sadayoshi-Komi) (uncle), [Ryouko Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130877/Ryouko-Komi) (aunt), [Shouko Komi](https://anilist.co/character/121956) (older sister), [Akira Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130876/Akira-Komi) (cousin)

Shousuke Komi is Shouko's younger brother. He's quiet most of the time but can converse well.

Shousuke has short trimmed hair and his eyes are usually hidden with his bangs. Still, his very appearance is similar to his mother and sister and can be referred to as a handsome man.

Shousuke appears to share many traits with his older sister, often choosing to remain silent and being widely popular among his peers as a result. Unlike Shouko, who stays quiet mainly because of her anxieties and problems communicating, Shousuke doesn't feel bothered talking, perfectly capable of communicating without speaking in the first place.

He is very apathetic, often neglecting to do anything he deems annoying or pointless, such as introducing himself to the class, instead opting to remain silent. In contrast to his sister, whose goal is to make friends, Shousuke seems to be perfectly content being by himself as he often flat-out ignores any classmates who invite him to eat lunch with them.

name: Fushi
gender: Male (in his main form; can be any)
description:
**Age:** 
**Relatives:** [The Beholder](https://anilist.co/character/136553/Kansatsusha) ("father"; creator), [March](https://anilist.co/character/136541/March) (adoptive "mother"), [Gugu](https://anilist.co/character/136554/Gugu) (adoptive brother)

Fushi is an immortal being created by The Beholder and placed on Earth to preserve the world.

Fushi is an immortal being that can take the form of anything that has given him stimuli. His original form was a featureless white sphere. Without consciousness, he copied the first thing he bumped into, which happened to be a rock. Soon afterward, he became moss and stayed like that for some time. When a wounded wolf wandered close in the middle of winter and died, the immortal copied the wolf. He retains the ability to turn into these things. Later, after the death of the [nameless boy](https://anilist.co/character/201555/Unnamed-Boy), he mimicked the boy's appearance and took the form of a young boy with white hair, a pale complexion, and green eyes. He wears a short, brown fur cloak and a light blue shirt and pants with fur boots. A rope dangled from his hand and neck as the nameless boy died holding [Joaan](https://anilist.co/character/163694/Joaan)'s leash, though the latter soon disappeared. Fushi commented on the form, saying it felt like it belonged to him the most.

Other than the nameless boy (whose form he usually defaults to), he can also take the form of many others; most notably:

name: March
description:
**Relatives:** Unnamed [mother](https://anilist.co/character/202865/March-no-Haha) & [father](https://anilist.co/character/201554/March-no-Chichi), [Risa](https://anilist.co/character/202890/Risa) (baby sibling)

March is a young girl from Ninannah. When running away from her village, she stumbles across [Fushi](https://anilist.co/character/136548/Fushi) near a pond.

March is very skilled at climbing trees. She's also small enough where she can easily crawl through tight spaces adults can't.

March was born in the village of Ninannah. Years later, she is chosen as a sacrifice to the [Spirit Bear](https://anilist.co/character/202861/Oniguma), a god her village worships to bring peace and prosperity, but is rescued by [Parona](https://anilist.co/character/136544/Parona).

name: Oniguma
description: He was the Demon Bear dwelling in the forests. [March](https://anilist.co/character/136541/March) was supposed the be the sacrifice to keep the bear away. He has many spikes in his body, which appeared to be spears. After he died, he became one of the forms of our main character.

name: Nokkers
description:
Nokkers are unknown creatures that were created to impede [Fushi's](https://anilist.co/character/136548/Fushi) progress in preserving the world. [The Beholder](https://anilist.co/character/136553/Kansatsusha) named them "Nokkers" because they "Knock on the doors of paradise, seeking its destruction."

A Nokker's main form resembles long, presumably sharp, vines. However, they adapt to their environment and take on various other forms - forms stolen from Fushi. Each time a Nokker is defeated they are said to come back stronger each time.

name: Gugu
description:
Gugu is a young man from Takunaha who originally worked at [Booze Man's](https://anilist.co/character/136555/Sakejii) shop. As [Fushi's](https://anilist.co/character/136548/Fushi) sworn brother, he fought the [Nokkers](https://anilist.co/character/232832/Nokkers) and anti-Fushi faction members on several occasions to create the peaceful world the immortal desires.

He wears a mask to hide his face.

name: Ligard
description: [Tonari](https://anilist.co/character/136550/Tonari)'s companion.

name: Joaan
description: Joaan is the [nameless boy](https://anilist.co/character/201555/Shounen)'s pet Reshy wolf. It was also the first animal that [Fushi](https://anilist.co/character/136548/Fushi) obtained.

name: Tonari
description:
__Affiliation:__ Tonari's Group (former)

Tonari is a girl that [Fushi](https://anilist.co/character/136548/Fushi) meets on the island of Jananda. She has short brown hair, green eyes, and tan skin. She's seen wearing a blue jacket and shorts, a black and white shirt, and has a pet owl named Ligard.

name: Mia
description: One of the girls that [Fushi](https://anilist.co/character/136548/Fushi) meets on the island of Jananda.

name: Pyoran
description: Pyoran is an old woman from Takunaha. She comes to Ninannah as a shaman.

name: Jousuke Higashikata
description:
__Height:__ 185 cm
__Nationality:__ Japanese

Josuke is the illegitimate son of [Jotaro](https://anilist.co/character/4003/Kuujou-Joutarou)'s grandfather, [Joseph Joestar](https://anilist.co/character/6356/Joestar-Joseph).

He is a caring, popular, and slightly naive teenager. Inspired by his police officer grandfather's (on his mother's side) sense of justice, he isn't afraid to fight for those in need. He is confronted by Jotaro with the need to eradicate evil Stand users from his hometown, Morioh. He refuses at first, believing that it is not any of his business. However, he quickly changes his mind when his policeman grandfather is killed by a criminal Stand user. With a vow paralleling that of [Peter Parker](https://anilist.co/character/154717/Parker-Peter), Josuke decides to deliver justice to evil Stand users in his grandfather's place.

Josuke's Stand power, Crazy Diamond, is a melee Stand with short range (3m). Crazy Diamond has the ability of "restoration".

appearsIn.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Diamond is Unbreakable
JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Part 4: Diamond is Unbreakable

name: Yoshikage Kira
description:
**Height:** 175 cm (5'9")

Kira is a man who longs for a simple life, and doesn't wish to be bothered. Although he reveals many talents, this yearning shows in his dislike of coming in first, as the cast eventually realizes. He becomes quite bothered when someone disrupts his "simplicity", and goes to extreme lengths to get it back. He keeps a collection of his own fingernail clippings, and believes when they grow quickly he has trouble. Kira also has a bizarre fetish for the female hand, stemming from an erotic fascination with the hands of the Mona Lisa. Unfortunately, his desire has never extended to the rest of the female person. This results in his murdering women in order to acquire their (severed) hands as "girlfriends"—when one "girlfriend" begins to decay, he goes off in search of a replacement.

Originally, Kira murdered his victims by stabbing them so viciously they were left with horrific back wounds (their hideous nature is implied by the fact that the reader is never actually shown [Reimi](https://anilist.co/character/90167/Sugimoto-Reimi)'s wound). However, his Stand, Killer Queen, eventually awoke from his desire to leave no evidence behind of his killings—hence its ability to make its victims completely disintegrate. He now lets Killer Queen annihilate his victims (except for his "girlfriend"-hands), letting everyone else think that the victims have simply gone missing.

appearsIn.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Diamond is Unbreakable
JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Part 4: Diamond is Unbreakable

name: Rohan Kishibe
description:
Rohan is a mangaka that first appears as an antagonist to [Koichi](https://anilist.co/character/24496/Hirose-Kouichi) and Toshizaku when they go to his house for an autograph. After they try to sneak a peek of the new issue of his manga he uses his stand Heaven's Door to make neither of them able to attack him. Then he reads their memories and in doing so finds out about [Josuke](https://anilist.co/character/13085/Higashikata-Jousuke), [Okuyasu](https://anilist.co/character/28991/Nijimura-Okuyasu) and everyone else in the story so far, but only according to how Koichi sees them. Then he decides to use them as materials for his manga. After using Koichi as his personal "Inspiration" Okuyasu and Josuke find out about where Koichi has been going by following him. They defeat him and leave him in the hospital for a while.

In the Jojolands Universe he appears as rich japanese who owns a Villa on Hawai'i Island and as a second antagonist who fight with [Jodio](https://anilist.co/character/298895/Joestar-Jodio), [Dragona](https://anilist.co/character/298896/Joestar-Dragona), [Paco](https://anilist.co/character/298904/Laburantes-Paco) and [Usagi](https://anilist.co/character/306164/Alohaoe-Usagi).
Furthermore, he saves in his safe the diamond which Jodio and his group want to steal and two Lava Rocks.

appearsIn.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Diamond is Unbreakable
JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Part 4: Diamond is Unbreakable

name: Kouichi Hirose
description: An ally and classmate who meets [Jousuke](https://anilist.co/character/13085/Higashikata-Jousuke) when [Joutarou](https://anilist.co/character/4003/Kuujou-Joutarou) is searching for him, resulting in the two becoming quick friends. His stand is Echoes, which has three distinct forms, or Acts (Koichi can only call upon one at any given time).

appearsIn.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Diamond is Unbreakable
JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Part 4: Diamond is Unbreakable

name: Okuyasu Nijimura
description:
Okuyasu isn't exactly the brightest character in the Jojo story, and tended to rely on his elder brother Keicho to make hard decisions. After his brother died, he sought revenge against the User of Red Hot Chili Pepper, Akira Otoishi. During this time and the following events surrounding Yoshikage Kira, he became fast friends with Josuke and Koichi. 

Okuyasu tends to be jealous of Koichi's relationship with Yukako, and enjoys Tonio's cooking. He also befriends Shigechi, after doing battle with his Harvest with Josuke.

appearsIn.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Diamond is Unbreakable
JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Part 4: Diamond is Unbreakable

name: Mikitaka Hasekura
description: Mikitaka first appears in chapter 378 (I Am An Alien! 1). He claims he's a 216 year old alien from the Mclon system looking for a planet for his people to live in. His job is piloting a space shuttle and his hobby is raising small pets. He possesses the ability to assume any physical form he desires. Although he can take a form vastly smaller than his normal mass, and can separate himself into several components in the process, it is not known if he can take on a much larger form. On the negative side, if exposed to a siren or similar sound, he suffers a painful rash until the sound stops. It was never revealed in the manga whether Mikitaka is a delusional stand user activated by the Arrow or truly an extraterrestrial life-form (he gives his full name as Nu Mikitakazo Nshi). According to JOJO!A-GO-GO artbook, his stand's name is Earth, Wind And Fire.

appearsIn.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Diamond is Unbreakable
JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Part 4: Diamond is Unbreakable

name: Yukako Yamagishi
description:
__Height:__ 167 cm

Yukako is a student in love with Koichi Hirose. At first she was very aggressive in her affections towards him, jealously attacking what she believed were potential rivals in love and even going so far as to kidnap him and threaten his life should he not return her feelings and not appreciate her efforts to "change him into a better person" – she had picked up false rumors that he was insufferable, false rumors that were spread by Josuke and Okuyasu in order to help Koichi in turning her away from him; unfortunately for them, their measures had the opposite effect.   Later in the story, Yukako, still lovestruck, seemed to have learned from her mistake in trying to force Koichi. Unhappy about her unrequited love she made use of the services offered by Aya Tsuji's beauty enhancing Cinderella stand, which rendered her into a bewitchingly attractive woman in the eyes of Koichi - for a price and a certain time limit, during which she was to use a special lipstick in order to uphold the "magic" i.e. the stand's power.

appearsIn.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Diamond is Unbreakable

name: Keichou Nijimura
description: A minor antagonist featured in the fourth part of JoJo's Bizarre Adventure, Diamond is Unbreakable, specifically in the "The Nijimura Brothers" story arc. Keicho is Okuyasu's older brother. He is the first in Morioh to possess the Bow and Arrow and liberally creates Stand users in hopes one of them can kill his monstrous father. Keicho himself is a Stand User and his Stand is the miniature army, Bad Company.

appearsIn.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Diamond is Unbreakable

name: Koneko Toujou
description:
__Rank:__ Low-class devil (Former nekomata)/Rook
__Power:__ Youjutsu

A 10th grade student. Originally about to be executed by the devils after her sister, [Kuroka](https://anilist.co/character/88080/Kuroka-), kills her own master. The Satan, [Lucifer](https://anilist.co/character/58343/Sirzechs-Lucifer), protected her, and left her under his sister's, [Rias](https://anilist.co/character/50389/Rias-Gremory)' care - becoming her servant. She refused to use the power of youjutsu because she didn't want to become like her sister. She overcame her power along with [Akeno](https://anilist.co/character/51347/Akeno-Himejima) after [Issei](https://anilist.co/character/50387/Issei-Hyoudou) made her overcome her own powers. She doesn't show any emotion at all, and says harsh things and hits Issei when he is doing or thinking something perverted. She shows the most concern for her comrades when they are in trouble.

name: Asia Argento
native: アーシア・アルジェント
description:
__Rank:__ Low-class 
__Devil Role:__ Bishop 
__Species:__ Reincarnated Devil (Former human) 
__Sacred Gear:__ Twilight Healing  

A second-year student at Kuou Academy. Originally a sister who was known as a holy maiden due to her healing powers. She was raised in an orphanage and was taken in by the Church after her powers were discovered. However, she was kicked out of the Church for healing a Devil, and was taken in by people affiliated with the Fallen Angels. She starts living with Issei after being saved from the Fallen Angels' grasp. As a person raised in the Church, she lacks common sense.

name: Rias Gremory
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm (5'8")
__Rank/Role:__ Top-class devil (Pure devil)/ King
__Power:__ Power of destruction

A 12th grade student and the prettiest girl in the academy. Comes from the old noble of pure devils, the house of Gremory, a top-class devil who is called a genius nicknamed "Crimson Ruin Princess". Her brother is in fact one of the Yondai-Maou, [Lucifer](https://anilist.co/character/58343). Both of them possess the power of destruction. She revives [Issei](https://anilist.co/character/50387) as her servant after finding him dead, killed by a fallen-angel and possessing a rare Sacred Gear. Kind and soft to her servants, becomes a totally different person when training or fighting.

name: Akeno Himejima
description:
__Rank:__ Middle-class Devil
__Role:__ Queen
__Race:__ Reincarnated Devil (Former Half-Human/Half-Fallen Angel)
__Power:__ Elemental magic (mainly thunder), Holy Lightning (From Volume 5 onward)


A third-year student and one of the "Two Great Onee-samas" of Kuou Academy along with [Rias](https://anilist.co/character/50389). Called the ultimate "Queen" by other members. Born between a human mother and fallen angel father, after the death of her mother, she became Rias' servant. She is a friend close enough to call Rias by her name in private, yet calls her Buchou in presence of others and displays a master-servant relationship in public. She persistently refuses to use her power of light, inherited from her father, but starts using it after being convinced by [Issei](https://anilist.co/character/50387).

name: Issei Hyoudou
description: A second-year high school student attending Kuou Academy. He is known to be stupid, lecherous and a pervert among his peers. A normal high school student born in a normal family, but is in possession of the Sacred Gear "Boosted Gear" which is listed as one of the ultimate Sacred Gears (Longinus). He was killed by his first girlfriend, a Fallen Angel, and was revived as a Devil and a servant of Rias Gremory, his new master. Now he aims to become a Harem King by gaining a peerage, unaware of himself attracting girls around him.

name: Yuuto Kiba
description:
__Rank/Role:__ Mid-class devil (Former human)/Knight
__Sacred Gear:__ Sword Birth -> Sword of Betrayer (Balance-Break)

An 11th grade student. Self proclaimed best friend of Ise, and the school prince. He was a victim of the "Project: Holy Sword" where he was the only sole survivor. He became Rias's servant when she saved him from death, but still swore the accomplish his revenge to those who treated him as test subjects and disposed his friends. He also harbors a great hatred towards the holy sword Excalibur.

name: Susan
description: Appeared in volume 8 of the novel and episode 6 of the anime. One of Issei's clients in his devil job, an American college student donned in samurai armor who is studying abroad.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Kalawarner
description: Kalawarner is a Fallen Angel who allied herself with Raynare in her plot to steal Asia's Sacred Gear.  In the anime, Kalawarner attacked Issei after the latter's first errand as a Devil (visiting one of Koneko's regular clients, Morisawa). Although she had the upper hand, she was forced to retreat when Issei activated his Sacred Gear (in its then-Twice Critical state) for the first time.   Later on, she, along with Dohnaseek and Mittelt, fought against Rias and Akeno during the Occult Research Club's mission to save Asia from Raynare.   (Source: High School DxD Wiki)

name: Dohnaseek
description: A Fallen Angel allied with Raynare, dressed in a trenchcoat and fedora. He was the first Fallen Angel to attack Issei after the latter became a Devil. As a Fallen Angel, he can use his wings to fly and has access to light-based weapons, with the spear of light being his preferred weapon. In the anime, his spear was a light blue color.    (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Marion
description: Riser's Pawn. Defeated by Yuto.

name: Cid Kagenou
description:
__Race:__ Human

Cid Kagenou, under the moniker of "Shadow," is the founder and leader of the secret organization "Shadow Garden." He founded the organization to help realize his fantasy of becoming an “Eminence in Shadow". However, unbeknownst to him, his fabrications are often revealed to be quite genuine in reality. Cid is the reincarnation of Minoru Kagenou.

name: Alpha
description:
__Race:__ Elf

Alpha is the second-in-command of Shadow Garden. After being cured of Demon Possession by [Cid Kagenou](https://anilist.co/character/136837/Cid-Kagenou), she would devote her life to his cause, becoming the first member to be recruited into his organization, Shadow Garden.

name: Beta
description:
__Race:__ Elf

Beta is the second member of Shadow Garden, supporting her master [Shadow](https://anilist.co/character/136837/Cid-Kagenou) against the Order of Diabolos.

name: Nu
description:
__Race:__ Human

Nu is the thirteenth member of Shadow Garden and an employee of Mitsugoshi Company.

name: Gamma
description:
__Race:__ Elf

Gamma is a member of Shadow Garden, being third of the original Seven Shadows as well as the director of the Mitsugoshi Company. Despite her lack of coordination, Gamma's knowledge has allowed her to recreate many of the items described by her master [Shadow](https://anilist.co/character/136837/Cid-Kagenou) to sell as Mitsugoshi's exclusive products.

name: Rose Oriana
description:
__Race:__ Human

Rosa Oriana is a noble Princess from the Oriana kingdom. She is known for being a genius in art in her kingdom. However, she came to Midgar Royal Spellsword Academy in order to learn swordsmanship.

name: Delta
description:
__Race:__ Beastkin

Delta is a member of Shadow Garden, being fourth of the original Shadow Seven to join the organization after her Demonic Possession was healed by her master [Shadow](https://anilist.co/character/136837/Cid-Kagenou). As the most physically gifted of the Seven, Delta is also often the most destructive and brutal of the group due to her lack of sense and self-control.

name: Epsilon
description:
__Race:__ Elf

Epsilon is the fifth member of Shadow Garden. Due to her insecurities with having a flat-chest, she manipulated her slime bodysuit every year to slowly increase the mass on her chest, eventually developing a fake large breast. As a consequence of this, she developed extreme magic control earning her the title, "The Precision."

name: Claire Kagenou
description:
__Race:__ Human

Claire is the older sister of [Cid Kagenou](https://anilist.co/character/136837/Cid-Kagenou) and heir to the Kagenou Family.

name: Alexia Midgar
native: アレクシア・ミドガル
description:
__Race:__ Human

Alexia Midgar is the second princess of the Kingdom of Midgar and younger sister of [Iris Midgar](https://anilist.co/character/204204/Iris--Midgar). She is also a student of Midgar Royal Spellsword Academy.

name: Tooru Honda
description:
A kind hearted orphaned high school student who, at the start of the story, begins living in a tent. She is then found by [Shigure](https://anilist.co/character/206) and [Yuki](https://anilist.co/character/208), who offer to take her in in exchange for housekeeping. She loves to cook and describes herself as an excellent housekeeper. She also has an after-school job as a janitor to pay her tuition fees to avoid being a burden on her grandfather. She is depicted as polite, optimistic, extremely kind, and selfless; several other characters, including [Kyo](https://anilist.co/character/209), [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/3892) and [Hanajima](https://anilist.co/character/376), tell her she needs to look out for her own interests and not shoulder everyone else's burdens.

Tohru habitually speaks formally, but not always correctly, a habit she picked up from her father, [Katsuya](https://anilist.co/character/9230), after he died when she was three, as a way of replacing him in her mother's eyes. Tohru's mother, [Kyoko](https://anilist.co/character/9754), raised her alone until she died in a car accident shortly after Tohru entered high school, a few months before the start of the story. Tohru repeatedly calls Kyoko the most important person in her life and treasures her photograph.

name: Yuki Souma
description:
__Height:__ 170.5 cm / 5'7"
__Zodiac Animal:__ Rat

Known as "The Prince" or "Prince Yuki" at school, Yuki is very pretty and refined, and has many admirers at school, but has a hard time being social. He wishes that he could be with people as friends, rather than admired and worshiped from afar. Yuki has suffered a traumatic childhood at the hands of [Akito](https://anilist.co/character/374), the head of the Soma clan, who locked up and mentally tortured him. Because of this, Yuki has a somewhat low sense of worth and is claustrophobic. With [Tohru's](https://anilist.co/character/207) help, however, Yuki is gradually able to loosen up. He is jealous of [Kyo](https://anilist.co/character/209) because he thinks Kyo can have a normal life, which Yuki always wanted.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Kyou Souma
description:
Kyo is a stubborn, hot-headed boy. He is easily provoked and angered in any situation. As with most of the Soma clan, Kyo is cursed with becoming an animal of the Zodiac when hugged by someone of the opposite gender. His Zodiac animal is the cat which, in legend, was barred from becoming one of the official twelve animals because of the rat's trickery. Kyo hates the current rat of the family, [Yuki](https://anilist.co/character/208), as a result. The two constantly fight and Kyo loses every time.

Ever since he met [Tohru Honda](https://anilist.co/character/207), who admires the cat of Zodiac legend, he has expressed a soft side of himself. Kyo was always separated from the Soma clan, including his parents, which is likely the cause of his short-fused temperament and stubbornness. He constantly trains in martial arts so that he might one day defeat his rival, Yuki. His martial arts master is one of the people he respects the most.

name: Hatori Souma
description:
__Zodiac Animal:__ Dragon

The dragon of the Zodiac and the private doctor to the Soma clan. Hatori is serious and is often without a sense of humor. It's his job to erase the memories of those who discover the Soma clan secret, though it is not entirely clear if this is simply a form of hypnosis or more of a supernatural power. When his curse activates he turns into a seahorse rather than an actual dragon, because the Chinese consider the seahorse to be baby dragons and the actual name in Japanese translates to it. He is very self-conscious about his transformation in the fact that he is the "great and powerful dragon" but appears as a "seahorse". Like Shigure and Ayame, he is very tall, and he is really a nice guy upon deeper inspection.



(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Makoto Takei
description: He's the student council president of Kaibara Municipal High School at the start of the series.

name: Shigure Souma
description:
__Zodiac Animal:__ Dog

Shigure transforms into the dog of the Chinese Zodiac whenever he is hugged by the opposite gender or his body comes under a great deal of stress. Shigure is one of the oldest members of the Soma family.  He is laid-back and anything but solemn. He is somewhat of a pervert, and as a writer of both romance novels and academic books.  Occasionally, Shigure shows that he has another side to himself. He can be surprisingly mature, thoughtful, and gives rather sage and insightful advice to Tohru, Kyo, Yuki, and other characters, acting like an actual "adult".

name: Isuzu Souma
description:
__Zodiac Animal:__ Horse

She is a willful, stubborn, independent, proud woman who despises the way the other members of her clan submit to [Akito](https://anilist.co/character/374/). She is tall and initially has hip-length dark hair. Although she isolates herself, she can occasionally be seen in the company of [Hiro](https://anilist.co/character/372), who along with [Hatsuharu](https://anilist.co/character/369), [Kagura](https://anilist.co/character/366), and Kagura's mother, were the only visitors Rin had during her stays in the hospital. Rin loves Hatsuharu, but she breaks up with him to protect him until she can find a way to free him from the curse.

name: Akito Souma
description:
Akito is the head of the Souma clan and very frail. He often runs fevers and rarely walks out of the main house other than to greet some of the Zodiac members, such as [Yuki](https://anilist.co/character/208) and [Shigure](https://anilist.co/character/206), that live in the outside world. Akito has a definite mean streak, and has physically and emotionally scarred many members of the Souma family, but Akito's rule in the Souma clan is absolute, and none dare oppose him.

A possible part of Akito's curse was that he would only live to be thirty. At a certain point in the Zodiac's life, Akito wishes to force them to live within the Souma compound with him for the rest of their lives in a never-ending "banquet". He even describes himself as the "Master of their (the Zodiac) Souls".

He has a deep hatred of [Kyou Souma](https://anilist.co/character/209), the Cat, whom he believes should be isolated for the rest of his life. He hates [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/207) most of all, since everyone seems to love and protect her.   

  



Akito is voiced by [Junko Minagawa](https://anilist.co/staff/95062) in “Fruits Basket: The Last Story” commemorative voice comic.

name: Motoko Minagawa
description: Motoko is very obsessive, romantic, and strong-willed. She will take desperate measures to get what (or who) she wants, but doesn't always succeed. Motoko often writes love poems about her crush, Yuki Sohma, who she constantly thinks and talks about. She is also the president of the Prince Yuki Fan Club at Kaibara High School. She mostly admires Yuki from afar and only rarely does she actually speak to him.

name: Hiroshi
description: Hiroshi is a classmate and goo friend of Kyo Soma.

name: Kazuma
description:
__Race:__ Shinki

Kazuma is a calm, serious, and sensible person. He is one of [Bishamon's](https://anilist.co/character/88239/Bishamon) Shinki and cares about her deeply. When he is called by his shinki name, "Chouki", Kazuma transforms into a cherry blossom-shaped earring with the ability to navigate and track others.

name: Suzuha
description: Suzuha is a young looking Shinki with a very kind personality.

name: Hiyori no Papa
description: Hiyori's dad. Has his own hospital

name: Ash Lynx
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm (5'11")
__Nationality:__ American-Irish

Ash has the personality, charisma, and skill to gather large groups of individuals together under his influence. Not only is he excellent in combat and an incredible marksman, but he's also highly intelligent with an IQ of 200. His intelligence lends itself well to solving the mystery of 'Banana Fish' and he has also been stated to be quite well-read, knowing his way around the newspaper's daily columns and political novels - unusual for someone who did not finish middle school.

Along with his remarkable intelligence, Ash's good looks and charisma allow him to sway the will of people to his benefit in dire situations, and he's well aware of it. Despite the influence he holds over others, however, Ash is mistrustful and holds most people at arms-length except for a few select friends in his inner circle, the most notable being [Eiji Okumura](https://anilist.co/character/21928). He is not afraid of death not because of courage, as he calls himself a coward, but because of his disillusionment with his own life.

(Source: Banana Fish Wiki)

name: Eiji Okumura
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm
__Nationality:__ Japanese
__Languages:__ Japanese, English
__Background:__ Eiji was a talented athlete and pole vaulter in Japan, until a injury left him unable to compete. Completely discouraged, faced with losing his sports scholarship, and ridiculed by his former competitors and coaches, Eiji fell into a depressed slump. Then [Ibe](https://anilist.co/character/127039/Ibe-Shunichi) took him in as his assistant, and the two traveled to New York City, to do a report on youth in street gangs. In New York, Eiji met [Ash Lynx](https://anilist.co/character/13580/Lynx-Ash).  

__Best 80's Fashion Statement:__ Hawaiin shirt over a tank top, tied in the front, falling off one shoulder.  

__Inspiration:__ In an interview, author [Akimi Yoshida](https://anilist.co/staff/97082/Yoshida-Akimi) said that the character design for Eiji was inspired by Japanese actor Nomura Hironobu.

name: Dino Golzine
native: ディノ・フランシス・ゴルツィネ
aliases: Dino F. Golzine (ディノ・F・ゴルツィネ)
description:
__Height__: 178 cm

A major mafia boss in New York City, and the adoptive guardian of Ash Lynx. He has a taste for young boys.

name: Michael Glenreed
description: Michael Glenreed is the son of Max and Jessica.

name: Skip
description: An African-American boy, and member of Ash's gang.

name: Eduardo L. Fox
native: エドアル ・L・フォックス

**Height:** 190 cm

He is the leader of a mercenary group and former regimental leader of the French Foreign Legion.

name: Blanca
description:
__Height:__ 196 cm (6'5")
__Hair Color:__ Brown

A retired assassin and the man who trained [Ash Lynx](https://anilist.co/character/13580/Ash-Lynx) to become heir to [Dino Golzine](https://anilist.co/character/132705/Dino-Francis-Golzine). Even though he cares for Ash, Blanca is a highly effective killer who dutifully carries out any contract he is hired for, such as when he is hired by [Yut-Lung](https://anilist.co/character/29576/YueLung-Lee) to murder [Eiji Okumura](https://anilist.co/character/21928/Eiji-Okumura). Ultimately declining to, Blanca instead defects to Ash's gang. He is shown to have excellent hand to hand combat skills, and insanely talented at long-range sniping.

description: Han Song-I is an E-Rank hunter who quit school after gaining money through the Yoo Jin-Ho and Sung Jin-Woo motley group of party. She is friends with Sung Jin-Ah. She first appeared when Jin-Ah visited Jin-Woo in the hospital but she didn't know him then.

appearsIn.title: Solo Leveling Season 2 -Arise from the Shadow-

name: Kazuya Kinoshita
description:
__Height:__ 177 cm (5'10")

A struggling university student living in Tokyo. He studies at Nerima University. Kazuya possesses a wishy-washy nature and is susceptible to yielding to his selfish desires. His lies often get him into trouble, because he cannot muster the strength to tell the truth. On the other hand, possessing a straightforward kindness that cares for those around him. He has also developed feelings for [Chizuru](https://anilist.co/character/128106/Ichinose-Chizuru).

name: Chizuru Ichinose
description:
__Height:__ 162 cm (5'4")

Chizuru Ichinose, alternatively known as Chizuru Mizuhara in her "rental girlfriend" persona, is a college student at Nerima University who is majoring in Literature and she currently lives in Room 204 of Royal Hills Nerima, just next to [Kazuya Kinoshita](https://anilist.co/character/128105/Kazuya-Kinoshita).

name: Ruka Sarashina
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm (5'2")

Ruka Sarashina suffers from arrhythmia and seeks a lover that will help her cope with her condition. She's seen as being a very pushy and possessive kind of person. This personality of hers developed after learning of her condition and being alienated from her peers. Because of this, she became very fixated on the idea that getting a boyfriend would help her in having a faster heartbeat.

Along with her rather brash personality, she doesn't like giving up easily; often making poor decisions to get what she wants.

name: Mami Nanami
description:
**Height:** 158 cm (5'2")

She is a freshman at Nerima University and the ex-girlfriend of [Kazuya Kinoshita](https://anilist.co/character/128105).

name: Sumi Sakurasawa
description:
**Height:** 156 cm (5'1")

Sumi is a college student who works as a rental girlfriend for the Diamond app. She's extremely shy which initially made the job quite difficult for her, but she started to improve after spending time with [Kazuya](https://anilist.co/character/128105/Kinoshita-Kazuya).

name: Nagomi Kinoshita
description: Kazuya's grandmother.

name: Yoshiaki Kibe
description: Kazuya's childhood friend from elementary school. He often cares for Kazuya.

name: Shun Kuribayashi
description: Kazuya's friend.

name: Sayuri Ichinose
description: She is Mizuhara's grandmother.

name: Saiko Yonebayashi
description:
**Height:** 143 cm

Saiko Yonebayashi is a Rank 3 Ghoul Investigator, a Quinx, and a member of the Quinx Squad. She dislikes having to work, as she prefers having a peaceful, happy-go-lucky and carefree life by playing video games and eating junk food excessively. Saiko often oversleeps, which earns her the absence from most missions. While not trying to reduce it, she is apparently embarrassed about her weight, humorously covering it during her introduction.

She is excessively lazy to the point of being a hikikomori, unable to remove herself from her room without the intervention and often force of others, even jeopardizing her occupation. Saiko is also depicted as greedy, and heavily involved in her video games to the point of escapism.

name: Tooru Mutsuki
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm (5'4")

Tooru Mutsuki is a Rank 3 Ghoul Investigator, a Quinx and a member of the Quinx Squad. Tooru is kind with a gentle heart and seems to be shy with little self-confidence. Having a constant case of Anemia, ironically, Mutsuki feels repulsive when he comes into contact with blood. Because of this anxiety, he faces discouragement as a ghoul investigator, to the point where he feels as though he isn’t even needed for the job. He expresses frustration with his own weakness, feeling anger at his lack of ability compared to his comrades. When not working, he is shown to enjoy reading books and is the one often left to relate information to Haise Sasaki. As such, he is shown to be a reliable and hard-working individual, following orders in contrast to the more troublesome or lazy members of his team. Though lacking in confidence, he shows a strong desire to help others and does not hesitate to place himself at risk to protect the innocent.

name: Ginshi Shirazu
description:
__Height:__ 176 cm (5'9")

Ginshi Shirazu is a Rank 3 Ghoul Investigator, a Quinx and the Current Squad Leader of the Quinx Squad. Shirazu, like most of his teammates, is shown to have great respect for his mentor, Haise Sasaki. However, this doesn’t stop him from going out of his way to execute missions without Sasaki’s permission, and so he is constantly seen accompanying Kuki Urie, the former squad leader, on dangerous assignments. Although he is a competent fighter with a ruthless nature, Urie describes Shirazu as a simple-minded person. 

He also seems to be quite exaggerated in his expressions and movements. His primary motive for joining the Quinx Squad is to get fast money for a purpose unknown at this point in time. Shirazu is also a quite carefree individual, and he seems to have an obsession for exterminating ghouls; both of which are traits that submit to the cocky grin he usually displays.

He is stated to be poor at tasks that require thought, such as academics or investigation. However, his consideration for others and attention to his surroundings convince Sasaki he has potential as a Squad Leader. In contrast to his loud and violent mannerisms, he is also someone that cares greatly for his team. While prone to bickering with Urie, he shows a gentler side when interacting with Mutsuki or civilians such as Chie

name: Kuki Urie
description:
__Height:__ 173 cm
__Species:__ Quinx
__Affiliations:__ CCG's Quinx Squad - Former squad leader
__RC type:__ Koukaku
__Quinque:__ Tsunagi (Bikaku)

He is a Rank 2 Ghoul Investigator,a Quinx and the former Squad Leader of the Quinx Squad.

Urie often displays himself as a cool-headed individual, holding a monotonous facial expression the majority of the time. As a Ghoul Investigator, he appears to be very dedicated and stern about his work, to the point where it may seem as though he is ruthlessly slaughtering more ghouls than necessary, which is a habit he often gets berated for. Urie also tends to be quite hasty when investigating the slightest details or signs of a suspect. He has a tendency to execute mission objectives independently, without awaiting the arrival of his fellow team mates, or even requesting their help. This is because he is an ambitious person, and does not wish to share credit with others, as he merely wishes to achieve higher ranks as a Ghoul Investigator. To achieve his personal goals, he is willing to go as far as manipulating his comrades or causing discord within the team. But beneath his ambition and cool-headed demeanor is an insatiable jealousy towards his superiors, particularly Sasaki. Urie believes that ghouls, under any circumstance, must cease to exist.

name: Eto
description:
__Height:__ 151 cm
__RC Type:__ Ukaku
__Rating:__


Eto is an executive of Aogiri Tree from the 24th ward. Eto is often seen interacting with fellow Aogiri member [Tatara](https://anilist.co/character/88418/Tatara).

name: Take Hirako
description:
__Species:__ Human
__Height:__ 172 cm
__Affiliations:__ CCG
__Quinque:__ Nagomi 1/3 (Rinkaku)

Take Hirako is a First Class Ghoul Investigator. In the past, he formed a duo with [Kishou Arima](https://anilist.co/character/88946/Arima-Kishou).

Hirako is of average height and his facial features have been described as "plain" or "bland." He usually has a blank expression on his face. Like all members of CCG, he usually wears formal attire.

Like his mentor Kishou Arima, Hirako has a very calm personality and has inherited the same cold and calculating approach to fighting ghouls. He is skilled to the point of being able to suppress a S-class Ukaku type ghoul.

name: Tatara
description:
A direct subordinate of the One-Eyed King and one of Aogiri Tree's leaders. He was a former member of the Chinese ghoul organization Chi She Lian. 

As one of the Aogiri Tree leaders and a trusted subordinate working under the One-Eyed King, Tatara comes off as a rather loyal individual. He is portrayed as composed and stoic mostly. He often monitors the activities of the Aogiri executives, but kills in cold-blood when embarking on a mission. He is also proud of his immense stamina when fighting and the accuracy of his calculations as well. Tatara seems to have a taste for precision; as shown when he turns down Kaneki considering he's an artificial one-eyed ghoul. He appears to hold a grudge against Houji, to the extent that even the Quinque associated with him, is enough to make him enraged and lose his near unflappable composure.

As the second-in-command of Aogiri, it can be inferred that he is quite powerful.

name: Roma Hoito
description: Roma Hoito is a ghoul and used to be a waitress at Anteiku.

name: Beatrice
description:
__Height:__ 140 cm (4'7")
__Age:__ 

The caretaker of the library in [Roswaal](https://anilist.co/character/90182)'s mansion. 

She has a distinct way of speaking, adding "I suppose" and "in fact" at the end of some of her sentences.

Regulus is known for being very talkative and calls himself unselfish, while in fact he is very prideful and likes to act above others and reference himself as above others.
