name: Katsuya Serizawa
description: He is an extremely powerful Esper who was formerly a part of the Super 5 of Claw. He now works at the agency alongside Reigen and Mob.

name: Sara
description: Sara was born in Asura in the Milbotts Region ruled by the Notos Greyrat Family. Her father was a hunter from whom she learned how to use the bow. Now a prodigy for her talent with the bow, she is an A-ranked adventurer and member of the party Counter Arrow.

name: Ariel Asura
native: アリエル・アネモイ・アスラ
aliases: Second Princess of the Asura Kingdom
description: Second Princess of the Asura Kingdom. She is hardly ever seen without her two bodyguards, [Luke](https://anilist.co/character/226703) and "[Silent Fitz](https://anilist.co/character/88346)". After surviving many assassination attempts, she and her bodyguards flee to The Magic City of Sharia and enroll at  the Ranoa Magic Academy.

name: Luke Notos Greyrat
native: ルーク・ノトス・グレイラット
description:
Luke Notos Greyrat is the second prince of the Asura kingdom Ariel Anemoi Asura's personal guardian and also holds the status of Knight. 
He's also the cousin of Rudeus Greyrat, but from another of the four different branch families in the Greyrat genus, namely the Notos family.

name: Soldat Heckler
native: ゾルダート・ヘッケラー
description: Soldat Heckler is an S-ranked adventurer and the leader of the S-ranked party Stepped Leader. He is a skilled swordsman with advanced-ranked Sword God Style and intermediate-ranked Water God Style.

name: Elinalise Dragonroad
native: エリナリーゼ・ドラゴンロード
description: Elinalise is a former member of Paul's party. She has an erotic nature due to her curse. She is a warrior that is good at managing monster aggro but isn't a great fighter.

appearsIn.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 2 Part 2

name: Suzanne
description: Suzanne is the vice leader of the party Counter Arrow.

name: Timothy
description: Timothy is the leader of the adventurer party Counter Arrow.

name: Mimir
description: Mimir is a member of the party Counter Arrow.

name: Shizuku Mizutani
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm (5'2")

A high school student who is only interested about studying and getting the top grades in the class. She appears indifferent towards everything outside of studying.

name: Haru Yoshida
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm (5'10")

Haru is the male protagonist of the story. He is a high school student who sits next to [Shizuku](https://anilist.co/character/37685/Mizutani-Shizuku) in class. He is a delinquent boy who is absent for a long time after getting in a fight early in the story. Despite being a trouble maker, he is a passionate boy who helps others and can achieve high grades with little effort. He does not like going to school because most people see him as a threat and are afraid of him, saddening him as he is unable to make real friends. After meeting Shizuku, he takes her as his first real friend and starts to attend school, falling in love with her in the process. He also keeps a rooster and brings it to school everyday, despite his teacher's disapproval. He has somewhat of a perverted mind, openly saying to Shizuku that he would "do" her and has "dirty thoughts" about her. It is unclear whether or not he actually thinks before he speaks.

name: Kenji Yamaguchi
description:
__Height:__ 177 cm (5'10)

He "takes" money from [Haru](https://anilist.co/character/37687/Yoshida-Haru), even though he is rich. He always is with 3 more guys and he knows Haru since he was a child. He is often lost and is very wary of Yuuzan.

name: Asako Natsume
description:
__Height:__ 157 cm  

She was a classmate of [Shizuku](https://anilist.co/character/37685/Mizutani-Shizuku) who one day asks for help in a re-test that she must not fail. She's revealed to be active on the web, where she has a blog, on which she even posted to need two strands of Mitti's hair to complete a ritual that'd assure them to become best friends. She's good at sports. She has poor grades, and does not have any friends outside of the internet. She was bullied and ostracized by her friends and classmates in the past, due to her popularity with the boys. She falls in love with [Mitsuyoshi Misawa](https://anilist.co/character/64079/Misawa-Mitsuyoshi) and is often comforted by [Souhei Sasahara](https://anilist.co/character/52617/Sasahara-Souhei) when her love attempts fail. She is voiced by Yuiko Tatsumi in drama CD.

name: Yuuzan Yoshida
description:
__Height:__ 176 cm  

Haru's older brother. He loves sweet things and is often seen eating them. He especially loves donuts. He and his brother don't really get along with each other. Although Yuuzan tries to get closer to his younger brother and understand him, Haru doesn't accept him. However Yuuzan claims Haru has a brother complex, though this is denied by Haru himself.   

He came to take Haru back home upon their father's request for Haru to attend a nearer school, where he has more leverage, although Yuuzan does want Haru to continue going to school with Shizuku.

name: Souhei Sasahara
description:
**Height:** 164 cm (5'5)

He is a cheerful, friendly, straightforward guy who says what's on his mind without hesitation. He has knows Haru since middle school and he gets along with everyone. Due to his kindness, he is seen by his friends as a popular boy who is always surrounded by people.

name: Chizuru Ooshima
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm (5'5)

She is a member of the committee class, chosen because she wears glasses. She was helped by Yoshida Haru, and after been cheered her up by Haru, she fell in love with him. She is very shy, a little pessimistic, and anxious, and even though she likes Haru, she always gives him advice when he can't understand Shizuku.

name: Yuu Miyama
description:
__Height:__ 146 cm (4'9)

A close friend of Oshima since middle school. She is currently in a long distance relationship with a prior classmate of hers from middle school.

name: Mitsuyoshi Misawa
description:
__Height:__ 185 cm (6') 

Mitsuyoshi is a tall, tan skinned young man with dark brown combed back hair. His attire often consists of casual clothes, his ever-present sunglasses, piercings, a silver necklace, two rings on each hand, a cigarette, and the occasional wrist band. Also, according to the manga, Mitsuyoshi's eyes strongly resemble [Haru](https://anilist.co/character/37687/Yoshida-Haru) and [Yuuzan](https://anilist.co/character/53087/Yoshida-Yuuzan)'s father's eyes, which is why he wears sunglasses constantly; so the two siblings do not hate him.

name: Kei Karuizawa
description:
__Height:__ 154 cm (5'0")

She is a girl with a bad attitude who is located at the top of the D class hierarchy. She fights with [Kushida](https://anilist.co/character/123214/Kushida-Kikyou) for their class' top 2 places. Even though she gives off the impression of someone who is careless, arrogant, and messy, Kei's true self is very logical and astute with a sharp mind. She has remarkable ability to read the environment and the people around her, and makes the correct decision often.

appearsIn.title: Classroom of the Elite 4th Season: Second Year, First Semester

name: Honami Ichinose
description:
__Height:__ 159 cm (5'2")

If there was one sentence to describe Honami, it would be that she is genuinely kind-hearted, benevolent, and a pacifist to the core who is against using underhanded means and violence. 

One of her main traits is her unselfish and supportive personality, combined with her excellent social skills and her being naturally people-oriented. Honami is also a charismatic and energetic person, and extends her sweet and benign character even to those of the lower classes, unlike many other upper-class students.

name: Sae Chabashira
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm

The homeroom teacher of the protagonist's class (D). She is originally indifferent to her class, doing almost nothing to help them in the battle between classes, and remains unmotivated for the most part.

name: Yousuke Hirata
description:
__Height:__ 174 cm (5'8")

The social leader of the D class. He has excellent academic and athletic ability, and is considered extremely handsome by his classmates, he is shown to be extremely compassionate and puts others before himself, considering everybody equal. He is considered a perfect male student and his placement in the D-class is originally considered a mystery.

appearsIn.title: Classroom of the Elite 4th Season: Second Year, First Semester

name: Manabu Horikita
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm (5'10")

He is the leader of the school council and is [Horikita Suzune](https://anilist.co/character/123213/Horikita-Suzune)'s elder brother.

name: Kakeru Ryuuen
description:
__Height:__ 173 cm (5'8")

Kakeru Ryuuen is the class representative of class 1-C and is known for being an infamous delinquent. He does not lead his class by trust, but rather by fear. He has a group of henchmen who do his dirty work, which contributes to his fearsome reputation.

name: Sebastian Michaelis
native: セバスチャン・ミカエリス
description:
__Height:__ 185 cm (6'1")  
__Race:__ Demon

Sebastian Michaelis is the series' antihero. He is the butler of the Phantomhive household and acts as [Ciel](https://anilist.co/character/12531/Phantomhive-Ciel)'s bodyguard, two jobs he is completely devoted to.

He is highly skilled in any area and handles every task, no matter how impossible it is as well as any problem that arises from the errors of the other staff with ease, stating it is only natural as the butler to the Phantomhive family. This is due to the fact he is a demon bound by a Faustian contract to abide by Ciel's will.

name: Ciel Phantomhive
native: シエル・ファントムハイヴ
description:
__Race__: Human
__Height__: 152 cm (5") ~ 158 cm (5'2")  
__Afiliation__: Phantomhive Family, Faustian Contract, Funtom Company  
__Occupation__: Earl of Phantomhive, Watchdog of the Queen  
__Know Relatives__:    

The Phantomhive family has, for years, been well known for making toys and sweets for small children. However, they are also the Queen's watchdogs; the Phantomhive family keeps an eye on black market dealings in ways that Scotland Yard isn't able to. Ciel Phantomhive is the heir to this legacy.  Earl Ciel Phantomhive is the business-savvy, twelve-year-old (later thirteen-year-old) head of the English Phantomhive noble family, taking over after the deaths of his parents, Lord Vincent and Lady Rachel Phantomhive. He also runs Funtom Company, which manufactures toys and sweets, and later adds a food branch after winning a Royal Warrant. His right eye, which is usually covered with a black eyepatch, bears a pentacle sign of the Faustian contract which binds the demon Sebastian Michaelis to his will. He also has a brand burnt into his back from when he was sold as a slave after his house was burnt down. Ciel is engaged to his cousin, Elizabeth Middleford. He sees her as an important friend and someone he needs to protect. His parents were killed and his mansion was set ablaze on his birthday, a reason why he does not like to celebrate the occasion. This tragedy causes him to not want to lose anyone important again.

name: Victoria Joou
description: She is the queen of the England.

name: Tanaka
description: The steward of the Phantomhive household. No one actually knows what Tanaka does around the house, save for sit around and drink tea. His reaction to any situation, no matter how strange, is to merely smile, take a sip of his tea, and chuckle. In other words, he's a bit of an enigma.    Most of the time he is in what is known as a chibi form. It is said he can only revert back to Normal Tanaka for a few minutes before reverting back to his small form.

name: Pluto
description: Pluto, also known as the Demon Dog, is a large dog that terrorizes the town of Houndsworth until Sebastian tames him. Afterward, he lives at the Phantomhive Estate. He can breathe fire, walk through barriers and shape-shift into a human. As a human, he retains dog-like qualities. Although Sebastian hates dogs, Pluto has taken a liking to him and gets jealous when he receives less attention than a cat. He only listens to Sebastian's orders. Finnian is in charge of walking him, as he is the only one strong enough to do so.        Pluto appears only in the anime adaptation    (Source: Wikipedia)

name: William T. Spears
native: ウィリアム・T・スピアーズ
description: William is a supervisor in the Dispatch Managment Division of the Death Gods. He appears in the 12th chapter of manga (or in the 6th episode of anime) to pick up Grell Sutcliff.   William is emotionless and generally calm. In regards to his job, he is strict, follows the rules precisely, and seems extremely devoted. He does not take kindly to individuals who cause problems or create more work for him, particularly if it forces him to apologize for their actions. Nonetheless, he seems to share Ronald's distaste for overtime work. He has no qualms with inflicting minor injury on others, as shown when he jumps off a roof to land on Grell Sutcliff's head and when he uses his death scythe to attack Sebastian on a few occasions.  He finds demons to be disgusting creatures, and is seen calling Sebastian Michaelis a variety of names, including "devilish fiend," "leech," and "hound." However, it is implied that he finds other demons to be even more abhorrent than Sebastian. In the anime, though, he is much more willing to work with Sebastian, as he aids him on a number of occasions.  However, he does not seem to like anyone very much, as Ronald comments that William is disappointed to see him, and he insults a variety of individuals, including Grell, Sebastian, and Ciel Phantomhive.

name: Undertaker
description:
Known only by his profession, the Undertaker is a mysterious man whose scarred face is never fully visible beneath his long hair and crooked top hat. 

He occasionally provides information to [Ciel](https://anilist.co/character/12531/Phantomhive-Ciel). While he finds Ciel amusing and enjoys helping him out, he has nothing but disdain for the [Queen](https://anilist.co/character/20367/Victoria-Joou). He tends to punctuate his words with sweeping gestures and creepy giggles and seems to spend a good deal of time inside of coffins. 

He also likes to hear jokes and ask people to tell him for exchanging information.

name: Bardroy
description: Bardroy, usually referred to as Bard, is the household cook of American descent. Bard gruffly treats everything as though it's a military exercise, often referring to troops, enemies, and weaponry when he goes off into one of his many long-winded speeches about what it truly means to appreciate the culinary arts. He rarely produces anything edible as he uses weaponry such as a series of flamethrowers, each more extravagant than the last to cook and believes cooking is an art requiring explosions. Sebastian believes anything he creates is made up of charcoal and carcinogens. It's unknown if the food he produces is actually edible.        (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Richard
description: Ghost of Richard, Duke of York, the youngest of the two princes murdered in the Tower of London. (Ep. 16)

name: Satoshi Isshiki
description:
He is a student at Totsuki Culinary Academy, a resident of Polar Star Dormitory and the current 7th seat of the Elite Ten Council. 

Aside from that, Satoshi's position as one of the Elite 10 also promote a strong determination for his kouhai(junior), [Souma Yukihira](https://anilist.co/character/75216/Yukihira-Souma) to drive his dream to become one of the 10 seat and could be a potential challenge for Souma due to his natural cooking abilities.

name: Yuuki Yoshino
aliases: Little Red Riding Hood of the Forest of Wild Beasts
description: She is a student at Tōtsuki Culinary Academy and a resident of Polar Star Dormitory. She and the other resident students from his hostel befriended with their fellow roommate Yukihira Soma and also aware to Soma's talent as one of the finest and unique of all. She is also a roommate and friend to her fellow student, Tadokoro Megumi and Sakaki Ryoko.  Yuki is more focus on animal meat as her main cuisine. Unlike Ikumi, the meat master in any meat culinary, Yuki often used the animal hunted game from domestic poultry to any other animals (like rabbits and deer) as her main theme. Yuki's cutting skill could be yet

name: Akira Hayama
description:
An assistant of Professor [Jun Shiomi](https://anilist.co/character/144632/Shiomi-Jun), Akira comes from overseas; they met when he was an orphaned child and warned her about adultered spices in a market (presumably in India). Jun recognized the dormant talent in him and brought him back to Japan, where he was adopted by her teacher, Hayama. Akira quickly learned Japanese and studied spices and aroma under Shiomi. Jun became a mother figure for him, and his motivation to succeed at cooking stems from wanting to give something back to Jun. Akira specializes in curry dishes, with a wide knowledge of spices and aroma.

He is a tall and handsome man with tanned skin and silver hair. Like [Sōma](https://anilist.co/character/75216/Yukihira-Souma), he aims to be at the top of the Elite Ten. His nose is very sharp when it comes to spices, capable of identifying ingredients and grade of cooking by the first smell, considered a worthy match of Erina's God's Tongue and being identified as an "Aroma Master". Although Jun and Akira are both experts in spices, she uses theoretical knowledge while he depends on his sense of smell. In contrast to Jun's naive, ditzy, easily angered and dependent persona, Akira is mature, reliable, street smart, cool and down-to-earth.

name: Koujirou Shinomiya
description:
Owner of a French cuisine restaurant called Shino's, Kojirou was a student of the 79th generation and held the first seat of the Elite Ten. He is commonly seen sporting glasses and red hair. Known as the "Legumes Magician", Kojirou was convinced he was going to be successful in France with his French–Japanese fusion restaurant, Shino's. However, his French staff refused to follow his recipes, even sabotaging his dishes. Facing financial ruin, he hardened himself emotionally and fired anyone who questioned his skills in the kitchen. Although this allowed him to reach the top, his proud and stubborn refusal to make exceptions resulted in his skills stagnating over the years.





Shinomiya Kojirou is the main character of the Shokugeki no Soma – Etoile spinoff manga which focuses on his time in France after he graduates from Toutsuki Academy.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Nao Sadatsuka
description: Nao Sadatsuka is a 92nd Tootsuki Generation student of Tootsuki Culinary Academy. Nao holds a deep harboring affection towards Erina Nakiri. Nao would do anything to get close to Erina including sending her 30 letters daily or watching her from afar using binoculars.

name: Tetsuji Kabutoyama
description: Tetsuji Kabutoyama is a 91st Generation student of Totsuki Culinary Academy and the president of the Skewer RS.

name: Yua Sasaki
description: A 92nd Tōtsuki Generation student. Like her fellow schoolmate, Urara Kawashima, she is also an MC for hosting important events occurring around and within Tōtsuki Culinary Academy.

name: Yousuke Maesawa
description: A member of the school basketball team. He has an attractive and charming demeanor, but he is ultimately not above slandering other students. Maezawa has bad-mouthed all of his past girlfriends.

appearsIn.title: Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dreaming Girl
Rascal Does Not Dream of Bunny Girl Senpai

name: Mai no Haha
description: She is the mother of Mai Sakurajima.

appearsIn.title: Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dreaming Girl
Rascal Does Not Dream of Bunny Girl Senpai

name: Miyuki Shiba
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm
__Classification:__ A-rank Magician

Miyuki is a first year student in Course 1 of First High School. She is the younger sister of [Tatsuya Shiba](https://anilist.co/character/55743/Shiba-Tatsuya). She is a bloom, which is considered the upper class. She was appointed as the freshmen representative, and is well known throughout the school.  Described as very beautiful, she draws attention everywhere she goes. Yet, she is still modest and kind. 

She has a warm and loving nature, and defends her brother readily. She feels bad about being labelled as a "genius"; she feels that her brother is the real genius. Miyuki feels sad that their father only cares about her, and ignores Tatsuya completely.

appearsIn.title: The Irregular at Magic High School
The Irregular at Magic High School: Visitor Arc

name: Tatsuya Shiba
description:
__Height:__ 182 cm

Shiba Tatsuya is a First Year Student in Course 2 of the First High School. He is the eldest son of Four Leaves Technology (FLT) company's president. His only sibling is [Shiba Miyuki](https://anilist.co/character/55741/Shiba-Miyuki). Since he was born in April and Miyuki born in March, they are studying in the same year according to Japanese school system. He is known as a Weed, which is the considered the lower class.

He has a rather cold personality and he doesn't show his feelings, but he seems to love his sister and cares for her. He calms her down, when she's about to lose control over her magic and doesn't seem to mind that she is one of the most talented students at the school, while he's only a reserve.

He is not easily intimidated by his opponents.

appearsIn.title: The Irregular at Magic High School
The Irregular at Magic High School: Visitor Arc

name: Sayaka Mibu
description: Sayaka is a second year student in course 2 of the First High School. She is in the Kendo Club.

appearsIn.title: The Irregular at Magic High School

name: Mari Watanabe
description: Mari is the Moral Committee Chairman of the First High School.

appearsIn.title: The Irregular at Magic High School
The Irregular at Magic High School: Visitor Arc

name: Azusa Nakajou
description: A Second Year Student. The student council secretary of the First High School.

appearsIn.title: The Irregular at Magic High School

name: Maya Yotsuba
description: Yotsuba Maya is the twin-sister of Shiba Miya, and the aunt of Shiba Tatsuya and Shiba Miyuki. She is the current Head of the Yotsuba Family. She is one of the strongest Magicians of the modern era in the world, known as the "Queen of Night" and "Demon King of the Far East".

appearsIn.title: The Irregular at Magic High School

name: Shun Morisaki
description: Morisaki Shun is a Course 1 student in First High School who exhibited elitism and used derogatory words against Tatsuya and the other Course 2 students on the first day of school.

appearsIn.title: The Irregular at Magic High School

name: Mikihiko Yoshida
description: A first year 2nd course student in E class with [Tatsuya](https://anilist.co/character/55743/Shiba-Tatsuya), [Mizuki](https://anilist.co/character/55741/Shiba-Miyuki) and [Erika](https://anilist.co/character/72311/Chiba-Erika). He is childhood friends with Erika.

appearsIn.title: The Irregular at Magic High School

name: Katsuto Juumonji
description:
Katsuto is the Club Activities Group Leader of the First High School.  

He is the eldest child and heir of the Juumonji family, one of the 'Ten Number Clans'.

appearsIn.title: The Irregular at Magic High School
The Irregular at Magic High School: Visitor Arc

name: Gongjin Zhou
description: Ancient magic user from the Great Asian Union. Looks very young despite being much older in reality.

appearsIn.title: The Irregular at Magic High School

name: Rena Kariu
description: A stoic tsundere who has good grades, sports prowess, and a competitive personality. However, she's never satisfied and is always aiming higher.

name: Arata Kaizaki
description: A 27-year old man who seems to fail at every job interview he partakes in. He accepts an offer to be part of the ReLIFE experiment in order to receive a recommendation to a company.

name: Chizuru Hishiro
description: A prodigy who has the best grades among the girls in her class. She's extremely bad at communication. She has a habit of immediately looking up anything she doesn't understand on the internet.

name: Ryou Yoake
description: A member of the ReLife research team, and the person in charge of Arata's experiment. He's always cheerful, but has a cunning personality. He takes the form of a high schooler and supports Arata as a classmate.

name: An Onoya
description:
__Height:__ 153 cm (5'0")

A third year in [Arata Kaizaki](https://anilist.co/character/89425/Kaizaki-Arata)'s class. She may be positive about everything she thinks about, but then she may not be thinking about anything.

name: Kazuomi Ooga
description:
__Height:__ 171 cm (5'7")

Kazuomi Ooga looks like a flashy student, but he has the best grades among the boys in his class. He has a pure side and is not interested in romance. He is not athletic.

name: Nobunaga Asaji
description: A kind and friendly young man. He is very skilled in athletics. [Tamarai](https://anilist.co/character/89838) and [Inukai](https://anilist.co/character/89839) call him "Nobu (-chan)."

name: Kokoro Amatsu
description: The teacher of Year 3 Class 3. She specializes in physical education. She is also in charge of the girls' volleyball club.

name: Saiki Michiru
description: Michiru was Arata Kaizaki's superior from his former company.

name: Honoka Tamarai
description: Honoka Tamarai is the captain of the volleyball team. She has a spacey personality and is easy-going, but is extremely skilled at sports and has monster strength. She's the childhood friend of [Inukai](https://anilist.co/character/89839/Inukai-Akira) and [Asaji](https://anilist.co/character/89840/Asaji-Nobunaga), and they call her "Tama (-chan)."

name: Kuririn
description:
A short, hairless (for most of the series) warrior monk, loyal Kuririn provides comic relief during tense moments. Like [Chiaotzu](https://anilist.co/character/2151/Chaozu), Kuririn doesn't have a nose. He is a good-natured, outgoing and competitive martial artist.

Once a fierce rival of [Son Goku](https://anilist.co/character/246/Son-Gokuu), he quickly became his best friend while training under [Muten Roshi](https://anilist.co/character/6167/Muten-Roushi). He also is close to Goku's son, [Gohan](https://anilist.co/character/2093/Son-Gohan).

name: Vegeta
description:
__Race:__ Saiyan  
__Date of Birth:__ Age 732  
__Height:__ 164 cm (5' 5")
__Hobby:__ Training  
__Favorite Food:__ All types of food  
__Favorite Vehicle:__ Space pod  
__Known Family:__ [King Vegeta III](https://anilist.co/character/9393/Vegeta-Ou) (father), [Tarble](https://anilist.co/character/15919) (brother),    

Vegeta is haughty, arrogant, and filled with hatred and bitterness as a result of the destruction of his home planet and his race's abusive treatment at the hands of [Freeza](https://anilist.co/character/3694). His royal status seems to have caused him to develop an inflated sense of superiority and he holds himself above most people he encounters.

In _Cross Epoch_ (the _Dragon Ball_ and [_One Piece_](https://anilist.co/manga/30013/ONE-PIECE/) crossover one-shot) Vegeta is the captain of an air ship and is seen wearing an eye patch and a cape with a clasp featuring the Kanji character for "vegetable." [Trunks](https://anilist.co/character/2707/Trunks), [Usopp](https://anilist.co/character/724/Usopp), and [Nico Robin](https://anilist.co/character/61/Nico-Robin) are members of his crew.

name: Piccolo
description:
__Race:__ 
__Height:__ 223 cm (7'4") 
__Birth Year:__ 753 Age  

Piccolo is a fictional character from the Dragon Ball series. He is introduced in the late stages of Dragon Ball as the main antagonist of the final saga and is a ruthless enemy of the protagonist [Son Goku](https://anilist.co/character/246/Son-Gokuu). He carries a very cold, menacing demeanour and is not afraid to show his evil nature, he is characterized wearing his weighted clothing, cape and turban.

name: Gokuu Son
description:
__Race:__ 
__Height:__ 175 cm (5'9")
__Birth Year:__ 737 Age  

Son Gokuu is a boy we meet in a forest far from any civilization. He lives in this forest alone as his grandpa passed away, he only has this special orb-like object called a Dragon Ball to remember him by, which he will sometimes talk to as if it is his Grandpa Gohan. As the series continues, Gokuu meets [Bulma](https://anilist.co/character/678), a brilliant teenage girl, and they go on a journey to collect these 7 magical dragon balls which actually have wish granting powers once all of them are collected. During this journey they meet and befriend [Yamcha](https://anilist.co/character/4014), [Oolong](https://anilist.co/character/2108), and [Pu'ar](https://anilist.co/character/677). Gokuu also encounters one his closest friends, [Kuririn](https://anilist.co/character/2159), and others during his time training. Participating in several World Martials Arts Tournaments,

name: Gohan Son
description:
__Race:__ Half-Saiyan, Half-Human  
__Height:__ 175 cm (5'9”)

Gohan is a shy and studious intellectual, and as a child lacks the Saiyan fighting spirit. However, because he is forced to protect the ones he loves, he taps into his vast half-breed Saiyan potential and emotional reserves, becoming one of the most powerful Z Fighters. As an adult, he abandons his superhero duties and uses his mind, as a premier scholar of the Dragon World. Gohan was extremely powerful, surpassing powerhouses like [Goku](https://anilist.co/character/246/Son-Gokuu) and [Vegeta](https://anilist.co/character/913/Vegeta) at times. 

(Source: Dragon Ball Super Exciting Guide, Character Edition)

name: Tenshinhan
description: Tenshinhan is a fictional character from the Dragon Ball metaseries and the franchise equivalent created by Akira Toriyama. Trained by Muten-Rôshi's rival, the Crane hermit he starts out as an enemy of Son Goku, but soon makes peace and becomes an ally. He is usually accompanied by Chaozu, his training partner and best friend, whom he can communicate with telepathically.  At the time of his introduction, Tenshinhan is among the most powerful warriors in the series, matched only by Goku himself. Like most other characters, his relative strength quickly diminishes as the story progresses.  As is the case with a handful of other characters from the early chapters of Dragon Ball, Tenshinhan was inspired by a character from Journey to the West; his unique feature of having a third eye was derived from the Chinese god Erlang Shen.  According to the Daizenshuu book 7 and the PlayStation 2 game Dragon Ball Z: Budokai Tenkaichi, Tenshinhan belongs to the alien race of the "three-eyed".  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Paikuhan
description: Pikkon is the West Kai's best fighter, dead for an untold amount of time Pikkon has been training relentlessly in otherworld until Goku encounters him in the Other World Martial Arts Tournament, Goku watches Pikkon's match against Olibu and considers him a worthy opponent.    Pikkon and Goku both make it to the final round, the match is close until Goku discovers a weakness in Pikkon's most powerful energy blast and knocks him out of the ring however due to both fighters touching the roof during the match the round is called a draw, afterwards Goku and Pikkon strike up a friendship and Pikkon vows to train as hard as he can to one day defeat Goku.     Pikkon makes another appearance during the Buu saga, alongside Olibu he taunts and briefly fights Kid Buu until Buu leaves attracted to Vegeta's and Goku's Ki. Pikkon also holds off Janemba until Vegeta and Goku can fuse into Gogeta during the 12th Dragonball Z movie Fusion Reborn.

name: Erasa
description: Erasa is a blonde girl in Son Gohan's class at Orange Star High School who has a bit of a crush on him, but never directly approaches him about it. She sits right next to him. Erasa becomes pretty good friends with both Videl and Gohan. After the Buu saga her whereabouts are unknown. She and Sharpner were named after school supplies, with her named being derived from eraser.

name: Yamu
description: Yamu is paired up with Spopovich and sent to the World Tournament to gather energy for Babidi, the evil wizard. The energy they are sent to gather is needed to awaken Majin Buu. When Yamu and Spopovich complete their task, Babidi kills Spopovich and when Yamu sees this he tries to escape but is killed by Pui Pui, one of Babidi's head cronies.

name: Muuri
description: Muri (ムーリ, Mūri) is the elder of a Namekian village that is the home of Dende. While being interrogated by Freeza's group, he manages to destroy all of Freeza's scouters, which causes Freeza's collection of the Dragon Balls to be delayed. He is killed soon afterwards. After being revived by Dragon Balls, he is named the new grand elder, giving him the ability to return the Dragon Balls to life. After traveling to the New Namek, he powers up the Dragon Balls, giving Porunga the ability to bring multiple people back to life with one wish.

name: Tsukasa Mizugaki
description: After failing his college entrance exams due to medical problems, he eventually gets a job through his father on Terminal Service No. 1, although he initially does not know what they do. He is assigned as [Isla](https://anilist.co/character/88753)'s spotter and soon becomes attached to her.

name: Isla
description:
Isla is a Giftia who has a childish appearance, is extremely clumsy, and doesn't show much emotion. She's also a veteran Giftia who is said to be the #1 in retrievals in the terminal service, and she is seen having a diary that records down what she has done with her retrieval targets. 
She is currently working on the same team as [Tsukasa Mizugaki](https://anilist.co/character/88754/Tsukasa-Mizugaki) and has previously worked with [Kazuki Kuwanomi](https://anilist.co/character/88757/Kazuki-Kuwanomi) years ago.

name: Takao Yamanobe
description:
Takao Yamanobe is the Section chief for the terminal service 1. Although he is in charge of the small office located behind the SAI tower, he leaves all duties and works to Kazuki Kuwanomi.

(Source: Plastic Memories Wiki)

name: Michiru Kinushima
description:
Michiru Kinushima is a Spotter at Terminal Service #1, and is partnered with Zack. She is Tsukasa Mizugaki's senior and mentor at Terminal Service.

(Source: Plastic Memories Wiki)

name: Hajime Iwai
description: is the husband of Mrs. Mari Iwai and is one of the owners of Edward.

name: Zack
description: Zack is a Giftia and a Marksman that is partnered with Michiru Kinushima, and works for the SAI Terminal Service Program. His personality is shown to be a quick-witted character, but also shows many degrees of compassion. Zack is also often portrayed playing quietly on his handheld video games, leading to his appearance of an antisocial character. He is also often portrayed teasing Michiru Kinushima's dialogues.

name: Kazuki Kuwanomi
description:
Kazuki Kuwanomi is the director of field work, a Spotter at Terminal Service #1 and the second in power only to the manager of the department, Takao Yamanobe. She was previously Constance's partner, but recently became Isla's partner again.

(Source: Plastic Memories Wiki)

name: Legoshi
description:
__Height:__ 185 cm (debut), 187 cm (currently)

Our main character is the quiet and sensitive gray wolf Legoshi. Because of his fearsome appearance and odd habits he is widely mistaken to be a scary, bloodthirsty carnivore. Legoshi is wholly aware of this and does everything in his power to minimize himself and downplay his intimidating aspects. The series is largely about him coming to terms with his place in the world as a wolf.

Legoshi develops some complicated feelings for the rabbit [Haru](https://anilist.co/character/125169).

name: Haru
description:
__Species:__ Netherland dwarf rabbit

Haru is the lone member of Cherryton School's gardening club. She is earnest and forthright which, in addition to her sexual promiscuity, has earned her a sleazy reputation. Haru is broadly confident, but a defeatist side sometimes peeks through her facade.
In spite of her caring nature she tends to keep people at an emotional distance.

name: Louis
description:
__Species:__ Red deer

The proud face of Cherryton's drama club. He has an enormous ego, but with acting skills like his this isn't surprising. He carries a number of personality complexes owing to his status as a deer, a species traditionally seen as carnivore fodder. While he has shown moments of genuine kindness he is also very emotionally manipulative.

Louis' greatest ambition is to achieve the rank of Beastar.

(Source: TV Tropes)

name: Jack
description:
__Species:__ Labrador Retriever

Both one of [Legoshi](https://anilist.co/character/125168/Legoshi)'s roommates and his best friend for many years, Jack is a rather average guy. He is often weirded out by Legoshi's behavior, especially involving [Haru](https://anilist.co/character/125169/Haru), but he is always there for his best friend.

name: Riz
description: Riz is a kindhearted and quiet Bear in the drama club who is loved and respected by his classmates. He prefers to draw little attention to himself by mostly standing in the background.

name: Bill
description: Bengal Tiger who is a student and member of the Drama Club at Cherryton Academy.

name: Juno
description:
__Species:__ Gray wolf

Juno is one of the five main characters of Beastars and is a member of the drama club on the actor team. A feminine, affable wolf, she wishes to become the next Beastar, competing against Louis.

name: Gouhin
description:
A back alley psychiatrist who tries to rehabilitate carnivorous animals that crave meat. The wounds on his face were made by violent patients. 

Despite his gruff appearance and rough character, he's gentle and caring.

name: Ibuki
description:
__Occupation:__ Member of the Shishigumi

Ibuki is a Maasai lion in his mid-thirties with an athletic build. He has light golden-yellow fur, light brown mane, and sharp, slanted eyes with small black pupils. Ibuki has tattoos on the left side of his body from his time as a child going to be used for making hyperdrugs.

name: Chousou
description:
Chousou is half human and half cursed spirit and the first of the Death Painting Wombs with a Special Grade rank. He and his two brothers, [Kechizu](https://anilist.co/character/210832/Kechizu) and [Eso](https://anilist.co/character/210831/Esou) are Cursed Womb: Death Paintings who have sided with [Mahito](https://anilist.co/character/133702/Mahito)'s group.

Chousou bears strong attachments to his brothers and is very overprotective of them.

description: One of the four Special Grade Sorcerers.

name: Naoya Zenin
description: Naoya Zenin is one of the sons of [Naobito Zenin](https://anilist.co/character/188432/Zenin-Naobito) and believes himself to be the true heir of the Zenin Family.

appearsIn.title: JUJUTSU KAISEN Season 3: The Culling Game Part 1

name: Ogi Zenin
description: He is the brother of Naobito Zenin and father of Maki and Mai Zenin. He believes he couldn't become head of the clan because his kids are worthless.

appearsIn.title: JUJUTSU KAISEN Season 3: The Culling Game Part 1

name: Jinichi Zenin
description: He is a high ranking member of the Zenin Family and a member of its elite unit of jujutsu sorcerers, the Hei.

appearsIn.title: JUJUTSU KAISEN Season 3: The Culling Game Part 1

name: Haruhi Fujioka
description:
__Height:__ 155cm (5'1") 

Haruhi Fujioka, the main heroine of the story, is an intelligent freshman attending the prestigious and expensive Ouran High School. She cut her hair short because of a little boy's gum that got stuck in it,  but this action caused the Host club to mistake her for a guy. However, unlike the other students, she is from a commoner family and got into Ouran through a scholarship. On her first day at school, she accidentally breaks a vase worth 8 million yen belonging to the Host Club. As a result, she is forced to work as a host to pay off her debt, and does so by disguising herself as a boy. Soon enough, she naturally takes to acting as a host to other girls, and even finds it enjoyable. However, she does not like to take time away from studying and often finds the antics of the other hosts to be annoying. Haruhi lives with her okama (cross dressing) father. As a result of her mother passing away when she was young, Haruhi has become very independent and never lets anyone worry about her. Although seemingly unflappable, she has a fear of thunderstorms.

name: Mitsukuni Haninozuka
description:
__Height:__ 145 cm (4'9")
__Grade:__ Third Year, Class A 


Mitsukuni Haninozuka (a.k.a. Honey-senpai) is a cake-loving, childish senior with an elementary school appearance. He attracts customers with his “shotacon” cuteness – however, he is also extremely talented at fighting. He can send people flying with one kick, and has been told by the Japanese Defense Minister to never show his full power for fear of other countries thinking Japan had a weapon of mass destruction. He learned his skills from his father, the owner of a famous dojo. Because of him, Honey tried to act like a “real man” for some time, but after Tamaki convinced him that liking cute things was not bad, Honey dropped his façade and joined the host club along with Mori, his cousin and the person he is often seen around with. Honey carries a stuffed bunny named “Bun-bun” (in Japanese, it is called “Usa-chan”, an abbreviation of usagi, meaning rabbit) that his beloved grandmother made for him. Like Kyouya, Honey is very ill-tempered when he wakes up, and gets very violent towards those that disturb his sleep.

name: Kaoru Hitachiin
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm (5'9") 

Kaoru Hitachiin is a devious and childish first-year student who greatly enjoys toying with his fellow Host Club members, [Haruhi](https://anilist.co/character/18/Fujioka-Haruhi) and [Tamaki](https://anilist.co/character/19/Suou-Tamaki) (whom he often calls “My Lord”). He and his older identical twin, [Hikaru](https://anilist.co/character/22/Hitachiin-Hikaru), are “little devil” type hosts who put on an act of “forbidden brotherly love” (with Kaoru as the uke) to draw in their clients. Unlike Tamaki, the Hitachiin brothers are wholly calculating in their customer relations; however, this is because of their deep dependency of each other and a reluctance to let anyone into their world. Hikaru and Kaoru share a deep emotional bond, which was forged through a lonely childhood and through the fact that no one could tell them apart without looking at the parting of their hair (Hikaru’s hair parts to the right; Kaoru’s parts to the left). Since Haruhi is the first person that can truthfully tell them apart, they greatly treasure her friendship. Haruhi has stated that Hikaru and Kaoru have their differences, despite being identical twins. Of the two, Kaoru is nicer, more mature, and considerate of others.

name: Hikaru Hitachiin
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm (5'9")

Hikaru Hitachiin is a devious and childish first-year student who greatly enjoys toying with his fellow Host Club members [Haruhi](https://anilist.co/character/18/Fujioka-Haruhi) and [Tamaki](https://anilist.co/character/19/Suou-Tamaki) (whom he often calls, “My Lord”). He and his younger identical twin, [Kaoru](https://anilist.co/character/24/Hitachiin-Kaoru), are “little devil” type hosts who put on an act of “forbidden brotherly love” (with Hikaru as the seme) to draw in their clients. Unlike Tamaki, the Hitachiin brothers are wholly calculating in their customer relations; however, this is because of their deep dependency on each other, and a reluctance to let anyone into their world. They share a deep emotional bond, which was forged through a lonely childhood and the painful fact that no one could ever tell them apart without looking at the parting of their hair (Hikaru’s hair parts to the right; Kaoru’s parts to the left). Since Haruhi is the first person that can truthfully tell them apart, they greatly treasure her friendship. Haruhi has stated that Hikaru and Kaoru have their differences, despite being identical twins. Of the two, Hikaru is a little more in control of their twincest acts but is also more childish and immature than Kaoru though he is the older twin.

name: Takashi Morinozuka
description:
__Height:__ 192 cm (6'4") 
__Grade:__ Third Year, Class A 

Takashi Morinozuka is a tall, stoic, but kind upperclassman who is Honey-senpai’s constant companion. The Morinozuka family had protected and served the Haninozuka family for many generations but marriage joined the families two generations ago, breaking the master-servant tradition. Despite that, Mori still faithfully protects Honey and attends to his wishes. His protectiveness extends to his classmates and fellow host club members, gaining him a certain level of respect. He does not talk very much and is considered the “wild” (“strong and silent” in the dub) type. However, when he is tired, he becomes uncharacteristically talkative and flirtatious. Mori’s hobbies include kendo and karate. He's the only member of the Host Club to call Honey-senpai by his first name.

name: Kyouya Ootori
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm (5’11”)  

Kyouya Ootori, a second year student at Ouran Gakuen, is the sly and calculating vice-president of the Host Club founded by his best friend and polar opposite, Tamaki Suoh. Despite Tamaki being president, Kyoya truly runs the club and plays the role of a puppet-master behind the scenes, earning him the nickname “Shadow King”. He takes care of the Host Club’s expenses and will even sell items belonging to the host club members (such as Haruhi’s pencil) for profit. In his words, “use whatever is at hand, be it friend or foe.” Almost everything he does is for his own benefit, but he can occasionally display a selfless side. He is the third son of his very wealthy and influential family; thus, if he wants to take over his family's business, he must work extremely hard to meet his strict father’s high expectations. Also, Kyoya's bad temper when waking up in the morning has earned him the name “Low-Blood Pressure Evil Lord."

name: Tamaki Suou
description:
__Height:__ 183 cm (6’0")

Tamaki Suoh is the half-French half-Japanese founder and president of the Ouran High School Host Club. Tamaki is flamboyant, emotional, and narcissistic; however, he is extremely dedicated to his duties as a host. He is the “prince” host type, who can charm any girl with sweet talk, though he is always truthful in his compliments. To him, all girls are pretty, and the happiness of his guest is his greatest enjoyment. 

Tamaki acts as the main comic relief in the series, exemplified in his extremely dense and naïve approach to his own feelings, and extreme emotional reactions to [Haruhi](https://anilist.co/character/18/Fujioka-Haruhi)’s comments about his stupidity. He has a family complex, as he asks Haruhi to call him “Daddy” and refers to [Kyoya](https://anilist.co/character/23/Ootori-Kyouya) as “Mommy”. He is shown to be partial to classical piano music and plays extremely well; one of his favorite pieces being [Mozart](https://anilist.co/staff/106768/Mozart-Wolfgang-Amadeus)’s Sonata for Two Pianos in D Major.

name: Kuretake
description: Kuretake is the Nekozawa family maid.

name: Ryouji Fujioka
description: Haruhi's father works at an okama (cross dressing) bar. He says that he was originally bisexual, but turned to cross-dressing after his wife's death because he could never love another woman. In contrast to Haruhi's practicality and lack of interest in material things, he is rather bad with money, and buys girly clothing for Haruhi in the hopes of getting her to dress more cutely. Haruhi's stubborn self-reliance causes her father to worry about her a lot; he would like to be more involved in her life and do more things for her, but she rarely lets him. However, the two of them do have a clearly loving relationship. While her father would like to be able to take care of Haruhi, it seems that often Haruhi ends up taking care of him instead.

name: Arai
description: Arai went to the same middle school as Haruhi. He is bright but shy, rather normal, and is on the soccer team.

name: Rudo
description:
__Height:__ 163 cm
__Jinki:__ "3R"

Rudo is the foster son of [Regto](https://anilist.co/character/266437/Regto). 

He was originally from the slums of the Sphere, but ended up sentenced to the Abyss after being falsely accused of murder. Due to being physically abused and abandoned by his real parents, Rudo is emotionally closed off and introverted and has permanent painful scars on his hands; having to keep them covered up by bandages and a pair of gloves Regto gifted to him to help sooth the excruciating pain.

name: Enjin
description:
__Height:__ 190 cm
__Affiliation:__ Cleaners
__Jinki:__ "Umbreaker"

Engine is from the Abyss and the man that saved [Rudo](https://anilist.co/character/266433/Rudo) when he fell out of the sky. He has a very bright and fun personality, but very little energy and seemingly is chill and laid-back. Despite his incredible abilities, he refers to himself as "your average janitor."

name: Zanka Nijiku
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm 
__Jinki:__ "Lovely Assistaff"

He’s a former Hell Guard trainee and is currently a member of the Akuta faction of the Cleaners.

name: Riyou Reaper
description:
__Height:__ 155 cm
__Jinki:__ "The Ripper"

She’s a former hitman and currently a member of the Akuta faction of the Cleaners. She has an unusual fighting style where she wields her large scissors with her feet. Normally cheerful and playful, she becomes strikingly pragmatic in battle.

name: Semiu Grier
description:
__Affiliation:__ Cleaners
__Height:__ 175 cm + 8 cm Heels
__Jinki:__ "Eyes"

Semiu is very confident and professional, preferring to get on with things as quickly as possible. She is dedicated to her job, being at the janitors desk and picking up calls as soon as dawn strikes. She says to Rudo that his stability using a jinki is high, so he needs to train it.

Semiu's jinki is unique in the sense it is not used as a weapon to take down Aberrant Beasts, but rather as a tool to assess a Givers potential. Semiu is able to see the unseen, and how far one can go, which sometimes leads to shocking discoveries.

name: Chiwa
description:
A girl who lives in the slums in the Sphere. [Rudo](https://anilist.co/character/266433/Rudo) likes her because of the way she seems to care and worry about him.

(Source: Official Site)

name: Regto
description:
The man who raised [Rudo](https://anilist.co/character/266433/Rudo) after he lost his parents. He gave Rudo a pair of gloves.

(Source: Official Site)

name: Jabber Wonger
native: ジャバー・ウォンガー
description:
__Affiliation:__ Vandals
__Height:__ 183 cm
__Jinki:__ Mankira

Jabber is a Giver and is a member of the Vandals, a criminal group of givers. He is known to be an unhinged psychopath and has a violent obsession with battle; always being eager to enter a fight with a wide grin and only acknowledging those that are strong enough to compete with him. He is also a masochist, being labeled as a "super masochist" by [Rudo](https://anilist.co/character/266433/Rudo), and finds excitement and ecstasy through pain.

name: Alice Stilza
description:
Alice Stilza is a famous doctor that took part in the treatment for body contamination since the very beginning, but while she was researching contaminated material for the treatment, she took one in without realizing it, causing her voice and her appearence to be weird.

Stilza is very old, with no hair left on her head. The skin on her face is sagging to the point her skull bones are poking out. She is missing several teeth and has a large nose and ear piecing's.

name: Konza
aliases: Arashiya no Otoko (荒らし屋の男)
description: A member of the Raiders with a snowshoe vital instrument.

name: Yuusuke Takinoue
description:
Height: 185.6 cm 
Position: Middle Blocker 

Karasuno High School volleyball club's alumnus. He and Shimada are part of the Karasuno Neighborhood Association team. And they often come to watch current Karasuno's games as well as to root for them. Yuusuke's working at Takinoue Electric Goods.

name: Hisashi Kinoshita
description:
__Height:__ 174cm 

Narita, Ennoshita and Kinoshita are 2nd years who couldn't keep up with the training when old Ukai returned and that's why they left volleyball club. However after some time they came back because they realized that they still want to play volleyball, though coach Ukai was no longer there. Ennoshita called them ''disgraceful'' 2nd years.

name: Lev Haiba
description:
__Team:__ Nekoma High School
__Height:__ 194 cm
__Weight:__ 79,7 kg
__Year:__ 1st Year
__Position:__ Middle Blocker

Lev is a half Russian, half Japanese. However he says he doesn't speak Russian because he was born and raised in Japan. His name in Russian means lion. Lev wasn't around when Karasuno and Nekoma had their first match together. He started playing volleyball in high school, that's why he was still a novice and spent whole time on bench at that time so he didn't come. Lev is blessed with natural physical ability, intuition and height. He declares that he's an ace even though he's a middle blocker. Kenma states that Lev is a good and honest guy.

Lev is quite childish and cheerful, shown when he was making fun of Hinata's height. Lev's appearance, as well as his piercing eyes, causes people to believe he is much more intimidating and serious than he actually is. Though he can be blunt, he never seems to mean any harm and adopts a playful attitude towards most things.
He is also shown to be enthusiastic about spiking as he gets excited about it very easily, and can be competitive with people he is interested in.

name: Mika Yamaka
description: Mika Yamaka is a third year at Nohebi Academy. She is the girlfriend of Suguru Daisho, the captain of the boys' volleyball team.

name: Tomokazu Wajima
description: A second year at Sarukawa Tech High and a libero.

name: Maya Ibuki
description:
Maya Ibuki is a First Lieutenant at NERV and a computer technician who works primarily with [Ritsuko Akagi](https://anilist.co/character/1251/Akagi-Ritsuko). Her main role during the fights with the Angels is to constantly monitor the Eva pilots’ synchronization ratios and send various emergency commands to the Evangelions as ordered by [Misato](https://anilist.co/character/1259/Katsuragi-Misato) or [Gendo](https://anilist.co/character/1257/Ikari-Gendou).

In spite of her profession, Maya despises violence of any sort, and is frequently shown becoming nauseous and averting her eyes during battles with the Angels. Notably, in The End of Evangelion, Maya is the only NERV officer who is shown refusing to fight back against the JSSDF invaders. She rejects the gun Shigeru hands her to defend herself saying "I can't shoot this thing", not because she is unskilled, but because she has never shot it at a human being.

appearsIn.title: Neon Genesis Evangelion: The End of Evangelion

name: Gendou Ikari
description: Gendou Ikari is the commander of NERV. He is responsible for the research done on the Evas, [Rei Ayanami](https://anilist.co/character/86), and the Human Instrumentality Project. He is the father of the Third Children, [Shinji Ikari](https://anilist.co/character/89), and the guardian of Rei. His original surname was Rokubungi, but he changed it to Ikari following his marriage to [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/1258). At the start of the series, he is the only person having an effective connection to Rei. As the series progresses, his unscrupulous past is revealed, as is the intensity with which he loved Yui.

appearsIn.title: Neon Genesis Evangelion: The End of Evangelion

name: Lain Iwakura
description: Lain is a 14 year old girl who uncovers her true nature through the series. She is first depicted as a shy junior high school student with few friends or interests.

appearsIn.title: Serial Experiments Lain: The Nightmare of Fabrication
Serial Experiments Lain: The Nightmare of Fabrication

name: Mika Iwakura
description: Lain's older sister, an apathetic 16-year-old student who casually picks on her little sister's habits and behavior. Mika is considered to be the only normal member of Lain's family; she sees her boyfriend in love hotels, is on a diet, and shops in Shibuya.

name: Yasuo Iwakura
description: Passionate about computers and electronic communication, he is shown as working with Eiri Masami at Tachibana Labs. He subtly pushes Lain, his daughter, toward the Wired and monitors her development until she becomes aware of her condition.

name: J.J
description: The DJ, who was a member of the Knights.

name: Chisa Yomoda
description: Chisa Yomoda is Lain's classmate. She's the one that initially gets Lain involved with the Wired.

name: Reika Yamamoto
description: Part of Lain's group of friends.

name: Juri Katou
description: Part of Lain's group of friends.

name: Sukuna
description:
__Species:__ Human, Reincarnated Sorcerer

According to the legend, Sukuna was a demon with four arms and two faces who lived in the golden era of sorcery 1000 years ago. Sorcerers of the era gave their all to defeat him, but to no avail. Without ever being defeated, his body was split into 20 separate indestructible cursed objects, which allowed him to live on and traverse the ages to come. In 2018, [Yuuji Itadori](https://anilist.co/character/127212/Itadori-Yuuji) consumed one of the aforementioned cursed objects, and Sukuna was reincarnated. 



Sukuna is hedonistic and has no regard for the suffering of others, believing that suffering is natural for the weak. He is selfish, and always wants to stay in control of the situation without caring about the consequences.

name: Revy
description:
Revy, sometimes referred by her full name Rebecca Lee, is the female protagonist of the series. She does most of the fighting for the Lagoon Company. Very little is revealed about her past, although portions can be pieced together through the series. Revy is a Chinese-American born and raised in Chinatown, Manhattan, near Mott Street, spending most of her youth as a thief and murderer. Flashbacks throughout the series reveal that Revy may have honed her skills with firearms by shooting at cans, and that her first murder may have involved shooting her father while using a pillow. It is unknown whether the pillow was used to suppress the noise or to help avoid looking at her first victim. She shot him as a result of being fed up with the abuse.



Revy is very competitive, easily bored, and extremely ill-tempered. Unlike [Rock](https://anilist.co/character/459/Okajima-Rokuro), she is undiplomatic, believing in the use of brute force and coercion to get her way. In contrast to this, she's revealed to be highly ticklish.

Revy is a merciless and sadistic killer, without a conscience, who will kill anyone at the slightest provocation, even unarmed civilians (as seen in episode 6).

name: Rokuro Okajima
description:
Rock, formerly known as Rokuro Okajima, is the protagonist of the series. He was a Japanese salaryman for Asahi Industries in Tokyo until he was taken hostage by the crew of the Black Lagoon. He joined the Lagoon Company after his department chief, [Kageyama](https://anilist.co/character/47291/Kageyama), abandoned him in an attempt to cover up the smuggling operation in which Rock had been an unwitting participant. Rock is a humble and mild-mannered person despite being on the business end of guns from friend and foe alike, and often seems surprised at the barbarity of the Southeast Asian crime world. He still wears his tie, short-sleeved dress shirt, and dress pants because although now a pirate, he still retains his business persona. He prefers to use words over weapons when interacting with others. Rock, after joining the Lagoon company, has wondered if he is experiencing Stockholm syndrome.  

Within the Lagoon Company, Rock is usually responsible for account management, diplomacy, negotiation, interpretation, and the occasional errand. Having once worked in the resource investigation department of Asahi Industries, Rock is also skilled in geology. He is also a skilled linguist, being effectively bilingual in Japanese (his native language) and English as well as being familiar with other languages, including Spanish, Romanian and Russian. He also has a surprisingly high tolerance for alcohol, owing to the heavy-drinking lifestyle of a ladder-climbing salaryman.

name: Dutch
description: The leader of Lagoon Company and captain of the ex-American Navy PT boat Black Lagoon. He is a former American soldier who fought in the Vietnam War. He tends to stay away from the fighting associated with Lagoon Company's activities. Instead, he gives orders and negotiates contracts with clients - usually Balalaika of Hotel Moscow. Dutch is a calm, easygoing character, and quite friendly. He is a Christian, denomination unknown. His body is heavily muscled, and he is always seen wearing a pair of sunglasses. He appears to be in his 30s, but is likely in his 50s, based on his military service in Vietnam.

name: Benny
description: Benny is a college dropout from a Florida university where he studied until getting into trouble with the FBI and the mafia. He works as the Lagoon Company's mechanic, computer specialist, and researcher. He is of Jewish descent as he puts it himself and is often called "Benny-Boy" by Dutch.

name: Balalaika
description:
Balalaika is the boss of Hotel Moscow. It is revealed in the novel that her real name is Sofiya Pavlovena, though this name is never used in her presence. She is sometimes referred as Vladilena reduction from Vladimir Ilich Lenin. She was brought up by her grandfather, the military head of the USSR. 

Before joining the mafia, Balalaika was a captain in the Soviet Army and a Vozdushno-Desantnye Vojska paratrooper who served in the Soviet war in Afghanistan. A fine marksman and sniper, she was nicknamed "balalaika", one of Soviet Army's slang terms for the Dragunov sniper rifle. Due to Balalaika's leadership during the hellish fighting in Afghanistan, her men look up to her as their superior and will do just about anything upon her orders. As a combat officer, she is a skilled strategist and well-rounded fighter, capable of taking care of herself despite the fact that all of her troopers, including [Boris](https://anilist.co/character/58147/Boris), often worry about her. Although she has shown herself to be rather cynical on occasion, she is also a pragmatic and professional businesswoman. She frequently employs Dutch and the Lagoon Company, apparently because they share a mutual respect.  

Balalaika can be easily identified by the burn marks which scar most of the right side of her face, neck, and chest which she suffered in Afghanistan, earning her the nickname "Fry-Face" by those who dislike her.

name: Eda
aliases: Damn nun of the Violence Church
description: Eda is a nun in a convent in Roanapur with ties to the underground (since the convent is mainly a smuggling operation). She is friends with Revy but that doesn't keep them from pointing their guns at each other in business matters as they share the same hotheaded personality. She has blonde hair and wears her pink sunglasses even with her nun outfit.

name: Roberta Cisneros
native: ロベルタ・チスネロス
description:
Roberta is a maid who worked for four years at the Lovelace household in Venezuela. Although her domestic skills, such as cleaning and cooking, were poor, she has developed a close friendship with the young scion of the Lovelace family, [Garcia](https://anilist.co/character/14238/Lovelace-Fernando-Garcia).



She is also heavily modeled on El Mariachi, popularized by Antonio Banderas down to suitcase machine gun signature and her Latin America background.

name: Bai Ji-Shin Chang
description: Wai-San Chang (also known as Mr. Chang) is the boss of a branch of the Triads based in Thailand. Like Revy, he is adept with wielding a pistol in each hand (Beretta 76 and AMT Hardballer) in a fashion similar to that of gun fu. Chang is far more proficient in it than Revy (in episode 11 she actually confesses that she is "not on his level yet," an unprecedented admission of anything less than perfection on her own part; it remains unclear, however, whether or not she is referring to gunplay in general or Chang's own particular style), and it is implied that it is he who taught her this style of combat. It may be this prowess in combat that makes Chang the only male to whom Revy respectfully refers to as "Sir".  Mr. Chang is based on characters commonly played by Chow Yun Fat in films by John Woo, such as John Lee in Replacement Killers and especially Mark Gor in A Better Tomorrow, as both Chang and Gor are members of the Hong Kong Triad, wield dual pistols and don similar attire.  Unlike most criminal bosses in the town, he advocates cooperation and joint ventures.

name: Shenhua
description:
Shenhua is a Taiwanese assassin in the employ of [Mr. Chang](https://anilist.co/character/3450/Chang-Bai-Ji-Shin). She prefers to use various edged weapons in close combat, in particular a pair of kukri knives linked together with a length of leather rope at the handles. She is also skilled in the use of throwing knives. Shenhua is a professional rival of [Revy](https://anilist.co/character/458/Revy), whom she has worked with and against at times. Her personal religion is Taoism. One of her most notable traits is her broken speech pattern, which is always moving between Chinese and English. This can be compared to [Shampoo](https://anilist.co/character/2421/Shampoo) from [Ranma 1/2](https://anilist.co/manga/30023).

It is unknown if Shenhua has any unarmed hand-to-hand skills, although it seems likely. In the anime she fights only with blades, and never engages anyone in true hand-to-hand combat.

name: Garcia Lovelace
native: ガルシア・フェルナンド・ラブレス
description:
__Height:__ 137.9cm

Garcia Fernando Lovelace is the only son of Diego Jose San Fernando Lovelace. He was heir to the Lovelace family line, and as such, is its current head, the twelfth in succession after his father was assassinated.  

He was kidnapped for a short while by a Colombian cartel and was transported by the Lagoon Company as "goods". He and Roberta left Roanapur shortly afterwards, with some help from Hotel Moscow. He has apparently returned to Roanapur searching for Roberta with a new maid named Fabiola, waiting in a local hotel called the "Sunken Palace Hotel" and seemed to have matured greatly in terms of emotional strength, as commented by Rock, since his last appearance. He treats both Roberta and Fabiola as if they were his extended family and in return, both care for him equally.

He requests help from Lagoon Company with additional help from Chang, Shenhua, Sawyer, and Lotton. However, the only person he truly trust among Roanapur is Rock.

name: Shouta Kazehaya
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm (5'9")

Kazehaya is Sawako's outgoing classmate and friend. He is so popular that during middle school, so many girls liked him that they formed a "Kazehaya is Everyone's" Alliance in order to maintain some level of peace among his admirers. Kazehaya has held a long standing interest in Sawako and admits (though not to Sawako) that he likes her, unaware that she feels the same for him.

appearsIn.title: Kimi ni Todoke: From Me to You
Kimi ni Todoke: From Me to You Season 2
Kimi ni Todoke: From Me to You

name: Sawako Kuronuma
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm  (5'2")

Sawako is a shy and honest high school girl who in search of friendship, though her resemblance to Sadako from _The Ring_ makes this difficult.

Sawako tends to take things too literally and often over-analyzes situations. Her quiet nature makes it hard for her to socialize, and leads to her classmates spreading rumors and having negative misconceptions about her, to the point where many of them think her name is actually Sadako. Fortunately, Sawako is gradually able to open up to her classmates and talk to different people. With help from [Kazehaya](https://anilist.co/character/13531/Kazehaya-Shouta), [Yano](https://anilist.co/character/13533/Yano-Ayane), and [Yoshida](https://anilist.co/character/13532/Yoshida-Chizuru), she gradually begins to make friends.

Sanada Ryuu is also one of Sawako's new group. He is quiet most of the time, but can still communicate well with Sawako (as they both don't talk much anyways). He is a close childhood friend with Chizuru. He is also good baseball mates with Kazehaya since they both played together in middle school.

name: Ayane Yano
description:
__Height:__ 161 cm

Ayane is a close friend of [Sawako](https://anilist.co/character/6977/Kuronuma-Sawako). She is the arguably the most mature of the group and she has a boyfriend in college as well as having her ears pierced multiple times. Initially the mangaka conceived of Yano and [Yoshida](https://anilist.co/character/13532/Yoshida-Chizuru) as a pair, and in the first two chapters the two are difficult to tell apart. She then redrafted the characters, combing Yano's hair and styling it in a fashion that looks like a pony-tail.

In [Kurumi](https://anilist.co/character/14117/Kurumizawa-Ume)'s fake rumors, it is said that Ayane has played more with more than 100 guys in middle school. In their current high school, it is said that Yano and Yoshida pretty much have authority in the year group. Perceptive and intelligent, a trait of Ayane's personality is that she gives just enough information to leave others wondering, thus forcing them to move forward, this as well as being able to figure out that it was Ume who spread the rumors and discovering that Sawako "liked" [Kazehaya](https://anilist.co/character/13531/Kazehaya-Shouta). Although she is usually calm and collected, she is easily infuriated if someone hurts Sawako and does not hesitate to attack the one responsible she believes is responsible (frequently Kazehaya) with kicks and sharp words. She's also fairly intimidating when angry, being called scary by Chizuru a number of times.

At one point, he is rejected after confessing to a girl he liked and is comforted by Kazehaya. After hearing about how Yano broke up with her boyfriend, he sets his attention onto her.

description: Yuka is a classmate that has gossiped about Sawako. Eventually, she ends up bullying her in the school bathroom when Sawako was brave enough to them to tell her that the rumors being spread are fake, which causes an uproar among the students.
