name: Akari Shinohara
description: Takaki's best friend in elementary school. She wanted to go to the same junior high school as Takaki, but because of her parents' jobs, she had to move to Tochigi after graduating from elementary school. She and Takaki keep in touch with letters.      (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Kanae Sumida
description: A classmate of Takaki in high school. She has been in love with Takaki since he began attending her junior high school, but cannot express her feelings to him. Kanae loves to surf and rides a scooter to school. Her older sister is a teacher at her high school.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Takaki Tohno
description: Takaki is the protagonist of the film. He and Akari are close friends, but begin to drift apart when Akari moves away and they end up attending different junior high schools. They continue to write to one another until Takaki discovers he must move to Tanegashima. The two decide to meet one snowy day, perhaps for the last time...   In high school, he belonged to the kyudo club.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Risa Mizuno
description:
Risa Mizuno is a girl Takaki met in Tokyo. They met a couple of times due to their work and started going out after a while.

In the movie, Risa and Takaki were together for a while and Risa started sending text messages to him, inviting him to hang out, but Takaki did not reply back since he still has feelings for Akari.





(Source: xbobx, AkatsukiUlquiora; MAL)

name: Yuichi
description: Yuichi (祐一, Yūichi) is a minor character in 5 Centimeters per Second. He is Akari Shinohara's fiance. His fiancée describes him as someone tolerant and generous, and won't mind if she thinks about her childhood crush.

name: Akari no Chichi
description: He was born in Iwafune. After marrried, he and his wife gave birth to their only child in Uchinomiya. He's been working for a regional electronics manufacturer based in Tochigi. Due to the nature of his job, their family had to constantly change their workplace once a few years. He used to work in Shizuoka before transfered to Tokyo.

name: Akari no Haha
description: After marrried, she gave birth to the only child in Uchinomiya. Due to the nature of her husband's job, their family had to constantly change their workplace once a few years. They used to live in Shizuoka before moved to Tokyo.

name: Chobi
description: The cat that belongs to the woman in the story. Also takes the role of the narrator. Has a girlfriend (cat) called Mimi. Seems to have feelings for the female (human) though.

name: Hange Zoe
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7")
__Affiliation:__ Survey Corps; Section Commander, Squad Leader.

Leader of the Survey Corps' Fourth Squad, Hange is also in charge of conducting research on Titans, and pursues this knowledge so passionately that they have become obsessed with Titans as a result. After originally holding a deep hatred for the creatures, Hange decided to take on a new outside-the-box approach to their research by letting go of their resentment towards Titans and approaching the test subjects with compassion. 

Hange is an energetic, freethinking and quirky scientist, with a unique way of conducting both themselves and their work. Hange is a genius outside of just Titan research too, using their brain to create weapons, tactical plans, and inventions for the benefit of humanity. As a leader, Hange is thoughtful of their comrades, and can easily figure out complex problems in order to create plans for their teammates to carry out.

appearsIn.title: Attack on Titan Final Season THE FINAL CHAPTERS Special 1

name: Pieck Finger
description:
__Height__: 155 cm

Pieck is an Eldian who serves as one of Marley's Warriors. She is shown to be somewhat sweet and kind, consistently shown to care about her fellow Warriors and the Warrior candidates.

appearsIn.title: Attack on Titan Final Season THE FINAL CHAPTERS Special 1

name: Shiro
description:
A mysterious albino girl that [Ganta](https://anilist.co/character/8630/Igarashi-Ganta) encountered during his first days as an inmate. Clothed only in a skin-tight bodysuit and muffly gloves, which conceals her heavily scarred skin, Shiro stands out among the other prisoners due to her bizarre appearance and mannerisms. To Ganta, Shiro's manner of speaking and acting remind him of a small child, even though Shiro is the same age as him. However, Shiro possesses inhuman physical abilities and has an intimate knowledge of the prison, having apparently lived there most of her life.

From the beginning of the story it is made clear that, as children, Shiro and Ganta were close friends. Ganta, however, has no memories of his childhood, which greatly saddens and annoys Shiro.

name: Ganta Igarashi
description: The main protagonist of the story. Ganta is a seemingly harmless, ordinary middle school boy who is framed for the slaughter of his entire middle school class, perpetrated by the mysterious Red Man. Sentenced to "death," he is sent to Deadman Wonderland, where he is initially confused and frightened by the brutality of the prison.

name: Kiyomasa Senji
description: Senji was the first "Deadman" that Ganta encountered at the prison. After making their way to sector G, Crow destroyed the Necro Macro security robot which had been chasing Ganta, Shiro and Yoh. After a small skirmish, and an interruption by Shiro, Crow was subdued by the Deadman security. The next day, Ganta and Senji were slated to be the next two Deadmen to compete in the "Carnival Corpse." Despite Senji's experience and skill with his 'branch' ability, Ganta managed to win by fooling Senji. As a consequence for losing, Senji's right eye was removed for research. He returns a short time later during Ganta's next match, sporting an eyepatch and gives Ganta assistance with figuring out his opponent's techniques. He also helps Ganta understand his own capabilities. His change in personality toward Ganta is due to his respect for Ganta's strength. Senji comments that because Ganta beat him, he is not allowed to lose until they have a rematch.   He seems to thoroughly enjoy violence, and his favorite phrase is "Dead Center" (or in the dub of the anime, "Sssslice."). Despite his wild and battle-hungry attitude, he does have a sense of honor and respects strength and determination. In an ironic twist, Senji becomes flustered and embarrassed when a woman acts immodest. When he first notices Shiro's form fitting body tights, his face becomes red and he give her his coat telling her to quickly cover up.   His Branch of Sin is called "Crow Claw".

name: En
description: Chan and En were the servants of Hagire Rinichirō and his artificial children.   Chan and En both wear the same clothes and look exactly the same way (with the exception of their hair). They wear a black formal suit with a white shirt under it. They also have a red tie. En's hair reaches over her shoulders and Chan's is shoulder length. They are albino so they have red eyes and a somewhat grey skin.

name: You Takami
description: A kleptomaniac and an informant to Assistant Warden Tamaki, Yoh was hired to watch over Ganta in return of large amounts for Cast Points. Though apparently friendly and polite, in truth he is ruthless, scheming and somehow paranoid, given his position as a spy for the prison's staff. A rarity among the prison population, Yoh made himself captured and sent to Deadman Wonderland in hopes to find his sister Minatsuki and buy her freedom with the accumulated Cast Points he got from Tamaki. He cares deeply about her, so much so that he is often thought of suffering from a sister complex, much to Minatsuki's disgust. The two eventually manage to forge an estranged relationship.  (Wikipedia)

name: Genkaku Azuma
description: A squad leader of the Undertakers, Tamaki's special enforcement group which selects prisoners who could not be rehabilitated and survived a special 'correctional' program to be anti-Deadman soldiers, wielding weapons that allow them to nullify the Deadmen's Branches of Sin. He dresses like a monk (though he prefers to be called a "Hyper Monk") and wields a guitar that can split into two machine guns, fire shock waves, or just play music like a regular slide guitar.

name: Kiwako Flügel Makina
native: 蒔名フリューゲル季和子
description:
Senior leader of the prison's guard staff, Makina is a harsh and cold enforcer which does not hesitate in punishing, often brutally, the prison's population. Known for her demeanor and her large breasts (G cup), she is infamous for carrying a decorated sword with herself at all times, and also for using it to cut whoever breaks the prison's rules, acts that almost always result in bloodshed. 

Despite her brutality she is far less twisted than Tamaki, whom she is greatly suspicious of, especially after discovering that she knows and has authority over only a part of Deadman Wonderland. This fact, coupled with Tamaki's ever more sick machinations, led her to forfeit her position and hunt him down with the aid of some allies, among them the Deadmen themselves, Ganta in particular.

name: Nagi Kengamine
description: The leader of Scar Chain, a group of Deadmen that oppose the the prison and plan to leak the truth to the rest of the world. Nagi speaks with a mechanical voice created by a synthesizer because of his vocal chords being removed after a rigged fight with his lover, who was later killed by Genkaku of the Undertakers. He has a son, left in the care of a nursery outside, and fights for freedom to see his child. His branch of sin is called "Owl's Eyeball", which creates small floating explosive spheres that can be controlled and detonated remotely.

name: Chan
description: Chan were the servants of Hagire Rinichirō and his artificial children.   Chan and En both wear the same clothes and look exactly the same way (with the exception of their hair). They wear a black formal suit with a white shirt under it. They also have a red tie. En's hair reaches over her shoulders and Chan's is shoulder length. They are albino so they have red eyes and a somewhat grey skin.

name: Mimi
description: A classmate and old friend of Ganta.

name: Reiji Andou
description: Nicknamed "Andre", he is the fat one of the group. He cares deeply about his friends, and is also an extreme masochist.

name: Kiyoshi Fujino
description: Kiyoshi is the main character of the series and the first boy in Hachimitsu Academy to make contact with a girl.

name: Takehito Morokuzu
description: He is the bespectacled boy in the group. A die-hard fan of the Romance of the Three Kingdoms.

name: Jouji Nezu
description: The weird one of the group. He always wears a hood and raises ants. He suffers from constant coughing fits due to severe stomatitis.

name: Shingo Wakamoto
description: Shingo is a blonde guy who looks like a delinquent. He has a crush on [Anzu](https://anilist.co/character/89755/Yokoyama-Anzu).

name: Kate Takenomiya
description: The President of the Student Council.

name: Kurihara
description:
He is the chairman of Hachimitsu Private Academy. Unlike the underground student council, faculty, and the school management, who are conservative about the school's traditional laws, he is more liberal and open minded about the idea of the school admitting boys; however, his ideas often put him into conflict with his daughter [Mari](https://anilist.co/character/64861/Kurihara-Mari) who is the president of the underground student council.

He has a rather dark secret where he is fond of surfing around porn sites. His main fetish are Latin American asses, much to the disgust of his daughter, Mari who also knows his secret.

name: Anzu Yokoyama
description: She is a second-year student in attendance at Hachimitsu Academy and also the love interest of [Shingo Wakamoto](https://anilist.co/character/64853/Wakamoto-Shingo).

name: Chiyo Kurihara
description: Chiyo is the first girl to talk to [Kiyoshi](https://anilist.co/character/46557/Fujino-Kiyoshi); she has romantic feelings for him.

name: Mari Kurihara
description: Mari is the president of the underground student council.

name: Takao Akizuki
description: A 15-year-old in his first year of high school. He hopes to become a shoemaker and practices on the side while he works his part-time job. His family circumstances have given him maturity beyond his years. He skips the first half of school on rainy days to think up new shoe designs in the garden.  (Source: official site)

name: Yukari Yukino
description: The mysterious woman [Takao](https://anilist.co/character/79463/Akizuki-Takao) met one rainy day in the garden. She spends her days with chocolate in one hand and a beer in the other. Their rainy morning meetings begin after she responds to Takao's greeting in classic verse.

name: Souichirou Itou
description: Souichirou Itou is a gym teacher at Takao's High School, He is Yukari Yukino's colleague and former boyfriend.

name: Shouko Aizawa
description: A proud girl in her third year of high school. She is never seen without company.  (Source:makotoshinkai.wikia.com/wiki/Shōko_Aizawa)

name: Reimi Akizuki
description:
A free-spirited divorced woman who, despite loving her family dearly, finds herself giving more attention to her romantic pursuits.

(Source: Makoto Shinkai Fandom Wiki)

name: Rika Teramoto
description: Naturally cheerful, she is on good terms with Takao. She is from Kansai.  (Source: official site)

name: Matsumoto
description: A classmate and close friend of Takao. He is dating a second-year girl named Satou.  (Source: official site)

name: Shouta Akizuki
description: Like Takao, he's not sure what to make of his free-spirited mother. He has plans to leave the house and move in with his girlfriend.  (Source: official site)

name: Satou
description: In her second year of high school and Matsumoto's girlfriend. She has friends aplenty and is always well-informed about the latest bits of talk flying around the school.

name: Tooka Yatogami
description:
__Code name:__ Princess
__Height:__ 155 cm

Tooka Yatogami's name is given by [Shidou](https://anilist.co/character/65257/Itsuka-Shidou) the second time they met. Due to being a spirit, she is always being targeted by the AST and is aiming for the kill; because of this, she hated humans for always shunning her and thinking that she wasn't allowed to live in this world. However, her whole life changed when she met Shidou.  Even with that high and cool presence, Tooka lacks some common sense and loves food very much.

name: Kotori Itsuka
description:
__Height:__ 145 cm  

Kotori is [Shidou's](https://anilist.co/character/65257) foster sister. Kotori is the head commander of Ratatosk which teaches Shidou about the spirit and spacequakes happening. She told Shidou how to save the spirits in a peaceful manner so as to prevent the spacequake from happening.  Kotori has two modes which is depicted by the ribbon she wears. The white ribbon depicts the Imouto Mode which makes her show love for her brother. The black ribbon depicts the Commander Mode which shows her tsundere sadistic bossy nature.

name: Origami Tobiichi
description:
__Height:__ 152 cm 

Origami Tobiichi is a student of Raizen High School, she is known for having high grades in her entire high school, while she is studying at this high school she is also a member of AST (Anti-Spirit Team) and she's one of the most skilled ones on their team.

name: Yoshino
description: The second spirit saved by [Shido](https://anilist.co/character/65257/Itsuka-Shidou). Yoshino is a shy girl who is said to be the Kindest spirit up to date. Her codename is Hermit.

name: Shidou Itsuka
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm

Shidou Itsuka is a student of Raizen High School. He was adopted into the Itsuka family when he was "abandoned" by his mother.

name: Reine Murasame
description:
__Height:__ 164 cm

She is highly intelligent and the Analysis Officer of Ratatosk's Fraxinus Crew.  She can be more called as the Vice Commander of the crew rather than [Kannazuki Kyouhei](https://anilist.co/character/75394), it is usually her at the side of [Kotori](https://anilist.co/character/65263) managing things around the crew. She transferred to Raizen Highschool as a physics teacher and an assistant home-room teacher at [Shidou](https://anilist.co/character/65257)'s class. She has this very big eyebags which you can tell she hasn't been sleeping for years.

name: Tamae Okamine
description:
__Height:__ 150 cm
__Relatives:__ [Mikie Okamine](https://anilist.co/character/85561/Okamine-Mikie) (Cousin), 

[Shidou](https://anilist.co/character/65257)'s homeroom teacher. Despite being 29 years old, she is still single. Always, when something dangerous happens, Tamae has a habit of panicking non-stop.

name: Mii Fujibakama
description: **Mii Fujibakama** is a member of the female trio that Tohka is friends with.

name: Kurumi Tokisaki
description:
__Height:__ 157 cm

Kurumi is the third spirit who appeared after [Tohka](https://anilist.co/character/65259) and [Yoshino](https://anilist.co/character/70603). She has a split personality: that of a gentle, mysterious highschool girl with a slow talking pattern, and that of a psychopathic killer. She is very aggressive in her actions which makes it harder for [Shidou](https://anilist.co/character/65257) to capture her.

name: Mana Takamiya
description: One of the Wizards of DEM (Deus Ex Machina), an organization which provides realizer units to other wizards throughout the world to fend off spirits. When DEM was transferred to Tenguu City's AST, she was posted on that spot to deal with the Spirit called Nightmare. Mana doesn't recall much of her past and it is said that she's one of the best wizards existing.

name: Cocytus
description: Cocytus is the guardian of the Fifth floor of Nazarick. An insectoid heteromorph, he was created by Warrior Takemikazuchi to be an honourable warrior and is tasked with keeping a cache of powerful weapons for Nazarick. He has a neutral alignment, which stands out against the many evil entities in Nazarick. An extremely skilled fighter, Cocytus is an expert at selecting the right combination of weapons for the fight, and dealing huge amounts of damage quickly. With the help of his extra arms, he is capable of wielding four of his twenty-one weapons at once, allowing him to deal the highest damage per second of any floor guardian.

name: Climb
description: The Personal Bodyguard of Princess Renner. She saved him when he was just a street urchin about to die from sickness. As such, he views his services to her as a fulfilling of that debt he owes and is even willing to give up his life for her. However, he remains unaware of Renner's true nature. He is rather disliked due to him having such a position despite not even being a commoner, but an urchin. Despite this position, he holds no talent at fighting, making up for it with sheer effort. He eventually meets Sebas and, after convincing him to teach him some of his skills, they become friends, though he remains unaware of his loyalty towards Ainz. He also has a close friendship with Gazef and Brain as well as several members of Blue Rose.(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Gazef Stronoff
native: ガゼフ・ストロノーフ
description:
__Race:__ Human
__Affiliation:__ Re-Estize Kingdom
__Occupation:__ Warrior Captain

Gazeff Stronoff is the Warrior Captain of the Re-Estize Kingdom and King Ramposa III's personal bodyguard, and professes his utmost loyalty to him. Incredibly talented with the sword and well-versed in martial arts, he is famously considered the strongest warrior in the entire kingdom, and commands the respect and admiration of everyone who knows his name. Due to internal power struggles among the nobles in the kingdom, Gazeff is not knighted, so the King granted him the title of "Warrior Captain", which allows him to command his own unit comprised of "Warrior Troops".

Born a commoner in a frontier village, he later became a mercenary. During his travels, he encountered a former adamantite-ranked adventurer who taught him his extraordinary swordsmanship. He participated in the grand tournament and defeated Brain Unglaus, becoming the champion and earning the King's trust.

name: Gu
description: Gu is a giant troll who ruled the Eastern Tob Forest.

name: Baziwood Peshmel
native: バジウッド・ペシュメル
description: Baziwood Peshmel is the acting leader of the Four Imperial Knights of the Baharuth Empire.

name: Nasa Yuzaki
description:
__Height:__ 169.5 cm
__Likes:__ Math, Physics, Finances

Kindhearted, charismatic, and intelligent, albeit only in certain areas. Nasa Yuzaki decided he had no need for a high school education, and, well, he was mostly right. He is the type of person who would worry if his friends got hurt when they tripped over a pebble, while he ended up falling down a cliff. He is very in love with his wife.

appearsIn.title: TONIKAWA: Over The Moon For You
TONIKAWA: Over The Moon For You Season 2

name: Tsukasa Yuzaki
description:
**Height**: 154 cm
**Relatives**: [Tokiko Tsukuyomi](https://anilist.co/character/188292/Tokiko-Tsukuyomi) (grandaunt), [Enishi Yuzaki](https://anilist.co/character/190386/Enishi-Yuzaki) (father-in-law), [Kanoka Yuzaki](https://anilist.co/character/190388/Kanoka-Yuzaki) (mother-in-law)

Tsukasa Yuzaki is the wife of [Nasa Yuzaki](https://anilist.co/character/130944/Nasa-Yuzaki). Not much is known about her, but what is known is that she's mysteriously cute.

Tsukasa has long pink hair with a clasp on the back and pink-red eyes. She wears elegant clothing and a skirt. While at home she is usually seen wearing modern clothing. During her trip to Kyoto, she wore a floral Yukata.

Tsukasa comes across as calm and level-headed; seemingly unsurprised by Nasa's rash and illogical actions. Despite this, she agreed to marry him and love him dearly. She gets embarrassed easily whenever Nasa proclaims his love towards her and how cute she is. She has a huge love for movies, games, and pop-culture. She has a wide range of knowledge concerning aspects of Japanese history. This includes how to handle a Katana properly and information regarding various locations and landmarks. Tsukasa talks about such things as if she had experienced them herself but never elaborates.

appearsIn.title: TONIKAWA: Over The Moon For You
TONIKAWA: Over The Moon For You Season 2

name: Enishi Yuzaki
description:
He is [Nasa Yuzaki](https://anilist.co/character/130944/Nasa-Yuzaki)'s father and is married to [Kanoka Yuzaki](https://anilist.co/character/190388/Kanoka-Yuzaki). He originally taught in a big Tokyo university but then he moved to Nara where he is living with his wife right now.

(Source: Tonikaku Kawaii Wiki)

appearsIn.title: TONIKAWA: Over The Moon For You

name: Aya Arisugawa
description: She is [Kaname](https://anilist.co/character/137513/Kaname-Arisugawa)'s older sister. She is a lazy ditz but, [Kaname](https://anilist.co/character/137513/Kaname-Arisugawa) considers her on the "genius side" for her great learning capacity. In contrast with that, she usually misunderstands important things and she gets really confused in the blink of an eye. Her favorite hobby is probably playing video games and she usually nags [Kaname](https://anilist.co/character/137513/Kaname-Arisugawa) into playing with her.

appearsIn.title: TONIKAWA: Over The Moon For You
TONIKAWA: Over The Moon For You Season 2

name: Kanoka Yuzaki
description: She is [Nasa Yuzaki](https://anilist.co/character/130944/Nasa-Yuzaki)'s mother and is married to [Enishi Yuzaki](https://anilist.co/character/190386/Enishi-Yuzaki).

appearsIn.title: TONIKAWA: Over The Moon For You

name: Arisugawa
description: The mother of [Kaname](https://anilist.co/character/137513/) and [Aya](https://anilist.co/character/137514/).

appearsIn.title: TONIKAWA: Over The Moon For You

name: Chitose Kaginoji
description:
Apparently, [Tsukasa](https://anilist.co/character/131106/Tsukasa-Yuzaki) saved her from falling off a cliff when they were children. Chitose wants to use her own life for the sake of [Tsukasa](https://anilist.co/character/131106/Tsukasa-Yuzaki) to pay her back. She obviously doesn't want [Tsukasa](https://anilist.co/character/131106/Tsukasa-Yuzaki) falling into [Nasa](https://anilist.co/character/130944/Nasa-Yuzaki)'s hands. She has two maids: [Aurora](https://anilist.co/character/137516/Aurora) and [Charlotte](https://anilist.co/character/137517/Charlotte). Chitose has a personality that quickly bends from being strong to whining. She considers [Tsukasa](https://anilist.co/character/131106/Tsukasa-Yuzaki) her sister.

(Source: Tonikaku Kawaii Wikia)

appearsIn.title: TONIKAWA: Over The Moon For You
TONIKAWA: Over The Moon For You Season 2

name: Kaname Arisugawa
description: She's been helping the bathhouse for a long time. Despite being young, she is very mature and always gives good suggestions to [Nasa](https://anilist.co/character/130944/Nasa-Yuzaki) to help him out with his couple life. Like her mom, she really likes dirty jokes and apparently, she has no fear of cleaning the males' bath while Nasa is in there. She isn't shy and prefers a direct approach.

appearsIn.title: TONIKAWA: Over The Moon For You
TONIKAWA: Over The Moon For You Season 2

name: Naoko Yanagi
description: She is a teacher from the middle school that [Nasa](https://anilist.co/character/130944/Nasa-Yuzaki) had frequented. She is always super busy with work and doesn't have much time for her life. However, once she sees how happy [Nasa](https://anilist.co/character/130944/Nasa-Yuzaki)'s marriage is, she becomes more open to future relationships. She considers herself a boring person.

appearsIn.title: TONIKAWA: Over The Moon For You

name: Charlotte
description: She is one of [Chitose](https://anilist.co/character/137515/Chitose-Kaginoji)'s maids. She quickly changes her personality from being simple-minded and innocent to going berserk with a giant sword in her hands. However, she is always happy with a big smile on her face. She will probably do everything [Chitose](https://anilist.co/character/137515/Chitose-Kaginoji) tells her to do without hesitation.

TONIKAWA: Over The Moon For You Season 2

name: Chise Hatori
description:
__Height:__ 155 cm

Chise Hatori is a Sleigh Beggy and one of the main protagonists of the series. She is the apprentice and wife of [Elias Ainsworth](https://anilist.co/character/121430/Ainsworth-Elias).

Devoid of love from a young age, Chise has a mysterious connection to magic, which causes her to attract fairies. She learns more about her magical abilities as she finds herself in the care and tutelage of Elias, a powerful mage.

(Source: Ancient Magus Bride Wiki & Crunchyroll)

name: Elias Ainsworth
native: エリアス・エインズワーズ
description:
He is an ancient magician with both human and fae characteristics. Despite his appearance, he is gentle and polite with humans and shows a great interest in them. He understands why humans feel the emotions they do, but has never experienced them himself. 

One day, he buys [Hatori Chise](https://anilist.co/character/88344/Chise-Hatori) from the black market and makes her his Mage Apprentice.

name: Cartaphilus
description:
Cartaphilus is a sorcerer that serves as a recurring antagonist of the series. 

(Source: The Ancient Magus Bride Wikia)

name: Fumiki Hatori
description: The son of Yuuki and Chika Hatori and the younger brother of Chise Hatori.

name: Adolf Stroud
native: アドルフ・ストラウド
description: A Sorcerer at the College. He is a former pupil of Lindel.

name: Matthew
description: Mina's husband

name: Fuyu no Megami
description:
Winter Goddess is one of the old gods of Winter and Death.

The Winter Goddess is first mentioned just before the night of Yule, an important cycle of the year that showcases the shift between the winter and the coming spring, by the Heralds of Yule and later by Elias. The Winter Goddess later seen riding on top of another god, it's revealed that she's pregnant as she unknowingly passes by Elias, Chise and Ruth. Before leaving she takes notice and picks up a mistletoe.

The Winter Goddess later appears again before Ruth as he searches for Chise, being first mistaken to be the Slay Vega before Ruth gets a closer look at her and sees a resemblance between her and the Winter Goddess from earlier, quickly deducing that this must be her daughter. The Winter Goddess learns that Ruth had offered gifts to her mother, the mistletoe, and as thanks, she decides to help him by lending Ruth her "flame", which reveals Elias position to him. Ruth says thank you before leaving to find Chise, the Winter Goddess replies only that next winter, when she's her mother, she asks only for that which Ruth offered her then.

As the mother, the Winter Goddess is a tall woman with exceptionally long, dark and wavy hair with a motherly figure. Her eyes are bright with white pupils. She's clad in a long dress that reaches down to her feet, it's black from the ankles and upwards while the lower parts are white.

name: Will o' The Wisp
description: Faerie that lures humans away from safe paths.

name: Dragon
description: She's almost always seen beside Lindel as they both protect the Dragon Aerie.

name: Keel
description:
__Race:__ Wanui


Keel was born and raised in the same village as Raphtalia. Naofumi purchased them as a slave in order to rebuild the village destroyed by the first wave.

appearsIn.title: The Rising of the Shield Hero Season 2
The Rising of the Shield Hero

name: Rishia Ivyred
native: リーシア＝アイヴィレッド
description:
__Race__: Human

Rishia is the daughter of the House of Ivyred, a noble family. Due to an unfortunate string of events, the family had grown poor and she was forcefully taken as ransom by a neighboring family in exchange for gold. She was rescued by The Bow Hero, whom she would later devote her life to.

appearsIn.title: The Rising of the Shield Hero Season 2
The Rising of the Shield Hero Season 3

name: Yousaiya
description:
She is the owner of the tailor store. Her name was never mentioned so she is referred to as the Tailor.

She made her debut in both the light novel and anime​ but never made her debut in the manga. She was only mentioned by the Magic Shop Owner as being a friend of hers.

appearsIn.title: The Rising of the Shield Hero Season 2

name: Itsuki Kawasumi
description: A high school student summoned to another world as the Bow Hero. He is usually calm and well-mannered. However, He has a messiah complex, and is pretty much a justice maniac. He vanquishes evildoers without thinking of the consequences of his actions. However, this is just because he is immature. He doesn't actually have any bad intentions.

appearsIn.title: The Rising of the Shield Hero Season 2
The Rising of the Shield Hero Season 3

name: Stella  Vermillion
native: ステラ・ヴァーミリオン
description:
Stella Vermillion is an A-rank Apprentice Knight and second princess of the Vermillion Kingdom.

Stella initially appears to be feisty, hot-blooded, and quick to anger possibly due to her sheltered upbringing. However, later she is shown to be anything but bitter, and is even willing to admit her mistakes and be friendly with others. Despite this, she exhibits frequent bouts of jealousy especially when it comes to [Ikki](https://anilist.co/character/88265).

Stella gets agitated whenever anyone says that she is strong because she is an "A Rank" and do not see all her hard work, but Ikki Kurogane was the only one to see Stella's hard work which was one of the reasons Stella started developing feelings for him.

name: Ikki Kurogane
description:
Ikki Kurogane is an F-rank Apprentice Knight who strives to become a real Mage Knight. He is a young man of average height with dark brown hair and brown eyes.

A noble young man with a caring personality. Ikki can be very cruel under certain circumstances. When it comes dealing women of his age and the whole academy in general Ikki is really clumsy because he has no prior experience with them outside of respect towards a superior or as a knight. This really shows when he confronts Stella on that subject.

name: Nagi Arisuin
description:
Kurogane Shizuku's close friend and roomate. Alice likes to give Ikki advice from time to time, and is very interested in how he is developing over time. Alice identifies as a woman, and prefers the name Alice to "Nagi". Her friends call her Alice as well. 

Alice's Device is Darkness Hermit and her Noble Art is Shadow Bind. Her device allows Alice to create shadow portals that enable her to travel from one place to another. It also immobilizes opponents by pinning them down by their shadow.

name: Shizuku Kurogane
description:
**Ranking:** A-Rank

Ikki Kurogane's younger sister. Unlike her older brother, she was well-respected as a child and was even forgiven due to her talent as a Blazer and was the only person in their family who didn't despise or look down on Ikki for being an F-Rank Blazer and was saddened after he left.

name: Touka Toudou
description: Touka Toudou is the current student council president of Hagun Academy and is considered to be the strongest student in the school.

name: Ayase Ayatsuji
description: Ayase Ayatsuji is a third year student from Hagun Academy. She is a D-Rank Blazer who uses the katana-style Device Hizume.

name: Mima Kirigoe
description: Mima started her career in the pop idol band CHAM which she quit to embrace a career as a drama actress.  Mima-rin is the nickname she is often called by her fans.

name: Rumi Hidaka
description: Rumi is Mima's manager. She is opposed to Mima's crossover into acting.

name: Murano
description: Although Murano is a well known photographer, it isn't easy to work with him. His specialty is photo shoots for women who are stripping, and he may end up seeing attractive woman naked, which causes him joy. During the shoot, he can't resist a cheerful grin.

name: Rei
description: Rei is a singer in the pop music group CHAM! After Mima left, Rei and Yukiko become more popular, which results of them getting into the best singing group charts. She does seem to care about Mima, even when she changed careers. In one scene in the film, Rei and Yukiko are on their radio talk show and when they bid goodbye to the audience, Mima's apparition appears. Although Rei is happy to see Mima, but is shocked when Mima suddenly leaves and goes after the apparition.   (Source: Satoshi Kon Wikia)

name: Tejima
description: In the film industry, Tejima is a very famous and influential man. He decides which actors, for example, get better roles.

name: Uchida
description: Me-Mania is one of Mima's biggest fans, to the point where he is totally obsessed with her.  When Mima starts to do things that go against his expectations of her, he becomes a stalker believing himself to be led by a "true" Mima.

name: Kou Mabuchi
description:
__Height:__ 176 cm (5'9")

Kou was well liked in middle-school, he liked [Futaba](https://anilist.co/character/41025) and they had a growing relationship, but then he suddenly moved away in the middle of the school year. His parents divorced and he now lives with his father (presumably he first lived with his mother after the divorce, but when starting high school he moved in with his father instead, for unknown reasons). Currently attending the same highschool as Futaba under a new last name (probably his mother's). He eventually admits to being "Tanaka-kun", and while acting cold and uncaring towards her most of the time, his nice side becomes gradually more prominent.

name: Futaba Yoshioka
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm  

Futaba often shied away from boys, writing them off as crude, rough and vulgar all except the mild voiced- small built [Kou](https://anilist.co/character/41026). They shared a brief attraction to each other.

One day Kou suddenly moved away without any notice leaving behind a stunned Futaba. Futaba's life took a drastic turn after Kou's departure - the other boys started to take notice of Futaba's flawless face, alienating her from the rest of the girls. They began to hate Futaba and blame her eventually exiling her altogether​. Now in high school, Futaba is determined to not be too girly in order to avoid a repetition of what happened in her middle school years.

name: Youichi Tanaka
description:
__Height: __180 cm 

Kou's older brother by eight years. He works as an English teacher at Futaba's high school. Futaba was initially interested in Youichi upon entering high school because he reminded her of Kou, but was unaware that the two were brothers. Youichi knows about Shuuko's crush on him but always rebuffs her advances, telling her that he will never see her as anything more than a student. However, he never hesitates to help her in times of need and is happy whenever he sees that she is fitting in. He enjoys a playful 'rivalry' with Aya over Shuuko. He often gives Futaba advice whenever she feels unsure about herself or about Kou.

name: Touma Kikuchi
description:
__Height:__ 178.5 cm (5'10")

Touma is a boy in Futaba's year, making his first appearance in Chapter 12. He initially has a very bad impression of Futaba, during which she trips and ends up accidentally groping him. However, he eventually softens up to her when he notices how remorseful she feels about the incident. Due to his earnest appearance, his intentions after often misunderstood, usually causing Kou to get jealous over his interaction with Futaba. His friends call him "Goodie-goodie" and "Hasabe" due to his straight-laced and honest behavior. He has a piercing on his left ear and likes wombats.

name: Aya Kominato
description:
__Height:__ 178cm (5'10")

Outgoing and spontaneous, Aya seems to be the only character without social problems. He is very open, caring, and sometimes even dense. He has an unrequited crush on Shuuko. Aya harbors a hatred for Tanaka-sensei, and initially did not like Kou due to his relation to him. He is good at Math.

name: Yuuri Makita
description:
**Height:** 155 cm

Introduced in the first chapter, Yuuri's high school life is parallel to Futaba's middle school life. She is very cute, causing her to be despised by many girls in her class, and she is often left alone. Yuuri gets by very well, however, for she prefers to be hated for who she truly is than to be liked for someone she isn't. Yuuri and Futaba soon become best friends. She falls in love with Kou after he helps her during a class leader's camp. Yuuri greatly treasures her friendship with Futaba, but often gets jealous of Futaba's closeness with Kou.

name: Shuuko Murao
description:
__Height__: 167 cm (5'6")

Much like Yuuri, Shuuko is another "lone wolf." She is very beautiful but has a cold exterior that drives others away. Due to experiences in middle school, Shuuko fails to trust girls. She has been in love with Tanaka-sensei, Kou's older brother, since her first year of high school after attending a guidance session between the two of them. Eventually, her trust in female relationships was restored after becoming friends with Futaba and Yuuri.

name: Yui Narumi
description:
__Height:__ 157 cm (5'2")

Narumi is Kou's childhood friend. They share the same tragedy of divorced parents at a young age and losing a parent soon after. Narumi enters the story when Kou invites her to the school festival and sees how close Futaba and Kou are. She tries to keep Kou away from Futaba as much as possible.

name: Ren Ichinose
description:
__Height:__ 179 cm  

Ren Ichinose; wears glasses but prefers to wear contacts. He is currently dating Mayuka, who is Daiki's older sister. He later finds out that he is also in love with Ninako later on in the series. Mayuka understands Ren's feelings, and so they break up. Used to work at a cafe until he became aware of his feelings towards Ninako then switched to a gas station job.

name: Guts
description: Guts is the protagonist of Berserk. He is a tall, muscular man that swings a huge sword called the Dragon Slayer, he has a prosthetic left forearm that has a magnetic grip that also conceals a cannon. Renowned as the "Black Swordsman", he is a former mercenary and branded wanderer who travels the world in a constant internal struggle between pursuing his own ends and protecting those dear to him.

name: Isidro
description: A runaway brat turned thief, Isidro dreams of becoming a great swordsman, which made him tag along with Guts. Despite his lack of strength and skill, he utilizes his small size and agility to his advantage, along with various tricks and tools. He has a great ego and plans to become the very best; he initially planned to "observe" Guts and steal his "techniques" to surpass him. But he slowly starts to realize the inconceivable difference in strength between him and Guts, but that there may even be ways for him to become a formidable warrior...  His most important role however, is probably to serve as a comic relief along with Puck.

name: Casca
description: Casca was the only female soldier in the original Band of the Hawk and is behind only to [Guts](https://anilist.co/character/422/Guts) and [Griffith](https://anilist.co/character/424/Griffith) in swordsmanship. Her ambivalent relationship to both of them makes her moody and capricious. Casca joins the Band of the Hawk after Griffith saves her from a sexual assault by a nobleman.

name: Schierke
description: Schierke is a young witch-in-training, a disciple of the witch Flora. She is accompanied by an elf, Evarella. She aided Guts's group with a troll infestation in the nearby village Enoch, where she showed how powerful magic can be in Berserk.   After a series of events, Schierke was forced to leave her home and Flora behind forever when they faced an attack Griffith ordered. Schierke, having lived a sheltered life, doesn't like the Human world or the Holy See's religion, but she finds life outside bearable due to her companions.   Her magic skills and knowledge of the world are impressive for a child her age. One of her most used and handiest spells is the ability to hypnotize or temporarily desensitize others. But due to her youth, she tends to exhibit dangerous overzealousness. Her ability to sense "Od" (life force or spirit energy) means she can sense the power, intent, and alignment of all creatures and artifacts.  As she sees Isidro as an incompetent monkey, there is some friction between the two, which frequently lends itself to comic situations. Though she initially couldn't stand Guts, Schierke has developed a slight infatuation with him and both now share a father-daughter relationship. When Sonia gave her an offer to join the Band of the Hawk, Schierke thought of Guts before declining. Their journey together constantly brings them into even deeper understanding.

name: Griffith
description:
Griffith was the founder and leader of the mercenary unit known as the Band of the Hawk, named for his helmet which was forged in the shape of a Hawk's head. 

Extraordinarily charismatic, intelligent, and handsome, his skill with his sabre and tactics gives him and his band the reputation of invincibility, making him the favored choice of the Midland King, who was locked in a century long war with the Empire of Chuder. Believing that he is destined for greater things than the average man, Griffith is willing to sacrifice everything for the dream of his own kingdom and only values others so far as they are useful to him. The one exception seems to be [Guts](https://anilist.co/character/422/Guts) and [Casca](https://anilist.co/character/423/Casca), both of whom he confides to in private moments. The source of his ambition is a Behelit given to him by a fortune teller she claimed was "The Egg of the King," which could lead an average person to becoming King himself.

name: Serpico
description: Serpico is Farnese's companion and unbeknownst to her, her paternal half-brother. During his time with the Holy See, Serpico was Herald for the Holy Iron Chain Knights.   When aggressive, Serpico belies his meek appearance and is comparable to a fox due to his shrewd observation and speed with a rapier.   Despite Farnese's childhood abuse and her forcing him to burn his own mother at the stake, he cares deeply for his half-sister. Serpico was her servant since she found him beaten on a snowy street over a decade ago.   Serpico's relationship with Guts has forever been plagued with animosity, due in large part to the dangers that inevitably surround Guts and anyone he takes into his Band. After a duel with Guts in the underground pillars of Vritannis, Guts spared his life. Their bond rekindled, and Serpico has since learned to trust Guts to protect Farnese when he can not.   Serpico uses two items blessed by the wind spirit Sylph in order to battle with tolerance alongside Guts: a rapier that can generate razor sharp gusts of wind; and a cloak that constantly generates a swirling vortex around its wearer which can deflect projectiles, assist in jumping, and slow falls from great heights.

name: Puck
description:
A wind spirit from Elfhelm, a utopia on the island Skellig in the Western Sea. Elves in Berserk can only be seen by the open-minded; the devoutly religious cannot see Puck at all, though he can play with their face unbeknownst to them.

Puck can secrete a powder from his wings to quickly heal wounds and can emit a bright flash to blind enemies. On occasion, he also resorts to his "Bloody Needle" attack, tossing a spiny object resembling a seed pod at someone. It deals no injury, but is painful enough to prompt most victims to cry out. Puck was the first to join [Guts](https://anilist.co/character/422/Guts)'s journey, and is starting to show a strange attachment to the Behelit Guts took upon his battle with the Count.

Puck often serves as comic relief along with [Isidro](https://anilist.co/character/7859/Isidro). The two are frequently drawn in an exaggerated manner. He is very angry when he ever is mixed up with a Pixie or Fairy quick to state the difference. He also seems to have a brother-sister relationship with the newest comic relief character the female elf [Evarella](https://anilist.co/character/7866/Evarella).

name: Farnese de Vandimion
native: ファルネーゼ・ド・ヴァンディミオン
description: Farnese is a noblewoman who led the Holy See's ceremonial guard, the Holy Iron Chain Knights. Since this position has been traditionally held by a woman, Farnese was appointed during her stay at the convent she was sent to by her father, Federico Vandimion.   A bit of a pyromaniac (and possibly a pyrophiliac), Farnese's habit of maniacally burning things she didn't like, along with her lack of empathy due to her poor upbringing provoked her to hunt down and burn supposed witches and pagans at the stake. This fueled a secret sadistic pleasure that she constantly tried to deny.   She and Serpico left their Holy See positions after her faith was shattered during the devastation of Albion and the events surrounding Griffith's reincarnation. She then chose to follow Guts in hopes of learning more about the world and has changed into a more sympathetic human being. Since then, Farnese has begun to study witchcraft under Schierke's tutelage. Farnese also seems to have developed a crush on Guts which becomes evident in chapter 287 and 288 of the manga.  Farnese is primarily Casca's care taker and thus rarely involves herself in battles. She and Casca both received enchanted chainmail shirts made of silver as well as a silver short sword for protection against creatures from the astral plane. During Ganishka's raid on Vritanis, she also received a trio of snake-like homonculi created by Schierke from thorn vines which Farnese remote controls with a vine ring.

name: Locus
description: Leader of the new Band of the Hawk's demon lancer squad, Locus would be a true stereotype of a proud knight, were it not for his demonic power. With a lance that seemingly bends to home in on its target, he can nail through dozens of heads in one thrust. In his Apostle form, Locus merges with his mount, becoming a centaur of steel.

name: Lord Gennon
description: Lord Gennon is a high-ranking noble in Chuder. During the early days of the Band of the Hawk, he hired them for a number of jobs. A notorious pedophile, he developed an attraction for Griffith, which culminated when Griffith agreed to sleep with him in exchange for funds to support the growing Band. He is often seen to be attended by many very young male servants, no older than being in their teens. Gennon's voice was done by Masashi Oki in the Japanese version of the original anime and Fred Velde was his English voice actor.

name: Mikoto Yamato
description:
__Race:__ Human
__Height:__ 157 cm (5'2")
__Affiliation:__ Hestia Familia • Takemikazuchi Familia (temporary leave)
__Level:__ 2
__Skills:__ Yatanokurogarasu • Yatanoshirogarasu
__Magic:__ Futsunomitama
__Weapon:__ Kotetsu • Chizan • Shunsan • Shakuya

Yamato Mikoto is a member of the Hestia Familia and the Takemikazuchi Familia, having converted to aid the former during the War Game. Mikoto originally hails from the Far East. Her parents died several years after her birth. Tsukuyomi and [Takemikazuchi](https://anilist.co/character/142543/Takemikazuchi) took the young girl into their orphanage, where she lived for years, eventually joining the Takemikazuchi Familia. Mikoto and the other members of the Takemikazuchi Familia used to sneak [Sanjouno Haruhime](https://anilist.co/character/142551/Sanjouno-Haruhime) out of her mansion at night to play with her. They were eventually caught, damaging relations between Haruhime's father and the shrine. They pursued their nightly fun regardless. Two years before the story, Mikoto and the other Takemikazuchi Familia members moved to Orario to earn money to help support the shrine.

Mikoto has a serious and honorable personality, unwilling to use cowardly tactics even in an emergency, as shown through her disapproval of Pass Parading the monsters that were chasing them onto the Hestia Familia. She also has a softer side as she cares for the well-being of her friends and is fiercely loyal to them.

Takemikazuchi is a God and the head of the Takemikazuchi Familia. Takemikazuchi is friendly with [Hestia](https://anilist.co/character/87654/Hestia) and has taught her many things such as the dogeza. He is kind to his Familia members. He is also a natural gigolo, and is clueless to how his actions affect others around him, which makes him come out as insensitive.

Chigusa Hitachi is a member of the Takemikazuchi Familia. Despite having a timid and shy personality, she is loyal to her Familia, especially Ouka who she has feelings for.

name: Lissos
description:
__Race:__ Elf
__Previous Affiliation:__ Apollo Familia
__Level:__ 2

Lissos is a former member of the Apollo Familia. He was the one who led the attack on the former Hestia Familia home. Lissos is prideful, not even thinking that the Apollo Familia would lose to the Hestia Familia. Like many Elves, he hates the Crozzo's Magic Sword for burning down several Elf villages. Because of this, he becomes angry at Ryuu during the War Game for using them.

name: Royman  Mardeel
native: ロイマン・マルディール
description:
__Race:__ Elf+
__Affiliation:__ Guild

Royman Mardeel is the head of the Guild under Ouranos. Royman is an arrogant Elf that constantly looks down on others except for the Gods and Goddesses. He likes money, causing him to be known as the Guild's Pig by other Elves. Royman also dislikes Half Elves, believing that they are low class. However, contrary to that, he is a hard worker. Eina theorized that his grumpy attitude was mostly likely due to stress.

appearsIn.title: Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? II

name: Aki Adagaki
description:
__Height:__ 162 cm

Aki comes from a well off family and is known for her brutal treatment of men. As a result, she has gained the nickname "Cruel Princess" from her classmates. She allegedly rejected [Masamune-kun](https://anilist.co/character/81967/Makabe-Masamune) and gave him the nickname "Piggy" when the two were children leading to his transformation and commitment to revenge.

name: Masamune Makabe
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm

A narcissistic boy who is obsessed with the idea of getting revenge. His feelings of revenge are aimed towards the popular rich girl, [Adagaki Aki](https://anilist.co/character/76364/Adagaki-Aki). Despite his handsome appearance now, he was once a chubby kid who people liked to make fun of.

name: Chinatsu Hayase
description: She is the younger sister of [Masamune Makabe](https://anilist.co/character/81967/Makabe-Masamune) and currently attends middle school as a second year. She does not possess the same surname as her brother due to Masamune's choice of changing from Hayase to Makabe.

name: Yoshino Koiwai
description: Yoshino is [Aki](https://anilist.co/character/76364/Adagaki-Aki)'s maid and follower. She seems to be a clumsy girl. However, beneath her clumsy and shy appearance she is actually extremely deceptive and cold, able to deceive and hurt Aki without a second thought. Unlike Aki, Yoshino easily gained weight from sweets.

name: Sonoka Kaneko
description:
Kaneko Sonoka is one of the girls who have self-proclaimed themselves as [Aki Adagaki](https://anilist.co/character/76364/)'s bodyguards and the Vice President of Yasaka High School Student Council.

Kaneko is a cute and fairly short girl. She has dirty-blonde hair that has two pink ribbons tying up two straps of her hair into ring-shaped like while the rest of her hair reaches her chest and pink eyes. She wears the Yasaka High School uniform which consists of a pink shirt, black vest with the school symbol on it, a striped yellow skirt and a blue and yellow ribbon.

name: Neko Fujinomiya
description:
**Height:** 159 cm

Neko Fujinomiya is a cute and cheerful rich girl who transferred school after [Masamune Makabe](https://anilist.co/character/81967/Makabe-Masamune) "gave her his coat on Christmas Eve" and fell in love with him. She has a frail body, needing to consume many drugs although she often makes jokes about it. Due to her habit of not wearing any panties, [Aki](https://anilist.co/character/76364/Adagaki-Aki) and [Yoshino](https://anilist.co/character/121008/Koiwai-Yoshino) nicknamed her "Pantie-less Woman".

name: Tae Futaba
description: Masamune's class rep. She loves Yaoi and likes pairing Masamune to Kojuurou.

name: Kojuurou Shuri
description:
**Height:** 155 cm

Masamune's best friend who looks like a girl, but is actually a boy.

name: Sylvia
description:
Sylvia was a chimera and one of the eight generals of the Demon King, serving as the director of the Monster Enhancement Division. They serve as the primary antagonist of the Konosuba Movie.

At first glance, Sylvia appeared as a towering, voluptuous and beautiful woman. They were so attractive that Kazuma seriously considered defecting to the Demon King's Army to be with them.

description:
__Height:__ 191 cm

In Fate/Zero
     (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Inori Yuzuriha
description:
__Height:__ 166 cm (5'5") 
__Occupation:__ Singer, student 
__Partner(s):__ Shu Ouma 
__Affiliation:__ Funeral Parlor  

Inori Yuzuriha is one of the main protagonists of the anime Guilty Crown and a member of the resistance guerrilla group called "Funeral Parlor".  She is also the voice of the internet artist Egoist who sings to release her emotions.  Inori is a very soft, quiet, and sweet girl, who is also very determined to complete her missions successfully and without fail (shown when she was threatened but didn’t show any sign of fear, even when she was about to be killed). She also seems to think she’s a burden to others but tries to protect the people close to her.   She usually comforts Shu and gives him words of strength when she can tell he’s feeling weak and helpless. Gai is dear to Inori, and she tells Shu that he is the one that gave her a name and a world, when no one else has.  As a member of Funeral Parlor, Inori is extremely skilled in forms of combat such as hand-to-hand fighting and marksmanship, to the point where she is able to outmatch and kill several soldiers of the GHQ forces by herself.

name: Shuu Ouma
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7")  
__Void:__ The King's Heart  

One of the main protagonists of Guilty Crown, who's right hand holds a special power called "The Power of the King". This ability allows him to extract weapons from his friends known as a "Void" which is a manifestation of a person's personality.  He is an unsociable 17-year-old young man who usually tends to stay out of people's way so as to not cause them any trouble. However, this changes when he meets a girl named [Inori Yuzuriha](https://anilist.co/character/43280/Yuzuriha-Inori). From that moment on, he must learn how to make friends because of his ability "The Power of King".

name: Shuuichirou Keido
description: Head of the GHQ Anti Bodies and a major antagonist.

name: Yahiro Samukawa
description: Shu's classmate and member of the motion picture research club. Yahiro is one Shu's closes friends who bothers to socialize with him.

name: Hare Menjou
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm (5’5”) 

Shu's classmate. They live in the same apartment building and they've been together since junior high school.

name: Arisa Kuhouin
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm  

The student council president. Her grandfather is the head of the Kuhouin Group which is at odds with the GHQ, and Arisa is his heir. She however does want that, but is unable to face it, resulting in her Void "The Coward's Shield", which is a disk-shaped shield controlled by a ball-shaped device. The shield can divide itself in 6 parts, and even grow in size.

name: Kenji Kido
description: A mass murderer and infamous terrorist responsible for the "Sky Tree Bombing". He was previously held at GHQ Isolation Facility Four before being rescued by Shu and the Undertakers. His Void is a Gravity gun.

name: Okina Kuhouin
description: Arisa's grandfather and head of the Kuhouin Group, the richest and most powerful conglomerate in Japan. Okina despises the GHQ for not only taking away Japan's independence but also their restrictive policies affecting his various businesses. Sharing a common enemy, Okina agrees to supply Gai and Funeral Parlor with funds and weapons.   (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Mana Ouma
description: A pink-haired girl who has a mysterious connection with Shu, Gai, Inori and Shuichiro.

name: Gai Tsutsugami
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm (5’11") 

At his young age,​ he is the leader of the group, "Undertaker". He has great physical strength and pilots the Jeet Kune Do. He has a lot of charisma and is Shu's rival. He guides Shu who has the "The Ability of King" and aims for a successful revolution. He hopes to push the revolution to success with the help of the "power of kings". He has the power to see people's Voids.  His everlasting dream was to save Mana (Shu's older sister, Eve of the New World) from the Virus, thus releasing her from pain. He even says it several times that his reason for fighting is "for a certain woman".

name: Akira Tendou
description: Akira Tendou is a former employee of a company that earned the nickname Black Company (exploitative employment system). This job made Akira so miserable that he was excited that there was a zombie apocalypse because he didn't have to go to work.

appearsIn.title: Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead
Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead

name: Kenichirou Ryuuzaki
description: An old friend of Akira Tendou from college and the rugby team. He hasn't seen him in a year before the apocalypse. After he graduated from college he became a salesmen at a major real estate company because of his great communication skills. In reality he seems almost perfect but he too was miserable at his job and wanted to become a comedian.

appearsIn.title: Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead
Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead

name: Shizuka Mikazuki
description: Shizuka Mikazuki is a very rational girl who prefers to act alone. Her actions are determined by the benefits and risk of said situation. This is the main reason why she didn't join up with [Akira](https://anilist.co/character/214584) and [Kenichirou](https://anilist.co/character/214583) at first. Her personality is because of her upbringing. Her father was a successful business man. He was very strict and wanted her to be perfect, to succeed.

appearsIn.title: Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead
Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead

name: Beatrix Amerhauser
native: ベアトリクス・アメルハウザー
description: She came all the way to Japan from Germany because she loves Japanese culture. She saved up money to visit but the apocalypse had already started once she arrived at the airport.

appearsIn.title: Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead

description: The CEO's mistress and unrequited crush of Akira.

description: She is a former violin instructor that lives neighbouring Akira, along with her husband Mikio Kousaka.

appearsIn.title: Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead

name: Sakamoto
description: A black cat who wears a scarf created by the [Professor](https://anilist.co/character/41055), which allows him to speak. Being technically older than both [Nano](https://anilist.co/character/10422) and the Professor, he speaks in a condescending tone towards them, though he occasionally succumbs to his catlike habits.

name: Yuuko Aioi
description: An energetic high school girl with short brown hair. One of her negative sides is that she is often too lazy to do her own homework and always copies from either [Mio](https://anilist.co/character/40081) or [Mai](https://anilist.co/character/10421).

name: Mai Minakami
description: A rather quiet girl who is very intelligent and often is seen with a book. She is seen to be multi-talented, excelling at using projectiles, arm wrestling, and especially pulling pranks, usually at the expense of [Yuuko](https://anilist.co/character/10418/Aioi-Yuuko). She also frequently enjoys carving Buddha and Drawing in her spare time.

name: Mio Naganohara
description: A bright and cheerful girl sporting light blue hair and pigtails held by two small wooden cubes. She has a crush on [Koujirou](https://anilist.co/character/41616). She's usually a calm and collected person who can support her friends whenever they're in a pinch. But she's a lot more sensitive than she lets on, and more often than not needs that support back in return.

name: Nano Shinonome
description:
A robotic schoolgirl that was built by a [Professor](https://anilist.co/character/41055/Shinonome-Hakase). She often worries about keeping her identity as a robot from others, despite the fact that everyone already knows about it due to the noticeable wind-up key exposed on her back. Luckily most don't make a big fuss about it. Her limbs will sometimes fall apart, revealing dubious items that Professor has installed without her noticing, ranging from bean-firing-weapons to Swiss rolls. She is also the Professor's caretaker.

She wishes to live life as a normal girl and therefore really wants the wind-up key on her back removed.

name: Hakase Shinonome
description:
She is a young scientist, who despite her outstanding intelligence, still reflects her age.

She loves sharks and snacks, and constantly modifies [Nano Shinonome](https://anilist.co/character/10422/Shinonome-Nano), whom she created, to add strange and unusual functions such as a machine gun right hand and a swiss roll dispensing arm. Nano, most of the time, is unaware of these modifications until they are first used. However, Hakase always refuses to remove the obvious wind-up key from Nano's back cause she thinks that it’s cute, despite Nano's requests to do so.

name: Koujirou Sasahara
description: A rich flamboyant high school boy who likes to think he is an aristocrat when in reality his family are just farmers. He likes to ride his goat to school and is often seen with his butler.

name: Akagi
description:
__First appearance:__ Episode 3  

The mathematics teacher for class 1-Q. His class is quite tough. 

 (Source: aniDB)

name: Izumi Sakurai
description: A young, shy, and easily frightened teacher. She tries to enforce the school rules to the students albeit unsuccessfully.

name: Haruna Annaka
description: Yuuko and Mio's classmate. She always wears a big red ribbon. Her common reaction to something that surprises/shocks her consists in expressing herself by making the sound "ehhhhh"

name: Ranpo Edogawa
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm (5'6")

The great detective of the Armed Detective Agency. He possesses sharp observation skills that are acknowledged by his coworkers, and he settles difficult cases at the request of the police. Because of his self-confidence, his speech is brazen and child-like. His motto is "If you'll have me, everything will be ok!" He likes logical thinking and fantastic tales.

name: Nathaniel Hawthorne
native: ナサニエル・ホーソーン
description:

__Likes:__ God, the Bible, faith, purity
__Dislikes:__ The Devil, heresy

He has the ability to convert his own blood into holy words and control them.

name: Fyodor Dostoyevsky
native: フョードル・ドストエフスキー
description:
__Ability:__ Crime and Punishment

Head of the underground organization "Rats in the House of the Dead" and part of the terrorist organization "Decay of Angels". He maintains a calm, confident, and arrogant yet polite personality towards others and has shown to be extremely intelligent, cunning, and sinister. He is highly religious and speaks often of the sin of man, especially ability users. According to him, he is anemic.

name: Andre Gide
description:
the leader of a criminal organization from Europe known as Mimic.

Due to his actions in Dazai Osamu and the Dark Era, he is considered as one of the main antagonists.

A member of The Guild. His name is a reference to H. P. Lovecraft, the American author who achieved posthumous fame through his influential works of horror fiction.

description: Clerk at the Special Detective Company. She is a best friend of Naomi.

name: Hanako
aliases: Crazy Knife (クレイジーナイフ)
description:
__Age of Death:__ 13

Hanako is a ghost haunting the old building of Kamome Academy. He resides on the third floor female bathroom, in the toilet of the third stall. He governs over the Seven Mysteries as School Mystery Number 7.

name: Nene Yashiro
description: Yashiro Nene is a normal student, and one day she listens to a rumor about ''Hanako-san'' who makes wishes for anyone, but the wishes come with a price. She visits him in the hope of getting her crush to fall in love with her. She becomes friends with Hanako-san soon after meeting him then. She is in the gardening club.

name: Kou Minamoto
description: Minamoto Kou is a student at Kamome Academy's Middle School Division, and a member of a renowned family of exorcists, the Minamoto Clan.

name: Yako
description: The fox statue spirit that holds the title of Number Two of The Seven Wonders (二番目の七不思議. Romaji: _Ni-ban me no Nanafushigi_) as the Misaki's Stair ghost. She took on the form of a beautiful lady inside her territory while outside, she took the form of a kitsune spirit.

description: The homeroom teacher of Nene's class.

name: Tsukasa Yugi
description: Yugi Tsukasa is a ghost haunting Kamome Academy. He currently resides at the school's broadcasting club room, with its members Sakura and Natsuhiko.

name: Lemon Yamabuki
description: Yamabuki Lemon is a first year student at Kamome Academy's High School divison and Nene, Aoi and Akane's classmate.

name: Kodama
description: Kodama is known as the Confession Tree and a supernatural that only appears in front of couples and brings all love confessed below it to fruition.

name: Sakura Nanamine
description: Nanamine Sakura is a 3rd-year student at Kamome Academy's High School division. She made a contract with [Tsukasa](https://anilist.co/character/137221/Yugi-Tsukasa) and is now bound to him. She is a member of the school's broadcasting club.

name: Teru Minamoto
description:
Minamoto Teru is a 2nd year student at Kamome Academy's High School Division and the school's Student Council President. He is also a member of a renowned family of exorcists, the Minamoto Clan.
Teru is Kou's older brother.

name: Akatsuki
description:
__Race:__ Human
__Class:__ Assassin
__Subclass:__ Tracker

A highly skilled level 90 adventurer who met [Shiroe](https://anilist.co/character/81367) and [Naotsugu](https://anilist.co/character/81371) shortly after the Apocalypse. Shiroe gave her the appearance changing potion (which allowed her character to look more like her real self); before that, she had been playing as a male character. She's very loyal to Shiroe for his generosity, and addresses him as "Master".

Akatsuki is rather insecure about her height, and hates it when people mistake her for a child (despite the fact that she is about Shiroe's age). She has a habit of kneeing Naotsugu in the face when he says anything perverted.

name: Shiroe
description:
__Race:__ Half-Alv
__Class:__ Enchanter
__Height:__ 177 cm (5'10")

Shiroe, the main protagonist of the series, was an engineering grad student before the Apocalypse. He's one of the most experienced and skillful adventurers in the game, due to having started playing Elder Tale when he was in middle school. He's also infamous for being a brilliant tactician. He is renowned as the strategist of the Debauchery Tea Party, an informal group that managed to tackle some of the game's most difficult raids. He knows [Naotsugu](https://anilist.co/character/81371) from the time both of them spent with the Debauchery Tea Party.

As an introvert with asocial tendencies, he would rather not have anything to do with guilds. Which is also because he doesn't want people to use him for his knowledge and skills. However, he doesn't actually hate other people, and he tends sympathize with beginners, especially if they happen to be children.

name: Naotsugu
description:
__Race:__ Human
__Class:__ Guardian
__Subclass:__ Border Patrol

Naotsugu is a friend of Shiroe. He believes that every man is a pervert, either openly or secretly. Thus, he prides himself for being an "open pervert", freely sharing his perverted thoughts about women with everyone.

name: Hien
description:
Race: Fox Tail
Class: Assassin

Often argues with Shouryuu over trivial matters.

name: Rodrick

Guild master of Merchant Guild Roderic.
