name: Elissa
description:
Elissa is Rayneshia's handmaiden from the Corwen clan. Much to Rayneshia's displeasure, Elissa often meddles in her affairs, especially when Krusty is involved.

(Source: Log Horizon Wiki)

name: Nyanta
description:
__Race:__ Werecat
__Class:__ Swashbuckler
__Subclass:__ Chef

Nyanta is an old friend of Shiroe, as he also used to be a member of the Debauchery Tea Party. He's the one who protected Serara while she was trapped in the city of Susukino. He considers himself a "gentleman"; his weapon of choice is the rapier which he can double-wield. He can cook meals that have actual taste due to his subclass.

name: Liliana
description:
Race: Elf
Guild: Crescent Moon Alliance

name: Kanami
description: Kanami was the former leader of the now-disbanded Debauchery Tea Party before she moved to Europe and started a new account on the European servers.

name: Miri  Yobami
description: Miri is a member of The Hundred Devouring Families. She arrived to the Hyakkaou Private Academy to gamble against Kirari Momobami in order to dethrone her from student council president position and thus choosing a new leader of their clan. Miri's and Miyo Inbami's families are specialized in medicine business (including poisons), being responsible for a conflict between other branches.

name: Rumia Uru
description: Rumia is a part of the Election Committee, serving as a referee during election gambling matches.

name: Ibara Obami
description: Ibara is a member of The Hundred Devouring Families. He arrived to the Hyakkaou Private Academy to gamble against Kirari Momobami in order to dethrone her from student council president position and thus choosing a new leader of their clan. Though his branch is widely known for being swindlers, Ibara isn't a good one, being known as a punching bag in his family.

name: Reze
description: Reze is a young girl who met [Denji](https://anilist.co/character/130102/Denji) in a phone cabin. She works at a local café and is a kind and gentle girl who seems to have a crush on Denji soon after meeting him. She laughs at his jokes and isn't afraid to get close to and intimate with him.

appearsIn.title: Chainsaw Man – The Movie: Reze Arc

name: Beam
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm (With fin: 176 cm)

He is a Shark Fiend and a Public Safety Devil Hunter from Special Division 4.

Beam is very eccentric. He often goes along with [Denji](https://anilist.co/character/130102/Denji)'s plans no matter how crazy they are due to having a lot of respect for the [Chainsaw Devil](https://anilist.co/character/170266/Pochita).

appearsIn.title: Chainsaw Man – The Movie: Reze Arc

name: Tenshi no Akuma
description:
__Height:__ 155 cm

Angel Devil is a devil who embodies the fear of angels, and a Public Safety Devil Hunter from Special Division 4.

The Angel Devil is a unique case among devils having virtually no hostility towards humans. He dislikes being ordered around and doesn't seem inclined towards combat. His extreme laziness holds him back from being a strong fighter and he often refuses to work, even claiming to prefer dying to working.

appearsIn.title: Chainsaw Man – The Movie: Reze Arc

name: Bouryoku no Majin
description:
He is a Fiend and Public Safety Devil Hunter from Special Division 4.

Despite his moniker as the Violence Fiend, he is extremely polite and straightforward. He apologized to [Beam](https://anilist.co/character/157232/Beam) after hitting him in self-defense and told the [Spider Devil](https://anilist.co/character/157277/Prinz) to evacuate the area when he mistook her for a human lady.

appearsIn.title: Chainsaw Man – The Movie: Reze Arc

name: Nimura Furuta
description: __Height:__ 175 cm

name: Donato  Porpora
description:
Donato Porpora is a Russian ghoul and a prisoner in the 23rd ward's Ghoul Detention Center. He was once running a Catholic orphanage in Japan. His alias was Priest (神父). He was also Koutarou Amon's foster father.

(Source: Tokyo Ghoul Wikia)

name: Katsuya Mabuchi
description: Katsuya Mabuchi is a ghoul investigator. He is the subordinate of Itsuki Marude and is normally seen standing beside Marude.

name: Uta
description:
__Height:__ 177 cm

A ghoul that has his own art studio where he makes masks for other ghouls. He has a lot of piercings and tattoos on his body, making him look pretty intimidating, even as a normal-looking human. He's the one who also made a mask for Kaneki.

name: Kakeru Naruse
description:
The series centers around him, his fate, and the efforts of his friends to fulfill the wishes of a letter from the future.

Kakeru is initially shown to be quiet and reserved, however, once [Hiroto Suwa](https://anilist.co/character/66595/Suwa-Hiroto) and the others invite him to join them on their walk home and hang out with him more, he seems to open up and enjoy himself. He enjoys video games. Though he puts up a happy front around his friends and family, he hides his true feelings often and is incredibly depressed over his mother's death/suicide, in which he blames himself for it happening. As the story progresses, he finally lets some of his feelings loose to Hiroto Suwa and [Naho Takamiya](https://anilist.co/character/66591/Takamiya-Naho), though even after the incident, he seems to still believe his feelings are only a burden to others. He is also very hard on himself on a consistent basis. He claims to think about killing himself every day. He is also a skilled runner and is the fastest runner in his class.

name: Hiroto Suwa
description: Suwa is [Naho](https://anilist.co/character/66591/Takamiya-Naho) and [Kakeru](https://anilist.co/character/66593/Naruse-Kakeru)'s classmate and friend. He is very energetic and outgoing and he loves to hang out with his friends. He likes Naho but knows she likes Kakeru, so he supports them both. Suwa will become a very important person to her in her future, but 16-year-old Naho doesnt know yet.

name: Naho Takamiya
description:
Naho Takamiya is the main female protagonist in Orange. When she receives a mysterious letter from the future involving [Kakeru Naruse](https://anilist.co/character/66593/Naruse-Kakeru), she and her friends try their hardest to fulfill the demands of the letter.

Naho is a very loving and shy girl who tends to scream whenever she is nervous or embarrassed. She is shown to have a rather passive personality, as on multiple occasions throughout the series, Naho is unable to speak her own mind and tell people (especially Kakeru Naruse) how she feels, possibly out of fear of hurting or confusing them. Despite this, however, Naho's feelings for what she cares about are very strong and passionate, even if she doesn't show it. As she gets older, she opens up and is able to tell people her feelings straight, but still shares some of her shy and reserved traits from high school. She is also shown to be fairly oblivious to people's romantic interest towards her, as seen with Kakeru and [Hiroto Suwa](https://anilist.co/character/66595/Suwa-Hiroto).

name: Saku Hagita
description: Hagita is a regular student in Nagano who becomes very good friends with [Kakeru](https://anilist.co/character/66593/Naruse-Kakeru). While he is not outgoing or charismatic, Hagita has a profound determination and intelligence. Hagita is a very big fan of reading manga and watching the television show 'Yuugata Get'. Later in the story, Hagita even goes as far as to buy Kakeru manga for his birthday. Throughout the story, subtle comments and interactions hint at an affection Hagita holds for [Murasaka](https://anilist.co/character/76830/Murasaka-Azusa) and in the future time line Hagita is married to Murasaka.

name: Azusa Murasaka
description:
She is one of [Naho](https://anilist.co/character/66591/Takamiya-Naho)'s best friend who supports her throughout the series. She is often seen arguing with [Hagita](https://anilist.co/character/76832/Hagita-Saku), but has a cheerful personality.

Azusa is shown to be cheerful, playful, bright, and kind to her friends. She accepted many of the nicknames she received in middle school, proving her to be open-minded to most things. Though, she may be mischievous at times.

name: Takako Chino
description: Takako is one of [Naho](https://anilist.co/character/66591/Takamiya-Naho)‘s best friends. She is shown as fairly mature and little boyish who is supportive and unafraid to stand up for her friends, especially Naho Takamiya.

name: Iori Kitahara
description: Iori Kitahara is a first year Mechanical Engineering student at Izu University. Despite no initial interest, Iori comes to love diving and spending time with the members of the club, whom he becomes friends with and cares about despite their rambunctious behavior and endless crazy schemes.

name: Chisa Kotegawa
description: Chisa Kotegawa is Iori's cousin and a first-year mechanical engineering student at Izu University. Chisa appears to more level-headed and serious compared to other characters. She has a clear dislike for rowdy behavior and can be quite hostile, especially when it is directed towards her (especially with Iori). She rarely takes part in drinking or crazy antics and is usually seen sitting off the side as an observer. She loves diving and looking at diving equipment. Chisa is one of three female students in her class idolized by her male classmates due to her major's lack of females.

name: Kouhei Imamura
description: A first-year Mechanical Engineering student at Izu University. He is [Iori](https://anilist.co/character/123182/Kitahara-Iori)'s best friend and a diehard otaku, perceived to be a lolicon by his acquaintances. He happens to be particularly obsessed with the little sister character trope (hence his obsession with [Shiori Kitahara](https://anilist.co/character/125928/Kitahara-Shiori)). While many are repulsed by his otaku lifestyle, he is indifferent to how he is perceived by others.

name: Aina Yoshiwara
description: Aina is a first year at Oumi Women's University. She joins Grand Blue Diving Club after getting to know Iori and Kouhei. She is a really shy girl and hates having to expose her skin. She soon becomes good friends with Chisa.

name: Azusa Hamaoka
description: Azusa Hamaoka is a third-year at Oumi University and is a part of the intercollegiate diving club with Izu University. Known for her very outgoing and exhibitionist personality, she displays particular friendship/comradeship to Iori.

name: Shinji Tokita
description: He is a third year Mechanical Engineering student at Izu University.

name: Ryuujirou Kotobuki
description: He is a third year Mechanical Engineering student at Izu University.

name: Nanaka Kotegawa
description: Iori's Elder Cousin. When Iori comes to Grand Blue he doesn't recognise her at first since she had become very beautiful and gets attracted to her only to find out later that she has become a siscon who smells her younger sister Chisa's after worn clothes and takes her photo all the time.

name: Yuu Mitarai
description: One of Iori's classmates at Izu University. Unlike most of the others, Yuu is in a relationship with his childhood friend Rie, which his friends immediately attempt to sabotage once they find out.

name: Rie Oohashi
description: She is a first year student at Oumi Women's University and Yuu Mitarai's childhood friend.

name: Reki Kyan
description:
__Height: __176 cm (5'9")
__Talent: __Skateboarding; Woodworking

Reki is a second year of high school student who loves skateboarding. He gets caught up in the underground skateboarding race "S".

name: Langa Hasegawa
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm (5'10")
__Talent:__ Snowboarding, Skateboarding

At first glance, Langa appears to be a very stoic young man, barely showing any emotions. But on the inside, he’s more complex and appears to be more confident.

Langa is a teenage boy with blue hair that grows past his ears and blue eyes. He is above average height as he’s taller than [Reki](https://anilist.co/character/195120/Reki-Kyan). Throughout the series, Langa wears the average high school uniform of black pants, a yellow jacket, and a white button-down shirt. But when he associates with [Reki](https://anilist.co/character/195120/Reki-Kyan) he wears baggy clothes consisting of dark pants, a blue coat, and a gray-colored shirt.

Langa was born in Canada to a Japanese mother and Canadian father and grew up snowboarding. As a teenager, he and his mother moved to Okinawa to start anew.

name: Miya Chinen
description:
__Height__: 158 cm (5'2")
__Talent__: Skateboarding, Talking to cats

Miya Chinen is a character in the SK8 the Infinity anime series who is an elite middle school student and candidate for Japan's national team. Miya is seen as a carefree boy. He is interested in skating, but not portrayed as obsessed like some of his competitors in "S," an underground and dangerous skateboard race at an abandoned mine.

As a child Miya loved skating and had fun with it. As he grew up, he began improving and received awards for it. However, this lead to his friends assuming that he saw them as "sidekicks" and looked down on them. Furthermore, this resulted in Miya losing his friends, eventually bringing about his negative outlook towards friendship as a whole.

name: Hiromi Higa
description: In his normal life, as a florist, Shadow looks friendly and kind to his customers. However, entering the middle of the night and S, he changes his attitude to be arrogant, bad, and rude which is thought to be his outlet whenever he experiences unpleasant things during the day.

name: Kaoru Sakurayashiki
aliases: Cherry Blossom (チェリーブロッサム)
description:
__Height:__ 182 cm

Kaoru is calm intellectual, well-known even outside of "S" as a famous and successful AI calligrapher. He's been shown to treat clients and strangers with polite respect, but is often prickly towards those closest to him, most prominently his fellow "S" member and childhood friend [Kojiro Nanjo](https://anilist.co/character/195123).
Kaoru is also notably competitive when skateboarding - but does truly trust and care for those who he considers his friends.

name: Kojirou Nanjou
description:
__Height:__ 189 cm
__Talent:__ Cooking
__Affiliation:__ Sialaluce (restaurant)

He is a skilled skater and a founding member of "S", he uses his unique build and status to skate in an aggressive, movement-oriented manner. 

Despite his aura of hostility towards [Cherry Blossom](https://anilist.co/character/195118/Sakurayashiki-Kaoru), they are good friends, who have the utmost confidence in each other and their abilities. He is shown to be deeply attached to Kaoru, being the person for whom Kaoru sneaks out of the hospital after his injury, and the one who carried Kaoru when he passed out after [Adam](https://anilist.co/character/195122/Shindou-Ainosuke)'s attack. Kojiro and Kaoru were shown to be close, using each other's first name in addition to the childhood friend aspect. Kojiro is extremely loyal to Kaoru and so is Kaoru.

Kojiro has a "papa bear" mentality and appears as a father figure to the young boys, giving them advice and noticing things that are wrong with them. He is very open-minded and kind to the young boys, trying to help them whenever he can.

He helps [Reki](https://anilist.co/character/195120/Kyan-Reki) overcome his doubts and often picks him up when he is afraid he might do something reckless. He talks to Reki when he is depressed, trying to help him regain his self-esteem. He notices the little things in the younger boy's behavior and his playboy personality fades as he shows support.

name: Ainosuke Shindou
description:
__Zodiac:__ Taurus
__Affiliation:__ Diet Member
__Relatives:__ 3 Unnamed Aunts; Aiichirou Shindou (father)
__Talent:__ Skateboarding

He can use an ability called "Love Hug" which allows him to seem like he is riding uphill.

name: Tadashi  Kikuchi
description: He is Ainosuke Shindo's secretary and the person who originally taught him to skate.

name: Shoukichi Oka
description:
Oka is the manager at Dope Sketch, he  appears to genuinely care about the wellbeing of his employees, especially Reki.

He demonstrates that he isn't afraid to be dramatic and tell jokes, such as when he led Reki and Langa to believe that the reason he couldn't deliver a package was due to needing to work to pay off Dope Sketch's debt.

name: Sketchy
description: Sketchy is [Oka](https://anilist.co/character/213236/)'s fennec fox.

name: Muten Roushi
description:
The "Turtle Immortal" is an ancient and wise martial arts master and the first Earthling to wield the Kamehameha. Though he seems frail, he is a mighty warrior. Muten-Rôshi trained [Grandpa Son Gohan](https://anilist.co/character/2104/Son-Gohan), [Ox King](https://anilist.co/character/2094/Gyuumaou), [Son Goku](https://anilist.co/character/246/Son-Gokuu), [Kuririn](https://anilist.co/character/2159/Kuririn), and [Yamcha](https://anilist.co/character/4014/Yamcha). His home, Kame House, a shack on a small isolated island, serves as a gathering place for the Z Fighters and friends.

He is a stock character, as he is both the archetypal wise old man and dirty old man, the latter being typical of shōnen anime. Sometimes he gets cranky, which further provides comic relief. He is bald, with a thick goatee and a thick mustache. Muten-Rôshi wears beach clothes or a martial arts suit and a turtle shell on his back. He usually wields a walking stick.

His companions are usually [Oolong](https://anilist.co/character/2108/Oolong), [Umigame](https://anilist.co/character/2112/Umigame) and [Lunch](https://anilist.co/character/2105/Lunch).

name: Yamcha
description:
__Dragonball:__ Yamcha, the notorious desert bandit, started out as an antagonist of [Goku](https://anilist.co/character/246/Son-Gokuu) but quickly became his friend thanks to [Bulma](https://anilist.co/character/678/Bulma). He lived in the desert, which resulted in him never having much female contact. Whenever he encountered Bulma, he would blush immensely and become petrified right on the spot.  Yamcha's trade mark move was known as the Fist of the Wolf Fang. With this move, he would strike the opponent with his hands in a claw like pose with his middle finger, ring finger and thumb curled.  His best friend is a floating shift-shaping cat named [Pu'ar](https://anilist.co/character/677/Puar).

__Dragonball Z:__ Yamcha's cleaned up his act as a desert bandit and become a member of the Z-fighters as well as a student of [Master Roshi](https://anilist.co/character/6167/Muten-Roushi).  Yamcha gained incredible ki control as displayed in his new signature move the Spirit Ball.  With this move, he can guide a ki ball in any direction using his middle and index fingers.

name: Bulma
description:
__Birth Year:__ 733 Age
__Height:__ 165 cm (5'5")
__Race:__ Earthling 

Bulma is originally a secondary main character, but her role is quickly downplayed as the series continues, even though she does remain an important support character for most of the series. Bulma is a direct parody of the character Xuanzang from the Chinese novel _Journey to the West_. Even though Bulma's character parodies a monk, her Japanese name "Buruma" is the brand of a popular gym short worn by girls in Japan. Her re-adapted name Bulma is a direct take on the word "bloomers", which was a popular brand of women's underwear in the early 20th century.

Bulma is the second character to be introduced in the Dragon Ball series. In the early part of the story, she is the inventor of the Dragon Radar and is searching for the legendary Dragon Balls. Bulma was hoping to use the Dragon Balls to wish for the perfect boyfriend. While searching for a nearby Dragon Ball, she runs into [Son Goku](https://anilist.co/character/246/Son-Gokuu). It is at this time that she finds out Goku inherited one of the balls (the four-star ball) she is searching for from his [Grandpa Gohan](https://anilist.co/character/2104/Son-Gohan). Because of Goku's love for the ball and his belief that his Grandpa's spirit lives in the ball, Goku is not willing to give it up. Bulma then asks him to loan it for her in exchange of taking him in her travels.

name: Chapa-O
description: A famed competitor known for his strength, he loses to Son Goku in the preliminary rounds of both the 22nd and 23rd Tenka-ichi Bud0kai's.  He is named after the Indian food Chapati.

name: Sergeant Major Purple
description: Even though he is smart, Sergeant Purple (a.k.a. Ninja Murasaki) loses to Goku after a long, drawn out, somewhat farcical fight. He uses several ninja tricks to which Goku counters in his own kooky way. Even when he "split" into 5 Murasakis (the Murasakis were just 5 identical brothers with Sergeant Purple as the oldest), Goku was still able to defeat him. After the fight he tries to unleash Android 8 upon Goku, or he would destroy Android 8. Android 8 refuses, and Goku knocks out Purple before he could do anything. Murasaki eventually goes after Dr. Flappe and Android #8, but was presumably killed when Goku unintentionally tossed #8's bomb onto Murasaki's cheek in the anime only.

name: Tsukutsun Tsun
description: The son of the Tsun family. He is a martial artists and becomes Akane's boyfriend.

name: Buyon
description: Buyon is the hidden, blubbery monster of Muscle Tower. In the manga he was called The Jiggler. Buyon resides on the fifth floor of the tower, which is only accessible by falling through the trap door on sixth level, where General White resides with the imprisoned major of the nearby Jingle Village. At first, Buyon posed a seemingly undefeatable threat to Goku and Android #8, as everything Goku threw at him, such as a Kamehameha in the stomach or a kick in the face, simply bounced back. Judging by all of the cow skeletons on the floor, Buyon is a creature of insatiable appetite, and will do just about anything to get some food. Through a long, tiring process - in which both Goku and #8 were almost devoured - Goku eventually discovers Buyon's weakness; the cold. Knocking a small hole in the wall, Buyon froze. Goku simply walked up to the frozen monster and punched him once, which made him crumble apart as if he were made of dried clay. After that, it was the simple matter of using the Power Pole to bash through the ceiling to confront the leader of Muscle Tower. He is an obvious parody of The Blob

name: Namu
description: Namu first appears in the 21st Tenka-ichi Budōkai, fighting Ran Fuan. He has problems fighting her, because he is a Buddhist monk and she strips to her underwear, socks & shoes, but he overcomes and defeats her. His next fight is against Son Goku, and while it is an intense fight, he loses in the end. He competed because he needed the money to buy lots of water; where he was from, there was a terrible drought, and he had been sent to find a solution. Being defeated, however, he is unable to get the money to buy water and decides to leave. Muten Roshi reads his mind and gets acquainted with his intentions. He then gives him a capsule so that he can store water from a well, and in return, asks Namu to impersonate Muten Roshi in the crowd, as to protect Roshi's secret identity from his students, who were suspicious of Chun being Muten Roshi. In the 22nd Tenka'chi Bud�kai, he also makes an appearance in one of its anime filler, claiming to Goku and Roshi that this time he came to enjoy it, but he ends up losing to Tenshinhan on the preliminary rounds, as he was left unconscious and nearly killed as Tenshinhan wanted to leave a message to Goku and his friends. Later, he is killed by Piccolo Daimaō's minion, Tambourine. He is then revived by Shenlong. He is seen later in the DBZ series contributing to Goku's spirited bomb, and has a brief appearance in GT in the episode titled Piccolo's Decision.

name: Makoto Naegi
aliases: Super High School Level Good Luck (超高校級の幸運)
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3")
__Talent:__ Good Luck

Makoto is a student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. His talent is Super High School Level Good Luck (超高校級の幸運), meaning he got into Hope's Peak by winning a lottery, rather than being scouted for an extraordinary talent like everyone else. His title is the Ultimate Lucky Student in the English localization.

Makoto is friendly and a lot more down-to-earth than other students. He tends to act passively in conversation. According to him, his most distinguishing feature is his optimism.

appearsIn.title: Danganronpa 3: The End of Hope’s Peak High School - Future Arc

name: Sayaka Maizono
aliases: Super High School Level Idol (超高校級のアイドル)
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm (5'5")
__Talent:__ Idol

Sayaka is a student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. She is the Super High School Level Idol (超高校級のアイドル), or the Ultimate Pop Sensation in the English localization.

She is the lead singer of an incredibly popular idol group. She and Makoto were classmates in middle school.

appearsIn.title: Danganronpa 3: The End of Hope’s Peak High School - Future Arc

name: Kyouko Kirigiri
description:
__Height:__ 167 cm (5'5")
__Talent:__ ???

Kyouko is a student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. Her talent is unknown.

Kyouko is a mysterious, stoic, and independent person who deliberately masks her feelings so that others won't be able to read her. Because of this, she has a cold demeanor and appears to remain calm and collected in most situations. Despite this, however, she can sometimes let her emotions get the best of her when she's especially upset. Though aloof and slow to trust others, Kyouko is adept at noticing things that the other students don't, which proves vital once bodies start turning up. She often advises [Makoto](https://anilist.co/character/63851/Naegi-Makoto) on conducting investigations.

appearsIn.title: Danganronpa 3: The End of Hope’s Peak High School - Future Arc

name: Monokuma
description:
__Height:__ 75 cm (2'6") (DR1 & DRV3), 65 cm (2'2") (DR2)

A stuffed robotic bear and the self-proclaimed Headmaster of Hope's Peak Academy who instigates the various killing games in the Danganronpa series. Monokuma is often described as easygoing and cheerful at first glance, but with a very sinister undertone.. He loves hysteria, violence, chaos, and most of all, despair.

appearsIn.title: Danganronpa 3: The End of Hope’s Peak High School - Future Arc

name: Celestia Ludenberg
native: セレスティア・ルーデンベルク
description:
__Height:__ 164 cm (5'5")
__Talent:__ Gambling

Celestia is a student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. She is the Super High School Level Gambler, or the Ultimate Gambler in the English localization.

Also known as the "Queen of Liars", Celestia is renowned for her exemplary luck in games of chance. She's accumulated a sizable fortune by robbing anyone stupid enough to challenge her blind. She speaks softly and smiles often, but in a way that tends to creep out everyone around her. She also hides a surprisingly short temper and will start shouting (usually at [Hifumi](https://anilist.co/character/65535/Yamada-Hifumi)) if she isn't pleased.

name: Aoi Asahina
aliases: Super High School Level Swimmer (超高校級のスイマー)
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3")
__Talent:__ Swimming

Aoi is a student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. She is the Super High School Level Swimmer (超高校級のスイマー), or Ultimate Swimming Pro in the English localization.

Always energetic and friendly, Asahina is also a bit airheaded. She has difficulty remembering names.

appearsIn.title: Danganronpa 3: The End of Hope’s Peak High School - Future Arc

name: Yasuhiro Hagakure
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm (5'11")
__Talent:__ Fortune Telling

Yasuhiro is a student of Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. He is the Super High School Level Fortune Teller, or Ultimate Clairvoyant in the English localization.

Yasuhiro is cheery, laid-back, and a bit of a conspiracy theorist. He isn't very well-liked by the other students, and Yasuhiro himself has admitted that he is quite cowardly, lazy, slow-witted, and has a habit to act selfishly. Notably, he is mentioned to be very clumsy with money and he has constant problems with massive debts.

name: Hifumi Yamada
aliases: Super High School Level Doujin Author (超高校級の同人作家)
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7")
__Talent:__ Creating Doujins

Hifumi is a student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. He is the Super High School Level Doujin Author (超高校級の同人作家), or Ultimate Fanfic Creator in the English localization.

Hifumi comes across as creepy and perverted, and he has a habit of referencing anime and video games. He loves Buko, the female lead in his favorite anime series, Heretic Angel ☆ Mochi Mochi Princess. He has a particular dislike toward people who supposedly don’t understand the true meaning of doujin. His dream is to ‘save’ other people by making a doujin that will inspire them to create their own.

name: Leon Kuwata
aliases: Super High School Level Baseball Player (超高校級の野球選手)
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm (5'9")
__Talent:__ Baseball

Leon is a student of Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. He is the Super High School Level Baseball Player (超高校級の野球選手), or the Ultimate Baseball Star in the English localization.

Leon is passionate and hot-blooded. He often slacks off from studying and baseball training. However, he never encountered any problem with his attitude due to his status as the Super High School Level Baseball Player. He claims that he actually never liked baseball, and he is determined to change his title to "Super High School Level Musician" to win a heart of a girl that he happened to meet at the hair salon. Later, Leon actually states that he somewhat missed playing baseball; something that he did all the time since he was young.

name: Mondo Oowada
aliases: Super High School Level Biker Gang Leader (超高校級の暴走族)
description:
__Height:__ 187 cm (6'2")
__Talent:__ Biker Gang Leader

Mondo is a student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. He is the Super High School Level Biker Gang Leader (超高校級の暴走族), or Ultimate Biker Gang Leader in the English localization.

Mondo is the second leader of the Crazy Diamonds, Japan's largest and most feared biker gang. He has ​high respect for his brother from whom he inherited the gang from after he died. Mondo acts tough and has a strong sense of honor and loyalty to his companions. After he finishes his role as a gang member, he wants to become a carpenter.

name: Shimoda
description: She is a former student of Rena Nakano (the Nakano Quintuplets' mother) during her 2nd year of senior high school and she is currently a cram school lecturer. She is first seen encountering Itsuki Nakano while visiting the Nakano Family Grave.

name: Morgiana
description:
**Height:** 162-164 cm
**Birthplace:** Dark Continent (Katarg)
**Special Skill:** Kick
**Household Vessel:** Amol Selseria

Descendant of the hunting tribe, Fanalis. Her name is based on the slave girl who served Alibaba in "Alibaba and the forty thieves".

Morgiana was Jamil’s slave before. She was emotionless and unfriendly at first, but as time passed after she was liberated, she became more emotional little by little.

Although she looks like a normal girl, she can get closer with an enemy far away in an instant. In addition to her strong leg strength which can even enable her to vertically run up walls, she has a keen sense of smell on par with that of a dog’s, can also smell the stench of death emanating from the bottom of the pit and the smell of someone hiding in unseen places. Although weaker than her leg strength, her arm strength is strong enough to send a human like Alibaba flying.

After Alibaba’s departure from Qishan, she put the words of her defector, Goltas, on her chest, and started a journey to her hometown, Katarg. In the middle of her journey towards Balbadd, she helped Leila and Sahsa’s caravan to eliminate the thieves at the rock quarry. She reunites with Aladdin after that, and then joins Alibaba again in Balbadd.







The name Morgiana (مرجانة) means coral in Arabic.

name: Aladdin
description:
__Height:__ 130 cm (Initial) - 167 cm

A mysterious young boy with a huge djinn within his flute. His name is based on 'Aladdin and the Magic Lamp'. He travels in search of metal vessels that contain other djinns. He has a pure and innocent, yet wise personality that dislikes fighting. Although he looks like a child, he has manly interests.

He is known as a 'magi', through mediating with his staff, he can gather the magoi of rukhs for attacks. He also has the ability to materialize the djinn Ugo that lies within his flute. In addition, he can also make the magical turban that is wrapped around his head fly. Because he was concealed in the 'Sacred Temple' (the place Aladdin calls 'a sturdy room'), he does not know much about his identity and the world.

name: Alibaba Saluja
native: アリババ・サルージャ
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm
__Birth place:__ Balbadd
__Special skill:__ Royal Fencing
__Djinn:__ Amon

Initially, after an incident, he fled his home country of Balbadd, and resided in Qishan where he worked as a cart driver. He dreams of getting rich enough to buy a country. Alibaba was a teenager when [Aladdin](https://anilist.co/character/41949/Aladdin) randomly met him on his journey. Alibaba seems to be greedy at first and only thinks of money and good payment, though he values human life more and will save those in need. After being helped by Aladdin, he decides to team up with him and do dungeon diving. It was Alibaba's dream for a long time, but since almost nobody returned alive, he was too afraid to start a journey by himself.

He considers [Sinbad](https://anilist.co/character/42528/Sinbad) his hero because Sinbad was the only person who managed to return alive from the first dungeon.

name: Spartos Leoxses
native: スパルトス・レオクセス
description:
__Height:__ 179 cm
__Weakness:__ women

One of the Eight Generals of Sindria, from the Sasan Kingdom. He is the younger brother of Mystras Leoxses, and youngest son of Darius Leoxses.

name: Drakon
aliases: Dragul Nol Henrius Govius Menudias Partenuvonomias Dumid Os Kortanon
description:
Height: 226cm
Likes: teaching his subordinates
Weakness: his wife

One of the eight generals.

name: Jamil
description:
Jamil was the Slave Owner of Morgiana and Goltas. Jamil was the chief of Qishan.

 (Source: Magi Wikia)

name: Barkak
description: Barkak is the right general of the Imperial Army of Balbadd. Barkak is the person who taught Alibaba royal swordplay.

name: Byoln
description: Member of a trio of agents sent by Al Thamen. A tall and thin man using a rapier-like Dark Metal Vessel to create doppelgangers from his shadow, he also proves to be a very capable swordsman being almost at Sharrkan's level.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Seisyun Ri
description: (current) Height: 158 cm  Likes: Reciting poems  Weakness: Insects  Birth place: Kou Empire   He is an old acquaintance and assistant of Hakuei, who captured a dungeon with her. He uses dual swords and his household's vessel is 'Double Moon Swords'. He gets along well with Hakuryuu and does martial arts training together with him. He is annoyed that Hakuryuu grew taller than him.   (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Yuuri Katsuki
description:
Yuuri began skating at a very young age and aspires to become a great figure skater like his idol, [Victor Nikiforov](https://anilist.co/character/90225/Nikiforov-Victor). As stated by his teacher [Minako](https://anilist.co/character/169094/Okukawa-Minako), Yuuri is not a prodigy at skating, but his skills were honed by rigorous training, which also grants him good stamina. He is Japan's top figure skater; his greatest skating assets being his peculiar sense of rhythm and unique step. However, Yuuri succumbs to pressure easily following the death of his pet dog Victor, causing him to mess up at crucial moments. After failing his first appearance at the Grand Prix Final, his self-confidence was greatly affected, succumbing to extreme anxiety due to his shortcomings and performances in following competitions, thus leaving a black mark on his career, and resulting in his returning home after being away for 5 years.

Yuuri is kind, sensitive, and mild-mannered; he is also introverted and has a hard time opening himself up to others, preferring to be alone and practice ballet or ice skating than socializing with his peers. Despite having a lot of support from his family and friends, he greatly lacks self-esteem and is easily discouraged, causing bouts of anxiety. Contrary to how Yuuri sees himself due to his past failures, he is still considered Japan's best skater, having the loyal support of his fans and the juniors skaters that look up to him, much to his bewilderment.

name: Yuuri Plisetsky
native: ユーリ・プリセツキー
description: A 15-year-old next-generation Russian figure skater who has won three consecutive junior world championships. Because of his looks, he is called the "Russian Fairy," but as soon as he steps off the ice he becomes vulgar and acts more like a delinquent. He is an ambitious person who believes without a doubt he will become the best in the world.

name: Victor Nikiforov
native: ヴィクトル・ニキフォロフ
description: A 27-year-old "living legend" who has garnered the attention of the world. He is a skater who has won five consecutive world championships. He is popular with men and women of all ages, and he has a rock star-like charisma. Yuuri has been chasing after him since he was a child. Victor begins to take an interest in Yuuri for a strange reason.

name: Kenjirou Minami
description:
Kenjirou has a bright and innocent (if not naïve at times) personality. He is very supportive of Yuuri and his opponents during their FS program performances and is shown to be wanting to try new things, such as wanting to try performing a quad even though he has never landed one before. He is also very energetic and can get nervous in stressful circumstances, as seen when he is about to perform his FS program.

Kenjirou treats Yuuri as his idol and strives to be just like him, taking every gesture from Yuuri to heart. He has a habit of letting his emotions get the best of him, especially when he is happy or in the presence of someone he looks up to.

name: Takeshi Nishigori
description:
Takeshi Nishigori is a childhood friend and ex-rink mate of Yuuri Katsuki. He is married to Yuuko.

As a child, Takeshi used to tease Yuuri for being overweight, though Yuuko was quick to defend Yuuri from his teasing. He did not share the same interest in Victor Nikiforov that Yuuri and Yuuko did.

As an adult, he has a laid-back and benign personality, and often gives Yuuri blunt but practical advice. Though he still sometimes teases Yuuri like he did when they were children, he does so in a more friendly and joking way. He no longer skates seriously, but is still a fan of the sport along with his wife and daughters.

(Source: Yuri!!! On Ice Wikia)

name: Seung-Gil Lee
description:
A figure skater from South Korea, Seung Gil is a stoic and calculating young man. He is generally emotionless, even during his programs, and only thinks about ice skating and improving his skills. Due to his handsome looks, he's very popular, especially with women, but pays no attention to his fans and often treats other people in a cold, detached manner.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Min-so Park
description:
Min-so Park is Seung-gil Lee's coach.

Min-so is single-minded with Seung-gil, insisting that all of Seung-gil's effort should work towards the PyeongChang Winter Olympics. She is pleased when Seung-gil performs well for the Rostelecom Cup short program, and outwardly shows her disappointment when the skater fails to perform up to standard for the free skate. She does not show much emotional support towards Seung-gil. Seung-gil is often seen beside Min-so, but he shows almost no emotional closeness with his coach.

(Source: Yuri!!! On Ice Wikia)

name: Celestino Cialdini
native: チェレステーノ・チャルディーニ
description:
The former coach of Yuuri Katsuki and Jean-Jacques Leroy and the current coach of Phichit Chulanont. Celestino is usually quite cheerful, both on and off the ice. He tends to be a bit rigid in making decisions for his skaters' programs, rather than bending towards their opinions.

(Source: Yuri!!! On Ice Wikia)

name: Minako Okukawa
description:
Minako Okukawa is a former ballerina who currently teaches ballet at her studio in Hasetsu and the ballet teacher of Yuuri Katsuki.

Minako is an energetic and outgoing person, often striking ballet poses whenever she gets enthusiastic about something. She insists on manners, discipline, and body management, though she also enjoys alcohol, which contradicts her emphasis on manners and causes her to be quite brash and loud. She tries to keep Yuuri Katsuki motivated as a skater because the number of youth in Hasetsu is declining, putting her job as a ballet teacher in peril.

She is a big fan of figure skating and constantly expresses her attraction towards the male skaters while drunk, especially to Victor. She is also a big fan of Christophe Giacometti's, cheering for him when he performs and becoming flustered when noticed by him.

(Source: Yuri!!! On Ice Wikia)

name: Georgi Popovich
native: ギオルギー・ポポーヴィッチ
description:
Georgi Popovich is a Russian figure skater. He has a very serious attitude towards competitions, but also has his own comical way of expressing himself. He takes relationships so seriously to the point that he uses his own heartbroken experience as the theme of his skating programs.

(Source: Yuri!!! On Ice Wikia)

name: Kei
description:
A young woman whom Kaneda meets on his quest to find Tetsuo. She is a member of an anti-government organization that Ryu and Nezu are also involved in. 

Kei's role in the Resistance is important because she is completely loyal to its cause and to Ryu. She is strong willed and is the one to discover that Lady Miyako is an Esper too. Miyako helps Kei channel her thoughts and discovers she is a conduit for the Espers' telepathy. Kiyoko does this in the movie and Kei communicates with Kaneda and Tetsuo. She works closely with Chiyoko, a physically strong and resilliant resistance fighter and they look out for each other.

name: Shoutarou Kaneda
description: Kaneda is a carefree gang-leader who boasts a custom-modified motorcycle. He and [Tetsuo](https://anilist.co/character/2589/Shima-Tetsuo) have been best friends since early childhood. He is brash and not above teasing Tetsuo despite feeling affection for him as a younger brother. Upon rescuing [Kei](https://anilist.co/character/9875/Kei), Kaneda becomes involved in the activities of her group of anti-government guerillas in hopes of locating Tetsuo.

name: Tetsuo Shima
description: Kaneda's best friend since preschool and the second principal subject of the story's theme. Tetsuo is shown as a black sheep in the gang he and Kaneda are part of, and quietly suffers from a deeply rooted inferiority complex. He admires his friend yet at the same time strongly resents his own reliance upon him. After his psychokinetic abilities manifest, Tetsuo quickly becomes Kaneda's nemesis; he desires Kaneda's motorcycle (a symbol of status and power), and seeks to prove himself supremely powerful, without need of protection.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Ryuusaku
description:
Ryuusaku is a comrade of Kei's in the resistance movement who claims to be Kei's brother, but it is implied that this is not the case.

(Source: Fandom.com)

name: Kai
description:
Sometimes known as Kaisuke, he is a high-ranking member of Kaneda's gang. He does not play a major role at first​ but becomes more prominent later in the story.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Nezu
description: Nezu was a parliament member who is also the leader of the terrorist resistance movement against the government.

name: Kaori
description: A timid young girl who ends up becoming Tetsuo's companion and Akira's babysitter.

name: Miyako
description: Lady Miyako was a former test subject known as "Designated #19" from the Project. She is the high priestess and leader of a temple in Neo-Tokyo and a major ally of Kaneda and Kei as the story progresses, who plays an important role in the final battle with Tetsuo Shima.

name: Makoto Edamura
description: The self-proclaimed "greatest con artist in Japan" who makes a living swindling innocent seniors and tourists. Used to be an honest, affable guy. Collects capsule toy figures and loves coffee.

name: Laurent Thierry
native: ローラン・ティエリー
description: An infamous French conman who travels the world. He never loses his cool, and always keeps his eyes on the prize. Likes to dress up and joke around. Becomes the target of one of Edamura's schemes while sightseeing in Asakusa.

name: Abigail Jones
native: アビゲイル・ジョーンズ
description: An exceptionally athletic conwoman from Iraq with a flexible and toned body. Blunt and belligerent. Hides a secret in her childhood memories.

name: Cynthia Moore
description: Cynthia is confident in her abilities and takes pride in her sex appeal. She is a confident and outgoing woman. She’s very smart and good at acting. She can speak multiple languages and can stay calm in stressful situations.

name: Anderson
description: An inspector at the Los Angeles Police Department.

name: Sebastian
description: Owner of a small boarding house in Nice, France.

name: Yao Chen
description: Second-in-command of the Shanghai Suzaku Association.

name: Xiao Liu
description: Chairman of the Shanghai Suzaku Association.

name: Riku Dola
description:
Riku was an 18 years old Imanity who lived during the Great War on Disboard. He was one of the main protagonists in Tet's story. He encountered Shuvi while going on an expedition and brought her to his colony after having lost in a game against her (albeit willingly).

He bears many similarities with Sora, being his black hair, slender body, black eyes and his face. Riku is a master strategist and manipulator, much like Sora. He is capable of duping even the matriarch of the Nilvalen family (known as the strongest and smartest Elf at the time) into giving out valuable information, albeit at the cost of his health.

name: Nonna Zell
description:
Nonna Zell was an Imanity that lived during the Great War. She is Chlammy Zell's ancestor.

Nonna bears many similarities with Chlammy. She is quite short and fair-skinned, and has short, black hair and navy blue irises with pink pupils.

name: Couronna Dola
description:
One of the colonists in Tet's story and the supposed older sister of Riku. She was also the founder of Elchea after the Great War and is Stephanie Dola's direct ancestor.

Couronna has a very similar appearance to Stephanie Dola; however, her hair is slightly longer and darker. She cares about Riku, going as far as calling herself his sister after he had lost his family. Though she is a mere Imanity, she seems to be sensitive to things, as she was able to figure out that Shuvi was not an Imanity right away.

name: Schwi Dola
description:
Schwi was the first Ex-machina to be introduced in Tet's story. In the story she seeks to understand the human heart and was found by Riku. She looks like a young human but with several differences, being two tails coming out from her back and other machine like features protruding from around her body. She bears many similarities with Shiro.

Her behavior is similar to that of a stereotypical artificial intelligence. She can absorb and process data and intelligence very quickly and act in the appropriate manner, a unique characteristic of her race. However, she seems to have difficulty in comprehending emotions and desires, otherwise characterized by her as the heart.

name: Izuna Hatsuse
description:
__Race:__ Werebeast

Izuna Hatsuse is a Werebeast girl and the former ambassador of the Werebeast race to Immanity. After [Sora](https://anilist.co/character/82523/Sora) and [Shiro](https://anilist.co/character/82525/Shiro) forced the werebeasts to join the Commonwealth of Elkia, Izuna was directed by [Miko](https://anilist.co/character/137440/Miko) to follow and learn from them. [Steph](https://anilist.co/character/82527/Dola-Stephanie) has noted that she actually shares similarities to Sora and Shiro, such as lacking common sense, being arrogant towards others, and being extremely smart and competent at gaming. She mostly exhibits an innocent personality pertaining to her age yet is very competent at playing games to the point of representing the Werebeasts in national games against other races. She possesses all the incredible physical abilities found in all Werebeasts as well as the rare Blood Break found in a select few Werebeast individuals.

name: Nina Clive
description:
__Race:__ Elf

Nina Clive was an Elf that lived during The Great War. After Think faked her death, he assumed the title of Grand Magus in order to help accomplish her plans.

As a penta-caster, he is capable of maintaining 5 spells at the same time. Since quad-casters are considered elites, he is in fact a better spellcaster than most Elves. However, his power pales in comparison to the legendary octo-caster, Think Nirvalen. Aside from his magical skills, he was able to pose as the Grand Magus and the head developer of the Spirit-Breaking Rites without being exposed, with nothing but Think's instructions to rely on. This shows that he is actually pretty good in diplomatic affairs.

name: Think Nirvalen
native: シンク・ニルヴァレン
description:
Think Nirvalen was an Elf that lived during the Great War. She is Fiel Nirvalen's ancestor. She encountered Riku Dola after her invention of Void Zero Protection and its sister model, Eternal Fourth Protection.

Think bears many similarities with Fiel. She has long, wavy blonde hair and her eyes have purple irises with pink pupils. She has a small pink ribbon that keeps a small portion of her hair in a plait and a very large bust. Her clothes consisted of a white, rather revealing dress that showed her midriff and barely covered her chest and legs and golden armbands with a long strip of white fabric that acted as her sleeves. She wore brown sandals with a ballet-like wrap that went just past her ankles and simple, blue bracelets.

She also had a headpiece that was made of four different-coloured jewels - two blue, two pink - and hair accessories that were shaped like white flowers.

name: Yue
description:
Yue is a vampire who was imprisoned in the abyss. She was betrayed by her uncle and peers because of her monstrous magic and regeneration that made her nearly immortal.

With a fateful encounter, Yue met [Hajime](https://anilist.co/character/132848/Nagumo-Hajime) in a sealed room in the abyss. After being rescued, Yue was the person who suppressed Hajime's madness before he became a monster and she soon became Hajime's "special" person after what transpired in the Abyss.

Her appearance was described to be like the highest grade bisque doll with blonde hair and crimson eyes. She is 323 years old despite her small physique because she is a Vampire Princess. Her name Yue isn't her real name and was only given by Hajime so that she could leave her dark past and move on.

name: Kaori Shirasaki
description:
Kaori is one the most caring personalities in the series. She is a classmate of [Hajime](https://anilist.co/character/132848)'s back in their original world. She admires Hajime for his "strong" personalty and is the only classmate who pays attention to Hajime's existence in class even if she is popular in their school.

When summoned to another world, she receives the "Healer" job.

name: Hajime Nagumo
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm

Hajime was a complete otaku and always came to class with a sleepy expression. He was always bullied and was disliked by both of his male and female classmates for being close to their idol-like classmate [Kaori](https://anilist.co/character/132849). After wishing for his annoying classmates to be summoned to another world, the next thing he saw was they were on top of a pillar like structure in another world to become heroes.

He obtained the job of "Synergist" and continued to be bullied due to also being weak in this new world. He eventually fell into an abyss due to being hit by a classmate's fireball where he survived though a hell-like environment to become the powerful man he is today.

Hajime at the beginning of the story is said to have black hair and also has a slim body. He also had a kind face and attitude. But after falling in the abyss and eating a wolf-like monster, his body began to violently degenerate. When he drunk the sacred water, it made his body heal by destroying his bones and muscles then healing over and over again until he got a very muscular body due to overcompensation.

Due to the stress of breaking and healing, his hair turned white, a victim of the Marie Antoinette syndrome. His eyes also turned red and his body gained tattoo-like red lines which is the sign of him becoming a demonic monster similar to the monsters he ate that also possessed red lines along their bodies.

name: Tio Klarus
description: Tio is a "pervert" with the main status of M but she is honest and the words this one speakeas are similar to the old legends. Her "M" personality was made into this because she was defeated by Hajime's party in the northern mountains of the village of Ul. She's loyal and devoted herself to Hajime to become his slave and calls him since then "Master."

name: Shia Haulia
description: Shia first appeared when Hajime and Yue were traveling in the Raisen Grand Canyon while being chased by a monster like a "shameless rabbit." She was in this situation because she foresaw Hajime would help her family. She soon became their traveling companion in the long run, having the attitude to get clingy to Hajime with energetic words and actions.

name: Eliheid S. B. Heiligh
native: エリヒド・Ｓ・Ｂ・ハイリヒ
description:
He was the king of the Heiligh Kingdom when the heroes from Earth were summoned to Tortus.

He was assassinated by Eri Nakamura's undead army and secretly turned into one of her slaves until he was destroyed by Hajime Nagumo.

appearsIn.title: Arifureta: From Commonplace to World's Strongest

name: Cam Haulia
description: He is the chieftain of the Haulia tribe and is gentle at first. But after they were trained by Hajime he became cruel and one of the best assassins in their tribe even defeating a group of 50 Bear-man tribe.

appearsIn.title: Arifureta: From Commonplace to World's Strongest

name: Nana Miyazaki
description: She is one of the students from Japan who got involved in the Summoning Incident, and ended up in Tortus along with her other classmates. She is friends with Yuka Sonobe & Taeko Sugawara, and is currently part of "Aiko-chan's bodyguards" meant to protect her from danger of any kind (including the templar knight escorts from the Kingdom).

appearsIn.title: Arifureta: From Commonplace to World's Strongest

name: Kouki Amanogawa
description: He is one of the students from Japan who got involved in the summoning incident, and ended up in Tortus along with his other classmates. He is somewhat like the leader of the whole class, as most of the students look up to him. This is further enforced by him being bestowed with the rare job as the Hero.

appearsIn.title: Arifureta: From Commonplace to World's Strongest
Arifureta: From Commonplace to World's Strongest Season 2

name: Leonardo Watch
native: レオナルド・ウォッチ
description: A kind and humble young photographer who came to Hellsalem's Lot to help his ailing sister. A mysterious entity gave him the "All-seeing Eyes of God," granting him a variety of ocular powers, at the cost of his sister's sight.

name: Klaus von Reinherz
native: クラウス・V・ラインヘルツ
description:
The leader of Libra and young head of the noble Reinherz family. A large, very powerful man with a distinctive underbite, he is actually very well composed and gentlemanly and honest to a fault, with an unshakable will. Master of the Brain Grid Blood Battle Style, which he can use to create large cross-shaped weaponry and seal away vampires. 



Klaus is also very intelligent, being able to play the game "Prosfair," the complexity of which is known to drive humans mad (Klaus himself begins to bleed internally after playing the game for 99 hours without a break) and is a game usually reserved only for one distinct species in Hellsalem's Lot that has studied it for a thousand years.

name: Zapp Renfro
description:
Described as a hotheaded, hyper-sexual juvenile punk, he is easily annoyed, quick to lose his temper, and his juvenile actions often get him and others into trouble.

Despite this, he is supposedly good at looking after new members, and so was assigned as Leo's partner/bodyguard. He is also something of a ladies man, possessing several lovers in town.

For reasons unknown, he continuously tries to fight Klaus, only to be routinely smacked down.

name: Mary Macbeth
description:
A mysterious girl who approached Leonardo Watch after he recovered from his injury. She is the younger sister of [Black](https://anilist.co/character/89131).
She doesn't appear in the manga, and thus is an anime-only character.

(Source: Kekkai Sensen Wiki)

name: Blitz T. Abrams
native: ブリッツ・Ｔ・エイブラムス
description:
Outwardly jovial for the most part, he seems entirely unaware why people go out of their way to avoid him, and can come off as insensitive, such as when he chastised Leo for damaging an eye, telling him to 'sacrifice an arm' next time.

(Kekkai Sensen Wiki)

name: Michella Watch
description: The younger sister of Leo. She is unable to walk since birth. When visiting Hellsalem's Lot, she lost her eyesight in order to let Leo keep his and gain the "All-Seeing Eyes of God".

name: Benjamin Macbeth
native: ベンジャミン・マクベス
description: Benjamin Macbeth is the deceased husband of Emma Macbeth and the father of William and Mary Macbeth.

name: Shiboroba
description: Shiboroba is a beyondian who together with Yahabio & Udeshiubo were using the Ghost Wagon to transport humans for food to the alterworld.

name: Chain Sumeragi
description:
While diligent in the field, she can sometimes come off as cruel or indifferent towards others, such as when she seemingly ignored [Leo](https://anilist.co/character/89025/Watch-Leonardo) when he was being mugged, only to win his earning back later.

Despite this, she can also be quite sadistic, often causing physical harm to others, usually [Zapp](https://anilist.co/character/89130/Renfro-Zapp), with whom she doesn't get along. However, she does show some protectiveness towards her friends, as shown when she refused to give her friend Angelica's phone number to Zapp who kept pestering her.

Chain is a competitive drinker. She can down dozens of shots of alcohol in one sitting.

name: Neyka
description: Patrick's assistant, as well as a member of Libra.

name: Subaru Mimasaka
description:
A heavily built student who is introduced during the Autumn Election. Despite his look, he's smarter than he appears and has a strong sense for details. He has no specialty, but painstakingly researches and copies the chefs he faces, predicting the exact dish they will make and marginally improving upon it. He loves intense cooking-duels and totally defeating his opponent, so he always bets his opponent's precious tool at Shokugekis. He is a gracious host and not averse to having a casual chat with future opponents. However, before and during a match he will mock, belittle and set out to destroy his opponent.





(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Hisako Arato
description: Erina's secretary and close friend, Hisako specializes in medicinal-based dishes. She thinks of Erina as the best, that only she could be Erina's number two and nobody could ever get past her to Erina's level.

name: Isami Aldini
native: イサミ・アルディーニ
description:
Isami is Takumi's brother, and the younger nephew of the owner of Trattoria Aldini. Unlike his brother, he has more of a Japanese appearance, with black hair and sharp eyes. Isami is originally shown to be overweight, with his eyes and mouth drawn in a simple fashion, although he briefly became much thinner during the Autumn Election preliminaries. Like Isami, he enrolled in Tōtsuki to hone his skills at the behest of their uncle.

Although an equally talented chef, Isami is shown to be less sophisticated than his brother. He was scolded for trying to (and failing to) revise a dish that Takumi had made during their time in the trattoria, and constantly sought to be praised for his cooking like Takumi. Though Isami is supportive of his brother, he does aim to eventually surpass him as a cook. Nonetheless, the brothers are very close.



Isami and Takumi are featured in the Shokugeki no Soma – Fratelli Aldini spinoff manga which focuses on their time in Italy before enrolling at Tōtsuki Academy.

name: Shouji  Satou
description: Shōji Satō is a 92nd Tōtsuki Generation student and a resident of Polar Star Dormitory.

name: Jun Shiomi
description:
Shiomi is a 74th Generation Toutsuki Academy Alumnus and a former resident of the Polar Star Dormitory. She is one of the lecturers in Tootsuki Culinary Academy as well as the professor of the Shiomi Seminar. Shiomi Jun is leagal guardian of Hayama Akira.

Jun is the youngest lecturer in the academy, but is actually older than she physically appears. Despite the fact that she in her 30s, she is shorter than both Souma and Megumi and has a noticeably youthful face, causing both Souma and Megumi to mistake her as a middle school student of the academy.

name: Eishi Tsukasa
description:
__Height:__ 176cm

Eishi is a 90th Generation student of Tootsuki Culinary Academy and the current 1st seat of the Elite Ten Council.

Eishi, despite being the current 1st seat of the Elite Ten Council, is quite pessimistic, feeling that he does not deserve the 1st seat. He feels exasperated by the work forced upon him as the 1st seat and the workload caused by the two Shokugekis during the 43rd Annual Tootsuki Autumn Election.

name: Nanaba
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm
__Affiliation:__ Scouting Legion Survey Corps

name: Marlo Freudenberg
native: マルロ・フロイデンベルク
description:
__Affiliations:__ Military Police, 104th Cadet Corps.

Recruit of the Military Police stationed in Stohess District.

While most who join the Military Police Regiment do so because they want a safe position far from the danger of the Titans, Marlo did so because he claims to want "to uphold justice and do what's right.", much to the amusement of his fellow officer, [Hitch Dreyse](https://anilist.co/character/86017/Hitch-Dreyse), whom he often clashes with due to them being near complete opposites. His goal is to rise to the top of the organization so he can stop the pilfering of taxes and misappropriation of land. Though steadfast in his idealism, he could make moral compromises to achieve his goal, confessing a willingness to act like "scum" in order to move up in rank. Due to his passion towards his ideals, he had often been compared to [Eren Yeager](https://anilist.co/character/40882/Eren-Yeager) by people who know both of them.

name: Megane no Kyoukan
description: Instructor with glasses that first appears in episode 3 and is later seen in episode 5 teaching the 104th Corps what is known about the Titans and their origins.

name: Keith Shadis
native: キース・シャーディス
description: Keith Shadis was the head instructor of the 104th Trainees Squad. He seemed to be a friend or have some sort of relationship with [Dr. Grisha](https://anilist.co/character/62477/Yeager-Grisha), as he knew [Eren](https://anilist.co/character/40882/Yeager-Eren) is the son of the doctor and praised Eren for his effort.

name: Naki Kitou
description: Naki Kitou, the ringleader of the Kitou Family who for generations have been sacrificing people to the "tsuchinoko".

name: Hana
description: Hana is an anthropomorphized anatomical model that resides with Ayase and Seiko.

name: Tarou
description: Taro is an anthropomorphized anatomical model that resides at Ayase's and Takakura's school.

name: Shinpei Ajiro
description: Shinpei Ajiro is the main protagonist of the Summer Time Rendering series. He returned to his hometown of Hitogashima for the first time in two years to attend the funeral of his childhood friend, Ushio Kofune. Since he lost his parents at an early age and grew up in the Kofune family, he has been close to Ushio and Mio as if they were his family.

name: Hizuru Minakata
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm

Hizuru Minakata is an author who writes using the pseudonym

name: Ushio Kofune
description:
__Height:__ 162 cm

She lives in Hitogashima, she lost her life in a maritime accident while trying to save Shiori from drowning in the sea. Her death acts as the starting point of the story, with Shinpei returning home to attend her funeral.

name: Mio Kofune
description: She is Ushio's younger sister and a first-year high school student. She is good at sports, belongs to the swimming club, and has tanned skin. Despite the death of her older sister, she has a healthy side, such as her cheerful attitude toward Shinpei when he returns home.

name: Tatsuo Kobayakawa
description: The father of [Shiori](https://anilist.co/character/155707/Shiori-Kobayakawa).

name: Tokiko Hishigata
description:
__Height:__ 150 cm


Tokiko Hishigata is Sou's younger sister, a first-year high school student. She is intelligent and has the top grades in her grade, but she is physically weak and not good at sports. She and Mio have known each other since childhood and are classmates at the same high school.

name: Shiori Kobayakawa
description: A young girl living in Hitogashima. Her family owns the Koba Mart. She was saved from drowning by [Ushio](https://anilist.co/character/155712/Kofune-Ushio), however, ended up drowning herself in that incident.

name: Masahito Karikiri
description: Masahito Karikiri is the chief priest of the Nitto Shrine located in the northern part of Hitogashima.

name: Alain Kofune
description: Alain is the father of [Ushio](https://anilist.co/character/155712/Ushio-Kofune) and [Mio](https://anilist.co/character/155706/Mio-Kofune). He is from France and runs a restaurant called "Western Cuisine Kofune" in Hitogashima. For [Shinpei](https://anilist.co/character/155703/Ajiro-Shinpei), he is the adoptive father who welcomed him after he lost his parents in an accident. His wife, Kotoko, died after the birth of [Mio](https://anilist.co/character/155706/Mio-Kofune).

name: Tetsu Totsumura
description: A lighthearted police officer who works at Hitogashima's only police station. His personality leaves people wondering if he truly is an officer.

name: Laios Thorden
description:
__Height:__ 185 cm (6'1")

Laios is the leader of his party and Falin's older brother. He is a tall-man from the Northern Continent.

Laios is a monster fanatic and a strong fighter. His deep knowledge and passion for monsters helps him to excel in combat and dungeon exploration. However, social skills are where he often falters; he struggles to pick up social cues, resulting in a lack of awareness and tact. This has caused him a lot of trouble throughout his life, a shortcoming that he is painfully aware of and insecure about. Despite this, Laios is extremely kindhearted, accepting, and friendly.

name: Marcille Donato
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3")

Marcille is mage who is part of [Laios'](https://anilist.co/character/126818/Thorden-Laios) party. She is an elf from the Northern Continent.



Marcille is kind, intelligent, principled, and loyal to her friends. However, she can also be very high-strung and has a difficult time dealing with things far outside her comfort zone (such as eating monsters). She has a lot of confidence in her magic ability due to her background, and can feel lonely when she's unable to help the party. She was one of the best students at the Magic Academy, where she joined the research program specializing in dungeon-making; this is where she met [Falin](https://anilist.co/character/130508/Thorden-Falin), and is still her closest friend to this day. Marcille can also be a bit naive at times, believing that friendships alone can keep a party together.

name: Senshi
description:
__Height:__ 140 cm (4'7")

Senshi is a member of Laios' party. He is a dwarf from the Eastern Continent.

Having spent 10 years studying monster cuisine and living a self-sufficient life inside the dungeon, Senshi loves cooking and is more than happy to share his knowledge and skills. He is dependable and strong, but can also be rather stubborn and set in his ways. He helps maintain the natural environment and ecology of the dungeon, and considers  himself part of it. He dislikes magic and treats it with a great deal of gravity and caution.

name: Izutsumi
description:
__Height:__ 150 cm (4'11")

Izutsumi is a former member of Shuro's party and currently a part of Laios' party. She is a tall-man (beast-man) from the Eastern Archipelago.

Izutsumi is rather stand-offish, but is not a distant person; she's fairly self-centered, but is in the process of learning the value of working with others. She is primarily fueled by a determination to find someone to lift her curse. She has terrible table manners and is a picky eater.

name: Chilchuck Tims
native: チルチャック・ティムズ
description:
__Height:__ 110 cm (3'7")

Chilchuck is a member of [Laios](https://anilist.co/character/126818/Thorden-Laios)' party. He is a half-foot from the Eastern Continent.

Chilchuck is shrewd, practical, and sharp-tongued. He refuses to take jobs unless he is paid in advance. His specialties are lockpicking and identifying and disarming traps. He's more open to eating monsters than [Marcille](https://anilist.co/character/127292/Donato-Marcille) is, but like her, draws a hard line at humanoids. He generally goes along with whatever the party does, but will speak frankly when they do something that can get them killed. His job as the party rogue puts him on edge, as failure to undo or avoid traps can lead his companions to immediate mortal danger. When his party members ignore his warnings, he quickly becomes agitated. He prefers to keep his private life separate from his work, so he doesn't tell his party a lot about himself.

name: Falin Thorden
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7")

Falin is [Laios](https://anilist.co/character/126818/Thorden-Laios)'s younger sister and a mage specializing in support spells. She is a tall-man from the Northern Continent.

Falin is a very kind, caring, and considerate person who doesn't want to hurt others. She extends this kindness even to the restless dead, who she has been attuned to since childhood. She can also be self-sacrificing and reckless; if the lives of her loved ones are in danger, she would not hesitate to take the blow in their stead. Like her brother, Falin has also had a fanatic interest in biology from a young age.

name: Toshirou Nakamoto
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm (5'11")

Shuro is a former member of the Thorden siblings' party. His real name is Toshiro Nakamoto.

He is an Eastern man with long black hair tied back in a ponytail, fair skin, and black eyes. He is shorter than Laios but taller than Marcille. When he appears again in the story, he appears more gaunt with sunken eyes and an unshaven face.

Ordinarily, Shuro is a reserved man who doesn't often make demands of others. He has trouble expressing his true opinions to other people, instead relying on subtle social cues to imply what he feels. If the other party doesn't understand it, he tends to go along with what they say instead of push the issue. He seems to be impulsive under pressure, making snap decisions such as rescuing Falin by himself.



(Source: Dungeon Meshi Wiki)

name: Namari
description:
__Height:__ 130 cm (4'3")

Namari is a former member of [Laios](https://anilist.co/character/126818/Thorden-Laios)' party and a current member of [Tansu](https://anilist.co/character/239685/Floke-Tansu)'s party. She is a dwarf from the Eastern Continent.

Namari is very knowledgeable about weapons and blacksmithing. Even though she has a strict personality when it comes to work and isn't on the best terms with her former party, she still worries about them and treats them like friends. It is rumored that she often argues with her employers over payment, and that her father is a well-known weapon dealer who scammed the government and later disappeared.

name: Kabru
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7")

Kabru is the leader of his party, exploring the dungeon together with [Rinsha](https://anilist.co/character/135289/Rinsha), [Mickbell](https://anilist.co/character/239690/Tomas-Mickbell), [Kuro](https://anilist.co/character/239687/Kuro), [Daia](https://anilist.co/character/239691/Diamond-of-Sadena), and [Holm](https://anilist.co/character/239686/Kranom-Holm). He is a tall-man from Utaya, part of the Western Continent.

Kabru typically appears rather laid-back, but he is an extremely socially intelligent, analytical, and calculating man with a strong sense of justice. His hobby is observing and analyzing people and their relationships; he remembers every tiny detail about everyone that he comes across. He can be ruthless when he needs to be. Kabru's main goal is to prevent the dungeon from expanding and destroying the nearest villages, which happened to his home village of Utaya and led to his mother's death when he was a child.

name: Rinsha
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm

She's a young wizard from the Eastern countries and a member of Kabru's party. It is hinted that she might have romantic feelings towards Kabru as she seems extremely jealous over him. 

Not much is known about her, except the fact that she's most likely from a country other than Shuro's homeland and she can use lightning with her magic. She's rather wary of people she doesn't know, and most of the time she looks like she's annoyed.

name: Kawaki
description:
__Height:__ 183 cm 
__Affiliation:__  

Kawaki is a shinobi raised by [Jigen](https://anilist.co/character/130418/Jigen) and his organization Kara to be the future vessel for [Isshiki Ōtsutsuki.](https://anilist.co/character/189948/Isshiki-Ootsutsuki) After being brought to Konohagakure, he is taken in by [Naruto Uzumaki](https://anilist.co/character/17/Naruto-Uzumaki) and develops a brotherly bond with [Boruto Uzumaki.](https://anilist.co/character/121439/Boruto-Uzumaki) 

After being brought to Konohagakure by Team 7, he is taken in by Naruto Uzumaki who raises him as his own, during which he develops a brotherly bond with Boruto Uzumaki to solve the mystery of the Kāma. Stemming from his harsh childhood, Kawaki is shown to be aggressive and vulgar to people he dislikes or opposes. He showed sympathy for weak and injured animals and refused to let innocent children get hurt. He is Naruto's disciple just like Boruto is Sasuke's.

name: Boruto Uzumaki
description:
Boruto Uzumaki is a shinobi from Konohagakure's Uzumaki clan and a direct descendant of the Hyūga clan through his [mother.](https://anilist.co/character/1555/Hinata-Hyuuga) While initially resentful of his [father](https://anilist.co/character/17/Naruto-Uzumaki) and his absence since becoming Hokage, Boruto eventually comes to respect his father and duties. Regardless, he vows to instead become a shinobi like his [mentor.](https://anilist.co/character/13/Sasuke-Uchiha)

Boruto is loud, energetic, and stubborn not unlike his father; even possessing a verbal tic, "dattebasa" (だってばさ), similar to Naruto's "dattebayo" and his paternal [grandmother's](https://anilist.co/character/7302/Kushina-Uzumaki) "(da)ttebane" ((だ)ってばね). However, compared to his father at his age, Boruto is more refined and crafty, seemingly knowing all the shortcuts, as well as more mature in knowing how the world works. Between the two, he is more sarcastic. Unlike Naruto, Boruto doesn't yell what he feels, which is the biggest difference. Despite his laid-back attitude, he is very diligent. Conversely, Boruto's upbringing has also been different than that of his father's: Boruto's family is always there for him, and he likewise has many friends, and his acquisitions came easily and naturally to him from a combination of prodigious talents and nurturing parents.

name: Mitsuki
description: Mitsuki was created as a synthetic human by [Orochimaru](https://anilist.co/character/2455/Orochimaru), being cultivated from the same embryo as at least one older "Mitsuki". Orochimaru, as Mitsuki's "parent", wanted Mitsuki to find his independence, having concocted a complex plot for Mitsuki to do so. On Orochimaru's sixth attempt of the plan, each time erasing Mitsuki's memories of the previous, Mitsuki mastered Sage Transformation and decided to rebel against his "parent" and "older brother". He left their company and set out to forge his own destiny himself, now going by the name "Mitsuki" by replacing the second character with "Tsuki". Upon discovering the existence of [Boruto Uzumaki](https://anilist.co/character/121439/Boruto-Uzumaki) via a gift from Orochimaru, Mitsuki decided to go to Konoha and befriend him in order to find his own path in life.

appearsIn.title: Naruto: The Seventh Hokage and the Scarlet Spring

name: Sarada Uchiha
description:
Sarada Uchiha is a kunoichi from Konohagakure's Uchiha clan. Because she grew up without having her [father](https://anilist.co/character/13/Sasuke-Uchiha) around, Sarada initially struggles to understand who she is or what she's supposed to be. After meeting him with the help of [Naruto Uzumaki](https://anilist.co/character/17/Naruto-Uzumaki), Sarada comes to believe that she is defined by the connections she has with others, and as a member of [Team Konohamaru](https://anilist.co/character/3889/Konohamaru-Sarutobi), she seeks to someday become Hokage so that she can connect with as many people as possible.

However, Sarada shares a complicated relationship with Naruto's son, [Boruto Uzumaki](https://anilist.co/character/121439/Boruto-Uzumaki), although she is also interested in him due to their similar relationships with their respective fathers. The two ninjas are often at odds with one another, with the young Uchiha valuing the Hokage post while Boruto initially showing utter disdain for it, and they usually argue and fight with each other for almost anything. Despite this, they are very close, deeply caring for one another's well-being and actually supporting their dreams greatly. In the anime, Sarada appears to be close to [Himawari](https://anilist.co/character/121445/Himawari-Uzumaki) as well, referring to her as "Hima-chan".

appearsIn.title: Naruto: The Seventh Hokage and the Scarlet Spring

name: Coco
description:
She is a young girl who becomes an apprentice witch under the witch [Qifrey](https://anilist.co/character/129841/) after her initial accidental use of forbidden magic turned her mother to crystal. She hopes to search the Tower of Books for the book containing the magic, in order to reverse its effects on her mother.

She is quite a dork for magic, with a child-like (even for her age) widen eyed look whenever she sees things that are common for every other witch. The very magic that inspired her was simple magic made by Qifrey's watcher that caused glowstone path to light up.

name: Qifrey
description:
Qifrey is a witch and [Coco](https://anilist.co/character/129840/Coco)'s teacher. He runs an atelier and currently has four disciples.

He is a caring teacher who patiently teaches his students magic.
