This is especially true for Coco, who has no special abilities as a witch at first but he continues to encourage her until she can draw magic skillfully. He is protective of all his disciples, as seen from how he protects them from being taken by Esheath from the Magic Security Council. However, Qifrey is overly obsessed with his goal to locate the Brimmed Hats, with his gentle attitude oftentimes replaced by a buried hatred he has always hidden. It appears he had a personal agenda against the Brimmed Hats, as well.

name: Richeh
description:
Richeh is a young witch in training and a disciple of [Qifrey](https://anilist.co/character/129841/Qifrey). She wants to keep her magic essentially "pure" and unchanged and resents having to do what others tell her to do. 

Richeh specializes in crystal magic, particularly in creating transparent crystal ribbons. She also excels at drawing small, intricate glyphs, and has been shown to be adept at connecting these together to form magical portal holes. She has a seemingly emotionless and childish personality. She avoids showing much emotion, though others can still notice emotions on her. She is particularly prone to showing that she's angry at people.

name: Tetia
description:
Tetia is a young witch in training at [Qifrey's](https://anilist.co/character/129841/) Atelier. She loves clouds and dreams of creating the perfect cloud magic.

She's perpetually energetic and has a habit of thanking people for thanking her. Tetia is an extremely upbeat, loving girl that tries to help everyone she knows and keep the mood high. She is also the one who often gets everyone grounded and keeps the mood up by being loving to her friends.

name: Agott Arkrome
native: アガット・アークロム
description:
Agott is a witch in training and [Qifrey](https://anilist.co/character/129841/)'s student. She belongs to the famous Arkrome house, who have served as librarians at the Tower of Books for generations.

She has a tendency to focus on how much more she still needs to accomplish, leading her to express dissatisfaction with her current progress. Agott suffers from self-esteem issues over being considered merely average and she takes that out on others who she doesn't think either deserves magic or have the talent to do so, which is usually [Coco](https://anilist.co/character/129840/Coco).

name: Olruggio
description:
He is a witch and serves as the Watchful Eye for [Qifrey](https://anilist.co/character/129841/Qifrey)'s atelier. He has a gruff way of speaking but his magic is often described as "warm". He has created a lot of magical items, such as the Glowstone Path, the Snugstone and the Searneedle Wand. His specialty is fire-based magic.

He is very caring to the apprentices and gives them things that might be helpful, as well as rushing to Qifrey's aid, but every time someone points out he's acting very nicely, he tries to brush it off as something anyone would do or to his work as watchful eye.

name: Alaira
description: Alaira is a senior witch who lives at the Witch Auditorium. She is friends with [Qifrey](https://anilist.co/character/129841/).

name: Iguin
description: Iguin is the Brimmed Hat Witch who sold a book of forbidden magic to [Coco](https://anilist.co/character/129840/Coco). Their motivation is somewhat unknown, but it has something to do with Coco. They appear to be incredibly powerful, possessing magic that is beyond the scope of normal witches. Iguin also has incredible agility, being able to jump while casting magic. They rarely appear except to interfere with Coco from the sidelines.

name: Fudemushi
description:
A member of a species called the brushbuddy. A small creature with fur resembling a paintbrush. It possesses a natural instinct to gather wherever it catches the scent of Magic Ink.

Friendly and affectionate, it has grown quite attached to [Coco](https://anilist.co/character/129840/Coco) and the members of the Atelier.

name: Coco no Haha
description: [Coco](https://anilist.co/character/129840/Coco)'s mother is a middle-aged woman who owns her own tailoring shop. She raised Coco by herself after her husband died.

name: Kaori Orimoto
description: [Hachiman](https://anilist.co/character/67065) and Kaori both went to the same junior school. Hachiman also used to like her and asked her out before.

appearsIn.title: My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU Climax!

name: Fujin Yuigahama
description: [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/67069)'s mother. She seems to be lenient, kind, friendly person being mostly like Yui herself.

appearsIn.title: My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU Climax!

name: Kakeru Tobe
description: Kakeru is one of [Hayato](https://anilist.co/character/79591)'s friends. He is in the football club. He has feelings for [Hina](https://anilist.co/character/79595) and is the only guy in class who often supports Hina's scripts.

appearsIn.title: My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU Climax!

name: Wirbel
description: Second-class mage and the leader of the eighth party during the first stage of the First Class Mage Exam. He is the captain of the Northern Magic Corps and is thus a very experienced mage. Specializes in magic that restrains the opponent when their body is in full-view.

name: Ehre
description: Second-class mage in the Eighth Party, alongside Wirbel and Scharf, in the First Class Mage Exam. Fern feels that she is the strongest within both the Fourth and Eighth parties.

name: Scharf
description: Scharf is a third-class mage and member of the eighth party along with Wirbel and Ehre for the First Class Mage Examination.

name: Minami no Yuusha
description: The Hero of the South is a Hero who fought on the front lines against the demons for mankind before Himmel met Frieren. He was said to be mankind's strongest.

name: Bojji
description:
The firstborn prince of the Bosse Kingdom.
Bojji was born abnormally small, weak, and deaf. He is a powerless prince who has lived his life under the shadow of his father, the legendary [King Bosse](https://anilist.co/character/244198/). He wants to be the world's greatest king, following his father

Bojji is extremely hard-working and sincere, and these traits draw people towards him even if they can't always understand him.

name: Kage
description: Kage is a literal shadow who becomes [Bojji](https://anilist.co/character/209532/Bojji)’s first friend.

name: Bosse
description: The king of Bosse Kingdom and Bojji and Daida's father. He placed seventh in the king's ranking.

name: Hiling
description: [King Bosse](https://anilist.co/character/244198/)'s second wife, current Queen. She is [Daida](https://anilist.co/character/231128/)'s biological mother and [Bojji](https://anilist.co/character/209532/Bojji)'s step mother. Originally a priestess from a neighboring territory/kingdom.

name: Daida
description: He is the second prince and second king of the Bosse Kingdom. He is the son of Bosse and Hilling, and the younger brother of Bojji.

name: Dorshe
description: [Hiling](https://anilist.co/character/231129/)'s bodyguard.

name: Ushio Okazaki
description:
Ushio is [Tomoya](https://anilist.co/character/4606) and [Nagisa](https://anilist.co/character/4604)'s daughter. She is a well-behaved, well-loved girl who is very curious about the world around her. Tomoya notes that she does not act like other girls her age. For example, most girls would want to have dolls; however, when Tomoya goes on a trip with her, he buys her a robot with which she is fascinated. Tomoya, finding it strange that she would prefer this type of toy, learns that Ushio has some interest in robots; thus he also calls her "boyish". Ushio also appears to like baseball. Ushio's interest has been influenced by her grandfather who teaches her to imitate famous baseball players. She refers to [Akio](https://anilist.co/character/7095) as "Akii" and calls her grandmother by her given name "Sanae".

In the few earlier episodes of the stories, Ushio stays with [Sanae](https://anilist.co/character/6831) and Akio. During her time with her grandparents, she learns to be a baseball addict like Akio, Ushio also learns strict disciplines from Sanae not to cry unless it is in the restroom.

name: Misae Sagara
description: Misae Sagara is the resident manager at Youhei's dorm. Misae is 23 years old at the time the story takes place; this is only mentioned in the visual novel. She was Hikarisaka's first female student council president when she was in high school. She achieved a full week of perfect attendance for the whole student body and she was loved by the students. Misae is friendly with the dorm students but strict when it comes to the dorm rules. She is also well-liked by the rugby members. Depending on decisions, Tomoya can change her to a violent dorm lady through his lecture, which is her original personality, who uses brute force to convince the dorm students to do their cleaning duty.

name: Umetarou Nozaki
description:
__Height:__ 190 cm (6'3")

Umetarou is the high school student that is the object of [Chiyo Sakura](https://anilist.co/character/87271/)'s affection. He is secretly a manga artist named Sakiko Yumeno, the creator of the shoujo manga "Let's Love~". This manga is published in the magazine called Monthly Shoujo Romance. Despite making a romance-oriented manga, he has no personal experience in love, and his story ideas are often ridiculous and farfetched. He appreciates Chiyo's drawing ability but is oblivious to her feelings.

In middle school, he was a captain of the school basketball team. In high school, he is now in class 2-B.

name: Chiyo Sakura
description:
__Height:__ 145 cm (4'9")

The viewpoint character of the series, Sakura is a high school girl with a crush on [Nozaki](https://anilist.co/character/87269), but when her confession is misinterpreted, she ends up becoming Nozaki's inker assistant. She is in class 2-A and a member of the school's art club. She is petite, and on her head, she wears two large ribbons that have a polka dot pattern, of which it becomes Nozaki's trademark of Chiyo and names a screen tone after her.

name: Mikoto Mikoshiba
description:
__Height:__ 177 cm (5'10")

Mikoto Mikoshiba is one of Nozaki's assistants and Yuu Kashima's best friend and classmate. He has red hair and equally red eyes. Both of his ears appear to be pierced and he usually wears tiny red earrings on them. He attracts the attention of many girls, and is admired by the males as well. However in reality, he has a timid and "tsundere" attitude. While outwardly he flirts with girls shamelessly and confidently, afterwards, he cringes and becomes embarrassed beyond words at his own actions.

name: Masayuki Hori
description:
__Height:__ 164 cm

A third year student and the president of the drama club. He is good in acting and used to appear in plays but stopped due to his short height and now in charge of props. Kashima always causes him trouble but he is often like a doting parent to her. 

Nozaki's Assistant who in charge of the background.

name: Yuu Kashima
description:
__Height:__ 176 cm

The prince of the school, even though she is female. She is very popular among the female students and flirts with them. She is part of the drama club and is in class 2-G.

Kashima displays a somewhat princely personality, often flirting with the girls and calling them, "hime" (Japanese for "princess"). She has a firm loyalty towards Hori (whom she calls Hori-chan-senpai), and often seeks his attention. She tries to please Hori, but more often than not, misunderstands the situation and ends up getting things very wrong. For example, she mistook Hori's interest in shoujo manga as a desire to dress and act as a girl, and ended up doing many embarrassing things to Hori such as leaving skirts in his locker.

She has a habit of skipping class and club duties, which finds herself in trouble with her drama club president, Hori, who literally has to go rough on her. She is known to excel in all school subjects and is good in all sports, but is tone deaf. She dislikes pungent food.

name: Yuzuki Seo
description:
__Height__: 163 cm
__Class__: 2-A

Sakura's classmate. Easily makes people feel offended.
She is a member of the choir club and her singing voice is beautiful enough to be referred to as "Lorelei".

name: Hirotaka Wakamatsu
description:
Freshman who belong to the basketball club and he knows Nozaki since middle school since they were in the same basketball club.

He played against Seo a basketball match and her rough play make him unable to sleep but was able to sleep soundly later thanks to the voice of Lorelei which he doesn't know her true identity.

name: Mitsuya Maeno
description:
**Height:** 176 cm

Previous editor in charge for [Nozaki](https://anilist.co/character/87269/Nozaki-Umetarou). He is obsessed with tanukis. He likes to attend mixers, drink at parties and read gravure pages.

name: Ken Miyamae
description:
**Height:** 171 cm

Editor in charge for Nozaki. Unfriendly, but Nozaki sees him as cool adult.

Ken's favorite foods are fried fish balls and alcohol, while his least favorite foods are sweet foods. His hobby is reading. His preferred type are sensible, responsible, and, self-reliant women.

name: Yukari Miyako
description:
__Height:__ 164 cm
__Favorite food:__ tomato
__Least favorite food:__ liver
__Hobbies:__ online shopping
__Family:__ mother, father, dog

A college student and a shoujo mangaka and also Nozaki's neighbor who lives upstairs.
Her type is people she can relax around.

name: Natsuo Fujii
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm (5'10")

Natsuo is introduced as a second-year high school student who loves writing novels, so he frequently heads to the rooftop during his lunch breaks to develop his passion. It is there that he meets the rookie English teacher named [Hina Tachibana](https://anilist.co/character/127595/Hina-Tachibana), who becomes his first crush. His current appearance is far different from his junior high days thanks to following the suggestion of [Fumiya Kurimoto](https://anilist.co/character/135349/Fumiya-Kurimoto) (Natsuo's best friend), who forced him to wear contact lenses instead of eye glasses and have his curly hair flattened daily.

name: Hina Tachibana
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm (5'4")
__Occupation:__ Teacher

She is the elder sister of [Rui Tachibana](https://anilist.co/character/127596/Rui-Tachibana), but soon after [Tsukiko Tachibana](https://anilist.co/character/135347/Tsukiko-Tachibana) (Hina's divorced mother) marries a widower named [Akihito Fujii](https://anilist.co/character/135352/Akihito-Fujii), Hina becomes the stepsister of [Natsuo Fujii](https://anilist.co/character/127594/Natsuo-Fujii).


It is not so clear if she feels becoming a teacher is her true call, even though she admits she has worked really hard to get her license. She is really into comedy shows. She does enjoy festivals in general, not only for the food but for the different attractions, especially the goldfish scooping. She is afraid of cockroaches to the point of running away from seeing them, without worrying if she is wearing something or not. She also freezes up with thunder storms.

name: Rui Tachibana
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3")
__Occupations:__ High school student, Apprentice Chef

Rui is the younger sister of [Hina Tachibana](https://anilist.co/character/127595/Hina-Tachibana), but soon after [Tsukiko Tachibana](https://anilist.co/character/135347/Tsukiko-Tachibana) (Rui's divorced mother) marries a widower named [Akihito Fujii](https://anilist.co/character/135352/Akihito-Fujii), Rui becomes [Natsuo Fujii](https://anilist.co/character/127594/Natsuo-Fujii)'s step-sister.

At first glance, Rui is an aloof and blunt girl who is hard to read emotionally. Her standoffish personality has made it difficult for her to socialize. As her first meeting at a mixer, she didn't do much to interact with the others. Once someone passes through her cold demeanor, Rui is actually a very kind and loving girl throughout the series. In spite of this, it can be hard for her to express her feelings towards someone she genuinely likes. She is very supportive of people she cares about, in spite of their flaws and even if their desires conflict with her own. Rui has a tendency to pout when things don't go her way, though [Natsuo](https://anilist.co/character/127594/Natsuo-Fujii) finds this feature of hers adorable. Rui is also surprisingly easy to embarrass in spite of her stoic personality. When [Natsuo](https://anilist.co/character/127594/Natsuo-Fujii) lists all of her behaviors he finds cute, especially to other people in front of her, she becomes overwhelmingly flustered.

name: Akihito Fujii
description:
__Hair color:__ Dark grey

Akihito Fujii is the father of [Natsuo Fujii](https://anilist.co/character/127594/Natsuo-Fujii). He began to date [Tsukiko Tachibana](https://anilist.co/character/135347/Tsukiko-Tachibana), after Akihito's wife died and he becomes the stepfather of [Hina Tachibana](https://anilist.co/character/127595/Hina-Tachibana) and [Rui Tachibana](https://anilist.co/character/127596/Rui-Tachibana) after remarrying [Tsukiko](https://anilist.co/character/135347/Tsukiko-Tachibana).

name: Miu Ashihara
description:
(at the beginning)
__Eye color:__ Green
__Hair color:__ Dark green
__Occupation:__ College student
__Debut:__ Chapter 17 / Episode 6

Miu Ashihara is the former president of the Literature Club.

_Appearance:_ Miu has dark green hair that is styled in a bobcut with her bangs covers much of her forehead and olive green eyes.

_Personality:_ Miu has an innocent vibe who can be awkward at times, especially when she's with their adviser. Her bashfulness is more intense than [Rui Tachibana](https://anilist.co/character/127596/Rui-Tachibana)'s. Just like [Natsuo Fujii](https://anilist.co/character/127594/Natsuo-Fujii), Miu is a hardcore bookworm and an aspiring novelist. Miu is also one of the primary targets of [Momo Kashiwabara](https://anilist.co/character/135348/Momo-Kashiwabara)'s pranks.

name: Masaki Kobayashi
description:
__Eye color:__ Brown
__Hair color:__ Black
__Occupation:__ Owner of L'Amant restaurant
__Debut:__ Chapter 5 / Episode 3

Masaki Kobayashi is the owner of L'Amant (French for 'The Lover') restaurant and a former Yakuza. He's an openly gay man and prefers to be addressed as Marie, though he is often addressed as The Master or Mari-san by others. His coworkers are [Fumiya Kurimoto](https://anilist.co/character/135349/Fumiya-Kurimoto) and Ayano. Kobayashi tends to aid [Natsuo](https://anilist.co/character/127594/Natsuo-Fujii) and others by providing advice and consultation.

_Appearance:_ Kobayashi is a strong and athletic individual, keeping himself in shape with various exercise, including yoga. He has long, curly black hair that is often tied in a ponytail, and sports a light trimmed mustache. He is very high maintenance, keeping his body hairless and well moisturized, and wears expensive cologne. Kobayashi has a typical Yakuza style tattoo that covers his back and parts of his chest. Although he can look quite intimidating when wearing his old Yakuza outfits, he often prefers to wear something more effeminate and/or revealing. His typical work attire includes a usual waiter's button shirt and bowtie, but he happens to wear very short trousers with leggings. He is also not opposed to dressing in drag, wearing a fundoshi, or even a leather thong.

_Personality:_ Kobayashi is a bright, cheerful, and flamboyant person. He often speaks in an effeminate form of speech.

name: Youta
description: [Ayano](https://anilist.co/character/203984/)'s son. He likes to eat a lot of candies.

name: Reiji Kiriya
description:
__Eye color:__ Dark green
__Hair color:__ Light purple
__Occupation:__ Teacher / Novelist
__Debut:__ Chapter 17 / Episode 6

Reiji Kiriya is a professional author and teacher who publishes under the pen name of You Hasukawa. He teaches Modern Japanese at [Natsuo Fujii](https://anilist.co/character/127594/Natsuo-Fujii)'s high school and the monitor of the Literature Club. Kiriya has a friendly relationship to [Shuu Hagiwara](https://anilist.co/character/135346/Shuu-Hagiwara), leading him to know [Hagiwara](https://anilist.co/character/135346/Shuu-Hagiwara)'s situation with [Hina Tachibana](https://anilist.co/character/127595/Hina-Tachibana).

_Appearance:_ Kiriya is a handsome young man with shoulder-length light-purple hair that has a few strands hanging over his face and empty dark-colored eyes.

_Personality:_ Kiriya has a cool and laid back demeanor who is considered an odd ball by other teachers, but his work as an educator is flawless. He is understanding of complicated relationships, and believes love can transcend age, gender, as well as social norms and status. Kiriya has a playful side to him, as he is known to tease his students. As mellow as he may be, he's not above strong-arming [Natsuo Fujii](https://anilist.co/character/127594/Natsuo-Fujii) into joining the Literature Club, especially after noticing he borrowed a book without permission.

name: Shuu Hagiwara
description:
__Occupation:__ Biology researcher

Shuu Hagiwara is a teacher and the ex-boyfriend of [Hina Tachibana](https://anilist.co/character/127595/Hina-Tachibana) due to fact that Shuu is married, therefore his relationship with [Hina](https://anilist.co/character/127595/Hina-Tachibana) for the last two years is an illicit affair and he also seems to have a good friendship with [Reiji Kiriya](https://anilist.co/character/135462/Reiji-Kiriya).

Shuu is a friendly and thoughtful person who has a playful side to him, owing to his puppets and ventriloquism skills. According to [Reiji Kiriya](https://anilist.co/character/135462/Reiji-Kiriya), Shuu was constantly sad and fatigued with having to deal with his wife. Because of his unhappy marriage, Shu was ready to take risks with his affair with [Hina Tachibana](https://anilist.co/character/127595/Hina-Tachibana). Unfortunately, he has been indecisive on ending the marriage for some time. When he noticed that [Natsuo Fujii](https://anilist.co/character/127594/Natsuo-Fujii) was in love with her as well, Shuu was a bit vexed, but nonetheless let [Hina](https://anilist.co/character/127595/Hina-Tachibana) choose between him or [Natsuo](https://anilist.co/character/127594/Natsuo-Fujii).

name: Tsukiko Tachibana
description:
Tsukiko Tachibana is the mother of [Hina](https://anilist.co/character/127595/Hina-Tachibana) and [Rui Tachibana](https://anilist.co/character/127596/Rui-Tachibana) who began to date [Akihito Fujii](https://anilist.co/character/135352/Akihito-Fujii) after Jou Mikimoto (Tsukiko's ex-husband) left her for another woman. Tsukiko becomes the stepmother of [Natsuo Fujii](https://anilist.co/character/127594/Natsuo-Fujii) after she got married to [Akihito](https://anilist.co/character/135352/Akihito-Fujii).

Tsukiko is a kind and warm woman who is pleasant to be around that she tends to think of others before herself and almost divorces [Akihito Fujii](https://anilist.co/character/135352/Akihito-Fujii) because she thought their marriage put a strain on their children. Again, her cheerful can turn into anger immediately whenever mention of her ex-husband is involved. She has long spoken ill of him to her girls, which had a negative affect on [Rui Tachibana](https://anilist.co/character/127596/Rui-Tachibana). However, Tsukiko has since been full of joy after meeting [Akihito](https://anilist.co/character/135352/Akihito-Fujii).

name: Maho Hiyajou
description:
__Height:__ 140 cm (4’7”)

Another researcher at Victor Concordia University's Neuroscience Lab, similar to Kurisu. She attends a lecture at Okabe's university as Professor Leskinen's assistant.

name: Eijirou Kirishima
aliases: Gouken Hero: Red Riot (剛健ヒーロー 烈怒頼雄斗)
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7")
__Quirk:__ Hardening

Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School.

Eijiro is a boisterous and outgoing guy with a fondness for manliness, often using the terms "manly" and "unmanly" to describe things and people he does or doesn't like, respectively. Eijiro is very honest and kind-hearted, having a straightforward way of thinking and following a specific code of chivalry that motivates him to live without regret. He is determined and selfless, bravely putting the safety of others before himself. He is also a big fan of Crimson Riot, a retro hero from whom he takes inspiration, including personal values and his hero name. Although Eijiro may not be as hot-blooded and competitive as [Katsuki Bakugou](https://anilist.co/character/88892), he does not shy away from comparing himself to him, with [Izuku](https://anilist.co/character/89028) stating that the two have managed to develop a relationship between equals. As a result, Eijiro is notably one of the few people that Katsuki holds in higher esteem.

Eijiro's Quirk gives him the power to harden and sharpen any or all parts of his body, causing his flesh to become jagged and rock-like. There is a limit to how much damage his hardened body can withstand, which causes the Hardening itself to slowly dissipate, and Eijiro to lose stamina from struggling to keep his Quirk active.

appearsIn.title: My Hero Academia: World Heroes' Mission

name: Melissa Shield
description: Melissa is a Quirkless girl and the daughter of Scientist [David Shield](https://anilist.co/character/125952/).

name: David Shield
native: デヴィット・シールド
description: David is a scientist who creates support items for heroes, and an old friend of All Might. He is the father of Melissa Shield.

name: Mina Ashido
description:
__Height:__ 159 cm (5'3")
__Quirk:__ Acid

Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School.

Mina is a cheerful and easygoing girl who usually displays a smile. Highly social and excitable, she loves to hang out with her friends and is shown to become very upset when denied an opportunity to be at a gathering. She possesses a strong fashion sense and likes to go shopping. Due to her athleticism and energy, Mina enjoys and is very skilled at dancing. Mina is extremely courageous and is viewed as an ideal personality for hero work.

Mina's Quirk Acid allows her to produce a corrosive liquid from her body. She can control the solubility and viscosity of this corrosive liquid. There is a limit to how long she can produce the corrosive liquid until her skin gradually loses its natural resistance to it. Overusing her Quirk or pushing it too far can also be fatal, as it dehydrates her body very fast. Mina can use her acid offensively, but has shown utility with it as well, such as melting handholds for herself to climb with. She is also known to secrete a non-corrosive version of the acid from her feet in order to slide around.

name: Cow Lady
description: Cow Lady is a Pro Hero in My Hero Academia: Two Heroes.

name: Tooru Hagakure
aliases: Stealth Hero: Invisible Girl (ステルスヒーロー インビジブルガール)
description:
__Height:__ 152 cm (5'0")
__Quirk:__ Invisibility 

Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School.

Tooru is a bubbly, cheery, and easygoing girl who does most things with an upbeat attitude. She is very socially eager and likes shopping, and her room suggests that she likes plushies and other cute things.

Tooru's Quirk is that her body is completely invisible. In addition to the stealth capabilities granted to her by her invisible body, Tooru can refract light that passes through her, allowing her to intensify the light into a blinding flash. She has further refined this application of her Quirk, achieving the ability to manipulate and redirect light-based attacks, such as [Yuuga Aoyama](https://anilist.co/character/127042/Aoyama-Yuuga)'s Navel Laser.

name: Tiese Shtolienen
native: ティーゼ・シュトリーネン
description:
Tiese Shtolienen is Eugeo's former valet who learned swordsmanship under him.

She is the eldest daughter of a 6th Class Noble family who entered the Sword Mastery Academy with an intent to rise her family status. She was a valet because she was one of the top 12 of her year, but she stated that it was not because she was a good swordswoman, but instead that it was because the entrance exam was on a Sacred Arts that she was good at.



(Source: Sword Art Online Wikia)

appearsIn.title: Sword Art Online: Alicization - War of Underworld

name: Takeru Higa
description: He is the Chief Developer of the «Soul Translator», working under Kikuoka Seijirou in Rath. He helped create «Underworld» as a means to produce «Bottom-Up-Artificial Intelligence» via nurturing a mass number of Artificial Fluctlights, in order to further advance Japan's military force.

appearsIn.title: Sword Art Online: Alicization - War of Underworld

name: Iskahn
description:
__Race__: Human
__Affiliation__: Pugilist Guild, Dark Army Territory
__Occupation__: Leader of the Pugilist Guild, Supreme Commander of the Dark Army Territory
__Novel Debut__: Volume 15, Chapter 17, Part 2
__Anime Debut__: Alicization Episode 28 (or Episode 4, Alicization - War of Underworld, "Dark Territory")
__Family__: 

Iskahn was a supporting character in the second half of the Alicization Arc, War of the Underworld. He was the Tenth Champion and leader of the Pugilists Guild, as well as a member of the Ten Lords Assembly that controlled the Dark Territory. Iskahn was one of the leaders of the Dark Territory who participated in the battle at the Great Eastern Gate against the Human Guardian Army, commanding the unit of Pugilists. During the battle, Iskahn and his Pugilists were ordered to pursue the decoy unit of the Human Guardian Army when they escaped southwards into the Dark Territory, where Iskahn dueled against [Scheta Synthesis Twelve](https://anilist.co/character/171679/Scheta) and became interested in her.

appearsIn.title: Sword Art Online: Alicization - War of Underworld

name: Deusolbert
aliases: Deusolbert Synthesis Seven (デュソルバート・シンセシス・セブン)
description: Integrity Knight that arrived to apprehend Alice after she broke the Taboo Index.

appearsIn.title: Sword Art Online: Alicization - War of Underworld

name: Tarou Sakamoto
description:
__Height:__ 188 cm

Tarou Sakamoto is a retired hitman. He was the greatest hitman, feared and revered by bad guys and hitmen everywhere. However, he left the hitman world in order to be with his wife. He currently owns a store, and has one child. He is the jack of all trades of his town, and is very popular and well liked by people in his town.

name: Shin Asakura
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm

Shin is a ex-hitman turned employee who works for [Sakamoto](https://anilist.co/character/196522/Sakamoto-Tarou). He has the ability to hear the thoughts of those around him.

name: Shaotang Lu
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm

Lu Shaotang is the daughter of a Triad Family, which is always being hunted down for their wealth and to get revenge for the past actions of the family. She meets Sakamoto when he saves her from assassins sent to steal a key to her family's safe. In return, she would make pork buns for him and has worked at Sakamoto's store since.



*Note: Lu was introduced with the wrong hanzi (小糖 instead of 少糖) which made her name Romanize as Xiaotang. In the first volume the mistake was noted and corrected, revealing her name should have been Shaotang. However, in the English release, Viz decided to keep using Xiaotang and have not corrected her name.*

name: Aoi Sakamoto
description: Aoi is the wife of [Tarou Sakamoto](https://anilist.co/character/196522/Sakamoto-Tarou) and mother of [Hana Sakamoto](https://anilist.co/character/272877/Sakamoto-Hana). She met Tarou at a convenience store where he fell in love with Aoi. Soon after the two married and had a daughter. Shortly after meeting, Aoi expressed her feelings about death and convinced Sakamoto to retire as a hitman and not kill anymore.

name: Heisuke Mashimo
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm

Heisuke Mashimo is a low-ranking assassin whose main skill is sharpshooting. Heisuke ended up losing his job, causing him to seek out [Tarou Sakamoto](https://anilist.co/character/196522/Tarou-Sakamoto)'s bounty in order to turn his luck around.

name: Yoichi Nagumo
description:
__Height:__ 190 cm

Nagumo is an old friend of [Sakamoto](https://anilist.co/character/196522/Sakamoto-Tarou). He is a member of "The Order", a group of assassins who are the highest ranked in the JAA. He's first seen paying a visit to Sakamoto to inform him of his bounty.

name: Kei Uzuki
description:
__Height:__ 179 cm

Uzuki, also known as Slur, is a killer seeking to overthrow the JAA. Roughly around the same time [Tarou Sakamoto's](https://anilist.co/character/196522) bounty was put up, Uzuki murdered a quarter of the assassin industry. The Order deemed him "X" as he leaves a large red 'X' at the scene of his crimes.

name: Osaragi
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm

Osaragi is an assassin and a new member of the Order, a group of powerful assassins that work under the JAA.

name: Boiled
description: Boiled is an assassin obsessed with being "hard boiled" and works for the assassin agency Dodenkai with [Obiguro.](https://anilist.co/character/348935/Obiguro) He knew [Sakamoto](https://anilist.co/character/196522/Tarou-Sakamoto) at the JCC and uses ball bombs to fight.

name: Hana Sakamoto
description: Hana Sakamoto is daughter of Tarou Sakamoto and Aoi Sakamoto.

name: Rachel Gardner
native: レイチェル・ガードナー
description:
__Height:__ 156 cm (5'1")

An amnesiac little girl who finds herself in a mysterious building. Being very calm and collected, she's often described as being extraordinarily dull but painfully honest, with some even remarking that she resembles a porcelain doll due to her difficulty in visibly expressing emotions and always having a strange, blank stare regardless of her mood. She's fixated on the idea of God, often overthinking her relation and worth to him, as well as projecting his will onto various events in her life, even desiring punishment and death once she labels herself a sinner.

name: Isaac Foster
native: アイザック・フォスター
description:
__Height:__ 186 cm (6'1")

An illiterate serial killer in charge of floor B6, the lowest in the building. He despises liars and dishonesty above all else and sees himself as a monster. His favourite weapon is a scythe, which was given to him by [Gray](https://anilist.co/character/127275/Gray-Abraham). He seems to have unnaturally strong destructive tendencies, going into a frenzy whenever he's allowed to let loose, as was the case with him destroying [Eddie](https://anilist.co/character/123329/Mason-Edward)'s graveyard on floor B4. Due to his tendency to speak his mind and being brutally honest, he swears very frequently.

Ever since he was a child, he sympathized with the villains of slasher films. Due to his strange behavior, his mother's partner attempted to burn him alive, forcing Zack to cover up his burns with bandages for the rest of his life. Soon after, he would be sent into an illegal orphanage, where his apparent insensitivity to death and pain would cause the owners to use him as an errand boy, disposing of other children's corpses and being forced to eat garbage. After escaping the orphanage and killing the owners, filled with a newfound hatred for people who see him as a "tool", he would go on to briefly live together with a blind old man who took him in on a whim - however, following the old man's death at the hands of a mugger, he would go back to living on the streets and killing those unlucky enough to run into him at night.

name: Daniel Dickens
native: ダニエル・ディケンズ
description:
__Height:__ 179 cm (5'10")

A psychiatrist in charge of floor B5 who claims to have been Ray's counselor. Despite his gentle facade, he hides a much more sinister persona.

He was born without his right eye, alienating him from other kids and adults alike. Despite his mother's mental health gradually declining as a result of seeing him struggle to fit in and blaming herself for his imperfection, he constantly attempted to show his affection towards her by staring into her empty, despair-filled eyes, eventually leading her to take her own life. Since then, he developed an obsession with people's eyes, chasing the same sort of despair and emptiness he'd seen in his mother's stare. 
When he worked in the same prison as Cathy and Lucy, he'd collect prisoners' eyeballs. His fixation would reach its peak the moment he met Ray - considering her eyes the most beautiful ones he's ever seen, he wishes to remain by Ray's side forever, going to extreme lengths to keep her in his care.



He has a quirk of swapping out his regular prosthetic eye for one with a double iris whenever he gets excited.

name: Edward Mason
native: エドワード・メイソン
description:
__Height:__ 154 cm (5'0")

Master of floor B4. A very immature gravedigger who's grown infatuated with [Rachel](https://anilist.co/character/123327/Gardner-Rachel) after seeing her documents, often seen obsessed with the idea of giving her the most beautiful burial and grave he can. He despises [Zack](https://anilist.co/character/123328/Foster-Isaac) for his lack of subtlety and finesse.

Born into a family that had been graveyard workers for generations, Eddie would pour all his heart into it, with creating beautiful graves quickly becoming his one true passion. He was always appreciated by his father, who'd often remark that he's the best worker in the family.

Despite that, due to being the third sibling - with one younger brother and two older ones - he'd always receive hand-me-downs from his older brothers, and would eventually be forced to give up his belongings to his younger brother (even boots which he purchased with his own money), thus never truly having anything of his own. He'd even be told that the family pets - which he not only loved, but took great care of - belonged to everyone and not him alone. Even when he had to bury the family's pet bird which his oldest brother killed in a fit of rage, he still felt like it wasn't "his" - only when he was forced to put down and bury the family cat would his heart find peace, leading to him developing an obsession with making things "his" by burying them in graves of his own making.

name: Catherine Ward
description:
__Height:__ 176cm (5'8"); 166cm (5'4") without boots

An ex-prison guard in charge of floor B3 of the building, thoroughly devoted to her role as a self-proclaimed judge and executioner, guided by her twisted sense of justice. A cheerful and sassy sadomasochist who enjoys torturing those sent to her using elaborate traps and challenges in order to create a game show-like spectacle for her own entertainment. She views Zack as an exemplary sinner, attempting to punish him thoroughly for her amusement, and tends to disregard Ray as "dull" despite her initial interest in her.

As the only child of a respected family of doctors, she attended a prestigious all-girls' school, where many other students initially idolized her and admired her beauty. However, after her parents committed malpractice and were murdered by a relative of their patient, a number of rumors began circulating, leading to her schoolmates heavily ostracizing her.

name: Abraham Gray
native: エイブラハム・グレイ
description:
An extremely eloquent and stern elderly priest residing in a cathedral on floor B2. He attempts to make Ray doubt her choices and beliefs, being deeply obsessed with exploring what religious beliefs truly mean to people.
He's also proficient in using illusions and hallucinogenic drugs (which, as Ray remarks, make him give off a strange, sweet scent) in order to lead his subjects into a state of mania and expose their true selves.

While not much is known about his past, he had apparently always shown a keen interest in studying what makes people believe in God and follow a religion. At some point he had become a reverend in a small town's church, gaining many followers thanks to his mesmerizing speeches and strange ability to learn their true nature (secretly derived from his proficiency with hallucinogenic drugs). After his curiosity reached its peak, he would come up with the idea of an experiment in which he'd use a group of ruthless, self-righteous serial killers - which he'd call his "Angels" - in order to determine what is it that makes people - whom he'd call his "Sacrifices" - religious.

Shortly after, Danny and Cathy visited him, having heard of him from a prisoner who was a religious fanatic. With the two fulfilling his critera of "Angels", he would recruit them to be part of his experiments. At some point in time, he would take in Eddie and Zack the same way, even giving Zack a scythe to encourage him to join.

name: Botamo
description: Botamo is a fighter selected for Champa's team on the 5v5 match he has with Beerus. He is the first to fight Goku and he loses in the first round via ring out. His skin is slick, oily and hairless, and he has an ability to displace all damage he receives somewhere else.

name: Cus
description: Cus is the Angel of Universe 10. She is also the attendant and martial arts teacher of Rumsshi. She is a child of Great Priest.

name: Cukatail
description: Cukatail is the Angel of Universe 5 and the attendant and martial arts teacher of Arack. He appears in Dragon Ball Super during the Universe Survival Saga.

name: Rabanra
description: Rabanra is a warrior from Universe 2 and a member of Team Universe 2.

name: Yuurin
description: Yuurin is a martial artist who went to the Crane School with Tien Shinhan and Chiaotzu in the past. She currently trains under Tien at the Tien-Shin Style Dojo.

name: Jiimizu
description: Jimeze is a Yardrat from Universe 2 and a member of Team Universe 2.

name: Korn
description: Korn is the Angel of Universe 8 and the attendant and martial arts teacher of Liquiir. He appears in Dragon Ball Super during the Universe Survival Saga.

name: Umigame
description: Muten-Rôshi's friend and long-time companion, the good-natured lovable turtle lives in the Kame House with the elderly hermit. During Dragon Ball Z in the anime filler, he celebrates his 1,000th birthday in episode 117. He plays a relatively small part in the manga, but he has quite a few large roles in the anime. When he first appeared, he was in the wilderness, alone and lost. He was picking mushrooms when he got separated from his friends and had since been wandering around on land for over a year. Goku kindly takes on the task of returning him to the ocean, which he is very grateful for. It is Umigame who introduces Muten-Rôshi to Bulma and Son Goku. Umigame does not care much for Muten-Rôshi's perverse interests, enjoying honest interests himself. He was one of the first animal characters Goku meets and befriends, giving a small sense of irony that in the final Dragon Ball GT episode, he's one of the few characters that Goku bids farewell to after departing with Shenlong. In the anime, his power level is 0.001, as evident when Bulma tests Raditz's scouter in the Vegeta Saga.

name: Yona
description:
__Height:__ 157 cm
__Race:__ Human

The spoiled princess of the Kouka kingdom, who has a crush on her cousin and childhood friend [Soo-won](https://anilist.co/character/88670). Soo-won comforted her when she lost her mother in young age. She hates her crimson red hair. Her bodyguard is the other childhood friend, the general [Son Hak](https://anilist.co/character/43815) who she finds really annoying.

As the princess and the only heir of the Kouka Kingdom, Yona was raised with extreme care and gets whatever she wants, for example, beautiful accessories and clothing. This lead her to being a spoilt princess. After some life-changing events, Yona developed into a strong young lady who lives for the people of Kouka Kingdom, while also paying back the friends who helped her survive.

name: Hak Son
description:
**Height:** 188 cm

He is the former chief and general of the Wind Tribe. He is famously known as Thunder Beast for his fighting skills that were said to be unrivalled by anyone, earning him the title of "strongest soldier in the kingdom".

name: Yun
description:
__Height:__ 162 cm
Race: Human

In Princess Yona's group, he is the healer and genius.

He is an outstanding curious intellectual. He can say mean things, but he's a caring pretty boy. He was born in a poor village of the Fire Tribe.

name: Ki-Ja
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm
__Race:__ Dragon

He is the white dragon of the group. He has dragon claws on his right hand, which is said to have ten times the strength of a normal human's.

name: Shin-Ah
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm
__Race:__ Dragon

He is the blue dragon and has dragon eyes that allows him to see great distances. Shin-Ah's dragon eyes are also capable of disrupting the nerves of anyone he glares at until it kills them.





He is also voiced by Sanae Kobayashi.

name: Jae-Ha
description:
__Height:__ 188 cm
__Race:__ Dragon

He is the descendant of the Green Dragon and possesses the power of a dragon in his right leg. His power allows him to jump high and long distances that almost make it look like he can fly. It also makes his leg incredibly strong and lethal when used to kick. He's a big flirt, he doesn't care whether it's a man or a girl.

name: Zeno
description:
__Height:__ 166 cm
__Race:__ Dragon

He is the yellow dragon and has a really strong body.

name: Soo-Won
description:
__Height:__ 185cm
Race: Human

He is the son of the deceased General Yu-Hon, the older cousin of Yona, as well as her and Hak Son's childhood friend, the three were best friends. He kills Yona's father and becomes the 11th King of Kouka and wants to unite the Kingdom to restore its original power after King Il's reign.



Nozomi Yamamoto voices him as a child.

name: Geun-Tae Lee
description: Lee Geun-Tae is the general of the Earth Tribe and he is the husband of Yun-Ho. He serves under Soo-Won after acknowledging his strength during the Battle Game Festival held in Chi'Shin. Geun-Tae is a bearded, dark-skinned man who is almost never seen without a proud snarl on his face. He has brown almond eyes (yellow in the anime) and long untidy dark brown hair that he ties in a ponytail using a rope-like ornament with tassels on both ends. His fringes cover most of his forehead and some of its strands hang to the sides of his face. Whenever he goes to the castle, he wears an outfit chosen by his wife: a brown leather overcoat with animal-prints atop a white robe with yellow-patterned hemlines, a two-layered purple beaded necklace, and a pair of black boots. While at home, he dons a simple robe where his scars can be visibly seen. Like the people in the Wind Tribe, he likes to take everything easy. He never considers the hierarchy on his tribe and he lets his people talk to him as if he is just an ordinary citizen. He also likes picking fights, especially against Han Joo-Doh, who he never shares a stable relationship with. However, as a general who fought on Emperor Joo-Nam’s era, he believes that he belongs to the battlefield and has been eager to use his skills and fight on the frontlines again. Ever since the banning of war under Emperor Il’s reign, he grew rusty and has been looking for a capable king who he can lend his strength to.

name: Miyako Shikimori
description:
__Height:__ 162 cm (5'4")

Shikimori is not only cute but also smart and athletic, however, she isn't very good at cooking! She is very protective of [Izumi](https://anilist.co/character/155701/Izumi-Yuuki) because he always puts himself in risky situations, when these situations occur, Shikimori reveals her "cool" appearance. She thinks Izumi is very cool and kind. She owns a pet dog named Kara.

Both cute and cool clothing styles suit her, but she seem to have a preference for a cute look. She became very popular at school with the girls after they saw her cool side during the tournament's volleyball game.

name: Yuuki Izumi
description: Izumi is a friendly, upbeat kid. He’s had terrible luck his entire life. If something can go wrong... he’ll probably wind up in the hospital. But he still thinks he’s the luckiest guy in the world, because Izumi has a girlfriend who is smart, sporty, and always looking out for him. [Shikimori](https://anilist.co/character/155702/Shikimori-Miyako) is his knight in shining armor.

name: Motoko Izumi
description: Mother of [Yuu Izumi](https://anilist.co/character/155701/Izumi-Yuuki).

name: Kyou Nekozaki
description:
**Height:** 166 cm

She's one of Shikimori's friends. She is a cheerful and energetic gymnast. She has a friendly personality. She watches over [Shikimori](https://anilist.co/character/155702)'s relationship with [Yuu](https://anilist.co/character/155701).

name: Yui Hachimitsu
description:
**Height:** 148 cm

She's one of [Shikimori](https://anilist.co/character/155702)'s friends. She has a tendency to melt when overworked. She has an expressionless, slow-paced, and elusive personality, but she pays close attention to her surroundings. She is an indoor girl who is not good at sports.

name: Fuji Shikimori
description: Older brother of [Miyako Shikimori](https://anilist.co/character/155702/Shikimori-Miyako).

name: Shuu Inuzuka
description: He's part of the group of friends surrounding [Izumi](https://anilist.co/character/155701) and [Shikimori](https://anilist.co/character/155702). He is honest, easy-going, and likes to have fun. He likes to play, but he is also a serious boy who studies hard.

name: Miyabi Shikimori
description: Shikimori's mother. Like her daughter, she gives off a serious look.

name: Tannin no Sensei
description: She is the homeroom teacher for [Izumi](https://anilist.co/character/155701/Yuuki-Izumi)'s class.

name: Ai Kamiya
description: Originally a friend of [Izumi](https://anilist.co/character/155701/Izumi-Yuuki). A star player on the volleyball team. She is tall and slim, and very popular at school. She and Izumi work on the library committee together.

name: Akari Kawamoto
description:
Akari is the eldest of three Kawamoto sisters.

After her mother and grandmother’s death, she stepped in as the parent figure for her younger sisters. In the mornings she helps her elderly grandfather run a traditional wagashi shop, and in the evenings she works as a hostess at a bar, which her aunt manages.

appearsIn.title: March comes in like a lion
March comes in like a lion Season 2
March Comes in Like a Lion

name: Hinata Kawamoto
description:
__Occupation:__ Student

Hinata Kawamoto, often called Hina, is the middle child of the Kawamoto siblings and a middle school student whose positive attitude inspires [Rei](https://anilist.co/character/21044/) to try to overcome his depression.

appearsIn.title: March comes in like a lion
March comes in like a lion Season 2
March Comes in Like a Lion

name: Momo Kawamoto
description: The youngest of the three sisters. A preschool student, she attends a daycare center. Pure and innocent, she has a bit of a selfish streak at times. Her favorite anime character is Bodoro (modelled on My Neighbour Totoro's [Totoro](https://anilist.co/character/269/Totoro)). She calls [Rei](https://anilist.co/character/21044/Kiriyama-Rei), "Rei-chan".

appearsIn.title: March comes in like a lion
March comes in like a lion Season 2
March Comes in Like a Lion

name: Rei Kiriyama
description:
__Occupation:__ Shogi Player
__Height:__ 170cm (5'6'')

He is the main protagonist, whose progression is explored through the series. He is a teenage professional shogi player, currently ranked at 5th-dan. He is widely lauded in the shogi community as the fifth shogi player to become a professional in middle school. Using his salary combined with his life savings, he lives in his own apartment while juggling between his official matches and high school. By the time the story begins, Rei is also a frequent visitor of the Kawamoto residence, where the family treats him as one of their own despite his initial reluctance to become close with them.

appearsIn.title: March comes in like a lion
March comes in like a lion Season 2
March Comes in Like a Lion

name: Masachika Kouda
description: Rei's shōgi teacher. He was both Rei's father's friend and rival in shogi. He cared for Rei like he did for his children and taught him shogi.

appearsIn.title: March comes in like a lion
March comes in like a lion Season 2
March Comes in Like a Lion

name: Touji Souya
description: The current meijin. He has longed for a rival like [Rei](https://anilist.co/character/21044). Similar to Rei, he became a professional shogi player in middle school.

appearsIn.title: March comes in like a lion
March comes in like a lion Season 2
March Comes in Like a Lion

name: Kyouko Kouda
description: Kouda's daughter. She is four years older than Rei. Beautiful and hot tempered, Kyouko seems to hold a grudge on Rei as she has the habit of exercising a negative influence on him by discouraging him on purpose before his official matches.

appearsIn.title: March comes in like a lion
March comes in like a lion Season 2
March Comes in Like a Lion

name: Kai Shimada
description:
Kai Shimada is a professional shogi player of rank 8-dan. 

Shimada possesses a calm and collected personality. At first, it seems like he's very plain, but as seen on his game with [Rei](https://anilist.co/character/21044/Kiriyama-Rei) he has a very intimidating yet serene personality.

He's observed to be caring over fellows under him like Nikaidou. Shimada is very kind to his fellow shogi players and tries to help them improve their game.

appearsIn.title: March comes in like a lion

name: Ayumu Kouda
description: Kōda's son and Kyōko's younger brother. He is of the same age as Rei. After losing to Rei in shogi, he stopped playing at all, and afterwards started confining himself to his room and only playing video games.

appearsIn.title: March comes in like a lion
March comes in like a lion Season 2

name: Harunobu Nikaidou
description: Rei's self-proclaimed "best friend" and "lifelong rival". A four-dan, he has played with Rei since they were children. Even though he might appear to be healthy, he is in fact in poor health. He is from a good family. He is modeled after real-life shōgi player Satoshi Murayama.

appearsIn.title: March comes in like a lion
March comes in like a lion Season 2

name: Maru
description: Maru is a boy searching for a place called "Heaven".

name: Kiruko
description: Kiruko is [Maru](https://anilist.co/character/289824/Maru)'s bodyguard, and he is searching for a place known as "Heaven".

name: Yuuko Aoshima
description: Yuuko Aoshima was a nurse at Takahara Academy and later became its deputy director.

name: Akihiko Kaji
description:
__Height:__ 184 cm

Akihiko Kaji is a college student in Given. Also the drummer in Ritsuka's band, he can play not only the drums but also violin, guitar, and bass.

name: Ritsuka Uenoyama
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm (5′8")

Ritsuka Uenoyama is one of the main protagonists of the Given Series. He is a high school student and has a guitar prowess despite being just a high schooler. He is a considerate and compassionate guy and is also a genuine younger brother of his sister [Yayoi](https://anilist.co/character/167937/Uenoyama-Yayoi). Uenoyama shows little consideration for small talk and can be quick to be irate. He can be smug when showing his high test scores, and says he can understand theory based subjects. Uenoyama can be very attentive to the feelings of others, particularly [Mafuyu](https://anilist.co/character/136844/Satou-Mafuyu).

name: Mafuyu Satou
description:
__Height:__ 173 cm

One of the protagonists of the manga-anime. He has a quiet, calm and mysterious personality, he can't express his thoughts and emotions very well, despite being a sincere boy. After all he is a strong person who has endured many bad things in his past. He lives with his mother (who works a lot and is never shown in the manga and anime) and his dog named [Kedama](https://anilist.co/character/230878/Kedama), but he usually calls him Tama (cat name). His best friends in the past were [Hiiragi](https://anilist.co/character/167930/Kashima-Hiiragi), [Yuuki](https://anilist.co/character/153048/Yoshida-Yuki) (his ex-boyfriend) and [Shizusumi](https://anilist.co/character/167938/Yagi-Shizusumi) (they were friends since childhood), his current best friends are [Uenoyama](https://anilist.co/character/136843/Uenoyama-Ritsuka) (his current boyfriend), [Kaji](https://anilist.co/character/136842/Kaji-Akihiko) and [Haruki](https://anilist.co/character/136845/Nakayama-Haruki), although he still maintains some contact with Hiiragi.

name: Haruki Nakayama
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm

Haruki Nakayama is a film major graduate student, and the bassist in the band Given. He is the oldest in the group and the leader of the band. Haruki “prefers lighter music (compared to other guys) and pop. Drawn to Japanese rock and light, slow tempo dance.”  He is “extremely good natured and kind” and is easily flustered. In the manga it is revealed that Haruki’s “stand” is a kind elderly man. He lives on his own in an apartment and is friends with [Ritsuka Uenoyama](https://anilist.co/character/136843/Uenoyama-Ritsuka), [Mafuyu Satou](https://anilist.co/character/136844/Satou-Mafuyu), and [Koji Yatake](https://anilist.co/character/174907/Yatake-Koji).

name: Shizusumi Yagi
description:
__Age:__ 16 (start to chapter 28)
17 (from chapter 28)
__Height:__ 180cm

Shizusumi Yagi is Mafuyu's former classmate. He formerly played drums in a band with Yuki and Hiiragi who he is childhood friends with.

name: Ugetsu Murata
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm

He is a world-renowned violinist. He is [Akihiko](https://anilist.co/character/136842/Kaji-Akihiko)'s room and classmate, and on-again-off-again boyfriend as well as a University student. He has been classmates with Akihiko since their high school days. Though he is Akihiko's roommate, he sometimes goes abroad and sometimes he stays in Japan.

Ugetsu is very intelligent and a prodigy violinist. He is generally a cheerful and friendly person, he is warm and affectionate towards others, such as welcoming Akihiko home. He is very sharp about other people‘s feelings.

Ugetsu is very emotional and capable of overwhelming feelings but he doesn’t know how to express them properly except through his music. When Ugetsu is under pressure he is easily irascible and unstable; in fact he shows to be moody, and violent as well, hitting Akihiko on the face and breaking or throwing things around him.

name: Hiiragi Kashima
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm (5'9")

Hiiragi Kashima is a high school student who, along with Mafuyu, seems to know something about Mafuyu’s guitar. He is also Mafuyu's former classmate. He formerly played bass in a band with Yuki and Shizusumi.

name: Shougo Itaya
description:
__Height:__ 176cm

He is one of the best friends of Uenoyama in the school. He is from the soccer club, but he also plays basket with his friends (including Ue), he likes all balls games and loves music.

name: Yuki Yoshida
description: He is a childhood friend of [Mafuyu](https://anilist.co/character/136844/Satou-Mafuyu).

name: Yayoi Uenoyama
description:
__Height:__ 163cm

Yayoi Uenoyama is Ritsuka's older sister who she lives with. She has an unrequited crush on his bandmate, Akihiko Kaji.

name: Chisato Nishikigi
description:
Said to be the strongest Lycoris of all time.
She enjoys solving private-sector problems that the DA would not address.
At Café LycoReco, she works joyfully and cheerfully as the self-proclaimed poster girl.

name: Takina Inoue
description:
Previously an exceptional Lycoris, but for some reason, she now works at Café LycoReco.

A realistic person with a distaste for inefficiency, she can be dissatisfied with [Chisato](https://anilist.co/character/260329/Nishikigi-Chisato), who is not a typical Lycoris.

She wants to see good results in her job at LycoReco.

name: Mika
description:
Lamenting the worsening of his eyesight as he grows older day after day, he is the surrogate parent gently overseeing his problematic employees.

Ohagi mochi and coffee, Japanese clothing and a café. It’s all about expressing a mix of Japanese and Western styles. He is the manager of the café with a traditional Japanese twist, "Café LycoReco”.

name: Mizuki Nakahara
description:
Previously a DA Intelligence Division member, she’s been with Chisato for a long time. In her desperate desire to marry, she took the job at the café in hopes of meeting her special someone.

Her routine includes a nightly drink while reading wedding magazines.

name: Kurumi
description: A young runaway girl of unknown origins who loves all kinds of games. She’s a terrible employee who reluctantly works in exchange for lodging. She only looks forward to gaming parties with the café’s regulars come closing time.

name: Shinji Yoshimatsu
description:
A member of the Alan Institute.
A regular at Café LycoReco.
[Mika](https://anilist.co/character/268459/Mika)’s old friend.

name: Majima
description: A terrorist who attacked a subway station.

name: Kusunoki
description: DA Commander.

name: Vanitas
aliases: The Vampire of the Blue Moon
description:
__Race:__ Human
__Height:__ 176 cm (5'9")
__Occupation:__ Doctor
__Partner:__ 	Noé Archiviste (now), Dante (former)

Vanitas is an average human being who inherited his name and the Book of Vanitas from the infamous vampire.

He seems to often take nothing seriously and almost always has a broad grin on his face. He acts more on emotions than thought most of the time since his plans are normally reckless. Also carries a mischievous air around him.

appearsIn.title: The Case Study of Vanitas Part 2

name: Noé Archiviste
native: ノエ・アルシヴィスト
description:
__Race:__ Vampire
__Height:__ 187 cm (6'1")
__Occupation:__ Student
__Partner:__ 	Vanitas

Noé is a gentleman vampire.

His story began when he received a letter from The Teacher, which explained that The Teacher wanted Noé to fly to Paris immediately, as there had been rumors that The Book of Vanitas had been found there. The Teacher then specifically ordered Noé to discern The Book of Vanitas' true nature.

appearsIn.title: The Case Study of Vanitas Part 2

name: Louis de Sade
description: He is a Vampire of the Crimson Moon. Louis had been born into the De Sade aristocracy alongside the likes of Veronica and Dominique de Sade, however because of certain circumstances Count de Sade sent him to live with his grandfather permanently. While living with his grandfather, Louis would come to meet Noé Archiviste and the two would become close friends.

name: Lucius Oriflamme
native: ルキウス・オリフラム
description:
__Race:__ Vampire
__Occupation:__ Grand Duke
__Partner:__ [Jeanne](https://anilist.co/character/89836/Jeanne)

He is a Vampire of noble birth born to inherit the title of Grand Duke, Luca is close to The Queen, though he is still too young to accept the role himself, thus allowing his uncle, [Lord Ruthven](https://anilist.co/character/155326/Ruthven-August), to act on his behalf.

name: Jeanne
description:
__Race:__ Vampire
__Occupation:__ Chevalier (now), Bourreau (previously)

A vampire who acts as the Chevalier to [Luca](https://anilist.co/character/153506/Oriflamme-Lucius).

Jeanne is fiercely protective of Luca and gives off an air of rigidity and power while conducting her duty as his chevalier; however, she is prone to frantic outbursts, especially when in the presence of [Vanitas](https://anilist.co/character/89590/Vanitas), whom she dislikes. Due to her past as a bourreau, she is unused to having kindness directed towards her, and as a result, easily becomes flustered when she receives it.

name: Dominique de Sade
description:
__Race:__ Vampire
__Occupation:__ Aristocrat, Royal Guard

Noé's childhood friend and the sister of [Louis](https://anilist.co/character/146017/de-Sade-Louis) and [Veronica](https://anilist.co/character/242848/de-Sade-Veronica). Her father is Count de Sade and her grandfather is [Noé](https://anilist.co/character/89835/Archiviste-No)'s teacher.

She is a flirtatious, playful, energetic, and charming young lady. She strides with style and elegance, even using a machine to spray rose petals when she first appears. However, she isn't afraid to hurt anyone who she suspects of harming those close to her.

name: Murr
description: Noé's cat. Murr never shows any other emotion apart from irritability but seems to care a great deal for Noé - often times lurking in the shadows and watching Noé.

name: Naenia
description: Naenia is a mysterious ethereal entity from Jun Mochizuki's The Case Study of Vanitas. As a member of Charlatan, Naenia works alongside her colleagues, invading the subconscious of Vampires in order to inflict them with a Malnomen by distorting their true names. It is not presently known who Naenia is or what her motivations for doing so are.

name: Riche
description:
__Race:__ Dhampir
__Occupation:__ Information Broker
__Partner:__ 	Dante, Johann

Riche is a Dhampir who acts as an Information Broker. Often partnered with fellow Dhampirs, Dante and Johann, Riche commonly works on cases in relation to Curse-Bearing Vampires.

Riche is a very scholarly and passionate woman, who often gets carried away talking about what interests her. She is also quick to apologize after sharing her knowledge, as she is self-conscious of her habit to overshare and ramble. She can be very competitive with her fellow information-brokers, but also cares for others deeply.

name: Dante
description:
__Race:__ Dhampir
__Occupation:__ Information Broker
__Partner:__ 	Johann (now), Riche (now), Vanitas (former)

Dante is a Dhampir acting as an insurance broker and jack-of-all-trades, he often partners with Vanitas, selling him information or working alongside him in pursuit of Curse-Bearing Vampires.

Dante tends to be rather carefree when dealing with Vanitas - though he is easily annoyed by his employer and partner - particularly when Vanitas addresses him as "Baldy." The two often take jabs at each other playfully, though in reality they enjoy each other's company. In a lot of instances Dante shows that he is very protective of those closest to him by nature. Dante is scared of dark and creepy places, like the catacombs and the forest.

name: Makomo
description: A cute and mysterious girl who wears a floral pattern kimono. Her fox mask has two flowers on its right cheek.

name: Yushirou
description:
__Height:__ 157 cm (5'2")

Yushiro is a traveling companion of Tamayo and close ally of Kamado Tanjirou. He was turned into a Demon by Tamayo. Yushiro was a human who was under the care of Tamayo as she was practicing as a medical practitioner. He was in the frail state fighting disease when Tamayo gave him the choice of succumbing to his illness or to live longer as a Demon. He agreed to become a Demon and has since stayed by Tamayo's side serving as an assistant as well as her guard.

appearsIn.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle

name: Daki
description: Daki, known as Warabihime in her oiran guise, is a member of the Twelve Demon Moons, holding the position of Upper Moon Six.

name: Kumo Oni Haha
description: Like most demons, she is cruel, unfeeling, and murderous towards humans. Though after much time with him, she developed fear for Rui and the Father Spider Demon who abused her for being weaker than expected.

name: Kaoruko Waguri
description:
__Height:__ 148 cm

An ace student at Kikyo Private Academy. Kaoruko is incredibly intelligent and kind, but often acts airheaded as well. She greatly enjoys eating sweets, meeting [Rintaro](https://anilist.co/character/268677/Rintarou-Tsumugi) in his family's cake shop and quickly befriending him. Despite later learning that he attends Chidori High—a school at bitter odds with her own—she continues to be close with him.

appearsIn.title: The Fragrant Flower Blooms With Dignity
The Fragrant Flower Blooms With Dignity

name: Rintarou Tsumugi
description:
__Height:__ 190 cm

A student at Chidori High. Rintarou is a very kind and calm person, but his blonde hair and piercings—adopted due to struggles with self-expression in his childhood—have led to many writing him off as a delinquent. The exceptions to this are his close friends at Chidori High, as well as [Kaoruko](https://anilist.co/character/268676), a girl from an opposing school known as Kikyo Private Academy. After first meeting Kaoruko in his family's cake shop, Rintarou gradually begins to spend more time with her.

appearsIn.title: The Fragrant Flower Blooms With Dignity
The Fragrant Flower Blooms With Dignity

name: Subaru Hoshina
description: [Kaoruko](https://anilist.co/character/268676/Kaoruko-Waguri)'s closest friend since middle school. Subaru is noted to be exceptionally pretty by her peers but has a somewhat withdrawn personality, particularly having trouble whilst talking to boys. She's also very protective of Kaoruko, initially disapproving of her relationship with [Rintaro](https://anilist.co/character/268677/Rintarou-Tsumugi) and the others before discovering how kindhearted the boys are.

appearsIn.title: The Fragrant Flower Blooms With Dignity
The Fragrant Flower Blooms With Dignity

name: Shohei Usami
description: A student at Chidori High and a close friend of [Rintaro](https://anilist.co/character/268677/Rintarou-Tsumugi)'s, alongside [Ayato](https://anilist.co/character/272243/Ayato-Yorita) and [Saku](https://anilist.co/character/272241/Saku-Natsusawa). Shohei is extremely outgoing, being the most talkative member of Rintaro's friend group. He also holds no hostility towards Kikyo's students despite the opposing school's vitriol towards each other.

appearsIn.title: The Fragrant Flower Blooms With Dignity
The Fragrant Flower Blooms With Dignity

name: Saku Natsusawa
description:
A student at Chidori High and a close friend of [Rintarou's](https://anilist.co/character/268677/Rintarou-Tsumugi), alongside [Shouhei](https://anilist.co/character/272240/Shohei-Usami) and [Ayato](https://anilist.co/character/272243/Ayato-Yorita).

Despite his attractive features he always appears gloomy, making him appear hard to talk to. But while he is more withdrawn than his friends he cares deeply about them and is naturally kind despite his cynical exterior. He is also incredibly intelligent, being the smartest student at Chidori High and even outdoing Kikyo's students, as noted by [Subaru](https://anilist.co/character/270095/Subaru-Hoshina) who begins to study with him.

appearsIn.title: The Fragrant Flower Blooms With Dignity
The Fragrant Flower Blooms With Dignity

name: Kyouko Tsumugi
description: [Rintaro](https://anilist.co/character/268677/Rintarou-Tsumugi)'s mother. She runs the Tsumugi Family Bakery alongside her husband [Keichiro](https://anilist.co/character/299398/Keichiro-Tsumugi).

appearsIn.title: The Fragrant Flower Blooms With Dignity
The Fragrant Flower Blooms With Dignity

name: Keichiro Tsumugi
description: [Rintaro](https://anilist.co/character/268677/Rintarou-Tsumugi)'s father. He runs the Tsumugi Family Bakery alongside his wife [Kyouko](https://anilist.co/character/286245/Kyouko-Tsumugi). He is dedicated to his work as a baker, spending nearly every day in the kitchen perfecting his technique.

appearsIn.title: The Fragrant Flower Blooms With Dignity
The Fragrant Flower Blooms With Dignity

name: Madoka Yuzuhara
description: A good friend of [Kaoruko](https://anilist.co/character/268676/Kaoruko-Waguri)'s that attends Kikyo Private Academy. Extremely friendly and outgoing, and unlike her fellow classmates at Kikyo, harbors no animosity or negative feelings towards the students at Chidori High.

appearsIn.title: The Fragrant Flower Blooms With Dignity
The Fragrant Flower Blooms With Dignity

name: Cliff Grimoire
description:
Cliff Grimoire is the Grandson of the Pope, and a friend of Rudeus. 

Cliff has a very high amount of pride, so much so that he will proudly tell people when they ask him for help. Though this trait may irk many people it cannot be said that he is arrogant since he is shown to be constantly studying to improve himself showing that he is very diligent as well. He is also very loyal to his friends, since it is shown that if he is asked for help, then that becomes his main priority

appearsIn.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 2 Part 2
Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Cour 2 - Eris the Goblin Slayer

name: Pursena Adoldia
native: プルセナ・アドルディア
description: Together with Linia Dedoldia they are the two troublemakers in Ranoa Magic Academy, but when it comes to fulfilling her dreams of becoming the Village Chief she will do her best. She likes eating meat.

appearsIn.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 2 Part 2

name: Nana Komatsu
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm (5’2)

Komatsu came to Tokyo, looking to find her dream. Unlike Osaki, Komatsu came from a large and happy household, though her childish outlook prevented her from living on her own initially. She's the middle child of three sisters.  

Her chance encounter with Osaki began a friendship which changes Komatsu's life forever. She is introduced to Osaki's band, Black Stones, and their members. She later even helps "Blast" to find their bassist, by drawing a poster to advertise the vacancy. Much to her surprise, she also discovers that the members of Blast were friends with the members of Trapnest, a popular rock band of which she's a very big fan.

name: Nana Oosaki
description:
__Height:__ 162 cm (5'4")

One of the two titular characters of the series, Oosaki Nana may look like a tough punk rocker, but she has a kind heart and is a devoted friend. Abandoned by her parents and raised by her grandmother, Nana was expelled from high school after she was falsely accused of prostitution. Despite these hardships, Nana "polishes the shards of her dreams" and is determined to be successful as the lead vocalist of Blast. She is now engaged to her first love, [Ren](https://anilist.co/character/1425), although she also has lingering, ambiguous feelings for [Yasu](https://anilist.co/character/2450). Nana's favourite things never change. Her favorite designer is Vivienne Westwood, and her favorite band is the Sex Pistols. She smokes Seven Stars and likes coffee with milk and strawberry cake. She also has the ability to cook, but prepares all her food with too much salt which only Ren seems to enjoy.

name: Nobuo Terashima
description: He is the guitarist of Blast; attended the same high school as Nana Osaki. He is friendly and optimistic, but at times, he tends to miss the focus of conversations around him. Before Nana's "smoking ban", he's the only non-smoking member of Blast. But, his poor threshold for alcohol meant that he leaked many secrets while he's drunk (most notably, about Nana and Ren's relationship to Shin). Like Yasushi, Nobu comes from a rich family (his parents own an inn). Despite this, he is still very passionate about music, even sharing Osaki's dream of making it big with a band one day.

name: Keiichi Mizukoshi
description: Owner to a cheap vintage furniture and clothing store near both Nana's apartment in Tokyo. He hired Hachi but soon closed the store to move back home. He later sends her a postcard with a wedding photo with him and his bride (a childhood friend), ironic to Hachi's lament at the time.

name: Kouichi Satou
description: A waiter at the Jackson's Burger restaurant. He is friendly with Hachi, Junko, and Shoji, who all curiously address him by his full name.

name: Layla Serizawa
description: Although her name is often transliterated as "Reira", her actual name is "Layla", after Eric Clapton's famous song of the same name. She is half-American, half-Japanese, and is the lead singer of Trapnest. She also penned some of their songs.    Layla's friendship with her band comes all the way back to her elementary school days, starting with Takumi Ichinose. The two met when Layla and her mother moved to Japan. Often criticized by the neighborhood because of her then-vague understanding of the Japanese language, Takumi was asked to befriend her. The two stuck together throughout their childhood, mostly teaching each other about their first language - Reira learned more about Japanese, while Takumi learned more about English.

name: Kyousuke Takakura
description: Junko's boyfriend who currently shares an apartment with her. He's also good friends with Hachi and Shouji. His laid-back attitude to life may deem him a slacker in the eyes of many, but he's actually quite perceptive and he coddles Hachi more than Junko would like. Both him and Junko are studying to become artists (his art being Romantic and hers being Post-Modernistic).

name: Yasushi Takagi
description: He plays percussion and is the leader of Blast, usually handling the business partnerships and financial decisions needed for the band's success. His favorite cigarette brand is "Black Stones", from which the band got their name. He is also a lawyer in training, despite his "scary" appearance (clean shaven head, many earrings and dark glasses). He's the big brother figure for Nana O—and sometimes Nobu—and acted as Nana's "guardian" when she arrived in Tokyo. In the past, he shared several ties with Trapnest's members. Yasu and Ren grew up in the same orphanage and remained close friends when Yasu was adopted. He dated Reira while in high school and was jealous of Takumi's success and influence on her, which he later relates as the reasons for their break up. Also, he's the oldest member of Blast which Nobu sometimes teases him about (by calling him "old man").

name: Nami Komatsu
description:
**Occupation:** Student

The youngest sister of Nana and Nao Komatsu. Her parents are Goro and Natsuko Komatsu. She currently attends a local college.

Nami follows the fashion trends of ganguro girls (similar to a kogal girl). Therefore she bleaches her hair platinum blonde and sports a dark tan. Additionally, she often wears her hair up with various accessories. Nami mostly wears brightly colored mini-skirts and shoulder-revealing tops with high heels.

(Source: Nana Wikia)

name: Takumi Ichinose
description:
**Height**: 183 cm  

The leader and bassist of Trapnest. He is handsome and has a reputation of being a playboy. Despite his raw sexual charisma, Takumi can also be a cold and controlling workaholic. His favorite brand of cigarettes is Gitanes.
