name: Jolyne Kuujou
description:
__Height:__ 174.5 cm 
__Nationality:__ Japanese-American 


She is the daughter of [Joutarou Kuujou](https://anilist.co/character/4003) and is the only female "JoJo" to date.  

Quick to anger and snappy with her elders, it seemed like Jolyne was a lost cause. She was irresponsible and flighty, at first only looking to satisfy a cheap thrill. Bitter at Joutarou for leaving the family for so long, she blamed him for her misguided outlook. However, she still had honorable morals and treasured her mother. She would selflessly do everything in her power to help her friends. Jolyne believed that her loved ones had a good heart and an honest nature. Unfortunately, she can believe in them to the point of being gullible as it was through [Romeo](https://anilist.co/character/130623)'s lies that she was sentenced to a prison sentence of 15 years.  When Joutarou sacrifices himself for Jolyne's freedom, she noticeably matures and her resolve to "revive" Joutarou turns into her first priority. She adopts more traits like her father and her wardrobe even changes to resemble Joutarou's look. She eventually gains pride for her Joestar bloodline and she becomes rather tough by the end of the series. Her strength and infallible integrity shine in her fights and her willpower soon echoed that of other Jojos.  Her distant and near-fatherless childhood bore a tinge of loneliness in her. Their relationship is challenging at first, not really fitting the typical father-daughter mold.

Few years later, when she was reunited with some of her classmates that were into anime, she started hanging out with them and discovered her love of anime and manga again, with this she also started cosplaying different characters with her friends to show them her gratitude.

name: Suzuka Itou
description: Suzuka is a photographer who often attends cosplay events. She gets overly excited by a variety of cosplay. She gets especially excited by cross-playing.

name: Miyako Honda
description: Miyako is a cosplayer and friend of the photographer [Suzuka](https://anilist.co/character/306932/Suzuka-Itou).

name: Taichi Yaegashi
description:
Though Taichi doesn't speak much, he's very sympathetic towards others and wants to help his friends when they're having trouble. He suddenly becomes passionate when he starts talking about his hobby, pro-wrestling, and Inaba stops him when he tries to add wrestling topics to their Cultural Research Club's newspaper. He has a little sister in elementary school, [Rina](https://anilist.co/character/64661/).

He is often described by Inaba as being a martyr who wishes to help people at his own sacrifice.

name: Iori Nagase
description:
Iori is [Taichi's](https://anilist.co/character/40195/) classmate, a bright, friendly, popular girl. She's the president of the Cultural Research Club, but rather than lead everyone, she sets the mood and gets them excited. Occasionally she takes bold actions in front of others, be it due to carelessness or simple naivety.

She is described as the most beautiful girl in her grade, and won the first year Miss Yamaboshi pageant.

name: Himeko Inaba
description: Himeko is vice president of the Cultural Research Club. She excels in gathering information and analysis, possessing private data on each of the club members. She's calm and logical, but she's actually a bit clumsy, so her difficulty with roundabout phrasings causes her to surprise many of those around her with her blunt statements.

name: Yui Kiriyama
description:
Yui is very active and expressive. She's a bit small, but she holds ranks in Karate, and even won tournaments when she was in middle school. She absolutely loves cute things, and her room at home is filled with fancy items. 

She always ends up insulting [Aoki](https://anilist.co/character/40199/Aoki-Yoshifumi) when he tries to approach her.

name: Yoshifumi Aoki
description: Yoshifumi is Yui's classmate. He holds affection for her, and continues his attempts to approach her, but she never gives him a chance. In the Cultural Research Club he's often called out, and his pathetic side stands out more, but he also relaxes them with some of his casual statements.

name: Maiko Fujishima
description:
Member of the Student Council Outreach Committee. Shares a class with [Taichi](https://anilist.co/character/40195/).

During the first year, she is the charismatic class president, and is known as a love guru that helps everyone with their relationship troubles.

name: Rina Yaegashi
description: [Taichi's](https://anilist.co/character/40195/) elementary school age younger sister. She often gives advice to her brother about love. Like Ryuuzen and Iori, she is sometimes controlled by Heartseed, but the different one from Heartseed the cultural club's members known.

name: Ryuuzen Gotou
description: Homeroom teacher of the Cultural Research Club members, and the advisor for the club itself. Also serves as a host for Heartseed, who occasionally takes control of Gotou's body to explain a phenomenon to the club. Afterwards, Gotou has no recollection of what happened at those times.

name: Sakamoto
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm (5'10.9")

Sakamoto is the protagonist of the series who is a model student for all in his school. He is the perfect man who can solve any problem with a kind yet calm persona. Because of this, many girls fall for him, and his male classmates resent him. Although he acts strangely sometimes (such as doing weird poses or acting sneakily), it only adds to his coolness. Sakamoto has a range of "secret skills" which allow him to do various things, such as catch bugs or blow bubbles.

name: Yoshinobu Kubota
description: Kubota is a rather stocky young man with a heavy build and frizzy, wavy hair that parts in the middle. He seems on the shorter side compared to his peers and had a round nose with small, brown eyes and freckles on his cheeks. He befriends Sakamoto early on and endures many hardships through his High School career.

name: Aina Kuronuma
description: Kuronuma Aina is a female student in Sakamoto's class who falls for him. She is very popular among boys but has no interest for anyone else except Sakamoto, which makes her disliked by other girls. She charms the boys to do her bidding by making them fall in love with her through 'love lessons', which turned out to be totally invalid to Sakamoto.

name: Erika
description: A girl that is sensitive to new trends. She seems to speak foreign accents very well, and she is found usually hanging around with Fujita Megumi's group.

name: Atsushi Maeda
description: A classmate in class 1-2, and one of the delinquent trio. His trademark is a red hat. Along with Kenken and Mario, he targets Sakamoto for bullying, but gets rebutted each and every time. He has since become a friend of his after Sakamoto helped rescue him and his friends when they were trapped in a room and accidentally lit the room with cigarettes. It is shown in a later episode that he has since switched to blowing bubbles. It has been hinted that he is harbouring a crush on Sakamoto, often blushing in his presence, stating how cool Sakamoto is, and even ordering a "smile to-go".

name: Shigemi Kubota
description: Kubota Shigemi is Yoshinobu's mother, who fell for Sakamoto ever since she met him, as he resembles Chon Choriso, her favorite Korean actor.

name: Mii
description: Mii-chan is a female student who belongs to Megumi's circle of friends.

name: Shigeru Kobayashi
description: The homeroom teacher for class 1-2. Guides his students using his life experiences where he has overcome many dangerous situations.

name: Fukase
description: A long-time delinquent who is in his 30's, has an IQ of 180 and had a strange past. He is popular among delinquents due to his tendency of targeting popular students while manipulating others to do his dirty work.

name: Yasuda
description: Yasuda is one of Sakamoto's classmates.

name: Haruka Sakura
description:
__Height:__ 169 cm

Haruka Sakura is a high school student in his first year. He attends Fuurin, a school known as a delinquent school, with aspirations to reach the top. He admires strong people. Rejected by others for his rough appearance, being alone was natural for him.  Hated by others and sitting at the bottom of the social strata, Sakura believes fighting is his only saving grace and that by winning those fights, he thinks he can feel his worth. He tries to keep an image of a ruthless and tough exterior, but in reality, he is kind-hearted. He easily gets embarrassed by compliments on his good acts. 

(Source: Official Website)

name: Touma Hiragi
description:
A third-year student at Furin High School in Class 1. One of the Four Kings of Bofurin, Hiragi is the leader of the Tamon Team. Hiragi is highly strung and possesses a strong sense of responsibility, often finding himself being pushed around by the overly gracious Umemiya. He's also a hard worker who can't let go of his stomach pain medicine. He possesses true martial arts ability, proven to be one of the best at his craft. He is an understanding person who loyally supports Umemiya.

(Source: WIND BREAKER Official Website)

name: Hayato Suou
description:
**Height:** 174 cm

A first-year student at Furin High School in Class 1. Suo has a refreshing smile and is pleasant to everyone he meets, but his outrageous jokes can cause chaos to the people around him. Despite his pleasantness, he can present an icy personality that leaves no tolerance for people who lack decorum. Suo's an enigma as he usually shows no emotions nor reveals his true feelings. He has a unique fighting style that resembles both kung fu and aikido. 

(Source: WIND BREAKER Official Website)

name: Kotoha Tachibana
description:
Kotoha works at Café Pothos. Her friendly and brave personality makes her seem like an adult, but just like Sakura and the others, she’s only 16. As manager of Café Pothos, she serves the best menu to the students at Furin High School and the local townspeople everyday. She will admonish Sakura for his actions from time to time.

(Source: WIND BREAKER Official Website)

name: Kyoutarou Sugishita
description:
**Height:** 192 cm

A first-year student at Furin High School in Class 1. Sugishita's a mad dog and quite talented — he's the only one who's been allowed to call himself "Bofurin" since middle school. His motivation and driving force come from his excessive loyalty and devotion to Umemiya - whatever Umemiya says, goes. He's usually quiet and has a unique sway as he walks. When he gets mad, though, he's the most unpredictable of them all. 

(Source: WIND BREAKER Official Website)

name: Akihiko Nirei
description:
**Height:** 163 cm 

A first-year student at Furin High School in Class 1. Nirei is weak at fighting, but his frank personality livens up the room — he's the life of the class. He wants to protect the town more than anybody else and thus has always aspired to become a student at Furin High School. Nirei always carries a notepad and pen in his chest pocket. He's a well-informed person whose hobby is collecting and analyzing data on people he thinks are cool. 

(Source: WIND BREAKER Official Website)

name: Hajime Umemiya
description:
**Height:** 188cm

A third-year student at Furin High School in Class 1. Umemiya is Bofurin's representative, meaning he stands at the top. With his friendly smile and amicable personality, he's a charismatic man who garners absolute trust from the people around him — not just the students at Furin High School but also from people around town. He's not just physically strong, however — with the tenacity to handle anything thrown his way, his very existence can overwhelm the people around him in a single shout. He likes to grow vegetables as a hobby.

(Source: WIND BREAKER Official Website)

name: Taiga Tsugeura
description:
__Height:__ 181 cm

A first-year student at Furin High School in Class 1. Always lifting weights and never without his protein shake, Tsugeura possesses a bright and honest personality that makes all his friends admire him. However, due to his constant state of high energy, his friends can also find him to be a pain in the butt at times. A lover of "virtues" as a way of life, he asks everyone he meets for the first time about their virtues. He’s a regular at the Muscle Power restaurant and recommends their protein okonomiyaki.

(Source: WIND BREAKER Official Website)

name: Mitsuki Kiryuu
description:
__Height:__ 165cm

A first-year student at Furin High School in Class 1. Toshiyuki’s gentle-mannered personality and thoughtfulness make him popular with the ladies, but he’s no pushover — his fighting abilities are the real deal. A lover of games, he'll play them whenever he has some free time, making it his daily routine to try and get game login bonuses. He likes to add “chan” to his close friends’ names as a term of endearment. He is revered as one of the five strongest of his grade.

(Source: WIND BREAKER Official Website, edited)

name: Yumi Hinode
description: She is the elder sister of Kento Hinode, who is a high school graduate and spends her time lazily, laying down on the sofa, reading magazines, watching TV, or using her phone.

name: Touma Kamijou
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm
__Classification:__ Esper (technically)
__Esper Power:__ Imagine Breaker
__Power Level:__ 0 (technically)

The main protagonist of Toaru Majutsu no Index and a supporting character in Toaru Kagaku no Railgun. He has the lowest psychic rank possible at Level 0—largely because the people testing psychic abilities cannot detect or classify his abilities. His power is Imagine Breaker, a power which negates all magic, psychic, or divine powers but also his own good luck. Due to the nature of his power, the founder of Academy City considers him neither a Psychic nor a Magician but rather a normal person with a unique ability. He tends to stay away from trouble but possesses a strong sense of justice, albeit somewhat shallow and dogmatic. He is a smart student and knowledgeable about certain subjects yet is a failure in his esper studies. While he is an idealist for the hopes of other people, ironically he is cynical about himself possibly because of his powers.

name: Index Librorum Prohibitorum
description:
__Height:__ 148 cm (4'10")
__Classification:__ Magician
__Affiliation:__ Anglican Church
__Ability:__ Spell Intercept

Index, also known by her full name Index Librorum Prohibitorum, is one of the main heroines and the titular character of the series. She is a young nun from Necessarius, a branch of the Church of England. 

Index is small in stature and has a petite build. About 14 or 15 years old, she has thigh-length, silvery-blue hair with very white skin and large green eyes. She also wears a white robe with golden embroidery sewed onto every edge of it, the Walking Church.

name: Aureolus Izzard
native: アウレオルス＝イザード
description: Aureolus is an alchemist who has the power (called Ars Magna) to turn his thoughts into reality. He was once Index's partner and became obsessed about her. In order to save her he made Deep Blood help him and was up to turn Index into a vampire and save her, though she was always saved by Touma. That made him really mad.

name: Komoe Tsukuyomi
description:
__Height:__ 135 cm

Despite her childish and very short appearance, she is actually an adult and one of [Touma Kamijou](https://anilist.co/character/13700/Kamijou-Touma)'s teachers. This is proven by her apartment being littered with beer cans and cigarettes. She also contradicts her age by acting childish to her students, having a child-like crush on Touma, and ending her sentences with desu, something a child usually does. This irony means that she is often regarded as one of the seven great mysteries of Academy City.

She has major interest in studying pyrokinesis and performs magic once, when [Index](https://anilist.co/character/13699/Librorum-Prohibitorum-Index) requires her to participate in a magical ritual to heal her wounds. The fact that she is able to do so indicates she has no esper abilities of her own.

name: Kikyou Yoshikawa
description: Academy City's researcher. She was in charge of the "Level 6 Shift" project. Even after the project was put to a stop, she kept herself in the laboratory, creating a vaccine for the virus program that Ao Amai put in Last Order. She is shot by Amai while trying to protect Accelerator and Last Order but recovers and is later released from the hospital along with Accelerator and Last Order.

name: Motoharu Tsuchimikado
description:
__Height:__ 176cm (5'9")
__Classification:__  
__Affiliation:__   

A blond teenager who is always seen with sunglasses and wearing an Aloha shirt. He is a friend and classmate of Tōma who just happens to be his next-door neighbor at the dormitory they're staying at. While he seem like a normal, average teenager, there's more to him than meets the eye.       (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Laura Stuart
description: The Archbishop of Necessarius and also the English Anglican Church. Despite being the Archbishop, she looks like an eighteen-year-old girl with long blonde hair that's 2.5 times her height; other than that, few details about her are unknown. She speaks funny Japanese, courtesy of Tsuchimikado Motoharu teaching her, though it was mentioned on a few occasions by Aleister and Stiyl as sounding 'weird', with Stiyl going further telling her it was a mistake to think of Tsuchimikado, who goes after his own sister, as a 'normal' Japanese person and learning Japanese from that source.  She loves baths and has a collection of the latest designs of baths from Academy City, courtesy of Aleister as a gift to sweeten relations between the two sides, in addition to other technology such as the latest design of washing machines given to the Necessarius female dormitories.

name: Shiina Kamijou
description: Touma's mother.

name: Pierce Aogami
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm (5'10")
__Classification:__ Esper  

Tōma's friend and classmate. A funny individual who tends to see Tōma's bad luck, who he calls "Kami-yan", in a different way. He is a self-confessed pervert, lolicon and masochist who enjoys being punished by his teacher, Tsukuyomi. He is always seen with Motoharu. Together with him, Motoharu and Tōma, they are known as the three idiots in their class, as not only do they have the lowest test scores but also they are all level 0's except the latter two have good reasons for being that way.  "Pierce Aogami" is actually a nickname that means "Blue Hair With Piercings"; his real name has not yet been revealed.

name: Hyouka Kazakiri
description: She is Index's first "friend" in Academy City. She is gentle but shy. Not much is known about her aside from the fact that she was an overachiever at Kirigaoka Academy for Girls (霧ヶ丘女学院, Kirigaoka Jyogakuin?), according to Aisa. Her ability is Counter Stop (正体不明, Shōtai Fumei?, "Unknown Identity"). Details about her level are unknown but it could be high, since it was mentioned that she was among the top psychics in the Kirigaoka Academy for Girls.      (Source: Wikipedia, edited by KazeFalcon)

name: Risu
description: Risu couldn't produce any magic smoke. Believing himself to be one of the many magically-impaired members of sorcerer society, he joined the CrossEyes organization to make a living.

name: Ebisu
description: Ebisu is a young, androgynous and sullen looking woman who first appears in chapter three, donning a skull shaped mask. She is walking through the Hole, unable to summon a door back to the Magic Users' world due to the barrier between worlds currently in effect. She runs in to [Caiman](https://anilist.co/character/9192/Kaiman) and [Nikaido](https://anilist.co/character/16057/Nikaido), who advance on her in their common fashion. Caiman cuts off Ebisu's fingers to prevent her from using magic, and bites down on her head after removing her mask. Before he can withdraw to ask her his "question", a frantic [Fujita](https://anilist.co/character/16062/Fujita) appears from a door behind her and forcefully pulls her out of his clamped down jaws, in to the door. This sudden and jerky movement causes trauma to her face and head, but they both get to safety.   After this incident, Ebisu is shown to be haunted by nightmares - and has become somewhat insane. At [En](https://anilist.co/character/16060/En)'s residence, she is restrained until [Noi](https://anilist.co/character/16059/Noi) can properly heal and restore her fingers and face. Past that point, it is evident her head trauma caused some (supposedly temporary,) brain damage as seen in her suddenly eccentric behavior. She is commonly seen with Fujita in the manga panels, possibly leading to believe that they are 'partners' now.   Her smoke is not seen directly, but records state she is skilled in Reptile transformation.

name: Nikaido
description:
__Height:__ 169 cm (5'6½)

Nikaido is a companion to [Kaiman](https://anilist.co/character/9192), who both hunt Magic Users. She is the owner of a restaurant called the Hungry Bug in the Hole. There she serves primarily gyozas with a few slices of shiso, which Kaiman adores. Nikaido's gyozas are constantly declared as the best in the Hole.



Nikaido has long blond hair, blue eyes, an athletic body build, and a curvy figure (shown mostly after her Devil training). At the beginning of the series, her clothes consisted of dark baggy pants and a black jacket with Chinese design. About midway in the series, she wears a green overalls with combat boots and leather gloves. She has an easy going and friendly attitude, though keeps many of her worries and anxieties to herself. She is confident in her physical abilities and isn't easily frightened.

name: Kaiman
description:
__Height:__ 216 cm (7'1)

Kaiman is a human born in the Hole with an immunity towards magic. He has made it explicitly clear that "Kaiman" was not his actual name, but was given to him by [Nikaido](https://anilist.co/character/16057) after he began suffering from amnesia. His lizard head being the result of a Magic User's curse, his main goal is to seek out the one who cursed him in order to change himself back. Because he can't remember who cursed him, due to his amnesia, he instead resorts to clamping his mouth around the head of every magic user he comes across, letting them see the "little man" in the back of his head before pulling them back out so he can ask them all the same question: "What did the guy inside my head say?"

Throughout most of the series, Kaiman, true to his moniker, takes on the appearance of a lizard-like entity. Though his body is consistently human with a tall and muscular build, his face and head have changed dramatically due to the effects of a Magic User. He most closely resembles a Caiman lizard, (though some think he looks more like an Iguana) his hair being replaced by long, very sharp spikes. It appears that despite having his head chopped off, he can regenerate it in a few days time. He sports small crosses over his eyes and wears gas masks most of the time, though he refrains from wearing them later on in the series.

name: Shin
description:
__Height:__ 196 cm (6'5)

Shin is an elite Magic-User, a cleaner for [En](https://anilist.co/character/16060/En), and the partner and long-time friend of [Noi](https://anilist.co/character/16059/Noi). His magic allows him to cut people up without killing them.

Shin is a tall man of muscular build, with short blonde hair, blue eyes, and pale skin. He is often seen in a formal suit while wearing a heart shaped mask backwards. He uses glasses when he isn't wearing his mask. He has stitches running along his arms and hands from his surgery to gain magic powers. He usually uses a hammer to fight, which is his primary weapon of choice besides his magic. Shin has a young looking face without any facial hair, but with a noticeable forehead, which wasn't very obvious at the beginning of the manga, though it became more prominent with the progress in art style. He also had spiky hair, but especially in later chapters his hair is closer to a more realistic or at least shorter hairstyle. As a teenager, Shin used to wear his then very long hair styled in a ponytail. At that time of his life he didn't yet wear glasses, so it can be assumed that with time, Shin's eyesight has gotten progressively worse since then.

Despite his job as En's cleaner, Shin has a very easy-going personality and is rather approachable by all within the En family. He cares deeply for his partner, Noi, and the two share a close bond as a result.

name: Noi
description:
__Height:__ 209 cm (6'10")

Noi is an elite Magic-User, and the partner and long-time friend of [Shin](https://anilist.co/character/16058). She works with him as a cleaner for [En](https://anilist.co/character/16060), who is her older cousin.

Noi has pink-white hair and red eyes. She is the fourth tallest character in the series and is very muscular. As a result, other characters are often unsure of her sex at first, until she opens her mouth or takes off her mask. Beneath the mask, she is a beautiful woman with long hair that often looks slightly disheveled. Her ears are pierced multiple times, with five piercings on each ear. Usually, Noi wears a zip-up tracksuit with her name on it in several places, gloves, and sneakers, though she also has other outfits for formal occasions. She wears a blue gimp mask with an exposed "skeletal" mouth, looking similar to a cenobite from the Hellraiser movies. The mask appears to have been patched with duct tape on top, similarly to the tracksuit, that seems to have duct tape around both the forearms including wrists and the calves.

Noi is very confident and carefree. So carefree, in fact, that as Shin mentions, later on, she has stopped trying to avoid attacks because she can easily heal herself. Noi enjoys fighting and often competes with her dear senpai to see who can kill the most. Her bold personality can get her into trouble because she doesn't bother to carefully observe her surroundings.

name: En
description:
__Height:__ 183 cm (6'0")

Boss of the En family and is an elite Magic User. He is cousins with Noi and Kikurage's partner. He's also good friends with Chidaruma, who is the most powerful Devil. En controls most of if not all business within the Magic-User realm and is regarded as one of the strongest Magic Users in the world. He's shown to be a man who has a large expansive group of lackeys, and is currently Noi and Shin's boss.

Typically seen in loosely worn formal attire and wears his long, red hair spiked upwards. He has a large forehead and menacing eyes further defined by his lack of eyebrows. His mask consists solely of a mouthpiece resembling something between a gas mask and the mouth of a skull. Beneath the mask, he is revealed to have a thin mustache with a goatee. En is cool and confident in everything he does. He often enjoys quietly drinking tea or tending to his exotic garden of mushrooms. En is very full of himself and his capabilities. The very thought of someone laying a finger on him in a fight, the world's most powerful magic user, can cause him to lose control of his emotions and go berserk, turning everything and everyone caught in the crossfire into mushrooms. Despite being a pretty big narcissist, he has shown that he truly does care about the members of his family. He is especially fond of Kikurage, often worrying about her safety and well being above everyone else.

name: Fujita
description: Fujita is a magic user residing in the Magic user’s domain, working for a company headed by En: a powerful magic user. Fujita isn’t a very good magic user at all, himself-- the only times he manages to produce any magical smoke at all are times when he or someone he cares about are in a bit of a bind. For example, when in the Hole (the domain of non-users,) he and a friend of his are stopped by Caiman, a nonuser who is mysteriously unaffected by magic due to his mutations. His friend is killed by Caiman, and in a scurry to get away with his own life he uses his smoke to open a door between the realms-- something that takes a fair bit of skill to do, as remarked by several characters later on.    Wanting to avenge his comrade, Fujita sets out to return to Hole heavily armed but is stopped by a messenger of En, who passes on the message that he’s been assigned to find the user who transformed Caiman into a saurian. A bit of research reveals a reptilian transformation specialist-- Ebisu. Fujita recalls passing her while in the Hole with his friend-- and so, goes to find her before Caiman can kill her, too. Fujita’s timing is just right, and so he manages to save Ebisu just as she’s stuck in the jaws of Caiman, her fingers broken clean off after she attempts to use her smoke on him. Unfortunately, her life comes at the price of her sanity and her face-- En assigns one of the higher-ups, Noi, to heal Ebisu’s face and fingers.

name: Chota
description:
Chota is an elite Magic-User, one of the "big brass" of The En Family, and the most avid fanatic of En. He is completely obsessed with En and ever-hopeful of being his partner. 

(Source: Dorohedoro Wiki)

name: Firo Prochainezo
native: フィーロ・プロシェンツォ
description: The youngest executive of Manhattan's Martillo Family Camorra. Firo is surprisingly friendly, humorous and compassionate, but he is a skilled fighter and can be ruthless or even vengeful towards those who bring harm to the people he cares about. He became a complete immortal in November 1930 after accidentally drinking Szilard Quates' immortality elixir. In the same year he falls in love with Ennis, and despite the fact that she initially is unsure of her affection due to her underdeveloped emotional capabilities, they live together as roommates and gradually she reciprocates Firo's feelings.

name: Ennis
description: Szilard's homunculus, though not his first creation. She was created to unthinkingly execute his every command; recently, however, she has been gaining emotions as well as independent thought, as a result of 'devouring' an alchemist threatening Szilard's life.

name: Maiza Avaro
native: マイザー・アヴァーロ
description: Bookkeeper of the Martillo family and one of the Advena Avis immortals. His younger brother, Gretto, was one of the first to be "devoured" for knowledge of the elixir's recipe.    (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Luck Gandor
description: Intelligent executive of the Mafia Gandor Family. The third of the brothers and childhood friend of Firo, having grown up in the same apartment block.  Although he and his brothers lead the Gandor family, Luck's close ties with Firo makes the Gandors allies of the Martillo Family. He is always calm and level-headed, preferring to resort to violence only when necessary. When that time approaches, he does not hesitate to eliminate his opponent while still maintaining his calm demeanor. Sometimes with a faint smile on his face, which according to Firo, is just a pretense to look cool. Luck intentionally pretends to be ruthless because he believes that he is not suited to be a mafia.

name: Jacuzzi Splot
native: ジャグジー・スプロット
description: A crybaby who is nonetheless capable of exceptional courage and leadership ability when the situation calls for it. At first, Jacuzzi seems almost cripplingly shy, even with a tendency to stutter in front of strangers. However, when his loved ones are in danger, he will summon the strength to face his problems directly, even though he'll continue to cry. After a member of his gang was killed, Jacuzzi robbed a record number of neighborhood stores, clutching a machine gun as tears stream down his face. Jacuzzi went out and received his "sword tattoo" on his face when Nice, his romantic partner, was injured in an explosives accident, so that they would both be similarly marked.

name: Ladd Russo
description: Ladd is a sadistic hit-man for the Russo family. His love for acts of violence truly shows in the maniacal glee he exhibits while fighting or killing. He is exceptionally skilled in hand-to-hand combat—particularly boxing—and the use of firearms. He is most happy while killing people that think they will never die and by seeing dead people or hearing gunfights. Ladd is deeply in love with his fiancée, Lua, although he expresses it through a passionate promise to kill her someday.

name: Czesław Meyer
native: チェスワフ・メイエル
description: The youngest Advenna Avis immortal. His guardian, Ferment, tortured him to test the limits of immortality. Czeslaw manages to devour Ferment, ending his suffering. Unfortunately, he learns from Fermet's memories that he was simply being tortured for Femet's own self-satisfaction. As a result, Czeslaw becomes paranoid and trusts no one, making it his mission to devour other immortals before they can devour him.  In the 1930's it appears he cares little for the lives of others, even requesting that a large group of people be killed so he could find an immortal among them. However, after meeting Isaac and Miria and being forgiven by Maiza, he stops hunting other immortals and moves in with Ennis and Firo.

name: Isaac Dian
native: アイザック・ディアン
description:
Issac Dian forms one half of the bumbling thief couple, who seem to cross into everybody's story in one way or another. He's in love with [Miria](https://anilist.co/character/3796/), and they've robbed everything and anything, from doors to the entire Genoard household. He's completely clueless, super eccentric and happy-go-lucky to the point you can't stop laughing from his bold and sometimes completely weird actions.  

He has a cameo appearance in Durarara!!

name: Miria Harvent
native: ミリア・ハーヴェント
description:
Another eccentric thief, she is the partner and lover of [Isaac Dian](https://anilist.co/character/3662). Miria wholeheartedly believes and supports everything Isaac says, often even going so far as to mimic his body language. Together they appear extremely stupid, whimsical and oblivious, but they have great affection for the people they meet, whom they always make a big impression on and always believe the best of them.  

She has a cameo appearance in Durarara!!

name: Claire Stanfield
native: クレア・スタンフィールド
description: The youngest train conductor for the Flying Pussy Foot, he tells [Miria](https://anilist.co/character/3796/) and [Isaac](https://anilist.co/character/3662/) the story of the dreaded "Rail-Tracer", a story about a brutish beast that causes passengers in a train to disappear one by one. He also seems to be the only one who knows how to stop the Rail Tracer...

name: Makoto Teruhashi
description:
A top idol and Kokomi's older brother. He has a serious sister complex and hates it when Saiki is near her.

(Source: Wikipedia)

He would have done anything to win against him when they were kids, but he would always lose against his little brother. This led to him being addicted to playing/fighting with Kusuo.

Miyabi Itou is a girl that believes in the supernatural, that's why she also joins the Supernatural club. She later learns the secret of Yamada. Although Miyabi is a considerably attractive and cheerful girl, due to her being a fan of the supernatural phenomenons and alike, she is considered among her peers to be a fraud and liar. Because of this, she didn't have any friends at all.

name: Toranosuke Miyamura
description:
**Affiliation:** Student Council and Supernatural Studies

Council vice president and supernatural club vice president. Knows of [Yamada](https://anilist.co/character/57489/Yamada-Ryuu) and [Shiraishi](https://anilist.co/character/57491/Shiraishi-Urara) switching secret.

name: Urara Shiraishi
description:
Class: 2-B
Affiliation: Supernatural Studies Club
Title: President of the Supernatural Studies Club

A beautiful girl who is Suzaku High's brightest student. She is one of the seven (original) witches.





She wears E-cup bras and lots of white underwear, but owns black ones as well. Yamada is the only person Shiraishi is willing to swap bodies with, i.e. kiss. In a special report, Miyamura does an in-depth analysis of the witches based on his observation. In it, he mentioned Shiraishi and her power, "It's so awesome that I get to enjoy using this power! The risks of using are way too high, though. Shiraishi is pretty and nice, but she only kisses Yamada, which is a bummer. I want in on the fun!"

name: Ryuu Yamada
description:
__Class:__ 2-B 
__Affiliation:__ Supernatural Studies Club

Ryuu Yamada is a second year student at Suzaku High. He is always late for school, naps in class, and gets abysmal grades. His life is a dead bore.

description: Class: 2-B   She is the leader of the bullies that tormented Urara Shiraishi.

Class: 1-C

Noa is one of the seven witches in Yamada-kun to 7-nin no Majo, and she is able to see the past. She has three other friends. They attempt to get the other witches expelled from school in order to get their powers.

name: Maria Sarushima
description:
__Class:__ 2-F 

Maria Sarushima is one of the seven witches in Yamada-kun to Nananin no Majo.

name: Kentarou Tsubaki
description: Kentarou is a member of the supernatural studies club.

name: Soichirou Kuzuki
description: A well-built man with angular glasses, Kuzuki is the strict homeroom instructor of [Rin's](https://anilist.co/character/498/Tohsaka-Rin) class. He primarily lectures on World History, though he also holds classes in Ethics. Kuzuki is well respected among staff and students, but he is widely regarded as austere and impersonal.

name: Chiaki Matsushita
description: Matsushita is one of the students of class 2-D. She has a quiet older sister type of personality. She is generally kind to all the boys and girls alike, but she does not actively go out to make friends.

name: Takeko Nishino
description: Takeko, according to Kiyotaka's first impression of her, is the type that speaks her mind without hesitation. She is a bit of a lone wolf, similar to her classmate Mio Ibuki.

name: Rokusuke Kouenji
description: Rokusuke Kouenji is one of the students of class 1-D. He came from a well-known family of scholars. However, he ended up in D-Class for his egotistical behavior.

name: Akane Tachibana
description: Akane Tachibana is a former student of Advanced Nurturing High School who has graduated from Class 3-A and the former secretary of the Student Council.

name: Rakurou Hizutome
description: Rakurou, better known by his nickname "Sunraku," is an enthusiast of Kusoge (shit games); games that are well-known for buggy states, unfair mechanics and awful AI. He is well known by his friends as a Kusoge fanatic and lunatic. Thanks to the skills Sunraku has built up playing such awful games, he becomes a more motivated and better player the crappier the hand a game deals him.

name: Momo Saiga
description: The leader of Schwarzer Wolf—a top-tier clan dedicated to the extermination of Lycagon the Nightslayer. Saiga-0, who holds the title of Attack Holder, is also a member, and the leader commands a formidable roster of highly skilled individuals.

name: Rei Saiga
description:
A highly skilled player in Shangri-La Frontier who holds the special title of "Attack Holder"—an honor bestowed upon the player who has unleashed the highest burst damage in the game. 

While they appear as a burly male character clad in a host of legendary-class armor within the game, in the real world, she is actually a charming young girl harboring a secret crush on [Sunraku](https://anilist.co/character/271367/Rakurou-Hizutome).

name: Towa Amane
aliases: Arthur Pencilgon (アーサー・ペンシルゴン)
description:
The second-in-command of the Ashura-Kai, an extremist PK clan whose primary activity is player-killing. Excelling in strategy and information warfare, she bears the moniker "Giant Killer"—a title earned by her ability to defeat even players of a significantly higher level. 

Having previously clashed with [Sunraku](https://anilist.co/character/271367/Rakurou-Hizutome) and [Oicazzo](https://anilist.co/character/281521/Kei-Uomi) in another game, she has since become both a sworn rival and a fellow gaming companion. She is currently aiming to defeat a certain Unique Monster.

name: Kei Uomi
description:
A gaming companion [Sanraku](https://anilist.co/character/271367/Rakurou-Hizutome) met through a "kusoge" (crappy game), and one of Japan's top-tier professional fighting game players, currently affiliated with a pro gaming team under the handle Kei. While she appears as an adorable female character in Shangri-La Frontier, Kei is, in reality, male. 

Thanks to his encounter with Sanraku, he has been dragged deep into the kusoge swamp. He boasts exceptional skill in player-versus-player combat.

name: Emul
description:
__Height:__ 40cm
__Species:__ Vorpal Bunny

Vorpal Bunny and the NPC guide for the unique quest that Sunraku encounters, titled “Invitation from Rabituza”. She is the daugher of [Vysache](https://anilist.co/character/281523/), the leader of the Vorpal Bunnies, and has 5 siblings including [Peatz](https://anilist.co/character/313385/), [Bilac](https://anilist.co/character/313386), and [Elke](https://anilist.co/character/313434). Emul is an enthusiastic and helpful ally to Sunraku, able to support him with her powerful magic and teleportation abilities.

name: Vysache
aliases: Usagi no Kuni no Kashira (兎の国の頭)
description:
Emul's father and the chieftain of the race known as the Vorpal Bunnies. His physique—vastly larger and more formidable than that of any other Vorpal Bunny—possesses a sheer intensity that overawes all who behold it. 

Impressed by the strength and audacity of [Sunraku](https://anilist.co/character/271367/Rakurou-Hizutome)—who visited the Rabbit Kingdom, Rabituza, under [Emul's](https://anilist.co/character/281522/Emul) guidance—he subjects him to a series of various trials.

name: Kuon Amane
description: Kuon Amane, also known as Orcelott is the Younger brother of [Arthur Pencilgon](https://anilist.co/character/281520/Towa-Amane).

name: Animalia
description:
__Height:__ 162 cm

The leader of SF-Zoo, a clan whose purpose is to observe and photograph monsters. A sorcerer who mastered abnormal status (debuffs) just to photograph monsters. She shows an abnormal obsession with monsters.

name: Ponyo
description: A goldfish princess who wants to become human after meeting the young boy [Sousuke](https://anilist.co/character/15009/Sosuke).

name: Sousuke
description: Sosuke lives by the sea with his mother, [Lisa](https://anilist.co/character/17231/Lisa). While playing at the shore, he rescues [Ponyo](https://anilist.co/character/14286/Ponyo) in her goldfish form. Their friendship begins from there.

name: Kumiko

name: Yoshida
description:
Yoshida is the main male character of the Hige wo Soru. Soshite Joshikousei wo Hirou. series. He is an office worker in Tokyo who lives alone in his apartment. One night, after being rejected by his boss, [Airi Gotou](https://anilist.co/character/127927/Gotou-Airi), he had a fateful encounter with a runaway high school girl named [Sayu](https://anilist.co/character/127925/Ogiwara-Sayu).

Living alone most of his life, Yoshida grew to be a highly independent person. He is an exceptional and reliable employee who's always dedicated to his work; pulling off overtime daily and even helps lighten the load of tasks of his colleagues. He is a man of virtue. Even though he barely knew Sayu he was more than willing to let her stay at his place and felt a sense of responsibility of guiding and watching over her. He is very kind towards others which baffles almost anyone who knew him. He is also a huge gentleman. Unlike most other men, he resists firmly to temptation as seen when Sayu was initially very seductive of him and asked him to make love with her. He believes that he should only do that with a woman whom he loves and that his feelings are also being reciprocated.

Because of his upright and serious nature, Yoshida is not good at dealing with women especially those who can control the flow of conversation. He only had one girlfriend throughout his life and it was a high school senpai. Yoshida openly admitted that his type is mature, older woman.

appearsIn.title: Higehiro: After Being Rejected, I Shaved and Took in a High School Runaway
Higehiro: After Being Rejected, I Shaved and Took In a High School Runaway

name: Sayu Ogiwara
description:
Sayu Ogiwara is the main female character of the Hige wo Soru. Soshite Joshikousei wo Hirou. She is a runaway high school girl from Hokkaido who ended up in Tokyo, in which she had a fateful encounter with a stranger named [Yoshida](https://anilist.co/character/127924/Yoshida).

After running away from her hometown and family for unclear reasons, Sayu was forced to adapt and live her new life as a runaway high school girl. With no money to sustain her basic needs like food and shelter, she gathered her resolve and resorted into seducing men, using her body as a bargaining chip in order to survive. As she kept this lifestyle for about half a year, she became shrewd and adopted a playful, flirty mask to hide her pain and used her bright smile for deceit. To mask her identity, she used aliases. She also developed a high level of maturity and strong mental fortitude, traits which are uncommon for a normal high school girl to have at her age. She hated what she was doing at first, but after a while, being wanted by those men made her feel she could be herself and that she was needed. For her, it was simple and she liked it that way. Because she was already used to that kind of arrangement, she was conflicted when Yoshida let her stay without any significant demands.
