name: Sagiri Izumi
description:
**Height:** 148 cm (4'10 ft)

Sagiri was taught to draw by her mother at a young age, and by the time she was around the age of nine, she became [Masamune](https://anilist.co/character/121470)'s illustrator. A year before the events of the novel, Sagiri met Masamune, though she didn't realize that he was the author she was working with despite the similar names. After her mother died, she temporarily stopped drawing and going outside. After seeing a live video of someone drawing images and getting a response, Sagiri became interested in live video feeds and started drawing images on a camera disguising her face and voice so that nobody would recognize her or learn about her. She eventually started to interact with people who saw her video feed (while still disguised). At some point, Masamune was too busy to cook and she chose to go hungry rather than go outside her room to get food.

name: Masamune Izumi
description:
__Height:__ 176cm 

Izumi Masamune is the protagonist of the story. He is a novelist that goes by the pen name "Izumi Masamune," his same name. He started out his novels in middle school after winning a light novel writing contest. He hopes to get closer to his younger step-sister.

name: Megumi Jinno
description: Sagiri's classmate and the class president.

name: Ayame Kagurazaka
description: The editor for Masamune and Yamada at a publishing company.

name: Elf Yamada
description: Yamada Elf is [Izumi Masamune](https://anilist.co/character/121470)'s fellow author and neighbor.

name: Chris Yamada
description: He is a Yamada Elf's big brother.

name: Kiki
description: A thirteen-year-old apprentice witch, leaving her home village to spend a year on her own. She has no visible magical abilities other than communicating with her cat and broom-flying (at which she is still a novice). She is excitable, innocent, and by turns eager and shy. Some of the earlier concept drawings of Kiki closely resembled the original longer hair illustrations by Akiko Hayashi. It was eventually decided to cut her hair short due to the extra difficulty for animators.

name: Roufujin
description:
One of [Kiki](https://anilist.co/character/6866/)'s customers.

A kind and gentle old woman of whom Kiki first meets when she phones for her to deliver a herring pie to her granddaughter's birthday party. Due to her electric oven breaking, she is unable to make the pie an offers to pay Kiki for her time. Instead, Kiki helps her make it using a wood-fire oven and does some odd chores around the house before delivering the pie in the rain. However, Madame's granddaughter expresses no gratitude for the pie, which upsets Kiki.

(Source: Ghibli Fandom)

name: Ursula
description: An artist in her late teens, who lives -- during the summer, at least -- in a one-room cabin in a wooded area outside of Koriko. She acts as an older sister to Kiki, explaining Kiki's temporary inability to fly in terms of artist's block, and telling her that gifts -- whether the ability to paint, to be a witch, or to bake bread -- must be used, not rejected.

name: Tombo Kopoli
description: A fourteen-year-old boy in the city where Kiki settles. He is obsessed with aviation, is a member of a club building a human-powered aircraft, and is at first intrigued only by Kiki's ability to fly. He later becomes her friend, although it is obvious that she awes him. (It is not clear, at least to an English-speaker, whether "Kopoli" is intended as a given name or family name. "Tombo", according to the novel, is a nickname, Japanese for "dragonfly".)

name: Kokiri
description: Kiki's mother, witch and town herbalist. She worries that Kiki isn't equipped to spend a year on her own.

name: Jiji
description: Jiji is Kiki's sharp-tongued, sarcastic, and sometimes humorously pessimistic feline companion. He is constantly offering well-intended advice (and admonishments) that might make him seem overcritical of Kiki. But he is really a big softie, and his humorous commentary on the events of the movie are hilarious... in a way only a talking cat can be.

name: Osono
description: Proprietress of a small bakery in Koriko, Kiki's new town. She is heavily pregnant throughout the film and can be seen feeding her baby in the end credits. She is the first person in Koriko to treat Kiki with kindness and respect. She also acts like a mother to Kiki. It is under Osono that Kiki works as a messenger.

name: Bertha
description: Oku-sama's housekeeper and friend. Her name is often rendered as "Bassa", an alternate spelling of "bāsa" the Japanese pronunciation of "Bertha".

name: Mine Kuramae
description:
Mine Kuramae works at Ayame Sohma's clothing store as a designer and seamstress, and lives with him in an apartment above the store. She is passionate, cheerful, and determined to do anything for Ayame; she takes care of details he neglects in his enthusiasm, such as getting permission to visit Yuki's class. According to Natsuki Takaya, "she is an amazing person" for being able to keep up with Ayame. She is depicted as especially enthusiastic about dressing girls up in her outfits, sparkling at the thought of doing so, and she herself is always shown wearing a frilly maid's uniform. According to Ayame, Mine is someone he "can confide in."  

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Kyouko Honda
description:
[Tohru's](https://anilist.co/character/207) mother: When she was young, Kyoko caused trouble and cut classes, and was disowned by her parents following a gang fight. She hated her family, as her father felt she wasn't needed in the world and her mother only cared about the appearance of the family. She was also the leader of an all-female suicide gang. In this she was called 'The Red Butterfly', the name originating from the legend of how the tail lights on her motorcycle danced like a bright red butterfly when she rode at night. However, Kyoko later moved on and got a job.

At some point, Kyoko fell in love with a student teacher named [Katsuya Honda](https://anilist.co/character/9230), which contributed to her leaving her gang. After she was beaten by her gang and disowned by her parents, he stood up for her and proposed to her. They shortly married and had a daughter, Tohru. Katsuya became a positive influence in her life, and they worked through difficulties in a joint effort. 

When Tohru disappeared one day as a young child Kyoko was in hysterics, even going so far as to threaten the police if they did not find her. After she was eventually found by Yuki Sohma, who had heard Kyoko's description of Tohru and lead the confused girl home, Kyoko was overjoyed.

name: Ayame Souma
description:
__Zodiac Animal:__ Snake

The snake of the zodiac, and big brother to Yuki, Ayame is vivacious, garrulous, and has a knack for making Yuki and Kyo angry. He runs a business that makes women's clothing, which men apparently wear as well, and he often wears women's clothing himself. He named his shop after himself and runs it with Mine, who is later revealed to be Ayame's girlfriend and the seamstress of the store. Ayame designs the dresses, erotic as some or all of them may be. Vain and somewhat self-conscious, he is really a thoughtful person underneath his "selective" skin. He has gorgeous gold eyes and silver hair in a startling contrast to Yuki's violet and grey. His fear, coincidentally, is a fear of being totally alone. Much to Yuki's chagrin and surprise, he was actually the student body president in high school. When Ayame was young, he did not care for Yuki at all until he realized that when he got older, he would be totally alone without Yuki, spurring his new obsession to gaining Yuki's love shown in the series. Yuki has slowly started to accept Ayame as a brother.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Hatsuharu Souma
description:
__Height:__ 170.2 cm (5'7")
__Grade/School:__ Freshman at Kaibara High School
__Zodiac Animal:__ Ox

The ox of the Zodiac, Haru has something of a Yin and Yang personality related to the Ox's personality. He is usually calm, placid, and otherwise an all-around nice guy, but can be goaded into "stampeding", where he's edgy and mean and slightly oversexed. White Haru is conscious during his "black" transformation, but is unable to do anything about it. He just either apologizes or doesn't care.

Additionally, Haru has a rather bad sense of direction; he had become lost for three days in another town after trying to find [Kyo](https://anilist.co/character/209) so he could challenge him. He likes to make fun of Kyo passively and wants to fight with him on a regular basis. He is very protective and caring, especially towards [Yuki](https://anilist.co/character/208), [Kisa](https://anilist.co/character/371), and [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/3892), and is constantly looking out for these characters.

__Manga:__

name: Mayuko Shiraki
description: Mayuko Shiraki (白木 繭子, Shiraki Mayuko) is Tohru, Kyo, Yuki, Saki, and Arisa's homeroom teacher; what subject she teaches is never given, though in an author's note, Natsuki Takaya said she thinks Shiraki fits the image of a literature teacher. Shiraki is depicted as generally good-humored but sometimes aggressive—when Kyo attempts to leave class on Valentine's Day, she stops him at the door with a folder in his face and threatens to dye his hair black instead of orange, and once breaks up a fight between Hatsuharu and Kyo by dumping a bucket of water over them;she once demanded as a joke that, after some students familiarly addressed her "Mayu-chan-sensei," that they call her "Great Teacher Mayuko." Her parents, who worry about Shiraki being unmarried, run a bookstore where she sometimes helps out. Takaya said in an author's note that Shiraki is "possibly sad" that she is a woman and "secretly insecure of how tall she is," but since Hatori Sohma is tall too, they "might look pretty good together."  Shiraki is best friends with Kana, Hatori's former fiancee, and through she met Hatori, Shigure, and Ayame two years before the series begins. While Shiraki was attracted to Hatori, she was glad that Kana and Hatori were happy together. She dated Shigure for a month before breaking up, partly because Shigure was distant and partly because she was only dating him to alleviate her loneliness.

name: Deishuu Kaiki
description:
The white swindler who once deceived [Hitagi](https://anilist.co/character/22037/Hitagi-Senjougahara) and the cause of [Nadeko](https://anilist.co/character/22050/Nadeko-Sengoku)'s curse. Kaiki is a capable conman, able to deceive multiple people to get the results he wants, usually being money. On one occassion, he has used the alias 'Suzuki'. Though he appears to be a deceitful man, Kaiki has tried to help others occasionally.

In Nisemonogatari, 

He is the narrator of Koimonogatari.

name: Yozuru Kagenui
description: Yozuru was first introduced in Tsukihi Phoenix. She is an onmyouji and one of [Meme](https://anilist.co/character/22552/Meme-Oshino)'s clubmates at the university. As a rule she imposed on herself, she's not allowed to step on the ground. Between the three kouhai during university she was the only one who graduated. She fights by using her fists and is powerful enough to punch through multiple floors at once.

name: Yotsugi Ononoki
description:
**Occupation:** Oddity Specialist

Yotsugi Ononoki is an expressionless human corpse tsukumogami and the shikigami familiar of [Yozuru Kagenui](https://anilist.co/character/57501/).

Despite appearing almost entirely stoic, she still has hinted at feeling genuine emotion. She's mentioned how she considers [Koyomi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/) her friend on multiple occasions, such as when giving him advice "as a friend" as opposed to as an oddity specialist. She's also expressed how she wouldn't want to have to harm him despite needing to follow orders as a shikigami.

She has an ability called Unlimited Rulebook which allows her finger to shape-shift and cause explosions. She also seems to have a type of super strength, being able to to carry Kagenui and others using only one finger.

She also has an appreciation for muscles.

(Source: Monogatari Fandom)

name: Punpun Onodera
description: Punpun is a socially awkward young boy whose age of innocence ends with his parents' divorce. As he continues to mature and interact with people around him as the average boy would, such as dealing with crushes and getting into mischief with his classmates, he begins to learn how crushing and harsh reality can be and struggles to find his purpose in the world.

name: Aiko Tanaka
description: An eccentric girl who is the main love interest of Onodera Punpun throughout the manga.

name: Sachi Nanjou
description: Sachi is a young woman pursuing a career as a manga artist. She befriends [Onodera Punpun](https://anilist.co/character/17706/Onodera-Punpun) and serves an important role in his life. She has realistic views on things and isn't afraid to speak out, but most people think she is just a rude person.

name: Yuuichi Onodera
description:
Punpun's uncle (Punpun's mom's brother) who is a 30-something freeter. He was previously a ceramics teacher, but he quit his job due to a certain incident. He looks after Punpun after Punpun's parents divorce.

Women of all ages find him very attractive. He is bad at resisting the charms of beautiful women which leads him to several serious troubles in his life. Because of that, he finds humans to be ugly and detestable creatures and prefers to keep contact with other people to the minimum.

name: Setsuyuki Mimura
description:
Punpun's friend from high school. They work at the same part-time jobs after going to university. He often acts like a fool and likes to brag about his muscles. Because of that, he is unpopular among girls. When he introduces Hebitsuka Gesumi as his girlfriend, his friends don't believe him.

He decides to pursue a teacher's career because both of his parents are teachers.

name: Saotome
description: The ex-husband of Sachi. He works in the TV industry. He worked hard to achieve his goals in life, and because of that, he despises all losers who do nothing but whine all the time.

name: Kamisama
description: Appears after Punpun says a special chant his uncle taught him. He helps Punpun with his problems.

name: Punyama Punpun Papa
native: プン山 プンプン パパ
description:
Punpun's dad. He turns down a work transfer due to family reasons but gets fired from work as a result. He is unable to find a job since then.

After the divorce, he goes to his hometown Kagoshima and starts working as night guard at a hydro plant. He sends letters to Punpun every month.

name: Komatsu
description: Punpun's friend from elementary and middle school. He has a natural talent for badminton.

name: Shuntarou Harumi
description: A childhood friend of Punpun, who moved away as a child.

name: Josee
description: A young girl who lives with her grandmother and calls herself "Josee" after her favorite book

appearsIn.title: Josee, the Tiger and the Fish

name: Tsuneo Suzukawa
description: A fourth year student at a university in Osaka.

appearsIn.title: Josee, the Tiger and the Fish

name: Kana Kishimoto
description: The librarian at the library that Tsuneo and Josee visit together.

appearsIn.title: Josee, the Tiger and the Fish

name: Hayato Matsuura
description: Tsuneo's friend who shares the same part-time job and age as him.

appearsIn.title: Josee, the Tiger and the Fish

name: Mai Ninomiya
description: Mai Ninomiya is Tsuneo's underclassman at the same diving shop where he works part-time.

appearsIn.title: Josee, the Tiger and the Fish

name: Alucard
description:
__Height__: 220 cm (7'2")

The secret weapon of the Hellsing organization, Alucard is a vampire specializing in killing other vampires. At first glance, he seems to be nothing but a rather odd gunman, but when he truly unleashes his powers, it becomes quite clear that he is not a mortal. After walking the night for half a millennium, he is constantly seeking a worthy opponent, and with his powers of regeneration, strength, and shape-shifting, not to mention his army of familiars, he lays waste to any of his master's enemies.    

 

Several of the typical weaknesses of vampires have no effect on him, like sunlight, as he claimed in chapter 13: "Sunlight is not my greatest enemy...  I just HATE it!" He can also travel over running water without any problem.

name: Integra Fairbrook Wingates Hellsing
native: インテグラル・ファルブルケ・ウィンゲーツ・ヘルシング
description: Sir Integra Hellsing is a noblewoman member of the Protestant Knights who is the head and last member of the Hellsing family, the Bureau Director of the Hellsing Organization, and the current master of Hellsing's vampire, Alucard. Integra is usually a collected individual, rarely allowing her emotions to get in the way of business. However, she is sometimes prone to fits of anger. The Hellsing family is "on a mission from God", and she values her duties to protect the United Kingdom and the Anglican Church above everything else. For her, failure is not tolerated, especially her own. She runs the Hellsing Organization with charisma and patriotism, and she is one of the few people who can stand up to the force of Alucard's personality and command his respect.

name: Seras Victoria
native: セラス・ヴィクトリア
description:
__Affiliations:__ Hellsing Organization, London Metropolitan Police (Former; Firearms Specialist)

A policewoman sent to investigate the troubles at Cheddar Village, her squad is killed and she is nearly raped and killed by the mad vampire priest inhabiting the dead village but is "saved" when [Alucard](https://anilist.co/character/601/Alucard) sends a bullet through her to kill the priest. On the verge of death, she allows Alucard to turn her into a vampire​ and joins Hellsing as Alucard's minion.

She is reluctant to embrace her new powers at first, but gradually comes to terms with what she is, and eventually discovers her true powers after a certain event.

name: Doc
description: The Doc is, as his nickname implies, a doctor, though of the rather questionable sort.  He is the mastermind behind Millennium's artificial vampires, and has not aged since the second world war. He  is also in the possession of a peculiar remote controller, controlling many different aspects of the Millennium war machine.

name: Abraham Van Helsing
native: エイブラハム・ヴァン・ヘルシング
description: A 19th century doctor of medicine, philosophy and literature, a man with a wide area of thought all around, also an experienced vampire hunter and a direct ancestor of Sir Integra Fairbrook Wingates Hellsing.

name: Jan Valentine
native: ヤン・ヴァレンタイン
description: The youngest of the Valentine brothers, Jan is a maniacal thug and an artificial vampire. He does not have any high class vampire abilities, and utilizes two P90s.  During the assault on Hellsing HQ, he fought Seras and Walter while hunting for Integra, and was eventually remotely killed by Millennium in order to seal his lips.

name: Heinkel Wolfe
native: ハインケル・ウーフー
description: Heinkel Wolfe, a pistol wielding assassin for the Iscariot organization, joins the fray along with Yumie and a squad of Vatican gunpriests.

name: Walter C. Dornez
native: ウォルター・C（クム）・ドルネーズ
description: Walter C. Dornez is the butler of [Integra Hellsing](https://anilist.co/character/603/), but is at the same time a deadly combatant, wielding high-velocity microfilament wires, and fought together with [Alucard](https://anilist.co/character/601/) in the Second World War to stop a certain group's attempt at creating an undead army.

name: Enrico Maxwell
native: エンリコ・マクスウェル
description: Enrico Maxwell is the leader of the Vatican's Special Section XIII, the Iscariot Organization. He is a bitter rival of Integra and the Hellsing organization, but establishes a form of cooperation with Hellsing when fighting Millenium.  But can Integra and the others truly trust him?

name: Leif aka Huger
native: レイフ aka ハガー
description: Leif aka Huger and his girlfriend Jessica were a couple of low level youngster vampires misguided into a belief that they can become immortal by killing off 13 random families on a road. They've managed to kill 4 before clashing with Hellsing operatives to our pair's great surprise.  In Hellsing manga vampire boyfriend's name has never been mentioned so in different adaptations authors went with different versions: in Hellsing TV series he is called "Leif" multiple times while in Hellsing Ultimate character's name is never spoken out loud, yet noted as "Huger" in the end credits of episode one.

name: All For One
native: オール・フォー・ワン
description:
__Quirk:__ All For One
__Occupation:__ Villain
__Fighting Style:__ Close Range and Long Range

All For One is the true leader and benefactor of the League of Villains. Once Japan's most powerful villain and All Might's arch-nemesis, his true motives are unclear and his true identity unknown. His current goal is to raise Shigaraki to become his eventual successor.

name: Enji Todoroki
description:
__Height:__ 195 cm (6' 4¾")
__Occupation:__ Pro Hero
__Quirk:__ Hellflame

Endeavor is a tall man with a muscular physique. He has short and spiky, red hair with bright blue eyes. His beard and mustache appear to be made of fire, but when he turns off his flames on his face voluntarily, his stubble shows.

appearsIn.title: My Hero Academia: World Heroes' Mission

name: Dabi
description:
__Height:__ 176 cm (5'9¼")
__Quirk:__ Blueflame

Dabi is a villain affiliated with the League of Villains and a member of the organization's Vanguard Action Squad. 

Dabi is a stoic, aloof, confident, and focused individual who rarely shows emotion. While rather crude and violent, he's also shown to be quite cautious. Overall, Dabi is a highly enigmatic individual who trusts no one, preferring to do things alone and in his way. He also gives off the impression of knowing more about certain people than he lets on.

Dabi's Quirk grants him the ability to generate and control highly destructive blue flames from his body. He has very well-developed control of his flames and can project them far from himself and in large amounts. However, Dabi's body has a low tolerance for his flame, and he will get burned if he uses them for prolonged periods.

name: General Boscogne
description: Boscogne is the ultra powerful commanding officer of Tuda's most powerful force, the Purple Rhinos. He is politically bound to take orders from Lord Gennon.

name: Adon Coborlwitz
native: アドン コボルイッツ
description: He is General of the Blue Whale Knights. Adon's resilience and extended speeches are legendary. He also possesses a wide array of ancient techniques passed down through generations of the Coborlwitz family, which helped him surviving several battles with the Band of the Hawk.

name: Judeau
description: The old Band of the Hawk's friendly mediator. A former circus performer who wielded throwing knives, Judeau was also well-aware of the world around him and was seen as a confidant for many of The Hawks. Throughout his stay with the Band of the Hawk, he was secretly in love with Casca, but never acted on it out of respect for Guts' and Casca's feelings for each other.

name: Bazuso
description:
Bazuso was exaggerated in stature, and stood much taller than other men. Although he was killed before he could be seen without his armor, it can be inferred that his physique was very muscular due to the excessive size of his weapon, as well as the incredible size and weight of his armor.

Bazuso was a violent and brash man. He was greatly arrogant and seemingly viewed himself as superior to his foes, taunting those reluctant to attack him and loudly goading his enemies right in front of him. He bore an insatiable drive for combat and possessed incredible physical strength, which allowed him to easily slay anyone who challenged him. However, after Guts emerged as the victor of their duel and mortally wounded Bazuso, he attempted to yield before Guts finished him off.

Bazuso's strength and fighting ability became infamous throughout the battlefield. It is said that he once successfully took on over thirty men in combat, earning him the moniker of "Thirty-Man Slayer", and that he defeated a bear by himself, both of which were testaments to his incredible physical strength. Bazuso was strong enough to send men flying with a single swing of his battleaxe, even when using just one arm.

Bazuso wielded a large battleaxe during his fight against Guts. Due to his fearsome reputation, one can assume that he was very skilled in wielding it. Furthermore, the size of the battleaxe complimented Bazuso's height, giving him a wide reach in combat.

name: Ubik
description: Ubik's design is directly based upon one of the Hellraiser Cenobite characters. He is also one of the Godhand, and thus extremely mysterious. He has the voice of an old man, and together with Conrad he shows Griffith a glimpse into his past so that he can make the choice to sacrifice the Hawks without question.

name: Gambino
description: [Guts'](https://anilist.co/character/422/Guts) adoptive father, and leader of a mercenary band. Gambino trained Guts to be a mercenary like himself and even gave Guts his first scar (across his nose) during a practice fight.

name: Shin  Wolford
native: シン ウォルフォード
description:
He is the main character of Kenja no Mago. After dying in a car accident. He was reincarnated into an unknown world carrying with him a vague memory of his previous life in his previous world.

(Source: Kenja no Mago Wiki)

name: Oliver Schtrom
native: オリバー＝シュトローム

name: August von Earlshide
native: アウグスト＝フォン＝アールスハイド
description: Hes the prince of the kindom of earlhide. His first appearance was at the royal mage academy.  Aug had never had a friend that treated him as a equal until shin said they are like "cousins"

name: Sicily von Claude
native: シシリー フォン クロード
description: Sizilien is the third daughter and fourth child of the House of Claude. [Shin](https://anilist.co/character/138191) encounters Sizilien when she and [Maria](https://anilist.co/character/138195) were being harassed by demon hunters. She was amazed by how quickly he dispatched the bigger and more intimidating men.

name: Mark Bean
description:
Class: S-class (Currently); A-class (Formerly)
Rank: 11th
Mark is a member of Ultimate Magic Research Society.

name: Olivia Stone
description: Olivia Stone is a member of the Ultimate Magic Research Society who used to be an A-class student, however due to a large improvement on her magic after joining the group she has become an S-class student along with Mark. Her family owns a dining hall called the Brick Oven.

name: Julius von Littenheim
native: ユリウス フォン リッテンハイム
description:
Name: Julius von LittenheimClass: S-class
Rank: 10th
Member of Ultimate Magic Research Society

name: Diseum von Earlshide
native: ディセウム フォン アールスハイド
description: He is the current king of the Earlshide Kingdom. His wife's name is Julia von Earlshide. They have two children: August and May.

name: Satone Shichimiya
description: [Yuuta Togashi's](https://anilist.co/character/65863/Togashi-Yuuta) friend from middle school with whom she went on delusional adventures. Shichimiya believes to have a magical ring called "Saturn VII" and calls herself "Sophia Ring SP Saturn VII."

appearsIn.title: Love, Chunibyo & Other Delusions - Heart Throb -
Love, Chunibyo & Other Delusions: Take on Me

name: Rin Matsuoka
description:
__Height:__ 177 cm (5'10"); 179 cm (5'10")
__Swim Style:__ Butterfly (specialty), breaststroke, individual medley

The rival swimmer from Sametsuka Academy.  Rin Matsuoka is [Haruka](https://anilist.co/character/83023/Nanase-Haruka)'s rival who is also in 11th grade. He had gone abroad to study swimming, but his personality changed immensely by the time he had returned to Japan and for this reason he often perplexes his former teammates.

Rin goes to all-boys school.

name: Nagisa Hazuki
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm (5'5"); 167 cm (5'6")
__Swim Style:__ Breastroke (Specialty)

Breaststroke swimmer of the Iwatobi High School swimming team. [Haruka's](https://anilist.co/character/83023/Nanase-Haruka) kouhai and a first year. He is a straight-forward person and his actions are faster than his words. He admires Haruka's swimming; it's the reason for him to start swimming. He enters Iwatobi High School because Haruka is there.

name: Haruka Nanase
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm (5'9"); 177 cm (5'10")
__Swim Style:__ Freestyle

Freestyle swimmer (crawl) of the Iwatobi High School swimming team. Haruka Nanase is an 11th grader who loves to swim. His strong and quiet swimming style fascinates many, and he holds a strong fixation on freestyle swimming.

His best friends include [Makoto Tachibana](https://anilist.co/character/83027/Tachibana-Makoto) & [Nagisa Hazuki](https://anilist.co/character/83021/Hazuki-Nagisa) from Grade School, then he later befriends [Rei Ryuugazaki](https://anilist.co/character/83025/Ryuugazaki-Rei). He used to be best friends with [Rin Matsuoka](https://anilist.co/character/83019/Matsuoka-Rin), but now Rin has become Haruka's rival. Haruka has created the Iwatobi High School Swimming Club along with his other friends to take down Rin.

name: Rei Ryuugazaki
description:
__Height:__ 177 cm (5'10")
__Swimming style:__ Butterfly stroke

A freshman who joins the Iwatobi High School swim team.

Rei Ryuugazaki is a classmate of [Nagisa](https://anilist.co/character/83021/Hazuki-Nagisa)'s in 10th grade. He was originally a member of the track team, but decided to join the swimming club instead. A handsome, intelligent young man who often gets manipulated by [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/83019/Matsuoka-Rin) for some reason.

(Source: ANN)

name: Makoto Tachibana
description:
__Height:__ 183 cm (6'0")  

Backstroke swimmer of the Iwatobi High School swimming team.

Makoto Tachibana is [Haruka](https://anilist.co/character/83023/Nanase-Haruka)'s inseparable best friend since 11th grade. He understands Haruka's good points, and is often forced to speak as his spokesman. He is very kind and considerate, but is also very easily scared and weak-hearted.

name: Gou Matsuoka
description: [Rin Matsuoka](https://anilist.co/character/83019/Matsuoka-Rin)’s little sister. She's [Hazuki](https://anilist.co/character/83021/Hazuki-Nagisa)'s classmate and 1st-year in Iwatobi high school. She has a refreshing personality in school but is always worried about her brother, Rin.

name: Miho Amakata
description: [Haruka Nanase](https://anilist.co/character/83023/Nanase-Haruka) and [Makoto Tachibana](https://anilist.co/character/83027/Tachibana-Makoto)'s homeroom teacher and classic literature teacher. She seems to have been an office lady in Tokyo in the past, but no one knows the details. She utters the words of great figures from ages past. Due to her personality, when she asks something of someone, they can't refuse.

name: Chigusa Hanamura
description: Gou's friend.

name: Seijuurou Mikoshiba
description: The captain of the swim team at Sametsuka Academy.

name: Haruhiro
description:
__Race:__ Human
__Height:__ 170 cm, 172 cm (Volume 8)
__Class:__ Thief

The main viewpoint character and Thief of the group. Haruhiro is the most well-rounded character of the series as he is neither arrogant in his nature nor humble. He is generally helpful and always willing to help out his party members.

name: Yume
description:
__Race:__ Human
__Height:__ 159 cm
__Class:__ Hunter

Brave and energetic, Yume is the Hunter of the group. She also has a tendency to try and protect [Shihoru](https://anilist.co/character/89316/Shihoru) because of her shy and timid nature. She has a good friendship with [Haruhiro](https://anilist.co/character/89313/Haruhiro) and they seem to get along well.

name: Mary
description: __Class:__ Priest

name: Ranta
description:
__Race:__ Human
__Height:__ 168 cm, 170 cm (Volume 11)
__Class:__ Dark Knight

The Dark Knight of the group. He is brash, impulsive, and somewhat perverted, which leads him to constantly arguing with [Haruhiro](https://anilist.co/character/89313/Haruhiro). Ranta is the troublemaker of the group constantly causing problems and making rash decisions for he has a slight hint of arrogance in his character.

name: Shihoru
description:
__Race:__ Human
__Height:__ Unknown
__Class:__ Mage

The Mage of the group. She is shy, only opening up to [Yume](https://anilist.co/character/89314/Yume) and [Manato](https://anilist.co/character/89317/Manato) which led to a one-sided crush on him. Yume is constantly trying to get her to interact more with the group.

name: Manato
description:
__Class:__ Priest

Manato chose to become a Priest and ultimately assumed the role of the group's initial leader. He saw the positives in people and with that he was able to effectively strategize battle plans when the group began hunting goblins for the first time. As they progressed as a team, they began mapping out abandoned towns while hunting bigger goblin parties.

name: Moguzo
description:
__Race:__ Human
__Height:__ 186cm
__Class:__ Knight

Moguzo is the tallest and heaviest member of the group and hence chose to become a member of the Warrior guild. He wears the most ironclad armor and wields a wide blade broadsword that comes up to shoulder height. Although he is the most physically imposing, he challenges Shihoru for being the most soft spoken. On several occasions he will allow his friends to sleep in and will take their turn at cooking breakfast in the morning. He somewhat remembers doing this before and finding joy out of it. He also would carve wooden figurines of noteworthy quality in his spare time.

name: Barbara
description: [Haruhiro](https://anilist.co/character/89313/Haruhiro)'s Thief master. Barbara has short brown hair and wears glasses. She wears an outfit that has a brown band around her breasts and green shorts, and is outfitted with belts around her waist and legs to hold knives.

name: Shinohara
description: The leader of the guild Orion

name: Hounen
description: [Manato's](https://anilist.co/character/89317/Manato) master.

name: Daisuke Narumi
description:
**Name**: Daisuke Narumi   **Height:** 194 cm  
**Weight**: Unknown   
**Team**: Josei  
**Position:** Center  
**Talent**: None   

Daisuke Narumi is a first year rookie at Josei High. Narumi is a very tall and buff high school boy. He has spikey, dark hair that is combed to the back, with a few hairs sticking out at the front. He plays with jersey number 9.  
Narumi is very arrogant and overconfident in his abilities. As a way of concentration, he listens to heavy metal and reads porn magazines.

**Extra**:

[1] His love for erotic women is further expressed when he heard Seirin had a female coach and he was dissappointed when he saw Riko, expecting a sexy woman with nice curves.[2] It seems that his tension on-court goes up when he knows a sexy woman is present, which didn't happen with Riko.

name: Kenichi Okamura
description: Kenichi Okamura is Yousen High's power forward.

name: Mugi Awaya
description: He falls in love with [Akane Minagawa](https://anilist.co/character/120991/Minagawa-Akane) accepting the fact he has no chance of making her his. He is shown to be emotionless and revealed minimum expression, but as the story goes on, things start to change. He also shows a caring side for the ones close to him. Moka, a childhood friend, has deep feelings for Mugi, but he denies her feelings for him because he knows well he would ruin her.

name: Hanabi Yasuraoka
description:
At the beginning of the story she's in love with [Narumi Kanai](https://anilist.co/character/120993/Kanai-Narumi), her childhood friend who is now her teacher. She immediately realizes that Narumi is in love with [Akane Minagawa](https://anilist.co/character/120991/Minagawa-Akane) and not her. She meets [Mugi Awaya](https://anilist.co/character/120990/Awaya-Mugi), who is in love with Akane, and starts a relationship with him to satisfy each other's loneliness.

She has different attitudes with each character: she's cheerful with [Sanae Ebato](https://anilist.co/character/120992/Ebato-Sanae), her best friend, timid with Narumi Kanai and sincere with Mugi because she trusts him a lot.

name: Akane Minagawa
description: Akane Minagawa is a music teacher at Hanabi's school. She hides her true personality with a "mask" at the beginning of the story, but it's clear to see that she is very manipulative and takes pride in hurting others.

name: Sanae Ebato
description: Sanae is introduced to the series as the best friend of the main character, Hanabi. She is shown to be a supportive character in the beginning, but when they're alone, she tends to be very possessive.

name: Noriko Kamomebata
description: Noriko Kamomebata or as she likes to be called, Moka, is shown to be childish and whiney. Her appearance is intended to make her look like a princess who is in need of a "prince". Mugi is her childhood friend who she fell in love with. Although she may be annoying, she seems to care for others and like to see them happy. Her size makes her look younger than she actually is.

name: Narumi Kanai
description: Narumi Kanai is amicable and benign. He is also a teacher at Hanabi's school, who he cares deeply about but never views her relationship wise, more like a precious little sister.

name: Mei Hayakawa
description:
Mugi's senior at high school. Mugi turned to her after being unable to initially confess to Akane and they had sex. Afterwards, Mei apologizes to Mugi for rushing him into it.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Kaldo Gehenna
description:
__Height:__ 175cm

Kaldo Gehenna is a Divine Visionary and Head of the Magic Talent Administration, a subdivision of the Bureau of Magic.

name: Love Cute
description:
__Height:__ 160cm

Love Cute is a second-year student at Easton Magic Academy. She is the Fifth Fang of the Magia Lupus.

name: Innocent Zero
description: Innocent Zero is the alias of the leader of the criminal organization of the same name and the primary antagonist of the series. He was once a pupil of Adam Jobs alongside Wahlberg.

name: Ryoh Grantz
description: A Divine Visionary and the captain of the Magic Security Forces. Unlike most members of the country, Ryou has no problem with magicless people, as long as they impress him. He also has a big ego, and sees himself as a star to the point of narrating his own actions.

name: Renatus Revol
description:
__Height:__ 180cm

Renatus Revol is a Divine Visionary and a member of the Magical Cemetary Administration, a subdivision of the Bureau of Magic.

name: Holo
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'2)

Holo is a wolf harvest deity originally from a land in the north known as Yoitsu. She made a promise with men from a town called Pasloe where she would ensure the town would have good wheat harvests year after year. However, as time went on, the townspeople slowly started to forsake Holo and did not rely on her as they once did. As such, Holo escapes from town in [Lawrence's](https://anilist.co/character/7374/) wagon and started traveling with him to see how much the world has changed since she has been in Pasloe. Holo has chosen the form of a girl younger than Lawrence, though she still retains her large wolf tail and ears. Her true form is that of a very large wolf which many people revered and feared.  

She refers to herself as the "Wise Wolf of Yoitsu" (ヨイツの賢狼). She is typically very haughty and self-sufficient, though due to her isolation for hundreds of years in Pasloe, she gradually feels very lonely, and sometimes shows a more fragile side of herself towards Lawrence, whom she relies on for company. Holo fears this loneliness, along with the difference in lifespans that she and Lawrence have, but hides it the best she can with jokes. She has a peculiar way of speaking, modeled after that of the oiran high-class courtesans. She is fond of delicious food and alcohol, but especially loves apples. She takes pride in her tail and takes special care of it, constantly combing and maintaining it.

appearsIn.title: Spice and Wolf: MERCHANT MEETS THE WISE WOLF

name: Kraft Lawrence
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm (5'10'') 

Kraft Lawrence is a twenty-five-year-old traveling peddler who goes from town to town buying and selling various things in order to make a living. When he was twelve, he became an apprentice to a merchant relative, and set out on his own at eighteen. His goal in life is to gather enough money to start his own shop, and he has already been traveling for seven years while gaining experience in the trade. He meets Holo one night and eventually agrees to her traveling with him. She helps him by providing her wisdom which helps to increase his profits and get him out of jams. Lawrence usually goes by his surname, only some who have known him for a long time, like Jakob Tarantino, the master of his guild, call him by his first name Kraft in the novel.

appearsIn.title: Spice and Wolf: MERCHANT MEETS THE WISE WOLF

name: Nora Arendt
description: She is a skilled shepherdess from a church-town named Lubinheigen. Her companion in this profession is a well-trained sheep dog named Enekk.

appearsIn.title: Spice and Wolf: MERCHANT MEETS THE WISE WOLF

name: Zheren
description: A mysterious merchant that Lawrence and Holo meet on their journey when they visit a monastery. He suggests a "get rich quick" scheme to Lawrence involving reminted coins.

appearsIn.title: Spice and Wolf: MERCHANT MEETS THE WISE WOLF

name: Chloe
description: Chloe is a villager of Pasroe and has known Lawrence for a long time. In fact, Lawrence taught her how to be a merchant. Despite still not knowing how she should feel about him, she respects him as her teacher. She is an anime-original character, meaning she does not exist in the manga/light novel version of Spice and Wolf.

name: Marhait Liechten
native: リヒテン・マールハイト
description: The manager of the large Pattio branch of the Milone Company. He is a calm, cool, and collected man who speaks very politely.

name: Marten Liebert
native: マーティン・リーベルト
description: He is a business worker for Hans Lemerio.

appearsIn.title: Spice and Wolf: MERCHANT MEETS THE WISE WOLF

name: Hans Remelio
description: Hans Remelio is the head of his Remelio Trading Company that was heading towards bankruptcy when first met by Lawrence and Holo.

name: Kaede Honjou
description: Maple is the main heroine, who has just started playing NewWorld Online. A shielder class. Since she doesn’t want to get hurt, she always puts her skill points into vitality. Due to this, many think of her as useless offensively, but much to their surprise, she manages her own. She's a bit silly, though surprisingly intelligent, and often abuses the game's mechanics in ways the game developers don't expect. Most of her actions in-game are done for the sole purpose of having fun, and though she participates in in-game tournaments often, she's only competitive insofar as it's enjoyable to her.

appearsIn.title: BOFURI: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense.
BOFURI: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense. Season 2

name: Risa Shiramine
description:
__Height:__ 155 cm (5'1")

[Kaede](https://anilist.co/character/147892)'s gamer gal pal who invited her to the VRMMORPG NewWorld Online. She is a professional gamer, having numerous achievements that certify her capabilities. Being the swashbuckler class, her reflexes are considered abnormal.

Sally is extroverted, cautious, and practical, reflecting on her past experience with other games. She also has a creative and tricky side to her, evidenced by her choice to become a swashbuckler so that her party with Maple "would never take any damage", as opposed to the more conventional choice of being a mage so she could support Maple from the rear.

appearsIn.title: BOFURI: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense.

name: Frederica
description: Frederica  is a member of Payne's Guild, Congregation of the Holy Swords along side Dread and Drag being part of the considerably more powerful players.

appearsIn.title: BOFURI: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense.

name: Mii
description:
Mii is a player in NewWorld Online. She is the guild master of the Flame Emperors guild along side Markus, Misery, and Shin.

Mii acquired a skill and unknowingly built up a character with her great charisma that others willingly follow. After realizing this, she became embarrassed to show her true self; a quiet girl who wants to enjoy cute things. She regrets her actions but decided to up appearances for those who chose to follow her.

appearsIn.title: BOFURI: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense.

name: Dread
description:
Dred or Dread, is a member of Payne's Guild, the Congregation of the Holy Swords along side Frederica and Drag.

He has a sharp intuition. His style puts focus on high speed and moderate attack power but his instincts tell him that’s he’s not an opponent for Payne or Maple.

appearsIn.title: BOFURI: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense.
BOFURI: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense. Season 2

name: Christmas Rose
description: Christmas Rose is a side character usually seen getting defeated.

appearsIn.title: BOFURI: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense.

name: Kanade
description:
A boy often mistaken for a girl because of his fair build. He joined Maple Tree when [Maple](https://anilist.co/character/147892) invited him.

Kanade is quiet and clever, showing a fascination with puzzles and mysteries of every kind. He will usually devote an entire day to any task he finds interesting.

appearsIn.title: BOFURI: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense.
BOFURI: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense. Season 2

name: Dorazou
description: Dorazou is the mascot and announcer character in NewWorld Online.

appearsIn.title: BOFURI: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense.

name: Syrup
description: Maple's pet turtle in New World Online.

appearsIn.title: BOFURI: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense.

name: Kasumi
description: Meets [Sally](https://anilist.co/character/147893) and [Maple](https://anilist.co/character/147892) during the game's second event. Despite rough first impressions, they become friends and she eventually joins Maple Tree.

appearsIn.title: BOFURI: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense.
BOFURI: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense. Season 2

name: Obi
description: Working for [Zen](https://anilist.co/character/18324/Wistaria-Zen), Obi, is a strange (but lighthearted mostly) and unusual character in the story. His first appearance is when he tries to frighten [Shirayuki](https://anilist.co/character/18323/Shirayuki) by shooting an arrow to a wall next to her. He tends to hide his face under a mask, which makes many people think of him as a bad guy. He later starts showing to have feelings for Shirayuki, for she is the only person that understands him. Out of all the characters in AnS, he is the only character with unknown motives for following Zen so far which makes him a rather mysterious character.

appearsIn.title: Snow White with the Red Hair
Snow White with the Red Hair Season 2
Snow White with the Red Hair

name: Shirayuki
description:
__Height:__ 162 cm (5'4")

Shirayuki is a bright and resourceful girl, determined, able to speak her mind, and knowledgeable in both botany and medicine. Whenever there is a problem or conflict, she often takes matters into her own hands. She later learns to rely on others, especially Zen.

Due to her rare hair color, Shirayuki gets a proposal to be a concubine of the foolish but famous prince Raji. As she cannot decline it, she escapes to the neighboring country. While traveling, she meets a boy named Zen, who accidentally gets injured, and she boldly cures his wounds. They become friends, and she finds out than Zen is actually a prince of that country, and he saves her from being taken by Raji. They later go to his palace, where she applies for the job of "Palace Pharmacist," to be able to go freely to the castle where Zen is.

appearsIn.title: Snow White with the Red Hair
Snow White with the Red Hair Season 2
Snow White with the Red Hair

name: Zen Wistaria
description:
__Height:__ 176 cm (5'9")

The 2nd prince of the Kingdom of Clarines. He is in love with Shirayuki and has told his brother, Izana that he wishes to make her his wife.

Zen is an excellent swordsman and has a penchant for exiting out windows instead of doors and jumping down from high places.

As a young child, Zen has built up an immunity against various poisons by exposing himself to poisons in specific controlled doses causing convulsions, fever, and difficulty walking to name a few. These results were carefully documented by his doctors.

(Source: Wikipedia)

appearsIn.title: Snow White with the Red Hair
Snow White with the Red Hair Season 2
Snow White with the Red Hair

name: Mihaya
description: Appears in chapter 2. He kidnaps Shirayuki on the mountain in order to make money by showing off her rare red hair. He explains he was once a noble who became penniless and as a result lost his rank and status. Desperate, he is willing to make money using any means necessary.  Later in the story he requests an audience with Prince Zen who demands him thrown out, still holding a grudge against him for kidnapping Shirayuki. Zen is wary and distrustful of him and suspects him having an ulterior motive. Mihaya provides information of a "pretty boy" who is looking for Shirayuki and may be planning on kidnapping her. He helps in the searching for the "pretty boy" when Shirayuki goes to Tanburn.

appearsIn.title: Snow White with the Red Hair
Snow White with the Red Hair Season 2

name: Mitsuhide Rouen
description: One of Zen's close Aides. He was first introduced to Zen when he was 17 by Zen's brother, the first prince, Izana. Mitsuhide is one with an outgoing and honest personality. He shares a close relationship with Zen and can often be seen having a friendly banter with each other. He was once described as 'protective' by Kiki, another close aide, towards Zen.

appearsIn.title: Snow White with the Red Hair
Snow White with the Red Hair Season 2

name: Atri
description:
Atri is one of the remaining members of the Lido family and became a rebel. Prince Izana punished the family because they considered victims and pawns of their lords but the truth is they filled up their pockets by trampling on the good.

He only appeared in the Episode 8 of the first season of the anime.

appearsIn.title: Snow White with the Red Hair

name: Izana Wistaria
native: イザナ・ウィスタリア・クラリネス
description: He is the crown Prince and also Zen's older brother. He also doesn't like the idea of Shirayuki being close to Zen, but knows that Zen is deeply in love with her.

appearsIn.title: Snow White with the Red Hair

name: Kihal Toghrul
description:
Kihal is a young girl hailing from a small island. Her village is known for it's beautiful messenger birds with oceanic blue and green feathers. Kihal has her own bird, Popo, that she controls with her flute, called a Walnut Stone. She despises nobles for the acts they have done on her island. They hunted the birds ignorantly and cared nothing for the islanders. Kihal enters the story by going to Clarines to complain about this problem, but only to be tested in the process.

(Source: MyAnimeList, edited)

appearsIn.title: Snow White with the Red Hair

name: Raji Shenazard
description: Raji is the prince of Shirayuki's mother country, Tanburn. Regarded by his people and known even by the neighboring country of Clarines as an idiotic and selfish prince, Raji does as he pleases. Raji orders Shirayuki to become his concubine simply because she has rare red hair. In response to this absolute order, Shirayuki cuts her long hair, leaves it behind, and escapes to the neighboring country. After Zen is poisoned by an apple (sent by Raji) intended for Shirayuki, Raji forces Shirayuki to come to his castle to be his concubine in exchange for the antidote. Shirayuki almost complies before a recovered Zen bursts in revealing himself to be the second prince of Clarines. He orders Raji at sword-point to leave Shirayuki alone or else strain the relation between Clarines and Tanburn. Raji of course, obeys.

appearsIn.title: Snow White with the Red Hair

name: Shuka
description: Shuka is an Apprentice Soldier stationed at Fort Laxdo.

appearsIn.title: Snow White with the Red Hair

name: Maika Sakuranomiya
description:
**Height:** 156 cm (5'1")
**Character:** Sadistic

Because she usually has an unpleasant look in her eyes, she was worried that she didn't pass the interview, but the shop manager hired her to work at Stile. Her dream is to one day study abroad. She is the "Do S" (extreme sadist) waitress.

name: Mafuyu Hoshikawa
description:
__Height:__ 135 cm (4'9")
__Character:__ Little Sister

She looks young but she is actually a college student. She's usually quite calm but when she starts work she becomes a sparkling "little sister" character. She loves children's anime. She is the "little sister" waitress.

name: Kaho Hinata
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm (5'4")
__Character:__ Tsundere

A popular blond, twin-tailed high school shop clerk who is so obsessed with games that sometimes leads her to spend too much money on it.

name: Kouyou Akizuki
description: He is in charge of the kitchen at Stile. He loves yuri.

name: Dino
description:
He is Italian, and scouted Maika to work at Stile. He has a bad habit of getting a nosebleed when he gets too excited.
He has a crush on Maika Sakuranomiya.

name: Aika Sakuranomiya
description:
Aika Sakuranomiya is the older sister of Maika Sakuranomiya. 

Aika is a cute and kind older sister who cares for her family and tends to worry about Maika Sakuranomiya's social life because of her scary eyes. Her care for her sister has been shown many times as she tries to help whenever she can.

name: Kouichi Sakuranomiya
description: The older brother of [Maika](https://anilist.co/character/123078/).

name: Hideri Kanzaki
description:
__Height:__ 150 cm (4'11")
__Character:__ Idol

An employee at Stile who dreams of becoming a cute idol.

name: Miu Amano
description:
**Height:** 163 cm (5'4")
**Character:** Big Sister

She normally wears glasses and is active in a doujin circle. She is the "older sister" waitress at Stile, but surprisingly, she is easily excitable.

name: Owner
description:
Owner is Dinos company dog

However, he is friendly dog always happy around Maika Sakuranomiya and sometimes Owner likes to lick Dino who takes care of him.

That being said, he's known to have more of a 'jerkish' side to him, such as him biting Dino for no reason when he and Maika were at the park or threatening to dismantle Dino's figures if he didn't give him walks. He also tends to have a mind of his own, namely feigning innocence.

name: Vivy
description:
Vivy is the first autonomous humanoid AI in history. Her mission as an AI is to make everyone happy with her songs, thus she aims to sing with all her heart. She attaches great importance to promises and feelings, and is an AI "diva" that serves humankind.

(Source: Official Site, translated)

name: Matsumoto
description:
Matsumoto is an AI that came to Vivy from 100 years into the future. Its mission as an AI is "to avoid the war between AI and humankind." To that end, its goal is to destroy AI with Vivy.

It is talkative, overconfident, and has a personality that is not like an AI.

(Source: Official Site, translated)

name: Estella
description:
Estella is an AI staff working at the space hotel "Sunrise" outside the atmosphere. Her mission as an AI is "to take care of human beings as a life keeper."

She is polite, tolerant, and friendly.

(Source: Official Site, translated)

name: Grace
description:
Grace is an AI nurse who works in hospitals and research institutes. Her mission as an AI is "to save human life as an AI nurse."

She is an angel in a white coat who always smiles and speaks in a polite tone so as to give the patient a peace of mind.

(Source: Official Site, translated)

name: Ophelia
description:
Ophelia is a diva AI active in small theaters around the world. Her mission as an AI is "to make everyone happy with songs" like Vivy.

She's usually a bit shy and sloppy, but she performs the highlight on stage.

(Source: Official Site, translated)

name: Momoka Kirishima
description: Momoka was helped by Diva once when she got lost in NiaLand, since then she has grown attached to her and deeply cares about her she gave her nickname Vivy (ヴィヴィ).

name: Osamu Matsumoto
description:
An AI researcher who sends “Matsumoto” one hundred years back in time to change history. He is the one who developed the AI for Matsumoto and is one of the world’s leading experts in his field.
(Source: Official Site, translated)

name: Youichi Aikawa
description: An assemblyman who is working to pass the AI Naming Law, which would grant human rights to AIs. He is friendly but has no notable achievements to his name.

name: Navi
description: The navigation system used by the employees of NiaLand. It has a foul mouth and speaks harshly to Vivy.

name: Yunyun
description: Yunyun is a member of the Crimson Magic Clan, and she and [Megumin](https://anilist.co/character/89361) are friends as well as rivals.

description: Chomusuke acts as [Megumin](https://anilist.co/character/89361)'s familiar. She is a black cat with a red cross-shaped marking on her forehead and bat like wings. She cannot speak human language, but she seems to be fairly intelligent and can understand human speech to some extent.
