native: ベルゼルグ・スタイリッシュ・ソード・アイリス
description: Iris has a little-sister type personality but also acts very kind and cheerful, almost always seen with a smile on her face. As a princess, she is very polite and treats everyone with respect. Iris always restrains herself, and acts like a model royalty, is obedient and won’t give trouble to others.

appearsIn.title: KONOSUBA -God's blessing on this wonderful world! 3
Konosuba: God's Blessing on This Wonderful World!

name: Mephisto Pheles
native: メフィスト・フェレス
description:
__Height:__ 195 cm (6'5") 

Pheles is the Chairman of True Cross Academy and also an Exorcist. After Fujimoto's death Pheles was ordered to kill Rin, however he accepted Rin's proposal in becoming an Exorcist and entered him into True Cross Academy. It has been heavily implied that he is the son of Satan along with his brother, the Earth King, Amaimon. He possesses the unique and peculiar ability of transforming into a small dog after counting down from three in German. How powerful he is has not been shown but he has mentioned that he is an honorary knight, the position two ranks below Paladin. He has been shown responsible for allowing several higher class demons onto campus. His name is an obvious pun on the word Mephistopheles, which is name for the another infamous devil, similar to his father Satan.

name: Shiemi Moriyama
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm (5'4")    

Slightly allergic to pollen. Shiemi is [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/24482/Okumura-Rin)'s classmate and friend. Before she met Rin, Shiemi tended her grandmother's garden while her mother ran an Exorcist only shop inside True Cross Academy. During her encounter with Rin and [Yukio](https://anilist.co/character/24734/Okumura-Yukio), they were able to discover that Shiemi was having her life force leached out by a Demon. After Yukio exorcised the demon, Shiemi finally decided to become an Exorcist and started to attend class. It was later revealed that Shiemi had talent in becoming a Tamer, as she was able to summon a Greenman Spirit during class. It is apparently a rare talent to possess amongst the Exorcists, where there are only a few who can control demons and fight.

name: Renzou Shima
description:
__Height:__ 176 cm

Renzou is a very carefree character, yet he has a fear of many things, mainly bugs. He's very loyal to Bon, his childhood friend. They grew up together along with Konekomaru in Kyoto. He is also has a big obsession with women. Plans to become a Meister in Aria He is the 5th and youngest son of his family, and tells Konekomaru he's glad of this because it means he has less responsibilities. His older brother Juuzou says he's the pervert out of the brothers. Renzou is a carefree character and was the first person to actually befriend Rin since the revealing of the blue flames, which shows Renzou is the friendly-type. He is also afraid of bugs, yet he is known as the pervert out of the Shima brothers.

name: Konekomaru Miwa
description:
__Height:__ 155 cm

Konekomaru Miwa hails from Kyoto along with Ryuji Suguro and Renzo Shima and is an Exwire of the True Cross Order, a student of the Exorcist Cram School, and the surviving head of the Miwa family.

name: Nemu Takara
description:
__Height:__ 163 cm

Takara is a quiet, mysterious character. He is also somewhat of a ventriloquist. He hasn't talked much, and when he does, it's usually through ventriloquism. He is short, only slightly taller than Konekomaru, and wears the typical True Cross Academy uniform. Has yet to be shown opening his eyes and is always seen with his rabbit puppet. Not much is known about him he also did not contribute to the group effort in the Exwire exam. However, when he speaks with his rabbit puppet, the voice and tone is usually very rude.

name: Satoru
description: Satoru is a young boy who was taken hostage by a mysterious masked figure.

name: Tomoya Aki
description:
__Occupation:__ Student / Executive producer / Director / Scenario writer / Manager

Tomoya is described as a 'hardcore geek'. However, he is one of the three most notable students at Toyogasaki Academy, along with [Utaha Kasumigaoka](https://anilist.co/character/88750/Utaha-Kasumigaoka) and [Eriri Spencer Sawamura](https://anilist.co/character/88749/Eriri-Spencer-Sawamura), due to his strong advocating of otaku culture at the school.

Tomoya is an otaku and prefers reading comics and light novels, watching anime, and playing visual novels above anything else. He is an enthusiastic fan of [Utaha](https://anilist.co/character/88750/Utaha-Kasumigaoka)'s novel Koisuru Metronome. He is the founder and representative member of Blessing Software, serving as the producer, director and programmer. He is also the manager of [Michiru](https://anilist.co/character/88752/Michiru-Hyoudou)'s cover band "Icy Tail". When motivated, especially by otaku-related factors, he can be shown to be very hardworking. After his encounter with [Megumi Kato](https://anilist.co/character/88748/Megumi-Katou), his strong desire to make his dream game drives him to take up several jobs for funding. He is extremely tenacious and would do anything to get what he wants, but is easily distracted. He was a typical consumer otaku who would spend the money at his part-time job on anime and games, but his money and time are later devoted to his own games.

appearsIn.title: Saekano: How to Raise a Boring Girlfriend
Saekano: How to Raise a Boring Girlfriend ♭

name: Megumi Katou
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3")
__Occupation:__ Student / Assistant Director / Main Heroine

Megumi Kato is the classmate of [Tomoya Aki](https://anilist.co/character/88747/Tomoya-Aki), who is hardly noticed by others. After Tomoya had met her during the fate summons, she inspired him to make a dating sim game, featuring her as his Main Heroine. However, he is disappointed by her real personality. She is one of the main characters of the [Saenai Heroine no Sodatekata](https://anilist.co/anime/20657/Saenai-Heroine-no-Sodatekata/) series and is essentially the inspiration for the series title.

appearsIn.title: Saekano: How to Raise a Boring Girlfriend
Saekano: How to Raise a Boring Girlfriend ♭

name: Eriri Sawamura
native: 澤村・スペンサー・英梨々
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm (5’2”)
__Occupation:__ Student / Illustrator / Painter

Eriri Spencer Sawamura is [Tomoya](https://anilist.co/character/88747/Tomoya-Aki)'s childhood friend. She is a student of class 2G art club. She wears two hats as a student and a doujinshi artist. Eriri is one of the most beautiful girls to attend to Toyogasaki High School. Her family is very affluent. Her father is an English diplomat and she lives in a mansion. She is the secret illustrator for a famous doujinshi circle called ''Egoistic Lily'' under the alias Eri Kashiwagi when she participates in doujin activities. She was greatly influenced by her fujoshi mother and otaku father. She was the illustrator for Blessing Software.

appearsIn.title: Saekano: How to Raise a Boring Girlfriend
Saekano: How to Raise a Boring Girlfriend ♭

name: Utaha Kasumigaoka
description:
__Height:__ 169 cm (5’6”)
__Occupation:__ Student / Author / Scenario Writer

Utaha Kasumigaoka is an up-and-coming young novelist and a student in class 3C who has a secret identity as a writer.

She is a hardworking girl who easily finishes writing their game's plot in the span of a night. Her usual disinterested expression gives off the impression that she is an unapproachable person. When she is with the people in [Tomoya Aki](https://anilist.co/character/88747/Tomoya-Aki)'s circle, she reverts to her disdainful self who enjoys making sarcastic remarks. She seems to be calm and quiet, but she actually has a sharp tongue. Utaha can be a little aggressive. Utaha is also very intelligent and is the smartest student in the school. She even writes plays for the drama club as a hobby. She is also a little bit self-centered, but she never talks back to her parents, making her well-mannered. However, when [Tomoya](https://anilist.co/character/88747/Tomoya-Aki) complimented her one time, she acted like a shy, embarrassed girl instead of her usual cold self and called [Tomoya](https://anilist.co/character/88747/Tomoya-Aki) by his first name instead of Rinri-kun.

appearsIn.title: Saekano: How to Raise a Boring Girlfriend
Saekano: How to Raise a Boring Girlfriend ♭

name: Michiru Hyoudou
description:
__Height:__ 174cm (5'8")

Michiru Hyodo is [Tomoya Aki](https://anilist.co/character/88747/Tomoya-Aki)'s cousin/childhood friend (and by far his longest standing friend). She is a student in class 3, in the second year of Tsubaki Girls' Senior High School.

Michiru would have been a well-rounded student if not for her poor academic performance. She is fickle and naturally good at anything she does. [Tomoya Aki](https://anilist.co/character/88747/Tomoya-Aki) once noted that Michiru had a lot of useless talents. She is not interested in anything but her band and music, and enjoys playing the guitar. Michiru had a prejudice against otaku culture and wasn't happy about [Tomoya](https://anilist.co/character/88747/Tomoya-Aki) being an otaku and tried to get him out of his 'nerd phase' until Tokino Himekawa, Echika Mizuhara and Ranko Morioka (band members) told her they were all otaku. Michiru is a kind and caring girl, but she can also be childish sometimes and she also seems to be naturally cheerful as she is usually seen with a smile on her face. However, she also has shown to be serious and mature. It is hinted that she has feelings for [Tomoya](https://anilist.co/character/88747/Tomoya-Aki), though its not completely clear due to her slightly impassive personality.

appearsIn.title: Saekano: How to Raise a Boring Girlfriend
Saekano: How to Raise a Boring Girlfriend ♭

name: Iori Hashima
description:
Iori Hashima is the older brother of Izumi Hashima, Tomoya Aki's former best friend and the previous representative of Rouge en rouge.

Iori is friendly at first, and despite being soft-spoken, he can be a little cold, and he dislikes being ignored. He can be kind as well as shown when he helped Tomoya Aki when he was in a tight spot.

appearsIn.title: Saekano: How to Raise a Boring Girlfriend

name: Ranko Morioka
description:
Ranko Morioka is the oboist of the Icy tail band who is a is a casual otaku fan.

She is a quiet and calm girl who also seems to be experienced in Data Processing.

appearsIn.title: Saekano: How to Raise a Boring Girlfriend
Saekano: How to Raise a Boring Girlfriend ♭

name: Echika Mizuhara
description:
Echika Mizuhara is another oboist of the Icy tail band who is a vocaloid addict.

She has shoulder-length purple hair that has a light purple colored hair band attached to her head and violet eyes.

appearsIn.title: Saekano: How to Raise a Boring Girlfriend
Saekano: How to Raise a Boring Girlfriend ♭

name: Tokino Himekawa
description:
Tokino Himekawa is another oboist of the Icy tail band who is a voice actor fanatic.

She is a petite girl that has purple shoulder-length hair that curls at the tip. She has purple eyes. Tokino is usually seen with normal Tsubaki Girls Senior school uniform.

appearsIn.title: Saekano: How to Raise a Boring Girlfriend
Saekano: How to Raise a Boring Girlfriend ♭

name: Izumi Hashima
description:
__Height:__ 157 cm (5'2")
__Occupation:__ Student / Illustrator


Izumi Hashima is a student in class 3A of Honoda Junior High School and a supporting-main character in the [Saenai Heroine no Sodatekata](https://anilist.co/anime/20657/Saenai-Heroine-no-Sodatekata/) series. She later attends the same high school as [Tomoya Aki](https://anilist.co/character/88747/Tomoya-Aki), the Toyogasaki High School.

When she was younger, Izumi used to be very outgoing and active and played with the boys. But after being introduced to the world of otaku by [Tomoya Aki](https://anilist.co/character/88747/Tomoya-Aki), she has become immersed in the fandom. Over all, Izumi has shown to very cheerful and glad, as she usually is seen with a smile on her lips. She usually is seen playing around, especially with [Tomoya](https://anilist.co/character/88747/Tomoya-Aki). Izumi is also very air-headed and childish and she rarely gives up on something that she really wants or likes. She has also shown to be quite matured.

appearsIn.title: Saekano: How to Raise a Boring Girlfriend
Saekano: How to Raise a Boring Girlfriend ♭

name: Abiko Samejima
description: Author of "Tokyo Blade".

name: Melt Narushima
description: Model and actor affiliated with Sonic Stage Productions. He appeared while still an untrained, yet arrogant, actor on the TV Drama *I'll Go With Sweet Today*. Melt was then cast in the role of Kizami in the 2.5D Stage Play *Tokyo Blade*.

name: Taiki Himekawa
description: Award-winning stage actor affiliated with the Lala Lai Theatrical Company.

name: Yoriko Kichijouji
description: A mangaka and author of "Today will be sweet". She used to be [Abiko](https://anilist.co/character/237576/Abiko-Samejima)'s mentor.

name: Shun Aonuma
description: Another one of Saki's childhood friends. Shun is very clever, with a strong intellectual curiosity and mature manners. His marks in magic are excellent at Saint Academy, and many have high hopes for his future. According to Satoru, Shun is the most talented at using the Force in their group.

name: Satoru Asahina
description:
A loud, brash 12-year-old who is part of a childhood friend group consisting of himself, Saki, Shun, Maria and Mamoru that attends Sage Academy in Kamisu 66. Satoru is a quick-witted and observant person who cares a lot about his friends despite poking fun at them. He is shown to be particularly close with Saki, as he teases and argues with her more often than the others. Like the rest of the students at the academy, he has a psychic ability called Cantus.

During summer camp, the group of five go off on a wild adventure that leads to Satoru and Saki being separated from the others and them meeting a Queerat named Squealer, who appears trustworthy at first but seems to have dangerous intentions.

name: Saki Watanabe
description: Saki is the main character and narrator of the story. Saki is a new student at the magic school, “Saint Academy”. Once she joins Saint Academy, she hangs out with [Satoru](https://anilist.co/character/57571/Asahina-Satoru), [Maria](https://anilist.co/character/57573/Akizuki-Maria), and [Shun](https://anilist.co/character/57575/Aonuma-Shun), her friends from Wakien Elementary School, as well as [Mamoru](https://anilist.co/character/57589/Itou-Mamoru), her new classmate. While she's not shy, she is sensitive and delicate.

name: Maria Akizuki
description:
Maria is Saki's best friend and a beautiful girl with pale, white skin and blazing red hair. She's very strong willed, and commands the weak, quiet Mamoru, but in times of need she devotes herself to protecting him. On the other hand, she does show a girlish fear of scary stories too.   

(Source: Crunchyroll)

name: Mamoru Itou
description: After joining Saint Academy and being put in the same class as Saki, he follows them around. He's a very shy boy, and rarely voices his own thoughts and opinions.    (Source: Crunchyroll)

name: Rijin
description: A high priest of the Temple of Purification who seals away the children's telekinesis for breaking the rules and escorts them to be judged.    (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Akki
description: Mysterious child who appeared in Kamisu-66 in July of year 237.

name: Mare Bello Fiore
native: マーレ・ベロ・フィオーレ
description: One of the Guardians of the Sixth floor of Nazarick alongside his twin sister [Aura](https://anilist.co/character/89129). He's rather shy and calm in comparison to his sister, although he can fight and be ruthless when necessary. Like his sister, Mare is a Dark Elf. Mare specializes in Druid magic, capable of twisting the earth to his whims.

name: Hamusuke
description:
Hamsuke resembles a giant Djungarian hamster with a long snake tail. Six sigils dot her silvery fur.

Before being inducted in the Great Tomb of Nazarick, Hamusuke was very boastful and prideful of her ability and power as the "Virtuous King of the Forest." However, since meeting [Momonga](https://anilist.co/character/89103) and witnessing the power of the denizens of Nazarick, she has seen how vastly inferior she is. She accepts this and swears loyalty to Momonga, willing to do anything to please his master and earn his keep.

name: Evileye
description:
Evileye is an adamantite ranked adventurer and magic caster of Blue Roses as well as a former companion of the Thirteen Heroes. 

Evileye has the figure of a twelve-year-old girl. She covers herself with a reddish robe and an uncanny mask which hides her face. Because of this, she is considered an enigmatic woman by others. Due to her short stature, she is called "Shorty" by [Gagaran](https://anilist.co/character/127669/Gagaran). Evileye's young appearance is presumably due to being an immortal vampire, which caused her body to stop developing at the age of twelve.

name: Vesture Kloff Di Laufen
native: ヴェスチャー・クロフ・ディ・ローファン
description: A former adamantite-ranked adventurer and the mentor of Gazef Stronoff.

name: Scama Elbero
description: The leader of the mithril class adventurer guild, Four Armaments.

name: Foire
description:
Foire is one of the forty one Homunculus Maids that are responsible for the various maid jobs on the 9th and 10th Floors of the Great Tomb of Nazarick.

(Source: Overlord Wiki)

name: Gagaran
description: She is an adamantite ranked adventurer and a warrior from Blue Rose

name: Lilynette Piani
description: A member of the mithril class adventurer guild, Four Armaments.

name: Fumikage Tokoyami
aliases: Shikkoku Hero: Tsukuyomi (漆黒ヒーロー ツクヨミ)
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm
__Quirk:__ Dark Shadow

Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School.

Fumikage is reserved, serious, and focused, albeit noble and valiant. Though not talkative, Fumikage will directly ignore questions or requests that seem in some way pointless. During combat, Fumikage is known to be fierce and dependable, with his strength and capabilities rarely being questioned. Fumikage is fond of darkness and other related concepts, considering himself a "creature of the dark" and employing archaic-sounding speeches that paint him slightly creepy or dramatic. 

Fumikage's Quirk "Dark Shadow" allows him to manifest a sentient shadow monster from his body that he can materialize and contract freely. Dark Shadow's energy is limited and can be drained by bright light. Dark Shadow retracts into Fumikage's body when it runs out of energy. The shadow entity's personality, strength, defense, and control depend on the lack of light. In bright light, Dark Shadow is weaker and smaller but still has considerable strength and defense and is easier to control, but in total darkness, Dark Shadow's size and parameters are drastically enhanced. It is powerful enough to rip out and cut down multiple full-grown trees easily. However, Dark Shadow is more difficult to control in the dark, causing it to rampage based on its own free will.

name: Keiichi Maebara
description:
Keiichi is the son of a famous and extremely wealthy artist and has recently moved to Hinamizawa after an array of unfortunate events in his hometown. His charismatic, lively attitude and talented tongue allow him to quickly fit in the town and make new friends and also win some club activities. Though he can be somewhat shy and is easily spooked at times. 
 When in need of a weapon, he wields Satoshi's old bat. Keiichi often receives the butt of the jokes in the club's activities from which he was the correct answer to some games they play, to wearing embarrassing costumes whenever he loses punishment games. Keiichi has brown hair with dark blue eyes and is described as charismatic to others.  During his school days, he wears a red shirt under a white one, black pants, a belt, and red shoes. However, during his free days, he wears a black sleeveless shirt under a short red one, green shorts with a blue belt, and shoes.

name: Rena Ryuuguu
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm (5'2'')

Rena is a girl who returned from Ibaraki to Hinamizawa one year ago and now is in the same grade level as [Keiichi](https://anilist.co/character/1851/Maebara-Keiichi). She is very kind and capable and takes care of Keiichi and her friends whenever possible, but is also naive and is usually subject to light teasing by Keiichi. She is distinguished by her obsession with things she perceives as adorable, calling them kāii (かぁいい), a slurred form of kawaii (かわいい) meaning "cute." Those tend to be moekko characters or items she finds while scouring the local dump, which are not considered cute by others. Despite this disarming trait, Rena is shown to be amazingly observant and perceptive about the things around her.

name: Mion Sonozaki
description: Mion is the oldest kid in [Keiichi Maebara](https://anilist.co/character/1851/Maebara-Keiichi)'s class. As the elder, she is the class president and everyone looks up to her as the leader. She acts like a perverted tomboy and calls herself old man, but has a hidden girlish side. Mion is next in line to be the head of the Sonozaki household, one of the Three Families which holds tremendous influence in Hinamizawa. Often when playing games with her fellow club members she is known for her ruthlessness, often coming up with the most embarrassing penalties for the losers.  Mion also serves as the leader of the main characters' gaming club.

name: Rika Furude
description: Rika Furude is one of the younger students in [Keiichi's](https://anilist.co/character/1851/Maebara-Keiichi) school, and is in the same grade level as [Satoko](https://anilist.co/character/1612/Houjou-Satoko). Naturally, she is great friends with her, as they live together in the same house. She is revered by the villagers as the heir of the local shrine, and plays the role of a miko in the annual Watanagashi Festival. She has been the head of the Furude house since her parents died, but rarely attends town meetings due to her young age. While she does not speak a lot, she likes to say nonsense words such as "mi~" and "nipa~" and often ends her sentences with "-nano desu", which inflames [Rena's](https://anilist.co/character/1427/Ryuuguu-Rena) passion for cute things. Despite her young appearance, she is rather calm and reserved-usually serving as the voice of reason amongst the club members. However, she can be calculating if she wishes.

name: Satoko Houjou
description:
Satoko is a younger classmate in [Keiichi](https://anilist.co/character/1851/Maebara-Keiichi)'s school. She has a distinctive style of speech, ending all of her sentences with 'wa' which, at times, is grammatically incorrect. In spite of her young age, she is quite clever in setting up traps, and likes to practice on Keiichi.  Despite her extremely energetic and playful disposition she is actually quite the crybaby, which [Mion](https://anilist.co/character/1611/Sonozaki-Mion) and Keiichi often tease her about. Satoko is also very close with [Rika](https://anilist.co/character/1534/Furude-Rika), who she lives with. 

  



She dislikes Japanese pumpkin, and cannot tell the difference between cauliflower and broccoli.

name: Shion Sonozaki
description:
Shion is [Mion](https://anilist.co/character/1611/Sonozaki-Mion)'s identical twin sister, who currently resides in Okinomiya. In spite of their different personalities, she and Mion often switch places, and it can be difficult to distinguish between them. 

  

She was sent by the Sonozaki family to a private boarding school, but escaped and returned to live near her hometown, where she lives with [Kasai](https://anilist.co/character/14928/Kasai-Tatsuyoshi). In spite of all this, she and Mion maintain a close relationship. In most of the arcs, she is at a different school from the other main characters, and therefore appears less frequently.  She works as a waitress at the Angel-Mort restaurant and is the manager's assistant for the Hinamizawa Fighters little league team. She is often seen carrying a taser, and also wears yellow ribbon in her hair. She is also shown to be good with guns, along with Kasai, in Matsuribayashi-hen.

name: Satoshi Houjou
description: Satoshi is the older brother of [Satoko Houjou](https://anilist.co/character/1612/Houjou-Satoko). Although he is currently missing, his past influence is the key to the actions of several characters in Higurashi. Similar to Satoko, he cannot distinguish the difference between cauliflower and broccoli. Because of this, it can be inferred that both Satoshi and Satoko are color-blind.

name: Kuraudo Ooishi
description: Kuraudo Oishi is a veteran police investigator at Okinomiya who has vowed to solve the mystery of the Hinamizawa murders before his retirement, due to personal reasons. Due to his uncouth tactics and the lengths that he goes to in order to solve the mystery, he is looked upon as a nuisance by the villagers.

name: Miyo Takano
description: Miyo is a nurse at the village clinic who has a keen interest in Hinamizawa's past and culture, recording all her speculation in notebooks. At times, her storytelling can be very mysterious and chilling—she seems to enjoy putting people on edge.

name: Toshiki Inukai
description: Toshiki is the grandson of the chief of the dam's construction.   In episode 14, he is kidnapped by some anonymous guys.

name: Irina Shidou
description:
__Rank:__ Angel (Former Human)
__Weapon:__ Excalibur Mimic

She is Xenovia's partner and Issei's childhood friend. After finding out that the God in the Bible is dead, she still follows the teaching and is under the direct command of Michael. She also has a crush on Issei and was shocked to find out he turned into a devil. They are still friends despite that flaw.

name: Vali Lucifer
native: ヴァーリ・ルシファー
description: Vali Lucifer is the leader of the Khaos Brigade's Vali Team. He is a descendant of the original Lucifer and the possessor of the Vanishing Dragon, Albion; wielding the Divine Dividing Sacred Gear. As such, he is the direct rival of Issei Hyoudou and Ddraig.

name: Misaki Kirihara
description: The Section-Chief of the Foreign Affairs Section 4 who is investigating matters that concern Contractors. Misaki has long brown hair and glasses and rarely smiles or laughs. She has a strong sense of justice and a sharp intuition. Kirihara became a policewoman in order to protect the weak, has a distaste for smokers due to their smell, and is sensitive about the exposure of her body. She likes eating greasy food but claims to stay fit due to constantly moving around everyday as part of her job. Her father is Superintendent Supervisor Naoyasu Kirihara of the National Police Agency.   (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Mao
description: His name means "cat" in Chinese. He is a Contractor who has lost his original body and now resides within that of a black cat. His messier code is HM-432. His brain is directly connected to a wireless network which enables him to send and receive information at any time, as well as subduing the natural instincts of the animals he possesses. Mao usually creates diversions for Hei in battle. Mao's ability is to possess the bodies of other animals. While he lost his remuneration along with his body, he must connect periodically with the wireless network or run the risk of having the animal's natural instincts take over.      Mao hates the Spring season as most cats would find a partner and try to have kittens.

name: Huang
description: Huang's position can be interpreted as that of field supervisor. He is a human and only possesses strategic abilities. He has a general dislike for contractors and voices it regularly in spite of having to work alongside three of them. Huang passes down orders from the Syndicate to the rest of the team.     (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Yin
description: A member of [Hei](https://anilist.co/character/2160/)'s team, an emotionless spirit medium known as a "Doll." Her power lies in tracking and observation through direct contact with water. [Huang](https://anilist.co/character/2164/) mentions that her "program" is a minimal one, incapable of showing emotion or even allowing her to make decisions for herself; however, she later debunks this by making the decision to keep working with Hei and the others when given the choice of leaving, a possible sign of her recovering her humanity.

name: Hei
description: His codename is Hei, which means black in Chinese. Hei is a very talented contractor, his Messier Code is BK-201. Hei lives two lives in the series. In public he is Li Shengshun, a foreign exchange student from China. He is very nice and well mannered. He lives in the Umitsuki apartments and is always working a new part-time job.He has a huge appetite, not unlike most anime characters.  Hei's other life is of a Contractor called BK-201 and also the Black Reaper, mostly by other Contractors. Before becoming a contractor Hei was an assassin which earned him his nickname. Hei is usually seen on the job in a mask and a dark bullet proof coat.  Hei has the ability to manipulate electrons and can also disturb matter on a quantum level.

name: Nobuhiro Aku
description: Aku Nobuhiro was part of the band [Razz Ma Tazz](https://anilist.co/staff/355209/). He wss the vocalist.

name: Norio Ukiyama
description: Contractor with the ability to change bodies with other humans.

name: Hourai Yoshimitsu
description: Chief of the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department, Public Security Bureau.

name: Meena Kandaswamy
native: ミーナ・カンダスワミ
description: She is a member of the same organization that Hei's works for and is infiltrated at PANDORA's research facility.

name: Eric Nishijima
description: A Japanese born overseas, he is a high-ranking official within PANDORA.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Momiji Souma
description:
__Zodiac Animal:__ Rabbit

A cute and seemingly happy teenager with a sad family life that he hides behind his cheery demeanor. His endless whining and crying often annoys Kyo. He is older than he looks, much to Tohru's surprise, he is only 1 year younger than Yuki, and Kyo, the same age as Hatsuharu. Momiji is the rabbit of the Zodiac and is the son of one of the richer members of the Soma family. His father is Japanese while Momiji's mother is German. Tohru unwittingly cleans Momiji's father's building for her job. He has a younger sister, Momo. Momo is unaware of the fact that she has an older brother. Her mom's memory of Momiji was erased because otherwise she might slip into utter madness. Momiji is actually very insightful and emotionally strong despite his upbringing. He took to Tohru very quickly, even ignoring the fact that he was a Zodiac and hugged her when they were formally introduced. Much to Kyo's horror, Momiji likes to wear the girl's version of their high school uniform, albeit with short shorts and not a skirt. Momiji sometimes sees Tohru at work, he sometimes helps her clean her share too. He even did Tohru's share once when she was sick with a cold. Momiji also develops feelings for Tohru. He tends to cross dress, meaning to wear clothing meant for the opposite sex.

name: Hiro Souma
description:
__Zodiac Animal:__ Sheep

Hiro is a very intelligent but verbally aggressive and smart-mouthed sophist. He is in love with [Kisa](https://anilist.co/character/371), and resents [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/207) because she unwittingly monopolizes Kisa's time and attention. He starts out hostile to Tohru, but eventually eases his initial attitude through a combination of grudging admiration for Tohru and Kisa telling him to let up. He is sarcastic and pessimistic.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Kimi Toudou
description: She's in the student council and known as the devilish woman.

name: Tomo Aizawa
description:
**Relatives:** Akemi (Mother), Gorou (Father)

Tomo is a high school student with a tomboyish personality, exceptional skills in combat sports, and an earnest desire to win the heart of her childhood friend Junichiro. Despite her athletic abilities, she is self-conscious about her masculine traits and seeks to become more feminine.

name: Junichirou Kubota
description:
Junichirou Kubota is the deuteragonist of Tomo-chan wa Onnanoko!. He is Tomo's neighbor, childhood friend, fellow dojo pupil and high school classmate. He is handsome but unaware of Tomo's affections towards him. He regularly trains with Tomo's father's dojo and feels jealous when she gives attention to other guys.

He does not get along with Misuzu, having briefly dated her in middle school.

name: Misuzu Gundou
description:
**Relatives:** Misaki (Mother)

Misuzu Gundou is the tritagonist of Tomo-chan wa Onnanoko!. She is Tomo and Jun's childhood friend and classmate. She is cunning and sometimes sadistic, often teasing Jun. However, she is also protective of her friend and dislikes the idea of Tomo and Jun progressing their relationship.

Misuzu teases Jun and they briefly dated for 3 days, but broke up because she couldn't keep up with his wild adventures. She has stated that she hates him for breaking up with her before she could break up with him.

name: Carol Olston
native: キャロル・オールストン
description:
**Relatives:** Ferris (Mother), Kousuke (Distant Cousin)

Carol is a classmate and friend of Tomo, Jun and Misuzu. A beautiful, doll-faced student of British origin with no filter between her brain and her mouth.

name: Tatsumi Tanabe
description: Tatsumi Tanabe is a classmate and friend of Jun. He develops a crush on Misuzu ever since she gave him a death glare after telling him to stay away from Tomo.

name: Ferris Olston
native: フェリス・オルストン
description: She is Carol's mother and wife of Eddie Olston. Ferris is as bubble-headed and airy like her daughter. She even got lost from the front gate of her house trying to get back to the house. She worked at her mother's café in Britain as a waitress and met Eddie when she was only thirteen.

name: Kousuke Misaki
description: Second-year student and a captain of karate club. He's a cousin and childhood friend of Carol. He also has British roots. Really admires Tomo.

name: Akemi Aizawa
description: Tomo's mother.

name: Gorou Aizawa
description: Tomo's father. He runs the Aizawa Dojo and he has trained both Tomo and Jun.

name: Misaki Gundou
description: She is Misuzu's mother.

name: Saitou Soumei
description:
Saitou Soumei is a 90th Generation student at Tootsuki Academy Alumnus, originally introduced as the 5th seat of the Elite Ten Council, he is also the former 4th seat.

(Source: Shokugeki no Soma Wiki)

name: Shun Ibusaki
description: Shun is presumably known his senior, Isshiki Satoshi better than anyone else as he was stayed much longer than the rest of the Polar Star Gang.  Unlike his passionate room mates, Shun is very realistic on the terms and very serious upon making his style in perfection. Shun is also a quiet student who prefer speak only whenever is considered as crucial by many. It is also once claimed that he is a calculative chef whose choose to act wisely over hesitation.

name: Momo Akanegakubo
description: 90th Generation student of Tōtsuki Culinary Academy and

name: Terunori Kuga
description:
__Couisine Style:__ Chinese

Terunori enrolled into Tōtsuki Culinary Academy as part of the 91st Generation and would later attain the 8th seat of the Elite Ten Council. As a second year student, Terunori completed the Tōtsuki Friendship and Rapport Training Camp and Stagiaire events in his first year. In his first year, he was one of the participants in the Main Tournament of the Tōtsuki Autumn Election.

He is a very competitive person and he has faith in his cooking style and abilities. He has a sadist nature which is one of the reason that he prefer Sezhwan spicy recipes because he likes his customers to sweat and turn red because of the strong taste, and yet keep going at it as the taste is still appealing . He is kind of arrogant too as he is seen boasting about his position and elite 10 at times and belittling the rest of the students.

 

(Source: Shokugeki no Soma Wikia)

name: Ryou Kurokiba
description:
Ryou Kurokiba is a 92nd Toutsuki Generation Student and Alice Nakiri's aide.

Generally lazy and gloomy, Ryou's personality drastically shifts once he puts on his bandana, becoming aggressive, short-tempered, and brash. He grew up in a port town in Denmark, where he became the head chef of a pub due to his commanding personality and great skill. Due to his heritage, he is an expert in seafood and he can judge the quality of any and all seafood with only a glance. Mainly seen to be beside Alice Nakiri and has known her since childhood.

name: Courage
description: Courage is a first class officer for the WGO, and she, along with Decora, were the ones who trained Anne to be a WGO bookman.

name: Batou
description:
Batou is nominally the second-in-command of Section 9. 

Little is known about the strange, large foreigner who has been with [Motoko Kusanagi](https://anilist.co/character/1795/Kusanagi-Motoko) for years. He was once American and served in the Special Forces in South America. 

His amount of cyborg-ization is variable according to the storyline, from his limbs only up to most of his body, second only to the Major herself.  Despite the availability of superior eyes, he grew superstitious about his old-style eye replacements, popular with many high-level military operatives. He also retains some residual body-image issues, causing him to continually purchase workout equipment despite the obvious anachronism.

appearsIn.title: Ghost in the Shell: Stand Alone Complex

name: Togusa
description: Togusa is the newest member of Section 9 and the only one not originally recruited from Kusanagi's team of SpecOps.  Recruited from the regular police forces, Detective Togusa (no first name is yet known) has only the most basic of augmentation and no cyberization outside of his cyberbrain.  The Major wanted him for his perspective as a real policeman and as an outside opinion so as to avoid intellectual incest within Section 9.  Togusa mostly feels inferior to the rest of the team, forgetting to recognize the reason for his inclusion in the group.  He is the only member with a spouse and child and he continues to carry his Mateba revolver, although it has been highly modified to fire anti-cyborg rounds.

appearsIn.title: Ghost in the Shell: Stand Alone Complex

name: Daisuke Aramaki
description: The wise and powerful Head of Section 9, Aramaki relies upon his many international and corporate contacts to supply his team with the information they need to get the job done. Though he commands a great deal of respect, he is occasionally called "Monkey Man" (in the Manga) by his subordinates (perhaps because of his unconventional hairstyle/face). Seldom directly involved in police actions, he is nonetheless constantly working behind the scenes to coordinate the efforts of his agents, making quick and authoritative decisions and maintaining tight control of Kusanagi.

appearsIn.title: Ghost in the Shell: Stand Alone Complex

name: Motoko Kusanagi
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm (5'6")

Motoko Kusanagi is the mysterious, even enigmatic woman who has led a group of SpecOps for years and was recruited by [Aramaki](https://anilist.co/character/2677/Aramaki-Daisuke) to work for Section 9. Almost nothing is known about her, her origins, birthdate, etc. She could not be older than 60 or so since the widespread use of full cyborgization was not in use until then. She was fully cyborged at a very young age and as she "grew" she went through a series of artificial bodies. This, more than anything, likely contributed to her great ease at controlling cyborg bodies of various types, even multiple at the same time.  More mysterious is her incredible ability as a hacker, as she is equally at ease in a cyborg body as she is without one while diving the net; she is also officially registered as a Super Wizard Class Hacker. Her romantic life does not officially involve anybody in the Stand Alone Complex series; however, in the original manga she is bisexual and dates the leader of Section 1 for some time.

appearsIn.title: Ghost in the Shell: Stand Alone Complex

name: Project 2501
description: Project 2501, also known as The Puppet Master from the film and manga, Ghost in the Shell is an artificial intelligence program secretly developed by Section 6 of Public Security that develops sapience.

name: Ishikawa
description:
Ishikawa is the information warfare/technology specialist in Public Security Section 9. It has not been stated in the series thus far as to the degree that he has been cybernetically augmented, though character dialogue suggests that he is one of the least augmented members of Section 9. His appearance is characterized by a large beard and perpetually unkempt hair, and he is the oldest of Section 9's field operatives. He formerly served with Kusanagi and Batou in South America when they were with the Ground Self-Defense Forces in the Japanese UN contingent. He was one of the earliest members recruited to be in Section 9 and seems to know the Major and her dislikes quite well. He is shown as being in charge of a gambling parlor called Parlor Ishikawa, and on occasion uses the cyberbrains of the old men who play there to complete particularly heavy data gathering, though it seems the men suffer no ill effects or are even aware of their situation. Ishikawa in terms of personality is the most seemingly laid-back member of the unit.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Nakamura
description: He is chief official at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and head of Public Security Section 6, where he investigates various mysterious cases. In an effort to solve the case of 2501 (an illegal hacking program) he frequently locks horns with Section 9. He was part of the original movie, however there is no mention of him in the serie. Nakamura is seen once again in the OVA (Solid State Society), in a scene that suggest the Major was working in freelance for Section 6.

name: Miyabi Aizawa
description: Anime - Aizawa began not to trust teachers anymore when one of her classmates got involved in a scandal due to an affair of their former instructor. From this, she and her cohorts began their quest of kicking out any teacher who will be assigned to their class. They were successful in making these teachers resign, but Onizuka...  Manga - What drives Miyabi to go bad and lead a rebellion against teachers is an incident which occured when she was in the 7th grade. She had been the favorite student of Mr. Ogi, teacher of Class 2-4 ( the name of her class back in junior high ). Ogi would praise her for her beauty and intellegence often. Miyabi misinterpreted this as Mr. Ogi having a crush on her. As a result, Miyabi began behaving and dressing in a more mature manner. She started cooking him lunch everyday. She also started wearing revealing clothes ( such as miniskirts and tanktops ). Instead of setting Miyabi straight, Mr. Ogi went along with it. To some degree, he did like Miyabi. He continued to praise her and accept her subtle advances. One day, Miyabi is invited to Mr. Ogi's house. She goes, thinking he is going to confess his love for her. As soon as she gets there, Mr. Ogi introduces her to his fiance. Miyabi storms off in tears, feeling hurt and used. As revenge, Miyabi takes illicit photos of herself and goes into class the next morning telling her classmates that Mr. Ogi raped her and then took pictures ( knowing that Mr. Ogi's hobby is photography ).

name: Azusa Fuyutsuki
description: A beautiful female teacher who is the heroine of the series. Unlike Onizuka, she led a relatively normal life, graduating from Waseda University. Her quiet manner and moderate ideas are misleading as she proves to be very tough on her own sometimes scaring even Onizuka. To prepare him for the test which would determine his teaching career, she prepares a mountain of jelly with eyes of Maguro tuna fish as fruits and imposes an impossibly tough schedule that would have killed anyone or drove them mad. Her field of teaching is Kokugo or Japanese language (English in the Live Action). She, not that surprisingly, falls in love with Onizuka, but as both are quite reluctant to admit their feelings and show them in the open they claim that they are just "friends". It's not really a major matter to anyone else except Suguru Teshigawara, who finds it most aggravating that a woman with her qualifications would fall in love with one with such a crude background as Onizuka. She has difficulty with the female students in her class due to all the boys in her class having crushes on her but brings them around fairly quickly after Onizuka's advice. She has a younger sister named Makoto.

name: Urumi Kanzaki
description:
The antithesis to the "dumb blonde" stereotype, Urumi Kanzaki is a prodigy with an IQ over 200. She is also a heterochromatic, possessing different colored eyes: one brown and one blue. 

However, she is psychologically disturbed, having her fair share of hate toward teachers. Her genius is displayed repeatedly by such abstract actions as the detonation of time bombs (i.e. firecrackers in disposable boxes) and making a harmless snake look like a cobra using paper cutouts. 

Her intellect is also shown through actions, such as shouting curse words in French and being able to speak fluent Mandarin. On the trip in Okinawa, Toshito Kikuchi noted that she can speak 5 languages.

name: Yoshito Kikuchi
description:
Yoshito Kikuchi is one of Eikichi Onizuka's students. This computer prodigy (scoring the highest without certain "aid" in the country, on a standardized test) serves as class president and is also notorious for making pornographic composite photos, during Onizuka's arrival at the Holy Forest Academy. He tries to blackmail him into resignation with several pictures posted all across the school for everyone to see. Onizuka catches Kikuchi and instead of punishing him, hires him to make composite pictures of Azusa Fuyutsuki and other female teachers, much to his surprise.

Kikuchi eventually befriends Onizuka, and later helps Noboru Yoshikawa prevent Anko Uehara's mother, the president of the local Parent-Teacher Association, from getting Onizuka fired. Kikuchi is an amateur martial artist, having prior experience in judo and other techniques learned from Mayu Wakui. It is revealed after the examinations that he was the one who switched Onizuka's test papers for a perfect score. When questioned about the actual results that Onizuka has, Kikuchi calculates it himself, and is thoroughly surprised at the score (it is unknown whether Onizuka actually did score perfect, or a score befitting his intelligence), and asks him directly, to which his teacher replies that he definitely received a perfect score. In the manga, a possible relationship is hinted between him and Ai Tokiwa, after some intervention and a forced embrace from Onizuka.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Kunio Murai
description:
The class "jock bully", Kunio Murai is not very bright and loses his temper easily. When Eikichi Onizuka arrives at the Holy Forest Academy, Kunio and his gang (consisting of Kouji Fujiyoshi and Tadaaki Kusano) attempt to kill him several times with seemingly innocent pranks, such as a cockroach planted in his school lunch. The plans backfire (such as Kunio eating the cockroach, instead) and he goes insane, nearly ending up with his face impaled on a pair of razor-sharp scissors. Onizuka then takes advantage of Kunio's 27 year-old mother, Julia Murai, after trouncing Kunio at several arcade games. It is later revealed that Julia was carrying her son at the age of 13, and her parents and boyfriend abandoned her, making Kunio overprotective of his mother.

Kunio and his gang befriend Onizuka, after he saves them from a group of ruffians, but not before Onizuka joins the ruffians and has Kunio bungee jump off the Tokyo Bay Bridge. Kunio still gets very angry when Onizuka tries to make a pass at his mother, especially with the possibility that Onizuka may well be his new stepfather. His fear of a new father also rears its head when he suspects his mother may be marrying a man who resembles Dr. Elefun from Astro Boy.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Tomoko Nomura
description: A student in Eikichi Onizuka's class, Tomoko Nomura has a large chest (her cup size is F), but is not too bright, leading to people calling her Toro-ko (Toro meaning "slow" in Japanese; she is nicknamed Slo-mo-ko in the English version). After initially messing up her role in one of Miyabi Aizawa's plans to get Onizuka fired, she is cut off from Miyabi's group. Seeing her rather slow, clumsy nature, Onizuka enters her into a local beauty contest. He even arranges two porn producer friends to dress her up for the competition. Rather than read the given script for the acting category, Onizuka gives her a couple of action figures and she ends up doing an excellent improvised piece (with Vice-Principal Uchiyamada getting an accidental role). In the anime, Onizuka throws a cellphone on stage and she leaves a sentimental message on Miyabi's answering machine instead. She doesn't win, but she gets noticed by several television producers and begins starring in various commercials. Her young male manager, impressed with her natural beauty, and after falling in love at first sight, makes it his lifetime goal to help her succeed.      She was friends with Urumi Kanzaki since childhood, and their close bond likely arose out of their opposite personalities (Tomoko is clumsy and rather docile with a heart of gold, compared to Urumi's intellect and potential to be savagely cruel).

name: Eikichi Onizuka
description: A hormonal, blonde-haired biker and virgin, Onizuka Eikichi graduated from a bottom-rung university by cheating and, as such, cannot get a decent job. His main way of spending time is peering up girls' skirts in a local mall. He is very athletic, as he can bench press 150 kg (331 lbs), has a second dan black belt in karate, and even claims to perform 500 push-ups, 1000 pull ups and 2000 squats daily.

appearsIn.title: GTO: The Early Years - Shonan Junai Gumi

name: Hiroshi Uchiyamada
description: Yoshiko's father and Vice Principal of Holy Forest Academy. He is a very strict man who readily blindly follows the school rules and places them on top of anything else. Also he doesn't have much patience. He is easily enraged by Onizuka's behavior basically always. He seems to have no respect for school delinquents or any rebels during the series. Hiroshi believes that Onizuka is the evil root of all his misfortunes. He was visibly against Onizuka's hiring, but had to accept Principal Sakurai's decision.  Uchiyamada is always yelling at Onizuka's behavior and argues with him a lot.

name: Noboru Yoshikawa
description: A student at Holy Forest Academy who didn't have a good time before Eikichi Onizuka arrived, as he was the victim of bullying, mostly from Uehara Anko and her group. He is extremely good with video games and somewhat of an otaku, but proves to be quite handy with making things. Anko's bullying is so bad it makes him attempt to commit suicide twice, both times by leaping off the roof of the school, and both times resulting in him being saved by Onizuka, at the cost of Vice-Principal Hiroshi Uchiyamada's car. The two strike a quick friendship, which works for Onizuka, as Noboru has plenty of items that he wants to "borrow". His loyalty to Onizuka is by far the strongest, seen when he willingly sells his game collection to help cover Onizuka's debt. While on the school trip to Okinawa, he gets assigned to the same room as Anko and her friends by Onizuka. In retaliation for Onizuka and Noboru's antics, he gets tied up and led away into the dense jungle by the girls, but they all end up getting lost and rely on him for help. Despite the abuse, he saves Anko's life after she falls off a cliff, getting separated from the others. As the rest of the events of the manga unfolds, Noboru begins to enjoy Anko's company enough that she begins to feel affectionate to him.

name: Mizuki Yokoyama
description: She is the reason 3-class 4 started bullying teachers. She was Miyabi's best friend. She committed suicide. Before that she seriously dated her teacher in year 2 class 4. His name was Saitou-sensei whom she said she truly loved and he loved her back.

name: Will Serfort
native: ウィル・セルフォルト
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm (5'6")
__Race:__ Lyzance

Will Serfort is a sixth year student at the Regarden Magical Academy shunned by most students and faculty due to his lack of magical aptitude. To make up for his lack of magic, Will trains his body and swordsmanship in the dungeon.

name: Sion Ulster
description:
__Height:__ 171 cm (5'7")

Heir to house Ulster, a renowned line of fire mages. He has one younger sister. Following a certain incident during his first year at the academy, he became painfully aware of Will and began to see him as a rival.

name: Wignall Lindor
native: イグノール・リンドール
description:
__Height:__ 176 cm (5'9")

An elf who transferred to the academy from Alfswood, located in the far north Urbus region. In accordance with elven customs, he only permits physical contact with those he has deemed worthy. Shares the same dream as a certain no-talent. He specializes in wind and illusion magic.

name: Rodge Holland
description: Fire Faction scout.

name: Elfaria Serfort
native: エルファリア・アルヴィス・セルフォルト
description:
__Height:__ 163 cm (5'4")
__Race:__ Lyzance

A true prodigy and the youngest Magia Vander in history, she watches over a certain young man from her windowsill in the Tower. Those close to her say she is an easygoing Magia Vander who likes to play the saint. [Will's](https://anilist.co/character/212394/Will-Serfort) childhood friend who specializes in ice magic.

name: Colette Loire
description:
__Race:__ Resans
__Height:__ 164 cm (5'5")

Only daughter of house Loire, a fallen family of nobles. She specializes in earth magic, but struggles considerably with any spell requiring precision. Colette befriended [Will](https://anilist.co/character/212394/Serfort-Will) following a certain incident during her first year at the academy.

name: Kiki
description: Will's familiar and pet. Kiki is a carbuncle, capable of casting reflective magic to protect Will in emergencies.

name: Edward Serfence
native: エドワルド・セルフェンス
description:
__Height:__ 177 cm (5'9")

An ascendant who made it to the top of the Tower, earning the qualification to become Magia Vander, before being defeated by another candidate. He now works as a professor at Regarden Magical Academy, where he teaches Dark Magic and History and Origins of Magic. Ten years ago, he was one of a group of problem children who enlisted to fight in the Great War despite still being students.

name: Cariot Incindia Wiseman
native: キャリオット・インスティア・ワイズマン
description: One of the Magia Vende.

name: Terry Foro
description: Sixth year student at Rigarden Magical Academy.

name: Xiaoshi Cheng
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm
__Skills:__ Basketball, Photography

Manager of Time Photography Studio. Rough around the edges, but good at heart. Often acts impulsively. In order to save his studio from going out of business, he works together with [Lu Guang](https://anilist.co/character/218267/Lu-Guang), using their powers to enter photos and fulfill client requests.

He can enter the world inside a photo and possess the photographer's body, temporarily controlling their words and actions.

name: Guang Lu
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm
__Skills:__ Intelligence, Strategizing 
__Dislikes:__ Things being messed up after he's tidied them up, Plans being messed up
__Likes:__ Gourmet Food, Basketball, Reading, Sleeping, Sunbathing

Partner at Time Photography Studio. Calm and rational. Works together with [Cheng Xiaoshi](https://anilist.co/character/218266/Cheng-Xiaoshi) to fulfill client requests by acting as his guide and directing his actions.

He can foresee everything that happens inside a photo within 12 hours of it being taken; can share the consciousness of the person going into the photo through a high five and use this to direct their actions.

name: Ling Qiao
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm

Current landlord of Time Photography Studio. Grew up with Cheng Xiaoshi. Acts as the middleman and picks up commissions for Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang.

name: Emma
description: Emma is a client in the first photo that Lu Guang and Cheng Xiaoshi are shown entering.

name: Karen Tendou
description:
**Height:** 165 cm (5'5)

She is the most popular girl of the school, but also a huge video game nerd. She's the club president of the Game Club, she invites [Keita](https://anilist.co/character/121826/Amano-Keita) to join but he rejects the invitation each time.

name: Chiaki Hoshinomori
description: She is a classmate of Karen Tendou from class 2-A at Otobuki High School and a member of a non-school recognized gamer appreciation group together with Keita Amano and Tasuku Uehara. Chiaki is a shy girl and very reclusive. She did not seem to care about her looks at first until Keita and Tasuku came into her life. She did not socialize much and mostly preferred to play games on her own.

name: Keita Amano
description:
**Height:** 159 cm

He is the protagonist of the GAMERS! series. He is the older brother of Kōsei Amano, a student from class 2-F and a member of a non-school recognized gamer appreciation group together with [Chiaki Hoshinomori](https://anilist.co/character/121825/Chiaki-Hoshinomori) and [Tasuku Uehara](https://anilist.co/character/121828/Tasuku-Uehara).

(Source: GAMERS! Wikia)

name: Aguri Sakurano
description: Aguri is Tasuku's girlfriend. In the anime, she is a petite girl with pink hair and purple eyes. Aguri is immature and tends to be a clingy girl towards Tasuku though this is because he now spends his time hanging out with others. She also tends to be somewhat of a ditz, she does not play video games nor does she have an interest in them.

name: Tasuku Uehara
description: He is a classmate of Keita Amano from class 2-F at Otobuki High School and the boyfriend of Aguri Sakurano.

name: Konoha Hoshinomori
description: She is the younger sister of Chiaki Hoshinomori and the Student Council President of Hekiyō High School.

name: Niina Oiso
description:
According to [Karen Tendo](https://anilist.co/character/121824/Karen-Tendou), Niina plays games due to trying to get her friend back from the "dark side". It is unknown what this statement really means but the only thing shown is that Niina plays games, so much that she barely associates with others. 

(Source: GAMERS! Wikia)

name: Riki Misumi
description: She is the adoptive younger sister of [Eiichi Misumi](https://anilist.co/character/122020/Eiichi-Misumi).

name: Eiichi Misumi
description:
Eiichi is Karen's classmate who joins the Game Club at the beginning of the series. He has short black hair. His specialty is in arcade puzzle games, but he also is able to adapt to learning new games and growing skills based on observing how others play. He says that he got into gaming because he had lost his memory when he was younger and playing block puzzles gives him a link to his past. 

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Gakuto Kase
description: Gakuto Kase is a third-year student and a prominent member of Otobuki High School's Game Club. He gets serious when it comes to FPS games and his attitude when playing these games made him one of the top FPS players of the world.

name: Nine
description: A villain and the primary antagonist in My Hero Academia the Movie: Heroes Rising.

name: Kousuke Tsuda
description: A good friend of Makoto.

appearsIn.title: The Girl Who Leapt Through Time

name: Chiaki Mamiya
description: Chiaki is one of Makoto's good friends that joins her and Kousuke in games of baseball after school.

appearsIn.title: The Girl Who Leapt Through Time

name: Makoto Konno
description: Makoto Konno is an ambivalent senior high school student still caught between that devilish question of "Arts or Sciences?" that her teachers require of her immediate academic future. She always sleeps in a few minutes too many, is remarkably clumsy, hates pop quizzes like every other high school student and never really makes an effort to brush her wayward hair.     About as average as can be, she spends the majority of her days after school hitting baseballs and playing catch with her best pals.

appearsIn.title: The Girl Who Leapt Through Time

name: Fukushima-sensei
description: One of the school's teachers.

appearsIn.title: The Girl Who Leapt Through Time

name: Kazuko Yoshiyama
description:
Kazuko Yoshiyama, a third-year junior high school student, is cleaning the school science lab with her classmates, Kazuo Fukamachi and Gorō Asakura, when she smells a lavender-like scent and faints. After three days, strange events transpire around Kazuko, including the burning of Gorō's house after an earthquake. The next morning, at the exact moment of a car accident, Kazuko is transported 24 hours into the past. She relives the day and relates her strange experience to Kazuo and Gorō. They don't believe her at first, but they are convinced when she accurately predicts the earthquake and ensuing fire. Fukushima, their science teacher, explains Kazuko's new ability is called "teleportation"; and "time-leap", and to solve the riddle of her power she must leap back four days.


In the anime and Tokikake manga she is Makoto's aunt and takes on a supporting role.

appearsIn.title: The Girl Who Leapt Through Time

name: Miyuki Konno
description: Makoto's younger sister.

appearsIn.title: The Girl Who Leapt Through Time

name: Soujirou Takase
description: Classmate of Makoto.

appearsIn.title: The Girl Who Leapt Through Time

name: Yuri Hayakawa
description: Makoto's friend.

appearsIn.title: The Girl Who Leapt Through Time

name: Kaho Fujitani
description: Kaho Fujitani is one of Makoto's classmates at school. She's got a huge crush on Makoto's friend Kousuke, after Kaho's grandmother told her all about him and his kindness towards her.

appearsIn.title: The Girl Who Leapt Through Time

name: Ichirou Inuyashiki
description:
__Height:__ 167 cm

At first glance, Ichirou is a timid man who rarely likes to speak out, which is evident in the way that his family treats him. He retreats into cowardice and melancholy when behaviors such as hatred, selfishness, rudeness or bullying come into his way. His introversion, however, is in conflict with his need to help and support all those around him. 

Ichirou is a middle-aged man who has been diagnosed with stomach cancer the day after moving to his new house. After finding out that he's not going to live for a long time, he runs away to a park to cry.

name: Hiro Shishigami
description: This young man cares about his childhood friend [Ando](https://anilist.co/character/123580/Andou-Naoyuki) and his mother more than anyone, but is completely indifferent to anyone else. Just like [Inuyashiki](https://anilist.co/character/123583/Inuyashiki-Ichirou), Shishigami got a mechanical body after being involved in the same UFO accident, but unlike Inuyashiki, he uses his powers to commit crimes in order to feel alive.

name: Mari Inuyashiki
description:
Mari Inuyashiki is a high school student, the daughter of Ichirou Inuyashiki and Marie Inuyashiki and the older sister of Takeshi Inuyashiki.

Mari is a tall and skinny pale-skinned young girl with straight waist-length black hair that is styled in a muffin top with bangs hanging over her eyebrows, black eyes and full pink lips.

When Mari was little, she was really close to her father and she was always holding his hand, which was to the extent where she would be worried that he would die soon due to him looking quite old for his age, reaching the point where she suggested getting cosmetic surgery. Now, she hardly talks to him as she got older,

name: Naoyuki Andou
description: Shishigami’s childhood friend and the only person outside of his family he can open up to. His nickname is Chokko. He had become a shut-in due to his classmates bullying him because of his pushover personality, but teams up with Inuyashiki to stop Shishigami when he goes on a crime spree after obtaining a mechanical body.

name: Hanako
description: Hanako is the adopted dog of the Inuyashiki Family.

name: Takeshi Inuyashiki
description:
Takeshi Inuyashiki is the son of Ichirou Inuyashiki and Marie Inuyashiki and the younger brother of Mari Inuyashiki.

Takeshi is bullied at school due to his personality, which leads to him displaying symptoms of depression.

name: Yuuko Shishigami
description: Hiro Shishigami's mother.

name: Oda no Chichi
description: A famous manga author. He lives in a big house next to the Inuyashikis.

name: Kaname Sudou
description:
__Sigil:__ Flame God's Hammer
__Clan:__ Sunset Ravens

He was sent a help request by Kyouda Hiroyuki and joined the Darwin's Game. He is only interested in surviving. His sigil allows him to forge any weapon. However, it can't be too complicated.

name: Rein Kashiwagi
description:
__Sigil:__ Worldwide Function
__Clan:__ Sunset Ravens

A player in Darwin's Game who is an information broker. Her sigil is analogous to Laplace's demon, a hypothetical being that knows the exact location and momentum of every atom in the universe.

name: Shuka  Karino
description:
__Sigil:__ Queen of Thorn
__Clan:__ Sunset Ravens

She is skilled at Darwin's game and has 49 wins with no losses.

name: Ryuuji Maesaka
description:
__Sigil:__ Lie Detector
__Clan:__ Sunset Ravens

He is a participant in the Darwin Game and uses a machine gun as a weapon. His sigil enables him to know if people are lying or not. He seems to have a personal grudge against "One", the leader of the clan "Eighth".

name: Themis
description:
__Sigil:__ Unbalance

Themis is the leader of the clan Trinity.

name: Souta
description: A player in Darwin Game who has the sigil to control ice. Sui's twin brother, who died in an accident 1 year ago. D-game brought his soul back in Sui's body.

name: Sui
description:
__Sigil:__ Light of Pollux
__Clan:__ Sunset Ravens

A player in Darwin Game who has the sigil to control water. Souta's twin sister.

name: Keiichi Katsura
description:
__Sigil:__ Tempest

Keiichi Katsura is a martial artist. Keiichi was disqualified in a tournament after he accidentally killed the opponent in the semi-finals, Wang convinced him afterwards that the only way to overcome the devastation of accidentally killing someone was to kill even more people. He became one of the top members of the Eighth after joining.

name: Danjou
aliases: アレクセイ・ベルジェンニコフ
description: Alexei Bergenikov, more commonly known as Danjou, is the leader of the Danjou Boxing Club.

name: Wang
description:
__Sigil:__ Beelzebub

Wang was the leader of the Eighth clan.

name: Reisi Munakata
description: __Age:__ 24  __Height:__ 185 cm  __Birthday:__ October 1  __Horoscope:__ Libra   (RH-)  The head of SCEPTER4 and the Blue King. Reishi is a sophisticated, observant and composed individual who is cautious in the battlefield. Though he is willing to use physical action in a fight, Reishi does attempt to win with victory through negotiation instead. He is a natural leader and generally puts the concern of innocent lives over his own. Though he possesses a general loathing towards Mikoto Suoh, Reishi still accepts him as a human being. He takes immediate notice when his vice-commander Awashima's displays apparent disregard for his civil rights. However, he remained indifferent to how the idea could effect the Red King, even stating that it was a good one. Reishi has a fondness for solving jigsaw puzzles during his spare time.  As a member of SCEPTER4, Reishi has power over lightning, imbibing himself in a blue color. When exerted, the aura has the defensive potential to protect Reishi and his subordinates against a direct attack from the flames of Mikoto Suoh, known as the king of HOMRA and an incredibly powerful combatant.  (Source: Project K Wikia)

name: Kuroh Yatogami
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm 

A young man with an unyielding personality. He is also a skilled swordsman, martial artist, and housekeeper. Kuroh is a quiet, serious and composed individual that appears tough and completely no-nonsense on the surface. He is very determined to accomplish his goals, whatever they may be, but despite so Kuroh is willing to set them aside for the finer things in life, such as genuine companionship. Kuroh says that he follows a policy where, rather than judging a man by his appearance or words, their actions are what matters more.  In his younger years, Kuroh was trained by the 7th King, Miwa Ichigen. However, after unknown circumstances, Ichigen had passed away, leaving behind a will in Kuroh to defeat the "evil" King.

name: Neko
description:
__Height:__ 155 cm

Neko has a very joyful, carefree, and energetic personality. She is very playful, often participating or even starting chases with people. In addition, Neko seems to have no qualms or worries about being nude, especially in front of men, showing some immodesty. She even stated that she does not like wearing clothes, the reason being that "Clothes are too restricting". She is also a mysterious girl, who is also a cat. Neko also likes Shiro and even calls him "My Shiro".

name: Yashiro Isana
description:
**Height**: 169 cm

A joker who goes around asking for his schoolmates to share their lunch with him. Yashiro is soft-spoken but very charismatic. He is very friendly and well-liked. In addition, he is quite respectful towards anyone he meets, even robots.  He is also somewhat laid-back and happy-go-lucky. Yashiro carries also a red, Japanese-style parasol with him at all times.

name: Mikoto Suoh
description:
__Height:__ 185 cm  

Third King, known as the Red King. Has an ability to control fire. Feared by people as the leader of the Red Clan, HOMRA. Mikoto is a quiet man who says very little, even to his own subordinates. He is very calm, rarely being irritated or annoyed, and even when his mood changes Mikoto still maintains his composure. Mikoto is an avid smoker, often holding a cigarette and a lighter in each hand.

name: Ichigen Miwa
description:
__Height:__ 177 cm 

Kuroh Yatogami's master, the former seventh king, the Colorless King. He was claimed to be able to see the future.

name: Chiho Hyuuga
description: The President of the Student Council

name: Saruhiko Fushimi
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm

Third in Command of SCEPTER4 and a former member of HOMRA, having betrayed the latter Clan at some point in the past. Fushimi often displays himself as a cool-headed, though lazy and bored individual. He gives off a listless attitude and seems unmotivated, but is in fact very competent. He prefers not to participate in most of his Clan's activities. However, he will cooperate if necessary with little to no arguments. At the same time, he would often disregard his associates and act out on his own. While focused on an objective, Fushimi is willing to use any method possible to make his tasks quicker and easier, such as drugging innocent civilians. He would even attack several former allies without any hesitation just to accomplish his goal, displaying additional traits of ruthlessness.   A sociopath by nature, Fushimi's personality is far more twisted then he leads others to believe. He is cruel, bloodthirsty, and occasionally sadistic. During battle, Fushimi often sports a wide grin and a tendency to laugh giddily about the dangerous event. He also displays more evident signs of arrogance and superiority towards his opponents. Fushimi often boasts about his strength and speaks to his opponents in a more mocking tone. Nevertheless, Fushimi retains a carefree attitude during battle and likes to make rude, though somewhat personal jokes.  Misaki usually calls him "Saru" (Monkey).    (Source: ANN, Project K Wikia)

name: Anna Kushina
description:
__Height:__ 140 cm 

A quiet, doll-like girl who serves as HOMRA's unofficial mascot. Anna is very quiet and shy compared to her louder, more eccentric HOMRA members. In addition, she rarely expresses much emotion nor does she actively participate in the gang-like activities of HOMRA, due to her young age and status as the sole female in the group; however, she is not unwilling to tag along and cooperate if necessary. She has the ability to locate things and people and read minds using her red marbles.

name: Fubuki
aliases: Jigoku no Fubuki (地獄のフブキ)
description:
__Race:__ Human
__Occupation:__ Superhero
__Height:__ 167 cm (5'5¾")
__Level:__ B-Class Rank 1
__Affiliation:__ Hero Association
__Family:__ Tatsumaki (sister)
__Abilities:__ Psychokinesis


Fubuki, also known by her hero alias Blizzard of Hell, is the B-Class Rank 1 professional hero of the Hero Association. She is an esper, the younger sister of Tatsumaki, and the leader of the Blizzard Group, a B-Class hero faction. She and her sister are known as the Psychic Sisters. Fubuki is currently trying to recruit [Saitama](https://anilist.co/character/73935/Saitama) into her group. She's also a self-declared member of the Saitama Group.

name: Satoru
description:

__Occupation:__ Superhero
__Level:__ C-Class; Rank: 1
