name: Tomoe
description:
Tomoe is one of the Greater Dragons, existing in the World of the Goddess. She is presently in servitude of [Makoto Misumi](https://anilist.co/character/138137/Misumi-Makoto).

She tends to have an easy-going personality, likes taking on new challenges and learning interesting things related to the Edo period of Japan. Different from her previously lazy and disˈinterested outlook of the world.

She's not serious at times to a dangerous degree.

She finds great enjoyment in seeing what changes would come from Makoto and especially learning things from his memories.

name: Mio
description: She is previously referred to​ as the Black Spider of Calamity and is a unique existence in the Goddess' World. She is presently in servitude of [Makoto](https://anilist.co/character/138137/Misumi-Makoto). She can be single-minded and straightforward in her loyalty to Makoto to the point that it reaches a dangerous level. She has no qualms about destroying anyone who intends to do harm to Makoto.

name: Makoto Misumi
description:
Makoto Misumi is the Main Protagonist of this series. He is a one of the three World Traveler's who got sent to the [Goddess](https://anilist.co/character/221535/Megami)' World.

Originally meant to be the only person to be sent to the other world as per the contract between his parents and the Goddess, but because of her own preferences in beauty standards, she abandons and throws Makoto to the edge of her world into the Wasteland, while secretly kidnapping two other people from Earth and sending them to her world as Heroes. [Tsukuyomi](https://anilist.co/character/195917/Tsukuyomi), the Moon God of Earth who worked as the middleman for the completion of the contract, helped Makoto and provided him with his blessing and told him to be free and live as he wants to.

name: Toa
description: She is an adventurer and the older sister of Rinon.

name: Aqua
description: Aqua is an Forest Ogre working in the Kuzunoha Company along with [Eris](https://anilist.co/character/247458/Eris).

name: Komoe
description:
Komoe is a recurring character in this series. She is the second fragment created by Tomoe after the death of the first offshoot. Like the previous one, her role is to help supervise and collect information regarding the alternate space Asora.

Following the demise of the first offshoot, the second has been given more power and strength, to the level that she is one of the stronger individuals in Asora, and has the additional role of supervising the combat training of other combat-oriented inhabitants of Asora.

name: Lime Latte
description: A former top adventurer from Tsige and currently working for the Kuzunoha Company as an employee.

name: Tomoe's Offshoot
description: Tomoe's Offshoot was an unnamed fragment of Tomoe created in order to help supervise and collect information regarding the alternate space "Asora". She is the first known fragment created by Tomoe and was predecessor to Komoe.

name: Fuchi
aliases: Yamada Asaemon Fuchi (山田浅ェ門付知)
description:
__Height:__ 148 cm
__Race:__ Human
__Tao Attribute:__ Metal
__Occupation:__ Asaemon
__Affiliation:__ Yamada Clan
__Rank:__ 9th

Yamada Asaemon Fuchi is the 9th rank Asaemon in the Yamada Clan and was chosen to be [Tamiya Gantetsusai](https://anilist.co/character/137264/Gantetsusai-Tamiya)'s assigned monitor. 

Fuchi is a rational thinker that has a good sense of judgement in situations and carries a no-nonsense view when it comes to matters that he deems are unscientific, pointless, and illogical. He has great pride as a Yamada Asaemon and does not tolerate anybody speaking disgracefully about the Yamada clan. He is very close with his Asaemon comrades and gives them nicknames instead of using honourifics. Even though the Yamada clan mainly deal with testing new swords and executions, Fuchi preferrs, and has a deep passion, for studying the human anatomy to improve medical science that came with the trade. He whole-heartedly believes that anatomical research would save lives and despises those who thought so little of this study.

name: Eizen
aliases: Yamada Asaemon Eizen (山田浅ェ門衛善)
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm
__Race:__ Human
__Tao Attribute:__ Unknown
__Occupation:__ Asaemon
__Affiliation:__ Yamada Clan
__Rank:__ 1st

Eizen is the 1st rank Asaemon in the Yamada clan. He joined the Shinsenkyo Island expedition and was assigned to keep watch over the criminal, [Rokurōta](https://anilist.co/character/302052/Rokurouta).

Eizen has great pride for the Yamada clan and believes that no task is impossible for them when it came to executing people, such as his assigned criminal Rokurōta. As an executioner, Eizen acts professional in his line of work as he knows that defiling the execution grounds by trying to bring pain to the condemned with his blade would defile the magistrate and he follows the Yamada clan's ideal way of ending lives by cutting his victims with no pain or emotion, a concept which he tried to impart to a young [Shugen](https://anilist.co/character/148752/Shugen). 

Eizen is also kind and caring as he promised to look after Shugen when he was young, which brought a great influence to him in the present. Like his fellow clan members, Eizen believes that women in the Yamada clan should not follow the path of a samurai and is antagonistic when [Sagiri](https://anilist.co/character/137263/Sagiri) took the shogun's mission.



Eizen has a profound influence on Shugen as he is the one person the young man looks up to the most.

name: Umaru Doma
description: A high school girl who is beautiful and intelligent, but at home she is lazy, and surrounds herself in games, anime, and manga. Nobody knows what she's like at home except her brother [Taihei](https://anilist.co/character/89020/Doma-Taihei).

name: Taihei Doma
description: A company employee who lives together with his younger sister Umaru. With his kind and methodical personality, he easily handles his job as well as taking care of all the housework for the two of them. He warmly watches over his carefree sister and scolds her as she spends her time lazying around.

name: Nene Ebina
description: Nana's Mother.

name: Nana Ebina
description: Umaru's classmate. She lives on the first floor of the same apartment as Umaru. She has a shy and gentle personality, but has a strong stomach.

name: Kirie Motoba
description: Umaru's classmate. Because of her reserved personality and eyes that always look like they're staring, she's often left out in class. She's actually just shy.

name: Sylphynford Tachibana
native: 橘・シルフィンフォード
description: [Umaru](https://anilist.co/character/89019/Doma-Umaru)'s classmate. She sees Umaru as her rival. Though she acts like a young lady from a good family, she is also a bit of an airhead.

name: Takeshi Motoba
description:
Takeshi Motoba is Taihei Doma's childhood friend and coworker, his nickname is Bomber.

Unlike Taihei, Takeshi is laid back and lazy, similar to Umaru Doma. He likes to goof off at work, and mess around when out and about. 

Takeshi has been friends with Taihei since at least high school, and followed each other to work in the same office. Takeshi has a little sister, who is also friends with Umaru, Kirie Motoba. His relationship with his sister is violent, with her becoming furious with him after upsetting her.

name: Kanau Kongou
description: The manager and childhood friend of [Taihei](https://anilist.co/character/89020/Doma-Taihei) and [Takeshi](https://anilist.co/character/137509/Motoba-Takeshi). She seems to have a crush on Taihei.

name: Alex Tachibana
description: Alex is Taihei's co-worker and Sylphynford's older brother. He enjoys playing video games. He also loves anime, just like Umaru, but secretly he seems to know the connection between Komaru and Umaru. He loves his sister Sylphynford.

name: Alice Nakiri
aliases: Heaven Sent Child of Molecular Gastronomy
description:
Alice Nakiri is a 92nd Tōtsuki Generation student and [Erina Nakiri](https://anilist.co/character/75284/Nakiri-Erina)'s cousin, whose cooking style is specialized in Molecular Gastronomy. 

Unlike her cousin though, Alice is much more friendly and cheery. She even will talk to her rivals casually, sometimes merely to poke fun at them, something she inherited from her mother. She is also a modern girl, eager to talk about love and gossip, even with the incredibly socially dense Erina. She is also very cunning, able to manipulate Erina using reverse psychology to keep her at a local public pool despite the latter's initial disgust at the location. She is quite bossy with [Ryō](https://anilist.co/character/88972/Kurokiba-Ryou), usually ordering him to do nearly everything for her. She tends to overreact when she is unhappy, throwing fits or snapping back at people. However, most of these are temporary and she will quickly return to normal in a few minutes.

appearsIn.title: Food Wars! The Third Plate: Totsuki Train Arc

name: Eizan Etsuya
description: He is a 91st Toutsuki Generation student of Toutsuki Culinary Academy and the current 9th Seat of the Elite Ten Council. He is known as the Alquimista aka "The Alchemist".

appearsIn.title: Food Wars! The Third Plate: Totsuki Train Arc

name: Osaji Kita
description: He was one of the 5 guest judges of Block "B" for the 43rd Annual Tōtsuki Autumn Election. A renowned entrepreneur and a founder of his own Gastronomy Club, Osaji's reputation in both his wealth and influence has made him a celebrity in the cooking industry.

appearsIn.title: Food Wars! The Third Plate: Totsuki Train Arc

name: Anne
description: Anne (アン, An) is a first class bookman for the WGO and was selected to be as an impartial judge for the Régiment de Cuisine between Central and the rebels.

appearsIn.title: Food Wars! The Third Plate: Totsuki Train Arc

name: Urara Kawashima
description: Urara is a 92nd Toutsuki Generation student and a popular idol at Toutsuki Culinary Academy. She is often an emcee for many of the academy's grand events.

appearsIn.title: Food Wars! The Third Plate: Totsuki Train Arc

name: Miia
description:
__Species:__ Lamia 

She is the first to arrive in [Kimihito](https://anilist.co/character/60225/Kurusu-Kimihito)'s ward when the cultural exchange began. She is sweet, naive, and a carefree individual. She has a habit of being clingy when she sleeps. She's very ticklish when one holds the very tip of her tail, which is why Kimihito exploit that weakness in order to get out of her grip.

appearsIn.title: Monster Musume: Everyday Life With Monster Girls

name: Kimihito Kurusu
description: Ever since the cultural exchange between humans and sub-species begun, he found himself suddenly forced to volunteer in such program where he has to be the custodian of 3 sub-species; namely Miia a lamia, Papi a harpy and Centorea Shianus a centaur, where everyday living with them is an accident waiting to happen.

appearsIn.title: Monster Musume: Everyday Life With Monster Girls

name: Papi
description:
__Species:__ Harpy

Papi is the second girl to move in with Kimihito after she abducts him and almost dropped him while flying. She has difficulty with words which makes it difficult for Kimihito to understand what she is saying. She's childish, both physically and mentally, despite being as old as Miia.

appearsIn.title: Monster Musume: Everyday Life With Monster Girls

name: Centorea Shianus
native: セントレア・シアヌス
description:
__Species:__ Centaur

Centorea, also known as "Cerea", is the third resident of Kimihito Kurusu's home. She is very prim and proper, referring to herself as a self-proclaimed knight.
As one of the noble creatures, Cerea is incredibly honorable and chivalrous, while being unerringly loyal to Kimihito. Also, she is somewhat archaic in speech and behavior. Centaurs have strict rules about only letting one's master ride on their backs. She has been shown to be just as possessive of Kimihito as Miia, the difference is that Cerea hides it much better and can seemingly be ashamed of it.
Due to her horse physiology and nature, Cerea's favorite food are carrots. She tries to hide her big appetite for the vegetable because people make fun of her for it.

appearsIn.title: Monster Musume: Everyday Life With Monster Girls

name: Suu
description:
__Species:__ Slime

A humanoid-like monster who tends to cling onto [Kimihito](https://anilist.co/character/60225/Kurusu-Kimihito) and loves to copy [Papi](https://anilist.co/character/63267/Papi). She can also copy speech word-for-word in the same pitch and tone as others. Can shape-shift to become like other humanoid beings but leaves her distinct traits to distinguish her from the person she copied.

appearsIn.title: Monster Musume: Everyday Life With Monster Girls

name: Meroune Lorelei
native: マーラウン・ロリライ
description:
__Species:__ Mermaid

Meroune Lorelei, or Mero for short, is a mermaid bound to a wheelchair. While she is the the fourth girl to officially move in with Kimihito, she is technically the fifth girl to move in with him because Suu is supposed to be the fourth, but she lives there illegally so she doesn't count. Mero has a very warm personality. According to Centaurea, she gets a vibe of royalty from her. As a young girl she had a fascination with the "tragic love" story of Hans Andersen's "The Little Mermaid", and wants to experience it in real life, even to the point of turning into sea foam (She wants to be a lover instead of a bride).   (Source: Monster Musume wikia)

appearsIn.title: Monster Musume: Everyday Life With Monster Girls

name: Rachnera Arachnera
native: ラチネラ・アラチネラ
description:
__Species:__ Arachne

Arriving to her first host family, the host family did not expect Rachnera to be a Arachne, which caused them to take a disliking to her. When a man offered them money for the rights as her host, they accepted. Being used as a way to make money by producing spider web the man could sell, she ran away from the man. While on the run she kidnapped Kurusu Kimihito, causing the police to search for him and her.

appearsIn.title: Monster Musume: Everyday Life With Monster Girls

name: Doppel
description:
__Species:__ Shapeshifter (claims to be a Doppelganger)

"Doppel" (real name unknown) is a member of the M.O.N., where she acts as the team's infiltrator. Doppel's default form has the appearance of a small, petite young girl. Her skin is dark, she has very long light-colored hair and black sclera. However, this is not her real form. It's unknown what her real form looks like, but is implied to be very eldritch, being called a "faceless existence". Indeed, Doppel herself admitted that if humans were to see it, "their mind wouldn't be able to handle it". 

Doppel seems to be a natural trickster, taking delight using her powers to prank people and loves seeing people freak out. It is said she often takes jokes too far. However, Doppel prefers to prank those who deserve it, such as criminals, as it is easier to avoid punishment that way.

appearsIn.title: Monster Musume: Everyday Life With Monster Girls

name: Kasegi
description: A human and a con artist who claims to be associated with the exchange project and bullies his way into Kimihito's house on the pretext of making a documentary, while using the alias "Kasegi". Using his ability to manipulate people, he attempts to create an exploitation film about the girls in order to steal Papi's egg and Miia's cast-off skin,[ch. 14] but is ultimately foiled by Suu and Kimihito. It is later revealed that he has kept Rachnee in his house under near-prison conditions for financial gain by selling her silk. After Rachnee has enough of him, she wraps him up with her web and leaves him to be arrested by the police; his current fate and whereabouts are unknown.  (Source: Wikipedia)

appearsIn.title: Monster Musume: Everyday Life With Monster Girls

name: Nishikata
description:
__Height:__ 150 cm (4'11")

Nishikata is a middle school student in class 1-2. He sits in the back of the classroom next to [Takagi](https://anilist.co/character/120800). He can't handle bitter things like black coffee, secretly watches/reads a romance titled "100% Unrequited Love", and gets frightened very easily. He does average academically.

name: Takagi
description:
__Height:__ 150 cm (4'11")

A middle schooler​ at an unnamed school. She sits at the back of class 1-2 next to [Nishikata](https://anilist.co/character/120799). Academically talented and physically capable, she claims her only weaknesses are her ticklish armpits and her inability to stop teasing Nishikata.

name: Kimura
description: Nishikata's friend

name: Mano
description:
Mano is [Nishikata](https://anilist.co/character/120799/Nishikata)'s and [Takagi](https://anilist.co/character/120800/Takagi)'s classmates and has an undisclosed relationship with [Nakai](https://anilist.co/character/128607/Nakai). 

Mano is generally shy, anxious, and sheepish towards other people, especially when she is trying to talk to Nakai. She also has noticeable anger issues, as she quickly becomes impatient when bothered or pestered by others. Regarding her relationship with Nakai, she often second-guesses herself while trying to interact with him. She wishes that Nakai would show more interest in the relationship, but loves him regardless. They are seen happily watching the fireworks together at the summer festival, showing that the two are able to enjoy each other's presence despite their issues with each other.

name: Mina Hibino
description: Mina is an energetic, bubbly girl and always cheerful in the group. She is very playful at all times and always noisy. Mina also is bad at running and gets tired easily, such as when she was excited for the school marathon, yet got tired at the start.

name: Nakai
description:
One of the classmates of [Nishikata](https://anilist.co/character/120799/Nishikata) and [Takagi](https://anilist.co/character/120800/Takagi) and the boyfriend of [Mano](https://anilist.co/character/128606/Mano). 

Nakai has a very calm, friendly and laid-back demeanor who enjoys hanging out with his male friends more than he does with Mano. He explains that it's hard for him to hang out with Mano, although he still greatly cares for her.

name: Sanae Tsukimoto
description:
Sanae Tsukimoto is one of [Nishikata](https://anilist.co/character/120799/Nishikata)'s and [Takagi](https://anilist.co/character/120800/Takagi)'s classmates and a close friend of [Mina](https://anilist.co/character/128608/Mina-Hibino) and [Yukari](https://anilist.co/character/128614/Yukari-Tenkawa).

Sanae is a very blunt, yet caring and intelligent girl. Known for always having a very stoic expression and demeanor, Sanae likes to keep to herself. She is extremely athletic and is particularly adept at running and swimming. Underneath her typically expressionless exterior, Sanae is shown to care greatly for her two closest friends, Mina and Yukari. The three girls are constantly seen together, both in and out of school. Sanae may have a soft spot for animals. In one instance, Sanae was chasing a cat that had taken Yukari's snack. However, upon realizing that the cat had taken the snack in order to feed its kittens, Sanae decided to let the feline keep the stolen snack.

name: Tanabe-sensei
description: Mr. Tanabe is the homeroom teacher of class 1-2, in which [Takagi](https://anilist.co/character/120800/Takagi), [Nishikata](https://anilist.co/character/120799/Nishikata), [Mano](https://anilist.co/character/128606/Mano), [Nakai](https://anilist.co/character/128607/Nakai), [Sanae](https://anilist.co/character/128611/Sanae-Tsukimoto), [Mina](https://anilist.co/character/128608/Mina-Hibino) and [Yukari](https://anilist.co/character/128614/Yukari-Tenkawa) are a part of.

name: Meryl Stryfe
description:
Meryl Stryfe and her junior co-worker [Milly](https://anilist.co/character/714/Thompson-Milly) were sent by the Bernardelli Insurance Society to evaluate claims regarding [Vash the Stampede](https://anilist.co/character/162/Vash-the-Stampede). Despite her serious attitude and short temper, she is a good person.

Although she doesn't often fight alongside Vash, she hides many derringer-style "throwaway" pistols under her coat. She once referred to herself as "Derringer Meryl".

Initially, she finds Vash to be a nuisance and dismisses the idea that he is the legendary Humanoid Typhoon. As time passes, she realizes that Vash isn't the villain that he is made out to be nor the buffoon that he presents himself to be. Gradually, she comes to respect Vash and love him deeply.

It is also hinted near the end of the anime that she may possibly be the reincarnation of [Rem Saverem](https://anilist.co/character/1180/Saverem-Rem). This, however, is not present in the manga, and may have been an independent decision by the producers of the anime. Another source of this belief is through the construction of her name, where as Meryl = Mer-yl = Rem

It is hinted that Meryl has problems involving her family. Early in Trigun Maximum, she celebrates her 23rd birthday, which means she was 21 at the beginning of Trigun.

Meryl is very short, more so in the manga than in the anime.

name: Vash the Stampede
native: ヴァッシュ・ザ・スタンピード
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm (5'11") 

Vash is an outlaw, commonly referred to as "The Humanoid Typhoon" due to the carnage and destruction left in his wake. Feared as a ruthless desperado, Vash is actually a man who hates violence and would much rather spread his message of "LOVE AND PEACE!"

name: Milly Thompson
description:
Milly Thompson is a fellow Bernardelli agent and friend and assistant to [Meryl](https://anilist.co/character/713/Stryfe-Meryl). Despite physically towering over Meryl, Milly looks up to her and always refers to her as "senpai," or "Ma'am" in the English Version, as a term of respect for a senior.

Although physically very strong, she appears rather simple and ditzy, but has an extremely kind heart and also reveals a strength of character and genuine optimism. However, Milly can be just as hotheaded as Meryl if someone is disrespectful towards their family (or wasting food, especially pudding). She can seem somewhat dim, but she has some amazing skills (chess playing, for one) which hint at a deeply buried intelligence. She does have a tendency to go a bit overboard when drinking.

She seemed to pick up on the fact that [Vash](https://anilist.co/character/162/Vash-the-Stampede) is the notorious Stampede before Meryl, but she is apparently still somewhat surprised upon realizing that she was correct. Milly comes from a very large family, and writes letters to them constantly (known as "The Milly Monthly").

Somehow Milly manages to hide a very heavy concussion gun (referred to as a "stun-gun") under her coat. The shots, which pop out into the shape of an X-shaped claw, are so powerful they can even knock over trucks. At one point Milly refers to herself as "Stun-gun Milly".

name: Nicholas D. Wolfwood
native: ニコラス・D・ウルフウッド
description: He is a priest who wields a large cross-shaped gun named the Punisher, which he and his former colleagues use either in saving people or for complete destruction. After showing potential in the orphanage in which he was raised, Chapel trained and modified him, giving him enhanced abilities and the ability to regenerate from heavy injuries using special vials. He was given a special large cross-shaped gun called the Punisher, which contains two machine guns and a rocket launcher. Wolfwood is found nearly dead in the desert by protagonist [Vash the Stampede](https://anilist.co/character/162/Vash-the-Stampede). They become recurring allies despite acting on different morals when fighting.

name: Rai-Dei the Blade
description: Rai-Dei is a samurai who seeks the knowledge learned only when facing death. He carries a sword with a built in gun that can be fired from the hilt, and is able to swing it with enough force to create a sonic blast. In the anime, he expresses anger in the fact that Vash is refusing to make his mark true and aim to kill, claiming he wants "a real battle". He escapes after Vash's Angel Arm is forced to activate, though Wolfwood soon kills him. In the manga, he wears "roller skates" that allow him to move at phenomenal speeds. After Vash defeats him, Rai-Dei attempts to attack Vash from behind, but is quickly killed by Wolfwood.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Kuroneko
description:
Kuroneko-sama is, as her name suggests, a black cat. Her formal name is Kuroneko Kukan.

She appears in every episode at least once, usually as a running joke of popping her oval-shaped, green-eyed head on screen at some opportune moment and usually uttering a simple "nyaa." Her appearances in the manga are not nearly as frequent as in the anime, and Nightow has stated that she is just something easy and calming to draw in between action scenes. His most common response to queries as to her nature or significance at anime convention panels is "Kuroneko-sama is a small black cat," stated fully in English. She could also be considered as a regular black cat that brings Vash bad luck wherever he goes.

name: Chapel the Evergreen
description: Chapel the Evergreen is part of the "Eye of Michael", an organization of assassins founded by a church that worships Plants. They provide Knives with mercenaries, with three slots of the Gung-Ho Guns reserved for the Eye of Michael's best. Chapel, also known as 'Master C', is shot and left as a paraplegic by Wolfwood, who impersonates Chapel. He is only middle aged, but the modifications on his body, which grants him enhanced strength and reflexes, and allows him to heal at a very fast rate, have aged him considerably. Though in a wheelchair, he still wields a large cross-shaped machine gun with four spiked ends at the base of the cross. Wolfwood kills Chapel with an immense head butt, cracking his skull and breaking his neck.    The anime features Chapel the Evergreen as Wolfwood's direct mentor. He carries the parent version of Wolfwood's Cross Punisher, though Chapel's splits into twin machine guns. He cares for Nicholas after Nicholas kills his abusive guardian. He dresses in dark green and has red goggles grafted to his face. He is killed by Knives after an unsuccessful attempt to kill Legato for taking control of him and forcing him to kill Wolfwood.    from wikipedia

name: Cliff Schezar
description: Cliff is the son of a Plant engineer who purchased land with copious amounts of water on it and as a result, makes a good living selling water to the town. He portrays himself at first as a kind, caring older man with a sense of humor who only wants to protect the water and his guest Marianne. He even hires Vash as bodyguard to help.     Appears in episode 2.   (Source: Trigun Wikia)

name: Elizabeth
description: Elizabeth is a plant technician hired to repair the plant at Inepril City. She is a beautiful woman who uses her looks to try to lure Vash The Stampede to his death in a sabotaged plant. As a former resident of July, she blames him for the death of her parents. She had intended on letting the plant to be sabotaged to get revenge on him, including hiring an assassin to distract him.

name: Loose Ruth
description: A bounty hunter who is after Vash the Stampede for the $60,000,000,000 reward.

name: Tomoe
description:
__Height:__ 190 cm (6’3”)

Tomoe is a familiar to the last land god, [Mikage](https://anilist.co/character/37871/Mikage). Currently he is the familiar of [Nanami](https://anilist.co/character/18343/Momozono-Nanami) and sealed their contract with a kiss. He shows a wonderful talent for cooking and is shown to be highly dedicated to the shrine. Tomoe worries a great deal about Nanami and is very aware of how delicate she is as a human, threatening anyone who harms her or speaks ill of her. It is often implied that he loves Nanami, such as doing random acts of kindness for her and refusing to kill in front of her. Plus, it is also indicated that he sometimes gets very jealous of other guys who hang around her. He is also very loyal to Nanami, as shown by him kissing her to seal their contract again after it had been broken.

name: Nanami Momozono
description:
__Species:__ Human / God
__Height:__ 162 cm (5'4")

A teenage girl whose father ran out on her because of his gambling debts, she was often mocked for her poverty by her classmates.

She becomes the local land god after former god [Mikage](https://anilist.co/character/37871/Mikage) transfers his position as master of the shrine over to Nanami. She begins with very little spiritual power, but works hard at balancing her godly duties with her schoolwork. Nanami is often upset when [Tomoe](https://anilist.co/character/18344/Tomoe) flirts with other women. Tomoe always puts Shiitake mushrooms in Nanami's food even though he knows she hates them.

name: Isohime
description:
Species: Yokai

She likes to rip humans off with her trade and can bargain very well. She has special clairvoyance, which can see what regular eyes cannot.

name: Numa no Himemiko
description: A catfish who became a swamp deity, and lives in a palace underneath her swamp with her many fish attendants. Ten years ago she fell in love with a young boy, and she asks Nanami to help her reconnect with the boy once again. As repayment, when Nanami visits her palace she allows her to wear one of her luxurious kimonos so she will look her best in front of Tomoe.   Despite rarely speaking, Himemiko is very perceptive and seems to be one of the few characters who has figured out that Nanami is in love with Tomoe. Initially she appears very "fishy," with bulging eyes and a fishlike noseless face. However after getting a makeover from Nanami, she maintains a more casual "human" appearance so she can meet the boy again.

name: Mikage
description:
__Species:__ God
__Height:__ 185 cm (6'0")

A mysterious man who was once the land god of the shrine, and who left twenty years ago for unspecified reasons. He met a newly-homeless [Nanami](https://anilist.co/character/18343/Momozono-Nanami) and bestowed the land-god mark on her, saying that she was better suited to be the god than him. He has light hair and glasses, and wears a trenchcoat and hat.

name: Kei Ueshima
description: [Ami Nekota's](https://anilist.co/character/67513/Nekota-Ami) best friend.

name: Akuraou
description: Akura-ou is a powerful demon with an immortal body, only considering Tomoe to be his equal. However when Tomoe left him, he succumbed to the gods powers and lost his body. After being locked up, he was given a chance to live in a boy's body and took it, returning to the world and is constantly seeking a way to retrieve his lost body.

name: Narukami
description: A bratty, selfish sky god who has an unrequited crush on Tomoe. She steals Nanami's mark and shrinks Tomoe into a toddler, and takes control of the shrine for a short period. She is very demanding and apparently goes through attendants at an unheard-of rate, and seems to take sadistic delight in abusing her familiar.   (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Kotarou Urashima
description:
__Occupation:__ Student

Kotarou is technically a shy type of boy who doesn't blend well with other people, claiming his only good point was probably his skill in solving rubix cubes. He has low self-esteem, making him doubt that Himemiko actually loves him and that it might just be a cruel prank of some kind.

name: Maki Kohirui
description: Hits on Nanami at a goukon.

name: Unmei
aliases: Cosette Schneider (コゼット・シュナイダー)
description:
L.V. Beethoven "Symphony No. 5 in C minor Op.67"

She is a Musicart who carries "Destiny" in her body. Despite her ladylike appearance, her facial expressions rarely change and her tone of voice is always calm and polite. At first glance, she looks pretty, but she has an unconventional personality, with a sharp tongue and a sweet tooth. She and her partner, the conductor [Takt](https://anilist.co/character/234535), have a deep and long past together.

name: Takt Asahina
description:
A conductor who made a contract with the Musicart "Unmei." He has the idea that "music is prioritized in everything."

(Source: Official Site, translated)

His father was Kenji Asahina, a famous conductor killed in the Boston tragedy incident.

name: Anna Schneider
native: アンナ・シュナイダー
description:
A girl who is a childhood friend of Takt and a fateful "sister". She has a cheerful and caring personality.

(Source: Official site, translated)

name: Titan
description:
"Titan" - Musicart with the score of "G. Mahler "Symphony No. 1 in D major".

(Source: Official Site, Translated)

name: Lenny
description:
A conductor belonging to "New York Symphonica". A good personality who treats any person without discrimination.

(Source: Official site, translated)

name: Tengoku
description:
Musicart belonging to "New York Symphonica". She looks beautiful, but she doesn't talk much about anything other than necessary.

(Source: Official site, translated)

name: Jigoku
description:
A Musicart who belongs to "New York Symphonica" and works with Shindler. She has a cruel and atrocious taste.

(Source: Official site, translated)

name: Felix Shindler
description:
Conductor who is the chief commander of "New York Symphonica". He directs the organization as Zagan's right arm.

(Source: Official site, translated)

name: Sagan
description:
Chief Executive Officer of "New York Symphonica", a strategic base for D2-a person who serves as GM (Grand Maestro).

(Source: Official site, translated)

name: Myers
description: The thunder whip magician.

name: Kouha Ren
description: Height: 158 cm (5'2")  Weight: 127.9 lbs (58 kg), now 55 kg (121 lbs) Djinn: Leraje  Kouha Ren is the Kou Empire's third Prince. He's a General of the Kou Empire's Western Subjugation Army together with his brothers, Kouen Ren and Koumei Ren. Kouha is a Dungeon Capturer, capturing one Dungeon, and one of Judal's King Candidates.    Kouha appears as a young boy with an androgynous aspect. He has long pink hair, short in the back and has three braids on his fringe, and pink eyes. He also wears a blue hat with a design on it that has golden wings, two long red veils and a white chinese-like dress with a pair of shorts. He also wears two golden bracelets, each with a green jewel. His Metal Vessel is his sword.   He appears to like hitting his attendants, particularly the females. He also has a twisted personality, or more commonly known as yanderu (gore) in which he likes to butcher his enemies brutally and takes pleasure while doing it. He also loves the sight of blood and is well known in Kou Empire for having an eccentric personality.  Kouha also has a nice and extremely caring side to him, especially to his attendants, JunJun, ReiRei and JinJin.    Kouha is loyal when it comes to his older brothers. He respects them and is willing to support them the best he can.   (Source: Magi Wikia)

name: Doron
description: Doron is a High Class Magician of Magnostadt and the Magnostadt Academy. He is Meyer's younger brother and defected from Partevia Empire.  (Source: Magi wikia)

name: Shambal Ramal
description: The head of a school for Gladiators

name: Darius Leoxses
native: ダリオス・レオクセス
description:
Darius Leoxses is the Knight King of Sasan, one of the countries that forms the Seven Seas Alliance. Darius is the owner of the Djinn Alloces. He is a Dungeon Capturer, capturing one Dungeon, and a King Vessel.

Darius is a middly-old man and has cunning eyes, a little beard and dark (possibly scarlet) hair. He has a serious look and a bang going down the left side of his face. He wears ornamented clothes and metallic protectors in his arms and legs, and carries around a long metal spear. He wears a light colored turban around his head, which has a dark feather sticking up from it.

In his Djinn Equip, Darius' face looks more youthful, though retained his serious side.

name: Iruma Suzuki
description:
__Rank:__ 
__Familiars:__ 

A human boy whose parents sold him to a demon named [Sullivan](https://anilist.co/character/135023), who subsequently transports him to the Demon World and adopts him as his grandson. He starts his new life by being enrolled into Babyls Demon School, where he constantly has to hide the fact that he is a human in order to avoid being eaten. However, after quickly making friends with fellow classmates [Asmodeus](https://anilist.co/character/135022/Alice-Asmodeus) and [Clara](https://anilist.co/character/135019/Clara-Valac), he eventually grows accustomed to his new lifestyle through both his numerous adventures and encounters with other demons.

appearsIn.title: Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun Season 2

name: Alice Asmodeus
native: アスモデウス・アリス
description:
__Height:__178 cm
__Rank:__ 
__Familiars:__ 
__Inherited Magic:__ 

Alice Asmodeus is the top student of his class at Babyls. His rank and power exceeds those of most other freshman. For a very short time, he was antagonistic, but later became [Iruma](https://anilist.co/character/135018)'s first and closest friend.

appearsIn.title: Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun Season 2

name: Clara Valac
description:
__Height:__ 153 cm
__Rank:__ 
__Familiars:__ 
__Inherited Magic:__ 

Clara is one of the stranger students at the school, acting very much like an excited child. She has abundant energy that most students can't keep up with. Other students find her weird and hard to deal with, but are drawn to her because her inherited power is so convenient. Since she had no friends, she would give students snacks and drinks as "payment" for playing with her. She is the second friend [Iruma](https://anilist.co/character/135018) made at Babyls.

appearsIn.title: Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun Season 2

name: Ameri Azazel
description:
__Height:__ 190cm
__Rank:__  
__Relatives:__ [Merize](https://anilist.co/character/326718) (Mother), [Azazel Henri](https://anilist.co/character/155682/Henri-Azazel) (Father)
__Familiars:__  
__Inherited Magic:__ 

Ameri is the president of Babyls' Student Council. She is convinced humans exist, despite them only being myth in the demon world, and believes [Iruma](https://anilist.co/character/135018) to be one. Ameri hides the fact that she enjoys manga, "the forbidden books of the human world", and has Iruma read them to her in secret.

appearsIn.title: Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun Season 2

name: Kalego Naberius
native: ナベリウス・カルエゴ
description:
__Rank:__ Chet (Anime & Manga)
__Height:__182 cm
__Inherited Magic:__ Cerberion
__Relatives:__ [Naberius Narnia](https://anilist.co/character/287564/Naberius-Narnia) (Older Brother)
__Occupation:__ Teacher

[Iruma Suzuki](https://anilist.co/character/135018/Suzuki-Iruma)'s Familiar/Contracted Demon

The homeroom teacher of the Misfit Class, and one of the prestigious professors at Babyls Demon School. Derisive, snappy, and short-tempered, he strongly dislikes demons who are boisterous, brash, and inconsiderate of others, believing them to be troublemakers. As such, he is generally pessimistic when dealing with his students. 

Due to how the familiar summoning spell works with humans, Kalego unwillingly becomes Iruma's familiar for a year. When summoned, Kalego appears as a fluffy white creature resembling a small crow, complete with black bat-like wings, black horns, and his distinctive front hair curl.

appearsIn.title: Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun Season 2

name: Sullivan
description: Sullivan is the adoptive grandfather of [Iruma](https://anilist.co/character/135018) and the principal of Babyls. He is one of the Three Heroes, the most powerful and influential demons in society, and is a possible candidate for the new Demon King. He's a Tet (9) Rank.

appearsIn.title: Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun Season 2

name: Opera
description:
__Occupation:__

Sullivan's servant who does the chores around the house.

Opera was Kalego's upperclassman when they were both students at Babyls.

Opera has a serious, down to earth personality. They often act as a voice of reason for Lord Sullivan, but are usually ignored. They are mostly reserved with their opinion, but will voice the occasional concern or cynical remark, and will sometimes dispense helpful advice.

Their interactions with Kalego reveal that they have a somewhat more mischievous and sadistic side not normally shown in their professional behavior, which was especially prominent when they were students at Babyls.

appearsIn.title: Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun Season 2

name: Sabro Sabnock
description:
__Rank:__ _Bet_ (Anime), _Daleth_ (Manga)
__Inherited Magic:__ Weapon Creation
__Battlers:__ Demon King Battler
__Height:__ 220 cm

Sabro is the second son of a prestigious family. He dreams of becoming the next Demon King and sees Iruma as a rival after the Rank placement exams. Sabro is a Bet (2) Rank and his familiar is a Kelpie.

appearsIn.title: Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun Season 2

name: Kiriwo Amy
description:
__Species:__ Demon
__Birthday:__ Deviler 13th
__Height:__ 162 cm (5'4")
__Rank:__ _Bet_ (Anime & Manga)
__Inherited Magic:__ Barrier
__Affiliation:__ Babyls Demon School (Formerly)
__Battlers:__ Magical Apparatus Battler (Formerly)

Kiriwo is a physically and magically weak demon. Despite being an upperclassman at Babyls Demon School, he is only a Beth (2) rank. He hopes to develop tools that will help other weak demons like him be treated fairly.

name: Keroli Crocell
description:
__Rank:__ _Bet_ (Anime), _Daleth_ (Manga)
__Inherited Magic:__ Ice Surface
__Familiars:__ Blizzard Wolf, Snow King Fox
__Height:__ 155 cm

Keroli is a student at Babyls Demon School. She is in the same class as Iruma, the Misfit Class. Normally under the guise of an ordinary-looking freshman student, she has an Akudol alter-ego named Kuromu. Around school, she wears big, rounded glasses that have the ability to disguise her appearance to other demons. When she is acting as Kuromu, she wears a wig.

name: Makoto Katai
description:
With the face of a delinquent, Katai is actually a nervous, awkward wreck who constantly stumbles over his words, with a goal to overcome his own awkwardness and make friends.

Tadano immediately sees through his false threatening nature and quickly becomes one of Katai's closest friends.

He views Komi as his "master" and thinks she's constantly cheering him on to become better friends with Tadano.

name: Hitomi Tadano
description:
**Relatives**: [Hitohito Tadano](https://anilist.co/character/78093) (older brother)

Hitomi Tadano is the younger sister of Hitohito Tadano. She bears resemblance to her brother in terms of understanding people's minds. She is active, unlike her brother who is timid and more passive in doing things.

Hitomi is a short girl that shares the same big beady eyes as her older brother and make similar expressions. She wears her medium length hair in two short twin-tails.

In contrast to her older brother, who is usually seen as "normal", Hitomi is an energetic and eccentric girl. Unlike her more self-conscious brother, she's not as concerned with what others think, doing odd things such as introducing herself via rapping and not being embarrassed by it. Because of her cheery nature, she is well-liked among her peers.

Hitomi is rather blunt and forthright, openly claiming that she's not very good in either grades or sports during her class introduction. She does not seem to possess the same level of self-awareness as her older brother and tends to jump to conclusions.

When [Shousuke Komi](https://anilist.co/character/130870/Shousuke-Komi) wasn't talking to her, Hitomi assumed he had a communication disorder when he was choosing to ignore her. Nonetheless, she does her best to "help" him communicate.

name: Karen Kohiruimaki
description:
__Height:__ 183cm (6'0")

Karen is a female college student who has a complex about her tall figure and has a poor social disposition because of it. In Gun Gale Online, she obtains a dream "chibi" avatar less than 150 centimeters in height that dons a full-body pink uniform.

She has excellent agility and specializes in close-range combat that utilizes her speed. She loves cute things, and all of her equipment is pink. Her main arm is P90 and she calls it "P-Chan".

appearsIn.title: Sword Art Online Alternative: Gun Gale Online

name: Goushi Asougi
description:
A male player who is Pitohui's acquaintance and longtime friend. Asougi Goushi, known as M in Gun Gale Online, is one of the main characters of the Sword Art Online Alternative "Gun Gale Online" spin-off series.

He is a giant man, over 190 centimeters tall, and is good at medium to long-range combat, and is especially good at sniping. He is calm, has excellent strategy planning skills, and serves as the team's staff officer.

appearsIn.title: Sword Art Online Alternative: Gun Gale Online

name: Miyu Shinohara
description:
Shinohara Miyu, known as Fukaziroh in ALfheim Online and Gun Gale Online, is one of the main characters in the Gun Gale Online spin-off series. She is a long-time friend of Kohiruimaki Karen from her hometown Hokkaido in the real world. She plays ALfheim Online as a Sylph but occasionally converts her account to Gun Gale Online to participate in Squad Jam tournaments.

Taking advantage of her high strength, she fights with two six-barreled grenade launchers in GGO.

appearsIn.title: Sword Art Online Alternative: Gun Gale Online

name: Pitohui
description: A tall beautiful woman with a tattoo on her cheek, Pitohui is a player in Gun Gale Online and LLENN's first friend in the game. She is a veteran GGO player and is a mysterious person whose only secret is that she is a gun enthusiast who uses a different gun every time she plays.

appearsIn.title: Sword Art Online Alternative: Gun Gale Online

name: Shirley
description:
She is a member of the "Northern Country Hunters Club" (KKHC), a squadron composed of real-life hunters. As a result of this background, all members are capable of sniping without relying on aim-assist lines.

Because their profession involves handling real firearms in the real world, they harbored an ethical aversion to "shooting people" and avoided anti-personnel combat. However, before she knew it, her teammates had rationalized the situation—viewing it merely as a game—and decided to enter Squad Jam to test their skills.

Shirley, who still couldn't shake that sense of aversion, was practically dragged into participating by her teammates...

Her weapon of choice is the R93 Tactical 2 (7.62mm model)—a version of the Blaser R93 hunting sniper rifle designed for law enforcement agencies—which is the same type she uses in real life; she also carries a hunting *kennata* (a heavy-duty hunting knife/machete).

appearsIn.title: Sword Art Online Alternative: Gun Gale Online

name: Norimi Kawaguchi
description: She is a friend of [Sawako](https://anilist.co/character/19569/Sawako-Yamanaka)'s from back when they were in high school, and they were both in the light music club together as part of the band Death Devil.  She and [Sawako](https://anilist.co/character/19569/Sawako-Yamanaka) used to try to outdo each other on the guitar.  Her stage name is Christina.

name: Himeko Tachibana
description:
Himeko Tachibana is one of the students from Class 3-2.

Himeko is a member of the school's Softball Club and has a part-time job at a convenience store. Her behaviour is that of any other high school girl, but she has in fact a warm-hearted and polite side. Yui Hirasawa, who sits next to her in class, quickly became attached to her.

name: Horigome-sensei
description:
He is a classical literature teacher at Sakuragaoka High School. He has taught there for a long time, since he was the supervisor of the Light Music Club when the members of the band Death Devil ([Norimi Kawaguchi](https://anilist.co/character/33872/Norimi-Kawaguchi), [Sawako Yamanaka](https://anilist.co/character/19569/Sawako-Yamanaka), Jane and Della) still attended school. Since the band members were too wild in Horigome's eyes, they caused him many problems, forcing him to scold them over and over again.

In the movie, Horigome caught wind of Ho-kago Tea Time's illegal concert and rushed towards it, despite [Sawako](https://anilist.co/character/19569/Sawako-Yamanaka)'s efforts to delay him. After he managed to reach the classroom, it was revealed that he just wanted to see it with his own eyes, having no ill intentions at all. Horigome told [Sawako](https://anilist.co/character/19569/Sawako-Yamanaka) that the Light Music Club had changed greatly, having become much "cuter". The class then pulled him and [Sawako](https://anilist.co/character/19569/Sawako-Yamanaka) inside, making Horigome smile.

name: Fuuko Takahashi
description: One of Yui, Mio, Tsumugi, and Ritsu's classmates in Class 3–2. She is normally quiet but can be frightening when she is angry. Her best friends are Natsuka and Nodoka.

name: Kimiko Makigami
description: Kimiko Makigami is one of the students from Class 3-2.She has a severe self-image complex and tries to avoid going near people with fair skin and slender legs.

name: Sucy Manbavaran
native: スーシィ・マンババラン
description:
__Height:__ 163 cm
__School:__ Luna Nova Magical Academy
__Occupation:__ Witch Student

Sucy is an aloof, calm, sarcastic, and somewhat sadistic person. She also surprisingly remains indifferent in various situations and things that drive the other girls crazy, which shows that she is calmer than her roommates.

name: Lotte Jansson
description:
**Height:** 156 cm

Lotte is shy, calm and timid, rarely ever getting angry. She is a kind-hearted girl who earnestly looks after [Akko](https://anilist.co/character/81645/Kagari-Atsuko). Lotte is often concerned about Akko, given that her determination to become a witch like [Shiny Chariot](https://anilist.co/character/81717/du-Nord-Chariot) sometimes makes her go too far, and that she would forget the well-being of friends and people who wish to help her.

name: Atsuko Kagari
description:
__School::__ Luna Nova Magical Academy
__Occupation:__ Witch Student

The main protagonist, an energetic and optimistic girl who attends Luna Nova after being inspired by the witch [Shiny Chariot](https://anilist.co/character/81717/du-Nord-Chariot). Having come from a non-magical background, she struggles using magic much of the time, and is disappointed by the mundanity of her classes as opposed to Chariot's more spectacular performances. However, her strong sense of self-confidence enables her to wield Chariot's Shiny Rod, which accepts her as its new master.

name: Amanda O'Neill
description:
__Height:__ 167 cm 
__School:__ Luna Nova Magical Academy
__Occupation:__ Witch Student

Amanda is by her own description a "rebel". An unruly and fun-loving child, she has little respect for authority and is primarily motivated by hedonism.

name: Fafnir
description:
**Age:** Thousands of years

Fafnir is an old wealthy business mogul who helped fund the construction of Luna Nova, his character's name is based on the Norse mythology of Sigrud who was effected by a curse which turned him into a Dragon.

name: Bernadette Cavendish
native: バーナデッド・キャベンディッシュ
description: Head of the Cavendish House and [Diana](https://anilist.co/character/81709)'s mother.

name: Jasminka Antonenko
native: ヤスミンカ・アントネンコ
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm

A friendly and laid-back Luna Nova witch student from Russia who has a passion for food and is always seen snacking on something, even during classes. She specializes in culinary magic.

name: Episode
description: A young vampire hunter who wields a giant cross as a weapon. He stole [Kiss-Shot](https://anilist.co/character/23602/Oshino-Shinobu)'s left leg. Despite his physical appearance, he's only 6 years old. Episode often says, "Gotta love it," or, "That's hilarious," as a catchphrase. He has an aggressive and arrogant personality, and has a tendency to get carried away when fighting.

name: Guillotine Cutter
description: Guillotine Cutter is the archbishop of a new religion he created in which believes that he is god. He is one of the three vampire hunters with Episode and Dramaturgy, who

name: Dramaturgy
description: Dramaturgy is a giant man over 2 meters tall and carries two flamberge swords. He is the one who took [Kiss-shot's](https://anilist.co/character/23602/Oshino-Shinobu) right leg. It's implied he may be German in Tsubasa Sleeping. He is also a Vietnam War veteran.

name: Yuuichi Katagiri
description: Yuuichi Katagiri is a hardworking lad who believes friends are more important than money. In reality, he is a dead broke student with multiple part-time jobs. In secret, he is "the mind" of the team, and often, even when things seem dire, Yuuichi manages to swing the odds to his favor with every ounce of his might. His past is heavy--and often, for it, he is called a "devil" and considered dangerous.

name: Yutori Kokorogi
description: A shy girl who used to get bullied in primary school that participated in Tomodachi Game alongside her friends. She is considered to be weak and helpless so she is oftenly used by Yuuichi Katagiri in order for his plans to succeed.

name: Makoto Shibe
description: A somewhat idiotic guy who comes from a rich family and has an obvious crush on Shiho Sawaragi. He participated in the Tomodachi Game alongside his friends.

name: Shiho Sawaragi
description: A solemn female student that is respected by her classmates for her hard working and serious nature. She participated in Tomodachi Game alongside her friends.

name: Tenji Mikasa
description: A strategist/genius with grades at the top of his class who participated in Tomodachi Game alongside his friends.

name: Hyakutarou Onigawara
description: High School 2nd Year student from Group K.

name: Wataru Sawaragi
description: Father of [Shiho Sawaragi](https://anilist.co/character/127638/Shiho-Sawaragi). He works as a policeman, and is close friends with Yutaka Mikasa.

name: Chisato Hashiratani
description: Part of group K

name: Yutaka Mikasa
description: Biological father of [Tenji Mikasa](https://anilist.co/character/127639/Tenji-Mikasa).

name: Juuzou Kadokura
description: The leader of Group K who battled against Group C in the third round of Tomodachi Game.

name: Mari Tamaki
description:
__Height:__ 155 cm (5'1)

A second-year high school student a sunny disposition. Although she has a great attitude and is admired by her friends, she is not good at finding a place in their midst or being a leader. In spite of being filled with curiosity, she is also rather cowardly and timid. She is troubled by the dilemma that although part of her wants to do things, another part of her just ends up not doing them.

(Source: Anime News Network)

appearsIn.title: A Place Further Than the Universe

name: Shirase Kobuchizawa
description:
__Height:__ 163 cm (5'5)

A second-year high school student who attends the same school as [Kimari](https://anilist.co/character/124545/Tamaki-Mari). She is a black-haired beauty that turns heads, but she is shy and not good at conversation. When she actually does speak, she can't help but say rather nasty things, which leads to misunderstandings. She has few friends and is treated as an oddball at school. At school, she is secretly called "Antarctica."

appearsIn.title: A Place Further Than the Universe

name: Hinata Miyake
description:
__Height:__ 145 cm (4'9)

A girl brimming with curiosity and always looking for fun things to do. She is very friendly and can get along well with everyone. 

Since childhood, she has been a leader who has always willingly taken on roles of responsibility, such as class committee and club leader. However, she quit high school because of something that happened and is now working part-time at a convenience store.

(Source: Anime News Network)

appearsIn.title: A Place Further Than the Universe

name: Yuzuki Shiraishi
description:
__Height:__ 152 cm (5'0)

A girl who is one grade lower than [Kimari](https://anilist.co/character/124545/Tamaki-Mari) and the others. She lives in Hokkaido. She has been an actress since childhood, and she now works as an entertainer while attending high school. She shows maturity and is a good speaker with polite manners. She is concerned that because of always working, she is unable to make close friends.

appearsIn.title: A Place Further Than the Universe

name: Rin Tamaki
description: Mari Tamaki's younger sister who serves as a school committee member at middle school.

appearsIn.title: A Place Further Than the Universe

name: Gin Toudou
description: Captain of the expedition to Antarctica and former friend of Shirase's mother.

appearsIn.title: A Place Further Than the Universe

name: Kanae Maekawa
description:
Kanae Maekawa is a woman who serves as vice commander of "Antarctica Challenge" under Gin and she was a member of the previous civilian expedition.

Source: A Place Farther than the Universe Wiki

appearsIn.title: A Place Further Than the Universe

name: Yumiko Samejima
description: Yumiko Samejima is the so-called Antarctic chef who serves as the head cook of the observation team and she was also a member of the previous civilian expedition.

appearsIn.title: A Place Further Than the Universe

name: Tamiko Shiraishi
description:
Tamiko Shiraishi is the mother of Yuzuki Shiraishi who is a manager of her daughter's works.

Source: A Place Farther than the Universe Wiki

appearsIn.title: A Place Further Than the Universe

name: Nadeshiko Kagamihara
description: A member of the outdoor crew at high school, she’s drawn into camping when she meets [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/124586/Shima-Rin) at a lake shore. She’s always cheerful and positive and loves anything fun.

name: Aoi Inuyama
description:
A gentle girl who speaks with a Kansai accent. Of the reckless outdoor crew members, Aoi is like the secret leader who looks out for everyone during important times. She’s called 'Inuko' by [Chiaki](https://anilist.co/character/124578).

(Source: Honey's Anime)

name: Chiaki Oogaki
description:
A bright and active person, in charge of choosing the camping spots and gear. She’s lively and cheerful, but is also full of emotion and easily brought to tears. Wanting to camp, she forms the outdoor crew with [Aoi](https://anilist.co/character/124577).

(Source: Honey's Anime)

name: Ena Saitou
description: Rin’s friend, a free spirited person who goes at her own pace. She’s not a member of the outdoor crew, but she occasionally shows interest in their activities. She also gives casual advice to Rin, who is bad at dealing with people. She has a dog called 'Chikuwa.'

name: Rin Shima
description: A solo camper who started camping due to her grandfather’s influence. She experiences camping with another person for the first time when she meets [Nadeshiko](https://anilist.co/character/124576/Kagamihara-Nadeshiko). She’s not a member of the outdoor crew, but she worries about Nadeshiko a bit.

name: Saki Shima
description: [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/124586/Rin-Shima)'s mother.

name: Minami Toba
description:
A substitute teacher, soon become the advisor for Outdoor Activities Club.

It is later revealed that she has already met Nadeshiko and Rin.

name: Ryouko Toba
description: [Minami](https://anilist.co/character/131523)'s sister.

name: Kikukawa Subaru
description: Talkative mountain climber

name: Sakura Kagamihara
description: Sakura Kagamihara is the older sister of [Nadeshiko Kagamihara](https://anilist.co/character/124576). She often drives Nadeshiko to and from campsite destinations.

name: Sena Kashiwazaki
description:
__Height:__ 164 cm (5'5")

Sena Kashiwazaki is the female tritagonist of the Boku wa Tomodachi ga Sukunai series. She is the first recruited member of the Neighbor's Club and the daughter of Tenma Kashiwazaki, headmaster of St. Chronica's Academy. Her wealth, beauty, and outstanding academic and athletic performance have made her popular among male students, and likewise, have made her an outcast among girls. Starting from high school, Sena continuously took first place in all tests, exams, and competitions. A year prior to the start of the story, Sena in her freshman year of high school, won multiple athletic events in the school annual festival. She entered the 200-meter race, cavalry battle, the scavenger hunt race, the obstacle race, the bread-eating race, the marathon, winning all of them effortlessly. 

On the outside, Sena appears to be an ordinary high school girl, but in truth, Sena is arrogant and prideful by nature and she is well aware of this. Sena considers herself to be the school queen or goddess and so often she treats her male classmates only as servants to be used, although many of them would like to be her boyfriend. Nonetheless, she holds [Kodaka](https://anilist.co/character/37512/Hasegawa-Kodaka) to a higher standard. Sena also believes that there are two types of girls; the ones who are willing to be her friends and the others who are not worthy of her.

name: Yozora Mikazuki
description:
__Height:__ 162 cm (5'4")

Yozora Mikazuki is the founder, first member, and club president of the Neighbor's Club. Prideful and easily provoked by nature, Yozora detests "normals" and that is the reason why Yozora doesn't have any friends along with the fact that she's a natural loner. She also preferred to have an "air friend", whom she calls "Tomo-chan" but decided to make a club to make friends. She is a cruel and selfish black-haired girl who says she understands and respects bullying but resents being called a bully herself. Yozora's difficult personality drives away anyone who might wish to make friends with her before she meets Kodaka. She dislikes individuals who act friendly over their first interaction, a trait she also shares with Sena, due to the suspicion of treachery and betrayal in the end. Yozora is also very prone to depression whenever she's at a state of loss to the point where her pessimism gets the best of her. Still, Yozora is very selfless and is willing to throw away her reputation and even her very own safety to lend a helping hand to the people who share her pain and past experiences as a neglected loner. Yozora is very smart, she had high results on the semestral tests and even scored full marks on one of them (Modern Japanese). She also has quite a good understanding of people combined with mentioned intelligence and acting skills, which lets her effortlessly outsmart and manipulate her fellow club members.

name: Kodaka Hasegawa
description: Kodaka is a transfer student who has not been able to make friends in his first month at St, Chronica's. Of all of the members of the club, he is the most gentle, balanced and socially competent in personality; but his unusual hair color, inherited from his late English mother, leads classmates to assume he is a violent and abusive delinquent and spread defamatory rumors about him. Because of his long experience of antagonism, Kodaka has become accustomed to fighting and can defend himself quite well. His father is working in the United States, and so he takes care of his younger sister alone at home, which has also made him a good cook. His childhood was characterized by frequent movement, and as a result he has few memories related to home life and close friendships; however, though he does not realize it at first, he and Yozora were childhood friends before his family moved.

name: Akari Fujibayashi
description: One of the character's from Sena's galge.

name: Yukiko Nagata
description: She is one of the characters from Sena's galge.

name: Stella Redfield
native: ステラ・レッドフィールド
description: Stella is the steward of the Kashiwazaki household.

name: Maria Takayama
description:
__Height:__ 146 cm (4'9")

Maria Takayama is a supporting character from the Boku wa Tomodachi ga Sukunai series. Maria is the supervising teacher and moderator of the Neighbor's Club and is a nun. While being exceptionally gifted in academics, she can also be very rude and immature, when annoyed. She refers to others as "Rotten mandarin." She develops a sibling-like relationship with Kodaka, who regularly makes her packed lunches, and is affectionate with him, also stating that she wouldn't mind marrying him when she gets older much to Kobato's annoyance. She is also gullible, which Yozora uses to her advantage. The reason why Maria cannot make friends is that she is an immature child prodigy whose wisdom stems not as much from natural talent, as from advanced education. Maria is childish and displays this tendency numerous times, even when claiming that she's an adult. While she may not realize this herself, Maria really wants to befriend Kobato, to the point that she felt jealous about how popular Kobato really is with her classmates. According to Kate, before becoming the Neighbor's Club's advisor, Maria was quite pessimistic. She feels a lot more comfortable in class than out of class. She says that she's real cocky with her grades and as such, has trouble making friends. Her ability to make friends has apparently gotten worse since she started skipping grades.

name: Pegasus Kashiwazaki
description: Sena Kashiwazaki's father and headmaster of St. Chronica Academy

name: Guernica Banfield
native: ゲルニカ・バーンフィールド
description: Lace's rival in "Kurogane no Necromancer".  Voiced by: Noriko Obata

name: Kobato Hasegawa
description:
__Height:__ 150 cm (4'11")

Kobato Hasegawa is the female secondary tritagonist from the Boku wa Tomodachi ga Sukunai series. She is Kodaka Hasegawa's younger sister and a student in the middle school division of St. Chronica's Academy who becomes the sixth member of the Neighbor's Club (with Yozora Mikazuki's approval) despite her juniority. She is very close to her brother and behaves in a jealous and clingy way whenever she feels that he is not giving her the attention she deserves, almost to the point where it is obvious that she has a brother complex. Shortly after birth Kobato and Kodaka's mother had passed away. Due to their father's low interaction with them, Kodaka had taken care of Kobato at a young age thus her becoming extremely clingy towards him. She sees Maria as a rival for Kodaka's brotherly affections and often gets into fights with the latter. The reason Kobato cannot make friends, (or rather, doesn't want to make any friends) is that she is under a constant self-delusion of being a Gothic vampire, and being naturally shy. In fact, she is wildly popular with the other students of her class, boys and girls alike. She has a penchant for darkness, vampires, and the macabre ever since she started watching an anime called Full Metal Necromancer.

name: Ilulu
description:
Ilulu is a female dragon who belongs to the Chaos Faction. Originally, she came to [Kobayashi's](https://anilist.co/character/120969) world to destroy [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970) and then tries to drive Kobayashi away from Tohru. After a change of heart, she begins to live with Kobayashi as her third dragon resident.

She has a caring personality and loves children. Later on, her personality leads her to taking over the running of a candy store from an old lady, who's looking for her replacement.

name: Makoto Takiya
description: [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969)'s co-worker who is initially believed by [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970) to be a rival for Kobayashi's affections, but is really just an otaku who likes to talk about maids with her. Kobayashi helps him set up during Comiket every year.

appearsIn.title: Miss Kobayashi's Dragon Maid: Valentines and Hot Springs! (Please Don't Get Your Hopes Up)

name: Chloe
description: She is an American who befriends Kanna when she had quarreled with Kobayashi.

name: Haru Onodera
description:
**Height:** 152 cm

She is the younger sister of [Kosaki Onodera](https://anilist.co/character/52723/Kosaki-Onodera) that has just entered her first year of high school.
On her way to school she was saved by a mysterious prince, who was actually [Raku](https://anilist.co/character/48393/Raku-Ichijou), and ends up with his locket. Her first impression of Raku was negative because she thought he was a womanizer trying to trick Kosaki and a pervert for unintentionally looking at her panties. When he asked her to return the locket she refused and told him to convince her that he was helping the prince. On another incident, Haru was helped by a mascot who was also Raku.

name: Suzu Ayakaji
description:
**Height:** 155 cm

She is the best friend and classmate of [Haru Onodera](https://anilist.co/character/84911/Haru-Onodera) and one of the classmates of [Paula McCoy](https://anilist.co/character/84917/Paula-McCoy).

name: Paula McCoy
description:
**Height:** 147 cm

Foreigner who is a classmate of [Haru Onodera](https://anilist.co/character/84911/Haru-Onodera). She was also an old acquaintance of [Seishirou Tsugumi](https://anilist.co/character/58885/Seishirou-Tsugumi) in America. Her assassin code name is White Fang.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Akari Watanabe
description: Akari Watanabe is a Gyaru who was assigned to be [Jirou Yakuin's](https://anilist.co/character/191673) partner during the marriage practical, a special course to train students how to function in a real romantic relationship, despite her wanting to be partnered with [Minami Tenjin](https://anilist.co/character/273110/Minami-Tenjin), her true fool love. She hopes by training by acting as a perfect newlywed with Jirou, she can earn the two of them enough points to swap each other out for who they truly want to pursue. However, after spending more time with Jirou, she begins to second guess herself and how she truly feels.

appearsIn.title: More than a Married Couple, but Not Lovers.
More Than a Married Couple, but Not Lovers.

name: Jirou Yakuin
description:
__Relatives:__ Himari and Leo (Younger Cousins).

Jirou Yakuin is the main protagonist, being an antisocial, pessimistic high school boy. He ends up forced to pair with [Akari Watanabe](https://anilist.co/character/191672) in their school's "Couple Practical" course, despite harboring feelings for his childhood friend [Shiori Sakurazaka](https://anilist.co/character/273105). Because of his crush, he makes it his goal to find a way to pair up with Shiori instead, being willing to do anything to reach his goal even if it means acting as a newlywed with Akari. However, the more time he spends with Akari, the more conflicted he becomes with his true feelings.

appearsIn.title: More than a Married Couple, but Not Lovers.
More Than a Married Couple, but Not Lovers.

name: Mei Hamano
description:
The overprotective friend of [Shiori Sakurazaka](https://anilist.co/character/273105/Shiori-Sakurazaka) and the assigned practice partner of [Shuu Terafune](https://anilist.co/character/286620/Shuu-Terafune). She is extremely supportive of Shiori and pushes her to get together with their childhood crush [Jirou Yakuin](https://anilist.co/character/191673/Jirou-Yakuin), despite her secretly having a crush on Shiori herself.

Mei is portrayed as a tomboy who enjoys playing sports. Fitting to the archetype, Mei does not usually wear clothes that are considered girly, preferring to wear t-shirts and pants as opposed to dresses. Despite being a star athlete, Mei has stated that she does not do well in academics, having to rely on Shiori to help tutor her. Mei's personality varies widely depending on who she is interacting with, tending to be more friendly and respectful towards girls. With boys, however, Mei often shows them her more brash, no-nonsense side. It's unclear Mei is lesbian or bisexual, but she at least has a strong preference for girls romantically. Mei is known to be a woman of action who prefers to be direct and to the point, having no qualms with being blunt with people and openly telling someone the truth no matter how much it may hurt.

appearsIn.title: More than a Married Couple, but Not Lovers.
More Than a Married Couple, but Not Lovers.

name: Shiori Sakurazaka
description:
Shiori is [Jirou Yakuin's](https://anilist.co/character/191673/Jirou-Yakuin) classmate and childhood friend (and crush). She was paired with [Minami Tenjin](https://anilist.co/character/273110/Minami-Tenjin) in their school's couples training.

She is a kind and gentle girl, but she isn't very confident in herself and has a shy demeanor. Shiori is academically intelligent and regularly scores high marks on her exams, although she is known to struggle athletically. She is especially bad at talking to boys she doesn't know due to past experiences she had in middle school, but is known to be very caring towards those close to her regardless of gender, including Jirou and [Mei](https://anilist.co/character/286619/Mei-Hamano). Despite the fact she is paired with Minami in the couples training, she seems to still harbor some feelings for Jirou.

appearsIn.title: More than a Married Couple, but Not Lovers.
More Than a Married Couple, but Not Lovers.

name: Sadaharu Kamo
description:
__Relatives:__ Keiichiro Kamo (Older Brother).

Sadaharu is a close friend of [Jirou Yakuin](https://anilist.co/character/191673/Jirou-Yakuin), being one of the few people Jirou is comfortable being open around. He is paired with Satsuki Kaneyama in their school's Marriage Practical.

Sadaharu is portrayed as being a mild mannered and eccentric otaku who enjoys reading manga, watching anime, and playing video games. Like Jirou, Sadaharu also has lousy luck with women, preferring the women to be "2D" instead of real so they can't end up hurting his feelings. However, it appears that he and his practice partner get along well which indicates that the practical has somewhat improved his social skills with women. Sadaharu is considered to be the series primary comic relief character, having a knack for making light of serious situations by comparing them to similar events found in many Japanese media and pointing out common tropes. He often showcases incredible creativity by imagining himself or others in fictional circumstances that almost appear to break the laws of reality, with his rampant imagination even causing him to the break the 4th wall on a few occasions. Despite his absurd antics, Sadaharu is ultimately a good, kindhearted person and will go out of his way to help and support those he cares for when he sees fit.

More Than a Married Couple, but Not Lovers.

name: Minami Tenjin
description:
Considered to be the most popular student at Seishun Academy, Minami Tenjin is [Shiori Sakurazaka's](https://anilist.co/character/273105) partner in the Marriage Practical and [Akari Watanabe's](https://anilist.co/character/191672) crush. He works at a café together with [Shuu Terafune](https://anilist.co/character/286620) and Keiichiro Kamo.

What makes Minami so admirable are the numerous amounts of traits and skills that he has that would make other boys jealous. He is a star athlete who is proficient in multiple sports including basketball, volleyball, and track-and-field, on top of him being academically intelligent. Above all else, he possesses a calm and cool demeanor in the presence of others which is what has earned him the respect and admiration of his peers. Despite his popularity amongst the school, Minami does not have an ego where he sees himself as superior to the other students, and is generally portrayed as a very friendly, humble person who treats everyone with respect. He is also known to be incredibly observant.

appearsIn.title: More than a Married Couple, but Not Lovers.
More Than a Married Couple, but Not Lovers.

name: Shuu Terafune
description:
He is the assigned practice partner of [Mei Hamano](https://anilist.co/character/286619), a friend/coworker of [Minami Tenjin](https://anilist.co/character/273110/Minami-Tenjin), and the self-declared rival of [Jirou Yakuin](https://anilist.co/character/191673/Jirou-Yakuin) for [Akari Watanabe's](https://anilist.co/character/191672/Akari-Watanabe) affection.

Shuu is generally portrayed as a self-absorbed, conceited, and presumptuous young man. As a result, some characters find him irritating, especially when he acts up in situations that do not call for it. In cases where things don't go his way, Shū may come across as desperate, pathetic, whiny, or unintentionally rude. Even though he has a crush on Akari, Shū appears to be a womanizer who shows attraction to other women and tries to make himself more appealing to them. In spite of his generally negative traits, Shuu does genuinely care for Akari's safety and wellbeing when she is in trouble and tries his best to be considerate even towards folks he dislikes, such as Jirou.

name: Isuzu Sento
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3")

A royal guard who carries a magical muzzle-loader infused into her body, named Steinberger, who forces [Seiya Kanie](https://anilist.co/character/87971/Kanie-Seiya) to go on a "date" with her to Amagi Brilliant Park.

She has a stoic personality and rarely shows emotion, finding it difficult to smile or understand the jokes of others. Her upbringing as a royal guard resulted in a tendency to quickly resort to violence by threatening others or inflicting non-lethal damage to them with Steinberger. Behind her mask of stoicism and violence, she is actually quite sensitive. She was the manager of Amagi Brilliant Park before Seiya's arrival but was unfit for the position due to her disposition for violence, which led to the park's staff collectively fearing her. Her muzzle-loader can be summoned from any exposed skin due to the effects of it being magically infused into her body. She uses a variety of different ammunition, all with different effects. To name a few, she can remove a target's memory or cause a target great pain when hit by Steinberger.

name: Seiya Kanie
description:
Seiya is a perfectionist high school student who is mentally sharp, intelligent, has excellent reflexes, and acts like a prince to the point of being a narcissist, much to the annoyance of others. 

He was involved with the entertainment industry as a child, bearing the stage name Seiya Kodama. According to [Isuzu](https://anilist.co/character/87970/Sento-Isuzu), he was a child who would have made every adult/parent proud.

name: Latifa Fleuranza
native: ラティファ・フルーランザ
description: The princess and ruler of Amagi Brilliant Park. She is a very cheerful and positive girl often seen with a smile on her face. She cares deeply about the amusement park as she is seen being concerned about the future of the amusement park and willing to do anything in order to preserve it.

name: Moffle
description: A fairy of candies with the form of a mouse with a hat and Amagi Brilliant Park's main mascot who takes a mutual disliking towards Seiya. He is Latifah's uncle. His appearance resembles Bonta-kun, the fictional mascot from Full Metal Panic? Fumoffu.

name: Kobori
description: The fairy of earth of the fairies of Elementario. She usually has a stoic demeanor and has shown interest in BL.

name: Salama
description: The fairy of fire of the fairies of Elementario, who usually has a lazy and unmotivated personality when it comes to performing at the park. She seems to enjoy being on her phone when she is not performing and apparently engages in flaming wars.

name: Macaron
description: A fairy of music with the form of a sheep, and one of the park's mascots. He has a short temper. He has the artist air and often takes time off work if he is not feeling inspired. He plays the violin. He's divorced and fighting for the custody of his daughter.

name: Tiramie
description: A fairy of flowers with the form of a pink Pomeranian dog, and one of the park's mascots. He seems to be a pervert with a keen eye for young women and bewitching older women. He also seems to be knowledgeable about explosives.

name: Muse
