description: The fairy of water and the leader of the fairies of Elementario. Muse has a very energetic and cheerful personality and she is often seen with a smile on her face. Despite the lack of popularity of the Elementario, she still works hard. Of the four fairies, she is the best at singing. (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Sylphy
description: The fairy of wind of the fairies of Elementario. She is an airhead, but also the best at performing of the four.

name: Himiko
description:
She has a crush on [Sakamoto](https://anilist.co/character/49657/Sakamoto-Ryouta) and cooperates with him in the Btooom! game. 

Himiko always carried a stun gun where ever she goes because she is afraid of being touched by men. Yoshioka-senpai and [Mitsuo](https://anilist.co/character/84457/Akechi-Mitsuo) Akechi have both tried to rape her, eventually resulting in her fear for men, and she said that every man on the island is her enemy. However, she slightly changed her opinion, as she realized that Sakamoto is the only one on the island whom she could trust.

name: Ryouta Sakamoto
description:
__Height:__ 176 cm  
__Players Data:__ No.1  
__Works:__ None 
 __Home:__ Tokyo  
__Bim Type:__ Timer type  

Ryōta Sakamoto (坂本・竜太 Sakamoto Ryōta) is the protagonist of the manga Btooom!. He is one of the top ranking players of the Btooom! game and is the best player on Japan. He is ranked #10 worldwide. He has been nominated to participate in the real life Btooom! game.  He is a regular guy in his twenties. He is of average height and weight. He has light brown hair and brown eyes. He wears a dark gray, buttoned shirt and regular black pants. He also wears a black belt. As any other Btooom! player, he has an IC chip implanted into his left hand. Later on in the story, he wears a black, long-sleeve shirt with a circle design on it. Inside the circle is the word "Btooom!" and the phrase "Soldiers, be ambitious." As seen on the cover of Btooom! 06, the circle design is light blue and the text is white.

name: Hidemi Kinoshita
description: Hidemi is a selfish and frivolous Btooom! player who joins forces with Nobutaka until she is abandoned by him. She has a large forehead and is a cute 19 year old girl. Originally a famous model, she had a boyfriend who was an aspiring soccer star player, who was forced to quit from his career due to an injury. Following their break-up, she promised to keep in touch with him, but after one year without hearing from her, he commited suicide, with his family and several others blaming her for it, what certainly led one of them to nominate her.

name: Isamu Kondou
description:
__Height:__ 171 cm  
__Occupation:__ Middle School Teacher 
__Hometown:__ Tokyo 
__BIM Type:__ Cracker 

Kondou is one of the Btooom! players who constantly spoke his mind and argued with Masashi Miyamoto. Subsequently, he was killed by Masashi early in the game. Prior to his participation, he was a Middle School Teacher.

name: Masahito Date
description: Date was a doctor who worked at the same hospital as Shiki Murasaki.

name: Yuki
description: Formerly a friend of Himiko. She was beaten and raped by Yoshioka's friends after being drugged. As a result, she was forced to move away and partially responsible for Himiko's nomination.

name: Hisanobu Sakamoto
description:
__Hometown:__ Tokyo  

Hisanobu Sakamoto is Ryouta Sakamoto's stepfather and Yukie Sakamoto's husband.

name: Kiyoshi Taira
description:
__Height:__ 164 cm  
__Players Data:__ No. 4  
__Job:__ Real estate agent  
__Home:__ Osaka  
__Bim Type:__ Homing type  

Kiyoshi is first Ryouta's teammate and the first adult who he manages to get along with. He hates feeling alone and seems to be a pacifist person the first time they meet each other.    It was hinted that he was put up for nomination by his employees because of him mistreating them.   (Source: Otaku-streamers)

name: Miho
description: Formerly the best friend of Himiko.    (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Reiko Terajima
description: She is a chemistry teacher at Katagiri High School and the homeroom teacher of class 3-1.

name: Sakura Kouno
description:
__Height:__ 163 cm

She is the vice-president of the student council. She is very competent and often does​ support work.

name: Shin Yasuda
description:
__Occupation:__ English Teacher
__Affiliation:__ Student Council (Manager), Katagiri Senior High School

He is one of the supporting characters for [Horimiya](https://anilist.co/anime/124080/Horimiya/). Yasuda loves high school girls and makes no attempt to hide this either. However, he never actually touches any of the girls, just acts overly friendly towards them and overly cold towards the guys. He often demands that any guys with girlfriends (mainly [Miyamura](https://anilist.co/character/66173/Izumi-Miyamura) and [Sengoku](https://anilist.co/character/72447/Kakeru-Sengoku)) break up with them, so that he can have them instead. Any time he is with only male students, he constantly bemoans the fact, loudly asking why they, and not some girls, are there. He also does not tend to remember the names of his male students, saying that he has no need to learn useless information. Many of Yasuda's female students also like him as well, thinking he's a cool, young, good looking teacher who's kind to them. Many of them like to visit with him in the counseling room. Yasuda even went out of his way to tell [Kyouko Hori](https://anilist.co/character/66171) to keep her ‘chin up’, and his little known fact about him is that he’s into ‘flat-chested’ girls, in an attempt to cheer her up with ‘confidence’.

name: Honoka Sawada
description:
__Height:__ 150 cm

Sawada is a very clingy towards Kyouko Hori. Due to her attachment to Hori, she often gets angry when Hori is together with Izumi Miyamura, choosing to push him away. She views Miyamura as a love rival, but also as a brotherly figure. She was very close to her older brother who passed away some years ago. She also appears to have mild androphobia, often freezing up, running away, or hiding when approached by men. However, ever since she got to know Miyamura, she would hide behind him instead whenever a male approaches her. She is slowly getting used to being around Miyamura's male friends.

name: Takeru Sengoku
description: Takeru is [Kakeru](https://anilist.co/character/72447/Kakeru-Sengoku)'s father. He went to high school with [Kyousuke](https://anilist.co/character/89726/Kyousuke-Hori) and [Yuriko](https://anilist.co/character/78279/Yuriko-Hori).

name: Tooru Ishikawa
description:
__Height__: 174 cm

Tooru is friendly with everyone, and has a calm personality. He attends Katagiri Senior Highschool.

name: Ippanjin
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm (5'5")

She was just a regular girl, born in a regular family, worked like everyone else, and was leading a simple life. One misfortune after another got her involved in the crimes of Akudama. She’s a kind of person who doesn't get depressed, and she deals with problems optimistically.

name: Hakobiya
description:
__Height:__ 185 cm (6'1")
__Estimated Prison Sentence:__ 745 years

Courier grew up being forced to transport things by adults. He has confidence in his work and is somewhat of a workaholic. He doesn't speak often, but when he does, he has the right words for the situation. He has a habit of clicking his tongue, and his favorite food is takoyaki.

name: Kenkaya
description:
__Height:__ 200 cm
__Estimated Prison Sentence:__ 348 years

The Brawler is pure and straightforward. He believes that power is everything and doesn't care if he dies as long as he can fight strong enemies. He often fist bumps people and his favorite food is meat.

name: Hacker
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm
__Weight:__ 47 kg
__Estimated Prison Sentence:__ 589 years 

The Hacker is more excited the more difficult something is, but is completely apathetic to things he's uninterested in. He likes healthy jelly drinks.

name: Isha
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm
__Estimated Prison Sentence:__ 432 years

The Doctor is a mad scientist who toys with people's lives for fun. She has a calm demeanor and speaks philosophically. She has a habit of messing with her nails, and her favorite foods are wine and cheese.

name: Chinpira
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm
__Estimated Prison Sentence:__ 4 years

Chinpira is greedy and is involved with crimes for money. He tries to act bold, but ultimately, he's a coward who believes that "if you can't beat them, join them." However, thanks to his weakness, he can show consideration to his comrades. He's a pathological liar and likes ramen.

name: Satsujinki
description:
__Height:__ 185 cm (6'1")

An Akudama. His estimated prison sentence is 967 years.

Cutthroat's hobby is murder. Paradoxically, his usual behavior is innocent and almost childlike. He becomes unable to control his murderous impulses under certain conditions, especially when he sees the color red. Just simply seeing the color red makes him excited to the point of childlike giddiness. His favorite food is marshmallows and he has an extreme infatuation with [Swindler](https://anilist.co/character/163011/Ippanjin).

name: Kuroneko
description: The mysterious employer of the Akudama who speaks through a robotic black cat. They enlist the Akudama to rescue [Cutthroat](https://anilist.co/character/163013/Satsujinki) and later hijack the Shinkansen.

name: Imouto
description: A mysterious girl. She is quiet, with little self-assertion. She tends to hide behind her [brother](https://anilist.co/character/188625/Kuroneko).

name: Shokeika Deshi
description: A young woman in the Kansai Police Execution Division. She is burning to eliminate Akudama, but there are times when her ambition exceeds her abilities. She greatly looks up to and admires the [Execution Division Master](https://anilist.co/character/188623/Shokeika-Shishou) in charge of her.

name: Haru Katou
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm

Haru is a member of the Modern Crime Prevention Task Force's Metropolitan Police Department. He is a hot-blooded humanistic detective who hates dishonesty and bending. Originally, he belonged to Investigation Division 1 as a promising rookie, but after a siege incident where he misfired and the target was seriously injured, he was dropped from the division and moved to the current headquarters he's in at the start of the series.

name: Daisuke Kanbe
description:
__Height:__ 173 cm

Daisuke is a scion of the millionaire Kambe family. Utilizing abundant financial resources and the latest technology, he solves various cases in a semi-aggressive manner. He becomes a member of the Metropolitan Police Department's Modern Crime Prevention Task Force, and forms buddies with [Haru Kato](https://anilist.co/character/158385/Katou-Haru). However, he seems to have no ear to hear what Kato says.

name: Yukihiro  Kiyomizu
description:
__Zodiac:__ Capricorn
__Hair Color:__ Light Brown
__Eye Color:__ Yellow
__Height:__ 167 cm

Yukihiro is a member of the Metropolitan Police Department Modern Crime Prevention Task Force. He is a good boss watching his subordinates while tinkering with his hobby plastic model during his duties.

name: Shinnosuke Kamei
description:
__Height:__ 183 cm

Shinnosuke is a member of the Metropolitan Police Department Modern Crime Prevention Task Force. He works on his own pace, and his enthusiasm for work is not so strong.

name: Chosuke Nakamoto
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm

Chosuke is a member of the Metropolitan Police Department Modern Crime Prevention Task Force. He is a veteran detective that used to be in the Investigation division. He is highly respected by [Haru Katou](https://anilist.co/character/158385/Haru-Katou).

name: Ryou Hoshino
description:
__Height:__ 171 cm
__Base of Operations:__ Metropolitan Police Department (Headquarters, Investigation Division)

Ryo is a member of the Metropolitan Police Department's Investigation Division I.

name: Katsuhiro Takei
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm

Katsuhiro is a member of the Police Agency's "Investigation Division I." He is the chief of the Investigation Department, and takes the lead when it comes to field work. His subordinates carry a strong trust with him. He also cares about his former subordinate, [Haru Katou](https://anilist.co/character/158385/Haru-Katou).

name: Mahoro Saeki
description:
__Hair Color:__ Light Pink
__Eye Color:__ Light Brown
__Height:__ 153 cm

Mahoro is a member of the Metropolitan Police Department Modern Crime Prevention Task Force. She is the only woman in the current headquarters. She loves sweets and always checks for new work.

name: Teppei Yumoto
description:
__Hair Color:__ Dark Brown
__Height:__ 166 cm

Teppei is a member of the Metropolitan Police Department Modern Crime Prevention Task Force. He is a gambler who loves horse racing and boat racing.

name: Suzue Kanbe
description:
__Height:__ 171 cm (5'7")

A relative of [Daisuke](https://anilist.co/character/158386/Kanbe-Daisuke).

name: Prushka
description:
__Species__: Human

Prushka is the adoptive daughter of the White Whistle Delver [Bondrewd](https://anilist.co/character/122463/Bondrewd). She lives with him at the Forward Operation Base.

Prushka is a cheerful and amiable girl who loves her adoptive father very much. She is incredibly devoted to him and would do anything to help him, holding him in higher regard than anyone else. Having lived the majority of her life in the 5th layer, she developed a strong curiosity for exploring and was fascinated by tales of others' travels through the Abyss. She is adventurous and quite brave, going on her own adventures through the 5th layer behind her father's back.

Due to her horrible past and the influence of her father, she developed an amazing mental fortitude, and became very obstinate, to the point of being willing to challenge the curse of the 5th layer multiple times just to learn more about it.

appearsIn.title: Made in Abyss: Dawn of the Deep Soul
Made in Abyss: The Golden City of the Scorching Sun

name: Meinya
description:
**Race**: Meinastoirim

Meinya is [Prushka](https://anilist.co/character/122466/Prushka)'s pet given to her as a present from her adoptive father, [Bondrewd](https://anilist.co/character/122463/Bondrewd), as her 10th birthday present. Its name is a result of Prushka not being able to pronounce "Meinastilim" when it was given to her.



Meinya is a rabbit-sized creature called a Meinastilim, also known as a child of change. It has an oval-shaped body, stubby legs and feet, and large ears it uses to fly with. Its face is somewhat resemblant of a toad's as its pupils are slitted horizontally across the entire diameter of the eye. By sniffing Meinya's fur, [Riko](https://anilist.co/character/122443/Riko) and Prushka can navigate Ido Front without succumbing to the Curse.



(Source: Made in Abyss Wiki, edited)

appearsIn.title: Made in Abyss: Dawn of the Deep Soul

name: Gyarike
description: Gyarike is a member of the Umbra Hands, also known as Ashen Gyarike due to his flamethrower Artifact. Umbra Hands with white coats, like Gyarike, are combat types equipped with powerful Artifacts.

appearsIn.title: Made in Abyss: Dawn of the Deep Soul

name: Gueira
description: Gueira is a member of the Umbra Hands who is stationed at Ido Front. He was in charge of taking care of Prushka as a child.

appearsIn.title: Made in Abyss: Dawn of the Deep Soul

name: Kouki Furihata
description:
**Height:** 170 cm
**School:** Seirin High 
**Number:** #12 
**Position:** Point Guard

name: Teppei Kiyoshi
description:
__Height:__ 193 cm (6'3")
__School:__ Seirin High 
__Position:__ Center 
__Number:__ #7 
__Favorite Phrase:__ Let's have fun~  

The progenitor of Seirin's basketball team and its ace, Kiyoshi is the last of the original Seirin team members to be introduced, due to a hospitalization for a knee injury he got during a game. Rumored to be very capable, his preferred position is that of the point guard, but since their team lacked any other player with the body size to play center, he offered to fill that hole. On [Koganei](https://anilist.co/character/22255/Koganei-Shinji)'s suggestion, he apparently tries to play both, despite the inherent impossibility. While goofy nearly to the point of stupidity, he is very shrewd and is almost always plotting something, though it is rarely what others would inherently conclude. With a pair of big hands that allow him to grasp the ball in play single-handedly, Kiyoshi possesses immense ball-handling skills, and an uncanny sense of timing that allows him to make decisions on-court after his opponents have already reacted. He is renowned and even revered by many players in the realm of high-school basketball, and is one of the few players to have held his own against the Generation of Miracles during their peak.

name: Shougo Haizaki
description:
__Height:__ 188 cm
__School:__ Fukuda Sogo Academy
__Number:__ #6
__Position:__ Small Forward
__Skill:__ Skill Stealing

Haizaki was a regular of Teiko Middle, before being replaced by Kise,

Haizaki is very violent and ruthless, whether in real life or during basketball games. He was kicked out of the team by Akashi. When in Junior High school, his hair was longer, light gray and messy.

name: Akane Koganei
description: The hot-headed older sister of Shinji Koganei. She's shown to be frequently exasperated by Shinji's lack of commitment, and alongside Mitobe encourages him to keep playing basketball.

name: Eiji Shirogane
description:
Eiji Shirogane is the coach of Rakuzan High.

In his 40s, Shirogane is among the older coaches shown in the series and his age is apparent in his face. He has clean, black and straight swept-back hair and dresses in a black business suit; a white shirt and red tie.

He is shown to have a cold personality.
As evident from one of Rakuzan High's games, it seems he trusts Seijuro Akashi as captain to better decide what his teammates should do.

(Source: Kuroko no Basuke Wiki)

name: Ryouta Kise
description:
**Height:** 189 cm (6'2")
**School:** Teiko, Kaijou High
**Number:** #8 (Teiko), #7 (Kaijou)
**Position:** Small Forward
**Talent:** Copy

Now a freshman at Kaijou High, Kise was the rookie of the "Generation of Miracles". Since he only started playing basketball in his second year of middle school, Kise was his team's least experienced member, and notes himself the weakest of the five.

Kise's unique skill is his ability to mimic the moves and plays of other players. The only moves he cannot copy are the special skills of truly exceptional players, like the other members of the "Generation of Miracles". Beyond being a strong player in his own right, Kise respects [Kuroko](https://anilist.co/character/18769/Kuroko-Tetsuya)'s abilities and wishes to play with him once again. He seems to have a slight obsession with Kuroko, believing that they were the two who got along most in middle school (though Kuroko said they didn't) and often blurting out random facts about him (mentioning that Kuroko was an Aquarius, even though [Kasamatsu](https://anilist.co/character/42804/Kasamatsu-Yukio) was talking about [Midorima](https://anilist.co/character/22253/Midorima-Shintarou)).   Also, he's a model in his free time, so girls are always mobbing him.

name: Miko Yotsuya
description:
__Height:__ 160cm
__Family:__ [Mamoru Yotsuya](https://anilist.co/character/250703/Mamoru-Yotsuya) (Father), [Touko Yotsuya](https://anilist.co/character/199025/Touko-Yotsuya) (Mother), [Kyousuke Yotsuya](https://anilist.co/character/199026/Kyousuke-Yotsuya) (Younger Brother)

Miko has the ability to see frightening supernatural things that most people can't, but she pretends that she can't see them to avoid conflict. Her Spiritual-Awareness power overpowers her sight, like the reflection in glass is overpowering and you're unable to see what lies beyond it.

She tries to have a stoic exterior when confronted with spirits, but is internally frightened by them. She also cares deeply for her friend [Hana Yurikawa](https://anilist.co/character/139632/Hana-Yurikawa), using her power to protect her in various ways, such as diverting her from certain routes with spirits and bringing her food when she was sick with a form of spiritual drainage. Miko prefers to ignore the spirits and she denies seeing them whenever she is confronted by others for her talents.

name: Hana Yurikawa
description:
__Height:__ 156cm

[Miko's](https://anilist.co/character/139631) close friend. She is clueless of the supernatural terrors that afflict her friend, but she does unknowingly attract a lot of them due to her unusual amount of life energy.

name: Yulia Niguredou
description:
__Height:__ 140cm

An aspiring spirit medium who believes she's somewhat special because she has the power to see spirits. However, she doesn't know that she can only see lesser spirits, and misinterprets [Miko's](https://anilist.co/character/139631) attempts to protect her from the greater dangers she cannot see as acts of malice.

name: Junji Rousoku
description: *Parody of ghost story talk show host and personality Junji Inagawa (稲川淳二)*

name: Arai
description: Miko and Hana's teacher.

name: Kido
description: School nurse.

name: Matahachi Honiden
description: Hedonist and childhood friend of Musashi.

name: Musashi Miyamoto
description: Miyamoto Musashi or Shinmen Takezo (his real name), only at a very young age, embarked on a journey to become the strongest samurai only after being exiled from his own village. Musashi is the son of a samurai family, whose father is one of the most renowned samurai across the nation. One of the foremost reasons that drive Musashi to excel in sword-fighting, is his desire to overcome his father for all the harsh treatment given during his childhood and Musashi's incapability to rebel. Musashi is unique in terms of his sword skill for the unfamiliar movements and lack of style he uses. This is due to the fact that he spent most of his entire time in the forest having been labeled as a demon child by his village for his demeaning and wicked nature. Simply put, the forest and mountains are his home and where his master resides.

name: Kojirou Sasaki
description:
The legendary archrival of [Musashi Miyamoto](https://anilist.co/character/6194/Miyamoto-Musashi).

Raised by [Kanemaki Jisai](https://anilist.co/character/25810/Kanemaki-Jisai), after he is found as a baby in casket, floating on the ocean. He develops an intense attachment to swords and fencing at an early age, possessing an almost preternatural ability to react to his opponents' moves. Kojirou is deaf and mute, though still literate. His personality is very playful, almost child-like. [Ittousai](https://anilist.co/character/24309/Itou-Ittousai) has also commented on the possibility that Kojirou's eyes have become better developed to compensate for his lack of hearing.

name: Touji Gion
description: One of the senior disciples who appears to be Yoshioka Seijuurou’s right-hand man or at least, follows him around. Arrogant. Vowed to hunt down Musashi as a self-proclaimed assassin for the Yoshioka school. Considered to have a refined bloodthirst by Agon of Houzouin. Visits the Houzouin temple and cuts off the arms of one of the priests. After witnessing the battle between Musashi and Inshun, he leaves momentarily realizing his own weakness.

name: Ryouhei Ueda
description: He is a loyal member of the Yoshioka School and is loyal to Denshichiro Yoshioka.

name: Inei Houzouin
description: An elderly Buddhist monk, Houzouin Inei is the retired founder of the Houzouin spear technique. Quirky and wise by nature, Inei helps and trains Miyamoto Musashi in order to give Inshun -- the second-generation master of the Hōzōin spear technique -- the valuable experience of mortal combat.

name: Seijuro Yoshioka
description: Seijūrō Yoshioka is the current head of the Yoshioka, is considered a playboy due to his great time spent visiting the pleasure quarters to spend time with Akemi. Yoshioka Kempō’s oldest son. Follows his instincts, both in and outside of combat, carefree and easygoing, seems to take things haphazardly.

name: Ittousai Itou
description: Founder of the Itto-ryu school of sword fighting. Before establishing his own style, Ittousai is said to have studied a variant of the Chujo-ryu style of sword fighting under Kinemaki Jisai's instruction. He was a mentor of Sasaki Kojiro for a short time after Kojiro left the care of Jisai.

name: Denshichirou Yoshioka
description: Seijuurou's younger brother, though completely dedicated to his swordsmanship. Blames the school's dwindling reputation on account of Seijuurou's cavorting. He fought with Musashi at Rengeoin temple.

name: Inshun Hozoin
description: Originally named “Shinnosuke Mitsuda,” he witnessed the death of his father and mother Saya at the hands of a bandit at an early age. He was renamed to Inshun by In’ei. A child prodigy in spearmanship, Inshun withdrew within himself desiring to become stronger. By 15 he was the strongest at the temple. Realized the potential of Seijūrō at a young age when Yoshioka Kempō came to the Hōzōin temple. The second-generation master of the Hōzōin spear technique.    (Wikipedia)

name: Kotoko Iwanaga
description:
Kotoko is the main female protagonist in Kyokou Suiri and the current girlfriend of [Kuro Sakuragawa](https://anilist.co/character/125947/Kurou-Sakuragawa).

She has a very outgoing personality and always makes an effort to find the root of any problem, especially when she has the help of yokai. She is oblivious to danger and she tends to be very clingy when it comes to Kuro. Kotoko is a self-centered, unrepentant prankster, who enjoys poking fun at others expense, and is also a bit of a pervert. She is also shown to have a rather childish demeanor whenever she feels she is not given enough attention or proper treatment, which is aimed especially at Kuro, to whom she can be very pushy.

Contrasting with her mischief belies a cunning individual, well worth her epithet of "Goddess of Wisdom", demonstrating a calculating intelligence that borders in almost diabolical precision and frightening acute. Although she is a terrible liar to her peers, she is a highly manipulative, convincing liar while at work, being able to fool both ancient yokai and a multitude of online fanatics with terrifying accuracy.

At the young age of 11, Kotoko Iwanaga was abducted by yokai for two weeks and asked to become their "God of Wisdom," a mediator between the spirit and human worlds, to which the girl quickly agreed but at the cost of her right eye and left leg. After what happened, whenever yokai wish for their problems to be solved, they make their way to Kotoko for consultation.

name: Kurou Sakuragawa
description:
Kuro is the main male protagonist of Kyokou Suiri (In/Spectre) and the current boyfriend of [Kotoko Iwanaga](https://anilist.co/character/125946). He has supernatural powers of immortality and precognition.

Kuro is quiet and tends to be very nonconfrontational, barely even taking notice of his own injuries. He is uncaring about his own safety due to his healing abilities.

name: Saki Yumihara
description:
Saki is [Kurou Sakuragawa](https://anilist.co/character/125947)'s former girlfriend. She works as a traffic division officer at the local police department.

She is a mature young woman who likes to think things through rationally but is easily scared by yokai.

(Source: Kyokou Suiri Wiki)

name: Rikka Sakuragawa
description: Rikka is [Kurou Sakuragawa](https://anilist.co/character/125947)'s older cousin and the reason he visited the hospital as regularly as he did. Just like Kuro, she also has the powers of immortality and precognition, although she wants them to be removed and has tried medical science and suicide to no avail.

name: Aoi Tanio
description:
Aoi Tanio is a woman convicted of murder and the reason that Guardian Serpent of Tsukana Swamp requested the help of Kotoko Iwanaga in Chapter 15 of the Manga and Episode 2 of the Anime.

She is the main suspect of a murder for disposing a dead body into the Tsukuna Swamp. Furthermore, the serpent claims to have heard her utters: "I really hope they find it," after disposing the body.

name: Basara Toujou
description: Toujou Basara is an ex-member of the Hero-clan. He lives with his two step sisters who are both Demons. Basara is determined no matter what to protect [Naruse](https://anilist.co/character/89158/Naruse-Mio) from anyone wanting to cause harm to her.

appearsIn.title: The Testament of Sister New Devil
The Testament of Sister New Devil BURST

name: Mio Naruse
description:
__Height:__ 156 cm

Mio is a beautiful young girl of average height, with long waist-length red hair and violet eyes. She is noted for having a distinctly voluptuous body for someone her age. Mio has been seen wearing a number of outfits throughout the series, with several casual attires at home that are usually form-fitting or revealing, as well as a uniform for attending school. After forming a contract with [Basara](https://anilist.co/character/89157/Toujou-Basara), Mio gains a choker-like tattoo around her throat which takes the appearance of a love heart with two prongs extending around either side of her neck.

Mio normally displays a calm demeanor, preferring to remain quiet when around others; however, she is prone to outbursts when faced with inappropriate situations such as finding erotic magazines underneath Basara's bed or being left at the mercy of [Maria](https://anilist.co/character/89160/Naruse-Maria)'s succubus curse. Despite this, she is also caring and affectionate, genuinely appreciate Basara's kind treatment and protection as well as feeling uncomfortable about having to deceive innocent people. Deep down she is afraid of her current situation and constantly being under threat, but when faced with danger she won't hesitate to face the challenge.

appearsIn.title: The Testament of Sister New Devil
The Testament of Sister New Devil BURST

name: Yuki Nonaka
description:
__Height:__ 163 cm

Yuki is a member of the Hero Clan who watches over Mio Naruse. She is also Basara's childhood friend.

appearsIn.title: The Testament of Sister New Devil
The Testament of Sister New Devil BURST

name: Maria Naruse
description:
Maria is Mio's sister and guardian.

She is a rather childish person and likes teasing people no matter how serious the situation is. Despite this, she can be dead serious as seen when she revealed her real identity to Basara.

appearsIn.title: The Testament of Sister New Devil
The Testament of Sister New Devil BURST

name: Jin  Toujou
description: Jin Toujou is the father of [Basara Toujou](https://anilist.co/character/89157/Toujou-Basara) and is a living legend among the Hero Clan renown as the War God.

appearsIn.title: The Testament of Sister New Devil

name: Shella
description: Shella is Maria and Lucia's mother.

appearsIn.title: The Testament of Sister New Devil

name: Kurumi Nonaka
description:
A Hero and the sister of [Yuki Nonaka](https://anilist.co/character/89159/Nonaka-Yuki). She is also an Element Master.

Kurumi is a petite, young girl who is surprisingly developed for her age. She has blue violet hair held up in a ponytail by a white scrunchy and yellow eyes like her sister. Her battle outfit tightly wraps around her slim figure and is the typical attire for female Heroes which is a navy blue leotard with a black collar and a white skirt. Kurumi chooses to wear short tights underneath and her limbs are covered by her Spirit Armor with her Spirit Gauntlet on her left hand.

appearsIn.title: The Testament of Sister New Devil
The Testament of Sister New Devil BURST

name: Zest
description: Zest is a Demon who originally served her creator, the Demon marquis Zolgear, as his aide.

appearsIn.title: The Testament of Sister New Devil
The Testament of Sister New Devil BURST

name: Chisato Hasegawa
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm

Chisato Hasegawa is the school nurse of Hijirigasaka Academy and a magic user. Originally she is one of the Ten Gods from the divine realm. At first, she acts as Basara's mentor often providing him with advice. Eventually, they develop a romantic relationship.

appearsIn.title: The Testament of Sister New Devil
The Testament of Sister New Devil BURST

name: Anna Yamada
description:
__Height:__ 171 cm (5'8")
__Occupation:__ Middle School Student (Second Year)

Yamada Anna is the main heroine of the story and is the classmate and love interest of [Ichikawa Kyoutarou](https://anilist.co/character/174191/Kyoutarou-Ichikawa). She is also an airhead who is pretty and very immature besides her looks.

She is a magazine model and actress. She is very popular with both boys and girls but has a clumsy side to her. Anna frequently snacks in the library, much to Kyoutarou's dismay. She is also shown to be very jealous to the point of obsession whenever Kyoutarou interacts with other girls.

appearsIn.title: The Dangers in My Heart Season 2

name: Kyoutarou Ichikawa
description:
__Height:__ 156.5 cm (5'2")
__Occupation:__ Middle School Student (Second Year)
__Twitter:__ https://twitter.com/thanatos_moros

Ichikawa is the protagonist of the story Boku no Kokoro no Yabai Yatsu and a classmate of  [Yamada Anna](https://anilist.co/character/174190/Anna-Yamada). He at the beginning of the manga is a gloomy, antisocial, sadistic boy and eager to kill his classmates, but in reality he is a kind boy with an incredibly low self-esteem, reaching the point where he believes that the people feel disgusted with the simple fact of being by his side, but the only person who does not think that of him is Yamada.

appearsIn.title: The Dangers in My Heart Season 2

name: Kana Ichikawa
description: [Kyoutarou](https://anilist.co/character/174191/)'s older sister.

appearsIn.title: The Dangers in My Heart Season 2

name: Chihiro Kobayashi
description: Anna's best friend.

appearsIn.title: The Dangers in My Heart Season 2

name: Moeko Sekine
description: Another of Anna's close friends. The loudest and most energetic of Anna's circle.

appearsIn.title: The Dangers in My Heart Season 2

name: Xylo Forbartz
native: ザイロ・フォルバーツ
description: The former captain of the Federated Kingdom's Fifth Order of the Holy Knights and the now de facto leader of Penal Hero Unit 9004. He was sentenced to be a hero for the crime of killing the goddess [Senerva](https://anilist.co/character/387992/Senerva). He would later meet and reluctantly make a contract with [Teoritta](https://anilist.co/character/355726), the "Goddess of Swords".

name: Teoritta
description: The Sword Goddess who made a contract with [Xylo](https://anilist.co/character/355722/Xylo-Forbartz). She summons numerous swords, including holy swords and demon swords. While possessing a high sense of self-worth and a fondness for being praised, she also exhibits a characteristic goddess-like trait of engaging in self-sacrificing actions.

name: Dotta Luzulas
description: An unparalleled petty thief, responsible for over a thousand thefts. He impulsively attempts to steal anything, from the Goddess's coffin to completely meaningless objects, and possesses the skill to actually steal anything. He has excellent low-light vision and is sensitive to presences, but is extremely timid.

name: Venetim Leopool
native: ベネティム・レオプール
description: The commander of the Punisher Heroes Squad 9004. He is a rare conman who attempted to sell off the royal palace to a circus. His eloquence and deception skills make him appear competent at first glance, but in reality he's a weakling with no guts. He always delivers "bad news" in a hurry.

name: Norgalle Senridge
native: ノルガユ・センリッジ
description: A terrorist who believed himself to be the true king of the United Kingdom and carried out a large-scale terrorist act against the royal family. Nicknamed "His Majesty." Although he displays an arrogant attitude, his concern for his people is genuine. He possesses exceptional talent in the art of Sacred Seal Tuning, which engraves sacred symbols.

name: Patausche Kivia
native: パトーシェ・キヴィア
description: Captain of the 13th Holy Knights. She was originally supposed to make a pact with the Goddess [Teoritta](https://anilist.co/character/355726/Teoritta). She is a serious and righteous holy knight, but can also be strict and harsh in her words. She is willing to sacrifice her own life and the life of the hero for the Goddess.

name: Tsav
description: A former elite assassin raised by an assassination cult. He possesses supernatural-level sniping abilities, but during his time as an assassin, he would develop empathy for his targets, preventing him from killing them, and would instead turn innocent people into "mincemeat" to cover up his losses. He's easygoing and talkative, and loves gambling.

name: Tatsuya
description: A berserker who has been a member of the Hero Squad longer than anyone else. Because he has been resurrected as a hero so many times, he has lost his sense of self and the ability to think, and is unable to speak. His true identity and everything else about him are shrouded in mystery. His close combat abilities are monstrous, and he wields a giant battle axe as easily as a kitchen knife.

name: Jayce Patiract
native: ジェイス・パーチラクト
description: A dragoon who rides a dragon and soars through the skies as the unit's aerial force. He is also skilled in spearmanship. Not only can he communicate with dragons, but he also has an abnormally endearing disposition. He himself is only interested in dragons and is unfriendly towards humans.

name: Neely
description: A female dragon who races alongside [Jayce](https://anilist.co/character/375408/Jayce-Patiract) on the battlefield. She possesses vibrant blue scales and can unleash powerful flames from her mouth. Because Jayce is loved by the dragon, she can sometimes become jealous and upset. According to Jayce, her dark eyes and strong will are her charms.

name: Phosphophyllite
native: フォスフォフィライト
description:
**Hardness**: 3.5 

The main protagonist and the youngest gem when the story began. They're weak, brittle - not suited for battle - and their clumsiness makes them difficult to maintain any roles, even though they've always wanted to be useful. Phos' initial job was to make a natural history encyclopedia which they progressed very little on. They promised to help [Cinnabar](https://anilist.co/character/123384/Cinnabar) find a job suited for them as well.

Phos is a young, overconfident, clumsy, and naive gem, who is the only one capable of getting away with talking back to [Kongou](https://anilist.co/character/123394/Kongou). Many gems describe them as lazy and useless due to their fragility and incompetence, although Phos does display a drive to help Sensei and the others, often held back by their low hardness. There is an underlying way of how Phos acts and speaks about themselves that hints at them taking the “useless” and “lazy” comments to heart, and impacting their self-esteem. These facts indicate that Phos may have something of an inferiority complex. They settle with what they can do and constantly state that they will try better next time. Phos displays a change of personality over the course of the series, mainly due to maturing, trauma, and outside influences. This is mainly due to the fact that the gems are not equipped to deal with trauma.

name: Shinsha
description:
**Hardness**: 2

The only gem who goes on night patrol. Due to their body producing Mercury (which is harmful to gems and living things), they are isolated and insecure. They hate fighting and hate to be seen.

According to [Rutile](https://anilist.co/character/123399/Rutile), Cinnabar has an extraordinary amount of talent and combat ability, but is too much to handle due to their uncontrollable poison. Cinnabar's silver poison gathers faint light at night, which keeps them awake and aware while night patrolling. According to [Kongou](https://anilist.co/character/123394/Kongou), the night patrol is something Cinnabar came up with themselves. They used to spend their time during the day in Hollow Cape, waiting for the Lunarians to take them since they thought they may at least be of use to them. They are knowledgeable about things other gems don't know about.

[Phosphophyllite](https://anilist.co/character/123385/Phosphophyllite) was recommended by the gems to see Cinnabar for the encyclopedia. After accidentally hearing their secret and wish, Phos promises to help Cinnabar find a job more suited to them than night patrol, saying, "a fun job only you can do." When encountering Phos each time, Cinnabar seems doubtful of their words, but they are the only gem they regularly speak to. Although they try not to show it, they have a tiny sliver of hope that Phos will be able to fulfill their promise.

Cinnabar is able to pull out an abundant amount of mercury.

name: Kongou
description:
**Hardness:** Unknown

Kongou is the teacher of the lustrous. He has a vast amount of knowledge and has the power to drive away the Lunarians with a single attack.

Normally, Kongou is quiet and stoic. When he speaks, he is straightforward and concise. He only rarely displays emotions, but this is rumored to be because he is deliberately hiding them and that his face would be very easy to read otherwise. On the rare occasions where he shows humor, he is still as deadpan as ever. Kongou cares for the Gems considerably and blames himself when they are injured or taken away by the Lunarians.

name: Diamond
description:
**Hardness**: 10

One of the gems who mainly does patrol duty. They're partners with [Bort](https://anilist.co/character/123389/Bort). Despite Diamond's high offensive power, their toughness is second-rate and easily broken. The other gems consider them lovely and a top fashion model.

Diamond is friendly, kind, and gentle. They appear to be relatively calm during battle, even when their situation isn't good. However, they are actually insecure and frustrated with their current body which, though being the hardest, shatters easily. They dislike being compared to Bort, although they admire their younger sibling a lot. They are perceptive regarding gems' inner feelings and relationships, though [Cinnabar](https://anilist.co/character/123384/Cinnabar) accuses them of seeing everything as some kind of romance. Despite Diamond's more gentle nature, they're very stubborn and tend to fight until they shatter. From Bort's point of view, Diamond is extremely reckless.

name: Bort
description:
__Hardness:__ 10

One of the gems who mainly does patrol duty. They're partners with [Diamond](https://anilist.co/character/123390/Diamond). Bort is a diamond-class gem whose hardness and toughness are top level. They are a calm yet ruthless warrior who excel at battles and are obsessed with combat. The other gems call them a "battle maniac".

Bort is an efficient and analytic fighter, often pointing out the flaws in the other gems' tactics in a blunt and straightforward manner. This causes them to be seen as cold and scary to the others, but also to be respected, looked up to, and seen as reliable. Despite their harsh personality, they do have a softer side.

name: Rutile
description:
**Hardness**: 6

A gem who works as a doctor. They repair cracked or broken gems and handle the management of herbs, pastes, powders, and other medical remedies. They are partners with the unstable [Padparadscha](https://anilist.co/character/124485/Padparadscha), whose body is actively being maintained. Besides repairs, Rutile is responsible for carrying out regular physical checkups and applying powder and saltwater resin to the gems' bodies.

Rutile is a workaholic takes their job very seriously. They are known to stay up all night if needed to put a gem back together. As a result, they are often tired and will take naps during the day. They are also a bit eccentric and sarcastic, and to take great pride in their job and research. They don't take well to having their medical authority questioned. Even so, they become easily embarrassed when pestered about things like love.

They are very close to Padparadscha. Hundreds of thousands of failed operations to fix them have not made them lose hope. They believe they cannot be called a doctor if they cannot solve Padparadscha's condition. They are extremely dedicated, bordering on obsessed with this task.

name: Alexandrite
description:
__Hardness:__ 8.5

A gem who works as an expert on the Lunarians. They are studious and passionate about this work, being referred to as a "Lunarian research maniac" by the other gems. They even draw original Lunarian designs sometimes. However, despite being a Lunarian researcher, Alexandrite is forbidden from looking at or engaging with them. This is because they have a condition where, when they look at Lunarians, they have a chance of turning into "Red Alex". In this mode, their color changes from blue to red, and they go berserk, becoming obsessed with just cutting down anything in their way until they eventually pass out.

Alex originally started researching Lunarians for two reasons: one, to overcome their condition, and two, in order to retain the "fresh feeling of hatred" they have for the Lunarians as a result of their former partner, [Chrysoberyl](https://anilist.co/character/393647/Chrysoberyl), being taken by them.

When referred to with honorifics, Alexandrite hates being called Alex-san, preferring the cuter Alex-chan. This is changed to Alexi and Lexi in the official English translation.

name: Antarcticite
description:
__Hardness:__ 3

Antarcticite is the gem assigned to winter duty while the others hibernate. Due to their crystal composition, Antarc "sleeps" in liquid form when it is above room-temperatures, and re-crystallizes when the temperature drops. The colder the temperature, the harder they become.

Antarc is a perfectionist who acts like a soldier, marching and speaking with extreme formality. They are used to working alone, as all the other gems hibernate during the winter. Despite their usual cold attitude, Antarc has a soft side, and they love [Kongou](https://anilist.co/character/123394/Kongou) more than anything, often breaking their usual icy demeanor around him. They do not like to openly show this softer side though, becoming extremely embarrassed when [Phos](https://anilist.co/character/123385/Phosphophyllite) sees them like that.

name: Amethyst 33
description:
__Hardness:__ 7

A gem who mainly does patrol duty. They are partners with their identical twin, [Amethyst 84](https://anilist.co/character/123387/Amethyst-84).

The twins work in tandem for most things, often talking at the same time or finishing each other's sentences. No one really cares which is which anymore, including themselves. Because twin gems won't break by touching each other, the Amethysts have a habit of clanging their heads together, much to the chagrin of the other gems.

name: Amethyst 84
description:
__Hardness:__ 7

A gem who mainly does patrol duty. They are partners with their identical twin, [Amethyst 33](https://anilist.co/character/209228).

The twins work in tandem for most things, often talking at the same time or finishing each other's sentences. No one really cares which is which anymore, including themselves. Because twin gems won't break by touching each other, the Amethysts have a habit of clanging their heads together, much to the chagrin of the other gems.

name: Tatsu
description: An ex-yakuza who now lives peacefully as a househusband.

name: Miku
description: Tatsu's wife. A graphic designer who loves Policure

name: Masa
description: Tatsu's former subordinate.

name: Kumichou
description: Tatsu's former yakuza boss.

name: Urita
description: Urita is a door-to-door salesman who sells fishy products.

name: Torajirou
description: Torajirou was part of a yakuza gang that had a rivalry with Tatsu. He became a food truck owner after serving time in prison.

name: Hibari Torii
description: Boss lady of the Tori Clan. Currently employed in a supermarket to maintain income after the loss of her husband, the former Tori Clan leader

name: Murdoch Swan
description: The Economics Teacher and the Housemaster of Dormitory 2, Cline Hall at Eden Academy. He is the only son of the former Headmaster of Eden Academy. His wife filed for divorce a month before the Eden Academy admissions interview, where she won full custody of their only daughter.

name: Melinda Desmond
native: メリンダ・デズモンド
description: Mother to [Damian](https://anilist.co/character/150424/) and wife to [Donovan](https://anilist.co/character/180192/)

name: Gerald Gorey
native: ジェラルド・ゴーリー
description: Gerald Gorey is the the Chief Medical Director of the Berlint General Hospital where Twilight works at, as Loid Forger. He possesses an immense jealousy towards Loid due to his popularity as a therapist within the hospital and his proximity with Fiona Frost, who Gorey has a crush on.

name: Akane Mizuno
description:
Student of class 3-1 who belongs to the track and field club. She's an easy going character, but can be self-conscious and timid at times. When feeling nervous, she would squeeze her potato mascot plushie. Akane moved to Kawagoe, Saitama when she was a fifth grader in Primary school. 



(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Kotarou Azumi
description: Student of class 3-1 who belongs to the literature club. He's aiming to become a novelist and is inspired by Osamu Dazai & Natsume Soseki who are both Japanese novelists. He generally has a calm and composed attitude. He initially is too embarrassed to show his novels to other people, but upon learning Akane's love for running and openness to use embarrassment as a method of improving oneself, he begins to open up to that prospect. From early childhood, Kotarou has received instruction in the performance of traditional dance and festival music accompaniment, Hayashi, at a local Shinto shrine.

name: Junko Azumi
description: Azumi's mother

name: Takeshi Kitamura
description: An editor working for ABC Publishing.

name: Kurama
description:
Kurama is first encountered in the series at the same time as Hiei. His ability is in manipulating plants, and he generally wields a whip created from a rose vine, complete with thorns. He is one of the wiser characters in the series and the smartest and calmest of the four main characters.

Kurama is generally regarded as the most calm and level-headed member of the group. His analytical nature is present in battle where he prefers to study the strengths and weaknesses of his opponents before devising a strategy of his own.  He is protective of those he cares about and is often merciless to anyone that poses them a threat, a shift in his usually friendly manner. In many instances, Kurama has shown to be very self-sacrificing in the interests of the safety of his friends and family.  

Fox Demon Kurama/Youko Kurama was a cold hearted and ruthless thief and the most feared bandit in Makai. He was considered to be an A-class demon (though he eventually surpasses that), and is said to be more than a thousand years old. After being wounded by a bounty hunter while in his spirit fox form, Kurama sent his spirit into the Ningenkai (human world) where his spirit took refuge within an unborn child that had not yet gained a soul. It was from this point that Kurama made the transfer to a human body with the intention to recover his strength as the child developed. Kurama planned to leave Ningenkai to return to Makai after regaining his strength after an estimated ten years.

name: Hiei
description:
Hiei is a main character in Yu Yu Hakusho, a demon who prefers to keep his distance from others. Because of this he often comes across as aloof and elusive. He has a rather cynical and even misanthropic view of the world around him, often belittling and mocking humans and their emotions and the significance they place on friendship and life.

Hiei is the shortest of the four main characters at only 147 cm (4'10) during the Dark Tournament as stated by [Juri](https://anilist.co/character/8717/). Despite his short size, he has a lean, muscular build to him. He wears a white headband that conceals his Jagan Eye, which is placed on his forehead and has a purple iris. His eyes are crimson, with an angular and slightly slanted shape, giving him a very sinister look in the beginning of the series. He has spiky black hair with blue outlining and white streaks. His skin complexion is regular peach-tan. Living up to his classic villainous persona, Hiei usually dresses entirely in black.

__Trivia:__
- Hiei was based on the character Skunky from [Patalliro!](https://anilist.co/anime/2835/)

(Source: Yu Yu Hakusho Wiki)

name: Kazuma Kuwabara
description:
Kuwabara, as most people call him, is the second-toughest kid in Sarayashiki Junior High School and is always trying to usurp [Yusuke Urameshi](https://anilist.co/character/729/Urameshi-Yuusuke)'s position as the toughest. In the manga(chp.1) he says he never lost a fight until he met Yusuke. He leads a gang consisting of himself, [Kirishima](https://anilist.co/character/9591/Kirishima), [Okubo](https://anilist.co/character/8641/Okubo), and [Sawamura](https://anilist.co/character/8640/Sawamura) (In the English dub, Komada). He has a soft spot for kittens (including his own, Eikichi) and an iron code of honor. He develops a minor crush on [Botan](https://anilist.co/character/734/Botan) when he first meets her, but later harbors intense feelings on the ice apparition [Yukina](https://anilist.co/character/736/Yukina), but is unaware that she is [Hiei](https://anilist.co/character/732/Hiei)'s sister.

Kuwabara has a tough older sister named [Shizuru Kuwabara](https://anilist.co/character/8595/Kuwabara-Shizuru). She and Yukina are the only characters known to call him by his given name. In the anime, Kazuma and Shizuru's parents never appear and are rarely, if ever, even acknowledged. His father does makes a brief appearance in the final volume of the manga to reveal that Yukina is going to be living with them and appears to be aware of the Reikai, etc.

name: Yuusuke Urameshi
description:
The main protagonist of the manga and anime series YuYu Hakusho.

He is a Spirit Detective who is tasked with protecting the Human World from various supernatural threats over the course of the series and his closest friends, as well as greatest allies, include [Kuwabara](https://anilist.co/character/730/Kuwabara-Kazuma), [Kurama](https://anilist.co/character/731/Kurama), [Hiei](https://anilist.co/character/732/Hiei), [Keiko](https://anilist.co/character/733/Yukimura-Keiko), [Genkai](https://anilist.co/character/735/Genkai), [Koenma](https://anilist.co/character/2305/Koenma) and [Botan](https://anilist.co/character/734/Botan). He is also the de facto leader of Team Urameshi and the general person to look to when the going gets tough.

At the start of the series, Yusuke is an uncontrollable teenage delinquent/street fighter with little to no positive qualities to his character. Over the course of the series, he starts becoming a better person, changing into an almost altruistic defender of the Human World while he himself continues to become a powerful martial artist.

(Source: Yu Yu Hakusho Wiki)

name: Fubuki Sato
description: Kuroko's eight-year old daughter. Both children prefer their mother's original surname and address each other as such, however their true surname is Sato.

name: Rishou
description: The dishonorable leader of the Shadow Channelers (Team Masho), he cheats to advance his team in the tournament and isn't above attacking his own teammates if they disagree with him. His attacks are based around earth, Armor of Clay (a defense and offense raise), and Spiked Armor of Clay (another boost), as well as a general control of the earth around him. He loses to a badly injured Kuwabara when Yukina arrives, motivating Kuwabara to unleash his spirit energy. Upper C class demon.

name: Shishiwakamaru
description: Shishiwakamaru is a member of the Fractured Fairy Tales in the Dark Tournament. His name is a take on Ushiwakamura, a famous historic general, whose exploits are recounted in Noh theater. The Cape of No Return is based on a Hagoromo, also famous in Noh plays. Shishiwakamaru is first introduced as one of the most sadistic and evil characters in YuYu Hakusho, and enjoys killing and fighting. As a hater of justice, in his own words "Violence is [his] meat, and wickedness [his] ambrosia," and he has no use for hypocritical "pacifists". Shishiwakamaru, however, is at times shown to be a protagonist, although he usually does so for reasons gaining towards him, very similar to Hiei. Shishiwakamaru, as shown in the Dark Tournament, has a very large amount of female fans, affectionately calling him "Waka," and he explains he fought in the Dark Tournament to please his fans. He is one of the few demons from the Dark Tournament to reappear again after the saga. Shishiwakamaru is the owner of the Cape of No Return, which sends whatever it touches to anywhere, even another dimension. His main weapon is his blade, the Banshee Shriek, which has the power to steal other souls and release them as either attacks or defenses.  He first fights Kuwabara and uses an item called the Cape of No Return. He then fights against Genkai.

name: Raizen
description: The strongest of the Three Kings, the God of War, and the strongest character in the series. Raizen, however, was injured in battle and nursed back to life by a human who he fell in love with and impregnated with his baby. Raizen vowed to never eat another human again until he saw her again, though she died before he could, and, keeping his promise, went on starving himself for hundreds of years, and his power decreased as his hunger grew. The family line of the witch doctor continued into Yusuke Urameshi. Just minutes before starving to death, Raizen still had enough strength to fight evenly with S-Class warriors. Raizen possessed Yusuke during his battle with Sensui, and with Raizen's help Yusuke defeated Sensui. Raizen then tells Yusuke to train relentlessly for months so he will surpass Raizen and gain his kingdom before he dies, but Raizen dies before Yusuke surpasses him, Yusuke still gains Raizen's kingdom.

name: Shizuru Kuwabara
description: Kazuma Kuwabara's tough older sister. Like her younger brother she also has a high level of Reiki sensitivity and is extremely strong; Shizuru, in the beginning of the manga, has more of a sixth sense than her brother. Shizuru, 17 at the start of the manga, wants Kazuma to grow up and get an education so he can make something of himself. Shizuru, an aspiring beautician, gives Keiko her new haircut after Keiko rescues Yusuke from the burning house in Chapter 13: Qualifications for a Girlfriend. Shizuru is also a chain smoker and the biggest part she plays in the anime series is during the Dark Tournament (Ankoku Būtsukai) where she falls in love with Sakyo, the owner of Team Urameshi's rival team, Team Toguro. He saves her life twice, but she is unaware of his true identity until the end. She also knows Yukina's connection to Hiei because she saw a videotape that provided the details for the mission that Yusuke and Kuwabara had to rescue Yukina from Gonzo Tarukane (only she, Botan, and Yusuke saw the details that Yukina is Hiei's sister). Like Keiko, she is a woman who is unafraid to speak her mind or deliver a beat-down where needed. She even yells out to Toguro during the Dark Tournament when he goes up to face Yusuke. Shizuru also appears in the Chapter Black and Three Kings saga.

name: Hokushin
description: One of Raizen's Generals. His spirit class is in the S level and he has the ability to convert his body into a puddy-like substance, making it extremely difficult to attack or even hurt him.

name: Alas Ramus
description: Alas Ramus is the appointed daughter of Sadao Maou and Emi Yusa.

appearsIn.title: The Devil is a Part-Timer! Season 2

name: Mayumi Kisaki
description: She is Maou's immediate superior at MgRonalds where he works.

appearsIn.title: The Devil is a Part-Timer! Season 2

name: Miki Shiba
description:
**Miki** is the landlord at the place the Devil King stays, "Villa Rosa Sasazuka". She requested that her apartment be rented out to "shady characters" such as Maou and Alciel. She seems to have some knowledge of Ente Isla.



(Source: Hataraku Maou-sama Wikia)

appearsIn.title: The Devil is a Part-Timer! Season 2

name: Rika Suzuki
description: Emi's coworker.

appearsIn.title: The Devil is a Part-Timer! Season 2

name: Vincent Law
description: An immigrant from Mosko working for Romdo's AutoReiv Control Division within the Temporary Immigrant Sector FG set up to hunt and dispose infected AutoReivs. Vincent appears driven to become a Model Citizen, but ultimately fails to suppress the burden of his traumatic past and flees from Romdo. He has a romantic interest in [Re-l Mayer](https://anilist.co/character/643/Mayer-Rel).

name: Re-l Mayer
description:
Embodiment of the no-nonsense personality, Inspector Re-l Mayer of the Citizen Intelligence Bureau is in charge of investigating a series of brutal murders apparently committed by AutoReivs infected with the Cogito virus. She is also the granddaughter of Donov Mayer, the Regent of Romdo. Given her privileged status, she expects respect from people around her, and speaks as such (she addresses Vincent as "o-mae"). 

Re-l accompanies Vincent on his journey in order to learn more about the mysterious Proxies, but having been living in comfortable conditions and being spoilt by Iggy all her life, she finds the "outdoor hiking" experience increasingly unbearable, and throws tantrums at both of them (often with comical effects). During the period that they get stranded without wind, she passes time by taking the both of them as study subjects. Her narration reveals her to be a very analytical person. Re-l is a young woman who wears black clothes, has black hair and is known for her blue eyeshadow. She eventually comes to share Vincent's feelings, but shows it subtly.

name: Pino
description: An infected Companion AutoReiv with a bubbly personality, she was owned by Raul Creed and Samantha Ross, Pino served as a surrogate child to the couple (in fact, in episode 19, everyone in the smile land gets so shocked that she is able to smile so "naturally", which is reasonable since she is "infected" with a soul. With the humanity within her, she then proceeds, under the request of all the friends she made in Smile Land, to save Smile Land from impending destruction upon Vincent's arrival). She was scheduled for decommissioning after the Creeds were granted a real baby son by the government, but the untimely deaths of Samantha and her new son prompted Pino to flee Romdo. Although she seems to be the AutoReiv that closely resembles a human child full of curiosity, it is ironic that she starts off without a clue about human death, nor understand that the emotion she feels right then is called loneliness (She knows that Timothy has died, but wonders if there is another Timothy to play with her). She becomes very attached to Vincent and accompanies him on his journey; she calls him "Vince" and occasionally throws her "tantrums" at him.

name: Iggy
description: An Entourage AutoReiv belonging to Re-l Mayer,

name: Raul Creed
description: The newly appointed Director-General of the Citizen Security Bureau, who reports directly to the Regent. He and his wife took Pino as a surrogate child prior to the beginning of the series. Initially loyal to the system, he comes to despise the ruling order responsible for the city's slow decay and lashes out destructively. His mentality also slowly degenerates, as he frequently has hallucinations of a smirking Vincent Law close by.

name: Kristeva
description: Raul Creed's Entourage AutoReiv, Kristeva carries out her duties to Raul loyally. She later takes up the role of being Pino's guardian, per Raul's request.

name: Daedalus Yumeno
description: Chief physician leading the Proxy Research Team, Director of the Division of Health and Welfare, and Re-l Mayer's personal physician. Daedalus displays a strange obsession in Re-l Mayer. He has two Entourages, Deleuze and Guattari.

name: Monad Proxy
description: Creator and Supervisor of Mosko Dome; Proxy Thirteen. Entrusted with the memories of Ergo Proxy. Killed by Ergo Proxy early in the series,          (Wikipedia)

name: Donov Mayer
description: The elderly debilitated Regent of Romdo City. He speaks by proxy through the voices of 4 Entourages in the form of stone statues (called, as a group, the Council, the Collective and the Administration Bureau) named after famous philosophers: Derrida, Lacan, Husserl and Berkeley. These AutoReivs appear as Michelangelo's statues from the Medici Chapel, two resting on either side of Donov's chamber. Donov is Re-l's grandfather.

name: Takeo Gouda
description: The protagonist of the story and a first-year student at Shuei High School. He is very tall and muscular, with a face that easily scares those around him. He scares many women but is very popular with many men, but Takeo is actually extremely kind and selfless, quickly helping others without a second thought throughout the story.

name: Rinko Yamato
description: A girl whom [Takeo](https://anilist.co/character/80757/Gouda-Takeo) saves from a molester on a train. After Takeo saves her, she immediately falls in love with him. She attends Koizumi Girls’ Academy and is very skilled in making sweets.

name: Makoto Sunakawa
description: Next door neighbor and childhood friend of Takeo, as well as his classmate. Because Makoto is so handsome, all of the girls Takeo liked ended up falling in love with Makoto instead. Makoto is always watching out for Takeo and is willing to sacrifice his own happiness for his friend.

name: Mariya Saijou
description: A classmate of Takeo. She begins to call Takeo "shishou" (master or teacher) after he trains her for a sports day relay race at their school.

name: Yukika Amami
description: Yukika Amami is a girl from Takeo's and Suna's childhood. She has a crush on Suna after he blocked a ball from hitting her during dodgeball in their childhood.

name: Hayato Oda
description: A classmate of Ai. They are both in the same seminar group at Ousaki University in Nagoya.

name: Ai Sunakawa
description: Suna's pretty older sister and a student at Ousaki University in Nagoya. Takeo mentions that she, like her brother, is a great and kindhearted person.

name: Yuriko Gouda
description: The mother of the Gouda family.

name: Nanako Yamazaki
description:
A friend of of [Rinko Yamato](https://anilist.co/character/87904/)'s and the girlfriend of [Osamu Kurihara](https://anilist.co/character/242615/). She is is a beautiful teenage girl with chin-length brown hair that is split on both sides, brown eyes and full pink lips.

She is mostly seen in her school uniform.

(Source: Ore Monogatari Fandom)

name: William Moriarty
native: ウィリアム・ジェームズ・モリアーティ
description:
__Height:__ 185 cm (6'1")
__Hometown:__ East End

A noble, a mathematics professor and the antiheroic protagonist of the manga. He is a genius who attempts to overthrow evil nobles and destroy the class system that has caused misery and pain to the poor everywhere.

name: Sherlock Holmes
native: シャーロック・ホームズ
description:
__Height:__ 185 cm (6'1")
__Hometown:__ North Riding, Yorkshire

He is the antagonist to Moriarty and also the figure around which Moriarty's plan revolves. He enjoys puzzles, is a violin player, has a prodigious observational skill, well-versed in hand-to-hand combat and has a machiavellian attitude when it comes to something he wants. He is a detective consultant and can be considered an intellectual match and rival to Moriarty himself.

name: Louis Moriarty
native: ルイス・ジェームズ・モリアーティ
description:
__Height:__ 183 cm (6')
__Hometown:__ East End

William's younger brother. When young, he was often very ill, but was later treated after moving in with the Moriarty family. Louis often serves as the family butler, despite being a nobleman.

name: Albert Moriarty
native: アルバート・ジェームズ・モリアーティ
description:
__Height:__ 188 cm (6'2")
__Hometown:__ London

The eldest son of the Moriarty family.

name: Hudson
description: The landlady of 221B, where Holmes and Watson live.

name: Sebastian Moran
native: セバスチャン・モラン
description: An ex-soldier in the army who was declared KIA (Killed In Action) during the war of Afghanistan but now works with the Moriarty brothers. He is a outstanding sniper who often acts on his own. Although on the outside he holds a cocky and charming exterior he secretly suffers from a lot of psychological trauma following his military service .

name: Fred Porlock
native: フレッド・ポーロック
description:
A quiet yet skilled martial artist affiliated with the Moriarty brothers
Although he rarely ever speaks unless prompted he is a gentle person at heart as well as being skilled at both spying and disguise

name: Mycroft Holmes
native: マイクロフト・ホームズ
description: Mycroft is the Director of the London Military Department and is the Brother of Sherlock Holmes.

name: John Watson
description: John H. Watson is a doctor and also the new roommate of Sherlock Holmes. He's an ex-soldier back from Afghan.

name: Claudia Enfield
native: クローディア・エンフィールド
description: Claudia is the second highest ranking student of Seidoukan Academy and its Student Council President. She recommended [Ayato](https://anilist.co/character/89058)'s transfer to the academy. She has held the position of President since junior high.

name: Saya Sasamiya
description: Saya is Ayato's childhood friend. She moved abroad six years ago due to her father's career. She seems to be an air-headed stoic who has trouble waking up in the morning and is directionally-challenged. She uses a 38th generation Lux grenade launcher Helnekrom but later switches to a type 41 Gleaming Form - twin particle guns Waidenholt and Type 34 wave Motion heavy artillery Ark Van Ders for the Phoenix. Like Kirin, she enters the Phoenix for her father's sake.

name: Kirin Toudou
description: Kirin is the top-ranking student of Seidoukan Academy. She is a shy and quiet girl who becomes the academy's top student as a 13 year-old and has not lost to anyone until Ayato challenges her a second time. She does not have a personal lux but rather carries a katana (Senbakiri) around as a weapon which often makes her greatly marveled by others as she tops the former No. 1 spot just by using a katana.

name: Ayato Amagiri
description:
He transfers to Seidoukan Academy to investigate his sister's disappearance and to figure out what he is supposed to do (). 
Ayato sports a friendly, polite, and helpful personality with a penchant for ending up in awkward situations. He is indiscriminate as to who he is being friendly to and is helpful to a fault, as well as being a bit naive. However, underneath the soft facade lies a person with an indomitable will who always tries to do the right thing, regardless of the potential trouble that he will get himself into.

name: Julis Alexia von Riessfeld
native: ユリス＝アレクシア・フォン・リースフェルト
description:
Julis is the fifth ranking student of Seidoukan Academy and is Lieseltania's First Princess. Her full name is Julis-Alexia Marie Florentia Renate von Riessfelt. She wields a rapier-type lux called Aspera Spina which she uses during the Phoenix tournament and bears the image of a flower for her power - control over flames.

She warms to [Ayato](https://anilist.co/character/89058/Amagiri-Ayato), unlike the other students with whom she is distant. She starts to like Ayato and often find herself arguing with [Saya](https://anilist.co/character/89060/Sasamiya-Saya) and [Kirin](https://anilist.co/character/89059/Toudou-Kirin) and even [Claudia](https://anilist.co/character/89061/Enfield-Claudia) for his attention.

name: Ernesta Kuhne
native: エルネスタ・キューネ
description: A student from Arlequint Academy and leader of Pygmalion (Sculptor Faction). A genius at making puppets, she wants AIs to be treated as equal to humans and sees AR-D and RM-C as her children.

name: Camilla Pareto
description: A student from Arlequint Academy and member of Ferrovious (Lions Faction). She is indebted to Ernesta and the two share a close relationship.

name: Dirk Eberwein
native: ディルク・ エーベルヴァイン
description: The student council president of Rewolf Black Institute. A base-line human whose unprecedented rise to top of a battle school for superhumans is due to his ability to manipulate others behind the scenes.

name: Korona Kashimaru
description: The student council secretary of Rewolf Black Institute. She has absolutely no combat capabilities. She isn't the brightest and can be considered a klutz.

name: Irene Urzaiz
native: イレーネ・ウルサイス
description: Rank 3 of Rewolf Black Institute. She wields the Gravisheath which influenced her fanged teeth allowing her to suck blood to power her ogre lux. She puts her sister Priscilla above all else.

name: Touya Mochizuki
description:
Touya is a young boy who has come to this other world. For the most part, he is very well-mannered, but when he feels that those close to him could be harmed, he also has a side that will not hesitate.

(Source: Honey's Anime)

appearsIn.title: In Another World With My Smartphone

name: Elze Silhoueska
description:
Elze is an adventurer equipped with gauntlets on both hands. She is the type who acts rather than talks and often pitches in before thinking. She is the older of the twins.

(Source: Honey's Anime)

appearsIn.title: In Another World With My Smartphone

name: Linze Silhoueska
description:
Linze was in the city with her sister and right before they were tricked into something, Touya saved them. She is reserved, but there are times where she shows her inner strength. She is the younger of the twins.

(Source: Honey's Anime)

appearsIn.title: In Another World With My Smartphone

name: Yae Kokonoe
description: Born in the far eastern country of Eashen to a samurai family, Yae left her home to travel and hone her skills elsewhere. Touya's group crosses paths with her during their travels, helping to fend off a group of ruffians attacking her. Thereafter, she decides to accompany Touya on his travels.

appearsIn.title: In Another World With My Smartphone

name: Yumina Urnea Belfast
native: ユミナ・エルネア・ベルファスト
description: A Princess of Belfast, and daughter of King Tristwin and Queen Yuel. Yumina met Touya when he heals her father from an attempted poisoning. Yumina possess the Null magic "Mystic Eyes", an ability that comes from her Heterochromic Eyes which give her the ability to see a person's true nature. Due to this power, upon seeing the selfless and kind aura surrounding Touya after he saves her father, she asks to be engaged to him, believing that she will never find a better candidate to be her husband. She is also proficient with bows and arrows, often choosing to fight alongside a pack of hunting wolves summoned with her darkness attribute.

appearsIn.title: In Another World With My Smartphone

name: Ren'aishin
description: A goddess from the Divine Realm who controls matters related to romance.

appearsIn.title: In Another World With My Smartphone

name: Kami-sama
description: God, later called the God of Worlds is an Omnipotent God who controls what occurs in the world that Touya currently resides in, as well as his previous world. When he come down to the world, he posed as Touya's grandfather and uses Shinnosuke Mochizuki as his name.

appearsIn.title: In Another World With My Smartphone

name: Sango
description: Sango is one of the pair that makes up Genbu. Sango's true form is a 4-meter-high tortoise. Kokuyou and Sango have a laid back personality.

appearsIn.title: In Another World With My Smartphone

name: Rene
description: Originally a homeless pickpocketer, but after Touya rescued her from two other pickpockets going after her because of a territory problem, he decided to hire her to be a maid.

appearsIn.title: In Another World With My Smartphone

name: Louise Françoise Le Blanc de La Vallière
native: ルイズ・フランソワーズ・ル・ブラン・ド・ラ・ヴァリエール
description:
__Height:__ 153 cm
__Familiar:__ A Knight (newly appointed), [Saito Hiraga](https://anilist.co/character/137/Hiraga-Saito)

Louise Françoise Le Blanc de La Vallière is the main female character. She is a second-year student at the Tristain Academy of Magic and a terrible mage who is often scorned by her fellow classmates. Because every spell she casts fails, she is nicknamed "Louise the Zero" after her zero success rate and zero attributes. The third daughter of the noble family La Vallière who owns the northeastern territory of Tristain. 



*She is named after Françoise Louise de La Vallière, a French mistress to Louis XIV of France from 1661 to 1667.*

appearsIn.title: The Familiar of Zero: Knight of the Twin Moons
The Familiar of Zero: "Rondo" of Princesses

name: Derflinger
description: Saito's talking sword. Seems to have the power to warp people, as seen in the beginning of the third ZNT series: Princesses no Rondo.

appearsIn.title: The Familiar of Zero: Knight of the Twin Moons

name: Saito Hiraga
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm (5'8") 

Saito is a student from Tokyo, Japan. One day, his laptop got broken and he decided to repair it; however, learning of the expensive fee for repair, he does not continue the repair, thinking of applying for a part-time job. As he walks down the streets, a mysterious portal appears before him, which can be only seen by him. He touches it out of curiosity, but it sucks him up despite his attempts to break free from it. Upon getting sucked, he arrives in Halkeginia as summoned by Louise de la Vallière as her familiar.

appearsIn.title: The Familiar of Zero: Knight of the Twin Moons
The Familiar of Zero: "Rondo" of Princesses

name: Longueville
description: Osmond's secretary, who is often the target of Osmond's lecherous behaviour. She gets mad when Osmond tries anything (for example: getting Osmond's familiar to peek up her skirt).

name: Wales Tudor
native: ウェールズ・テューダー
description: Prince of Albion and Henrietta's cousin. He and Henrietta had a romantic relationship, but is faced with their status as cousins. His vow to the water spirits is to one day be able to show his feeling to Henrietta without needing to hide it from the public. He is killed by Wardes and in the second season, revived to abduct Henrietta to Albion but killed again.  Wales is a triangle wind mage, and in the second season, he showed that nobles of royal heritage can combine their magical power with other royals and create power above pentagram grade (possibly up to decagram grade with two pentagram mages).

name: Henrietta de Tristain
native: アンリエッタ・ド・トリステイン
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm (5'2") 

The Princess of Tristain. She is loved by her nationals and is also an old friend of Louise. Later, she becomes the queen of Tristain and decides to defend Tristain from the Albion invasion after the assassination of the Albion prince.  She is named after Henrietta Anne, the youngest daughter of Charles I of England and sister of Charles II of England.

appearsIn.title: The Familiar of Zero: Knight of the Twin Moons
The Familiar of Zero: "Rondo" of Princesses

name: Kirche Augusta Frederica von Anhalt-Zerbst
native: キュルケ・アウグスタ・フレデリカ・フォン・アンハルツ・ツェルプストー
description:
__Height:__ 171 cm (5'7") 
__Familiar:__ A salamander, Flame 

Louise's classmate. Fire magic is her speciality - drawn from her strong passion for money. The territory she is from has long since had a dislike for the La Valliere family. She flirts and has dated (and heavily implied in the anime, slept with) many of the academy boys, but falls in love with Saito.  Kirche means "Church" in German, and the rest of her names might be named after Sophia Augusta Frederika of Anhalt-Zerbst.
