appearsIn.title: The Familiar of Zero: "Rondo" of Princesses

name: Chevreuse
description: A professor at the Tristain Academy of Magic.

name: Siesta
description:
__Height:__ 162 cm 

A maid at the academy. She has a crush on Saito, and treats him very kindly.

appearsIn.title: The Familiar of Zero: Knight of the Twin Moons
The Familiar of Zero: "Rondo" of Princesses

name: Paprika
description: Paprika is a playful girl that guides others through their dreams in the experimental psychotherapy treatment. She never means any harm. She is Atsuko's alter ego.

name: Atsuko Chiba
description: Chiba Atsuko is the head of the DC Mini development team. She also uses the DC Mini to treat patients by entering their dreams as her alter ego Paprika. She does this in secret since the system is still under development, and such unauthorized treatments are illegal.

name: Toshimi Konakawa
description: A curious detective who is immersed in a dream with Paprika in the beginning of the movie. Throughout the movie, he is trying to understand what is the cause of a reoccuring anxiety dream that he is having.

name: Kousaku Tokita
description: The inventor of the DC Mini. He's childish and doesn't know much about responsibility or the eventual consequences that the DC Mini comes with.

name: Morio Osanai
description: Chiba's research assistant. He is also obsessed with her because she is beautiful and he is jealous of Tokita because Chiba respects Tokita more as a scientist.

name: Jinnai
description: He's the bartender in the Radioclub bar.

name: Kuga
description: He's the waiter in the Radioclub bar.

name: Seijirou Inui
description:
Dr. Seijiro Inui, often referred to as 'Chairman', is indeed the chairman of the Institute for Psychiatric Research.  He is in opposition of the use of electronic devices, especially the DC Mini, to explore the dreams of patients, feeling that the realm of dreams should never be invaded. 



(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Kei Himuro
description: Colleague of Tokita. He worked under Tokita and helped him in his production of the DC Mini, but got jealous and disappeared.

name: Toratarou Shima
description: A gifted psychiatrist and the head of the department which is developing the DC Mini. Once it's stolen, the Chief goes on a nonsensical tirade and defenestrates himself out of the building, nearly killing himself. After going insane, he becomes stuck in a strange dream that apparently one of his former psychotic patients had until Paprika rescues him.

name: Faputa
description:
**Race**: Narehate
**Relatives**:

Faputa is referred to as "Princess of the Narehate" by the inhabitants of the Narehate Village Ilblu within the inviolable 6th layer of the Abyss. She is described by Majikaja as "the embodiment of value", and is incredibly highly regarded by all the Narehate in the village.

Faputa appears to be unstable and unreasonable, displaying a wild behavior that makes her comparable to a beast. She speaks in a simplistic and primitive manner, referring to herself in third person, and communicating only with short sentences that are sometimes hard to understand. She is very possessive and seemingly quite jealous, claiming [Reg](https://anilist.co/character/122444/Reg) to be of her property entirely, and feels entitled to examine him thoroughly without any indication of shame or restraint. She seemed a bit shaken when Reg failed to remember her and grew upset when Reg said he wanted to spend time with [Riko](https://anilist.co/character/122443/Riko) and [Nanachi](https://anilist.co/character/122445/Nanachi) rather than her.

Faputa is beloved by the Narehate of the village, but she is often irritated or angry according to Majikaja, and she seems to greatly dislike being observed. The Narehate in Ilblu freaks her out a bit, especially the ones with lots of eyes.

appearsIn.title: Made in Abyss: The Golden City of the Scorching Sun

name: Vueroeruko
description: Vueko, whose full name is Vueroeruko, is a mysterious woman who was chained by her neck in a deep pit of sludge beneath Ilblu before [Riko](https://anilist.co/character/122443/Riko) set her free.

appearsIn.title: Made in Abyss: The Golden City of the Scorching Sun

name: Belaf
description: Belaf is one of the Three Sages of Ilblu.

appearsIn.title: Made in Abyss: The Golden City of the Scorching Sun

name: Wazukyan
description: Wazukyan is one of the Three Sages of the Village of Ilblu.

appearsIn.title: Made in Abyss: The Golden City of the Scorching Sun

name: Irumyuui
description: Irumyuui is the infertile daughter of the chief of a tribe living inside the rim of the Abyss. The tribe feared she was cursed, due to her infertility, and sent her as tribute into the Abyss with the Ganja.

appearsIn.title: Made in Abyss: The Golden City of the Scorching Sun

name: Linia Dedoldia
native: リニア・デドルディア
description: Linia Dedoldia is the granddaughter of the Village Chief, Gustav, of the Doldia Tribe.

name: Reida Reia
description: The current Water God and the grandmother of Isolte Cruel.

name: Badigadi
description: Engaged to the Great Demon Emperor Kishirika Kishirisu, it is said that he is the demon lord who grants wisdom to those who deserve it. He is the current Fighting God and has been alive even before the war with Laplace. He has an immortal body, being able to regenerate injuries and body parts instantly.

name: Moore
description: Captain of [Atofe's](https://anilist.co/character/247634) guards.

name: Ghislaine Dedoldia
native: ギレーヌ・デドルディア
description: __Ghislaine Dedoldia__ is the daughter of Gustav the former Doldia village chief, and the mentor of [Eris](https://anilist.co/character/88349/Eris-Boreas-Greyrat) and she is also the student of [Rudeus Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat) in magic and other subjects. She is one of the few people who have become a Sword King.

name: Yamato Kurosawa
description: One of the most popular boys in his school. He is quite protective of [Mei](https://anilist.co/character/24201) as he protects her of anyone who does anything rude to her or insults her. [Asami](https://anilist.co/character/38441) describes Yamato as someone who thinks of others more than anyone else, protects what should be protected, and cares for others despite having his own problems to deal with.

name: Mei Tachibana
description: Mei was a social person before, but ever since her friends turned against her, she decided never to befriend anyone again. At first, she is described as "freakishly gloomy" and "doesn't speak". She is anti-social, clumsy, observant as well as honest, and funny. Her dad passed away from cancer and her mom is alive.  By episode 3, she enters a relationship with Yamato at his demand. She loves Yamato very much but she finds it difficult to express her feelings as she is new to interacting with people. She receives a blue bracelet as well as a pair ring from Yamato as a symbol of their relationship, she treasures it very much as she says that when she wears the bracelet it's as if Yamato is right by her side and she feels secure.

name: Aiko Mutou
description: A classmate of Yamato and Mei's. She's brash and bad-mouthed, but a nice girl. She's liked Yamato for a long time, but he hasn't reciprocated her feelings. Aiko used to be chubby, but she was okay with it as long as her boyfriend liked her. She spent much time trying to look beautiful, using cosmetics. Yamato noted that she doesn't need any makeup, which made Aiko fall for him because he was the first person who saw the real "her". One day she saw her boyfriend with another girl and looked for comfort from Yamato while breaking down and crying in his arms. Aiko asked Yamato to sleep with her, due to Yamato saying that she is beautiful just the way she is and his answer was positive. Aiko has been in love with Yamato since then.  After breaking up with her boyfriend, she lost 17 kilograms in two months. It was for Yamato to see the beautiful side of Aiko.

name: Kai Takemura
description: Yamato's classmate in junior high who used to be bullied. Due to certain circumstances, he is currently a grade behind Yamato and Mei. He is a regular patron of where Mei works and loves the theme park Land.

name: Kenji Nakanishi
description: One of Mei's classmates, and a good friend of Yamato's. He has a big crush on Asami.

name: Mei no Haha
description: Mei's mother. She raises Mei alone.

name: Miki Arai
description: A girl in Class B. Yamato has been in the same school with her since middle school, and it seems she was Yamato's first crush. She's the one girl he hasn't kissed, even though she's cute.  Mei describes her as such, "She's not very tall, her eyes are perfect. Her hair is fluffy and soft, high colored lips. She looks like a doll."

name: Daichi Kurosawa
description: Yamato's older brother. He runs a barber shop and is said to be just as handsome as Yamato. He rejects styling people if they want to imitate others and instead styles according to what they want to be.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Megumi Kitagawa
description: A teen model and transfer student who was placed in [Yamato](https://anilist.co/character/26243)'s class. She acts sweet but in reality is aiming for Yamato.

name: Yatora Yaguchi
description:
__Height:__ 173 cm (5'8")

He is a second-year high school student with remarkably high grades despite his delinquent lifestyle. Yatora feels like his life is dull and predictable, that is, until he comes across his senpai, [Maru Mori](https://anilist.co/character/157117/Mori-Maru), painting in the school's art club. He discovers his passion for painting and dedicates his remaining school years to it, aiming to pass the Tokyo University of the Arts entrance exam.

Although Yatora is very hardworking and looks composed, there is an underlying insecure part of him that is further exposed when he starts making art. He has an extroverted nature and can easily understand what others are looking for in a relationship, further adapting himself in order to please everyone around him. For that reason, he tends to oppress his own feelings and wishes. Yatora relies a lot on his studied social skills whenever he is under a stressful or unfamiliar situation, but when he is caught by surprise or can't keep up his composed act he has an emotional outburst, often resulting in him crying and speaking more honestly. Yatora is especially hard on himself, putting high standards on himself while constantly undervaluing his own work and comparing himself to others, which ends up overwhelming him. Whilst comparing himself with others, he has great respect and admires the art that others around him create.

name: Mayu Ooba
description:
Ooba is an instructor at the prep school that Yatora attended.

She is a highly eccentric, carefree, and wise teacher who cares deeply for her students and her craft. She tends to be blunt and loud, and often tells her students about random animal trivia, more so during stressful times.

name: Ryuuji Ayukawa
description:
__Height:__ 5'9 (175cm)

[Official Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/ryuji_ayukawa/)

Yatora's classmate and fellow art club member, they are responsible for inviting Yatora to the art club. Yuka has a talent for modern street fashion.

They are closest to their grandmother, who is the reason why they decided to pursue Japanese Art. Yuka will often put on a bright demeanor in front of themselves, and when placed in stressful situations they are often brash and impulsive. Yuka's mother and father both disapprove of their identity and lifestyle. It's shown that they don't have a very happy home life, and can only find solace in the company of their Grandmother, who is accepting of them and their aspirations. It is implied that they often go out at night to get away from home, and that their parents suspect them of trading dates with men for money.

Prefers to be called "Yuka", as they choose not to go by the name "Ayu" since their idol is singer Ayumi Hamasaki. Yuka is known to often crossdress and test gendered standards of clothing.

name: Maru Mori
description: An upperclassman from the art club. Her painting of angels opened Yatora’s eyes to the world of art and inspired him to make art himself.

name: Utashima
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm

He is one of Yatora Yaguchi's friends.

name: Sumida
description:
__Height:__ 166 cm

He is one of Yatora Yaguchi's friends.

name: Koigakubo
description: He is one of Yatora Yaguchi's friends. He has short, slicked-back hair and thin eyes. Likes baking sweets.

name: Yotasuke Takahashi
description:
He has a reserved and shy personality but is shown to be standoffish and easy to anger. He’s blunt, and often says things as they are in his mind without stopping to explain to others what he means. He has complete confidence in his art skills.

He goes to the same cram school as [Yatora](https://anilist.co/character/144674/Yaguchi-Yatora) and provokes Yatora with his genius art skill and antisocial personality.

name: Sakura Minamoto
description:
__Year of death:__ April 7, 2008
__Cause of death:__ Collision with a pickup truck on her way to an idol audition

Before becoming a zombie, Sakura was an ordinary girl with nothing special going on in her life. She is shown to be an energetic girl and becomes very passionate whenever she is singing as an idol.

name: Saki Nikaidou
description:
__Death:__ August 30, 1997

Formerly a biker who conquered the entire Kyushu with her biker gang Dorami. Saki has a tough and rebellious attitude, calling [Sakura](https://anilist.co/character/127540) a goody-two-shoes, and outright stating that she has no respect for those who don't have guts. However, after a successful performance, Saki takes being an idol very seriously and becomes leader of Franchouchou. Saki also occasionally shows a soft side, as seen in episode 6 where she comforts [Ai](https://anilist.co/character/127539). When she was alive, she was fond of her Tamagotchi and enjoys going to Drive in Tori.

name: Ai Mizuno
description:
__Death:__ August 4, 2008

She was a popular idol in the early 2000s from the idol group called Iron Frill.



When alive, Ai demonstrated a cheerful and determined personality, but after becoming a zombie she became rather skeptical and suspicious. As she gradually begins to warm up to her group, she begins to act like herself. She has shown a supportive side when aiding the other members with her idol experience.

name: Junko Konno
aliases: Densetsu no Shouwa Idol (伝説の昭和アイドル)
description:
__Death:__ December 9, 1983
__Height:__ 155cm (5'1")

Konno Junko was an idol from the 80s whose popularity caused the idol boom of said decade. She died in 1983 on a plane crash. She is titled as the Legendary Showa Idol.

Junko seems to be calm, collected, little shy, but also a little serious if not daring. This serious side is shown when she tries to escape the mansion, collaborates with [Saki](https://anilist.co/character/127538) and [Sakura](https://anilist.co/character/127540) in going in the Hot Springs, and when it comes to idols. She seems prone to panic whenever something disturbing happens. Because of the different time period she lived in, her views of Idols contrast from modern times.

name: Koutarou Tatsumi
description: He is the energetic producer of the idol group Franchouchou. He's the one who resurrected the girls from different eras as zombies to be part of his idol group.

name: Tae Yamada
description: A mysterious girl with an unknown past, titled only as the Legendary Tae Yamada. She is the only one of the girls who has not fully regained consciousness, and so has remained a mindless zombie. As such, Tae is unpredictable and driven by pure instinct, doing things such as biting at the other members and launching herself at the crowd. However, she does seem to have some semblance of awareness, being able to at least understand the members to some degree and be cooperative enough to participate in the practices and performances.

name: Yuugiri
description:
__Death:__ December 28, 1882

Yuugiri was a high-ranking courtesan from the Meiji era. After being resurrected from the dead, she becomes a member of the zombie idol group, Franchouchou.

Yuugiri remains very calm and traditional in various situations, probably due to the period in which she lived and where she worked. Despite this, she seems to calmly accept and adapt to the changes in modern Japanese society. Every time she sees someone depressed, she physically hits people to get them out of their mood. The problem is that most of the time, they have already recovered when Yuugiri slaps them and tells them exactly what they were trying to say. Although she is not immune from freaking out around others, she is generally able to remain calm and composed in most of her outlandish situations, which is even more impressive because she is the oldest of the group. In reality, she has never been seen to have any questions or ask another of the girls about something since it seems that she can learn very quickly or is simply one of the people who have no doubts when doing something. Despite this characteristic, she still looks collaborative with the group doing everything that is said without asking.

The name Yugiri means "evening mist."

name: Lily Hoshikawa
description: Lily is often seen with a smile, and due to her young age, is shown to be quite playful as well. She has also demonstrated a professional aspect from her experiences before her death.

name: Romero
description:
Koutarou's pet zombie dog.

Supposedly a toy poodle, although according to various people his size always seems to change. Being a zombie dog, Romero can gobble up food that would be bad for most dogs. His favorite food is cuttlefish. His gender is male. *Never feed dried squids to living dogs!

(Source: Zombieland Saga Wikia)

name: Suenaga
description:
__Height:__ 167cm (5'6")

Although he is more of a threat to zombies than he realizes they are to him, his reasons for repeatedly trying to kill them on sight are perfectly understandable, as he is just an ordinary, generally affable, scared cop.

name: Mikoto Misaka
description:
__Height:__ 161 cm (5'3")
__Classification:__ Esper
__School:__ Tokiwadai Middle School
__Esper Power:__ Electromaster
__Power Level:__ 5

One of the main heroines in the Toaru Majutsu no Index series and the protagonist of her side story, Toaru Kagaku no Railgun. An Esper of Academy City, her powers are ranked Level 5, the highest rank for the most powerful Espers. She ranks as third-strongest out of the seven people who hold this rank in Academy City.

name: Ruiko Saten
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm
__Classification:__ Esper
__School:__ Sakugawa Middle School
__Esper Power:__ Aero Hand
__Power Level:__ 0

A Level 0, classmate and friend of [Uiharu](https://anilist.co/character/20622) who is known for wearing a flower on the left side of her hair. She is a little shameless as she sometimes flips Uiharu's skirt in public.  She first appears in the Toaru Kagaku no Railgun manga and its anime series and makes a cameo appearance in the Toaru Majutsu no Index light novel series and the opening of the anime.

name: Kuroko Shirai
description:
__Height:__ 152 cm (5'0")
__Classification:__ Esper
__School:__ Tokiwadai Middle School
__Affiliation:__ Judgment
__Esper Power:__ Teleport
__Power Level:__ 4

Kuroko is [Mikoto](/character/13701/)'s kouhai in Tokiwadai Middle School and a protagonist in Toaru Kagaku no Railgun, as well as a supporting character in Toaru Majutsu no Index. A Level 4 Esper, she is a member of Judgment, a special public committee group whose duty is to maintain peace and order in Academy City. She has an unhealthy obsession with Mikoto, whom she calls "Onee-sama" (big sister), and is on the constant lookout for a chance to get physically intimate with her (and getting called a pervert in the process). 

Her power is instant teleportation, which allows her to teleport herself and anything she touches as long it weighs under around 130-137 kilograms to anywhere in a radius of around 81-85 meters.

name: Kazari Uiharu
description:
__Height:__ 153 cm
__Classification:__ Esper
__School:__ Sakugawa Middle School
__Affiliation:__ Judgment
__Esper Power:__ Thermal Hand
__Power Level:__ 1

Shirai's friend and colleague in Judgment and another protagonist in Toaru Kagaku no Railgun. Shy and humble, she goes to Sakugawa Junior High, different from Shirai's, and is known for wearing a headband made of flowers on her head, and sometimes a surgical mask as she constantly suffers the flu. She has a sweet tooth but is often called for Judgment duties before she can enjoy her sweets. She displays various skills with the use of the computer, such as repelling hackers and information gathering.   She makes a cameo appearance in the opening of the Index anime and appears as a supporting character in the second season. She has small parts in the novels, larger ones in the Railgun SS novels.

name: Wataru Kurozuma
description: The true leader of the Big Spider whom someone believe that he died from the explosion two years ago from the incident of saving his comrades that has been captured alone. In the present, Mikoto and Kuroko encountered him on the place where skill-out is gathered. He's strong physically and mentally, and Mii Konori's crush since. He often said, "When it comes to a milk, it's definitely Musashino", a brand of a milk he most favors.

name: Mii Konori
description: Kuroko and Kazari's superior at Judgment Branch 177. She's currently a Level 3 with the ability of "Clairvoyance", similar to x-ray vision that lets her see things in concealed areas.

name: Hatsuya Kaitabi
description: Kaitabi Hatsuya is a character from the Toaru Kagaku no Railgun side-story. He's registered in Academy City's databank as a level 2.

name: Miho Juufuku
description: Ability: Dummy Check, Level 2    She appears in episode 3. She is a 2nd year student in Sekisho Middle School. She becomes a 'terror' against girls who study in Tokiwadai Middle school due to her boyfriend on forsaking her for another girl who studies in Tokiwadai Middle school because her eyebrows are weird.    Re-appearance in episode 14

name: Daigo
description: Daigo-sensei seems very kind and honest person. He does volunteer work in Cypress Park Orphanage(/Child Warefare Facility Asunaro-En), where he takes care of "child errors". He is a pretty good cook, or so he says and he would love to get married and cook together with his wife, so he says it is a dream of his. He is also Tokiwadai middle school dormitory supervisor's love's target.

name: Maaya Awatsuki
description: Maaya is a Level 3 esper and Kuroko's classmate who reside in the same dorms as Mitsuko and is a member of the swim club. Her ability is Float Dial ("Fluid Repulsion"), which allows her to alter the buoyancy of herself and her surroundings, letting her make things lighter or heavier. She is often seen hanging around Mitsuko along with Kinuho.

name: Eiji Hasegawa
description:
__Height:__ 210 cm
__Occupation:__ First Division Vice-Captain

Eiji is a professional and formal man who takes his job very seriously, for this reason he often clashes with Captain [Gen Narumi](https://anilist.co/character/241577/Gen-Narumi)'s childish behavior. For his inflexible demeanor on duty and for his usual leadership role in the First Divsion, Eiji is highly respected by anyone both in his own division and in others.

name: Kaijuu 10-gou
description:
Kaiju Juu-gou is an Identified Kaiju who attacked Tachikawa Base. It is created by [Kaijuu Kyuu-gou](https://anilist.co/character/259598/Kaijuu-Kyuugou) and is considered a "prototype".  

 

Kaiju Juu-gou is a extremely powerful Identified Kaiju, with a fortitude level of 8.3 when it first appeared,

name: Hiroto Mori
description: Hiroto Mori is a man working at Professional Kaiju Cleanup Company Monster Sweeper Inc.

name: Rin Shinonome
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm
__Occupation:__ Platoon Leader in the First Division of the Defense Force

Rin is a serious woman who follows Captain [Gen Narumi](https://anilist.co/character/241577/Gen-Narumi)'s order without question, despite letting her guard down sometimes. She is a calm individual who faces things correctly, still managing to have fun while doing so. Rin also seem to take a liking in brave people. Her brave and rigid behavior, however, is sometimes a shield to hide her deep emotions of joy and excitement. She also seems to secretly cultivate her physical appareance and beauty.

name: Kaijuu Juugo-gou
description: Kaijuu Juugo-gou was one of the many Identified Kaiju created by [Kaijuu Kyuu-gou](https://anilist.co/character/259598/Kaijuu-Kyuugou). It was created to defeat [Kikoru Shinomiya](https://anilist.co/character/183889/Kikoru-Shinomiya).

name: Masahide Tokuda
description:
__Height:__ 188 cm

Masahide Tokuda also known as Toku is a man working at Professional Kaiju Cleaning Company Monster Sweeper Inc.

name: Tomoko Kuroki
description:
Socially inept and often desperate, the series chronicles her various attempts to try to be more popular at her school, Makuhari Shuuei High School. She is 15 years old at the time of the series' debut and was born towards the end of February of either 1994, 1997, or 1998.

Tomoko started off very excited about high school. After all, she had had over 50 years of dating experience with over 100 boys in otome games, and she could not have been more enthralled with the years of popularity her secondary education was bound to bring! However, after going two months without speaking to anyone in her class, Tomoko is baffled by her continuing lack of notoriety and becomes more determined than ever to gain her peers' approval. In both the manga and anime, Tomoko debuts looking up the definition of "unpopular girl"--"mojyo" spelled in the English titles later--on the internet only to discover she fits all of the criteria! In the anime opening titles, she is depicted as a prisoner having her pictures taken wearing a placard that identifies her as "mojyo" in English letters.

One of the ways Tomoko plans to rehabilitate herself is through daily talks with her brother, [Tomoki Kuroki](https://anilist.co/character/67405/Kuroki-Tomoki), who begrudgingly agrees to this unusual request. She also frequently spends times with her grade school friend, [Yuu Naruse](https://anilist.co/character/52827/Naruse-Yuu), whose favorable social status is often coveted by Tomoko.

appearsIn.title: WataMote: No Matter How I Look At It, It's You Guys' Fault I'm Not Popular!
No Matter How I Look at It, It's You Guys' Fault I'm Not Popular!

name: Kiko Satozaki
description:
Kiko is a cousin of Tomoko and Tomoki Kuroki. She first appears in the manga Chapter 14 and in the anime Episode 8 to visit the Kuroki family. While she is first amazed with Tomoko's stories about having a boyfriend, when she finds out Tomoko has been lying to her all this time, she starts to act superior to her. Eventually, Tomoko suspects that Kii treats her like a pet dog. 

It is implied that she is cheerful, since she is usually smiling. However, she is not as gullible as she once was before going into middle school, and Tomoko soon catches wind of this.

(Source: WataMote Wikia)

description: Tomoko's younger brother.

No Matter How I Look at It, It's You Guys' Fault I'm Not Popular!

name: Yuu Naruse
description: Yuu is Kuroki Tomoko's old friend from middle school. Back then she had rather average looks and average grades. After she entered high school she saw that everyone was being flashy and she felt out of place. Soon after, she started wearing contacts, bleached her hair and now looks all flashy and beautiful as well.

appearsIn.title: WataMote: No Matter How I Look At It, It's You Guys' Fault I'm Not Popular!
No Matter How I Look at It, It's You Guys' Fault I'm Not Popular!

name: Ogino
description:
Tomoko's Gym Teacher.

Later becomes her Homeroom teacher for 2nd and 3rd year of school.

appearsIn.title: WataMote: No Matter How I Look At It, It's You Guys' Fault I'm Not Popular!

name: Hina Nemoto
description:
Hina Nemoto is a classmate of Tomoko since her first year in high school. Hina first met Tomoko during their entrance exam; however, Tomoko quickly forgot about her. She is Tomoko's high school classmate who wants to become a voice actress. While appearing friendly and vivacious, she often tries to keep herself above others while inwardly accusing them, including Tomoko, over "looking down" on her. She lost her middle school friends then vowed to put on an act in high school. She confesses to Tomoko that she wants to live a "slice-of-life anime lifestyle."

Outwardly sociable, friendly and cheerful, she is usually seen talking and laughing with Okada, Kiyota, and Suzuki in class and hanging out with them after school. She inwardly worries how others see her and whether or not they feel they are better than her. She will subtly denigrate others and becomes upset if she feels they have exceeded her. This explains her desire to have Tomoko as a friend on the one hand while periodically digging at her to imagining that Tomoko is in competition with her on the other. She befriends Tomoko at the start of the second year, mainly due to Tomoko's love of anime. Hina seems very friendly to Tomoko, allowing Tomoko to use her chapstick once, though she also seems very competitive. She largely hides her anime interest from Okada and her other friends.

appearsIn.title: WataMote: No Matter How I Look At It, It's You Guys' Fault I'm Not Popular!

name: Tomoko no Haha
description: The mother of Tomoko and Tomoki Kuroki.

appearsIn.title: WataMote: No Matter How I Look At It, It's You Guys' Fault I'm Not Popular!

name: Kumoko
description:
A high school girl of self-professed low standing who has reincarnated as a spider. 

In her former life, she lived as a shut-in and immersed herself in video games, but now she uses her remarkable mental strength to fight for survival. She uses battle tactics that make up for her low stats with her mastery of agility, spider thread, and poison fangs.

The current Demon Lord.

description: Sophia Keren, formerly known as Negishi Shouko in her previous life, is one of the reincarnated students. She was reincarnated as a True Vampire in a noble human family, the Kerens. Her relatives are normal humans, so she hides the fact that she is a Vampire.

name: Filimøs Harrifenas
native: フィリメス・ハァイフェナス
description: In her previous life, she was Okazaki Kanami, homeroom teacher to the kids who were reincarnated, and they affectionately call her "Oka-chan." After reincarnating, she began attending school with [Shun](https://anilist.co/character/130487/Schlain-Zagan-Analeit) and the others as their classmate. Since she reincarnated as an elf, she looks younger than she actually is. She's a caring teacher who continues to follow her students after their reincarnation, but she has many secrets.

So I'm a Spider, So What?

name: Schlain Zagan Analeit
native: シュレイン・ザガン・アナレイト
description:
The fourth prince of the Kingdom of Analeit.

His name in his previous life was Yamada Shunsuke. He was a textbook example of the average high school student and retains that quality after reincarnating. However, he has a deep admiration for his older brother [Julius](https://anilist.co/character/196477/Julius-Zagan-Analeit), the hero, and spends every day working hard to catch up to him.

appearsIn.title: So I'm a Spider, So What?
So I'm a Spider, So What?
So I'm a Spider, So What?

name: Julius Zagan Analeit
native: ユリウス・ザガン・アナレイト
description:
The second prince of the Kingdom of Analeit. 

Julius is [Shun](https://anilist.co/character/130487)'s older brother and the strongest hero among all humankind. Despite his mastery of both swordsmanship and magic and his achievements in combat, he remains virtuous and not at all proud. He is a true hero, devoting himself to fighting for world peace.

appearsIn.title: So I'm a Spider, So What?
So I'm a Spider, So What?
So I'm a Spider, So What?

name: Suresia Analeit
native: スーレシア・アナレイト
description:
The second princess of the Kingdom of Analeit.

As [Shun](https://anilist.co/character/130487/Schlain-Zagan-Analeit)'s half-sister, born to a different mother not long after his birth, her talents rival his. Her obsession with her brother Shun is extreme enough to put others off, and she's noticeably hostile toward all girls who get friendly with him.

appearsIn.title: So I'm a Spider, So What?
So I'm a Spider, So What?

name: Karnatia Seri Anabald
native: カルナティア・セリ・アナバルド
description:
The daughter of Duke Anabald.

In her previous life, she was a boy named Ooshima Kanata, but she reincarnated as a beautiful girl. She's a prodigy on par with [Shun](https://anilist.co/character/130487/Schlain-Zagan-Analeit), and has been his best friend since their former life. Her speech is normally elegant and refined, but when talking with others who have reincarnated, she talks like a boy.

appearsIn.title: So I'm a Spider, So What?

name: Feirune
description:
[Shun](https://anilist.co/character/130487/Schlain-Zagan-Analeit)'s pet Earth Wyrm.

In her previous life, she was a girl named Shinohara Mirei, but she reincarnated as a monster instead of a human. As a monster, her stats grow at a very fast rate, and she has excellent situational judgment. She has a cheerful, open personality, but she was a bully in her former life, and this shows in her behavior.

appearsIn.title: So I'm a Spider, So What?

name: Hugo Baint Renxandt
native: ユーゴー・バン・レングザンド
description:
The crown prince of the Renxandt Empire.

In his previous life, he was Natsume Kengo, and he was regarded as the leader of the class. His skills are the real deal, but his habit of exaggerating his own abilities detracts from the magnitude of his power. He's as belligerent as he was in his former life, viewing [Shun](https://anilist.co/character/130487/Schlain-Zagan-Analeit) as his rival.

appearsIn.title: So I'm a Spider, So What?

name: Sei Handa
description:
__Height:__ 172cm (5'8½")

A 23-year-old calligrapher. He goes to the Goto Islands in Nagasaki to focus more on his calligraphy and to take time to understand himself and find his passion.

name: Naru Kotoishi
description: She is an energetic and cheerful kid who likes to play around. She keeps coming to Seishuu's house and doesn't seem to understand personal space. She also has a lot of friends. Even though she can sometimes be seen as annoying by Seishuu, she properly apologizes if he gets really mad. She may have a possible crush on him since she was worried when she considered the possibility he might have a girlfriend. She also likes to collect strange things such as bugs and shells from the beach (with slugs and other creatures still living inside them). She is also rather adventurous as shown in the first episode and chapter where she continually climbs over a tall wall despite the danger to see a beautiful sunset. She has a bad habit of imitating the behaviors and language of the people she sees which causes her to say words she doesn't understand that are rather inappropriate.

name: Yuujirou Kido
description: The village chief and Hiroshi's father.

name: Miwa Yamamura
description:
Miwa Yamamura is the only daughter of a liquor seller. She is a 3rd-year middle school student whose brash and blunt personality leads her to shenanigans, often involving [Handa-sensei](https://anilist.co/character/31274/Handa-Sei).

She is best friends with [Tamako Arai](https://anilist.co/character/88327/Arai-Tamako).

name: Kazuyuki Sakamoto
description: The headmaster of the branch school in the Nanatsutake village (grades 1 & 2 of elementary school). He is often smoking and sometimes appears unreliable, although he is a cheerful and capable educator.

name: Tamako Arai
description: A 3rd-year middle school student and a close friend of [Miwa Yamamura](https://anilist.co/character/88326/Yamamura-Miwa). Her future ambition is to be a mangaka. Perpetually wary of seeming like an otaku, she attempts to hide her manga-related interests and fujoshi-like tendencies.

name: Takao Kawafuji
description: Seishuu's friend who takes cares of his calligraphy and other needs. He visits Seishuu every so often.

name: Hiroshi Kido
description: Hiroshi Kido is the son of the village chief and a 3rd-year high school student who lives in the Goto Islands. Mediocre in all his undertakings, his report card boasts of straight 3's. He was inspired to work harder after witnessing the efforts of Handa-sensei. He is currently working hard to get to the culinary school outside the island.

name: Emi Handa
description: The mother of the male protagonist, Seishuu.

name: Hina Kubota
description: She is a child from the island and the best friend of Naru. She is really shy and quick to cry, especially when dealing with strangers.

name: Isabel Magnolia
native: イザベル・マグノリア
description:
Isabel Magnolia is one of [Levi's](https://anilist.co/character/45627/Levi) two old companions from his time in the capitol's Underground District, the other being [Furlan Church](https://anilist.co/character/87928/Furlan-Church). She met the two of them after she was discovered trying to sneak past a checkpoint to the surface without paying and was forced to flee until she arrived at their doorstep and was saved by them. Impressed by her saviors, she asked to join their gang, and they agreed on the condition that she be trained to use ODM gear 

Isabel is an energetic, outspoken young woman who is rarely afraid to speak her mind and confident in her abilities. She is able to use ODM gear quite well and calmly, and is also quite prideful of her skill. She values Levi as a brother figure and often becomes emotional if he berates her. She takes his opinions very seriously, as shown when she cried when he said she was an idiot for not knowing how to do math and continued to cry until he ruffled her hair. She is known to have a soft spot for animals, claiming to get along with them better than other humans and going out of her way to save any animals she discovers.

name: Furlan Church
native: ファーラン・チャーチ
description:
Furlan Church is a delinquent who roamed the capital's Underground District and one of [Levi's](https://anilist.co/character/45627/Levi) two old companions from his time living in the underground, the other being [Isabel Magnolia](https://anilist.co/character/87929/Isabel-Magnolia). He's a very talented ODM user, having learned to use it and teach his fellow delinquents how to use it. The way he managed to acquire and learn how to use ODM gear is unknown.

Furlan, in contrast to Isabel, is very focused and able to make the distinction between when to have fun and when to be serious. He is usually depicted as level-headed and calm, but he dislikes when things spiral out of control. He has a clear understanding of when he's been bested, and when to give up if he knew that he had lost, though he can also be defiant. Furlan places a great deal of trust in Levi and followed his decisions and leadership without question. After one of many heists pulled with Levi's gang, Furlan was placed in charge of dividing the profits from the job among his comrades. He is shown to be sympathetic towards others, such as when he knew that one of his accomplices, [Yan](https://anilist.co/character/137155/Yan), was suffering from a leg injury and would need extra money to afford medicine, so he gave them a larger cut compared to everyone else.

name: Flagon
description:
__Affiliation:__ Survey Corps; Squad Captain

A member of the Survey Corps and a Squad Captain at the time [Levi](https://anilist.co/character/45627/Levi), [Furlan Church](https://anilist.co/character/87928), and [Isabel Magnolia](https://anilist.co/character/87929/Isabel-Magnolia) had joined the Scouts. He disliked the idea of allowing the trio of former thugs to join the Survey Corps, especially when they were assigned to his squad and were from the Underground District. However, he acknowledged Levi's skills after seeing his abilities in action.

name: Nicholas Lovof
description:
__Occupation:__ Councilor

An anti-scouting mission faction leader and close associate of the Lang Company. 

Lovof is a selfish and greedy noble, who is prepared to go to brutal lengths to get what he wants. Lovof has proven to be manipulative, often blackmailing people in order to make them do his bidding. He is cautious to an extent and also tends to leave no loose ends.

name: Mike Zacharias
description:
Squad Captain of his own squad, Squad Mike, a major division within the Survey Corps. He has been described by others as "humanity's second strongest soldier", being only behind [Levi](https://anilist.co/character/45627/Levi).

Mike is an extremely strong and durable soldier and an acknowledged leader with a brave heart and a tactical mind. He also has a remarkably good sense of smell, which allows him to detect Titans from great distances. During times of ease, Mike is shown to be a quiet and reserved man, rarely speaking unless it concerned a more serious matter. He also has a bizarre habit of "sniffing" people when he meets them.

name: Yan
description: He is an Underground companion of [Levi](https://anilist.co/character/45627/Levi), [Furlan Church](https://anilist.co/character/87928/Furlan-Church), and [Isabel Magnolia](https://anilist.co/character/87929/Isabel-Magnolia). He is known to be a calm and considerate person to other people living in the Underground city. Yan is one of the underground companions who gets paid by Furlan Church. Since Furlan knows well that Yan needs more money for his leg treatments, he gives Yan more money than usual.

name: Elaina
description:
On her broom, she flies from country to country with her long, black robes adorning the lengths of her arms and trailing behind her with every weave and turn. Her purple-blue eyes peer out from beneath a black tricorn hat to reveal beautiful and silky ashen hair that flows down her back like clouds flowing through summer skies. On her chest is pinned a star-shaped brooch — signifying her status as a witch.

Prior to the main story, she was a sheltered child who was greatly proficient in magic, innocent, and "not knowing what failure is."

appearsIn.title: Wandering Witch: The Journey of Elaina

name: Saya
description:
__Occupation:__ Witch

Saya is a character introduced in the [Majo no Tabitabi](https://anilist.co/manga/98741/Wandering-Witch-The-Journey-of-Elaina/) series. She is an apprentice witch who [Elaina](https://anilist.co/character/125736/Elaina) meets in the Land of Mages as a novice.

Saya has black hair tied back in a small tassel on the left side and blue eyes. She initially wears a charcoal grey outfit, black stockings, and white boots.

Saya is a person with a kind personality on the outside, but is slightly manipulative in her thinking as shown when she manipulated Elaina to stay with her for a while.

She also has a desire to have company and friends, which mostly stemmed from her younger sister returning back to her homeland without her.

appearsIn.title: Wandering Witch: The Journey of Elaina

name: Fran
description:
__Occupation:__ Witch

Fran is a character introduced in the [Wandering Witch](https://anilist.co/manga/98741/Wandering-Witch-The-Journey-of-Elaina/) series. She is [Elaina](https://anilist.co/character/125736/Elaina)'s master and a witch.

Fran has long black hair, blue eyes, and has a beauty mark underneath her right eye. She wears a midnight-blue hat with a red ribbon coiled around it and a matching color outfit both of which have a stary night pattern in the interior. She also wears beige-colored pants, red earrings, brown boots, and her witch's brooch on her right chest.

She's portrayed as an elated and jocular woman. Compared to the other witches in Robetta, she's shown to be a non-judgemental person.

appearsIn.title: Wandering Witch: The Journey of Elaina

name: Sheila
description:
__Occupation:__ Witch

Sheila is a character introduced in the [Majo no Tabitabi](https://anilist.co/manga/98741/Wandering-Witch-The-Journey-of-Elaina/) series.

Sheila has long blonde hair tied back in a ponytail and green eyes. She wears a white jacket with a navy blue interior over a brown dress shirt, brown pants, and brown shoes.

appearsIn.title: Wandering Witch: The Journey of Elaina

name: Elaina no Haha
description: Light Novel Volume 14 Chapter 4 & Anime Episode 10 Spoilers:

appearsIn.title: Wandering Witch: The Journey of Elaina

name: Amnesia
description:
Amnesia is a character introduced in the [Wandering Witch](https://anilist.co/manga/98741/Wandering-Witch-The-Journey-of-Elaina/) series. She is described as a mysterious girl who always lost her memories every time she sleeps.

(Source: Majo-no-tabitabi Wiki)

appearsIn.title: Wandering Witch: The Journey of Elaina

name: Shuichi Kagaya
description:
Shuichi is a third-year high school student and wants to be a normal person and wants things to stay the same forever. but he is scared of himself as he has the ability to turn into a monster.

His abilities allow​ him to transform into a mascot character which gives him enhanced physical strength and sense of smell. It also has a zipper which can be unzipped so that someone can go inside of him. This will allow that person to control Shuichi's body. 

If he and the person inside of him have the same goals, he can collaborate with them and join forces and fuse together to become one being and their soul, body and memories will be connected and they will be able to overcome their limits.

name: Clair Aoki
description:
A female freshman from Shuichi's highschool that in the beginning of the series attempts to commit suicide by immolation due to the death of her parents to the hands of a "monster." She is saved from this situation by Shuichi. Whilst being saved, she discovers Shuichi's other form and with this information she later convinces him into doing what she wants him to do.

She is a rather smart girl that takes advantage of any opportunity to gain the upper hand in any given situation be it by using her female attributes (mostly against Shuichi) or by using the enemies' secrets and goals against them. She is also quite emotionally complex, being very caring and concerned for the people that she cares about while at the same being able to kill someone in order to ensure that she and the people closest to her survive but feeling terrible with herself after the fact. She also massively enjoys the power that comes with teaming up with Shuichi to the point of almost sexual pleasure.

name: Elena Aoki
description:
She is Claire Aoki's Older Sister. A 3rd year high school student in a far-off private school. She is bad at talking to people.

She told Claire that she killed their parents for her because they were bad people. They were very strict people and their dad was on the diet but he was doing all sorts of bad things in secret and her mom was cheating on him with all the younger men at her company.

name: Ikeuchi
description: A young man who loves Chihiro and is part of Koyanagi's group.

name: Tadanori Sanbe
description: A second year student at Yamakita University.

name: Abukawa
description: He was an older student and friend of Shuichi.

name: Isao Kasuga
description: He loves plants and flowers. His powers allows him to change the form of soil at will and make plants grow.

name: Uchuujin
description: An alien who is looking for his comrades, coins that got spread after a crash. Upon bringing a coin to him, he will grant any wish.

name: Hikawa
description:
Hikawa was a girl who became Collector for the Alien.

Hikawa used to be a nice girl, but after being dropped from the competition running team, she became desperate and depressed and that would mean she will lose the chance of sports scholarship. After obtaining a coin and getting her wish granted, she was able to return to the team, but started to transform. If people saw her like that, she won't be able to be in the team anymore, so she desperately looked for another coin to get another wish and was even ready to kill for it.

(Source: Gleipnir Wiki)

name: Aiko
description: One of Shuichi and Elena's friend.

name: Bomb
description: Bomb  is Bang's older brother as well as a dojo master. He and Bang are the two greatest masters of the Martial Arts world.[2] He's one of the few people who are aware of Saitama's true strength and is part of the Saitama Group.

name: Isamu
description:
__Height:__ 135cm (4'5")
__Race:__ Human
__Occupation:__ Superhero
__Level:__ S-Class; Rank: 5
__Affiliation:__ Heroes Association

Child Emperor is a young boy with large eyes. He wears a plain T-shirt with two buttons both of which are buttoned, along with a black school bag on his back.

As a genius, the Child Emperor values education, which can be seen when he mentions about going to cram school even after hearing about the Earth being in danger. He easily becomes infuriated when being labeled as childish by others. He is very analytical, observing the situation and formulating plans in a calm and collected manner.

name: Puri-Puri Prisoner
description:
__Occupation:__ Superhero 
__Level:__ S-Class; Rank 17

Puri-Puri Prisoner is a flamboyant, openly homosexual superhero. He takes an interest in other, up-and-coming heroes and criminals; an interest which led to his titular jail sentence, as he kept attacking them. Criminals that he apprehends are then added to his harem.

name: Kumiko Oumae
description:
__Height:__ 162 cm  
__Instrument:__ Euphonium

Kumiko enrolled in Kitauji High School after long hoping to wear the uniform. She wasn't particularly dead set on it but decided to join the wind ensemble and continue playing the euphonium. She has a habit of immediately saying what she's thinking and changes her mind easily. She is very preoccupied with something she said to [Reina](https://anilist.co/character/88710/Kousaka-Reina) at a contest in junior high school.

name: Reina Kousaka
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm
__Instrument:__ Trumpet

A girl who graduated from the same junior high school as [Kumiko](https://anilist.co/character/88708/Oumae-Kumiko). Influenced by her dad, who is a pro, she has been playing the trumpet since she was little, so she continues at the wind ensemble in high school. She is stoic and cool, and tends to keep herself distanced from other people.

name: Hazuki Katou
description:
**Instrument:** Tuba

Kumiko's classmate. She was in the tennis club in junior high school, and is a beginner in music. She admired the trumpet and joined the wind ensemble, but ends up playing the tuba. She's a bright and perky mood-maker.

name: Sapphire Kawashima
description:
**Instrument:** Contrabass

Kumiko's classmate. At an elite junior high school for young ladies, she learned to play the contrabass. She joined the wind ensemble to continue to happily play music. She has a positive personality, but worries about her name.

(Source: Anime News Network)

name: Asuka Tanaka
description:
__Height:__ 171 cm
__Instrument:__ Euphonium

A third-year high school student. She is the vice president of the brass band club, and also leads the bass section. Like Kumiko, she plays the euphonium. Her standoffish nature has brushed people off time and again. Her red-rimmed glasses are her trademark.

name: Yuuko Yoshikawa
description:
__Height:__ 156 cm
__Instrument:__ Trumpet

Yuuko is a nice, friendly and cheerful person who is also shown to have confidence, determination and a strong personality. She can openly and confidently show others what she is thinking through her actions, her facial expression, and her words.
However, Yuuko is also an emotional person as she can easily get annoyed or angered when something didn't go in the way she wants it to. Yuuko does acknowledges these flaws of her and tries to improve herself and gets over her own pride for the success of the band.
By nature, Yuuko will put great importance on the people she cares about that she will do anything she can to ensure their happiness and well-being. Sometimes, this leads her to make some mistakes but other times it elicits very noble actions from her. On the opposite, Yuuko behaves acerbically towards individuals she dislikes or someone she perceives as a threat to her cherished friends.

name: Shuuichi Tsukamoto
description:
__Instrument:__ Trombone

Shuuichi is a first-year high school student. He is Kumiko's childhood friend, and the two went to the same junior high school. He and Kumiko are not classmates in high school because they are studying different courses. He was originally a French horn player, but he gets to play the trombone after winning a game of rock-paper-scissors.

name: Noboru Taki
description:
__Height:__ 184cm

Taki is the new music teacher in Kitauji High School and serves as the adviser to the concert band club. He is also in charge of Class 5 of the second-year students. He is polite and has a methodical personality. He emphasizes independence in his students, and to this end he pushes them to reach their goal of going to the national competition.

name: Aoi Saitou
description:
__Instrument:__ Tenor Saxophone

She is a third-year student who quit the Kitauji brass band, having played the tenor saxophone since junior high school.

Aoi was Kumiko Oumae and Shuuichi Tsukamoto's childhood friend, two years older than them. They lived in the same neighborhood, and often played together, but grew apart as they got older.

name: Mamiko Oumae
description: Kumiko's older sister. She is a college student and was a trombone player in a brass band. She taught Kumiko to use a mouthpiece when she was a child.

name: Shinichi Sakurai
description: Shinichi Sakurai is a tall, introverted college student with short brown hair. Shinichi enjoys peace and quiet and likes playing video games. He prefers to be left alone, but despite his objections, he often ends up hanging out with [Hana](https://anilist.co/character/130665/Hana-Uzaki). Shinichi works at a college café run by [Mr. Asai](https://anilist.co/character/169505/Akihiko-Asai).

name: Hana Uzaki
description: Hana Uzaki is a short, silver-haired college student with an energetic personality. Her antics often annoy her senpai, [Shinichi](https://anilist.co/character/130664/).

name: Kiri Uzaki
description: [Hana's](https://anilist.co/character/130665) younger brother, and a high-school junior.

name: Instructor
description:
A nameless character. She instructs the main characters on rock climbing.

Appears in Episode 11 of Season 1.

name: Tsuki  Uzaki
description: The wife of [Fujio Uzaki](https://anilist.co/character/266217), and the mother of [Hana](https://anilist.co/character/130665), [Kiri](https://anilist.co/character/190106), and [Yanagi](https://anilist.co/character/191905). While surprisingly old in age, she appears deceptively young and beautiful. Like her [daughter](https://anilist.co/character/130665/Hana-Uzaki), she is voluptuous.

name: Itsuhito Sakaki
description: Itsuhito Sakaki is [Shinichi](https://anilist.co/character/130664/Shinichi-Sakurai)'s college classmate and friend. He likes to tease [Shinichi](https://anilist.co/character/130664/Shinichi-Sakurai) about [Hana](https://anilist.co/character/130665/Hana-Uzaki), and he tries to cooperate with [Ami](https://anilist.co/character/159410/Ami-Asai) to come up with plans to get [Shinichi](https://anilist.co/character/130664/Shinichi-Sakurai) and [Hana](https://anilist.co/character/130665/Hana-Uzaki) closer together.

name: Ami Asai
description: Ami Asai is Shinichi's coworker and [Mr. Asai](https://anilist.co/character/169505/Akihiko-Asai)'s daughter. She has medium length hair and wears glasses. Ami enjoys "people watching" and ogling attractive males, and she has a fond interest in watching the interactions between [Shinichi](https://anilist.co/character/130664/Shinichi-Sakurai) and [Hana](https://anilist.co/character/130665/Hana-Uzaki). Ami hopes to see Shinichi and Hana enter a relationship, although Ami herself seems to find Shinichi's athletic build attractive.

name: Hiroshi Odokawa
description:
__Occupation:__ Taxi Driver

Odokawa is an eccentric and quiet person who does not open up to others. He has a serious and compassionate side. His hobbies include listening to rakugo before going to bed and listening to the radio while working.

name: Daimon Ani
description: __Occupation:__ Police officer

name: Kanon
description: __Occupation:__ "Freeter" (Unemployed)

name: Miho Shirakawa
description:
__Occupation:__ Nurse

Shirakawa is a nurse at Gouriki's medical clinic. She is a calm and mature woman, but sometimes shows a mischievous side. She is learning capoeira as a hobby.

name: Daimon Otouto
description: __Occupation:__ Police officer

name: Shun Imai
description:
__Occupation:__ Cabaret club boy

Imai is a big fan of Mystery Kiss' Rui Nikaidо. He has an honest and cheerful personality. He spends a lot of money on Nikaido's goods.

name: Gouriki
description:
__Occupation:__ Doctor

Director of the Gouriki Medical Clinic and Odokawa's family doctor. He is always concerned about his patient and friend, Odokawa. He is calm, intelligent, and serious. Has a wife and children.

name: Shibagaki
description: __Occupation:__ Entertainer

name: Yuuya Tenjou
description: Yuuya Tenjou is the main protagonist of the series. Located in his grandfather's secret room, Yuuya came across a door leading to another world, Argena, where he gained his powers. Being able to go back and forth between Earth and Argena, Yuuya became extrodinary in both worlds.

appearsIn.title: I Got a Cheat Skill in Another World and Became Unrivaled in The Real World, Too
I Got a Cheat Skill in Another World and Became Unrivaled in The Real World, Too

native: レクシア・フォン・アルセリア

name: Kaori Houjou
description: The daughter of Ousei Academy's chairman, Tsukasa Houjou, Kaori Houjou was saved by [Yuuya Tenjou](https://anilist.co/character/192860/Yuuya-Tenjou) when she was harrased by strangers near a convenience store. With her recommendation, she was the reason behind his acceptence into Ousei Academy.
