name: Sora Tenjou
description: Twin of Youta Tenjou.

appearsIn.title: I Got a Cheat Skill in Another World and Became Unrivaled in The Real World, Too

name: Malty Melromarc
native: マルティ・メルロマルク
description: The first princess of Melromarc who betrayed [Naofumi Iwatani](https://anilist.co/character/88817) in the beginning of the series. She is notorious for manipulating other people in order to satisfy her selfish desires.

appearsIn.title: The Rising of the Shield Hero Season 3

name: Motoyasu Kitamura
description: A university student summoned to another world as the Spear Hero. He is an easy-going and handsome womanizer.

appearsIn.title: The Rising of the Shield Hero Season 3

name: Ren Amaki
description: A high school student who was summoned to another world as the Sword Hero. He's considered a bishounen and tends to stay quiet.

appearsIn.title: The Rising of the Shield Hero Season 3

name: Melty Q Melromarc
native: メルティ・Q・メルロマルク
description:
The second princess of Melromarc.

Melty is in many ways the exact opposite of her sister, [Malty](https://anilist.co/character/129808/Melromarc-Malty). This includes their personality, appearance, magic specialty (water vs fire), and color schemes (blue and white against red and brown).

appearsIn.title: The Rising of the Shield Hero Season 3

name: Jouichirou Yukihira
description: The father of Sōma Yukihira, and owner of the diner Yukihira in the Sumire Shopping District. His passion for cooking knows no bounds and his skill is world-class. As the sole parental-figure and family member in Sōma's life, he is a mentor, teacher, and rival to his son. Like Sōma, Jōichirō is laid-back but professional and has a serious side that emerges when he is cooking. The two share the same habit of creating horrible experimental dishes. Jōichirō is supportive of his son but does occasionally like to see Sōma stressed and frustrated by challenging him to many cook-offs – always ending in Jōichirō's victory – to show him how much he has to grow. He left home to work abroad and sent his son to Tōtsuki Academy, telling Sōma that he needs to succeed in Tōtsuki if he ever wants to surpass him.

name: Rindou Kobayashi
description:
__Height:__ 171 cm

Rindou Kobayashi is a 90th Generation Tōtsuki Academy alumna and the previous Second Seat of the Elite Ten Council who formerly serves as one of the Senior Officers of Central.

name: Lanterby
description: A second-class WGO adjudicator.

name: Tommy Revolver
description: Tommy Revolver is a BLUE´s contestant who is part of Les Cuisiniers Noirs.

name: Natsume Sendawara
description: Natsume Sendawara is one of the heads of the Haubi Food Corporation along with her twin sister, Orie Sendawara, and one of the five judges of Block A in the 43rd Annual Tōtsuki Autumn Election Preliminaries

name: Hina
description: A strange girl with supernatural powers that suddenly comes into [Nitta](https://anilist.co/character/89229/Nitta-Yoshifumi)'s house in a strange box. She usually has a problem communicating properly with other people and rarely shows emotion.

name: Yoshifumi Nitta
description: The main character, a yakuza member. His life changes dramatically after he met [Hina](https://anilist.co/character/89228/Hina).

name: Yassan
description: A kind homeless man whom Anzu gets to know and teaches her about the value of money.

name: Sayo Aizawa
description: Sayo Aizawa is one of Hina's classmates. The bespectacled girl helped her peers discover Hitomi's secret job as a bartender and enjoys playfully teasing the girl about her profession.

name: Atsushi Yamamoto
description: A member of the rock band Rockfusion that Hina joins.

name: Tsubasa Matsutani
description: He is a teacher in Hina's school.

name: Watashi
description: An unnamed (his name translates to "me" or "I") college student in Kyoto who is recollecting his past two years of college life. He entered college dreaming of the "rosy campus life" that must surely be his. He wants to meet the raven-haired girl of his dreams, which is why he joins a new social circle in each episode. He is quite shy, and easily manipulated by the other characters. Even though he is the central character, he seems to be the most powerless and normal person in the roster.

name: Akashi
description:
Akashi has a very icy personality and is hard to approach. She appears to be slightly less harsh to the main character.

A freshman student who is commonly (but not always) the center of the protagonist's affections. She acts rationally and even coldly towards most people, but often shows hints of affection (or helpfulness) to the protagonist. Her fear of moths also contrasts with her normally calm demeanor.

name: Ozu
description: The main character's mischievous friend, tied to him by "the black thread of fate." Ozu also appears as a child in The Night is Short, Walk on Girl. His ghastly appearance is due to his refusal to eat vegetables or anything of that nature, rather, he subsists off of instant foods and ramen.

name: Seitarou Higuchi
description: Originally introduced as a deity of matrimony in the first episode, Higuchi Seitarou (his full name given in episode four, though he is more commonly referred to simply as Master) appears to be an eighth year student at the university living in the same dorm as the protagonist. He always wears a yukata and has a wise, distant, nonchalant air about him. He often aids the protagonist most directly, though the protagonist may not see it that way.

name: Masaki Jougasaki
description: An eighth year student at the University who leads the Film Circle Misogi. He harbors a secret fetish for breasts, and keeps a love-doll (Kaori). He often takes an antagonistic role of sorts relative to the protagonist, and Ozu often assists Jougasaki in some way, usually a way detrimental to the protagonist's progress, in spite of the fact that Ozu is helping the protagonist at the same time.

name: Ryouko Hanuki
description: A student at the university studying dentistry. She likes getting inebriated, at which point she drastically loses her sense of judgement and flirts with whoever is around. Aware of this, she is cautious about choosing who she goes drinking with. She is very good at speaking in English.

name: Uranai-baba
description: She is a stingy fortune teller.

name: Neko Ramen Tenshu
description: The owner of the Neko Ramen shop the protagonist favors. He is mostly silent, occasionally putting in a short, new insight into the protagonist's current conversations or problems. He occasionally takes on a more active role in the protagonist's adventures, always on a helpful note. The rumor is that he uses actual cats to make the broth, but whether that's true or not cannot be ascertained. However, the taste is unmatched.

name: Kaori
description: A love doll secretly owned by Jougasaki. She becomes one of the protagonist's love interests in episodes 6-8.

name: Chinatsu Kano
description:
__Sports Team:__ Basketball
__School:__ Eimei Junior and Senior High
__Year:__ High School Second-Year / Third-Year

A first-year high school student and the rising star of Elmei Junior and Senior High's girls' basketball team. Her personality and skills have made her incredibly popular both inside and outside of her school, to the point where she's been featured in various magazines. Chinatsu can be quite competitive, as she always arrives to Elmei's gymnasium in the morning for open practice even earlier than [Taiki Inomata](https://anilist.co/character/191242/Taiki-Inomata), whom she frequently shares the floor and sometimes plays one-on-one games with. 

The day after she completed her years as a junior high school student, Chinatsu tearfully practiced playing basketball, having barely failed to qualify for nationals. When Taiki reminds her both of said event and how hard she works, Chinatsu makes it her goal to go to nationals despite her family moving overseas. To get around this, she stays at Taiki's house due to their mothers being friends and former teammates. She gives Taiki a matching foot bracelet when she learns that he also plans to go to nationals.

In the _Ao no Hako_ one-shot, Chinatsu is the captain of her school's girls' basketball team.

name: Taiki Inomata
description:
__Sports Team:__ Badminton, Volleyball (one-shot)
__School:__ Eimei Junior and Senior High
__Year:__ Junior High Third-Year

A third-year middle school student and a member of Eimei Junior and Senior High's boys' badminton team. While not the most-talented player, Taiki is nonetheless extremely hardworking. He very routinely goes to Eimei's gymnasium for morning open practice, sharing the floor with his crush, [Chinatsu Kano](https://anilist.co/character/191241/Chinatsu-Kano). Taiki's strong work ethic is complemented by his optimistic view of things and his headstrong demeanor. His two friends, [Kyou Kasahara](https://anilist.co/character/218647/Kyo-Kasahara) and [Hina Chono](https://anilist.co/character/218648/Hina-Chono), notice that he likes to push himself beyond his own limits in order to achieve his goals, no matter how far away said goals are from him. Taiki also tends to gets ahead of himself in various situations, as his first few interactions with Chinatsu reveal.

Chinatsu is frequently shown to be an inspiration for Taiki, as seeing her do her best motivates him to work harder. He vows to go to nationals after learning that Chinatsu will stay at his house so that she can focus on doing the same.

In the _Ao no Hako_ oneshot, Taiki is instead a member of his school's boys' volleyball team.

name: Hina Chouno
description:
__Sports Team:__ Rhythmic Gymnastics
__School:__ Eimei Junior and Senior High
__Year:__ Junior High Third-Year

A third-year middle school student and a member of Eimei Junior and Senior High's girls' rhythmic gymnastics team. The youngest daughter of a former representative of the Japanese gymnastics team, Hina is considered a prodigy in the sport among her peers, having ranked fourth among all junior high school students in the country. While she doesn't consider herself to be a hard worker, Hina is willing to put in considerable amounts of effort if it results in her being able to achieve her goals.

Hina is friends with both [Kyou Kasahara](https://anilist.co/character/218647) and [Taiki Inomata](https://anilist.co/character/191242), frequently teasing the latter whenever the three hang out. She admires Taiki's headstrong stance towards tackling challenges.

name: Kyou Kasahara
description:
__Sports Team:__ Badminton
__School:__ Eimei Junior and Senior High
__Year:__ Junior High Third-Year

A third-year middle school student and a member of Elmei Junior and Senior High's boys' badminton team. He is friends with both [Taiki Inomata](https://anilist.co/character/191242) and [Hina Chono](https://anilist.co/character/218648/Hina-Chono).

In the _Ao no Hako_ oneshot, Kyo is instead a member of his school's shogi club.

name: Kengo Haryuu
description:
__Sports Team:__ Badminton
__School:__ Eimei Junior and Senior High
__Year:__ High School Second-Year

A second-year high school student and a member of Elmei Junior and Senior High's boys' badminton team. He placed third in the prefectural qualifiers for badminton, barely missing the mark to qualify for nationals.

name: Shuuji Yusa
description: First-year student at Sajikawa High and a member of the Badminton Team. Older brother of [Haruto](https://anilist.co/character/316617).

name: Shouta Hyoudou
description: Third-year student at Sajikawa High and a member of the Badminton Team. He is a former National Champion. Badminton rival to [Kengo Haryuu](https://anilist.co/character/225314/Kengo-Haryuu).

name: Nagisa Funami
description: Second-year student at Eimei Senior High School and a member of the basketball team.

name: Yukiko Inomata
description: Mother of [Taiki Inomata](https://anilist.co/character/191242)

name: Ryousuke Nishida
description: Current captain of the Eimei Senior High badminton team.

name: Kasumi Nomura
description:
A girl who appears to be a goody-two-shoes who reads book in the classroom after school, but she's actually extremely unskilled at English. She asks [Olivia](https://anilist.co/character/126451/) to teach her English.
(Source: ANN)

name: Hanako Honda
description:
An energetic and bright girl who can both play sports and hit the books. However, that doesn't mean she's the sharpest knife in the drawer. She admires popular girls with fulfilling lives, and she's currently part of her middle school's soft tennis team in order to become one herself. However, there seems to be no hope of her becoming popular anytime in the near future.

(Source: ANN)

name: Olivia
description:
A blonde-haired, blue-eyed girl who transferred into [Hanako](https://anilist.co/character/126452/)'s midde school. Both of her parents are non-Japanese, and her appearance might make you think she knows English, but she's actually really bad at it because she was born and raised in Japan. In fact, she can barely speak a word of English.

(Source: ANN)

name: Maeda
description:
Hanako's family servant.
Maeda has vowed to always assist and teach Hanako, even if it means lying to her as to appear all knowing and helpful, he's been doing that since her childhood though, she does act more disdainful towards poor Maeda but both still are fairly close.

He often appears out of nowhere to assist Hanako and the rest.

His loyalty goes as far as to

name: Seitokaichou
description:
She is a smart, bespectacled girl whose real name has not been revealed. Despite her timid demeanor, she managed to win her position with a speech that sounded threatening to the rest of the student body. She constantly throws up procedural barriers for the Pastimers Club, and wavers between trying to be friends with them or undermining their club.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Fujiwara
description: Hanako and Olivia's classmate who takes Olivia's place in the English speech contest. Everyone thinks she's good a classical Japanese because of her appearance but she's actually fluent in English, because of her trouble with the Japanese language she prefers to talk in English.

name: Ruu Oka
description: Oka is the leader of the Occult Research Club and essentially its sole member who befriends the Pastimers Club, teaching them occultic games.

name: Tsugumi Aozora
description: She is a feminine-presenting classmate who the Pastimers suspect of actually being male, leading them to go to great lengths to uncover Tsugumi's true identity. Tsugumi keeps their identity ambiguous and enjoys teasing the club in return.

name: Kentarou Honda
description:
Younger brother of Hanako Honda.

Not much is known about him but he seems to show strong care for Hanako.

name: Kaguya Yamai
description: Outgoing and out-spoken, one can say that she is childish or immature. Kaguya often speaks before considering what she is talking about.

name: Yuzuru Yamai
description: Often speaks in a robot-like speech pattern; when arguing with Kaguya, Yuzuru always sneers at her and points out the flaw in Kaguya’s argument.

name: Miku Izayoi
description: Miku is a Spirit who is an idol and lady. She hates men to the point that [Shidou](https://anilist.co/character/65257) even has to crossdress in order to interact with her.

name: Mildred F. Fujimura
native: ミルドレッド・F・藤村
description: Holding the rank of "second-class non commissioned officer", she is described as a girl with blue eyes and blond hair who wears glasses. She often goes by the nickname "Mily". Her chronological age is close to Origami's thus leading her to have a strange attraction to Origami. She is a mechanic who occasionallyhe gets delusional about others for her own personal fantasy.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Kyon no Imouto
description: Not much is revealed about Kyon's fifth-grade sister; not even her real name is given. Other characters simply refer to the eleven-year-old as Kyon's (Younger) Sister or Little Sis. She has relatively few speaking lines, though she does appear in The Adventures of Mikuru Asahina - Episode 00, Episode 6, and Episode 14, fulfilling the duties of an irrepressible younger sister. She has even fewer lines and appearances in the original novel version than the anime's rendition. Usually, her presence is made apparent whenever Kyon is at home.    She is carefree, happy and playful and is also the force behind the use of the nickname "Kyon"; after she heard their aunt call her older brother such, she started using the nickname as well in front of his school friends. From there, the name spread and eventually stuck. She seems to get along well with all of the SOS Brigade, especially with Mikuru, sharing a sister-like relationship with her.

name: Maki Shijo
description: Maki is a classmate and friend of [Nagisa](https://anilist.co/character/134330). She has short hair styled in short pigtails. She is friends with Nagisa and is secretly jealous of Nagisa's relationship with her boyfriend, as she too liked Kashiwagi's Boyfriend, but could not confess before. As a branch member of the Shinomiya clan, she is [Kaguya](https://anilist.co/character/120649)'s second cousin twice removed so she sometimes refers to Kaguya as "Auntie". [Miyuki](https://anilist.co/character/121101) and [Yuu](https://anilist.co/character/121102/Yuu-Ishigami) observe she acts very tsundere (cold on the outside but wanting to be affectionate), and similar to Kaguya in personality. She declares Yuu and Miyuki as her friends, due to their support in helping her process her failed romance, much to Kaguya's horror

appearsIn.title: Kaguya-sama: Love is War -The First Kiss That Never Ends-

name: Kenji
description: While Brock was at Professor Ivy's lab, Ash and Misty land on Tangelo Island and meet this young man, Tracey. He is a Pokemon Watcher and is also a very big fan of Professor Oak. Knowing that Ash and Misty are close to Professor Oak, Tracey decides to tag along with Ash as the crew travels the Orange Islands. Only after the Orange Islands adventure, Tracey decided to stay in Pallet Town and be Professor Oak's assistant.

name: Matadogas
description:
Matadogas is a purple Pokémon consisting of two spherical heads connected by a thin tube with another sphere in the center. The heads have differing sizes and features. The left head is larger and has prominent eyebrows, pointed teeth protruding from its lower jaw, and two flat teeth in its upper jaw. The smaller, right head simply has two pointed teeth, one at each corner of its mouth. The larger head has a cream-colored skull-and-crossbones marking below its face, while the smaller head has a ring marking instead. It is covered with many geyser-like protrusions, which usually expel mustard-colored gases. Matadogas is said to form when poisonous gases pool and two Koffing fuse over many years. Very rarely, two Koffing can become a Matadogas in a short timespan because of a sudden mutation. Triplet Matadogas have been discovered, although they are extremely rare.

Each of Matadogas' heads contains a different toxin. It mixes its gases by inflating one head and deflating the other. When its gases mix, Matadogas becomes more toxic and putrid. Matadogas can hover in midair, presumably due to gases lighter than air, as is the case for Koffing. Despite their stench and poison, Matadogas' gases can be used to make top-grade perfume by diluting them to the highest level.

Matadogas lives in urban areas. It seeks a dirty, unkempt house and nests there. At night, when the people in the house are asleep, it will go through the trash.

name: Arbok
description:
Arbok is a serpentine Pokémon that resembles a cobra. It has narrow eyes and several sharp teeth. Just below its head is a large hood with a face-like pattern. This pattern has over 20 possible variations. The pattern typically has two red and yellow eyespots outlined in black, a wide black streak resembling an upturned mouth, and a black V-shaped stripe above the eyespots.

Arbok is capable of crushing opponents by coiling its body around them and squeezing them tightly. It can even flatten steel oil drums. If it encounters an enemy, it raises its head, mimics, and stuns the opponent using the frightening pattern on its body. It can also make eerie sounds by expelling air from its mouth. It has been stated that if any part of Arbok's body except for the head is cut off, it can regrow the rest of its body again in a matter of a few weeks. It also has the ability to detect vibrations as shown in the anime. Arbok has been known to be capable of spending long periods underwater and surviving in aquatic environments. One particular Arbok could change its pattern at any time to increase power to different stats and get invulnerability to status conditions, if the pattern is uncovered.

Arbok is territorial. It lashes out at intruders with long fangs tipped with deadly venom. Vengeful in nature, it will not give up a chase once it targets its prey or an opponent, no matter how far.

name: Kojirou
description: Kojirou is a member of the Rocket Gang, more specifically part of a trio with [Musashi](https://anilist.co/character/3935/Musashi) and [Nyarth](https://anilist.co/character/3937/Nyarth), that follows [Satoshi](https://anilist.co/character/2473/Satoshi) and his friends around in the Pocket Monsters anime, usually trying to steal Satoshi's [Pikachu](https://anilist.co/character/3891/Pikachu).

name: Pikachu
description: Pikachu is the signature Pokémon of the Pocket Monsters anime, and the first Pokémon that Satoshi obtained on his journey as a Pokémon Trainer, given to him by Professor Okido.

name: Sonans
description:
Sonans is a tall, cyan Pokémon with a soft body. Its eyes usually appear scrunched, and it has a jagged upper lip. Female Sonans have a red marking on their mouth that resembles lipstick, while males do not. It has flat arms that are wider towards the tip and four stubby legs at the base of its body. There are two eyespots on its black tail. Sonans is very protective of its tail, to the point where it will suddenly turn uncharacteristically aggressive if the tail is attacked.

(Source: Bulbapedia)

Musashi's Sonans originally belonged to a different trainer until she accidentally traded her Beroringa for it. It has a tendency to break out of its Pokéball whenever it feels like it, usually to the dismay of the rest of Rocket-dan, and often joins in when they are blasting off. Sonans is the only Pokémon Rocket-dan obtained in the Original Series that is still part of their team today.

name: Musashi
description: Musashi is a member of the Rocket Gang, more specifically part of a trio with [Kojirou](https://anilist.co/character/3936) and [Nyarth](https://anilist.co/character/3937), that follows [Satoshi](https://anilist.co/character/2473) and his friends around in the Pocket Monsters anime, usually trying to steal Satoshi's [Pikachu](https://anilist.co/character/3891).

name: Togepy
description:
Togepy is a small, light yellow Pokémon with a round body that is still encased in its eggshell. Togepy does not shed its shell. The Egg has red and blue shapes on it. Togepy has stubby hands and round feet with two toes each. Togepy has black eyes and five spikes on its head that seem to form a crown. It also has semi-oval, brown pads on the soles of its feet.

Togepy is able to release poison from the spikes on its head. The anime has shown that it can retract into its shell, which it usually does to sleep. It is able to siphon the positive energy of others, and then release it to those in need of it. It has a very joyful nature. As a result, it is said that it shares its joy with those who take care of it. Because of its disposition, Togepy is seen as a sign of good luck, especially if a Trainer is capable of getting a sleeping Togepy to stand. It is also shown in the anime that Togepy can act very maliciously at times, causing havoc and bad luck to its enemies. Although it is rare in the wild, Togepy can most commonly be found living within the forests.

(Source: Bulbapedia)

name: Kasumi
description:
Kasumi is a Gym Leader of Hanada City's Gym, known officially as the Hanada Gym. She gives the Cascade Badge to Trainers who defeat her in battle. She specializes in Water-type Pokémon.

Kasumi is a friend and former traveling partner of the anime's main character, Satoshi. After he stole her bike and proceeded to accidentally destroy it, Kasumi followed him around the Kanto region, the Orange Islands, and the Johto region, using the time she spent with him to further her goal of becoming the greatest Water Pokémon Master.

native: ジオルド・スティアート
description:
__Magic Type:__ Fire

Gerald is the third prince of the country, and the capture target that is Katarina's fiance. Even though he looks like an orthodox blonde-haired, blue-eyed prince, Katarina thought otherwise that on the inside he’s actually an evil sadistic prince.

However, even though Gerald in the game was supposed to be “not interested in Katarina at all, and almost never visited her, before she noticed, he would come over to her house once every three days. And, he even helps Katarina harvest the fruits and vegetables from the field, and would always bring her sweets as presents, and were completely friends now. They have a lot of contact.

__Game Description:__ Gerald, though have a prince out of a fairy tale look but his personality was twisted and schemer. He is a genius who can do anything. He has no particular interests and is bored with his everyday life.

description:
__Magic Type:__ Light

Maria Campbell was the main character of the game Fortune Lover.

Maria worked hard and actively participated in household chores, never complained or said anything selfish, and desperately studied. When she entered magic school, her long years of hopes for magic school were immediately shattered when she learned she was the only commoner. What’s more, she was also bullied for the audacity of having magic powers despite only being a commoner.

Because of this scar, she considered the prince to be hers, and bound him to her. In addition, she didn’t think highly of suddenly getting a stepbrother, and often bullied him.

Keith is the capture target that was adopted into the Claes family seven years ago for his powerful magic. He’s a handsome boy with flaxen hair and blue eyes, and since he was neglected by his stepmother and stepsister, had a lonely upbringing and became a playboy type character because of it. And when he entered school, his loneliness was supposed to be healed by the heroine and he would fall in love, but to prevent that from happening, Katarina has been pulling him out of his room every day. During this time, without Katarina having to pull him out anymore it turned out that they were always together.

Game Description: The 3rd capturable character in the game Fortune Lover and the stepbrother of Katarina Claes. He was adopted from a branch family because of his huge magical powers. he is treated coldly by his stepsister and stepmother. As a reaction to this lack of affection, he grew up to be a playboy.

description:
__Magic Type:__ Water

Alan is the fourth prince of this country, and is Gerald’s younger twin brother as well as a capture target. He’s a beautiful prince with a wild streak, with silver hair and blue eyes, and he’s always being compared to Gerald, so he’s constantly in pain from feelings of inferiority, and it should have been set that he hates his brother, but Alan didn’t seem to be troubled by an inferiority complex or anything at all now, and it doesn’t seem like he hates Gerald either. Katarina didn't know she was the reason why the twins relationship has been reasonably good.

Although Alan route Katarina didn’t appear as she wasn’t a rival, in the game she should have had hardly any contact with Alan but he would come to visit her almost every day, and his talent for music has completely bloomed so Katarina always receive invitations to his piano and violin concerts and would always go together with everyone. Katarina and Alan were completely friends now.

__Game Description:__ Gerald’s younger twin brother, the fourth prince of the country. Until he was five, he was quite sickly, and almost died. Because of that, he was raised over protectively, and became a rather spoiled prince. However, compared to his older twin that can do anything, he’s a bit perverted. He always had a strong sense of rivalry and inferiority towards his older twin, and barely interacted with him at all.

name: Mary Hunt
description:
__Magic Type:__ Water

The 4th daughter of Marquis Hunt, a feeble and weak character in the otome game Fortune Lover who was supposed to have no contact with Katarina.

Mary is Alan’s fiancee, and is also the rival character on his route. She’s a beauty with auburn hair and doll-like eyes. In the game settings, she didn’t think highly of Katarina Claes, and just like Alan, should have had almost no contact with Katarina, but she’s already one of her best friends now.

(Source: Destruction Flag Otome Wikia)

appearsIn.title: My Next Life as a Villainess: All Routes Lead to Doom!
My Next Life as a Villainess: All Routes Lead to Doom! X
My Next Life as a Villainess: All Routes Lead to Doom!

name: Nicol Ascart
description:
__Magic Type: Wind__

The fourth capturable character of the otome game Fortune Lover.

He’s the taciturn, expressionless son of the prime minister, and also a capture target. With black hair and eyes, and a perfect doll-like face, he’s a handsome boy with a devilish charm that can even capture men as well as women with his unique atmosphere.

Game Description: Nicole Ascarot, the prime minister’s son, Alan and Gerald’s childhood friend. He’s one year older than the heroine, and is a taciturn senpai type of character.

(Source: Destruction Flag Otome Wikia)

appearsIn.title: My Next Life as a Villainess: All Routes Lead to Doom!
My Next Life as a Villainess: All Routes Lead to Doom! X

name: Sophia Ascart
description:
__Magic Type:__ Wind

Sophia, Nicol's sister and rival for the path of Nicol. She is as beautiful as her brother and should not have been in contact with Katarina, but now she is her companion, and one of her best friends, like Mary.

appearsIn.title: My Next Life as a Villainess: All Routes Lead to Doom!

Student Council President at Magic Academy.
