description: Oldest of the slime spirit sisters. Loves books and math.

appearsIn.title: I've Been Killing Slimes for 300 Years and Maxed Out My Level
I’ve Been Killing Slimes for 300 Years and Maxed Out My Level

name: Shalsha
description: Youngest of the slime spirit sisters. Loves books and history.

appearsIn.title: I've Been Killing Slimes for 300 Years and Maxed Out My Level
I’ve Been Killing Slimes for 300 Years and Maxed Out My Level

name: Rosalie
description: A ghost girl and resident of the house in the highlands. She's devoted to Azusa, who didn't shy away from her as a ghost and instead reached out to her. She can go through walls but can't touch people. She can also possess others.

appearsIn.title: I've Been Killing Slimes for 300 Years and Maxed Out My Level
I’ve Been Killing Slimes for 300 Years and Maxed Out My Level

name: Flatorte
description: Flatorte is a cheerful, energetic blue dragon girl who obeys what [Azusa](https://anilist.co/character/135592/Aizawa-Azusa) says. Since she's a dragon like [Laika](https://anilist.co/character/135593/Laika), there is somewhat of a rivalry between them, but she's an optimistic and energetic girl. Unlike Laika, she has a tail in human form.

appearsIn.title: I've Been Killing Slimes for 300 Years and Maxed Out My Level
I’ve Been Killing Slimes for 300 Years and Maxed Out My Level

name: Provat Allières
native: プロヴァト・ペコラ・アリエース
description: The Demon King. A girl with a devilish temperament who loves to use her power and influence to bewilder her subordinates and Azusa. She actually has a masochistic desire to be subordinate to someone stronger than she is, and she adores Azusa.

appearsIn.title: I've Been Killing Slimes for 300 Years and Maxed Out My Level

name: Natalie
description:
Natalie Jr. is a new guild receptionist at the Adventurer's Guild in Flatta village. She shares a name with her predecessor [Natalie](https://anilist.co/character/217736).

Natalie Jr. is the one who reveals that Azusa has achieved max level by killing nothing but slimes for over 300 years with her Increased EXP Acquisition ability. However, due to Azusa wanting to keep a low profile and continue with her quiet slow life, she requests that Natalie keep her stats and level a secret, to which, Natalie agrees.

appearsIn.title: I've Been Killing Slimes for 300 Years and Maxed Out My Level

name: Baki Hanma
description: Baki is the son of Yujiro Hanma and Emi Akezawa.

appearsIn.title: Baki: The Search of our Strongest Hero

name: Kureha Shinogi
description: The older brother of Shinogi, he is very narcissistic and trains to develop the perfect body. He is also a surgical genius able to do surgeries that normally take several hours in only 30 minutes, though he does not have a license. He fights Baki Hanma and is destroyed in combat by him after Baki meets the people that got screwed over by him. Ironically, he is saved by one of his victims when he needed a blood transfusion after his match with Baki. In the tournament, he fights his younger brother Shinogi and though he destroys Shinogi he decides to give up to let his younger brother continue in the tournament. During that match, despite losing his eyesight when Shiogi severed two of his cords, he surgically fixed his nerves during his fight. He serves as tournament medic as the matches go on and tried to stop Jack Hammer from using any steroids only to be beaten by him. Later, he helps Jack Hammer develop new ways of getting stronger without the use of steroids.

name: Izo Motobe
description: Motobe Izo is an old Japanese Jujitsu master. He is a calm and pretty gloomy person, who rarely shows any excitement. At one time, he seemed to have more of an obsession with defeating Yujiro Hanma than most martial artists, but he has never shown to be a match for him.

name: Kozue Matsumoto
description:
**Age**: 17
**Height**: 160cm
**Fighting style**: none

A girl from Baki's school, her mother is Baki's landlord. Her father fought and died in the Underground arena. She cares deeply for Baki, but denies when asked. She is disillusioned by Baki's violent life as an Underground fighter and begs him several times to quit. Though she still disapproves, Kozue better understands Baki's resolve after visiting Emi's grave site. After Baki's first tournament match, he reveals that he cares for Kozue.

appearsIn.title: Baki: The Search of our Strongest Hero

name: Katsumi Orochi
description: Yūko Maekawa - A 3rd dan, Doppo's son and current prodigy of Shinshinkai karate.

appearsIn.title: Baki: The Search of our Strongest Hero

name: Gaia Nomura
description: The leader of a mercenary group who fought Baki. He was once a reckless mercenary called Nomura who loved killing. However, after facing the "ultimate fear" when faced with a firing squad during the Ugandan Bush War, he lost his hair and the personality of Gaia manifested from Nomura, as well as gaining supersensory ability. It is said that Gaia is Yujiro's equal in combat. However, when it comes to jungle warfare, he is considered to be the king and he is often called as "Mr.War" and "War god". As a evidence of his ability, he and his mercenary team was hired by the JGSDF as a instructor for non-conventional warfare, and they defeated an entire company of soldiers including a Type 90 Tank in a training battle with ease. As Nomura he is best described as a weakling who acts as a medic for the team. However, when the situation is right and his adrenaline starts pumping, the Gaia personality will manifest itself to fight. He utterly despises Yujiro, stating he is nothing but a thrill seeker that fights for pleasure. He fights Baki and honorably loses to him. When he crossed paths with Yujiro, Gaia told him that Baki is a better warrior than Yujiro can ever be before the two fight (even though he loses miserably). Gaia makes a surprising appearance in the 'Search of Our Strongest Hero' manga by replacing Jack Hammer during his fight with the Russian convict Sikorsky. He proceeds to defeat Sikorsky with ease, and terrorises Sikorsky into admitting defeat.

name: Dorian
description:
Dorian is a great Chinese Kenpo fighter from the United States.

Of all the five convicts, he is most notable for using a wide variety of tools during fights, such as flammable materials and lightweight wire.

appearsIn.title: Baki: The Search of our Strongest Hero

name: Oliva Biscuit
description: An assassin working for the US. He possesses an iron body and is almost invulnerable to anything. He and Yujiro crossed paths while he was sent to assassinate a drug cartel leader. He also has one bizarre technique in which he curls into a perfect sphere of muscle in which he is impervious to attacks, but can uncurl and seize his opponents, 'eating' them "like Pac-Man". He then crushes them with his muscles. His appearance and name are based on former Mr. Universe and three-time Mr. Olympia Sergio Oliva.

appearsIn.title: Baki: The Search of our Strongest Hero

name: Kaiou Retsu
description: Chinese Kung-Fu (referred to as "Kenpo" in Japanese) practitioner. Trained in China and became the heir to his Kung Fu style in his temple.   Despite his great knowledge in his style he does not open his mind to the possibility of learning from other disciplines at first but after striking up a friendship with Katsumi Orochi post tournament he appears to want to teach as well as learn at the Shinshinkai Dojo.

name: Hector Doyle
description:
Hector Doyle is a death row inmate who escaped the Caglios prison to find a suitable opponent to face him. He survived his execution on the electric chair. He doesn't use a specific fighting style, but is extremely dangerous due to his modified body.

(Source: Baki Wiki)

name: Yoshitake Shiraishi
description:
One of the Abashiri Convicts who travels with Sugimoto's Group. 

Shiraishi is carefree and goofy, and prefers to sneak his way out of trouble. He is also rather immature. Most of the time, Shiraishi lacks seriousness and prefers to spend time on frivolous pursuits like gambling or eating rather than looking for the gold. He also likes pretty women; his backstory involves him searching for a woman he fell in love with through a sloppy drawing.

Shiraishi has a roguish personality. Because he lacks strength, he prefers to flee danger but is confident in his ability to escape any bond. He tends to keep his calm when in danger as a result and given time, can psychologically dominate his guards and manipulate them.

Shiraishi is based on the real life figure _Yoshie Shiratori_ who is known for having escaped from prison at least four times.

name: Asirpa
description:
Asirpa is an Ainu girl who finds [Sugimoto](https://anilist.co/character/124704/Sugimoto-Saichi) when he is attacked by a bear. Her father was one of the Ainu killed by the Japanese who stole the Ainu gold. Her Japanese name is Asuko Kochoube (小蝶辺明日子).

From a young age, Asirpa was trained by her father to become a hunter. As such, she possesses many skills that are necessary for a successful hunter: trapping, poison brewing, knowledge of traditional medicine, archery, deep knowledge of Hokkaido's flora and fauna, harsh winter survival. Asirpa is also a great cook and can prepare many traditional Ainu dishes from the animals she hunts, along with what she forages in the forest.

name: Saichi Sugimoto
aliases: Sugimoto the Immortal (不死身の杉元)
description: A demobilized soldier who survived the Russo-Japanese War in 1904. He served in the 1st Division of the Imperial Japanese Army and fought in the battle of 203 Hill. He was feared for his savage fighting style and amazing toughness on the battle field, and was known as "Immortal Sugimoto". He decides to make money to save his dead comrade [Toraji](https://anilist.co/character/131880)'s wife, [Umeko](https://anilist.co/character/131882).

name: Hyakunosuke Ogata
description:
Ogata is the former Superior Private of the 7th Division and a member of [Hijikata's](https://anilist.co/character/125422/Hijikata-Toshizou) Group. Loyal only to himself, Ogata is pursuing the gold for his own reason, unknown to anyone.

Ogata is analytical and coldblooded, a proud sniper who is used to examining things from afar and evaluating circumstances in order to best take advantage of them. Even when at a disadvantage, he keeps his nerve and takes the most efficient course of action. He is also known for his marksmanship, a skill he honed since his childhood. He is ruthless and doesn't hesitate to kill, although he is aware that wanton slaughter is counterproductive, and would rather escape a fight he can't win than throw himself into it impulsively.

On the surface, Ogata is capable of acting amiable and polite; in order to achieve his goals, he can lie and deceive others. He is prone to caustic remarks and may openly look down on some people. Ogata also likes to snark about any perceived absurdity and incompetence, especially if it comes to warfare and keeping one's gun safe. Although he is generally emotionless and indifferent to others, Ogata seems to be a very proud man who doesn't like to be doubted. If challenged, he would attempt to do a task that someone says would be difficult for him. He has a habit of slicking his hair back, as well as exhaling through his nose when praised.

name: Genjirou Tanigaki
description:
The Private First Class of the 7th Division and a Matagi of Tohoku. He seems to have a frail and low self-esteem, being shown to cry easily under heavy criticism.

Tanigaki is a Japanese man from Akita, around the age of [Sugimoto](https://anilist.co/character/124704/Sugimoto-Saichi) and the Nikaidou twins, with a muscular body and body hair. He has dark brown eyes, short, black hair, a thin beard along his jawline, and thick eyebrows. Since his and Nihei Tetsuzou's fight against Sugimoto's group, he has a little scar on his right cheek from a wound caused by Sugimoto's knife.

name: Toshizou Hijikata
aliases: Demon Vice Commander of the Shinsengumi
description:
Hijikata is the vice-commander of the Shinsengumi and leader of his group. Despite being imprisoned for decades, he remains energetic and optimistic.

Hijikata is very ambitious despite his old age and plans to take over Hokkaido and create his own country in defiance of Japan. To do so, he takes swift and decisive action to search for the gold. As a former Shinsengumi, Hijikata is ruthless and doesn't hesitate to kill his opponents. Always smiling, Hijikata is flamboyant and regularly boasts about his ambitions and prowess despite his age. He is civil toward people but merciless against his enemies, always shouting to his men to kill every opponent. Hijikata considers that in battle, the best soldiers are those ready to die fighting.

name: Shinpachi Nagakura
description: Nagakura Shinpachi is a member of Hijikata's Group and regarded as the best swordsman in the Shinsengumi.

name: Tetsuzou Nihei
aliases: The Hunter Who Gives Hibernating Bears Bad Dreams
description: Tetsuzou Nihei was a hunter and one of the Abashiri Convicts. He owns a dog named [Ryu](https://anilist.co/character/131135/Ryu).

name: Youhei Nikaidou
description: Younger twin brother of Kouhei Nikaidou and a member of the 7th Division.

name: Joe
description:
An underground Megaloboxer from the outskirts of town whose real name is unknown, Junk Dog is forced to throw fights to earn money for his crooked manager, [Gansaku Nanbu](https://anilist.co/character/130056/Gansaku-Nanbu). He had something that most boxers lack however: ''A True Fighting Spirit''. He fights not just for the sake of earning a dime or two, but to prove himself as a Megaloboxer. So, he gets challenged by [Yuri](https://anilist.co/character/127574/Yuuri) to join the Megalonia Tournament and fight him in order to prove he's a real fighter, he immediately jumps at the opportunity and goes for it, taking on the name "Joe" when he has a Citizen ID forged in order to enter the Megalonia tournament.

He initially fights with old Gear that is constantly in need of repair.  He later takes on the ring name "Gearless Joe" as part of a gimmick to rise in the rankings quickly, fighting without Gear against Gear-equipped opponents. Joe also later met and saved a orphan boy named [Sachio](https://anilist.co/character/130054/Sachio) and his friends, together along with Nanbu they formed "Team Nowhere".

(His counterpart in the original [Ashita no Joe](https://anilist.co/anime/2402/Ashita-no-Joe/) is [Joe Yabuki](https://anilist.co/character/11804/Joe-Yabuki).)

name: Yuuri
description: Yuuri is [Yukiko Shirato's](https://anilist.co/character/130053/Yukiko-Shirato) bodyguard and the current champion of Megalolania, a massive megaloboxing tournament headed by the Shirato Group. He seeks out the underground fighter [Junk Dog (Joe)](https://anilist.co/character/125369/Joe) after he had insulted both him and Yukiko, meeting him in the underground ring where he easily defeats him and challenges him to work his way up to Megalonia if he wants to fight him again. Yuuri is equipped with a unique prototype state-of-the-art "integrated" Gear, which is surgically grafted directly to his arms.

name: Yukiko Shirato
description: Head of the Shirato Group who oversees the Megalonia tournament.

name: Fujimaki
description: A mob boss that sets up fixed fights for Junk Dog and Nanbu. He assists the duo in acquiring a forged Citizen ID so they can enter Megalonia and pay him back with the prize money after Junk Dog refuses to throw a fight.

name: Sakuya Togane
description:
Togane has narrow gray eyes and long black hair whose bangs curl. His attire consists of a black suit with a gray and green vest worn over a white shirt and black tie. His collar points seem to be tucked under the vest. He is an Enforcer in Division 1 of the Public Safety Bureau.

(Source: PSYCHO-PASS Wiki)

name: Mika Shimotsuki
description: She is a student of Oso Girl's Academy who seems to be aware of what's going on around campus. She is [Kagami](https://anilist.co/character/74009/)'s friend and classmate.

name: Kirito Kamui
description: Kirito Kamui is a person who cannot be detected by any scanners or by the Dominators themselves. He aids and abets criminals, including Akira Kitazawa, with his ability to clarify their Hues.

name: Nobuchika Ginoza
description: A veteran Inspector working with Akane. He coordinates all the Enforcers in Unit 1. An old friend of Shinya's, his hatred for those with high Crime Coefficients and his zeal to oust them from society came from the inability to stop his former partner from becoming a latent criminal. Although he still has a certain degree of trust with Shinya, he holds a dislike for Shinya's Enforcer partner, Masaoka, for unknown reasons. Ginoza constantly tells Akane to draw a line between herself and the Enforcers she works with.

name: Yayoi Kunizuka
description: The only female Enforcer of Unit One. She stays calm and collected in the face of even the most brutal crimes. She and Shion are lovers.

name: Mizue Shisui
description: Mizue Shisui was an inspector in Division 2.

name: Haruhiko Ichijou
description:
A first-year high school student, he has the power to summon or seal Phantoms by drawing them in a sketchbook.

Haruhiko keeps a massive library in his house, and is knowledgeable on all kinds of subjects. This often comes in useful when dealing with Phantoms, but his teammates do not always enjoy listening to his trivia.

name: Mai Kawakami
description:
Mai is a second-year high school student at Hosea Academy and the leader of her Phantom-hunting team. Her ability is called "Spirit of the Five Elements", which requires her to  channel a specific element from parts of her body into her fists, using the classic Chinese elemental system.

She specializes in close combat and fights on the frontline, with Haruhiko backing her up.

name: Reina Izumi
description:
__Height:__ 157 cm (5'2")
__Affiliations:__ Hosea Academy, Team E
__Occupation:__ First year High School Student. Ability Wielder, Phantom Hunter

Reina Izumi is a first-year high school student who transferred to Hosea Academy in April. She has a special ability, and because of this she later joins the Phantom-Hunter club with [Haruhiko Ichijou](https://anilist.co/character/89033/Haruhiko-Ichijou) as a member of Team E. She does not get along well with her parents until some events that happen later.

Reina has a special ability to consume and seal away phantoms, hence why she was given the nickname ‘The Phantom Eater.’ This ability also satisfies her hunger. However, if she doesn’t want to eat the phantom then she won’t. She notably doesn’t require an incantation to use her ability, unlike her other teammates in Team E. Other than her sealing ability, she also has the ability to heal through mouth contact. As a practitioner of Aikido, Reina knows basic self-defense where she can easily throw people taller than her (like Haruhiko).

name: Koito Minase
description:
__Height:__ 162 cm (5'4")
__Affiliations:__ Hosea Academy, Team E
__Occupation:__ 1st-year High School Student, Ability Wielder, Phantom Hunter

Koito Minase is a 1st-year high school student who transferred to Hosea Academy in April. Initially, instead of joining a club or fighting the phantoms together with the others, she chose to fight them alone. This is due to the fact that she has shut herself off from other people because of an incident that happened during her childhood. After Team E helped her on various occasions, despite wishing to work on her own, she decides to join them as an official member of the club.

In order to fight, Koito has a special ability that she commands with her voice. By using an incantation, she can create bindings that can capture, immobilize, and even destroy phantoms if she so chooses to.

name: Ruru
aliases: Rururaruri Rurararirararururirirari Rirararururararururararirari (ルルラルリー・ルララリララルルリリラリー・リララルルララルルララリラリー)
description:
Ruru is a Phantom who accompanies Haruhiko. She is not the type of Phantom that is hunted, and is a self-proclaimed 'good girl'.

Her full name is Rururaruri Rurararirararururirirari Rirararururararururararirari.

name: Kurumi Kumamakura
description:
__Height:__ 132cm (4'4")
__Affiliations:__ Hosea Academy, Team E
__Occupation:__ 4th-year Grade School Student, Ability Wielder, Phantom Hunter

Kurumi Kumamakura is a 4th-year grade school student at Hosea Academy. After getting to know [Haruhiko Ichijou](https://anilist.co/character/89033/Haruhiko-Ichijou), she joins Team E as a member of the Phantom-Hunter club.

In order to fight, she uses her special ability, Albrecht, a teddy bear in which she always carries around her wherever she goes. If she could, Kurumi would put her life on the line if it meant protecting him, as she considers him to be her childhood best friend (even if he doesn't talk). In fact, she loves everything that has to do with bears, from the animal itself, her favorite food, her birth place, and her last name which has "Kuma" (Bear) in it's name.

name: Arisu Himeno
description:
A teacher at Hosea Academy. In charge of the school's Neural Error Corrections Room, thus responsible for assigning phantom hunting jobs to students with special abilities.

Also a Member of the Alayashiki Research Facility.

name: Floki
description: A Jomsviking commander whom contracted [Askeladd](https://anilist.co/character/13020) to assassinate [Thors](https://anilist.co/character/13021), Floki's former comrade.

name: Hild
description: An engineering genius from a young age.

name: Sigurd
description: [Halfdan](https://anilist.co/character/140356/Halfdan)'s Son, and [Gudrid](https://anilist.co/character/89270/Gudrid)'s previous husband.

name: Faxi
description: is a young boy from Thorfinn's village.

name: Magni
description: is a young man from Thorfinn's village.

name: Anaguma
description: Member of [Snake](https://anilist.co/character/79913/)'s mercenaries employed as guards of [Ketil](https://anilist.co/character/223346)'s farm.

name: Brodd
description: A messenger for King Canute.

name: Asrid
description: Asrid is [Sigurd](https://anilist.co/character/148022/Sigurd)'s mother and [Halfdan](https://anilist.co/character/140356/Halfdan)'s wife.

name: Manaka Mukaido
description: The heroine, a middle school girl who is indecisive and prone to crying. She is best friends with [Hikari Sakishima](https://anilist.co/character/73067).

name: Chisaki Hiradaira
description:
A calm and compassionate 14-year-old middle school student from Shioshishio, a village located in the sea. Chisaki is the childhood friend of [Manaka](https://anilist.co/character/73065/Mukaido-Manaka), [Hikari](https://anilist.co/character/73067/Sakishima-Hikari), and [Kaname](https://anilist.co/character/86313/Isaki-Kaname), and together they attend Mihama Junior High School, which is located in the surface town of Oshiooshi. She attempts to act mature in most situations, putting her friends' feelings before her own, but her temper can flare up whenever she gets especially frustrated - in particular towards [Tsumugu](https://anilist.co/character/86225/Kihara-Tsumugu), whose new presence she believes is spoiling the harmonious relationship between her friends. 

Chisaki harbors an unrequited crush on Hikari, although he is unaware of her feelings. She also has a complex about her body​ and hates change to the point where it hinders her own emotional development.

name: Kaname Isaki
description: One of four childhood friends from Shioshishio. He is [Hikari](https://anilist.co/character/73067/Sakishima-Hikari)'s best friend and is quiet and mature for his age. He is interested in [Chisaki](https://anilist.co/character/86227/Hiradaira-Chisaki) and cares deeply for her.

name: Hikari Sakishima
description: One of four childhood friends from Shioshishio. He has a short temper and usually scolds Manaka for her mistakes, though he has deep feelings for her. He is the son of Shioshishio's Chief Priest, who serves the Sea God.

name: Tsumugu Kihara
description: A boy from the surface whose grandfather is a fisherman. One day, he meets [Manaka](https://anilist.co/character/73065/Mukaido-Manaka) when she is caught in his net. He is quiet, stoic, and very interested in the underwater world.

name: Miuna Shiodome
description: A third grade elementary school girl whose mother, Miori (originally from Shioshishio), died when she was young. She met Akari a couple of times and played with her when Akari came to visit Miuna's mom and the family.

name: Sayu Hisanuma
description: A third grade elementary school girl with brown haired pigtails and eyes. She is Miuna's best friend who often instigates confrontations with sea people. She appears to have a crush on Kaname.

name: Uroko
description: He's the wise Lord of the village and makes sure everyone follows the laws of the sea. A pervert that also enjoys drinking Sake, it's hard to take him seriously. Manaka says he's like a God.

name: Sensei
description: Teacher at Mihama Middle School

name: Tomoru Sakishima
description:
The father of Hikari Sakishima and Akari Sakishima and "Chief Priest" of the village Shioshishio. He is regarded very highly among the others in the village and is the attentent of Uroko.

(Source: Nagi no Asu Kara Wiki)

name: Shin Reglia
description: Right hand of Demon King [Anos Voldigoad](https://anilist.co/character/138595) and the most powerful swordsman among the demons.

appearsIn.title: The Misfit of Demon King Academy Ⅱ: History's Strongest Demon King Reincarnates and Goes to School with His Descendants
The Misfit of Demon King Academy

name: Kanon
description: Kanon is a hero that battles against Anos. He seems to have a mutual respect with Anos, with both of them understanding each other. Before Anos was slain by Kanon, Anos wished they could be friends in 2000 years, should they ever meet.

appearsIn.title: The Misfit of Demon King Academy Ⅱ: History's Strongest Demon King Reincarnates and Goes to School with His Descendants
The Misfit of Demon King Academy

name: Lay Glanzudlii
native: レイ・グランズドリィ
description: Lay Glanzudlii is a member of the Generation of Chaos, commonly known as "The Demon Sword Saint" and a transfer student at Demon King Academy.

appearsIn.title: The Misfit of Demon King Academy Ⅱ: History's Strongest Demon King Reincarnates and Goes to School with His Descendants

name: Misa Ilioroagu
description: **Misa Ilioroagu** is Anos' classmate, and shows herself as skeptical about the current society in which pure-blooded demons are favored.

appearsIn.title: The Misfit of Demon King Academy Ⅱ: History's Strongest Demon King Reincarnates and Goes to School with His Descendants

name: Yuu Koito
description:
__Height:__ 153 cm (5'0")

A first year high school student who has never experienced romantic feelings. She joins the student council, where she meets [Touko Nanami](https://anilist.co/character/123529). She lives above the family bookstore, where she occasionally works.

name: Touko Nanami
description:
**Height:** 163 cm (5’4”)

A second year high school student, and the busiest member of the student council. She consistently ranks number one with her test scores and grades, and excels in sports as well. Due to this, and her beauty, admirers frequently confess to her - only to be turned down, as the confessions never make her feel anything.

name: Suguru Doujima
description: Doujima is a first-year high school boy and a member of the student council.

name: Sayaka Saeki
description: Sayaka is [Touko Nanami](https://anilist.co/character/123529/Nanami-Touko)'s best friend from her first year of high school. She is a second-year high school girl and the student council vice president.

name: Koyomi Kanou
description: Yuu's classmate and friend from middle school. She wants to become a writer.

name: Miyako Kodama
description: Owner of a small café. Riko's girlfriend.

name: Seiji Maki
description: Maki is a first-year high school boy and a member of the student council. He grew up surrounded by two older sisters and a younger sister, so he finds it easy to talk with girls.

name: Akari Hyuuga
description: Akari is Yuu's classmate and friend from middle school. She is a member of the basketball club.

name: Riko Hakozaki
description: A literature teacher and the student council's staff advisor. Miyako's girlfriend.

name: Rossweisse
description:
__Rank:__ Low-class 
__Devil Role:__ Rook 
__Species:__ Reincarnated Devil (Former Valkyrie) 
__Power:__ Norse Magic 

Originally Odin's bodyguard. After the battle with Loki and Fenrir, Odin leaves her in Issei's town. She then gets persuaded by Rias to become her servant. She remains in Kuou Academy as a teacher.  Rossweisse is known to be a very serious person. She has a tendency to buy things at sales when they're cheap, allowing Issei to coin for her the nickname "The 100-Yen Shop Valkyrie".  Rossweisse makes her first appearance in Volume 5 as Odin's bodyguard, reminding him of his status and telling him not to look at Serafall Leviathan lecherously. Odin responds by mocking her for not having a boyfriend.  

Rossweisse is highly proficient in the use of Norse magic, specializing in long-range and bombarding attacks. She is capable of using ice, fire, water, lightning, wind, thunder, light, summoning, and explosive-based magic.  Upon returning from her training in Valhalla in Volume 12, she starts to use defensive spells (using the trait of Rook) which are strong enough to easily shield against Balance Breakers.

name: Chito
description: She travels with [Yuuri](https://anilist.co/character/120890) on their Kettenkrad. She can read and write in the current language, but not in kanji or Latin alphabets, because they became old languages in this world. She loves reading and collecting books she finds during traveling.

name: Yuuri
description: Yuuri is a care-free, fun-loving girl. She is the direct foil and companion of [Chito](https://anilist.co/character/120889). She carries an Arisaka type 38 rifle and loves food more than anything else in the world.

name: Ishii
description: Woman with glasses who repaired Chito's and Yuri's vehicle and asked for help with plane construction in exchange. The last pilot in history. Like Yuuri, Ishii is also left-handed.

name: Kanazawa
description: A traveler Chito and Yuuri meet while trying to find a path to the upper stratum of the city. He is a cartographer who wants to map the entire city.

name: Nuko
description: A mysterious creature that Chito and Yuuri pick up on their journey. It can shape shift to activate mechanisms and communicate via radio signals.

name: Ojii-san
description: Grandfather was the caretaker of Yuuri and Chito when they were young. The two girls have no recollection of their parents, and it is presumed that the grandfather had raised them for a long time.

name: Katsuhito Ichinose
description: Mizuhara's grandfather

name: Risa Koizumi
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm 

Risa Koizumi is not your average Japanese high school student. Risa's height is well above that of most Japanese girls her age (the average height for a female is 160 cm (5 ft 3 in) Ironically, her surname means 'little spring'.

She and other characters compare her to a giraffe. Risa can be impulsive and strong-willed at times, and is rarely willing to display her softer side. She had a crush on [Suzuki](https://anilist.co/character/3026/Suzuki-Ryouji) before he started dating [Chiharu](https://anilist.co/character/3024/Tanaka-Chiharu).

name: Atsushi Ootani
description:
__Residence:__ Osaka
__Height:__ 156 cm (5'2")

Atsushi Ootani is one of the main characters. He is very short for a boy, standing 156 centimeters. Like [Koizumi](https://anilist.co/character/2379/Koizumi-Risa), Ootani's surname (roughly, "big valley") is a pun on his diminutive stature, and he can be thoughtless and rude; at heart, however, he is kind and a little silly. Ootani is also the star player of the school basketball team. Some say he wears padded shoes so he can reach 162 cm.

name: Mayu Kanzaki
description:
__Height:__ 142 cm

She is the ex-girlfriend of Ootani. She looks very similar to Chiharu (or Chiharu to her), which is one the most likely reasons that Ootani had that crush on Chiharu. They started dating in middle-school, and she was the manager for the school basketball team. She broke up with him, leaving him completely heartbroken, because she was in love with someone else that just so happened to be really tall.

name: Ryouji Suzuki
description:
__Height:__ 182 cm (5'10")

Chiharu's boyfriend. Suzuki's cool demeanor is often mistaken for standoffishness, and so he has few friends. Oblivious to Risa's crush on him, he developed feelings for Chiharu.     

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Umibouzu
description: A popular rap group. Risa and Otani are both avid fans of the eponymous lead singer, Umibouzu, leading to Nobu's suggestion that the two are compatible. Risa and Otani accidentally cross paths with Umibouzu while on a class trip, and learn that he is actually a devoted family man.

name: Nobuko Ishihara
description:
__Height:__ 156 cm (5'1")

Fashionable and charming, Nobu is [Risa](https://anilist.co/character/2379/Koizumi-Risa)'s best friend. She is generally wiser than Risa or [Chiharu](https://anilist.co/character/3024/Tanaka-Chiharu) in the ways of love, and is always ready to offer her advice. She's mostly the one who sets up all the "alone time"; moments with Risa and [Otani](https://anilist.co/character/2380/Ootani-Atsushi), but it usually ends up failing and Risa goes back to her for comfort.

name: Maitake Kuniumi
description: Student teacher at Risa and Ōtani's school. Maitake, who prefers the nickname "Maity", he is 24 years old [he mentioned that in the Anime] and he is taller than Risa and extraordinarily good-looking. He soon acquires a legion of female fans. Gaining affection from Risa, Ōtani soon becomes jealous and quickly starts to realize his feelings for her.   Interestingly, he bears a resemblance to "Cain-sama", a character in one of Risa's favorite visual novels.

name: Heikichi Nakao
description:
__Height:__ 182 cm (5'10")

Nobu's boyfriend. Mild-mannered and easygoing. Nakao is absolutely dedicated to Nobu, and when he is not playing basketball with Ootani, he can usually be found helping with her match-making schemes.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Worick Arcangelo
native: ウォリック・アルカンジェロ
description: One half of Benriya, Worick is the more personable and communicative partner. He presents himself as fairly happy-go-lucky, but can be serious when a job is on the line. Worick works as both a freelance gangster and gigolo in order to pay the rent. In chapter seven it is revealed that he has exceptional recall abilities. He is the second son and only surviving member of the influential Arcangelo family.

name: Alex Benedetto
native: アレックス・ベネデット
description: A prostitute who is assisted by [Worick](https://anilist.co/character/41198/Arcangelo-Worick) and [Nicolas](https://anilist.co/character/41197/Brown-Nicolas) during one of their jobs. Although ordered to eliminate her, Benriya decides instead to claim her as "loot" - effectively saving her life. With nowhere else to go, Alex begins working as Benriya's secretary. She is currently learning sign language so that she can better communicate with Nicolas.

name: Nicolas Brown
description:
__Height:__ 5'5"

One half of Benriya, Nicolas is highly skilled with a sword, imposing and somewhat aloof. He is deaf and communicates primarily through sign language, though he can speak in a limited capacity. Along with [Worick](https://anilist.co/character/41198/Arcangelo-Worick), Nick works as a gangster-for-hire. He is an A/O level Twilight or "tagged" (in reference to his dog tags), making him both feared and reviled on the streets. Despite his rough exterior, Nicolas has a soft spot for [Nina](https://anilist.co/character/43900/Nina) and is beginning to accept [Alex's](https://anilist.co/character/41199/Benedetto-Alex) presence at the Benriya residence. He is also rather short.

name: Emilio Benedetto
native: エミリオ ベネデット
description: Alex's younger brother, recently returned to Ergastulum.

name: Constance Raveau
description: Owner of the local store Constance. She is the granddaughter of Joel, the elderly woman who sometimes hires Benriya. Connie is in a relationship with Marco Adriano of the Cristiano family.

name: Daniel Monroe
description: The head representative of the Monroe family crime syndicate who sometimes hires Benriya.

name: Diego Montes
description: A member of the Monroe group.

name: Marco Adriano
description: A heavily scarred executive member of the Cristiano family. In a relationship with Connie, owner of the local store Constance.

name: Ginger
description: A Twilight and member of the Paul Klee guild. Although she appears clumsy and bashful at times, Ginger is an extremely serious professional when the situation calls for it.

name: Georgiana
description: Head of the Corsica family and owner of the brothel "Georgiana's Pussy."

name: Ichirou Suzuki
description: Suzuki, or Satuu, is an adult programmer who had been transported into a game-like world after falling asleep. This game-like world is strangely related to the video games he was working on. In this world of levels and skills, Suzuki has a special ability to immediately learn a skill related to the actions he takes.

appearsIn.title: Death March to the Parallel World Rhapsody
Death March to the Parallel World Rhapsody

name: Pochi
description: Originally a nameless slave known simply as "Dog" belonging to a man named [Urs](https://anilist.co/character/188389/Urs), but became master-less after his death. She was given the name "Pochi" by [Satou](https://anilist.co/character/124921/Ichiro-Suzuki) during the events of the labyrinth and became his slave after leaving the labyrinth.

appearsIn.title: Death March to the Parallel World Rhapsody
Death March to the Parallel World Rhapsody

name: Zena Marientail
native: ゼナ・マリエンテール
description: A female soldier whom Ichirou saved in the first village he visited.

appearsIn.title: Death March to the Parallel World Rhapsody
Death March to the Parallel World Rhapsody

name: Lulu
description: [Satou](https://anilist.co/character/124921/Suzuki-Ichirou) purchased her along with her younger sister, [Arisa](https://anilist.co/character/124917/Arisa). Her great-grandfather was Japanese. She is seen as ugly due to the different beauty standards in the world of Death March even though she is extremely beautiful in the eyes of the Japanese. She was born in Kubooku Kingdom.

appearsIn.title: Death March to the Parallel World Rhapsody
Death March to the Parallel World Rhapsody

name: Liza
description:
Originally known as Lizaryu in her youth. Liza was a slave belonging to a man named [Urs](https://anilist.co/character/188389/Urs), she became master-less after his death. Being initially low-leveled, weak, and trapped in the labyrinth, she pleaded [Satou](https://anilist.co/character/124921/Ichiro-Suzuki) to take her with him, going as far as to offer herself as his literal shield. She officially became Satou's slave together with [Pochi](https://anilist.co/character/124912/Pochi) and [Tama](https://anilist.co/character/124914/Tama) after leaving the labyrinth. Her forename is derived from her real name rather than the word "lizard" (at least according to Satou), as her real name is too hard to pronounce for human tongues.

In her day-to-day life, Liza is normally very stern, acting like Satou's loyal bodyguard, a SP (Security Police), or conditioned soldier.

appearsIn.title: Death March to the Parallel World Rhapsody
Death March to the Parallel World Rhapsody

name: Mia
description: Mia is the youngest elf of Boruenean Forest and the daughter of Laya (Lamisauya) and Lia (Lilinatoa).

appearsIn.title: Death March to the Parallel World Rhapsody
Death March to the Parallel World Rhapsody

name: Arisa
description:
First seen in a carriage carrying 10 female slaves.[ Satou ](https://anilist.co/character/124921/Ichiro-Suzuki)purchased her from a Slave Trader, Nidoren, along with her older half-sister, [Lulu](https://anilist.co/character/124918/Lulu). She hid her skills before she was bought in order to prevent being purchased. She took a liking to Satou when she first saw him due to him being a young teenage male. She subsequently used her mind magic to brainwash Satou to buy her.
Her violet hair and irises are considered a bad omen, and it might be the reason she was unsold as a slave.

appearsIn.title: Death March to the Parallel World Rhapsody
Death March to the Parallel World Rhapsody

name: Tama
description:
Originally a nameless slave known simply as "Cat" belonging to a man named [Urs](https://anilist.co/character/188389/Urs), but became master-less after his death. She was given the name "Tama" by [Satou](https://anilist.co/character/124921/Ichiro-Suzuki) during the events of the labyrinth and became his slave after leaving the labyrinth.
Tama considers [Pochi](https://anilist.co/character/124912/Pochi) as her younger sister despite the fact that she is a Cat demi-human and Pochi is a Dog demi-human.

appearsIn.title: Death March to the Parallel World Rhapsody
Death March to the Parallel World Rhapsody

name: Nana
description: A Homonculus created based on Mia that was with the Iron Golem in the center room of the maze created by Trazayuya. Despite being less than a-year-old at her introduction, Nana has the appearance of an busty eighteen-year-old due to her homonculus background.

appearsIn.title: Death March to the Parallel World Rhapsody
Death March to the Parallel World Rhapsody

name: Nadi
description: Nadi, a 20 years old woman who the sole employee at a jack-of-all-trades (General Merchant in the light novel) store in Seriyuu City ran by the elf Yusalatouya. While supposedly in charge of accounting, Nadi seems to handle most job requests by herself.

appearsIn.title: Death March to the Parallel World Rhapsody

name: Yuri Honjou
description: Main protagonist of the series. One day, she founds herself in a weird world where masked people try to kill her. After realizing that her brother is in the same world as her, she is determined to stay alive and meet her brother.

name: Mayuko Nise
description: Nise was bullied and neglected by classmates and family alike. Thus, she learned to not trust anyone. This behaviour reached extreme heights when she reached this world, turning her into a seemingly cold-blooded killer, that is, until she met [Yuri Honjo](https://anilist.co/character/127441/Honjou-Yuri).

name: Kuon Shinzaki
description: Shinzaki Kuon is a God Candidate. She is sometimes referred to as the Railgun User.

name: Rika Honjou
description: Brother of [Yuri Honjou](https://anilist.co/character/127441/Honjou-Yuri).

name: Sniper Kamen
description: Sniper Mask also known as the "White Grim Reaper"

name: Shinji Okihara
description: A God Candidate.

name: Haruka
description: Haruka is the daughter of Azuma.

name: Dealer Kamen
description: Dealer Kamen is an Angry Mask.

name: Moriko Morioka
description: Morioko is an insecure, socially anxious woman who quit her job and turned into a NEET. She scarcely leaves her apartment, spending her days playing the game Fruits de Mer as her in-game character Hayashi, a blue-haired ikemen guy. Morioko calls herself an "elite NEET" because she chose this life for herself.

name: Yuuta Sakurai
description: Sakurai is a half-British elite employee who works in a trading company. He is not very good at socializing and is timid when outside of work.

name: Hayashi
description: Morioko's character in the game Fruits de Mer.

name: Lily
description: Lily is a kindhearted healer in the "@Home Party"  guild. She spends too much money for gacha rolls.

name: Homare Koiwai
description: He is [Sakurai](https://anilist.co/character/123092/Sakurai-Yuuta)'s senior. In the past, he worked in a different department at [Moriko](https://anilist.co/character/123085/Morioka-Moriko)'s workplace. He often interferes between Sakurai and Moriko.

name: Kazuomi Fujimoto
description: Kazuomi is a college student working part-time at a convenience store near Moriko's house.

name: Kanbe
description: Kanbe is the master of the "@House Party" guild. He may be rough-sounding and acts as a strict master, but he thinks of his guild members more than anyone. He is a shield-carrying assassin.

name: Lilac
description: Lilac is a gossip-loving sorcerer in the "@House Party" guild. In real life, her player is [Nao](https://anilist.co/character/340460/Nao) and she's a university student.

name: Pokotarou
description: Pokotarou is the sub-master and the oldest member (in terms of age) of the "@House Party" guild. In real life, he is Himeralda's husband. Since there is only one PC at home, he often goes to a net cafe on his way home.

name: Himeralda
description: Himeralda is a member of the "@House Party" guild. In real life, his player is a woman, and is Pokotarou's wife.

name: Nagara
description:
__Height:__ 170cm (5'7)
__Ability:__


Nagara has long hair and wears the uniform the rest of his classmates do. Nagara is bored with the environment around him and feels like giving up on life. He has trouble communicating with his family and the students at school keep their distance and watch him with a cold attitude.

name: Nozomi
description:
__Height:__ 165cm (5'5)
__Ability:__


Nozomi has a strong will and never bends herself, no matter how difficult the situation is.

name: Rajdhani
description:
Fascinated by This World around him, Rajdhani investigates how and why the students went adrift in a logical and calculating manner. He can get along with most people and he briefs everyone on his findings openly. Rajdhani is rational, scientific and decisive in nature.

Rajdhani has the power of "Pocket Computer" by which he can design a program which then comes to life. With this ability he creates many useful "gadgets and tools" which aid in uncovering the truth within This World.

name: Mizuho
description:
__Height:__ 162 cm (5'4")
__Ability:__


A third-year high school student who always carries her grandmother's three cats, Tora, Gen, and Sakura, in a tote bag. Mizuho's personality is fast-paced and moody, and honest. She does not actively get involved with the people around her and is isolated.

name: Asakaze
description:
__Ability:__ A form of gravity control

A rebellious boy caught up in the drifting incident. He opposes the student council's attempts at control.

name: Hoshi
description: A boy with a charming face and mature personality. He immediately tries to take control after the disappearance incident by appointing a leader for the group.

name: Kossetsu
description: A timid honor student with a crush on [Asakaze](https://anilist.co/character/225131/Asakaze)

name: Souta Mizushino
description: An introverted student in his second year of high school. He's an avid anime and manga fan.

name: Selesia Upitiria
native: セレジア・ユピティリア
description: The heroine of the franchise "Elemental Symphony of Vogalchevalier".

name: Meteora Österreich
native: メテオラ・エスターライヒ
description:
An NPC from the open world RPG "Avalken of Reminisce." She is an intellectual person who is silent, stoic, and speaks in a dry tone. However, she tries her best to be to make puns to cheer others up. She is also a bit of a glutton, enjoying real world food.

She is capable of flight as well as creating magical shields, but lacks offensive abilities, relying on real world artillery to make up for her weakness.

name: Altair
description:
A mysterious girl who wears a military uniform and can freely travel between worlds. She is the one who brought the other fictional characters into the real world. She claims to do this in order to overthrow their creators and force them to improve the living conditions of their worlds. However, she is actually aiming for the destruction of the real world.

She is capable of flying and manipulating dozens of swords through telekinesis at once for both attack and defense.

name: Yuuya Mirokuji
description:
The main antagonist of the "Exclusive Underground - Dark Night" manga. He is a violent person who enjoys picking fights, though he is shown to have a more calm and laid-back side. He fights using a bokken and can summon a spirit called Hangaku to fight by his side.

He is not interested in making his creator alter his world, being fine with the way he is.

name: Rui Kanoya
description:
The protagonist of the mecha anime "Infinite Divine Machine Monomagia". Rui pilots the giant robot "Gigas Machina".

A child soldier in his world, Rui was constantly thrust into battle, having never had the chance to enjoy life or even go out on a date. He is thus relieved that the real world is much more peaceful. He is attracted to girls younger than him.

name: Takashi Matsubara
description: The writer of the light novel series "Elemental Symphony of Vogalchevalier".

name: Marine
description: The illustrator and character designer of the franchise "Elemental Symphony of Vogalchevalier" that Selesia is from. Her real name is Ayano Kouura.

name: Alicetaria February
native: アリステリア・フェブラリィ
description:
A noble's daughter and the protagonist of the fantasy epic manga and anime franchise "Alicetaria of the Scarlet". A brash and heroic warrior who only wishes to save her people, she supports the Military Uniform Princess, and expresses intense hatred towards her Creator for making her world into such a dark setting for the sake of entertainment.

She fights using a lance and can use powerful magical blasts. She can also summon and ride a Pegasus.

name: Mamika Kirameki
description:
The protagonist of the magical girl anime series Magical Slayer Mamika. A supporter of the Military Uniform Princess, she doesn't like fighting and thus prefers to win over her enemies using negotiation.

She can fly and use magical attacks. While not that dangerous in her original world, her attacks are deadly in the real world. This further weakens her will to fight, as she becomes afraid of her own destructive power.

name: Elucia de Lute Ima
native: エリュシア・デ・ルート・イーマ
description:
__Height:__ 159 cm (with bun)
__Job:__ Private Household Demon
__Class:__ 2-B

Elsie is a shinigami who was assigned to capture evil spirits that have escaped from hell and is the Deuteragonist of the story. She is shown to have a very sweet, pure and innocent personality and often tries to please [Keima](https://anilist.co/character/13468/Katsuragi-Keima)'s expectations as a "little sister" though often fails due to the cultural differences between them.

Her feather cloth (the floating scarf she is always seen with) can change the appearance of an object, create disguises, or hide people in plain sight. She is left-handed and is rarely seen without her broom, which she had for 298 years, as it was from her original role as a cleaner for hell. Ironically, despite being a demon, she is shown to have an incredible fear of ghosts and the dark.  

To stay close to Keima, she tells [Mari](https://anilist.co/character/22308/Katsuragi-Mari), Keima's mother, that she is an illegitimate child of Keima's father (nearly getting his parents divorced), and ends up living in the Katsuragi household as well as attending the same class in school.

appearsIn.title: The World God Only Knows II

name: Keima Katsuragi
description:
__Class:__ 2-B
__Height:__ 174 cm

Keima Katsuragi is a 17-year-old high school student attending Maijima High School Academy. At an early age, he acquired an obsessive interest in video games; now he is known as "The Capturing God (Otoshi-gami)" in the gaming world for his legendary skills in "capturing" any girls in dating sims.

appearsIn.title: The World God Only Knows II

name: Ayumi Takahara
description:
__Class:__ 2-B
__Height:__ 158 cm

A girl in [Keima Katsuragi](https://anilist.co/character/13468/Katsuragi-Keima)'s class at school, Ayumi is a member of the school's track team. She is an exceptional runner and quite likely the best on the team. However, she was bullied by the upperclasswomen in her team.

appearsIn.title: The World God Only Knows II

name: Mio Aoyama
description:
__Height:__ 149 cm
__Class:__ 2-A

She is known as the rich girl of Maishima Academy. However, her father passed away over a year ago and has been living in an run down apartment since then. She is the second heroine to appear in the series.

name: Kanon Nakagawa
description:
__Height:__ 161 cm

Kanon is the most popular teen idol around for her beauty and singing talents. She was also in [Keima](https://anilist.co/character/13468/Katsuragi-Keima) and [Elsie](https://anilist.co/character/14015/de-Lute-Ima-Elucia)'s class but had not been in school because of her idol status. However, she returns one day.

She is constantly worried about the acknowledgment of her existence by others; this fear was so extreme and demonstrated when she attacked Keima with a stun gun after he said that he did not know her. Kanon hopes that her song would "resound in everyone's hearts."

name: Shiori Shiomiya
description:
__Class:__ 2-C 
__Height:__ 157 cm   

Shiori is a quiet girl who loves to read books. She is the librarian of the enormous collection of books in the school. [Keima](https://anilist.co/character/13468/Katsuragi-Keima) immediately catches her attention and anger by saying that books are useless. Shiori finally brings herself to shout out at Keima after he abused, marked, and tore some books.

name: Chihiro Kosaka
description:
__Class:__ 2-B 
__Height:__ 158 cm   

A friend of [Ayumi Takahara](https://anilist.co/character/15636/Takahara-Ayumi). Chihiro is a girl who tries to confess to a boy immediately after she thinks that he is handsome and attractive. However, she has confessed to many boys without positive results. [Keima](https://anilist.co/character/13468/Katsuragi-Keima) describes Chihiro as a "mob character" using visual novel argot.

appearsIn.title: The World God Only Knows II

name: Mari Katsuragi
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm 

[Keima](https://anilist.co/character/13468/Katsuragi-Keima)'s mother resembles a typical shoujo manga-style mother; optimistic, ditsy, and loving. However, when she is angry, Mari removes her glasses and lets her hair down and changes her personality completely. Keima claims that she used to be a part of a biker gang.  

(Source: Wikipedia)

appearsIn.title: The World God Only Knows II

name: Yuri Nikaido
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm  
__Class:__ 2-B    

A born sadist, Nikaido is [Keima Katsuragi](https://anilist.co/character/13468/Katsuragi-Keima)'s homeroom and Japanese teacher. She has been ignoring Keima ever since he told her that there are 5012 games that are more fun than her lessons.  Nikaido is also a school senior of [Jun Nagase](https://anilist.co/character/22307/Nagase-Jun).

appearsIn.title: The World God Only Knows II

name: Ichirou Kodama
description: Maijima High's English teacher and the Head of Arts Clubs. Kodama's personality is similar to that of Nikaido and he has a tendency to deny students from doing what they enjoy, such as denying the creation of a Light Music Club for Chihiro's band unless they all manage to achieve 100 percent in the oncoming test. Kodama has an insidious nature against Keima, because he cannot do anything about Keima playing games in his class due to the fact that Keima was able to ace all of the tests given out by Kodama.

name: Yuru
description:
__Daemons:__ Sayuu-sama ([Hidari](https://anilist.co/character/287182/) and [Migi](https://anilist.co/character/324638/))

The elder twin. A blond-haired boy who embodies the Night. Rescued from the village by [Dera](https://anilist.co/character/334313/) and [Hana](https://anilist.co/character/334316/) during the massacre, his primary goal is to find [his younger sister](https://anilist.co/character/270810/), parents [Mine](https://anilist.co/character/395408/) and [Nagisa](https://anilist.co/character/395409/), and uncover the cause of the conflict unfolding around them. Including finding out why his sister's comrades killed adults in his village and taking revenge on them. As someone who has spent his entire life in a village preserving the Edo-period way of life, Yuru acts like a traveler from the past, unprepared for modern life, yet quickly navigating complex situations thanks to his advanced hunting skills.

name: Asa
description:
__Daemons:__ [Kai](https://anilist.co/character/398964/), [Inyou](https://anilist.co/character/397635/) (Ohagi and Daifuku)
__Affiliation:__ Kagemori Family

The younger of the twins. A tall, masculine girl who embodies the Day. Although she displays a very tough character and a readiness for violence in critical situations, she is also a reliable friend to [Jin](https://anilist.co/character/321814/) and [Gabby](https://anilist.co/character/321813/), and has a pronounced brother complex towards [Yuru](https://anilist.co/character/270811/) due to their long separation. She actually left the village at a young age with her parents, and a ["False Asa"](https://anilist.co/character/270809/) with a more idealized personality and the ability to regenerate lived in the settlement in her place.

name: Migi
description:
__Master:__ [Yuru](https://anilist.co/character/270811/)

Formerly the right statue in the settlement, he now takes the form of a large, very muscular man reminiscent of an oni. He possesses the mentality of an old-fashioned, communicative warrior who relishes battle, but is completely devoted to his master's commands.

name: Hidari
description:
__Master:__ [Yuru](https://anilist.co/character/270811/)

Formerly the left statue in the settlement, she now takes the form of a muscular, tall woman reminiscent of an oni. Like [Right](https://anilist.co/character/324638), she values strength and communicates in an old-fashioned manner, but in contrast, she has a more phlegmatic personality.

name: Ryuu Tadera
description: A middle-aged man with slightly gray hair, initially portrayed as a traveling merchant, who serves as a link between the villagers and the outside world. In reality, he is a member of a long line of skilled warriors, capable of defeating a group of soldiers unarmed, and sent by his family to rescue and protect [Yuru](https://anilist.co/character/270811/Yuru) from hostile or dangerous individuals seeking to exploit him. He works in tandem with [Hana](https://anilist.co/character/334316/Danno-Hana), and occasionally flirts with her, half-jokingly convincing her to marry him as part of the cover story of his new young wife and stepmother to Yuru.

name: Hana Danno
description:
__Daemons:__ Zenko Kourou ([Kotetsu](https://anilist.co/character/397198/) and [Jirou](https://anilist.co/character/397199/))

A young woman who helps [Dera](https://anilist.co/character/334313/) protect [Yuru](https://anilist.co/character/270811/). Although she sincerely helps protect the boy, she reluctantly accepts the cover story of being Dera's young, new wife, even though she actually dreams of Jason Statham as her ideal man.

name: Jin Kagemori
description:
__Daemons:__ Sukabenjaa "The Scavenger" ([Ai](https://anilist.co/character/396609/) and [Makoto](https://anilist.co/character/396610/))
__Affiliation:__ Kagemori Family

Jin is a Tsugai user and member of the Kagemori Family. He's first seen picking up [Asa](https://anilist.co/character/270810/Asa) and [Gabby](https://anilist.co/character/321813/Gabby) from the raid on Higashi Village.

name: Gabby
description:
__Daemon:__ [Gabriel](https://anilist.co/character/394436/) (Joe William Frederic Gabriel I and Kirk Douglas Auldglaive Gabriel II)
__Affiliation:__ Kagemori Family

A blonde teenage girl with a Daemon shaped like a floating pair of teeth with eyes named Gabriel. Although she is initially introduced as a cynical and cruel killer who kills anyone regardless of gender or threat, she is also shown as convincingly not harming children, and acting like a normal teenager when interacting with her friends.

name: Nise Asa
description: The person showered with love as the twin of [Yuru](https://anilist.co/character/270811/Yuru).

name: Ken Tadera
description: [Ryu](https://anilist.co/character/334313/)'s Ethiopian 13-year-old half-brother. He is sensitive, shy and inexperienced with Daemons.

name: Rigur
description:

Rigur, after making Gobuta the garrison squad leader, has been supporting his father Rigurdo.

name: Chihiro Furuya
description:
__Height__: 170 cm (5'7")
__School__: Shiyou Boys High School
__Class__: First Year Student

The protagonist, a first year student at Shiyou Boys High School. His father is a Shinto priest. He is "everything-what-zombie-freak". He makes a potion that can bring the dead back to life. The first animal he revived as a zombie was his dead cat, Babu, and the first human he revived as a zombie was Sanka Rea.

name: Rea Sanka
description:
__Height__: 161 cm (5'3")
__School__: Sanka Girls' High School
__Class__: First Year Student

Rea is the heroine of the story who steals and drinks some of the zombie potion made by [Chihiro](https://anilist.co/character/36494/Furuya-Chihiro) in an attempt to commit suicide because of the sheltered life she lives. She fails in the attempt but she resurrects as zombie when she accidentally falls of a cliff and dies. As a zombie, she lives together with Chihiro in order to know how it feels to become free from [her father](https://anilist.co/character/43297/Sanka-Danichirou)'s chains.

Rea is friendly with everyone at the shrine, including [Darin](https://anilist.co/character/43301/Kurumiya-Darin-Arnschent) despite her intentions to use Rea as a research subject. She calls [Mero](https://anilist.co/character/36497/Furuya-Mero) by Mero-Chan similar to that of [Mero's mother](https://anilist.co/character/64031/Furuya-Yuzuna) which causes Mero great discomfort at first. Similarly, she calls Darin with the -Chan suffix to Darin's discontent.

She likes Chihiro and feels like she is bothering or interrupting Chihiro and [Ranko](https://anilist.co/character/36496/Saouji-Ranko)'s relationship. She seems to understand [Bābu](https://anilist.co/character/36495/Baabu). She's also physically strong as her body is no longer retrained by her brain as a result of her death.

name: Heren Shino
description: Ranko's underclassman who plays tennis just like Ranko and likes to follow her around.

name: Mero Furuya
description:
__Height__: 144 cm  
__Class__: First Year Middle School Student

Chihiro's 12-year-old little sister. She likes to dress as a ghost and is quite expressionless. Despite this, she loves her brother very much and often teases him.

name: Yasuda
description:

__Class__: First Year Student

name: Satsuki
description: Chief maid.

name: Mizuki Yamanouchi
description: A teacher at Sanka Girls' High School.

name: Megane no otoko
description: Full name unknown. Danichirou's SP leader.

name: Anita
description: Anita is the daughter of a wealthy spice merchant who was assassinated by one of the Zaoldyecks. she takes the Hunter Exam because she knows that Killua is there and she wants to kill him to avenge her father.

name: Uvogin
description:
__Height:__ 258cm

Uvogin is the eleventh member of the Phantom Troupe. Nobunaga has compared his personality to Gon's, seeing how not only do they have the same Nen type, but their behavior is similar as well, being impulsive and short tempered. 

Uvogin is one of the Phantom Troupe that originated from Meteor City. However, like all of the Phantom Troupe, Uvogin doesn't hesitate to kill anyone. Out of all of the Phantom Troupe, Uvogin is the strongest in terms of physical power. Although he prefers to fight alone, Uvogin works best when fighting with a partner (specifically, Nobunaga) as he fights better when he has someone else to protect, though he would never admit it.

  

__Nen Ability:__

name: Togari
description: Togari is a former Hunter examiner, who returns at the 287th hunter exam. He appears during the third phase of the exam where he confronts Hisoka, not as examiner but to take revenge for Hisoka giving him the two scars on his face from the previous exam. During the battle Togari shows Hisoka how much he has improved his fighting skills being able to use four knives at the same time,

name: Pakunoda
description:
Pakunoda exudes an air of self-confidence that can be intimidating to others. She is fully loyal to [Chrollo](https://anilist.co/character/58/Lucilfer-Chrollo). She is one of the original Phantom Troupe from Meteor City. Her physical strength is 11th in the Troupe. 

She has the ability to read the conscious thoughts of any person she is in physical contact with and can extract memories by asking specific questions. Attempting to create false information is impossible, since she can extract her target's purest memories. The information she collects is highly useful in exposing weaknesses and secrets, especially in finding out the opponent's nen ability or in situations requiring some form of extortion or blackmail. Her ability can also be used to see the recent past of an object. 

She also has the ability to share her memories by shooting them into another person's head using a revolver and conjured nen bullets called "Memory Bombs". This is not a combat ability, and does no damage. If she shoots a Memory Bomb into the person from whom the memories were read, those memories are erased permanently.

name: Shichika Yasuri
description: Shichika is the current head of the Kyotouryuu style. He was trained rigorously by his father, the previous head of the style. He is deeply dedicated to his training, and is strong enough to win against challengers without even using Kyotouryuu. Through the years, he has even developed new moves for the Kyotouryuu style.  He cares deeply for his older sister Nanami, who has poor health, and often does her chores for her.  He is in love with Togame, who trusts him because of this fact. Though he says he's in love with her, he has no idea how to deal with girls, as he shows no sign of arousal around Togame when she's naked, and doesn't even realize he's supposed to praise her when she wears new clothes. However, this allows Togame to be very open with him, which is an advantage to their quest of collecting the twelve deviant swords.  He says that he is "bad at thinking," but he could not be called naive as he is very aware of what is going on around him.

name: Togame
description:
Togame is the shogunate's self-titled "strategian." She is physically weak but mentally superior, though she is not immune to lapses in judgment and bouts of clumsiness.

Though [Shichika](https://anilist.co/character/28522/Yasuri-Shichika) is in love with her, his lack of interest in her body allows her to be shameless around him, so she can be naked around him without worrying about being taken advantage of. In this way, they have a very comfortable and open relationship. [Meisai](https://anilist.co/character/30956/Tsuruga-Meisai) thinks that she wears bright clothing so she doesn't forget herself, and comments on her extremely long, white hair, saying hair doesn't become that way without a reason. She also possesses a special eye.  She says "gyafun" when she falls, and has a habit of saying "cheerio!" while hitting Shichika, though it turns out "cheerio!" is erroneous and is supposed to be "chest!" This greatly troubles her, though in the end, she decides to stick with "cheerio!".

name: Nanami Yasuri
description:
**Relatives**: [Shichika Yasuri](https://anilist.co/character/28522/Shichika-Yasuri) (younger brother), [Mutsue Yasuri](https://anilist.co/character/28557/Mutsue-Yasuri) (father), [Migiri Yasuri](https://anilist.co/character/34923/Migiri-Yasuri) (mother), [Kazune Yasuri](https://anilist.co/character/38115/Kazune-Yasuri) (ancestor)

Nanami Yasuri is Shichika's elder sister. She's a sickly girl who's babied by him. She's extremely intelligent and knows many things despite living on a secluded island her entire life.

She is a slender girl who resembles her mother with long dark green hair, decorated with pink markings of cherry blossoms. She has purple eyes and her clothing is based on Eastern culture. Later in the series, she changes into a monk-like outfit of black and purple monk sashes, silver armbands under long black sleeves, white/mint green stockings, a pink choker, and eastern shoes.





(Source: Katanagatari Wiki, edited)

name: Mutsue Yasuri
description: Shichika and Nanami's father, previous master of Kyotouryuu, who died a year prior to the story's events.

name: Koumori Maniwa
description: The first Maniwani member Shichika meets. His name literally means "bat," and he models his clothing after one accordingly. He is the holder of the deviant sword Kanna and has the ability to swallow it completely to protect it.  His ability is to shift his body into someone else's, copying their abilities and their appearance.

name: Takahito Hida
description: Togame's father.

name: Ginkaku Uneri
description: Uneri is the holder of the deviant blade Namakura. Togame offers him anything in exchange for Namakura, but his wish of restoring Inaba can't be fulfilled, so he opts to fight Shichika instead. His style, Zerosen, entails cutting with the sword faster than the speed of light. To hasten the process even more, he wounds himself and lets his blood seep into the sheath, negating the friction of the blade on the sheath.

name: Shirasagi Maniwa
description: Shirasagi is one of the twelve ninja leaders of the Maniwani. His name literally means "heron," and he dresses like one accordingly. He has an interesting quirk: he speaks backwards.

name: Hakuhei Sabi
description: The strongest swordsman in Japan. He is the owner of the deviant blade Hari. His catchphrase, as stated many times by Togame, is: "I will have you fall for me."    (Source: Japanese Wikipedia)

name: Meisai Tsuruga
description: Meisai is the holder of the deviant sword Tsurugi, which is split into 1000 swords. "Tsuruga Meisai" is the name of the previous priest of the shrine she presides over; she claims that she forgot her original name. After her father, a kendo master, was killed along with all his followers, she joined and became the leader of a group of bandits. After learning of the shrine and the physically and mentally injured shrine maidens who live there, she killed all 43 of the bandits and brought Tsurugi to the shrine to heal the shrine maidens, killing the previous Tsuruga Meisai in the process.    Her name literally means "camouflage" or "disguise," which corresponds with her fighting style, Sentouryuu. She uses the many swords that make up Tsurugi to confuse and trap the opponent while she hides herself.

name: Mari Makinami Illustrious
native: 真希波・マリ・イラストリアス
description:
Mari Makinami Illustrious is an Evangelion pilot introduced into the franchise during the second installment of the four part theatrical remake series, Rebuild of Evangelion. 

Little is known about her as of yet except that she is the pilot of the Provisional Evangelion Unit-05 which differs from previous incarnations drastically featuring four mechanical "legs" that end in wheels and a lack of hands which have been replaced with a jousting lance and "claw". Because of it's unique design, Mari pilots her Eva wearing a helmet-like contraption and her plugsuit is equipped with several attachments that connect to tubing that apparently help her in moving the Evangelion. 

Mari is probably the most content with being an Eva pilot. She is also shown to be more informed than the other pilots, knowing various backdoors into both Nerv and the Eva operational programs and access Eva abilities known to only the higher-up staff of Nerv. Mari also revels in piloting Eva, usually singing over the comm-radio before excitedly engaging an Angel in combat.

name: Nashetania Loei Piena Augustra
native: ナッシェタニア・ルーイ・ピエナ・アウグストラ
description: Though she is the princess of the large kingdom Piena, she is a wild and free girl, full of mischief. She is the Saint of Blades.

name: Fremy Speeddraw
native: フレミー・スピッドロウ
description: A girl whose cool indifference won’t allow others to get close. As the Saint of Gunpowder she uses guns and bullets in battle.

name: Adlet Mayer
description: A young boy who calls himself the strongest man in the world. He fights with a mastery of various secret weapons.

name: Mora Chester
description: An extremely serious and intellectual woman. She serves as the leader of the Saints and is the Saint of Mountains.

name: Hans Humpty
description: A strange man who mimics a cat as he talks. He fences with an unworldly and peculiar skill.

name: Goldof Auora
native: ゴルドフ・アウオーラ
description: A young knight completely devoted to Nashetania, he wields a giant spear.

name: Chamo Rosso
description: A proud girl who is called the most powerful warrior of the current age. She is the Saint of Swamps.

name: Rolonia Manchetta
native: ロロニア・マンチェッタ
description:
Rolonia Machetta is one of the Six Flowers, and also, Saint of Fresh Blood. She meets with the Six Flowers, around the end of first volume of LN, or in the last episode of the anime. She has a timid personality. She uses a whip for weapon, and has healing abilities. She can analyze any blood by tasting it.

She was just a servant who washed clothes at the temple of the God of Fresh Blood. After being selected as the Saint of Fresh Blood, [Mora Chester](https://anilist.co/character/89080) guided and helped her. Mora has sent her next to Atro Spyker for training and education. She has met with [Adlet Mayer](https://anilist.co/character/89079) there and become friends with him.

name: Tgurneu
description: Tgurneu is one of the three Kyouma leaders along with Dozzu and Cargikk.

name: Yoichi Nasu no Suketaka
description: A very effeminate man of nineteen. Although he died many years before Nobunaga and Toyohisa, Yoichi is the youngest in the group. His historical death date is unclear, yet some records indicate that he either died on August 8 in 1189 or in October of 1190. Historically he is known as a powerful warrior who served Minamoto no Yoshitsune during the Genpei War, and he also appears in the Tale of the Heike. However, Nobunaga notes that Yoichi is very different from historical accounts. Yoichi acts as the group's archer, killing fleeing enemies.

name: Nobunaga Oda
description: A famous warlord who conquered most of Japan during Sengoku period. Historically he is known for being the daimyo who took the first step of unification of the Japan, and the first Japanese military commander to utilize arquebuses in battles. Perhaps because of this, as a Drifter he uses an arquebus in battle. He died twenty years before [Toyohisa](https://anilist.co/character/24183/Shimazu-Toyohisa) (1582). As a Drifter, he has only aged six months since arriving in the new world.

name: Toyohisa Shimazu
description: The protagonist. Historically he died in 1600. When he first arrived in the world, he was critically injured, only to be brought to the hideout of [Nobunaga](https://anilist.co/character/24184/Oda-Nobunaga) and [Yoichi](https://anilist.co/character/24200/Nasu-no-Suketaka-Yoichi) by some young "elves". Of the three Drifters in the group, Toyohisa is the most willing to help the elves, first by attacking the humans massacring them and then by convincing them to kill the leader of those humans. He uses a long sword and is seen carrying a short sword as well. He's also shown carrying a rifle, which he only uses when his swords are infeasible.

name: Anastasia Nikolaevna Romanova
native: アナスタシア・ニコラエヴナ・ロマノヴァ
description:
The youngest daughter of the last Russian tsar, Nicholas II. Anastasia and her family were shot by a Bolshevik firing squad when Anastasia was seventeen. Now she has the supernatural ability to create blizzards.  

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Scipio Africanus
native: スキピオ・アフリカヌス
description: Hannibal's Roman adversary during the Second Punic War, who is believed to have died around 183 BC. As a Drifter, he is as old as Hannibal, who he is seen constantly arguing with, claiming that "a winner takes all" since he won at Zama. Nevertheless, Scipio respects Hannibal greatly, saying he is worth a million men, because though a million men would not budge Rome, Hannibal nearly tore it down.

name: Grigori Rasputin
description: A famous Russian mystic who once held a great influence over the Russian Imperial Court because of his ability to supposedly heal the Romanov's hemophiliac heir, Alexei. He now serves the Black King.

name: Violet
description:
__Farm Identifier:__ DIV332-198 (Grand Valley)
__D.O.B:__ Unknown
__Hair Color:__ Purple
__Eye Color:__ Purple

Violet is a former orphan from the Grand Valley orphanage and a member of the Goldy Pond Resistance. Violet is the first person to encounter Emma at Goldy Pond.

name: Zazie
description: Zazie is a former Λ7214 experiment. He is the strongest among the humans. He gets mad when he doesn't wear the paper bag. He loves his boss, Norman.

name: Paula
description: Paula is a 17-year-old girl born and raised at Grand Valley Orphanage with the ID number AXI640-651. She was shipped out to Goldy Pond to become prey for the Poachers to hunt. After arriving in Goldy Pond, she joined the Goldy Pond Resistance, where she ended up in charge of the provisions. Paula is a fair-skinned girl with long, black hair partially done up. She dresses in dark clothes and wears a bandanna covering her mouth. Paula is loyal and caring like all the Goldy Pond kids. However, she is reserved and doesn't talk much. Paula is skilled in sniping Demons with her gun.

name: Rentarou Aijou
description:
__Occupation:__ First-Year High School Student
__Debut:__ Chapter 1

Rentarou is an extremely kind and thoughtful person who loves all of his many girlfriends very dearly, often to a scarily self-sacrificing degree.  

Before he began his days as a high school student, Rentarou had been rejected a total of 100 times. Following a rejection from his friend on the day of his junior high graduation, he goes to a matchmaking shrine and prays to the shrine's god, wishing for a happy high school life by getting a girlfriend. In response, the Love God appears before Rentarou, telling him that he will meet his "soulmate" in high school, and that they will fall in love at first sight. He then reveals that Rentarou has 100 of such soulmates, and that should he ever meets one, he must make them his girlfriend and make them happy, or else they will die.

Hakari is described as a "clumsily calculative" lady. She is often planning and plotting to achieve her goals which may or may not go as planned due to her clumsiness. She is prim and proper on the outside while inside she is just as much of a degenerate, if not more so, than the other members of the Hanazono family. She also teases [Inda Karane](https://anilist.co/character/173760) a lot, often leaving her embarrassed or pissed.

Karane is known for being straightforward and honest about how she feels about a given situation except for two subjects: her feminine figure (or supposed lack of) and her deep love for [Aijou Rentarou](https://anilist.co/character/173758/Aijou-Rentarou). Her desperate attempts to hide how she feels about a given situation despite her honest nature often make people think she is going to strike them.

description:

__Occupation:__ First-Year High School Student
