**Girlfriend No. 003**

Shizuka is rather timid especially given her rather quiet or mute voice which makes her rather distant from other people. However, ever since she met [Rentarou](https://anilist.co/character/173758/Aijou-Rentarou) she has become braver, even willing to sacrifice her own safety to help [Hakari](https://anilist.co/character/173759/Hanazono-Hakari) out. She is also the most modest of Rentarou's girlfriends as she refused to peep on him when he was taking a bath and even tried to stop them from doing so.

description:
__Type:__ Kuudere
__Occupation:__ First-Year High School Student
__Debut:__ Chapter 6

**Girlfriend No. 004**

Nano is practical to a fault, obsessed with solving a problem in the most efficient way possible no matter what.

Nano is the smartest among the girls. In her school exam, she gets the perfect score (700/700), which is better than the scores of genius-level characters in other manga. Nano has memorized hundreds of digits of Pi, which she sometimes uses to calm herself down. Due to her extreme intelligence and efficiency, in most difficult situations Nano is the first to come up with solutions. However, her solutions are sometimes brutal due to her lack of social experience.

name: Hahari Hanazono
description:
__Type:__ MILF
__Occupation:__ High School Chairwoman
__Debut:__ Chapter 17

**Girlfriend No. 006** 

[Hakari](https://anilist.co/character/173759/Hakari-Hanazono)'s mother.
Hahari appears as a very mature and sophisticated woman, until she sees something cute. She has an uncontrollable love for cute things, including children, as well as Rentarou and his family. When she sees something she finds cute, she may start drooling. Like her daughter, she is also a pervert towards Rentarou as she is shown to have perverted fantasies about him. 
She is incredibly wealthy, and willing to throw her money around to get what she (or Rentarou) wants. Although she fell in love with Rentarou, Hahari still deeply loves her deceased lover. She feels guilty about falling in love again until Rentarou comforts her and assures her that there is nothing wrong with loving more than one person.

description:
__Type:__ Maid
__Occupation:__ Personal Maid
__Debut:__ Chapter 30

**Girlfriend No. 008**

The personal maid of [Hahari Hanazono](https://anilist.co/character/173812/Hahari-Hanazono). Mei is polite and proper, rarely showing strong emotions. She is loyal to Hahari above all else, and is unlikely to do anything unless given permission or ordered to by Hahari specifically. Mei's fanatical loyalty to the Rentarou Family and the Hanazono Family results in her gladly offering to "eliminate" people that threaten, insult, or even mildly inconvenience [Rentarou](https://anilist.co/character/173758/Aijou-Rentarou), Hahari, or the other girlfriends.

Mei is an all-around maid. It seems that she can do nearly everything, including driving, cooking, shooting, and even nursing. Mei is also shown to exceed her already exceptional abilities if ordered to do so by Hahari.

description: The boy with a terminal illness whom Hahari had fallen in love with when she was a schoolgirl. Before he died, Hahari was artificially inseminated using his sperm at the age of 13, which led to the birth of Hakari. Rentarou meets his spirit after rescuing Hakari and causing Hahari to fall in love with him.

appearsIn.title: The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, REALLY Love You

name: Yousuke Shibazaki
aliases: Wolfgunblood (ウルフ・ガンブラッド)
description: A 34-year-old man who woke up from coma after 17 years, but actually went to another world during that time. His unattractive appearance barely changed since the time he transferred to another world, and he was frequently mistaken for an orc and treated extremely poorly by the inhabitants of the other world, to the point where he had to continuously wipe his own memories to maintain his sanity. He retained his magic ability and uses it freely.

name: Takafumi Takaoka
description:
__Occupation:__ Part-time worker
__Family:__ [Shibazaki Yousuke](https://anilist.co/character/205566/Yousuke-Shibazaki) (Maternal Uncle)

Takafumi resides with his Uncle [Shibazaki Yousuke](https://anilist.co/character/205566/Yousuke-Shibazaki) at the House and have fun playing games on a videogame console, sometimes his Uncle uses an otherworldly technology to play his previous-life moments to Takafumi and his friend [Fujimiya](https://anilist.co/character/205567/Sumika-Fujimiya).

name: Sumika Fujimiya
description:
__Occupation:__ University Student
__Family:__ [Chiaki Fujimiya](https://anilist.co/character/293824) (Younger Brother)

Fujimiya is [Takafumi](https://anilist.co/character/205568/Takafumi-Takaoka)'s childhood friend, they shared their school Days together and now also meet frequently at [Takafumi](https://anilist.co/character/205568/Takafumi-Takaoka)'s house

name: Suzailgiererzegalnelvzegilreagranzelga Elga
native: スザイルギラーゼガルネルブゼギルレアグランゼルガ=エルガ
description: An elf who [Yousuke](https://anilist.co/character/205566/Shibazaki-Yousuke) rescued in the other world. She has a crush on him after he saved her from a dragon, but since the term 'tsundere' only became popular four years after Yousuke went into coma, he does not understand her tendencies and thinks she is harassing him instead. Despite this, she is kind, often defending Yousuke when other people attempt to slander him, though he interprets this as blackmail.

name: Mabel Laybelle
description: A descendant of the Frost Clan. She is the guardian of the ice sword that has been passed down from generation to generation. She lived in a frozen room inside a large tree trunk. Her demeanor and heart were very cold, as cold as the place she lived in.

name: Alicia Edelcia
native: アリシア=イーデルシア
description: A rookie priestess in a party with [Edgar](https://anilist.co/character/278619/Edgar) and [Raiga](https://anilist.co/character/278618/Raiga).

name: Ricardo Markfield
native: リカルド=マークフェルド
description: Commander-in-Chief of the Royal Army of Lucidion

name: Yoichi Shigaraki
aliases: First User of One For All (初代ワン・フォー・オール)
description: All For One's younger brother.

name: Yuuga Aoyama
aliases: Kagayaki Hero: Can't Stop Twinkling (輝きヒーロー)
description:
**Height:** 168 cm (5'6")
**Quirk:** Navel Lazer

Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School.

Yuuga appears to be vain and prideful, thinking of himself as superior to the rest of his classmates, especially regarding his Quirk. He exhibits flamboyant mannerisms, is fond of posing, and likes to grab the attention of those around him despite frequently getting ignored by his peers. He also plays up his French heritage, occasionally implementing French words into his sentences.

Yuuga's Quirk allows him to shoot a powerful sparkling laser cannon from his navel. It is so powerful, it can blast through two meters of solid concrete. If he fires the laser for more than 1 second at a time, he will suffer intestinal distress.

name: Mei Hatsume
description:
__Height:__ 157 cm (5'2")
__Quirk:__ Zoom

Mei is a smart, off-setting, and assertive girl, often making those around her uncomfortable. She loves creating gadgets, which she refers to as her "super cute babies". Mei has a habit of "going straight to the point" and is very shameless and opportunistic when it comes to advertising her inventions. While talking to people, she has a habit of getting awkwardly close to them, which usually causes them to back away from her but she still moves up to them.

name: Charlotte Dunois
native: シャルロット・デュノア
description: Charlotte is a first year student at the IS academy and is the IS cadet representative from France. Charlotte was originally introduced in the series as "Charles", the second male IS pilot student that was transferred into Ichika's class but was actually sent to the academy to spy on Ichika. Charlotte is put in a room with Ichika,     Charlotte pilots the Rafale Revive Custom II IS.

name: Cecilia Alcott
native: セシリア・オルコット
description: Cecilia is a first year student at the IS academy and is the IS cadet representative from England, as part of the British Aristrocracy. Her father was a weak and timid man who had little influence both outside and inside the Alcott family which made her swear to never marry a weak man (A difficulty due to the shift in social status). She was orphaned 3 years ago after a train accident and was forced to protect her family fortune from those who wish to claim a stake of it. She pilots the Blue Tears IS.

name: Ichika Orimura
description: The protagonist of Infinite Stratos. He is a first year student at the IS academy. His older sister, Chifuyu, is a legendary IS pilot. The siblings were abandoned by their parents at a young age and Ichika was raised by his sister thereafter. Ichika has a habit of personally assessing the situation with interior monologues as well as being easily out-guessed about his tactics. As the first (and thus far only) male IS pilot, his new reputation has made him somewhat famous. He pilots the Byakushiki IS. He is also considered to be fairly dense as he doesn't realize the feelings of those around him (especially the girls) despite repeated attempts and even open hints.

name: Laura Bodewig
native: ラウラ・ボーデヴィッヒ
description: Laura is a first year student at the IS academy and is the IS cadet representative from Germany. A genetically engineered super soldier, Laura is a member of the German military and holds the rank of second lieutenant. She has one red eye, long silver hair, and a black eye patch over her left eye. Laura was under Chifuyu's guidance when the latter was working with the German army's IS divison and holds Chifuyu in high regard.     Laura pilots the Schwarzer Regen IS.

name: Lingyin Huang
description: The Chinese Representative of the Infinite Stratos Academy and the pilot of the Shen Long, Lingyin is the second childhood friend of Ichika. She was best friends with Ichika during their days in Junior High School and had a crush on him because of him standing up for her when several kids bullied her due to her nationality. Of all of the cast members, she is perhaps the most open to physical interaction with him (although this mostly platonic physical interaction). During her stay in Japan, Ichika would visit her family's restaurant as his sister was out at work most of the time and she is a natural cook. Before she left however, she made a promise to him that he would marry her if she could cook well for him. Ichika however misinterpreted that for free food.  She joined the academy shortly after Cecilia became another member in his harem and among the cast is known for her flat chest which takes heavy offense to.

name: Houki Shinonono
description:
Houki is a first year student at the IS academy and has been friends with [Ichika](https://anilist.co/character/35659/Orimura-Ichika) since they were kids though they have not seen each other for six years. She has a very long ponytail. Her place of resident is home to a kendo dojo and she has been interested in kendo since she was young. Houki even competes in kendo competitions at a national level and was the winner of the national tournament that was hosted one year before the story of Infinite Stratos began. She is part of the kendo club at the IS academy. Houki harbors feelings for Ichika. She pilots the Aka Tsubaki IS.

History: Prior to the start of the main series, she was a childhood friend of Ichika. Her place of residence is home to a kendo dojo and she has been interested in kendo since she was young. Houki even competes in kendo competitions at a national level and was the winner of the national tournament that was hosted one year before the story of Infinite Stratos began. Her older sister Tabane is the creator of the IS yet Houki hates her because six years ago, Ichika agreed to become her boyfriend if she could win the national kendo tournament of their grade. However, the day of the tournament was also the day the IS were introduced to the world. Because of their links to Tabane, Houki's family was placed under government protection and Houki was forced to withdraw from the kendo tournament.

name: Tabane Shinonono
description: She has purple eyes, long purple hair that extends to her hips, wears a lab-coat and a pair of robotic rabbit ears. Tabane is often seen wearing a frilly maid like blue and white dress. Much to everybody's surprise, Tabane is a very energetic person and runs around like a happy kid. She often refers herself as "Tabane the Genius", hinting to a sense of cockiness. She is very fond of the people she loves and would hug them as many times as she feels like. Her explosive entrances and her childish manners often costs her being hit on the head by people like Chifuyu and Houki, but she recovers extremely fast and gets energetic again. Although she sometimes acts like a kid, her intelligence is at the top of the world and can work at a very fast rate, such as adjusting the Akatsubaki to fit Houki's body in less than a minute and declaring that she can finish configuring Akatsubaki in just seven minutes.   __History:__ She first started on the creation of the IS for the concept of the space exploration 10 years ago. Having created the 467 cores and shocking the world of the existence of the unit, she disappeared from the face of the earth. Even in the time line of the novel, she's still the most wanted person by all the organizations related to IS due to her knowledge.

name: Honne Nohotoke
description:
Honne Nohotoke is a minor character who appears infrequently in the Infinite Stratos series. She is one of Ichika Orimura's classmates and enjoys eating snacks. She is affectionately called "Nohohon-san" by others.

__Appearance:__ Honne Nohotoke has sleepy yellow eyes and pink shoulder length hair, most of which hangs free, the exception being two small pigtails on either side of her head held in place by yellow hair ties. Her appearance is usually marked by her long sleeves that obscure her hands; however, her long sleeves are not always present, as the skin-tight suit used during IS exercises lacks any sleeves at all.

__Personality:__ She is presented as a cute, childish, happy and enthusiastic girl. Honne loves eating snacks.

(Source Infinite Stratos wiki)

name: Ran Gotanda
description: Ran is Dan's younger sister and is currently attending a private girls' school. She is in her third year of middle school and is the student council president. Ran apparently has feelings for Ichika.

name: Pazu
description:
**Age**: 13

Pazu is an orphan who lives alone in a small hut atop a hill in Slag Ravine. While no mention is made of his mother, his father was an avid aviator who, though no one had believed him, had previously discovered and photographed the floating kingdom of Laputa. After his death, Pazu swore that he would find Laputa and prove his father right.

Pazu has brown hair and brown eyes. He wears a white shirt and orange vest, blue pants that are patched at the knee, a yellow cap, and brown laced boots.

Pazu is an energetic, amicable young boy with a heart of gold, always willing to help out wherever needed. He's a dedicated and hard worker in the mines and is also particularly enamored with technology.

Late one evening, Pazu discovers a girl named [Sheeta](https://anilist.co/character/8523/Sheeta) floating down from the sky. After being unsuccessful in his attempt to tell his boss of her appearance, he takes her home and cares for her until she wakes. The two become quick friends and he tells her of his plans to finish an ornithopter to set off and find Laputa.

(Source: Ghibli Wiki, edited)

name: Muska
description:
Colonel Muska is a government special agent. He holds [Sheeta](https://anilist.co/character/8523/Sheeta) in custody at the beginning and pursues her during the film with the military.

Muska has light brown hair and hazel eyes. He wears tinted glasses, a brown suit, a white shirt, and a pale yellow cravat. He is armed with what seems to be a Webley Mk VI revolver.

Muska is cold, calculating and duplicitous, and will turn on his allies once he has used them to attain his goals.





(Source: Ghibli Wiki, edited)

name: Sheeta
description:
Sheeta is a 13-year-old orphan farm girl. After falling from the sky, she is saved by an orphan named [Pazu](https://anilist.co/character/8524/Pazu). 

Compared to Pazu's more boisterous, energetic personality, Sheeta is reserved, somewhat shy with strangers, and quiet. She at first insists on being on her own due to the danger her very company presents and out of fear of causing damage to Pazu or his hometown. Despite her taciturn and shy personality, Sheeta is polite, kind, and intelligent.

name: Dola
description:
Dola is the captain of a gang of air pirates composed of her three sons and five other subordinates. She is interested in the treasures of the ancient floating city of Laputa, which puts her at odds with [Sheeta](https://anilist.co/character/8523/Sheeta) and [Pazu](https://anilist.co/character/8524/Pazu).

Dola is an obese, short, and stocky woman with pink hair, which has faded from the red color it had been during her childhood; she wears it in two thick braids. She has dark eyes and a large nose. She wears a dark blue shirt and pants with a lacy white collar and cuffs, gold hoop earrings, and a green brooch. When flying, Dola wears a pilot's cap and goggles, and she sometimes wears a blue hat with a red band when dressing up.

Initially, Dola comes across as bossy, greedy and selfish, wanting nothing more than to get her hands on Laputa's treasures. Later, though, she is revealed to be a rather soft-hearted person and grudgingly grows fond of Sheeta and Pazu. Sheeta, in particular, reminds Dola of herself as a child. Dola's sons respect her greatly and always follow her orders, although they often forget to call her "captain" and just call her "Mom" instead. Dola is also brave and resourceful, which has helped her become a successful and respected air pirate over the course of her life.

At the start of the film, Dola and her gang board the airship where Colonel Muskais holding Sheeta captive.

name: Pom Jii-san
description: An old miner who meets Sheeta and Pazu and tells them of "volucite" ("aetherium" in Disney's English language dub), the crystal that provided Laputa with its power. He reveals that Sheeta’s pendant is one of the largest and purest such crystals in existence, and counsels Sheeta to remember that the crystal's power rightly belongs to the earth, and that she should never use it to commit acts of violence.

name: Lui
description:
Dola's eldest son and a member of her gang of air pirates.

He has dark brown hair, dark eyes, a long face with a square chin, and a mustache. Like the rest of the boys in the gang, Louis almost always wears a brown shirt with pink pants, a belt, a red hood, and brown slip-on shoes.

As the oldest of Dola's sons, Louis is more or less their leader. He is first seen capsizing a civil airship; right at the beginning of the movie. He tries to catch [Sheeta](https://anilist.co/character/8523/Sheeta), but she escapes by falling from the airship. He and his brothers are looking for her, but they stop and continue the search the next day.

(Source: Ghibli Wiki, edited)

name: Mitsumi Iwakura
description: First-year high school student who moved to Tokyo from the outskirts of Ishikawa Prefecture near Suzu. Raised a child prodigy, she entered high school at the top of her class; however, she has no athletic ability. Her pure personality unintentionally influences the people around her. She has a younger sister and brother.

name: Sousuke Shima
description: [Mitsumi](https://anilist.co/character/138851/Iwakura-Mitsumi)'s classmate who is popular with girls. He is known for sabotaging the entrance ceremony and skipping classes. Though he planned to skip the entrance ceremony, he meets Mitsumi and they run to school together.

name: Mika Egashira
description: Mitsumi's classmate who approached her after Mitsumi became friends with Sousuke. Mitsumi's pure nature inspired her to face her complexes. She develops a caring relationship with Mitsumi.

name: Yuzuki Murashige
description: [Mitsumi](https://anilist.co/character/138851/Iwakura-Mitsumi)'s classmate and her first friend in Tokyo. Her popularity among boys made her develop a complex about being shunned by other girls. She studied abroad in her childhood and has blonde hair, so people assume she is good at English, but according to herself she is not that good at it.

name: Makoto Kurume
description: Mitsumi's classmate. She is introverted and worries about becoming isolated; she meets Mitsumi when she joined the student council to join some kind of community. Despite not liking flirtatious people, she meets Yuzuki through Mitsumi and they become close friends.

name: Fumino Toyama
description: Fumino is Mitsumi's childhood friend. She remains in Ishikawa while Mitski attends high school in Tokyo. Despite the distance, the two remain best friends, frequently catching up over video calls, and confiding in each other.

name: Nao
description: [Mitsumi](https://anilist.co/character/138851/Iwakura-Mitsumi)'s paternal aunt. She is a transgender woman and works as a stylist. Mitsumi's guardian since she moved to Tokyo.

name: Narumi Kanechika
description:
Second-year classmate of [Mitsumi Iwakura](https://anilist.co/character/138851/Mitsumi-Iwakura) and a member of the Drama Club.

He's very strong-willed and passionate about his interests, especially acting. He has shown to be very willing to put in lots of time and work into what he loves, and doesn't hesitate to drag others into it. His love for acting, and his will to share it with everyone does somewhat blind him from seeing other's emotions on the other hand. Despite being somewhat oblivious to emotions at times, he always helps others and cares about their wellbeing.

Narumi dreams of becoming a playwright in the future.

name: Tsukasa Mukai
description: Mitsumi's classmate and Sousuke's friend since middle school. He is quiet and kindhearted.

name: Kento Yamada
description: Mitsumi's classmate and Sousuke's friend. He is the class clown who is loved, teased, and harmless to humans and animals; however, he is surprisingly diligent, making cookies for everyone in the class and supporting his classmates quietly.

name: Green
description: Custos of Eden Academy.

name: Vadim
description: Vadim is a member of the Red Circus. Together with Billy Squire, the group hijacked two Eden Academy school buses while on a field trip and took the students inside hostage.

name: Kokkahoankyoku Kyokuchou
description: The boss of the SSS who dotes on [Yuuri](https://anilist.co/character/150425/Yuuri-Briar) because he finds him adorable like a puppy.

name: Shizuku Yaegashi
description:
Kaori's best friend. She's the childhood friend of Kouki and her family runs a dojo.

Shizuku is a hardworking, kind and caring girl who passes her time on practicing her swordsmanship. She is regarded as a cool and stoic beauty, but actually has a girlish side that likes cute things, such as the color pink, as well as cute animals like cats and bunnies. She has often hid her true feelings and would put up a brave face, as a front so other people did not worry about her.

name: Aiko Hatayama
description:
She is the Homeroom Teacher who along with her students from Japan got involved in the Summoning Incident, and ended up in Tortus. She is a responsible teacher and cares for her students a lot.

(Source: Wikia)

appearsIn.title: Arifureta: From Commonplace to World's Strongest Season 2
Arifureta: From Commonplace to World’s Strongest

name: Myuu
description: A young girl from the Sea-Dweller Tribe who got kidnapped to be sold as a slave, but was saved by Hajime Nagumo and Shea Haulia while they came across her in Fuhren. Initially,​ she had been calling Hajime as "Onii-chan", but later changed to call him "Papa".

appearsIn.title: Arifureta: From Commonplace to World's Strongest Season 2

name: Takumu Mayuzumi
description:
__Class__: Year 1 Middle School - 7th Grade
__Height__: 170 cm (5'6")

Chiyuri's boyfriend. He is excellent at academics and athletics. He attends a famous school that goes from elementary to high school.

name: Haruyuki Arita
description: He is a middle school student and is overweight. He has been bullied for many years and because of that likes to go to places where no one is like the squash game on the local network at school.

name: Kuroyukihime
description:
__Class__: Year 2-3 Middle School
__Height__: 159 cm (5'3")

The main female protagonist and leader of the Nega Nebulus legion, her real name is unknown. Her pseudonym is Japanese word play with Snow White. Beautiful and popular, she is also the Student Council Vice-President at Umesato Junior High School. She has been a Burst Linker since she was eight years old.

name: Chiyuri Kurashima
description:
__Class__: Year 1 Middle School - 7th Grade 
 __Height__: 156 cm (5'1") 
 __Weight__: 51 kg 
[Haru](https://anilist.co/character/49637/Arita-Haruyuki)'s and [Taku](https://anilist.co/character/49631/Mayuzumi-Takumu)'s childhood friend. Although she is dating Takumu, she also cares a lot for Haru. Her non-accelerated avatar is a catgirl.

name: Ash Roller
description: Haruyuki's first opponent in the Accel World. His Duel Avatar is a biker gangster with a skull for a head. He also rides a chopper which is considered a part of his avatar and serves as his weapon as well.  He defeated Haruyuki cleanly in the first match but Haruyuki challenged him to a rematch in the same day after getting instructions from Kuroyukihime.   He was beaten in the rematch after Haruyuki exploited the weakness of the motorcycle's design which forced him to get off the motorcycle and resort to a fist fight.

name: Black Vise
description: Black Vice has shown to be very calm no matter what situation arises. He is also quite laid-back, as shown when Silver Crow broke out of his move, Static Pressure, and when Black Lotus appeared and challenged him.  (Source: Accel World Wikia)

name: Red Rider
description: Red Rider was passionate enough to express his dislike towards war and fighting amongst one another to attain level ten and was open-minded to other people's opinions. He is friendly and willing to trust people as seen during the Kings of Pure Color meeting, where he received a hug from Black Lotus as a sign of respect. However, this would be his undoing as Black Lotus took the chance and used Death By Embracing on him.  (Source: Accel World Wiki)

name: Crimson Kingbolt
native: クリムゾン・キングボルト
description: Crimson Kingbolt has a laid-back personality and is willing to use his burst points in order to help Itosu and Ruka level up. He cares deeply for the two as he is willing to stall Sulfur Pot to let them escape if needed.   He originally lived in Tokyo were he was friends with Black Lotus. However, he moved to Okinawa after his parents divorced. After moving to Okinawa, he became a parent to Ruka Asato who later becomes a parent to Itosu Mana. He became a "master" to both of them as he taught them the rules of Brain Burst. He also gave them both rules to always follow which are never use acceleration for selfish purposes and only talk about the Accelerated World to other Burst Linkers. He is also a freshman in high school.  (Source: Accel World Wiki)

name: Mihaya Kakei
description: Second in command of the legion Prominence under Scarlet Rain. She works as a waitress at a cake shop that also serves as a secret base for Prominence. She is usually seen wearing a maid outfit that she wears for work and rides a motorcycle. Leopard, as she prefers to be called, is cold, blunt, and distant, though she has a sarcastic sense of humor. Her Brain Burst avatar is level 6 and has the Shape Change ability. Her non-accelerated avatar is an anthropomorphic red-furred leopard woman wearing a leather bodysuit. She develops a rivalry with Sky Raker for unknown reasons.

name: Yellow Radio
description: First appears in volume 2.  Yellow Radio being the Yellow King makes him a very powerful and commanding person. He is also very cruel and manipulative person as he was the one who stole the chrome disaster armor and essentially created the fifth one in order to exploit the rules that allows him to kill the Red King.   He along with the Kings of Pure Color attained level nine and decided to create a treaty that seperates their territories and disallowed fighting amongst each other to obtain level ten.   (Source: Accel World Wiki)

name: Eita Kidou
description: The main character and a first year high school student. He aims to attend medical school after graduating from high school. Eita is very smart and always places at the top of the class during term exams. He doesn't like romance and love, as he calls himself "anti-romance." However, there is a reason for this: his parents divorced to search for 'the real one' and left him alone, never appearing before him again. This is why he lives with his aunt, Saeko-san.

name: Masuzu Natsukawa
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm 
 __Weight:__ 52 kg  
__Likes:__ Jojo's Bizarre Adventure  

Masuzu is [Eita](https://anilist.co/character/48997/Kidou-Eita)'s classmate and his girlfriend. A first year high school student, who spent nine years overseas. She is considered to be the school beauty and is constantly confessed to by male students before she forms a fake relationship. She is bold and acts more evil out of school and she is very devious. Like [Chiwa](https://anilist.co/character/48999/Harusaki-Chiwa), she is a terrible cook.          (Sources: Novels, Wikipedia)

name: Chiwa Harusaki
description:
__Height:__ 150 cm (4' 9")

Eita's childhood friend and neighbour who is in love with him, and a 1st year Highschool student. Her friends often call her 'chihuahua' (Chiwawa), due to her petite appearance and two ponytails that resemble puppy's ears. She used to be in Kendo Club until the last year of junior highschool due to a critical injury. She is tomboy, who loves eating and meat, as she thinks about food from dawn till dusk. She want's to be popular with males, and constantly fights Masuzu for Eita's efforts. She is also a terrible cook.

name: Ai Fuyuumi
description:
__Height:__ 157 cm (5' 2")  
__Relatives:__ Yuki Fuyuumi (Younger Brother), Daigoro Fuyuumi (Father)

She is an uptight and by the book member of the Student Council's Hallway Monitoring Committee, it is hinted that she often reprimands [Chiwa](https://anilist.co/character/48999/Harusaki-Chiwa) due to her rowdy behavior along the hallways. Ai is talented at cooking. She and [Eita](https://anilist.co/character/48997/Kidou-Eita)'s friend, [Kaoru](https://anilist.co/character/75772/Asoi-Kaoru), were classmates in elementary school.

name: Himeka Akishino
aliases: Burning Princess Saint Dragon Lady of Dawn
description:
__Height:__ 153 cm (5')  
__Weight:__ 46 kg (101 lbs)  
__Likes:__ Video games  

A mysterious, black-haired girl who is actually a chuunibyo. She sent Eita letters and messages so she could finally see him. Himeka calls herself "Himekashizuka Heaven's Rain" while being in chuuni mode, and tells that her name from past life was "Burning Princess Saint Dragon Lady of Dawn".  She has a one-sided crush for Eita, and says that she is his former girlfriend. However, when she isn't in chuuni mode, she has a poker face usually on, talks in third person, is a taciturn who answers usually by nodding and even throws tantrums sometimes about how Eita is only hers.  In the anime she is known as "Burning Pudding Princess."

name: Mana Natsukawa
description: Masuzu's little sister.

name: Kaoru Asoi
description: Eita's classmate and his best friend.  He is also friends with Ai whom was his former classmate back in elementary school.    (Source: Otaku-streamer forum)!~

name: Saeko Kiryuu
description: Saeko is Eita's aunt. She lives and takes care of him, but rarely comes home due to work. Saeko works in a gaming company, where she mostly makes scripts, graphics, coding and even music.

name: Tannin Kyoushi
description: Eita's teacher.

name: Yamamoto
description: Appears in episode 1.

name: Naoya Mukai
description:
**Height:** 170 cm (5'7")

Naoya is considered to be a very straightforward and outgoing person. His straightforward personality is very explicit and knows no bounds; Naoya is straightforward regardless of his situation, be it in front of the mass crowd or in private with his girlfriends. Additionally, Naoya can be considered slightly selfish for he openly asks his first girlfriend, [Saki Saki](https://anilist.co/character/162886/Saki-Saki), whether he can two-time her and go out with [Minase Nagisa](https://anilist.co/character/162885/Minase-Nagisa).

Despite his two-timing behavior, Naoya would do his best to keep himself to only two girlfriends, as seen by constantly rejecting and fending off [Hoshizaki Mirika](https://anilist.co/character/182020/Rika-Hoshizaki) despite her persistent behavior to gain his affection. He would also protect his relationship from all compromise, as seen with Mirika and Shino who tried to expose his two-timing relationships.

The straightforward personality branches off into Naoya's persistence, repeatedly asking Saki out until she finally gives in over many years. It also introduced his restraint, in which he refrains himself from laying hand on the girls (his girlfriends, Rika and Shino) no matter how suggestive the situation may have been.

name: Saki Saki
description:
**Height:** 161 cm (5'3")

Saki Saki is [Mukai Naoya](https://anilist.co/character/162887/Mukai-Naoya)'s girlfriend. She is one of the female protagonist of Kanojo mo Kanojo series, along with Naoya's other girlfriend [Minase Nagisa](https://anilist.co/character/162885/Minase-Nagisa).

Saki is stated to be a cheerful and energetic girl. She is also an emotional, naive and forgetful girl. She excels in sports and can be openly aggressive against anyone, mostly Mukai Naoya, whose actions are a bit too much.

name: Nagisa Minase
description:
**Height:** 155 cm (5'1")

Minase Nagisa is [Mukai Naoya](https://anilist.co/character/162887)'s girlfriend. She is one of the female protagonist of Kanojo mo Kanojo series, along with Naoya's other girlfriend [Saki Saki](https://anilist.co/character/162886)

Nagisa is shown to be a collected, considerate and humble girl. She seems to have no talent, often working hard to stay on her classmates average. Despite her considerate personality, she would resort to underhanded tactics, even to the point of cheating, to preserve her relationship with Mukai Naoya. Nagisa has been shown to have a lack of talent in singing and sports.

name: Rika Hoshizaki
description: Hoshizaki Rika, also known as her alternate name Mirika, is a popular virtual content creator on MeTube, and is persistently pursuing over [Naoya's](https://anilist.co/character/162887/Mukai-Naoya) affection for her. She is a first year high school student who attends the same school as [Saki Saki](https://anilist.co/character/162886/Saki-Saki) and Naoya.

name: Shino Kiryuu
description: Shino is a close friend of [Saki Saki](https://anilist.co/character/162886/Saki-Saki). They are in the same class and the same after school club. Shino is serious and considerate, and also academically talented, being the top scoring student at school.

name: Astolfo
description:
**Height:** 164 cm

Rider of Black is the Rider-class Servant of [Selenik Icecol Yggdmillennia](https://anilist.co/character/122393/Icecolle-Yggdmillennia-Celenike) as part of the Black Faction in the Turifas Holy Grail War of Fate/Apocrypha.  Black Rider's identity is Astolfo, the Twelfth Paladin of Charlemagne.

name: Jeanne  d'Arc
description:
__Height:__ 159 cm (5'3)

Ruler's True Name is Jeanne d'Arc, the Saint of Orleans. A Catholic saint born in Domrémy, France, and the heroine of France who liberated Orléans in the Hundred Years' War.

A Ruler Class Servant is the Standard-Bearer who Correctly Guides the Holy Grail War. Jeanne is a special Heroic Spirit summoned by the Holy Grail itself to act as the administrator of the Holy Grail War instead of the Church. Being summoned in the Ruler class also allows her to retain the memories of each repeating "game" unlike other Servants.

Jeanne d'Arc was a common farmer's daughter. She claims she had received the command of God to fight. She heard the Lord’s lament that the world changed straight into hell. The Lord wept into sorrow as no one could stop it and people were not even allowed to live simply, and were compelled to become either beasts or food. Conflict never ended, and blood continued to rain incessantly and soak the land. She received a revelation from the Lord, the voice contained no glory or victory, no obligation or sense of purpose but only the Lord laments. She caught his small, feeble murmurs that everyone else failed to hear. 

Jeanne also has a minor cameo in the second season of Fate/Zero.

name: Sieg
description:
Sieg was created by Yggdmillennia as one of their many homunculi suited to various purposes. Initially kept in a prana supply tank devised by Gordes Musik Yggdmillennia to grant energy for Servants, he was one of many allowed to be used by Caster of Black for usage as harvesting materials for his golems. Due to his unexpectedly high quality Magic Circuits, he was thought to be a good choice for Caster's Golem Keter Malkuth.

Sieg comes into consciousness without anything to form a personality. He is scared of everything but himself, believing to be nothing. He calls himself transparent and colorless because he possesses nothing and had received nothing from his birth. 

(Source: Type-Moon Wikia)

name: Vlad III
description:
Lancer of "Black" ("黒"のランサー, "Kuro" no Ransā) is the Lancer-class Servant of Darnic Prestone Yggdmillennia of the Black Faction in the Great Holy Grail War of Fate/Apocrypha. 

Lancer's True Name is Vlad III (ヴラド三世, Vurado Sansei), the Lord Impaler (串刺し公, Kushizashi Kō) (1431-1476), the greatest hero of Wallachia, whose feats in war caused him to be known fearsomely as the "Impaling Prince" to the Turks. Due to the legends associated with him, another name has been spread across the world, The Little Dragon, better known as the vampire Count Dracula. While the nation was small, he was a hero who ascended to the throne and managed to turn back the numerous invasions of the Ottoman Empire that had trampled over every other country. Though the model for Dracula, he was not a vampire, but a man of devotion and great hero.

It is said that the difference between him and his counterpart is their aspects being different, Fate/Apocrypha's version being Vlad III's aspect as a King, while his Fate/EXTRA counterpart is his aspect of a Warrior.

name: Kairi Shishigou
description: Master of [Mordred Pendragon](https://anilist.co/character/55977/Pendragon-Mordred).

name: Chiron
aliases: Kuro no Archer (黒のアーチャー‚ Archer of Black)
description: Archer of "Black" is the Archer-class Servant of Fiore Forvedge Yggdmillennia of the Black Faction in the Great Holy Grail War of Fate/Apocrypha.

name: Laeticia
description: Laeticia is a French girl who is chosen by the Holy Grail as a match for the materialization of Ruler Jeanne d'Arc in the Great Holy Grail War of Fate/Apocrypha. After accepting the role, her personality is temporarily suppressed for most of the war.

name: Shirou Tokisada Amakusa
aliases: Shirou Kotomine (シロウ・コトミネ)
description:
The Master of [Assasin of Red](https://anilist.co/character/35596/Semiramis), Shirou was dispatched by the Church as one of the Masters of the Red Faction. 



He wants to make use of the Holy Grail War to fulfill his own wish. He has no connection to [Shirou Emiya](https://anilist.co/character/496/Emiya-Shirou) of the [Fate/stay night](https://anilist.co/manga/30715/Fatestay-night/) timeline.

name: Jack the Ripper
native: ジャック・ザ・リッパー
aliases: Kuro no Assassin (黒のアサシン)
Densetsu no Shiriaru Kiraa (伝説の連続殺人鬼)
description:
Jack the Ripper is a Servant of the Assassin class and one of the main characters in Fate/Apocrypha.

She is a young girl who embodies contradiction itself, combining the dual natures of "day" and "night." She displays a childish manner of speech, but she is truly quick of thought. Rationality dominates her behavior, but there are many inherent weaknesses to her psyche. Her personality is both pure and cruel, and she is inclined to repay cruelty with cruelty and benevolence with benevolence. Her psyche is inherently broken, and mistreatment toward her may result in irreversible deterioration. While needing to feed on the souls of humans to keep herself in existence, she claims that she will only eat evil people because their souls "taste" better.

name: Mordred Pendragon
description:
Mordred is the "son" of [King Arthur](https://anilist.co/character/497/Pendragon-Artoria) though, in reality, she is a woman. 

[Morgan le Fay](https://anilist.co/character/239533/le-Fay-Morgan), Artoria's sister, created Mordred as a homunculus clone of the King. Morgan grew Mordred in secret, inculcating her the desire to usurp the King and ascend to the throne as the rightful heir. To achieve this objective Mordred was made to be one of the Knights of the Round Table. 

With time Mordred grew to idolize her "father", but the King refused to recognize her as a rightful heir. These clashing feelings of love and hate made Mordred play an important role in the fall of Camelot.

__In Fate/Apocrypha:__

name: Andy
description:
Andy is member no. 9 of the Round Table. He is a Negator with the alias Undead. His original personality is that of Victor.

Andy is a deuteragonist along with Fuuko Izumo.

Andy is insanely reckless, he enjoys attempting to die and is always looking for new methods of death. He also has a soft spot for Fuuko, who he is very protective of and gets very angry when she is hurt, to the point where he will willingly remove the card in his head to release Victor. 

Andy is a tall and muscular man, with white combed back hair. He has a card in his forehead above his left eye which causes his eye to be half-closed which has left a scar. Due to his ability, he has stopped aging around his mid-20's. He has the words DEAD END tattooed on his left shoulder, but the first D in dead is backwards. He has the number 1865 tattooed on his left pectoral as well as a scar that will not go away even when he regenerates.

name: Shen Xiang
description: Member No. 2 of the Round Table.

name: Gina  Chamber
description: Gina is a Negator who crossed paths with Andy over fifty years ago.

name: Juiz
description: Leader of the Union. Juiz is a founder and no. 1 member of the Round Table. She is determined to kill the being on the other side of Apocalypse, gathering several Negators in order to gain enough power to defeat it, thus forming The Union.

name: Tatiana
description: Member no. 5 of the Round Table. She lived in Russia before becoming a member. The armor she wears acts as a restraint to contain her ability.

name: Rip Tristan
description: Rip Tristan is a member of Under.

name: Isshin
description:
__Gender:__ 

Member no. 6 of the Round Table.

name: Nico Vorgeil
description: Member no. 8 of the Round Table. He is the smartest member of The Union. Nico is married to [Ichico Nemuri](https://anilist.co/character/314230/Nemuri-Ichico) and has a daughter with her, [Mico Vorgeil](https://anilist.co/character/321801/Vorgeil-Mico).

name: Billy Alfred
description: Member no. 3 of the Round Table. He is a cool and carefree person that seems to not mind being in danger or even realizing he was in the first place. He's shown to be knowledgeable of guns and is a self-admitted sweets lover.

name: Kazuhiko Nukumizu
description: Kazuhiko is a student in Class 1-C at Tsuwabuki High School and the president of the Literature Club. He is fairly intelligent and quite experienced in handling girls' issues due to taking care of his little sister. He also has a terrible sense of style, much to the chagrin of his more popular and fashionable friend, [Anna Yanami](https://anilist.co/character/230873/Anna-Yanami).

name: Anna Yanami
description: A first-year student at Tsuwabuki High School and one of the loser heroines. She is a popular girl in [Kazuhiko](https://anilist.co/character/230874)'s class with a bright and charming personality as well as a big appetite, often bickering with Kazuhiko when he says anything to her about gaining weight.

name: Lemon Yakishio
description: A first-year student of Tsuwabuki High School. She's the ace of the Female Track and Field Team and also a member of the Literature Club. She has romantic feelings for her long-time friend [Mitsuki Ayano](https://anilist.co/character/341640/) and is currently friends with Ayano's girlfriend [Chihaya Asagumo](https://anilist.co/character/341637/).

name: Chika Komari
description: A first-year student at Tsuwabuki High and a member of the Literature Club, she is an avid web/light novel reader and writer. Behind her timid and awkward exterior lies a hardworking girl who deeply cares for her siblings and treasures her closest relationships.

name: Kaju Nukumizu
description: Kaju is the younger sister of [Kazuhiko Nukumizu](https://anilist.co/character/230874/Kazuhiko-Nukumizu).

name: Koto Tsukinoki
description: A third-year student at Tsuwabuki High who's a massive fujoshi. She is the vice president of the Literature Club and the former Vice President of the Student Council. She's currently in preparation to go to University outside of Toyohashi. She is the girlfriend of [Shintaro Tamaki](https://anilist.co/character/339760/Shintarou-Tamaki) and also his childhood friend.

name: Shintarou Tamaki
description: A third-year student who is the President of the Literature Club. Childhood friend and now boyfriend of [Koto Tsukinoki](https://anilist.co/character/339761/Koto-Tsukinoki).

name: Sousuke Hakamada
description: The childhood friend of [Anna Yanami](https://anilist.co/character/230873/Anna-Yanami) and the boyfriend of [Karen Himemiya](https://anilist.co/character/341639/Karen-Himemiya)

name: Karen Himemiya
description: The girlfriend of [Sousuke Hakamada](https://anilist.co/character/341638) who is also friends with [Anna Yanami](https://anilist.co/character/230873/Anna-Yanami).

name: Sayo Konuki
description: The school nurse and advisor to the Literature Club.

name: Shounen Bat
description: The enigmatic figure the series revolves around. He appears as a grinning, baseball cap-wearing juvenile who travels on golden inline skates and attacks people with a gold-colored metal baseball bat that is curiously bent.

name: Tsukiko Sagi
description: One of the central characters of the series, she is a famous, but timid, character designer best known for a cartoonish dog named Maromi. She carries a plush toy copy of Maromi everywhere. She is Shounen Bat's first apparent victim in the series, and the catalyst who jump-starts the plot.

name: Keiichi Ikari
description:
Keiichi Ikari is a detective in charge of the Shounen Bat case alongside [Mitsuhiro Maniwa](https://anilist.co/character/5131/). In comparison to his coworker, Maniwa, Keiichi is very old fashioned and prefers to do things simplistically. He's extremely uptight and easily frustrated. He is impatient and doesn't try to work with the witnesses and victims of his case and gets upset at Mitsuhiro's attempts to be understanding.

Husband of [Misae Ikari](https://anilist.co/character/12387/).

name: Mitsuhiro Maniwa
description: Mitsuhiro works with [Keiichi Ikari](https://anilist.co/character/5130/) in the Metal Bat case, and is often the more understanding of the two. He has a very gentle personality and questions Keiichi's hastiness in his mind. It is thanks to Mitsuhiro that they've been able to get through to many of the witnesses and victims of Metal Bat's attacks.

name: Harumi Chouno
description:
Harumi Chouno is a young woman employed as a researcher at a university, as well as [Yuuichi Taira](https://anilist.co/character/16422/)'s tutor.

Harumi suffers from dissociative identity disorder, and her alter ego is a sex worker named Maria. She is typically quiet and reserved, but at night she becomes her alter ego. Harumi fears letting others know about Maria, as evident with her husband and her interrogation with the police. She is also shown to be great with kids due to her day job as a tutor. Harumi even comes to Yuuichi's birthday party, making her the only guest besides his mother.

(Source: Paranoia Agent Wiki)

name: Maromi
description: Maromi is a popular Sanrio-esque mascot created by Tsukiko Sagi. A pink dog with big black eyes and droopy ears, Maromi is considered rather cute in appearance. The little plush toy is seen by the audience as life-like because it gets up, walks around and talks to Tsukiko.

name: Fuyubachi
description: Fuyubachi is an old man introduced in the eight episode of the show, who groups up with [Zebra](https://anilist.co/character/13595/) and [Kamome](https://anilist.co/character/13596/) to commit group suicide.

name: Dok-Ja Kim
description:
__Height:__ 176 cm

He is the sole reader of the webnovel Three Ways to Survive in a Ruined World (AKA 'Ways of Survival'), an apocalyptic fantasy story written by tls123.

name: Jung-Hyeok Yu
description:
__Height:__ 184 cm

Yoo Joonghyuk is the main character of tls123's novel Three Ways to Survive in a Ruined World.

name: Su-Yeong Han
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm

Han Su-Yeong is first shown to have a selfish personality, prioritizing her own interests over anything else. However, throughout the story she grows closer to the members of , gradually coming to  value each of them. Han Su-Yeong is a very confident, intelligent, and witty person, constantly insulting and joking around with her companions, but she gets angry very easily when others do stupid things. Similar to [Yu Jung-Hyeok](https://anilist.co/character/180892/), she will berate the people she cares about even as she tries her hardest to keep them safe. When [Kim Dok-Ja](https://anilist.co/character/180887/) is absent, Han Su-Yeong is the de facto leader of , using her astounding intelligence to guide them through any hardships that may come their way.

name: Sang-Ah Yoo
description:
__Height:__ 166 cm

Yoo Sang-Ah is one of Kim Dok-Ja's colleagues and current party members. She is described as being Mino Soft's beauty, with a gentle and lively look about her. While her expression is normally smiley, it becomes somewhat cold when she is thinking.

name: Uriel
description:
Demon-like Judge of Fire is a constellation of the  nebula who makes judgments through fire. Their real identity is the Archangel Uriel. Their contractor must only perform acts of "absolute good." In return, they gain enormous power.

She is one of the original 4 constellations who wishes to sponsor Kim Dokja. Despite being rejected, she is an avid supporter of .

name: Jecheon Daeseong
aliases: Great Sage the Equal of Heaven
description: The Great Sage, Heaven's Equal, also known as the Great Sage the Equal of Heaven, is one of the "story bodies" i.e. versions of Sun Wukong.

name: Seol-Hwa Lee
description: Lee Seol-Hwa is one of the 10 Evils, the Poisoner. She was Yoo Jong-Hyuk's companion in his second round.

name: Nam-Un Kim
description: Kim Nam-Un is a side character in Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint. He was one of Yoo Joonghyuk's companions in Three Ways to Survive in a Ruined World.

name: Bihyeong
description:
Bihyung is the dokkaebi in charge of Kim Dokja's scenario. Kim Dokja makes several deals with Bihyung.

He is the creator of the 'Random Item Box'. He was fired from the Star Stream Administration Bureau after the product was forced to be banned by the bureau and became a streamer.

name: Simyeonui Heugyeomnyong
description: The Abyssal Black Flame Dragon is a constellation and the leader of the  group. He offered to sponsor Kim Dokja in the first Sponsor Selection, but was turned down. Despite being snubbed, he followed Kim Dokja through the scenarios and became a strong supporter of his nebula.

name: Göll
description:
__Species:__ Demigod

Göll is the youngest of the 13 Valkyrie Sisters and the deuteragonist of the series. During the Ragnarok matches, she is usually seen with Brunhilde anxiously watching each match.

She's usually anxious and worried about many things to the point that it gets on Brunhilde's and Hrist's nerves. Whenever humanity's warriors die, she cries and mourns each of her sisters as they die with them.
As an apprentice valkyrie, she doesn't seem all that interested in saving humanity compared to worrying about her sisters.

name: Brunhilde
description:
__Species__: Demigod

Brunhilde is the eldest of the 13 Valkyrie Sisters and the main protagonist of the series.

She is the one who chose humanity's finest and strongest warriors in Ragnarok to stand up against the strongest gods in combat and slay them in an attempt to save Humanity.

name: Adam
description:
Adam was a very calm, collected, and carefree individual; speaking to Zeus in a very casual manner, much to the chagrin of the other gods present.
We later find out that Adam holds no grudge against heaven, despite the fact the Serpent assaulted Eve and then framed her when he was elsewhere, resulting in humanity's banishment from Eden. However, at the same time, he did not hesitate to kill the Serpent the moment he attacked them.

Adam loved Eve, so much so that he abandoned the paradise of Eden without a second thought when his wife was banished.

Adam displayed selflessness to the highest degree, pushing himself past his limits in his fight against a god to give humanity a bit of hope. Adam's love for his children was strong enough that, even in a battle for his life, he only thought of protecting humanity from anyone who'd try and do them harm.

name: Thor
description:
__Species:__ God
__Affiliation:__ Gods

Similar to Lü Bu, Thor is a battle maniac and takes great interest in fighting; especially with strong and/or worthy opponents. Furthermore, he only shows happiness and joy in combat, displaying his finest smile in the first round of Ragnarok. Thor is also a man of few words, not speaking unless absolutely necessary or when in combat. He often does not show this and has a more stoic and aloof expression on his face most of the time, making him seem unapproachable to others.

name: Zeus
description:
__Species:__ God
__Affiliation:__ Gods

Zeus is a prominent deity and the Supreme God in the Greek Pantheon. He is also the chairman of the Gods' Council and often referred to as the "God Father of Cosmos"

When addressing his fellow gods, Zeus is extremely calm and authoritative while possessing a very formal and wise disposition. Like most gods, Zeus holds his own kind to a superior and extremely high standard, always expecting them to win no matter the odds, and seething with anger when they lose to humans. Zeus is also an eccentric individual, having random exaggerated emotional outbursts, breaking into a dance at the start of the second round of Ragnarok in front of everyone present, even being called the most shameful god by Hermes.

However, after several rounds of Ragnarok passed, Zeus became more humble, even acknowledging Humanity's strength. He is also extremely faithful and confident in those of the Greek Pantheon.

name: Bu Lü
description: Lü Bu, the Flying General was the strongest warrior of The Three Kingdoms.

name: Kojirou Sasaki
description: Kojiro Sasaki's a famous swordsman from Japan, known as "History's Greatest Loser".

name: Poseidon
description: Poseidon is a prominent deity in the Greek Pantheon as the God of the Seas.

name: Hermes
description: Messenger of the gods.

name: Ilse Langnar
description:
__Affiliation:__ Survey Corps; Soldier. 

Ilse Langnar was a member of the Scout Regiment. She was a participant of the 34th expedition beyond the Walls and was in charge of the left wing of the second brigade who went MIA. In a notebook, she documented information regarding an [Abnormal Titan](https://anilist.co/character/133213/Abnormal-Titan) she encountered, which later was discovered and aided in [Hange Zoë's](https://anilist.co/character/71121/Hange-Zoe) research. 

Ilse appeared to be quite emotional, yet brave, attempting to stand firm in moments of despair. She seemed to be a very devoted and smart soldier. She cared deeply for her family, regretful of being unable to give anything back to her parents. Ilse thought of herself as a proud member of the Survey Corps and resolved to do whatever she could to benefit the branch.

name: Nick
description: Pastor Nick is a member of a religion that worships the Walls as holy.  He claims that he lost his family as a result of addiction to Vine.   As a religious leader, Pastor Nick used his influence to oppose any modification of the walls, be it permanently sealing the gates or even mounting cannons on the top. Though he claimed it was blasphemy for humans to "maim" the wall,   (Source: Shingeki no Kyojin Wikia)  Note: Minister Nick is the official English translation by Kodansha.

name: Mina Carolina
description: Mina appears in Ch. 3. When the Colossal Titan appears outside Trost District, the burst of steam from its body knocks a number of trainees off the Wall. She follows when Eren instructs the other trainees to attack the Colossal Titan. After the second attack of the Colossal Titan, she was assigned to the middle guard along with Eren Yeager and Armin Arlert. Initially tasked with working under the training corps, they eventually were incorporated into the front guard due to the number of titans. Catching the group unaware, a titan lunged at the roof top they were standing on.   When Eren was talking about how killing titans that got in Trost District will get their rank up high, she joined him indicating that she is also signing up for Scouting Legion.

name: Thomas Wagner
description: Thomas Wagner was from Trost District. A member of the 104th Trainees Squad, he first met Eren Yeager while questioning him about the Colossal Titan. Later, he operated the training gear for the Three Dimensional Maneuver Gear during Eren's second attempt at his aptitude test. At Keith Shadis' orders, Thomas exchanged gear with Eren and it was discovered that Eren's gear was defective. After graduating, Thomas planned to join the Scouting Legion.

name: Kikou-shuna Kyojin
description: During the 34th expedition beyond the Walls, Ilse Langnar fleed towards human territory and encounters this Titan. After it cornered her against a tree, rather than eating her, it instead stares at her until, to her amazement, it began to speak.

name: Samuel Linke-Jackson
native: サムエル・リンケ-ジャクソン
description: Samuel is a member of the 104th Trainees Squad.  He appears in Ch. 3. When the Colossal Titan appears outside Trost District, the burst of steam from its body knocks a number of trainees off the Wall. While most are able to switch to their Three Dimensional Maneuver Gear and anchor themselves to the Wall, Samuel is struck in the head by a piece of falling rock and stunned. Sasha saves him from falling to his death by firing one of her grappling hooks into his leg. Eren tells Sasha to take Samuel somewhere safe, then instructs the other trainees to attack the Colossal Titan.

name: Nariyuki Yuiga
description: Yuiga has been appointed by the principal as [Rizu](https://anilist.co/character/121776) and [Fumino](https://anilist.co/character/121775)'s tutor to get them into their desired universities. Later is also asked to tutor [Uruka](https://anilist.co/character/121778).

name: Fumino Furuhashi
description:
**Height:** 165cm

Fumino is a genius with liberal arts but terrible with math. Left-handed. She is a blue-haired girl whose dream is to be able to reach for the stars just as how her mother dreamt of studying the stars. Her father is a professor and teaches Math, but she genetically relates to her mother where they both can't do math. Along with being one of the main heroines of the series, she teaches [Yuiga](https://anilist.co/character/121777) about the feelings of a woman, not knowing that she would later fall for him in the series. She is quite insecure with her chest size, and tends to hurt anyone who makes fun of it, such as [Ogata](https://anilist.co/character/121776) comparing her test scores in which she thought it was a comparison between their chests.

name: Rizu Ogata
description:
**Height:** 143cm

Rizu is a genius with math and science but terrible with liberal arts.

Rizu is one of the four students that is being tutored by Yuiga in Liberal Arts. She is smart when it comes to Science and Math, but is terrible with liberal arts. She is also terrible at understanding people's feelings and reading the mood of the conversation. She tends to see everything in a logical manner whenever something related to emotions such love and awkwardness arise.

name: Uruka Takemoto
description: Uruka is a genius when it comes to sports, having earned several titles in freestyle swimming, but her lazy nature and hatred for studying has made her terrible with her other academics.

name: Mafuyu Kirisu
description:
Student Counselor at [Yuiga](https://anilist.co/character/121777)'s school and one of [Rizu](https://anilist.co/character/121776) and [Fumino](https://anilist.co/character/121775)'s ex-tutors.

She is a pink-haired individual whose clumsiness (ie. misplacing her keys and a messy house) and being reckless (ie. Can drive at "normal levels" in which it frightens Yuiga) is part of her overall personality. Being a person who isn't close to her parents, she was once a professional skater until she abruptedly stopped due to the fact that her parents had the expectation of being a skater when she only wanted to be a teenage schoolgirl. She tends to give out tough love by sending out mixed signals. She is also abhors cockroaches and had asked Yuiga to stay with her while getting rid of the cockroach with the promise of doing anything for him. Even mentioning cockroach would make Mafuyu scared that she has to interrupt anyone from saying the animal outloud.

name: Asumi Kominami
description: Part-time worker at a maid café called High Stage and classmates with [Yuiga](https://anilist.co/character/121777) at a summer cram school.

name: Mizuki Yuiga
description: She is the younger sister of Nariyuki.

name: Sawako Sekijou
description: She is the President of the chemistry club.

name: Chinami Umihara
description: Member of Uruka's swim squad.

name: Ayuko Kuwase
description: Uruka's teammate on the swim team

name: Henrietta
description:
__Race:__ Human
__Class:__ Bard
__Subclass:__ Accountant
__Guild:__ Crescent Moon Alliance

She works directly under Marielle and loves everything that's cute.

name: Soujirou Seta
description:
Race: Human
Class: Samurai
Subclass: Sword Saint
Guild: Caravan of the West Wind


Guild master of Caravan of the West Wind. He was popular with girls even before the Apocalypse. Because Shiroe declined his offer to join his guild, he was led to believe Shiroe didn't like him. This is cleared up when Shiroe asks for his help.

name: Karashin
description:
Charasin, also known as Young Boss Charasin, is the guild master of Shopping District 8, one of the top three production guilds in Akihabara. He is a Human Summoner-Merchant and a member of the Round Table Alliance. His Overskill is Multi-Line.

Charasin's real name is Yousuke Mikami, and he works in an advertising agency.

(Source: Log Horizon Wiki)

name: Demikas
description:
Race: Human
Class: Monk
Subclass: Outlaw
Guild: Brigandia

Guild master of Brigandia, who has been bossing people around in Susukino. Even before the Apocylips, his guild had a bad reputation. He obsesses over finding Serara only to let her know who's boss. Because of this, she is unable to return to her guild in Akiba.

name: Roe2
description: Roe2 was Shiroe's alt on the beta test server, which he used in order to try and experiment on the content of future pack extensions.

name: Natsuno Yuuki
description: Natsuno lives and attends school in Sotoba. He hates living in the village and prefers to be in the city. Originally a city dweller, Natsuno reluctantly moves to Sotoba with his parents when they wanted a change of environment. He often exhibits a cold exterior, especially disliking Megumi Shimizu's presence, who has a crush on him and is obsessed(to the point where she stalks him). He is kind and friendly toward those whom he considers his friends (Tooru, Kaori, Akira and Tooru's younger siblings)  Natsuno is one of the two main protagonists in the series.

name: Toshio Ozaki
description: The dean of the hospital in Sotoba, Toshio resigned from university hospital, returning to take up his father's position when he passed away. He is fondly given a nickname, "Waka-sensei", by his colleagues as well as the residents. Toshio has a dislike to both his mother and his late father, as both of them often put reputation of the Ozaki family before anything else. He is childhood friends with Seishin Muroi and Mikiyasu Yasumori. Toshio is a chain smoker and is married to Kyouko who manages an antique shop. He is baffled by the mysterious deaths and swears to solve the case and protect his village. One of the two main protagonists in the series.

name: Seishin Muroi
description: Seishin is the local priest in Sotoba, as well as an author in writing novels. His latest work is called Shiki, which translated in English is called Corpse Demon. He has a sense of the supernatural and detects the presence of the real "shiki." He is childhood friends with Toshio Ozaki and Mikiyasu Yasumori. He is single and once attempted to commit suicide in a drunken state during his university days.

name: Sunako Kirishiki
description: A young girl who moves into the Kanemasa mansion atop the hill with her family. She has a rare genetic disorder known as SLE, which leads her to stay inside her home during the day and only come out at night. She and her family are fans of the essays and novels written by Seishin Muroi, and is the reason they moved to Sotoba. Sunako dislikes people calling her name with the honorific "chan".

name: Megumi Shimizu
description: A girl attending the same school as [Natsuno](https://anilist.co/character/7582/Yuuki-Natsuno), Megumi hates living in the village and longs for city life. She has a one-sided crush on Natsuno and often daydreams of a relationship with him. Megumi encounters the Kirishiki family in the beginning of the series.

name: Kaori Tanaka
description: Shimizu Megumi's childhood friend, though the sentiment is one-sided on her part, as Megumi is disgusted by the Sotoba villagers in general and doesn't think any more highly of Kaori. Later, she and her brother Akira becomes friend with Natsuno and aids him in the investigation about the Shikis.

name: Akira Tanaka
description: Kaori's brother and one of the first persons to find out about the existence of Shiki. He becomes a friend of Natsuno.

name: Tooru Mutou
description: Natsuno's best friend. He has a slight crush on the nurse, Ritsuko.

name: Ritsuko Kunihiro
description: Nurse at Ozaki Clinic. She has a dog named Taro. Tohru has a crush on her.   She used to have a boyfriend, who disliked the isolated Sotoba village, and offered to marry her and bring her to the city. Ritsuko refused, as she couldn't leave the place where she grew up and her family.

description: Sunako's father.

The complete opposite of [Gabriel](https://anilist.co/character/120937/Tenma-White-Gabriel), Vignette is very responsible and often has to look after Gabriel, who lives in the same building as her, contrary to her actual role as a demon.

Raphiel is the second-ranked angel in Gabriel's class, who has since become a sadistic stalker who takes delight in teasing Satanichia and causing chaos for entertainment.

(Source: Gabriel DropOut Wiki)

name: Master
description: The owner of Coffee Angel, the coffee shop where Gabriel works part time. He is often bewildered by Gabriel's behavior, but assumes it is just because she is a foreigner. He is quite proud of his house blend. To attain his signature flavor and fragrance, he uses five different types of coffee beans.

name: Seishirou Shishirui
description: Seishirou Shishirui was Shinobu Oshino's first vampire minion and the original oddity slayer. He was an afamed oddity specialist in his time.

name: Ougi Oshino
description:
Ougi appears to be a girl with short black hair, black pupils, and pale white skin. She is a junior of [Koyomi Araragi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi) at Naoetsu Private High School. Ougi often talks to Koyomi about oddities, and helping him remember what he knows. Her catchphrase is, "I don't know anything, Araragi-senpai. It's you who knows."

Ougi is mysterious and can come off as spooky/creepy. She also speaks in a condescending tone towards Koyomi and [Hanekawa](https://anilist.co/character/22055/Tsubasa-Hanekawa). Furthermore, Ougi is capable of pulling off many things, despite what she says about what she knows.

name: Sodachi Oikura
description:
[Koyomi Araragi's](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Araragi-Koyomi) childhood friend. She is a student with a strong sense of competitiveness which led to her popular nickname, much to her chagrin.

Sodachi was the president of a first-year class where both [Hitagi](https://anilist.co/character/22037/Senjougahara-Hitagi) and Koyomi also belonged to. At school, she wanted to be called as "Euler", but ends up getting the nickname "How Much", a pun on her surname and a reference to her personality.

name: Issa Matsumoto
description: 26 years old. Five dan. He is 181 centimeters tall. A quite expressive and enthusiastic person, he can be aggressive at times as well. He comes from the countryside. He is a fan of Akari.

A tanuki-human high school student who secretly escaped to Anima City. She is communicative and has a bright and cheerful personality.

(Source: Official Website)

description: A close friend of the main character, Michiru Kagemori.

name: Shirou Oogami
description: A social worker Wolf Beastman. He despises humans and fights for the rights of Beastmen.

name: Kuro
description: Shiro's pet crow.

name: Mirai Kakehashi
description: He was raised by his abusive uncle and aunt after his family were killed in a car crash. The abuse he endured resulted in him trying to commit suicide by throwing himself from a tower block, but he was saved by [Nasse](https://anilist.co/character/89232).

name: Nasse
description:
Nasse is [Mirai](https://anilist.co/character/89231/Kakehashi-Mirai)'s life saving's angel, and as such, knows everything Mirai has been through, everything which is related to him, notably his being being mentally abused by his aunt and uncle since they have been fostering him.

She saved Mirai's life as he jumped off a building, and gave him the possibility to be happy, by giving him Freedom, and Love.

name: Revel
description: [Saki](https://anilist.co/character/89974/Hanakago-Saki)'s angel. He is rather calculating and manipulative, a trait that is considered by [Nasse](https://anilist.co/character/89232/Nasse) to be the reason why he was relegated to be a class two Angel, thus capable only of bestowing Saki with the red arrow.

name: Saki Hanakago
description: Saki is [Mirai](https://anilist.co/character/89231/Kakehashi-Mirai)'s classmate, his love interest, and coincidentally, a God candidate as well.

name: Tonma Rodriguez
description:
Tonma Rodriguez is a human who was selected by the angel Luta to be a god candidate.

Tonma is a very selfish individual, who has no problem using his new found power as a god candidate to force women to fall in love with him. He also has a large ego, brazenly stating in a television interview that he already feels like a god.

name: Kanade Uryuu
description: The main antagonist of the series who intends to become God by all means necessary, including killing all other candidates.

name: Meyza
description: Meyza is a special-rank angel and is the Angel of Greed. She is one of the thirteen angels and selected [Kanade Uryu](https://anilist.co/character/122073/Uryuu-Kanade), a.k.a. Metropoliman, as her god candidate.

name: Luta
description: Luta is a second-rank angel. He is one of the thirteen angels and selected Tonma Rodriguez as his god candidate.

name: Shogo Hatakeyama
description: Shogo Hatakeyama is a human who was selected by the angel Emaka to be a god candidate.

name: Saburo Tabuchi
description: Saburo Tabuchi is a human who was selected by the angel Egura to be a god candidate.

name: Giru
description: Giru is a Machine Mutant that accompanies Son Goku, Pan, and Trunks on their quest to find the Black Star Dragon Balls. His true name is G2006. The three first met him on a desert planet, while he was on the brink of death. After eating the Dragon Radar for energy, he tried to escape from them, but was ultimately caught by Goku. After that, they found out that the radar intergraded into his software. Upon arriving on the planet, M2, he seemingly betrays his friends, though it is later revealed he was in league with Trunks to reveal Myu's ultimate secret: Baby. The plan works, and Giru and Trunks successfully rescue Goku and Pan as well. Giru then becomes part of the Black-Star Dragon Ball team again. In the series, Giru keeps getting destroyed but is later fixed by Trunks.

name: Trunks
description:
__Race:__ __Birth Year:__ 766 Age
__Height:__  129 cm (4'2") (Kid), 170 cm (5'6") (Future)

A mysterious person who comes from the future and tells our protagonist Son Goku of the bleak future to come. He is characterized as well-mannered, serious, and very cautious.

name: Pan
description: Pan is a fictional character in the manga and anime series Dragon Ball Z, as well as Dragon Ball GT. She is a Human-Saiyajin quarter breed. In the original Japanese version, she was voiced by Yuko Minaguchi, while she is voiced by Elise Baughman in the FUNimation dub and by Caitlynne Medrek in the Blue Water Studios redubs. It should be noted that Pan's name comes from the Pan of Roman (as well as others) mythology. That means that, at first glance, she appears to have been named after her mother Videl rather than her father Gohan. However, closer inspection reveals a double-pun on behalf of author Akira Toriyama, in that Pan is also the Japanese and Spanish word for bread, continuing her father's food-based name as well as her mother's god-religion-based name.    Pan is introduced in the series following the ten year interval between the defeat of Majin Buu and the end of the written Dragon Ball series. In the series, Pan is daughter of the primary character named Son Gohan, and as a result, the granddaughter of the main character named Son Goku. Pan is the only original character in the series with the most diluted Saiyajin heritage, and as a result, it was stated in the Daizenshuu that she didn't have the ability to become a Super Saiyajin. However, this is later contradicted by the Dragon Ball GT Perfect file books that stated that she could have ascended if she trained hard enough.

name: Yi Xing Long
aliases: Super Yi Xing Long (超一星龍)
description:
The final villain in Dragon Ball GT. He is the seventh and last of the Evil Shadow Dragons to appear. He later transforms into Super Yi Xing Long (Omega Shenron) after absorbing all seven of the Dragon Balls.

(Source: Dragon Ball Wiki)

name: Mr. Popo
description: Mr. Popo is an immortal djinn who lives with [Kami](https://anilist.co/character/6108/Kami) in Kami's Lookout and is bound there eternally as the gardener and caretaker. He has served every other Kami (God/Guardian) of the Earth since the beginning of time. He was trained by the recent Kami himself and trained [Goku](https://anilist.co/character/246/Son-Gokuu) for 3 years in order to fight [Piccolo](https://anilist.co/character/914/Piccolo).

name: Bra
description: Bra is the second child (after Trunks) of Bulma and Vegeta. Unlike Pan who acts tomboyish, Bra acts feminine and sticks around her mom. Like Bulma, Bra has blue hair in the anime and purple hair in the manga. Her father doesn't appear to make a point of encouraging her to train (like he does to her brother Trunks), but the two are quite close, as it becomes apparent in Dragon Ball GT, where Vegeta proves to be very protective of his daughter on multiple occasions. During the Baby Saga, Bra (along with the rest of the world) is possessed by Baby. She is one of the four characters who help Baby become stronger; after this, however, her role is greatly reduced. Although she has never been seen in combat (She'd rather shop than train), except when Baby had her under his control, she does have the ability to fly through use of her ki.    *Wikipedia

name: Mister Satan
description: His name in the original Japanese version media is Mister Satan. It was changed to Hercule in FUNimation's English dub and Viz Media English version of the manga. In the U.S. edition of Shonen Jump it is explained that Hercule is the real name of the character while Mr. Satan was his stage name though no such explanation was present in the original. He is voiced by Daisuke Gouri in the original Japanese version, Chris Rager in the FUNimation version and by Don Brown in the English version from the UK and Canada.     Source: Wikipedia

name: Majin Boo
description:
Boo is introduced in the series as an innocent looking, pudgy, pink genie-like creature. Later in the series, it is revealed that Boo's original form is a more sleek child form ("The Boo of Pure Evil"), however his nature and form had been altered after he'd assimilated the gentle, pudgy god (Dai Kaioshin) into his body. Boo's creator, a wizard named Bibbidi, had used Boo to wage war on the Kaioshin. Boo managed to assimilate two of the four Kaioshin, the second being the one who altered his nature to become innocent. After Bibbidi sealed Boo away, Bibbidi was killed by the fourth Kaioshin, and Boo was transported to Earth where he layed dormant for five million years until he was revived by Bibbidi's son Babbidi during the events of Dragon Ball.

Boo has numerous counterparts in the series. When he first emerges from his shell, he is tall and round, and his personality is naive and innocent. Boo's anger later manifests itself in the form of another Boo ("The Boo of Pure Wrath").  After a battle with the Boo of Pure Wrath, Boo is absorbed and the two combined create Super Boo, who tracks down the protagonists of the series Piccolo and Gotenks. He later reverts to his purest form, the original state called "The Boo of Pure Evil".

name: Kanna Makino
description:

Kanna is a high school student in the same year as her friends, [Tamako](https://anilist.co/character/74850/Kitashirakawa-Tamako) and [Midori](https://anilist.co/character/75080/Tokiwa-Midori), and is a member of the baton club. She is the daughter of a carpenter who works in the same shopping district as Tamako and her family. A relaxed and laid back girl, Kanna does not care what anyone else thinks and is not easily swayed, however she does have a fear of heights.

name: Tamako Kitashirakawa
description:
__Height:__ 156 cm (5'1") 

Tamako is a first-year in high school whose family runs a mochi shop in their town's shopping district called Tama-ya. She enjoys her high school life and the baton club with her friends Kanna and Midori. She helps her family run the shop and invent new kinds of mochi.
