description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3") 

Midori is Tamako's classmate, childhood friend, and baton club member. Her grandparents, whom she lives with, own and run a toy shop in the town's shopping district. Midori feels the need to "take care" of Tamako, so much that she feels she may be in love with her.

name: Ryuu  Lion
description:
__Race:__ Elf
__Height:__ 165 cm (5'5")

Ryuu Lion is a waitress at the Hostess of Fertility.

Ryuu was a member of a family that cared for the sacred tree in their home forest of Ryumilua. As time passed, she began to think that beautiful Elves were the ugliest of all people, due to seeing her fellow Elves' behavior toward those of other races. No matter how much she tried to forget it, once she began thinking about it, the thought firmly planted itself in her mind. Eventually, the thought became enough to make her decide to leave the forest.

Ryuu is calm and stoic but also cares deeply for her friends. When a person related to her or her friends are in danger or in need of help, she is always ready to step in and help no matter the cost. Like many Elves, Ryuu is selective with who may touch her. However, she has been advised by [Alise](https://anilist.co/character/288478) to not let go of a man that was able to grab her hands, and began to follow [Bell](https://anilist.co/character/88860) with her eyes. Unlike most Elves, she doesn't bear the same hatred towards the Crozzo family or their magic swords for their role in the destruction of the forests the Elves lived in, stating that the event took place many years ago and that her village wasn't directly affected.

Kashima Ouka is a member and captain of the Takemikazuchi Familia. Ouka is a strong and respected member of his familia. Being the leader, he often decides the course of action for his Familia members during dungeon trips. He is capable of instructing his companions and making harsh decisions in desperate situations. Despite his decisions, he shows deep care for his Familia due to them knowing each other from when they were children. Ouka is also headstrong and unafraid to express his thoughts to others, believing that he made the right decision in doing a Pass Parade. He has a habit of handing out free potions, causing financial problems for his Familia, and is referred to as a "natural gigolo" along with Takemikazuchi due to his friendliness toward women. He's the main character of the series. He's the son of a baronet, the lowest caste for a noble, and is [Emma](https://anilist.co/character/187864/Brightness-Emma)'s childhood friend. He lost his job but became an adventurer and wants to pass the exam to enter the Hero Academy. He gained a lot of new skills and abilities from [Olivia Servant](https://anilist.co/character/187862/Servant-Olivia), his master trapped in the Unending Dungeon. Noir is a good young man who is usually serious, but occasionally tends to be venomous. Because he looks like a good man and for being a baronet, Noir is often overlooked or disrespected by people who don't know his abilities or personality. He is cautious and timid, as he admits himself. He is also naive, and although he has been favored by several women, he is completely unaware.

__Race:__ Human

Daughter of a family of barons, [Noir](https://anilist.co/character/187865/Stardia-Noir)'s childhood friend. She is good at close quarters battles with daggers. She has a kind heart that treats everyone equally and she is very popular with the opposite sex. She likes Noir and enrolled with him into Hero Academy.

name: Alice Stardia
description:
__Race:__ Human

Despite being [Noir](https://anilist.co/character/187865/Stardia-Noir)'s younger sister, she's very possessive and protective of him, and although Alice is very popular with the opposite sex, she is only interested in Noir and has a Brother Complex.

name: Luna Healer
description:
__Race:__ Half Elf

A Cleric of the church, Luna is seen as a saint for using her healing skills on people while listening to their problems, but she fears that using her skills will lead to a premature death like her mother's. Luna is Lola's best friend and a solo adventurer. Luna is convinced that it is her mission to save people and make them smile. She is usually a very dignified person but reveals a strange expression when Luna passes out and murmurs what she really feels.

name: Elna Stongs
native: エルナ・ストーングス
description:
__Race:__ Human

Elna was a mercenary from the ages of 7 to 24, but under some circumstances, she becomes a teacher in Hero Academy just last year. She teaches the S-Class students and she is Noir's teacher. Elna is very harsh with her students, but she doesn't mind using her sex-appeal to motivate the male students, getting to the point of rewarding her students by sitting in their faces.

description: She is Maria's bodyguard. When Maria decided to take the Hero Academy entry exam, Amane volunteered to take it too. Like Maria, she's a S-Class student in Hero Academy. She is very loyal to Maria.

name: Lenore Bludon
description:
__Race:__ Human

She is the daughter of the Earl of Bludon and her degree of Nobility is the title Count. Noir met and teamed-up with Lenore during the Hero School Audition. Lenore is haughty. She acts cold to Noir just because he is from a Baronet noble family. After learning his outstanding skills, she start to respects him.

name: Maria Fiana Albert
native: マリア・フィアナ・アルバート
description:
__Race:__ Human

Maria is the younger daughter of the Duke from House Albert. Maria is a very dignified person who does not despise the aristocrats below her. In the past, her ancestor defeated a powerful wizard, and due to the curse the wizard bestowed, she was born with the Sixteenth Year Death Curse. A Cursed Skill that causes waves of violent pain attack the body in a set cycle and leads to its user's death on the 16th birthday. Maria was manifesting the symptoms since she was a child.

name: Ken Usato
description: An ordinary high school student who just dreams of something special. While he was on his way home from school with Suzune and Kazuki, he was involved in the summoning to the Ringle Kingdom. When it was discovered that he has an aptitude for healing magic, he is forced to join Rose's lifesaving group. There he acquires his strong body through hellish training.

appearsIn.title: The Wrong Way to Use Healing Magic
The Wrong Way to Use Healing Magic

name: Rose
description: Leader of the Lingle Kingdom Lifesaving Team. She is a healing magician, but her combat abilities are very high, and she once served as a battalion commander of the Knights. She forces Usato, her healing magician, to join the lifesaving group and trains him as her right-hand man.

appearsIn.title: The Wrong Way to Use Healing Magic
The Wrong Way to Use Healing Magic

name: Kazuki Ryuusen
description: Usato's classmate and student council vice president. Like Suzune, he was summoned to the Ringle Kingdom as a hero and has an aptitude for light-attribute magic. He is extremely popular with the female students, but on the other hand, he is troubled by the fact that he has no male friends.

name: Madara
description:
A mysterious feline spirit. 

Madara was sealed in a shrine until he was accidentally released by Natsume. Because Madara was trapped in a material form for so long, Madara ordinary takes on the shape of a maneki neko (lucky cat), leading Natsume to nickname him Nyanko-sensei. In this form, other people can see him, leading for Natsume having to ask his guardians if he could keep him as a pet.   

Madara is a powerful spirit, who protects Natsume from others and teaches him spells on occasion, in return for Natsume's promise to give him the Book of Friends when he dies. They often fight each other, which leads to Natsume punching Madara on the face and knocking him out. Despite his protests of not being a cat, he likes to play with cat toys. Nyanko's design is based on a lucky cat statue Midorikawa was given as a child. 

In the anime, Natsume is more respectful to Madara.

name: Takashi Natsume
description:
__Height:__ 167 cm (5'6")

Natsume Takashi is the main protagonist of the series who, like his deceased grandmother [Natsume Reiko](https://anilist.co/character/13886/Natsume-Reiko), has the ability to see ayakashi (spirits). He inherited the Book of Friends from her, a book of contracts binding ayakashi to servitude when they were defeated by Reiko. Due to Natsume's strong resemblance to his grandmother, he is often mistaken for her and is pursued by ayakashi who hate Reiko but yearn for the Book of Friends. To rid himself of these troubles, Natsume resolved to end the book by returning all the contracted names to their former owners. He is accompanied by the youkai [Madara](https://anilist.co/character/13784/Madara), nicknamed "Nyanko-sensei" (or simply "sensei"), promising him possession of the book once he dies. In return, the creature must serve as his bodyguard until then.  

Orphaned at an early age, Natsume was passed on from relative to relative. His ability to see and communicate with ayakashi isolated him from both family and friends throughout his childhood. He was labeled as a 'liar' and 'attention seeker' for trying to tell others about the ayakashi, and his attempts to run away from the youkai had them calling him insane. Natsume then became reclusive in order to try to lead a relatively “normal” life with people. Eventually, he was passed on to the Fujiwaras, a middle-aged couple from his father's side of the family.

name: Reiko Natsume
description:
__Family:__ Takashi Natsume (grandson), Takashi's Mother (daughter)

Reiko Natsume is the maternal grandmother of [Takashi Natsume](https://anilist.co/character/13783/Takashi-Natsume), and the person whom Takashi inherited his strong spiritual power from.

She was despised by both humans and youkai. She was a bully towards humans and youkai alike, resulting in her being socially isolated. She defeated many Youkai and made them write out their names in the Yuujinchou (translated into Book of Friends), making them "servants" to her. However, there are times she is kind to humans but they don't return the gesture. For instance, she had taken a doll from a pot youkai, Kayatsubo to return to a human child but they told her that she could keep it, believing she stole it.

  Some of the youkai she "enslaved" or made plans with grew to despise her, while some youkai (like Santou) continued to wait for her return.

name: Shuuichi Natori
description:
__Height:__ 175cm 

A man who is also able to see spirits. He is a famous actor and exorcist and has a lizard birthmark that moves around on his body. He has the ability to manipulate paper dolls and has three youkai under his command. Natsume tends to disapprove of his forceful exorcism methods.

name: Kaname Tanuma
description:
__Height:__ 171 cm

Another student who had recently moved into the area. He is sickly and quite susceptible to illnesses. Like Natsume Takashi, he is able to detect spirits, but to a lesser degree limited to seeing merely shadows and sensing slight presence of spirits. He wants to help Natsume in anyway he can, but is afraid that he will just be a burden because of his weak ability.

name: Satoru Nishimura
description: Natsume's friend from class. He is funny and easy-going, with a slightly perverted side. He has a crush on Taki Tooru, but thinks that she and Natsume are going out, and ran off comically crying.

name: Atsushi Kitamoto
description: Natsume's friend from class. He is a sensible and rational person.

name: Jun Sasada
description:
The class president of Takashi's class. 

Sasada believes that Takashi can see spirits, and constantly asks him questions about it, to which he replies that he doesn't have such an ability. Much to Takashi's chagrin, she wants to come along with him when he's visiting spirits.   

The story in the manga differs slightly, as Sasada moves away after the encounter with Shigure.

name: Touko Fujiwara
description: The wife of Shigeru Fujiwara. In the past, she has offered Natsume Takashi to live with her and her husband. She said that she does not have any children. Touko is a very kind and loving housewife who treats Natsume as her own child, since she cares about him a lot.

name: Shigeru Fujiwara
description: The husband of Touko Fujiwara. Along with Touko,Shigeru took Natsume over and he and his wife raise him as their own child. He is a quiet and considering man. When he was young, he met Natsume's grandmother, Reiko. When Shigeru was a young boy,he met Reiko and they became friends.

name: Kojou Akatsuki
description:
Kojou was a normal high school student 3 months ago, until the original 4th primogenitor had released her spirit into him because of a wish she had granted him. It's possible they made a deal.

Sometimes, his vampire urges try to take over and his eyes are about to turn red. He usually gets a nosebleed and coughs. Yukina claims that it is impossible for a human being to randomly become the 4th primogenitor, but he can't remember any details of the incident.

As a vampire, he possesses superhuman strength, speed, reflexes, and durability, but is much more powerful than normal vampires due to his status. He has also inherited Avrora's twelve familiars.

name: Yukina Himeragi
description: Yukina Himeragi is the female protagonist of the series. She is an attack mage, or in the Lion King Organization, a Sword Shaman, who is sent by the Lion King Organization to observe the Fourth Primogenitor, Kojou Akatsuki. As she's appointed to observe him, she became a middle-school student studying in Saikai Academy who follows him everywhere and is also ordered to kill him if he becomes too powerful and insane to control himself.

name: Nagisa  Akatsuki
description: She is Kojou's younger sister and is also Yukina's classmate. She is usually chatty with people she likes and is a very good cook.

name: Natsuki Minamiya
description:
Akatsuki Kojou's English teacher that claims to be 26 years old.

She also assists Itogami Island Security with investigating crimes perpetrated by supernatural beings around Itogami Island.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Asagi Aiba
description: She is one of Kojou's classmates who works as a part-time computer programmer at the Security Department of "Itogami Island Management Corporation" in Level B. She is very proficient with computers and deciphering complicated codes, which is why she was kidnapped by Christoper Gardos to awaken the "Nalakuvera" a so called ancient weapon of the gods. She created an AI program that she calls "Mogwai" that she uses to help her break into any firewalls, to hack into any secured sites or create and alter any programs. It was pointed out she has feelings for Kojou.

name: Motoki Yaze
description:
He is Kojou and Asagi's classmate. He is a member of the Far East District of the Lion-King Organization, and is the real observer of Kojou, the 4th progenitor, he is also Asagi's childhood friend and therefore often offers support to the latter for going after Kojou. He is actually an Esper whose special ability is called "Air Current Manipulation" which is the ability to manipulate air, vibrations and sound waves, but needs certain drugs or enhancers to strength his ability, he can also use his special ability to eavesdrop on anybody from any location most especially when listening on to Kojou and Asagi's conversation. 

(Source Wikipedia)

name: Christoph Gardos
description: The leader of the Black Death Emperor Faction and a former soldier of the Warlord's Dominion.

name: Astarte
description: Astarte was a homunculus servant of Rudolf Eustach until Kojou and Yukina defeated him. Since then she has been sentenced to 3 years probation and is currently entrusted to Natsuki, who made Astarte her maid.

name: Kazuki Kurusu
description:
[Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/fantastic_sweeper0516/)

Kazuki lives with his colleague and buddy [Rei](https://anilist.co/character/289969/Suwa-Rei), who also looks after his personal needs. Contracting, gathering information in advance, and making execution plans are the main areas of work with Rei. He likes women and gambling and he has good communication skills. He is skilled at cooking and cleaning, and he occasionally chastises Rei for his indulgent lifestyle. 

He was previously married and had a wife who was pregnant with his child, but he lost her due to his shady work.

name: Rei Suwa
description:
Rei is a man of few words who doesn't mind that [Kazuki](https://anilist.co/character/289968/Kurusu-Kazuki) has already moved into his house. He is physically strong, and his fighting abilities and marksmanship are among the best in the industry. He has a clear separation between his professional and personal lives and spends most of his time at home playing video games. His family is a large underworld family, and his parents have been training him as a gifted assassin since he was a child. 

He has not been able to escape the family feud and has no comprehension of normal parent-child relationships.

name: Miri Unasaka
description: Miri is an innocent girl who is just as energetic and fearless. Her father is a mafia boss and a major broker for a human trafficking organization. Her mother is the mistress of the boss. When she arrives at the hotel in search of her father, she becomes involved in a gunfight and is rescued by Kazuki. She is friendly and refers to Kazuki as "Papa Kazuki" and Rei as "Papa Rei".

name: Kyutarou Kugi
description: A cafe owner who supplies Rei and Kazuki with both jobs and information.

name: Anna Hanyuu
description: A nursery teacher at Aozora Nursery School.

name: Yuzuko Kurusu
description: Kazuki's pregnant wife.

name: Atsushi Hayami
description: Major broker in human trafficking organization.

name: Reina Aharen
description: A small, timid, and unfathomable girl who grows attached to [Raidou](https://anilist.co/character/121704/Raidou-Shouta) after he begins talking to her. She has a bad sense of distance.

name: Shouta Raidou
description: A tall, calm, and generally nice guy who looks after [Reina Aharen](https://anilist.co/character/121703/Aharen-Reina). He wants to help her with her problems, despite them not being his own to deal with.

name: Toubaru-sensei
description:
A teacher of literature at the school [Reina](https://anilist.co/character/121703) and her friends attend. She has a unique way of describing things.

(Source: Official Site, translated, edited)

name: Mitsuki Ooshiro
description: [Aharen](https://anilist.co/character/121703/Reina-Aharen)'s friend since middle school. She is very shy, constantly watching over Aharen-san from a distance, very good at hiding. She's also very good at martial arts.

name: Ishikawa
description: A friend of Raido.

name: Hanako Satou
description: A friend of Raido.

name: Riku Tamanaha
description:
Riku Tamanaha is a kind and cheerful girl who is also very shy and has a fear of interpersonal relationships. She is a kogyaru, a type of gyaru who is known for her fashionable style and outgoing personality. However, Tamanaha's shyness often prevents her from expressing herself fully, and she often overthinks situations and makes herself anxious. This is due to a past experience where she was too clingy to her friends in elementary school, which ended up pushing them away.

Despite her shyness, Tamanaha is very determined to make friends in high school. She is especially eager to be friends with Aharen again, but she is afraid of being rejected. However, Aharen is actually very happy to see her again and they quickly become friends.

Tamanaha is a likable character who is easy to root for. She is relatable to many people who struggle with social anxiety, and her story is one of hope and redemption.

name: Futaba
description: Little girl with black hair. She considers herself a rival of Aharen.

name: Atsushi
description: A neighborhood elementary school boy. He calls Reina "Aha-Ou-sama" (Lord). He is completely oblivious to the affection of his childhood friend Futaba, and always treats her ill.

name: Makoto Itou
description:
**Height:** 167.5 cm (5’6”)

Makoto Ito is the protagonist of the series. A generally mannered and composed student in year one of class three, his life becomes complicated when he begins to unfaithfully initiate numerous relationships with girls that he is unable to singly commit to. Though he is initially casual, gregarious and understanding, his addiction to sex over time corrupts his personality and he instead becomes more apathetic, rash and egotistical towards others, regardless of interpersonal harm or later consequence. However, once he truly knows he has done wrong, he is quick in his attempts to remedy the situation.

Makoto lives with his divorced mother and has a younger sister name Itaru who lives with their father. He is good friends with [Taisuke Sawanaga](https://anilist.co/character/5275/Sawanaga-Taisuke) and [Otome Katou](https://anilist.co/character/4085/Katou-Otome).

name: Sekai Saionji
description:
**Height:** 155 cm (5’1”)

Also in year 1, class 3, she is [Makoto's](https://anilist.co/character/3358/Itou-Makoto) classmate. Sitting next to him in class, she sees the picture that Makoto has secretly taken of [Kotonoha](https://anilist.co/character/3359/Katsura-Kotonoha) on his mobile phone. She then helps him get close to Kotonoha despite harboring strong feelings for him.

Even though she is good-natured her emotions overwhelm her in many situations. She lives with her mother in an apartment.  Known to be both a cheerful mood-maker and somewhat of a loudmouth. Her cute appearance and bright personality (as admired by [Taisuke](https://anilist.co/character/5275/Sawanaga-Taisuke)) attract a lot of secret fans, but with her frank and outspoken personality, all the boys who've confessed to her so far have been mercilessly rejected.

name: Kotonoha Katsura
description:
**Height:** 156.7 cm (5’2”)

A shy, quiet girl from class 1-4, one door down from [Makoto](https://anilist.co/character/3358/Itou-Makoto) and [Sekai](https://anilist.co/character/3360/Saionji-Sekai)'s class.

Due to her striking appearance, she's always been somewhat frightened of boys. She is disliked by the girls in her class, and distanced from the boys, who restrain each other from approaching her. Having taken an interest in Makoto as he watches her from afar, she decides to accept when he confesses with the help of Sekai's mediation.

name: Taisuke Sawanaga
description:
**Height:** 171.6 cm (5'8)

He is one of Makoto's friends since junior high, and is in the same class as Makoto. He's cheerful, dorky and appears to be strongly attracted to Kotonoha because of her good looks. In the anime, he often tries to impress Kotonoha, but she constantly tells him that she is Makoto's girlfriend and therefore cannot date him; Taisuke doesn't give up, though, and this ultimately causes some of the events that break Kotonoha the most. Kotonoha eventually becomes somewhat cold with him, telling him directly that she has no feelings for him. In the game, however,

name: Kokoro Katsura
description:
**Height:** 122 cm (4’0”)

Kotonoha's younger sister. Unlike her shy older sister, she is very talkative, full of curiosity, and likes to tease Kotonoha around, but she actually worries about Kotonoha a lot. She often wants to play with Makoto during his visits at her house.

name: Otome Katou
description:
**Height:** 164 cm

She is in year 1 class 4 of Sakakino Gakuen, and one of [Makoto's](https://anilist.co/character/3358/Itou-Makoto) friends since junior high.

She's in girl's basketball team, and also is the head of the group of girls who bullies [Kotonoha](https://anilist.co/character/3359/Katsura-Kotonoha). She has always had a crush on Makoto since junior high. Although she has feelings for Makoto ever since junior high, he does not seem to think of her romantically. While Kotonoha dates Makoto, Otome is extremely irritated and jealous when before, she thought the relationship was one-sided.

name: Nanami Kanroji
description:
**Height:** 173 cm

A friend of Sekai's that used to go to the same school with her. Nanami is in year 1, class 3. She was offered admission to the school based on her special athletic talents. 

Her boyfriend is also her senior and is in the school's basketball club. Her boyfriend is a hardcore otaku.

name: Minami Obuchi
description:
**Height:** 164 cm

One of the girls in year one, class four that is apart of [Otome](https://anilist.co/character/4085/Katou-Otome)'s group that bullies [Kotonoha](https://anilist.co/character/3359/Katsura-Kotonoha).

name: Hikari Kuroda
description:
**Height:** 161 cm

Temperamental and fastidious, Hikari Kuroda is a student in year one of class three, recognizable by her signature squid rings hairstyle. She initially believes that Makoto and Sekai are dating from the very start, and tends to negatively generalize him; later growing closer to him herself.     Though she is actually quite friendly and social, Hikari is the most childish of the cast; sporting an unduly knack for whining and prying into the affairs of others. Her family owns a confectionery store and café, famous for its lemon custard pie. Hikari is good friends with Sekai and has an unreciprocated crush on Taisuke Sawanaga.

name: Setsuna Kiyoura
description:
**Height:** 142 cm

Also in Year 1, Class 3, Setsuna is a member of the class committee and is childhood friends with [Sekai](https://anilist.co/character/3360/Saionji-Sekai). Their mothers are good friends and they work together at the same company.

Setsuna is constantly worried about Sekai and tries to make sure that [Makoto](https://anilist.co/character/3358/Itou-Makoto) will keep Sekai happy. This leads her to go so far as to try to eradicate [Kotonoha](https://anilist.co/character/3359/Katsura-Kotonoha) from Makoto's love life by cutting short any interactions they had while she was around, although this was only done for Sekai's sake and she didn't harbor real ill feelings towards Kotonoha herself.

Although silent-looking and almost emotionless, she is conscious about her underdeveloped body, especially in comparison with Kotonoha and Sekai.

name: Yoshiko Hanabatake
description:
**Height:** 160 cm

She is a high school girl who is stupid both academically and socially. She even gets zeroes on multiple choice tests.

Yoshiko is a complete crack head that is addicted to bananas, to put it simply. She is an incredibly eccentric person who is also very annoying towards [Akuru Akutsu](https://anilist.co/character/121875/Akutsu-Akuru), even though she truly wants him to love her. Yoshiko even goes so far as to let him see her panties. [Yoshie Hanabatake](https://anilist.co/character/121879/Hanabatake-Yoshie) even goes as far as to beg Akuru to be her boyfriend. Her idiotic actions towards Akuru caused her to get beat up by him. Akuru went as far as to punch her so high in the air it literally knocked her out. She downright annoys him. As a result of stupidity, her social skills are beyond abysmal, and generally makes the worst first impressions.
Yoshiko is quite perverted, as she enjoys groping the disciplinary committee president's breasts, has sneaked into Akuru's room and started sleeping around him, and likes to peek in the men's room just to see Akuru.

As a child, she showed a strong proclivity towards great agility and speed. She is strong for a girl despite her petite stature, as when she carried Akuru with little to no effort above her head when they were children. She can jump from one balcony to another, and is shown to have fast reflexes, with the exception of Akuru’s fast punches.

name: Akuru Akutsu
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm

He is a smart and serious high school student who is constantly annoyed by [Yoshiko](https://anilist.co/character/121874/Hanabatake-Yoshiko)'s antics. He is Yoshiko's neighbor, childhood friend, and classmate.

Akuru is an intelligent and serious high school student who is forced to deal with Yoshiko Hanabatake’s stupidity. Though only interested in studying, he is unwittingly dragged into many of Yoshiko’s escapades much to his dismay.

Throughout the series, Akuru is seen as the straight man, constantly dealing with the eccentric personalities of those around him (especially Yoshiko) and is quick to make rude remarks. He is very upfront about his disgust for Yoshiko, often resorting to physical violence whenever she annoys him.

Despite this, Akuru is said to be strange himself as he is completely antisocial, having few friends due to his abrasive attitude. The only people Akuru gets along with is [Sayaka Sumino](https://anilist.co/character/121877/Sumino-Sayaka) and [Dog](https://anilist.co/character/121880/Inu) who are the only beings besides him to have sense.

name: Akane Eimura
description:
The leader of a trio of gyaru classmates whom Yoshiko starts interacting with later in the series. She doesn't really like her, but she's just as dumb as Yoshiko in school. Akane has red hair and is the most antagonistic of the three against Yoshiko. She dislikes Akuru, who calls her ugly. She also wants to be more popular and have a boyfriend.

Akane is a hot-headed girl who often hangs out in her friend's small group and she despises Yoshiko Hanabatake so much that she often takes her anger out on her.

name: Kii Hiragi
description: The second of the gyaru classmates. She has short blond hair.

name: Sayaka Sumino
description:
Sayaka is Akuru and Yoshiko's classmate who ends up becoming friends with the two. She is level-headed and assumes the straight-man role, often moderating interactions between Yoshiko and others.

Sayaka is kind and worries about being boring. She is very sensitive, especially when others point out her small chest, which appears slightly small, even after she pads it. She sometimes loses her patience. Most people acknowledge her kind aura and the binding and relaxing effect it has on everyone.

name: Kuroko Shiina
description: The third of the gyaru classmates. She has long dark hair. She is only one of the three who has a boyfriend, although she is extremely shy about it. Kuroko is a usually calm and collected girl who is often seen as socializing with Akane Eimura and Kii Hiiragi.

name: Yoshie Hanabatake
description:
The perverted mother of Yoshiko Hanabatake, who desperately wants Yoshiko to be normal or find a husband so Yoshie can retire. She is very skilled in hand-to-hand combat and can tell a woman's intentions by looking at her panties.

Yoshie is not an idiotic person like Yoshiko as Yoshie wishes for Yoshiko to be a normal person. She is shown to be rather devious schemer, as she longs to be free of her idiot daughter and retire happily. To do this, she hopelessly tries to set Yoshiko up with Akuru, who wants absolutely nothing to do with her in the future. She is willing to stoop to deprave methods to assure this, such as trying to find ways to get Yoshiko to "seal the deal" with Akuru to ensure he'll marry her in the future once he gets a well-paying job. The extent of her immorality is best shown when she encouraged her daughter to drug Akuru and then "seal the deal" with him after leaving him vulnerable, showing just how far her depravity goes.

Like her daughter, she is rather dirty-minded.

name: Fuki Iincho
description:
She is a member of the disciplinary committee.

As disciplinary committee president, Fuki has a serious personality as she is rather bossy because she was trying to fulfill her role as president, but after she met [Akuru Akutsu](https://anilist.co/character/121875/Akutsu-Akuru), she began to stalk his every move and justifies her actions as concern for Akutsu's well being and her responsibility as the disciplinary committee president.

name: Inu
description: A big dog that [Yoshiko](https://anilist.co/character/121874/Hanabatake-Yoshiko) takes a liking to. Later on, it becomes her pet.

name: Nozomi
description: She's rather easily frightened by anything and is as smart as Yoshiko, which isn't saying a lot. She's also rather cheerful.

name: Akihito Narihisago
description:
__Occupation:__ Homicide detective (formerly) / Mizuhanome pilot / Brilliant Detective (Sakaido persona) 
__Affiliations:__ Kura 
__Height:__ 178 cm (5'10") 

He was once a happy man with a family. Two years ago, his daughter was assaulted and later bashed to death by the serial killer, [the Challenger](https://anilist.co/character/164167/Denshin-Katsuyama). This later spiraled Ayako's severe depression, and despite Narihisago's best efforts, committed suicide out of grief soon afterwards. Disdained and vengefully driven, Narihsiago shot the Challenger out of vengeance after finding out his true identity, unintentionally saving [Kiki Asukai](https://anilist.co/character/160111/Kiki-Asukai). After this decisive victory, Narihisago was sentenced to prison for Katsuyama's murder.

Two years later however, having killed someone, he now is capable of entering ID-Wells and retrieving information about serial killers using their murderous intent. Once he enters the wells, he is known as Sakaido "the brilliant detective", with no prior memory of his real identity, he assists in investigating and analyzing the serial killer's subconsciousness. Over the next year, he would go on to aid in the capture of at least four serial killers, among them being "[the Face-lifter](https://anilist.co/character/164168/Hitoshi-Sonoda)", "Tongue-tearer", "Arm-twister" and "Thigh-severer".

name: Hunetarou Momoki
description: A former colleague of [Akihito Narihisago](https://anilist.co/character/143399/Akihito-Narihisago), he heads the Kura division that operates the Mizuhanome System.

name: Tamotsu Fukuda
description:
__Height:__ 190 cm (6'2")

Tamotsu Fukuda is a prolific, mentally disturbed serial killer known as "The Perforator", he murders his victims by drilling holes in their heads, under the belief that he is helping them achieve a new, better state of mind.

name: Koharu Hondoumachi
description: Koharu Hondoumachi is one of the protagonists of ID:Invaded. She assists [Matsuoka](https://anilist.co/character/145232/Kokuryuu-Matsuoka) in tracking down serial killers in the field.

name: Sarina Tougou
description: Sarina Togo is Inspector Momoki's main assistant and general analyst.

name: Masamune Habutae
description: Masamune Habutae is a member of Inspector Momoki's team who analyses people who appear in id wells.

name: Shiratake Sennosuke
description: Sennosuke Shiratake is a member of Momoki's team who digitally analyzes crime scenes.

name: Nishio Shirakoma
description: Nishio Shirakoma is the inventor of Mizuhanome System.

name: Kokuryuu Matsuoka
description: He is the ex-colleague of Narihisago Akihito.

name: Kabane Kusaka
description:
__Height:__ 151 cm
__Species:__ Half-Human/Half-Ghoul
__Abilities:__

Kabane has been taken care of by his aunt since he was young, as a favor for her older sister, Kabane's mother. Since then, Kabane has lived with his aunt, [Mrs. Kusaka](https://anilist.co/character/243784/Kusaka), and cousin, [Yataro](https://anilist.co/character/243785/Yatarou) at the Deer Village and was given a job to work where he wouldn't be around anyone due to his smell. Kabane is quite emotionless due to being raised neglectfully; he is blunt when it comes to responses and could possibly be considered stupid and clueless about things. When in battle he does not consider his own well-being, he only seeks to stop the enemy. Despite his lack of emotions, Kabane is a good kid who cares for his friends and strives to protect them. Through the course of his life, Kabane becomes more expressive and less naive due to his interactions with others. Kabane is in possession of a life calculus, an extremely rare white stone capable of shielding a Kemono's 'thirst', left to him by his unknown parents. Wanting to know who his parents are, he joined the Kemono Office agency in order to look for them.

name: Akira
aliases: 岩木山雪里白那之五十六子晶
Iwakiyama Yukisato Shirona no Gojuuroku Shi Akira
description:
__Height__: 159 cm
__Species__: Snow Kemono

Akira, is the fifty-sixth child of Shirona of the Snow Village in Mount Iwaki. He's currently an employee of the Kemono office. Akira is a very energetic and approachable person but sometimes clumsy, sometimes even not being able to complete tasks properly. He also likes cute things and is seen constantly talking selfies to commemorate what he feels and currently doing. Akira is very fragile and gets grossed out and gets scared easily to the sight of insect, other dirty things and when in danger. However, despite these weaknesses, Akira can be seen as a reliable friend, willing to overcome his fears just to save his friends. Akira came to Inugami to look for his older brother. Before coming to Tokyo, he lived deep in the mountains of Aomori with his family. However, when they tried to run away, they got separated. Because Akira is a Yuki-onoko he possesses the powers the species are known for. It should be noted that it takes him a lot of concentration to use his powers and because of this isn't very good at controlling them.

name: Shiki Tademaru
description:
__Height:__ 163 cm
__Species:__ Half-human/Half-Arachne

Up until he came to Inugami's detective agency and before his uncle took care of him, he lived in Kinshi-Go in the Gunma Prefecture with his mother. Shiki initially comes off as a bully, holding his age of one year over Kabane as an authority, and telling the other boy they aren't friends because they're both hybrids. But this is shown to only be a facade, as he shows surprise at Kabane never having had pizza, and laughing when the other first had trouble trying it. But as Akira says, he's only self-conscious due to the fact another hybrid sits under the same roof as him. When on a job, he can see things in a calm and cautious manner. He is also able to judge and react to things in a fast manner, like using his thread to protect him and Akira from Kon's attacks. However, he can also be seen with a short temper. When faced with intimidating enemies, he has the tendency to freeze up but always manages to defeat his enemy.

name: Kohachi Inugami
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm
__Species:__ Bakedanuki

A detective that specializes in the occult. Inugami runs a Kemono detective agency in Tokyo. After meeting [Kabane](https://anilist.co/character/154749/Kusaka-Kabane), he took him with him in order to help him find his parents. Inugami is a calm person who doesn't like conflict and is kind enough to follow Kabane and the others casually. He is good at taking care of the children, even helping them in their own various circumstances. As the head of the detective agency, he is good at solving and making sure the job is done right.

name: Mihai Florescu
native: ミハイ フロレスク
description:
__Height:__ 176 cm
__Species:__ Vampire

Member of the Inugami Detective Agency. Mihai is a several hundred years old vampire Kemono from Romania. Over his life, he has apparently acquired professional-level expertise and knowledge in numerous fields, to the point that he had run out of things to do. Sometime in the past, he became an acquaintance to Kohachi Inugami. When Mihai had started to become disillusioned with life, Inugami asked him to come to Japan and work for the former's detective agency, where he become absorbed in Japanese online games. Mihai is a callous and self-centered individual who considers the people around him to be toys for his amusement. He is willing to lie and manipulate others into perilous situations for his own entertainment. He does not seem to be able to understand how other people react to the result of his actions. Even Inugami considered Mihai to be potentially dangerous and volatile when he is in a bad mood. However, he is not actively malicious and is willing to offer assistance as long as he finds the situation interesting. 

Although he has a nonchalant and laidback attitude, Mihai has surprising diligence and dedication to whatever he has set out to do. Once he has agreed to work on something, he will deliver the best possible result, even to the detriment of his temporary enjoyment. Mihai hates boredom and not having anything to interest him. As he is an accomplished polymath, Mihai takes great pride in his skills and creations.

name: Kon
description:
__Height:__ 162 cm
__Species:__ Kitsune

Kon formerly worked under [Yoko Inari](https://anilist.co/character/154758). Kon idolizes Inari and wants her attention as well as her approval. While seeming emotionless at first Kon does her best to please Inari who she perceives as a mother. She gets extremely mad at those who insult her. Kon was ignored and abandoned by Inari after failing her mission. Kon is not very intelligent or emotionally stable. Because she wants to be a "good girl" more than anything she will do anything to fulfill that role. If anything happens that she believes will prevent her from fulfilling that role, she becomes disoriented and goes into a blind rage.

name: Yui
description:
__Height:__ 171 cm
__Species:__ Snow Kemono

Yui is Akira's older twin brother.

name: Aya Tademaru
description:
__Height:__ 121 cm
__Species:__ Half- Arachne

The younger half-sister of Shiki Tademaru and revealed to be the Golden Thread. When first introduced Aya seemed to be shy and innocent to those around her. However, she is quickly revealed to be quite confident, loud-mouthed, and bratty- especially to Shiki. Despite being described as obnoxious by others, Aya is kind and often tries to help those that need her abilities. Aya is the result of many experiments of Akio Tademaru to be able to create the golden thread. She had the healing thread powers when she was born.

name: Youko Inari
description:
Species: Kitsune

The head of the Metropolitan Police Department. When she is first introduced to the story, she and Inugami were allies although they didn't particularly like each other. They become enemies and hate each other after she tried to steal Kabane's Life Calculus multiple times, and Inugami's group attacked her human meat company. Inari is selfish and cruel, she uses her illusions to control the police department and will throw away anyone that no longer fits her agenda. On the outside, she portrays herself as a nice and cheerful lady. She also doesn't hesitate to kill anyone just to cool down her anger. She is manipulative and sadistic, even using Kon as a servant, and making her believe that she is useful and important to her and even muddied her memories.

name: Nowaki Homuramaru
description:
__Height:__ 179 cm
__Species:__ Kitsune
__Abilities:__ Replication: Nobimaru is able to replicate himself, producing many copies of himself to confuse the enemy. Transformation: Nobimaru is able to change his form from kid to an adult

Subordinate of [Yoko Inari](https://anilist.co/character/154758/Inari-Youko). He is also the leader of the Special Investigation Unit. He has a polite and elusive personality. He always follows Inari's order to him without any hesitation. On the other hand, he sometimes shows his ruthless and brutal side, obliterating enemies with his own power if he feels he doesn't need them. Although he faithfully follows Inari's orders, he dislikes Inari secretly and acted according to his own considerations.

name: Ling Lin
description:
__Height:__ 180cm

Former employee at an advertising agency in charge of producing commercials for [Nice](https://anilist.co/character/362412) and [Moon](https://anilist.co/character/361972). After being fired from his job, he witnesses Nice's apparent suicide and is found at the scene by [Juan](https://anilist.co/character/361976). She and her men take Ling Lin and begin the process of turning him into the hero Nice.

name: Cheng Yang
description:
A university student who works part-time as an actor playing E-Soul in a Children's Theater. He dreams of being reunited with E-Soul, who saved his life as a young child.

(Source: Official Site)

name: Xingyun Qing
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm

A singer-songwriter blessed with exceptional luck and a natural voice. Lucky Cyan is overwhelmingly popular both as a hero and as a musician.

(Source: Official Site)

name: X
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm

A man in a suit who claimed the title of X in the blink of an eye. His lack of affiliation to any organization makes him all the more enigmatic.

(Source: Official Site)

name: Yuwei Liu
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm

The pinnacle of female heroes, Queen is superior in many ways. She hopes to win the tournament to bring order to the world.

(Source: Official Site)

name: Luo Li
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm

A girl in a battle suit jam-packed with all kinds of tricky gadgets. She confronts all her opponents with engineering talent and a strong sense of justice.

(Source: Official Site)

name: Mo Sha
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm

A cool-headed hero who completes his mission without uttering a single word. He is loved by his many fans for the silence with which he completes his work and for the chiseled, handsome face behind the mask.

(Source: Official Site)

name: Xiaoqiang
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm

Half of a hero duo that's become famous for their mascot-like charm. Once Big Johnny goes berserk, only Little Johnny can stop him.

(Source: Official Site)

name: Liang Long
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm

An unruly lone wolf known for his superhuman resilience, he eagerly awaits his opportunity to take the title of X with his indomitable fighting spirit.

(Source: Official Site)

name: Ahu
description:
__Height:__ 30 cm (35 cm with hat)

An empathic, loyal hero dog that made it into the Top 10 at record speed, Ahu turns gratitude into superpowers.

(Source: Official Site)

name: Tetsurou Kuroo
description:
__Team:__ Nekoma High School 
__Height:__ 187.7 cm
__Year:__ 3rd Year, class 5 
__Number:__ 1 
__Position:__ Middle Blocker  

The captain of the Nekoma High School volleyball club. Kuroo has a somehow manipulative and cunning personality, but cares about his friends and teammates very deeply. As Nekoma's captain he has a sense of responsibility and confidence. Even though Kuroo's a middle blocker, he often uses offensive plays too.

name: Koutarou Bokuto
description:
__Height:__ 185.3 cm

Bokuto is a third year student at Fukurodani Academy and is its volleyball team's captain and wing spiker. His spikes pack a powerful punch that others can struggle to receive. Despite this, Bokuto has a tendency to not doing well in the middle of games when getting shut out. Luckily, [Akaashi](https://anilist.co/character/88938) has a whole list of things Bokuto does and tries his best to bring Bokuto back up to his usual self. Besides Akaashi, Bokuto is friends with a few other rival team's players, such as [Kuroo](https://anilist.co/character/71269) and sorta friends with [Tsukishima](https://anilist.co/character/67329).

name: Akane Yamamoto
description: The younger sister of Taketora Yamamoto.

name: Tatsuki Washio
description:
__Height:__ 187.8 cm (6'1.9")
__Uniform Number:__ 2

Tatsuki is a third-year middle blocker at Fukuroudani Academy.

name: Suguru Daishou
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm
__Year:__ Third Year Highschool Student
__Number:__ 1
__Position:__ Captain, Outside Hitter
__Team:__ Nohebi Academy

Daishou is a competitive person who enjoys mocking others, especially the members of Nekoma. However, he gets flustered and emotional when he is mocked in return, such as when [Kuroo](https://anilist.co/character/71269/Kuroo-Tetsurou) brought up his ex-girlfriend.

He is a cunning, manipulative person who uses a polite façade during matches to win the referee's favor; he would admit to net-touches and apologize loudly to bolster Nohebi's reputation, but use somewhat underhand tactics without the audience knowing, such as purposely spiking a ball at an opponent's face and using the referee's influence to get away with spikes that were originally out. During the match, he shows composure in analyzing the situation of the match, which is pointed out by the Nohebi coach.

name: Tanaka
description:
**Height:** 167 cm

Tanaka is a listless student who is always dozing off and acting exhausted when awake. He is constantly sighing and refrains from any tiring work, all while being accompanied by his friend, [Oota](https://anilist.co/character/89788). Due to his disdain towards hard-work, he often relies on his family and friends (namely Oota) to assist him with activities. He's apathetic and hardly ever outwardly expresses how he feels. When he does, it's normally done in an impassive-seeming manner as well and thus makes it seem like he's mature at best and emotionless and uncaring at worst. He rarely does anything where he exerts more energy than required; however, he shows a surprising dedication to maintaining his lifestyle and daily routine, even going out of his way sometimes to maintain it even at the cost of expending energy he'd rather not use.

Tanaka is somewhat scatterbrained or clueless at times, coming up with eccentric-at-best ideas that hold some form of merit or have some argument behind them but end up resulting in something stupid or bizarre. Tanaka is very capable but chooses to use his head for things that interest him.

name: Oota
description:
__Height:__ 184 cm (6'0")

A tall and stoic student, who is very reliable and is often looking after [Tanaka](https://anilist.co/character/89787/Tanaka). Tanaka states that because of Oota's caring nature, he sees Oota as the perfect candidate for marriage. He states on multiple occasions that he admires Tanaka's ability to be listless in any given situation, but also feels that Tanaka's personality causes him to miss out on things like romance and love.

He is serious, kind, and doesn't seem to be able to leave his good friend, Tanaka, alone. Oota is pretty much Tanaka's caretaker, always assisting him with different school activities, making sure he gets places on time, and even carrying him when necessary. He is very capable and responsible, and with that, everything Tanaka needs. Tanaka often states "you would be a good wife" to him. Oota seems to jump to conclusions relatively quickly. He seems to be patient at times. He is an optimist and is always encouraging people no matter the circumstances.

name: Katou
description:
[Tanaka](https://anilist.co/character/89787/Tanaka)'s classmate. He is good at sports and loves soccer.

Katou seems to always be happy and active. He is usually seen with [Shimura](https://anilist.co/character/89794/Shimura) at school, and he likes to make jokes with his friends. Katou is also good at sports like badminton but his favorite is soccer.

name: Saionji
description:
Saionji is an employee for WacDonalds.  She works part-time at a public pool as a pool-attendant as well.

Saionji is an eager worker and enthusiastic about her job. She is easily unnerved and misunderstands [Tanaka](https://anilist.co/character/89787/Tanaka) and [Ohta](https://anilist.co/character/89788/Ohta) due to appearances. However, she finds them interesting due to their contradictory actions.

name: Miyano
description:
Tanaka's classmate with short stature. She admires [Tanaka](https://anilist.co/character/89787/Tanaka) for his listlessness. She constantly proclaims herself to be Tanaka's apprentice in listlessness, however he constantly decries her.

Miyano is an energetic girl who likes to make friends. She is [Echizen](https://anilist.co/character/89791/Echizen)'s best friend and admires Tanaka's listlessness and persistently approaches him to become his apprentice. Eventually, she comes to self-proclaim herself as his apprentice and calls others to be his apprentice too.

She is immensely loyal to those who are close to her, shown when she helps Tanaka and [Ohta](https://anilist.co/character/89788/Ohta) with their landscape sketches, takes pictures so that her club president could practice his art skills, and yells at her own "Master" (Tanaka) for being an idiot when she thinks that he had a girlfriend and worries about [Shiraishi](https://anilist.co/character/89790/Shiraishi)'s feelings for him.

Whilst looking oblivious to the eye, Miyano can catch on to situations quickly. This can be seen when she spots Shiraishi at the door staring at both her and Tanaka's conversation and later approaches Shiraishi in an oblivious manner which made it seem as if the latter wanted to become his apprentice too. After confirming the friendships of Shirashi and Tanaka, she sends a message to her saying that she will cheer on Shiraishi's pursuit in having a crush on Tanaka.

name: Shiraishi
description:
**Height**: 160 cm
**Hair Color**: Strawberry Blonde
**Eye Color**: Brown
**Hobbies**: Studying
**Occupation**: Class Representative

Shiraishi is a beautiful, intelligent, and popular student among males and females. She's a stylish girl with long and lengthy strawberry blonde hair brown eyes. Her hair is described as the idol hairstyle.

Shiraishi is responsible for her duty as the class representative. Due to her being a loner back in middle school, there are times when she's depressed whenever reminded of her "lame school girl" days.

Before meeting [Tanaka](https://anilist.co/character/89787/Tanaka) and [Ohta](https://anilist.co/character/89788/Ohta), she wore contact lenses and her hairstyle often bothered her. After meeting them, she retains her public style but wears red glasses instead of lenses. In private, she keeps her bangs up with a small hair tie while wearing a ponytail.



(Source: Tanaka-kun wa Itsumo Kedaruge Wikia, edited)

name: Echizen
description:
[Ohta](https://anilist.co/character/89788/Ohta)'s childhood friend. She loves [Miyano](https://anilist.co/character/89789/Miyano) as a friend and affectionately calls her Myaano.

Echizen is quite aggressive toward anyone, excluding Miyano. She gets upset or angry about small things; one example is whenever Ohta calls her 'Ecchan'. She also lacks the ability to eat sweets if they are "cute". She easily jumps to conclusions but is very dedicated to helping in what she believes in.

name: Rino Tanaka
description:
[Tanaka](https://anilist.co/character/89787/Tanaka)'s little sister. She is a middle school student who is the manager of the Volleyball Club of her school.

Rino is often told that she is similar to Tanaka as they both have a listless look in them. Unlike her brother, Rino is more consistent and is normally the one doing the shopping, cooking, cleaning etc. She has grown the habit of cleaning leather shoes as shown when [Oota](https://anilist.co/character/89788/Ohta) paid a visit to Tanaka's apartment. It is also shown that Rino has Brother-Complex, or "brocon" as she purposely gave Oota dark chocolate knowing that he loves sweet things and gave Tanaka hand-made sweets. She expresses a dislike towards Oota, brought about by Oota and Tanaka's close relationship and sometimes gets jealous. She is friends with Oota's younger sister [Saya](https://anilist.co/character/89793/Saya-Ohta)

name: Yoshitaka
description:
One of [Shiriashi](https://anilist.co/character/89790/Shiraishi)'s and [Miyo](https://anilist.co/character/217601/Miyo)'s best friends.

She is shown to be kind and hardworking and vowed to Shiriashi that she will help with her crush on [Tanaka](https://anilist.co/character/89787/Tanaka).

name: Sherry Tueli
description: Sherry Tueli is the daughter of the Tueli family and later becomes Sugawara's official lover after he saved her by allowing her protection provided by the Japanese Embassy at the Jade Palace. After the death of her parents at the hands of the Oprichnina She is currently the adoptive daughter of Casel El Tiberius, a member of the Imperial Senate and a prominent member of the Pro-Peace faction.

name: Duran
description: The king of the Elbe kingdom, and commander of the Allied Kingdoms army, the second wave of forces sent by the Empire to recapture Arnus hill from the JSDF "invaders".

name: Shunya Kengun
description: The commander of the 4th combat unit in the Special Task Force.

name: Rit
aliases: Rizlet of Loggervia (リーズレット・オブ・ロガーヴィア)
description:
A B-rank adventurer from the nearby settlement of Zoltan, Rit is a long-time associate of Gideon. Upon hearing about Red from the adventurer's guild, she wonders whether it's actually Gideon and visits the newly opened pharmacy. She ends up living there and helping out.

(Source: Official Site)

appearsIn.title: Banished from the Hero’s Party, I Decided to Live a Quiet Life in the Countryside
Banished from the Hero's Party, I Decided to Live a Quiet Life in the Countryside

name: Red
aliases: Gideon Ragnason (ギデオン・ラグナソン)
description:
A D-rank adventurer from the nearby settlement of Zoltan, Red gathers and sells herbs to make a living and hopes to one day open his own herb shop and live a quiet life. He is blessed with the sign of the 'Guide' to protect and guide heroes on their journey, and was once a member of such a party.

(Source: Official Site)

appearsIn.title: Banished from the Hero’s Party, I Decided to Live a Quiet Life in the Countryside
Banished from the Hero's Party, I Decided to Live a Quiet Life in the Countryside

name: Ares Srowa
description:
A member of the Hero's party, Ares is blessed with the sign of the 'Leader'. While his intellect and magical aptitude allow him to excel as a magician, he is also proud and incredibly ambitious. He ran Gideon out of the party and told others that he left of his own accord.

(Source: Official Site)

appearsIn.title: Banished from the Hero’s Party, I Decided to Live a Quiet Life in the Countryside
Banished from the Hero's Party, I Decided to Live a Quiet Life in the Countryside

name: Ruti Ragnason
native: ルーティ・ラグナソン
description:
Gideon's younger sister, Ruti is blessed with the sign of the 'Hero', she is destined to slay the Demon Lord. This has granted her unimaginable power, yet also inhibits her emotions and very humanity as these are unnecessary for a hero.

(Source: Official Site)

appearsIn.title: Banished from the Hero’s Party, I Decided to Live a Quiet Life in the Countryside
Banished from the Hero's Party, I Decided to Live a Quiet Life in the Countryside

name: Theodora Dephilo
native: テオドラ・ディフイーロ
description:
Servant to the church of Almighty Demis and instructor in the Temple Knights' Style of spearmanship, Theodora is a member of the Hero's party and blessed with the sign of the 'Crusader'. She is stoic and devout, loyally following the teachings of the church, yet secretly holds questions to which she will one day find answers.

(Source: Official Site)

appearsIn.title: Banished from the Hero’s Party, I Decided to Live a Quiet Life in the Countryside
Banished from the Hero's Party, I Decided to Live a Quiet Life in the Countryside

name: Yarandrala
description:
A high elf, fellow veteran and close friend of Gideon, Yarandrala was born in the Kingdom of Kiramin and is blessed with the sign of the 'Forest Speaker'. She is able to ask plants to lend her their aid.

(Source: Official Site)

appearsIn.title: Banished from the Hero’s Party, I Decided to Live a Quiet Life in the Countryside
Banished from the Hero's Party, I Decided to Live a Quiet Life in the Countryside

name: Tanta
description:
Tanta is the son of Gonzo's sister Nao and her husband Mido. Red has taken a liking to him. Although he does not yet know his blessing, he wants to be a carpenter like Gonzo. He suffers from a white-eye disease that may ultimately lead to blindness.

(Source: Official Site)

appearsIn.title: Banished from the Hero’s Party, I Decided to Live a Quiet Life in the Countryside
Banished from the Hero's Party, I Decided to Live a Quiet Life in the Countryside

name: Newman
description:
A doctor from a clinic in Zoltan, Newman is blessed with the sign of 'Fast Preparation' and is thus able to prepare any medicine in only an hour. Having diagnosed Tanta's White Eye Disease alongside Red, he's come to trust him.

(Source: Official Site)

appearsIn.title: Banished from the Hero’s Party, I Decided to Live a Quiet Life in the Countryside
Banished from the Hero's Party, I Decided to Live a Quiet Life in the Countryside

name: Nao
description:
Gonzo's sister and Tanta's mother, Nao is a bright, personable woman who's been shipping Red and Rit ever since they started living together. She enjoys visiting saunas and drinking beer inside, but she's worried that the one Zeff runs isn't doing well.

(Source: Official Site)

appearsIn.title: Banished from the Hero’s Party, I Decided to Live a Quiet Life in the Countryside

name: Stormthunder
description:
Although just a nickname, Storm is a half-orc craftsman in charge of a furniture shop in downtown Zoltan. He's generally on good terms with Red. He is a fine artisan, rough in tone and attitude, but quickly becomes the consummate salesman with customers who will actually spend coin.

(Source: Official Site)

appearsIn.title: Banished from the Hero’s Party, I Decided to Live a Quiet Life in the Countryside

name: Moka Akashiya
description:
__Height:__ 166 cm

__Outer Form:__
Moka’s Outer form is a tall fair-skinned girl with knee-length pink hair that has bangs swept to the right side, green eyes and full pink lips. As a vampire, Moka has pronounced fangs that allow her to drink blood and her expressions are much softer in this form. This form always has her trademark Rosary attached to a black choker since it is what causes this personality to surface. 

__Inner Form:__
Whenever Moka's Rosario Cross is removed, she transforms into her Inner form where she retains the same hairstyle and hair length, but it is in a silver color instead, her eyes are much more demonic as they have red irises with slit pupils and her expressions are much more stern, serious and sometimes cocky and her vampire fangs have also become much more pronounced.

name: Tsukune Aono
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm

He is an average, ordinary human boy who is somehow accepted into a school of monsters and despite the danger it entails for him, he remains on campus, with one of his motivations for staying being [Moka Akashiya](https://anilist.co/character/3861/Akashiya-Moka).  Tsukune Aono is a young man who has failed all of his high school entrance exams. With no options left for him, his parents sends him to Yōkai Academy. Upon arriving there however, he soon discovers that it is a special school for monsters and demons alike, and any human who discovers its existience will be killed. Fearing for his life, he later meets Moka Akashiya, a beautiful girl who turns out to be a vampire. Soon after he becomes friends with her, he soon learns from her that she hates humans.

name: Kurumu Kurono
description:
__Height:__ 153 cm 

Kurumu Kurono is a succubus, and is initially jealous of Moka's popularity overshadowing her own, though she eventually considers Moka a friend. She tries to seduce Tsukune and the male student body, using her charming techniques (through her succubi abilities, including her busty physique), making them her slaves. This is so she can find her "mate of fate", in order to save her diminishing species, with the assumption that Moka is blocking her path. After Tsukune persuades the unsealed Moka to spare her, she becomes infatuated with him and makes a decision that he will be her "mate of fate", becoming friends with the pair.  While she does continue to tease and try to seduce Tsukune, it is clear that she possesses true and honest feelings for him- she's been shown to be willing to risk her life for him numerous times throughout the anime and manga. In the manga, Kurumu is shown to be a kind and soft-hearted girl who loves her rivals for Tsukune's love like sisters, tenderly comforting and supporting them in their moments of sadness, as well as defending them when they are in danger. This kind-hearted character-trait is downplayed in the anime in favor of a more typical "flirt" character, although the kind-heartedness is still present, and in reality, she is actually an innocent character.

name: Yukari Sendou
description:
__Height:__ 137 cm 

Yukari Sendo is the smartest student at Yokai Academy, and the youngest at age 11 (later 12). She is a witch who dons a typical witch costume (consisting of a hat and cape), which is considered by some students to be a violation of the school rules, and frequently ends her sentences with "desu", which roughly translates to "it is". However, it can also have the effect of raising the politeness of one's speech. As a witch, she has problems with her classmates discriminating against her (according to Kurumu, witches are viewed as "Beings of the Borderline", those that are something between humans and the supernatural, as it is impossible to tell their difference by appearance alone).   Despite ranking #1 on the examinations, she was a lonely prankster before meeting Tsukune and Moka. She initially hated Tsukune, claiming that she has fallen in love with Moka, and uses her magical powers to try to drive them apart. However, after both Tsukune and Moka save her from bullying classmates, she falls for him too, and her obsession with both has driven her to try to create a three-way relationship between them.   Despite her genius IQ, Yukari is very childish in nature, and is often indecisive on whether or not she either loves Tsukune or Moka more than the other. Though it seems that despite her young age, Yukari might be bisexual, as she still has interest in Tsukune as well as Moka.

name: Mizore Shirayuki
description:
__Height:__ 156 cm

Mizore Shirayuki is a yuki-onna who is in the same homeroom class as [Tsukune](https://anilist.co/character/3862/Aono-Tsukune) and [Moka](https://anilist.co/character/3861/Akashiya-Moka).

name: Ruby Toujo
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm 

Ruby Tojo is a witch from the human world who was part of a plot to destroy mankind as a response to a large garbage dump polluting her mistress' sanctuary. Her hate for humans stems from a car accident caused by a human drunk driver that took her parents' lives while the family was vacationing in the human world. Upon remembering the kind of love her parents had given her, she attempts to persuade her mistress to call off her plan but to no avail, as her mistress was bent on destroying the human world. She disappears after her mistress is defeated and put to rest, and reappears when Tsukune becomes out of control as a ghoul, aiding Mikogami in sealing his abilities. She now resides at Yōkai Academy as Mikogami's aide and continues to work for him in the second manga serialization. Despite not being an official student, she receives permission to become a member of the Newspaper Club. Exclusively in the anime, a running gag involves her randomly switching positions to help the school. When asked why, she states "many many things" have happened, though it is believed these are orders from Mikogami as a debt of gratitude for providing her with a new magic wand.  It is later revealed in an omake that the reason why Ruby works under Mikogami is because of her infatuation with Tsukune, and by working at the academy, she could be near him.

name: Untenshu
description: A mysterious, unnamed bus driver who seems to know more than he reveals and constantly shows up to offer advice to Tsukune, he is usually portrayed smoking a cigar. He is the one who requests the board chairman help keep Tsukune's ghoulish nature at bay. It is unknown if the bus driver is human or a yokai, but he does have an extensive knowledge in the supernatural, having identified Ishigami's Lilith Mirror as the cause of the uproar during the school festival. He seems to know about Tsukune secretly being a human being, but it is only subtly implied.

name: Ginei Morioka
description: Ginei Morioka nicknamed "Gin" for short, is a werewolf and the president of the Newspaper Club who speaks in an Osakan dialect. He is a second (later third)-year student at Yokai Academy and a shameless peeping tom who initially began as an antagonist to Tsukune, but becomes somewhat of an older brother/guardian to him and his friends. He ceases his schemes so other students will stop calling him a pervert, but remains unchanged in the anime. He has no second thoughts about trying to impress other girls, though his affections lie with Moka. While working in the club, he tends to leave all the work to his subordinates, including the distribution of the paper.Ginei has proven himself to be a loyal friend and has provided the group with helpful information, often acting as the pervert. In his first year at Yokai Academy, all he did was fight. Because of this, he was known as "Mad Dog" Morioka until San put him in his place by being his opponent.

name: Shizuka Nekonome
description: Tsukune's homeroom teacher and Newspaper Club advisor. Her true form is a cat and she loves to eat fish, her favorite fish are the ones from the human world. She has a tendency to say 'meow' in or after sentences. A recurring gag is that she lectures students about staying in human form, but unknowingly has her tail extended.

name: Nazo Koumori
description: A bat who acts like a narrator saying things like how long a battle takes place and occasionally covering up fanservice.  It appears in the manga's sequel, Rosario + Vampire II. He seems to be Shuzen Kokoa's servant.  His special ability is to turn into any kind of melee weapon, his only draw back is he weighs 100 kg.  He has a tendency for saying 'weeee!' after any commentary or plain statement.

name: Victorique de Blois
native: ヴィクトリカ・ド・ブロワ
description:
__Height:__ 140 cm   

The heroine of the story. Victorique has the appearance of a small, almost doll-like, girl with long golden hair and emerald eyes and a voice that sounds exactly like that of an older woman. It is mentioned once that she is 15 years old. Another important part of Victorique's appearance is a pipe that she smokes when thinking about something. She spends her days at the conservatory at the top of the library, reading several difficult books, often in different languages, simultaneously. She points at one wall of the library and has told [Kazuya](https://anilist.co/character/22724/Kujou-Kazuya) that she has read almost all the books over there. Along with her sharp tongue, abusive bluntness and eccentric attitude, she possesses amazing detective skills. She enjoys "reconstructing chaos" and often complains of the boredom that causes her headaches. Victorique also seems to love sweets, since she's always really happy when Kujo gets her anything sweet.

name: Kazuya Kujou
description:
**Height:** 168 cm (5'6")

The main character of the story. As the youngest son of a soldier, Kazuya has spent most of his life struggling with living in his highly successful siblings' shadows. Jealous of all the attention his brothers got, he worked hard to compete, but everything changed when he understood that adults, who think that the youngest child is always spoiled and useless, will never acknowledge his efforts. With a permanent scar in his heart he left the military academy in Japan and before anyone from his family could stop him, went to study abroad to St. Marguerite. Unfortunately, his appearance, combined with the student body's belief that "the traveler who comes in the spring brings death with him" has resulted in Kazuya being called the "Reaper" and having no friends. By some twist of fate he becomes a messenger and companion to the most eccentric pupil in the school, Victorique. At first he didn't like Victorique because of her arrogant attitude, but after some time he started to care for her and be protective of her. He is described, by Victorique, as a good and sincere person whose soul is pure and beautiful enough to admit pride. Despite everything that happened in Japan he is proud to be a soldier's son.

name: Jacqueline de Signore
native: ジャクリーヌ・ド・シニョレー
description: The case of the imperial lost treasures of Sauville, she appears after the case to help one of the orphans, Luigi to return school by paying his tuition. She also later appears at the Saint Marguerite Academy to donate some books to the library.

name: Lee
description: A character in the cases 'The Souls of the Dead Raise a Shipwreck' and 'The Hares Exchange Promises Beneath the Morning Sun'.

name: Anastasia
description: The case of the lost imperial treasures of Sauville.

name: Mildred Arbogast
native: ミルドレッド・アーボガスト
description: Mildred Arbogast is a thief who encounters Kazuya Kujō and Avril Bradley in a market in Sauville.

name: Yutaka Hoshino
description: Peco is a member of the Katase High table tennis club, along with his best friend [Smile](https://anilist.co/character/20325/Tsukimoto-Makoto). Unlike his friend, Peco is very charismatic and has a real passion towards Ping Pong. Peco dreams of becoming the Ping Pong world champion, and claims that he'll move to Europe to start playing professionally after he graduates.

name: Makoto Tsukimoto
description: Smile is a member of the Katase High table tennis club, along with his best friend [Peco](https://anilist.co/character/20326/Hoshino-Yutaka). Unlike the other members of the club, Smile thinks of the sport as a job or a way to pass time. He does not try to enjoy it for fun and often lets less able players beat him out of consideration for their feelings. The other members of the club nicknamed him Smile because he never does.

name: Michio Tamura
description: Obaba's son.

name: Ryuichi Kazama
description: Kazama is captain of the powerful table tennis club of the Kaiou Gakuen academy. He has also won the Inter-High for the second consecutive year. He has a stoic personality and devotes everything to table tennis.

name: Jou Koizumi
description: Mr. Koizumi is the Katase High School Table Tennis club advisor. He recognizes Smile's gift and ability towards the sport and so vows to train him. When Mr. Koizumi was younger he was considered to be the best table tennis player in Japan, and was nicknamed 'Butterfly Joe' because of his extraordinary skills. Mr. Koizumi states that Smile reminds him of his younger self. He is also an English teacher.

name: Manabu Sakuma
description: Demon is a childhood friend of Peco's and a member of the Kaio Academy table tennis club. Despite being Peco's friend, Demon is also his rival.

name: Kong no Haha
description: Kong Wenge's mother.

name: Yurie Kazama
description: Kazama's cousin and implied girlfriend.

name: Masayuki Sanada
description: The vice-captain of Kaio High School, and the second-best player on the team, he is shown to possess qualities befitting a captain.

name: Akemi Souryuuin
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm
 
Like all women in her family, Akemi has a muscle fetish, and she is way more blunt about it than her sister, Shion. She tells Hibiki that she chose to join the Silverman Gym in order to live a healthy life. By her own account, she was never really interested in anything before she discovered her love of muscles.

She is unaware of how impressive her life is compared to the average person, as it is completely normal to her.

description:
Yakusha is a beautiful woman, with long black hair and a generally serene expression. She is slightly more muscular than the rest of the female cast, but not to the extent of, say, Utsunomiya. She rarely opens her eyes, but when she does, her clan's trademark darkened eyes can be seen.

She is married to Hanjuro, a hitman (who is 12 years older than her), and has two children: Karla and Sarla.

name: Narciso Annasui
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm (Manga), 183 cm (Anime)
__Occupation:__ Student (formerly)


Obsessed with disassembling objects, Annasui grew up a bit awkward during his childhood days. He painstakingly dissected a pocket watch, his neighbor's car, and whatever else that struck his fancy. One day while returning from work, he found his girlfriend cheating on him with another man. In response, he methodically tore both of them apart. He was sent to prison and a faced twelve year sentence for first degree murder.

Although he was briefly seen next to Weather Report by [Hermes](https://anilist.co/character/13369/Costello-Hermes), Annasui doesn't get involved with [Jolyne](https://anilist.co/character/11222/Kuujou-Jolyne) until F.F. comes to Emporio for help. Seemingly entranced by the tales he has heard of her, Annasui agrees to become Jolyne's bodyguard out of his burning love for her. Upon finding her, Annasui keeps true to his word and protects Jolyne - to the point of self-sacrificing at times.

JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Part 6: Stone Ocean

name: Kenzou
description:
Kenzou is a small yet athletic old man, with a heavily wrinkled and clean-shaved face, but he has unusually long eyebrows over slanted eyes. He has several thin braids on the back of the head.

Kenzou wears a furred bodysuit open on the chest, a jeweled skullcap on which are several big pearls, and a similarly jeweled necklace.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

name: Sports Maxx
description:
Sports Maxx is a man of average to above-average height and medium build. He has short, sparse hair in soft spikes; and eyebrows in the shape of large, light circles, tapering into short tails. He wears a long, light coat and light pants, both patterned by a dark paisley design.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)
