native: ヴィヴァーノ・ウエストウッド
description:
__Height:__ 186 cm
__Stand:__ Planet Waves
  
Viviano Westwood is a muscular man with a sharp square face. After his companion violently punches him, a significant part of his inner mouth, gum and teeth included, is visible. He has dark hair and an undercut. Westwood wears the uniform of the Green Dolphin Street Jail guards.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

appearsIn.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: STONE OCEAN Part 2

name: Rokuro Enmadou
description:
__Height:__ 157 cm

In the past he was quite cheerful, having dreams to cleanse and destroy all Impurities and Magano, but after the Hiinatsuki tragedy, due to the fear of losing more "people that he cared about", he decided to stop fighting and quit being an exorcist. He often attempts to become someone big in various areas like: soccer, acting, etc. but he lacks all kind of talent and fails at everything, including simple things as map reading.

Even though he doesn't want to fight, he can't stand by and do nothing when someone needs help, and he is ready to risk his life to help those in need, for example, when he saved [Benio](https://anilist.co/character/89538/Adashino-Benio) from the impurity she had trouble defeating herself, and when he rushed to Magano to save [Ryougo](https://anilist.co/character/89701/Nagitsuji-Ryougo), not taking any dangers in consideration.

Rokuro is a bit reckless at times and is very talkative, or, as Benio calls him, "loud". He retains a lot of emotional pain but keeps a strong exterior to make sure none of his friends worry about him.

name: Benio Adashino
description:
Benio first comes off as a cold, quiet person, who dislikes talking and is easily irritated. However, regarding exorcism she is very passionate and can be very talkative. Since she comes from an important family, honor and pride are both very important to her. She is also very competitive, especially around [Rokuro](https://anilist.co/character/89537/Enmadou-Rokuro), and since she was taught to never back out from her words, she can be pretty stubborn and will use any argument to win.

Later on, Benio seems to be able to show her feelings comfortably compared to when she first met Rokuro, and seems to show her jealousy more openly than before.

name: Shimon Ikaruga
description:
Shimon Ikaruga is an exorcist and Crimson Phoenix of the Twelve Guardians. He was born in the branch family of Ikaruga House of Tsuchimikado Island, and was later adopted by the main family.

He was the youngest member of the Twelve Guardians until Mayura Otomi took her father's place in the ranks. He is one of Seigen Amawaka's apprentices, as well as Keiji and Sayo Ikaruga's cousin and foster brother.

name: Kamui
description: Kamui is calm yet ruthless, having no mercy for humans or other creatures, he does not care about their feelings, comparing them to mere insects. Though, he tends to often let his opponents choose the death of their preference, and always gives them ten seconds to decide.

name: Momochi
description: Momochi is a Basara that hails from the Outcast Valley village. He is Chijiwa's twin brother.

name: Tenma Unomiya
description:
__Height:__ 161 cm (5'3")

The Kijin of the Twelve Guardians and the 6th and current head of Unomiya House.

name: Chijiwa
description: Chijiwa is a Basara that hails from the Outcast Valley village. He is Momochi's twin brother.

name: Haruka Kaibara
description: Haruka Kaibara is an exorcist of Mainland at Ayame City Branch of Exorcist Group. In the anime, she joins the Seika Dormitory.

name: Yuuto Ijika
description:
__Height:__ 163 cm (5'4")

The older brother of [Benio Adashino](https://anilist.co/character/89538/Adashino-Benio).

name: Shinnosuke Kunizaki
description: Shinnosuke Kuzaki is a young exorcist who lives in the Seika Dormitory.

name: Ayumu Fujino
description: Fujino is a fourth grader who draws 4-panel manga strips for the elementary school's newspaper. Her talent as well as her funny stories are praised by her classmates. But one day, she is challenged by the skilled drawings of a truant student from next-door class, and becomes determined to improve her art.

name: Kyomoto
description: Kyomoto is a truant student in fourth grade. Because she doesn't show up to school, she practices drawing at home relentlessly. One day, her art gets published alongside [Fujino](https://anilist.co/character/286677)'s in the elementary school's newspaper, which began a one-sided rivalry.

name: Yuki Takeya
description: Yuki Takeya is the main protagonist of the Gakkou Gurashi! series. She is a former senior student at Megurigaoka Private High School and a member of the School Life Club, where she, as the most cheerful and optimistic person, comes up with club activities and brings comfort among the club despite their surroundings.

name: Kurumi Ebisuzawa
description: Kurumi Ebisuzawa is a former student at Megurigaoka Private High School and the primary "zombie killer"/strategist of the School Life Club, where her abilities prove invaluable.

name: Yuuri Wakasa
description:
Yuuri Wakasa is one of the main characters of the Gakkou Gurashi! series. She is a former student at Megurigaoka Private High School. As the big-sister figure, Yuuri is the president of the School Life Club, where she is more commonly referred to as "Rii (-san)".
She keeps a detailed record of food, electricity, lessons, and other resources and activities. Yuuri is usually very calm and mature, and acts in a collected and proper manner. She also is quite serious, always looks after her comrades, and is not afraid to scold someone when they put themselves in danger pointlessly.

name: Miki Naoki
description:
Miki Naoki is one of the main characters of the Gakkou Gurashi! series. She is a second year student of Megurigaoka High School. She eventually joins the School Life Club as the youngest member after being rescued during the members' outing to the mall. 
Miki is very polite and kind, as she uses the honorifics and calls her seniors "senpai". Though she is usually quiet, Miki is very caring and supportive, as she comforts her friends when they feel down, and gives them words of encouragement when they need it.

Miki has had many appearances with "The Stand," a book by Stephen King, which is a post-apocalyptic horror/fantasy novel.

name: Megumi Sakura
description: Megumi Sakura is a Japanese teacher at Megurigaoka Private High School and the faculty adviser for the School Life Club. She is affectionately called "Megu-nee" by her students (rather than her preferred "Sakura-sensei"). Megumi is a kind, patient young woman, who cares more for her students than herself. She has a soft tone in her voice and generally a calm demeanor when around others. Despite being an adult, she is also very innocent and meek at times, as Yuki states that she doesn't have much of a presence.

name: Akiko Kamiyama
description: Teacher at Megurigaoka Private High School

name: Arnault Hatonishiki
native: アーノールト ハトニシキ
description: A pigeon caught by Kurumi Ebisuzawa, tasked with sending a letter.

name: Tsumugi Katsuragi
description: An upperclassman that Kurumi had romantic feelings for.

name: Kei Shidou
description: Mii-kun's friend.

name: Taroumaru
description:
In the anime, Taromaru is notably an intelligent and tolerant dog, putting up with anything Yuki puts him up to and being able to open doors and escape.
He is able to avoid infected citizens and escape to the safety of Kei and Miki, and is later found by Kurumi in the mall. He is taken in by the School Life Club members as their "mascot."

After upsetting Taromaru at the mall by yelling at him, Taromaru dislikes being around [Miki](https://anilist.co/character/89054/Miki-Naoki), preferring to be with the other girls instead. 



In the manga, Taromaru is a Shiba Inu puppy that Yuki found while exploring.

name: Sentouin Roku-gou
description:
The man known as "Combat Agent Six" joined the Kisaragi Corporation in his first year of high school, roughly three to four years before the beginning of the story. He began working there part-time at age nineteen.

Six is a senior in the organization being the oldest member of the organization left except for the generals. That is why, when the company was on the verge of the global conquest, Six was one of the candidates to explore an alternate world similar to Earth in order to conquer it.

Six was eventually chosen, being sent to a alternate world in order to spy on it and prepare him for this world's domination at the hands of Kisaragi.

name: Alice Kisaragi
description: A high-spec android developed with the latest technology the Kisaragi Corporation has to offer. Her internal reactor will melt down and self-destruct if exposed to excessive levels of violence.

name: Snow
description: A diligent woman who rose up from the slums to become captain of the Royal Guard. She's very ambitious and zealously seeks credit for accomplishments.

name: Grimm
description: She's an archbishop. She rides in a wheelchair due to a curse accidentally placed on her by herself that does not allow her to wear shoes.

name: Rose
description: A Chimera who can copy the abilities of any monster she eats, just like K*rby. She treats the dying words of her elderly creator as gospel, resulting in....rather tacky lines.

name: Tillis
description: She is the Princess of the Grace Kingdom and current ruler of Grace Kingdom.

name: Belial
description:
Belial the Great Flame is a supreme leader in Kisaragi.

Daughter of the venerable Kazoku family, Belial helped her friend Astaroth found Kisaragi, alongside Lilith the Dark, becoming head of the combat division.

Belial is one of the generals that assign Six to a reconnaissance mission in an alternate world. She openly states that she wanted to go on the mission herself, but due to a bad dice roll, she wasn't picked.

name: Astaroth
description:
Freezing Astaroth is a supreme leader in Kisaragi.

Daughter of the Kirasagi Conglomerate president, she founded Evil Organization Kisaragi alongside Belial the Great Flame and Lilith the Dark, receiving ice manipulation powers after being operated by the last one. Astaroth was begged by Six to join the organization whilst begging for incoherent things such as being the husband of hers.

Astaroth is one of the three generals in the evil organization, the Kisaragi Corporation. She and her co-worker, Belial, assigned Combat Agent Six to a reconnaissance mission to an alternate world. A high-performance android named Alice is assigned to join him on his mission by her as well.

name: Lilith
description: She is a head scientist in Kisaragi.

name: Heine
description: One of the Demon Lord's Elite Four, also known as Heine of the Flames. She has huge boobs. If you like dark-skinned demi-humans, this demoness is definitely your type.

name: Broly
description:
__Birth Date:__ Age 737, Age 732 (Super)
__Allegiance:__ Frieza Force (formerly)
__Occupation:__ Space Pirate (noncanon)
__Relatives:__ [Paragus](https://anilist.co/character/9394/Paragus) (father)
__Mentors:__ [Paragus](https://anilist.co/character/9394/Paragus), [Son Goku](https://anilist.co/character/246/Goku-Son)

__DRAGON BALL SUPER__
Broly is the son of Paragus and the misguided main antagonist of [Dragon Ball Super: Broly](https://anilist.co/anime/101302/Dragon-Ball-Super-Broly/). He is the latest of the Legendary Super Saiyans, a demonic Saiyan warrior who appears every thousand years. Because of his extreme power, he was stranded on the planet Vampa by [King Vegeta](https://anilist.co/character/9393/King-Vegeta), where he was raised by his father until rescued years later by the Frieza Force.

Broly was the son of a low-class Saiyan warrior, yet even as an infant he displayed an abnormally high combat potential. For this reason he was placed in the highest priority Saiyan nursing facility, something which King Vegeta did not take kindly to.

name: Cold Daiou
description: The father of Frieza and Cooler.

name: Lemo
description: Is an old veteran in the Freeza Force.

name: Nappa
description: Nappa is an elite Saiyan warrior that accompanied Vegeta to Earth in search of the Dragon Balls. He has been Vegeta's attendant ever since Vegeta's childhood, and has a somewhat violent nature, even among Saiyans. He survived the attacks of Tenshinhan and Chaozu which drained their lives and put Piccolo to death with his incredible might, but fell powerless to Son Goku who had returned to Earth with new training from North Kaio. Vegeta ordered him to stop fighting Goku due to Goku's clear dominance over him; He was then executed by Vegeta when Goku defeated Nappa.  *Wiki

name: Shen Long
description:
Shen Long is the wish granting dragon of Earth. The Shen Long of the Black Star Dragon Balls is red, opposed to the Shen Long of Earth who is green.  Shen Long can be summoned by gathering all seven of the Dragon Balls of Earth. Shen Long can bestow any wish as long as it does not exceed the power of his creator, who must be still alive (i.e. Kami or Dende). 

Multiple times in the Dragon Ball series, Shen Long threatens to kill the summoner if they do not say a wish on time, or if they do not say a wish at all. Shen Long cannot bring back a person from the dead more than once. The Dragon Balls cannot be used for 365 Earth days after a wish is made, as they turn to stone. The Earth Dragon Balls are relatively small, each about the size of a large orange, much smaller than the Namekian Dragon Balls, which are the size of beach balls. The base for Shen Long is a stone statue kept by his creator. If Shen Long is killed, the Dragon Balls turn to stone. The statue also shatters. If the creator or another Namekian wishes to, they can rebuild the statue to give life back to Shen Long and the Dragon Balls. This happened after Shen Long granted Demon King Piccolo's wish for youth.  

While Kami and Piccolo weren't merged, Shen Long could only grant one wish. After Dende brought him back to life, he was able to grant two wishes (three if the first does not revive more than one at a time). If the summoner wants, he can only make one wish.

name: Goten Son
description:
__Race:__ Half Saiyan, Half-Human  
__Height:__ 123 cm (4')  
__Birth Year:__ 767
__Hobbies:__ Playing War, Catching Bugs  
__Favorite Food:__ Pocky, Strawberry Daifuku  
__Favorite Vehicle:__ Bicycle  
Goten is a fictional character in the manga and anime series Dragon Ball Z, as well as appearing in Dragon Ball GT. He is the second son of Son Goku and Chi Chi. Goten is a Human-Saiyan hybrid, just like his older brother, Son Gohan.  Son Goten's natural physique almost perfectly replicates his father Goku's, even though his appearance such as hairstyle and clothes change from time to time. Goten is generally seen wearing an outfit that mimics his father's, with only slight differences. As in the case of the last few episodes of Dragon Ball Z, his hair has grown long, no longer looking like his father's, he also wears a blue and white shirt with his name printed on it. In Dragon Ball GT, he wears a white shirt with purple jeans, and his hair is much shorter. His skin color stays lightly tanned for all of his appearances in Dragon Ball Z/GT. Goten, unlike his brother, was never shown to have a tail. This is never explained.  In  _Dragon Ball Online_ (which takes place 216 years after Dragon Ball Z, and unlike Dragon Ball GT, Toriyama had a lot of creative control over the story), it is stated that in 800 Age, Goten, along with Present Day Trunks had created the Kikoukenjutsu Sword School   (Source: Wikipedia, Dragon Ball Super Exciting Guide, Character Edition)

name: Beerus
description: Beerus is powerful, yet lazy and playful (like most cats). His similarities to cat-like behavior also display in his love for long sleep sessions and how he grooms himself. Beerus is always in a bad mood when he wakes up from his deep slumber, but becomes less grumpy the more awake he is. Similar to many cats, he likes to display dominance, and will claim whatever he desires to have without much consideration for how it will affect others. He is also a gourmet, and his planet is stocked with fish and other sorts of food. While he is a fearsome god, his cat-like gestures and his variety of facial expressions separate him from the more malevolent antagonists in the series. He has a very indifferent behavior toward death, being the God of Destruction, and cares little to none about death and the billions, possibly trillions of lives he has taken over the years he has been the God of Destruction. He often uses the threat of destroying Earth as a means to get what he wants or as a simple warning to Whis and the other Z fighters.

name: Izuko Gaen
description:
She is a young-looking woman who wears clothes that are too large for her. Izuko often boasts about her knowledge, coming off as somewhat arrogant. She claims to know everything, to the degree where she can predict the future; as a result, she likes to brag about this with her catchphrase, "There is nothing I don't know, I know everything." Izuko is also the younger sister of [Tooe Gaen](https://anilist.co/character/137496/Gaen-Tooe).

When others get help from her, she wishes for something in return; usually ending up with them doing her a favour.

name: Arue

name: Chihaya Ayase
description:
__Height:__ 167 cm (5'6")

A determined schoolgirl who "possesses a remarkable hearing ability". She believes that by persevering in karuta, she will meet [Arata](https://anilist.co/character/47165/Wataya-Arata) again, and begins a karuta club at her high school with [Mashima](https://anilist.co/character/47167/Mashima-Taichi). While she is beautiful, she is considered too weird; her classmates refer to her as a "waste of a beauty". She has been described as a "tomboy trapped in a supermodel's body".

name: Taichi Mashima
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm (5'7") 

Taichi is from a wealthy family (His father & Grandfather are both doctors). [Chihaya's](https://anilist.co/character/47163/Ayase-Chihaya) childhood friend is quite the golden boy. Smart, good looking, and mature, he excells at nearly everything he does which makes him the voice of reason in the Misusawa Karuta Club. While he sees himself as keeper of Chihaya and the less experienced members, he demands a lot of himself both in games and as a leader and can overthink even the most simple situations. Taichi's karuta leverages his incredible memory to give him a sense of which cards might be called next and the ability to out-think opponents. He also has a crush on Chihaya but is hesitant to do anything as he thinks that she only has eyes for [Arata](https://anilist.co/character/47165/Wataya-Arata).

name: Arata Wataya
description:
__Height:__ 173cm (5'8") 
__School:__ Fukui Prefecture East Hitsufujioka High School 
__Karuta Society:__ Fukui Nagumo Society - A Class

Arata Wataya was a transfer student from Fukui that went to Chihaya's elementary school. The grandchild of a master karuta player, Arata inspires Chihaya to take up karuta by telling her that he thinks she has a talent for it. He had difficulty fitting in at Chihaya's elementary school because of his Fukui dialect and his family's poverty. His passion for karuta is inspired by his grandfather, a Meijin (master). After their first game at Arata's house, Chihaya befriends him. His dream is to become a Karuta Meijin. After graduating from elementary school, he returned to Fukui to care for his sick grandfather. He stops playing karuta because his grandfather died while Arata was competing in a karuta tournament to rise to A-rank. However, after Chihaya and Taichi visit him in Fukui, he regains his resolve to play competitive karuta again.

name: Hideo Harada
description:
__Level:__ Class A, 6. Dan
__Group:__ Shiranami Karuta Society

Hideo Harada is the head of the Shiranami Society for karuta that Chihaya and Taichi are part of. He used to teach Arata as well, while Arata was in primary school with Chihaya and Taichi. He taught Chihaya throughout Junior High School and is currently mentor to both Chihaya and Taichi. He is also a medical doctor and married.

Harada Hideo is portrayed as a kind man with a deep and insightful knowledge of the game of karuta. He states that he teaches his students offensive karuta, which aims to take cards from the opponent's side. He is extremely competitive, whether on behalf of his students or as a competitor himself, or even as a figurehead, representing his karuta society, and is his students' staunchest supporter.

Once a top karuta player who had previously played against Chihaya, Arata and Taichi in an elementary school tournament, Yusei quit karuta after suffering a defeat against Arata and took up tennis as a refuge. However, Chihaya manages to remind him how he used to play for fun and he ends up joining the karuta club.

Hwaryun is a quiet person who says little and she has a gloomy and ominous aura. She is also quite manipulative.

In Part II, she's depicted as mischievous and teasing, as she clearly mocked the Viole impostor and repeatedly called him "Pig". She almost always smiles in mischief and probably a little bit of arrogance. She also tends to be extremely blunt, caring very little about other peoples' feelings; though this could be considered her way of spurring a person on. This leads her to seem very harsh.

Hwaryun is Viole's Guide but is also the Guide for FUG's Rankers notably Ha Jinsung.

name: Lero-Ro
description: Lero-Ro is a former Examiner of the Second Floor. He is an exceptionally strong Ranker, to the point that even Quant, also a former Test Administrator (and a haughty one), would constantly boast about his strength. He was supposedly the strongest Second Floor Test Administrator and is particularly skilled in the use of Shinsoo. He was also the Light Bearer position instructor. He is fairly old, older than Yuri Zahard, as he stated that Anak Zahard didn't live up to a Princess's chaotic expectations like Yuri Zahard did, whom he met when they were both Regulars. He and Quant are awkwardly described as a "Set Menu", explained by the fact that Lero-Ro and Quant climbed the Tower together like a team. He is apparently quite famous, and he took over 300 years to climb the Tower.

name: Reflejo
description: Reflejo was a Regular and a former Fisherman of Team FUG led by Jue Viole Grace during the 30F Workshop Battle. He spent thousands of years in the E-Rank level hiding as a sleeper agent for FUG.

name: Rouka Numachi
description:
Rouka Numachi is the former basketball rival and supposed arch-nemesis of Suruga Kanbaru. Though she once shared an affinity for basketball akin to Suruga, albeit as a defensive player, she would go on to sustain a leg injury that would end her endeavor in sports. The two had a falling out in middle school due to Rouka's injuries causing a rift between the two.

Rouka is characterized by the concept of "schadenfreude"; in which she derives pleasure from the misfortune of others. A self-proclaimed collector misfortunes, she enjoys listening to people's problems whilst offering empty promises of helping them out. Turning this form of counseling into a non-profit service, Rouka began to operate under the alias called "Lord Devil"; in which she promises her customers that she can solve anyone's problems with absolute certainty.

Contrasting Suruga's virtuous nature, her desire for collecting misfortunes is one of malice. Though she genuinely sympathizes towards her customers' issues, her actions are maliciously self-beneficial and acted out with impartiality towards her customers. She justifies her sense of "evil" as non-harmful, as it not only benefits her state of mind while also allowing her customers to solve their own problems by simply letting the time pass. She carries a crutch due to her injury, which she described as allowing her customers to open up more easily with her.

name: Tooe Gaen
description: Tooe is [Izuko Gaen](https://anilist.co/character/87115)'s older sister. Like Izuko, Tooe used to be a specialist; unlike her sister, she created oddities, including the Rainy Devil. Tooe is [Suruga Kanbaru](https://anilist.co/character/22054)'s mother. When Suruga was young, Tooe and her husband died in a traffic accident; due to this, Suruga was given the Rainy Devil's left arm: the monkey's paw.

name: Seiu Higasa
description:
Seiu is a member of the basketball team with Suruga Kanbaru. During her second year, she was the vice-captain. After Suruga retired due to the Rainy Devil's effects, Seiu became the captain. 

Seiu is a student at Naoetsu High and is in the same year as Kanbaru. She is often blunt, calling Kanbaru an idiot for having bad grades. As a friend of Kanbaru and fellow teammate of the basketball team, Kanbaru and Seiu are presumed to be somewhat close friends. As Kanbaru's friend, she has given her the nickname "Ruga." Initially, Seiu seems to be a background character, though she has a more prominent role in Monster Season.

Remi is usually shown as a rather childish and immature girl who has a very straightforward personality, and often wears her emotions on her sleeve. And seems to rely on other people's help. She's also not very smart, often compared to [Miyamura](https://anilist.co/character/66173/Miyamura-Izumi) about which one is more of an idiot.

She loves insects, though she's bad with dragonflies. Her room is filled with her insect collection, and she has been nicknamed the Insect Queen. She also enjoys reading, especially fairy tales. description:
Satou is an Ajin. He is referred to by officials such as [Yuu Tosaki](https://anilist.co/character/122294/Tosaki-Yuu) as Hat (帽子, Boshi). His real name is Samuel T. Owen.

While Satou's father is British and his mother is Chinese, he himself is from the United States of America. He was part of the United States Marine Corps in the past. Before dying for the first time he had a large x-shaped scar on the left side of his face and was missing his right leg.

He is passionate about video games and gaming in general.

name: Yuu Tosaki
description:
Yuu Tosaki is a high-ranked member of the Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare.

Generally, Tosaki has a commanding air about him and wears a serious expression. His answers are always short and to the point. He is also quite blunt and lacks patience.

He's quick to anger with certain triggers, such as multiple instances in which he snaps at the mispronunciation of his name - "Tozaki" as opposed to what he claims is correct, "Tosaki".

From the very start, Tosaki is shown to be morally ambiguous. It isn't above him to resort to violence through either his own force or those beneath him to get something done. If the consequences of his actions don't have a direct effect on him, his reaction is mild at best.

Tosaki relies heavily on Izumi Shimomura to protect him from the Ajin and their IBM with her own abilities, threatening her with the prospect of being locked up and experimented on if he dies.

name: Izumi Shimomura
description:
__Height:__ 155 cm

Izumi Shimomura is an Ajin. Her name is taken from her birth father's last name (Shimomura) and her mother's maiden name (Izumi). Her former name was Yoko Tainaka. 

Izumi is a rather quiet and reserved individual, talking mainly when informing Tosaki about something. Her answers are usually short and to the point. Even though she is an Ajin, she chose to live between humans in secret and doesn't seem to be consumed completely by resentment towards humans despite her background. She seems to be quite intelligent and understanding, both towards Tosaki and when interrogating Nagai Kei's younger sister, Eriko. However, despite her initial stoic appearance, she can get embarrassed easily (for example when she said too much to Eriko and when Tosaki commented on her casual clothes).

name: Kouji Tanaka
description:
Kouji Tanaka is the second Ajin discovered in Japan. He is a partner to Satou.

Tanaka shows a rather large resentment towards humanity after the daily torture and experiments he was subjected to during his capture. Other than this, he is rather impassive; not really getting frustrated or angry in many situations, and is completely unresponsive to bloodshed and gore.

(Source: Ajin Wiki)

name: Kei Nagai
description:
Kei Nagai is an Ajin and the main protagonist of the series.

Kei was first shown with an academic, serious personality. He is very intelligent and hardworking with ambitions to be a doctor who cures illnesses that don't yet have a cure; specifically to cure his sister [Eriko](https://anilist.co/character/290487/Nagai-Eriko).

Despite Kei's lack of emotional investment in others, he seems to have strong personal values that he tries to live by. He demonstrates gratitude for [Kaito](https://anilist.co/character/120727/Kaito)'s help and cares about his welfare. He also doesn't begrudge [Satou](https://anilist.co/character/89797/Satou) for having killed others to free him, but does not support killing more people unnecessarily.

(Source: Ajin Wiki)

name: Ritsu Nagai
description: Ritsu Nagai is Kei and Eriko Nagai's mother. She used to work as an emergency physician.

name: Watanabe
description: Watanabe is Kei Nagai's classmate.

name: Hirasawa
description: Hirasawa is a 'man in black' who used to work for Kido.

name: Araki
description:
Araki is a detective from the investigation department. He assisted in the search for Kei Nagai at the beginning of the series.

(Source: Ajin Wiki)

name: Mitsuyoshi Hashiguchi
description: President of the Musashi Industries.

name: Moritaka Mashiro
description:
__Horoscope:__ Aquarius
__Height:__ 171 cm 

Mashiro is a 14-year-old boy who doesn't know what to do with his life. One day his classmate Takagi finds out about his amazing drawing skills and asks him to help create a manga. He initially declines but changes his mind when Takagi helps him to ​get engaged with his crush, Azuki Miho.  He and Takagi create manga for Shonen Jump under the pen-name Ashirogi Muto. Mashiro is very talented in drawing although he is very dissatisfied with his style. He specializes in drawing fairly dark characters. His favorite manga is Ashita no Joe.

name: Akito Takagi
description:
__Height:__ 175cm (5'8.9")

Akito is a young 14-year-old who gets some of the best grades in the country and is an award-winning writer. With these brains and writing skills,​ you would think he would have a stable and bright future, but no, this boy has dreams of becoming a mangaka and he is determined to make his dream come true at any cost.   Takagi persuades Mashiro into creating a manga with him after he finds out about his amazing drawing abilities. The two work under the pen-name Ashirogi Muto. Takagi specializes in serious and realistic story lines. His favorite manga is Dragon Ball.

name: Yuriko Aoki
description:
__Pen name:__ Ko Aoki (蒼樹紅)   

Aoki is a manga creator who used to work for a shoujo magazine called Margaret Magazine​ until she was advised to switch over to a shounen magazine. Over at Shounen Jump, she worked with Nakai on her series Hideout Door. She usually bears a tough exterior and can come off as having a cold personality. Aoki attended To-Oh University with Iwase, the same fictional and prestigious university that L and Light from Death Note attend together.

name: Aiko Iwase
description:
__Birthplace:__ Saitama-ken, Japan   

Iwase is an intelligent girl who was a classmate of Mashiro and Takagi during Junior High. Iwase is an academic achiever in school. She's difficult to get along with due to her strict and high-standard nature. She leads a rather lonely life however, this doesn't bother her as she's always focused on her studies. In her world, she only respects people that rivals her ranking in school.

name: Miho Azuki
description:
__Height:__ 162 cm

Azuki is [Mashiro](https://anilist.co/character/14545/Mashiro-Moritaka)'s classmate. Her dream is to be a voice actor. She agreed to marry Mashiro when both of their dreams come true. However, she also told him that in the mean time, they should not have any distractions so they will contact each other only through emails.

Her best friend is [Kaya Miyoshi](https://anilist.co/character/17976/Miyoshi-Kaya).

Although her outer image is shy, she is a very mysterious girl. It is sometimes hard to know what she is thinking about.

name: Songyuu Kim
description: An editor at Shueisha's Weekly Shounen Jump.

name: Shinta Fukuda
description:
Fukuda is a main supporting character in Bakuman and the founder of Team Fukuda. He left home after high school and worked as an assistant to [Eiji Niizuma](https://anilist.co/character/16596/Niizuma-Eiji) for Crow, along with [Mashiro](https://anilist.co/character/14545/Mashiro-Moritaka).

Fukuda had already won an honorable mention when he tried for the Tezuka Award and also got seventh place in the same issue of Akamaru Jump in which where Ashirogi's Money and Intelligence ran and got third place. Later, Fukuda competed with Ashirogi and [Nakai](https://anilist.co/character/23483/Nakai-Takuro) in the Golden Future cup with his original manga, Kiyoshi Knight.

Later, Fukuda successfully serializes Kiyoshi Knight, quits his job as Niizuma's assistant, and gains a new assistant named Yasuoka. His editor is [Yujiro](https://anilist.co/character/23485/Hattori-Yujiro). With the serialization of Kiyoshi Knight, Fukuda became an aspiring rival to Ashirogi, Eiji, and Nakai. Among these three, he is considered to have the worst drawings, though they apparently match his stories. His drawings often border on grotesque.

Fukuda is rash and often seems fueled by his emotional swings. He's very competitive and enjoys the competition between him, Ashirogi, Eiji, and Nakai. Along with all of this, he's also rather conceited, but at the end of the day is a very good friend (and rival).

name: Hisashi Sasaki
description: Editor-in-Chief of Weekly Jump. He tends to behave indifferently or even coldly but it's all for Jump's authors and editors to regain their spirits. He has a good eye for manga and believes it's most important for a manga to be interesting. He's not afraid to make a gamble in order to make the magazine better, but will not put authors' lives at risk.   He knew Saikou's uncle, Kawaguchi Taro, since he was the Assistant Editor-in-Chief at the time Kawaguchi Taro had to quit.

name: Taiki Uchida
description: Koogy's editor.

name: Takuro Nakai
description: Nakai is an assistant for Niizuma. He won a monthly award ten years ago and has been determined to get serialized since. He is good with backgrounds and angles.

name: Tooru Kokonoe
description:
__Blaze:__ Shield

The male protagonist, a kind boy with an irregular Blaze. His Duo is Julie Sigtuna.

name: Julie Sigtuna
native: ユリエ・シグトゥーナ
description:
__Blaze:__ Twin Blades

A quiet girl from a foreign country in Europe, as well as a princess. The reason she came to Japan and Kouryou Academy is because she wants to get stronger to avenge her father's death, and so she seeks out Tooru for help and to teach her his Final Move.

Julie says "Yes" and "No" in Swedish: "Ja/Nej". Her Surname is also a name of a Swedish town.

name: Lilith Bristol
native: リーリス・ブリストル
description:
__Blaze:__ Rifle

A rich girl from Great Britain. She is an "Exception" that came to make Tooru, the "Irregular", her Duo partner. Lilith's hobbies include hunting and DNL (Deathnewland).

name: Miyabi Hotaka
description:
__Blaze:__ Lance

A shy, kind, and caring girl who is often panicking. Because she came from an all-girls school, she is very bad with the opposite sex (except for old men with a gentle atmosphere). Tomoe is the one who keeps supporting her when she wants to get stronger.

name: Tomoe Tachibana
description:
__Blaze:__ Kusarigama 

A smart, mature, and talented student who knows a lot about martial arts. She has a dignified atmosphere about her, and cannot tolerate laziness.

Tomoe always cares for Miyabi who's bad at interacting with men. She also often advises her friends to eat vegetables for a balanced diet and to regain stamina and power.

Her blaze is a modified kusarigama with one end a sickle and the other end having a sharp dagger like point. The chain is made up of individual shards that are not connected, but acts as if they are.

name: Aoi Torasaki
description:
__Blaze:__ Katar

Tooru's childhood friend. Aoi is stubborn and blunt with everyone.

name: Imari  Nagakura
description:
__Blaze:__ Sword

A girl that Tooru first met at the Entrance ceremony. They fought to determine who would enter the Academy, and Tooru won.

name: Rito Tsukimi
description:
__Blaze:__ Whip blade

A homeroom teacher at Kouryou Academy.

name: Sakuya Tsukumo
description: Chairman of Kouryou Academy.

name: Ryuutarou Tatsuno
description:
__Blaze:__ Naginata

Tora's duo partner.

name: Tadatsuru Teori
description:
Tadatsuru Teori was a dollmaster and another Oddity specialist. Similar to Yozuru Kagenui, he specialized in immortal oddities. In particular, he specialized in dead oddities rather than living ones like Kagenui. As a stray specialist, Tadatsuru was obsessed with oddities and viewed them as beautiful creatures and even sometimes captured them for himself.

Tadatsuru was also involved in Izuko Gaen's group in college that included Meme Oshino, Yozuru Kagenui, and Deishuu Kaiki known as the Occult Research Club. Due to their different interests in oddities, Tadatsuru and Kagenui didn't get along well. After the group created Yotsugi Ononoki and she chose Kagenui over him as her master, they've been rivals ever since.

name: YoRHa 2-gou B-gata
description:
__Type:__ YoRHa B-Type (Battle model)
__Affiliation:__ YoRHa Soldiers
__Height:__ 168 cm (heels incl.)

An all-purpose battle android deployed as a member of the YoRHa Soldiers and dispatched to the surface for the 243rd Descent Operation. She specializes in close-quarters combat. She tries to follow YoRHa's regulations that emotions are prohibited, and even amongst androids of the same type, 2B is comparatively cool, calm, and collected.

name: YoRHa 9-gou S-gata
description:
__Type:__ YoRHa S-Type (Scanner model)
__Affiliation:__ YoRHa Soldiers
__Height:__ 160 cm

Of the YoRHa Aircraft Soldiers, he specializes in exploration and research. His main role is collecting information, but by making full use of his hacking, he also supports combat models like [2B](https://anilist.co/character/132494). Due to his role and characteristics, he is full of curiosity. Amongst androids of the same type, 9S is comparatively varied in his emotional expressions.

name: YoRHa A-gata 2-gou
description:
__Type:__ YoRHa A-Type (Attacker model)
__Affiliation:__ YoRHa Soldiers?
__Height:__ 168 cm (heels incl.)

A prototype model that came before the current YoRHa Soldier units were officially instated, she is an Attacker model type that is currently no longer in use.

name: Adam
description:
__Type:__ Machine Lifeform
__Height:__ 188 cm

A mysterious and unique entity. Despite being a Machine Lifeform, his appearance closely resembles an android.

name: Eve
description:
__Type:__ Machine Lifeform
__Height:__ 188 cm

A mysterious and unique entity. Despite being a Machine Lifeform, his appearance closely resembles an android.

name: Pascal
description:
__Type:__ Machine Lifeform
__Height:__ 250 cm

A Machine Lifeform with a soft demeanor and gentle personality who is disconnected from the Machine Network that binds all Machine Lifeforms. Extensively knowledgeable, he created his own community where he lives with other like-minded Machine Lifeforms.

name: Pod 042
description:
Pod 042 and Pod 153 are tactical support units that are the standard assigned Pods to YoRHa soldiers in NieR:Automata. They are mainly loaded with various weapons for long-ranged attacks. These Pods display correspondence from the command center and exchange operational intelligence between units.

Pod 042 supports 2B.

name: Pod 153
description:
Pod 153 and Pod 042 are tactical support units commonly assigned to YoRHa soldiers. They are mainly loaded with various weapons for long-ranged attacks. These Pods display correspondence from the command center and exchange operational intelligence between units.

Pod 153 supports 9S, and is black with red coloring.

name: Shirei-kan
description:
__Type:__ Commander
__Affiliation:__ YoRHa Soldiers
__Height:__ 175 cm

The commander of the YoRHa Soldiers and Operators. She takes command of the YoRHa Soldiers based on instructions from the Council of Humanity located on the moon.

name: Operator 21O
description:
__Type:__ YoRHa O-Type (Operator model)
__Affiliation:__ YoRHa Soldiers
__Height:__ 167 cm

A messenger who delivers orders and instructions from headquarters to the active YoRHa Soldiers on the ground. 21O is in charge of supporting 9S. She has a calmer and stricter personality compared to [6O](https://anilist.co/character/289475/Operator-6O).

name: Grand Fisher
native: グランドフィッシャー
description:
__Height:__ 342 cm

Grand Fisher is a hollow that had evaded the shinigami for over 50 years and is responsible for the death of Ichigo's mother, Masaki Kurosaki. In the anime, he prefers to eat women, which is why he killed Ichigo's mother; in the manga, he prefers to eat children, and Ichigo's mother merely got in the way. In hollow form, he resembles a giant hamster with bird-like hands and feet and a tentacle-like limb that hangs from his forehead, similar to the esca (lure) of an angler fish. The lure is vaguely human-sized and can be transformed to resemble anyone Grand Fisher wishes, usually taking the appearance of one of his previous victims. It can act independently of Grand Fisher, and as long as either the lure or Grand Fisher himself survives, he cannot be purified. 

 As a hollow, Grand Fisher's preferred method of fighting shinigami involves using his angler to keep opponents at bay, rather than attract them as it would normally be used. By transforming the angler into a decoy copy of someone close to his enemy, he can keep them from attacking, since they will be unwilling to harm the decoy. He can also grow his hair and fingers into spikes to stab enemies, or use them to restrain an opponent. Grand Fisher explains that when his hair and claws are used as spikes to stab an enemy, they also absorb the memories of that particular enemy, hence his ability to use the lure to create a copy of their loved ones or friends and use their image as a shield.

name: Iceringer
description: Iceringer is either an incomplete arrancar or one that never learned how (or cared how) to seal his power in a form of a Zanpakutō, stating that he abandoned human form for greater power. He has four arms, each with three fingers that he uses to shot his Uňa Tirotear from. His Hollow mask is in the shape of a beak with only the upper-left quarter of his mask showing his face. While he does not appear to have legs he is able to use Sonido and his speed is able to match that of Uryū Ishida Hirenkyaku.    Source: Bleach Wiki

name: Clare
description:
Clare is the series' protagonist. In the beginning of the series she is number 47 of the organization's 78th generation, making her the lowest ranked claymore. She also holds the distinction of becoming the first individual to willingly become a claymore.  Her goal is revenge against the awakened being [Priscilla](https://anilist.co/character/2624/Priscilla).

She saves [Raki](https://anilist.co/character/2208/Raki) from a youma and takes him under her care because he reminds her of herself when she was younger.

Clare bears a striking physical resemblance to [Ikuno](https://anilist.co/character/8568/Ikuno-Shirataki) from Angel Densetsu, Norihiro Yagi's previous manga.

name: Miria
description:
__Name:__ Miria
__Alias:__ Phantom Miria
__Rank Number:__ No.6 of 78th Generation
__Type:__ Offensive
__Special attack:__ Phantom Mirage

Miria is Claymore No. 6 of the 78th generation. Her great speed leaves after-images of herself in battle, confusing the opponent, thus earning herself the nickname, "Phantom Miria." She is also skilled at teamwork and tactics. Miria has long, pale blonde hair, styled in a razor-shag cut. She has silver eyes. After the Northern Campaign, she sometimes ties it in a ponytail. Miria has superior leadership qualities. But contrary to Organization aims, Miria takes personally the deaths of those under her command. She will go to great lengths to keep them alive, including disobeying the Organization's rules and orders. She can plan strategy under difficult conditions. Since [Hilda](https://anilist.co/character/10149/Hilda)'s death, Miria lost all trust in the Organization and seeks its destruction.

name: Raki
description:
__Race:__ Human
__Hometown:__ Doga (Lautrec)  
__Occupation:__ Swordman  
__Afiliations:__ Claymore (Ally) ∕ Seven Ghost (Ally) 
__Generation:__ [Clare](https://anilist.co/character/2188/Clare) ~ [Clarice](https://anilist.co/character/3336/Clarice) 
__Know relatives:__ [Zaki](https://anilist.co/character/35614/Zaki) (brother), Clare, 

Living in his peaceful village like any ordinary boy, Raki's life is changed forever when most of his family is killed by a Yoma. When the "Claymore" Clare arrives in Raki's town to kill the Yoma, it turns out the Yoma camouflaged itself as Raki's older brother after killing the other family members. After killing the Yoma and saving Raki, Clare leaves the town. However, the superstitious villagers throws Raki out, fearing that he might turn into a Yoma himself after being so close to one. Raki follows Clare, and is eventually allowed to accompany her as her cook.  But the true hardships has not yet begun for Clare and Raki...

name: Sophia
description:
__Rank:__ #4
__Type:__ Offensive
__Height:__ 175 cm

Because of her brute strength, Sophia was called Muscular Sophia in the organization. She had a very polite, lady-like way of speaking except when she was arguing with her rival and friend, [Noel](https://anilist.co/character/3960/Noel).

Sophia was among Claymores ranked #2 - #5 sent to kill [Teresa](https://anilist.co/character/2398/Teresa). The Awoken [Priscilla](https://anilist.co/character/2624/Priscilla) killed her after the battle with Teresa.

name: Galk
description:
Galk is one of the captains of the holy city Rabona and is very close to fellow warrior [Sid](https://anilist.co/character/31826/Sid). He is the older and wiser of the two. Galk's weapon is a longsword, which he uses very effectively.

He meets [Clare](https://anilist.co/character/2188/Clare) in an earlier episode and helps to purge the city of yoma. He also later gives his sword to [Raki](https://anilist.co/character/2208/Raki).

name: Undine
description: The muscular and aggressive no. 11, Undine uses two swords and had used Youki energy to enhance her muscles.

name: Rafaela
description: Number two of the seventysixth generation, Rafaela and her older sister were the subjects of one of the organizations experiments. The experiment ended in a horrible failure, in which Rafaela lost her eye, and she left the organization as an inactive Claymore. After a certain event, her skills were needed once more, and she became number five of the seventyeight class, acting as an assassin for the organization.

name: Isley
description:
Isley is a male Awakened being, ex Number 1 of the Organizations very first generation of warriors. When in his transformed state he resembles a sleek, black centaur whose right arm can act as a lance or axe and the left as a bow or shield. He fires homing arrows with great skill.

Isley initiated the Northern campaign in order to kill [Luciela](https://anilist.co/character/3340/Luciela) and take over the south and become an unrivaled power by destroying the possibility of an alliance between [Riful](https://anilist.co/character/2622/Riful) and Luciela against him and [Priscilla](https://anilist.co/character/2624/Priscilla). Isley sacrificed his awakened followers to distract the organization and Riful, while he went south to eliminate Luciela. The organization sent 24 claymores to slow down Isley's allies, while they prepared [Alicia](https://anilist.co/character/3243/Alicia) for controlled awakening.

During the North campaign, he finds [Raki](https://anilist.co/character/2208/Raki) and takes him in. Later when Raki compliments him on his skills with a sword, Isley agrees to become Raki's teacher and begins to instruct him in swordsmanship. Isley comments that Raki reminds him a lot of how he was in his own youth.

In the next seven years after he the sent the awakened beings to the west and east, it is discovered that Isley emerged victorious against Luciela in which both contestants nearly died.

name: Sid
description:
Sid is one of the warriors of the holy city, he along with [Galk](https://anilist.co/character/19523/Galk) fights [Clare](https://anilist.co/character/2188/Clare) on the roof top while on patrol. He appears brash, arrogant and short tempered early on in the story. He later helps Clare in her fight against the powerful Yoma she was assigned to slay, resulting with breaking his leg. He later sees her and [Raki](https://anilist.co/character/2208/Raki) off when they leave the city and gives her a good bye kiss (to which Raki kicks him in the crotch in the manga, and the two start a fist fight).

He appears after the 7 year time skip and helps [Miata](https://anilist.co/character/2836/Miata) and [Clarice](https://anilist.co/character/3336/Clarice) evade some guards. He does not seem to have the same arrogance or other rude qualities as he did during his first appearance.

Later when the Former Number 2 awakened being [Agatha](https://anilist.co/character/26883/Agatha) attacks, he is used as the central point in the defenders efforts to take her down. While the guards distract her, he attacks her from behind; he is caught one step away from attacking her however. She commends him on his skill and offers to "have some fun" with him on account of his handsomeness, when he refuses she proceed in trying to kill him but he is saved by [Galatea](https://anilist.co/character/2771/Galatea).

name: Aoba Suzukaze
description:
__Birth Place:__ Tokyo, Japan
__Height:__ 149 cm

A high school graduate who joins the Eagle Jump game company as a character designer, as they made her favorite game, Fairies Story. Due to her small stature, she is often mistaken for a middle school student.

name: Kou Yagami
description:
__Birth Place:__ Tokyo
__Height:__ 164 cm

The lead character designer of Eagle Jump. She spends a lot of time at the office, often sleeping there overnight in her underwear, and has a laid-back but stern attitude. She was the character designer for the game that inspired [Aoba](https://anilist.co/character/89641/Suzukaze-Aoba) to become one herself.

name: Hifumi Takimoto
description:
__Height:__ 162 cm

Takimoto Hifumi is a character designer  for Eagle Jump, a gaming studio located in Tokyo.

Hifumi is especially shy to the point of avoiding talking to people or looking at them directly. As a result, in order to not make her feel uncomfortable, the other employees interact with her through the company's computer messenger system. Although, in later seasons she becomes more lively and goes out of her way to try to improve talking to people. 

Contrary to her normal personality, she becomes very lively, outgoing, and cheerful while texting or messaging, often using emoticons in chat. She secretly enjoys cosplay and owns a pet hedgehog named [Sojiro](https://anilist.co/character/158503/Sojiro).

Some trivia about Hifumi:
- Her favorite colors are Blue and Pink
- Her favorite clothing style is "Sweet Lolita"

name: Shizuku Hazuki
description:
__Birth Place:__ Tokyo, Japan
__Height:__ 161 cm

A game director with a strong interest in cute girls, hence why her department is entirely female. She owns a cat named [Mozuku](https://anilist.co/character/127138/Mozuku).

name: Mozuku
description: Mozuku is a pet cat owned by Shizuku Hazuki, the director of Eagle Jump.

name: Rin Tooyama
description:
__Birth Place:__ Aichi prefecture, Japan
__Height:__ 158 cm

An art director and head of the background department. She joined the company at the same time as Kou whom she is very close friends with.

name: Hajime Shinoda
description:
__Birth Place:__ Tokushima Prefecture, Japan
__Height:__ 167 cm

A motion designer who works in the character design department as there are no open seats in the animation department. She enjoys sentai shows and owns various prop weapons.

name: Yun Iijima
description:
__Birth Place:__ Mie Prefecture, Japan
__Height:__ 151 cm

A character designer who designs monsters and often dresses in gothic clothing. She has two younger siblings.

name: Nene Sakura
description:
**Birthplace:** Tokyo
**Height:** 144 cm

Aoba's friend from high school who is currently in university. She took an interest in programming and eventually became an intern at Eagle Jump after beta testing Fairies Story 3.

Nene is described as childish, selfish, and goofy by Aoba, who can't stay focused on the task given to her, which is why she's often seen leaving her post. She is also an otaku and a fan of Faries Story Series.

name: Umiko Ahagon
description:
__Birth Place:__ Okinawa Prefecture, Japan
__Height:__ 162 cm

A programmer who often gets annoyed when she has to fix errors and is embarrassed by her surname. She is a military fan and has several airsoft weapons in her workspace.

name: Yagi
description: He sits next to Sawako after the Winter break in the first year. He starts conversations with her and tells her that he gets sleep paralysis often.

appearsIn.title: Kimi ni Todoke: From Me to You Season 2

name: Kazuichi Arai
description:
__Height:__ 193 cm

Arai Kazuichi is the temporary homeroom teacher for the gang's class. He is nicknamed Pin and always is called that way (except [Sawako](https://anilist.co/character/6977/Kuronuma-Sawako) who obeys the formalities and still calls him Arai-sensei). (The previous homeroom teacher had been said to be sick after he made Sawako do his work during the summer holidays.)

He is a great fan of baseball as well as the school baseball team's coach. He used to be part of [Shouta Kazehaya](https://anilist.co/character/13531/Kazehaya-Shouta)'s father's league team, so he has known Shouta since when he was young. He had once said that he likes to 'interrupt' people. He nicknames Kazehaya and Sawako's found-beside-the-river puppy Pedro Martinez.

appearsIn.title: Kimi ni Todoke: From Me to You Season 2

name: Kento Miura
description: A student in Sawako's class during second year who sits next to her. When Sawako befriends Miura, Kazehaya becomes jealous of him as a potential rival for Sawako. He is interested in girls, particularly Sawako.

appearsIn.title: Kimi ni Todoke: From Me to You Season 2

name: Arc
description: A Japanese gamer who, after falling asleep playing an online game, finds himself trapped in his game avatar, seemingly transported to a different world. In the game, the only paid avatar was a full-body skeleton, which he chose despite wearing full-body armor. When arriving in this world he still is in the body of a skeleton, which he figures out to be a curse. So he thinks up his own background story to be "a knight that is trying to find a cure for his curse".

name: Ponta
aliases: ベントゥヴォルピーズ
description: Arc's traveling companion. Ponta is of the species Bentou Volpies, a spirit beast also known as Fluffy Fox. Arc encounters it caged and hurt when defeating some bandits. He frees and heals it. Which makes it decide to follow Arc, so Arc gives it the name Ponta. The species is known for being very rarely tame.

name: Ariane Glenys Maple
native: アリアン・グレニス・メープル
aliases: Ariane Glenys Lalatoya (アリアン・グレニス・ララトイア)
description:
A dark elf female warrior with lilac skin, long white hair, and golden eyes. Excellent in magic and swordsmanship. She encountered [Arc](https://anilist.co/character/161637/Arc) when he assisted her in trying to rescue kidnapped elves. Ever since they have been working together.

Elven names don't follow the same custom as human names do. First, you have an elf their first name, followed by the name of their parent with the same sex's name and as last the name of the place they belong too.

name: Eevin Glenys Maple
native: イビン・グレニス・メープル
description: She is the older sister of [Ariane](https://anilist.co/character/194353/Glenys-Maple-Ariane) and is considered one of the finest swordsmen in all of Canada Forest.

name: Dylan Tahg Lalatoya
native: ディラン・ターグ・ララトイア
description: He is the father of [Ariane](https://anilist.co/character/194353/Glenys-Maple-Ariane).

name: Rita Farren
description: She works as the Chambermaid for the eldest daughter of Luvierte House, Lauren Laraiya du Luvierte.

name: Lauren Laraiya du Luvierte
native: ローレン・ラーライア・ドゥ・ルビエルテ
description: She is the eldest daughter of Viscount Buckle du Luvierte.

name: Carcy Held
description: He is an elf, who meets arc and lady Ariane for a short time.

name: Funba Soda Rozobanya
description: He's the beast tamer of Rozobanya.

name: Mamedai Kitashirakawa
description:
Tamako's father who runs the family's mochi shop.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Mecha Mochimazzi
native: メチャ・モチマッヅィ; 王子
description: The prince of the southern island Dela journeyed from.

name: Hinako Kitashirakawa
description: Mamedai Kitashirakawa's wife and Tamako and Anko's late mother.

name: Komari Koshigaya
description:
__Height:__ <140cm (4'7'')

A second-year middle school student and Natsumi's older sister. She is quite short, which she has a complex about.

name: Natsumi Koshigaya
description: A first-year middle school student and Komari's little sister. An airheaded tomboy who has bad grades.

name: Hotaru Ichijou
description: A fifth grade elementary school student who transfers into Asahigaoka Branch School from Tokyo. She is quite tall and mature for her age, but she is also shy and has a crush on [Komari](https://anilist.co/character/54149/Koshigaya-Komari).

name: Renge Miyauchi
description: A first-grade​ elementary school student. Renge is always attached to her recorder and likes to make up nicknames for all the characters in the show. She is quite attached to [Kaede](https://anilist.co/character/87829/Kaede-Kagayama), to whom she likes to call "Candy store" and is very fond of her since she was a baby.

name: Kaede Kagayama
description: Owns the local candy shop and is Kazuho's underclassman. She used to babysit Renge when Renge was still a baby.

name: Suguru Koshigaya
description:
__Height:__ 171cm (5'7")

A third year middle school student and Natsumi and Komari's older brother. He doesn't say much and has very little presence.

name: Yukiko Koshigaya
description: Natsumi, Komari and Suguru's mother. She is also a graduate of Asahigaoka branch school.

name: Kazuho Miyauchi
description:
Kazuho Miyauchi works as the only school teacher at the Asahioka branch school. Her eyes are drawn as closed and she mostly wear plain cloths or a lab coat when she's teaching. She is a laidback person and is shown to be rather lazy. The Asahioka branch school only has five students attending, ranging from elementary to junior high school, are together in the same class. Since the class is mixed, the students mostly study on their own while Kazuho sleeps at her desk most of the time. She's not the most inspiring teacher and it's not unusual that she's late for class, even coming in as late as noon because she over slept. When she isn't sleeping she grades test, write hand-outs or assign class duties that she's too lazy to do herself.

Kazuho is the eldest sister in the Miyauchi family and lives with her parents and two younger sisters Hikage and Renge. Hikage, the middle sister is attending high school in Tokyo and Renge the youngest sister, who is part of the main cast, is a student at Asahikoka. Kazuho used to attend Asahioka herself when she was younger and later she studied in Tokyo when Renge was born.  At home she is also seen taking frequent naps during the day, but compensates by staying up late to complete her teacher assignment. Renge is sometimes annoyed over Kazuho's lazy manners and wants her to be more of an inspiring teacher who can motivate her students to do better. Instead the students use her as a bad example and studies hard to not turn out like her.

name: Konomi Fujimiya
description: Konomi Fujimiya is a character of the Non Non Biyori series. She's a graduate of Asahigaoka Branch School who lives next door to the Koshigayas. Konomi is a very mature teenager. She acts as a role model for Komari and Natsumi as well as Renge. She is very caring and fun but she can also be serious sometimes as well.

name: Hikage Miyauchi
description: The middle of the three sisters in the Miyauchi family, Hikage goes to a high school in Tokyo, which she frequently tries to boast about to Renge.

name: Osamu Mikumo
description: Osamu Mikumo is one of the main protagonists of World Trigger and is a member of the Border with low Trion level. He joined the Border after [Jin](https://anilist.co/character/89014/Jin-Yuuichi) saved him. He is usually referred as simply "Four Eyes" by people outside the Mikumo unit.

name: Yuuma Kuga
description:
__Height:__ 141 cm (4'6")

Yuuma has a laid back personality and is not very knowledgeable about Japanese customs, due to being from another world (despite having a Japanese father), leading to some run-ins with rough people. 

He is logical, advising [Mikumo](https://anilist.co/character/81237/Mikumo-Osamu) to stay away from the Trion Battle Soldier rather than save the students as Mikumo could die. He seems to be aligned with Border's cause, fighting against Neighbor forces.

name: Yuuichi Jin
description:
__Height:__ 179 cm (5'10.5")

Yuuichi Jin is an S-Rank agent and also a member of Tamakoma Branch. He is one of the strongest members in Border. He also has a Black Trigger named Fujin. Jin's Side Effect is Foresight, allowing him to predict future events. His mentor Soichi Mogami lost his life making Jin's Fujin. 

With the help of engineers at Border, Jin was able to create a new type of trigger, Scorpion, which was adopted by many Border agents.

name: Chika Amatori
description:
__Height:__ 140 cm (4'5")

Chika Amatori is one of the main protagonists of World Trigger. Chika is very shy, and rarely says much. She has very few friends, because she voluntarily distances herself from others. She believes that she'll just get hurt when those she gets close to get kidnapped by the Neighbors. She is really patient and serious and can concentrate very well, but she has low confidence and can't see her own potential. After meeting Yuuma and joining Tamakoma Branch, however, she starts warming up to others and becoming more sociable and confident on herself. She is a kind-hearted person and admits that she is terrified of hurting others.

name: Kirie  Konami
description: Kirie is an A-Class agent, member of Tamakoma Branch and [Yuuma](https://anilist.co/character/81239/Kuga-Yuuma)'s mentor. She is a naïve girl who gets tricked easily, who everyone likes to make fun of because she's so gullible, and she tends to make a big ruckus over little things. She also dislikes weaklings, hence why she chose to mentor Yuuma.

name: Viza
description:
Visa is a Neighbor from Aftokrator and a Black Trigger user.

Visa is a gentle person, even to those who are considered his enemies. However, his actions imply that he has a darker side than he usually shows. Despite him being a skilled combatant and a black trigger user he is not arrogant and is even willing to praise his opponents for their skills and traits as seen with Yuma and Reiji respectively. He is willing to acknowledge both opponents and colleagues, treating them with respect and politeness.

Viza is an extremely capable and experienced fighter, who was deemed worthy of wielding one of Aftokrator's national treasures, Organon, and has been confirmed to be one of the most powerful characters in the series. Despite his lack of Trion Receptors, Replica referred to him as the most powerful of the Aftokrator humanoid invaders, and it expressed surprise that a fighter of that caliber had been assigned to an away mission.

name: Masamune Kido
description:
He is Border's highest person in charge. Due to his actions, he is the main antagonist of the Black Trigger Retrieval Arc.

(Source: World Trigger Wiki)

name: Fuku Arashiyama
description:
Jun Arashiyama's younger brother and attends the same school as Osamu.
(Source: World Trigger Wikia)

name: Akane Hiura
description: A B-rank agent and the sniper of Nasu Squad.

name: Shamisen
description: Shamisen is a stray cat selected by Haruhi to play the role of Yuki's familiar for their film "The Adventures of Mikuru Asahina", Shamisen is unusual in the sense that he is a male calico cat. During the filming of the movie, Haruhi's reality-altering powers temporarily give Shamisen the ability to speak. He is adopted by Kyon after the completion of the movie, and is given the nickname "Shami" by his sister.

name: Shiki
description:
Shiki is a Lich and presently in servitude to [Makoto Misumi](https://anilist.co/character/138137/Misumi-Makoto). 

His origins and original name are unknown. What is easily ascertained is that he was a brilliant researcher in magic knowledge. Before his death he possibly came back as a lich or possibly, he turned himself into a lich; when and where is unknown. All that is known is that he’s been a lich for a very long time and with quite the reputation.

name: Beren
description: Beren is an elder dwarf that Makoto Misumi met and is currently one of the blacksmiths of Asora and the Kuzunoha Company.

name: Sif Rembrandt
description: Sif Rembrandt is the older daughter of Patrick & Lisa Rembrandt, and she is a student of Rotsgard Academy. She was afflicted with a deadly Level 8 Curse, along with her mother and younger sister.

name: Eva
description: Eva is one of the survivors of the fallen Kingdom of Kaleneon. She is now acting as the ruler of the newly formed government of liberated kingdom

name: Abelia Hoperaise
native: アベリア・ホープレイズ
description: Abelia is a student of Makoto Misumi in the Rotsgard Academy. After graduating, she is planning to work at the Kuzunoha Company and training as a spy.

name: Sui
description: Sui is a slime that Mukoda took as his second familiar. At the time when he got as a familiar, Sui was just a baby slime but evolved on the third day.

appearsIn.title: Campfire Cooking in Another World with my Absurd Skill
Campfire Cooking in Another World with My Absurd Skill

name: Tsuyoshi  Mukouda
description:
A salaryman summoned from modern Japan. He possesses the unique skill, "Online Supermarket", which allows him to buy goods from modern Japan any time, any place. The food he buys with his skill has buffing effects, making anyone who eats it become much stronger than before. He is very good at cooking, but is a coward by nature.

Mukouda was first seen wearing a suit and tie, a huge difference from his co-summoned heroes which were wearing school uniforms. After selling his former clothes, he now wears a dark green shirt with long sleeves that he usually kept folded when he cooks.

appearsIn.title: Campfire Cooking in Another World with my Absurd Skill
Campfire Cooking in Another World with My Absurd Skill

name: Fel
description:
__Level:__ 906
__Race:__ Fenrir

Fel is a Fenrir who is considered a legendary magical beast, one of the descendants of the Goddess of the Wind, Ninrir.

Formed a contract with Mukouda and became his first familiar due to his great interest in his cooking. Fel absolutely hates vegetables and prefers to eat meat.

Campfire Cooking in Another World with My Absurd Skill

description: Ninrir is the Goddess of Wind and the Fenrirs are her descendants. She gave Mukouda her blessing in order to extort offerings from him. She's weak to otherworld sweets, especially dorayaki.

Campfire Cooking in Another World with My Absurd Skill

description: Agni is the Goddess of Fire. She gave Mukouda her blessing so that she could get offerings from him. Agni likes otherworld alcohol, especially beer.

Campfire Cooking in Another World with My Absurd Skill

name: Kisharle
description: Kisharle is the Goddess of Earth. She gave Mukouda her blessing so she could receive his offerings. She's entranced by the effects of the otherworld's beauty products.

appearsIn.title: Campfire Cooking in Another World with my Absurd Skill
Campfire Cooking in Another World with My Absurd Skill

name: Rusalka
description: Rusalka is the Goddess of Water. She gave Mukouda's familiar, Sui, her blessing so that she could receive offerings from Mukouda. She absolutely loves eating food from the otherworld.

appearsIn.title: Campfire Cooking in Another World with my Absurd Skill
Campfire Cooking in Another World with My Absurd Skill

name: Mutsu
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm (5' 2")

Mutsu is the merchant fleet Kaientai's 2nd in Command, but is de facto the one running the company. This is because her "natural idiot" leader Sakamoto Tatsuma is always going MIA (missing in action). Things once got to the extent that she had to install a homing device in his pistol so that when he fired it, the homing device would indicate her to his whereabouts.

name: Taizou Hasegawa
description:
__Height:__ 179 cm 

Hasegawa used to be an official working for the Bakufu, but after an unfortunate incident with Amanto dignitary [Prince Hata](https://anilist.co/character/7929/Hata-Ouji), whom he was assigned to serve and protect, his superior asked him to succumb to his shame and commit seppuku, hearing that he ran away from his quarters.

He initially believed that humans should focus on appeasing the Amanto, but after his encounter with [Gintoki](https://anilist.co/character/672/Sakata-Gintoki), his mindset changed, which led to him punching Hata out, thus getting fired. Since then, he has been living a life of somewhat like a loser, getting fired almost every time he gets a new job, mostly due to the unfavourable look his sunglasses and goatee give him.

No matter what, he refuses to remove his sunglasses because it's the only thing he had left to remind him of his successful past. Although he does exchange the sunglasses for a decent pair of half-moon spectacles at one point, he goes back to wearing them after he decides that he is going to live out his life in the best way he can. He is constantly seen working various part-time jobs. He is often referred to as "Madao," short for "marude damena ossan," which roughly translates into "totally useless middle-aged man."

name: Zenzou Hattori
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm

A highly skilled ninja who sports a light-brown/dark-blonde mop-top and a goatee. He is first introduced in episode 37 when he and [Gintoki](https://anilist.co/character/672/Sakata-Gintoki) attempt to fight to the death over the last remaining issue of the Christmas Double Issue Jump, which in fact, was actually the Christmas Double Issue AKAMARU Jump. (in fact, he first appeared in episode 36 as the conman dreamcatcher's assistant). Apparently, he used to be from the Oniwabanshu too, and is acquainted with [Ayame](https://anilist.co/character/1759/Sarutobi-Ayame). He is the first ninja in the series to apparently equal Gintoki's skill and obsessive devotion to Jump. He apparently suffers from hemorrhoids. He commands a freelance ninja team known as the "Shinobi 5." His father is said to be the strongest man in the Oniwanbanshu, and an instructor to many of his peers, including Ayame Sarutobi. 

His name is roughly based on a famous ninja from Iga, Hattori Hanzō.

name: Matako Kijima
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm

Matako Kijima is the only female member of the Kiheitai and is skilled in using a pair of pistols. She is fiercely loyal to [Shinsuke Takasugi](https://anilist.co/character/2948), and appears to have a crush on him.



Her name is roughly based on a samurai of the Bakumatsu era, Kijima Matabei.

name: Katakuriko Matsudaira
description:
**Height:** 168 cm

A high-ranking government officer under direct control of the Bakufu government, Police Superintendent Matsudaira Katakuriko is in charge of the Shinsengumi and the immediate superior of Commander Kondo Isao.

He has extremely violent tendencies, often seen wielding a pistol, or occasionally heavier weapons. He also believes that people who wear sunglasses are usually assassins, even though he himself wears them. He earned the nickname of 'God of Destruction', as his method of solving problems is to blow everything up using bazooka, tanks etc.

He believes in other abnormal things such as righteousness is what makes up 80% of old men and the police being not more than a group of mafia community.  He is also extremely protective of his daughter, Kuriko, recruiting the Shinsengumi to carry out a hit against his daughter's boyfriend.   He is a party-person who gets lewd when he is drunk, he frequently accompanies the shogun Tokugawa Shigshige on his outings or rather as Gintoki said, he tends to bring the shogun to all sorts of seedy places, under the pre-text of being a 'father figure' to the young shogun.

Womanizer, always frequenting hostess/cabaret clubs, a VIP customer at 'Snack Smile', where Otae works. His name and role are based on the Matsudaira Katamori.

name: Hatsu Hasegawa
description: Daughter of a well-connected Bakufu official's family, Hasegawa Taizou 長谷川 泰三, who was from a poorer samurai needed family, married into her family.  Willing to humble herself for her husband's sake, she knelt to beg for forgiveness on her husband's behalf (for dressing inappropriately to work) at his superior's house, even though the superior is of lower social rank than her own family.

name: Sinbad
description:
__Height:__ 183cm 

He is the king of Sindria and the leader of the Alliance of the Seven Seas. He was 14 years old when he first captured a dungeon, the first dungeon "Bael". Since then, he had sailed the seven seas and captured seven dungeons. He is known as the "Legendary Dungeon Capturer" being the master of seven djinn. He is also commonly known as "High King of Seven Seas". His nickname is Sin. His name is based on "Sinbad the Sailor".  He met Aladdin and his friends when he was in Balbadd, trying to reopen trade.

name: Hinahoho
description:
Height: 240cm  
Likes: taking care of children  
Weakness: heat (because of where he was born)   

Hinahoho is one of the eight generals.

name: Ja'far
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm  
__Likes:__ Working  
__Weakness:__ Easily angered 
__Birthplace:__ Unknown 
__Special skill__: Assassination   

One of the eight generals, he uses the weapon household's vessel "Balalark Sei." His loyalty towards [Sinbad](https://anilist.co/character/42528/Sinbad) is so high that he'll approach anyone who insults him with murderous intent. When Sinbad does things as he pleases, Ja'far worries endlessly and sometimes even feels faint.

Ja'far usually only wears official clothing as he only has one set of normal clothing he received from Sinbad when he was 14 years old.

His name is based on the "Harun al-Rashid's" Persian vizier "Ja'far ibn Yahya" also known as "Ja'far al-Barmaki" which is one of the real people (not a fictional character) in "One Thousand and One Nights" stories. He appears in many stories in the "One Thousand and One Nights" series.

name: Yunan
description: Yunan is one of the four Magi in the current era. It is revealed that he is the one who raised the first dungeon, Baal, 14 years before the start of the story.   His name is based from the King Yunan, a fictional king of one of the ancient Persian cities, in the province of Zuman, now modern Azerbaijan who appears in The "tale of the vizier and the Sage Duban", one of the "One Thousand and One Nights" stories.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Pisti
description:
Height: 140cm
Likes: singing

One of the eight generals. Due to her looks, she has complicated feelings towards sexy girls. Her only female friend is Yamuraiha. Although she is good at pretending to cry, she says it no longer works on Ja'far. Her household vessel is a flute, which allows her to communicate with animals.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Rashid Saluja
description: Balbadd's previous king and father of Alibaba, Abhmad and Sabhmad. Also he had close connections with Sinbad as he taught him a lot of things.

name: Scheherazade
description: Scheherazade is one of the four Magi in the current era. It is revealed she has lived for over 200 years supporting the Reim Empire as a great priest.   Her name is based from the Persian queen, Scheherazade who tells her stories to King Shahryar in "One Thousand and One Nights" stories.

name: Gyokuen Ren
description: Gyokuen Ren is the wife of the former Emperor of the Kou Empire.

name: Sasaki
description:
__Occupation:__ Office Worker

A tired middle-aged corporate slave. His daily relaxation comes from cigarettes and Yamada's cheerful hospitality.

appearsIn.title: Smoking Behind the Supermarket with You
Smoking Behind the Supermarket with You

description: Yamada is an employee of the supermarket known as Super S. She initially started in a part-time position 8 years ago as a teenager.

__Occupation:__ The manager of Super S.

Smoking Behind the Supermarket with You

description: Head of the produce department at Super S. He greatly respects [Goutou](https://anilist.co/character/307811/Gotou) and works hard every day to become someone she can rely on among the staff.

description: Head cashier at Super S. She has an energetic personality and loves fun things. She nicknames [Sasaki](https://anilist.co/character/281763/Sasaki) as [Yamada](https://anilist.co/character/281764/Yamada) Fan #28.
