description: He is Sasaki's co-worker.

appearsIn.title: Smoking Behind the Supermarket with You
Smoking Behind the Supermarket with You

name: Karen Kino
description: She is a member of the mass media club at Shuchi'in Academy.

name: Terashima
description: She's a third-year high school student at Shuchi'in Academy and a member of the Tabletop Gaming Club which Chika Fujiwara is also a part of. Terashima, being demoted from Terako to Gigako, is a pun on metric prefixes

name: Koromo Shiranui
description: Koromo Shiranui is a supporting character in the series. She is a first year student at Shuchi'in Academy and one of The Impossible Girls.

name: Saburou Toyosaki
description: In the past, he used underhanded tactics to sabotage [Shirogane](https://anilist.co/character/121101/)'s grades, but he now fights fair and square. He only opens his eyes when he shows his "true power."

name: Chtholly Nota Seniorious
native: クトリ・ノタ・セニオリス
description:
She describes herself as "responsible and mature." Chtholly is a Leprechaun Fairy Soldier who lives at the Fairy Warehouse on Sky Island 68. She is the oldest fairy of her generation and she is also the wielder of the strongest sword of the Emnetwiht race, Seniorious. As the oldest fairy of the warehouse, she tries to be a good example for the little ones, she even avoids eating sweets in front of the little ones because she thought it was childish to do so.

She's not very honest with herself.

appearsIn.title: WorldEnd: What are you doing at the end of the world? Are you busy? Will you save us?

name: Ithea Myse Valgulious
native: アイセア・マイゼ・ヴァルガリス
description:
Ithea is a Leprechaun that has her hair styled like cat ears. She has a happy-go-lucky personalty, and often jokes that Willem only likes girls of her age. She is one of the main characters in Suka Suka and is a supporting character in Suka Moka. 

(Source: SukaSuka Wiki)

appearsIn.title: WorldEnd: What are you doing at the end of the world? Are you busy? Will you save us?

name: Willem Kmetsch
description:
Originally an orphan, he started training with a weapon at 11 in order to become a Brave. A jack of all trades, he exceeded in a myriad of techniques - earning him the title of  "strongest" Quasi Brave. After an hard fight, several curses caused by his techniques hit back, resulting in his 16 year old body being petrified in a frozen lake for 525 years.

When the events take place, he has been freed from the ice for two years with a deeply broken body caused by the petrification.

By the help of his boggard friend [Grick](https://anilist.co/character/163065/Graycrack-Grick), he becomes the caretaker over a military base run jointly by the Guarding Wings Military and the Orlandry Merchant Guild, where they keep special weapons - the Leprechauns.

appearsIn.title: WorldEnd: What are you doing at the end of the world? Are you busy? Will you save us?

name: Nopht Keh Desperatio
native: ノフト・ケー・デスペラティオ
description:
Nopht Keh Desperatio is one of the fairies who live at the Fairy Warehouse. She is one of the main characters in Suka Suka and is a supporting character in Suka Moka.

She was 14 during the events of Suka Suka and was originally assigned to the Surface Artifacts Recovery Team along with Rhantolk Ytri Historia.This lasted until the Battle of Gomag, where she lost her Dug Weapon, 'Desperatio,' after Chtholly Nota Seniorious took it for her final stand-off against the Timere.

(Source: SukaSuka Wiki)

appearsIn.title: WorldEnd: What are you doing at the end of the world? Are you busy? Will you save us?

name: Nephren Ruq Insania
native: ネフレン・ルク・インサニア
description:
Nephren is a quiet Leprechaun, who almost never shows her emotions. Despite this, she cares a lot about her friends, and tries to support them as best as she can, especially Willem. Nephren cares a lot for Willem because she thinks he is the same as her. While she was having a conversation with Nygglatho, she described her feeling for Willem as: "I don’t want him to break down. So I’ll try my best to stay by his side and support him."

(Source: SukaSuka Wiki)

appearsIn.title: WorldEnd: What are you doing at the end of the world? Are you busy? Will you save us?

name: Rhantolk   Ytri Historia
native: ラーントルク・イツリ・ヒストリア
description:
__Age__: 14

She is one of five full-grown fairy weapons stationed in the Fairy Warehouse. Alongside Ctholly, Nephren, and Ithea, she is classified as Grade A Fairy Weapon. She wields the Dug Weapon Historia.

appearsIn.title: WorldEnd: What are you doing at the end of the world? Are you busy? Will you save us?

name: Souwong Kandel
description:
The creator to Sky Islands and the advisor to Guardian Wings Military. He is a "Barrowwiht", a race of immortal undead. He had lived for 539 years. He has the appearance of a 83 years old man



His young self is voiced by [Mutsumi Tamura](https://anilist.co/staff/105013/Mutsumi-Tamura)

appearsIn.title: WorldEnd: What are you doing at the end of the world? Are you busy? Will you save us?

native: エルク・ハルクステン
description: A young girl with a mysterious mental connection to Chtholly.

description: A magical girl who wished for a cheesecake that her mother would think was the best. Nagisa is usually rather childish, serving as the plucky and cheerful comic relief of the group, though she's shown to be more perceptive than she seems. She tends to speak rather eloquently. She fights with a trumpet horn that can shoot bubbles powerful enough to put cracks in a witch's barrier.

Kazuko is Madoka's class teacher. Her relationships with guys don't last very long, and so she's extremely frustrated in these regards. Many of her classes involve her complaining about men. She also seems to be a friend of Junko Kaname, Madoka's mother.   

(Source: Official Production Notes & Puella Magi Wikia)

description: Nakazawa is rare among Madoka's classmates in that his family name is known. However, his given name is unknown. He answered Ms. Saotome's question about whether he prefers hard-boiled or soft-boiled eggs.  Source : Puella-Magi Wiki

name: Yaritsukai
description:
Spearman is a silver-ranked adventurer based in the frontier. He is the partner of Witch. As a silver ranked adventurer, the third highest rank attainable, he induces the respect of his fellow adventurers, especially newbies, who look up to him.

He has brown spiky hair, and has light red earrings matching the color of his eyes. He wears a resplendent blue armor and is equipped with his singature weapon, a spear.
Extremely confident in his abilities, he is keen on trying to impress other people in the Adventurer's Guild by boasting about his skills, and he can be often seen doing so at the desk in front of Guild Girl.

name: Taishou
description: Taishou is the leader of the six gold-ranked adventurers renowned for defeating the Demon Lord ten years ago.

name: Shoujo Fujutsushi
description:
__Age:__ +20
__Race:__ Rhea
__Job:__ Adventurer
__Rank:__ Bronze
__Affiliation:__ Adventurer's Guild - Heavy Warrior's Party

Druid Girl has a kind disposition and is friendly towards others. She tries to give advice to newer adventurers when given the chance.

name: Reijou Kenshi
description:
Noble Fencer took up adverturing to become independent from her family. She was prideful, expecting to rise to Gold and even Platinum rank within a short period of time; and looked down upon goblins. However, her traumatizing ordeal with them crushed her into becoming a brooding woman fixated on killing the goblin paladin and retrieving her stolen family sword. After accomplishing those goals with the aid of Goblin Slayer's party, she is able to overcome her rage and move on.

Now known as Female Merchant, she retires from adventuring and becomes a successful merchant and advisor to The King regarding management of adventurer affairs. She is friends with Priestess and respects Goblin Slayer for saving her life.

Female Merchant has honey-colored hair and wears fancy clothing reflective of her status as nobility. She currently wears her hair in a short bob; having cut her pigtails off after surviving her ordeal with goblins. Female Merchant carries two weapons: an ancient aluminum rapier that is a family heirloom, and an aluminum dagger meant to aid in defense. Learned as part of a family tradition, she can also use magic to cast lightning bolts.

name: Tokage Souryo
description:
A lizardman adventurer who forms a party with High Elf Archer and Dwarf Shaman. They later team up with Goblin Slayer and Priestess. His rank is silver, the third highest rank.
Calm and composed, he speaks to people politely and adresses them in a respectful manner. He seems to be the most soft-spoken, even-tempered, and sociable member of the party.

Lizard Priest has green skin and horns on his head. His intimidating visage and towering stature makes him come off as unnerving, even to his friends. He wears what is presumed to be the traditional garb among priests in his people. 

Lizard Priest is a skilled close quarters combatant, proficient with his curved blades. By using a catalyst, he is able to summon a Dragon-Tooth Warrior, a bipedal draconian skeleton, as an ally. In addition, he is capable of using healing magic to a degree.

When he tries out cheese, he instantly becomes enamored with the taste, and  often calls it "sweet nectar" or "the nectar of the gods", since he finds it extremely exotic as his people do not practice the art of raising livestock.

name: Hideyoshi Kinoshita
description:
Hideyoshi Kinoshita is a class 2-F student in Fumizuki Academy. A classmate of [Akihisa](https://anilist.co/character/27362/Yoshii-Akihisa) since 1st grade. Hideyoshi is the fraternal twin of [Yuuko Kinoshita](https://anilist.co/character/29562/Kinoshita-Yuuko), class ambassador for Class 2-A. He is also a member of the Drama Club. He is one of the most famous characters in the series and in the manga, particularly due to his gender neutrality.

Unlike the rest of Class F, Hideyoshi is relatively calm and normal. Hideyoshi remains stoic at most times, but there are times when Hideyoshi loses his calm demeanor. When mistaken for a girl, Hideyoshi will correct them and states he is male. Despite this, Hideyoshi usually ends up wearing female costumes in the Drama Club. His passion for the Drama Club seems to be the reason behind him being in Class F, due to his focus on the former.

appearsIn.title: Baka and Test - Summon the Beasts

name: Akihisa Yoshii
description:
__Height:__ 177 cm

Although Akihisa denies it, he is a rarely found 'fool' who even his own parents call him as "the fool over all the world." Not only are his grades the lowest, but he's really so stupid that he is titled the "Kansatsu Shobunsha (under observation)" from the school. For him his own safety is the most important thing and does not hesitate to use the most cowardly ways if needed, in circumstances where his harm is unnecessary.   However he also has a righteous heart that can stand up against for other friends (except [Yuuji](https://anilist.co/character/29607/Sakamoto-Yuuji)). Even going as far as selflessly putting himself in harms way to help others, with no significant gain in sight for himself. Though shown he can have a perverted/active side, he's usually peaceful, gentle, kind and quiet towards those around him, which gains him certain popularity.

appearsIn.title: Baka and Test - Summon the Beasts

name: Mizuki Himeji
description:
__Height:__ 164 cm  

2nd Grade highschool student in Fumizuki Gakuen. 

She's in the same F-class along with [Akihisa](https://anilist.co/character/27362/Yoshii-Akihisa) and friends, but actually she is ranked 2nd from the whole school in academics. She came to the F-class because she exited the room midway during the class division examinations- resulting in a zero score. 

She was Akihisa's first love since long ago when they were in elementary school, but never noticed until recently when he pleaded for her during the class division examinations. But why she likes Akihisa is the greatest mystery of the 21st century. It seems it has something to do with the rabbit-shaped hair decoration she likes. After the incident she tried several times to confess to Akihisa, but due to unfortunate circumstances she did not succeed. But when she is drunk or her emotions are stirred, her actions can cross the line.

She is very smart but because of her innocent character, she believes in others' words too easily. She also does not have any love experience; and although she knows Akihisa is trying his best for her, she thinks it's just because he is kind.

appearsIn.title: Baka and Test - Summon the Beasts

name: Minami Shimada
description:
__Height:__ 166 cm  

2nd year highschool student in Fumizuki Gakuen. In Class F. Classmates with Akihisa from 1st grade. Born in Germany, she returned to Japan. She is strong and wild; according to herself, her hobby is "beating up Akihisa" and really does hit him all the time for whatever reason, but it's just a reverse way of displaying her special feelings to him. The so-called 'tsundere'. Whenever Akihisa's up to do anything useless, she restricts him with excessive violence; and for this reason, Akihisa takes her as his natural enemy.  She is taking the rumor of Akihisa liking a boy quite seriously (the same applies to Mizuki), she shows opposition to Hideyoshi or Yuuji as well, but does not notice her real rival Mizuki, and Akihisa's ever-growing friendliness to her. 

Her parents are almost always out for work and she is mostly alone, and thanks to this she is good at cooking. But after she finds out Akihisa's cooking skills, she lost her confidence a bit. She likes collecting rag dolls.

appearsIn.title: Baka and Test - Summon the Beasts

name: Kouta Tsuchiya
description:
__Height:__ 162 cm

2nd Grade highschool student in Fumizuki Gakuen. In Class F. Friends with Akihisa since grade 1.   Because of his silent and serene nature he is not often noticed, but for his perverted heart and how he is always trying to hide it, he was nicknamed "Muttsurini (parody of Mussolini, also said to be the shortened form of Muttsuri Sukebe (Reticent Pervert)".  His grades are as low as Akihisa (but just a bit higher than him), but his knowledge of sex is unusually broad. However in reality he lacks boldness so much that spouts out nosebleed just by imagining in his head. And in such cases he bleeds so much that requires several packs of blood to maintain vitality.  He also excels in Health and Physical Education subjects.

appearsIn.title: Baka and Test - Summon the Beasts

name: Yuuji Sakamoto
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm (5'11")

Yuuji Sakamoto is the class representative of class F. In the series, the class rep position is assigned to the smartest student of that class. He is cool, collected, and exhibit surprisingly high intelligence and foresight unexpected of a student from class F. In volume 1, his strategies and tactics had helped class F to attain victory after victory, until the duels with class A in which he overestimated his ability in elementary school level Japanese history. Yuuji was once known as a child prodigy in his childhood. The only reason why he ended up in class F was because he did not study at all and he holds the strong belief that grades are not everything. However, due to the consequences he 'suffered' from his defeat from [Shouko Kirishima](https://anilist.co/character/29560/Kirishima-Shouko), his childhood friend and also the top student of his level, he became motivated to study again, and in the later volumes, his Shoukanjuu became reasonably strong in just a few months due to his test scores improving by leaps and bounds. It is implied that he is actually smarter than his childhood friend, Shouko. After the tournament in volume 2, he acquired a platinum bracelet which allows him to control the size of the force field of his Shoukanjuu, allowing him to form a one-man army choke point since humans cannot pass through this force field.

appearsIn.title: Baka and Test - Summon the Beasts

name: Shouko Kirishima
description:
Shouko Kirishima is the childhood friend of [Yuuji Sakamoto](https://anilist.co/character/29607/Sakamoto-Yuuji). She is the top student in her level and the class representative for class A.

In the story, she is portrayed as a soft-spoken, but highly assertive and intelligent girl. In the novel, her dialog always starts with ellipses. She is described as elegantly beautiful and very popular like a typical Yamato Nadeshiko, but yet has no boyfriend, which initially created the impression to others that she is a lesbian. Later, it was revealed that the reason for this is because she is crazily infatuated with Yuuji since childhood and acts possessively towards him, to the point of frequently poking out his eyes in order to prevent him from seeing other girls' underwear, applying locks and chains while they are together, using a hand-held taser if he is being 'unfaithful' to her, and even attempted to submit a marriage certificate to the civil registrar (but fails in the anime due to them being underage). Despite being tricked multiple times, she still shows a trusting nature towards Yuuji and practically believes everything he says.

Shouko is also shown to be someone who is a very long-term thinker, and has already decided on her children's names (Shoyu for a girl, and Kosho for a boy).

appearsIn.title: Baka and Test - Summon the Beasts

name: Aiko Kudou
description: She is an A class student and is especially good in health.  In episode 2, she fights against Kouta and loses. She also likes to pick on Kouta's ability to handle girls by talking about her underwear and bra. She does this in episode 19 when the summoners avatars are saying their secrets. She also abused this in episode 16, which was easy for her to do because she was swimming at the beach with the rest of the main characters.

appearsIn.title: Baka and Test - Summon the Beasts

name: Hiromi Nakabayashi
description: The class representative for class 2-E. Her Shoukanjuu appeared as a baseball player. Has an overconfident personality.

appearsIn.title: Baka and Test - Summon the Beasts

name: Yuuko Kinoshita
description: Hideyoshi's sister and a member of class A. She beat Shimada in math in episode 2. Her summoned being wears knight armor and it uses a Lance as its main weapon.

appearsIn.title: Baka and Test - Summon the Beasts

name: Hotaru Shidare
description:
__Height:__ 162 cm (5'3")

A girl from the city whose father owns a world famous sweets company. Since she will one day inherit the company, she desires to make it the best sweets company in the world. She is often amazed by [Kokonotsu](https://anilist.co/character/89168/Shikada-Kokonotsu)'s uncanny ability to create and design the perfect sweets without even trying.

Hotaru came to the sweets shop to hire Kokonotsu's father who is actually very well-known. However when he refused, she found out he would not leave until Kokonotsu was guaranteed to take his place as head of the store. She was horrified when she discovered Kokonotsu's natural talent would go to waste so she struck a bargain with his father: if she could convince Kokonotsu to become the head of the store, then his father would immediately join her father's company.

name: Kokonotsu Shikada
description: He is an aspiring mangaka, who also happens to be the son of a once famous confectionery maker who now runs a lowly candy shop which was also been owned by his family for generations. He is always being pestered by his father to take over the business, much to his annoyance. During his spare time he would hang-out at Edo Cafe and chat with his childhood friends, [Tou](https://anilist.co/character/89171/Endou-Tou) or [Saya](https://anilist.co/character/89170/Endou-Saya).

name: Saya Endou
description:
[Kokonotsu](https://anilist.co/character/89168/Shikada-Kokonotsu)'s classmate who runs a nearby cafe. She has a crush on Kokonotsu. At first alarmed by [Hotaru](https://anilist.co/character/89119/Shidare-Hotaru)'s presence, she quickly befriends her for their goals are aligned: Hotaru wishes Kokonotsu to run the store while she wants him to keep staying in town.

Saya has a hidden talent of toy mastery. At one point she defeats well prepared Hotaru at a Menko game, an event that leads Hotaru to start addressing her with suffix shi, an antiquated designation used by disciples to their masters.

She is the younger twin sister of [Tou](https://anilist.co/character/89171/Endou-Tou).

name: Tou Endou
description: Older twin brother of [Saya](https://anilist.co/character/89170/Endou-Saya) and a good friend of [Kokonotsu](https://anilist.co/character/89168/Shikada-Kokonotsu). A laid back person who usually wears Hawaiian shirt and sunglasses. He and Saya run a cafe named "Cafe Endō".

name: You Shikada
description: [Kokonotsu](https://anilist.co/character/89168/Shikada-Kokonotsu)'s father as well as the current owner of Shikada store. He is desperate to make his son 9th head of the shop so that his legacy will continue. He agrees to [Hotaru](https://anilist.co/character/89119/Shidare-Hotaru)'s bargain that if she can convince his son to be the next head of his shop, he would become part of Hotaru's company.

name: Freida
description: She is the [guildmaster](https://anilist.co/character/126540)'s granddaughter. She is 1 year older than [Myne](https://anilist.co/character/126156) and has the same health condition as her but not to the same extent. According to the rumors she is the one kid amongst all the guildmaster's grandkids who's the most like him. She has cherry-blossom hair and light brown eyes.

name: Corinna
description: [Otto](https://anilist.co/character/126534)'s wife. She’s a seamstress famous for her excellent skills. She has pale, cream-colored hair and gray eyes.

name: Leise
description: She is the house cook for [the guildmaster](https://anilist.co/character/126540) of the merchant’s guild. She used to work for a noble house. She has orange-red hair and bright green eyes.

Myne's father. He has blue hair and light brown eyes. He works as a soldier, currently a guard at the South Gate of the city of Ehrenfest.

name: Gustav
description: He is the proprietor of the Othmar Company and the manager of the Merchant's Guild, an institution of the city of Ehrenfest that serves as a department of commerce and a bank. He and [Benno](https://anilist.co/character/126537) don't get along well. He really dotes on his granddaughter [Freida](https://anilist.co/character/126541). He has gray hair and light orange eyes.

He is a blue priest who serves as the High Priest of the temple of the city of Ehrenfest. He is tall and slender, he has light blue hair that reaches down towards his shoulders and pale golden eyes. People frequently mistake him by being older than he really is.

name: Lihanna Owenzaus
native: リアーナ・オーウェンザウス
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm (5'2")

Born to the knight family of Owenzaus. Her abilities have made her the best in her year and earned her the nickname of "Miss Perfect." She specializes in thunder magic.

name: Julius Reinburg
native: ユリウス・レインバーグ
description:
__Height:__ 174 cm (5'9")

An ice mage and one of the top three students in Will's year. He is a typical noble, with pride and self-assurance to spare. Since the incident at the magic festival, he has been forced to work at Gina's bar.

name: Rosti Naumann
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7")

A skilled magical artificer and Will's roommate. His boundless affection for Will is enough to make Colette nervous. While lacking any natural gift for artificing, he has become a great talent and often devises various magical items under the pretense of making them for Will.

name: Workner Norgram
native: ワークナー・ノーグラム
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm (5'10)

Professor of Magizoology. As one of the few people who understands Will, he always worries when Will pushes himself too hard. Though he tends to show his love for his students by being strict with them, this has made him an object of terror at the academy. He has earned various nicknames, including "Remedial Teacher from Hell," "Four-Eyed Fiend," "Magical Creature Nut," and "Immortal Workner," and is feared by friend and foe alike.

name: Yoruichi Shihouin
description:
__Height:__ 156 cm (5'1")
__Previous Position:__ 
__Partner:__ [Kisuke Urahara](https://anilist.co/character/210)

Yoruichi Shihouin is an attractive, dark-skinned woman who can transform into a black cat for long periods of time. She is intelligent and witty, and is intimately knowledgeable of Soul Society and its workings, as she was the former leader of the special forces. Although of noble birth, she acts differently from other nobles. For instance, she instructed [Soifon](https://anilist.co/character/905) to refer to her without using honorific suffixes. She also transforms into her human form directly in front of [Ichigo](https://anilist.co/character/5) on several occasions just to see his reaction to seeing her naked.  

Yoruichi tends to avoid battles, preferring to help after a fight is over, but she will step in if she thinks her side cannot win. She was responsible for training [Chad](https://anilist.co/character/575) and [Orihime](https://anilist.co/character/7) prior to their entrance into Soul Society. She also supervised Ichigo Kurosaki's final release training using the methods developed by Kisuke Urahara.

appearsIn.title: BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War - The Conflict
BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War - The Calamity

name: Ganju Shiba
description: An outrageous figure, Ganju wears a vest, scarf, bandana, and pair of goggles. He is often found with his gang, who all ride large boars. Ganju's boar is named Bonnie (affectionately referred to as Bonnie-chan). The omake sketch after episode 114 implies that Bonnie was accidentally cooked into a stew by Retsu Unohana during a friendly cookout including her, Ganju, and a few others from the 4th Division. Similar sketches have occurred in the series, but Bonnie is always shown alive and well by the next episode. Ganju possesses a deep hatred for shinigami, a hot temper, and a strong ego. Though he always acts tough, he has shown that he also has a softer side, easily being cowed by his older sister Kūkaku, and later develops an understanding to Ichigo Kurosaki with a relationship similar to Ichigo and Renji Abarai's. The fact that he is not particularly attractive is a running joke in the series, and rather than deny this fact he tends to talk around the subject, especially when Yumichika Ayasegawa makes note of it.    Because of his brother's, Kaien Shiba, death at the hands of Rukia Kuchiki when he was still young, Ganju holds a grudge against all shinigami. This grudge is slow to dissipate even after he learns the truth of the incident. It is implied that after Kaien and his wife Miyako's death, the Shiba clan lost its status as one of the Noble Clans (which include the Kuchiki and Shihouin clans).

description: A second-year student in class D. A bright, positive, and excellent student, she has been given details about [Ayanokoji](https://anilist.co/character/123212/Ayanokouji-Kiyotaka) by [Tsukishiro](https://anilist.co/character/288362/Tsukishiro-Tokinari), and has information about the White Room and other things that only a select few know.

name: Ken Sudou
description:
__Height:__ 183 cm (6'0")

Ken is apart of Class 1-D and is apart of the Basketball Club. Due to his poor academic ability, he is referred to as one of the 3 Idiots of D-Class. Regardless of this, his athletic ability is without a doubt one of the best among the school. He has a crush on Suzune after receiving help from her. Under the constant supervision of Suzune, he gradually matures and begins to improve academically rising out of the bottom ladder of class and earning her trust.

appearsIn.title: Classroom of the Elite 4th Season: Second Year, First Semester

name: Hakkai Shiba
description:
__Height:__ 183 cm

Vice Captain of the Second Division of the Tokyo Manji Gang. The younger brother of [Yuzuha](https://anilist.co/character/170482/Yuzuha-Shiba) and the younger brother of [Taiju](https://anilist.co/character/167845/Taiju-Shiba), the leader of the 10th Generation Black Dragons.

Hakkai is shown to be a timid but friendly guy. When it comes to his personality he is nothing like his older brother Taiju who is disciplined and bloodlusted.

Hakkai has deep admiration for [Takashi Mitsuya](https://anilist.co/character/167841/Takashi-Mitsuya)

name: Taiju Shiba
description:
__Height:__ 198 cm

The Black Dragon's 10th leader and [Hakkai's](https://anilist.co/character/167842/Hakkai-Shiba) and [Yuzuha's](https://anilist.co/character/170482/Yuzuha-Shiba) elder brother.

Taiju is brutal and abusive. He enjoys tormenting his opponents and has little care for others' wellbeing, even his own siblings'. He doesn't care who his opponent is regardless of gender. He is Catholic and has a cross tattooed on his back.

name: Ryouji Kaji
description: Kaji, while only being a special inspector, secretly works for SEELE investigating NERV's true intentions. During college, he had a serious relationship with [Misato](https://anilist.co/character/1259/Katsuragi-Misato), but after having long broken up, they see each other again on the UN fleet ferrying Unit 02 and its pilot, [Asuka Langley Soryu](https://anilist.co/character/94/Souryuu-Asuka-Langley), to Japan.

name: Lavi
description:
__Height:__ 177cm (5'9")

A cheerful Exorcist of mixed race, who aims to become a Bookman and is working along the Black Order just to be close to the events that must be seen. To help him, he developed an incredible memory: he is able to memorize every single aspect of something he saw.

His anti-Akuma weapon is a size-shifting hammer, which he calls Ouzuchi Kozuchi or Nyoibo. It can grow or extend. The weight increases with its size, but since Lavi is the conformer, the weight does not effect him; however, it does to everyone else. His hammer can also summon several "judgments" with kanji possibly representing the classical elements that can be used individually or combined. However, between some of the seals are question marks. This probably means that Lavi has some seals that he has yet to learn from his Innocence.

name: Yuu Kanda
description:
__Height:__ 177cm (5'9")
 
Amember of the fictional religious organization known as the Black Orde. Kanda is a young and handsome Japanese man usually found in any mood that isn't positive.

Kanda comes across as cold, stoic, and arrogant, even to his fellow exorcists. In battle, he will do anything to win, sometimes at the risk of his teammates. He once made a sarcastic joke about leaving them to die. It is his opinion that exorcists are not saviors. Yu, or Yuu, is Kanda's given name, though he dislikes being called by it or even introducing himself as such. He calls [Allen](https://anilist.co/character/139/Allen-Walker) "bean sprout" (moyashi). Kanda seems to know [Lavi](https://anilist.co/character/779/Lavi), though he doesn't hesitate with his usual threats if Lavi calls Kanda by his given name. However, it is clear that Kanda does care for his fellow Exorcists and the Finders (whom he claims not to care about). He tends to mask his emotions and often claims, "It's none of my business." In spite of his intentions, he and Allen are often at each other's throats and rarely see eye-to-eye on anything.   

Kanda's favorite foods are soba noodles and tempura (especially pumpkin, shishitou [a small, sweet green pepper], and lotus root). Kanda dislikes many things, to the point that "there are too many to write down".

name: Lenalee Lee
description:
__Height:__ 166 cm 
__Nationality:__ Chinese 

[Komui's](https://anilist.co/character/142) younger sister, and assistant Head Officer. 

Her parents were killed by an Akuma when she was very young. Because she is an Accommodator, the Black Order took her away from her only remaining family member (Komui) to Headquarters against her will. For three years she was never allowed to leave the place, which felt like a prison to her. Because she attempted suicide, she had to be restrained and tied to her bed. However, once Komui joined the Black Order, Lenalee became more at ease in the Black Order. She once told Allen that her "world" consists of her friends and family; if something terrible ever happened to them, she would be devastated.  

She is an Exorcist whose anti-Akuma weapon is a pair of boots, "Dark Boots". That, when invoked increases one's speed and strength greatly in the legs. Aside from being able to have great speed, she can also fly with her boots.

 __Manga Spoilers:__

name: Allen Walker
description:
__Height:__ 168-170 cm (5’6”-5'7")   
__Nationality:__ British

Allen is the main hero of the series. He was abandoned by his biological parents because of the supposed "deformity" of his left arm (which was later revealed to be caused by his Innocence). He was eventually found and adopted by a traveling performer named [Mana Walker](https://anilist.co/character/9032/Walker-Mana) on Christmas Day. Some time later Mana died, and Allen, tormented with grief and manipulated by the Millennium Earl, turned Mana into an Akuma, hoping that his beloved surrogate father would be fully resurrected. But the Mana Akuma cursed Allen and sliced through his left eye, leaving the "Pentacle" — the mark of the Akuma — which scars the left side of his face. This enabled his left eye to see the souls trapped within the Akuma from then on. It was at this same moment that Allen's left arm first invoked as an Anti-Akuma weapon, which instinctively destroyed the Mana Akuma. During the course of this traumatic event, Allen's hair turned from brown into a stark white.  

Allen eventually meets [Cross Marian](https://anilist.co/character/2283/Marian-Cross), a General of the Black Order, who explained to Allen the ways of the Akuma and the trapped souls within them: Once a soul becomes trapped inside an Akuma, they are trapped forever; and that the only way to save one is to exorcise them from their Akuma vessel.

name: Lala
description: A doll in the ruin city of Mater, Italy. She continued moving for 500 years after the city fell. She is attached to Guzol, as he was the only human to accept her for what she is.

name: Lero
description: A talking umbrella that belongs to the Earl and the Noah clan. Lero is often used as a toy, by the Noah Road. Lero posesses great magical powers,but he only uses them when the Earl tells him to do so. He transforms into a sword for the Earl to use,the first time the Earl encounters Allen, after Allen's evolution to Crown Clown.    He finishes almost every sentence with the word ''Lero''.

name: Reever Wenhamm
description: In charge of the Science department of the Black Order, therefore he is technically the "boss" of the science department, but still carries out Komui's orders (though he does protest). He is Australian, and 26 years old. He is a rather comical character, being the main helper of Komui, and is often distressed over the fact that he works under such a weird man. His character was included in the game Jump Superstars. His name was translated to Riba in volumes one and two of the English manga. Reever dislikes tobacco and alcohol, instead drinking various soft drinks; he specializes in mathematics, physics and language.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Mana Walker
description:
__Height:__ 188 cm

He appeared early on as a figure deeply connected to the protagonist, [Allen Walker](https://anilist.co/character/139/Allen-Walker).

For Allen, he was the person who taught him the street performance skills that became his livelihood and gave him his name, making him essentially a foster father.

Although the cause remains unknown, his death led Allen to accept an offer from the [Millennium Earl](https://anilist.co/character/858/Sennen-Hakushaku), resulting in the man's soul being summoned back into an Akuma. Allen acquired the pentacle-like mark on the left side of his face because, after transforming into an Akuma, the man struck back and slashed Allen's face just as he was being destroyed by the activation of the Innocence in Allen's left arm.

name: Sennen Hakushaku
description:
A mysterious figure who has been operating from the shadows of human history for over 7,000 years.

He is a sorcerer and humanity's greatest enemy, constantly sowing tragedy and misfortune in a bid to bring about the end of the world, all while using tragedies—and the suffering souls of those affected by them—to manufacture malevolent weapons known as "Akuma."

He is a member of the Noah Family, holding the position of the "First Disciple"—the leader of the group—and is addressed by the other Noah as the "Earl of Millennium."

name: Malcom C. Rouvelier
description: Malcom is a special inspector sent to Headquarters by the Order's administration at the Vatican after General Cross and the other Exorcists return with the Ark. He is a tall man who speaks to intimidate those around him. Malcom is quite critical of General Cross and seems to know much more about the Ark and General Cross than he lets on. Currently he wants Allen tried for heresy as he sees his possible link with the 14th Noah as a liability. He has ordered General Cross to a desk job and has forbidden him from speaking with Allen. He wishes to use the Ark to attack the Earl and is setting in motion plans to find new Exorcists to bolster the Order's power for the coming final battle. Most recently he has decided to forcibly invoke Lenalee's Innocence, guilting her with Komui's joining the Black Order for her sake, despite the fact that it could be disastrous both for the Black Order and Lenalee's life.    He appears in Lenalee's flashbacks to her early time in the order when she sees him. He apparently had something to do with her early days of imprisonment with the Order. Even now when he's around Lenalee becomes stressed and goes to Kanda to calm down the way she did since they were kids. Rouvelier has a toothbrush mustache and is said to make great cakes.    (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Takumi Fujiwara
description:
__Car:__ Toyota Sprinter Trueno GT-APEX (AE86) (color: High Tech two-tone) 
  
Takumi Fujiwara is the son of [Bunta Fujiwara](https://anilist.co/character/2820/Fujiwara-Bunta), the owner of a tofu shop in his hometown Akina. He rarely shows emotion. His best friend is [Itsuki Takeuchi](https://anilist.co/character/7955/Takeuchi-Itsuki), who is a racing fan. Takumi works part-time at a gas station with Itsuki, along with [Iketani](https://anilist.co/character/15003/Iketani-Kouichirou), who is a member of the local racing team, the Akina Speed Stars. 

Takumi has been manipulated subtly by Bunta into developing driving skills, without being fully aware of Bunta's intent. Bunta aside, Takumi's driving technique is the best on Akina; the very fact that he has managed to win races against far more powerful cars with his AE86 Trueno is testament to his driving skills. As a result of constant everyday practice and over 5 years of experience on Akina, Takumi is able to adapt to nearly any situation that presents itself during a race with astonishing speed. One factor in his nearly unparalleled driving skills is his ability to visualize the road in his head, thus making up for the lack of visibility no matter how dark the mountain pass may be. He is an instinctive rather than an intellectual driver. Although the mizutoshi technique is a great but difficult technique that his father taught him, it lead him to many victories through out the story.

name: Keisuke Takahashi
description:
__Car:__ Mazda RX-7 Type R (FD3S) (color: Competition Yellow Mica)  

Keisuke Takahashi is the number two driver for the Red Suns. Keisuke drives FD3S and is a skilled driver, second only to his brother. Keisuke is a rather hot-headed young man and does not like losing. Keisuke is also known to drive with his emotions, for example if he realises that he cannot win his driving suffers and if he is in the lead he is carefree and much relaxed. Before Ryousuke got Keisuke involved in street racing he was the leader of a Bosozoku gang. He joins his brother's new team and has a rivalry with Takumi. Keisuke races the Hillclimb (Uphill) on most races, while Takumi races the downhill. Keisuke isn't analytical like his older brother, and Ryousuke's ability to compute and analyze amazes Keisuke. But at the same time, Keisuke's ability to think less while he is driving, and to do only what he feels amazes Ryosuke. While Ryousuke has decided that he won't race much longer, and that he will become a doctor in the future, Keisuke has dedicated his life to racing, his eventual goal is to become a professional racer. But first he must defeat Takumi. Though visibly getting along, they still have some kind of argumentation over who is the ace, he has respect for Takumi. He stated once he was not as strong minded as Takumi, because Takumi fell asleep really fast before a great battle, making him ask himself if he knew what was pressure.

name: Ryousuke Takahashi
aliases: Ryou Takashi (リョウ・タカハシ)
description:
__Car:__ 1990 Mazda Savanna RX-7 ∞III (FC3S)

He is the leader of the street racers called "Red Suns". One of the most talented and skilled drivers in the Gunma prefecture. The older brother of Takahashi Keisuke, who also drives for Red Suns. To win races he thoroughly analyzes his opponent and the course to come up with an optimal strategy. Has an extraordinary ability to study technical data and set his car up to perform its best.   Has been called "Akagi's White Comet" and is also the founder and manager of "Project D", a street racing team started solely for the purpose of capturing every time attack record in Japan.

name: Hiromichi
description: __Car::__ Nissan Silvia K's (S13)

name: Kouichirou Iketani
description:
__Car:__ Nissan S13 Silvia
__Height:__ 175.3 cm

Iketani is the leader of the Speedstars and drives an S13 Silvia. He has great pride in his racing team and cares for everyone, including some oppenents. He doesn't know how to drift, but he is working on the back-brake-skid. His driving skills are fairly weak and is scared when the car begins to skid. However, he is getting over his scare and is willing to try almost anything to improve his skills.

Iketani is often called "senpai" by [Itsuki](https://anilist.co/character/7955/Takeuchi-Itsuki) and [Takumi](https://anilist.co/character/2819/Fujiwara-Takumi) (because he is older than them and watches out for them most of the time). He also works at the Esso (GS in the anime) gas station with Takumi and Itsuki and loves to talk about cars non-stop! Iketani is one of those guys that are somewhat dense about women (his relationship with Mako) and often jumps to conclusions too early. However, he learns from his mistakes quickly and even under the heaviest pressures, tries to remain calm and collective.

name: Itsuki Takeuchi
description:
__Height:__ 162 cm (5'3")
__Car:__ Toyota Corolla Levin SR (AE85) (color: High Tech White)  

Itsuki is Takumi's best friend and a member of the Akina SpeedStars. Itsuki provides the comic relief in the series, as he is the most enthusiastic of the whole street racing scene. Wanting to be more like Takumi, he accidentally buys an AE85 (Known as Hachi Go, "Eight-Five") Corolla Levin mistaken it for an Hachi-Roku (Eight-Six). This upsets him until Takumi takes him for a drive (ultimately racing it downhill), demonstrating that the driver's skill can make a difference. With a car, he is a self-proclaimed member of the Akina SpeedStars. He eventually purchases a turbocharger for his Hachi-Go.

name: Papa
description: Middle aged man driving a white Mercedes. Has a "sugar daddy" kind of relationship with Natsuki Mogi.

name: Mako Satou
description:
__Car:__ Nissan Sileighty (color: Royal Navy Blue Pearl)

Mako Satou is the driver of the Usui combination; Sayuki is her co-driver/navigator, a combination similar to that found in the WRC. Mako is interested in Iketani of the Akina Speedstars. She originally got close to him in order to race Takumi's AE86 in Usui, offering her virginity in exchange. But she and Iketani had true feelings to each other later on. Unfortunately, a misunderstanding kept them apart.

name: Takebayashi
description: Fuutarou's childhood friend.

name: Juliet Persia
native: ジュリエット・ペルシア
description:
The leader of the 1st Year High School division of the "White Cats". She is the only daughter of the Persia household, a high ranking noble family from the West. Since only males can inherit the rank of nobility, the household is at risk of losing its noble status. This motivates Juliet to become stronger so that her strength and intelligence are no less than that of a man. She initially mistakes [Romio](https://anilist.co/character/128066/Inuzuka-Romio)'s protection of her as pity for being a woman and has been harboring animosity towards him until he confessed his love.

Throughout the series, her feelings towards Romio grow, to the point when she can confidently express her love for him in front of others. Her cooking skill also grows, although she can currently only bake cookies. When going out with Romio publicly, she goes undercover as a "Black Dog" Middle School boy named Julio.

name: Romio Inuzuka
description:
The leader of 1st Year High School division of the "Black Dogs". He has been in love with Juliet since their childhood and has always secretly protected her during the group's war. He is a romantic when it comes to dating Juliet and is often timid when making advances. However, he will always confront problems head-on, especially regarding Juliet or fellow students. Whilst physically strong, he struggles with his studies and is unable to swim.

He is currently a servant under Teria's care whilst aiming to become one of the "Black Dog's" prefects. He is also now the leader of 2nd Year High School division of the "Black Dogs".

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Anne Sieber
description:
The secretary for the White Cats' side of the student council and one of the prefects. A 2nd year student, she is strict and uncompromising, and values hard work and dedication from others. She has a weakness towards things she deems as cute.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Chartreux Westia
native: シャルトリュー・ウェスティア
description:
Persia's childhood friend in the White Cats House. She is one of the people who is aware of Persia's secret romantic relationship with Romio Inuzuka.

Chartreux is quite sadistic, and takes pleasure in using others as tools. She likes using others as a 'play things', in which she orders them around to do activities such as acting like animals. Her sadistic and terrible personality is what gives her the nickname 'The Tyrant Princess of the West'.

Besides her sadistic nature, she also has a burning lust for Persia. While she treats Juliet happily, she treats Inuzuka in a cold manner; not only is she jealous of Persia and Inuzuka's relationship, she also reassures to keep it a secret.

name: Somali Longhaired
native: ソマリ・ロングヘアード
description: A 1st year student, Somali possesses superhuman strength and has a happy-go-lucky attitude. She was bullied by fellow classmates when she was younger together with Aby. As a result, she also sought to become a prefect and takes orders from Aby, no matter how underhanded they are. She cares deeply for Aby and aims to becoming a woman fit for him. She's not as condescending as most other White Cats members are toward the Black Dogs and seems to be aware of the relationship between Romio and Juliet.

name: Airu Inuzuka
description: Head prefect of Black Doggy.

name: Scott Fold
native: スコット・フォールド
description: Juliet's right hand man. A fellow 1st Year, he is in love with Juliet, having apparently been saved by her in the past. As a result, he is often seen stalking Juliet, often tracking her from distance. More recently, he has become a target of Chartreux's sadistic tendencies.

name: Aby Ssinia
description:
A 1st year student and a popular figure within the "White Cats". Initially hailing from a lower status background, he was bullied as a child together with Somali. He aims to become a prefect to prove his worth and earn the admiration of others. To this end, he resorted to underhanded tactics throughout the Sports Festival in order to defeat both Romio and Juliet, whose popularity threatens his goal. He believes he's the only one who can keep up with Somali's antics. He is a currently a servant under Cait's care.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Sayaka Kanamori
description:
[Asakusa](https://anilist.co/character/149676/Asakusa-Midori)’s classmate who is tall and long-legged. Though she has neither interest nor knowledge of anime, she somehow took interest in Asakusa and hangs out with her. Kanamori loves the activity which makes money and she tries to find the way even in small talk. 

After starting up Eizouken, she takes on the role of producer, being the only realist in the team, and proves herself through negotiating with the school and student council. Asakusa and [Mizusaki](https://anilist.co/character/149678/Mizusaki-Tsubame)'s nature of being creators always troubles her though she respects their abilities.

name: Midori Asakusa
description:
Asakusa is a freshman at Shibahama Highschool who likes anime. She is full of curiosity and imagination, yet not that sociable. Her policy is “Anime is all about its setting” and she has kept various settings inspired by her daily life in her sketchbook. 

[Sayaka Kanamori](https://anilist.co/character/149677/Kanamori-Sayaka), Asakusa’s classmate, used to be the only person who knows about Asakusa’s passion, but when they visited Anime Club together they got along with [Tsubame Mizusaki](https://anilist.co/character/149678/Mizusaki-Tsubame), which led them to start up Eizouken. Her goal is to explore her own “Incredible World”.

name: Tsubame Mizusaki
description:
Asakusa’s classmate who is a charismatic amateur model and is famous in the school. She is expected to be an actress in the future as both of her parents are actors, but she actually wants to be an animator and is especially good at capturing motion of characters. 

As Mizusaki has been banned from joining Anime Club by her parents, she joins Eizoken instead and starts to create anime together with Asakusa and Kanamori. She has different sense of money from two of them as she comes from a rich family.

name: Seki
description: Member of the Robot Club in Shibahama High.

name: Kobayashi
description: Member of the Robot Club in Shibahama High.

name: Sowande Sakaki
description: The school council’s secretary. She is better at seeing through the essence of things than the president, and considered as a power broker of the school council. She seems to care about Eizouken which tends to push their ways, but her true intent is unknown.

name: Nakamura
description: A member of the Art Club.

name: Parker Doumeki
description: The only member of Audio Club. She joined the club for the vast numbers of the audio files that are stored in the club, but ended up giving up a part of storage to the student council. Proposed by Eizoken, she accepted to take the role of audio adviser with the condition that she can lodge in their club room.

name: Okamoto
description: A member of the Art Club.

name: Natsuki Shinohara
description: A spirited 18-year-old high school student and a close friend of [Kenji Koiso](https://anilist.co/character/22808/). She invites Kenji to meet her large extended family for her great-grandmother Sakae Jinnouchi's 90th birthday.

name: Sakae Jinnouchi
description: The great-grandmother of [Natsuki](https://anilist.co/character/22809/Shinohara-Natsuki) and indomitable head of the family. Despite her advanced age, she holds the family together. She also has connections in the highest ranks of political and financial circles.

name: Kenji Koiso
description: A math-savvy 17-year-old high school student and a moderator of the interactive computer world OZ along with his close friend Takashi Sakuma. Kenji is less skilled in dealing with people. Kenji is invited by his friend Natsuki Shinohara for Sakae Jinnouchi's 90th birthday. After receiving a cryptic code on his cell phone and cracking it, he becomes a primary suspect for hacking into OZ.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Wabisuke Jinnouchi
description: A handsome and sardonic 41-year-old computer expert and the "first love" of Natsuki.     He is the illegitimate son of Natsuki's grandfather but was adopted by Sakae, whom Wabisuke cares for deeply. Wabisuke had long been estranged from their family and returned after selling off his program to the U.S military. The U.S. military had chosen to test the efficacy of the Love Machine on Oz. When the rest of the family learns of this, they are understandably upset and angry at Wabisuke.

name: Kazuma Ikezawa
description: A 13 year old Oz user and one of Natsuki's cousins.  On Oz, he is known as King Kazma. He is famous on there for being an excellent fighter in the Martial Arts Championship. He refers to Oz's fighting games as not being a game, but a sport. He says that he 'likes the fighting and winning, but not the gaming part.'   He assists in helping Kenji with the fight against Love Machine. When he lost the first battle against Love Machine, many people sent him hate messages for not winning.  His Oz avatar is a white rabbit wearing a red vest, jeans, goggles around the neck, and white and red gloves. Kazuma later on gives his avatar a haircut similar to his except blond to show his dedication to defeating Love Machine.  Kazuma secludes himself in his room most of the time. He used to be very weak before learning Shaolin Kung Fu from his grandfather, whom he refers to as 'master.' He sees Kenji's braveness as an inspiration. Kazuma wears wifebeaters and shorts, and is usually seen with a laptop.

name: Yumi Jinnouchi
description: The 38-year-old wife of Katsuhiko Jinnouchi.

name: Kunihiko Jinnouchi
description: The 42-year-old middle son of Mansaku Jinnouchi. Kunihiko works as a fire sergeant in Suwa's fire department.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Kana Jinnouchi
description: The 2-year-old daughter of Kunihiko Jinnouchi and Nana Jinnouchi.

name: Mariko Jinnouchi
description: The 71-year-old daughter of Sakae Jinnouchi and mother of Riichi Jinnouchi and Rika Jinnouchi. She works as a housewife.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Yuhei Jinnouchi
description: The 7-year-old middle son of Katsuhiko Jinnouchi and Yumi Jinnouchi.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Ayumu Aikawa
description:
__Height__: 175 cm (5'8")

He was murdered by a serial killer and and brought back to life as a zombie by Eucliwood Hellscythe, a Necromancer of the underworld. The Necromancer now resides with him, improving in his combat skills as he attempts to track down the killer who murdered him.

name: Haruna
description:
__Height__: 150 cm (4'11")

A "Masou" Shoujo (pun on the word mahou shoujo meaning magic equipment girl rather than magical girl) from a magic world. She lost her magical powers to Ayumu. She is now a freeloader at Aikawa house. She uses a pink chainsaw as her weapon.

name: Seraphim
description:
__Height__: 173 cm  

 Seraphim, "Sera" for short, is a well-endowed vampire ninja (吸血忍者, Kyūketsu-ninja) who combines her Tsubamegaeshi secret sword technique (秘剣 燕返し, Hiken Tsubamegaeshi?) and ninja reflexes with her vampire powers to fight her enemies. She is able to form a pair of bat wings and a katana out of several leaves.  As a vampire, she periodically requires blood to stay alive, and can anesthetize people with a kiss in order to numb the pain from neck bites. She does this with other girls, since kissing a boy would symbolize marriage in her cult's rules. She comes to Ayumu's house to serve Eucliwood, though when rejected, she ends up being Ayumu's servant in hopes she can change her mind. She is rather cold towards Ayumu, constantly calling him a "piece of shit" (クソ虫, kuso mushi?, lit. "dung beetle"), though has a healthy respect for his combat abilities.

name: Eucliwood Hellscythe
native: ユークリウッド・ヘルサイズ
description:
__Height__: 155 cm 

Eucliwood, also called Eu or Yuu for short, is a necromancer who brought Ayumu back to life to be her guardian and has been living with him since. She wears an armor that suppresses her abilities and doesn't talk because her power can make every word spoken become reality. Instead, she communicates to others by using note pad, which usually pertains to her appetite. Although seemingly emotionless and mute, it is shown that she cares deeply about her friends and other people, even Ayumu though she considers him to be her servant. She does not like the word "death" taken lightly especially since her powers can instantly take a person's life. Ayumu often daydreams about her speaking in a cutesy manner.

name: Yuki Yoshida
description:
__Height__: 168 cm

A vampire ninja from a different faction from Seraphim's who is also a student in Ayumu's high school. Maelstrom is able to use tonkotsu ramen soup to instantly defeat Megalos, though the explanation behind it is too advanced for even her to understand, and has a machine which sprays said soup over the city whenever a horde of Megalos attack. As a result of accidentally kissing Ayumu when he was pushed by Haruna, they are technically declared married by her faction's customs, and she constantly acts like a wife while at school, where she goes under the alias Yuki Yoshida. Because of how this name is written, she is nicknamed "Tomonori" by Orito.

name: Orito
description: Ayumu's classmate. He supposedly has data of all the female students, however, his luck with girls is really bad. Despite that, he continues to act like every single girl wants him.  He is a friend of Kyouko, who he actually sees as a little sister.

name: Kerberos Wansard
native: ケルベロス・ワンサルド
description: Kerberos is the "Watchdog of the Underworld" with the body of a man and the head of a Doberman whose job it is to make sure that all of the souls that enter the Underworld never leave. He is an acquaintance of Eucliwood Hellschythe, and seems to respect and care about her a lot.

name: Kyouko
description:
__Height__: 160 cm
 
Kyoko is a girl who is confined in Furumachi Hospital due to being a victim of the mysterious serial killer. It appears that she was Ayumu's classmate in middle school and also takes a liking to Ayumu, as she often blushes when they speak to each other. In the series so far she is the only survivor of the mysterious serial killings and the only one to have seen the killer.

name: Ariel
description: Haruna's teacher at her magical school, also known as Dai-sensei (大先生 lit. Great Teacher), who has an affinity for Kyoto-style tofu and sends Haruna to get her some due to her credit cards being overcharged. It is unknown what her true motives are.

name: Yoru no Ou
description: He likes penguins.

name: Misaki Takasaki
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3")

A beautiful and popular girl who everyone likes. After hearing [Yukari](https://anilist.co/character/121846)'s confession, Misaki also confess that she likes Yukari but is reluctant to enter a relationship with Yukari due to the government's arranged marriage policy. She became friends with [Ririna Sanada](https://anilist.co/character/121847) after discovering that Ririna is Yukari's marriage partner.

name: Yukari Nejima
description:
__Height:__ 169 cm (5'6")

A shy young man who has less spine than a scarecrow, yet kind and understanding. He first fell in love with [Misaki Takazaki](https://anilist.co/character/121845) after lending her half his eraser and seeing her smile. Yukari however, is forced to be engaged with [Sanada Ririna](https://anilist.co/character/121847) by the government marriage policy after confessing to [Misaki Takazaki](https://anilist.co/character/121845).

name: Ririna Sanada
description:
__Height:__ 152 cm (5'0")

The marriage partner chosen by the government for [Yukari Nejima](https://anilist.co/character/121846/). Ririna is somewhat of a tsundere. She is mostly very blunt and speaks what's on her mind which earned her the nickname Snooty Sanada. She claims to have no special feelings for Yukari and acts as a love cupid for Yukari and [Misaki](https://anilist.co/character/121845). She is very interested in romantic stories and encounters.

name: Yuusuke Nisaka
description:
__Height:__ 171 cm (5'7")

Close friend of [Yukari Nejima](https://anilist.co/character/121846). Yuusuke first met Yukari when an angry guy confronted Yuusuke for "stealing his girlfriend". Yuusuke is portrayed as a cool and handsome young man. He is very popular with the girls and even had a few ex-girlfriends.

name: Shuu Igarashi
description: Misaki's best friend since middle school who seems to know the reason behind Yukari's sudden partner change.

name: Jurgen Sanada
description: [Ririna](https://anilist.co/character/121847/)'s father and [Kaede](https://anilist.co/character/123517/)'s husband.

name: Ayano Katou
description: [Misaki](https://anilist.co/character/121845)'s friend and [Yukari](https://anilist.co/character/121846)'s classmate. Kasugayama High School student.

name: Kagetsu Ichijou
description: A social worker at the Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare. She is responsible for Yukari Nejima's government notice.

name: Motoi Yajima
description: A social worker at the Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare. He manages the Yukari couples alongside his partner, Kagetsu Ichijou. Motoi is currently married, but he's not happy with his partner and hasn't called his wife in two years.

name: Klein Moretti
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm (Debut); 180 cm (Chapter 1268)

Klein Moretti is the main protagonist of Lord of Mysteries. "He" is a Beyonder. "He" is the mysterious leader of the Tarot Club known as The Fool and a Transmigrator who comes from the modern era.

Klein Moretti has exhibited a cautious and good-natured personality. "He" is humorous, polite, mature, and gentlemanly. Fundamentally a lover of justice, "He" will not hesitate to do what is right even at a personal cost. As an ordinary citizen of Earth who transmigrated suddenly into a dangerous world, Klein was naturally a bit fearful and indecisive at first. But during the short span of time following "His" transmigration, Klein experienced a lot of dangerous or tragic situations. "He" even became the leader of a secret organization, killed numerous monsters (even some humans), and finally evolved into a Beyonder. Klein indeed became much more ruthless, confident, and mysterious compared to "His" former mentality. In fact, Klein Moretti became gradually incomparable from the Zhou Mingrui of Earth. "His" experiences notwithstanding, Klein still preserves the core of his personality as one who is cautious, yet will uphold justice where necessary and not involve or target the innocent.

The current transmigrator is like the original Klein, "He" is interested in history and cares about his appearance.

name: Alger Wilson
description: Alger is a Mid Sequence. 7 Beyonder, Seafarer. One of the first members of the Tarot Club.

name: Leonard Mitchell
description: Leonard is a relaxed person who doesn't like rules by nature. He often put his feet on the table and didn't like going to church.

name: Dunn Smith
description:
Dunn Smith looks to be a man in his thirties, with light brown hair, a straight nose, and sharp gray eyes. [Klein Moretti](https://anilist.co/character/192557/Moretti-Klein) described his eyes as "like a lake in an ancient forest that no one visited, giving him an indescribable sense of depth". He also has an receding Hairline despite his young Age.

Dunn Smith is the captain of the Nighthawks, a division under the Church of the Evernight Goddess, in Tingen City diocese.

He is a Sequence 7 Beyonder of the Darkness Pathway but has the power not too different from a Sequence 6.

name: Roselle Gustav
description:
Roselle Gustav is a "senior" Transmigrator from the modern era. "He" transmigrated in the year 1143, over two hundred years before Klein Moretti. Roselle was responsible for bringing over a lot of proverbs, literature, and advancements in technology.

Roselle Gustav "invented" the steam engine, improved sailboats, and started the Industrial Revolution. "He" became a legendary inventor and gained approval from the Church of the God of Steam and Machinery. "He" led a revolution against the Intis Kingdom, overthrowing the monarchy. "He" formed the Intis Republic and became its governor.

name: Audrey Hall
description:
Audrey is an extremely beautiful young lady with emerald green eyes and smooth blonde hair. She is known as the most dazzling gem in Backlund.

One of the first members of the Tarot Club.

name: Melissa Moretti
description: Melissa Moretti is the youngest Moretti sibling and a civilian. She does not believe in the occult and is unaware of her brother Klein's activity as a Beyonder and Nighthawk. She loves her two brothers both very much and tries hard to save money.

name: Daly Simone
description: Daly Simone was the most famous Spirit Medium from Awwa County had been living at Enmat Harbor. She is a Beyonder of the Death Pathway. She used to belong to the Tingen City division of the Nighthawk before being transferred to the Backlund division due to her high potential.

name: Trissy
description: A Beyonder of the Assassin Pathway Sequence 7 Witch.

name: Angelina Kudou Shields
native: アンジェリーナ・クドウ・シールズ
description:
Angelina Kudou Shields is a foreign exchange student from USNA who arrived at First High School during the latter half of the main characters' freshman year, taking Shizuku's place who went to study in Berkeley, California.

She is introduced as a member of the Kudou Family from the Ten Master Clans. Because of her popularity and not wanting to spend time after school, she is unable to decide which club she will join and is instead placed as a temporary member of the Student Council. She refers to herself as "Lina", and usually hangs out with Miyuki.

appearsIn.title: The Irregular at Magic High School: Visitor Arc

name: Shizuku Kitayama
description: A first year 1st course student in A class with [Miyuki](https://anilist.co/character/55741/Shiba-Miyuki), Jun and [Honoka](https://anilist.co/character/88191/Mitsui-Honoka).

appearsIn.title: The Irregular at Magic High School: Visitor Arc

name: Minami Sakurai
description: Sakurai Minami is a student of First High School. She is a member of the Second Generation Sakura Series constructed by a laboratory linked to the Yotsuba Clan. She serves as Guardian of Shiba Miyuki.

appearsIn.title: The Irregular at Magic High School: Visitor Arc

name: Hanzou Hattori
aliases: Hattori Gyoubushoujou Hanzou (服部刑部少丞範蔵)
description: Hanzou is a Second Year Student. The student council vice president of the First High School.

appearsIn.title: The Irregular at Magic High School: Visitor Arc

name: Ayako Kuroba
description: A member of the Kuroba Family, a branch family of the Yotsuba Clan. She is also a second cousin to the Shiba siblings.

appearsIn.title: The Irregular at Magic High School: Visitor Arc

name: Mizuki Shibata
description: A first year 2nd course student in E class with Tatsuya, Leo and Erika.

appearsIn.title: The Irregular at Magic High School: Visitor Arc

name: Alisa Ilichina Amiella
native: アリサ・イリーニチナ・アミエーラ
description: Transferred from a Russian branch, she is one of the new type of God Eaters. She has a lot of pride, will say whatever is on her mind, and may even be mentally unstable as time will show. In many incidents, she has failed her teammates by going into shock triggered by a past memory. Her parents were killed by an Aragami in the past, therefore she is extremely prejudiced towards them; particularly to Shio

name: Lenka Utsugi
description: The main protagonist of the story and A New-type god eater recruited by the Far East Branch. He cares for his subordinates so much that he forgets to take care of himself during a battle with the aragami. He is willing to give himself up for other people's safety. He soon is brought into the 1st Unit and learns a lot from his superiors. Lenka was named by his sister, Iroha Utsugi, after a flower that blooms from the mud.

name: Soma Schicksal
native: ソーマ・シックザール
description: A God Eater veteran at the age of only 18. Being so taciturn, he hates interacting with others. He is believed to have a much larger strength capacity than the other team members. Son of Johannes and Aisha Gauche.

name: Shio
description: A mysterious pale girl who appeared before the God Eaters. Has a very innocent nature and likes to sing. She is also seen walking the deserts at the end of the animated promotion clip (God Eater Prologue).

name: Tsubaki Amamiya
description:
Tsubaki joined Fenrir Far East Branch in 2059 and served as Captain until her retirement a decade later. She now acts as both the supervisor for the 1st-3rd units and instructs new recruits.

As a God Eater Tsubaki wielded a first generation ranged God Arc and was peerless in her achievements on the battlefield.

name: Rindou Amamiya
description: The leader of the offense team.  Quick to joke around, but shows distinguished judgement and acting power in battle.    He holds a serious secret and was reported MIA (Missing In Action) during the Moon in the Welkin mission.

name: Rikka Kusunoki
description: Licca Kusunoki is a female mechanic of the God Arc Maintenance Crew.

name: Kouta Fujiki
description: A 15-year old God Eater who joins the Far East branch the same day as the protagonist. He is an old-type and wields an assault gun formally used by [Tsubaki](https://anilist.co/character/44395/Amamiya-Tsubaki). He has a mother and younger sister, Nozomi, whom he cares for deeply.

name: Sakuya Tachibana
description: The sub-leader of first unit. She is a top-rank shooter, and her god arc is a sniper (old-type; long range).

name: Iroha Utsugi
description: Lenka's adoptive sister.

name: Mahiro Fuwa
description: Mahiro Fuwa has left a month ago to find his family's killer without any clues to who it might be. When Yoshino is held at gun-point, Mahiro comes out of nowhere and swiftly saves him and can stop bullets in mid-air, claiming to have a deal with a sorceress; not just any, but the strongest sorceress, Hakaze Kusaribe, who promised to help find his family's killer with her magic so he can kill the killer himself. After saving Yoshino, Mahiro informs him about the epidemic, a curse that turns living things into metal, claiming Kusaribe clan plans to revive the Tree of Zetsuen that could destroy the world.

name: Hakaze Kusaribe
aliases: Princess of the Tree of Beginnings
description: The princess of the sorcerers and the strongest sorceress in history, she was left in a desert island to die by the leader of Kusaribe clan, Samon. Since the Island did not allow the use of magic, she joins Mahiro's quest to revenge Aika's death, and her own revenge against Samon. She talks to Mahiro and Yoshino through a wooded doll necklace.            Hakaze's setup and behavior includes allusions to Prospero, the main character from Shakespeare's play The Tempest, who just like her, is a magician betrayed by his servants and left for dead on a deserted island.

name: Yoshino Takigawa
description: Yoshino was living a normal high school life until he meets a Evangeline Yamato while he was visiting the grave of a family friend. His world is then changed as he decides to help his friend and save the world. Yoshino is calm and clever who is brave and strong. He is the type to make calculative judgements before making any decisions.

name: Aika Fuwa
description: Aika was [Mahiro](https://anilist.co/character/42202/Fuwa-Mahiro)'s sister that was brutally murdered. Her murder is the central mystery that haunts the narrative in the series. Aika had a penchant for quoting [Shakespeare](https://anilist.co/staff/98134/William-Shakespeare), particularly Hamlet and The Tempest by William Shakespeare.

name: Evangeline Yamamoto
native: 山本エヴァンジェリン
description: A 28-year-old single and unemployed woman.

name: Megumu Hanemura
description: A kind boy that meets Yoshino in a train station. He is your average freeter who's a little timid and unreliable. Was recently dumped by his girlfriend, "Yu-chan".       (Source: zetsuen.net)

name: Samon Kusaribe
description: Part of the Kusaribe Clan, Samon believes that the Tree of Beginning will bring the end of the world and the only way to stop it is awakening the Tree of Zetsuen. Because he didn't want Hakaze to interfere, he leaves her stuck on a deserted island.

name: Futaba Igarashi
description:
Igarashi is a short young adult woman of a relatively slender build and is often confused for a child. Because of this, she gets treated like one which annoys her. She usually has her shoulder-length green hair tied in a ponytail and forest green eyes. She can be seen in a suit in the office area.

From the moment she met her senpai Takeda, she gradually gets annoyed at everything he does and says. Takeda annoys her all the time with the things he says, his laugh, his size, and the way he pats her head. However, in time her feelings for him started to be romantic, although she doesn't want to confess it to herself.

name: Harumi Takeda
description:
Takeda Harumi is one of the main characters in My Senpai is Annoying. He is a senpai to a junior employee at a company who finds him annoying. He is reliable but dense.

Takeda is a large well build man with short black hair. Takeda is a nice man who gladly helps out his coworkers. He is in charge of Igarashi and will always try his best to support and help her, and will even apologize to their boss for her mistakes. He cares for her.

name: Touko Sakurai
description:
Sakurai Touko is one of the secondary characters in My Senpai is Annoying. Sakurai is a young adult woman with long black hair. She has a mole under her right eye.

She is a senpai at Igarashi Futaba's company and is very popular among male employees because of her looks and friendly personality. She works alongside Igarashi and has a secret crush on Kazama Souta.

name: Mona Tsukishiro
description:
**Height**: 160 cm (5'3")

Tsukishiro has a unique presence and manner of speaking. Her behavior and activity is quite strange, like bringing a love article into the office or licking Igarashi's fingers to heal her papercut.
She often uses Russian phrases when greeting people.

(Source: My Senpai Is Annoying Wiki)

name: Souta Kazama
description:
Kazama Souta is one of the secondary characters in My Senpai is Annoying. He is a senpai at Igarashi Futaba's company.

Kazama is a young adult with short black hair, who can be seen in a white button-up shirt with black working pants and occasionally, a blue necktie. Kazama is boring and gives a boring look, and seemingly doesn't have many friends. He prefers to spend the New Year alone playing video games. He also has a hobby of making origami. His ears are sensitive.

name: Natsumi Kurobe
description: Natsumi Kurobe is a childhood friend of Futaba Igarashi since middle school. She genuinely cares about her friends, but likes practical jokes.

name: Yuuto Sakurai
description: Yuuto Sakurai is the younger brother of [Touko Sakurai](https://anilist.co/character/131619). He used his enrollment in high school as an opportunity to move to his sister's town.

name: Kyouka Uzen
description:
__Species:__ Human
__Height:__ 167 cm (5'6")
__Peach Ability:__ Chains of Eternity, "Slave"
__Affiliation:__ Anti-Demon Corps (7th Unit Chief)

Kyouka is the chief of the 7th Unit of the Anti-demon Corps, an elite group of women who have received power from the Peaches. She is [Yuuki Wakura](https://anilist.co/character/170329)'s savior and becomes his master after she decided to make him her slave. She is a fierce militaristic, calm, and serious woman befitting the 7th Unit Chief. She often fights against the Shuuki more seriously than other chiefs. She cares for the people around her to the point where she will do anything to protect them.

name: Yuuki Wakura
description:
__Species:__ Human
__Height:__ 173 cm (5'8")
__Occupation:__ Caretaker
__Affiliation:__ Anti-Demon Corps (7th Unit)
__Family:__ [Aoba Wakura](https://anilist.co/character/170333/Aoba-Wakura) (sister)

Caretaker of the Anti-Demon Corps 7th Unit. He attended Kaminoge High School as a third-year student but after getting caught up in a Mato Disaster, he was rescued by [Kyouka Uzen](https://anilist.co/character/162524) and became her Slave, granting him the power to fight alongside her.

Due to being a male, he could not become an official member of the Demon Corps since men can't receive special powers after consuming Peaches and has instead became the caretaker of the 7th unit, lending his support to his comrades both in and out of combat.

name: Shushu Suruga
description:
__Species:__ Human
__Height:__ 165 cm (5'5")
__Peach Ability:__ Imperial Liberation, "Paradigm Shift"
__Affiliation:__ Anti-Demon Corps (7th Unit)

name: Himari Azuma
description:
__Species:__ Human
__Height:__ 159 cm (5'3")
__Peach Ability:__ Noble Aspirations, "Learning"
__Affiliation:__ Anti-Demon Corps (7th Unit Vice-Chief)
__Family:__ [Tobera Azuma](https://anilist.co/character/266761/Tobera-Azuma) (grandmother),  [Fubuki Azuma](https://anilist.co/character/192784/Fubuki-Azuma) (mother), [Yachiho Azuma](https://anilist.co/character/170337/Yachiho-Azuma) (sister), [Maia Azuma](https://anilist.co/character/266758/Maia-Azuma) (sister), [Homare Azuma](https://anilist.co/character/266760/Homare-Azuma) (sister-in-law), [Yumina Azuma](https://anilist.co/character/266763/Yumina-Azuma) (sister-in-law)

name: Nei Ookawamura
description:
__Species:__ Human
__Height:__ 145 cm (4'9")
__Peach Ability:__ Sure To Find, "Promise"
__Occupation:__ Scout
__Affiliation:__ Anti-Demon Corps (7th Unit)

name: Tenka Izumo
description:
__Species:__ Human
__Height:__ 163 cm (5'4")
__Peach Ability:__ "Ame-No-Mitori"
__Affiliation:__ Anti-Demon Corps (6th Unit Chief)

Tenka is the 6th Anti-Demon Corps Chief. She is [Kyouka](https://anilist.co/character/162524)'s friend and rival.

name: Sahara Wakasa
description:
__Species:__ Human
__Height:__ 156 cm (5'1")
__Peach Ability:__ "Crazy Sheep"
__Affiliation:__ Anti-Demon Corps (6th Unit)

name: Ginna Bizen
description:
__Height:__ 159 cm

Ginna Bizen is a member of the Anti-Demon Corps' 10th Unit.

name: Aoba Wakura
description:
__Species:__ Humanoid Shuuki
__Peach Ability:__ I am the Older Sister, "Invincible"
__Affiliation:__ Hidden Village

Aoba Wakura is the older sister of [Yuuki Wakura](https://anilist.co/character/170329/Yuuki-Wakura) who'd taught him about being a proper young man, but later went missing at least six years prior in a Mato Disaster

name: Fran
description:
__Race:__ Beastman
__Species:__ Black Cat
__Class:__ Swordlord

Fran is the main female protagonist of the Tensei Shitara Ken Deshita story. 

She is normally stoic and expressionless, Fran can be quick to anger when her race is insulted and is almost completely unafraid of the idea of displaying violence and mercilessness for the sake of achieving her goals. She views most Blue Catkin with hostility due to their betrayal and selling of her people into slavery. Fran will express happiness or excitement at the prospects of fighting a strong opponent or eating curry. Anyone, that insults that which she takes pride in, will face her wrath. Fran does not completely understand metaphors and will take things literally.

name: Shishou
description:
__Species:__ Intelligent Weapon

Master is the main protagonist of the Tensei Shitara Ken Deshita series and the main weapon of Fran.
