His personality is that of a father/guardian of sorts towards Fran, he takes care and protects her while also assisting her by providing his abilities and bonuses to Fran. Towards other people Master acts in a kind and well mannered way, except if that people disrespect or try to hurt Fran in any way or shape.

In sword form, Master looks like a white longsword with three blue lines on it. Beneath the pale gold hilt there is the sculpture of a courageous wolf and a decorative blue string. The handle is wound with a latticework of blue and white strings.

Before being reincarnated into a sword, he appeared to be a 30-year old salary man who enjoyed anime, manga, VRMMOs, and light novels. He had a friendly personality, enjoyed eating curry, and had some level of proficiency in cooking but had never dated before. He is killed at the start of the story by an oblivious driver who was texting and driving.

name: Rufus
description:
__Class:__ Merchant

Shopkeeper and owner of the Saber-Tooth General Store. Former adventurer.

name: Amanda
description: Amanda is a half-elf who is an extremely famous and powerful A-ranked Adventurer of Altessa, who's main weapon of a choice is a mixture of a whip and wind magic.

name: Donadrond
description: Donadrond is an instructor working at Alessa's Adventurer's Guild. He is also tasked with dissuading weaker looking wannabe adventurers wanting to sign up to the guild by beating them up in a duel.

name: Galus
description:
__Race:__ Dwarf
__Class:__ Arcane Blacksmith

A dedicated and passionate blacksmith. He possesses Godsight, a special skill allowing him to discern a weapon's status.

name: Neru
description: Receptionist of Alessa's Adventurers' Guild

name: Randell
description: A merchant the Fran and Shishou meet after saving him from six goblins on the highway to Alessa.

name: Ragna
description: A dragon hunter who teamed up with [Crimson](https://anilist.co/character/168967/Crimson) to kill all dragons.

name: Crimson
description: Crimson is the previous Winged Monarch who betrayed the dragons and tried to kill the Dragon God. Crimson teamed up with [Ragna](https://anilist.co/character/204860/Ragna) to slay all dragons, himself included.

name: Leonica
description: Leonica is a young prodigy dragon hunter. She helped out Ragna and he started traveling with her.

name: Woltekamui
description: Second Seat of the Winged Bloodline.

name: Disas Trois
description: Third Seat of the Winged Bloodline.

name: Nebulim
description: Seventh Seat of the Winged Bloodline. Fourth Seat in the future timeline.

name: Nagi Umino
description:
Nagi is a second-year student at Megurogawa Gakuen. He is the biological son of a hotel tycoon, but due to a mix-up after his birth is raised by a different family.

Nagi seems to be obsessed with studying to the point that he studies day and night in order to achieve top marks. He is quite capable in pretty much everything, whether it is housework or schoolwork, proving his culinary skills multiple times by preparing delicious dishes everyday. He is a free-willed and determined person with a stubborn attitude to never give up. He is also naïve when it comes to the girls around him. Yet his kindhearted nature means that he will protect the ones that he cares about by doing everything in his power to help them.

name: Erika Amano
description:
**Height:** 160 cm

Erika Amano is a second-year student at Orpheus Jogakuin but transfers to Megurokawa Gakuen. She is a popular social media celebrity and the biological daughter of the family that raised Nagi.

name: Hiro Segawa
description: Hiro Segawa is the love interest of Nagi Umino.

name: Sachi Umino
description: Sachi Umino is the sister of [Nagi Umino](https://anilist.co/character/166730/Nagi-Umino).

name: Shion Asuma
description: A second-year student at Megurogawa Academy and classmate of Nagi Umino.

name: Asami Segawa
description: She is a priestess and the mother of Hiro Segawa.

name: Axel Gilberto
description: Parkour specialist originally from Brazil. He has outstanding physical abilities and is a quick thinker, who can fly through the city like a bird. He is famous for his numerous jailbreaks.

name: Doug Hadine
description: Originally from Nigeria. He's an intelligent man who creates strategies as the brains of the team, and hides his warm heart behind a calm and collected demeanor. As a student, he studied physics and had a great respect for [Dr. Skinner.](https://anilist.co/character/347658/Skinner) He has a high-strung and prideful personality.

name: Christine Blake
description: Originally from Russia. She has a lively and frank personality, allowing her to get along with anyone. She acts as a gun specialist, who can use any type of gun. She is also a heavy drinker and optimist.

name: Leland Astor
description: Originally from Canada. His special skill is piloting drones. He seems like a normal dumb middle school student, but has a complicated family situation which is kept secret. He is skilled at reading the room but never says his real intentions. His hobby is ego surfing.

name: Eleina
aliases: Mad Screamer (マッド・スクリーマー)
description: Originally from Hong Kong. Although she seems unsociable and is bad at listening to what others say, she is actually a famous hacker under the name "Mad Screamer."

name: Hersch Lindemann
description: Leader of Lazarus. She has a lot of influence on both nations and large corporations, and does her job without being carried away by emotions. She is an angry and terrifying woman.

name: Abel Anderson
description: Director of the National Security Agency (NSA). He is always unfazed, calm, and rational, to the point his colleagues questioned if he is secretly an AI.

name: Deniz Skinner
description: Skinner is a three-time Nobel Prize winning scientist. He suddenly disappeared three years ago. He is the inventor of the cure-all drug Hapna, and was seen as a saint for donating his patent and prize money to solving world issues.

name: Kintarou Ooe
description: Kintaro "The Golden Boy" Oe is the 25-year-old protagonist of the anime, manga, and OVA series "Golden Boy." As a "Tokyo University Department of Law" dropout, he is studying the way of life by traveling with his bike through Japan. Although he dropped out, he mastered the entire curriculum. This fact combined with his knowledge of the human behavior and psyche lets one assume that he is indeed quite intelligent. He goes from place to place, applying for whatever job he can, instead of sticking to one occupation.

name: Onna Shachou
description: She is the owner of a software company in episode one. She is a strong, independent and intelligent woman. Moreover she is really hot and wears expensive, sexy clothes. She does not believe in showing sincerity to men because of their true intentions, that's why she never employs men. Kintaro is the first man to work in her office.

name: Naoko Katsuda
description:
__Relatives:__ Juzo Katsuda (father), Noriko Katsuda (mother)

Naoko is the daughter of a powerful local politician and Noriko Katsuda and the friend of Yuka Kanzaki who has employed Kintaro Oe as part of his campaign team to run for a third term as mayor.

name: Noriko
description: Golden girl No.3. Dreams about arranging flowers for her beloved one. Her parents run a noodle restaurant. She is looking for true love and is very shy and sensitive. She contends with marrying a rich businessman from yakuza. Kintaro helps her with making the right decision.

name: Ayuko Hayamizu
description: Golden girl No.4. An olympic gold medalist and swimming instructor that runs her own swimming school. Ayuko is very dominant and disciplined, she requires a lot of involvment in work from her staff. Furthermore her methods of learning need some changes, because they're not suitable for students. Kintaro is about to influence her attitude.

name: Reiko Terayama
description: Reiko Terayama is the daughter of Daitaku Terayama; one of the richest men in Kyoto. In public Reiko is beautiful, elegant and well mannered. However, secretly she has an obsession with her motorbike she calls her "bimo". She has a distaste for men and prefers her "bimo" over them. But as soon as she met Kintaro Oe her views change...

name: Chie
description: Chie is a cel-painter at the animation studio where Kintarou works as an errand-boy.

name: Yuka Kanzaki
description: Yuka is a side character of Golden Boy. She is a friend of Naoko Katsuda.

name: Tatsuya Engawa
description:
The manga author of the film the animation studio is working on, and also the author of "Imperial University Story" and "Golden Girls". Tatsuya Engawa is based on the original author of Golden Boy, Tatsuya Egawa.

(Source: MAL)

name: Umi Sonoda
description:
__Height: __159cm

Umi is normally a shy girl, but she has a strong will and some qualities of a leader. Despite this, she is content to stay reserved and always thinks logically. Umi is uncomfortable with wearing short skirts but gets used to it after their first live. Although Umi tends to be hard on others, she is especially hard on herself. She doesn't do anything criminal and despises laziness.

name: Rin Hoshizora
description:
__Height:__ 155cm

Rin appears to be a bit of a tomboy, though with a girly streak. She likes sports and is arguably the most athletic member of μ's, on par with Eli. Like Honoka, Rin is very energetic, hard-working and active. One key difference between her and Honoka, however, is that Rin is known for being very mindful of other people's opinions, as she puts their feelings first before taking action into something.

name: Nico Yazawa
description:
__Height:__ 154 cm 

Nico has been observing [Honoka's](https://anilist.co/character/46171/Kousaka-Honoka) new Idol group for a while but eventually joins them. She has past experiences as an amateur school idol. At first, she was secretly the President of the school's unknown Idol Research Club, but after an incident, the club was later joined together with Honoka's Idol Club. She likes bossing people around and acting superior, but she also has an energetic and cheeky personality.

name: Hanayo Koizumi
description:
__Height:__ 156 cm  

A shy girl who dreamed of being an idol since she was very young; Rin and Maki finally convince her to join µ's.

name: Maki Nishikino
description:
__Height:__ 161 cm

Maki Nishikino is a first-year​ high school student in Otonokizaka High School. She has a beautiful voice and loves jazz music more than anyone else in the group. At first, she didn't want to join µ's because she had decided to inherit their family's hospital and take up medicine in college, but after joining forces with Rin to push Hanayo to join, she decides to follow the same path and join along with her two fellow first years.

name: Nozomi Toujou
description:
__Height:__ 159 cm 

Nozomi is the vice-president of Otonokizaka High School. She is the best friend of [Eli](https://anilist.co/character/46173/Ayase-Eli). She is also a Shrine Maiden in a temple because she believes that a shrine is the source of people's faith. Eventually she will join the school idol club with Eli and will be one of the most successful school idols.

(Source: Character Book)

name: Eli Ayase
description:
__Height:__ 162 cm

Eli Ayase is the student council president of the Otonokizaka High School. Along with her best friend, [Nozomi](https://anilist.co/character/46169/Toujou-Nozomi), they do plans so the closure of the school could be prevented. She is partly Russian because her grandmother is a Russian. Alongside Nozomi, they join the school idol group for the prevention of their schools closure.

name: Kotori Minami
description:
__Height:__ 159 cm

Kotori is known for having her head in the clouds. Despite this, she is μ's designer along with [Nico Yazawa](https://anilist.co/character/46163/Yazawa-Nico). Kotori has a very huge aptitude for fashion and is very good at drawing costumes for the group. Kotori is shown to be very kind and supportive to her friends and genuinely cares about them, especially their feelings. However, this can go too far as Kotori usually backs [Honoka](https://anilist.co/character/46171/Kousaka-Honoka) up when she is scolded by [Umi](https://anilist.co/character/46167/Sonoda-Umi).

Kotori is also shown as the most indecisive person among all nine members and tends to have her friends make decisions for her. She also has a hard time expressing her feelings, since she always takes other people's feelings into consideration.

name: Honoka Kousaka
description:
__Height:__ 157 cm

Honoka is the main character, who is a second-year student at Otonokizaka Academy. Her family works in a japanese sweet shop named Homura. When Otonokizaka Academy is planned to be shut down due to lack of applicants, Honoka becomes determined to save it by starting up a school idol group. Honoka also has a knack for finding loose change on the ground. Since she was young, she has been friends with [Kotori](https://anilist.co/character/46013/Minami-Kotori), and she befriended [Umi](https://anilist.co/character/46167/Sonoda-Umi) after inviting her to play hide and seek.

name: Ard Meteor
description:
**Race:** Human

Socially awkward Demon Lord whose goal is to make friends.

appearsIn.title: The Greatest Demon Lord Is Reborn as a Typical Nobody

name: Ireena Olhyde
native: イリーナ・リッツ・ド・オールハイド
description:
**Race:** Elf

Ireena Litz de Olhyde is the childhood friend of the Ard Meteor.

appearsIn.title: The Greatest Demon Lord Is Reborn as a Typical Nobody

name: Ginny de Salvan
native: ジニー・フィン・ド・サルヴァン
description:
**Race:** Succubus

A young succubus who got bullied a lot by Elrado and his gang even through their childhood. She began to worship Ard after he came to her rescue.

appearsIn.title: The Greatest Demon Lord Is Reborn as a Typical Nobody

name: Sylphy Marheaven
native: シルフィー・メルヘヴン
description:
**Race:** Human

Sylphy Marheaven was a soldier in the Demon Lord's Army formerly known as Raging Champion.

She spends thousands of years practicing in Phantom Forest in order to defeat the Demon Lord.

appearsIn.title: The Greatest Demon Lord Is Reborn as a Typical Nobody

name: Olivia Vine
native: オリヴィア・ヴェル・ヴァイン
description: Olivia vel Vine is one of the Four Heavenly Kings and Varvatos's sister.

appearsIn.title: The Greatest Demon Lord Is Reborn as a Typical Nobody

name: Irma Fellicha
native: イルマ・フェリーチェ
description: Irma Fellicha is an opera singer from Leidenshaftlich who entrusts Violet to write her a letter that will be used in her new opera. Her lover, Hugo, was killed during the war.

name: Wazaemon
aliases: Hakamori no Wazaemon (墓守のウェザエモン)
description:
__Height:__ 198 cm

One of the Seven Colossi—Unique Monsters that inhabit the world of Shangri-La Frontier. 

He is an peerless hero who ceaselessly stands guard over the grave of his beloved, who passed away in the distant past. Possessing multiple attacks capable of instantly killing players, he boasts a strength that defies all logic. Ten minutes after combat begins, he summons a horse-shaped robot known as Kirin.

name: Sonoshee McLaren
native: ソノシー・マクラーレン
description: Sonoshee is the winner of the Yellow Race which qualified her to enter the Redline race. She's commonly known as the Cherry Boy Hunter even though it was never completely described why.

name: JP
description:
"Sweet JP"—a nickname earned for JP's personality and retro style, though most likely from a refusal to mount any form of weapons or upgrades on his race car. Seemingly, the only advantages of JP's car, the Trans Am 20000 WR, are Frisbee's modifications and the Old man's mechanical skills.  One of two human racers to qualify for REDLINE, though through unusual circumstances (default and popular demand). An ambitious and talented racer, JP pushes his driving skill and soul to their limits when he feels the time is right, throwing an extravagant show whilst putting his body and vehicle on the line for the ultimate racing experience.
 (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Machine Head Tetsujin
description: The four times consecutive winner of the deadly Redline Race.

name: Boiboi
description: BoiBoi is a racer and a member of royal family from planet Supergrass. Along with BosBos, they are known as SuperBoins and create a singer group. They take part in Redline race in their vehicle called BoinCar.

name: Frisbee
description: A mechanic and JP's friend.

name: Kyouya Mitsurugi
description: A Japanese citizen who was also reincarnated to the fantasy world by Aqua. He is one of Belzerg's strongest adventurers and wields the cursed sword Gram. The sword was his gift from Aqua.

appearsIn.title: KONOSUBA -God's blessing on this wonderful world! 2: God's Blessings on These Wonderful Works of Art!

name: Hakase
description: "Head Researcher" is an unnamed person who lived and died centuries before the main story begins. He is sometimes also referred to as "Idiot Inventor," "Stupid Chief Engineer," "The Scientist," or some other names along those lines. He was born in modern Japan and sent to the distant-past Fantasy World as a Reincarnator to fight the Demon King of that time. While we never get to meet him when he was alive, we do see glimpses of his life from his research diaries.

appearsIn.title: KONOSUBA -God's blessing on this wonderful world! 2: God's Blessings on These Wonderful Works of Art!

name: Kayo Horikoshi
description: Younger sister of Jirou

name: Hans Castorp
description: He is german, likes salad and smokes.

name: Caproni
description: Giovanni Battista Caproni is a famous Italian airplane designer who inspires Jirou Horikoshi to become also an airplane designer. He called Jirou not by name but the "boy from Japan".

name: Satomi
description: Father of Nahoko Satomi.

name: Panty Anarchy
native: アナーキー・パンティ
description:
__Height:__ 164cm (5'4")   

Panty is Stocking's sister. She is an angel forced to kill evil spirits in order to earn her way back into Heaven. She is obsessed with sex and as such, spends a lot of her free time in love hotels with random men. She speaks with a traditional Tokyo dialect and bad girl's dialect. Her name is also the source of her power as she is able to transform her panties into a diamond handgun named Back Lace, that has amazingly destructive power against spirits but can't even bruise humans.

name: Briefers Rock
native: ブリーファス・ロック
description: A self-proclaimed ghost hunter who has a crush on Panty.

name: Garterbelt
description:
The priest of the Cemetery Hills Church on the outskirts of Daten City. He serves as the overseer of the angel sisters, but beneath his calm demeanor, he occasionally acts suspiciously and engages in dubious activities, making him a mysterious character. 

(Source: Official Site)

name: Stocking Anarchy
native: ストッキング・アナーキー
description:
__Height:__ 152 cm (4'11")

The younger angel sister, banished to Earth along with her sister [Panty](https://anilist.co/character/32800/Panty-Anarchy). A goth girl with straight bangs and ultra-long hair. She fights by transforming her stockings into two katana-shaped heavenly weapons, Stripe I & II. Stocking enjoys eating various desserts and sugary food, but doesn't seem to gain weight. However, she acts quite enraged and sensitive whenever someone calls her fat. She is usually a level-headed and intelligent girl, though she can be rude if provoked, especially towards her older sister Panty.

name: Oscar H. Genius
description: A famous actor who started a popular nose-picking fad in Daten City.

name: Terao
description: An aging, struggling salary man living in the slums of Daten City whose daughter's birthday wish is to see Panty and Stocking in person.

name: Patrick Fagry
native: パトリック・ファグリィ
description: An ill-mannered ghost,

name: Daten City High School Principal
description: The principal of Daten City High School. He is short and often referred to as a joke of principal.

name: Natsumi
description:
__Angel:__ Haniel
__Height:__ 144 cm (normal), 170 cm (adult form)
__Rank:__ B-Class spirit 

Natsumi is the seventh Spirit to appear in the series. She first appears as a slender woman whose age should be slightly past 20 years old.

name: Ryouko Kusakabe
description: Captain of the Japan Ground Self Defense Force (JGSDF) Anti-Spirit Team (AST) who leads the young girls of the AST while being 27 herself.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Isaac Ray Peram Westcott
native: アイザック・レイ・ペラム・ウェストコット
description: The managing director of DEM Industries, He is around 30 years old and a tall man with dark ash blond hair and sharp eyes.

name: Aoi Miyamori
description:
**Occupation:** Production assistant for Musashino Animation

Aoi is cheerful and positive and has an interest in animation and was a member of the animation club in high school. However, she does not know what specific job she wants to do in the anime industry.

name: Ema Yasuhara
description: Animator at Musashino Animation. Was a member of the animation club in high school.

name: Shizuka Sakaki
description:
__Occupation:__ Voice actress at Akaoni Production.

Shizuka also works part-time as a waitress and is a former member of her high school animation club.

name: Misa Toudou
description:
Aspiring 3D computer graphics operator.

Misa once worked at the computer graphics studio Super Media Creations and was a former member of her high school animation club.

name: Midori Imai
description:
Aspiring scriptwriter and university student.

The highly enthusiastic Midori is a former member of her high school animation club.

name: Seiichi Kinoshita
description:
The Director of Musashino Animation. Like many typical directors, Kinoshita tends to be nervous on the production of his team's work.

The character is loosely based on [Seiji Mizushima](https://anilist.co/staff/100083/).

name: Akane Uchida
description: Key animator at Musashino Animation.

name: Masato Marukawa
description:
The president of Musashino Animation.

He was once the production desk at the now-defunct Musashino Pictures. He is more often than not seen cooking absurd amounts of food for his employees. In the past, he had a distinctive hippie look, with long hair past his shoulders and a headband, but in the present, he is nearly bald and has a distinctive gap between his front two teeth.

The character is loosely based on [Masao Maruyama](https://anilist.co/staff/103170/).

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Mitsuaki Kanno
description:
The famous director of Neon Generation Avangaldon.

The character is loosely based on [Hideaki Anno](https://anilist.co/staff/100111/).

name: Yuuji Atsumi
description: Art director of The Third Girls Aerial Squad anime.

name: Loo
aliases: Loo Lulucy (ルールーシー＝ルー)
description:
__Race:__ Vampire
__Affiliation:__ Taiju Village, Kingdom of Galbart (Formerly)

Loo is a Female Vampire, who stumbles into Hiraku's farm during his early days of living in the formidable forest of death. On the run, with no where to turn, she falls in love with Hiraku who by this time has not seen another person since coming to the world. She can change her body/age to suit her needs to survive. She is a skilled magician as well as a farmer who works at Hiraku's farm. At first she viewed Hiraku's farm (now a village) as a place she can hide from the nobles and now she views it as home.

name: Ria
description:
**Race:** High Elf

Ria is the leader of a group of high-elf girls who wandered in the forest after their village was destroyed by humans in a war. They were homeless for 200 years until Tier brought them to Hiraku's farm. Ria is a reliable construction enthusiast and contributes to the farm by establishing a smithy and bringing other technologies such as building construction and baking. After meeting Hiraku and his friends, Ria decides to live with them.

name: Hiraku Machio
description:
**Race:** Human

Hiraku Machio is the main protagonist of Isekai Nonbiri Nouka series. He was resurrected with a healthy body, the ability to speak the common tongue, and the All-Purpose Farming Tool (AFT) by God. Despite being unable to use magic, he cultivates the forest to create farmland and a village, with the help of the wolves Kuro and Yuki, the demon spider Zabuton, and even humanoid species.

name: Tier
description:
**Race:** Angel

Tier is one of the main characters of Isekai Nonbiri Nouka series. She is an angel with celestial magical powers and bird-like wings that allow her to fly. She is part of the Angel of Annihilation tribe, specializing in golem magic. Tier visits the forest in search of Loo, her frenemy, and ends up living there with Hiraku and Loo.

name: Flora
description:
**Race:** Vampire

Flora is a skilled witch who arrived at Hiraku's house searching for Loo. She is also a researcher interested in fermentation, which led her to move to the village. She contributed to the farm by introducing the first two heads of cattle and her knowledge of potion making.

name: Ann
description:
**Race:** Oni

Ann is an Oni and represents the Oni Maids who now live in the village with Flora. Formerly working for Loo and Flora, she now also looks after Hiraku and his family in the forest.

name: Senna
description:
**Race:** Beastman

Senna is the leader and representative of the Beastmen immigrants who migrated from Howling Village to Hiraku's village. She is also the daughter of the former chief of Howling Village.

name: Graffaloon
description: A white dragon who is Doraim's wife and Rasutisumoon's mother.

name: Hakuren
aliases: Ancient Dragon (エンシェントドラゴン)
description:
**Race:** Dragon

Hakuren is the older sister of Doraim and Rasuti's aunt. She initially attacks the village upon hearing that her niece, Rasuti, has a boyfriend, but is eventually repelled by Hiraku and decides to settle down in the village.

name: Doraim
description:
Doraim is the dragon tribe's leader. Royalty and defender of his domain which lies south of the Taiju Village in the western mountains. His lands, acts as a defensive post for civilization, since its situated between the Forest of Death & the lesser known Iron Forest. 
While a powerful being, his personality quite a normal being, with taste for drink (such as the Taiju Village in particular). After the defeat of the rare firebreathing wild Wyvern at the hands of Hiraku Machio, he felt such a being must be befriended (he also fears). After becoming fast friends, and discovering the fantastic food & drink the village had to offer. His personal assistant Guchi, must drag him back to his duties as the Gate Keeper in the mountains or he would never leave.

He was such a frequent visitor his own daughter, Lastismun, became gravely concern that he was cheating on his wife, Graffalun, only to find he was over indulging at the Taiju Village, now having a guest home.

After his daughter, attempted to attack the village, he ordered her to remain there to get better acquainted with them and cool down her temper.

name: Kyouya Hashiba
description: Main protagonist of the series. He travels back ten years ago by an unknown event. Kyouya shows a very calm personality. He is inspired by a group of talented people known as "The Platinum Generation".

name: Tsurayuki Rokuonji
description: A close friend of Kyouya Hashiba. Although displaying a lazy nature, he is a genius in writing scripts.

name: Nanako Kogure
description: She is a resident of Share House Kitayama, and a very talented singer. Despite her appearance, she's innocent and caring.

name: Aki Shino
description: Aki has an unfussy and motherly temper while also known to have a caring nature too. She's also a very talented artist. She is a second-year student in [Kyouya Hashiba](https://anilist.co/character/197117/Hashiba-Kyouya)'s Department of Film who is commonly known as "Shinoaki".

name: Eiko Kawasegawa
description:
Eiko is a competitive, stubborn, and mature young woman whose enthusiasm and talent for film-making have no bounds. She is also somewhat prickly and looks up to her older sister and professor Misaki Kanou. 

At the same time, she is able to empathize with others and holds herself to the same high standards she expects of her colleagues.

name: Puck
description:
__Height:__ 7 cm

Puck is an Artificial Spirit that [Emilia](https://anilist.co/character/88572/Emilia) was formerly contracted with. He is the current Great Spirit of Fire.





Puck can be described as cute or adorable, thus his skin being pink around his cheeks. His fur is mostly grey with silver in certain spots (i.e. tip of the tail). His eyebrows are pretty small and rhombus-shaped. He also has a gold earring on his left ear. Sometimes, he carries a purple bag.

Puck is generally a nice spirit. He is very happy and stays at Emilia's side to protect her, affectionately calling her "Lia". He occasionally goofs around and gets along especially well with [Beatrice](https://anilist.co/character/90181/Beatrice).

appearsIn.title: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- OVAs

name: Chap
description: Chap is a member of Ganak's underworld until he was abandoned by the organization he was a part of.

appearsIn.title: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- OVAs

name: Roswaal Mathers
native: ロズワール・Ｌ・メイザース
description:
The lord of the Roswaal Mansion and a descendant of the original Roswaal.

He comes across as an eccentric due to his flamboyant appearance and odd speaking style, the latter which he shares with his grandmother. However, he harbors a more calculating and reserved side with a sharp political mind and gaze that reads others quite well.

appearsIn.title: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- OVAs

name: Petra Leyte
description: Petra is a bright and kind girl from Irlam Village. She likes [Subaru](https://anilist.co/character/88573/Natsuki-Subaru) very much after he saved her from the Wolgarm incident.

appearsIn.title: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- OVAs

name: Iska
description:
Iska is the main protagonist of the series. He is the current wielder of the Astral Swords and is determined to end what he considers a pointless war. 

He was the youngest Saint Disciple to ever receive the title; but after releasing a "witch" from captivity, he was stripped of his rank and imprisoned for life. Circumstances around the war against the Nebulis Sovereignty have led to his release, but his goals haven't changed. 

Iska has a moral code that doesn’t discriminate, even if a supposed enemy is at hand. He shows kindness and bravery, despite putting himself at risk, and even willing to risk committing treason for them. On the battlefield, Iska becomes very fierce yet also calm, not being afraid of whatever power his opponent has or taking dangerous gambles to protect himself from their attacks. However, Iska usually avoids cutting down most opponents when he doesn't see any value in doing so, simply knocking them out. This has led Iska to be known as a 'peace-loving war nut'.

(Source: KimiSen Wiki)

appearsIn.title: Our Last Crusade or the Rise of a New World

name: Aliceliese Lou Nebulis IX
native: アリスリーゼ・ルゥ・ネビュリス9世
description:
Aliceliese is a calm person and a kind heart to which she uses mostly to protect her family legacy. While she comes off as a cold fighter when she's on the battlefield, Aliceliese isn't much different from a normal girl her age. She enjoys going to the opera (having cried during one play), and is a fan of art and can be very talkative at times.

Being a teenage girl, Alice has some interest in the opposite sex. Not having many males her age around her, she expresses most of this interest in [Iska](https://anilist.co/character/170215/Iska) when they're not on the battlefield. She even treats their rivalry as something similar to a relationship, as [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/180987/Vispose-Rin) compared the way she was planning for their final battle to planning for a wedding.

appearsIn.title: Our Last Crusade or the Rise of a New World

name: Sisbell Lou Nebulis IX
native: シスベル・ルゥ・ネビュリス9世
description:
Sisbell is the third princess after [Aliceliese](https://anilist.co/character/170214/) and [Elletear](https://anilist.co/character/198582/) of the Nebulis Sovereignty.

Prior to the start of the anime, [Iska](https://anilist.co/character/170215/) and Sisbell knew each other when he freed her from the hands of the Heavenly Empire. After saving her from them, she found out that Iska was treated as a prisoner for being a traitor to the country. She was in disbelief at how he went on his way to treat a princess and stated that Sisbel only had weak astral power and was a little girl. With determination, she set out to find the whereabouts of her fated "dream knight" just to be captured by Lord Mask. Though, in the end of the anime, it was seen that Iska was being fought over by Alice and Sisbell, with Sisbell making a statement that he would be the perfect knight for the next queen.

appearsIn.title: Our Last Crusade or the Rise of a New World

name: Mismis Klass
description:
Mismis is a supporting character in KimiSen. She is the captain of the 907th unit belonging to Iska's squad. She can be seen as a cute yet highly supportive teammate since her fighting skills are subpar to the other characters in her squad. Even though that she isn't highly smart with combat, she is usually the morale booster of their team, and gives everyone the emotional support that they need. She was formerly a human until she was sucked into the vortex where she got exposed. Her power included nullifying every astral mage's to use their abilities whenever she uses hers.

Being  the oldest person in their group, she acts and looks childish as she contains many stuff animals and cute dresses in her room. She also considers herself to be a girl rather than a woman and doesn't like it people call her a child.

appearsIn.title: Our Last Crusade or the Rise of a New World

name: Elletear Lou Nebulis IX
native: イリーティア・ルゥ・ネビュリス9
description: Elletear is one of the princesses and the older sister to Alice and Sisbell. She dons a heterochromatic eye where her left eye is colored Gold, her right eye contains a Light Blue hue, and in the manga, she has green eyes.

appearsIn.title: Our Last Crusade or the Rise of a New World

name: Jhin Syulargun
description: Jhin is part of the 907th unit and serves as a sniper. He is shown to be a calm and collected individual, along with being the smartest among them. He usually makes sarcastic remarks, often making a witty remark, but he tends to care a lot for his comrades in his squad.

appearsIn.title: Our Last Crusade or the Rise of a New World

name: Nene Alkastone
description: Nene is a supporting character of the anime KimiSen. Along with Jhin, Iska and Mismis, they make up the members of the 907th unit with her specialty being able to graph coordinates of her target to a machine and releasing out projectiles to her enemies. She is a cheerful and high spirited girl that will help her teammates even if they go into such troubles, such as when Mismis became an Astral Mage after being exposed to a spirit vortex. She usually sees Iska as her brother and has a close relationship with her squad. Her weapons includes an anti-astral power grenade that disrupts the use of astral powers in a defined range, and has a ring that can indicate the position of her target.

appearsIn.title: Our Last Crusade or the Rise of a New World

name: Shanorotte Gregory
native: シャノロッテ・グレゴリー
description: A friend of Mismis and the captain of the 104th Unit of the Empire.

appearsIn.title: Our Last Crusade or the Rise of a New World

name: Akira Takizawa
description:
Height: 166cm  

He lost his memory during a brain washing program. At first he thinks he is a terrorist. He met Saki in Washington D.C., being naked and only carrying a gun and a cellphone. When he helps her out, because she threw a coin in the grounds of the White House and is questioned by policemen, she gives him her coat, scarf and her hat. He has a very modern cell phone with the phrase "noblesse oblige" printed on it and 8.2 billion yen in digital money credit. When he makes his first call, a female voice claiming to be Juiz answers. After she sent him a map with the place where he was supposed to go he finds, in his apartment, guns and many different passports which seemed to all belong to him (after his arrival in Japan, Juiz told him that he has to use up all his digital money). Then he met the girl named Saki and they return to Japan together.

name: Saki Morimi
description: Saki is in her last year in university. She is 22 years old, born on January 6, 1989. After her parents died she lived with her elder married sister, brother-in-law and niece. She visits New York City as part of her graduation trip with her friends and after visiting Washington D.C. alone, she meets Takizawa Akira who helps her out when is questioned by the police for suspicious behaviour. She gives the completely nude Akira her coat, scarf and hat. After noticing that she left her passport in the coat, she chases after Akira and then they decide to go back together to Tokyo, Japan.   She plans later on working in a company under the recommendation of her brother-in-law because she is ashamed of living off their money. She could only go to college with the aid of her sister and her brother in law. Saki also harbours a long-time crush on her sister's husband, and especially wants to leave their house since she cannot bear being around him.  Most of Saki's friends are NEETs who developed the Eden system that they plan to launch and bring themselves out of unemployment. Her only friend with a job, Ohsugi, has had a deep and long-lasting crush on her that she does not return; whether she is actually oblivious to his feelings or simply pretending not to notice as to not hurt  his feelings is unclear.   She starts developing a deeper connection with Akira as her fascination with the enigmatic stranger grows every time she meets him.

name: Jintarou Tsuji
description: Another Selecao working with Mononobe and Yuuki. He seems to care very little about Mr. Outside's "game" and wishes simply for it to be over as soon as possible. He claims he has not spent any of the 10 billion yen he was given.    (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Daiju Mononobe
description: Selecao No. 1. The mysterious man seen in the red car at the beginning. (wiki)

name: Mr. Outside
native: ミスター・アウトサイド
description: An unseen and mysterious character who chooses twelve Japanese citizens as Seleção and gives them the special Noblesse ("nobility" in French) phones. Mr. OUTSIDE gives the Seleção the mission to bring stability to their own country in whatever way they wish to. However, he/she will send "Supporters" to kill them if they use up their money before they can complete it, or do not meet the requirements to accomplish the mission.   (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Ryou Yuuki
description: Selecao #10

name: Kuroha Shiratori
description: Selecao #11 - Modeling agency president by day, serial killer demon by night. She uses her Noblesse Oblige to ‘elegantly’ get rid of the evidence.

name: Ryosuke Morimi
description: He is the husband of Saki's sister and the brother-in-law of Saki. Saki apparently may have had feelings for him at some point.  His surname is probably Sangetsu and he is a baker.  (Source: Eden of the East Wikia)

name: Mikuru Katsuhara
description: Micchon is a very shy girl, who is only open and frank when around people she is close to. She is apparently a genius programmer, as she is the person who programmed Eden of the East's image recognition software. She is also very good when it comes to working with computers.

name: Haruo Kasuga
description: A member of the Edan of the East group, Haruo is not a very important character in the series, but plays a semi-important role in Higashi no Eden: Gekijouban I The King of Eden and Higashi No Eden: Gekijouban II Paradise Lost. Haruo is good at computers just like the other members of Edan of the East.

name: Alto Goldfield
native: アルト・ゴールドフィルド
description: Alto is the male protagonist of the Kinsou no Vermeil series. He is the one who summoned the most powerful devil of all time, [Vermeil](https://anilist.co/character/171759).

name: Vermeil
description: She is the devil summoned by [Alto Goldfield](https://anilist.co/character/171760) from a book that she was imprisoned in centuries ago.

name: Lilia Kudelfate
native: リリア・クーデルフェイト
description: [Alto](https://anilist.co/character/171760)'s childhood friend, who is in love with him and becomes jealous when [Vermeil](https://anilist.co/character/171759) appears and other girls surrounds Alto. She made a contract with a high-class wind spirit, named [Sylphid](https://anilist.co/character/319902).

name: François
description: [Marx](https://anilist.co/character/274616)'s familiar.

name: Kufa Vampir
native: クーファ=ヴァンピール
description:
Kufa is dispatched to Melida as her tutor (and her possible assassin), but continues to train Melida in defiance of his orders.

(Source: ANN)

name: Melida Angel
description:
Melida is a girl born in a family of Holy Knights but with no talent with mana.

(Source: ANN)

name: Elise Angel
description:
Elise is Melida's cousin and a Holy Knight who can use mana unlike Melida. She boasts the most talent in her class despite her stoic, silent nature.

(Source: ANN)

name: Rosetti Pricket
native: ロゼッティ=プリケット
description: Rosetti is an elite member of the holy city guards. She is currently Elise's tutor.

name: Kagura
description: __Height:__ 156 cm   Her name comes from Shinto ritual: the kanji for Kagura (神楽) meaning "entertainment of the gods". It was used to describe the traditional music played at shrines and the Imperial Court. Kagura also makes a cameo appearance as an anthropologist in Classroom of Thesis; From the Report to the Graduation Thesis by Kazuhisa Todayama which refers to several other Azumanga Daioh characters.  While she makes appearances earlier on as one of Nyamo's students, Kagura doesn't become a true acquaintance of the group until sometime later, joining Yukari's class in the 2nd year (Yukari selects her as a ringer to win the school athletic competitions). She devotes most of her time to the swim team but is an all-around good athlete. Thanks to her dedication to swimming Kagura receives some rather pronounced tan lines during the summer months, which friends like Osaka waste no time in pointing out.  She also has a one-sided rivalry with Sakaki and attempts to outdo her in all things, be it playing softball, sprinting, or even eating lunch. This is how her character was introduced to the rest of the cast, when during 1st year's field day, she was defeated by Sakaki in a running event. The next time the two meet, Kagura has decided to make Sakaki her rival, yet she also makes continuous attempts to be a good friend to Sakaki.

name: Ayumu Kasuga
description:
__Height:__ 156 cm

Ayumu Kasuga is a transfer student from Osaka. [Tomo](https://anilist.co/character/181), expecting her to act like the stereotypical Osakan—loud, exuberant and fond of jokes—chose for her the nickname "Osaka", although Ayumu's behavior could not be more different. Ayumu considers the name "slow" and "spacey", but she lacks the energy or motivation to dispute it. The nickname sticks so well that she is called Osaka by teachers and even in the class roster, to the point that no one remembers her real name. In the manga, Osaka mentions that she lived in Kobe when she was in elementary school and was born in Wakayama. Tomo, who says she doesn't know where Wakayama is, tells Ayumu to "just be Osaka".

name: Minamo Kurosawa
description: A gym teacher at the girls' school. In the girls' first year of high school, she is the homeroom teacher of Class 5. During their last two years, she is the homeroom teacher of Class 2. An old high school friend and rival of Yukari, they have a juvenile, exasperating, but funny relationship with each other; Yukari relentlessly insults and freeloads from Nyamo, but Nyamo gets her digs in, too. "Nyamo" is a nickname from her student days, but Yukari calls her that, and so does Tomo. Other students call her Kurosawa-sensei. Whereas Yukari appears to be an older version of Tomo, Nyamo resembles Yomi (more in personality than looks) and the two teachers' odd relationship is similar to the one that Tomo and Yomi share.  Popular with the students, Nyamo is nicer, less obnoxious, and far more in control than Yukari. Yukari often teases her about her past romantic relationships and that she is a "stupid P.E. teacher". During one of the summer trips the girls take together, Nyamo gets very drunk (usually, Yukari is prone to this behaviour; as a matter of fact, Nyamo drank specifically to keep the alcohol away from Yukari) and tells the girls all about the birds and the bees, which embarrasses Sakaki and confuses Chiyo, but impresses the other girls.  In addition to teaching her homeroom class and P.E., Nyamo is the coach/advisor of the women's swim team. Kagura calls her "Coach" and holds her in very high regard.

name: Chiyo Mihama
description: Chiyo Mihama , usually called Chiyo-chan, is a child prodigy, having skipped five grades to 10th grade (first year in Japanese high school) at the start of the series yet is still top of the class. Such grade-skipping would be unthinkable in Japan, and the series humorously explores its potential consequences. The other characters find Chiyo amazingly cute, but sometimes take advantage of both her youthfulness and her scholastic abilities. Her diminutive stature leads to her having a lack of confidence, particularly in sports where she fears she is a burden to others. Chiyo is frequently viewed with jealousy by fellow students, initially because of her intelligence, but later also because of the discovery that her family is exceedingly wealthy (they own an enormous mansion and a summer house which Chiyo invites her classmates to visit on several occasions). The stylistic rendering of Chiyo's pigtails allow for several visual gags in both the manga and anime: Osaka often imagines them to be flapping wings, or as entities independent of Chiyo herself. At home, she can almost always be found in the company of her enormous dog, Tadakichi-san. Of all of the girls, she is the only one who does not sit through college "entrance exams" as she intends to study overseas, possibly in America.

name: Koyomi Mizuhara
description: Koyomi Mizuhara, commonly known as Yomi, is a grade-school friend and general antithesis of Tomo. She is the voice of reason of the series, carrying herself as the most mature and serious of the group. Though smart and athletic, she is constantly dissatisfied with herself due to her weight and is always trying various diets in an effort to become thinner. She can never seem to stick to these diets however, as she finds herself constantly tempted by her favorite foods. Another weakness of Yomi's character is that while she is above average in everything else, Yomi is an awful singer, but karaoke is one of her favorite pastimes. While usually functioning as Tomo's "straight man", she sometimes manifests a rather cruel sense of humor. Yomi also has an uppercut that Tomo is usually on the receiving end of whenever she pushes Yomi too far. However, even though she likes to think that she is well above the childish behavior of some of her classmates, Yomi has demonstrated in the story that she can be just like the rest of the characters on certain occasions, such as trying to get Chiyo to infuse a shrine charm with some of her intelligence so that she could pass her college entrance exams.    (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Sakaki
description:
__Height:__ 174 cm

Sakaki is a quiet, stylish girl. Looking cool and distant, she's often seem staring out of the window. Being tall and well-endowed in both athletics and body, she's often admired by many girls in the school where Azumanga Daioh takes place. Despite being tall, cool and aloof or distant, deep in her heart she wishes to be small, soft, and cute, like [Chiyo-chan](https://anilist.co/character/247/Mihama-Chiyo), but she perceives that she can't - because of her height. She loves cats and always attempts to be friendly with them, but often gets scratched and bitten in response. Her soft and girly side shows when she's drawing, talking and reading about cats, or when she's holding one.

name: Tomo Takino
description:
Tomo Takino is extremely energetic and competitive, despite being nonathletic and a slacker at the same time. She tends to irritate everyone around her, especially [Yomi](https://anilist.co/character/182/Mizuhara-Koyomi), who has been her classmate since elementary school. Tomo's character is extremely impulsive and never considers nor cares about the consequences of anything she says or does. However, on the occasions when Tomo has actually been inspired to concentrate on something, she has demonstrated that she is quite capable. She succeeded in gaining the grades needed to qualify for the same high school as Yomi, though Yomi ridiculed her and openly said that there was no way that she could do so. Once Tomo began attending high school, however, she returned to her lackadaisical ways. 

 (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Yukari Tanizaki
description: Tanizaki Yukari is the girls' English and homeroom teacher (class 3), but a teacher with very unconventional methods and a close relationship with the class. Her students are casual enough to call her by her first name: Yukari-sensei, and even use the very informal and intimate name and title of Yukari-chan. She can be moody and, like Tomo, is incredibly impulsive and has a tendency not to think things through. Yukari has a rivalry/friendship with Minamo and attempts to prove that she is the superior teacher.

name: Chiyochichi
description: Chiyo's father first appears within a dream of Sakaki's, where he is given to her as a pet, claiming to be both a cat and Chiyo's father. In an episode not long after, a stuffed doll in his likeness is given to Chiyo for her birthday. He continues making appearances at regular intervals throughout the series, most often in Sakaki's daydreams.

name: Kamineko
description: Kamineko ( "Biting Cat" in Japanese) is a cute gray cat that Sakaki occasionally sees on the way to and from school. Having a great soft spot for cats, Sakaki tries to pet it, but it ends up latching its huge, beartrap-like teeth onto her hand. This becomes one of the series'; biggest running gags. Kamineko seems to bear Sakaki strong malice, and at one point attempts to rally an entire neighborhood's worth of cats to attack her. Tomo has somehow managed to get her hands on a plush version of Kamineko, complete with bear trap teeth.    (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Niina Sugawara
description: Kazusa's friend, a melancholic girl who the guys call a "crane" because of her fragile beauty. Initially, Niina ignores the boys because of a harassment experience in her childhood but gradually begins to develop feelings for Izumi because of his caring and kindness. Thus, her loyalty to her friend and their common love of one boy quickly becomes one of the main conflicts of the story.

appearsIn.title: O Maidens in Your Savage Season

name: Kazusa Onodera
description:
Kazusa is the series main lead. 
Since childhood, she has been in love with Izumi, but all this time she was afraid to take a step forward, while the mockery of more popular classmates did not motivate her to be more active in an attempt to attract his attention. However, as the story progresses, she notices that Izumi is clearly sexually attracted to Sugawara’s outstanding beauty and tenderness. She is Sugawara's friend and is childhood friends with Izumi and Momoko.

appearsIn.title: O Maidens in Your Savage Season

name: Momoko Sudou
description: A shy girl and Kazusa’s best friend. At first, like the other girls, she becomes interested in relationships with boys. However, as the story progresses, she gradually realizes her true feelings and growing attraction toward other girls. At first, she dismisses it as a misunderstanding about why girls like boys, but eventually she develops a one-sided crush on Sugawara.

appearsIn.title: O Maidens in Your Savage Season

name: Rika Sonezaki
description: The president of a literary club, a tall, prudish girl who is ashamed of her interest in the opposite sex because of her strict upbringing and serious nature. Nevertheless, in spite of her purism, she gets the most healthy relationship with guys compared to other girls. Over time she comes to realize that romantic affection and sexual attraction are not the same thing, thus she begins to lower her guard and starts a relationship with [Shun Amagi](https://anilist.co/character/141291/).

appearsIn.title: O Maidens in Your Savage Season

name: Hitoha Hongou
description: A blunt girl aspiring to publish erotica novels. Being a virgin, she relies on online adult chatrooms to get inspiration and feedback on her sexual writing. When her editor describes her first draft as if it was written by a virgin 40 year old man, she decides that she needs to go further on her journey for sexual knowledge.

appearsIn.title: O Maidens in Your Savage Season

name: Satoshi Sugimoto
description: A boy who attends the same cram school as Momoko and tries to start a relationship with her.

appearsIn.title: O Maidens in Your Savage Season

name: Izumi Norimoto
description: Kazusa's childhood friend and the subject of interest from her and Sugawara. A kind and caring young guy, he doesn't have any sexual experience or knowledge about love in general, therefore his problems with the differentiation of love and sexual attraction quickly become the cause of a love triangle and a conflict between him and two girls.

appearsIn.title: O Maidens in Your Savage Season

name: Hisashi Saegusa
description: A famous director, who also works in acting classes for little children, including one Sugawara attended.

appearsIn.title: O Maidens in Your Savage Season

name: Kumatetsu
description: Kumatetsu is a potential successor to the throne of the Beast Kingdom. He has to choose someone to be his apprentice and he ends up choosing a human boy named [Ren](https://anilist.co/character/122894) (and later names him Kyuuta).

name: Ren
description: A young boy who runs away from home and ends up accidentally going to the beast world. He meets a beast named [Kumatetsu](https://anilist.co/character/122871), who is a potential candidate to become lord of the beast world. Kumatetsu ends up making Ren his apprentice and later names him Kyuuta.

name: Kaede
description: Kaede is a kind girl who meets [Ren](https://anilist.co/character/122894) in the human world. Humbled by his kindness, yet baffled by his horrible Japanese, she offered to tutor him for free and they became good friends.

name: Ichirouhiko
description: The son of Iozen.

name: Iouzan
description: Iouzan is a father of two sons and a potential successor to the throne of the beast world.

name: Chiko
description:
Chiko is a strange beast that Ren finds. 
He will follow him to Jûtengai

name: Mikiya Kokutou
description:
__Height:__ 173 cm

[Shiki](https://anilist.co/character/3105/Ryougi-Shiki)'s friend who, two years ago, made a promise with Shiki to attend college.

He discovers a doll at an exhibition his friend asked him to and falls in love with its flawless craftsmanship. He is so charmed by it that he seeks out the maker, [Touko Aozaki](https://anilist.co/character/5266/Aozaki-Touko), and then finds her residence. With his hopes of attending college with Shiki crushed because of her coma, he drops out of college to work under Touko as an assistant investigator. Touko holds his investigative skills with high-regard because of his ability to find her workplace, an abandoned building hidden to all except those who wish to find it.

The male Shiki and the current Shiki call him Cocteau due to his last name's resemblance to Jean Cocteau's last name, though the current Shiki dislikes it for an unknown reason.

appearsIn.title: the Garden of sinners Chapter 1: Thanatos. (Overlooking View)

description:
__Height:__ 165 cm (5'5") 

Appearing as a puppet maker, Touko is actually an extremely powerful magus.

appearsIn.title: the Garden of sinners Chapter 1: Thanatos. (Overlooking View)

name: Kirie Fujyou
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm

A girl who was sick in a hospital bed. She has long hair, wearing all white. She could barely move and she was starting to lose her eye sight as well. Her parents and younger brother died soon after she got sick and she didn't get any visitors. She wouldn't last long and has always been looking out of the window. She must have been so lonely. Although she was scared of dying, that feeling of death was the only thing she was able to make her realize that she was alive.

appearsIn.title: the Garden of sinners Chapter 1: Thanatos. (Overlooking View)

name: Shiki Ryougi
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm

A teenage girl who possesses the "Mystic Eyes of Death Perception," a supernatural ability that allows her to view the death of any given object and destroy its origin. She recently recovered from a two-year coma caused by a traffic accident.

appearsIn.title: the Garden of sinners Chapter 1: Thanatos. (Overlooking View)

name: Azaka Kokutou
description:
**Height:** 160 cm 

Mikiya's younger sister, who she is in love with. She becomes an apprentice of Touko due to her rivalry with Shiki and is talented in the magic of ignition. She is quite similar both in appearance and abilities to Akiha Tohno (although Akiha's ability consists of controlling external heat, whereas Azaka's ability is inducing ignitions).

appearsIn.title: the Garden of sinners Chapter 1: Thanatos. (Overlooking View)

name: Maou
description: The main female protagonist and the supreme ruler of the Demon Realm. Soon after Demon Queen and the Hero join forces, she sets for the Human Realm, disguising herself as a human noblewoman known as the Crimson Scholar (紅の学士 Kurenai no Gakushi), and sharing a part of her vast knowledge with the Human society to help improve their civilization.  Becoming famous in the Human World not only by her feats, but also by her beauty, the Crimson Scholar is viewed with distrust by the church who brands her as a heretic in spite of her growing influence, fearing it would loosen its grasp over the countries helped by her. To ensure a temporary ceasefire between the Humans and Demons, the Demon Queen disseminates rumors that her battle with the Hero indeed occurred, resulting in his disappearance and her body becoming severely wounded, thus leading her servants to the false belief that she would not be able to command them until her recuperation is completed.

name: Yuusha
description:
The main male protagonist and the greatest warrior of the Human realm. He gives up on his task of slaying the Demon Queen after he is convinced to join her in her efforts to ensure a truly peaceful solution to the war between Humans and Demons by first addressing the issues of both societies that could put them into greater turmoil once the conflict ends. 

He is an unequaled swordsman capable of standing against the strongest Human or Demon, along with being capable of powerful magic ranging from healing to creating familiar spirits, and able to instantly teleport to any location he previously visited. He eventually develops feelings for the Demon Queen which are also requited. 

As part of the Demon Queen's plan, he conceals his true identity and adopts the name of White Swordsman (白の剣士 Shiro no Kenshi?). While traveling through the Demon Realm as a peacekeeper, he dons an imposing black armor belonging to a former Demon Lord, addressing himself as a servant of the Demon Queen called the Black Knight (黒騎士 Kuro Kishi?). 

The Hero used to fight along three companions: a Female Knight, an Archer, and a Wizard, all of whom went separate ways after the Hero left the party to confront the Demon Queen alone.

name: Fukukan
description: Appears in episode 6.

name: Rekidai Maou
description: Spirit of the former Demon Kings.  First appearance: episode 11

name: Higashi no Saishou
description: Appears in episode 6.

name: Tetsukoku Shoui
description: Lieutenant from the Land of Steel.  Appears in episode 11.

name: Maid Chou
description: The Demon King's most trusted servant and commander of her army. She usually does not refrain from expressing her point of view even before her master. Despite making unflattering comments to her master, she remains loyal to her master ever since they were children.

name: Onna Kishi
description: One of the members of Hero's old party. A powerful swordswoman who also excels as a commander in battle. She reunites with the Hero by accident much to her surprise, as no one had news from him since he left for the Demon Realm. Despite failing to get a proper explanation from him, she joins the Crimson Scholar's efforts to improve Human society by teaching swordsmanship to her students. The Female Knight eventually becomes a close friend to the Crimson Scholar, staying by her side even after learning about her true identity, but also viewing her as a rival for the hero's affection as she also loves him.

name: Chikage Rokujo
description: Rokujo Chikage is a biker gang leader whose members were attacked      He is a strong fighter, who fought Shizuo in the 5th novel. He and Kadota were fighting at the end of 6th novel.    Chikage is a ladies man who has a throng of girls follow him around. However, like a gentleman, Chikage refuses to harm any female, enemy or not.

name: Aoba Kuronuma
description: Aoba is 1st year student in Raira Academy. He has a bright personality and is always seen smiling, but has also a darker side to him. He's described as being akin to "a younger version of [Izaya Orihara](https://anilist.co/character/24596/Orihara-Izaya)".

name: Tom Tanaka
description:
Tom Tanaka is an old friend and senpai of Shizuo Heiwajima. He works as a debt collector, and later becomes Shizuo's employer. Tom is usually seen walking around in a suit, but his clothing and his hair don't make him look too formal. This is probably due to his job as a debt collector, which needs him to look sharp and business-like but not too polite and friendly, as he often confronts people. It is likely that he works as an underground debt collector, and not for something like a bank. The light novels state that he works for an online dating website. He generally has a sort of reserved, laid back personality, and as harsh as you might expect an underground debt collector to be. He is usually calm, and is able to calm Shizuo down and make him stop without angering him and incurring his wrath.  

(Source: Durarara wiki)

name: Mika Harima
description: During the Raira Academy entrance exam, Harima Mika sits between Mikado and Seiji and falls in love with Seiji. She immediately begins collecting information about him. Later Seiji saves Mika and Anri from a gang of bullies. Mika then starts to stalk Seiji.

A Japanese-language teacher.

He's an 'average' high school student who somehow seems to get into ridiculous situations with his teacher, [Kana Kojima](https://anilist.co/character/135226/Kojima-Kana). He also has zero luck with girls.

A high school student feared by his giant stature and scary face, but at heart he is a kind person.

Taka-kun's neighbor and childhood friend. Despite her constant teasing, they're always stuck together.

appearsIn.title: Why the hell are you here, Teacher!?

__Height:__ 176 cm (5'7")

Kou is a 3rd year at Kawanuma-higashi High School.

appearsIn.title: Why the hell are you here, Teacher!?

name: Deldro Brody
native: デルドロ ブローディ
description: Brody can materialize as a gigantic living armour that surrounds Hummer, granting him immense physical strength.

name: Luciana Estevez
native: ルシアナ・エステヴェス
description:
Luciana Estevez is a doctor and former human.

She is able to divide herself into numerous units causing her to de-age and look like a child.

Blood Technique:

Phardem Triga - Luciana and her clones slices her victims with her scalpel, thus, causing the latter to split into pieces. The clones then become one Luciana who has longer hair and a more mature physique.

(Source: Kekkai Sensen Wikia)

name: Dog Hummer
description: A handsome man who had his blood replaced with the liquefied body of the serial killer and "bad boy" Deldro Brody.

name: Patrick
description: A Libra agent known as the Armoury.

name: Zed O'Brien
native: ツェッド・オブライエン
description:
A stern merman with similar powers to Zapp, as they were both taught by the same master. Joins Libra after being abandoned in Hellsalem's Lot. A stark contrast to Zapp, Zed is a decidedly serious individual who has little patience for nonsense, particularly those of his fellow disciple.

As a merman, he has yellow eyes, blue skin with black markings adorning his head & wrist-blades that extend backwards like fins. He wears a black, sleeveless muscle-shirt, finger-less gloves & green cargo pants with metal sneakers. There is also a water breathing apparatus around his neck with a very sleek design, making them look like headphones.

He is also usually quiet and easy to get along with, going with the flow of events and tries to be agreeable. He is very well read, often seen reading books in his spare time due to the fact that in the past his creator, an unknown count, talked with him a lot about poetry and music, art and science, philosophy, astronomy etc. In addition, he feels a strong sense of loneliness as he is the only one of his kind, since he is a heteromorph who is half fish half human and is therefore not human but also not a creature from Hellsalem’s lot and as a result is rejected by both species.

name: William Macbeth
native: ウィリアム・マクベス
description:
A fairly talkative person with a sweet and caring nature, he is also a rather awkward individual. Upon meeting [Leonardo](https://anilist.co/character/89025/) for the first time, he readily introduces himself and acts in a relaxed and friendly manner.

During Leo and Black’s lunch together, it is established that the two have a lot in common, especially when it comes to having low self-esteem. Black is shown to feel rather insecure about himself and his abilities, showing no hesitation in talking down on himself when recounting memories of being bullied in his younger years. Along with this, Black is also shown to be awkward and clumsy when he spills his drink all over himself in front of Leo, and is shown to panic in the embarrassing situation in an exaggerated manner.

He is White's older brother. Black is incredibly protective of his younger twin sister [White](https://anilist.co/character/89024), as seen in multiple occasions throughout the series, especially when he is seen desperately trying to keep the King of Despair from involving her in his plans. As children, he and White were raised lovingly by their parents, however Black began to develop feelings of being lesser than his family due to the fact he saw himself as emotionally weak. He came to this conclusion when he and White were making mud balls together when they were very little, and when White made better a mud ball than him he used his psychic powers to burst the ball out of frustration.

name: Steven A. Starphase
native: スティーブン・Ａ・スターフェイズ
description:
__Occupation:__ Fang Hunter

Steven Alan Starphase is Libra's second-in-command. A shady man with many connections, and a genius of deception and intuition. Seemingly laid back, he gives off an air of a suave businessman, always with a quip or sardonic comment to make about the situation. When crossed, however, he shows a ruthless side, and is not above using his connections to make 'problems' disappear. Steven is the middle child in his family and he has at least two sisters, one older and one younger.

name: Wein Arbalest
native: ウェイン・サレマ・アルバレスト
description:
Wein is the crown prince of Natra. He will take over the future of the country on behalf of his sick father. Although the retainers trust him due do his superior position, he is actually lazy. He wants to sell the deadlocked kingdom of Natra and lead a comfortable retired life.

(Source: Official Site, translated)

appearsIn.title: The Genius Prince's Guide to Raising a Nation Out of Debt

name: Ninym Ralei
description: Ninym is a beautiful white-haired, red-eyed Flahm girl who is [Wein](https://anilist.co/character/206359/Arbalest-Salema-Wein)'s childhood friend. As his top aide, she assists him in everything from affairs of the state to combat. She is among the few who know what he is really like, as well as the kingdom's current dire straits.

appearsIn.title: The Genius Prince's Guide to Raising a Nation Out of Debt

name: Fyshe Blundell
native: フィシュ・ブランデル
description: An ambassador dispatched from the Earthworld Empire to the Kingdom of Natra. A calm and capable young bureaucrat who has earned the trust of [Princess Lowellmina](https://anilist.co/character/206741/Earthworld-Lowellmina) as her aide back in the Empire. She keeps a close eye on [Wein](https://anilist.co/character/206359/Arbalest-Salema-Wein)'s talent and movements.

appearsIn.title: The Genius Prince's Guide to Raising a Nation Out of Debt

name: Falanya Elk Arbalest
native: フラーニャ・エルク・アルバレスト
description: The younger sister of [Wein Salema Arbalest](https://anilist.co/character/206359/Wein-Salema-Arbalest).

appearsIn.title: The Genius Prince's Guide to Raising a Nation Out of Debt

name: Lowellmina Earthworld
native: ロウェルミナ・アースワルド
aliases: Lowa Felbis (ロワ・フェルビス)
description: The youngest princess of the Earthworld Empire and a former classmate of [Wein](https://anilist.co/character/206359/Arbalest-Salema-Wein) and [Ninym](https://anilist.co/character/206374/Ralei-Ninym).

appearsIn.title: The Genius Prince's Guide to Raising a Nation Out of Debt

name: Zeno
description: An executive officer in the Marden Liberation Army. He is the aide of [Prince Helmut](https://anilist.co/character/207258/Helmut), the leader of the army. A brilliant man with keen insight, but there are times when he becomes emotionally absorbed in his vengeance against the Kingdom of Cavarin, which conquered his homeland.

appearsIn.title: The Genius Prince's Guide to Raising a Nation Out of Debt

name: Nanaki Ralei
description: Nanaki is the bodyguard of princess Falanya Elk Arbalest.

appearsIn.title: The Genius Prince's Guide to Raising a Nation Out of Debt

name: Caldmellia
description: Director of Levetia's Gospel Bureau. She is a shrewd woman who rose to the position of director of the prestigious Gospel Bureau, in a society where women are not allowed to hold important positions. She is a cunning individual who hides her craftiness behind a smile and a gentle atmosphere.

appearsIn.title: The Genius Prince's Guide to Raising a Nation Out of Debt

name: Hagal
description: General of the Kingdom of Natra. A veteran of the battlefield, he is trusted by Wein with handling military affairs. He holds Wein's talents in high regard, and works to suppress the local lords who are dissatisfied with his leadership.

appearsIn.title: The Genius Prince's Guide to Raising a Nation Out of Debt

name: Raklum
description: Commander of the Kingdom of Natra's army. He is loyal to Wein, spearheading him into battle, and in some cases serving as his bodyguard. Though he has a large physique, his modest nature keeps him from seeming intimidating.

appearsIn.title: The Genius Prince's Guide to Raising a Nation Out of Debt

name: Akira Inukai
description: A young man with an unfriendly, blunt, but also honest personality. He's the kind of person to act before speaking. [Tamarai](https://anilist.co/character/89838/Tamarai-Honoka) and [Asaji](https://anilist.co/character/89840/Asaji-Nobunaga) call him "Aki (-chan)."

name: Kazuyoshi Usui
aliases: Mr. Wild Pitch (ミスターワイルドピッチ)
description:
__School:__ Kaimei High School
__Class:__ 2-C (chapters 1-209); 3-C (chapters 210-288)
__Affiliation:__ Sket Dan

Switch is the brains and secretary of the Sket Dan. As a result of the events that happened in his life, he opts to speak through a voice synthesizer on his computer. 

He has a deadpan sense of humor and seems to enjoy teasing others. Because he always communicates through speech synthesis software and has a tendency to joke with a straight face, it is difficult to tell what he is really thinking. While he usually "speaks" without much emotion, he would sometimes purposely raise his "voice" to abnormally high levels for comic relief. He often becomes very passionate about anime and often provides a very detailed and hilariously in depth commentary on the various anime featured in the series. He also has a strong belief in Science which is shown through his rivalry against Occult lover, [Reiko Yuuki](https://anilist.co/character/40307/).



(Source: SKET Dance Wiki)

name: Gedoumaru
description: Gedoumaru is a Shikigami of the Ketsuno Clan. She was given to Sakata Gintoki of the Yorozuya as a precaution, during the Exorcist Chapter, by Ketsuno Ana, who had requested the Yorozuya's assistance.  Cold and relentless, Gedoumaru will do anything to beat her opponent, as seen in Episode 195 when she tricked the other Shikigami into thinking her mother had just died, when it was all just an act to get them to lower their guard. If her master shows any sign of weaknesses, she will turn on him.   Gedoumaru was caught by the Ketsuno clan when she was tearing up Mt. Oe during the Heian period, and was forced to serve them ever since, as told by Gedoumaru herself in Episode 195.

name: Pandemonium
description: She was one of the objects of the Pandemonium-eating contest held in episode 197. Shinpachi had to eat her.

name: Tsuu Terakado
description: An idol pop singer whose song lyrics are often very dirty or controversial. She started her career singing on the sides of streets. This was when Shinpachi met her and has followed her ever since, being captain of her fan club. Her talent was recognized by Bansai Kawakami (under his producer alias "Tsunpo"), and she has since gained popularity. Her mother manages her, and her father is currently serving time in prison. When she was younger, her father made a bet with her, saying that if she became famous, he would bring a number of roses to her first concert. He broke out of prison specially for the occasion, and although he couldn't give her the roses, he gave her a single flower. He donned a paper bag over his head, so he wouldn't trouble her with his presence, yet she knew it was him, and thanked him with tears in her eyes.  She had previously dated a man named Goemon, who worked in the entertainment industry alongside her. Tsu admired him greatly, as "he was the only person who was nice to her", but it was revealed that Goemon truly thought nothing of her, and even went as far as to send her threatening anonymous letters advising her to finish with him.  She became part of the Shinsengumi for a day, to raise morale.  She is often referred to as "Otsu" due to her habit of making words using the last letter of previous words (Terakad-O-Tsuu.)

name: Tama
description:
__Height:__ 166 cm 

Tama is an android that was found by Gintoki. At the time she was only a disembodied head. She was given her name by Kagura, who was obsessed with eating egg on rice at the time. She is an android maid currently working at Otose's Snack House. When she isn't cleaning or serving Otose's customers, she often visits the Yorozuya Gin-Chan to collect rent.  Tama was originally an android created by Professor Hayashi to provide his sickly daughter with a companion. But when the professor tried to implant the personality of his daughter into Tama, the experiment killed his daughter in the process. Tama however, possesses the element known as the "Seed", allowing her to retain some of Fuyou's personality and making her capable of human emotions.  Even though Tama is an android, she is capable of human emotions. Her interactions with living human beings, however, often seem to be severely limited by her lack of knowledge of the outside world. This is due to a memory loss she already suffered before her initial introduction. As the series progresses, however, it seems that Tama learns more and more just from being around the Yorozuya Gin-Chan. She also seems to have some rather strange main functions, such as imitating the Dragon Quest RPG.

name: Aria Shichijou
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm 

Aria Shichijou is a second-year student (later a third-year student) who serves as the Student Council as Secretary and Shino Amakusa's best friend. She is the most mature character in appearance and comes from an affluent family. However, her mind tends to follow the same paths as Shino, seemingly more so and seems especially interested in bondage

name: Shino Amakusa
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm

The student council president and a second-year student. She is serious, diligent, and talented in most subjects. However, she is almost always thinking of perverted things, even suggesting that one of her main reasons to be interested in [Tsuda](https://anilist.co/character/32770/Tsuda-Takatoshi) is curiosity about information not covered in health classes. She is also a very popular girl with a lot of female fans in school, and has a complex about her chest, which is exacerbated by the fact that [Aria](https://anilist.co/character/32798/Shichijou-Aria) happens to be more well-endowed than she is. She later develops some feelings for Tsuda.

name: Takatoshi Tsuda
description:
The main character of the story, he chooses to attend a former all-girl school simply because it is close to his home. The first day at the school, he is forced to join the student council as its vice president and sole male representative.

Tsuda plays the role of the straight man, and is often worn out by his friends' antics.

name: Suzu Hagimura
description:
__Height:__ 140.6 cm

A first-year, sixteen-year-old genius return student. She's really the most mature of the characters, but she is very sensitive about her body, which still appears to be that of an elementary school student. She is the smartest student at Ousai Academy and boasts an IQ of 180. She can also perform 10-digit calculations in her head.

name: Naruko Yokoshima
description: A teacher at Ōsai Academy, who happens to be the advisor of the student council. She, like Aria and Shino, often has perverted thoughts on her mind, and apparently has a thing for younger guys (and the male students of the school are often targeted by her). She is often portrayed as unreliable and useless, from an educator's point of view.    (Source: Wikipediea)

name: Mutsumi Mitsuba
description: A member from the judo club. She is the one who approached Tsuda to ask to create a judo club and is very passionate about judo. She has an innocent way of thinking. She listens to the student council president, Shino and it's shown that she also looks up to her. She is hinted to have feelings for Tsuda.

name: Kaede Igarashi
description: A member of the Disciplinary committee. She is afraid of men.

name: Ranko Hata
description: Ranko Hata is the head of the school's newspaper club. She likes to take photos of the student council members to sell around the school, usually without the permission of those being photographed, and she often gets caught. When she conducts an interview, she likes to twist the responses to something dirty or perverted, with Tsuda as a frequent target; running gags in the series have her constantly trying to get Shino and Takatoshi to admit that they are dating, or her admitting to spreading rumors about it, much to their chagrin.
