She is expressionless most of the time (but has been shown to smile on infrequent occasions) and has a deadpan monotone voice in the anime, which strongly contrasts with the other girls' excitable temperaments. She is also the only character who breaks from standard movement conventions, namely sliding across floors, phasing through doors, etc. She has a habit of saying "kodak" whenever she is about to take a photo of someone and in one of the episodes every time she took pictures Aria and Shino would erase it afterward.

name: Sayaka Dejima
description: Aria's maid at home. She's good with cooking and cleaning, but can still be ditzy and unreliable as her master.

name: Kenji Yanagimoto
description: Takatoshi Tsuda's classmate

name: Lio Fotia
description: The leader of Mad Burnish. Lio seems like someone who keeps his cool, but it's actually the opposite. Lio aims to burn everything with the power of a special flame called "Burnish Flare".

name: Galo Thymos
description:
Galo Thymos is the Burning Rescue's newest recruit. Set with a burning passion to extinguish all that is wrong, you can expect Galo to rush in first to the scene of an emergency. His 'Burning Soul' is his strongest characteristic.

Galo isn't one for planning ahead of time and often speaks his mind. He is willful and often relies on that to get through battles. While Galo appears to be all brawn and no brain at first, he is actually deeply compassionate and hates to see others hurt. Furthermore, his plans, while odd, have been shown to work. Said plans consistently use the likes of hikeshi and Matoi as a basis such as his first rescue. He also has a heavy interest in Edo period firemen. This has resulted in him giving PowerPoints on the subject and incorporating them into his personal mech.

name: Heris Ardebit
native: エリス・アルデビット
description:
Aina’s sister and a young female doctor who belongs to the Foresight Laboratory and is a member of Burning Rescue. She works for a very peculiar development in the laboratory…

(Source: Official site)

name: Kray Foresight
native: クレイ・フォーサイト
description: The administrator of the Independent Republic of Promepolis and chief director of the Foresight Foundation. He used to research fireproof building materials, but successfully developed an instant-freeze bullet that can put out a Burnish fire. Galo looks up to him.

name: Deus Prometh
description: A scientist who has been researching Burnish for many years as a national research team. Much about the man and his research remains a mystery.

name: Gueira
description: A leading member of Mad Burnish along with his comrades Lio and Meis.

name: Aina Ardebit
native: アイナ・アルデビット
description: A member of Burning Rescue who, like Galo, is in her teens. She is cool, calm, and professional at all times, and does things at her own pace. She plays the straight man to Galo and Varys.

name: Vulcan Haestus
native: ヴァルカン・ヘイストス
description: Vulcan is the Colonel of Freeze Force, a police and military organization responsible for war against Burnish crimes and attacks, specifically Mad Burnish. A hardened, mildly hysterical man whose more than a little enthusiastic about both his position and mission.

name: Remi Puguna
description: The vice-captain of Burning Rescue. He's a good-looking guy in his 20s, and he is as smart as he looks. He is an indispensable adviser to the captain Ignis.

name: Ganta Nakami
description: A high school student of Kuyo High School who suffers from insomnia. He comes off as grumpy and unfriendly due to his condition. Ganta is determined to protect the observatory and the revived Astronomy Club, of which he becomes the president.

name: Isaki Magari
description: A cheerful high school girl who also suffers from insomnia like Ganta. She first discovered the abandoned observatory and made it her sleeping haven, until Ganta came along.

name: Usako Kurashiki
description: School nurse and advisor of the Astronomy Club.

name: Yui Shiromaru
description: Former member of the Astronomy Club, where she won the grand prize in the National High School Astrophotography Contest.

name: Nikolai Gogol
description:
__Height:__ 184 cm (6’0)
__Ability:__ The Overcoat

Nikolai Gogol is a member of the Decay of Angels. He's a sadist who enjoys putting on a show with his words. He is freakish, vigorous, unrepentant, and quite enigmatic. However, Gogol suggests that his quirky image could or might not be real. The side of him that has no remorse for murdering others is just as genuine as the one who has guilt and is well aware of the unjust and cruel nature of his acts. He joined the Decay of Angels in order to experience what he had always desired: freedom against gravity.

The Overcoat, Gogol's ability, allows him to use his coat to manipulate spaces and what emerges from it. It functions essentially as a portal, capable of relocating and moving anything. He may use this to materialize a pillar or to manifest his hand and pistol in a location unrelated to him. The ability is also applicable to living beings.

name: Edgar Poe
native: エドガー・アラン・ポオ
description:
__Height:__ 182 cm (6'0")
__Ability:__ Black Cat in the Rue Morgue

A member of The Guild who is rarely seen without his pet raccoon, Karl. Poe's ability, Black Cat in the Rue Morgue, can transport someone into a story they're reading.
Poe is portrayed as shy but determined. He spent six years on a plot to defeat Ranpo, showing that he will work hard at something he cares about. He often talks too quietly for others to hear.

name: Ango Sakaguchi
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm
__Ability:__ Discourse on Decadence 

Port Mafia's former exclusive informant. Works as an assistant counselor at the Special Ability Department at the Ministry of Internal Affairs.

For the most part, Ango is a composed, calm young man, showing more restraint than [Osamu Dazai](https://anilist.co/character/89198/Dazai-Osamu) and more discipline than [Oda Sakunosuke](https://anilist.co/character/120625/Oda-Sakunosuke). Although he values both as genuine friends, he strongly believes that Dazai needs someone to keep him from acting out as much as he does.

name: Mushitarou Oguri
description: A member of the "Rats in the House of the Dead". His ability is "The Perfect Crime."

name: Michizou Tachihara
description:
__Height:__ 176 cm
__Ability:__ Midwinter Memento

A commander of the Black Lizards, the Port Mafia's squad of hitmen. Though he puts up a tough and violent front, he cares deeply for his friends. Very skilled gunner, especially when dual wielding.

name: Tokio Murakami
description: The lead actor of the play *The Living World Is a Dream, the Nocturnal Dream is Reality* performed at Theatrum Mundi.

name: Seiji Amasawa
description: A boy who first appeared reading a book that Shizuku had left behind. In the book, Shizuku left her song lyrics inside, and Seiji read them. He, in reality, liked them, but when Shizuku returned to retrieve her book, he called the lyrics corny, which caused her to call him a jerk. He's frequently seen riding his bicycle during the movie. Like once when Shizuku forgot her lunch in his grandfather's shop, he returned the lunch to her, with his bicycle. He playfully comments on the enormous amounts of food inside the lunch, asking her if she eats that much. Shizuku again yells at him. Their first real pleasant encounter is when Shizuku stops Shiro Nishi's (Seiji's grandfather) store while it's closed. She explains to Seiji that she wanted to see The Baron again. So Seiji takes her inside the shop and shows her the cat, he even let's the sun glisten in in the cat's eye. Shizuku is mesmerized by it.  Seiji is an asipiring violin crafter. He even plays a little bit, yet he really loves making them. He wants to become a professional, much to his parent's dismay. He says that only his grandfather supports him. Shizuku pleads him to play a little, and he agrees on one condition. Shizuku must sing along. So the two of them play and sing the song "Country Road". Midway through the song, Seiji's grandfather comes with two of his friends and they join in. This is when Seiji and Shizuku first become great friends.

name: Shizuku Tsukishima
description: Shizuku is a junior high student living in the Tokyo Suburb of Tama New Town. She loves to write, or at least has the potential for she writes the translation of the song "Country Road" from English to Japanese for graduation (she also creates her own version for Tokyo, which shows that potential as well). At the beginning of the film, it's summer and all the students are awaiting the arrival of the new school year. Shizuku is determined to read at least twenty books before that happens. Her local library does not have one that she wants to read the most, so she goes to school to find it and it's there. While she is checking it out, she notices the name "Amasawa Seiji" on the card. And she remembers that most of the other books had that same name. It turns out that it's a boy in her same grade, whom had mocked her original lyrics to "Country Road' as corny earlier. She calls him a jerk, without even knowing who it is.

name: Humbert von Gikkingen Danshaku
native: フンベルト・フォン・ジッキンゲン男爵
description: As the owner of the strange "Cat Bureau", he is known as a helper to all. He is an artisan's statue that somehow has been brought to life.

name: Muta
description: A fat, cynical cat who leads Haru to the Baron.

name: Yuko Harada
description: Shizuku's best friend. She enjoys singing and gossip. At the beginning of the movie, she was shown singing one of Shizuku's songs, and then admitting to her, that she has a crush on a boy named Sugimura.

name: Asako Tsukishima
description: Shizuku's mother.

name: Shiho Tsukishima
description: Shizuku's older sister. She's very supportive for her sister.

name: Nishi Shiro
description: Seiji's grandfather. He owns a small private antique store and restoration shop. He is a kind and gentle old man with a great deal of life wisdom that he shares with the people around him.

name: Masaya Kaburagi
description: Masaya Kaburagi is a TV and Web-TV producer.

name: Minami Kotobuki
description: She's a classmate and friend of Ruby Hoshino. Minami is a Gravure model who uses a fake accent.

name: Leo Demonheart
description:
**Abilities:**
-Crimson Comet: A High level attack magic
-Twelve Layers Of Barrier (Statis)': A High level magic which can nullify or seal any type of magic regardlessly.
-Voice Changer: A magic that allows to change your voice to anybody's.
-Metamorphisis: A magic for disguise.
-Clearance: A magic which can heals diseases or curses.
-Mirage Eye: A magic technique that can send the information that was seen as it is in its eyes to its caster.

Leo Demonheart is the strongest of all of the Twelve Demonheart Series. He is the main protagonist of the Yuusha, Yamemasu series.

name: Echidna
description: Echidna is the demon queen leading the latest invasion on mankind in search of the Philosopher's Stone. After being defeated by Leo Demonheart, she was driven into retreat, but seeks to rebuild her army.

name: Eibrad
description: Eibrad is an imp that went to earth, he is nice to humans and cares about peoples wellbeing

name: Steina
description: Steina is one of the Heavenly Kings of the Demon Army. She is the magic general.

name: Lily
description: Lily is one of the Heavenly Kings of the Demon Army. She is the beast general.

name: Melnes
description: A fast assassin, one of the headmasters of the Demon Army.

name: Edvard
description: Edvard is one of the Heavenly Kings of the Demon Army. He is the dragon general.

name: Dianet
description: Steina assistant

name: Jerietta
description: Jerietta is the aide and daughter of the Edvard.

name: Binolt
description: A skilled Blacklist Hunter who's also on the wanted list himself, he has the ability to learn every bit of information from someone after chewing on someones hair that's been cut using his favorite scissors.  He preys on Bisuke but does not back down after learning about her true form, requesting a match without Nen.   Being beaten by Bisuke, he's being forced to practice with Gon and Killua.

name: Koala
description: Koala was a soldier under Meleoron's command, but disapproved of Meleoron's pacifist attitude. He generally does not take part in the war between the Hunters and Chimera Ants. After Meleoron has gone individual, he is presumably free from any duty.

name: Wing
description: Wing is a Nen trainer whose main student is Zushi. He meets Gon and Killua at the Celestial Tower. Although in the beginning he refuses to train Gon and Killua, and even lies to them about Nen's purpose, he changes his mind when they reach the 200th floor, as he realizes they could die or be badly injured from nen "initiation". For the next several months he teaches them the basics of Nen, after which he announces they have passed the secret final requirement for being a Hunter. His teacher was Biscuit Kruger.

name: Todo
description: Todo is a wrestler and aspires to become a blacklist hunter. He is the 255th participant in the 287th Hunter Exam. As stated by Tonpa before the start of 1st stage of the Hunter Exam, Todo is a lot smarter than he looks. He shows the sense to not jump down the ravine at Split Mountain. He seems to be irritable hate injustice and is very opinionated and judgmental as he protests against Menchi's initial disqualification of the entire hunter examine pool, believing culinary ability is not necessary in becoming a hunter and that gourmet hunters are inferior to other hunter types. He seems to have a vengeful streak, as he swears he will not forget his humiliation at the hands of the two gourmet hunter examiners.

name: Nozomi Kaminashi
description:
Nozomi Kaminashi is the main protagonist of Keijo!!!!!!!!. She was a student at Setouchi Keijo Training School. She previously resided in Room 309 before being promoted to the Elite Class.

Upon graduating from Setouchi, Nozomi officially becomes a B-Rank Keijo player, affiliated with the Kansai's Hyougo Branch. After her winless start in the professional world of Keijo, Nozomi tries to seek a mentor to guide her. After meeting [Sumire Sakuragi](https://anilist.co/character/271330/Sakuragi-Sumire), Nozomi asks Sumire to become her mentor. Although Sumire initially refused, Sumire is later willing to become soeur with her.

After her match with [Sayaka Miyata](https://anilist.co/character/90194/Miyata-Sayaka), Nozomi is able to advance to the A-Rank. Sometime later, Nozomi and Sayaka start to stay in the Garden Worth, a lodging for Keijo players, where they reunite with [Hanabi Kawai](https://anilist.co/character/121783/Kawai-Hanabi) and [Saya Kogatana](https://anilist.co/character/136254/Kogatana-Saya).

name: Sayaka Miyata
description:
Kaminashi's first friend and rival. 

Before Keijo used to be a judo's athlete, she was the Japan's hope for a golden medal in the Olympics but threw it all away in the qualifications. She has a complex about her bust size and Kaminashi usually makes fun about it.

She previously resided in Room 309 before being promoted to the Elite Class. Upon graduating from Setouchi, Sayaka officially becomes a B-Rank Keijo player, affiliated with the Kansai's Hyougo Branch.

name: Kazane Aoba
description:
She is a student at Setouchi Keijo Training School, a former resident of Room 309 and currently a member of the Elite Class.

Upon graduating from Setouchi, Kazane officially becomes a B-Rank Keijo player, affiliated with the Chugoku's Hiroshima Branch. Sometime later, she is able to advance to the A-Rank.

name: Non Toyoguchi
description:
Non Toyoguchi was a student at Setouchi Keijo Training School. She previously resided in Room 309 before being promoted to the Elite Class.

Upon graduating from Setouchi, Non officially becomes a B-Rank Keijo player, affiliated with the Kyushu's Kagoshima Branch. Sometime later, she is able to advance to the A-Rank.

name: Rin Rokudou
description:
Rin Rokudo was a student at Setouchi Keijo Training School. She was ranked second in the Elite Class.

Upon graduating from Setouchi, Rin officially becomes a B-Rank Keijo player, affiliated with the Kansai's Hyougo Branch. Sometime later, she is able to advance to the A-Rank.

name: Miku Kobayakawa
description: Miku Kobayakawa is a former S-Rank Keijo player. She is currently working as an instructor at Setouchi Keijo Training School. She specializes in giving classroom lessons.

name: Nami Nanase
description:
Nami Nanase also known as the Butt Eater Nanase (尻喰いの七瀬, Shiri Kui no Nanase), was a student at Suruga Keijo Training School.

Upon graduating from Suruga, Nanase officially becomes a Keijo player. Sometime later, she is able to advance to the A-Rank.

name: Saya Kogatana
description:
Saya Kogatana was a student at Setouchi Keijo Training School. She was ranked sixth in the Elite Class.

Upon graduating from Setouchi, Saya officially becomes a B-Rank Keijo player, affiliated with the Kansai's Kyoto Branch. After collecting enough points, she is able to advance to the A-Rank.

name: Satomi  Shiomi
description: She is an interviewer.

name: Mai Itoeda
description: Mai Itoeda was a student at Suruga Keijo Training School. She was ranked eighth in Suruga.

name: Senko
description:
__Race:__ Kitsune+
__Height:__ 135 cm (4'5")

Her name is Senko, and she’s a divine messenger fox of 800 years! Her mission is to ease the anxiety and darkness plaguing humanity, and thus she has come to pamper and take care of [Nakano](https://anilist.co/character/130431/Nakano-Kuroto) by cooking, cleaning, and more!

name: Kuroto Nakano
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm

Nakano is a depressed salaryman working for an exploitative company, until [Senko](https://anilist.co/character/130429/Senko) intrudes into his life!

name: Yasuko Kouenji
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm

She is a student and mangaka. She is the next door neighbor of [Kuroto Nakano](https://anilist.co/character/130431/Nakano-Kuroto) and [Senko-san](https://anilist.co/character/130429/Senko).

Spoiler:

name: Shiro
description:
__Height:__ 140 cm

Another fox goddess, who appears at [Nakano](https://anilist.co/character/130431/Nakano-Kuroto)’s house after [Senko](https://anilist.co/character/130429/Senko). Her pure white tail is a proof of her pure blood! She has special abilities like reading people’s hearts and seeing visions.

name: Sora
description:
__Height:__ 145 cm

A black fox with four tails. She seems to be a Demi Fox goddess like [Senko](https://anilist.co/character/130429/Senko) and [Shiro](https://anilist.co/character/130430/Shiro).

name: Don Tanukiman
description: A character from the Little Yoko, Inari Girl anime shown in this anime.

name: Little Yoko
description: Little Yoko or Inari Girl is a character from the anime with the same name shown in Sewayaki Kitsune no Senko-san.

name: Mitaka
description: Mitaka is background character. He works in the same corporation as Nakano. Mitaka is asking Nakano for assist often, what ends with main character is coming back late home or sleep in office.

name: Suzu
description: She is a training divine messenger.

name: Albedo
description: The overseer of the Floor Guardians and one of the most powerful NPC in Nazarick. She takes the form of a beautiful woman with fallen angel wings and horns. Because [Ainz](https://anilist.co/character/89103) modified her settings on a whim, she ends up madly in love with him. Albedo's romantic obsessions are so strong that if Ainz were to even glance at her body, she would immediately become excited. Albedo's obsession with Ainz has led him to greatly regret his actions. While she tries to act calm, as befitting of her role, any perceived insult against Ainz or Nazarick, real or imagined, sends her into a rage. Like most inhabitants of Nazarick, she despises humans which she refers to as "lower life-forms."

name: Shou
description: Shou is a young boy who befriends Arrietty. In the beginning of the film he moves in with his great aunt because he suffers from a heart condition and needs lots of rest and quiet.

name: Arrietty
description: A 14-year old borrower who lives with her parents under the floorboards of Shou's house.

name: Pod
description: Arrietty's father. He's quiet in nature and precise in his talk. Cares so much about his family and does all he can for them to survive. He's the head of the house and so his word is what is mainly listened to with little negotiation.

name: Homily
description: Arrietty's mother. She worries so much about her husband's and daughter's safety, especially her daughter's.

name: Yupa
description:
Nausicaä's teacher and legendary swordsman. He's been traveling the world in search of the secret of the Sea of Corruption.  

(Source: nausicaa.net)

appearsIn.title: Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind
Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind

name: Kushana
description: Princess of Torumekia, youngest daughter of the Vai Emperor.      In the anime, she lost one of her arms as a child during an Ohmu attack, and is driven by a desire for revenge against the giant insects.  She intends to wipe the Sea of Corruption off the face of the earth, by any means necessary.  While she is not presented as completely evil, she is definitely an antagonist.    In the manga, she has a much more complicated role, more of an antihero/ally than an antagonist.  She is mostly driven by a desire for revenge against her father and three older half-brothers, whom she hates and blames for the fate of her mother.  She commands the Torumekian Third Army, whom she trained personally; she is devoted to her men, and they are unswervingly loyal to her.  Despite her ferocity in battle, she has a nobility of character that earns her the respect of both Nausicaa and Master Yupa.  While she admires Nausicaa's pacifist ideals, she sees herself as inescapably destined to walk the path of bloodshed.

appearsIn.title: Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind
Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind

name: Asbel
description:
Rastel's twin brother. He is the sole survivor of Pejite, and deeply hates Kushana and Torumekians. He is a very good pilot, mechanic, and swordsman. He was rescued by Nausicaä at the bottom of the Sea of Corruption, and witnessed the secret of the Sea of Corruption with Nausicaä. He sometimes accompanies Nausicaä, and sometimes travels alone or with others.

(Source: nausicca.net)

appearsIn.title: Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind
Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind

name: Nausicaä
description:
The Princess of the Valley of Wind. She is clever, resourceful, and a skilled swordswoman. She is a windrider, who can read and utilize the wind well, and flies a "Mehve", a glider with an engine. She has an empathetic ability and can even communicate with insects from the Sea of Corruption.

As a next chieftain of the Valley, she joins [Kushana](https://anilist.co/character/541/Kushana)'s army, but the gruesome reality of the war devastates her. She desperately tries to stop mass killing and suffering, and her quest for the truth leads her to the most unimaginable places, and to the biggest secret of the world.

appearsIn.title: Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind
Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind

name: Mito
description: Sergeant-at-arms and Nausicaa's faithful retainer.

appearsIn.title: Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind
Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind

name: Kurotowa
description: Princess Kushana's staff officer.  In the manga, he was sent by Kushana's father, the Vai Emperor, to spy on her and to steal the God Warrior's control stone.  Once Kushana uncovered this plot, Kurotowa immediately offered to switch allegiances and work for her in earnest.  At first, he was mainly concerned with staying alive; however, he soon developed genuine admiration and loyalty toward her.    Kurotowa is shrewd, clever, and pragmatic.  Unlike most of Kushana's officers, he is a commoner who worked his way up through the ranks, making him somewhat popular among the mechanics and crewmembers who can relate to him more easily.

appearsIn.title: Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind

name: Anzu Hoshino
description: Anzu Hoshino is the protagonist who bears the "anti-heroine" attribute. She is a high school first year who claims her 3 great desires are video games, cat, and chocolate. She has no interest in real life romance and has been counter-measuring all the shojo manga-like situations conspired by [Riri](https://anilist.co/character/285561/Riri). She is logical and a very caring person who can't leave her troubled friends. Her biggest fear are cockroaches.

name: Riri
description: Riri is a wizard who can do romantic magic with their star shaped magic wand.

name: Tsukasa Kazuki
description:
A cold and reserved boy who is Anzu's first romance candidate. He is popular among women due to his good looks but tends to avoid them, rejecting any romantic proposals outright. He meets Anzu in a meet cute where she accidentally bumps into him and breaks his phone. Due to Riri's meddling, his house is flooded and he has to live with Anzu early in the story. 

It is later revealed that before transferring schools he was a warm and caring person who could "befriend anyone", indicating that his cold appearance is a façade.  In an effort to distance himself from women's attention, he often wears hats in public and experiences panic attacks if left alone with them due to traumatic memories. 
His personality changed drastically after being repeatedly stalked by an older woman he had helped once, to the point where he was forced to transfer from his house and school to be away from her and his strict father who blamed him for the situation.

name: Hijiri Koganei
description: A wealthy boy who is not in touch with the lives of "peasants", also set up by Riri for Anzu. He meets Anzu in a twist on a classic anime meet cute, where she is running late to school and is hit by his car. He takes her on a date for compensation, assuming she got hit on purpose, and is shocked when she rejects him. He is not used to having girls reject him so he tries to woo Anzu by buying her off. After being called out and further by Anzu, he tries to navigate common life by getting a job at the convenience store that Anzu works at and getting his own money. Knowing how much Hijiri was used to getting what he wanted, his father had transferred him from his former private school so that he could learn to fend for himself. It is shown that he too gradually developed a romantic interest in Anzu, as well as a hot and cold "tsundere" personality.

name: Junta Hayami
description:
The "childhood friend" that Riri set up for Anzu. Anzu originally believed him to be a random hot guy brainwashed by Riri, but it is later revealed that he is in fact a childhood friend of Anzu.

He had picked up baseball and changed himself after overhearing Anzu say that she would like to date an "athletic guy who can beat the boss."

Anzu is aware of his feelings for her, and acts oblivious to hide it from him.

name: Arisa Kazuki
description: Older sister of Tsukasa Kazuki

name: Tsuchiya
description: Hijiri Koganei's chauffeur who cares for him deeply. He offers romantic advice to Hijiri, and at times appears as a joke romance candidate, considered equally handsome to the candidates. He can appear by Hijiri's side at the click of a finger, and gets emotional when Hijiri expresses gratitude to him. He genuinely appreciates Anzu's presence in Hijiri's life, and considers her to be a very good influence on him. Unfortunately, because of the amount of girls who have flung themselves in front of his car to get to Hijiri, he is on a watch list.

name: Yume Irido
description: Yume moves in with her ex-boyfriend Mizuto Irido when their parents remarry. Loves reading, especially mystery novels. Used to be quite introverted and shy but put in the effort to socialize and become popular after entering high school.

appearsIn.title: My Stepmom's Daughter is My Ex

name: Mizuto Irido
description: Mizuto is a relatively introverted high-school boy with high intelligence and an interest in books of all kind. Moved in with his ex-girlfriend after their parents remarried.

appearsIn.title: My Stepmom's Daughter is My Ex

name: Isana Higashira
description: An introverted otaku girl that loves light novels. Despite generally poor grades, she was able to enter the same high-school as the rest of the characters, where she befriends Mizuto Irido due to their shared hobbies.

appearsIn.title: My Stepmom's Daughter is My Ex

name: Kogure Kawanami
description: A cheerful, popular high school boy, and the self-proclaimed best friend of [Mizuto Irido](https://anilist.co/character/214058/Mizuto-Irido). He calls himself a "Read-Only Member" when it comes to love, declaring that he has no intention of pursuing it due to personal circumstances. He's also a close childhood friend of [Akatsuki Minami](https://anilist.co/character/214061/Akatsuki-Minami), a girl he appears to share a complicated past with...

appearsIn.title: My Stepmom's Daughter is My Ex

name: Akatsuki Minami
description: A short, athletic high school girl, and a good friend of [Yume Irido](https://anilist.co/character/214056/Yume-Irido). She’s chirpy, great at interacting and up-to-date in fashion sense and makeup, but she has a tendency to become obsessive when she begins to care about or like someone, both in friendships and romance. She's also a close childhood friend of [Kogure Kawanami](https://anilist.co/character/214060/Kogure-Kawanami), who she seems to share a complicated past with...

appearsIn.title: My Stepmom's Daughter is My Ex

name: Mineaki Irido
description: Married to [Yuni](https://anilist.co/character/279387). [Mizuto's](https://anilist.co/character/214058/Irido-Mizuto) father and [Yume's](https://anilist.co/character/214056/Irido-Yume) stepfather.

appearsIn.title: My Stepmom's Daughter is My Ex

name: Yuni Irido
description: Married to [Mineaki](https://anilist.co/character/279386/Irido-Mineaki). [Yume's](https://anilist.co/character/214056/Irido-Yume) mother and [Mizuto's](https://anilist.co/character/214058/Irido-Mizuto) stepmother.

appearsIn.title: My Stepmom's Daughter is My Ex

name: William Maryblood
native: ウィリアム・G・マリーブラッド
description:
He is a lone human from the City of the Dead, born with vague memories of a past life and raised by a group of undead until the age of adulthood, he swore an oath to [Gracefeel](https://anilist.co/character/129753/Gracefeel) and leaves the city in search for adventure and civilisation while he restores the faith of his guardian deity.

He was brought to the City of the Dead as an infant by demons with the intention to be used as a sacrifice to break the seal placed upon the High King, however, he was found and taken in by a group of undead, these three undead were [Blood](https://anilist.co/character/129746/Blood), [Mary](https://anilist.co/character/129744/Mary), and [Augustus](https://anilist.co/character/129747/Augustus).

William recalls that he had a previous life in Japan, he can only vaguely remember certain events and common knowledge, his previous life was lamentable which becomes his determination to lead a proper life in his current one.

name: Meneldor
description:
Meneldor is a half-elf outcast and most loyal friend of William. He was previously an adventurer and hunter.

He is a half-elf a mix race between humans and elves. His hair is silver that is tied up into a ponytail and his eyes are the colours of jade.

Meneldor was born in Grassland to the north, in the Great Forest of Erin where the elves live. Because of his mixture of elf and human blood he was an outcast and couldn't get along with any of the residents, he later decide to run away and become an adventurer. However, he was betrayed and poisoned by one of his companions, after killing the traitor and losing his comrades, he bumbled his way to a village in a weaken state where he was later found and taken in by Marple.

(Source: Saihate no Paladin Wiki)

name: Reystov
description: Reystov was a highly skilled adventurer and companion of William. He retired as an adventurer and decided to settle down with his newly-wedded wife, Anna.

name: Mary
description: Mary is a devout follower of the Goddess Mater that granted her the title of Mater's Daughter.

name: Blood
description: He is massive skeletal humanoid male who that was previously human, his hair is red and his eyes are will-o'-wisp.

name: Anna
description: She is a priest dispatched by Bishop Bagley to assist William, she is one of the primary figures who handles the daily affairs in the city of Torch Port.

name: John
description: John was a resident of the one of the villages in Beast Woods which would later become Torch Port.

name: Gracefeel
description:
Gracefeel is a mysterious goddess associated with the flame and enteral flux. She is the guardian deity of William.

She is a humanoid goddess with long black hair and gold eyes. She has a gentle face and wears a hooded robe that covers her notable features. She holds a lantern in her right hand usually held by a long handle. In her herald form, she takes the appearance of a warm flame.

Gracefeel is the goddess of the flame and flux. She was a renowned deity with many followers in the Union Age but after the Great Collapse, her followers dispersed and her image became obscure over time. She became a mysterious deity, even her gender was forgotten by society and her only notable feature was her hooded robe, lantern and her connections with the deities Volt and Mater notable for being her parents.

Her elder sister, previously helped guide the souls but she slowly grew tired as she watched the heroes she adored lose their light and decided to leave younger sister, Gracefeel and use her power to enteralise her image of heroes.

(Source: Saihate no Paladin Wiki)

name: Noko Shikanoko
description:
__Grade:__ 3rd Year
__Positions:__ Founder, Mascot, and Official Deer of the Deer Club, Part-Time Deer at Hino Zoo.

Noko Shikanoko is a unique human-deer hybrid and the founder and mascot of the Deer Club at Hino Minami High School.

She is a transfer student who becomes the best friend, classmate, and clubmate of [Torako Koshi](https://anilist.co/character/330137/Torako-Koshi).

name: Torako Koshi
description:
__Grade:__ 3rd Year (Formerly 2nd Year).
__Positions:__ President of the Deer Club, Head of the Student Council, Delinquent Gang Member (Formerly).
__Relatives:__ [Anko Koshi](https://anilist.co/character/330138/Anko-Koshi) (Younger Sister).

Torako Koshi is a student at Hino Minami High School, and a highly respected one at that; being considered by many to be a "perfect girl". She is the classmate, best friend, and clubmate of [Noko Shikanoko](https://anilist.co/character/330136/Noko-Shikanoko).

Wanting to change for the better after her past of being a delinquent, Koshi vowed to renew her ways. Within a year, she had become the complete opposite, becoming an honor student who's athletic, kind, helpful, and adored by all. However, after meeting Shikanoko Noko, she found out the deer girls chaotic actions makes some of her delinquent-like traits slip out more often than she would like to admit, threatening to expose her dark past to their classmates and ruin her reputation. 

Excluding the narrator, Torako is the one of few characters to break the fourth wall, along with being able to recognize the absurdity of Shikanoko Noko's antics. On top of being an honors student, she is also very passionate about her likes and hobbies - having a collection of stuffed toys she kisses before going to bed, calling out to several shonen manga characters for help when met with difficult situations, and displaying her knack for interior design.

name: Anko Koshi
description:
__Grade:__ 1st Year
__Position:__ "Self-Proclaimed Sister Caretaker" of the Deer Club

Anko is a new student at Hino Minami High School, the 3rd official member of the Deer Club, and the younger sister of [Torako Koshi](https://anilist.co/character/330137/Torako-Koshi). She is best known for her sister complex towards their older sibling; being highly obsessed with everything regarding her sister and making it her personal life goal to be always by her sister's side 24/7, much to the latter's dismay and embarrassment. She will not hesitate to try and outright assassinate anyone who goes as far as to even just stand within near proximity of Koshitan, typically having a dark and sinister aura whenever somebody starts to act all chummy with them. Anko is also known to be adept at arming herself with her collection of kunai when faced with possible "threats" and in setting traps in her victims' surroundings. 

The only time she has made an exception to anyone else getting close to her sister was when she tried killing [Noko Shikanoko](https://anilist.co/character/330136/Noko-Shikanoko), only to see, much to her surprise, that her sister deeply cares for Nokotan. Thus, she decided that someone else, for once, was also worthy of supporting Koshitan as well, just as long as it was together.

name: Meme Bashame
description:
__Grade:__ 1st Year
__Position:__ "Deer-In-Training" of the Deer Club

Meme Bashame is a new student at Hino Minami High School and the 4th official member of the Deer Club. Bashame joined the Deer Club because of her newfound idolization of [Noko Shikanoko](https://anilist.co/character/330136/Noko-Shikanoko), who had offered Bashame kindness and deer crackers: saving Bashame from starving on their first day of high school. Bashame hopes of learning to become a full-fledged deer during her stay in the deer club under Nokotan, viewing her as a sensei of sorts and having somewhat of a passive obsession over them.

Bashame can be described as laidback and sluggish, having no problem falling asleep anywhere and everywhere at anytime, usually ending up dozing on the cold concrete floor. Bashame miraculously never gets sick from this. Bashame also is notable for having illeism, a tendency to refer to oneself in third person when speaking, and a fascination with rice, as Bashame often cooks, eats, and grows rice in the Deer Club, more times being seen with rice than not. This could be from Bashame's passion for self-sufficiency, or Bashame may just really love rice. Bashame also tends to eat this rice excessively, many times being seen with a towering amount of rice in a bowl, much to the shock of other characters. Bashame also cannot whistle.

name: Neko Nekoyamada
description:
__Height:__ 132 cm
__Grade:__ 3rd Year
__Positions:__ Vice President of the Student Council, Honorary Member of the Deer Club

Neko Nekoyamada is a student at Hino Minami High School, and the self-proclaimed rival of the Deer Club. She is very catlike, both in appearance with her hair stylized into neat cat ear-like cones, and in personality with wanting to be praised and seen as superior by her fellow classmates. Due to her always being outshined by both [Torako Koshi](https://anilist.co/character/330137/Torako-Koshi) and the Deer Club's extreme popularity, Neko has the goal to discover Koshitan's weakness and overthrow her, and to get the deer club disbanded, so she can finally be in the spotlight and become the President of the Student Council. 

She is known to be hot-headed and competitive and likes to be organized and get work done in the student council, tending to do a lot of work. She is easily influenced by praise, completely forgetting her goal in mind and becoming very happy and gloatful about it. She also seems to be one of the only other characters than Koshitan that is put off by the unpredictability of [Noko Shikanoko](https://anilist.co/character/330136/Noko-Shikanoko) and frequently confused at the shenanigans they cause. Neko is also extremely attached to Tsuchi despite her initial fear of them, and often displays motherly qualities when thinking about them. She also owns a personal stepstool, in order to help compensate for her noticeably short height.

name: Kinu Tanukikoji
description:
__Grade:__ 2nd Year
__Position:__ Secretary of the Student Council

Kinu Tanukikoji is a student at Hino Minami High School and a complete girlfailure, being extremely timid and overthinking almost everything. Whenever she makes a simple mistake like accidentally getting papers in the wrong order, she mentally spirals and goes into a state of panic, even going as far as coming up with imaginary disastrous events that would (but actually won't) unfold from her minor mistake and attempting to commit seppuku. 

Kinu is also childhood friends with [Chiharu Tsubameya](https://anilist.co/character/337287/Chiharu-Tsubameya).

name: Chiharu Tsubameya
description:
__Grade:__ 2nd Year
__Position:__ Treasurer of the Student Council

Chiharu Tsubameya is a student at Hino Minami High School. She initially appears to be a much calmer and more collected girl, having a cool and laid-back personality. So laid-back, in fact, that it is extremely difficult to figure out what she is thinking. She is known to unconsciously give glares and almost completely ignore what others are offering or saying to her. The exception of this rule is [Noko Shikanoko](https://anilist.co/character/330136/Noko-Shikanoko), of which she treasures and loves any small gift or attention from, due to her being a massive fan of them. 

Despite appearing somewhat distant on the outside, she has been shown to care for others outside of Nokotan, such as when she felt bad for mistreating [Koshitan](https://anilist.co/character/330137/Torako-Koshi) due to her having felt envious that she could speak so casually with Nokotan, seeing her as an acquaintance who helped break the ice and helped her gather the courage to speak to their idol.

She also has an older brother that she lives with at his Cafe, [Yoshiharu Tsubameya](https://anilist.co/character/342963/Yoshiharu-Tsubameya), and is childhood friends with [Kinu Tanukikoji](https://anilist.co/character/337286).

name: Tomodachi
description: The main antagonist of the series. An enigmatic cult leader who, in 1997, began using the symbol [Kenji](https://anilist.co/character/3442/Endou-Kenji) and his friends put together in the 1970s. His followers have filled venues such as the Budokan.One of his goals is to take over the world. His face is hidden in shadow throughout the series; he even confronts Kenji by wearing a mask. His true identity is one of the driving mysteries of the series. As of 2000, the Friendship Democratic Party (FDP) is established as a political group with government representatives such as Manjome Inshu.

name: Kenji Endou
description: Endo Kenji grew up in late-1960s/early-1970s Japan, at a time when American phenomena, notably the space race and the era of Woodstock, were resounding around the world.  An avid reader of manga who often saw apocalyptic scenarios playing out, he always responded with the cry of "I would fight".  During this time, he and his friends made up a scenario for world conquest in order to play heroes.  Flash forward to 1997, when Kenji has taken charge of his family liquor shop, and turned it into a convenience store.  He is now raising the daughter of his sister, [Kiriko](https://anilist.co/character/29789/Endou-Kiriko) (who disappeared immediately after leaving her daughter to Kenji), and living a fairly ordinary life.  However, after events from the prophecy he made up earlier begin to come true, he learns of an evil organization, led by a masked man called "Friend", which is using his plans to conquer the world.  As the organization's hold on the government strengthens, he becomes a wanted man and lives on the streets, continuing to (covertly) oppose Friend on the streets, partially through terrorism and partially through a protest song he wrote (named "Bob Lennon").

name: Kanna Endou
description: [Kenji](https://anilist.co/character/3442/Endou-Kenji)'s niece, she serves as the protagonist for the events in the aftermath of the "Bloody New Year's Eve". She is shown to have ESP at an advanced level, and is capable of predicting the future (To a small extent), bend spoons with her mind, and even once strangled a woman without touching her (in a fit of emotional rage). She loves rock&roll, due to Kenji's obsession with it. She idolizes Kenji despite what the rest of the world thinks of him, and is also quite skilled at the guitar. She lives by herself in a low-rent apartment and works part-time at a small noodle shop in the middle of Thai/ Chinese Mafia territorium.

name: Chouji Ochiai
description: A childhood friend of Kenji's who created the "Friend" symbol and became a salaryman. Later traveled to Tibet and Thailand after his son died, at which point he gets involved in the dealings of the "Friend" group.  長治 is sometimes misread as "Nagaharu" but his first name is Chouji.

name: Yamane
description: [Kenji](https://anilist.co/character/3442/Kenji-Endou)'s classmate and friend of [Fukubei](https://anilist.co/character/21461/Fukubei-Hattori) and [Sadakiyo](https://anilist.co/character/27225/Sada-Kiyoshi). He became a bacteriologist that worked with [Kiriko](https://anilist.co/character/29789/Kiriko-Endou).

name: Saburou Kido
description: In 1997, Donkey became a teacher in a technical school. Married and father of a boy, he lost almost all contact with his old friends. It investigates a little too close to Friend, and sends letters to Kenji about it and it will lead to his assassination by Masao and another henchman of Friend. His death is the starting point for the investigation of Kenji, equally shocked and saddened his friends Donkey's death.

name: Katsumata Tadanobu
description: A friend of [Fukubei](https://anilist.co/character/21461/Fukubei-Hattori)'s who often wore a double of the same mask [Sadakiyo](https://anilist.co/character/27225/Sada-Kiyoshi) wore.

name: Shouhei Chouno
description: Chono is the grand-son of the "legendary" Inspector Cho. The latter was murdered by his colleague, Yama, in 1997, because he had discovered the identity of his friend and projects.

name: Kiyoshi Sada
description: Kenji's classmate who wasn't part of the original gang. As a child, he often wears a mask, but was bullied a lot in school and eventually left after a semester, thus his face remains unknown to most of the gang.

name: Masao Tamura
description: In 1997, Masao was a passionate member of Friend's cult since its early days. He was first shown dancing in his underpants, performing his "morning healing aerobics" while listening to Friend's "healing CD"; his room was also seen with various Friend posters, and he owns Friend t-shirts. Later on, he "purified" Pierre Ichimonji, a leader of a rival cult, once again showing his fanaticism and obsession towards Friend.

name: Otto Heckel
description:
A common thief who runs into Tenma in Chapter 17 when he breaks into a murder victim's house where Tenma is investigating. Heckel is not interested in solving the mystery surrounding the monster, he is more preoccupied in making quick cash by any means necessary. Nonetheless, both Tenma and Heckel must rely on each other in order to survive.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Christof Sievernich
native: クリストフ・ジーヴァーニッヒ
description: Johan's disciple and another survivor of 511 Kinderheim. He and Johan decided to meet each other again in 10 years after they escaped the orphanage, and in the end they meet at a party with the guidance of Eva Heinemann, who was hired to point Johan out. His deceased stepfather was one of the four individuals of Neo-Nazi, and he was likely to succeed the post. He possesses qualities similar to Johan's and intimidated Martin, Eva Heinemann's bodyguard, by reminding him of what happened to his mother and wife. Nothing else is known about Christoph, other than that either Johan or the organization of the four individuals tried to change him into the second monster. He first appears in chapter 124.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Yami Sukehiro
description:
__Height:__ 183 cm

Yami Sukehiro is a foreigner from the Land of the Sun and the first captain of the Clover Kingdom's Black Bulls squad of the Magic Knights.

appearsIn.title: Black Clover: Sword of the Wizard King

name: Rumiko Manbagi
description:
**Height:** 158.3 cm

Rumiko Manbagi is a gyaru girl who enters the second year of school with no friends. She becomes friends with [Shouko Komi](https://anilist.co/character/121956/Komi-Shouko) and [Hitohito Tadano](https://anilist.co/character/78093/Tadano-Hitohito), her being the first Komi was able to befriend alone.

Manbagi is a manba-styled gyaru girl with tanned skin, bleached light hair, and a very girly fashion sense. She's introduced in ridiculous, heavy makeup, but once that's removed she is revealed to have a naturally beautiful face. She has shoulder-length, wavy blonde hair, a dark complexion, and a curvy figure. Manbagi had a short, black bob and fair skin when she was in middle school.

Manbagi is a cheerful, friendly girl who easily gets along with people once she becomes friends with them. In contrast to Komi, she's quite energetic and talkative. Though the two are more alike than it initially seems, both being sweet, lonely girls who desperately want friends. She seems somewhat naive and insecure, believing that her heavy makeup is what makes her pretty and thinking she doesn't compare to Komi.

Manbagi has a tsundere personality as she can be harsh to Tadano. That harshness has softened as she's become nicer, but can still be short-tempered when embarrassed.

name: Ryouko Komi
description: Ryokuo Komi is Shouko's aunt. She is just as lively as Shouko's mother so she sometimes unknowingly intimidate Shouko.

name: Chika Netsuno
description: Chika Netsuno is a student one year above Tadano, Shouko, and Najimi, and serves as Shouko's athletic rival.

name: Miwa Omojiri
description: Omojiri Miwa is a teacher at Itan Private High School

name: Maya Takarazuka
description:
Maya Takarazuka is a second-year at Itan Private High School.
Takarazuka is a talented actress casted to play the role of the prince in the play for class 2-1's cultural exhibition, directed by Tadano (Najimi). Takarazuka is a very considerate person, understanding Komi's crippling social anxiety, she is very patient with Komi, who was of course voted to play the princess. Takarazuka even creates an entirely new play altogether built around Komi's anxiety to make it more comfortable for her to take part in the class's exhibition.
Maya's incredible acting skills are limited to boys' roles only; she cannot play feminine roles.

name: Yakuna Katou
description: Katou Yakuna is the mother of Katou Mikuni. Although first appearing as a stern, upper-class woman, however upon meeting Shouko and Ayumi, she pulls them aside and gets them to wear the kimonos she just made, and just being a regular mom. The two from then on always wear the same kimonos when they're at the Katou household.

name: Kakushi Gotou
description: He writes vulgar manga and tries to hide it from his young daughter, Hime. He tends to be overprotective, which often leads to misunderstandings, but all he wants is for Hime to grow up well.

name: Hime Gotou
description: [Kakushi](https://anilist.co/character/120482)'s kind daughter who loves her dad very much. As far as she knows, her dad works as a normal salaryman.

name: Hildegard
description:
__Height:__ 162 cm (5'3")

Hilda, is a Demon that serves as both the adoptive mother and wet nurse to [Beelzebub IV](https://anilist.co/character/21154/Beelzebub-IV-Kaiser-de-Emperana). 

She is an attractive young woman with blonde hair that covers one side of her face and is tied in a bun, green eyes and a well-endowed chest. Her clothes are mostly elegant and black with frills and white quillings, thus resembling Lolita Fashion.

name: Kaiser de Emperana Beelzebub IV
native: カイゼル・デ・エンペラーナ・ベルゼバブ4世
description:
The son of the Devil King. He is very attached to [Oga](https://anilist.co/character/20766/Oga-Tatsumi), clinging with a vice-like grip to Oga's back. When he is agitated or sees blood, he will spontaneously electrocute anyone within his vicinity. Beelzebub's characteristic cry is "Daabuu!" and he is always naked with a pacifier in his mouth.

Baby Be'el is very easily impressed, especially by strong people since he himself is still weak and loses to other babies as well as to cats. On the other hand he is not the smartest one out there and tries to force his way through the most simple problems. It is also shown that he is afraid of insects. He often displays a fondness for things that might frighten "normal" babies, such as violence, exposed muscle tissue (on an anatomy model), heavy metal music, and demonic toys.

name: Alaindelon Bathin de Emuna
native: バティム・ド・エムナ・アランドロン
description:
Alaindelon surprisingly resembles Queen lead singer Freddy Mercury. They share hairstyles, moustache and even attitude. However, Alaindelon is better built being quite muscular. He often wears sweatshirts along with boxer shorts.  Alaindelon is a very comical person. Even though he tries to remain serious, his uselessness usually puts him down. 

He is a dimensional demon capable of going in between dimensions. He also has the ability to open himself up in order for people to enter him and be able to travel alongside him. He also lacks physical strength, but seems to make up for it with incredible durability. Most demons at least make some attempt to conceal their powers while in the human world, but Alaindelon tends to use his transport ability fairly often, splitting himself open even in front of people (which causes a fair amount of shock or disgust).  He first appears faking his death floating down the river where [Oga](https://anilist.co/character/20766/Oga-Tatsumi) finds him. Beelzebub popped out of him making Oga his caretaker. Thought dead, he later appears to usually bug Oga and [Furuichi](https://anilist.co/character/20769/Furuichi-Takayuki). He later goes to live with the latter after finding him a noble person.

name: Takayuki Furuichi
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm (5'9") 
__Likes:__ cute women, beautiful women, simply women

Furuichi is one of the main protagonists of Beelzebub.  Furuichi is Oga's best friend and along with him is a 1st year at Ishiyama High. After finding out about Oga's baby he joins him up in his search for a new parent. He is actually the most normal person in the anime/manga because he tries to add common sense to everything. He also has no powers.  Although Furuichi does retain a rational, passive and calm demeanor, he usually reacts in an insane (but often comical) fashion whenever a character does something outrageous. This usually comes as a surprise to the others around him.  He also has an overly wild imagination when it comes to women, always fantisizing about them in a overly perverted manner which earned him his common nickname among the female characters "Creepichi". Despite his desire to hit it off with the ladies, he often fails to please them or get their attention because most of them, demon or human, are stronger than him and many moments of comic relief in the series arise when his advances on girls are foiled, particularly by Alaindelon.  His attitude changes when women are involved in a situation. Out of sheer instinct, Furuichi acts "cool" in order to impress the woman involved. He is shown to gain some bravery from it, but this often gets him into bigger trouble than he already is in.

name: Aoi Kunieda
description:
__Name meaning:__ State Branch's Sunflower 
__Height:__ 162 cm (5' 4'') 
__Occupation:__ High school student, Shrine maiden 
__Affiliation:__ Touhoushinki, Red Tails 

Aoi is a second-year student and the third leader of the "strongest ladies of Kantou", the Red Tails. She is first introduced in disguise at the park taking care of her baby brother, Kouta, who is constantly mistaken as being Aoi's own child by the mothers at the park. She is the daughter of a local temple keeper. Her nickname is Queen because she is the protector of all the girls at Ishiyama High from the men's "grubby hands". Because of Oga's dense personality, he has yet to realize that the girls he befriended at the park and Kunieda are one and the same. Despite her tough personality, she has a rather girlish crush on Oga but refuses to admit this fact to others. She can feel Saotome using his demon power, which shows she has notable strength for a human.  Kunieda differs from the other thugs at Ishiyama in that she has formal martial arts training from her grandfather, the master of the Shingetsu style. She is also not a bully and steers the leadership of the Red Tails towards preventing unnecessary fights in the school.

name: Tatsumi Oga
description:
**Height:** 179 cm (5'11'')
**Occupation:** High school student, adolescent delinquent
**Debut:** Ep. 1/Ch. 1

Tatsumi Oga is the main protagonist in the Beelzebub series, first introduced as a strong fighter, beating up some fellow class mates and then making them bow down to him because they had attacked him in his sleep. He was picked to become Beelzebub's parent as he possessed the qualities of the ideal parent for the future Demon Lord: strong, arrogant, and thinks-nothing-of-fellow-man. In addition to the aforementioned attributes, Oga also seems to take pleasure in tormenting others.As the series continues, it should be noted that the trials Oga has faced and the new friends he has gained has altered his personality somewhat. For example, when the Rokkisei called out Ishiyama to meet them on the rooftop, he initially came alone. But later on when Himekawa, Kunieda, and Natsume soon arrived, Oga smiled knowing that they have his back. Though he retains his love for his cruelty.

name: Hidetora Toujou
description:
__Height:__ 188 cm (6'2") 

The fourth Touhoushinki member. He is by far the strongest member of the Touhoushinki (his strength in comparison to [Kunieda](https://anilist.co/character/23278/Kunieda-Kouta) is not confirmed, though it can be implied that he is stronger than her indirectly from their other fights). Toujou has an unexpected soft side towards smaller creatures and babies, though said creatures do not feel similarly towards him. He is mostly bored with weaklings and is always looking for a good fight, which subsequently leads to his interest towards [Oga](https://anilist.co/character/20766/Oga-Tatsumi). He works multiple jobs and sometimes has to miss school because of them. He can feel [Saotome](https://anilist.co/character/39937/Saotome-Zenjuuro) using his demon power, which shows he has notable strength for a human.

He appears to know the female horsemen from Saint Ishiyama Academy ([Shizuka Nanami](https://anilist.co/character/33077/Nanami-Shizuka)) quite well. She referred to him as Tora when they met after the volleyball match.

He sees Oga as a potential rival, while Oga sees him as an opportunity to lay off [Baby Be'el](https://anilist.co/character/21154/Beelzebub-IV-Kaiser-de-Emperana) on someone else. Oddly enough, despite his appearance, he seems to have a thing for cute animals. He is often absent from school due to working several part-time jobs. One of his jobs is construction work.

name: Shizuka Nanami
description: She is an attractive senior and the only female memeber of the six knights. Her hair colour is unknown and her fighting style is undetermined aswell. It is likely that she posesses a strong fighting style on par or slightly higher than Mikki's as her presense was enough to startle Mikki. She arrived on the rooftop if the school to end the battle and was shortly accompanied by Kaname. She seems to have a strong relationship with her leader as she is able to joke and laugh with him, something the other horsemen seem unable to do (likely due to their fear of him). She is seen recently massaging her leaders back after their training session. She also seems to have a good relationship with Mikki. It is unknown whether Mikki's fear is mutual, however, she does show a certain degree of concern when Mikki is found to be training alone. She is the captain of the archery team.

name: Yuka Hanazawa
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm (5'2")

Yuka Hanazawa is a talkative member of the Red Tails who often makes embarrassing statements. She has long hair that is always adorned with a flower-shaped hairpin that can be used as a dagger. As a member of the Red Tails, she is a very good fighter and is not afraid of facing men. Lately, she and [Kanzaki](https://anilist.co/character/23248/Kanzaki-Hajime) have been getting along, beginning when both witnessed [Toujou](https://anilist.co/character/23247/Toujou-Hidetora)'s fight with a demon. He nicknamed her "Paa-ko".

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Yolda
description: She bears a strong resemblance to Hilda and carries a mop with her, which she uses as a weapon much as Hilda uses her parasol. The two seem to have an unsettled score and Yolda positively despises Hilda. She is also able to move very quickly and knocks Furuichi and Kunieda out easily. In contrast to Hilda, she has a femme fatale attitude.     Regardless of what she is saying she will commonly speak in a cheerful and playful manner, even if she is issuing death threats or insults. She also seems to be flirtatious, as she attempted to kiss Oga upon first meeting him.

name: Pieyon
description: A famous physical training YouTuber affiliated with Strawberry Productions, where he is the agency's top earner. On request from company president Miyako Saitou, he promotes the new B-Komachi by collaborating with Ruby Hoshino and Kana Arima in a physical training video on his channel.

name: Kansatsu-sha
description: The mysterious being and observer who cast the orb onto the Earth. His goal is to preserve the world. He sent [Fushi](https://anilist.co/character/136548/Fushi) to acquire various kinds of information from the world and aid his observations.

name: Bonchien Nicoli La Tasty Peach Uralis
native: ボンシェン・ニコリ・ラ・テイスティピーチ・ウラリス
description: Bonchien is the prince of the Uralis Kingdom.

name: Parona
description:
**Relatives:** Unnamed mother, father, and [sister](https://anilist.co/character/201557/Paronas-sister).

Parona is a girl from Ninannah and a close friend of [March](https://anilist.co/character/136541/March). She looks after March like an older sister.

name: Hisame
description: Hisame is the granddaughter of [Hayase](https://anilist.co/character/136545/Hayase).

name: Rean Cropp
description: Rean is a young girl from Takunaha.

name: Lotton
description: Lotton "The Wizard" is a mysterious looking man and one of the bounty hunters hired to catch "Greenback" Jane. He has gray hair, wears a black trench coat and shaded glasses, and speaks in a light voice. His weapon of choice is one or more Mauser C96(s) with an extended magazine, although it's unknown whether this is an actual Mauser or a foreign version of the gun. He does not drink alcohol (he claims it makes him vomit). He gets shot by Revy, when he tries to make a fancy entrance.     It is implied that he is not a mighty fighter, but a poser. However, he did survive a fall from atop a warehouse building after getting shot due to his Kevlar vest, so the full extent of his abilities is still in question.    He is also one of the few bounty hunters to survive the manhunt for Jane. After the battle takes off in the sea, he gets up and aids a gravely wounded Shenhua and Sawyer. Due to the uncommon act of mercy, Shenhua comments that he is not the type to kill and would be better as a host in a bordello, but Lotton claims that he is too clumsy for that.

name: Hänsel
description: Hänsel and Gretel are two unnamed Romanian identical twin orphans, suggested to be male and female, who were abandoned in a state-run orphanage due to the Nicolae Ceauşescu regime's ban on abortion. As a result of being repeatedly forced to participate in paedophilic snuff films in which they are either raped or forced to murder other children, the twins eventually became deranged, sadistic killers just to survive. Unknown to most people, "Hänsel" and "Gretel" are actually two personalities alternately adopted by the two children, both of whom suffer from Dissociative Identity Disorder, meaning they swap being "Hänsel" and "Gretel" with each other from time to time. There is also slight implications that they could be incestuous, though this may be due to the abuse they've suffered.    In combat, "Hänsel" wields a sharp, wicked-looking battle axe while "Gretel" uses a M1918 Browning Automatic Rifle that appears to be taller than 'she' is. Both also carry additional sidearms. While they were mentally deranged, Hänsel and Gretel were also cunning, having used two other children as decoys to distract the "Hotel Moscow" ex-soldiers and using money to distract Eda. They were also not above using their innocent appearance to deceive their enemies.
