name: Hikari Shinomiya
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm

Hikari Shinomiya was a former Captain of the Second Division of the Defense Force and Vice-Captain of the First Division. She was also the wife of [Isao Shinomiya](https://anilist.co/character/257340/Isao-Shinomiya) and mother of [Kikoru Shinomiya](https://anilist.co/character/183889/Kikoru-Shinomiya).

Hikari used to be very strong yet understanding and caring individual, as well as being more jovial and lively than her husband Isao.

name: Touko
description: Touko is a member of the Fourth Division of the Defense Force.

name: Kaijuu Ichi-gou
description: Kaiju Ichi-gou, also known as The Future Sight Kaiju, was the first Identified Kaiju to ever receive an I.D. number. After its death, it was turned into Numbers Weapon 1, currently used by First Division Captain [Gen Narumi](https://anilist.co/character/241577/Gen-Narumi).

name: Keiji Itami
description:
__Height__: 178cm

Deputy Director of the Japan Anti-Kaiju Defense Force even though he dislikes being in a position of power over others. He likes quiet places, taiga (historical) dramas and tangerines.

name: Juugo Ogata
description:
__Height:__ 183 cm

Juugo Ogata is the Captain of the Fourth Division of the Defense Force.

Juugo seems to be a rather calm and peaceful individual, wishing to get along with his fellow division captains despite their hot-blooded and belligerent behaviours. He's not above drinking alcohol or plucking his nose hair when on duty.

name: Shichirou Balam
description: Mythical Zoology teacher at Babyls. He's close friends with [Kalego](https://anilist.co/character/135021/Naberius-Kalego) as they were classmates in the past. He's a Cheth (8) Rank.

appearsIn.title: Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun Season 2

name: Alikred
description:
__Rank:__ _Gimel_ (Anime), He (Manga)
__Height:__ 20 m
__Occupation:__ Ring of Gluttony (Avatar)
__Affiliation:__ [Iruma Suzuki](https://anilist.co/character/135018)

The physical embodiment of the Ring of Gluttony.

appearsIn.title: Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun Season 2

name: Jurai Andou
description:
Jurai is the main protagonist of Ino Battle wa Nichijo-kei no Naka de. He is also part of the school Literature Club on his right hand he has a superpower called, "Dark and Dark."

Jurai is a goofy boy. Due to his Chunin Syndrome, he often falls into a world of his own, causing annoyance to those around him. Because of this he has developed a very care free personality that can often accept other peoples' faults without much trouble. When he gained his superpower, he was excited, saying that even though it didn't do much, he still loved it all the same, because every guy wants one.

(Source: Inou-Battle wa Nichijou-kei no Naka de Wikia)

name: Chifuyu Himeki
description:
She is a shy elementary school girl, she was accepted as an unofficial member of the Literature Club mainly because she is the club advisers's relative. Her special powers allows her to create anything out of thin air, she can also create portals, dimensions and she can also manipulate any materials down to its sub atomic level. 

Just like the rest of the girls in her club, she too has feelings for Andou.

(Source: Zinc View)

name: Tomoyo Kanzaki
description:
Tomoyo Kanzaki is one of the main characters of Ino Battle wa Nichijou-kei no Naka de. She has the superpower to manipulate time, "Closed Clock," and she is also part of the Literature Club.

A red-haired girl who is constantly bemused by Jurai's antics. Her power allow her to speed up, slow down, or stop time, though she cannot rewind it.

name: Hatoko Kushikawa
description:
Hatoko Kushikawa is one of the main characters of Ino Battle wa Nichijo-kei no Naka de. She is also a part of the Literature Club.

She is a polite air-headed girl who often takes Jurai's chunibyo antics seriously. Her power is "Over Element," which gives her the ability to manipulate five main elements of the natural world: earth, water, fire, wind, and light.

She is also Jurai's childhood friend and next door neighbor, who sometimes drops by to his house to cook for him and his big sister, since both of them admit to being bad at cooking. She has a tendency to be jealous towards Jurai when she sees him with Tomoyo, though she keeps quiet about it.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Sayumi Takanashi
description:
She is a senior student and the president of the Literature Club. She is normally seen reading books, and there are hints that she has feelings for Andou. Her power is "Root of Origins" in which anyone she touches returns to his or her original state, although the exact nature of this remains vague. She a very refine girl, whose other hobbies, besides reading, includes ikebana, origami, and martial arts.

For some reason, she dislikes being called "cute."

(Source: Zince-View, edited)

name: Hajime Kiryuu
description:
He is Tomoyo's half brother. Though he is a NEET (Not in Education Employment or Training), he spends most of his time engage in "Fairy Wars" where he fights with other people with special abilities or "power users" like himself. His special ability is the "Pinpoint Abyss" where he opens up worm holes that sucks his opponents in, to which they get transported to their previous location prior to the encounter without any memories of what just happen. He is also like Jurai who has some degree of chunni delusions except that his delusion were at bit real. Though a lone-wolf, he can sometimes be in the company of other people who are also "power users" and were also engage in fairy wars.

Prior to being a "power user" he used to attend college and even had a job.

He dislikes being called by his real name and prefers to be called "Kiryuu Heldkaiser Luci-First." 

(Source: Animefreak, edited)

name: Mirei Kudou
description:
She is the school's student council president, who always gets to reprimand the Literature Club for being noisy mainly due to Andou's antics. She somehow acquires the ability to steal someone else's special powers and use it as well, where she can only do when that particular individual with special powers activates it first. She briefly falls in love with Andou because she mistaken the letter that she receives from him as a love letter wherein one particular caption he misused the kanji symbols that reads "grateful lover" instead of "great robber," referring to her special powers, which is what Andou intended to be.

In spite of the painful misunderstanding she becomes friends with Andou.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Madoka Kuki
description: Chifuyu's closest friend and classmate. Madoka cares for Chifuyu so much that she is usually seen keeping her in check by fixing her uniform, brushing her, walking her to school, etc. Chifuyu refers to her as "Cookie."

name: Shizumu Sagami
description:
He is Andou's school mate and an otaku. However, he and Andou don't get along. He is also a member a Kiryu's group.

He is very observant and manipulative, it is is suggested that he is also a power user whose ability is to read minds.

name: Hitomi Saitou
description: She is one of the members of Hajime's clique who is also a "power user," her ability is the "Eternal Wink" which suggest that her ability is to put people to sleep.

name: Keita Suminoe
description: Keita is a third-year junior-high school student studying for his high school entrance exams and although he is the younger brother, it is obvious he is the most mature of the three siblings. He wants to enter the same high school as his older twin step-sisters [Ako](https://anilist.co/character/8040) and [Riko](https://anilist.co/character/8041), and to do so must study hard while getting help from his sisters as well as he was originally planning on relying on his track running scholarship for another school. While at first he initially dislikes himself for becoming attracted to Ako and Riko, he later becomes proactive in his desires. It is later revealed he was in love with his sisters when they were kids, and even used all of his money that he saved up for a prayer that he could marry both of them. This changed when he found out from his father that polygamy is illegal and "grew up". He is weak when it comes to alcohol, and will become livelier when he drinks, but after he sobers up he does not remember anything he did. After chapter eighteen of the manga, he makes it into his sisters' school Gakushuu Senior High. He has strong morals (that have clearly weakened with the constant "attacks" his sisters have done throughout the series), as he will try to resist to the best he can, but if pushed too far he will simply indulge in the moment. He has also shown an attraction towards [Miharu](https://anilist.co/character/31548) and [Yuuzuki](https://anilist.co/character/31550).

name: Ako Suminoe
description:
__Height:__ 145 cm (OVA 7)  

Ako is the elder twin sister. A way to tell her apart from [Riko](https://anilist.co/character/8041/Suminoe-Riko) is that she wears a hair clip to keep the hair off her forehead. She has a reliable, level-headed personality, but can be sullen, moody, even a bit childish and is quickly embarrassed. She carries herself differently than her sister, is more skilled in cooking which she learned to help her mom out with the housework, and is strong with alcohol which she sometimes uses to her advantage to knock out Riko to have the livelier [Keita](https://anilist.co/character/8039/Suminoe-Keita) all to herself. She is a closet pervert and more often planning her seduction of Keita, even hiding porn magazines in her room. At school, she is on the school committee, but has a habit of abusing her authority to get Keita.

name: Riko Suminoe
description:
__Height:__ 145 cm

Riko is the younger twin sister. A way to tell her apart from Ako is that she wears her hair in a ponytail, and it is longer than her sister's hair. Also, she has a bandage below her left eye. She has a habit of answering truthfully but very bluntly, causing everyone else to jump to conclusions, even at one time about to honestly state that she and her sister wanted a computer solely for porn, however was quickly stopped by Ako. She is much shyer in person than her sister, as she could not kiss Keita in front of others. At school, she is on the disciplinary committee, where she uses a bokken/shinai to punish the students and she has more of a strict personality, yet just like her sister will abuse her authority to get Keita.

name: Suminoe no Haha
description: Keita, Ako, and Riko's mother.

name: Toda Edogawa
description: Toda is one of Keita's many classmates who are jealous of him for living with Ako and Riko. Throughout the entire anime/manga he is seen admiring Ako and Riko or Bothering Keita about his love life.

name: Mikazuki Kiryuu
description: She is an underclassman that is "chasing after him (Keita)". They were in the same sports club back at his old school. She is even more perverted than Ako and Riko when it comes to getting Keita's attention, with no qualms of flashing her privates at him in front of others. She is also a bit of an airhead, believing that Miharu and Keita are no longer virgins when she found them hugging. Yuuzuki's is her older sister, usually referring to her in private as "my otaku sister", who Mikazuki looks up to and loves very dearly, even stating once the visual novel she bought was for her to cover for her sister. However, she also enjoys taking lewd pictures of her sister in cosplay as compensation for covering for her. She was able to correctly assume that her sister has feelings for Keita.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Yuuzuki Kiryuu
description: She is Mikazuki's older sister, the new teacher to Gakushū Senior High and homeroom teacher to Keita and Miharu, who in an earlier chapter was a clothing store clerk because she liked western style clothing. Through bad timing and unaware that Keita and his sisters are not related by blood, she believes that he is a deviant who dates multiple girls while having an incestuous relationship with his sisters. She becomes excited by her exaggerated ideas of what he and his sisters do at home or with other girls. Through these beliefs, she tries to recruit Miharu, believing she is one of the girls Keita is dating, to have them go on a date to separate him from his sisters. She is a virgin, however after clearing everything up, she starts to have growing feelings for Keita as well that goes to a lustful desire, practically raping his P.E. clothes as she is addicted to the scent of his sweat and fantasizing them having sex. She is a closet fujoshi (female otaku) with a samurai  fetish, and also likes to cosplay. Due to this, she spends so much money on otaku goods that she usually eats instant noodles. This is also why she no longer lives with her parents, as her mother would disown her if she continued with her otaku ways. The sisters see her as a possible threat for Keita's heart because they believe he has fetish for older woman, and the fact that she has a much bigger bust than them.

name: Miharu Mikuni
description: A teenage girl that was introduced in chapter 18 where she returned Keita's acceptance letter when she found her dog trying to bury it in her yard. Out of a combination of stress from believing he did not get in to the relief he found out he did get in, Keita hugs her out of the blue. After that action she has shown an attraction towards Keita, often blushing when they talk and feeling very comfortable when he hugs her, but overall states she has nothing to do with him. Though it is obvious she is attracted to him, keeping her distance because of his sisters as well as her own inexperience being around boys, even fantasizing him raping her and experiencing an orgasm from him giving her a piggy back ride. Even though she does not go after him, his sisters still see her as a possible threat for Keita's heart. It is noted from Keita that she has a bigger bust than his sisters when he recalls the first hug they shared. She is currently in Gakushū Senior High and in the same class as Keita. People often mistake her being involved with Keita and will most of the time become caught in the cross fire of many of the twins' antics (which she comments on in chapter 25). She is the only girl Keita gets nervous around, suggesting he might have feelings for her. She has a weak bladder and occasionally wets herself, including once in front of Keita, but he promises to keep it a secret.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Chichi
description: Keita, Ako, and Riko's father. He completely supports his son having relations with any of the women in the story. Nothing shocks him and he is always rooting for Keita.

appearsIn.title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime the Movie: Scarlet Bond

name: Hiiro
description: A survivor of the Ogre Village. He is given his name by  [Towa](https://anilist.co/character/285168), the queen of the kingdom of Raja.

appearsIn.title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime the Movie: Scarlet Bond

name: Zonda
aliases: Violet no Ryourijin (ヴィオレの料理人‚ Violet's Chef)
description: Zonda is a Demon that serves as one of Ultima's lieutenants, and is her personal chef.

appearsIn.title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime the Movie: Scarlet Bond

name: Kae Serinuma
description: A nerdy and chubby girl in second year of high school. She's a fujoshi obsessed with BL and otome games. After spending a week without eating due to sadness after the death of her favourite character, she loses weight and becomes stunning, earning four suitors.

name: Asuma Mutsumi
description:
__Affiliation:__ History Club

He is a high school student in his third year and head of the history club. He is also one of the four boys and one girl who are trying to win Kae Serinuma's affection.

Mutsumi is depicted having straight shaggy brown hair that is styled on either side, slanted light brown eyes, a calm expression and he is often seen with a soft, genuine smile.



(Source: Watashi Ga Motete Dousunda Wikia)

name: Kirari Nanashima
description: Nanashima's younger sister. She is a fan of the anime Puri Puri Moon.

name: Shima Nishina
description: Shima Nishina is a first-year high school student, fujoshi, mangaka and cosplayer. She's in class 1-4, and is known to be quite popular and crafty. She's a smooth talker and can easily appear likeable to her peers.

name: Amane Nakano
description: Kae's friend.

name: Takurou Serinuma
description: Kae's older brother who often picks on her.

name: Kazuma Mutsumi
description: [Asuma Mutsumi's](https://anilist.co/character/89546/Mutsumi-Asuma) older brother. He is a student teacher who teaches at the same school Asuma is attending.

name: Minako Aino
description: Minako is the fourth member of the Sailor Team to be discovered by [Sailor Moon](https://anilist.co/character/2030/Tsukino-Usagi), and serves as the leader of the Guardian Senshi who protect her. She uses love-related powers. In the manga and anime series she dreams of becoming a famous idol, whereas in the live-action series her character is refactored to already be a celebrity. Silly or serious, Minako consistently displays great confidence, enthusiasm, and leadership skill. She is the "owner" of [Artemis](https://anilist.co/character/5408/Artemis), the white guardian cat who introduced her to her life as a Senshi. He lives in her home (as [Luna](https://anilist.co/character/5407/Luna) lives in Usagi's) and is one of her closest friends.

name: Mamoru Chiba
description: Mamoru Chiba is the major romantic interest of [Usagi Tsukino](https://anilist.co/character/2030/Tsukino-Usagi). He is often portrayed as stoic, steady and introverted.

name: Rei Hino
description: An elegant miko (shrine maiden), called Raye in the English version and Raya in the French version. Because of her work as a Shintô priestess, Rei can sense and dispel evil even in civilian form. When she transforms into Sailor Mars, she can also manipulate fire. She is very serious and focused, but although easily annoyed by [Usagi's](https://anilist.co/character/2030/Tsukino-Usagi) flightiness, cares about her very much. Rei is portrayed as boy-crazy in the early anime, but is uninterested in romance in both the manga and live-action series. She attends a private Catholic school, separate from the other girls.

name: Usagi Tsukino
description:
__Family Members:__ [Kenji](https://anilist.co/character/18345/Tsukino-Kenji) (Father), [Ikuko](https://anilist.co/character/17937/Tsukino-Ikuko) (Mother), [Shingo](https://anilist.co/character/18346/Tsukino-Shingo) (Younger Brother) 

The main character of the series, called Serena in the English dub (nicknamed Bunny in the manga). Usagi is a carefree schoolgirl with an enormous capacity for love, and transforms into the heroine called Sailor Moon. At the beginning of the series she is portrayed as an immature crybaby who hates having to fight, but over the course of the series you come to know her sweet and selfless side.

Usagi is a bit selfish and very much a crybaby, lazy, clumsy, and also an academic underachiever. She's also not very good at cooking. However, she cares deeply about her friends and family.

Usagi is very trusting, and believes that everyone has a better nature. She doesn't believe in killing innocent humans, even when they have been transformed into vicious monsters, and always seeks ways to heal them instead. Usagi matures a great deal through the series, and even though she is still prone to some childish behavior and bouts of silliness, she becomes a capable young woman.

name: Makoto Kino
description: Makoto is the third member of the Sailor Team to be discovered by [Sailor Moon](https://anilist.co/character/2030/Tsukino-Usagi), and serves as the "muscles" of the group. In addition to being physically tough, she is able to manipulate electricity and uses some plant-based powers. Her friends rarely use her full given name, normally shortening it to Mako-chan.

name: Artemis
description: Artemis is the companion to the leader of the Guardian Senshi—he trained [Minako Aino](https://anilist.co/character/2826/Minako-Aino) as Sailor V, and remains by her side when she takes on her proper role as Sailor Venus. His memory of the Silver Millennium seems to be more intact than Luna's—in fact, before appearing in the Sailor Moon series he guides her through the Sailor V video game at the arcade. Later, he fills in the details of her true mission. Artemis is more easy going than [Luna,](https://anilist.co/character/5407/Luna) and has a "big brother" relationship with Minako, although his attraction to her is sometimes implied. He also cares very deeply about Luna, often comforting her when she is distressed and stating his admiration of her. In addition, he is a good father to [Diana](https://anilist.co/character/11899/Diana) as evidenced by her affection for him. Artemis does not seem to mind the fact that he is named after a female goddess, even when teased about it by Minako.

name: Luna
description:
Luna was a talking cat and advisor to [Usagi Tsukino.](https://anilist.co/character/2030/Usagi-Tsukino) It was she who first detected Usagi's power, but at the time did not realize that she was the Moon Princess. Luna and her partner [Artemis](https://anilist.co/character/5408/Artemis) were advisors to [Queen Serenity](https://anilist.co/character/17010/Queen-Serenity) in the Silver Millennium, and when the kingdom was ruined Serenity used the power of her Silver Crystal to send the two cats to Earth's future in order to awaken the Sailor Senshi. 

She and Artemis one day married and had a daughter named [Diana](https://anilist.co/character/11899/Diana) who became the advisor to [Chibiusa.](https://anilist.co/character/2827/Chibiusa) Chibiusa's toy Luna P was also modelled on Luna.

(Source: Wikimoon)

name: Ami Mizuno
description: A quiet bookworm in Usagi's class called Amy in the English adaptations of the series. She is hugely intelligent, with an IQ of 300, and can transform into Sailor Mercury, acquiring power over water. Ami's shy exterior masks a passion for knowledge and for taking care of the people around her. She hopes to be a doctor one day, like her mother and tends to be the practical one in the group. Secretly, she is also a fan of pop culture and romance novels and becomes embarrassed whenever this is pointed out.

name: Queen Serenity
description:
Queen Serenity was the queen of the Moon Kingdom during the Silver Millennium and the mother of Princess Serenity. She sacrificed her life by using the Silver Crystal to send the court of the Silver Millennium, including the spirits of her daughter, the Solar System Senshi, and her daughter's lover Prince Endymion, into the future to be reborn on Earth.

She described herself as being the incarnation of the Moon Goddess Selene.

name: Jumeau
description:
Jumeau is a female youma under the control of Nephrite in episode 018. Her mission is to gather the energy of doll maker Mika Kayama once she reaches her peak energy output. Nephrite puts his evil crest on a French doll made by Mika, causing her to become obsessed with making ten replicas of the doll and hastening her approach towards her peak energy output. Jumeau has a doll-like, disjointed white body and blue hair. She wears no clothing except for a necklace bearing Nephrite's evil crest. Jumeau gets her name from a type of antique French dolls made by the doll maker Pierre Jumeau. These dolls were made during the 1800s, and they look almost exactly like the dolls that Mika Kayama makes. The dolls are highly prized among collectors.    

(Source: The Oracle :: BSSM Encyclopaedia)

name: Yuuta Hibiki
description: Yuuta has amnesia at the beginning to the extent of not even remembering where he lives. He fuses with Junk to become Gridman.

name: Rikka Takarada
description: The sole female member of Gridman Alliance and Yūta's classmate, who found the amnesiac boy in front of her house. Out of her teammates, she desires a normal life but wishes Yūta to keep fighting as Gridman to save her friends.

name: Akane Shinjou
description: Akane is noted to be a kind and popular girl, liked by all her classmates, and especially admired by Utsumi.

name: Gridman
description: Gridman (グリッドマン, Guriddoman) is a Hyper Agent from the Hyper World and the titular hero of SSSS.GRIDMAN and GRIDMAN UNIVERSE.

name: Namiko
description:
__Height:__ 150 cm

Namiko is one of Rikka Takarada's closest friends.

name: Alexis Kerib
description: He is the main antagonist of SSSS.GRIDMAN and is the spiritual successor of Khan Digifier.

name: Gesicht
description:
He attempts to capture a powerful killer in Germany who is attacking both humans and robots with no apparent motives.

In the original manga, Gesicht's name was Gerhart, and in the 1980's anime his name was Zeron. In Pluto, he along with his wife and the other robots in the story are given a human appearance - contradictory to his prior robot appearances in both the manga and 1980 series.

name: Atom
description: Loosely based off of Osamu Tezuka's classic character, "Astro Boy," Atom of the "Pluto" series is a highly developed robot. He is constantly classified as one of the worlds top seven robotic technological advances in science, to the point that even Gesicht's sensors have trouble distinguishing him as a robot or human.  He works with Gesicht in order to help discover the truth behind the recent chain of murders. He has a sister, Uran.

name: Tawashi
description:
Police Inspector Tawashi (a.k.a. Inspector Gumshoe) is a law enforcer and recurring character in the Tetsuwan Atom mythos. Known for his surly demeanor, Inspector Tawashi is a dedicated officer. And he hates robots.

He is similar to Inspector Geta in that both always appear as police investigators, and both are known for their dedication to their job. However, while Geta is known for his honesty and uprightness, Tawashi is most known for his suspicion of people. He is suspicious not only of Tezuka villains such as Ham Egg and Lamp, or of ambiguous characters such as Rock Holmes, but is even critical and untrusting of such figures as Astro Boy. The series which contains most of his appearances is Astro Boy, but he also has notable appearances in such series as The Amazing Three, Black Jack, Lion Books, Unico, and Rainbow Parakeet.

name: Dr. Roosevelt
description: A.I created to aid the president of the United States of Thracia.

name: Chika Kudou
description:
**Height:** 178 cm (5'10")

The first member to join Kurata in the club. Kudou brings with him a reputation for fighting and delinquency, which initially makes others distrustful of him. However, underneath his rough exterior is a kind heart who wants to honor his deceased grandfather by playing the koto.

appearsIn.title: Kono Oto Tomare!: Sounds of Life

name: Kouta Mizuhara
description: Kota Mizuhara is a second year student at Tokise High School and a member of the Tokise High School Koto Club.

appearsIn.title: Kono Oto Tomare!: Sounds of Life

name: Satowa Houzuki
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm (5'2")

Satowa is a first year student and the daughter of a famous koto family, Houzuki. She has been learning to play koto since she was little and has won many contests. Although she is a koto prodigy, Satowa was debarred from Houzukikai. She claims that she joined the koto music club because she wants to become known as "young virtuoso koto player that led a no-name school club to become number 1 in nation" when she makes professional debut. She loves koto.

appearsIn.title: Kono Oto Tomare!: Sounds of Life

description: Michitaka Sakai is a second year student at Tokise High School and a member of the Tokise High School Koto Club.

appearsIn.title: Kono Oto Tomare!: Sounds of Life

name: Hiro Kurusu
description: She is Takezou's classmate and joins the koto music club after hearing their first performance. She has knowledge of koto due to the influence of her grandmother. She becomes the koto music club's vice-president.

appearsIn.title: Kono Oto Tomare!: Sounds of Life

name: Takezou Kurata
description: President of koto music club. He's shy and weak in difficult situations. After his failure at the exam, depressed, Takezou saw his senpai's performance, where she was giving her all even though no one listened and koto's string had been broken. He was deeply moved by her performance, so he joined the club. After senpai's graduation, he became an only member of koto music club and had to find strength to protect it.

appearsIn.title: Kono Oto Tomare!: Sounds of Life

name: Suzuka Takinami
description: A math teacher at Tokise High and the Koto Club's advisor.

appearsIn.title: Kono Oto Tomare!: Sounds of Life

name: Saneyasu Adachi
description: Saneyasu is a second-year student at Tokise High School and a member of the Tokise High School Koto Club.

appearsIn.title: Kono Oto Tomare!: Sounds of Life

name: Chiharu Houzuki
description: Satowa's mother.

appearsIn.title: Kono Oto Tomare!: Sounds of Life

name: Tetsuki Takaoka
description: Tetsuki has been classmates with Chika since middle school. He's worried about his friend, because he knows Chika's circumstances. He seems to be a quiet person, but in reality he shows his true colors when fighting. He comes from wealthy family, his father is the director of a large hospital.

appearsIn.title: Kono Oto Tomare!: Sounds of Life

name: Diego Brando
native: ディエゴ・ブランドー
description: Diego Brando (usually called "Dio" for short) is a famous professional jockey from England. He is one of the participants in the Steel Ball Run race. Although unrelated to his DIO counterpart directly (parts 1-6 and 7-9 take place in two distinct, separate universes), he appears to be very similar to the original Dio in both looks and personality.

appearsIn.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Part 7–Steel Ball Run
STEEL BALL RUN JoJo's Bizarre Adventure 1st STAGE

name: Johnny Joestar
native: ジョニィ・ジョースター
description:
Johnny Joestar is an American former jockey turned paraplegic, and is the main protagonist of Part 7. He is a depressive man with a bleak outlook on life, but he is also very stubborn and capable of extreme, unwavering determination to the point of disregarding any risks or consequences, putting his goal above all else. He joins the Steel Ball Run race to find out the secret behind [Gyro Zeppeli's](https://anilist.co/character/11772) steel balls, as Johnny believes they're capable of healing his legs.

Johnny was once a horse racing prodigy. However, when waiting in line for a play, the girl he was with convinced him to cut to the front of the line and bribe the bouncers to throw out the youth in the front of the line, who had been waiting there all night. Furious, the youth shot Johnny in the back, paralyzing him from the waist down.

appearsIn.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Part 7–Steel Ball Run
STEEL BALL RUN JoJo's Bizarre Adventure 1st STAGE

name: Lucy Steel
native: ルーシー・スティール
description: Lucy Steel is the wife of Steven Steel, the organizer of the Steel Ball Run race. Lucy is a kind, intelligent, and gentle girl who is extremely loyal to her husband. Although she appears nervous and meek, Lucy is incredibly courageous, resourceful, and determined.

appearsIn.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Part 7–Steel Ball Run
STEEL BALL RUN JoJo's Bizarre Adventure 1st STAGE

name: Funny Valentine
native: ファニー・ヴァレンタイン
description:
Funny Valentine is the 23rd President of the United States, and the main antagonist of Steel Ball Run. He is the true mastermind behind the Steel Ball Run race. He watches the competition from behind the curtains and hopes to gather the Saint's Corpse to use the Holy Relic to further the United States of America's interests and power, and explains that his way to do that is by "taking the first napkin".

Valentine has a lot of importance for patriotism and seems to care about his country. Most of his bad deeds are not selfishly centered, but instead are done in order to achieve what he thinks is power for America, and to follow his goal of making America the most dominant country.

appearsIn.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Part 7–Steel Ball Run

name: Gyro Zeppeli
native: ユリウス・カエサル・ツェペリ
description:
Gyro has a cocky and flamboyant personality, appearing to have a high opinion of himself. However, he can be driven by emotions for other people and become realistic and serious when a problem presents itself.

Like most Manga archetypes, Gyro is incredibly intelligent when he needs to be. His most distinguishable body features are his long hair, western hat and his gold teeth which have "GO! GO! ZEPPELI" displayed on them, revealed whenever he smiles at someone. His signature laugh/chuckle is "Nyo ho ho ho~".

appearsIn.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Part 7–Steel Ball Run
STEEL BALL RUN JoJo's Bizarre Adventure 1st STAGE

name: D-I-S-C-O
description: One of [Valentine](https://anilist.co/character/20147/Funny-Valentine)'s henchmen. He is a stand user, wielding the gauntlet-like Chocolate Disco.

appearsIn.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Part 7–Steel Ball Run

name: Ferdinand Hakase
native: フェルディナンド博士
description: Dr. Ferdinand is a geologist and paleontologist who works as one of [Valentine](https://anilist.co/character/20147/Funny-Valentine)'s henchmen. His stand is Scary Monsters, which allows him to turn people into dinosaurs.

appearsIn.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Part 7–Steel Ball Run

name: Gaucho
description: Gaucho is a Spanish competitor in the Steel Ball Run. During the third stage of the race, he is shown going the long way around a lake to reach the finish line.

description:
Rina Higashikata is a minor character briefly shown in Steel Ball Run. 



(Source: JoJo's Bizzare Encyclopedia Wikia)

description:
Norisuke Higashikata is a minor character in Part VII: Steel Ball Run.

Norisuke is a mysterious Japanese competitor in the Steel Ball Run race.

(Source: JJBA Wikia)

appearsIn.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Part 7–Steel Ball Run

name: Rika Shiguma
description:
Rika Shiguma is a main supporting character from the Boku wa Tomodachi ga Sukunai series, a freshman and scientific genius whose presence at St. Chronica's Academy was designed to increase its prestige. She was saved by Kodaka when she fell unconscious during a disastrous lab experiment (she invented and released sleeping gas that works in just a few seconds), and begs to repay his kindness with sex. She joined the Neighbor's Club just to get closer to him. She is the fifth member of the club. Rika was a shut-in before joining, being isolated from the outside world her personal room in the school, she prefers the life of a loner like Yozora and like her, is extremely anti-social. 

As a fujoshi, she is a passionate consumer of BL dōjinshi and magazines, is comically aroused by intercourse between mecha, and is delighted when Yukimura offers to have sex with Kodaka.  Although there are many adult themes in the series, she is the most sexually forward member. This was clearly highlighted in her first speaking appearance when she described the attractions of rape to Kodaka in the middle of a stunned class. She has a habit of inserting any sexual innuendo possible in her sentences, to the point where she finds it normal to convert every innocent thought into something perverted. Rika is proud of her pervertedness, as she says that she would be a boring person if people only thought of her as a genius girl. To compound her eccentricity, she speaks in the third person.

name: Hayato Hasegawa
description: Kodaka and Kobato's father, whose job as a travelling archaeologist made him leave his two children in the care of his old friend, Pegasus Kashiwazaki.

name: Aoi Yusa
description: Novel Debut: Volume 7  She is the student council treasurer and also a classmate of Sena, who always takes 2nd place in exams since beginning of high school. Aoi looks way younger than she actually is, having small body and being quite short. She has spiky hair with red tinge. Fitting her appearance, she has rather childish or better called "strange" personality, and shares rivarly (one-sided) with Sena, whom she regards as a perfect person. She also has rather strange taste in dress and looks calling Kodaka "super cool", and "very fashionable".   (Source: Boku wa Tomodachi ga Sukunai Wiki)

name: Kate Takayama
description: Maria's big sister. She is 15-years-old and also calls Kodaka "Onii-chan." She loves her little sister a lot but would never admit it.

name: Koyomi Fujioka
description: Character from "Homoge-bu"

name: Agni
description:
Agni is the titular protagonist of Fire Punch. He is a large, muscular young man with black hair and his entire body is on fire except for his mouth and the left side of his face. Agni possesses the blessing of Regeneration. His regeneration is extremely powerful, as he is able to regrow lost limbs instantly and even regenerate from being beheaded.

On his way home one day, he sees a plane flying towards the village. Investigating, he sees a large group of men rounding up the older members of the village at gunpoint. He intervenes, telling the men to leave the elders alone. Agni is approached by a man who introduces himself as [Doma](https://anilist.co/character/120595/Doma), stating they are searching for Blessed Ones to bring with them to the city of Behemdolg. Upon hearing one of the soldiers report that the village houses were filled with human meat and the villagers were in fact cannibals, Doma orders the soldiers to return to the plane before setting the village ablaze with his Fire Blessing. Agni is left burning, as his Blessing prevents him from dying, surrounded by charred corpses and burning buildings. Longing to die as he thinks of his family, a heavily burned [Luna](https://anilist.co/character/238189/Luna) shuffles towards him. Just before her body is reduced to ash, she utters a single word: “Live”.

name: Judah
description: Judah (ユダ, Yuda) is one of the main characters of Fire Punch. She had an overwhelmingly powerful blessing of regeneration.

name: Daida
description: Daida is an inmate on Behemdolg's death row who is Blessed with the ability to increase his muscular strength.

name: Doma
description:
Doma is a blessed one with a high position in Behemdorg. He is gathering young men to defeat the Ice Witch and bring back the green nature. As a passionate follower of the king, Doma only uses his ability for the king.

His ability is to control a fire which does not extinguish until the prey is burnt to ashes.

name: Fugaitai
description: Fugaitai was a death row inmate from Behemdolg.

name: Jack
description: Jack is a soldier of Behemdorg who is blessed with the power to heal wounds.

name: Togata
description:
Togata is an avid film watcher whose film collection - and thus life purpose - burned up in a fire. Upon hearing about the mysterious man on fire, Togata decided to direct an autobiographical film in an effort to get back some meaning in life. Togata ended up accompanying [Agni](https://anilist.co/character/120594/Agni) on his journey and even helping him out at times.

Togata often comes off as an unempathetic, but high-energy person, not caring for the feelings and wellbeing of others. Togata tends to find awe in some of the harsher aspects of life.

name: Uroy
description:
Uroy is a member of Behemdolg army.

Apparently, he had a high position commanding several soldiers, when they were afraid of going into battle, Uroy would show them his blessing to create and manipulate flames, claiming to be one chosen by god, his king, and that he would use his power to defeat the enemies.

name: Ivan
description: Ivan is a soldier of Behemdolg and Jack's younger brother.

name: Sun
description:
Sun's first appearance was when he was being transported to Behemdolg to be sold as a slave, when the group of soldiers guarding the caravan decided to execute some of these slaves as examples for the others to fear. It was at this time that Agni happened to be passing by.

Agni, having rescued Sun and the prisoners by killing the soldiers continues on his track to kill Doma. However, Sun decided to follow Agni. After some time Sun collapses due to exhaustion and the cold, and Agni stays by his side to warm him up. The duo is then ambushed by a group of Behemdolg soldiers and are caught in an avalanche, but Agni manages to rescue the boy.

name: Akane Kousaka
description: The leader of doujin circle Rouge en rouge.

appearsIn.title: Saekano: How to Raise a Boring Girlfriend ♭

name: Fiona Frost
aliases: Nafalia Foney (トバリー・フォニー)
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm
__Occupation:__ Hospital Assistant (secretly a spy)

A spy who works undercover as an assistant to [Loid Forger](https://anilist.co/character/138101/Loid-Forger) at Berlint General Hospital to provide him with mission details. Fiona is deeply in love with Loid, even telling Loid to replace [Yor](https://anilist.co/character/138102/Forger-Yor) and let her take over the role of the Forger wife.

name: Kanata Hoshijima
description:
__Height:__ 181 cm (5'11")
__Hometown:__ Mousanish District

Kanata is naturally athletic and a steadfast person that wants to become a space explorer. He is also a very selfless person who would willingly help anyone in distress and would take any risks necessary to save them. He acts like a leader and wishes to be acknowledged as one by his comrades.

name: Luca Esposito
description:
__Height:__ 162 cm (5'4")
__Hometown:__ Mousanish District

Luca is deft with their hands and has a strong artistic sense.

name: Quitterie Raffaeli
native: キトリー・ラファエリ
description:
__Height:__ 157 cm (5'2")
__Hometown:__ Mousanish District

She likes being fashionable and doesn't feel comfortable around strange animals. Although she's not good at socialising, [Zack](https://anilist.co/character/139432/Walker-Zack) and her have been friends since they were little due to their parents being coworkers.

Quitterie's mother is the head doctor at a hospital and she wishes to become a doctor like her in the future, so she's studying medicine. She never knew her father.

name: Aries Spring
native: アリエス・スプリング
description:
__Height:__ 162 cm (5'4")
__Hometown:__ Rosapop District

Aries is a very cheerful, optimistic, and spacey girl. According to her friends, she is also careless and can't take a hint. She is also a very grateful person that would repeatedly thank someone who helps her.

name: Zack Walker
description:
__Height:__ 185 cm (6'1")
__Weight:__ 76 kg (168 lbs.)
__Eye color:__ Blue
__Hometown:__ Mousanish District

Zack is a genius with an IQ of 200 whose field of expertise is space science. He even has a spaceship pilot's license. He and [Quitterie](https://anilist.co/character/122754/Raffaeli-Quitterie) have been friends since they were little due to their parents being coworkers.

name: Ulgar Zweig
native: ウルガー・ツヴァイク
description:
__Hometown:__ Mousanish District
__Height__: 165 cm (5'5")

Ulgar is a snarky person and extremely reserved, he is a lone wolf and tries to stay away from the group. His favourite piece of clothing is his knit cap from the popular fashion brand Rocket Rollance. He's a member of Group B-5, He treasures his beanie, and he is good with things like calculating trajectory.

name: Funicia Raffaeli
native: フニシア・ラファエリ
description:
Height: 136 cm (4'6")
Weight: 31 kg (68 lbs.)
Eye color: Violet
Hometown: Mousanish District

Quitterie's little sister. Her favourite toy is a Beego hand puppet. Beego is the main character of her favourite cartoon show, _Animaroid B5_.

name: Charce Lacroix
description:
__Height:__ 176 cm (5'9")

Charce is well-versed in biology and extremely curious about all living things. He's also an excellent cook.

name: Yun-Hua Lu
description:
**Height:** 179 cm (5'10")
**Hometown:** Mousanish District

Yun-Hua has a shy personality with a tendency to suppress any self-expression.

name: Mark Vix
description: A resident of the noble city of Vixia. He's close to Noah Vix.

name: Haruka Amagiri
description: Ayato's older sister. She is the one that taught Ayato the family fighting style. She entered school five years prior to Ayato's entrance to Seidoukan Academy but disappeared half a year later. She also participated in the unofficial underground Eclipse tournament. She once wielded the Ser-Versta; however, all records of her and including those pertaining to Lux have been erased.

name: Priscilla Urzaiz
native: プリシラ・ウルサイス
description: She is Irene's younger sister. She cares deeply for her sister, Irene, and is a lot more level-headed than her.

name: Sylvia Lyyneheym
native: シルヴィア・ リューネハイム
description: She is the Student Council President and the top student of Queenvail Girls' Academy who is very persistent. She is the world's top idol. Her singing is omnipotent.

name: Kongming Zhuge
description:
**Occupation:**
Chancellor of Shu Han (Former)
Part-Timer (BB Lounge)
Manager

Zhuge Kongming is the main male protagonist of the Paripi Koumei series. He is the former Chancellor of Shu Han, well-known strategist of the Three Kingdoms Period (220 -280 AD). As his life reached its end at the Battle of the Wuzhong Plains, he wished on his deathbed to be reborn into a world where peace thrives. Thus, he is reborn to modern-day Tokyo, Japan.

name: Eiko Tsukimi
description:
**Height:** 164 cm (5'4")
**Occupation:** Singer, Part-Timer (BB Lounge)

Eiko Tsukimi is the main female protagonist of the Paripi Koumei series. She is an amateur singer, who was about to give up her dream of being a singer. But after meeting [Kongming Zhuge](https://anilist.co/character/256378/Kongming-Zhuge), a military strategist, she begins to develop her talents with his help.

name: KABE Taijin
description:
**Occupation:** Rapper

KabeTaijin is renown as a young rapper who won the DRB Rap Battle Competition 3 years in a row.

name: Nanami Kuon
description: Kuon Nanami is a vocalist and bassist that Eiko found singing on the streets. Nanami and Eiko immediately befriend each other, finding themselves singing in the street in their first meeting, after Eiko prevented Kuon from being taken away by the police because of her lack of a permit to perform in public.

name: Lloyd de Saloum
description:
The seventh prince of the royal family that rules the Kingdom of Saloum. He was reincarnated and grows up with the memories of his previous life as a sorcerer. Although he's only ten years old, he has an enormous amount of sorcery knowledge and possesses mana that even terrifies demons. He's not interested in things such as succession to the throne, girls, or romance. Instead, his activities and desires are all focused on the research of his beloved sorcery and its practice. 

(Source: Official Site)

appearsIn.title: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability
I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince So I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability

name: Grimoire
description:
A demon who uses the old magic and once drove the Kingdom of Saloum into the verge of collapse. After being sealed inside of a forbidden tome that was locked away in the kingdom's sealed archive for several centuries, he's released by Lloyd and they have their first encounter. But he becomes overwhelmed by Lloyd's immeasurable mana and sorcery and surrenders to him. After that, he turns into a cute familiar and serves Lloyd. 

(Source: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability Official Site)

appearsIn.title: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability
I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince So I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability

name: Alieze de Saloum
native: アリーゼ=ディ=サルーム
description:
The sixth princess of the Saloum Kingdom, Lloyd's older sister. With her personal maid, Eris, she keeps a menagerie of her favorite animals in the castle's "Boxed Garden Tower", and spends her days leisurely looking after them. A laid-back and absent-minded girl who, much like her brothers, dotes on Lloyd. She possesses a magical power that lets her subconsciously connect with animals and monsters, resulting in even high-level creatures like a lesser fenrir being among her pets. She believes this is purely the result of the affection she shows them 

(Source: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability Official Site)

appearsIn.title: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability
I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince So I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability

name: Ren
description:
Part of the Assassins Guild, whose members all have bounties on their heads. Members of this guild are all born with a condition affecting their mana, known as “The Blighted”, and in Ren's case she is able to secrete poison through her skin, earning her the name "Ren the Poison Moth." Normally wears heavy clothing, and when her skin is exposed she is capable of spreading poison around an area. A bit of a tomboy, who has a shy personality thanks to her power. 

(Source: Official Site)

appearsIn.title: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability
I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince So I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability

name: Shiro
description:
One of the four wild bearwolf monsters that live in the forest. After being doused in Lloyd's magic power he transforms into a white, fluffy form, earning him the name "Shiro." With a keen sense of smell and a massive body, he can transport Lloyd and Sylpha around with ease. 

(Source: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability Official Site)

appearsIn.title: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability
I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince So I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability

name: Tao
description:
A martial artist that uses a foreign breathing method that gives access to superhuman abilities, known as “Qi”. After a life dedicated wholly to training, she fled her dojo to become an adventurer in pursuit of a fateful meeting with a handsome man. However, she had little luck with finding adventuring comrades, and encounters Lloyd while traveling on her own. Has a weakness for pretty faces, with a cheerful and excited disposition. 

(Source: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability Official Site)

appearsIn.title: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability
I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince So I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability

name: Sylpha
description:
[Lloyd](https://anilist.co/character/290877/de-Saloum-Lloyd)'s loyal maid, who serves the Kingdom of Saloum. In charge of his education and his protection. Has mastery with a blade that adventurers envy, along with the alias "The Silver Blade Princess." Seems very kind at first, but rigorous when it comes to training with a sword. She was a cold-hearted swordswoman in the past, and during battle that side of her surfaces. 

(Source: Official Site)

appearsIn.title: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability
I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince So I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability

name: Jade
description:
After assembling a group of other Blighted, he created the Assassin's Guild, acting as its leader. Known as the Phantom Blighted, his power will teleport him to random locations regardless of his own will. He was originally the third son of the noble family who ruled the territory of Lordost. He formed his team of Blighted in order to oppose his relatives, who dominate Lordost with political power. Kind-hearted and caring, the Assassin’s Guild looks to him for their direction, until... 

(Source: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability Official Site)

appearsIn.title: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability

name: Dian de Saloum
native: ディアン=ディ=サルーム
description:
The fourth prince of the Saloum Kingdom, and one of Lloyd's older brothers. While he had a fondness for magic from an early age, due to a lack of talent, at age 10 he chose to pursue blacksmithing instead, traveling to the neighboring kingdom of Bartram for his education in the subject. His dream is to create swords enchanted with magical power, with an eye towards establishing a Magic Swordsman Corps in Saloum. A dedicated craftsman with a rough edge, but a kind heart. 

(Source: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability Official Site)

appearsIn.title: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability

name: Albert de Saloum
native: アルベルト=ディ=サルーム
description:
The second prince of the Saloum Kingdom, and one of Lloyd's older brothers. The current heir to the throne with both martial and academic ability. Often at the center of attention in the palace, but lacking in arrogance, he treats his subordinates with care and has earned the backing of many parties. Albert has recognized Lloyd's talent with magic where others have overlooked it, and considers him a potential valuable ally for the future. 

(Source: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability Official Site)

appearsIn.title: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability

name: Inaho Kaizuka
description:
__Height:__ 164 cm

Inaho is a young boy of average height and short tousled black hair. His eyes hold a burgundy color and he has a blank gaze. He is seen in his high school standard uniform which consists of a white shirt, red tie and white sweater, along with a light brown blazer on the outside and black pants. His backpack is dark blue.

Inaho is a calm, intelligent boy. Even at times of great distress, he calmly thinks of a way out. He is intuitive and not afraid to go on many different tactics to analyze the opponents and figure out the suitable strategy.

Inaho's parents died sometime prior to the war and he lived alone with his sister. Waking up, cooking breakfast for his sister, he leaves for his school in Shinawara. He, along with his friends, attended the parade where the princess was killed by a missile attack. Shortly after, the Orbital Knights declared war on the Terrans and invaded Earth. Inaho's daily life was shattered because of the attack.

name: Slaine Troyard
native: スレイン・トロイヤード
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm

He is the son of Dr. Troyard, a brilliant scientist researching Aldnoah, and was launched to Mars by his father as a means to protect him. He was found by [Princess Asselyum Vers Allusia](https://anilist.co/character/88175/Asseylum-Vers-Allusia) who took him in and later on became her tutor. After several years of living on Mars, [Count Cruhteo](https://anilist.co/character/88435/Cruhteo) takes custody over Slaine.

Slaine is very friendly and loyal towards Princess Asselyum as she was the one who saved him and the first person he met on Mars. He wishes to support her in any way possible and is willing to put his own life at risk in order to protect Princess Asselyum. Towards others however, he acts coldly and does not seem to trust anyone other than the Princess, often distancing himself from both Martians and Terrans. He is always seen with a serious look on his face.

Slaine proves himself to be a very capable pilot, able to quickly maneuver around in a Kataphrakt and face [Inaho](https://anilist.co/character/88173/Kaizuka-Inaho) by himself.

name: Asseylum Vers Allusia
native: アセイラム・ヴァース・アリューシア
description:
__Height:__ 155 cm

The Princess of the Vers Empire. She is very close to [Slaine](https://anilist.co/character/88174/Troyard-Slaine). She went to Earth on a goodwill visit, but her motorcade was attacked and she was presumed to have died. This assassination was used by the orbiting Martians as a casus belli for their invasion. However, the princess was ill that day and the person who died was a body double. Asseylum now travels with Inaho's group under a false identity until they can get a message back to her grandfather in hopes of stopping the rekindled war.

Asseylum is an idealist and pacifist. She believes in peaceful solutions and she sees the people of the Earth in a good light. Unlike many of the Martians shown so far, she seems to treat the people of Earth as equal humans. Asseylum appears to be regretful of the actions that led to the Second Earth-Mars War between the Martians and the people of Earth, yet she feels that she has the responsibility to help stop the war.

Asseylum is kind, caring, and compassionate, however she is also naive, believing that if her grandfather found out that she were still alive, that the war would end. Asseylum later realizes her naivety, and that certain people of VERS were only using her as an excuse to start a war with Earth.

Asseylum seems to also have a bold and decisive side, she is not particularly guarded around others being quickly open and friendly.

name: Cruhteo
description:
__Height:__ 187 cm

A Count and a member of the Orbital Knights. Cruhteo is a tall Martian with parted blonde hair and green eyes. He wears a noble outfit which consists of a long burgundy trouser and coat, a white frilled dress shirt, and black knee high boots. He is always seen with a serious and determined look on his face.

After finding out about [Princess Asselyum](https://anilist.co/character/88175/Asseylum-Vers-Allusia)'s assassination on Earth, he was one of the first Counts to support the Martian's invasion on Earth. He was the first Martian to land on Earth and examine the location of the Princess's assassination.

Cruhteo has a very egoistic personality, often belittling and looking down at those who are weaker than him. Being a Martian and a high ranking member of the Orbital Knights, Cruhteo despises Terrans and looks down on them. He treats them cruelly and unfairly as shown when he punishes Slaine for simply being born on Earth. However, he respects the Royal Family of Vers and those who do not surrender easily. 

He pilots the Martian Kataphrakt, Tharsis. It possesses an Aldnoah Drive allowing the Kataphrakt to view a few hours into the future. It is extremely mobile allowing the pilot to close distances very quickly and evade enemy attacks, however this is all dependent on the pilot itself.

name: Rayregalia Vers Rayvers
native: レイレガリア・ヴァース・レイヴァース
description:
__Height:__ 185 cm

The first Emperor of the Vers Empire and the grand-father of [Princess Asselyum](https://anilist.co/character/88175/Asseylum-Vers-Allusia). Rayregalia is an aging man with long golden curls and green eyes. His clothing consists of a long burgundy robe and a navy blue tunic that reaches his feet. Due to his old age, he carries around a cane-like walking stick to assist him when walking.

After the colonization of Mars and the discovery of the Aldnoah Drive, Raygalia was the man responsible for Mars' independence from Earth and the creation of the Vers Empire with claims that the Emperor has the rightful authority over the Aldnoah. However, shortly after the colonization and revolution of the Vers Empire, the citizens of Mars are oppressed by a feudal system caused by the Aldnoah. Although Mars possess superior and advanced technology compared to Earth thanks to Rayralia, Earth has diverse creatures, luscious fields, and unique foods in which the Martians do not have which became the main reason for Martians resenting Terrans.

Rayregalia is a very intelligent man who carefully assess and understand any situation he is in and makes the best decision possible. Although he is intelligent, he is vulnerable to manipulation and words as seen when [Count Saazbaum](https://anilist.co/character/88437/Saazbaum) manipulates and convinces him to declare war against Earth instead of taking [Slaine](https://anilist.co/character/88174/Slaine-Troyard)'s honest words.

name: John Humeray
native: ジョン・ヒュームレイ
description:
A soldier who fought alongside Koichiro against the Martians invsion on Tanegashima and the older brother of Darzana Magbaredge. Durring the Martians assult on Tanegashima led by Viscountess Orlane and Count Sazzbaum, John and Koichiro's tank was heavily damaged causing it to burst in flames. However, John's leg was trapped rendering him immobile. He begged Koichiro for help but he was frozen in fear and only able to stare at his trapped friend. After all hope was lost, John asked Koichiro to shoot him and put him out of his misery which Koichiro did before escaping the burning tank.

As an older brother, he cherishes his younger sister, Darzana, and dotes on her often.

name: Souma Yagarai
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm

Souma is a doctor who later enlisted in the UFE. He is the best friend of [Kouichirou](https://anilist.co/character/88433/Kouichirou-Marito) and is often seen counseling and offering him help about his PTSD and alcoholism.

name: Saazbaum
description:
__Height:__ 190 cm

A Count and a member of the Orbital Knights. He is a middle aged man with medium length brown hair and eyes. He wears the traditional Orbital Knights uniform which consists of a burgundy coat and trousers, a white dress shirt underneath, and knee high black boots.  During the first Earth-Mars War, he was sent to Tanegashima in his Kataphrakt, the Dioscuria, along side his fiancé to fight. However, when Heaven's Fall occurred, Saazbaum barely managed to escape alive with the help of Dr. Troyard at the cost of his fiancé's life. After this tragedy, Saazbaum blames everything on the Royal Family of Vers which ignited him to take part in the assassination attempt on [Princess Asseylum](https://anilist.co/character/88175/Asseylum-Vers-Allusia).

Count Saazbaum appears to be a blood thirsty and violent man who seeks the destruction of all Terrans and Earth. However, he has another objective which is to seek vengeance on the Royal Family of Vers after causing the incident that killed his fiancé. Count Saazbaum adopts Slaine and treats him respectfully as his father was the one who saved his life. He holds a great amount of trust towards him, going as far to tell him his own goals and vengeance towards the Royal Family of Vers.

He is the pilot of the Martian Kataphrakt Dioscuria and it's successor, the Dioscuria II.

name: Nezumi
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm (5'10")  

A fugitive who is on the run from the police after escaping from prison. He sneaks into [Shion](https://anilist.co/character/42307/Shion)'s house after being shot. Nezumi gets treated and sheltered by him for a night, then disappears without a trace in the morning.  He hates No.6 and appears to know something about the city that no one seems to know.   

Nezumi is a rude and straightforward person. He has a deep hatred towards No. 6. Though deemed a criminal in the beginning, he seems to be an honorable person.

name: Shion
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7")

Shion is a main character in the manga and anime No.6. He is kind and understands people. He doesn't seem amazed by No.6 even though he lives there. He also feels that something about the city is weird - something just feels wrong. Initially, he had brown hair and hazel brown eyes. He has an amazing IQ level, proven by his acceptance into the Special Course.

name: Rico
description: Karan's brother.

name: Karan
description: Rico's sister.

name: Inukashi
description: Inukashi, otherwise known as Dogkeeper, is one of the denizens who live outside No.6. Raised by a dog,  They now run a hotel where they rent out dogs to the tenants, allowing them to keep warm in the winter, though they also engage in an information trade. They have a strong bond with dogs, particularly the dog that was their mother, going as far as to try to kill anyone who would insult their memory. Though their relation with Nezumi is antagonistic on the surface, the two have come a little closer since Shion has appeared.

name: Safu
description: She is Sion's best friend. Safu seems to be in love with him, but if he returns her feelings is unclear. The evening before she leaves, she asks Sion a favor, to have sex with her. He promised when she comes back in two years, he will grant her request.

name: Karan
description: Shion's mother.

name: Betty
description: Safu's friend from No.5.

name: Minato Hinageshi
description: 21 years old. Firefighter. A trusted team member with a strong sense of righteousness. Physically dextrous and seemingly able to take on anything, but always put in extra effort.

name: Hinako Mukaimizu
description: Hinako is a university student and loves surfing and is considerably skilled at it. Comes across as bright and carefree, but has insecurities about her own future.

name: Youko Hinageshi
description: A curt and blunt high schooler and Minato's younger sister.

name: Rody Soul
description:
__Quirk:__ Soul

Original character from My Hero Academia The Movie: World Heroes' Mission.

Rody is a very carefree individual who always looks for an opportunity/job to support his younger brother and sister and make their lives better. He is a smooth liar and a good negotiator, able to talk his way out of most situations.

appearsIn.title: My Hero Academia: World Heroes' Mission

name: Keigo Takami
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm (5' 7¾")
__Occupation:__ Pro Hero (No.3 - former, No.2 - current)
__Quirk:__ Fierce Wings
__Affiliation:__ Hero Public Safety Commission, 

Hawks is carefree, jovial, and dislikes formalities, often acting in a spontaneous and unpredictable way while being cocky and taunting. He believes that popular approval is the most important metric a Pro Hero should be judged for, and does not appear to take the official rankings seriously, showing a preference for the lower ranks as it would allow him to act more freely and avoid the burdens of being a top hero. He states his wish to patrol in a leisurely fashion and "take it easy".

It is hinted that Hawks was a fan of [Endeavor](https://anilist.co/character/126158/Todoroki-Enji) from an early age, as depicted by the drawing of him as a child holding an Endeavor figurine.

appearsIn.title: My Hero Academia: World Heroes' Mission

name: Kyouka Jirou
description:
__Height:__ 154 cm (5'1")
__Quirk:__ Earphone Jack
__Affiliation:__ U.A. High School
__Fighting Style:__ Medium Ranged + Support Combat

Kyoka is a petite, fair-skinned girl with a slender build. She has triangular, lazy-looking onyx eyes with notably long lower eyelashes, and rather small eyebrows. Kyoka has a pragmatic, unenthusiastic and teasing personality that is mostly shown to those she finds irritating. Kyoka is not always like this though, as she does enjoy socializing with others, in which case she is usually nice and friendly. Kyoka's Quirk (Earphone Jack) allows her to plug the jacks that hang from her earlobes into all sorts of things and channel the sound of her heartbeat into them; causing havoc inside the plugged objects. It's also used to catch sounds and vibrations from her surroundings.

appearsIn.title: My Hero Academia: World Heroes' Mission

name: Itsuki Hashima
description:
__Occupation:__ Novelist

Itsuki is the protagonist of the series who has an obsession towards younger sisters. He is a novelist who debuted when he was in high school; all of his novels feature younger sisters as the heroine. In the span of five years, he has published 20 books, some of which have ranked in the top 10 weekly rankings for light novels on Oricon. Despite his success, his irrational personality and writing style has led to mediocre success compared to his fellow writers.

name: Nayuta Kani
description: Nayuta is a genius novelist who is in love with [Itsuki](https://anilist.co/character/123942/Hashima-Itsuki). She debuted as a novelist after she won a newcomer prize. Nayuta Kani is her pseudonym and even Itsuki does not know her real name. She cannot write if she is not naked. Starting in junior high school, she refused to go to school after getting bullied.

name: Miyako Shirakawa
description: Itsuki's former college classmate. Although she is not attempting to be a professional author like Itsuki is, she enjoys reading his works. She supports him, and Kani's work.

name: Haruto Fuwa
description: Haruto is another novelist who debuted around the same time as Itsuki. He is 22 years old and often drinks alcohol with Itsuki. Despite his cool appearance, he loves maid characters and owns a lot of adult games and figurines. Haruto has a "persona" in his social media to gain fans for his novel series' popularity. He has a younger sister whom puts on a tsundere persona around him.

name: Chihiro Hashima
description: Chihiro appears as Itsuki's younger step-sibling. Chihiro is a dependable person who looks after everyone and attends high school.

name: Setsuna Ena
description: A 16 year old illustrator who used to do the art for Itsuki's novels until he was told to stop, as Itsuki didn’t believe his series was worthy of Setsuna's art just yet. He is very easygoing and spontaneous.

name: Ashley Oono
description: Ashley is a 32-year-old tax accountant who wears a red lolita style dress. She is reliable but very sadistic; she makes her clients reveal their fetishes through their expenses, but raises their tax return in exchange.

name: Kenjirou Toki
description: Itsuki's editor at GF Bunko. He and Itsuki seem like they don’t get along well at first, but they are actually very close. He's normally seen nagging Itsuki and/or Setsuna about their deadlines.

name: Kaiko Mikuniyama
description: The girl who is in charge of adapting Itsuki's light novel series, Mahou Gakuen, (Imouto no Subete in the novel) into a manga. She is highly talented and looks up to Itsuki, as she also has a little sister fetish. She has an underwear fetish as well, and even goes as far as to wear panties in the shape of a bow on her head. When writing, she takes off the panty bow and puts the panties on her face.

name: Ayane Mitahora
description: [Itsuki](https://anilist.co/character/123942/Itsuki-Hashima)'s childhood friend and daughter of his housekeeper.

name: Cerberus
description:
Cerberus, nicknamed "Kero", is the appointed guardian of the book which holds the Clow Cards. He is one of two magical creatures created by Clow Reed along with the Clow Cards. Before his death, Clow appointed Kero as the one to select the potential candidate to be the next master of the cards, Cerberus himself, and his "brother" and fellow guardian, Yue. After Sakura accidentally releases the cards, Cerberus chooses her to be the candidate and teaches her the basics of capturing the cards. Throughout the series, he displays an extensive knowledge of mysticism.

Having spent a lengthy amount of time in the book while it was in Osaka, Cerberus speaks with a pointed Osakan accent. He tends to be bossy, demanding, egotistical, and glutton, but clearly displays his affection for Sakura, especially if she is hurt or in danger. He becomes very fond of video games and is addicted to sweets. Cerberus spends most of his time in a "false form", a small figure resembling an orange-stuffed animal with wings.

Unlike Yue, Cerberus draws his life energy from the sun and is not dependent on the magical power of his master. However, his master must have control of the Firey and Light cards in order to power his true form, a large-winged cat. In the anime adaptation, the Firey card is changed to the Earthy card to avoid delaying his obtaining his true form.

name: Tomoyo Daidouji
description:
__Height:__ 136 cm
__Grade:__ 4th - 6th

Tomoyo is the best friend of the series heroine, [Sakura Kinomoto](https://anilist.co/character/2671/Kinomoto-Sakura). When she discovers that Sakura has become the Cardcaptor, she becomes Sakura's primary assistant by designing "battle costumes" and filming all of her magical (and non-magical) endeavours. (The videotaping, however, seems to be more to Tomoyo's personal benefit and enjoyment than it is to Sakura's.) Tomoyo faithfully keeps Sakura's new identity secret and often covers for her in times of need.

Tomoyo is very mature for her age. One of her major character traits is her selflessness towards Sakura. Tomoyo is kind, caring, highly intelligent, beautiful, meticulous, and very melodic (she has a superb singing voice and often has solos in choir recitals). She always speaks using formal verb conjugations and expressions, giving her a unique air of refinement amongst the cast. When needed, Tomoyo can exhibit considerable cunning and resourcefulness, which was most prominently displayed in the final movie.

name: Sakura Kinomoto
description:
__Grade__: 4th - 6th  
__Height__: 138 cm - 143 cm 
__Family__: [Fujitaka Kinomoto](https://anilist.co/character/3614/Fujitaka-Kinomoto) (Father), [Nadeshiko Kinomoto](https://anilist.co/character/3615/Nadeshiko-Kinomoto) (Mother), [Touya Kinomoto](https://anilist.co/character/3076/Touya-Kinomoto) (Brother)  

Sakura is an extremely energetic and cheerful character. She is very athletic, being a member of her school's cheerleading squad and an excellent runner. She loves Physical Education and Music, but she really dislikes Math. Her "invincible spell," "Everything will surely be all right"), has carried her through innumerable trials and obstacles as she masters her magical skills. She often comes across as naive, clumsy, and clueless, but she is perceptive, sweet and loyal. She has a best friend named Tomoyo and is often recorded by her in action. She is cute and caring and has a big brother that is a chick magnet. She has a pretty normal life, except that she is the Cardcaptor, responsible for collecting all the Clow Cards, and also knows a magical "Beast of the Seal" named Kero who loves sweets.

Her favorite colors are pink and white, and her favorite flower the cherry blossom (sakura). She's really good at cooking pancakes, but her favorite dishes are ebi fry, fried rice with eggs, and noodles. Sakura can't stand konnyaku.

name: Xiaolang Li
description:
**Height:** 140 cm - 148 cm  
**Grade:** 4th
**Family:** [Yelan Li](https://anilist.co/character/174356/Ieran-Li) (mother), [Meiling Li](https://anilist.co/character/6768/Meiling-Li) (cousin)  

Syaoran is a distant relative of [Clow Reed](https://anilist.co/character/3612/Clow-Reed), the creator of the Clow Cards. As a member of the Li clan of sorcerers from Hong Kong, of which Clow's mother was a member, Syaoran believes that he should be the one to inherit the Clow Cards rather than [Sakura Kinomoto](https://anilist.co/character/2671/Sakura-Kinomoto). He first appears as an antagonist in the story, capturing a few cards for himself in the anime (though none in the manga).

name: Eriol Hiiragizawa
description: Eriol Hiiragizawa moved from England to transfer to Tomoeda Elementary school. He is depicted as a quiet, mature boy while at school, though he also shows a mischievous side when he regularly joins classmate Takashi Yamazaki in weaving complex lies about the history of objects, places, and events. While seeming a normal student to Sakura, Syaoran Li is suspicious of him.

name: Fujitaka Kinomoto
description:
__Occupation:__ College professor

Fujitaka Kinomoto is a professor of archaeology at Towa University and the father of Sakura Kinomoto.

Fujitaka met his late wife Nadeshiko while doing his first year as a teacher at her high school. Nadeshiko had climbed a tree to return a baby bird to its nest, but fell out of the tree, landing on Fujitaka. Upon seeing her, he stated that "an angel has fallen from the sky." They fell in love and married when she was sixteen. Though Nadeshiko died seven years before the start of the series, Fujitaka is shown to still be very much in love with her and devoted to her memory. He keeps a picture of her in the dining room, changing it each morning. Little is initially said about Fujitaka's family or past.



 (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Yukito Tsukishiro
description: From the moment Yukito is introduced, it is clear that [Sakura](https://anilist.co/character/2671/Kinomoto-Sakura) has an enormous crush on him. She continually marvels that he can be friends with her "barbaric brother."

name: Touya Kinomoto
description:
__Grade:__ 11th 
__Family:__ Father (Fujitaka Kinomoto), mother (Nadeshiko Kinomoto - deceased), sister (Sakura Kinomoto), great-grandfather (Masaki Amamiya)  

 __In Cardcaptor Sakura__ Touya is the brother of Sakura Kinomoto. His birthday is on February 29th, which makes him a leap year baby, a person that can only "properly" celebrate their birthday once every four years. He holds the belief that as Sakura's older brother, he is the only person entitled to make fun of her, a belief that his best friend Yukito Tsukishiro refers to as a "sister complex." However, he is also protective and caring of her, which leads him to dislike Syaoran Li when he finds Syaoran cornering Sakura in the schoolyard. Though Syaoran and Sakura eventually stop fighting, Toya continues to dislike Syaoran when he becomes friends with Sakura, knowing that Syaoran will eventually take Sakura away from him. He is a perceptive young man and has had a vague idea as to what Sakura has been up to as a Cardcaptor, despite Sakura's attempts to keep it a secret.  Toya's main relationship is with his best friend Yukito. Throughout the series Toya and Yukito are extremely close and eventually Yukito openly admits his love for Toya to Sakura after Toya saves his life.Toya was born with some magical ability, allowing him to see ghosts (including the one of his late mother).

name: Clow Reed
description: Clow Reed is the magician who originally created the Clow Cards, and their magical guardians Cerberus and Yue. Born of an English father and a Chinese mother, Clow created a new type of magic that blended both Eastern and Western magical elements. His plan was to hand down the magic to people who would use and protect it while meeting all of the qualifications, however few people could learn his brand of magic. The character of Clow is only seen in flash backs, as he has long been dead before the series starts. Few details are revealed about his character, personality, or life.

name: Yue
description:
Yue is one of two guardians of Clow Cards and judges candidates to become the next master of Clow Cards. Yue's appearance is that of a young man with long, silver braided hair and violet cat-like eyes (blue in the anime). He has a pair of angelic wings that he can use to fly. Yue has jurisdiction over wind and water—the elements "under him" which in part draw on him for their existence. He is a capable fighter who can raise powerful magical barriers, send deadly crystal shards at his adversaries, draw up energy around his hands which seems to be able to cut like a blade, shoot energy arrows from an energy bow that he can summon at will, in addition to other magical attacks, such as telekinesis. On the outside, he acts very cold and aloof and is serious and intimidating.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Tetsuo Takahashi
description:
The main protagonist. A biology teacher who is fascinated by demis and wants to learn more about them. He is occasionally referred to as "Iron Man" by his students, a pun on his bulky physique and his name. As he learns about demis, he starts to understand the problems they face, both as teenagers and demis, and strives to help them in any way he can.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Hikari Takanashi
description: A highly energetic vampire. She usually avoids biting other people's necks, instead drinking blood packs sent by the government and using blood substitutes like tomato juice.
