Contrary to myths, she loves eating garlic and merely dislikes bright lights. She occasionally has the urge to nibble on someone, usually her sister. Despite her lackadaisical nature, she often strives to help others in need.

name: Yuki Kusakabe
description:
A timid snow woman whose body is always cold. She will sometimes spread cold air while experiencing negative emotions and is susceptible to heat. She initially dislikes her demi nature, fearing that she could harm others, though Tetsuo manages to show her that the only things she can actually freeze are her tears and sweat. She's also secretly a manga enthusiast and has a taste for multiple genres.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Sakie Satou
description:
A succubus who works as a math teacher. Due to the aphrodisiac her body produces, she constantly has to take precautions to avoid inadvertently seducing her male students, such as wearing a tracksuit and taking early trains. While her nature as a succubus leads several males to become attracted to her, she herself develops a crush on Tetsuo.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Kyouko Machi
description:
A shy dullahan whose head is always detached from her body, which has a blue flame coming from where the neck should be. Since she can't move her head by herself, she is always longing for contact with others. She develops a crush on Tetsuo, due to his kind and caring nature. She initially found it hard to make friends as people found it awkward to talk to her without bringing up her detached head in some way, despite her own acceptance of the concept and desire to joke about it. Incidentally, she does possess a neck, which allegedly exists in another space and serves as a wormhole between her head and body.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Claude Faustus
native: クロード・フォースタス
description:
__Height__: 191 cm (6'3")  
__Race__: Demon   

The butler of the Trancy household.  He is a demon and he has a line similar to that of Sebastian's, which is "私は旦那様を飽くまで貪りたい" (Watashi wa danna-sama wo akumade musaboritai) which means "I want to greedily devour you to the end, my master." The kanji of "akumade" might means something else. 

Claude has a very different personality then that of Sebastian Michaelis, in which he speaks and acts motionlessly, not even responding to direct taunts from Alois, such as him undoing his buttons moments after Claude fixed them. He seems to know Sebastian well, but within moments of seeing each other, they begin to fight.    He is very loyal to his master and knows his master's darkness.  He has black, short hair and wears glasses similar to those worn by William T. Spears. He has yellow, slanted eyes and a somewhat angular facial structure. His chin is quite flat. Claude can transform his body, like Sebastian.     He wears an outfit that is similar to the one Sebastian wears, but Sebastian wears a tie while Claude wears a ribbon, and Claude had one button of his tailcoat on whilst Sebastian does not.   Like Sebastian, his contract mark with Alois is one his left hand covered by the gloves he wears. However, his mark isn't always visible, only becoming so when he nears Alois's.      (Source: Kuroshitsuji Wikia)

name: Alois Trancy
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm (5'5")  

Earl Alois Trancy is the head of the Trancy household and referred to as " Your Highness" by both his butler Claude Faustus, and his maid Hannah Anafeloz. It is stated that he is 14 years old at the beginning of the story, with the birth date of November 5th.  Alois lies to his uncle, Arnold, by telling him a false story of his past after being suspected of not being the real Alois Trancy. 
   Alois's emotions are quite unpredictable; one of his few consistent traits is his very deep attachment to his butler, Claude, demanding attention from him frequently. His mood swings tend to result in violent acts and he seems to have an overall cheerful disposition in spite of his hardships and misgivings, making him a sort of foil to Ciel. He takes an interest in having Ciel due to wanting Sebastian to suffer.  Alois appears to be easily angered and loses interest in things very quickly. He often uses harsh and impolite language, regardless of whom he is speaking. His contract mark is held on his tongue and not visible at all times, whereas Ciel's contract mark is in his eye and is visible at all times. His contract mark only shows if Claude is nearby. 

(Source: Kuroshitsuji Wikia , Alois Trancy obsession, EarlCiel)

name: Grell Sutcliff
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm (5'9")  

Grell is Madam Red's somewhat ineffectual butler. Mostly, she tends to hang around the edges of the scene, fretting over the socially unacceptable things that her mistress continually gets up to. When something is not up to Madam Red's exacting standards, she takes it out on Grell whether or not it's actually her fault. Her tea is said to be far inferior to Sebastian's. Meek, easily scandalized, and highly nervous, Grell's personality is entirely at odds with her mistress's. As a result, the other characters tend to either ignore or walk all over her.

name: Mey-Rin
description:
__Height__: 165 cm (5'5")

The glasses-wearing maid of the Phantomhive household. Mey-Rin is enthusiastic about her job but extremely bad at it (her main fault being clumsy.) She adds too much soap while washing clothes, trips and shatters the good china, and is generally a gigantic klutz. When asked to do an important task, she stutters and panics, which only adds to her natural clumsiness. She owns a pair of glasses that do nothing to improve her clumsiness. However, she refuses to purchase a new pair as they are the first thing [Ciel](https://anilist.co/character/12531/Phantomhive-Ciel) bought for her. It's implied that she has a crush on [Sebastian](https://anilist.co/character/10863/Michaelis-Sebastian) as she is even clumsier when Sebastian is watching.

name: Finnian
description:
__Height__: 163 cm (5'4")

Finnian often called Finny, is Phantomhive household gardener. However, it seems every time he tends to the garden it is killed through an accident caused by his clumsiness and overenthusiastic pruning or not noticing that the pesticide container is leaking. In fact, if left to his own devices, he's stated that he'd like to make the garden into the shape of a giant robot.   He is portrayed as an innocent, child-like character, but is dubbed an idiot by Sebastian. But his combination of tears, innocent looks, and willful ignorance of anything that doesn't fall into his cheerful worldview makes Finny probably the most successful of the servants at wheedling favors and money out of Sebastian. He is very carefree and is almost always seen with a happy smile on his face.

name: Gaku
description: Gaku is an extremely powerful assassin under [Slur](https://anilist.co/character/272878/Uzuki). He wields a long cube-headed mace, the tip of which contains a powerful cannon. He usually covers this weapon with bandages.

name: Takamura
description: An old man carrying a katana. He is an assassin from The Order, a group consisting of the strongest members within the JAA.

name: Lira Echigo
description: She attends the night school [Nico Hirata](https://anilist.co/character/175657/) teaches at.

name: Hatsuka Suzushiro
description: Hatsuka is a man of small stature with an androgynous physique, having a rather masculine, but very thin, upper body and feminine hips, his head adorned with shoulder-length black hair, and a narrow face. He prefers to dress femininely, which he says is apparently because it suits him better. The clothes he mainly wears are dresses and coats, his footwear consisting of dark calf length boots, smaller shoes and slippers when he is at home.

name: Agnese Sanctis
native: アニェーゼ＝サンクティス
description: Agnese is the former leader of the Agnese Forces, a group of Battle Nuns under the Catholic Church. She has long, red, braided hair strands and wears platform shoes to compensate for her small stature. She is first introduced in the 7th novel and the episode "Liber AL vel Legis / The Book of the Law" where she and her forces were helping Necessarius search for Orsola and "The Book of the Law" grimoire. But in reality, the battle nuns true mission was to kill Orsola as she was able to decipher the grimoire as they fear she will expose its secrets. She wields a staff called Lotus Wand, which any damage she does to the staff also happens to her opponent.

name: Kaori Kanzaki
description:
__Height:__ 175cm 
__Classification:__ Magician
__Affiliation:__ Necessarius, Amakusa-Style Remix of Church (Priestess)  

A  sorceress from Necessarius. Unlike her partner Stiyl, she uses magic to magically strengthen her body. Her sorcery name is Salvere000. She uses a 2 meter long katana (which actually is a Nodachi) called "Seven Heavens Seven Swords" as her weapon. She has a special attack called Nanasen (七閃, Nanasen? "Seven Flash") that uses her katana and some wires. She used to be a kind woman who treated Index like a sister, but when Index's memories were deleted by Necessarius, Kaori changed into a cold and silent woman as Index no longer remembered her and consequentially did not trust her. 

After Touma saves Index's life and her current memories, she decides to stay in Academy City to be with Index and protect her.  Later in the novels, more of her past is revealed. Not only is Kaori a skilled swordswoman, but she is a Catholic Saint possessing the "Stigma" — the ability to call upon God's power — and the former leader of the Amakusa Catholics. However, Kaori left the group as she resented that she had been fated since birth to become its leader, which led her to despise the concept of luck and fortune. Though she is Catholic, she joined Necessarius in hopes of changing her fate and befriended Index, developing a sisterly relationship with her.

name: Stiyl Magnus
description:
__Height:__ 200cm (6.56 ft)
__Classification:__ Magician, Priest
__Affiliation:__ Anglican Church (Necessarius)

A sorcerer from Necessarius. His sorcery name is Fortis931. He is an extremely heavy smoker; he claims a world without nicotine would be hell. He specializes in using flames and is able to use a flame sword or summon a 3000 degree Celsius fire called Innocentius ("King of Witch Hunters") to battle his enemies. Despite his looks, he is actually fourteen-years-old and ironically is physically weak. He mostly has a bad temper but is actually kind, as he cares about Index very much and his failure to save her life without losing her memories was his greatest regret. When he learns the Church lied to him and Kaori about Index's condition, he decides to disobey orders to capture Index and let her live her life.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Terra of the Left
description: Member of God's Right Seat. Blessed with the nature of "God's Medicine". A small, menacing-looking old man wearing a green robe. Tōma encounters him when he went to France. He uses the spell "Execution of Light", which can manipulate the hierarchy of everything around him. He also uses a guillotine made of flour, a byproduct of the "Execution of Light" spell. It seems that he knew something about Tōma's Imagine Breaker, but it was never revealed. He also discovered about his memory loss during a fight with him.

name: Sasha Kreuzhev
native: サーシャ＝クロイツェフ
description:
A character introduced in Toaru Majutsu no Index, she is an operative of Annihilatus of the Russian Orthodox Church, which specializes in the hunting down of spirits that are not supposed to exist. Her Misha form makes its appearance early in the series during the Angel Fall Arc, but her first actual appearance is seen much later in the series. She is hinted to be an avid drinker and doesn't mind enjoying Brandy in work hours even though she is not supposed to.

Sasha can easily be distinguished by her signature look, which consists of a red hood and cape (which hides her long curly blond hair) and matching pointy red shoes. Her torso and limbs are covered with leather belts, and has metal braces on her ankles, wrist and waist, the latter being used to carry her many eccentric weaponry. Underneath is a small layer of clothing that covers her torso and her arms up to the wrist, and acts like thigh-high socks. They are form-fitting which naturally shows Sasha's figure. Sasha's skimpy dress can be attributed to her female superior—Vasilisa—who forced Sasha to wear it as part of her hobby.

name: Angelene
description: Angelene is a nun of the Agnese Forces and Lucia's  partner. Angelene and Lucia as a pair is almost always with Agnese after the Queen of Adriatic incident. She is slightly shorter than her partner with longer, braided hair. She seems to be quite shy in contrast to her partner, though her personality at times can be childish, and she does get angry. She has a real sweet tooth for various deserts and sweet drinks. Her magic revolves around a bag she carries around, which is reference to a passage in Matthew's Gospel and gold.  One of Angelene's hobbies is flipping up girl's skirts to get their attention, like Saten does with Uiharu.

name: MISAKA 10032
description: Misaka is the 10032nd clone of Misaka Mikoto, a Sister, that was first introduced in Toaru Majutsu no Index and plays a relatively small role in Toaru Kagaku no Railgun. Originally supposed to be killed in the 10032 experiment against Accelerator as part of the Level 6 Shift Project, she is one of the few Sisters that remained in Academy City for readjustments. She becomes the most prominent clone in the series after being rescued by Kamijou Touma, and is referred to as Misaka Imouto (御坂妹 Misaka Imōto?, lit. "Misaka's little sister") whenever they meet.

name: Hayato Kamitani
description: A third-year student and Ryuuichi's classmate. He is the older brother of Taka. He is also a member of the baseball team.     Hayato's name is written using the kanji for falcon.

name: Taka Kamitani
description:
Taka is one of the children Ryuuichi Kashima babysits. He is the son of Shizuka Kamitani, a science teacher at the middle school, and he is the younger brother of Hayato, who he looks up to. The two share a bittersweet relationship, in which his brother sometimes expresses his love. Most of the time, however, he hits Taka on the head as punishment (a running joke in the manga). Their father is later revealed to be Hebihara Taizou, a chemistry teacher at the high school.

Taka is very talkative. He is close friends with Kotarou and is friendly toward all the other children in the daycare. He enjoys playing heroes and often cries about his brother hitting him, sometimes calling him "Baka Aniki" (stupid older brother).

(Source: Gakuen Babysitters Wikia)

name: Kotarou Kashima
description: [Ryuuichi](https://anilist.co/character/39758/Kashima-Ryuuichi)'s younger brother. He doesn't speak much. He is very attached to (and protective of) his brother.

name: Ryuuichi Kashima
description: Older brother, babysitter, and has a very close relationship with his toddler brother [Kotarou](https://anilist.co/character/41488/Kashima-Kotarou). Both his parents died in a plane crash, now Kotarou and Ryuuichi live alone.

name: Yayoi Kumazuka
description: Kirin's mother and a drama teacher at Morinomiya Academy.

name: Umi Mamizuka
description:
__Gender__: Female
__Occupation__: P.E. Teacher at Morinomiya Academy

Married to Mamizuka Kousuke and the mother of the twins Mamizuka Kazuma and Mamizuka Takuma.

name: Kirin Kumazuka
description: One of the children being taken care of at the babysitting club.

name: Kousuke Mamizuka
description:
__Occupation:__ Actor

Married to [Mamizuka Umi](https://anilist.co/character/237105/Mamizuka-Umi) and the father of the twins [Mamizuka Kazuma](https://anilist.co/character/125259/Mamizuka-Kazuma) and [Mamizuka Takuma](https://anilist.co/character/125260/Mamizuka-Takuma).

name: Maria Inomata
description: Top student from the advanced Class A, she later joins the cooking club in high school.

name: Noel Niihashi
description:
__Race:__ Human
__Affiliation:__ Wing Bind
__Profession:__ Witch, High School Student
__Position:__ 1st Order Conservation, Ranger "Pipers"
__Partner:__ [Ninny Spangcole](https://anilist.co/character/127130/Ninny-Spangcole)
__Base of Operations:__ Reverse London

A Witch working for Wing Bind in Reverse London. She is the partner of Ninny Spangcole.

name: Ninny Spangcole
native: ニニー・スパンコール
description:
__Race:__ Human
__Affiliation:__ Wing Bind
__Profession:__ Witch, Singer
__Position:__ 2nd Order Conservation, Ranger "Pipers"
__Partner:__ [Noel Niihashi](https://anilist.co/character/127129)
__Base of Operations:__ Reverse London

A Witch working for Wing Bind in Reverse London. She is the partner of Noel Niihashi.

name: Balgo Ywain Parks
description:
__Race:__ Human, Dragon
__Type:__ Dragonclad
__Affiliation:__ Wing Bind

A human who became a Dragonclad after living with Selvie for 10 years and being bitten by him. He is currently looked after by Noel Niihashi and Ninny Spangcole.

name: Sullivan Squire
native: サリバン・スクワイア
description: The leader of the Sabres division of Wing Bind.

name: Osushi
description:
__Race:__ Dragon
__Type:__ Disguiser/Dark Dragon
__Owner:__ [Balgo Parks](https://anilist.co/character/185999/Balgo-Ywain-Parks)

A Dragon masquerading as Balgo Parks's pet dog in London. In his dog form, Osushi is a small Pomeranian with light-colored fur and dark paws. In his Dark Dragon form, Osushi is a large, black dragon with a light underbelly, four thick legs and two enormous wings. He is heavily scaled and possesses many sharp teeth.

name: Wolfgang Slashhaut
native: ウルフギャング・スラッシュハウト
description: The leader of the Gallows division of Wing Bind.

name: Bruno Bangnyfe
native: ブルーノ・バングナイフ
description: The leader of the Inks division of Wing Bind.

name: Billy Banx Jr.
description: Billy Banx Jr. is a member of the Pipers of Wing Bind and Noel Niihashi and Ninny Spangcole's commanding officer. He was briefly a member of the Sabres until he was demoted for laziness.

name: Roy B. Dipper
description: The leader of the Anthems division of Wing Bind.

name: Macy  Baljure
native: メイシー・バルジャー
description: Former member of the pop idol group Cecile Die Twice.

name: Tuesday Simmons
native: チューズデイ・シモンズ
description:
__Singing Voice:__ [Celeina Ann](https://anilist.co/staff/139883/Celeina-Ann)

Tuesday is a kind, somewhat airheaded daughter of a prominent politician. She ran away from home with her Gibson acoustic guitar to become a musician. She's from Mars.

name: Carole Stanley
native: キャロル・ステンリー
description:
__Singing Voice:__ [Nai Br.XX](https://anilist.co/staff/139884/Nai-BrXX)

An outgoing orphaned girl from Earth trying to survive in Alba City by working multiple (short-lived) part-time jobs, while pursuing her dream of becoming a musician.

name: Angela Carpenter
native: アンジェラ・カーペンター
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3")
__Singing Voice:__ [Alisa](https://anilist.co/staff/144934/Alisa)

A famous model and child actress from Mars working with Tao to become a singer.

At first, she seems childish and selfish, and seemingly only wants to become a singer because being she finds being a model and actor is "boring". She speaks very rudely to her managers, degrading them and often firing them very quickly. Though she does what she does for the people, and her mother wants her to become a singer, so she is to please her. Angela wants her mother to finally accept her, and appears genuinely happy when people cheer for her debut song.

name: Joshua
description: A vocalist of the ultra-popular band Omega.

name: Cybelle
description: A Mars’ Brightest contestant and Tuesday’s biggest fan.

name: GGK
description:
A mysterious singer that is connected to the universe(?).
Vocal：Madison McFerrin

name: Ezekiel
description: A young man who emigrated from Earth. Currently active as a rapper.

name: Schwartz
description: A big shot known as the “Hedge Fund King”

name: Katy Kimura
description: Angela’s new manager.

name: Kyle
description: A journalist covering the presidential elections.

name: Hana Sunomiya
description: She is a high school student who joined the art club during Senpai's third year as well as an acquaintance of his since middle school and the younger cousin of the former Art Club [President](https://anilist.co/character/145717/Sunomiya-Sana), with whom she shares a striking physical resemblance and habit of public nudity. She is a kouhai to all of the other characters.

appearsIn.title: DON'T TOY WITH ME, MISS NAGATORO 2nd Attack
Don't Toy With Me, Miss Nagatoro

name: Misaki Nagatoro
description: She is Nagatoro's big sister

appearsIn.title: DON'T TOY WITH ME, MISS NAGATORO 2nd Attack
Don't Toy With Me, Miss Nagatoro

name: Orihara
description: An Olympic team candidate for the Judo team, Orihara is [Nagatoro's](https://anilist.co/character/124696/Hayase-Nagatoro) rival in Judo, originally being talentless.

appearsIn.title: DON'T TOY WITH ME, MISS NAGATORO 2nd Attack
Don't Toy With Me, Miss Nagatoro

name: Kinjirou Sakamachi
description:
__Age__: 16-17   
__Height__: 176 cm (5'9")    

The protagonist of the story. A second year high school student who discovers Konoe's secret. He suffers gynophobia in which his nose bleeds whenever a girl touches him, he reveals the cause to be his mother and sister practicing their wrestling moves on him on a daily basis for 10 years, he states his nose bleeds when a girl touches him because his body developed the reflex because he believed his mother and sister would stop beating him up once he started bleeding (as his blood would ruin the carpet). As a result can take pain well due to his everyday awakening from his sister, Kureha Sakamachi, with a series of beatings. He was forced to sign a contract with Kanade Suzutsuki to not reveal the secret of Subaru Konoe and find a way to cure his gynophobia. He hates it when people call him his full name as, due to the Japanese culture of putting the familiy name before their given name, it creates a pun on the english word chicken as his full name is Sakama __chi Kin__jirou.    

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Subaru Konoe
description:
__Age__: 16-17  
__Height__: 165 cm (5'5")  

A second year high school student who works as a butler for the Suzutsuki family. She dresses like a male due to the family circumstance of a must to have a male from her family to serve Kanade's family. Because of her being the only child, she has to cross-dress and Kanade's father only allowed her to be her butler if she could spend the entire 3 years at school with her true gender undiscovered, her physical features makes her believed by everyone to be a boy until one day, Kinjirō Sakamachi accidentally discovers her secret.     Like Kinjirō, she enjoys instant noodles and is also a fan of the popular "Lost Sheep" series of plush dolls.

name: Kanade Suzutsuki
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm (5'6")  

The single daughter of the high school's principal, who, on the outside, behaves well like a rich man's daughter. On the inside, she is revealed to be quite sadistic and threatens [Kinjirou](https://anilist.co/character/41377) on his greatest fear and using his gynophobia to make him suffer. She is shown to enjoy tormenting and teasing Kinjirou by using his gynophobia against him. However, she did give thoughts about finding a way to cure his gynophobia although her methods to do so are generally overly complicated or humiliate him in some way and she does not deny that she finds them amusing. She notes that Kinjirou is the first, and only, a man who is willing to talk her down, and she is implied to have fallen in love with him as a result.

name: Nakuru Narumi
description:
The cat-eared ganguro student that is spying Konoe and Kinjirou. She is a first year and a member of the crafts club along with Kureha, she is also revealed to be the chairman of the "Let's warmly protect Subaru-sama comittee" and is shown to have a fetish for glasses and boys love which is expressed through her manga drawing of Subaru and Kinjirou (much to his chagrin).    

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Nagare Konoe
description:
Head Butler of the Suzutsuki family and Kanade's father's butler.       

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Kureha Sakamachi
description: Kureha is the younger sister of Kinjirou, who is a first year in high school and loves wrestling. She is a member of the crafts club. After watching and following Kinjirou and Konoe, believing her a male pervert cross-dresser, attacks Konoe to reclaim Kinjirou, only to be quickly defeated in turn. After this incident, still believing her a male, she has fallen in love with Konoe, much to Kinjirou's chagrin. While tomboyish most of the time, she tends to try and act feminine when Konoe is around.

name: Mary Sioux
description: She is the sole daughter of [Anson Sioux](https://anilist.co/character/135048).

appearsIn.title: Saga of Tanya the Evil - the Movie -
Saga of Tanya the Evil Season 2

name: Wilibald Koenig
native: ヴィリバルト・ケーニッヒ
description: Wilibald Koenig is the 3rd Company commander of V601 under the command of [Tanya Degurechaff](https://anilist.co/character/121052).

appearsIn.title: Saga of Tanya the Evil - the Movie -
Saga of Tanya the Evil Season 2

name: Kon
description:
Harutora's shikigami. A diminutive silver-fox spirit who wears miko-like clothing and wields a wakizashi and has served the Tsuchimikado clan since a long time. She has been by Harutora's side since the moment he became Natsume's shikigami, but due to his low spiritual power and awareness, he was unable to hear or see her. A rare Gohou-type shikigami, she possesses independent thought and actions and is fiercely loyal to her master, and even gets jealous when Harutora associates with other girls.



(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Jin Ootomo
description:
Harutora's homeroom teacher. A fairly quirky fellow who tends be more laid back then one would expect from a teacher, to the point where some would accuse him of being irresponsible. Despite that, he's usually good at giving solid advice to students and is known activist against the school's harsh policies when comes to education. He lost his leg in a clash with Ashiya Douman and now has a prosthetic leg. He was a former Magic Investigator and Divine General nicknamed "The Shadow" who worked under Daizen Amami to investigate the Twin Horn Syndicate until he gave his resignation and started working as a homeroom teacher of Onmyo Preparatory School in order to observe and protect Natsume.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Miyo Kurahashi
description:
The current head of the Kurahashi family and Onmyo Prep School. She is a known figure in the underworld of Onmyouji. The current Kurahashi Clan is considered one of most powerful noble families who's influence over the politics of Onmyoudo and Japan rivals that of once glorious Tsuchimikado family. A skilled Diviner, she helped the Onmyo Agency solve numerous extremely difficult cases. Miyo is also one of the few people who knew Yakou personally. She has a pet cat which uses as a messenger to relay information at long distances.

(Source:Wikipedia)

name: Atsune Hirata
description: A member of the Magical Investigations Bureau who works under Amami. He is in charge of investigating the "Twin Horns Syndicate."

name: Parks Orlok
native: パークス・オルロック
description:
Parks Orlok is the appointed representative of the Vampires by The Queen following the war between humans and Vampires; tasked with maintaining a balance between the human and Vampire worlds by watching over Vampire-related activities.

(Source: The Mochizuki Wiki)

appearsIn.title: The Case Study of Vanitas Part 2

name: Mikhail
description:
__Race:__ Human
__Age:__ Unknown

Misha has a cheerful smile and seems to be quite friendly and perceptive, but he also appears to be a bit dangerous.

appearsIn.title: The Case Study of Vanitas Part 2

name: August Ruthven
description:
__Race:__ Vampire
__Partner:__ 	Jeanne (former)

Lord Ruthven is a Vampire Lord who serves the Queen as a member of the senate. Due to his position, Lord Ruthven has had prominence since the war between humanity and Vampires.

appearsIn.title: The Case Study of Vanitas Part 2

name: Sensei
description:
The Master belongs to the de Sade aristocracy - being the grandfather of Dominique de Sade - and is widely feared by many.

(Source: Pandora Hearts Wikia)

appearsIn.title: The Case Study of Vanitas Part 2

name: Loki Oriflamme
description: Loki is the elder sibling of Luca Oriflamme and serves the Queen as a powerful Beastia; however, he is also a known Curse-Bearer.

appearsIn.title: The Case Study of Vanitas Part 2

name: Chloé d'Apchier
description:
__Race:__ Vampire
__Partner:__ 	Jean-Jacques

She is a vampire that resides in the castle of Marquis d'Apchier, where her existence is hidden and is known there as the "Hidden Vampire" of the Marquis' family.

appearsIn.title: The Case Study of Vanitas Part 2

name: Veronica de Sade
native: ヴェロニカ・ド・サド
description:
A Vampire of the Crimson Moon, the second eldest child of Count de Sade and older sister of Dominique de Sade. She acts as a Beastia - or an enforcer to Queen Faustina - a result of her ability to alter World Formulae to produce ice. During her tenure as Beastia, Veronica entered an intimate relationship with fellow Beastia, Marquis Machina.

(Source: The Mochizuki Wiki)

appearsIn.title: The Case Study of Vanitas Part 2

name: Sougetsu no Kyuuketsuki Vanitas
native: 蒼月の吸血鬼　"ヴァニタス"
description:
Vanitas of the Blue Moon is a vampire. According to legend, they were born under the Blue Moon and were the ostensible creator of the Book of Vanitas and the disease Malnomen. It was their intent to destroy vampires through the corruption of their True Name, hoping to take revenge for a lifetime of prosecution for their birth. This power would be passed onto their kin, prophesied to bring about the end of all vampires.

(Source: Mochizuki Jun Wiki)

appearsIn.title: The Case Study of Vanitas Part 2

name: Keith Kazama  Flick
native: キース・風間・フリック
description: Keith Kazama Flick is a character in B: The Beginning. On a winter eight years ago, his sister, Erika Flick, was murdered by someone, causing him to go into depression and eventually retire from the police force. During present day, he is called out of retirement by his old friend, Eric Toga, to help the R.I.S. criminal investigation force to track down the serial murderer known as "Killer B".

name: Koku
description: Koku is one of the main characters in B: The Beginning. He works as a Violin Craftsman under Lily's father and has the ability to transform into a black-winged, heteromorphic being. He is also the true identity of Killer B, a name derived by his unusual way of writing the number "13" at his murder sites.

name: Lily  Hoshina
description: Lily Hoshina is one of the main characters in B: The Beginning. She comes from a family of violin repairers and is a detective that works for the Royal Investigative Services.

name: Yuna
description: Yuna is one of the main characters in B: The Beginning. She is the childhood love of Koku and the reason behind what Koku does as Killer B.

name: Boris Meyer
description: Boris Meyer is a main supporting character in B: The Beginning. He is an inspector for the Royal Investigative Services and is Lily Hoshina's superior

name: Jean Henri Richard
native: ジャン・アンリ・リシャール
description: Jean Henri Richard is one of the main supporting characters in B: The Beginning. He has known Keith Kazama Flick for a long time and is an inspector with the Royal Investigative Services who works as a member of Erik's team.

name: Heath Kazama Flick
description: Heath Kazama Flick is a supporting character in B: The Beginning. He is the father of Keith Kazama Flick and was a researcher at the Jaula Blanca Royal Scientific Research Institute.

name: Izanami
description: Izanami is a minor anti-hero character in B: The Beginning.

name: Sou Inuoka
description:
__Team:__ Nekoma High School 
__Height:__ 185.3 cm 
__Year:__ 1st Year, class 1 
__Number:__ 7 
__Position:__ Middle Blocker  

Middle blocker of the Nekoma High School volleyball club. He has friendly personality and becomes friends with Hinata after their game.

name: Tooru Oikawa
description:
__Height:__ 184 cm 

The setter and captain of the Aoba Josai High School volleyball club. He was [Kageyama](https://anilist.co/character/64771/Tobio-Kageyama)'s senpai when they were attending Kitagawa Daiichi. According to Kageyama, he is a very talented setter and volleyball player with a ​complex personality. 

His favourite food is milk bread.

name: Kanji  Koganegawa
description:
__Height:__ 191.5 cm
__Team:__ Datekougyou High School
__Year:__ 1st year
__Number:__ 7
__Position:__ Setter

Koganegawa is a first year setter at Date Tech High. He is very energetic and enthusiastic but often lacks the ability to think carefully about his actions. Despite being rather simple-minded, he's also shown to be determined to improve his abilities and support his team as their setter and with his height but tends to focus on improving the wrong areas.

name: Sadayuki Mizoguchi
description: Sadayuki is the coach of Aobajohsai High.

name: Akinori Konoha
description: Akinori is a third year wing spiker from Fukuroudani Academy.

name: Satou Matsuzaka
description:
Satou Matsuzaka learns to love for the first time after meeting [Shio Koube](https://anilist.co/character/126755) and lives with her in a shared apartment. Publically, she tells people that she resides with her aunt in her apartment, and keeps the fact that she lives with Shio a secret.

Satou is a freshman at Makikou High School and primarily works at Cure á Cute, maintaining a kind nature and getting along well with other people in order to sustain her lifestyle with Shio. While she wishes she could spend her time with Shio forever in their apartment, she is aware of the fact that they cannot live on peacefully if she does not work and earn money for food, utilities, etc. Because of this, Satou often has to confront the outside world where people interfere with her relationship due to her past history of accepting anyone who has confessed to her and changing partners every three days. Satou is prone to severe animosity when people disrupt her relationship with their interpretation of "love," and can be easily provoked when it comes to Shio due to her overprotectiveness. She is willing to take any action necessary to eliminate threats to Shio and their "Happy Sugar Life."

name: Shio Koube
description:
Shio Kobe is a young, innocent girl who lives with Satou Matsuzaka in their apartment. She loves and cares for Satou deeply, but often remains blissfully unaware of Satou's endeavors aside from Satou's necessary attendance in school and work, as she is not allowed outside of the apartment.

Shio is a kind and innocent girl who tries her best to work hard and watch over the house while Satou is away at school and work. She routinely greets Satou whenever she returns home and is always genuinely happy to spend time together with Satou. Shio believes that both she and Satou need to stay together, otherwise they would both be broken and incomplete forever.

name: Minori Kitaumekawa
description:
Minori Kitaumekawa is the preschool daughter of Daichi Kitaumekawa and Shizuka Kitaumekawa. 
Minori appears to be a cheerful preschooler who loves her family. 

(Source: Happy Sugar Life Wiki)

name: Shizuka Kitaumekawa
description:
Shizuka Kitaumekawa is the wife of Daichi Kitaumekawa and the mother of Minori Kitaumekawa. Shizuka is the dutiful housewife of Daichi. She only sees her husband in a positive light 

(Source: Happy Sugar Life Wiki)

name: Asahi Koube
description:
A young boy in a hood who is constantly searching for his younger sister, [Shio](https://anilist.co/character/126755/Koube-Shio), in order to reunite their family. He regularly prints out posters to put up around the city and sleeps underneath the park bench at night.

Asahi is devoted and kind. As a child, he was quiet and well-behaved, listening to his mother at all times and did his best to support her physically and emotionally. When Shio was born, Asahi encouraged his mother to work hard for Shio because she became a symbol of hope for the both of them. He cared so much about his mother and Shio to the point where he urged his mother to leave the house with her and that he would stay behind with their abusive father so that he wouldn't pursue Asahi's mother.

Due to his father's extreme abuse, Asahi grew resentful of adults and chose to never trust them. He wants nothing more than to live a happy life with his mother and Shio, and unlike [Satou](https://anilist.co/character/126754/Matsuzaka-Satou), he doesn't favor hurting people to achieve that.

name: Yuuna Koube
description: Shio and Asahi's mother. After having been forced into marriage under unfortunate circumstances, she gave birth to and raised the two children until being separated from Asahi while escaping their father; afterwards abandoning Shio.

name: Taiyou Mitsuboshi
description: Taiyō Mitsuboshi is Satou Matsuzaka's coworker who first met her at Princess Imperial,

name: Shouko Hida
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm (5’2”)

Shouko Hida is Satou Matsuzaka's coworker. She considers Satou to be a good friend since they used to spend time together hanging out with guys as they both searched for their one true love.

name: Daichi Kitaumekawa
description:
Daichi Kitaumekawa is Satou Matsuzaka's teacher who is renowned for his good looks and nice personality among his students. However, underneath this facade lies a deeply perverted man who takes an interest in Satou, obsessing over her after a school event. 

At school, Daichi is considered to be a kind and helpful teacher who demonstrates his concern for his students by speaking to them privately about personal matters and offering assistance in any way he can.  

(Source: Happy Sugar Life Wiki)

name: Satou no Oba
description:
A relative of Satou who had taken full custody of her after her parents died many years ago. She is basically the one responsible for making Satou the deranged psychopath that she is today.

(Source: Wikipedia, edited)

name: Emilico
description:
Emilico is the main protagonist of the Shadows House series and narrates some of the chapters. She is a Living Doll working as a maid in the Shadows House and as a "face" of [Kate Shadow](https://anilist.co/character/127319/Kate).

Emilico is cheerful and hard-working. Her top priority is taking care of her master Kate Shadow, whom she is friends with. She likes making friends and spending time with them. Although she is inexperienced and sometimes clumsy, she is also dependable. She keeps a positive attitude and stands up for others. Emilico is curious and eager to learn new things. She enjoys cleaning in the Shadows house and always tries to improve.

name: Kate
description:
Kate is a young girl in the Shadow family, a noble family. Her "Living Doll" is [Emilico](https://anilist.co/character/127318/Emilico). Like the rest of the Shadow family, Kate is a shadow. Her whole body including her hair is black. She wears a red dress with a white frill underneath. She is a very calm and intelligent young girl.


__Season One Spoiler__

name: Shaun
description:
Shaun is one of the side protagonists in the Shadows House series. He is a Living Doll working as a servant in the Shadows House and as a "face" of [John Shadow](https://anilist.co/character/197307/John).
He completes his work flawlessly and secretly has poor vision.

name: John
description:
John is one of the side protagonists in the Shadows House series and the shadow living under the care of the "Living Face", [Shaun](https://anilist.co/character/197306/Shaun).

John is known to be quite friendly with everyone and very open-minded. Unlike many shadows, he treats Shaun with respect and even offers to wear glasses so that Shaun can be seen while wearing his. Like Kate and Emilico, John and Shaun are polar opposites. John is a muscle-headed extrovert while Shaun is a thoughtful introvert. Despite this, the two are very good friends and John cares for his "face" immensely.

name: Shirley
description:
Shirley is one of the side protagonists in the Shadows House series and the Shadow living under the care of the Living Face, Rum.

Due to the fact that Rum barely spends any time with her Master, we don't get to see Shirley's personality much. The best way she could be described would be as quiet and shy, like her Face.

name: Lou
description:
Lou is one of the side protagonists in the Shadows House series. She is a Living Doll working as a maid in the house and as a "face" of [Louise Shadow](https://anilist.co/character/198188/Louise).

Lou is a quiet and obedient girl who listens to her master's every order. Her top priority is taking care of Louise and her own safety. She often gets worried about her face getting damaged and has been known to invade in people's personal space. When she sets her mind to something, she's very determined to achieve it, especially if it has to do with Louise. Unlike Emilicol, she doesn't think of "unnecessary thoughts" and has the potential to be an outstanding Living Doll.

name: Louise
description:
Louise is one of the side protagonists of the Shadows House series and the shadow living under the care of the "Living Doll", [Lou](https://anilist.co/character/197877/Lou).

Louise is sassy and confident. She loves to show off her Face, Lou, and has complete faith in her. She has multiple drawings of Lou posted on the walls in her room. Serious talk bores her and has been known to just want to have fun.

name: Ricky
description:
Ricky is one of the side protagonists in the Shadows House series. He is a Living Doll working as a servant in the Shadows House and as a "face" of [Patrick Shadow](https://anilist.co/character/200311/Patrick).

Ricky is known as being a very confident and self-centered person, even more so than his Master, Patrick. He manages to get along with the other Living Dolls just fine and takes a particular liking to Lou. He and Patrick appear to be quite close and trust each other. However, much like Patrick, Ricky puts up an air of arrogance to cope with any insecurities he has, though he is much better at hiding them, as he is able to appear calm even when he is panicking.

name: Patrick
description:
Patrick is one of the side protagonists in the Shadows House series and the Shadow living under the care of the "Living Doll", [Ricky](https://anilist.co/character/200247/Ricky).

Patrick is arrogant, confident, and loyal. He has a strong sense of duty and will help out those who help him. He's not as smug as his "Face", Ricky, but can be annoying at times.

name: Rum
description:
Rum is one of the side protagonists in the Shadows House series. She is a Living Doll working as a maid in the house and acts as Shirley's face.

Rum is a very shy and lonely girl. Not only does she not kiss her master goodnight, but she also gave herself her own name. She's very insecure and has a habit of talking to her finger to calm herself down.

name: Rin Kaga
description:
__Height__: 112 - 120 cm (3'6" - 3'9")

Rin is a six-year-old girl and the the illegitimate daughter of Daikichi's grandfather, Souichi Kaga and and manga artist Masako Yoshii. After Souichi died, Masako abandoned Rin for the sake of her career as a Manga artist.   Rin is very independent and mature for her age and is often dealing with issues on her own. Living with Daikichi, she develops a fondness of cooking for him. 

Manga spoilers:

name: Daikichi Kawachi
description: Daikichi is a 30-year-old bachelor who has a tendency of scaring away both women and children. Whilst he doesn't exactly mind that he scares children, as he isn't too fond of young people, he seems to be lonely as a single man. At his grandfather's funeral, he meets a newly orphaned illegitimate child, named Rin. In a fit of anger at his relatives' cold shoulder to the girl, he announces that he will be the one to take care of her. Daikichi now finds himself in the role of father and must adjust his life accordingly.  Daikichi doesn't have much motivation aside from getting to work each day. When his grandfather passes away, Daikichi feels sorry for the unwanted child who is left behind and takes her in. A bachelor and inexperienced with kids, he has a lot to learn so he can care for Rin properly but with his laid-back personality and honest hard work to give her exactly what she needs, Daikichi learns as he goes. His patient, awkward, gentle and straightforward nature works perfectly opposite to Rin's shy wit.

name: Souichi Kaga
description: Daikichi's maternal grandfather and Rin's father.

name: Kazumi Kawachi
description: Daikichi's younger sister.

name: Haruko Maeda
description: Daikichi's cousin on his mother's side and Mii-chan's mother.

name: Masako Yoshii
description: Rin's biological mother. She's a mangaka.

name: Yukari Nitani
description: Kouki's mom. A single mother. She places her son's well being above her own.

name: Hideyuki Maeda
description: Reina's father.

name: Sachiko Kawachi
description: Daikichi's mother and grandfather Kage's daughter. This makes Rin-chan Sachiko's half-sister.

name: Smile
description: Smile is very self-conscious about her teeth, so she wears a mask most of the time. She's a famous JK streamer and one of the most popular on the "Curious Live" platform.

appearsIn.title: Words Bubble Up Like Soda Pop

name: Cherry
description: Cherry often gets nervous and blushes, therefore making it almost impossible for him to speak to others. He's often seen wearing headphones, so that people won't talk to him; this is also to tune-out the sound around him, as he dislikes loud sounds, finding it difficult to cope with them. He expresses himself through Haiku, as talking to other people is hard for him.

appearsIn.title: Words Bubble Up Like Soda Pop

name: Kouichi
description: Cherry's father.

appearsIn.title: Words Bubble Up Like Soda Pop

name: Maria
description: Cherry's mother.

appearsIn.title: Words Bubble Up Like Soda Pop

name: Fenrys
description: She is the younger sister of Fengaril, a Garo tribe member who was one of the Four Heavenly Kings in the Demon King's army. She meets Flio and begins her tentative married life with him. As a Garo tribe member, she can be quick to pick a fight. Above all, she loves [Flio](https://anilist.co/character/207817/Flio).

appearsIn.title: Chillin' in Another World with Level 2 Super Cheat Powers
Chillin’ in Another World with Level 2 Super Cheat Powers

name: Flio
description: A kind-hearted young man who loves peace. He is suddenly summoned to another world as a "candidate for hero." He is banished because his abilities at level 1 were mediocre, but when he reaches level 2, his status changes to "∞." He obtains powers that ordinary people cannot handle.

appearsIn.title: Chillin' in Another World with Level 2 Super Cheat Powers
Chillin’ in Another World with Level 2 Super Cheat Powers

name: Elizabeth Klyrode
native: エリザベート・クライロード
description: First princess of the Magical Kingdom 'Klyrode'.

appearsIn.title: Chillin' in Another World with Level 2 Super Cheat Powers

name: Airy
description:
__Race:__ Spirit

Aerial or Airy is the first Spirit summoned by Taichi Nishimura and becomes one of the main characters of the Isekai Cheat Magician series.

Aerial has platinum green hair with teal colored eyes and pointed ears similar to an elf. She is shown to be wrapped in a green hagoromo like sash with four feathered wings sprouting from and wing like accessories in her hair and three diamond markings on both of her legs. She generally takes on the form of a young female fairy.

Aerial is shown to be a very loving and caring spirit with a strong sense of duty and loyalty, despite the fact that she wished Tachi could have summoned her sooner so that she could help him, she could not disobey the conditions needed in order to summon her and feels both sad and regretful that she could not aid him when he needed it most in the beginning. Since her summoning she has done everything she can to be both helpful and useful to Tachi and is shown to be very loyal and protective of him, telling Tachi that she would never abandon him. 



(Source: Isekai Cheat Magician Wiki)

name: Myura
description: An Elf swordswoman and a former apprentice of Lemia, she is a Dual Magician capable of using the magical elements Fire and Earth. She is known under the title "Golden SwordsWoman" for her skill with the blade. Impressed with Rin's abilities, the two girls become fast friends.

name: Rin Azuma
description: After being summoned to Altia alongside her childhood friend Taichi Nishimura, she decides to become an adventurer with him in the hopes of finding a way back home.

name: Taichi Nishimura
description: He is a 16-year-old high school student and role-playing game fan blessed with good reflexes but lacking ambition.

name: Remia
description: A Master Triple Magician whom everyone in the kingdom knows who she is due to her magical prowess, thus her nickname as the Magician of Fallen Leaves. She taught Muller magic before teaching Taichi and Rin.

name: Anastasia
description: Former assassin.

name: Melo
description: Milo twin sister. Controls earth element.

name: Akuto Sai
description: Akuto Sai was left on the door steps of a church by a strange woman. He grows up and transfers into the Constant Academy for Magical Arts, wanting to be a high priest. He meets Junko Hattori on the train to the school, and forms a pact with her to make the world a better place. The predicting spirit Yata Garasu predicts that he will be a Demon Lord upon graduation. Yata's predictions have never been wrong, and everyone becomes afraid of him as a result. Even so, he still tries to do the right thing when situations happen around him and he is shown to have an incredible amount of power within him, shown when he absorbs a demon dog's mana to revert it back to normal, something which a normal mage is unable to do. He struggles from time to time when his power comes forth and attempts to use the destructive energies to help instead of harm. Sai aims to become part of his country's highest order of magicians and contribute to society.

name: Keena Soga
description: A weird girl who seems to have some kind of relationship with Akuto, who she calls Aa-chan. She is astonishingly optimistic. Her special abilities are disappearing, flying and eating amazing amounts of rice, to the point that, when she has to grow a plant using her mana, the plant takes the form of a rice plant. Her hair has two sprouts on the top that wag depending on how she feels.

name: Korone
description: Korone is a Liladan (リラダン Riradan?), a race of androids, sent by the government to observe Akuto 24/7. She is usually emotionless and stolid, but occasionally curious when it comes to certain things. However, she does display human characteristics on occasion; particularly, she enjoys teasing Akuto, often doing ecchi things in front of him. She sleeps in a small storage closet in Akuto's dorm and has numerous firearms and other items stored inside her handbag, a sort of hammerspace. Korone has the ability to read other people's emotions and can detect an individual's mana levels. She, like all Liladans, can be temporarily deactivated by pulling a switch resembling a rabbit's tail located on her lower back. She starts having feelings for Sai.

name: Junko Hattori
description: Junko is introduced in episode one of the anime. She's very skilled with a short blade and wooden sword, both of which she carries or summons. She also has a tsundere nature, often becoming embarrassed and misunderstanding situations because of that. She comes from a Suharaist family that protects the Empire and is very strict about upholding the values that were taught to her.

name: Fujiko Etou
description: Fujiko Etou is the current head of the Etou family, the head of the girl's dorms at Constant Academy, and the only person who understands Akuto's current situation. Her older brother, the Etou's previous head, was killed after failing a mission, causing Fujiko to become the new head of the family, though for unexplained reasons, she kept her brother's (revived) head, which is kept in a jar-like container filled with fluid. She is the leader of an underground movement that uses black magick (magic) for evil purposes and plans to use Akuto's demon powers once he becomes Demon Lord for her own purposes.

name: Hiroshi Miwa
description: A boy who thinks Akuto Sai is amazing and always bugs him by pretending to be brothers and calling Sai "Demon King". He often states that he is Sai's most loyal follower.

name: Mitsuko Torii
description: School's physician and instructor. She constantly reminds Akuto that if he dies she wants to turn him undead so she can analyze him, she even goes to the extent where she tells him if he wishes to die to just go to her.

name: Lily Shiraishi
description: Student council president. She is a little bit secretive in the undergrounds of the school. Judging by her expressions it seems like she knows a little more then she lets on.She develops a crush on Akuto. She doesn't want Akuto to be the demon lord.

name: Eiko Teruya
description: She just transfered to the school but seems to know what Etou Fujiko is up to. She also states that she was just going to tease Sai Akuto a little but now that she knows he is cute he will be seeing a lot more of her. She also stated that once she gets attached to something she can't leave it alone.

name: Michie Ootake
description: Member of the Student Council. She uses magic to tame bats and fight with them.

name: Diana Cavendish
native: ダイアナ・キャベンディッシュ
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm

Diana is serious, composed, and erudite. Being descended from a prestigious line of witches back to ancient times, she is exceptionally devoted to her magical studies and to the tradition and history of magic. Her status as Luna Nova's best student cannot be solely attributed to heredity — she has self-discipline and maturity far surpassing the average teenage girl.

She quickly becomes [Akko](https://anilist.co/character/81645/Kagari-Atsuko)'s rival, though she doesn't see herself as her rival.

name: Chariot du Nord
description:
__**Height:**__ 170 cm

From her early childhood, Chariot sought to become a witch who could make people smile. Her natural charm and radiant personality attracted everyone around her. However, Chariot's passion for magic exceeded her skill, which led to many blunders, she pursued doing magic shows, as it connects with her message of wanting to make everyone happy.

name: Natsume
description:
A girl who lost her father and her right arm due to a Gadoll attack when she was a child. She dreams of joining the Kanochikara and fight the Gadoll as a warrior, but reality bites, and ends up working under [Kaburagi](https://anilist.co/character/170192/) as an armor repairer.

Cheerful, energetic, and reckless.

(Source: Official Site)

name: Kaburagi
description:
__Height:__ 190 cm (6'2 ft)
__Race:__ Cyborg

__Human Avatar__
Kaburagi is a middle aged man sporting greying black hair, which he slicks back, and facial hair on his chin. He wears a tucked-in wide necked short-sleeved shirt (with the sleeves tucked up and buttoned) with two buttons on the front. He wears olive wide pants and are tucked into brown boots. He has a black belt tied and a leather bracelet on his wrist.

__Cyborg Form__
In his cyborg form, Kaburagi is very short and cylindrical. He has a rectangular faceplate, and a brown and mint-green color scheme. He wears a red jet pack on his back. He also has brown spikes coming off his head, giving the appearance of spikey hair. 

Kaburagi is a  veteran Deca-dence armor repairer with a blunt and surly manner. He was once a great warrior but lost the ardor to fight and spends his days supervising a team on maintenance duties. He follows the cyborg Hugin's orders and spends his nights eliminating "bugs" by removing their chips. His apathetic state of mind changes through his encounter with Natsume who is determined to become a fighter.
Kaburagi is quiet and cold when you first meet him, but is very kind-hearted and caring underneath. He is impulsive and does not often make plans, preferring to jump right into the action. He has a strong moral compass, and often makes the right choice guided by a gut feeling.

name: Minato
description:
The Commander in Chief of Deca-dence. Calm, composed, and cerebral, he is irreplaceable in the fight against the Gadoll, as he is in charge of game plan building to emergency decision making. He has known [Kaburagi](https://anilist.co/character/170192/) for a long time, and still worries about him, despite Kaburagi having retired from the battlefield.

(Source: Official Site, edited)

name: Fei
description:
A friend of [Natsume](https://anilist.co/character/170191/)'s who grew up in the same orphan home. She became a demolition worker after she left the home. She respects Natsume's dream to becoming a warrior, but always worries for her welfare. She felt relieved when Natsume became an armor repair worker.

(Source: Official Site, edited)

name: Linmei
description:
A girl who grew up in the same orphan home [Natsume](https://anilist.co/character/170191/) lived in. She is always with her entourage. Linmei is ill at ease with Natsume, often picking a fight one way or another.

She worked as a demolition worker after she left the home.

(Source: Official Site, edited)

name: Kurenai
description:
One of the strongest female warriors among the tankers in The Power. She spearheads her troop on the battlefields with her henchmen Sou and Ryu.

Brave, but plenteous in mercy, she bundles her men together with her charisma. She is the object of [Natsume](https://anilist.co/character/170191/)'s long-time admiration.

(Source: Official Site, edited)

name: Kyouya Sata
description: At the begining, when Erika suggested her idea of faking lovers, Kyouya agrees to it with a "Prince Charming" attitude. However,shortly after, he blackmails her, torments her and makes her his "dog." Gradually he starts to care for her and becomes jealous whenever she gets close to other guys. He also develops a protective attitude towards her.

name: Marin Tachibana
description: One of Erika's friends.

name: Nozomi Kamiya
description: He's a super flashy guy and belongs in the same class of Sata and Erika. Also, he's a sort of a  playboy type. He can easily remember the names he just acquainted to. Especially cute girls' name.

name: Yuu Kusakabe
description: An unconfident and shy outcast, deemed a "coward" by Sata. Erika becomes friends with him after discovering that under his quiet exterior is an earnest, kind-hearted person.

name: Ayumi Sanda
description: A short-haired girl and Erika's friend who only knows the 'fake boyfriend' thing. She is also the classmate of Kyouya Sato during their first year. She also admitted that Sato-kun and her aren't close.

name: Hitomi Sata
description: Kyouya and Reika's mother.

name: Takeru Hibiya
description: Takeru Hibiya is Kyouya Sata's classmate from his middle school days. He goes to a nearby all-boys school.

name: Yoshito Kimura
description: Helps Erika when she was being bullied and after that went with her on a date. Is later discovered that he was just trying to take revenge on Kyouya due to his ex girlfriend break up with him because she fell for Kyouya.

name: Aki Tezuka
description: One of Erika's friends.

name: Misumi Tozawa
description: Tozawa Misumi was a student at the Aeterna Girls' Academy, where she befriended her classmate [Yuuki Asuna](https://anilist.co/character/36828/Asuna-Yuuki). Being one of the 1,000 beta testers for Sword Art Online, Misumi encouraged Asuna to play the game with her in the official release.

appearsIn.title: Sword Art Online the Movie -Progressive- Aria of a Starless Night

name: Diavel
description: A player with a kite shield and proclaims himself to be a knight. He was the one who organized the first meeting of players to form a raid party to take on the first floor boss. He organized the participating players well into groups according to their specialty and displayed great leadership to motivate and lead the raid party.

appearsIn.title: Sword Art Online the Movie -Progressive- Aria of a Starless Night

name: Kyouko Yuuki
description: She is Asuna's mother, she hates FullDive programs after her daughter was trapped in one for 2 years. She is strictly with Asuna as she decides her daughters future and gets angry very fast.    She once tried a FullDive program but she logged off in just a few minutes saying that she was dizzy.

appearsIn.title: Sword Art Online the Movie -Progressive- Aria of a Starless Night

name: Yuuki Cross
description:
__Height__: 156 cm  

The adoptive daughter of the headmaster of Cross Academy, Yuuki is a member of the school's disciplinary committee (public morals committee in Japanese), which is the 'front' for the Guardians. Ten years prior to the events of "Vampire Knight," Yuuki was attacked by a vampire, but was rescued by Kaname. She has lost all memory of her life before the attack, and Headmaster Cross took her in as his own daughter. Yuuki loves Kaname, and even though she has witnessed his vampiric nature when he bit Ruka, she still couldn't stop loving him. However, she has also started to let Zero, a childhood friend, drink her blood, hoping to save him from madness. Yuuki is cheerful and easygoing, and thanks to her work as a Guardian she is good at keeping her cool in sticky situations. There have been hints that she is special, given that vampires are especially drawn to her blood. Her weapon of choice is the "Artemis Rod," an extensible staff she received from Headmaster Cross.

name: Zero Kiryuu
description:
__Height__: 178 cm - 183 cm 

Yuuki's childhood friend, Zero is also a Guardian and likewise on the disciplinary committee. Yuuki has been taking care of him as her little brother since he was brought into their home (the Headmaster's). His family, a line of vampire hunters, was murdered by the pure blood vampire Shizuka Hio when he was young. He harbors a deep hatred for vampires and claims to have taken on the role of Guardian to learn to hunt them better. In truth, Zero was bitten during the attack on his family, and have kept the secret that he was a vampire from Yuuki until he was no longer capable of controlling his vampiric urges.  Zero's body rejects the blood tablets that most vampires take to control their hunger. Drinking Yuuki's blood helps him maintain his sanity, but he is destined to become a Level E vampire eventually. He has started to accept his feelings towards Yuki and has gone as far as to almost kissing  her. Zero's weapon is the gun "Bloody Rose," given to him by Headmaster Cross. He made Yuuki promise that if he becomes a Level E vampire, she will kill him with that gun.

name: Kaname Kuran
description:
**Height:** 184 cm  

A pureblood vampire. He saved Yuuki from an attack by another vampire when she was little. Kaname is the class president of the Night Class, much feared and respected by the other Night Class students. While he is cold and authoritative towards his fellows in the Night Class, he is always kind and sweet to Yuuki. He has shown that he cares deeply for Yuuki ever since he saved her, and loves her in a romantic sense.   As a Pureblood, Kaname is capable of controlling lesser vampires, but he chooses not to exercise his powers, thus earning the respect of the Noble vampires. He shares the Chairman's hopes for peace between vampires and humans. He worked with the Chairman to create the Night Class at Cross Academy and with his presence, allows the Night Class to be kept in check. But the real reason Kaname agreed to attend the academy is so that he can be near Yuuki and protect her as she is his love.

name: Kaien Cross
description: Yuuki's adoptive parent, who also took Zero into his home several years ago. Headmaster Cross dreams of peace between humans and vampires, and established the Night Class to promote understanding between the two races. Although he is often eccentric, he has a serious side as well. It is revealed that he is a former vampire hunter.

name: Toga Yagari
description: The current top ranked vampire hunter, Toga Yagari, formerly trained Zero to be a vampire hunter. He had lost his right eye due to trying to save Zero long ago from a level E vampire. He showed up once at Cross Academy serving for a short while as a Night Class teacher to decide whether Zero is considered dangerous or not. He also appears briefly in volume five, when he appears shocked about the council's decision to punish Zero.

name: Ruka Souen
description:
__Height__: 167 cm  

A female vampire popular with the Day Class students and is one of those are the most faithful and protective of Kaname. She seems to dislike Zero because Kaname acknowledges him and carries bitterness for Yuuki's place in Kaname's heart as her feelings for Kaname run deep. When Yuuki was younger and had not become one of the school's Guardians yet, she once witnessed Kaname drinking Ruka's blood when she paid Kaname a visit. Ruka has feelings for Kaname, although he does not reciprocate them and only drank her blood one time to keep himself from biting Yuuki.

name: Hanabusa Aidou
description: Nicknamed "Idol" by the Day Class girls. Along with his cousin Akatsuki Kain, Hanabusa Aido is known among the Night Class as "Kaname-sama's right hand," and he has a fierce admiration for Kaname. He possesses an upper-class vampire ability to control ice. He knows that Zero is a vampire, but keeps quiet about it. Aido can seem cheerful and friendly one moment, and cold and vindictive the next. He is not fond of Yuuki, but he tolerates her because Kaname cares for her.

name: Senri Shiki
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm

Senri Shiki is one of the youngest Night Class members and works as a model with Rima Touya. Senri is usually the one sent out to hunt down a level E vampire. He is able to control and bend his blood at will. Senri's father is Rido Kuran, making him Kaname's cousin, and his mother's uncle is part of the council.

name: Akatsuki Kain
description: Aidou's cousin and another one of "Kaname-sama's right hand." His carefree attitude gets both him and Aido in trouble at times. His nickname is "Wild," despite the fact he is actually mellower than Aido. He tends to get blamed for the actions of other vampires, especially Aido, despite not being involved and ends up getting punished as a result. He is incredibly perceptive and is frequently sensitive to others' feelings, most particularly with Aido and Ruka's. He seems to have feelings for Ruka.

name: Maid
description: She is the one that offers Ichijou a roughly 3 meters tall stack of books regarding Kaname's past, and is also the one to notify Ichijou that his grandfather is heading over for a visit.

name: Ellen
description:
Eren is an adventurer and a member of Kaval's Party. 
 
(Source: Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken Wikia)

name: Treyni
description: Treyni is a dryad that resides in the Jura Forest.

name: Myrd
description: Myrd is younger brother of Garm and Dord. Though he was a dwarf of few words, he was an expert at what he does. Having knowledge in construction, and well-versed in the arts, he is a one of a kind genius. Myrd was appointed as the captain of the construction team.

name: Fate  Graphite
native: フェイト・グラファイト
description:
Fate is a young man that has black hair and brown eyes. However, when the glutton skill is activated, the color of his eyes become red.

After his father passed away, the villagers kicked him out from the village. The villagers think of him as a useless guy after his father had passed away. Fate then looked for a job to live.

name: Greed
description: He's the sword of [Fate](https://anilist.co/character/161604).

name: Saya Kisaragi
description:
A miko and a chiropteran slayer. She is known to her friends to be very dense with no common sense especially when it comes to love. 

Saya is portrayed as a kind, clumsy and helpful person, acting very cheerful and singing songs in the morning. She loved her friends, her family, and her normal life as well as being dutiful in her family's fighting against the Elder Bairn.

name: Tadayoshi Kisaragi
description: Saya's father and the priest at the shrine where he and Saya reside. While Saya is out fighting the Furukimono, he worries about her, though he is not inclined to show it. He cares deeply for Saya and helps with her training, often commenting on her clumsiness.     (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Shinichirou Tokizane
description: A quiet classmate who harbors a secret interest in Saya. He is usually seen skipping lunch, as he stated once to Saya that he'd rather sleep than eat.

name: Fumito Nanahara
description: Saya's neighbor and the owner of Guimauve, a coffee shop near Saya's home. He is also a friend and junior of Tadayoshi back in their high school years, although he attended it much later than Tadayoshi. Fumito usually serves breakfast for Saya and makes bento lunches for her. He once stated to Saya that she is special to him, and that she is more important to him than anything else. After her battles, he expresses his concern towards Saya by bringing coffee and guimauve to her after her battles. Saya once questioned him about his guimauve asking if they were always pink in color —he is mysteriously states it depends what is mixed in them.

name: Itsuki Tomofusa
description: Tomofusa is the class representative of Saya's class.  He seems to have a crush on her.

name: Yuuka Amino
description:
Occupation: Student

Saya's classmate.

Personality: She is shown to have great annoyance at Saya for being too soft and always helping people (the reason she comes to school late) which causes her to get angry. But she is still kind despite her hot headed nature. In reality, Yūka is actually a cold woman who will do anything to achieve her goals and shows little value towards human life.

Appearance: She has the appearance of a tall teenager with fair skin, dark eyes and nude lipstick. Yuuka sports chin length black hair with a fringe cut on the right side. On terms of clothes, Yūka mostly wears her school uniform. 


In "Blood-C: The Last Dark" movie,

name: Dog
description: The dog is almost always around Saya, watching over her though he doesn't like to be petted. The dog has a mysterious kind of air.

name: Nene Motoe
description:
Occupation: Student, Criminal, Former member of the Main Cast

Twin sister of Nono Motoe and a classmate of Saya.  How the two of them act together is similar to Moro and Maru from another of CLAMP's works.

Personality: Nene seemed to be a very happy and energetic young girl that would speak in sync with her twin sister Nono. She was very fun-loving.


Appearance: Nene looks completely identical to her sister, Nono. She has short, curly, strawberry blonde hair with a braid that is swept to the left in the front (Nono's braid is swept to the right). She has green eyes and pale skin. She has a slim build and legs that are noticeably thicker than most of the female characters. She is mostly seen wearing her high school uniform.

name: Nono Motoe
description: Twin sister of Nene Motoe and a classmate of Saya.

name: Kanako Tsutsutori
description: Teacher of class room 2-B, Saya's teacher.

name: Rakka
description: Rakka is the newest addition to Old Home and the main character of Haibane Renmei. The series largely focuses on Rakka's adjustment to the strange new world of Glie. Although happy to have several new friends, Rakka cannot help but wonder who she was before she became a Haibane and if her family is somewhere in this world. She feels a connection with the birds of Glie, especially since her dream involved falling with only a crow as company. She is very amiable and quickly becomes attached to her new family.

name: Reki
description: Reki is the unofficial leader of Old Home. She's tough when she needs to be but is also caring and compassionate. Her role at Old Home is to care for the young Haibane as well as take care of New Feathers like [Rakka](https://anilist.co/character/1995/Rakka). Reki is a major part of Rakka's life in Glie as she was the one who discovered her cocoon and stayed by her side during the painful process of growing wings. Reki is most always cheerful, at least on the surface. We receive hints of a darker past throughout the series. Despite whatever these problems from her past may be, Reki is a strong and reliable person, which explains why the other Haibane respect her as they do.

name: Kuramori
description: A Haibane who once took care of Nemu and Reki. Despite her delicate health, she was kind and helpful. She no longer lives in Old Home.

name: The Communicator
description: A presiding official of the Haibane Renmei who gives spiritual advice and worldly assistance and on occasion doles out punishment to wayward Haibane.

name: Shorta
description: One of the 'Young Feathers' of Old Home.  He insists his cocoon dream was about shortcake, hence his name.

name: Midori
description: Midori is a girl at the Abandoned Factory who can't forgive Reki for what happened in the past with her and Hyouko.

name: Sumika
description: Sumika works as a librarian at the library.

name: Kuu
description: Kuu is the youngest Haibane in the older group, having only been at Old Home two years more than Rakka. She is seemingly full of boundless energy and is nearly always cheerful. Rakka and Kuu became close friends shortly after Rakka arrived at Old Home. Kuu confides in Rakka that she had wished her to be a younger sister but was happy that Rakka wound up being older than her since she would have been placed with the younger group otherwise. Kuu is curious and enjoys trying out different things, which can sometimes result in disaster. She tried Reki's scooter and crashed into a telephone pole, and when she tried Hikari's glasses she became dizzy and fell down the stairs. She occasionally works at a cafe in town and is seemingly paid in sugar cubes.

name: Nemu
description: Nemu is the oldest member of Old Home, having been there for approximately nine years. Nemu lives up to her namesake by being rather sedate and often sleeping in or taking naps. She's even been known to catch the occasional snooze at work, the town's library, but her boss doesn't seem to mind since she does such a good job. After a turbulent start she formed a close friendship with Reki when she arrived seven years ago.

name: Hikari
description: Hikari has been around Old Home the longest after Reki and Nemu at approximately four years. She is a kind person though she sometimes acts before thinking. When she saw the mold for the halo that she was to make for Rakka she was struck with the idea of pouring dough in it to make halo-like pastries. It is because of this that the little ones think that Rakka smells like cake. Not surprisingly she works at a bakery in town. Though modest about her contributions, her co-workers insist that she does more than her share, which is why they don't mind when her friends stop by to have a few treats while visiting her. Hikari may be a bit mischievous at times but she always means well and is the first to volunteer to help.

appearsIn.title: I'm Standing on a Million Lives
I'm Standing on a Million Lives
I'm Standing on a Million Lives
I'm Standing on a Million Lives

name: Kahabell
description: Ready to enforce justice no matter the common sense with her indomitable spirit, Kahabell's actions reflect that of a truly fanatical knight. She is also known to be rather sadistic as she enjoys the sensation of cutting the flesh of living things.

appearsIn.title: I'm Standing on a Million Lives

name: Keiki Kiryuu
description:
Keiki is a kind-hearted, friendly and considerate guy. He cares for his close friends and family, and is, in turn, cared for and liked just as much by them. His kindness is pointed out, by [Shouma](https://anilist.co/character/138711/Shoma-Akiyama), as his good trait and as to why girls would have a reason to like or love him.

Keiki also wants a girlfriend and is annoyed by the many couples he sees and is quite envious of them.

He cares very much for his sister [Mizuha](https://anilist.co/character/138709/Mizuha-Kiryuu) and spoils her with affection, to the point of being described as a sis-con by [Mao](https://anilist.co/character/138710/Mao-Nanjo) 

He also has a rare trait as a harem protagonist as he is not very dense. He has been able to figure out the feelings some girls hold for him in some respect, but did not know their perverted sides. He also seems to have quite a bit of confidence/courage when interacting with the girls as shown when he confronts [Sayuki](https://anilist.co/character/135802/Sayuki-Tokihara) about her secret (which he thinks is her romantic feelings for him). He is quite assertive when it comes to finding out who is in love with him.

He may not be dense, but he has a hard time understanding the emotions of girls and doesn't seem to completely grasp the situation. He also believes that there should be 'love' behind his acceptance of the girls' true nature towards him.

appearsIn.title: Hensuki: Are you willing to fall in love with a pervert, as long as she’s a cutie?

name: Sayuki Tokihara
description: She is a third year student and the Calligraphy Club's President. On the outside, she is a mature upperclassman, with a playful attitude and a kind spirit. She enjoys calligraphy and tends to make a huge mess whenever she is writing. She always seems to be at odds with [Yuika](https://anilist.co/character/135803/Yuika-Koga) and teases/picks on her, the same goes both ways.

appearsIn.title: Hensuki: Are you willing to fall in love with a pervert, as long as she’s a cutie?

name: Yuika Koga
description: On the outside, she is a cute and outgoing girl who is playful with her friends, especially [Keiki](https://anilist.co/character/135801/Keiki-Kiryuu). She can sometimes be childish and jealous when Keiki is around other girls, especially [Sayuki](https://anilist.co/character/135802/Sayuki-Tokihara). She does not get along with Sayuki and is always picking on her and the same goes both ways.

appearsIn.title: Hensuki: Are you willing to fall in love with a pervert, as long as she’s a cutie?

name: Mizuha Kiryuu
description: Mizuha is a kind and cheerful girl and acts somewhat air headed and cute at times. She is good at giving different types of advice to her brother [Keiki](https://anilist.co/character/135801/Keiki-Kiryuu) and cares for him dearly. She enjoys being pampered by him.

appearsIn.title: Hensuki: Are you willing to fall in love with a pervert, as long as she’s a cutie?

name: Mao Nanjou
description: She is somewhat of an introvert, she's quiet, passive and is a bit of a loner. The only person she is seen talking to in class is [Keiki](https://anilist.co/character/135801/Keiki-Kiryuu) whom she most likely has romantic feelings towards. She is shown to be quite open with Keiki however and gives him advice as well as acting like a tsundere towards him at times.

appearsIn.title: Hensuki: Are you willing to fall in love with a pervert, as long as she’s a cutie?

name: Okita-sensei
description: A teacher at Momosawa High School and the calligraphy club advisor.

appearsIn.title: Hensuki: Are you willing to fall in love with a pervert, as long as she’s a cutie?

name: Ayano Fujimoto
description:
