Ayano is a serious-minded student council vice president whose specialty is sweets. She is reputed for her high grades and reliability, but she often acts reserved yet cute. She is also very clumsy.



(Sources: Kawaikereba Wiki and Wikipedia)

appearsIn.title: Hensuki: Are you willing to fall in love with a pervert, as long as she’s a cutie?

name: Koharu Ootori
description: Koharu is a third-year from the Astronomy club. She is extremely tiny, resembling a small child.

appearsIn.title: Hensuki: Are you willing to fall in love with a pervert, as long as she’s a cutie?

name: Shoma Akiyama
description:
Shouma is a cool and friendly guy. He has a very close and playful relationship with Keiki and is good at giving advice about girls. He is popular with girls throughout the school however he is not interested in any of them. 



(Source: Kawaikereba Wiki)

appearsIn.title: Hensuki: Are you willing to fall in love with a pervert, as long as she’s a cutie?

name: Ushikai Musume
description: Cow Girl is the childhood friend of [Goblin Slayer](https://anilist.co/character/126458) and a farm hand on her uncle's farm.

appearsIn.title: Goblin Slayer Side Story: Year One

name: Uketsuke-jou
description: A young woman who runs the Guild's front office as a receptionist and hands out contracts to adventurers. She shows concern over the villages pleading for help against the goblins and is exasperated from how few experienced adventurers would take such jobs. This problem would leave inexperienced rookies to die from them or worse. She holds great amounts of respect for Goblin Slayer, due to his willingness to take on many goblin contracts others would not touch.

appearsIn.title: Goblin Slayer Side Story: Year One

name: Majo
description:
Witch is a silver ranked adventurer who is in a party with [Spearman](https://anilist.co/character/126488/Yaritsukai). She is a beautiful spell-caster with long, purple hair who wears a revealing set of robes, dark colored with gold yellow outlining. She is usually shown as being rather seductive, acting in a rather amorous manner, often suggesting sexual undertones in otherwise normal conversation, which causes those she interacts with to become flustered or embarrassed. Despite her teasing, she is shown to be caring of those around her, offering advice and help to those who need it. She tends to speak in terse and paused sentences. 

As a powerful spellcaster, she is known to posess at least the spells Inflammarae (burn), Magic Missile, and Missile Deflect. She is shown using her Inflammarae spell to light a smoking pipe, to which she herself admits is quite the waste.

Witch is first shown helping [Priestess](https://anilist.co/character/126483/Onna-Shinkan) get away from a pair of privy newbies who wanted to scout her for their own party. She also gives her advice on her current situation with [Goblin Slayer](https://anilist.co/character/126458/Goblin-Slayer), explaining she did him a favor by selling him a magic scroll not too long ago, but without entering into much more detail.

appearsIn.title: Goblin Slayer Side Story: Year One

name: Jaina Repellista Jahad
description: Jaina Repellista Zahard is a Zahard's Princess from the Jaina Family. She seems to be addicted to sitting in her darkened room in front of her Lighthouse watching what's happening within The Tower.

name: Daniel Hatchid
description: D-rank Scout who is affiliated with and is highly valued by FUG. Daniel came on the Hell Express with the initial aim of reviving Roen by helping Hoaqin become 'complete' again.

name: Nia Nya
description: Nya Nia is a Regular working as a Jjamppong delivery boy on the 20th Floor. He later quits his job to take part in the Tests.

name: Beta
description: Beta is one of Sophia Amae's "children" and Horyang and Cassano's "brother", a living Ignition weapon created by the Workshop.

name: Yuri Ha Jahad
description: Ha Yuri Jahad, more commonly known as Yu​ri Jahad (lacking her family name), is a High Ranker and Princess from the Ha Family. Notably, she is one of the most famous Princesses and therefore highly favored, with much political influence throughout The Tower.

name: Morihito Otogi
description:
__Height:__ 181 cm  (5'11")

An ogre. Strong and level-headed, he's had his hands full ever since his childhood friend [Nico](https://anilist.co/character/207345/) returned. Nico's nickname for him is "Moi."

name: Nico Wakatsuki
description:
__Height:__ 159 cm (5'3")

A witch. Clumsy and goofy, she has a tendency to let compliments go straight to her head. Her dream is to be a great witch who helps others.

Due to being the Witch of Thousand, a type of witch that is born every 1000 years that is able to use various spells unlike normal witches, she is targeted by a group of Black Witches. Her childhood friend and first love, [Morihito](https://anilist.co/character/207344/), is assigned the task of being her familiar and protecting her from harm.

name: Kanshi Kazamatsuri
description:
__Height:__ 164 cm  (5'5")

A tengu. Due to clan differences, he didn't like [Morihito](https://anilist.co/character/207344/) at first. He's highly sociable and makes friends easily. He joins the Otogi household as [Nico's](https://anilist.co/character/207345/) familiar.

name: Keigo Magami
description:
__Height:__ 176 cm  (5'9")

Nico's classmate and self-proclaimed hipster. He was a figure skater until an accident forced him to retire.

name: Miharu Kiryuu
description:
__Height:__ 157 cm  (5'2")

He is a very polite and elegant vampire with absolutely no filter. He will say whatever is on his mind, no matter how rude it is. He doesn't drink blood but uses his soul-stealing ability to absorb vital energy of others. He joins the Otogi household as Nico's fourth familiar.

name: Nemu Miyao
description:
__Height:__ 152 cm  (5'0")

A witch from a venerable household who specializes in shape-shifting magic and can turn into a cat. Falling asleep turns her back. She wants to make [Morihito](https://anilist.co/character/207344/) her familiar.

name: Wolf
description:
__Height:__ 185 cm  (6'1")

Wolf is the main antagonist in the Dogs and Raindrops Arc alongside [Fuyo no Majo](https://anilist.co/character/266670/). He runs a secret website where he provides candy called "drops" that have a stimulant effect to people. Nobody knows what year he's in or his real name.

name: Rui Fujiki
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm (5'10")

Magani Middle School's Student Council President. He is a descendant of Jekyll from Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde, so he possesses a destructive urge that he cannot control on his own.

name: Kara Minami
description: [Nico's](https://anilist.co/character/207345/) classmate. She's interested in romance, but her sharp tongue and blunt personality often get in the way. She cares deeply for her friends. She creates a familiar called [Shiki](https://anilist.co/character/296513/) after Nico performs a spell to bring it to life.

name: Shiki
description: A shikigami who is [Kara's](https://anilist.co/character/266623/) familiar. It comes to life after Kara gave it form by one of [Nico's](https://anilist.co/character/207345/) spells. It usually stays perched on Kara's hairclip.

name: Maki Maehara
description: A boy who doesn't know how to make friends because he kept changing schools.

appearsIn.title: I Made Friends with the Second Prettiest Girl in My Class
I Made Friends with the Second Prettiest Girl in My Class

name: Umi Asanagi
description: She is smart, friendly, and is considered "the second cutest girl in the class" by the boys.

appearsIn.title: I Made Friends with the Second Prettiest Girl in My Class
I Made Friends with the Second Prettiest Girl in My Class

name: Yuu Amami
description: She is the undisputed No. 1 beautiful girl in her class. She and [Umi](https://anilist.co/character/316482) have been best friends since elementary school.

appearsIn.title: I Made Friends with the Second Prettiest Girl in My Class
I Made Friends with the Second Prettiest Girl in My Class

name: Itsuki Maehara
description: Maki's father.

appearsIn.title: I Made Friends with the Second Prettiest Girl in My Class

name: Eri Amami
description: Mother of [Amami Yuu](https://anilist.co/character/316484/Amami-Yuu)

appearsIn.title: I Made Friends with the Second Prettiest Girl in My Class

name: Yamamoto
description: He is Light Yagami's high school friend      He also makes an appearance in the One-Shot chapter. As revealed in chapter 108, he and Matsuda share a close friendship. According to Matsuda, they've gone drinking together on some occasions.

name: Kyosuke Higuchi
description: Kyosuke Higuchi is the head of Technology Development at the Yotsuba Corporation and one of the eight members of the Yotsuba Group: a group inside of the Yotsuba Corporation that uses the Death Note to kill individuals from competing companies to dominate the business industry.

name: Steve Mason
description: He is the FBI director and a member of the SPK.  He helped L in the Kira's investigation sending FBI agents to Japan but gave up after all the agents were killed by Kira. He was too a leading Near's employees who helped to convince the U.S. President to form the SPK.

name: Conrad Leto
description: The 27th Wizard King of the Clover Kingdom's Magic Knights.

appearsIn.title: Black Clover: Sword of the Wizard King

name: Hitomi Tsukishiro
description: Hitomi is a reserved girl who hesitates to interact with people. She cannot see the colours around her and sees everything in monochrome. Hitomi is sent back 60 years in the past by her grandmother and tells Hitomi to meet her younger self from when she was in high school.

name: Kohaku Tsukishiro
description: She is the grandmother of [Hitomi Tsukishiro](https://anilist.co/character/128075/Hitomi-Tsukishiro) who sends her back to 2018 to explore the past, make friends and regain her sense of color.

name: Yuito Aoi
description: Yuito Aoi is one of the main characters of Iroduku Sekai no Ashita kara. He is a member of the photography club whose hobby is drawing and Hitomi Tsukishiro is able to see his drawings in color for some reason.

name: Chigusa Fukazawa
description: Chigusa is a first-year and the youngest member of the art & photography club.

name: Asagi Kazano
description: She is a member of Art & Photography Club who likes to taking photos of rabbits. Shou is Asagi's childhood friend whom she has a crush on.

name: Kurumi Kawai
description: She is the vice president of art & photography club who was the first to notice and take a video of Hitomi Tsukishiro slipping out of Yuito Aoi's room where she is insistent that Hitomi is in a relationship with him or that he may have been about to force himself on her and she was also responsible for uploading the video to social media. Kurumi is a fun-loving and cheerful girl. Kurumi admires her elder sister the most that she wants to be like her.

name: Ruri Tsukishiro
description: Kohaku Tsukishiro's mother.

name: Seika Lamprogue
native: セイカ・ランプローグ
description: He is the reincarnation of Haruyoshi Kuga. He is very kind and will do anything to protect people dearest to him.

appearsIn.title: The Reincarnation of the Strongest Exorcist in Another World

name: Yifa
description: A young girl who served as a slave in Seika's birthplace, the House of Count Lambrogue. Although she hides it from her surroundings, she has the power to see "spirits" that even Seika cannot see, and the talent to follow them. Ever since she was young, she has taken a liking to Seika, who has treated her well.

appearsIn.title: The Reincarnation of the Strongest Exorcist in Another World

name: Amyu
description: A commoner girl who, like Seika, came to take the entrance exam for Rodnaire Academy of Magic. She has magical aptitude for all attributes, and she has an amazing talent for swords and magic, topping the entrance exam. Because of her ability, it is rumored that she is a "hero" who can defeat the Demon King.

appearsIn.title: The Reincarnation of the Strongest Exorcist in Another World

name: Kagura Souma
description:
__Zodiac Animal:__ Boar

She has been in love with [Kyo](https://anilist.co/character/209) since they were young, although she doesn't know that Kyo is in love with her friend, [Tohru Honda](https://anilist.co/character/207). Because of her "pity" of him as a child, when he was all alone because he carried the curse of the cat, she played with and took care of him. Eventually, it developed into a near-obsessive love for him. She is convinced she will marry him, mainly because she threatened him into proposing to her (at age 7 with knives in the manga, or a boulder in the anime to a 5-year old Kyo), and partly because she thinks that they belong together because they can hug each other without transforming into their zodiac form. 

Despite this love, she often loses her head and beats him senseless when he does something to anger her or make her anxious. As one of the only three female members of the zodiac, she is able to hug any of the male members and neither she nor they transform.

She lives with her mother, who is perfectly okay with Kagura's double-edged personality, and [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/3892). Kagura seemingly is the only female member of the zodiac that has not been personally hurt by [Akito](https://anilist.co/character/374).

name: Kazuma Souma
description:
When he was a child, Kazuma was mean to [his grandfather](https://anilist.co/character/233304), who was then the member of the Soma family possessed by the cat of the Chinese Zodiac, during their first and only meeting simply because his grandfather was cursed by the cat. 

Hoping to make amends for how he had treated his grandfather, he decided to take care of the young [Kyo Soma](https://anilist.co/character/209)  He is Kyo's martial arts teacher, but is also an adoptive father to him. Kazuma thinks well of [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/207) and hopes that her love for Kyo is sincere and that her relationship with Kyo will not mirror that of his grandfather and grandmother. Kyo calls him "Shishou" which means "master". Kazuma has taught many of the other Somas martial arts, including [Kagura](https://anilist.co/character/366), [Yuki](https://anilist.co/character/208) and [Haru](https://anilist.co/character/369).

name: Ritsu Souma
description:
__Zodiac Animal:__ Monkey

As far back as he could remember, his parents always had to apologize for everything he did, so he is very unsure of himself. He feels that every day, he is robbing the world of its air by breathing.

He found that it always made him feel more comfortable to dress like a girl, but that only gave his parents even more to apologize for. Since he looks so much like a girl, that's what [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/207) thought when she first saw him, until he accidently transformed. Somehow, Tohru convinced him that he does have a reason to live, he just hasn't found it yet. Shigure likes to play with Ritsu's insecurities and gullibility, much as he does his editor, [Mitsuru](https://anilist.co/character/9759).

  

Natsuki Takaya derived his name from the eighth month, odakaritsuki or "rice harvest month," which is the month of the monkey, of the traditional Japanese calendar. In an author's note, Takaya said that she regretted how little role Ritsu played in the main story.

(Source: AbsoluteAnime.com)

name: Saki Hanajima
description:
Saki is a psychic girl with a goth-like appearance who has the ability to sense people's "auras" and send out electric waves (denpa in Japanese). Much like [Arisa](https://anilist.co/character/375/Uotani-Arisa), Saki is extremely protective of [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/207/Honda-Tooru), who was the first person in school who had truly accepted her.

She is very observant, polite, and loves to eat (and is rarely seen not eating outside of school). Her nickname (Hana-chan) and her manga symbol, a violet with fangs, relate humorously in that hana means "flower" in Japanese. Hanajima has a close relationship to her family who accept and even nurture her gifts (her younger brother, [Megumi](https://anilist.co/character/15870/Hanajima-Megumi), looks up to Hanajima, has his own special ability so that she wouldn't be the only "weird" one in the family). Her mother seems to resemble Tohru's protective and caring nature (maybe explaining her attachment to Tohru). In the near "parental" protection she and Arisa give Tohru, she acts as the protective "motherly" figure.

name: Kobeni Yonomori
description:
__Race:__ 

The main heroine, a responsible sixteen-year-old who handles cooking and chores well. 

On her 16th birthday, a young man named [Hakuya](https://anilist.co/character/87583) and [Mashiro](https://anilist.co/character/87582) suddenly appear in front of her, in which it turns out that Hakuya is her fiancé and Mashiro is her future sister-in-law.

name: Hakuya Mitsumine
description: Hakuya is Kobeni Yonomori's fiancé who suddenly appears on her 16th birthday with his little sister Mashiro Mitsumine. He and his sister start living in the same house as Kobeni and her own sister, Benio Yonomori.

name: Mashiro Mitsumine
description: Hakuya's younger sister, who somehow manages to enroll in Kobeni's class. She often tries to vocalize that she isn't a child, but her honest feelings over her likes and dislikes are often read easily by the others. She is quite fearful of Benio but is easily swayed by sweet things.

name: Benio Yonomori
description: Benio Yonomori is Kobeni's elder sister who has two personas: an immature and a carefree loving sister at home and the student council president at school, where she maintains her respectable popular image as a demure, well-mannered and an elegant top-performing student in front of her legion of fans. She has taken a liking to Mashiro to the extent that she would do all sorts of advances to her at home.

name: Mayura Momouchi
description: Kobeni's classmate and best friend.

name: Konoha Suetsugi
description:
She is the student council secretary. She idolizes Benio due to how nice Benio was towards her when she first moved into town. As a result, she studied hard to get into the same school, and managed to work her way into the student council to be near Benio.

She hates Mashiro due to how close the latter seems with Benio, and even after Mashiro gets into a rant about how much she hates being smothered by her, Konoha refuses to see Benio in a bad light.

name: Nadeshiko Kashima
description: The student council vice president. She is much more refined and mature than Benio (who is the student council president). She is always the one who keeps Benio in-check whenever she is getting out of control. Benio often calls her up whenever she is feeling down, even if the cause isn't that bad. This is much to Kashima's annoyance—so much so that she often hangs up.

name: Akane Yonomori
description: Benio and Kobeni's mother.

name: Niko Oono
description: She is a member of the school's newspaper club, she is very nosy and often spies on ones personal affairs just to make a story.

name: Shirayuki Mitsumine
description: Hakuya and Mashiro's mother.

name: Fermi Amarty
native: フェルミ・アマーティ
description: He is a young man who works as a fish broker.

appearsIn.title: Spice and Wolf: MERCHANT MEETS THE WISE WOLF

name: Dian Rubens
native: ディアン・ルーベンス
description: Dian is an alchemist who is in the process of chronicling pagan tales and beliefs so as to print them in books.

appearsIn.title: Spice and Wolf: MERCHANT MEETS THE WISE WOLF

name: Adelle Cole
description: Marc's wife.

appearsIn.title: Spice and Wolf: MERCHANT MEETS THE WISE WOLF

name: Mary Kozakura
description:
First appeared in Imagination Forest. A 1/4-Medusa, 3/4-human girl. 

Her parents told her “We’re medusae, so if we make eye contact with a human they’ll be turned to stone.” While growing up, she always stuck to their words and hid herself away from the world in the forest. Even after they died she continued to live alone. By chance, a boy named [Seto](https://anilist.co/character/67945/Seto-Kousuke) visited the forest and found her. He has since brought her to the outside world. 

After coming to the Mekakushi Dan’s hideout, and joining the group, she leads a sideline life making fake flowers in her room which generate a very small income. When she went into town to buy ingredients, the first people she met were neighborhood children. They bullied her, and she was traumatized by the incident, so she rarely goes outside anymore. Her ability is to “make eye contact”, which allows her to temporarily stop the movement of whoever meets her gaze.

name: Hibiya Amamiya
description: First appeared in Heat-Haze Days. A boy that visits the city to take summer courses with Hiyori. He is known to be very mature for his age, yet has a cheeky personality. His quarrels with Momo are endless. On August 15, he becomes involved in a certain incident with Hiyori, but is the only one saved, and obtains the “eye focusing” ability under these circumstances.   (Source: Vocaloid Wikia)

name: Kousuke Seto
description:
First appeared in Imagination Forest. A young man who belongs to the Mekakushi Dan and is from the same orphanage as Kido and Kano. He works as a florist at the shopping center as well as various other fields of work such as traffic control and newspaper delivery. He is also the person that invited Mary into the Mekakushi Dan. With his "eye-stealing" ability, he can read information from any target. However, he dislikes it because, "it's a power where you steal with glances, without needing communication," so he rarely uses it. He has a pet hamster named "Hanao." He also has a habit of wandering around where he shouldn't be.

(Source: Vocaloid Wikia)

name: Takane Enomoto
description:
__Species:__ Human

A strange program taking the shape of a young girl which has taken up residence inside [Shintaro](https://anilist.co/character/67167/Kisaragi-Shintarou)'s computer. She calls him "Master", and yet adores bothering him.  First appeared in Artifical Enemy. A naive cyber girl who lives in Shintaro's computer. She can possibly invade anything that uses electricity and gives her all in doing things that Shintaro hates. Was once a human, but lost her body in a certain experiment. She now possesses the power of immortality from her "opening eyes" ability.

name: Shuuya Kano
description:
Kano is a young man who is part of the Mekakushi Dan. He outwardly has an unfocused, aloof personality and always has a smile on his face. Because he teases [Marry](https://anilist.co/character/67947/Kozakura-Mary), [Momo](https://anilist.co/character/67949/Kisaragi-Momo), and [Kido](https://anilist.co/character/67171/Kido-Tsubomi) a lot, he's often considered to be a flirt, but when it counts, he's worth relying on. His actual personality, which he hides behind his ability the majority of the time, is quite subdued and mature. 

(Source: Kagerou Project Wikia)

name: Tsubomi Kido
description: A mysterious girl who has appeared before [Shintaro](https://anilist.co/character/67167/Kisaragi-Shintarou) in a shopping center. She's seemingly the leader of the Mekakushi Dan. First appeared in Blindfold Code. A girl that plays the role of the leader of the Mekakushi Dan. She's essentially good-natured, but struggles to keep the individual members, like [Kano](https://anilist.co/character/67943/Kano-Shuuya) and [Seto](https://anilist.co/character/67945/Seto-Kousuke), in line. Using her "eye concealing" ability, she can erase the perception towards objects within a certain distance of herself or her surroundings. She is most always seen listening to music through her earphones.

name: Shintarou Kisaragi
description: The main protagonist of the manga and brother of Momo Kisaragi, Shintaro is a hikikomori and as such, he has a hard time dealing with people. He seems to be constantly bothered by Ene.  First appeared in Transparent Answer. A hikikomori (recluse/shut-in) young man with an IQ of 168. In middle school and high school, he performed at the top of his class in National Mock Examinations, but due to the suicide of a close friend (Ayano), he dropped out of his first year of high school. Subsequently, a mysterious software enters into his computer named "Ene," and, being unable to control her actions, his lifestyle is at a loss. Due to one of Ene's pranks, his computer breaks down, so both Ene and him go to the department store for shopping where they happen upon a group of terrorists. They end up stopping them together with the Mekakushi Dan. After this, he and Ene come to join the Mekakushi Dan.

name: Momo Kisaragi
description:
First appeared in Kisaragi Attention. A very popular idol in her first year of high school. Ever since a childhood marine accident at the beach with her father, she has the "eye-captivating" power that can draw peoples' attention regardless of their preferences in tastes or interests. Because of her power she was often alienated from people and had no friends, but since her meeting with the Mekakushi Dan, she regains her original, bright character. She has peculiar sense in taste and fashion, and as such, it is common for her opinions to disagree with other people's. She is also the younger sister of [Shintaro](https://anilist.co/character/67167/Kisaragi-Shintarou)

(Source: Vocaloid Wikia)

name: Haruka Kokonose
description:
A mysterious albino with supposed amnesia that appeared at Hiyori's relative's house one day during the summer. He was once a human called Haruka Kokonose but somewhere before the current timeline, he was turned into a cyber-being. He is currently living at Hiyori's sister's house as a foster child. Not knowing about the normal world, he's rather my-pace (air-headed, lost, confused). He is known to possess a strong curiosity for the unknown.

Haruka Kokonose was a boy in high school with a severe illness. He would often get tired easily, collapse, and not be able to do much. Caring greatly for any friends he had, he was sweet and gentle. Not once was he combative. Haruka was particularly good at drawing, even going as far as to create his own video game character who was strong, unlike himself. He was good friends with Enomoto Takane before he had particularly terrible symptoms on August 15th. On that day, he disappeared and hasn't been seen since—until Konoha came along, with an apparent bout of amnesia.

name: Me wo Samasu Hebi
description: One of Azami's many snakes that is now connected to Kokonose's eye ability, Awakening Eyes.

name: Shinako Morinome
description:
[Rikuo](https://anilist.co/character/69339/Rikuo-Uozumi)'s former classmate and close friend. She taught at the same high school [Haru](https://anilist.co/character/11766/Haru-Nonaka) attended. She only wishes to be friends with [Rikuo](https://anilist.co/character/69339/Rikuo-Uozumi). She feels at fault for [Haru](https://anilist.co/character/11766/Haru-Nonaka) dropping out.



(Source: Yesterday wo Utatte Wiki)

name: Haru Nonaka
description:
__Height:__ 153 cm

A high school dropout because her school didn't approve of her working at Milk Hall, a cafe and bar, since they serve alcohol in the evening. She has feelings for [Rikuo](https://anilist.co/character/69339/Uozumi-Rikuo) and frequently visits him at his part time job at the convenience store.

Often seen with her pet crow, [Kansuke](https://anilist.co/character/180177/Kansuke).

name: Rikuo Uozumi
description:
Rikuo is a university graduate who has a passion for photography, but lacks motivation to find a career in life. He works part time at a convenience store to pay for his rent and living utilities. Rikuo has feelings for [Shinako](https://anilist.co/character/68127/Shinako-Morinome) ever since their university days.

He works at Nico2 Mart four days a week. [Haru](https://anilist.co/character/11766/Haru-Nonaka) claims that she knew him for a long time, but he has no recollection of her. He has a past that he doesn't want to remember. 

(Source: Yesterday wo Utatte Wiki)

name: Kyouko Sayama
description: Owner of the Milk Hall cafe and bar.

name: Kinoshita
description: Kinoshita is a coworker of Rikuo's, they both work part time at Nico Mart. He is a member of an amateur rock band called Wandering High.

name: Chika Yuzuhara
description: Chika used to date Rikuo in high school. She eventually broke up with him to date someone else. She has tendency to never turn someone down when they confess their feelings towards her, which leads to rumors and her nickname the "Queen of Disaster."

name: Rou Hayakawa
description: Rou is a childhood friend of Shinako's and considers her family. Even though he treats her like an older sister, he has feelings for her.

name: Managing Director
description: He is the managing director at the art gallery where [Uozomi](https://anilist.co/character/69339/Rikuo-Uozumi) works part-time.

name: Youichi Minato
description: Youichi attended the same high school as Haru. They both were taught by Shinako before Haru dropped out.

name: Krulcifer Einfolk
native: クルルシファー・エインフォルク
description:
One of the main female characters. She is a transfer student from the Ymir Theocracy, a powerful nation from the north. She is the user of the Divine Drag-Ride "Fafnir" ファフニール Fafunīru).

(Source: Saijaku Muhai no Bahamut Wiki)

name: Philphie Aingram
native: フィルフィ・アインクラム
description: Lux's childhood friend who is frail, has a notably large bust, and has a sleepy expression on her face. She wields the Divine Drag-Ride "Typhon". She comes from the powerful and influential Aingram merchant house and took Lux and Airi in after their mother's death.

name: Celistia Ralgris
native: セリスティア・ラルグリス
description:
Celistia Ralgris is the Third Year knight leader of the “Knight Squadron”. She was said to be the strongest of the Academy. She's a young woman of the Duke House, one of the four Great Nobles, and she's famous for being a man-hater.

She is user of the Divine Drag-Ride "Lindworm."

(Source: Saijaku Muhai no Bahamut Wikia)

name: Lisesharte Atismata
native: リーズシャルテ・アティスマータ
description:
Lisesharte Atismata is a princess of the New Kingdom of Atismata. At first, Lisha acts like a tsundere, but as series goes on she opens up to Lux little by little.

She is user of the Divine Drag-Ride "Tiamat."

(Source: Saijaku Muhai no Bahamut Wiki)

name: Lux Arcadia
native: ルクス・アーカディア
description: He was a prince from the Empire that was destroyed five years ago due to the coup d'état. He is a Drag-Knight who is called the “Weakest Undefeated” and also the "Black Hero". He is also the user of the Divine Drag-Ride "Bahamut". (Source: saijakumuhainobahamut.wikia.com)

name: Yoruka Kirihime
description: She was the princess of the fallen nation of Koto, later becoming an assassin for the Old Arcadia Empire and then a student of the New Kingdom's Royal Officer Academy.

name: Airi Arcadia
native: アイリ・アーカディア
description: Lux's younger sister.

name: La Krusche
description: She is an Automaton and the supervisor of the Ruin Ark. She appears to be around eleven or twelve years of age. She has light green hair and red eyes. She has mechanical rabbit ears on her head, her feature as an Automaton.

name: Tillfur Lilmit
native: ティルファー・リルミット
description: She's a second-year student in Lux's classroom and one of the elite members of the “Triad”.Tillfur has a very energetic and cheerful personality, and often jokes with and teases others.

name: Fugil Arcadia
native: フギル・アーカディア
description: Lux's older brother.

name: Fudou Nomura
description:
Nomura is a pacifist by nature, but his freedom-loving ideals as well as his cheeky attitude often finds himself rebelling against figures of power and authority. Ultimately, though, he’s a relatively laid-back guy with a cheerful demeanor.

Nomura was originally a talented user of the Jigen-ryū school of Japanese swordsmanship; however, due to extremely harsh and rushed training enforced by his former master, his body was broken beyond repair, which made him incapable of picking up a sword ever again. Instead, he developed his capabilities in hand-to-hand combat, and eventually crafted a powerful technique known as “Madan” (Magic Bullet). This technique utilizes muscle control to focus his strength into the palm of his hand, allowing for a devastating palm strike akin to a shock-wave from any position he so chooses.

name: Rin Onigawara
description:
Leader of the Tenka Goken. Onigawara is known for being merciless and a prominent hater of men, causing many to quit the academy. However, she softens significantly after meeting Nomura, showing many signs of affection.

When her father abandoned their family after having an affair, Onigawara had to deal with the mental backlash of her distraught mother. Because she resembled her father, her mother would call her “ugly” or “ the child of a demon” and would demand her to wear a demon’s mask whenever she was around. This would cement the thought that Onigawara was hiding her “shameful self” by wearing the mask and continued to do so even after she left home.

Onigawara is a skilled practitioner of the Kashima Shinden Jikishinkage-ryū school of Japanese swordsmanship. This style places an emphasis on proper breath control, allowing for improved strength and speed.

name: Satori Tamaba
description:
__Height:__ 156 cm

A member of the Tenka Goken. Satori is said to be reminiscent of a creature of sorts attempting to imitate human-like behavior. Since she primarily lacks the ability to empathize, she tends to act in various extreme ways as a means to compare and explore herself and others. As a result, she can be incredibly unpredictable as said actions are often irrational.



Satori is a user of the Keishi-ryū, a kendo style that consists of 10 different kata of several Ko-ryū and is the style used by the Japanese Police Force.

name: Warabi Hanasaka
description: While Hanasaka fronts a blatantly evil persona, she only acts that way for the sake of her beloved pet bear, Kyoubou. Many have attempted to get rid of Kyoubou from the premises of the academy, so Hanasaka rose to the position of one of the Tenka Goken so that no one would oppose her. Hanasaka is a user of the Taisha-ryū.

name: Kirukiru Amou
description:
A deranged psychopath carrying an unhealthy obsession with [Fudou Nomura](https://anilist.co/character/121446/Nomura-Fudou), seemingly stemming from a twisted sense of love where she demands his total submission before her and is willing to kill him otherwise. She earns the title of “Empress” after defeating two members of the Tenka Goken simultaneously.

Amou specializes in Uechi-ryuu, a traditional style of Okinawan Karate that emphasizes toughness of the body by being attacked and pained while practicing nukite based counter-attacks to a point of being able to respond reflexively. This is the basis for her technique “Auto-counter”.

name: Mary Kikakujou
description: Mary is a prim and proper French-Japanese student and is a member of the Tenka Goken. She is an expert in western-styled fencing in combination with techniques of the Jigen-ryū style. She is also into executing the buriburi style of torture.

name: Tsukuyo Inaba
description:
Tsukuyo is a child prodigy that skipped several grades, making her the youngest member of the Tenka Goken. Despite being so young, however, she is unquestionably the strongest member. 

While blind, she has excellent hearing, to the point that she is capable of hearing most things going on in the academy. Even though she carries a calm and collected demeanor, she can still act childishly, much like the many instances where she likes to show off her knowledge resulting in long rambles.

Tsukuyo is a skilled user of the Yakumaru Jigen-ryū, the descendant style of the Jigen-ryū that Nomura practiced.

name: Kabane Shinden
description:
The Corpse God, later known as Polka Shinoyama, is the main protagonist of Dead Mount Death Play. As a human born with the Evil Eye, the Corpse God (not yet known as such) was sold to the necromancer Easlies Swordfrail at the age of ten and studied Necromancy under her tutelage, eventually becoming an Undead himself. Though he wanted nothing more then to live a peaceful life, the Geldwood church spent a century wanting nothing more than to see him dead. To achieve the peaceful life he so desired, the Corpse God pursues the secret art of reincarnation with the intention of reincarnating as one of his fallen kinsmen. His spell works, but not as fully expected: rather than reincarnating as his kinsman, the Corpse God instead wakes in the corpse of the real Polka Shinoyama, freshly murdered in the Shinjuku ward of Tokyo, Japan.

Despite having reincarnated in a wrong body and world, the Corpse God has concluded this is his best chance yet at having a peaceful life. With the real Polka's permission, he has assumed Polka's name and identity along with Polka's body. His real name is unknown, as it is unpronounceable in Japanese.

name: Misaki Sakimiya
description: Misaki Sakimiya, known professionally as Zaki, is the former heiress to Sakimiya Steel and the assassin hired to kill the original Polka Shinoyama. In the aftermath of her own premature murder and subsequent resurrection as a Zombie—respectfully the accidental and purposeful doing of the Corpse God—she moves in with the Corpse God and assists him with his fortune-telling endeavors. Misaki has since evolved to become a Vampire Larva per the Corpse God's magic, her newfound powers allowing her to better assist him as an offensive agent. At the start of the series, those with the Evil Eye would have been able to see the spirits of Misaki's victims haunting her.

name: Takumi Kuruya
description: Takumi Kuruya is an informant based in Tokyo's Shinjuku Ward who uses illegal drones to collect data alongside other methods; occasionally, he also helps contract killers conceal their victims' corpses. Per Lisa Kuraki's instructions, he has become companion to the Corpse God and assists his fortunetelling business by collection information on clients during their sessions.

name: Xiaoyu Lei
description: Xiaoyu Lei is a former member of the Heilei who currently serves the Shinoyama Clan. His ongoing assignment is to protect Sayo Shinoyama during her residence with the impostor posing as her half uncle.

name: Sayo Shinoyama
description: Sayo Shinoyama is the second eldest granddaughter of Rozan Shinoyama. Currently unemployed, she lives at the Shinoyama mansion.

name: Polka Shinoyama
description: Polka Shinoyama is the second son of Rozan Shinoyama and one of two heirs to the Shinoyama Financial Group. Shortly after running away from home, Polka is assassinated by contract killer Misaki Sakimiya. The Corpse God reincarnates into Polka's freshly murdered body, anchoring Polka's spirit, and soon transfers Polka's spirit to one of Takumi Kuruya's drones. Later, he again transfers Polka's spirit to a stuffed bonito shark toy. Polka has given permission for the Corpse God to use his name and identity, and - as the shark plush - currently accompanies the Corpse God wherever he goes.

name: Miyabi Hosorogi
description:
Miyabi Hosorogi  is a spirit possessing [Misaki Sakimiya's](https://anilist.co/character/205705/) mechanical pencil as per a pact with the [Corpse God](https://anilist.co/character/205706/). He currently works as a 'gimmick' in the Corpse God's fortune-telling business, acting as an autonomous pencil in order to convince clients of the Corpse God's legitimacy.

While alive, Hosorogi was at one point Chief of Police and an Internal Affairs inspector investigating a certain symbol alongside [Tsubaki Iwanome](https://anilist.co/character/255864/). He was murdered before he could see his case through, and his last lingering attachment to the world is his desire to see the case entrusted to Iwanome.

name: Tsubaki Iwanome
description:
**Occupation:** Policeman 
**Affiliation:** Member of Materials Compiling Group No.3.

He is the manager of Materials Compiling Group No.3 and currently in charge of the Phantom Solitaire investigation's jurisdictional side.

name: Kouzaburou Arase
description:
**Occupation:** Policeman 
**Affiliation:** Member of Materials Compiling Group No.3.

He is a former yakuza who works as a detective for the third Materials Compiling Group of the Shinjuku Police's community safety division.

name: Lisa Kuraki
description: Lisa Kuraki, also known as Clarissa, is a mediator and bartender who runs Youtoukorou: a legal bar-illegal freelance agency that operates in Shinjuku.

name: Darui
description:
Darui is a jōnin-level shinobi from Kumogakure. He is also the Commander of the First Division of the Allied Shinobi Forces.   

__Personality__ 

Darui is portrayed as being easy-going and mellow; when compared to the Fourth Raikage's over-the-top exit through a window, he tells C that he'll just use the door. Whilst having a laid-back demeanour, Darui isn't lazy, leaping to the Raikage's defence when the bodyguards of the other Kage overreact to the Raikage's actions. He also has a habit of referring to things or events as being "dull" a play on his name. Darui is also very apologetic, even apologizing for other people's actions, a trait he'd never noticed himself; this attribute led him to say "sorry" just as much as "dull". He is also very loyal to the Raikage who considers Darui his "second right hand". He adresses the Raikage with "boss" rather than "Raikage-sama".   

__Abilities__ 

Darui is a highly skilled and capable shinobi. He learned how to create Black Lightning under the tutelage of the Third Raikage, making his lightning techniques even more powerful. His chakra reserves are great enough to not die of chakra exhaustion after using three of the Treasured Tools of the Sage of the Six Paths and still have enough chakra left to continue fighting. His abilities have earned him the praise and recognition of the Fourth Raikage himself, who appointed Darui as his personal bodyguard and considers him his right-hand man.

name: Kurotsuchi
description: Kurotsuchi is a female shinobi who along with Akatsuchi escorts the Third Tsuchikage, who is her grandfather. She refers to Deidara as Deidara-nii (nii-san = big brother), either as family or a sign of respect.

name: Tono Katasuke
description:
Katasuke Tōno is a tokubetsu jōnin of Konohagakure's Scientific Ninja Weapons Team. 

After the Fourth Great Shinobi War, Katasuke headed up an effort to help all surviving war causalities recover from their maiming injuries. He would often visit and pester [Naruto Uzumaki,](https://anilist.co/character/17/Naruto-Uzumaki) the Seventh Hokage, for approval on various new projects, ultimately getting well-acquainted with the Hokage's family. He developed an advanced form of prosthetics that would allow people to return to normal life. One of his patients was [Ao.](https://anilist.co/character/23420/Ao) At some point, he learned of Chamaru's injury and contacted [Akita Inuzuka](https://anilist.co/character/189947/Akita-Inuzuka) to tell her that he'd make the ninken a prosthetic limb. Upon doing so, the dog made a full recovery, and Akita became his assistant. 

Boruto would often visit Katasuke's lab when he was feeling upset, hoping to see impressive new ninja tools to brighten his mood. Katasuke made a habit of having special edition games around for Boruto to play, and often gave him advice about life to help him feel better.

name: Gaara
description:
__Height:__ 146 cm

Gaara was introduced in the series in Chuunin Exams arc, as a violent shinobi from Konoha's allied country, the Wind country. He came to Konoha with his siblings [Temari](https://anilist.co/character/2174) and [Kankuro](https://anilist.co/character/4694), and with his mentor [Baki](https://anilist.co/character/15081), to participate in Chuunin exams.

name: Daphne Lauros
description:
__Race:__ Human__Height:__ 164 cm (5'5")
__Affiliation:__ Miach Familia (past), Apollo Familia (present)
__Level:__ 3
__Achieved Floor:__ 27
__Status:__ • Strength: I0 • Endurance: I0 • Dexterity: I0 • Agility: I0 • Magic: I0 • Abnormal Resistance: I • Escape: ?
__Skills:__ Elios Passion • Laurus Wreath
__Magic:__ Raumure
__Equipment:__ Fencer Laureate

Daphne Lauros is a member of the Miach Familia and a former member of the Apollo Familia. Daphne is a calm and collected person despite her looks. She has mixed feelings for Apollo due to him taking care of her despite forcing her into his familia, stating that she was thankful, but hated him even more for that. She cares for Cassandra Ilion, although she doesn't believe her visions and dismisses them as dreams.

appearsIn.title: Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? IV Part 2

name: Kaiji Itou
description: The main character of the story. Kaiji is poor, downtrodden and lazy - he lives by himself in a slum and is constantly in debt. He bides his time by playing cheap gambling games with neighbors, though he always loses. In spite of this, when his life is in danger, he displays a remarkable hidden capacity for gambling, which allows him to endure the hardships he faces. He is shouldered with a 3,850,000 yen debt at the beginning of the story by a coworker who convinced him into consigning a loan, leaving Kaiji with the full weight of the debt compounded over a year. Though he started off as somewhat of a naive man, he quickly develops into a clever and thoughtful gambler after his first experience on the Espoir.

name: Jouji Funai
description:
Jouji Funai is one of the veterans (or Repeater) of previous voyages on the Espoir. Funai is an excellent conman and uses the fears and worries of the other competitors to his advantage.

He can be considered the first main antagonist encountered in the Tobaku Mokushiroku Kaiji arc.

name: Yuuji Endou
description:
A dirty loan shark with ties to the yakuza. He lends out large sums of money to the desperate, but charges an absurd (and illegal) interest rate. He tracks down Kaiji after a client of his, Furuhata, disappeared without repaying a loan, which Kaiji cosigned in an act of weakness. Recognizing Kaiji could never repay the loan, Endō offers him the opportunity to board the gambling ship Espoir, where he would be able repay his debt and make some money as well.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Kitami
description:
Kitami is a clear-headed man who Kaiji encounters on the Espoir. 
He came up with the strategy of buying up all the rock cards and holding them constant; as the other cards deplete, he and his men then prey on those who have scissor cards.

name: Takeshi Furuhata
description: Debtor and one-time coworker of Kaiji. One year before the first tournament on Espoir, he lured Kaiji into cosigning a loan for him, making Kaiji liable in case Furuhata did not repay the loan. Although believed to have disappeared, Kaiji discovers him on Espoir and makes an alliance with him after Funai's betrayal. (source: wikipedia)

name: Kouji Ishida
description: A man whom Kaiji saved from the other room on the Espoir on a whim.  Participates in the human derby to clear his wife's debts.

name: Makoto Sahara
description: Kaiji's coworker who wants money to "get his big shot" at life. Participates in the human derby.

name: Yukio Tonegawa
description: Kazutaka Hyoudou's right-hand man and the CEO of the Teiai Corporation. He oversees the majority of Teiai's diabolic gambles and possesses keen powers of observation.

name: Mamoru Andou
description: A bespectacled, fat man who forms and alliance with Kaiji and Furuhata after losing all of his gesture cards. (source: wikipedia)

name: Hiroshi Satou
description:
Hiroshi Satou is from the same class as Reita. He is the epitome of an ultimate normal guy, everything that Kusuo has ever wanted to be. Hiroshi was first introduced as someone who gets the same rank in school as Kusuo. Someone who has boring name, common appearance, average in brains and body and has no single quality to stand out. He blends into the background, so the other characters tend to lose sight of him. Hiroshi has his own circle of friends: a chubby guy and a skinny glasses guy.

He is completely average in everything he does. His grades, height, and weight are exactly average. Down to the millisecond, Hiroshi is timed to have the exact average times for the PE evaluation. He is also noted to go to the bathroom for the average amount of time and use the average amount of toilet paper.

appearsIn.title: The Disastrous Life of Saiki K.: Reawakened

name: Midori Nendou
description: Riki Nendou's mother.

appearsIn.title: The Disastrous Life of Saiki K.: Reawakened

name: Jun Naruse
description:
A girl whose words were sealed away.

(Source: Official website)

name: Takumi Sakagami
description: A boy who avoids talking about his true feelings.

name: Daiki Tasaki
description:
An ex-baseball club ace who spends his days sulking.

(Source: Official website)

name: Natsuki Nitou
description:
An honors student in the cheerleading club who is concerned about love.

(Source: Offical website)

name: Isuzu
aliases: Yamada Asaemon Isuzu (山田浅ェ門威鈴)
description:
__Height:__ 215 cm
__Race:__ Human
__Age:__ Unknown
__Tao Attribute:__ Water
__Occupation:__ Asaemon, Female Combat Instructor
__Rank:__ Unranked

Isuzu is an unranked Asaemon in the Yamada clan. After the shogun became impatient of the first team acquiring the Elixir of Life, Isuzu and [Kiyomaru](https://anilist.co/character/151776/Kiyomaru) were chosen to join [Shugen](https://anilist.co/character/148752/Shugen) and [Jikka](https://anilist.co/character/148756/Jikka) to be a part of the second team sent to acquire the elixir.

Isuzu is very respectful towards her allies and wishes to avoid any conflict between them. In battle, or when one of her allies steps out of line, such as Kiyomaru, Isuzu behavior changes and becomes more serious and fierce. She is also capable of self restraint, that is greatly expressed on her face, when dealing with a troublesome situation. Isuzu highly respects Shugen and follows his view of justice in believing that criminals should not be given mercy or to those that protect them as well.



As a child, Isuzu was sensitive about her stature and would often be referred to her as a gorilla. However, after receiving words of encouragement from her brother about gorillas being strong animals, Isuzu no longer took it as an insult and believed that gorillas embody the concept of bushidō.

name: Tao Fa
description:
__Height:__ 173-185 cm
__Race:__ Tensen
__Tao Attribute:__ Wood
__Occupation:__ Partial Ruler of Kotaku
__Affiliation:__ Lord Tensen, Xu Fu

Tao Fa is a member of Lord Tensen, as well as one of the rulers of Kotaku.

Tao Fa is very cheerful and always seems to be in a good mood. Unlike the other members of Lord Tensen, Tao Fa is rather friendly towards humans, or at least ones that are willing to cooperate with Lord Tensen's plans. However, she still carries the same view of using them as tools and shows no signs of sympathy towards them. Because she specializes in Bōchū Jutsu, Tao Fa is quite vulgar and often likes to flirt with others.

Tao Fa is always being protected by [Ju Fa](https://anilist.co/character/151772/Ju-Fa) since they had been by each others side from the moment they were born, because of that [Rien](https://anilist.co/character/148754/Rien) stated that the two were special in that they are in fact two of a whole.

Tao Fa had stated that they preferred the female gender because of their liking to their appearance. As such, they also acted feminine on top of their appearance.

name: Makiya Moro
description:
__Height:__ 191 cm

Death row convict recruited to find the Elixir of Life. Makiya had an ambition to overthrow the shogun and went about it by forming a cult that was based off of multiple religions.

name: Genji
aliases: Yamada Asaemon Genji (山田浅ェ門源嗣)
description: __Height:__ 205 cm

name: Yui
description:
__Race:__ Human
__Occupation:__ House Wife
__Affiliations:__ Iwagakure

Yui is the daughter of the [Iwagakure chief](https://anilist.co/character/301607/Osa) and the wife of [Gabimaru](https://anilist.co/character/137260/Gabimaru).

Yui is very kind, caring and gentle. She truly loves Gabimaru and believes that he is not completely emotionless as people make him out to be. She accepts the fact that he kills people and is not terrified being around him. Yui is also shown to be wise as she gave Gabimaru words of wisdom on why he should relax his body while giving him a bath. She is very civilized as she taught Gabimaru basic manners when they became a couple.

Yui was born as the daughter of the Iwagakure chief. Being born a female, Yui was not trained in the ways of the shinobi and instead lived a semi-normal life within the village.

name: Somali
description: A young human girl who is found by [Golem](https://anilist.co/character/140697/Golem) in his forest. She has endless curiosity, which usually gets her in trouble. She wears a hood on her head with minotaur horns to hide her human features since humans are a delicacy in the monster world.

name: Golem
description: An ancient automaton protector of the forest who stumbles upon [Somali](https://anilist.co/character/140696/Somali) while patrolling the woods. He exhibits no emotions, but instinctively protects Somali from any potential threat. He acts like Somali's father and is referred by her as "Dad".

name: Kokilila
description: A Woolly Shurigara who runs a diner in Anthole City. He's Kikila's father.

name: Jirou Jou
description: Jirō Jō is a 1st-year economics student at Kansei University. He is the younger twin brother of Tarō Jō. He is a resident of room 201 at Chikuseisou. Joji has a yellow spiky hair. He is often seen wearing a necklace and a long sleeve shirt underneath a yellow shirt and shorts. He and his brother played soccer for three years in high school. The only two things he knows how to cook is pasta and a simple ochazuke. Originally intending to run for the sake of becoming popular with girls, he realize that running was something enjoyable in itself.

name: Yukihiko Iwakura
description:
Height: 170 cm (5'7)

Yukihiko Iwakura is one of the Aotake runners. He is a 4th-year law student at Kansei University and the resident of room 102 at Chikuseisou. Yuki is a rather slim yet lean young man. His skin is a pale peach color. He has side-swept black hair and an undercut. He also wears glasses and piercings on his ears. He is often seen wearing a blue sweatshirt and black pants. He is short-tempered and gets easily annoyed by his teammate's actions. However, he does care about his teammates and often jokes with them. He is very detail-oriented as seen when he points out Shindo's lower center of gravity. He is an avid clubber and often boasts the fact that he passed the lawyer's bar exam in one go to any girl he meets. Yuki was initially reluctant to run and was bent on defying Haiji's enthusiasm, but eventually got drawn into it as the others members did. He hates the smell of tobacco coming from Akihiro's smoking until he quit for running.

name: Musa Kamala
description:
Height: 176 cm (5'9)

Musa is a native to Tanzania. He moved to Japan to study Space and Engineering as a sponsored international student at Kansei University. His Japanese still has flaws leading to some misunderstandings and written mistakes. Kind and earnest, Musa is always supportive of his other team members and is well known by the residents of the local shopping district. He is the resident of room 203 at Chikuseisou. Musa is a young man with tall build. He has a dark-toned skin and has black colored shaved hair. He enjoys meditating in the dark in the Aotake bathtub from time to time.

name: Akihiro Hirata
description:
Height: 178 cm (5'10)

Akihiro Hirata is a 3rd-year science and engineering student at Kansei University. Hirata is resident of room 104 at Chikuseiso. Nico is the tallest among the Aotake runners with a muscular statue. He also has a light beard and chin-length brown hair, which he wears in a low ponytail. He is often seen in sweats. His nickname, Nico-chan-senpai, comes from the abbreviation of the word nicotine due to his past cigarette addiction. It is also seen that the residents of Aotake will just draw a cigarette doodle in place of his name on the chore chart. In an effort to stop smoking, he took up wire sculpting, quickly accumulating dozens of little metal figurines. Yuki later capitalizes on this and sells them to help fund the track team. Prior to entering Kansei University, he ran Track during high school but quit due to his coach. As Akihiro picked up running again under Haiji's influence, he stopped smoking and began to make small metallic figures as a substitute.

name: Kakeru Kurahara
description:
Height: 172 cm (5'8)

Kakeru has short, straight black hair and slate-colored eyes. When he runs, the wind pushes his hair to the back. He has a lean and athletic build that was developed over the years of competitive running. He often maintains a serious expression and he is usually seen wearing his sky blue sports jacket and gray sweatpants.

Kakeru is a first-year sociology student at Kansei University and the current resident of Room 103 of Chikuseisou. A prodigious athlete since high school who became disillusioned due to an incident in his old Track and Field team. He first joined the Chikuseisou after Haiji met him stealing from a convenience store. Personality-wise Kakeru is rather cold towards his fellow runners and takes running very seriously. He also doesn't like when he has to slow down to match the pace of others. However after joining Kansei Track and Field time he slowly learns what it really means to run.

name: Akane Kashiwazaki
description:
Height: 167 cm (5'6")

Nicknamed "Prince" because of his good looks, Prince is a 2nd year literature student at Kansei University. He is most notably known for having copious amounts of manga in his room and being the slowest runner in the group with the most unique running style. Prince currently stays in room 204 in Chikuseisou. Prince is rather inactive and occasionally speaks in dramatized speech. It is noted by Musa that he speaks in a more proper Japanese than the rest of the team. He began as one of the most reluctant and slowest members due to his lack of physical stamina and indoor tendencies. Akane picked up his training after Takashi had his family send over a treadmill for him to remain indoors to read manga. After finding true inspiration from his friends at Chikuseisou and Kakeru's presence, he pushes himself beyond his limitations.

name: Haiji Kiyose
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7)

Haiji Kiyose is the deuteragonist in the series Run with the Wind. He is a 4th year literature student in Kansei University Student and a long time resident of Chikuseisou. He is the resident of room 101 of Chikuseisou. He has a friendly and outgoing personality, but underneath has a bit of a manipulative side. He's never willing to compromise on his dreams, even if it means reasonably threatening his housemates in the process. Despite this, he is very caring towards his teammates. He has shown concern towards them throughout the show. 

 He is the cook of the Chikuseisou.

name: Takashi Sugiyama
description:
Height: 167 cm (5'6)

Takashi Sugiyama is a third-year business student at Kansei University. He is the resident of room 205 at Chikuseisou. Generally considered an honor student by the other residents of Chikuseisou, Takashi is an earnest student from the Yamagata Prefecture- a mountainy region. He used to walk ten kilometers through the mountains to get to school and back every day. He was the first convinced by Haiji to give running a chance and has been a significant driving force behind the others. His dedication towards training originally stemmed from wanting to inspire and impress his family, but eventually became something entirely his own.Shindou has light brown hair and curved eyes. He has a mole under one of his eyes. He has a pretty small stature compared to his teammates. He is often seen wearing sweatshirts and pants. Shindou is shown to be very determined and dedicated to running, despite just starting out. He is very pure and wants to help his friends.

name: Youhei Sakaguchi
description:
Height: 165 cm (5'5)

Yōhei Sakaguchi is one of the Aotake runners. Known as 'King' due to his love of trivia, Yohei is a 4th year Sociology student at Kansei University. He is the resident of room 205 at Chikuseisou. He has a buzz cut, a large nose, and black eyes. Yohei can usually be seen wearing a yellow tracksuit or an orange sweatshirt with grey sweats. He is a joker and is very desperate to get a job, even going as far as joining in Haiji's dream because of the idea of the experience in the Hakone Ekiden could help him land a job. He seems to be shy around people and has trouble opening up to them. Besides his nightly trivia marathons, he's generally preoccupied by job hunting to no avail. Yohei eventually relented and joined in the team's efforts due to the earnest words of Takashi.

name: Tarou Jou
description:
Height: 172 cm (5'8)

Tarō Jō is a 1st-year economics student at Kansei Univeristy. He is the older twin brother of Jirō Jō. He is a resident of room 201 at Chikuseisou. He and his brother played soccer for three years in high school. He goes by Jota and is nearly indistinguishable from his younger brother. The two think and act in tandem. Though he was originally driven by the intention to attract girls through running, Jota came to appreciate the sport. He wears green and purple accent running shoes.

name: Dende
description: Dende is a Namekian who takes the role of the Earth's god after Kami fuses with Piccolo. He is first introduced in the Namek Saga when Son Gohan and Kuririn save him from Dodoria. He gets his power unlocked by their elder, giving him the power to heal. He aids the warriors during the fight with Freeza until he is killed by the tyrant. After being revived by Shenlong, he lives on New Namek until Son Goku can teleport there during the Cell Saga to ask a Namekian to become the new God of Earth and revive the Dragon Balls. Dende accepts, and continues to serve as the God throughout the rest of the series.  Source - Wikipedia

name: Noufu
description: The Farmer (an ostrich farmer) was the first human to encounter the Saiyan warrior Raditz upon his arrival on Earth and the first person to have a certified power level in Dragon Ball Z.

name: Chaozu
description: Chiaotzu is seemingly a small, doll-like human with plain white skin and red cheeks; his name is based off of the food jiaozi. When first introduced Chiaotzu is a student of the Crane Hermit (a rival of Master Roshi) and the constant companion of fellow student Tien; he quickly amends his ways though and joins Goku and his friends. While not outstanding in physical prowess compared to other superhuman warriors in Dragon Ball, Chiaotzu has considerable potency in psionics, especially in psychokinesis. Chiaotzu is not very well educated, as shown in the Tien Shinhan Saga. There was one part where Krillin was called "squid" due to his shaved head. Krillin angered and said that Chiaotzu was also a bald. But Chiaotzu took off his cap, revealling ONE hair on top of his head (which makes Krillin very angry). Chiaotzu lost the battle in the 22nd Martial Arts Tournament by Krillin's maths knowledge.    Chiaotzu's importance in the series rapidly diminishes after his introduction in the Tenshinhan Saga, where he is a major character. He is a minor character in the subsequent Demon King Piccolo, Piccolo Junior and Vegeta sagas, and is more-or-less a background character for the others. Chiaotzu also has a prominent role in the Dragon Ball movie "Mystical Adventure".    *Wikipedia

name: Fleur Boland
description: A merchant staying at the same inn in Renos as Lawrence and Holo.

name: Helena
description: Helena is a waitress working at the Tails of Beasts and Fishes restaurant in the town of Renose.

name: Lurie Abendroth
native: ルリイ＝アーベントロート
description: A daughter of the Abendroth House. She has a crush on Matthias since the first day they met and bears the "First Crest" just like Matthias's previous reincarnation.

appearsIn.title: The Strongest Sage with the Weakest Crest
The Strongest Sage with the Weakest Crest

name: Matthias Hildesheimer
native: マティアス＝ヒルデスハイマー
description: Known as "Gaius" in his previous life around 5000+ years ago, he reincarnated himself as Matthias in order to obtain a new Crest by his Reincarnation magic, which would be better than his "First Crest". He was able to successfully achieve his goal upon reincarnation in the form of "Fourth Crest". His main goal in life is to gain power so that he could challenge and fight against the powerful Monsters in the Outer Space.

appearsIn.title: The Strongest Sage with the Weakest Crest
The Strongest Sage with the Weakest Crest

name: Alma Lepucius
description: The 3rd Daughter of the Lepucius House. She is a best friend of Lurie and bears the "Second Crest". Although her magic power is lower than Matthias and Lurie, she has been good with her archery skills.

appearsIn.title: The Strongest Sage with the Weakest Crest
The Strongest Sage with the Weakest Crest

name: Iris
description: Also known as the "Black Dragon Iris", she is one of the oldest and strongest Dragons still alive. She is the only one who knows Matthias's true identity after reunited thousand years later and decided to keep it a secret upon his request.

appearsIn.title: The Strongest Sage with the Weakest Crest
The Strongest Sage with the Weakest Crest

name: Kokuou
description: The King of Eis Kingdom.

appearsIn.title: The Strongest Sage with the Weakest Crest
The Strongest Sage with the Weakest Crest

name: Devilius
description: He's the representative from the first academy. He appeared to be a demon

appearsIn.title: The Strongest Sage with the Weakest Crest

name: Feikus
description: The First Royal Academy's principal.

appearsIn.title: The Strongest Sage with the Weakest Crest

name: Ashril
description: **Species**: Demon

name: Iroha Igarashi
description:
A beautiful and flashy high school student dating [Tsutsui](https://anilist.co/character/83235/Tsutsui--Hikari). She is a very honest and easy-going person often fooling around with her close friends. 

Iroha is a very honest girl who is a little bit shy, but not all that much and she is also quite easy-going and can get jealous rather easily. She doesn't like it when others say rude things about her friends.

name: Hikari Tsutsui
description: An awkward otaku who has bad luck with relationships but is ironically dating [Igarashi Iroha](https://anilist.co/character/83237/Iroha-Igarashi). He has a very timid personality which often leads others to push him around.

name: Sumie Ayado
description: A shy high school student and otaku. Due to her very timid personality, she is often seen isolating herself from other classmates. She views Tsutsui greatly due to their similar interests and views Iroha as an idol, wishing to be like her.

name: Arisa Ishino
description:
An outgoing high school student friends with [Tsutsui](https://anilist.co/character/83235/Tsutsui--Hikari) and [Iroha](https://anilist.co/character/83237/Iroha-Igarashi). She has a hard time judging other people and is gullible, often being misled by boys.

Arisa is a bit nosy and is a bad judge of character, but she is still friendly enough to become friends with Hikari Tsutsui and Iroha Igarashi, despite their reputations.

name: Yuuto Itou
description:
An innocent high school otaku and best friend of [Tsutsui](https://anilist.co/character/83235/Tsutsui--Hikari). He is known for wearing cat ears on his head often causing his classmates to distance themselves from Yuuto. He is a very caring and kind person who supports Tsutsui in every way he can.

Ito is very kind and cares for his friends. He is awkward when meeting new people.

name: Mitsuya Takanashi
description:
A popular and handsome high school student. He has feelings for [Iroha](https://anilist.co/character/83237/Iroha-Igarashi) and often flirts with her in hopes of making her his girlfriend. He views [Tsutsui](https://anilist.co/character/83235/Tsutsui--Hikari) as his rival and is incredibly jealous of him to the point where he spreads false rumors about him.

Takanashi was initially snobbish, deceptive, and arrogant to the point of ruining Hikari Tsutsui reputation just so he could have a chance with Iroha Igarashi by spreading rumors that Hikari was a lolicon. Later though, after witnessing the gravity of his actions, he begins to feel a bit of remorse and eventually apologizes to Hikari's family along with his younger sister who assisted him with this act. He eventually begins to tag along with Hikari and his group of friends more. He begins to act more like a friend to Hikari as the story progresses and starts to care more about Arisa Ishino, although he continuously denied it that this hints he is having feelings for her and plays into the "tsundere" trope.

name: Pecorine
description:
__Race:__ Human
__Height:__ 156 cm

Possessing a voracious appetite and boundless energy, Pecorine lives a seemingly carefree life from meal to meal. She is ever optimistic and is proactive in making friends, regardless of their attitude in return. Pecorine also loves to travel in search of exotic delicacies, and pays respect to all life by not letting any food that is prepared go to waste. She is the Guild Master of the guild 'Gourmet Edifice'.

name: Karyl
description:
**Race:** Beast
**Height:** 152 cm

Karyl can be described as a 'Tsundere' as she is often complaining about her friend, but always follows along regardless. She has a sharp tongue and often gets annoyed and/or flustered. She tries to act tough and harsh on the outside but in fact she is quite soft-hearted. She is a member of the guild 'Gourmet Edifice'. She also likes to play with cats.

name: Kokkoro
description:
**Race:** Elf
**Height:** 140 cm

A member of the guild Gourmet Edifice.

name: Yuuki
description: An amnesiac with good intentions but often clueless.

name: Shiori
description:
__Race:__ Beast
__Height:__ 153 cm

Shiori is a calm and reserved girl. She has a condition that leaves her rather sickly and staying at The Farm helps her condition with its outdoor atmosphere. She is the younger sister of [Hatsune Kashiwazaki](https://anilist.co/character/169507/Hatsune) and a member of the guild 'Elizabeth Park', she also likes reading and strolling.
