description: [Twitter](https://x.com/hanatirukoko) | [Syosetsu](https://mypage.syosetu.com/1678681/) | [Kakuyomu](https://kakuyomu.jp/users/rainless)

name: Hugh McGrath
description: Lune's guild master

name: Sensei
description: A talented writer, on the brink of ending his life alongside his cherished "Sachiko", was unexpectedly struck by a "that truck" and transported to another world. Carrying his favorite sleeping pills, he is always searching for a place to die.

appearsIn.title: No Longer Allowed in Another World
No Longer Allowed In Another World

name: Annette
description: A priest at the Airsten Cathedral where Sensei was transferred. A pure-hearted person who devotes herself to others.

appearsIn.title: No Longer Allowed in Another World
No Longer Allowed In Another World

name: Nir
description: A boy whose job is introducing travelling bodyguards in the village of Viridis. The sword passed down from his father holds great value to him.

appearsIn.title: No Longer Allowed in Another World
No Longer Allowed In Another World

name: Tama
description: A martial artist girl who Sensei helped. Although she has a competitive personality, she also has an honest and cute side.

appearsIn.title: No Longer Allowed in Another World
No Longer Allowed In Another World

name: Suzuki
description: A transferee who appeared in the city of Veil. He is gifted with the ability "Absolute Obedience (Pet)", which makes anyone he pets into his slave unconditionally.

appearsIn.title: No Longer Allowed in Another World

name: Yuriko
description: She is one of the "Seven Fallen Angels", the heroes who defeated the Demon King, and is known as the "Fallen Angel of Greed". She has the gift of "Greed", and takes the form of a schoolgirl.

appearsIn.title: No Longer Allowed in Another World

name: Kotetsu
description: One of the two attendants at [Nanami's](https://anilist.co/character/18343/Momozono-Nanami) shrine. Appears to be a bald childlike yokai wearing masks, but like [Tomoe](https://anilist.co/character/18344/Tomoe) is able to shapeshift. Is extremely fond of Nanami and Tomoe both.

name: Jirou
description: On the first few parts, Jirou was known as a cruel leader. He was merciless and banished many other tengu when they showed any sign of weakness. An example was how he had treated Kurama when he had been younger.

name: Shinjirou Kurama
description:
__Species:__ Tengu Yokai
__Height:__ 183 cm (6'0")
__Occupation:__ Idol

A wildly popular idol with the gimmick of being a "fallen angel", with goth makeup and a bad boy attitude.

He is a crow tengu who wished to become the land god instead of [Nanami](https://anilist.co/character/18343/Momozono-Nanami) by eating her heart. After being thwarted by [Tomoe](https://anilist.co/character/18344/Tomoe), he becomes friendly with Nanami and even allows her to stay at his apartment when she temporarily loses her godhood. He has a lingering dislike for Tomoe.

He left Kurama mountain 16 years ago and has been living in human world since then. He also shown to have more normal human's attitude than the others (Tomoe, [Mizuki](https://anilist.co/character/37872/Mizuki), etc.).

name: Mizuki
description:
A snake familiar at the Yonomori shrine.

[Nanami](https://anilist.co/character/18343/Momozono-Nanami) saved his life from her cruel classmates by releasing him out a window, he fell in love with her, so he left an engagement mark on her wrist. After a day, he arrives at her school and whisks her away to the shrine, which she is unable to escape from.

Unlike other snakes, he was apparently raised in a greenhouse and has little knowledge of how most snakes behave. Mizuki is also very lonely because his god has vanished; she once existed when people visited the shrine and believed in her, but now no one lives in the valley and she has dwindled away to nothing. However, he still believes that she exists and will return. As a result, he wants Nanami to live with him forever at his shrine, but when she refuses he tries to rape her and is interrupted by [Tomoe](https://anilist.co/character/18344/Tomoe).

It is revealed that the shrine is an illusion meant to hide his god's favorite plum tree, which Mizuki treasured. Nanami promised to come look at the blossoms with him whenever he felt lonely. Like [Kurama](https://anilist.co/character/24252/Kurama-Shinjirou) he seems to still be harboring a crush on Nanami, and even comes to cook for her when she's ill.

name: Onikiri
description: One of the two attendants at [Nanami's](https://anilist.co/character/18343/Momozono-Nanami) shrine. Appears to be a bald childlike yokai wearing masks, but like [Tomoe](https://anilist.co/character/18344/Tomoe) is able to shapeshift. Is  extremely fond of Nanami and Tomoe both.

name: Isobe
description: An annoying classmate of Nanami's, who enjoys calling attention to her poverty.

name: Yuuko Kanoe
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm
__Age:__ 15 
A young girl who was left to die alone in the old school building of Seikyou Private Academy long ago. She has no recollection of how she died and is currently searching for clues together with [Teiichi Niiya](https://anilist.co/character/34471/Niiya-Teiichi). As a ghost, she is normally invisible to the people in the school, with the exceptions of Teiichi and [Kirie Kanoe](https://anilist.co/character/39417/Kanoe-Kirie), a blood relative who can also see her.

Apparently, she has grown fond of Teiichi and has expressed her desire to be by his side forever.   Except for Teiichi, the other members are unaware that Yuuko is actually the 'absentee' president of the Paranormal Investigations Club.   Meanwhile, the surname "Kanoe" is derived from the 7th sign of the Chinese calendar, which originally meant "evening star" and also means "a person's age".

In the anime series, Yuuko is attributed to autumn leaves and the sky during sunset, which both share the same fiery hues. "

name: Kirie Kanoe
description: In her first appearance, she warns [Niiya](https://anilist.co/character/34471/Niiya-Teiichi) about [Yuuko](https://anilist.co/character/30273/Kanoe-Yuuko).

name: Teiichi Niiya
description: Teiichi is a pupil in the school [Yuuko](https://anilist.co/character/30273/Kanoe-Yuuko) died about 50 years ago, he once heard rumors about a spirit in the school who was left to die alone. Teiichi is able to see her and wants to help Yuuko to find out why she died.

name: Momoe Okonogi
description:
The most enthusiastic member of the Paranormal Investigations Club, Momoe is a year older than [Niiya](https://anilist.co/character/34471/Niiya-Teiichi) and begins to develop feelings for him after seeing his dedication to solving the Seven Mysteries. Like most people, she is not able to see [Yuuko](https://anilist.co/character/30273/Kanoe-Yuuko).

Momoe also becomes close friends with [Kirie](https://anilist.co/character/39417/Kanoe-Kirie) by the time of the school festival. Officially, Momoe is a member of the school's Third Newspaper Club, but she is able to participate in the activities of both clubs due to the unofficial nature of the Paranormal Investigations Club.

She is also someone who easily believes in any urban legend she comes across.

name: Yuuko Kirishima
description: A second year student who shares the same first name with the ghost in the school's stories. Because of this, she becomes the target of unwanted attention from the other students around her.

name: Manako Kawatou
description: Appears in episode 5.

name: Yukariko Kanoe
description: Yukariko is [Kirie](https://anilist.co/character/39417/Kanoe-Kirie)'s grandmother and one of the school directors. She is [Yuuko](https://anilist.co/character/30273/Kanoe-Yuuko)'s younger sister.

name: Hitomi Nishikawa
description: Appears in episode 5.

name: Sonchou
description: He was the village chief 60 years ago.

name: Asa
description: [Yuuko Kanoe](https://anilist.co/character/30273/Kanoe-Yuuko)'s friend. Suffered from unknown illness during the plague epidemic 60 years ago. Appears in flashback in episode 10.

name: Saori Makishima
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm   

One of Kirino's otaku friends. She is a tall, bespectacled girl dressed in otaku fashion. Her alias Bajeena is a clear reference to Quattro Bajeena from Zeta Gundam.   She is the moderator for the 'Otaku Girls Unite' Community.

name: Yoshino Kousaka
description: Yoshino is the mother of Kyousuke and Kirino. Her role in the family is pretty neutral; however, she often takes Kirino's side when arguing with her husband, Kousaka Daisuke. She has a rather sarcastic yet playful personality. She enjoys making fun of Kyousuke, especially concerning his porn collection. Kyousuke suspects that she goes through his porn collection checking for new additions every time she cleans his room. However, she doesn't seem to mind that Kyousuke owns porn; in fact, she finds it somewhat amusing.  She will always cook curry rice for lunch and dinner. Kyousuke finds it strange having almost curry rice every day of the week. Probably, it is the easiest dish to cook.

name: Manami Tamura
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm

Manami is Kyousuke's classmate and childhood friend. She usually behaves in a pretty traditional mindset, which Kyousuke made fun of her by calling her 'grandma'. In return, Manami calls him 'grandpa'. Kyousuke would sometime drop by her house for studying.

name: Ayase Aragaki
description:
__Height:__ 166 cm

Ayase is [Kirino Kousaka](https://anilist.co/character/24544/Kousaka-Kirino)'s friend and classmate who works as a model alongside her and is also her best friend.

Ayase is a friendly, nice, and refined lady, but becomes agitated and somewhat violent at the thought that she is being lied to, which she hates above all else. She tends to believe what she sees on the news. Therefore, she disapproves of anime and manga, calling it a disgusting hobby, especially eroge, due to the media portrayal that otaku will eventually become criminals.

Originally she had a simple crush on [Kyousuke](https://anilist.co/character/24543/Kousaka-Kyousuke), thinking of him as Kirino's caring brother. That all changed when she finds out of Kirino's otaku hobby and how he was aware of it and helps support it. She later refers to Kyosuke when she needs to talk about Kirino and her hobby, even asking for his help in making up with Kirino. However, she still dislikes him, believing him to be the reason for Kirino being an otaku. She is also friends with [Manami](https://anilist.co/character/31007/Tamura-Manami) and even exchanged numbers with her.

name: Bridget Evans
native: ブリジット・エヴァンス
description:
__Height:__ 151cm

Bridget is a girl from England, who initially gets popular with her cosplaying video on Nico Nico Douga and eventually wins the championship of the 1st Stardust Witch Meruru Cosplay Contest by playing Alpha Omega.

name: Yuzu Kichougasaki
description: She is in love with her sister [Akane Hiyama](https://anilist.co/character/122435/Hiyama-Akane).

name: Akane Hiyama
description: The school's idol who [Seiji](https://anilist.co/character/122437/Aino-Seiji) is in love with, she turns out to be a yandere. Although they have different surnames, she's also the older sister of [Yuzu Kichougasaki](https://anilist.co/character/122433/Kichougasaki-Yuzu).

name: Guri
description: An Angel/Cupid. She often treats her duty as a Cupid like a joke, forming almost exclusively gay couples due to her love for male romance.

name: Seiji Aino
description: Seiji is a more-or-less level headed individual, trying to please all the women around him without hurting them. He is a high school student and older brother of [Akua Aino](https://anilist.co/character/122432/Aino-Akua).

name: Shikimi Shiramine
description: The sadistic, hollow, and manipulative cousin of [Akane](https://anilist.co/character/122435/Hiyama-Akane) and [Yuzu](https://anilist.co/character/122433/Kichougasaki-Yuzu).

name: Tarou Tsuruoka
description: He is Yuzu's personal attendant and chauffeur assigned to her by her mother, Ameisha.

name: Akua Aino
description: Seiji's tomboyish younger sister.

name: Kyuuma Kagami
description:
She is Kaname's classmate and is always looking for her. She lacks logic and always draws queer conclusions. In a word: a klutz.

(Source: Tonikaku Kawaii Wiki)

appearsIn.title: TONIKAWA: Over The Moon For You Season 2

name: Ouka Nakiri
description:
She was Nasa's classmate in middle school and is the same age as him. She currently owns an electronics store and apparently, she doesn't have any clear desire for affective relationships.

(Source: Tonikaku Kawaii Wiki)

appearsIn.title: TONIKAWA: Over The Moon For You Season 2

name: Toast
description: [Nasa](https://anilist.co/character/130944) and [Tsukasa](https://anilist.co/character/131106)'s cat.

appearsIn.title: TONIKAWA: Over The Moon For You Season 2

name: Tokiko Tsukuyomi
description: She was the minister of education, but she resigned a few days after Nasa and Tsukasa married. As for why she says she is worried about her health and she may no longer be involved in politics due to her age. She has great influence and power. Indeed, she easily tracks down Tsukasa's location while she was still living in Nasa's apartment.

appearsIn.title: TONIKAWA: Over The Moon For You Season 2

name: Kusuriuri
description:
A mysterious wandering man with a vast knowledge of the supernatural and is mystical in appearance. He carries around a large wooden box filled with medicine and holy tools. Among them is an enchanted sword that is used to slay the mononoke. To use the sword, the Medicine Seller must find the "Katachi" (shape), "Makoto" (truth), and "Kotowari" (reasoning) of the mononoke he wishes to exorcise. Once the sword has been unsheathed, he transforms into a demon-like creature.

While his origins are unknown, it is clear that the Medicine Seller is not human or at least not entirely human; he has elf-like ears, and pointy canine teeth. Even in the time-skip Bakeneko arc, the Medicine Seller still appears as the same handsome youth from the previous arcs (the only differences in his appearance from previous arcs is he now wears small round red stud earrings and a ring on his index finger).

name: Genyousai Yanagi
description: A minstrel who is also an exorcist of some skill. Narcissistic and theatrical, he prides himself on his knowledge in the occult. While on the boat, he considers the Medicine Seller as a rival.

name: Chiyo Nomoto
description: She appears in the Bakeneko of Mononoke. She is involved with the others witnesses in the new metro.

name: Shino
description: A pregnant western woman who took shelter at the inn, hoping to protect her unborn baby from assassins. She encounters the Zashiki-warashi while staying there.

name: Hyoue Sasaki
description: A loner and soft-spoken, he is a servant to the Lord of Shioya. He carves wood when at leisure. His disheveled appearance and squeaky voice coupled with the possession of a katana gives him a dangerous presence.

name: Souta Takanashi
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm

Souta is a high school student recruited by [Popura](https://anilist.co/character/24417/Taneshima-Popura) to become a new employee at the family restaurant Wagnaria.

He is enamored by cute things and thus favors Poplar over the other employees due to her cute appearance. He voices his thoughts out loud and occasionally offends his co-workers, often resulting in him getting punished by them. He usually finds his co-workers and the rules of the restaurant to be strange, but he still has an attachment to his job. He can adapt quickly to his job at the restaurant.

He has three older sisters and it is because of them that caused his dislike for older women as he had been tormented by them all his life. He received hand-me-downs from his sisters when he was young, giving him the appearance of a little girl. He also has a younger sister in elementary school who is almost as tall as he is.

name: Aoi Yamada
description:
Aoi is a mysterious, self-proclaimed 16-year-old girl who [Otoo](https://anilist.co/character/32294/Otoo-Hyougo) meets on his travels to find his missing wife. He brings her back to Wagnaria where she starts working as a waitress and living in Wagnaria’s attic.

While she has great confidence in herself, during work she is an unhelpful troublemaker who gets yelled at by other staff members, especially [Souta](https://anilist.co/character/24418/Takanashi-Souta). Since she is in training, her position among the staff is low, which she complains about. She is bad with dealing with Souta’s constant complaints about her, but she does write down some of his suggestions (along with idle complaints).

She yearns for the idea of having a family, especially towards Otoo whom she sees as an ideal father figure, and goes as far as to apply to be adopted by him.

Her favorite food is natto.

name: Yachiyo Todoroki
description:
Yachiyo is another employee at the restaurant. She usually carries around a katana which, according to her, was made by her parents who used to be blacksmiths. Yachiyo is unaware that some of the customers, and even [Souta](https://anilist.co/character/24418/Takanashi-Souta), are intimidated by her blade.

She admires [Kyouko](https://anilist.co/character/24420/Shirafuji-Kyouko) considerably. She gets angry if anyone offers Kyouko food or tries to take her away, although is willing to allow Satou to feed her because she considers him trustworthy, much to his chagrin.

name: Hiroomi Souma
description:
A chef who works in the kitchen, he is a young man with an easygoing attitude.

He often blackmails other workers to do his job for him and pass it off as a form of modesty from the other employees. He can blackmail anyone except [Inami](https://anilist.co/character/24419/Inami-Mahiru), who punches him even before he manages to talk to her. He is terrified of Inami's urges and is thankful for [Souta](https://anilist.co/character/24418/Takanashi-Souta)'s existence in the restaurant since Inami is taking out her urges all on Souta and not him.

name: Mahiru Inami
description:
__Height:__ 166 cm

Inami is a timid girl who joins the rest of the employees at Wagnaria.

She has androphobia and is thus terrified of men; she punches any male that comes near her. This violent behavior arises from her belief that every man is ready to attack her, but instead, she is prone to violently attacking men at a moment's notice. This androphobia was caused by her father who did not want her to eventually wed due to jealousy and thus told her that males would attack her, which ended in her fearing men since then.

As she and [Souta](https://anilist.co/character/24418/Takanashi-Souta) usually share shifts, he takes the brunt of her attacks. However, she makes considerable progress with her fear of men by taking it out on Souta; she states that she can be about two meters close to guys without having the urge to hit them. Though this extends to only having fairly civil conversations (often ruined by Souta's rudeness) or if Inami launches an attack on him.

She wears a hairpin in her hair, which she changes every day due to Souta's compliment on it (according to Souma). At first, she begins to develop a crush, but later she falls in love with Souta when he confronts her father (as Kotori) about her androphobia.

name: Jun Satou
description:
A chef who works in the kitchen, Satou is a helpful but intimidating individual.

He is in love with [Yachiyo](https://anilist.co/character/30905/Todoroki-Yachiyo), but has problems expressing it. Of course, because she is so devoted to [Kyouko](https://anilist.co/character/24420/Shirafuji-Kyouko), she fails to recognize any hints he attempts to make.

He likes to take out his anger on [Popura](https://anilist.co/character/24417/Taneshima-Popura) by messing with her or bending the truth, to which Popura naively believes. When [Souma](https://anilist.co/character/30686/Souma-Hiroomi) tries to help with Satou's development with Yachiyo, Satou unrelentingly hits him with a pan, showing that he is sensitive about his feelings for Yachiyo.

name: Popura Taneshima
description: Popura is a short 17-year-old high school student who works at Wagnaria. Ironically, she was named after the poplar tree so that she would grow tall. She is a hard worker, but she sometimes makes clumsy mistakes in her job. She is very sensitive about her small appearance; many customers usually mistake her to be younger than she really is. She often fails to gain respect from [Souta](https://anilist.co/character/24418/Takanashi-Souta), who is one year younger than her, as he usually regards her as an elementary school student. She is also unable to properly call him by his surname, saying "Katanashi" rather than "Takanashi", even when corrected.

name: Kyouko Shirafuji
description:
Kyouko is the manager of Wagnaria.

She usually maintains a rather apathetic attitude about how the restaurant is run and almost never bothers to do any work herself. She is not beyond using violence to deal with unruly customers and firmly believes that employees come before the customers, as the employees are the ones doing all the work. She is 28 years old, but she becomes despondent whenever her age is mentioned.

Kyouko saved [Yachiyo](https://anilist.co/character/30905/Todoroki-Yachiyo) as a little girl from bullies, which is how they met.

name: Inami Haha
description: [Mahiru](https://anilist.co/character/24419/)'s mother.

name: Izumi Takanashi
description:
__Height:__ 173 cm

Izumi, [Souta](https://anilist.co/character/24418/Takanashi-Souta)'s second eldest sister, is an author who tends to stay in her room for long periods of time focusing on working while ignoring the cleanliness of herself and her surroundings.

name: Rhiner Neumann
description: Rhiner Neumann is serving as the 4th Company Commander of V601 under the command of [Tanya Degurechaff](https://anilist.co/character/121052).

appearsIn.title: Saga of Tanya the Evil Season 2
The Saga of Tanya the Evil

name: Matheus Johann Weiss
native: マテウス・ヨハン・ヴァイス
description: He is the vice captain of the 203rd Aerial Mage Wing, and the captain of the 2nd Aerial Mage Squadron belongs to it.

appearsIn.title: Saga of Tanya the Evil Season 2
The Saga of Tanya the Evil

name: Shuu Ogata
description:
**Height:** 179 cm

The protagonist who runs a small private military company. He is usually broke as he cannot handle finances well. He is an orphan, as the rest of his family is presumed to be dead after an incident prior to the events of the series.

name: Kisara
description:
**Height:** 158 cm

A young girl who goes to a high school in Bayron City. She is actually a demon girl who is hundreds of years old. She has the ability to eat the memories of people, including [Shuu](https://anilist.co/character/268522/Ogata-Shuu).

name: Ayano Yuugiri
description:
**Height:** 165 cm

[Shuu Ogata](https://anilist.co/character/268522/Ogata-Shuu)'s first ex-girlfriend. Although she and Shuu have broken up, she still has feelings for him. She is also [Akino](https://anilist.co/character/278138/Yuugiri-Akino)'s daughter.

name: Miles Morgan
description:
Height: 174cm
A veteran of Baylong City Police's special crimes unit (the "demon-eradicating unit")

name: Tetsuya Mikami
description:
Height: 184cm
A detective in Baylong City Police's special crimes unit (the "demon-eradicating unit")

name: Kanna Ogata
description:
__Height:__ 145 cm

[Shuu Ogata](https://anilist.co/character/268522/Ogata-Shuu)'s sister. Half human and half demon. Disappeared due to the incident 12 years prior.

name: Sharon Holygrail
native: シャロン・ホーリーグレイル
description:
**Height:** 162 cm

[Shuu Ogata](https://anilist.co/character/268522/Ogata-Shuu)'s second ex-girlfriend, who dresses as a nun. She is actually an assassin and a part of an international organization tasked with fight against D-Hazards.

name: Akino Yuugiri
description:
__Height:__ 169cm

[Ayano](https://anilist.co/character/268524/Ayano-Yuugiri)'s mother

name: Linhua Hachisuka
description: The second-oldest daughter of Baylong City's mayor

name: Shenhua Hachisuka
description: The oldest daughter of Baylong City's mayor

name: Nagisa Kashiwagi
description: Nagisa is a classmate who occasionally asks [Kaguya](https://anilist.co/character/120649) about what to do in her relationships. [Tsubasa](https://anilist.co/character/134327)'s girlfriend.

appearsIn.title: Kaguya-sama wa Kokurasetai: Tensaitachi no Renai Zunousen OVA
Kaguya-sama: Love is War - Doujin Edition

name: Macrophage
description: Her kind plays many roles in the body, from nursery school teachers to professional killers. Therefore, she bears many faces and personalities depending on which role she is playing. By default, Macrophage is a humble, easygoing cell manifesting as a mother figure who speaks in a polite manner. However, she can brutally kill intruders without showing empathy or mercy.

name: Killer T Saibou
aliases: Memory T Saibou (メモリーＴ細胞)
description: A T-cell who leads his own squad in exterminating pathogens.

name: Kesshouban
description:
Platelet is a type of cell working under the Platelet Division. She and her coworkers are responsible for reconstructing injuries and forming blood clots in the human body. Due to the Platelet's actual cell size, they are depicted as children. Platelet is a small, adorable cell with waist-length caramel blonde hair and brown eyes. She wears the Platelet uniform and is always seen working with her fellow workers.

Platelets play an important role in healing the body. They are powerless against threats; however, they are small and nimble thus able to move through bacterium under the protection of white blood cells to cover up wounds. Platelets also can aggregate together to close an open wound. They use a protein known as "Von Willebrand Factor" to help them, which functions similar to super-glue. Then, the "Coagulation Factors" in the blood will work to coat the blot with a net of Fibrin, causing it to solidify. She has a polite, bouncy personality that manifests a strong leadership to other Platelets. Her innocent and humble character made her loveable to other cells.

name: Hibiki
description: __Height:__ 5'7"

name: Uta
description: __Height:__ 5'2"

name: Favaro Leone
description:
Favaro makes his living as a bounty hunter. He can't live without women, money and wine. His life takes a turn when he meets [Amira](https://anilist.co/character/88554/Amira).

Favaro is a young man with an orange hair styled into an afro, and green eyes. He has a large X-shaped scar on his face. His armor consists of a left pauldron, plate on his left elbow, plates on both of his knees and plated boots.

Speaks with a carefree attitude and is somewhat of a self-proclaimed ladies' man. He doesn't like to be responsible for others and claims that he only watches out for himself.

name: Kaisar Lidfard
native: カイザル・リドファルド
description:
Kaisar used to be a knight from a prestigious family, but has since become a bounty hunter. He chases Favaro, blaming him for his current status.

Kaisar is a very tall man, with white pants, a green shirt with white stripes and golden buttons, and a dark green vest hung over it, with green arm covers and golden stripes on the wrists. He has his knight's sword sheathed in a navy blue scabbard on his left side at all times. At times he's seen in gray knight's armor; even when he takes the armor off he keeps the leggins of the armor on his legs. Can be often seen holding a knight's pose and usually bears himself with knightly demeanor.

He is a righteous man with a very strong sense of honor, and constantly follows his own ideal of justice. Kaisar is shown to be very empathetic and compassionate, as seen during his meeting with Rita. Because of his tragic past as a rebellious son who was distant from his family, Kaisar now highly values family and abhors other people who take their family for granted. Seems to have a crush on Amira, calling her a beauty on their first encounter.

name: Amira
description:
A mysterious woman who fell from the sky. She, by all means, wants to reach the northern land called Helheim.

Amira is a very tall young woman with pale skin, violet eyes, and long, flowing, pink hair she ties in two ponytails. Her attire is somewhat unusual, consisting of a white blouse with a black vest above it, and a knee-length tan-colored shirt which acts as a coat, with a maroon and red vest covering her shoulders. She wears white and beige shorts, held up with a black belt, and two long, cowboy-looking boots with folded top edge, patched black in color.

name: Rita
description: Rita is a young child who lives in Nebelville, and is the daughter of the village doctor. She has short black hair and bangs, and usually wears a lopsided hat. She has somewhat of a quiet and timid personality.

name: Jeanne d'Arc
description:
Jeanne d'Arc is a captain of the Orleans Knights. She is a strong, fearless, and honorable warrior.

She is a fairly tall, blonde woman with magenta eyes and fair skin. Most of her long hair is pulled back into a tail, leaving locks of hair on either side of her face and straight-cut bangs free. She is most frequently seen in plate-armor. The armor is white with red accents and consists of an asymmetrical breastplate, pauldrons, gauntlets, a skirt, and boots. The breastplate appears to belted into place over dark teal and brown cloth. Underneath the plating, she wears a long-sleeved top and gloves in dark red and striped maroon leggings

name: Bacchus
description:
Bacchus is the god that alongside Hamsa is in charge of giving the rewards to the bounty hunters after they have done their job. He is periodically drunk and his love for wine defines his personality. Doesn't tend to get involved in major events unless pushed.

A very tall, black man with a perky red nose and gray hair which is long on the back, and stretches to a beard around his chin tied in a ponytail with a golden tie, and the top of his head is bald.  Wears a long, thick, dark brown overcoat with light brown fur around the top edge and a brown shirt under it and turquoise pants and  large, brown shoes. He is always seen carrying a long, thick, brown staff with a silver top, which he often uses for fighting.

He nicknames Favaro as "Bomber Head", due to his afro.

name: Hamsa
description:
Hamsa is the reincarnation of a god that inexplicably has taken the appearance of a duck. Alongside Bacchus he is in charge of guiding the bounty hunters in their job.

Hamsa looks like a normal duck with blue eyes. He wears a small golden crown. Shares with Bacchus a passion for alcohol, but he is considerably more focused and less likely to laze around, and is often seen reprimanding him.

name: Lavalley
description: Lavalley is a member of the Orleand Knights, serving under captain Jeanne d'Arc.  He is a tall man with dark skin, a black shirt, and a vest covering it which is a combination of maroon and brown, black pants, and tan leggings covering most of his legs and all of his feet. Has long, brown hair with a wide-looking mullet in the back, red eyes, and a small mustache.

name: Azazel
description: He is the fallen angel since he dared to disobey the God himself. He now tries to get hold of the God's key.

name: Cerberus
description: Cerberus is the Guard Dog of Hades. She accompanies Azazel on his quest to find out who is behind the theft of the God Key.

name: Touma Akechi
description: Touma Akechi, used to be a classmate and one of the very first friends [Kusuo](https://anilist.co/character/90107/Saiki-Kusuo) had in Kindergarten. He is a 3rd student in PK Academy that knows of Kusuo's powers.

appearsIn.title: The Disastrous Life of Saiki K. Season 3

name: Chisato Mera
description:
Chisato Mera is a classmate of Kusuo's. She works part time in Cafe Mami as a waitress.

(Source: Saiki Kusuo no Sai Nan Wikia)

appearsIn.title: The Disastrous Life of Saiki K. Season 3

name: Akatsuki Ousawa
description: Akatsuki came back to the real world after defeating the demon king in a world of sword and magic called Alayzard.  A fine young man who is confident of his strength, perverted yet serious.  He has a nasty habit of irritating girls by taking off their lingerie in a stealthy manner.  For some reason, Miu is the frequent victim of his perversion.

name: Chikage Izumi
description: A classmate of Akatsuki's and Miu's. She is a friendly, tomboyish girl with short brown hair and amber eyes. She becomes friends with Miu immediately. She is also a lesbian, and admits this fact with no shame. Her element is water, and her weapon is a crossbow.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Haruka Nanase
description: The Vice President of Student Council, who has long, green hair and green eyes. She seems to dislike Akatsuki a lot, especially after he steals both her bra and her panties during the middle of a school day, though she attacked him out of nowhere. Her weapons are two big blades.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Kuzuha Doumoto
description: A classmate of Akatsuki's and Miu's, also the Class Rep of their class. She is a really small girl, who is also really young, about the age of an elementary schooler. However, because of her being really smart and clever, she gets to be in high school. Doumoto has usually an emotionless expression most of time, and rarely smiles. Her element is earth, and her weapon is a gigantic, wooden hammer.

name: Miu Ousawa
description: She is the daughter of the Demon King Akatsuki. For some unfortunate reason she would always finds herself being a victim of Akatsuki's perversion be it accidental or intentional however she is pretty much capable of fending him off.... some of the time that is. Though Akatsuki treats her like his sister, it is suggested that he may have deeper feelings for her.

name: Kotoko
description: Kotoko is another laptop persocom, like Sumomo, but she was custom-built by Yoshiyuki and has much higher specifications than Sumomo.    Kotoko is far more serious than Sumomo, and thinks that everyone in the Motosuwa household is crazy, especially Sumomo, although she herself occasionally exhibits a sarcastic wit. Kotoko is programmed to always tell the truth, no matter what, even when it works to Yoshiyuki's disadvantage.

name: Chii
description:
__Height:__ 152 cm (5'0")

Chii is a Persocom who is found by [Hideki Motosuwa](https://anilist.co/character/225) in a garbage dump. At first, she is only able to say "Chii", thus earning her that name. Later on, she is taught various things, and is eventually able to communicate with other people.

name: Hideki Motosuwa
description:
**Height:** 178 cm (5'10'')

Hideki Motosuwa is a student who is attempting to qualify for university by studying at the Seki cram school in Tokyo. He's an honest and kind teenager who was raised on a farm, and unfortunately for him, has no experience with women. He has a very active imagination, which tends to result in him talking to himself in public. Hideki is interested in finding a girlfriend and has a great desire to have a Persocom—a computer shaped in the form of a human who can do all sorts of things. Although he cannot afford one, his luck holds out when he finds one lying in a garbage dump on his way home from the groceries, which he names [Chii](https://anilist.co/character/227/Chii).

name: Anata
description: Anata is a strange creature resembling a rabbit, similar to Atashi, who is the supporting character of Chi's favorite book series "A City With no People."

name: Takako Shimizu
description: Takako Shimizu is Hideki and Shinbo's teacher at the Seki cram school.

name: Hiromu Shinbo
description: Shinbo quickly becomes Hideki's best friend once Hideki moves into the same apartment complex as him. He is quite knowlegdable when it comes to Persocoms, which ends up in Hideki turning to him whenever he needs help with Chii. He has his own Persocom named Sumomo (Plum). He also attends to the same cram school as Hideki.

name: Dita
description: Dita is the second of the two persocoms looking for Chii. Her role is to protect Jima both physically and as a pro-active firewall, hacking into any persocom who tries to hack into Jima and shutting it down (which happens to Yuzuki during her attempt to hack Jima). Dita appears to love Jima, but tries to deny it, believing the persocoms cannot or should not experience such feelings.

name: Yoshiyuki Kojima
description: Kojima is known as "Dragonfly" on online BBS boards, and like Minoru, is also a custom Persocom builder. His obsessions with Persocoms are shown when he kidnaps Chii in order to find out more about her origins after hearing about her on the BBS board where Minoru posted. He later makes amends for his actions by helping Hideki and Minoru find out more about Chii's origins and the Chobits.

name: Sumomo
description: Sumomo is a mobile persocom - which is the persocom equivalent of a laptop computer. She is programmed to be cute and tends to be quite hyperactive, for example her morning 'wakey wakey exercises'.     At the beginning of the series, Shinbo uses Sumomo in an attempt to analyze Chi, and Sumomo is nearly broken in the process, requiring new main memory, and in the manga, a new video card as well. Once Kotoko joined Hideki, she quickly came to the conclusion that Sumomo was crazy, with her nonsensical ways. Sumomo's password after being received by Hideki is Chobits (case sensitive) and ちょびっツ　(case sensitive because of the katakana at the end)

name: Hiroyasu Ueda
description: Hiroyasu Ueda  is the owner of Chiroru, a local bakery which Yumi once worked in and which Chi ends up working at. He, too, has suffered a trauma involving persocoms.

name: Minami Fuyuki
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3'')

[Tsubasa](https://anilist.co/character/142802/Shiki-Tsubasa)'s 16-year-old classmate at Kitami Hokuryo High School, who is popular and talkative. She follows the gal subculture; dyeing her hair blonde, wearing short skirts in winter, and refusing to wear gloves in the winter so that she can still use her phone. She seems to have a crush on Tsubasa and enjoys flirting with him to make him embarrassed and flustered.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Tsubasa Shiki
description:
__Height:__ 179cm (5'10'')

He is a city boy who is quite a fool. He speaks his mind at times when he'd rather not let those thoughts slip out. He is very weak to the cold.

name: Sayuri Akino
description:
__Height:__ 157cm (5'1")

Tsubasa and Minami's classmate who, with her raven-hair, reserved personality and choice not to use the Hokkaido dialect, is the exact opposite of Minami. She is very into video games, but pays attention to her appearance; reading fashion and make-up magazines in order to fit in. Because she sweats a lot, Sayuri avoided all forms of exercise, which eventually found her avoiding people in general. Because she has no friends, Sayuri felt a kinship with Tsubasa, and she becomes friends with him and Minami.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Rena Natsukawa
description:
__Height:__ 150cm (4'11")

[Tsubasa Shiki's](https://anilist.co/character/142802/Shiki-Tsubasa) senpai or upperclassman one grade above him. 

She is a gal like [Fuyuki](https://anilist.co/character/142801/Fuyuki-Minami), who respects her a lot. She is really timid and insecure, even though she's considered really talented, especially at studying.

name: Kaede Hanamiya
description:
__Height:__ 154cm

Tsubasa Shiki's grandma.

name: Hina
description:
Asuka's friend and classmate who calls herself Minami's biggest fan. She has long hair and wears big glasses. Having gone to the same middle school as Minami, she is obsessed with her as she resembles her favorite fictional character. Hina follows Minami on the internet and thoroughly researches everything around her, including Tsubasa.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Mai Fuyuki
description: [Minami's](https://anilist.co/character/142801/Minami-Fuyuki) and [Momoko's](https://anilist.co/character/323450/Momoko-Fuyuki) mother.

name: Special Week
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm

Rar'n to go! A pure-hearted girl focused on her dream.

Born in Hokkaido, Special Week is a bright and cheery, hardworking Umamusume. After losing her birth mother, Special Week was raised by her mother's friend. Now, she hopes to make both her moms proud by fulfilling her promise of becoming Japan's top racer. Though she may falter along the way, her indomitable spirit ensures that she runs ever forward.

name: Silence Suzuka
description:
__Height:__ 161 cm

The silent runner aiming to break the sound barrier.

An Umamusume seen as a prodigy who's always ahead of the pack, both figuratively and literally. She gets so absorbed with running that she comes off as aloof, but most know that she is dedicated. She is roommates with Special Week and many find themselves attracted to her authentic personality.

name: Gold Ship
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm

Wild and unpredictable, this golden runner is unlike anybody else!

An unpredictable firebrand born with an extra helping of free spirit. She's prone to some dramatic swings in mood and motivation—one moment she could be setting up an elaborate punchline, and in the next you would be hard-pressed to get her to move. She seems to get along with anyone and everyone, but it is unclear just how she views her bonds with others. Truly, one could call her Tracen's greatest mischief-maker.

name: Daiwa Scarlet
description:
__Height:__ 163 cm

Beyond arrogant! This hothead hates to lose.

Unyielding, strong-willed, and cheeky, she wants to be number one at everything she does. She usually plays the role of the perfect, mild-mannered honor student, but the truth is that she hates losing more than anything else. If it'll help her be number one, she'll go through any training—no matter how grueling. She sees her rather showy roommate Vodka as both her motivation and her rival.

name: Vodka
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm

Headstrong and full of life! A roadster with a heart of gold.

Dedicated to being the coolest, this Umamusume tries her best to act like a delinquent. She takes after her motorcycle-loving father, emulating his hobbies and attitudes down to the letter. Her grandstanding nature sees her charge daringly into any challenge, never afraid of what she might face. She has a bit of a cat-and-dog relationship with her roommate, Daiwa Scarlet.

name: Toukai Teiou
description:
__Height:__ 150 cm

Unbeatable and adorable! A happy hoppin' racer.

A bright, bubbly Umamusume with a natural knack for racing. She's long looked up to the student council president, [Symboli Rudolf](https://anilist.co/character/140844/Symboli-Rudolf), and this admiration serves as her ultimate motivation in becoming the number one racer. Fans can't get enough of Teio's boundless confidence, and have lovingly dubbed her upbeat march the "Teio Step."

name: Mejiro McQueen
description:
__Height:__ 159 cm

The crown jewel of the prestigious Mejiro clan. A classy and poised young lady.

Born into a family of racing legends, Mejiro McQueen is a long-distance runner who is the envy of her peers. She has class and decorum befitting her prestige, and is determined to take first at the Tenno Sho, like many Mejiro racers before her. On her days off, she enjoys having afternoon tea with the many other residents of the Mejiro estate.

name: Trainer
description: Trainer of Team Spica.

name: El Condor Pasa
description:
The North American Phantom Bird! A vivacious and quirky lucha libre.

A masked luchadora, she's always hyped up and ready to wrestle. She has ultimate confidence that she's the world's strongest Umamusume, and loves to proclaim that fact to anyone who'll lend her an ear. Her mask is a present from her pro wrestler father and she insists on keeping it on all the timeーno matter what. Her best friend and roommate, Grass Wonder, constantly scolds her for being too reckless.

name: Oguri Cap
description:
__Height:__ 167 cm

A coolheaded dreamer from the countryside.

Originally hailing from the countryside, she enrolled in Tracen Academy after dominating the racing scene back home. She works to make her hometown proud, but try as she might, her clumsy side always comes out. At the academy, she's known as a fearsome gourmand, able to empty an entire pot of rice in the blink of an eye.

name: Kyousuke Munakata
aliases: Super High School-Level Student Council President
description:
__Height:__ 186cm (6'1")
__Talent:__ Ultimate Student Council President

A character featured in _Danganronpa 3: The End of Hope's Peak High School_. During his time in Class 74th at Hope's Peak Academy, his title was the Ultimate Student Council President. He is later the vice-chairman of the Future Foundation and is the Branch Office 2 Director. His responsibility as the director is the management of the Future Foundation, including construction of new facilities, expansion of the organization, etc. He, along with the other Future Foundation Directors, is forced to participate in the Final Killing Game.

appearsIn.title: Danganronpa 3: The End of Hope’s Peak High School - Future Arc

name: Ryouta Mitarai
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'2")
__Talent:__ Ultimate Animator

A character featured in _Danganronpa 3: The End of Hope's Peak High School_. During his time in Class 77-B at Hope's Peak Academy. He is a member of the Future Foundation and is the Branch Office 10 Director. His responsibility as the director is assistance in reviving education and culture. He, along with the other Future Foundation Directors, is forced to participate in the Final Killing Game.

Ryota is a very timid, insecure, and rather asocial person. He holds anime in very high regard and is extremely passionate about it, considering it his savior during his harsh childhood. His life goal is to give others a similar sense of hope through his anime. However, this led him to shut himself in his room to work, frequently neglecting to eat or sleep as he wanted to spend all his time creating anime. Ryota suffers from extreme anxiety, worrying constantly, and lacks self-confidence, seeing himself as a burden who fails to protect everyone. He has a weak stomach and is easily startled. Though he's very hard on himself, he does his best when given a mission.

appearsIn.title: Danganronpa 3: The End of Hope’s Peak High School - Future Arc
Danganronpa 3: The End of Hope’s Peak High School - Despair Arc

name: Monaka
description:
__Height:__ 134 cm (4'5")

The true leader of the Warriors of Hope and the head of the "Mage" class. Her title when she attended Hope's Peak Elementary was Li'l Ultimate Homeroom (超小学生級の学活の時間 lit. Super Elementary School Level Homeroom Period).

appearsIn.title: Danganronpa 3: The End of Hope’s Peak High School - Future Arc

name: Kouichi Kizakura
description:
__Talent:__ Ultimate Talent Scout

During his time at Hope's Peak Academy, he was the original homeroom teacher of Class 77-B, being succeeded by [Chisa Yukizome](https://anilist.co/character/90003/Chisa-Yukizome), and a scout for talented students.

He is a member of the Future Foundation and is the Branch Office 3 Director. His responsibility as the director is general HR, including scouting of members and branch heads, distribution of personnel, etc. He, along with the other Future Foundation Directors, is forced to participate in the Final Killing Game.

He was once a former student of Hope's Peak Academy.

appearsIn.title: Danganronpa 3: The End of Hope’s Peak High School - Future Arc

name: Nagisa Shingetsu
aliases: 超小学生級の社会の時間
description:
__Height:__ 137 cm (4'6")

The vice leader of the Warriors of Hope and the head of the "Sage" class. His title when he attended Hope's Peak Elementary was Li'l Ultimate Social Studies (超小学生級の社会の時間 lit. Super Elementary School Level Social Studies Period).

Nagisa is the most serious member of the Warriors. He is calm, intelligent and educated, yet also the most child-like. He has an aversion to things he considers childish and, though he refers to himself as a child, doesn't like to be underestimated on the basis of age.



Nagisa is incredibly loyal, humble, compassionate and protective over his friends and fellow children, truly caring about them even though they often annoy him a lot. He is willing to go to any lengths to ensure that they don't have to live in fear any longer.

appearsIn.title: Danganronpa 3: The End of Hope’s Peak High School - Future Arc

name: Ashito  Aoi
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm
__Year:__ 1st Year
__ Jersey Number:__ 33
__Position:__ FW 

Ashito is a brash and naïve kid from a remote prefecture called Ehime who has dreams of becoming the world's greatest forward. He currently lives in Tokyo as a first year high school student and member of Tokyo City Esperion FC.

name: Tatsuya Fukuda
description:
__Height:__ 176 cm

Director of Tokyo City Esperion FC Youth, and Head Coach of the A Team. He was born in Ehime, Japan but moved to Tokyo to attend high school. He joined Tokyo City Esperion FC of the J-League (Japan's top professional football league) at the age of 18 and became a regular at 20. At 23 he was signed by the Spanish club Sabadell FC who had been recently promoted to Spain's top division, La Liga. A while later, his mother married [Hana Ichijou](https://anilist.co/character/162035/Hana-Ichijou)'s father and he became her step-brother. Fukuda happens to meet [Ashito](https://anilist.co/character/133818/Ashito--Aoi) in Ehime, discovers his talent, and invites him to try out for Esperion Youth.

name: Haruhisa Kuribayashi
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm
__ Year:__ 2nd Year
__Jersey Number:__ 10
__Position:__ MF

Kuribayashi is considered a football genius, making his professional debut at age 16 for Tokyo City Esperion FC of the J-1 League. He also plays for Japan's Under-20 National Team.

name: Hana Ichijou
description:
__Height:__ 157 cm

Hana Ichijou is the younger step-sister of [Tatsuya Fukuda](https://anilist.co/character/133817), the coach of Tokyo City Esperion FC Youth. She has been a football fan since she was very young. She was especially a fan of Fukuda, even before their parents married. Hana has a deep knowledge of nutrition as she aspires to become a sports surgeon. She uses that knowledge to make meal plans for the players, notably [Ashito](https://anilist.co/character/133818/Ashito--Aoi) and [Kuribayashi](https://anilist.co/character/162034/Haruhisa-Kuribayashi).

name: Nagisa Akutsu
description:
__Height:__183cm
__Year:__ 2nd Year
__Jersey Number:__ 4
__Position:__ DF

He is the only player from the class one year above [Ashito](https://anilist.co/character/133818/Aoi-Ashito) to have passed the tryouts. A defender with the skill to earn a starting spot on the first team as early as his freshman year, he is stoic and hot-tempered, often clashing with his teammates. He took a dislike to Ashito after facing him during the tryouts, and even after joining the team, he picks fights with him at every opportunity, trying to take him down.

name: Eisaku Otomo
description:
__Height:__ 163 cm
__Year:__ 1st Year
__Jersey Number:__ 30
__Position:__ MF

A first year student and midfielder playing for Tokyo City Esperion FC's Youth Team. He’s the team’s mood-maker, always looking out for everyone. He gets incredibly nervous before matches, but once the game starts, he’s a midfielder who controls the team with cool, level-headed judgment.

 In everyday life, he’s a bit of a joker who tries desperately to impress girls, but his efforts fall flat (despite his best efforts).

name: Kanpei Kuroda
description:
__Height:__ 161 cm
__Year:__ 1st Year
__Jersey Number:__ 26
__Position:__ MF

Promoted from Junior Youth. He usually has a laid-back, gentle, and approachable vibe, but he's a realist who prioritizes becoming a pro above all else.

name: Souichirou Tachibana
description:
__Height:__ 173 cm
__Year:__ 1st Year
__Jersey Number:__ 28
__Position:__ FW

A first year student playing as forward for Tokyo City Esperion FC.

name: Keiji Togashi
description:
__Height:__ 187 cm
__Year:__ 1st Year
__Jersey Number:__ 31
__Position:__ DF

Togashi is a first year high school student and member of Tokyo City Esperion FC Youth. He is a hot-headed and passionate kid who came to Esperion after leaving his motorcycle gang behind. His dark black hair is regularly styled in a classic biker-yankee pompadour.

name: Ryuuichi Takeshima
description:
__Height:__ 171 cm
__Year:__ 1st Year
__Jersey Number:__ 27
__Position:__ DF

A promotee from the junior youth team. A rarity in the ultra-attacking Esperion team, a defender specialized in defense. He shares a conflict with Togashi, who has a different philosophy on soccer, alongside Kuroda

name: Keisuke Hirose
description: Keisuke was Shouya Ishida's friend in elementary school. Although he did bully Shouko Nishimiya, he wasn't a huge participant and usually seemed uncomfortable picking on her. However, he was more than happy bullying Shouya later on.

name: Miki Kawai
description: Nicknamed "Kawaiichi," Kawai was the school representative at Ishida's elementary school. She is popular and normally takes charge of situations and is shown to be kind to everyone; however, all her actions seem to have her academic reputation in mind. Kawai is also a narcissist who believes that everyone should love her, as well as wants to be the victim in every problem she faces.

name: Satoshi Mashiba
description: A boy who becomes interested in and joins Ishida's group of friends upon learning they are making a movie. He is eager to be the leading actor and is considered handsome and talented enough to do so. Mashiba was lonely as a child and the other children took him for granted and bullied him, now he is completely intolerant of bullies in any form, and while generally calm and level-headed, he reacts violently to any random act of bullying he sees.

name: Kazuki Shimada
description: Ishida's best friend in elementary school. He helped him bully Nishimiya.

name: Tokiyuki Houjou
description:
__Skill:__ Elusiveness: combined techniques in running away, evasion, and stealth 
__Emblem:__ Mitsuuroko (Three Scales)

A boy in the Houjou clan who was expected to inherit the rule of the Kamakura shogunate. He excels at fleeing and is now gathering strength at Suwa Grand Shrine so he can use that skill in his efforts to reclaim the throne.

name: Yorishige Suwa
description:
__Skill:__ Future Sight

Worshiped as the God of Suwa by having the spirit of Suwa Myojin within him. He's the person who offers safety to Tokiyuki after the fall of his clan in 1333. He is one of the 3 most outstanding arahitogami in Japan.

name: Shizuku
description: The priestess of Suwa Shrine under the orders of [Yorishige](https://anilist.co/character/300898/Suwa-Yorishige). She's a member of Elusive Warriors.

name: Kojirou Nezu
description: Tokiyuki's ally and a member of Elusive Warriors. He belongs to the Nezu clan.

name: Ayako Mochizuki
description: A member of Elusive Warriors.

name: Genba Kazama
description: A thief that belongs to the Kazama clan, a branch of the Suwa clan. He is a member of the Elusive Warriors.

name: Takauji Ashikaga
description: The man who overthrew the Kamakura shogunate with his overwhelming strength and charisma, causing [Tokiyuki's](https://anilist.co/character/215499/Tokiyuki-Houjou) family and standing to be lost.

name: Fubuki
description: A strategist and swordsman who travels in search of a lord. Initially was a member of the Elusive Warriors.

name: Moronao Kouno
description: Takauji Ashikaga's steward.

name: Chocolat
description: A carefree and upbeat girl who claims to have come to Kanade to help free him of his "Absolute Choice" curse. However, ends up having amnesia on arrival and becomes very little help at all. Enjoys sweets and particularly chocolate.

appearsIn.title: My Mental Choices Are Completely Interfering With My School Romantic Comedy

name: Kanade Amakusa
description:
He is a regular high school student who has a curse that he calls "Absolute Choice". This curse will at random times cause a voice in his head to give him two or more choices to make. If he doesn't choose one of them soon after, he will start getting a severe headache, forcing him to choose one.

Ouka affectionately calls him "Amachi."

appearsIn.title: My Mental Choices Are Completely Interfering With My School Romantic Comedy

name: Furano Yukihira
description: Kanade's classmate who is quiet but a little weird. She likes verbally abusing Kanade.

appearsIn.title: My Mental Choices Are Completely Interfering With My School Romantic Comedy

name: Ouka Yuuouji
description:
__Height:__ 145 cm (4'9")

One of the Reject 5 members. She is a very cheerful and happy girl. She also likes Kanade and doesn't mind being a 5th wheel.

appearsIn.title: My Mental Choices Are Completely Interfering With My School Romantic Comedy

name: Touya Yoshiwara
description: One of the popularity five. He has a crush on Chocolat.

appearsIn.title: My Mental Choices Are Completely Interfering With My School Romantic Comedy

name: Konagi Yawakaze
description: Yuuouji's best friend. She is very pure at heart and very innocent. She often feels very embarrassed around male students, as she rarely spends time around them, but wants to learn to do so. She is the third most popular girl in the school, and has many admirers who wish to guard her and protect her innocence. If any student attempts to do something of a perverted nature with her, her "guards" will beat that person up. Amakusa has been a victim to several of these beatings, due to his "curse" often requiring him to make perverted decisions.

appearsIn.title: My Mental Choices Are Completely Interfering With My School Romantic Comedy

name: Kyouka Yuuouji
description: Ouka's mother and the wife of Ouma. Former idol, now works as news commentator.

appearsIn.title: My Mental Choices Are Completely Interfering With My School Romantic Comedy

name: Guo Chen
description: Owner of Happy Internet Cafe and the boss of Team Happy. She plays under the account Chasing Haze, a Launcher class.

name: Rou Tang
description: Plays a Battle Mage by the name of Soft Mist in the game of Glory.

name: Xiu Ye
description:
He is well-known by players as a textbook expert and the God of Fighting. Ye Xiu is one of the first batch of players and a first-generation Glory player. He is also known to be skilled at all professions, having developed combo guides, created techniques like 'Delivery Gun' and various other popular types of playstyles in Glory.

Former captain of team "Excellent Era" who obtained 3 consecutive championships during the first 3 season of the Glory Pro League.

name: Mucheng Su
description: Su Mucheng is an eSports player of Glory. She plays the launcher class under the users "Dancing Rain" and "Cleansing Mist".

name: Bao Rongxing
description: User of Steamed Bun Invasion, a Brawler class account in the game Glory.

name: Shaotian Huang
description: Vice-Captain of Blue Rain. Current user of Troubling Rain, a God-Level Account under the Blade Master class.

name: Xinjie Zhang
description: Vice-Captain of Tyranny and current user of the Cleric class God-Level account, Immovable Rock. He is known to be strict, serious and extremely punctual. He is not one to jump to conclusions and won't make claims unless he is 100% sure. His tactical ability makes him one of the Four Master Tacticians alongside Ye Xiu, Yu Wenzhou, and Xiao Shiqin.

name: Yifan Qiao
description: Member of Tiny Herb and Gao Yingjie's best friend.

name: Zekai Zhou
description: Currently the captain of Samsara and the user of the God-Level Sharpshooter account, Cloud Piercer. Due to his exceptional  looks, he makes a good face for sponsors. He is quite shy and barely speaks in interviews, giving short answers which makes him difficult to interview.

name: Wenqing Han
description: Captain of Tyranny and current user of the Striker class God-Level account Desert Dust. He is considered Ye Xiu's rival.

name: Hanyuu Furude
description:
Hanyuu is the mysterious "transfer student" in Matsuribayashi-hen. She has a pair of dark colored horns on her head, one of which is chipped slightly (however, no one seems to notice or mention them, with the exception of [Takano](https://anilist.co/character/4934/Takano-Miyo), who calls her a "monster").

In fact, she has appeared to [Rika](https://anilist.co/character/1534/Furude-Rika) all her life, but only in Matsuribayashi-hen and Miotsukushi-hen did she gain the power to interact with others, posing as a distant relative of Rika's and given the name "Hanyuu Furude." Like many of the characters, she can be frightening when angered, and with her spirit-like nature, her appearance can change with her mood until she takes a physical form.

She is very meek and often makes the noise "Au au, au au…" when she is nervous or uncomfortable, or sometimes while trying to make a point. She also tends to end her sentences with nano desu (なのです?, lit. "it is so").

She dislikes alcohol and kimchi, which Rika imbibes in large amounts as punishment when she finds Hanyū annoying (as both Hanyuu's and Rika's senses are linked together). She mentions that she is a "being above humans" after being sacrificed to atone for the sin of humans, while both Rika and Takano describe her as a kind of deity.

name: Hikaru Gero
description:
__Specialist Type:__ Poison User

Hikaru Gero is part of the Gero Family, one of the top five families of specialists. He is the current heir to the Poison clan. A poison-using hitman from the clan of assassins. In order to keep his sister from being forced into having a child to continue the lineage of the clan, Gero decides to try and get married and have a child of his own.

name: Mei Kinosaki
description:
__Occupation:__ Swindler

Mei Kinosaki is a marriage swindler who charms both men and women in order to get money from them to help keep their sick brother alive. Mei was saved by [Gero](https://anilist.co/character/297787/Gero-Hikaru) after being captured by a crime syndicate that they had wronged. Mei agreed to help Gero find a wife in exchange for Gero's protection, and help with keeping their sick brother alive.

name: Toshiki Hanamaki
description:
__Specialist Type:__ Bug User

He is a specialist from Hanamaki Clan a sub-branch of the Gero Family. He's Gero's best friend.

name: Sirius
description: [Kimie Arashiyama](https://anilist.co/character/299681/Kimie-Arashiyama)'s partner.

name: Shiori Ureshino
description: She is the next heir of the Ureshino Family. After the death of her father, he would leave her in charge of the company. This would cause her to be under the care of her uncle who would try to help her in everything she needed. After her uncle informed her that a murderer was after her, she agrees to be escorted by someone.

name: Tonako Dogo
description:
__Specialist Type:__ Wolf User

She is the current head and member of the Dogo Family.

name: Akari Gero
description: She is a specialist part of the Gero Family alongside her brother and Teruaki.

name: Teruaki Gero
description:
__Height:__ 167cm (5'6'')

He is a specialist part of the Gero family and the cousin of Gero and Akari, as well as Akari's former fiancé.

name: Kyouko Himekawa
description: She is a famous art thief known in the underworld. Himekawa is an animal lover as she is friend with a shark named Jawshua. She is also able to see the feelings of painting.

name: Miyuki
description:
Miyuki's backstory deals with her fear of returning home. She is a runaway girl who leaves home because she hated her father's over-controlling ways. In the past, Miyuki was slightly overweight, but after 6 months on the streets, she has lost a substantial amount of weight.

Miyuki considers herself to be a very independent young woman, however at her young age, she greatly relies on the support and safety that Hana and Gin provide for her in order to survive on the streets.

name: Kiyoko
description: The little baby that Hana, Gin and Miyuki want to protect.

name: Hana
description: A homeless trans woman. She never knew her actual parents, and thus feels the most sympathy for "Kiyoko", the baby she finds and names. Because of her upbringing, she is the kindest out of the three main characters, but is also the sickliest, which she hides from the others.

name: Gin
description: An alcoholic that once made money by racing bicycles. When his daughter became ill, he threw a race to get the money for her medicine, but because of that got banned from the sport.      After that he started living on the streets with Hana and Miyuki.

name: Gin no Musume
description: (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Kurumizawa
description: As Miyuki, Hana and Gin have reached a dead end in their search for Sachiko, Kurumizawa tried to grab the trio with information on the ground. It ends, however, so that they and their neighbors a little gossip about the couple.

name: Miyuki no Chichi
description: After an argument with his daughter, he is severely injured by her with a knife, which he survived but. She runs off and no longer has the courage to return home, even though her ​​father is not angry at her, and she would love to go back in its vicinity.

name: Isha
description: As a doctor, he is a very able man, and because he treats everyone the same patient, he makes on others always a nice impression. His life has not been easy, as both his wife and his child he lost. Of which he has not let it get in Kiyoko and has now found a new love with which he is engaged. He also has a physical disability affecting his right leg.

name: Asako Kusakabe
description:
__Height:__ 174 cm

Asako was Yuuji's former master. She took charge of raising Yuuji when his parents passed away. She was both harsh and sweet, capable and incompetent and drilled many of her own values into Yuuji. Thanks to her job of bringing him up, he can at least act normal, but now possesses a strong wariness for the horrors of large women. She also completely and utterly incompetent at cooking as she couldn't even make fried rice.

Asako wasn't particularly different from Yuuji; she loved to read. She was content to pass time with a book, a pack of cigarettes, and a pot of coffee especially on rainy days when she didn't have anything particular to do.

name: Heath Oslo
description:
An international terrorist who was an acquaintance of Yuuji's father, and took him after Yuuji killed his father. He trains Yuuji to be an assassin, and has him complete missions for him.

He is the main antagonist of Grisaia no Rakuen.

name: Tomoe Inui
description:
__Race:__ Mystic Wolf

Tomoe Inui is a recurring character of Genjitsu Shugi Yuusha no Oukoku Saikenki series.

(Source: Genjitsu Shugi Yuusha no Oukoku Saikenki Wiki)

appearsIn.title: How a Realist Hero Rebuilt the Kingdom Part 2
How a Realist Hero Rebuilt the Kingdom

name: Juna Doma
description: Juna Doma is one of the female protagonist of Genjitsu Shugi Yuusha no Oukoku Saikenki series. She is the granddaughter of [Excel Walter](https://anilist.co/character/214660/Walter-Excel).

appearsIn.title: How a Realist Hero Rebuilt the Kingdom Part 2
How a Realist Hero Rebuilt the Kingdom

native: ジャンヌ＝ユーフォリア
description:

Jeanne Euphoria is a recurring character of Genjitsu Shugi Yuusha no Oukoku Saikenki series. She is the crown princess and commander of the military of the Gran Chaos Empire as well the younger sister of the current Empress Maria Euphoria.

(Source: Genjitsu Shugi Yuusha no Oukoku Saikenki Wiki)

How a Realist Hero Rebuilt the Kingdom

native: ジーニャ・マクスウェル
description: Genia is reclusive, but is quite personable. She is capable of maintaining normal conversations, even when others dismiss her ideas as crazy. This is most noticeable in her interactions with Kazuya, Ludwin, and her newfound researcher colleagues.

native: マリア・ ユーフォリア
description: She is the older sister to Jeanne Euphoria. She is the current Empress of the Gran Chaos Empire and the first female to rule the empire.

appearsIn.title: How a Realist Hero Rebuilt the Kingdom Part 2

name: Marx
description:
__Race:__ Half Elf

He was the former Prime Minister of the Elfrieden Kingdom before being replaced by Hakuya Kwonmin and now serves as the chamberlain for the former rulers, Albert Elfrieden and Elisha Elfrieden.

appearsIn.title: How a Realist Hero Rebuilt the Kingdom Part 2

name: Noor
description:
Though he aspired to become an adventurer, at the age of twelve he was deemed to possess "absolutely no talent whatsoever in anything." Yet, refusing to abandon his dream, he secluded himself in the mountains to hone his "Parry" skill—a dedication that eventually allowed him to grow capable of deflecting a thousand blades. 


He is currently registered with the guild at the lowest possible rank, he spends his days simply performing menial chores around the town.

name: Lynne
aliases: Linneburg Clays (リンネブルグ・クレイス)
description:
The First Princess of the Kingdom of Clays, her full name is Linneburg Clays. She excels in every conceivable ability, having graduated from the Royal Capital Training Academy with the highest scores in its history across all disciplines. She has comprehensively mastered skills spanning all six elemental systems. 

She was once attacked by a monster and saved from a perilous situation by [Noor](https://anilist.co/character/213554/Noor); ever since, she has looked up to him and affectionately addresses him as Sensei.

name: Ines Harness
description:
A knight of the Kingdom of Clays and deputy commander of the Warrior Corps. She possesses a special defensive ability known as the “Divine Shield,” which she uses to serve as [Lynne's](https://anilist.co/character/330746/Lynne) bodyguard. 

A former orphan, she was taken in by the “Shield Saint” [Dandalg](https://anilist.co/character/330747/Dandalg), who taught her how to wield her power.

name: Rolo
description: A kind-hearted boy with the special ability to communicate freely with monsters. He is a descendant of the demon race, considered an abhorrent existence that has long since gone extinct, and spent a very unhappy childhood working for a slave trader.

name: Gilbert
description: He serves as the Vice-Commander of the Spearman Corps—the guardians of the Kingdom of Clays—and bears the title of "Spear Saint." Possessing an unrivaled passion for battle, he once traveled far and wide in search of worthy opponents. He is a disciple of [Sig](https://anilist.co/character/330744/Sig), the "Sword Saint," and wields a spear.

name: Clays Ou
description:
He is the King of the Kingdom of Clays—the nation that houses the world's oldest labyrinth, the "Labyrinth of No Return"—and the father of [Lynne](https://anilist.co/character/330746/Lynne) and [Rein](https://anilist.co/character/330742/Rein). In his days as an adventurer, he explored the "Labyrinth of the Lost" alongside the Six Sovereigns, ultimately discovering the Black Blade deep within its innermost depths. 

Although he has since retired from adventuring, he remains one of the kingdom's most formidable assets; having sensed the ominous atmosphere now shrouding the nation, he remains on high alert.

name: Rein Clays
description: He is the First Prince of the Kingdom of Clays; his full name is Rein Clays. Possessing a calm and composed demeanor, he also serves as an aide to the King of Clays.

name: Sig
description: One of the Six Sovereigns who serve as guardians of the Kingdom of Clays. He has been bestowed the title of "Sword Saint"—the highest rank attainable by a swordsman—and also serves as an instructor at the School of the Swordsmen in the Royal Capital.

name: Dandalg
description:
One of the Six Sovereigns who serve as guardians of the Kingdom of Clays. He holds the title of "Shield Saint"—the highest distinction attainable by a Warrior—and also serves as an instructor at the School of the Warrior in the Royal Capital. 

He is [Ines's](https://anilist.co/character/330745/Ines-Harness) adoptive father; having taken her in from an orphanage, he taught her how to harness her powers.

name: Mianne
description: One of the Six Sovereigns who safeguard the Kingdom of Clays. She has been bestowed the title of "Bow Saint"—the highest rank among Rangers—and also serves as an instructor at the School of the Ranger in the Royal Capital.

name: Kenshin Himura
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm  

Kenshin Himura, also known throughout the anime as Hitokiri Battousai (Battousai the Manslayer) or Himura the Battousai, is the main character of the series Rurouni Kenshin. His original name was Shinta (心太). 

His parents died of cholera when he was very young and as a result, was adopted by three slave women in a traveling slave wagon. Soon after meeting them, bandits had raided the convoy and killed his three new guardians and where about to kill him when [Seijuro Hiko](https://anilist.co/character/2406/Hiko-Seijuurou) killed the bandits. Hiko soon adopted the child and because Shinta was not a name fitted for a swordman, he renamed him Kenshin, meaning "Heart of Sword," took him under his wing and taught him the Hiten Mitsuruugi Ryu.   



The next time we see Kenshin is 10 years later as he has become a wanderer who helps out anyone in need who is suffering right before his eyes. Those long 10 years have taken him from Kyoto, all over Japan to where we find him in episode one of the anime, in Tokyo, still keeping his vow never to kill again. It is here where he meets [Kaoru Kamiya](https://anilist.co/character/148/Kamiya-Kaoru) and his whole life begins to change once again.

Kenshin is usually depicted as a care-free swordsman who is very aloof and tends to be a bit simple-minded when it comes to living normally. He is seen to be doing many of the chores around the dojo that he stays at with Kaoru, (i.e., cooking, cleaning, laundry, etc.).

name: Kaoru Kamiya
description:
__Height:__ 155cm 
__Affiliations:__ Kamiya dojo

The primary instructor of the Kamiya Kasshin-Ryū fighting style developed by her late father, Kamiya Koshijirō, Kaoru inherited a small dojo from her father after he was killed during the Seinan War and operates it by herself. Naturally, she is independent, possessive, compassionate, courageous, feisty, strong-willed, and a great fighter to boot- with only the occasional mood swing. Kaoru is also known for her cooking disliked by her friends and family and her ability to see the good in others.

name: Yahiko Myojin
description: Yahiko is a samurai descendant. Yahiko's father died during the Battle of Ueno during the Boshin War, slain at the Keneiji Temple. His mother died of syphilis in a brothel to put food on their table not long after giving birth to her son. Yahiko was originally forced to live as a thief for the local Yakuza, who tricked him into believing that he still had to pay off the money the gangsters gave to his mother to buy medicine. With the help of Himura Kenshin and Kamiya Kaoru, he becomes an apprentice of the Kamiya Kasshin-Ryu style. Yahiko has a friend/rival, Tsukayama Yutaro and a sweetheart, Sanjo Tsubame, who works at Akabeko.

name: Sanosuke Sagara
description: Sagara Sanosuke left home at an early age to join the Sekihou Army (Sekihou-tai), leaving behind his father ([Kamishimoemon](https://anilist.co/character/49245/Higashidani-Kamishimoemon)), his mother (Naname), and his younger sister ([Uki](https://anilist.co/character/49541/Higashidani-Uki)) who adored him.

name: Souzou Sagara
description: Based on the actual captain, Sagara Sōzō (1839 - 1868) was the leader of the Sekihōtai's First Troop. Sanosuke looked up to him greatly; he was, to Sanosuke, the ideal role model. He was killed when the Meiji government purged the Sekihōtai, leading to Sanosuke's embitterment towards it. His head was placed on a platform and in a cage for all to see, it haunts Sano still to this very day. Sometime after his death, Sano took his name and became Sagara Sanosuke.    Info taken from Wikipedia

name: Makoto Shishio
description:
After the death of Yukishiro Tomoe, Himura Kenshin became a free wielding swordsman to protect members of the Ishin Shishi. Shishio Makoto became his successor as the shadow hitokiri (assassin) and was responsible for the assassination of Izuka, the man who had betrayed the shishi.  

The future Meiji government was more secretive about Shishio than Kenshin; many members of the Chōshū and Satsuma clans (the members of the future Meiji government) would have very little information on him.  Later, the new Meiji government believed it would be in their best interests to eliminate Shishio before he became too powerful since Shishio was a man who desired power. Thus during the Boshin War, Shishio was rendered unconscious by several gunshots, doused in oil and burned alive by the new government formed by the Ishin Shishi. He survived, sustaining severe damage to his entire body. Afterwards, he assembled a group of the best fighters in Japan, called the Juppongatana (Ten Swords), to overthrow the Meiji government.  

Shishio envisioned a Japan ruled by him, enforcing the principles of natural selection, or what he called "the strong eat the weak". Using this belief he ran a campaign against the Meiji government, as he felt it was too weak to effectively lead the country. Using his motto, he molded an ideological disciple out of Seta Sōjirō, who served as his right-hand man, and the strongest of the Juppongatana.

name: Yutarou Tsukayama
description: Yutaro is a young boy that inherited a HUGE fortune from his parents. His parents had died when he was younger. He appears when Dr. Genzai's sister (she looks just like his brother) is working for Yutaro.    Yutaro lived in a wealthy mansion on a hill, who was practically served and waited on everyday. He wanted to learn swordsmanship since his father was deemed as an excellent fighter. He sees Kenshin with a sword and demands lessons from him. But Kenshin refuses, and Yutaro flies off the handle and says negative things about him. As time went by he found a man, Raijūta, that uses a powerful sword. Yutaro asks for Raijūta to teach him the sword techniques.

name: Tokisada Mutou
description: The father of Shougo and Sayo in Amakusa Arc of the anime.

name: Anisphia Wynn Palettia
native: アニスフィア・ウィン・パレッティア
description:
Anisphia is the first Princess of the Kingdom of Palettia. 

Possessing memories of her past life, she longs to be able to fly in the sky with the power of magic. However, as she's unable to use magic herself, she spends her days conducting questionable research in hopes of fulfilling her dream. Her eccentric behavior earned her the nickname "Princess Peculiar".

appearsIn.title: The Magical Revolution of the Reincarnated Princess and the Genius Young Lady
The Magical Revolution of the Reincarnated Princess and the Genius Young Lady

name: Euphyllia Magenta
native: ユフィリア・マゼンタ
description:
The daughter of [Duke Magenta](https://anilist.co/character/261968/Ruomen). A genius beauty who not only excels at magic, but also well-versed in academics, politics and combat.

As the fiancé of [Prince Algard](https://anilist.co/character/287676/Von-Palettia-Algard), she showed promise as the kingdom's next queen. But one fateful night would change the course of her life forever...

Occasionally she conducts joint research with [Anisphia](https://anilist.co/character/203119/Wynn-Palettia-Anisphia), but they have a complicated relationship because of their different beliefs.
