name: Rebecca Bluegarden
native: レベッカ・ブルーガーデン
description:
Rebecca Bluegarden, the female protagonist, is a kind and energetic girl from the planet Blue Garden who travels to different planets to record videos of and upload to her channel on Aoneko, a video-sharing website, with the goal of obtaining one million subscribers. She pilots a spaceship called the Aqua Wing, which also functions as a seaboat.

Rebecca's power, Leaper, is an Ether Gear that enhances her jumping ability, giving her great speed and agility.

name: Shiki Granbell
description: Shiki, the main protagonist of the story, is a friendly yet socially awkward boy who's the sole human denizen of the Granbell Kingdom, a fantasy theme park on the planet Granbell inhabited by robots. He possesses an ability called Ether Gear, which is inherited from the park's animatronic Demon King, granting its user powers akin to those of a machine; Shiki uses a variation known as "Satan Gravity" that allows him to alter and redirect his own personal gravity. Encouraged by his artificial family to go out and make some real friends, he gets swept up on a journey with Rebecca to see new worlds across the cosmos.

name: Witch  Regret
native: ウィッチ・リグレット
description:
Witch Regret is a machine part of the Four Shining Stars. She is responsible for defending Edens Zero. Her power, Shield Ether, allows her to produce barriers made of Ether. 

Witch is very dutiful and holds a deep respect to Ziggy and his adoptive grandson Shiki. Although she is usually emotionless, Witch is capable of showing emotions. She finds it embarrassing to show her face to other people.

name: Happy
description: Happy is a machine cat from the planet Excede, Rebecca Bluegarden's companion, and a member of the Edens Zero's crew. His ability "Happy Blasters" allows him to transform into a pair of guns that fire Ether bullets. These bullets are powerful enough to incapacitate their targets, but won't kill them.

name: Homura Kougetsu
description: Homura Kougetsu is a member of the Demon King's crew on Edens Zero, and a self-described knight from Planet Blue Garden. Her power, Soul Blade, is a type of Ether Gear that allows her to create bladed weapons made of Ether.

name: Hermit Mio
description: Hermit Mio is an android who's the member of the Four Shining Stars. Her power, Master Code, is a type of Program Hacking. Hermit likes clothes and video games, and used to dislike humans, but not anymore.

name: Sister  Ivry
description:
Sister Ivry is a machine part of the Four Shining Stars. Her power, Heal Atomizer, is a Healing Ether ability that allows her to mend wounds, undo negative status effects, and repair living machines. Sister is short tempered, enjoys teasing, and has a laid-back attitude, but she is also dutiful and can be friendly to her allies. She has a sadistic side and enjoys torture. She dislikes things that can't be healed.

Sister is shown to be someone who cannot accept death as a finality for machines, going as far to believe machines can be brought back by using the cloud's stored data.

name: Weisz Steiner
native: ワイズ・シュタイナー
description:
Weisz is a member of Edens Zero and a former thief from the Planet Norma. His power is Machina Maker, an Ether Gear that manipulates machines.

Weisz is a selfish, stubborn, and vain man with a perverted side. However, he does care for his friends, and shows concern for others in his own way. Weisz likes money and bunny girls, and dislikes studying.

name: E.M. Pino
description:
Pino is a miniature anti-bot machine who joins the crew of Edens Zero. She can emit bursts of electromagnetic pulses, also known as EMP, that short out electronics for a few seconds and cancel out Ether Gear when it's in use.

Her digital avatar resembles a young human girl with rabbit-like ears. She wears a necktie that is decorated with a single large heart.

name: Noboru Maeda
description: Maeda Noboru, nicknamed Suppon (Turtle). He has been detained for theft, con, dine-and-ditch, and many other crimes which could not be fully investigated during his detention.    Maeda is one of the seven protagonists in RAINBOW. He is the smallest guy in the group and the most cunning in the team. Other than An-chan, he seems to get along with Jou best,  most probably because of them being same aged and both being orphans.

name: Mansaku Matsuura
description: Matsu'ura Mansaku is seventeen and is one of the seven protagonists in RAINBOW. He is nicknamed Cabbage. He has been detained for violence and underage drinking. He performed an act of violence while drunk, leaving the victim with grave injuries.    Despite his huge figure, Mansaku is quite gentle in nature and probably the most calm amongst the seven cell mates. He showed his caring nature by wiping away the blood clots from Sakuragi's body after he was heavily beaten and left senseless for being in a fight with new cell mates by the inspector in charge.

name: Mario Minakami
description:
Minakami Mario is one of the seven main protagonists in RAINBOW. Nicknamed Mario has been detained to two years of confinement in the Shonan Special Disciplinary School. He was found guilty of inflicting grave injuries on one of his teachers who attempted an act of violence towards a female student.

Mario is strong willed and hates being looked down upon. He was the first one to start a fight in day one soon after being confined in a cell with [Sakuragi](https://anilist.co/character/31741/Sakuragi-Rokurouta)

name: Ryuuji Nomoto
description:
Nomoto Ryuji, nickname Baremoto, which means "Uncovered" has been detained for con, usurpation, and theft. He frequently committed crimes in shopping centers.

Nomoto is one of the seven protagonists of RAINBOW. He wears glasses and have a character of being an observer. [Sakuragi](https://anilist.co/character/31741/Sakuragi-Rokurouta) used his glasses to refract sunbeam to light the cigarette which [Joe](https://anilist.co/character/31748/Yokosuka-Jou) gave to him.

name: Rokurouta Sakuragi
description:
Sakuragi Rokurouta, referred as 'An-chan' by his cell mates, is the oldest of the seven protagonists in Rainbow. He is strong and has great boxing technique which he used to take on all the six new comers when [Mario](https://anilist.co/character/31742/Minakami-Mario) instigated a fight.

Although it seemed he looked down upon the six new cell mates in the beginning, which lead to a fight he won with ease, the six new cell mates found out later that Sakuragi is in reality a guy worthy to look upon and soon start to refer him as An-chan, which can be translated as an 'intimate bro'.

The reason why Sakuragi has been detained is unknown. Rumors are he killed his own parents. It seems Sakuragi holds the key to lead the six new comers to the outside world when they end their detention in two years time.

name: Tadayoshi Tooyama
description: One of the seven main protagonists of RAINBOW. Nicknamed Heitai (Army Corps/ Soldier), he has been detained for acts of violence and false imprisonments. He ruthlessly struck his mother's boyfriend, seriously injuring the man.

name: Jou Yokosuka
description:
Yokosuka Jou, nicknamed Joe is one of the seven protagonist of RAINBOW. He has been detained for 2 years for violence after being forced to have intergender relationships. He inflicted injuries requiring three months of recovery on the person who attempted to violate him.

Joe is weak by nature. He offered [Sakuragi](https://anilist.co/character/31741/Sakuragi-Rokurouta) a cigarette in the first day to beg for mercy as Sakuragi took all six of them on in a fight started by [Mario](https://anilist.co/character/31742/Minakami-Mario).

He has a younger sister named [Megumi](https://anilist.co/character/32315/Yokosuka-Megumi).

name: Ishihara
description: Ishihara is an evil security guard at the institute and has it out for Sakuragi.

name: Gisuke Sasaki
description: He is a doctor and Shio's reformatory director.

name: Junko Yoshida
description: The girl Mario protected, which caused him to go to the reformary.

name: Solada
description: Solada is a member of the Winged People Clan

appearsIn.title: The Seven Deadly Sins the Movie: Prisoners of the Sky

name: Erlatte
description: Erlatte is a member of the Winged People Clan.

appearsIn.title: The Seven Deadly Sins the Movie: Prisoners of the Sky

name: Yahiro Takigawa
description: He poses as a student of Hijirigasaka Academy and serves as Mio's observer. He is also known as the Demon Lord Lars

appearsIn.title: The Testament of Sister New Devil BURST

name: Nanao Tachibana
description: Basara's friend and a member of the student council.

appearsIn.title: The Testament of Sister New Devil BURST

name: Yui to Ui no Haha
description: [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa) and [Ui](https://anilist.co/character/19571/Ui-Hirasawa)'s mother. She is usually away with their father so [Ui](https://anilist.co/character/19571/Ui-Hirasawa) is left to do all of the chores and take care of [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa).

name: Shiho
description:
Shihois the guitarist and one of the vocalists of the band Love Crysis. Shiho and her bandmembers Maki and Aya invite the band of Maki's friend Ritsu Tainaka, Ho-kago Tea Time, to play at a live house as the first live performance outside of the band's school.
Although Shiho might appear "scary" at first sight, she is actually pretty kind, greeting strangers without reservation. She also appears to be very carefree and is mostly seen with a smile on her face.

name: Haruna Okada
description: Haruna Okada is one of the students from Class 3-2 during the second season of the anime. Haruna has a refreshing personality and is a close friend of Keiko Sano. She does karaoke to relieve stress and can be easily influenced by others' moods.

name: Kyouko Shimizu
description: Kyouko Shimizu is one of the students from Class 3-2 during the second season of the anime. Kyouko is quiet and gentle while the expression on her face doesn't often change that much. She likes flowers. She also seems to know a lot about award ceremonies and the music they use. Kyouko has an older sister which also attended the Sakuragaoka High School before her, where she was part of the Occult Club.

name: Charlotte Soller
native: シャルロット・ソレル
description: Charlotte is a maid at the de Médicis house and Pharma's childhood friend. Later on, she joins her master as a pharmacy clerk.

name: Farma de Médicis
native: ファルマ・ド・メディシス
description: Pharma is the otherworldly reincarnation of Kanji Yakutani, a world-famous medical researcher at T University who created countless medical advances and medicines to counter any sickness.

name: Eléonore Bonnefoi
native: エレオノール・ボヌフォワ
description: Pharma's personal tutor and a talented pharmacist who passed her first-grade exam at the age of fifteen. Has so many glasses to replace those she lost. She joins her student in building his dreams.

name: Chiyu Yakutani
description: [Kanji Yakutani](https://anilist.co/character/161669/Falma-de-Mdicis)'s younger sister from his past life. She died from a brain tumor as a young child.

name: Pierre
description: Owner of Dawn Pharmacy, which is Parallel World Pharmacy's first partner location.

name: Lehm Brick
description:
The oldest member of Koko's crew and the second in command. A former Delta Force operator who used to be active in Somalia during the 1990s, he is a veteran mercenary with strong leadership skills. He acted as Floyd Hekmatyar's bodyguard together with Chiquita, his ex-wife, before joining Koko's squad. Lehm also does sniper work either alone or together with Lutz.  His surname "Brick" was reveled in ep7 of season 2.  

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Sofia Velmer
native: ソフィア・ヴェルマー
description: An ex-mechanized jäger major of the Finnish Rapid Deployment Force who is skilled with knives. She is in love with [Koko](https://anilist.co/character/33451/Hekmatyar-Koko), but it is unknown whether Koko returns her feelings. Her real name is Sofia Velmer. Valmet comes from a military family and served as a UN peacekeeping officer in Africa. Her entire Finnish-led UN squad was annihilated by [Chen Guoming](https://anilist.co/character/65311/Guoming-Chen) and she herself lost an eye in that attack. Since then Valmet feels uneasy and even frightened whenever she sets foot on African soil.

name: Koko Hekmatyar
native: ココ・ヘクマティアル
description:
The series' protagonist. A young arms dealer and the daughter of Floyd Hekmatyar, a global shipping magnate. Belongs to HCLI's European and African Logistics Division.

She is physically attractive, with long silver-white hair, pale alabaster skin, striking blue eyes and her trademark smile, which is present even under dire circumstances. She is extremely charismatic and bold, which earned her great success in her business as well as the fierce loyalty of her subordinates. While generally behaving in a bubbly and slightly childish manner, Koko is actually rather ruthless and has been called a 'monster' by various characters.

She considers [Jonah](https://anilist.co/character/36566/Mar-Jonathan) a little brother and is very affectionate towards him. [Valmet](https://anilist.co/character/38954/Velmer-Sofia) has a crush on Koko, but whether Koko reciprocates the feelings is unknown.

name: Jonathan Mar
description:
A child soldier. His parents were killed by an airstrike by a F-22 Raptor. Picked up as a child soldier soon after this traumatic event. Despite his intense hatred of weapons, Jonah decides to work under the enigmatic arms dealer, [Koko Hekmatyar](https://anilist.co/character/33451/Hekmatyar-Koko). Though he is young, his skills on the battlefield are extraordinary and is frequently shown besting men much older than himself. Also, infrequently displays a childish nature. Is shown to dislike mathematics and science and excels at languages.

His primary weapon in season 1 is an FN FNC and in season 2 it is the Magpul Masada.

name: Renato Socci
native: レナート・ソッチ（アール）
description: A former Italian Army Bersaglieri intelligence officer who now works for Koko.

name: Orchestra
description: His is a ruthless gun for hire who is known for his flair of massacre, he was also Chinatsu's mentor.    (Source: ANN)

name: Lee
description: Former People's Liberation Army officer who served as Chan Guoming's bodyguard and driver, later succeeding Karen Low as his head of security.

name: Lew
description: Curry's other bodyguard. Unlike Mildo, Lu is more calmer than her.

name: Kasper Hekmatyar
native: キャスパー・ヘクマティアル
description: Koko's older brother. He is the one who sold the weapons responsible for the death of Jonah's parents, and also the reason Jonah joined up with Koko. He always has his bodyguard Chiquita with him.

name: William Nelson
native: ウィリアム・ネルソン（ワイリ）
description:
An Afro-American explosive expert and ex-lieutenant of the 20th Engineer Brigade of the XVIII Airborne Corps in the US Army. Graduated from University of Virginia School of Architecture. Wiley met Lehm and Echo in the first Gulf War when he was assigned to blow up a chemical factory. After several years, Wiley paid Lehm a visit and met Koko. His real name is William Nelson. He is put in charge of giving Jonah English lessons. He is the only person on the team aside from Koko to be blacklisted by the FBI.  

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Sae Nakata
description:
__Class:__ 1-B
__Height:__ 151 cm


A friend of Miya's. Having studied at an all-girl's school for most of her life, Sae is incredibly shy around men.   She is the main female character on the third arc in the anime

name: Junichi Tachibana
description:
**Height:** 172 cm
**Class:** 2-A

Junichi Tachibana is the lead male protagonist of the story. He has a hard time opening up to others due to trauma two years ago when his date stood him up on Christmas Eve, leaving him heartbroken. In the anime, he has acrophobia, which is referenced several times.

name: Tsukasa Ayatsuji
description:
**Class**: 2-A 
**Height**: 165 cm 

Tsukasa is the classmate of Junichi and is also the class representative of Class 2-A. She is very hard-working, and often takes the jobs that her classmates do not want. Her study habits, looks, and personality are perfect. She is popular with the students, and is also seen as a reliable student by the faculty. Her hobbies include reading in a quiet place, as such she often appears to be in the library after school.  Her arc is the 6th arc to be shown in the Anime.

name: Kaoru Tanamachi
description:
**Height:** 168 cm
**Class:** 2-A

One of Junichi's childhood friends, and is often seen with his other friend Masayoshi. She is unpredictable as she would punch Junichi anytime. She works part-time at a Family Restaurant to support her single mother.  She is the main female character on the second arc in the anime.  Kaoru is the second heroine of Amagami - Precious Diary.

name: Haruka Morishima
description:
**Height:** 169 cm 

A very popular girl in her final year, who has many fans at school. She can be described as picky, innocently insensitive, insecure, forgetful and eccentric. She also has a liking for cute things, especially puppies. Her best friend is Hibiki Tsukahara, a captain of the girls swimming team. She has one older brother and two younger brothers. She is a quarter British from her mother's side of the family. Her middle name is "Lovely" which was given by her British grandfather.  Her arc is the first in the anime.

name: Rihoko Sakurai
description:
__Height:__ 164 cm

She is Junichi's childhood friend who, despite having a big appetite, avidly reads the dieting books in their school library. She is a member of the Tea-Making Society.   Riihoko's arc is the 5th in the Anime.

name: Ai Nanasaki
description:
__Class:__ 1-B 
__Club:__ Swimming Team 
__Height:__ 160 cm 

A classmate of Miya's. She is part of their school's girl swimming team. She has a younger brother named Ikuo and is very calm in nature, and humble.   Her story is the fourth arc of the anime.

name: American Director
description: Appears in Episode 12. The director of the movie Sae and Junichi go to see as a prize for their participation in the Best Couple contest.    His words of motivation push Junichi to declare his love to Sae. It is unclear if Junichi even understood the Director as he was speaking English.    His appearance bears a resemblance to Steven Spielberg.

name: Kanae Itou
description: Rihoko Sakurai's good friend in school.

name: Maya Takahashi
description: Junichi's homeroom teacher. She tends to be a serious teacher, but can easily get drunk when she drinks sake.

name: Ai Mie
description:
An absentminded and innocent middle-school girl who sits next to Komura-kun. She has poor eyesight and must wear glasses, but she tends to forget them quite often. 
Whenever Mie forgets her glasses her depth perception in particular suffers and thus she tends to lean in close to Komura-kun.

appearsIn.title: The Girl I Like Forgot Her Glasses
The Girl I Like Forgot Her Glasses

name: Kaede Komura
description: Komura is a shy, good-natured middle-school boy. He has had a crush on Mie since the first days of school, but because of his fear of being rejected, it is difficult for him to confess his love to her. He loves playing games, especially those at the arcade.

appearsIn.title: The Girl I Like Forgot Her Glasses
The Girl I Like Forgot Her Glasses

description: Mie's friend and classmate.

appearsIn.title: The Girl I Like Forgot Her Glasses

description: Mie's friend and classmate.

The Girl I Like Forgot Her Glasses

description:
__Height:__ 161cm

A miniskirt-wearing Santa calling herself "Touko Kirishima". She claims she's been handing out presents—Adolescence Syndrome.

appearsIn.title: Rascal Does Not Dream of Santa Claus

name: Ikumi Akagi
description: Sakuta's classmate from middle school who seems to share a troubled past with him. She currently attends the same college as [Sakuta](https://anilist.co/character/127221/Azusagawa-Sakuta). She's highly intelligent, and appears to have a number of secrets.

appearsIn.title: Rascal Does Not Dream of Santa Claus
Rascal Does Not Dream of a Knapsack Kid

name: Sara Himeji
description:
__Height:__ 154 cm

A first-year student at Minegahara High with excellent grades, and one of Sakuta's students at cram school.

appearsIn.title: Rascal Does Not Dream of Santa Claus

name: Miori Mitou
description: A beautiful college girl in Sakuta's class. She follows trends and dresses up, but rather than to impress she does it exclusively for herself. Like Sakuta, she doesn't own a phone and is not easily dissuaded—has declared herself a potential friend.

appearsIn.title: Rascal Does Not Dream of Santa Claus

name: Junko Enoshima
aliases: Super High School Level Gyaru (超高校級のギャル)
description:
__Height:__ 169 cm (5'7")
__Talent:__ Gyaru

Junko is a student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant in the Killing School Life. She is the Super High School Level Gyaru (超高校級のギャル), or Ultimate Fashionista in the English localization.

Junko is talkative, charismatic, and can be hotheaded at times.

appearsIn.title: Danganronpa 3: The End of Hope’s Peak High School - Despair Arc

name: Hajime Hinata
description:
__Height:__ 179 cm (5'10")
__Talent:__ Ultimate ???

A student of Hope's Peak Academy's Class 77-B, and a participant of the Killing School Trip featured in Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair. He doesn't remember his talent at the beginning of the Killing Game, so his title is the Ultimate ???.

Hajime seems cynical at first glance, but it would be better to describe him as a realist. He is quite skeptical and tends to worry more than the other students, but his worries are usually understandable. He is logical and smart; often annoyed by the idea of not being able to understand someone or something at all. He tends to be quite serious, but he does joke around and often goes along with his classmates' eccentric hobbies anyway, and sometimes smiles awkwardly and sheepishly while his friends engage in some of their usual weird behavior. He is sometimes annoyed by some of his classmates and can be snarky towards them in his thoughts as well as blunt while speaking to them, though he's more frank than sarcastic or mean-spirited. Though sometimes a bit submissive (especially with bossy girls), he is not afraid to speak his mind, and he can be rude if annoyed enough (for example, after enduring [Hiyoko](https://anilist.co/character/90017/Saionji-Hiyoko)'s attitude during her Free Time Events, he finally ends up stating "I don't even care anymore"). He can sometimes be short-tempered and snap at others, especially when he's tired or under pressure.

appearsIn.title: Danganronpa 3: The End of Hope’s Peak High School - Despair Arc

name: Chisa Yukizome
aliases: Super High School-Level Housekeeper (超高校級の家政婦)
description:
__Height:__ 161 cm (5'3")
__Talent:__ Ultimate Housekeeper

She was later Class 77-B's homeroom teacher, and then the Future Foundation's Branch 5 Office Director responsible for the inquiry and secret intelligence regarding Despair. She, along with the other Future Foundation Directors, is forced to participate in the Final Killing Game.

appearsIn.title: Danganronpa 3: The End of Hope’s Peak High School - Despair Arc

name: Mukuro Ikusaba
aliases: Super High School Level Soldier (超高校級の軍人)
description:
__Height:__ 169 cm (5'7")
__Talent:__ Soldier

Mukuro is a student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. She is the Super High School Level Soldier (超高校級の軍人), or Ultimate Soldier in the English localization.

appearsIn.title: Danganronpa 3: The End of Hope’s Peak High School - Despair Arc

name: Chiaki Nanami
aliases: Super High School Level Gamer (超高校級のゲーマー)
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'2")
__Talent:__ Ultimate Gamer

A student of Hope's Peak Academy's Class 77-B, and a participant of the Killing School Trip. 

Chiaki normally has a quiet and sleepy disposition, but she becomes a lot more lively when discussing games and concentrates hard when playing. She has a number of unusual habits, such as dozing off while playing games and taking long pauses during her conversations to think about everything she wants to say. She sometimes even sleeps while standing and forgets to breathe when she's playing games. She also quite often uses gaming terms and references, and has a habit of ending her sentences with an uncertain note, such as with "...I think", or "Maybe...". [Hajime](https://anilist.co/character/90007/Hinata-Hajime) has told her that he wishes she had a more positive catchphrase.

Chiaki is very calm, and she once mentioned that she has never screamed. She often helps Hajime Hinata during the Class Trials and provides important points. She can be stern and bluntly honest, even at times forgetting to take other people's feelings into consideration. However, Chiaki truly does care about and wants to protect everyone. She dislikes killing more than anything and she gets very serious about the topic. She is the nicest towards [Monomi](https://anilist.co/character/73237/Monomi) and she is very understanding towards [Nagito Komaeda](https://anilist.co/character/73227/Komaeda-Nagito), even though his actions frustrate her.

appearsIn.title: Danganronpa 3: The End of Hope’s Peak High School - Despair Arc

name: Nagito Komaeda
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm (5'11")
__Talent:__ Ultimate Lucky Student

Nagito is a student of Hope's Peak Academy's Class 77-B, and a participant of the Killing School Trip. 

On the surface, Nagito is friendly and easygoing. He genuinely cares for his classmates and holds a lot of respect for ideals like love, friendship, and teamwork. However, he doesn't care for "ordinary, untalented people" such as himself and is extremely self-deprecating; he sees himself as "worthless trash" whose life has no value, something he brings up often. Nagito is also highly intelligent, usually solving the murders long before anyone else, though he doesn't share his findings easily.

Nagito has an extreme, twisted obsession with hope. He believes that hope is an absolute good that will always win in the end, and that anything done in the name of hope, even murder, is virtuous. He sees Ultimates as the embodiments of hope that are chosen at birth, and thinks they can strengthen that hope by facing and overcoming despair. He doesn't consider himself to be a "real" Ultimate, and instead wishes to sacrifice himself so that they can shine.

appearsIn.title: Danganronpa 3: The End of Hope’s Peak High School - Despair Arc

name: Chou Koukou Kyuu no Sagishi
description:
__Talent:__ Ultimate Imposter

The Ultimate Imposter is a student of Hope's Peak Academy's Class 77-B, and a participant of the Killing School Trip featured in _Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair_. They impersonate Byakuya Togami as the Ultimate Affluent Progeny.

The Ultimate Imposter's real appearance is that of a person with long, black hair and green eyes with a heavy build. Their age and gender is unknown, but they are able to give off a largely male impression while disguised as Byakuya and even mimic his voice perfectly. In Danganronpa 3, their real voice is quite deep and masculine. However, originally in Danganronpa 2, the brief glimpse of their apparent real voice sounded notably different, more high-pitched and rather gender neutral. The Imposter also refused to go swimming in front of others, which implies that removing their clothes would reveal their true gender. Their true personality is also somewhat unclear as they spend most of their time mimicking someone else's behavior. However, they speak briefly without disguise and it's implied that their real nature is polite and meek. Most notably, they appear to be truly kind and caring, but also quite serious.

The Ultimate Imposter doesn't have a name, family register, relatives, and anything that could link them with their true identity. In order to have their existence acknowledged, they take other people's data and learn it so they can impersonate them flawlessly.

appearsIn.title: Danganronpa 3: The End of Hope’s Peak High School - Despair Arc

name: Mikan Tsumiki
aliases: Super High School Level Health Committee Member (超高校級の保健委員)
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm (5'4")
__Talent:__ Ultimate Nurse

A student of Hope's Peak Academy's Class 77-B, and a participant of the Killing School Trip featured in _Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair_.

appearsIn.title: Danganronpa 3: The End of Hope’s Peak High School - Despair Arc

name: Mahiru Koizumi
aliases: Super High School Level Photographer (超高校級の写真家)
description:
__Height:__ 165cm (5'4")
__Talent:__ Ultimate Photographer

A student of Hope's Peak Academy's Class 77-B, and a participant of the Killing School Trip featured in _Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair_. 

Mahiru is optimistic, sensible, and unafraid to speak her mind. She's a reliable person who is prone to taking care of people, but won't hesitate to scold them either. Hajime has likened being scolded by her to being yelled at by his mom. Mahiru has high expectations of men and is quick to be abrasive towards them, while she is much more tolerant and friendly with girls. Likewise, the subjects of her photos are usually girls, as she gets bored photographing guys. Despite her love for photography, Mahiru believes her title is stupid compared to her classmates. She compares her photos to those of her mother, a famous war photographer whose career made her absent for much of Mahiru's life. Mahiru's father was a very poor parent, leaving housework entirely to her. 

(Source: Danganronpa Wiki, edited)

appearsIn.title: Danganronpa 3: The End of Hope’s Peak High School - Despair Arc

name: Kenji Miyazawa
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm (5'2")
__Ability:__ Undefeated by the Rain

A member of the Armed Detective Agency. Before he was scouted, he lived in a rural area without electricity. He knows no suspicion, and will be understanding and considerate no matter who he is talking to. He has a lot of friends who call him "Ken-chan." He likes music, tempura soba, and Mitsuya cider.

name: Sakunosuke Oda
description:
__Height:__ 185 cm (6'1)
__Ability:__ Flawless

Was a member of the Port Mafia. Oda was a man described as kind, despite working for the mafia, by [Dazai](https://anilist.co/character/89198/Dazai-Osamu). He had an incredibly perceptive side to him that allowed him to come the closest to understanding Dazai, whom he referred to as "his dear friend, who had grown tired of the world and is simply waiting to die."

name: Tatsuhiko  Shibusawa
description:
__Ability:__ Draconia

He is the main antagonist in DEAD APPLE. Six years ago, he pulled the strings behind the Dragon's Head Conflict.

name: Agatha Christie
description: is the Knight Commander of the Guards in the Order of the Clock Tower. Her ability is And Then There Were None.

name: Shintarou Midorima
description:
__Height:__ 195 cm (6'5")
__School:__ Shuutoku High School 
__Position:__ Shooting Guard  
__Special Ability:__ Shooting from anywhere on the court (Far-Distance Shooter)  

Midorima often acts reserved, mean, and brusque with others, coming off as arrogant—although [Takao](https://anilist.co/character/53563/Takao-Kazunari) claims Midorima is just "tsundere." He has a hard time acting kind to his opponents and generally hates "fooling around" (although Takao often pursues him into it). He can be seen, at all times, with a lucky item due to his strong belief and passion for horoscope. He is left-handed, and always bandages his dominant hand outside of matches (claiming that his hand must be in perfect condition so nothing will influence his shot).

Formerly a member of the basketball team of Teikou Middle School, Midorima is a member of the Generation of Miracles (Kiseki no Sedai); during his time with Teikou, his jersey number was seven, switching to six as he joined Shuutoku's. He also served as a vice-captain under [Akashi](https://anilist.co/character/42038/Akashi-Seijuurou).

His strength is his absolute accuracy, which is shown in his shots that always go in. He can shoot accurately no matter how far he is from the ring. He likes red bean soup and Oha-Asa

name: Seijuurou Akashi
description:
**Height:** 173 cm
**School:** Rakuzan 
**High Position:** Point Guard 

The final member of the Generation of Miracles, he stood at their head as captain, leading their team to uncontested victory during the three years he played for Teikou Middle School. He is uninterested in winning, simply because victory in his eyes is an absolute given, requisite to his own life as much as breathing. But he has grown tired of victory in the absence of a chance of defeat;

name: Daiki Aomine
description:
__Height:__ 192 cm (6'3'')
__Number:__ #6 (Teikou), #5 (Touou) 
__Position:__ Power Forward 
__Talent:__ Skill and Agility, Unusual Speed, Zone Play 

Aomine was the ace of Teikou's team, embracing an aggressive and liquid style, made even more powerful by Kuroko's misdirection. In fact, Aomine was once Kuroko's "Light", before Kagami. Incredibly fast and versatile, Aomine's strength lies in his unpredictability, as well as an uncanny ability to shoot from virtually any position.  

In his second year in middle school, Aomine inspired Kise to play basketball and he became his training partner. Kise was still a complete rookie, apart from his copying ability, and Aomine was obviously stronger than him, but Aomine kept training with Kise, just because he loves basketball. He taught Kise a lot and became his mentor/idol. During that time, Aomine also became the ace of the team.  

Though he loves basketball, he has  grown sardonic and unenthusiastic toward the sport, skipping practice and even arriving late for important matches. This is due to his frustration in not being able to find an opponent capable of matching his skill, and thus making him conclude that the only one that can defeat him is he himself.  

He and Momoi are childhood friends. Even though he doesn't show it, he's actually really fond of her, and they have a sibling-like relationship.

name: Yukio Kasamatsu
description:
**Height:** 178 cm 
**School:** Kaijou High 
**Number:** #4  
**Position:** Point Guard  
**Motto:** "Steady progress; rapid advance"

The captain of Kaijou's basketball team, Kasamatsu is a nationally credited point guard. Possessed of a short temper and often exceedingly serious demeanor, he can become quickly enraged over the antics of his teammates, Kise in particular, and often vents his feelings with sudden fits of violence. As he takes his responsibility as team captain very seriously, he is extremely devoted to his team and does his best to trust in their abilities and lead them to glory. He likes to play guitar.

name: Nikki Hanada
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm (5'11")

Nikki is a survivor that was revived by [Tsukasa](https://anilist.co/character/124144/Tsukasa-Shishiou), who assigned her to keep watch over [Taiju](https://anilist.co/character/124146/Taiju-Ooki) and [Yuzuriha](https://anilist.co/character/124147/Yuzuriha-Ogawa). She later defected from the Tsukasa Empire and joined the Kingdom of Science, where her unofficial role is that of disciplinarian. She has great physical strength, constantly being shown keeping people like [Magma](https://anilist.co/character/145095/Magma) and [You](https://anilist.co/character/145061/You-Uei) in line.

Nikki is a massive fan of [Lillian Weinberg](https://anilist.co/character/149274/Lillian-Weinberg). In the modern world she was having a rough time at school and listening to Lillian's songs saved her.

name: Lillian Weinberg
native: リリアン ・ ワインバーグ
description: A famous American diva and songstress whose name is known by the whole world. Her passion in adventuring lead her aboard the International Space Station (ISS) alongside Senku's father, Byuakuya Ishigami.

name: Karim Flam
description: Karim is a second generation pyrotechnic, a Lieutenant of Special Fire Force Company 1, and priest of the Holy Sol Temple. He is a serious and cautious young man. He shows a high disrespect towards strangers, which can result in him insulting people.

name: Rishe Weitzner
native: リーシェ・イルムガルド・ヴェルツナー
description: Rishe is a noble who dies at the age of 20 and returns to the moment of her broken engagement five years earlier. As a result of her various lives, she has acquired numerous skills and resilience; in this life, her seventh loop, she is engaged to Crown Prince [Arnold](https://anilist.co/character/312404/Arnold-Hein).

appearsIn.title: 7th Time Loop: The Villainess Enjoys a Carefree Life Married to Her Worst Enemy!

name: Arnold Hein
description: The crown prince of Galkhein.

appearsIn.title: 7th Time Loop: The Villainess Enjoys a Carefree Life Married to Her Worst Enemy!

native: テオドール・オーギュスト・ハイン
description: Arnold's younger brother and the second prince of Galkhein.

appearsIn.title: 7th Time Loop: The Villainess Enjoys a Carefree Life Married to Her Worst Enemy!

name: Oliver Friedheim
native: オリヴァー・ラウレンツ・フリートハイム
description: He was cut off from being a knight due to an injury and was picked up by Arnold. He has served as Arnold's squire ever since.

appearsIn.title: 7th Time Loop: The Villainess Enjoys a Carefree Life Married to Her Worst Enemy!

name: Kaine Tully
description: The chief of Aria Trading Company.

appearsIn.title: 7th Time Loop: The Villainess Enjoys a Carefree Life Married to Her Worst Enemy!

name: Kyouko Toshinou
description: Toshinou Kyouko is the founder of the amusement club. Goes so wild that no one can keep up with her, but it's not as if anyone even tries in the first place, so it's ultimately no big deal. She is actually an otaku who creates her own doujinshi of Mirakurun, an anime character in Yuru Yuri. Her favorite ice cream is rum raisin.

name: Akari Akaza
description:
Akari is a polite red-haired girl who is supposedly the main protagonist of the series. However, due to her rather small presence and plain personality, she is often forgotten about or pushed into the background. 

She is often thought of as having the ability to fire her hair dumplings and turn invisible whilst shouting "Akkari~n!". [Kyouko](https://anilist.co/character/35871) and [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/35874) are her childhood friends, while [Chinatsu](https://anilist.co/character/35875), [Sakurako](https://anilist.co/character/35878) and [Himawari](https://anilist.co/character/35879) are her classmates.

name: Yui Funami
description: A cool-headed girl who often acts as the voice of reason, usually when it comes to keeping [Kyouko](https://anilist.co/character/35871) in check. She is a reliable friend and usually lives alone in an apartment complex, but actually feels lonely without anyone else around. Although generally quiet, she will sometimes burst into laughter upon hearing [Ayano](https://anilist.co/character/35876)'s puns. She likes playing video games.

name: Chinatsu Yoshikawa
description: Akari's pink haired classmate who originally wanted to join the Tea Ceremony Club, but ended up joining the Amusement Club as the Tea Ceremony Club was already abolished. She is often chased after by Kyōko due to her resemblance to Mirakurun, though she herself has a passionate crush on Yui. She generally acts cute, especially in the presence of Yui, but she occasionally shows dark thoughts and a terrifying lack of artistic skills.

name: Sakurako Oomuro
description:
__Height:__ 153 cm

She has a tsundere type personality and aims to be the next student council vice president. She and [Himawari](https://anilist.co/character/35879/Furutani-Himawari) are childhood friends.

name: Mari Funami
description: The daughter of one of Yui's relatives who often visits Yui. She is a fan of Mirakurun, though does not take kindly to Chinatsu after learning her personality doesn't match her image. Her favorite food is sea urchin and she is very smart for her age.

name: Kaede Furutani
description: [Himawari's](https://anilist.co/character/35879/Himawari-Furutani) sister.

name: Hiro Takaoka
description: Chinatsu's classmate, who is an admirer Kyoko's doujin works

name: Rise Matsumoto
description: The current student council president who has very little presence and often speaks in a whispery quiet voice that only a few people such as [Nana](https://anilist.co/character/45529/Nishigaki-Nana) can understand.

name: Akira Akao
description:
__Height:__ 164 cm

Akira Akao is one of the examinees taking part in the JCC Exam. She is the niece of [Rion Akao](https://anilist.co/character/288224), Nagumo's and Sakamoto's old classmate.

name: Shishiba
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm

Shishiba is an assassin and member of The Order, a group of powerful assassins tasked with keeping the order within the Japanese Assassin Association (JAA). His weapon of choice is a claw hammer.

name: Kiki Seiran
description: She is one of Zen's close Aides. Her partner is Mitsuhide whom she likes to tease.

appearsIn.title: Snow White with the Red Hair Season 2
Snow White with the Red Hair

name: Garack Gazeld
description: She's the Chief Pharmacist of Clarines and the one gives Shirayuki the test to become a royal pharmacist.  Source: Wikipedia

appearsIn.title: Snow White with the Red Hair Season 2

name: Sakaki
description: Prince Raji's long-suffering aide. He puts up with the antics of the idiot prince of Tanbarun but will offer advice or a sarcastic response to his words and conduct.

appearsIn.title: Snow White with the Red Hair Season 2

description: Introduced as the general of the "Lions of the Mountain."

appearsIn.title: Snow White with the Red Hair Season 2

name: Kazuki
description: This "pretty boy" is first seen searching around the harbor suspiciously inquiring about a "red haired girl"...

appearsIn.title: Snow White with the Red Hair Season 2

name: Ranko Nakago
description: The tallest member of Sweet Bullet.

appearsIn.title: Rascal Does Not Dream of a Sister Venturing Out

name: Yui
description: Along with her twin [May](https://anilist.co/character/155752), they are recruited to Maple Tree while still on the first layer.

appearsIn.title: BOFURI: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense. Season 2

name: Chrome
description:
Introduced [Maple](https://anilist.co/character/147892) to [Iz](https://anilist.co/character/155754). He is invited to join Maple tree after the guild system was introduced.
He is a caring and honest person who is open-minded and serious. Outside of combat, he gives off a strong parental vibe. Like Maple he is part of the Shield class as well as a sword he still tries to master.

appearsIn.title: BOFURI: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense. Season 2

name: May
description: Along with her twin [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/155753), they are recruited to Maple Tree while still on the first layer.

appearsIn.title: BOFURI: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense. Season 2

name: Iz
description: She plays the production-specialized crafter class, being one of the top crafters in NWO. She joins Maple Tree upon [Maple](https://anilist.co/character/147892)'s invitation.

appearsIn.title: BOFURI: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense. Season 2

name: Drag
description:
Drag is a member of Payne's Guild, Congregation of the Holy Swords along side Frederica and Dread.

He is a gentle man with rough behavior. His combat style is like a boar, rushing in with a lot of power and laying waste to those around him. This style leads to even those close to him having a rough time supporting him.

appearsIn.title: BOFURI: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense. Season 2

name: John Bacchus
description: The mayor of Sakurami.     He is named after Bacchus —the Roman god of winery.   (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Ouji Kousaka
description: Another one of Yukiteru's classmate, Ouji is in Yukki and Yuno's classroom during the previous semester and is one of the first people to betray him during the terrorist bombing incident. He writes down a list of all of his proudest accomplishments in a blog he dubs the "Kousaka King Diary", often using the phrase "I'm Shining!" after each sentence.     (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Orin Miyashiro
description: An assistant to the 8th.

name: Mur Mur
description:
__Occupation__: Deus's Servant
__Height__: 95 cm

Deus' servant, Mur Mur is often seen with the eliminated candidates in omake panels. As of chapter twenty-four it is revealed her favorite is Yuno Gasai, and she is betting on her to win the game. She has a rather playful and nonchalant attitude toward Deus despite his warnings to her.   In a spin-off series she accidentally destroyed Yuno from existence, so she currently has taken Yuno's place as the Second till the damage can be fixed.

name: Deus Ex Machina
native: デウス・エクス・マキナ
description: The god of time and space, Yukiteru's supposed imaginary friend and the mastermind behind the game. He is looking for a successor, which is why he gave future diaries to twelve candidates and placed them in a game of life and death. He seems to favor Yukiteru the most out of all the other candidates as his next possible successor due to the miracles Yukiteru is able to pull off, not paying attention to the fact that Yuno is helping him.   _Deus_ means God in Latin.

name: Ena Komiya
description:
Ena is a second-year student, and a member of the photography club that is close to being disbanded. In order to save the club, she plans to enter a photography competition. In search of a good photo, she witnesses the reunion between Eita and Haruto.

(Source: ANN)

name: Hazuki Morikawa
description:
Hazuki is a member of the school concert band who has already decided on her preferred college. Her family has tended to a farm since her grandfather's time. She does not stand out in class, and seems uninterested in romantic relationships.

(Source: ANN)

name: Haruto Souma
description:
Haruto is a baseball team member who has already secured a job after graduation. He plans to hit the home run that he couldn't hit during the summer competition, and confess to someone he likes.

(Source: ANN)

name: Mio Natsume
description:
Mio was Eita and Haruto's classmate during middle school. She plans to enroll in college and is studying hard to make that happen. Her unrequited feelings for a middle school crush still influence her.

(Source: ANN)

name: Eita Izumi
description: Eita is a transfer student who has lived away from the town where Mio and the others lived for four years, but has now returned. He had been close friends with Haruto since middle school, and his transfer into their high school is a reunion for them.

name: Kai
description: Kai is the Boss of the CrossEyes organization, whose symbol and namesake comes from the cross marks around Kai's eyes. Kai's only two interests are food and power. He is a ruthless killer who targets powerful sorcerers and butchers them to appropriate their magical abilities. But he has his own ability, as well: an aura which has the same effect as Hole's rain, crippling any sorcerers in its range. Though Kai's murderous exploits started as relatively low-key, they later escalated to genocidal proportions, amassing mountains of corpses to fuel his scientific experiments.

name: Kururi Orihara
description: Kururi is one of Izaya's younger sisters. She has a twin sister named Mairu. Unlike her more outgoing sister, Kururi is shy and softspoken. She still stands out at school because she wears a gymnastics outfit as apposed to the usual uniform, and gets bullied due to her sister's reputation. According to Mairu, she was very happy when he said he found her to be cuter than the girl who was bullying her. Like her sister, she is a big fan of Shizuo's brother Kasuka.

name: Renton Thurston
native: レントン・サーストン
description: Renton Thurston is the son of the late military hero Adroc Thurston and co-pilot of the Nirvash typeZERO. He has been in love with Eureka the other pilot of the Nirvash ever since he first saw her. He is a very outgoing and emotional person possessing strong ideals and compassion yet is naive and tends to jump into matters before understanding what's going on. Before joining Gekkostate, he lived with his grandfather Axel Thurston in Bellforest, attending school and learning to be a mechanic in Axel's shop. He was heavily influenced by his sister Diane Thurston and believes that he will see her again one day. Though somewhat of a celebrity, being the son of a savior, Renton feels uncomfortable being the son of Adroc Thurston. His surname is recognized everywhere he travels, and he constantly feels as if he lives in his father's shadow. Renton believed Adroc was a poor father and abandoned his family for his research.

name: Holland Novak
description:
**Affiliation**: Gekkostate
**Relatives**: Azmodeus Novak (father), Cicily Kane (mother), 

Holland Novak is the leader of Gekkostate, captain of the Gekko, and pilot of the LFO Terminus typeR909 (and later the Terminus B303).

name: Eureka
description:
**Age**: 14 - 16 ([Eureka Seven](https://anilist.co/anime/237/Eureka-Seven/)), 30 - 32 ([Eureka Seven AO](https://anilist.co/anime/12471/Eureka-Seven-AO/))
**Relatives**: [Maurice](https://anilist.co/character/4049/Maurice) (adoptive son), [Maeter](https://anilist.co/character/17776/Maeter) (adoptive daughter), [Linck](https://anilist.co/character/17777/Linck) (adoptive son)

Eureka is a member of Gekkostate and the pilot of the Nirvash type ZERO, alongside her co-pilot [Renton Thurston](https://anilist.co/character/477/Renton-Thurston). 
A bit of an enigma, Eureka is a young girl who has trouble communicating with and understanding people. She speaks very calmly and directly, and due to her initial lack of empathy, often comes across as blunt. She is often perplexed by other peoples' emotions and behaviors, making her naive, especially when it comes to interpersonal relationships.

name: Talho Yuuki
description: Talho Yūki is the head pilot of the Gekko. She is also best friends with Hilda. She and Holland are romantically involved throughout the series, with context suggesting that the relationship goes back at least to Holland's military service. During the early episodes she feels insecure in Holland's commitment to her, constantly reacting jealously to Eureka, as well as to the memory of Renton's sister whom Holland had dated.

name: Ray Beams
description: Wife of Charles Beams, Retired SOF and electronic warfare specialist.

name: Matthieu
description: Matthieu is the easygoing, afro-haired pilot of the Terminus typeR606. He has a passion for music, and seems to be constantly bored. Matthieu seems to be responsible for gathering information from and maintaining contacts with ref boarders and DJs. Early on, he was one of the few members of the Gekkostate who showed any sympathy for Renton, although he played his fair share of jokes on him, too.   Matthieu and Hilda often act like husband and wife, though the two don't seem to share any such relationship apart from their arguing. Hilda orders Matthieu around as if he were her husband, and Matthieu treats Hilda as if she were his wife. He even calls her "honey" all the time. They also seem to watch each other's back fairly closely, which usually means Hilda warning Matthieu of something.   (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Woz
description: Woz is sometimes called "Woz the Whiz." He is the ship's hacker and maintains the ship's software. He and Jobs were originally stowaways aboard the Gekko, but they were invited to stay because of their technical skills. He and Jobs tend to argue over how best to configure the Gekko's systems, since Woz insists on rewriting the control systems to compensate for every modification Jobs makes while Jobs asserts that the software is fully capable of supporting the changes. His hippy attitude and grunge attire are a deep contrast to Jobs, but they seem to maintain a strong friendship anyway. He is modeled after Steve Wozniak (hence, "Woz"), another of Apple's co-founders.   (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Maria Schneider
native: マリア・シュナイダー
description: Maria Schneider is the executive officer of the Izumo and trusted right-hand woman of Jurgens. In the movie version of Eureka Seven she's named only as Maria and is married to Jurgens.

name: Julio Chesaré
native: ジュリオ・チェザーレ
description: A priest from the Holy Romalian Empire sent as transfer student to the Tristain Magic Academy. He has Moon Eyes (月目?), as his eyes are heterochromic—one red, one blue, like the two moons of Halkeginia. Julio is sent by Romalia's Pope as his support for Henrietta's expedition to Albion, now in political strife after the fall of the royal family followed by the death of Reconquista's leader, Cromwell.  Although not a mage, Julio is a dragon knight and expert swordsman. During his duel with Saito to win Louise's kiss, Julio could easily win against Saito—who does not use Gandalfr's skill, but he let Saito win to tease him. He has beautiful looks and a personality that grants him popularity among girls. He can be considered a replacement for Guiche after his depart to the military service because he is similar to Guiche in looks—however, Julio is worldly, as opposed to the vain, foolish Guiche, and hardly had to exert effort to charm most of the female students in the Academy.

She is a typical best friend who always watching Aika and comforts her whenever she faced undesired circumstances.

name: Alicia
description: One of the thirteen heroes who set out to slay the lord of Dark Beasts, [Clevatess](https://anilist.co/character/339319/Clen). She was bestowed the sacred treasure "Rock Swallow" by [King Haiden](https://anilist.co/character/359337/Haiden-Ou). She is the daughter of the hero [Margo](https://anilist.co/character/366646/Margo-Glenfall), who was once granted the title of "Sword Saint."

name: Clen
description:
One of the Four Great Demon Beast Kings, he dwells upon the Moon Mountain of the South. He is also known as "Clevatess of the Moonlight." He possesses a massive, jet-black body resembling that of a wolf, with a single long horn protruding from his forehead and seven sharp tails.

Deeming that he could not walk the human world while retaining his colossal form, Clevatess assumed a human guise. It is modeled after the appearance of the pageboy who entrusted him [Luna](https://anilist.co/character/355949/Luna).

name: Luna
description: A newborn infant entrusted to [Clevatess](https://anilist.co/character/339319/Clen), who had attacked Hiderat, the capital of the steel nation of Hiden, by a dying page. He is a pure-blooded Hidenean and holds the right to the Hiden throne.

name: Neruru
description: A slave woman raised among the bandit clan known as "The Crow."

name: Haiden Ou
description: The King of Haiden, the Land of Steel. The only one capable of forging Regalia in the Royal Forge.

name: Roberto De Niro
description: A middle-ranking reporter for Bernardelli News Agency. Travels with Meryl as her educator. He is a drunkard who loves sake and is aloof, but he is a veteran who has overcome many battles.

name: Rem Saverem
description:
Rem left the Earth aboard Project Seeds when the planet's resources were all consumed and it became inhospitable. In their search for a new home, the remnants of humanity, with their cryogenically frozen human cargo in tow, traveled the stars and came upon a young Vash and Knives alone on a hostile planet. While most of the crew wanted to exterminate them, Rem stood in the way and saved them. She was treated by Vash and Knives like human beings, and not monsters.  

Rem is Vash's inspiration. She's the reason why he won't kill, for she once had said "No one has the right to take the life of another." She's also the inspiration for Vash choosing to wear a red coat. Rem's favorite flower was the red geranium, a flower that symbolized unshakable determination. Wearing the red coat not only reminds him of Rem, but also reminds him of his promise not to kill and to help others.

name: Knives Millions
native: ミリオンズ・ナイブズ
description:
As Trigun unfolds, it becomes apparent that Knives believes that humans are parasites that need to be exterminated. He wants to create a peaceful and fair world with [Vash](https://anilist.co/character/162/Vash-the-Stampede) and his other plant brethren, and he believes the only way to do this is by killing off all humans. 

Knives never claims to be a god; simply a superior being to homosapiens. If Knives were able to kill all humans and begin creating his "Eden" on Gunsmoke, it is very likely that he would act similarly to Vash, and act as a kind and loving individual.

name: Takao
description: President of the "real" Game Creation Club with no known first name. Friends with Roka, even though she left and started her own Game Creation Club on negative terms. Others in the school refer to Takao as a "Boobs" elemental in later chapters due to their large size and amount of times they affect other people.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Chitose Karasuyama
description: A second-year and the Student Council President. Her authority is so great even the teachers fear her. Her element is "Earth", and her main combat method includes punching her opponent, throwing dirt at them, or digging traps. She also has a habit of burying her victims up to the neck. (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Kenji Kazama
description: An 'infamous' delinquent at Fujou High. Unlike the members of his gang, he possesses no special or remarkable traits other than his hard spiky hair and his straight man ability. He is also a member of the Game Production Club (Temp), after he was coerced into it by the other 4 original members.   He has a desire to be the strongest at the school, but constantly wonders why the girls are much more stronger; and why the guys are usually freaks.

name: Sakura Mizukami
description: A first-year and a pink-haired tomboy. Her element is "Water", and she carries around a water bottle at all times. Her combat method includes pouring water on her hands, or forcing water down an opponent's throat. She later starts referring Kenji as her big brother, while Noe as her little sister, despite the denial from both. (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Roka Shibasaki
description: The president of the Game Creation Club (Provisional). She refers her element as "Fire", but later states that her true element is actually "Darkness." Her main combat method is putting a bag over her opponents' head, rendering them blind, hence the darkness element. She carries a lot of spare bags so she can use them anytime. Despite having a small profile, she is referred as "Strongest Darkness" and is the strongest in school. She refers Kenji as her "important person", and shows jealousy when other girls approach him. (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Haijima
description: A student at Fujou High School, delinquent and a member of 14 Orchestra of Evil. He belongs to Team B in "Space Porn Book War Game ver 1.02 Arc," get beaten up Along with Myoukaku. He have Twin dragon Attack together with Myoukaku however it's useless, and just like most other members at his gang. Haijima sometimes also don't appreciate Odawara as their leader.

name: Hiroshi Nagayama
description: He is one of Kenji and Yokoshima's longtime​ friend and classmate, he is also part of the infamous trio called "Kazama's Party."

name: Odawara
description: A student at Fujou High who is also the leader of the Band of 14 devils gang, and it is the one that is feared the most at their school.

name: Tsutsumi Inada
description:
A glasses-wearing girl with a perverted streak who often dresses up Sakuragaoka in girly outfits. She acts as Chitose's counterpart for the "real" Game Creation Club. 

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Fukuko Nishinaga
description: She is a teacher at Fujou High and is also the Advisor of the Cooking Club.

name: Anna Sasaki
description: Anna Sasaki is the introverted core protagonist of the Japanese animated film, When Marnie Was There by Hiromasa Yonebayashi. Anna has short brown hair and blue eyes. She typically dresses in tan shorts, blue sneakers, and a two-shades of blue t-shirt. At the Tanabata festival, she wears a pink kimono.

name: Marnie
description: Marnie was raised in the Marsh House when she was growing up.

name: Yoriko Sasaki
description: Yoriko Sasaki is the aunt and carer of Anna Sasaki, the main protagonist of Studio Ghibli's film, When Marnie Was There.

name: Kiyomasa Oiwa
description: Kiyomasa Oiwa is a character in When Marnie Was There and voiced by Susumu Terajima.

name: Dr. Xeno
aliases: Xeno Houston Wingfield (ゼノ・ヒウストン・ウィングフィールド)
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm (5'11")

Scientist and leader of the American Colony. Similar to Senku, Xeno is brilliant when it comes to science. He is very observant, somewhat eccentric, and has a penchant for stating the word "Elegant."

name: Stanley Snyder
native: スタンリー・スナイダー
description: Stanley is a tall, well-built man with very feminine facial features.

name: Sousuke Yamazaki
description: He is the butterfly and freestyle swimmer on Samezuka Academy's swim team and a 3rd year high school student at Samezuka Academy. Sosuke is a close elementary school friend of Rin Matsuoka, and the person who understands him the most.

name: Mitsuyoshi Tada
description: He is in his second year at the Ginga University Affiliated Koinohoshi High School. He wants to become a photographer just like his late father, and is working at Tada Coffee Shop, which is run by his grandfather. He is a part of the photography club at school, and his specialty is atmospheric pictures. He doesn't talk much, but he is a kind boy who works very hard and cares for his friends. Those around him sometimes envy him, because he is always himself and very attentive to his surroundings. He lives with his grandfather, his sister [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/125339/Tada-Yui), and his beloved cat [Nyanko Big](https://anilist.co/character/161337/Big-Nyanko) in a corner of Ginza.

name: Teresa Wagner
description: A student from the European country of Luxembourg. She is a beautiful girl with blonde hair and bright, jade-like green eyes. She has a bubbly and honest personality, and always has a bright smile on her face. She loves a Japanese historical drama called "Rainbow Shogun" and even though she is really good with Japanese, she sometimes ends up using samurai language. She is living together with [Alexandra](https://anilist.co/character/125337/Magritte-Alexandra), who is also a fellow exchange student and they also like to spend a lot of time together.

name: Charles de Loire
aliases: シャルル・ド・ロワール
description: Charles is a descendant of French nobility. He is an exceptional person because even though he is a second year university student, he is also a competent company president. He not only has great reflexes but is also a gentle person full of consideration for others. He seems like a superman that can do anything. He has been in contact with Teresa since they were children.

name: Nyanko  Big
description: Rescued and adopted cat of Mitsuyoshi Tada 10 years ago in s1 timeline. He is proud of Mitsuyoshi and has watched over him as he grew. He has his own internet blog where Mitsuyoshi Tada uploads daily.

name: Hinako Hasegawa
description: She is a childhood friend of Hajime and part of the photography club. She was forced into joining the club by Hajime so that they could meet the quota. She is an honor student who can handle anything and has a vast amount of knowledge. She wears her long hair in a braid. Ijuin and Tada are in the same class as her and since she is part of the student council, the members of the club call her 'student rep.' She is very modest and serious and wants to change herself, so she is making an effort to do so.

name: Kaoru Ijuuin
description: He is a childhood friend of Tada and also a member of the photography club. If he doesn't open his mouth, he actually is quite handsome but sadly he can never keep it shut long enough to fool anyone. He is due to take over his family's famous restaurant in Ginza, so he is very good at cooking. When they were small, Tada saved him from a dangerous situation so he thinks of Tada as his one and only friend. Because he often spends his days at the Tada Coffee Shop, he is also good friends with Grandpa and Yui, but since he is hated strongly by Nyanko Big, he goes into self-defense mode whenever they meet.

name: Alexandra Magritte
native: アレクサンドラ・マグリット
description:
Alexandra came together with Teresa as an exchange student and is also from Luxembourg. 

She is childhood friends with Teresa and often acts as her guardian. To protect her, she would do anything. 

She isn't just smart, but also strong and is very calm and serious. She doesn't laugh much, but as she gets closer to Ijuin her ability to read between the lines is shaking him. However, she also has a side to her that loves romantic books and movies.

name: Hajime Sugimoto
description: He is in the year above Mitsuyoshi and is the president of the photography club. His club members refer to him as the 'in-focus-senpai.' He is very bright and gets good grades, but unfortunately tends to say exactly what's on his mind. His dream for the future is to be a photographer of nudes and thinks unsavory thoughts no matter when and where. He is an enthusiastic fan of the gravure idol and model HINA. He often argues with his childhood friend Hinako Hasegawa.

name: Yui Tada
description:
Mitsuyoshi's younger sister who keeps her black hair in a bob. She has a bright and bubbly personality. Since losing both her parents, she has looked up to her grandfather and older brother as parental figures, and has a sibling-like relationship with the cat Nyanko Big. She enjoys mystery novels, and is currently into the "Sunflower Express Love Incidents" series.

She looks up to Yamashita and holds secret feelings for him. It seems she is trying to keep her crush a secret, but it is so obvious that everybody knows.

name: Kentarou Yamashita
description: Yamashita is the only first-year member of the photography club, and Tada and Ijuin are his upperclassmen. He's an androgynous pretty boy with a tall, slim frame and fluffy hair which he always clips back. He went to the same middle school as Tada, so they have had a lower/upperclassman relationship for a while. He has a deep respect for Tada to the point he seems like a loyal puppy. Therefore the other group members have given him the nickname 'Yamashita-Ken,' with 'Ken' being written with the character for 'dog.' He loves animals, but unfortunately, they don't seem to love him back. Of course Nyanko Big doesn't like him either.

name: Kirie Goshima
description: Kirie Goshima, a schoolgirl in the town of Kurouzucho, becomes concerned with her boyfriend Shuichi Saito’s father who has become obsessed with collecting and staring at spiral patterns to the ignorance of all else. After Shuichi’s father kills himself inside a washing machine, his cremated remains hang over the town in a giant cloud. The obsessive behaviour starts to spread to Kirie’s father and others, while all around the town people start bodily mutating into spiral creatures.

name: Shuuichi Saitou
description: Shuichi is Kirie's boyfriend. He is the only one who feels and understands the fact that the town is cursed by the spiral.

name: Mitsuru Yamaguchi
description: A seventh grader who was in same school as [Kirie Goshima](https://anilist.co/character/6540/Kirie-Goshima) who loved to jump out and surprise people. He also had a crush on her.

name: Azami Kurotani
description: Azami Kurotami is a high school student from Midoriyama-Shi who goes to the same school as Kirie in Kurôzu-Cho.

name: Toshio Saitou
description: Shuichi's father. One day he stopped going to work to study "the art of the spiral", creating an abnormal obsession with that shape.

name: Yukie Saitou
description: Shuichi's mom. After her husband developed an obsession with spirals, she developed an uncontrollable fear for that shape.

name: Yasuo Goshima
description: The father of Kirie Goshima and Mitsuo Goshima who is a potter situated next to Dragonfly Pond.

name: Chizuko Goshima
description: The mother of Kirie and Mitsuo Goshima and the wife of Yasuo Goshima.

name: Mitsuo Goshima
description: Kirie's younger brother.

name: Kyoko Sekino
description: One of Kirie Goshima's school friends.

name: Afro Samurai
description: The holder of the title "Number Two," Afro is out to hunt down Justice, the man who killed his father for the rank of "Number One." From the time he was a child, Afro honed his skills as a swordsman; his style typically consists of wielding his sword with only his right hand while his left continues to hold on to his sheath, although during his fight with Jinno, he held his sword with both hands to compensate for Jinno's dual wielding speed. He is a very quiet individual, likely because the life of the "Number Two" does not allow him to have any close relationships with anyone, so when approached by others he says very little, if anything.  Although he seems cold, he is still haunted by his memories and past relationships; Justice later remarks that Afro, like his father, is still "soft inside." He also has a fondness for lemonade.

name: Jinno
description:
Perhaps one of the most noble and tragic characters He is perhaps the only friend [Afro Samurai](https://anilist.co/character/2549/Afro-Samurai) has ever known. Once a charismatic and young sub-leader of a secret sword school, fate destines that Jinnosuke get horribly disfigured and trapped into the powerful and twisted mechanical teddy bear helmet which earns him the name Kuma (which means "bear" in Japanese).

With his two-sword technique still in tact and even further enhanced by his cybernetic implants, Kuma is nearly unstoppable. Too bad that underneath this frighteningly powerful warrior, is still the troubled mind of a good friend whose life light was snuffed out too early...

name: Yashichi
description: He is the brother of Hachiro and was with him in their first attack upon young Afro. Some time later, young Afro managed to interrogate him for the info on who has the Number Two Headband before killing him.

name: Brother One
description: The leader of the Empty Seven, who believes that obtaining both headbands will lead to immortality and godhood. He has a golden robotic left arm, which he can switch out for a machine gun.

name: Ninja Ninja
description: The white haired companion of Afro Samurai. Afro's herald, hype-man and a real trash-talker; Ninja Ninja bears witness to Afro Samurai's search for Justice. Ninja Ninja is a force of nature - mischievous, highly-strung and dangerously irresponsible. When something is going down he'll split as fast as his veneer of cool. It's sometimes hard to tell if Ninja Ninja is Afro's ally or his enemy.

name: Sasuke
description: One of the orphan children raised and trained by the dojo master.

name: Justice
description:
A lightning-quick gun-fighter and current #1 fighter of the world, little is known of this reclusive warrior. The only thing known for sure is that he killed the prior top fighter in the world in a one-on-one duel -- that top fighter was the father of Afro Samurai. It is rumored that his strange skin color is due to some kind of horrible accident. The holder of the Number One headband for most of season one, Justice is the man who killed Afro's father before his eyes many years ago and to some extent convince him to challenge him when he was old enough. 

He is a remarkably skilled gunman, dressing in a cowboy garb with the Number One headband tied around his wide-brimmed hat. He has discolored, diseased-looking skin, which his bio on the official site implies is the result of a past accident (undecided, but assumed by the publishers to have been submerged in toxic waste) which would explain his abnormal abilities. Justice has the ability to regenerate himself after being exposed to blood, as seen just before his final fight with Afro when the injured hero's blood flows to Justice's feet and his withered body begins to reshape into the young version that fought Afro's father. He also has a third arm hidden on his back that holds a sword for catching opponents off guard (in an earlier version of the official website, Justice was described as "The Gunman with Three Arms"), which explains how he decapitated Afro's father.

name: Otsuru
description: A young woman who specializes in the art of healing, Otsuru is an excellent cook and adores fireworks. She is the one who discovered Afro in the shrine after he lost the Number Two headband as a boy, and took him to Sword Master's dojo where he befriended Jinno. When she is introduced as "Okiku," she has once again found Afro in a near-death state (having been blown off a cliff by an RPG fired by Brother 6 and badly poisoned by an arrow in a fight with Soshun); she bandages him and takes him to her home to heal. She and Jinno survived the attack that was meant to claim the Number Two headband from Sword Master, and they were both saved by the Empty Seven Clan.   Apparently, some time after the events at Sword Master's dojo, she became an agent working for Brother 1 of the Empty Seven Clan. She possesses the unique ability to siphon memories from people as they dream and did this to copy down Afro's sword style to be used to complete the Afro Droid. She was also supposed to kill him should the opportunity ever present itself, but she finds herself unable to after having sex with him. She remarks that she still thinks of him as the same innocent boy she knew so long ago, revealing to him that she is actually Otsuru. Brother 2 of the Empty Seven then kills her for failing to carry out her mission and betraying the Empty Seven.

name: Sword Master
description: Following the death of his father, Afro is found and taken in by the master of a Sword School. As he comes to understand Afro’s dark past, Sword Master attempts to dissuade the boy from pursuing his father’s killer and to live a normal life, creating a conflict that only serves to push Afro further along the path to vengeance.

name: Rokutarou
description: Rokutarou, Afro's father, was the Number One at the beginning of the series, who lost his title and life to Justice when he decapitated him. How he attained the Number One headband, what he did during his time as Number One, and how long he'd had it prior to Justice killing him remains unclear.

name: Sueharu Maru
description: Sueharu Maru was originally a very famous child actor, and his mother was also one. However, his mother couldn't express emotions well, so she couldn't become very famous. She supported her son so he could become a fantastic actor for both her and his sake. He likes Shirokusa Kachi and he's a fan of her. Kuroha Shida is Sueharu's childhood friend.

appearsIn.title: Osamake: Romcom Where The Childhood Friend Won't Lose

name: Kuroha Shida
description: Sueharu's childhood friend. She also lives next door to Sueharu and is the eldest of the 4 sisters in her family.

appearsIn.title: Osamake: Romcom Where The Childhood Friend Won't Lose

name: Shirokusa Kachi
description: A child novelist who has received well-known awards at a very young age for her astounding works. She is Sueharu's first love interest.

appearsIn.title: Osamake: Romcom Where The Childhood Friend Won't Lose

description: A famous child actor who worked with Sueharu in the past.

name: Tetsuhiko Kai
description: Sueharu's classmate and friend.

appearsIn.title: Osamake: Romcom Where The Childhood Friend Won't Lose

description: Kuroha Shida's little sister.

appearsIn.title: Osamake: Romcom Where The Childhood Friend Won't Lose

name: Midori Shida
description: Kuroha Shida's little sister.

appearsIn.title: Osamake: Romcom Where The Childhood Friend Won't Lose
