description: Father of Shirokusa Kachi.

appearsIn.title: Osamake: Romcom Where The Childhood Friend Won't Lose

name: Meiko Mine
description: One of Shirokusa's only friends at Hozomino High School.

appearsIn.title: Osamake: Romcom Where The Childhood Friend Won't Lose

name: Uramichi Omota
description:
**Height:** 175 cm (5'9)

He works as an exercise instructor (or gymnastics teacher) for the educational TV program "Together with Mama". The characters of his name implies that he is two-faced.

He was among one of the elites in Nippon Sport Science University, which is known for its many famous athletes.

When he has some free time after work, he enjoys taking some time to relax his muscles because it makes him forget about his problems, otherwise he "drops dead".

name: Iketeru Daga
description:
**Height:** 184 cm (6")
**Smoker:** His body can't handle it
**Alcohol:** Incredibly weak

One of the song instructors along with Tadano Utano. His name is a pun meaning "But I'm handsome".
Former musical actor with a beautiful voice and a face that girls can't resist.
He loves low level puns, he can't read between the lines or take a hint. He can't even read a clock.
He has an obsession over food, making him think about food constantly.

name: Utano Tadano
description:
**Height**: 162 cm (5'3")

One of the song instructors along with Daga Iketeru. Her name is a pun meaning "Just a singer".

Former washed up pop idol, then cover singer, then Jazz singer at a nightclub. She graduated from an elite music school, but because of bad luck or poor timing, her career got unstable.

She's been living together with her comedian boyfriend for 6 years and constantly talks about marriage.

name: Tobikichi Usahara
description:
**Height:** 182 cm (6')

He wears the costume of a rabbit while on stage. He is the target of Uramichi's stress, and as such, Usahara fears him. Because of his fear of Uramichi, Usahara makes sure to avoid eye contact with him by not removing his mask often. Usahara gossips about Uramichi behind his back and once he notices Uramichi around him, he freezes in fear. His partner, Mitsuo Kumatani, often tells Uramichi what Usahara thinks of him and this frustrates Usahara of how easily Mitsuo can betray him. Regardless, he still drinks out with Uramichi and Kumatani and often visits Uramichi's home.

name: Mitsuo Kumatani
description:
**Height:** 176 cm (5'8")
**Smoker**: Quit
**Drinker:** Yes (High tolerance)

He wears the costume of a bear while on stage.

name: Hanbee Kikaku
description:
**Height:** 178 cm (5'10.1")

He works for the MHK Sales Planning Department and is in charge of developing merchandise. 
He is a former band member with long hair and many piercings. 
At first glance, he appears to be emotionally unstable, but he is in fact serious about his work.

name: Chinatsu Hiyama
description:
Chinatsu Hiyama is one of the main characters in the series.

Chinatsu has long orange-red hair that reaches mid-torso, and pink eyes. She is slender and tall, once mentioning that if she wore high heels she would probably be taller than Tatara.

name: Tatara Fujita
description: A third year middle school student living a quiet boring life and getting bullied by the upperclassmen. He then meets Kaname Sengoku and gets dragged into trying ballroom dancing. He soon fall in love with ballroom dancing after watching a video of Kaname Sengoku at a tournament and winning it. He aspires to become a professional ballroom dancer.

name: Shizuku Hanaoka
description: A third year student who is studying ballroom dancing at Ogasawara Dance Studio. She aims to be a professional dancer. She is good enough to beat most cheap professional dancers.

name: Kiyoharu Hyoudou
description: He is a third year junior high student and is studying dancing at Ogasawara Dance Studio. He won the JDSF Grand Prix and ranked first in the 'latin' and 'standard' division.

name: Tamie Idogawa
description:
__Birthday__: November 1__Height:__ 173 cm (5'8")

Tamie is Kugimiya Masami's dance partner.

name: Masami Kugimiya
description: Masami is a gentleman with an elegant height. He still styles his hair the same way he used to as a child, wavy, long bangs, short at the back, and shaved on the sides. He tends to pull it all backwards, or pull only one side of it depending on occasion, but lets it down to his face when he's at home or inside. He wears graceful suits usually with suspenders, and Derby or Oxford shoes of some sort professionally, but tasteful and fashionable in his day to day life; scarfs, boots, cloaks, ragged or ripped skinny jeans, necklaces, fur collared jackets, skinny long sleeved shirts, etc.

name: Karen Banba
description: She is a dance teacher at Ogasawara Dance Studio.

name: Tomochika Jinbo
description: He is a dance teacher at Ogasawara Dance Studio.

name: Tamaki Tsuburaya
description: She works at Ogasawara Dance Studio.

name: Mako Akagi
description: She is Akagi Gaju's younger sister as well as his dance partner. They have been dancing together since she was four years old, with her being the one who initiated the pair's entry into the dance world. She thinks herself as somewhat unworthy of her brother's partnership.

name: Yukari Akiyama
description:
**Height:** 157 cm (5'2")
**Home Town:** Tsuchiura, Ibaraki Prefecture

A member of Anko Team, and the loader of the Team. She gets overly excited when she sees or hears anything about tanks - to put it, she is a tank otaku. Yukari has had a deep love for all things tanking and WW2 since a young age. She collects tank models and frequently utilizes WW2-era equipment whenever possible. She uses her knowledge of tanks to help the team.  She has a deep respect and admiration of overall tank commander [Miho](https://anilist.co/character/62939/Miho-Nishizumi), going as far to refer to her as "Nishizumi-dono". Yukari is also known for her infiltration missions, where before a match she will sneak her way into the competing team's school in order to get intel for Miho and the rest of Oorari.

name: Mako Reizei
description:
**Height:** 145 cm (4'9")
**Home Town:** Ooarai, Ibaraki Prefecture

A member of Anko Team and is the team's driver. She is a quiet and gloomy girl who falls easily asleep, and hates mornings. She is also weak to certain conditions.

She is late to school everyday but is top of the class and can learn things almost instantly just by reading. She is a genius with a high level grade performance. But, due to her habitual tardiness in the morning she has insufficient credits, and so in exchange for credits, she is pursuing Sensha-do. She is childhood friends with [Saori Takebe](https://anilist.co/character/62941/Saori-Takebe). Mako lives with her aging and strict grandmother [Hisako Reizei](https://anilist.co/character/74701/Reizei-Hisako).

name: Miho Nishizumi
description:
**Height:** 158 cm (5'2")
**Home Town:** Kumamoto City, Kunamoto Prefecture

She was born into the distinguished family of the Nishizumi Style of Sensha-do, but she changed schools to Ooarai Girls Academy intending to run away from Sensha-do.   However, perplexingly enough, she was extorted into joining Sensha-do by the student council. She's a second-year and considers her friend's feelings more than anyone else. She has traumatic memory of tanks because of an incident that happened during her past with a tank. She's Ankou Team's Commander and is Ooarai's De Facto captain.   

Miho has a polite personality and can lack self-confidence when in social situations. However when in a Sensha-do battle, Miho is known for her quick and decisive thinking. Miho also has a deep sense of loyalty to her friends, being ready to sacrifice her own reputation for the sake of others. Finally, Miho is a fan of the teddy bear brand Boko, having a large collection of the bandaged/beat-up bears in both her apartment and her old room back home.

name: Saori Takebe
description:
**Height:** 157 cm (5'2")
**Home Town:** Ooarai, Ibaraki Prefecture

Hana's friend and the other girl who befriended Miho during the first day of school. She is a social butterfly and is incredibly talkative. She yearns for a love that will love everything in the world, despite never being in a relationship before. She thought she would be popular among boys if she took Sensha-do. She is a member of the Ankou Team and serves as the Radio Operator and machine gunner. She also acts as a big sister for the Rabbit team comprised of the freshman. She sometimes calls [Miho](https://anilist.co/character/62939/Miho-Nishizumi) "Miporin". Saori is also a talented cook. 


(Source: Official Character Sheet)

name: Hana Isuzu
description:
**Height:** 163 cm (5'4")
**Home Town:** Mito, Ibaraki Prefecture

A member of Anko Team and the Team's gunner. A beautiful girl who has a gentle and composed demeanor, and is the other girl alongside Saori who befriended Miho during the first day. She was born into a home that had mastered the art of flower arrangement, but having felt dissatisfaction with this way of life, as a genuine Ojou-sama she chose Shensha-do instead.

name: Alisa
description:
A manipulative and aggressive radio operator who taps enemy communications to obtain an unfair advantage in combat. 

Commanded the flag tank in Saunders' match against Oarai in first round of the national Sensha-dou championship. She was scolded by [Kay](https://anilist.co/character/72655/Kay) when the latter found out about her radio tapping.

name: Shinzaburou
description: Servant in the Isuzu household.

name: Taki Momose
description: Taki is a first year student from Ooarai Girls High School, She's an online game fanatic. She's also the driver of the Anteater Team's Type 3 Chi-Nu.

name: Katyusha
description: She's Captain of the Pravda High School team. Since she always gets remarks on her short stature, she is called the Tiny Tyrant.

name: Nonna
description: She's the vice commander of the Pravda Girls High School Sensha-Dō team, as well as its sniper. She mainly operates a Soviet T-34-85 tank, although she can also operate an IS-2 as well. In the anime, she only missed one shot when she served as the gunner of IS-2. Throughout her public and private life she has followed the various actions of Katyusha.

name: Lisara Restall
description:
__Race:__ Shinigami  

The heroine of the story and a beautiful Goddess of Death, who has came to the human world to find the ''Singular Man''. Ryosuke first encounters her when he sees her drenched in the rain.  She later makes a contract with Ryosuke, and tries to take away his perverted spirit.

name: Quele Sellier
description: Lisara's distant cousin and another Grim Reaper. She calls Lisara "Onee-sama" despite not being her sister. She made a contract with Mina as her energy source to both Ryosuke's and Lisara's dismay. Wields a gladius called "Carnun Solace".  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Iria Fukumune
description:
Lisara's rival Grim Reaper during her school years at Grimwald who is also a famous pop idol in the human world. Despite being 2nd in the school (1st being Lisara), she has the biggest bust size of the main cast (92.5cm). However, her large breasts are revealed to be a result of infusing breast pads with magic, and her actual bust size is smaller than Lisara's. Her weapon, "Froddy," is a falchion.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Ryosuke Kaga
description: The main protagonist of the story who lost his perverted spirit to Lisara, and now struggles to regain that spirit back. Ryosuke cannot enjoy himself while living with the Death Goddess Lisara under a contract, because he gave up his erotic spirit under the deal. He cannot get excitement from watching girls and wonders if his adolescent days are over. Also, he learns from Lisara, that he will die in three months and in return of his help, she will try to change his fate.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Mina Okura
description: She is Ryosuke's childhood friend, who lives next door from him. She rather a good cook and she would often drop by Ryosuke's place to either fetch him or prepare his meal. She also has a large bust size which the latter would look at, from time to time.

name: Dalnia Earhart
native: ダルニア・イアハート
description: She is a Grim Reaper who works for Merilot Life Insurance.

name: Almeia Restall
native: アルメイア・レストール
description: She is Lisara's Mother

name: Touka Takanashi
description: Older sister to [Rikka Takanashi](https://anilist.co/character/65865). According to Rikka, she is the alleged powerful and overseeing Priestess of the Deep Horizon. She uses a ladle as a weapon against Rikka's crazy antics. She works as a cook.

appearsIn.title: Love, Chunibyo & Other Delusions: Take on Me

name: Nanase Tsukumo
description: Yuuta and Rikka's homeroom teacher, who is often kind, if sometimes a little sadistic in teasing her students, particularly Rikka. She is called Nana-chan by Yuuta and Rikka.

appearsIn.title: Love, Chunibyo & Other Delusions: Take on Me
Love, Chunibyo & Other Delusions: Glimmering...Explosive Festival (Slapstick Noel)

name: Chaika Trabant
native: チャイカ・トラバント
description: Chaika is usually an optimistic girl that longs to help everyone, regardless of who they are. Her speech pattern differs from the rest of the characters and speaks in the "Laake" language fluently but to avoid confusion Chaika speaks the common tongue (the official language of the continent). However, because it is not her native tongue, Chaika's language fragmented and broken. Chaika is scared easily, as seen when Akari was telling them a scary rumor. Chaika can be very clumsy sometimes too.

name: Toru Acura
description:
The protagonist is a Saboteur from the village of Acura. He has dark hair and eyes, but in the anime he has dark blue hair. After the downfall of the Gaz Empire and the return of peace, he has lost his way of life. When introduced, he is jobless and poor, and initially mistaken by Chaika to be a bandit attempting to rob her. However they inadvertently encounter a man-eating Unicorn and they work together to defeat it.

He has the power of the mysterious Iron-Blood Form (also Iron-Blood Transformation) that when activated turn his hair red and cause crimson markings to appear on his body. He wields two short sword comblades that have retractable wires at their hilts.

name: Fredrica
description:
A dragoon of Dominica who has the ability to shape-shift. She has been living in the shadows of Dominca after her death. After losing her battle with Toru's group, she takes on the form of a Lucie Skoda in honor of her master's late sister. She also joins Toru's group on their adventures with a new goal, to have a fight to the death with Toru, although Toru usually postpoints their fight, claiming that he must first accomplish his mission to assemble Emperor Gaz's remains for Chaika.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Chaika Bohdan
native: チャイカ・ボフダーン
description: Looks identical to "White Chaika", except her hair is in a shorter bowl cut, and she wears a different outfit which is red rather than white. Like White Chaika, her speech is distorted grammatically, and she also carries a giant coffin which has rollers and rope to pull along. She is essentially the opposite of White Chaika in terms of personality; stubborn, aggressive, and loud-mouthed. She carries a longsword with a snake blade as her weapon.

name: Albéric Gillette
native: アルベリック・ジレット
description:
The leader of the Gillette Corps. A cavalier from a noble family.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Nikolai Avtotor
native: ニコライ・アフトトル
description: The second-in-command of the Gillette Corps. A mercenary.

name: Viivi Holopainen
native: ヴィヴィ・ホロパイネン
description: A member of the Gillette Corps, and an Assassin who utilizes needles as weapons. She serves as the Corp's infiltrator, alongside Zita. She greatly adores Albéric but never finds the time to properly confess her feelings to him.

name: Zita Brusasco
native: ズィータ・ブルザスコ
description:
A female Wizard serving in the Gillette Corps. She specializes in magic vehicles, and is the main operator of the Corps' personal vehicle "April." She has a crush on Albéric, but supports Viivi in her attempts to gain his attention.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Matthäus Callaway
native: マテウス・キャラウェイ
description: A male wizard who can control creatures.

name: Runa Shirakawa
description: Considered one of the school's most beautiful girls, Shirakawa is easygoing and friendly with most people, earning her even more popularity. Since she is so popular, bad rumors tend to go about her, like how she dates guys for two or three months at best, and how easily she switches from guy to guy at the drop of a hat. All those rumors are false though. Despite her gal appearance, Shirakawa is sincerely devoted to whoever she is dating (to the point of being called "Heavy" or "Annoying"). She reaches the point of putting her boyfriend's happiness first or enduring a lot to keep the relationship going. This ends up backfiring as guys dump her once they "get what they wanted." She is called the school year’s number one most beautiful girl. Although being called that, she has fake rumors that she only stayed with one person for three months at most, and the taste of people she was dating varied from older to the same age, and from athletic to cultural, resulting in boys calling her a "bitch".

appearsIn.title: Our Dating Story: The Experienced You and The Inexperienced Me

name: Ryuuto Kashima
description: Kashima has admired Shirakawa since the first year and got the lucky break of moving to the same class as her during the second year, turning simple admiration into a one-sided crush. Kashima never hoped to get more than that and was happy with keeping the status quo.

appearsIn.title: Our Dating Story: The Experienced You and The Inexperienced Me

name: Yuka Mochida
description:
__Height:__ 140 cm (4'7") 

Despite being a teenager, Yuka acts in a much younger manner than her age due to her being pampered by her parents. She tries to act like an adult in order to be taken more seriously by her peers, but her constant failures at doing so cause her to come across as even more immature. Her naivety makes her childlike innocence more apparent than most others trapped in Heavenly Host Elementary School, but it also makes her susceptible to being manipulated by the school's more ill-intentioned residents (humans and ghosts alike). It also makes her more psychologically vulnerable to the horrors of the school, causing her to easily break down at the sight of blood, violence, and death. Because she is spoiled, she depends on those older and more mature than she is to make decisions for her. However, her experiences throughout Heavenly Host force her to act more on her own decisions.

name: Yui Shishido
description:
__Height:__ 164 cm (5'5") 

Yui an English teacher and the homeroom teacher of Kisaragi Academy's high school class 2-9, and a victim trapped inside Heavenly Host Elementary School. She's very close to the students and everyone loves her.

name: Yoshiki Kishinuma
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm (5' 8")  

Giving off the aura of a delinquent, Yoshiki faced difficulty in school due to issues at home. At one point, Yoshiki considered getting himself expelled from Kisaragi Academy since he could not find a reason to continue attending if he had no interest. However, Ayumi changed Yoshiki's mind on the matter after standing up for him against their PE teacher Mikio Tsubota. Carrying over from his attitude at school, Yoshiki is prone to outbursts of frustration when faced with difficult situations. Though he often means well, his actions can appear cold or even selfish to those around him.

(Source: Corpse Party Wikia)

name: Seiko Shinohara
description:
__Height:__ 154 cm (5'1")  

Seiko is an extremely cheerful and energetic girl who enjoys playing around with her friends. She often comes across as immature and crass, and makes over-the-top outbursts that surprise everyone around her, but her friends are able to put up with it.

name: Ayumi Shinozaki
description:
__Height:__ 151 cm (4'11") 

Ayumi is the representative of Class 2-9. She is a tough girl with a creepy personality when it comes to occult topics.

name: Sachiko Shinozaki
description: Sachiko Shinozaki is a former student of Heavenly Host Elementary School, and one of the recorded victims of the 1973 serial kidnappings and murders at the school. Her ghost rules the multidimensional nexus where Heavenly Host exists, making her the main antagonist of the Corpse Party series.

name: Naomi Nakashima
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm (5'2")  

Naomi is generally a bright and cheerful, if stubborn, teenage girl. A tomboy, she often feels the need to take charge of everything she is involved with, which usually causes her to butt heads with Satoshi Mochida. This behavior hides a more "girlish" side to her that enjoys shopping and grooming herself like other average girls her age, which shows itself whenever she plays with her friend Seiko Shinohara. She also tends to let her emotions control her actions: when stressed, she is prone to acting like a spoiled child who whines, complains, and lashes out at everyone around her. However, she is very self-aware of herself during such intervals, but has extreme difficulty stopping herself from acting in such an immature manner, which causes her to feel guilty whenever she regains control of herself.

name: Satoshi Mochida
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm (5' 6")

A student from Kisaragi Academy's high school class 2-9. Satoshi is kindhearted by nature, often willing to go the extra mile for those he cares for. Ironically, Satoshi is also a bit of a coward, and was highly reluctant to take part in the ritual that placed him and his peers at Heavenly Host Elementary School. A bit of a blockhead, Satoshi is blissfully unaware of the crushes multiple girls in his group of peers have for him, which never sees further development as everyone becomes more preoccupied with surviving the horrors of Heavenly Host. Despite the grotesque environment and macabre events that occur within Heavenly Host, Satoshi somehow finds the courage inside himself to push forward for the sake and safety of those important to him, such as his younger sister Yuka.  

(Source: Corpse Party Wikia)

name: Mayu Suzumoto
description:
__Height:__ 154 cm (5'0")

Mayu is a member of drama club. Even though she seems much smaller than she is, Mayu have a great heart, in fact, thanks to her energetic nature, she is very popular between the students and she earned the nickname "Suzume". She is also the only one who can call Sakutaro with a nickname (namely Shige-nii).

name: Yuuya Kizami
description: A student from another school who performed the "Sachiko Ever After" charm with his classmates and wound up in Heavenly Host. Although reasonably well-liked by his peers and greatly involved in school activities, he seems to have built a wall around his true feelings, never deigning to share them with anyone. As a result, he comes across as something of a Lone Wolf - a quality which contributes to his "cool" image, but does tend to keep people from really getting to know him. After his transportation into the accursed elementary school, he's focused most his energy on finding his little sister.

name: Muriel Besson
native: ミュリ・エルベッソン
description:
Muriel Besson is a young French student with a keen interest in the Japanese culture. Her brother, Frank Besson, is the boss of a Milieu, who spoils her very much.

During Masamune's trip to France, she uses him as her model of her hero, and Aki as the heroine.  

Muriel has medium length blonde hair that is usually tied up, and blue eyes. Her right eye is usually covered with a black eye patch, with a white rose symbol on the patch. She has a black tattoo on the upper left side of her back.

name: Kanetsugu Gasou
description: __Gender:__

name: Lyrule
description: She is Winona's adoptive daughter. Tsukasa suspects Lyrule might hold the reason for their presence in the world.

appearsIn.title: High School Prodigies Have It Easy Even In Another World

name: Tsukasa Mikogami
description: Genius serving as the prime minister.

appearsIn.title: High School Prodigies Have It Easy Even In Another World

name: Ringo Ohoshi
description: World's best inventor.

appearsIn.title: High School Prodigies Have It Easy Even In Another World

name: Jeanne De Leblan
native: ジャンヌ・ド・ルブラン
description: Captain of Gustave's Imperial Silver Knight Order, tasked with patrolling the region to enforce the "Beautification Project" decreed by Gustave.

appearsIn.title: High School Prodigies Have It Easy Even In Another World

name: Winona
description: She is a buman resident of Freyjagard.

appearsIn.title: High School Prodigies Have It Easy Even In Another World

name: Tooru Kirishima
description: First lieutenant of the Sakuragi Family. Infamously known as "The Demon of Sakuragi".

name: Yaeka Sakuragi
description: The sole daughter of the Sakuragi family boss. A timid girl who struggles at expressing her emotions.

name: Kei Sugihara
description: A regional boss of the Sakuragi family. For better or worse, he's an honest guy. He gets very emotional, so people tend to tease him. With everything said and done, he respects [Kirishima](https://anilist.co/character/212596/Kirishima-Tooru). His hobby is watching movies. His capacity to empathize with others is astounding. He gets so attached to the main characters that he'll often start shouting or bawling his eyes out.

name: Kazuhiko Sakuragi
description: The leader of the Sakuragi family. He is strict with himself and others, but has a soft spot for Yaeka.

name: Kanami Kurosaki
description: Yaeka's aunt. Runs a restaurant called Kurosaki. Not intimidated by her brother-in-law Kazuhiko or Kirishima, she talks to all on equal footing. Her hobbies include dressing up Yaeka and Kirishima.

name: Miyuki Sakuragi
description: Yaeka's comatose mother.

name: Touichirou Aoi
description: The former right-hand man of the Sakuragi family. He's sociable and good at looking after others like a big brother. He's relatively short-tempered. His hobbies are going on drives and dismantling and remodeling things.

name: Kouki Aoi
description: Toichiro's son. He's at the age where he copies everything his father does. He's a precocious little brat who does things without thinking them through. His hobbies are collecting free toys that you get when you order food and hitting on girls.

name: Remon Yamano
description:
__Height__: 139 cm (4'7")  
__Class__: 3rd Year  

A short, third year high school student with a petite appearance and a distinctive voice. She is generally cold towards people, but befriends Ichika when they first meet. She is good at picking locks and can be quite mischievous, such as when she makes the rest of the group drink an alcoholic drink, then records them sleeping. She seems devious, as though everything she does has an ulterior motive. Since she claims to have written a script for Lucas in Hollywood (implying George Lucas), she ends up being the writer for the group's movie. She thinks of Ichika as her best friend. Remon is somewhat sarcastic, usually laughing like "uhuhu", although she is almost always seen smiling.

name: Tetsurou Ishigaki
description:
__Height:__ 177 cm (5'9")
__Class:__ 1st Year

A close, easygoing friend of Kaito and Tanigawa. He knows of her feelings for Kaito and encourages a relationship between the two. He seems to be an all-around savvy guy with females and is easily able to smooth-talk a female teacher into giving out Ichika's body measurements. He is known to be quite handsome in his class, even in the eyes of the teachers.

name: Kanna Tanigawa
description:
__Height:__ 152 cm (5')
__Class:__ 1st Year

[Kaito](https://anilist.co/character/47299/Kaito-Kirishima)'s classmate. She seems to have a crush on him, and gets jealous when he talks about other girls.

name: Mio Kitahara
description:
__Height:__ 157 cm (5'2")
__Class:__ 1st Year

A beautiful girl who is quite shy, but has pretty lewd thoughts sometimes. A good friend of Tanigawa. She has feelings for Tetsuro and her thoughts seem to innocently go in a sexual direction.

name: Kaito Kirishima
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm (5'2")
__Class:__ 1st Year

The main protagonist is a student in his first year of high school. He is an avid videographer, and is constantly out recording things. Others sometimes refer to him as "The Director". He's seemingly aware of Tanigawa's feelings for him, nonetheless he seems to have a genuine interest for Ichika. He has day dreams of conversing with Ichika and talks out loud sometimes during them. This may even lead to misunderstandings in a comical sense.

name: Ichika Takatsuki
description:
__Height:__ 163 cm (5'3")
__Class:__ 3rd Year

name: Emika Takatsuki
description: Ichika's older sister.

name: Rinon
description: Ichika's pet. It knows how to dance, and it is always by Ichika's side.

name: Nanami Kirishima
description: Kaito's sister who cries easily.

name: Satoshi Ogura
description: Tetsurou's brother-in-law who is married to his sister Manami.

name: Fudou Aikawa
description: Fudo Aikawa is the main character of the manga Love After World Domination. He is the Red Gelato and leader of the hero squad Gelato 5. He is also the strongest member among them.

name: Desumi Magahara
description: Desumi Magahara is the deuteragonist of the manga Love After World Domination. She is a beautiful high school student, with blond hair and green eyes, her Gekko Battle Gear is a kind of erotic black demon-style outfit with bunny-like ears. Ever since young, her strength has been remarkable. It is so incomprehensible that she managed to close down a dojo unintentionally after defeating a dojo master there. Her family have some past and connections with Gekko, hence getting her involved with them despite not wanting to.

name: Yuuji
description: A former office worker who was forcefully summoned to another world and gained the Class of "Tamer" and "Sage".

appearsIn.title: My Isekai Life: I Gained a Second Character Class and Became the Strongest Sage in the World!
My Isekai Life: I Gained a Second Character Class and Became the Strongest Sage in the World!
KamiKatsu: Working for God in a Godless World
KamiKatsu: Working for God in a Godless World

name: Enlilter Liesheid Bertrand
native: エンリルタ・リースハイド・ベルトラン
description:
__Gender:__ Male 

He was a knight who belonged to the Imperial Guard.

appearsIn.title: KamiKatsu: Working for God in a Godless World

name: Souichirou Urabe
description: [Yukito](https://anilist.co/character/292734) and [Chiyamaru](https://anilist.co/character/292867)'s father.

appearsIn.title: KamiKatsu: Working for God in a Godless World

name: Okada
description: Develops a crush on Azami Kurotani because he is drawn in her scar in "The Scar".

name: Tokuo Katayama
description: One of Kirie's classmates. Only comes to school when it's raining.

name: Yami Yuugi
description:
__Height:__ 153 cm (5')

Yami no Yuugi is the spirit residing in the Milennium Puzzle. After a historic battle against Zorc Necrophadius, he had sealed his soul along with Zorc in order to save Egypt. However, he had lost his memory as a result.

3,000 (5,000 in the dub) years later, [Yuugi Mutou](https://anilist.co/character/1374/Mutou-Yuugi), after trying to solve the puzzle for eight years, awakens Yami no Yuugi from his slumber, although Yugi does not realize this until much later in the story, more specifically, Duelist Kingdom.

At the end of Duelist Kingdom, he asks Yugi to help him recover his memories and Yugi agrees to help him.

name: Yami Bakura
description: The strange dark spirit that lies inside the Millennium Ring. He searches for all the other Millennium items. Although the purpose is unknown, it's obvious that the intent is pure evil. When in full possession of Bakura's body, he is capable of invoking many magical powers of the Shadow Realm into this world. The spirit has linked itself through the Millennium Ring to Bakura and is able to return itself to Bakura even if discarded or lost.    He's the main arch enemy of Yami Yugi. He holds a 5,000 year old grudge with Yami Yugi which he never reveals.    Yami Bakura uses an occult deck focused around Fiends & Zombies to unleash powerful dark magics.

name: Hiroto Honda
description: Another one of Yugi's friends. Honda used to bully Yugi with Jounouchi. He never understood Yugi's fashination with games but he was able to understand the feelings of others. Honda always helps Jounouchi or Yugi when they are in need. He's a friend to the end.

name: Katsuya Jonouchi
description: Jonouchi is [Yugi](https://anilist.co/character/1374)'s best friend. At the beginning Jonouchi used to bully Yugi but after being saved by Yugi from an even more of a dangerous thug, Jonouchi has been pals with Yugi ever since. Jonouchi likes to hang around with Yugi and learns a lot of new games. He's not always confident that he'll win his games but he always tries his best. He enters the Duelist Kingdom Tournament to get money for his sister, [Shizuka](https://anilist.co/character/5989), who is losing her eyesight. He wants to use the money for her surgery.

name: Seto Kaiba
description:
__Height:__ 186 cm

Seto Kaiba is the majority shareholder and President of his own multi-national company, KaibaCorp, who aims to become the world's greatest player of the Duel Monsters card game. To accomplish this goal, he must defeat his arch-rival, [Yugi Muto](https://anilist.co/character/1374/Mutou-Yuugi).

He is largely considered an anti-hero, as his motives are usually ego-centric, but in several cases towards a good cause. Among one of the recurring plots in Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Monsters is Seto Kaiba being forced to deal with either people adversely affected by Gozaburo Kaiba's actions wanting to take their revenge on Seto Kaiba, or people from within KaibaCorp attempting to take over the corporation.

name: Anzu Mazaki
description:
Anzu is the childhood friend of [Yugi Mutou](https://anilist.co/character/1374/Mutou-Yuugi). She becomes a good friend to [Katsuya Jonouchi](https://anilist.co/character/1377/Jonouchi-Katsuya) and [Hiroto Honda](https://anilist.co/character/1380/Honda-Hiroto), though she is not fond of them at first. 

In the first series anime, Miho Nosaka is also one of Anzu's friends. Anzu does not usually play games with Yugi and his friends, though she is once shown beating Jonouchi. In the manga, especially in the beginning, Anzu has a spunky, tomboyish personality, and in the first chapter, frightens Honda and Jonouchi into leaving the room after they bully Yugi. Anzu possesses a very kind-hearted, strong-willed, and supportive personality. In the Duel Monsters anime, she and Honda, are basically cheerleaders for Yugi and Jonouchi whenever they duel, but she has proven herself adept at dueling as well, and usually keeps up with the going-ons of a duel. She is more feminine, polite, and has a stronger sense of faith and friendship for her group of friends, often serving as the mother/sister figure for the boys. She is known among fans of the Duel Monsters English anime for her "friendship speeches".  

Anzu is athletic and holds jobs to save money in order to attend a dance school in New York City. In the beginning of the series, she is revealed to be working at "Burger World". By Volume 4 in the manga, Anzu is fired from that job for punching a customer who had pinched her buttocks.

name: Yuugi Mutou
description:
__Height:__ 153 cm (5'0")

Yugi Mutou is the main protagonist of Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Monsters. At the start of the series, he is a shy boy who is really short for his age, something he always gets teased about in school. For this reason, he was always alone. However, his grandfather gives him the Millennium Puzzle prior to the story's time line and Yugi is told that if he solved it, one wish of his could be granted. He manages to solve the Millennium Puzzle and he asks for friends and his wish is immediately granted. He also awakens the spirit residing in the Puzzle, but Yugi is not aware of this until much later in the story.  When Yugi does become aware, he and the spirit become very close, with him calling the spirit 'Mou Hitori No Boku' - The Other Me - and the spirit calling him 'Aibou' - Partner. Yugi then becomes a vessel for the spirit and he is told that his duty is to help the spirit find his lost memories. With the help of his friends, he helps the Pharaoh regain his memories while overcoming the most difficult of situations.  

Yugi is mostly seen living with his grandfather, since his parents are mostly on business trips. His mother, Ashita, makes a very brief appearance in the beginning of the second season, when Yugi argues with the spirit. Yugi is also very gifted as a duelist with the Duel Monsters card game, thanks to the expertise and upbringing of his grandfather.

name: Ryou Bakura
description: Bakura Ryou is a classmate and friend of [Yugi Muto](https://anilist.co/character/1374/Mutou-Yuugi). [Yami Bakura](https://anilist.co/character/1489/Yami-Bakura) is his other self, released from the power of the Millennium Ring. The two rarely directly converse. Unlike the close, cooperative relationship between Yugi Muto and [Yami Yugi](https://anilist.co/character/1375/Yami-Yuugi), Yami Bakura is a malignant entity that completely suppresses Bakura's spirit when he takes him over.

name: Mokuba Kaiba
description: Kaiba's little brother. Mokuba is always following Seto where ever he goes. He has a very strong bond with his brother and has all of his faith within Seto as well. Mokuba helps run Seto's company and will do what ever it takes to please his brother.

name: Insector Haga
description:
Insector Haga is the Japanese champion at Duel Monsters (Magic and Wizards in the original manga), hailing from East Japan.

 He is a cunning trickster who has no qualms about cheating or misconduct in or around his duels. Despite this, he is actually a very talented duelist who plays with a deck of Insect cards. Haga develops into a rival of [Yugi Mutou](https://anilist.co/character/1374/Yuugi-Mutou). He is jealous and adores insects, for his deck is mainly insect-type monsters and insect-related magic and trap cards.

name: Mamako Oosuki
description: Mamako is a beta tester in the MMORPG alongside her son, [Masato Oosuki](https://anilist.co/character/141135/Oosuki-Masato) who she is overprotective of. She is a very powerful adventurer, to the point that Masato often questions his role as the hero.

appearsIn.title: Do You Love Your Mom and Her Two-Hit Multi-Target Attacks?
Do You Love Your Mom and Her Two-Hit Multi-Target Attacks?

name: Lina Inverse
description: Lina is the primary protagonist and the only character that appears in all incarnations of Slayers. She is an adolescent but very powerful sorceress, with a great love of money, treasure (especially the magical sort) and food. In the anime and manga (but not the light novel) Lina uses overly destructive magic recklessly (but comically), often with little provocation. She is reputed to be an evil, powerful, destructive, diminutive sorceress (the evil part isn't true). She has an older sister, Luna, who is a powerful swordswoman. Although Lina has faced down dragons, monsters, and even Dark Lords with little fear, the mere mention of Luna's name sends her into terrified hysterics. She also suffers from a fear of slugs.  In the first episode of the TV series, she introduces herself by destroying a gang of bandits known as the Dragon Fangs. She steals a large portion of their treasure, then sets off towards the nearest town to cash it in for a sizable profit. On the way to the town she is ambushed by the remainder of the Dragon Fangs. However, mere seconds before she would have blasted them to bits, Gourry Gabriev valiantly comes to her "rescue" and they begin their adventures together. In manga, anime and novels, Lina and Gourry do fall in love, but acting on these feelings is an entirely different story.  Lina has many different nicknames, one of them being "Dragon Spooker", a name that she isn't too fond of.

appearsIn.title: Do You Love Your Mom and Her Two-Hit Multi-Target Attacks?

name: Ran
description: Ran is this generation's Prophet in Gabe and, therefore, she has the ability to see into the future. She goes every now and then into Lux to sell flowers, but recently she seems to just follow people around. She takes special interest in Ichise and helps him escape from the sewers when Isshii's men throw him down there.

name: Ichise
description: One of our protagonists. When he was younger, his father, Ikuse, was killed for what Ichise believes was betraying his friends. A short time after, his mother also died. All he was left with was a vial that contained some of his mother's cells. Soon after, he began his life as a fighter in an underground arena, and proved to be quite formidable.  Ichise is very quiet and rarely speaks. He has an odd tendency to go berserk at very inopportune times. Whenever something has angered him, he channels nearly all his energy in an effort to destroy whatever it is that has crossed him. Throughout the course the series, he becomes a little more open, but still remains fairly reserved unless someone directly asks him a question.    (Source: somehow-someday.com/texhnolyze)

name: Shinji
description: Shinji is Lakan's leader. He believes in the free will of people and that is what his group is based on. He is rather carefree, but believes very strongly in his ideals. He's basically a younger, rasher Oonishi, and could probably be considered the third protagonist of the series.     (Source: somehow-someday.com/texhnolyze)

name: Keigo Oonishi
description: Oonishi is the leader of Organ and one of our protagonists.

name: Motoharu Kimata
description: The leader of the Alliance, he is opposed to the use of Texhnolyze.

name: Yoshii Kazuho
description: Yoshii came from the surface world to see the city of Lux. He seems to be intrigued by humanity's emotions, and the way the city of Lux works.

name: Haru
description: Shinji's best friend, who has a Texhnolyzed arm.

name: Toyama Haruhiko
description: A member of Organo who teaches Ichise the ropes.

name: Bunken Kohakura
description: He's a member of the council of Organ.

name: Kotori Iida
description: A lonely high schooler and student of [Kohei](https://anilist.co/character/89273/Inuzuka-Kohei) who gives Kohei the address to her mother's restaurant and ends up asking him to make meals and eat them with her (along with [Tsumugi](https://anilist.co/character/89272/Inuzuka-Tsumugi)). She is a shy, lonely girl whose mother is a good cook but is so busy she rarely has time for her daughter. Her parents divorced when she was in third grade. She is kind and gets along well with Tsumugi. She is a bad cook, partially because of having a large fear of knives. She has a large appetite.

name: Tsumugi Inuzuka
description: Kohei's adorable daughter who attends kindergarten. Though energetic, she is well-behaved and loves her father dearly. She always thinks of him and begins to truly enjoy eating when her father and Kotori start making meals together. She has large fluffy hair and is a fan of magical girls. She likes meat, particularly hamburger steak, and doesn't like green peppers.

name: Kohei Inuzuka
description: The single father of Tsumugi. His wife died of unknown illness and he is currently doing his best to take care of his daughter. He is a math teacher at Kotori's school. He currently works hard with Kotori to become a good cook to make his daughter happy. The three often hang out at Kotori's place and eat meals together. He is a bit plain and wears glasses, but is a very kind hearted and hard working person whose daughter is his life.

name: Shinobu Kojika
description: Kotori's friend from another class, whose family runs a vegetable shop where [Megumi](https://anilist.co/character/284843/Iida-Megumi) often buys vegetables from.

name: Yuusuke Yagi
description: Kohei's friend since high school and childhood friend of Tae (Kohei's wife). He works at a restaurant. Kohei often depends on him to watch Tsumugi when he can't book a babysitter.

name: Tae Inuzuka
description: Tsumugi's mother.

name: Megumi Iida
description: Mother of Iida Kotori. Often out of the house due to her work with TV food shows. Owns the diner Kotori and Inuzuka-sensei use for cooking practice.

name: Chiyo Suzuno
description: Kotori's classmate and friend.

name: Petralka Anne Eldant III
native: ペトラルカ・アン・エルダント三世
description:
Emperess of the Holy Eldant Empire. She's proactive and brimming with curiosity, so she's curious about importing Otaku culture and proactive in supporting Shinichi. 

(Source: ANN)

name: Myucel Foaran
native: ミュセル・フォアラン
description:
A Half-Elf in the Holy Eldant Empire, currently serving as Shinichi's maid. She is naturally adept at learning and is able to quickly pick up on the written language of Japanese through Shinichi's tuition. 

She is also said to be proficient at offensive magic during her time at the military camp as stated by Bluk.

name: Shinichi Kanou
description:
The protagonist of this story. He decides to look for a job in order to escape the hikkikomori lifestyle he'd fallen into after entering high-school, but as a result he ends up employed in spreading Otaku culture for the “Holy Eldant Empire”, a fantasy world that's mysteriously connected to Japan. He's a hardcore otaku who's true and honest to his interests.

(Source: ANN)

name: Saishou Zakhar
description: The empress’ personal advisor.

name: Romilda Garde
description: A dwarf in the Holy Eldant Empire. Attends school to learn the 'otaku culture' created by Shinichi.

name: Luna
description: A Half-Elf in the Holy Eldant Empire. She attends school to learn the "otaku culture" created by Shinichi.

name: Galious En Koldobar
native: ガリウス・エン・コルドバル
description:
Galious appears very reluctant to allow the "otaku culture" to be introduced into his world and calls Shin'ichi Kanō a "poison" to their world. 

He is the cousin of the Empress Petralka Anne Eldante III.

name: Loic Sleison
description: A Half-Elf in the Holy Eldant Empire. Attend the Schoo to learn the 'otaku culture'l that was created by Shinichi.

name: Elbia Hanaiman
native: エルビア・ハーナイマン
description: A werewolf from the kingdom of Bahariam. First believed to be a spy, she spends her time drawing art for Shinichi.

name: Minori Koganuma
description: Shinichi’s personal bodyguard. She is extremely fond of BL.

name: Izana Kurokawa
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm

Due to his years alone, Izana became ruthless and cruel. Not only has he become mentally unstable but, he strives for absolute power. Izana is the former leader of the eighth generation Black Dragons as well as the former president of Tenjiku. He is one of the main antagonists of The Tenjiku Arc.

name: Hajime Kokonoi
description:
__Height:__ 174 cm

Koko sees the world as a series of calculations. He acts solely in his own interests; every move of his is to benefit himself. He cozies up to those more powerful than he, but will turn his back on them the moment they lose their instrumentality.

name: Tetta Kisaki
description:
Kisaki is the principal antagonist of Tokyo Revengers. He's especially known for rising to the top of the Toman at full speed. 

Kisaki is a ruthless, cunning, and ambitious individual who will stop at nothing to achieve his goals. Although average in stature, his power to rule with fear makes even those stronger than he obey him. The entirety of his actions in the entire story revolves around becoming the most powerful and influential criminal in Tokyo.

name: Haruchiyo Sanzu
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm

Vice captain of the 5th division in the Tokyo Manji Gang.

name: Bocchan
description:
He is the firstborn of his noble family, and was considered to be the next head of his family until he was ostracized and cast out of his family for being cursed.

As the single possessor of a curse that allows him to unintentionally kill any living thing with a single touch, he lives alone in a decrepit mansion located deep within a forest with his servants, [Alice](https://anilist.co/character/132921/Lendrott-Alice) and [Rob](https://anilist.co/character/132924/Rob).

appearsIn.title: The Duke of Death and His Maid
The Duke of Death and His Maid

name: Alice Lendrott
native: アリス・レンドロット
description: Alice is a maid who assists the protagonist of the story, [Duke](https://anilist.co/character/132920/Bocchan), with his daily life. She is responsible for maintaining Duke's mansion and helping him with his day-to-day functions along with the family butler, [Rob](https://anilist.co/character/132924/Rob).

appearsIn.title: The Duke of Death and His Maid
The Duke of Death and His Maid

name: Rob
description: An old butler that was sent to serve the [Duke](https://anilist.co/character/132920/Bocchan) in his solitary, alongside [Alice](https://anilist.co/character/132921/Lendrott-Alice).

appearsIn.title: The Duke of Death and His Maid

name: Dulles
description: Head of the Witch Covent and sister to the witch that cursed the [Duke](https://anilist.co/character/132920/Bocchan).

appearsIn.title: The Duke of Death and His Maid

name: Hugo
description: A former pickpocket, Hugo now chooses the highroad, and works with [Zain](https://anilist.co/character/179366/Zain) and [Cuff](https://anilist.co/character/179365/Cuff) at the Circus.

appearsIn.title: The Duke of Death and His Maid

name: Cuff
description: A witch and childhood friend of [Zain](https://anilist.co/character/179366/Zain).

appearsIn.title: The Duke of Death and His Maid

name: Lawine
description: Lawine is a third-class mage in the Second Party of the First Class Mage Examinations. She specializes in manipulating ice.

name: Linie
description: Linie is a Demon working under [Aura](https://anilist.co/character/219110/Aura). Under Aura's instruction, she was sent to assist [Lügner](https://anilist.co/character/316985/Lgner) alongside [Draht](https://anilist.co/character/316987/Draht) to perform negotiations with [Graf Granat](https://anilist.co/character/318147/Granat-Hakushaku).

name: Sense
description: First-class mage that is proctoring the Second Exam of the First Class Mage Examination. She is a solemn person who rarely speaks.

name: Schlacht
aliases: Zenchi no Schlacht (全知のシュラハト)
description: Schlacht, also known as the Omniscient Schlacht, is a demon who was said to be the Demon King's confidant.

name: Neu
description: Neu is a member of the Empire's Special Forces of Magic.

name: Jahy
description: Jahy was originally the Dark Realm's second-in-command. After the destruction of the Mana Crystals, however, she becomes a small and adorable girl! She works as a part-time waitress.

appearsIn.title: The Great Jahy Will Not Be Defeated!
The Great Jahy Will Not Be Defeated!

name: Druj
description:
Former denizen of the Dark Realm.

As Jahy's loyal servant, she is willing to anything and everything for her master.

appearsIn.title: The Great Jahy Will Not Be Defeated!
The Great Jahy Will Not Be Defeated!

name: Chisa
description:
The owner of the restaurant Jahy works at. Her sister is the landlady of the apartment Jahy lives in.

She is a nice person who cares for Jahy. She tends to call Jahy "Hy-chan," even though Jahy tells her otherwise. When she found out that Jahy can transform, she found Jahy to be even more cute. She isn't afraid of Jahy and instead sympathizes with her situation.

appearsIn.title: The Great Jahy Will Not Be Defeated!
The Great Jahy Will Not Be Defeated!

name: Ryou
description:
The landlady of the apartment complex Jahy resides in. Her sister is the owner of the restaurant Jahy works at.

She is ready to resort to violence in order to get her rent and, unlike her sister, is ready to throw Jahy on the streets at any moment. However, the landlady fears her sister, a fact that Jahy sometimes abuses.

appearsIn.title: The Great Jahy Will Not Be Defeated!
The Great Jahy Will Not Be Defeated!

name: Kyouko Jinguu
description: The one who destroyed Jahy's home world.

appearsIn.title: The Great Jahy Will Not Be Defeated!
The Great Jahy Will Not Be Defeated!

name: Saurva
description: Former elite of the Dark Realm. She was transported to the human world, where she continues to try and beat Jahy.

appearsIn.title: The Great Jahy Will Not Be Defeated!
The Great Jahy Will Not Be Defeated!

name: Kokoro
description: A young girl who lives in the same town as Jahy. Upon meeting Jahy, she agrees to help her find Mana Crystals in order to restore the Dark Realm. She and Jahy quickly become best friends. Jahy credits her as one of the only people who understands her.

appearsIn.title: The Great Jahy Will Not Be Defeated!
The Great Jahy Will Not Be Defeated!

name: Maou
description: The ruler of the Dark Realm, and Jahy's sole superior who was destroyed as a result of the destruction of the Mana Crystals but later reforms back at the house of Kyouko Jingu.

appearsIn.title: The Great Jahy Will Not Be Defeated!
The Great Jahy Will Not Be Defeated!

name: Su
description: She is the mysterious being of light responsible for turning [Kyouko Jinguu](https://anilist.co/character/133102/Kyouko-Jinguu) into a magical girl, and taking all of the Mana Crystals from the Dark Realm.

appearsIn.title: The Great Jahy Will Not Be Defeated!
The Great Jahy Will Not Be Defeated!

name: Eri
description:
She is the girl that [Yuuta](https://anilist.co/character/270546/Itou-Yuuta) meets on the hospital roof where he was about to commit suicide.

She likes movies and chooses to exploit her passion to help Yuuta create a movie himself.

name: Yuuta Itou
description: A boy tasked to film his mother's disease battle.

name: Tauchi
description: A nurse who is close to Yuuta's mother and presumably treats her. Yuuta mispronounces her name as "Taguchi".

name: Yuuta no Haha
description: She is suffering from an unspecified terminal illness and asks her son to record her final months.

name: Yuuta no Tomodachi
description: She is friends with Yuuta and Eri. After Dead Mother Explosion is aired at the school festival, she criticizes the ending but expresses understanding about the rest, as her own mother had passed a year before.

name: Paul von Oberstein
native: パウル・フォン・オーベルシュタイン
description: Paul von Oberstein is a captain serving as chief of staff in fortress Iserlohn of the Galactic Empire. He was born blind and has to wear artificial eyes to see. He has nothing but contempt for his incompetent commander and despises the high nobles, realizing fully well the decadence of the Goldenbaum dynasty and how ignorant they are of the common people’s plight. If he himself had been born a few years earlier, when the “inferior genes exclusion law” was still in effect, he would have been discarded as dangerous to the species. Because of that and realizing Reinhard’s abilities, he wants to join his camp. Oberstein is a genius strategist and organizer, both in war and politics. Calm and composed, he never shows any sign of emotional distress, everything he says and does is part of a well thought, reasonable plan.

name: Wolfgang Mittermeyer
native: ウォルフガング・ミッターマイヤー
description: Wolfgang Mittermeyer is a rear admiral serving in Reinhard’s fleet and, along with Oskar von Reuenthal, Reinhard’s ablest field commander.   Mittermeyer is a commoner, born to a middle-class family. He first met Reuenthal while stationed in fortress Iserlohn, early in his career, and the two became close friends. Kind and caring, Mittermeyer has been a stabilizing factor for Reuenthal’s self-destructive tendencies ever since. A family man at heart Mittermeyer soon married his childhood sweetheart Evangeline and became a dedicated husband, but their efforts to have children have been fruitless thus far. Unfortunately for him, his lowly pedigree was about to cause him serious trouble.   Mittermeyer ordered the execution of one of his subordinates for assaulting, robbing and murdering a civilian woman. Although his decision was just, he turned out to belong to a powerful noble family and Mittermeyer was soon arrested. While the nobles plotted his death, desperate to save his only friend Reuenthal met with Reinhard von Müsel (later Lohengramm) and offered his and Mittermeyer’s loyalty to him, in exchange for aid in saving Mittermeyer from the nobility and clearing his name. Reinhard, who had his own well-known issues with the nobles, readily accepted and both of them were transferred under his command.

name: Dusty Attenborough
native: ダスティ・アッテンボロー
description:
**Rank:** Commander, later Commodore 
**Occupation:** Advisor, later Squadron Commander Group Affiliation: Free Planets Alliance 	 
**Base of Operations:** Flagship Patoroklos (2nd Fleet); Battleship Triglav (13th Fleet) Marital Status: Divorced 	 
**Known Relatives:** Patrick (father), unnamed ex-wife 	 
**First Appearance:** MOVIE "My Conquest is the Sea of Stars" (as Commander), Book 2: "Ambition" (Novels) 	 
**Hair:** Blue/Black (Golden Wings OAV: Blond) 	 

Dusty first met Yang Wen-Li at the military academy in 785UC, and they have been friends ever since.  First Lieutenant Dusty Attenborough began a distinguished military career during the 5th Iserlohn Assault in 792UC. Later, after being promoted to Commander, he returned to Iserlohn for the 6th Assault as Captain of the Free Planets Destroyer "Elm 3" in 794UC. In 795UC he was assigned to the 2nd Fleet Flagship Patoroklos as gunnery officer.  Dusty has learned quite a bit from his friend and has proven himself to be an able commander. Also appears briefly in the OAV "Golden Wings".  Dusty Attenborough and Olivier Poplan coin the phrase "foppery and whim" to describe the Yang Fleet's motivations in the face of incredible odds stacked against them.

name: Julian Mintz
description: Julian Mintz is the son of a soldier who served in the Alliance’s army, he lost his mother at a very young age and, some years later, his father was killed in battle leaving him a war-orphan. As such Julian was admitted in the wartime welfare program and, through the mediation of vice admiral Alex Cazellnu, he was made Yang Wenli’s ward.  Julian is a very intelligent and responsible boy with a knack for house chores and is the one who takes care of the domestically incompetent Yang, so much so that their friends often wonder who amongst the two is the real guardian and who the ward. Julian loves Yang and deeply respects him, both for his kindness and his well-defined philosophy on life. Yang wants a peaceful life for Julian, but, much to his disappointment, Julian’s dream is to follow in his and his father’s footsteps and become a soldier.

name: Hildegard von Mariendorf
native: ヒルデガルド・フォン・マリーンドルフ
description: Birthdate: 468 R.C. (777 U.C.)  Hildegard von Mariendorf is one of the principal characters in the series. She served as the New Galactic Fleet's Chief Advisor    Hildegard, usually referred to by the nickname Hilda, was born in Galactic year 777 into an distinguished noble family of the Goldenbaum dynasty, the sole daughter of the benevolent and just Count Franz von Mariendorf. From an early age, she was distinguished from the other girls of the aristocrat society by her independent ideas. Completely unconcerned, Hilda pursued her own interests in reading, politics and history. Her mother having died when Hilda was young, her open-minded father respected Hilda's unique ideas and choices in life.  In U.C. 797, the old galactic empire spilt into civil war, where the old nobility stood against the new emerging camp of military elites lead by Reinhard von Lohengramm. Hilda convinced her father to plea allegiance to the latter, whereupon she met Reinhard for the first time and impressed him with the clarity of her insight. When the Lohengramm camp emerged victorious from the civil war, Reinhard gained complete political and military power in the empire, and Hilda became Reinhard's chief secretary and assisted him in the progressive reforms that swept across the empire.  From U.C. 798 to U.C. 800, Hilda played an active role on the galactic stage, advising Reinhard wisely on imperial policies and tactics, and became one of his most valued and trusted staff.

name: Wenli Yang
description:
Yang Wenli is a commodore, currently serving in the 2nd fleet of the Free Planets Alliance.

The son of a merchant and a pacifist at heart, Yang never wanted to be a soldier, his dream was to become a historian, but he didn’t have the money to pay for his tuition and joined the army to get a scholarship. He barely made it through the officer’s academy due to his lack of interest, though he did make a number of friends there including [Dusty Attenborough](https://anilist.co/character/3869) and [Jean Robert Lap](https://anilist.co/character/24155). He also met music student [Jessica Edwards](https://anilist.co/character/19468) and both him and Lap developed a crush on her, Jessica eventually chose Lap, Yang accepted her decision and they remained friends.

Soon after he graduated, Yang became involved in a battle near the friendly planet El Facil, because of his superiors’ incompetence and cowardice, the planet was abandoned while a hostile imperial fleet was on its way. Yang was one of the few officers that remained behind and tried to help the population, thanks to his efforts the planet was evacuated in time. Because of this achievement he became famous as “the hero of El Facil” and “miracle Yang”, forever earning the envy of his peers and the scorn of his superiors.

name: Siegfried Kircheis
native: ジークフリード・キルヒアイス
description: Siegfried Kircheis was an Imperial high admiral who was most notable for his role as the best friend and personal confidant of [Reinhard von Lohengramm](https://anilist.co/character/3066/Reinhard-von-Lohengramm) since childhood, who later became his top admiral. Often referred to as Reinhard's "shadow," Lohengramm viewed Kircheis as a part of himself. Kircheis was frequently present with Reinhard throughout their military career while rising through the ranks of the Imperial Fleet, following him from assignment to assignment, before reaching the admiral ranks himself in 796 UC. Although some regarded him as being the blond admiral's "henchman," Kircheis demonstrated himself to be a highly competent admiral in his own right during the Castrop Rebellion and the Free Planets Alliance's attempted invasion of the Empire.

name: Oskar von Reuenthal
native: オスカー・フォン・ロイエンタール
description: Oskar von Reuenthal is a rear admiral serving in Reinhard’s fleet and, along with Wolfgang Mittermeyer, Reinhard’s ablest field commander. He was born to a lowly, but rich noble father and a mother from a distinguished but impoverished line that only married his father for his material affluence. Reuenthal was born with a rare condition called heterochromia, one of his eyes is blue, while the other is brown. Since both his parents had blue eyes, this was seen as proof of his mother’s adultery. His mother committed suicide after trying to pluck out his brown eye while he was still an infant. Reuenthal’s father put the blame on him and he grew up hated and neglected.   Reuenthal joined the military and rose through the ranks rather quickly, finding in war the reason he needed to keep on living. While stationed in fortress Iserlohn, he met Wolfgang Mittermeyer and the two became close friends. Mittermeyer is probably the only person Reuenthal has managed to have a normal relationship with and he greatly values their friendship. When Mittermeyer was unjustly detained and in danger of assassination by the nobility, Reuenthal didn’t hesitate to pledge his loyalty to Reinhard in return for his help with Mittermeyer’s case.

name: Frederica Greenhill
native: フレデリカ・グリーンヒル
description: Frederica Greenhill first met Yang during the evacuation of El Facil. She joined the military to find him again and was assigned as his adjutant.

name: Reinhard von Lohengramm
native: ラインハルト・フォン・ローエングラム
description:
Count Reinhard von Lohengramm is a young admiral in the Galactic Empire.

He was born Reinhard von Müsel to an impoverished aristocratic family. His mother died when he was very young and he only has faint memories of her. His father's will was shattered at about the same time and the only person left to care for young Reinhard was his beloved older sister [Annerose](https://anilist.co/character/13100/von-Grnewald-Annerose). When Reinhard was about ten years old, his family had to move into a middle class suburban neighborhood. There he met [Siegfried Kircheis](https://anilist.co/character/12550/Kircheis-Siegfried) who would become his best and perhaps only friend, but whatever happiness Reinhard managed to find as a child was to be short-lived.

The emperor [Friedrich IV](https://anilist.co/character/313169/von-Goldenbaum-IV-Friedrich) took a liking to his sister and ordered her to move into his palace and become his new concubine. Afraid that if she refused she would bring down the emperor's wrath on her younger brother, Annerose reluctantly accepted and her father even managed to get some money out of it. Infuriated Reinhard swore vengeance against the emperor, vengeance against the Goldenbaum dynasty and vengeance against the oppressive nobility. He swore that he would never rest until he freed his sister of her predicament and became powerful enough never to be ordered by anyone again.

To achieve his goals and with Kircheis by his side, Reinhard joined the military.

name: Cain von Silford
native: カイン・フォン・シルフォード
description: An average Japanese teenager with very little going on in his life in the past, and the third son of a noble family with a strong fixation with fantasy and high talents in magic and swordsmanship in the present - Cain is a carefree individual who likes taking things at his own pace. Despite being an aristocrat, he doesn't evaluate people by their status and often hates when others start abusing their titles, showing his cheeky side when necessary. While he knows it's better to hide his true powers, his ardent temperament often takes better of him, resulting into all kinds of troubles and funny situations.

native: テレスティア・テラ・エスフォート
description: The third-born daughter of Rex Terra Esfort, and is the third crown princess of Effort Kingdom. After being rescued by Cain von Silford, she falls in love with him and becomes engaged to him.

name: Gregory Lestrade
native: グレゴリー レストレード
description: Gregory Lestrade is an inspector with the Shinjuku Police and he often assists Sherlock in his investigations. Despite often getting annoyed by Sherlock Homes reckless actions he puts a great deal of faith in him often trusting him even when things look bad. Although his police co-workers tend to be disregard human life he has a much greater set of morals caring about the safety of others above all

name: Arterton
description: Chief of Scotland Yard

name: Gosling
description: He works for Milverton.

name: Charles Milverton
native: チャールズ・オーガスタス・ミルヴァートン
description:
Charles Augustus Milverton is a media mogul who seeks to stir up conflict in London, making himself an enemy of both William James Moriarty and Sherlock Holmes. He is known for blackmailing people.

(Source: Moriarty the Patriot Wikia)

name: Honoka Takamiya
description:
Honoka Takamiya (多華宮　仄 Takamiya Honoka?) is the male protagonist of the story. He is a second year student and the new student council president of Tougetsu Academy.

(Source: Witchcraft Works Fandom)

name: Ayaka Kagari
description: The female protagonist of the series. She is known as "Princess" by many female students due to her intelligence and high grades, which makes her the most popular girl at Tougetsu Academy. Ayaka is Kazane Kagari’s foster daughter, the chairwoman of the school who also happens to be head of "Workshop Witches."

name: Atori Kuramine
description:
A soft-spoken witch with cat-like ears who wields a large sword. Atori prefers to talk through a small, magical ventriloquist doll she keeps nearby at almost all times. Has a questionable understanding of first-aid.

(Source: MAL)

name: Kazane Kagari
description:
Kazane Kagari is the commander of Workshop Witches in Tougetsu City and the chairwoman of the school where Honoka Takamiya is studying. She is the mother of Ayaka Kagari and the best friend of Honoka Takamiya's mother. She has great belief in her daughter's strength, despite scolding Ayaka regularly due to her reckless fighting nature.

(Source: Witchcraft Works Fandom)

name: Ai
description:
Ai is one of the "Tower Witches" who transferred to high school, Tougetsu Academy.

(Source: Witchcraft Works Fandom)

name: Chronoire Schwarz VI
native: クロノワールシュヴァルツ・シックス
description:
Chronoire Schwarz VI is a powerful tower witch. She first appeared in front of Kazane Kagari to inform her that she will unseal the "white princess". She is shown to be very knowledgeable about the things going around Honoka Takamiya.

(Source: Witchcraft Works Fandom)

name: Kasumi Takamiya
description:
Kasumi Takamiya is daughter of Komachi Takamiya and younger sister of Honoka Takamiya. She is a Workshop Witch. She is studying in Tougetsu Academy's girls middle school branch.

(Source: Witchcraft Works Fandom)

name: Evermilion
description:
Evermillion (エヴァーミリオン?), fully named White Princess Evermillion (白姫エヴァーミリオン Shirohime Evamirion?), is an entity of unknown origin sealed inside Honoka Takamiya. She is addressed as the White Princess by various characters. A total of five seals were placed on her.

(Source: Witchcraft Works Fandom)

name: Kanna Utsugi
description:
Kanna Utsugi is a Tower Witch and the member of the Ivory Quintet―KMM Gang.
She is transferred with other members of KMM Gang after the second loss of Tanpopo Kuraishi to Honoka Takamiya's class. She is a underling of Medusa. Later, it was hinted that the five of KMM Gang, including her, be the allies of Workshop Witches by protecting Honoka allying with Ayaka.

(Source: Witchcraft Works Fandom)

name: Tanpopo Kuraishi
description:
Tanpopo Kuraishi is one of the "Tower Witches" who transferred to Honoka Takamiya and Ayaka Kagari's high school, Tougetsu Academy.

(Source: Witchcraft Works Fandom)

name: Kogarashi Fuyuzora
description:
__Height:__ 174 cm (5'9")

The main protagonist of Yuragi-sou no Yuuna-san. A skillful psychic who banishes spirits through his punches. He is poor and used to be homeless before arriving at Yuragi Inn.

description:

A girl who befriends [Kogarashi](https://anilist.co/character/126834/Fuyuzora-Kogarashi) after meeting him during the first day of high school. She is also a popular girl at school, known for her beauty.

appearsIn.title: Yuuna and the Haunted Hot Springs
Yuuna and the Haunted Hot Springs

name: Chitose Nakai
description:
__Height:__ 135 cm (4'5")

A zashiki-warashi who is the caretaker of the Yuragi Inn. She has the power to manipulate the fortune of others, but she rarely uses it because of its potential consequences.

appearsIn.title: Yuuna and the Haunted Hot Springs
Yuuna and the Haunted Hot Springs

name: Yuuna Yunohana
description:
__Height:__ 153 cm (5'0")

Yuuna is a ghost who is bound to the Yuragi Inn. She has no recollection of her life when she was alive and asks for Kogarashi's assistance in helping her discover who she was, developing an attachment to him in the process.

appearsIn.title: Yuuna and the Haunted Hot Springs
Yuuna and the Haunted Hot Springs

name: Sagiri Ameno
description:
__Height:__ 163 cm (5'4")

A ninja from the Chuuma Village. She hails from the Ameno house, a clan specializing in the art of demon slaying. She is dedicated to her duty as a ninja, spending time going on missions to destroy harmful supernatural creatures. 

As a result of her upbringing, she has a stern personality and is often flustered when someone compliments her appearance.

appearsIn.title: Yuuna and the Haunted Hot Springs
Yuuna and the Haunted Hot Springs

name: Oboro Shintou
description:
__Height:__ 151 cm (4'11")

The chief retainer and the older half-sister of Genshiro Ryuga, the Black Dragon God. She is a stoic woman who moves into the Yuragi Inn after being impressed by Kogarashi's strong physical and spiritual prowess. Her motivation to moving in is to preserve her family's bloodline by attempting to seduce Kogarashi. As she continues on this plan and interacting with the fellow tenants, she begins to display emotion and genuine romantic feelings. She and her brother have the ability to manipulate their arms into blades.

appearsIn.title: Yuuna and the Haunted Hot Springs
Yuuna and the Haunted Hot Springs

name: Yaya Fushiguro
description:
__Height:__ 150 cm (4'11")

A timid girl who acts as a vessel for a cat god. She exhibits catlike behavior as well as having cat ears and a tail when she is possessed by it. Through their bond, she is able to call on its power whenever it is needed, and she can also warp in more cat gods through her body.

appearsIn.title: Yuuna and the Haunted Hot Springs
Yuuna and the Haunted Hot Springs

name: Nonko Arahabaki
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm (5'8")

An oni who works as a manga author. She loves to drink alcohol, and as she becomes more intoxicated, her power as an oni grows. She is formerly a member of the Yoinozaka (宵ノ坂 Yoinozaka) family, one of the three great families in Japan, but left the clan and pursued her passion.

appearsIn.title: Yuuna and the Haunted Hot Springs

description:

Shigaraki Koyuzu is a Tanuki yokai who was stalking [Chisaki Miyazaki](https://anilist.co/character/127015/Miyazaki-Chisaki). After confronting [Kogarashi Fuyuzora](https://anilist.co/character/126834/Fuyuzora-Kogarashi) she became a resident of Yuragi-sou.

name: Tigrevurmund Vorn
native: ティグルヴルムド＝ヴォルン
