name: Eleonora Viltaria
native: エレオノーラ＝ヴィルターリア

name: Titta
description: She is maid to Earl Tigre Vorn, and also his childhood friend (little sister-like existence). Descended from a family of Priestess' who worship the Zechtd gods.

name: Gerard Augre
description:
Hughes' son, a man in his twenties, he also becomes Tigre's ally along his father. He is very fast making calculations, Gerard takes care of the logistics at the Silver Meteor Army, effectively distributing food, money and weapons in the times of need. Unlike his father, he is a rather sarcastic person and often gets in arguments with Rurick. He constantly tests Tigre to see if he really is worth following, even if his father will punish him severely for it. After the Civil War he becomes Secretary of the Royal Court, being tasked with supervising the progress of the construction of an important road that will connect Brune and Zhcted as part of the peace agreement.
(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Faron Bastien do Charles
native: ファーロン＝ソレイユ＝ルイ＝ブランヴィル＝ド＝シャルル
description: King of Brune, Faron was a just a benevolent ruler, until the apparent death of his only daughter, Princess Regin, which caused him to breakdown mentally and suffer an illness that began afflicting his body and rendering him unable to keep Ganelon and Thenardier in check. It is later revealed he was poisoned by Ganelon's minions to (if not the initial cause) keep him mindbroken and ill while killing him extremely slowly. After the civil war ends, he is reunited with his daughter and formally recognizes her as a member of the Royal Family and his heir. He also congratulates Tigre and his friends for saving her and ending Thenardier and Ganelon's plans. With his dying breath, Faron gives Tigre the title of Knight of the Moonlight, a title that, in ancient times, was only given to a hero who became the next king of Brune, although only Badowin knows of the true meaning of the title.

name: Shouma Takakura
description: More innocent than his brother, he is uneasy at the thought of performing any morally ambiguous deeds. He is assigned to obtain [Oginome Ringo](https://anilist.co/character/43385/Oginome-Ringo)'s diary, assuming that it is the Penguindrum, and hesitates after being told to obtain it by any means necessary. As he accompanies Ringo in her stalking activities, the two of them develop a strange closeness.

name: Himari Takakura
description: The brothers’ younger, ever-cheerful sister. Himari loves her brothers very much, and is constantly smiling so that they will worry less about her illness. After being discharged from the hospital, she loses consciousness and dies at a trip to the aquarium. She is revived by a penguin hat bought at the aquarium's souvenir shop. When she wears the penguin hat, her appearance and personality changes to that of a dominatrix, donning a skintight costume and ordering the brothers to obtain the Penguindrum in order to extend her life.

name: Kanba Takakura
description:
The more serious and colder of the twins. He takes his duty to obtain the Penguin Drum seriously, willing to resort to any method to obtain it, whether legal or not.

He has red hair and is more popular with girls than his brother. He has a past history as a playboy, dating girls only to dump them later on, causing some heartbroken girls to join forces to take revenge on him. Kanba seems to actually harbor feelings for [Himari](https://anilist.co/character/43009/Takakura-Himari).  Both Kanba, [Shouma](https://anilist.co/character/43335/Takakura-Shouma) and [Ringo](https://anilist.co/character/43385/Oginome-Ringo) were born on the day of the sarin gas attack on the Tokyo subway.

Throughout the story, his feelings and motivation to keep Himari alive become more visible. It is also shown that he is responsible as the eldest to maintain their finances and lifestyle.

name: Ringo Oginome
description: The target the brothers are ordered to watch. She was born on the same day her older sister [Momoka](https://anilist.co/character/49853/Oginome-Momoka) died, which caused her family to fall apart, and she now lives only with [her mother](https://anilist.co/character/44801/Oginome-Eriko). She possesses a diary that belonged to Momoka that foretells future events. She started to believe that by turning herself into Momoka she could bring her family back together, often going to extreme lengths to have what is written there fulfilled.

name: Keiju Tabuki
description: A teacher whom Ringo has an obsessive crush on. He is the teacher of Shoma and Kanba and the advisor of a birdwatching club. He was Ringo's older sister Momoka's childhood friend before she died.

name: Mario Natsume
description: Masako's brother. He is also under the influence of a penguin hat similar to Himari's.

name: Satoshi Oginome
description: Ringo's father.

name: Masako Natsume
description:
A strange woman who is usually seen arround [Kanba](https://anilist.co/character/43334/Takakura-Kanba) and serves as an antagonist.

She possesses a laser sighted slingshot that fires red balls which erase memories and also owns a penguin just like each of the Takakura siblings, which she names [Esmerelda](https://anilist.co/character/48355/Esmeralda). She appears to be an old admirer of Kanba and seems to be the in same situation as him, as her brother [Mario](https://anilist.co/character/47813/Natsume-Mario) is also under the influence of a penguin hat similar to [Himari's](https://anilist.co/character/43009/Takakura-Himari) and to ensure his survival she also must retrieve [Ringo's](https://anilist.co/character/43385/Oginome-Ringo) diary.

name: Shirase
description: One of the black bunnies.

name: Freya
description:
__Race:__ God
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7"), 
__Affiliation:__ Freya Familia, 

Freya Is the head of the Freya Familia. Long ago, Hera, at the request of [Zeus](https://anilist.co/character/142554/Zeus), asked Freya for help in their goal to save the world. Freya made her a challenge, telling her that she would help her if she won. Having lost the challenge, Freya was forced to stay in Orario as part of the deal, in addition to losing several members of her Familia as a result. Some time later, Freya met a girl named Syr. After telling her that she would rescue her, Freya asked the girl what she wanted. Hearing that she wanted to be like her, Freya decided to offer her a deal, which she accepted.

Freya is flirtatious, loves to tease, and has an unending appetite for talented adventurers. She seeks the best and most talented adventurers and will obtain them no matter the cost. She holds an obsession over [Bell Cranel](https://anilist.co/character/88860/Cranel-Bell) and actively does anything in her power to see him grow as an adventurer. Freya doesn't like to be bound by anyone, though she doesn't wish to become an arrogant ruler either. She is very impatient. She constantly interferes with Bell's activities knowing it might kill him but wanting to see him grow as fast as possible. At the same time, she is just as willing to help Bell to see him grow, such as when she gave up a grimoire just to speed up his progress.

appearsIn.title: Is It Wrong To Try To Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? V

name: Ottarl
description:
__Race:__ Boaz
__Height:__ 210 cm (6'11")
__Affiliation:__ Freya Familia
__Level:__ 7
__Skills:__ Vana Arganture • Stortus Ottar
__Magic:__ Hildis Vini
__Weapon:__ Supreme Black Sword • Greataxe • Great Hammer

Ottar is the captain of the Freya Familia and is currently the only Level 7 in Orario. When Ottar was a child, he was abandoned without even having known his own name. Freya found him dying in an alley somewhere and told him he was beautiful and took him into her Familia. She also gave him his name at this time. Due to her material support and emotional warmth, Freya would become everything to Ottar. Two years after joining her Familia, Ottar would become Level 2. Around this time, Mia joined the Freya Familia at the request of Freya in order to train Ottar. Ottar clashed a few times with the Zeus and Hera Familias before they were defeated by the One Eyed Black Dragon and were forced out of Orario. Each time ended in him being defeated. At some point in the past, Ottar half-killed a Balor, the Monster Rex of the 49th floor. Later, after learning about Ais defeating Udaeus by herself, he also defeated Udaeus by himself while managing to obtain the Udaeus' sword. He reached Level 6 fifteen years before his battle with Udaeus and Level 7 after defeating Zald seven years before the same battle.

Ottar is extremely loyal to Freya and will follow her orders.

appearsIn.title: Is It Wrong To Try To Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? V

name: Allen Fromel
description:
__Race:__ Cat People__Height:__ 162 cm (5'4")
__Affiliation:__ Freya Familia
__Level:__ 6
__Weapon:__ Spear

Allen Fromel is the vice captain of the Freya Familia. When Allen was four years old he lost his parents and home, being forced to wander through the ruins of a kingdom along with his sister Anya. During this time he protected her, having to fight monsters on some occasions and escape from them on others. So it was for two years until they met Freya, who offered them to go with her, which he accepted. 

Like the other members of the Freya Familia, Allen is extremely loyal to Freya, and is shown to be jealous of Bell Cranel because of the attention he receives from her. He is also poison tongued, telling Ais to go die during the Loki Familia expedition. According to Syr, his tongue is sensitive to hot food, mentioning that he secretly blows on hot drinks to cool them down before drinking them. Allen is siblings with Anya Fromel. However, they have both cut all ties with each other. Despite his attitude towards her, calling her even the person he hates the most in the world, Freya pointed out that Allen still loves her, which was demonstrated when he saw her while under the effects of Seale's curse, which made the opponent see their most loved one.

appearsIn.title: Is It Wrong To Try To Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? V

name: Electra Ovilo
native: エレクトラ・オヴィロゥ
description: Electra Ovilo is a veteran of the Titan War. Her love for Vincent caused them to have a short-term relationship, during which Vincent transferred the vaccine to Electra. She is unaware of this until Vincent sets free the Nanomachines on the Monorail and she survives. She meets Spike by chance when he infiltrates a bio weapon lab fronting as a pharmaceutical company where she works. After a few more chance meetings, and witnessing his being shot and thrown from a monorail by Vincent, she teams up with the crew of the Bebop to put an end to Vincent's intent to destroy the population of Mars. The samples of her blood are used to make the vaccine that is spread over Alba city. In the end, it is she who shoots Vincent and kills him. She cries for him when he admits he remembers her and their love for one another as he is dying.   (Source: Wikipedia)

appearsIn.title: Cowboy Bebop: The Movie - Knockin' on Heaven's Door

name: Vincent Volaju
native: ヴィンセント・ボラージュ
description: Main antagonist of the movie, Vincent is a rather melancholic introvert.  He was used as a test subject during the experimentation after the Titan War. He was the only survivor in a field of test subjects, ergo, the vaccine only he carried was successful. He was abandoned to die on Titan by the government, but somehow survived and returned to civilization. He has also loved Electra very deeply, but has suffered amnesia from his ordeal and does not remember.  His plan is to release the virus throughout the world, leaving only a handful of survivors. As a side-effect of the virus, Vincent was driven to insanity; which was also aided by the hallucination of golden butterflies he saw continuously (another side-effect of the infection). Vincent is in many ways a contrast to Spike. Aside from equal physical strength and similar physical appearances, Vincent and Spike are both men who consider themselves to be "dead" due to tragic incidents in their pasts, both kept alive by their love of a woman. The archetypal comparisons between the two have lead many fans to argue that the film itself is merely one of Spike's dreams, in which he confronts the guilt of his past and the end of his own life's situation.  Watanabe has declined to deny or confirm this. It has been stated that he may have been inspired by Bob Dylan and that his look is based on Vincent Gallo.

appearsIn.title: Cowboy Bebop: The Movie - Knockin' on Heaven's Door

name: Carlos
description: A friend of [Jobim](https://anilist.co/character/240934/) and [Antonio](https://anilist.co/character/240935/).

appearsIn.title: Cowboy Bebop: The Movie - Knockin' on Heaven's Door

name: Ein
description: Ein is a Pembroke Welsh Corgi brought aboard the Bebop by Spike after a failed attempt to capture a bounty. Ein is a "data dog": while the televised series only briefly hints on the fact that this means Ein's brain was somehow enhanced drastically, the manga shows Ed accessing data stored in Ein's brain via a virtual reality-type interface with which she has a conversation with a human proprietor. It is obvious that Ein is abnormally intelligent, as he is able to answer the telephone, drive a car (just the wheel), use the SSW, play shōgi, and generally do a number of other things that an average canine should not be able to do, but he never talks in a human language during the show. He does, however, speak in Session 18 "Speak Like A Child" after the credits Ein tells Spike "Next Episode: Wild Horses". He is able to "speak" to other species, as demonstrated in Session 17, "Mushroom Samba" (he spoke to a cow with a subtitled bark of "Thanks", to which the cow has a subtitled moo back of "No problem"). It is likely that Ed is the only crew member with any idea of Ein's capabilities, as the other crew members are quick to dismiss Ein, and never seem to acknowledge him as more than a pet. Ein initially takes a shine to Jet, but when Ed joins the crew, he comes around to her as well. Frequently the two trade roles, with Ein expressing very human sentiments via facial expression and Ed regressing to a feral state.

name: Oboro
description: Oboro is the current leader of the Tensho School and the strongest assassin within the Naraku organisation.   Trained in the Tensho school and later succeeding the previous generation's head position. He once fought against Sakata Gintoki during the Amanto War, but wasn't able to kill him. It is heavily implied that he was under Tokugawa Sadasada orders to kill the remaining Joui Patriots. Oboro also has extensive knowledge about Yoshida Shouyou and Gintoki's past.   He refers to Gintoki as a demon who howls at Heavens.

name: Kyuubei Yagyuu
description:
The successor to the Yagyuu family name, the daughter of [Koshinori Yagyuu](https://anilist.co/character/15581/) and the granddaughter of [Binbokusai Yagyuu](https://anilist.co/character/15580/).

They were brought up as a male, following the code of the Yagyuu clan, but in later years decided to follow neither femininity or masculinity, but live as only "Yagyuu Kyuubei." During their introduction, they tried to take [Tae Shimura](https://anilist.co/character/2944/) as their fiancee, though [Shinpachi](https://anilist.co/character/673/) and the rest stopped them from doing it. Yagyuu still has feelings for Tae, though they remained in friendly ties.

A genius swordsman; surpassing average swordsmen in skills, and is able to hold themself against veteran swordsmen, like [Toushirou Hijikata](https://anilist.co/character/2650/) and [Gintoki](https://anilist.co/character/672/).

name: Jugem Jugem
description:
His full name is "Jugem Jugem Shit-Tossing the Life of Shin-Chan’s Two-Day-Old Underwear Balmung Fezalion Isaac Schneider 1/3 True Love 2/3 Hangnail Anxiety Betrayal Knows My Name Or Does It Really Ignore Calls Squid Dogfish Halibut Trout-Cod Dogfish This Is A Different Dogfish, I’m Talking About The Dogfish Shark Kaluga Ray Yuuteimiyaoukimukou pepepepepepepepepepepepe Runny Diarrhea."   

Kyubei is assigned to make him into a celebrity monkey.  *The name "Jugem Jugem" is a reference to a story where the parents of a new-born baby couldn't decide a name out of many advised to them, the first being Jugemu. In the end, they named the baby with all the names together.  Different from the monkey's name, the baby was named "Jugemu Jugemu Gokō-no surikire Kaijarisuigyo-no Suigyōmatsu Unraimatsu Fūraimatsu Kūnerutokoro-ni Sumutokoro Yaburakōji-no burakōji Paipopaipo Paipo-no-shūringan Shūringan-no Gūrindai Gūrindai-no Ponpokopī-no Ponpokonā-no Chōkyūmei-no Chōsuke"

name: Tae Shimura
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm 

Tae Shimura is [Shinpachi](https://anilist.co/character/673)'s older sister. She runs the Kakidokan Dojo—which was her father's failing dojo—with her brother. She is usually addressed as "Otae"; the "O" is an honorific used to refer to women. [Kagura](https://anilist.co/character/674) always addresses her as "big sister" (anego). Despite her sweet face, she is one of the most violent characters in _Gintama_ (and arguably strong too). She mercilessly beats up [Isao Kondo](https://anilist.co/character/2943) and [Gintoki Sakata](https://anilist.co/character/672) whenever they anger her; in episode 19, she mercilessly kicks the men out onto the road (namely her brother, Gintoki and [Taizou Hasegawa](https://anilist.co/character/3760)) so as to stop a car for a hitch ride. She often displays her trademark sweet-looking smile with her eyes closed before engaging in her violent activities. Her killer intent is so strong that on one occasion, a stare from her brings the entire Shinsengumi on their knees begging for mercy. Her weapon of choice seems to be a naginata, a Japanese spear.

Her cooking skills are terrible, seeing as her tamagoyaki (i.e. sweet fried egg) is so inedible that Kondo suffers amnesia after eating it and others are barely able to swallow it down. [Sagaru Yamazaki](https://anilist.co/character/4653) even describes it as "poison" after some of it accidentally gets into his eye.

name: Ayame Sarutobi
description:
__Height:__ 169 cm

Sarutobi Ayame is a ninja from the Oniwabanshuu by training, but is currently working as an assassin. She also has a part-time job at the Kunoichi Café.

Since her initial appearance, she has developed a serious obsessive infatuation with [Sakata Gintoki](https://anilist.co/character/672/Sakata-Gintoki), to the point of even stalking him. She is severely myopic, to the point of being almost blind (cannot tell living things from inanimate objects) without her eyeglasses. It was also hinted that she doesn't see well even with her eyeglasses on, as she once mistook [Kagura](https://anilist.co/character/674/Kagura) (dressed up as Gintoki) for Gintoki himself. However, this could solely be due to her infatuation with him. She has frequently clashed with [Otae](https://anilist.co/character/2944/Shimura-Tae) for various reasons.

Ayame has a playful attitude but gets serious when it comes to her work. She also seems to enjoy bondage and S&M. Although Gintoki is indifferent to her affections and even treats her badly most times (e.g throwing things at her whenever he senses her stalker presence), her 'M' or masochistic personality only makes her enjoy the punishment, and his 'cruelty' only serves to encourage her.

name: Shinsuke Takasugi
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm

A former comrade of [Gintoki](https://anilist.co/character/672/Sakata-Gintoki) and [Katsura](https://anilist.co/character/1533/Katsura-Kotarou) and a major antagonist. He is easily recognisable through his bandaged left eye, his colorful  kimono, his eerie smile, and the pipe he is often seen smoking.



He, Gintoki, and Katsura studied in the same temple elementary school when they were children, and he fought with them against the Amanto invasion during the latter part of the Joui war. After the war ended, he vanished, and has since gained a dangerous reputation due to his assassination of many of the Bakufu's main officers and his planning of a large-scale coup d'etat. Before his first appearance in both the anime and the manga, he was mentioned to have fled Edo and to have been hiding in Kyoto, although it is unclear how long before this was.  He now believes that the only way to save it is to destroy the "rotten" post-Joui war world.

He is shown to like festivals, although this is mainly due to the opportunity they provide for a large-scale terrorist attack: he appears to have an attraction to ruin that is almost nihilistic. He also appears to have considerable insight due to his 'seeing through Itou's heart' and subsequently planting him in the Shinsengumi's ranks.

It can be assumed that he is as skilled a swordsman as both Gintoki and Katsura, having fought alongside them as one of the 'heroes' of the Joui war.

Between her perverted ero-artist father and her expectations built up from his publications, she often embarasses herself in front of Kijima. Her life is changing and she doesn't know how to cope in many ways, but she isn't exactly against it happening.

Ao thinks he’s a sexually experienced stud just trying to get in her panties, but he genuinely likes her. Because of this, he’s often nervous when they see each other. He is unaware that Ao’s father is a famous erotic author.

name: Hayato Kisaragi
description:
Hayato Kisaragi is the main protagonist of Hundred. He is the older brother of Karen Kisaragi originating from Yamato prior to the Second Attack, but later moved to Gudenburg due to their father's job where he befriended Emilia Hermit until his parents' death, then moved to an insitutute in Yamato. 

Hayato was later scouted to enroll in Little Garden with both his tuition waived and under a scholarship under the condition his little sister would receive the treatment she needed due to his high aptitude for a Hundred, as a result of him being a variant and become a first-year student in Bugeika High School.

name: Emile Crossfode
native: エミール・クロスフォード
description:
Emilia Gudenburg is the main female protagonist in Hundred.

She is the third princess of the Gudenburg Empire.

Having snuck outside of the royal palace several times, Emilia befriended, Hayato Kisaragi under the alias of Emilia Hermit. During the Second Attack, she was turned into a variant after being attacked by a savage and was separated from Hayato.

She soon enrolled in Little Garden under the guise of a male student named Emile Crossfode where she had become the roommate of Hayato but was later removed after Claire found out she was a female.

name: Claire Harvey
description: Claire Harvey is one of the three main female protagonists of Hundred. She is the first daughter and second child of Bill and Linis Harvey, thus making her the little sister of Judal Harvey and older sister of Liza Harvey. After being admitted into Little Garden, she became the highest-ranked Slayer known as the Perfect Queen and Rose Guardian.

name: Mash Kyrielight
native: マシュ・キリエライト
description: Mash Kyrielight is a clerk at Chaldea and a Shielder-class Demi-Servant contracted with [Ritsuka Fujimaru](https://anilist.co/character/120734/Fujimaru-Ritsuka) in Fate/Grand Order. The title Demi-Servant indicates that she's a human bonded with a Heroic Spirit's Soul.

appearsIn.title: Fate/Grand Order Absolute Demonic Front: Babylonia

name: Ritsuka Fujimaru
description:
Ritsuka Fujimaru is the protagonist of Fate/Grand Order, acting as the Master of many Servants for the purpose of solving the Grand Order conflicts. He has absolutely no background details or connections to other people or events. He is simply "someone who just happened to see a recruitment flyer at a station, applied and got accepted into the job, and somehow ended up getting taken into the Chaldea Security Organization.'' 

He is a rather mediocre magus with skills comparable to Lord El-Melloi II.

appearsIn.title: Fate/Grand Order Absolute Demonic Front: Babylonia

name: Merlin
description:
Merlin is believed to be the son of the Princess of Wales and an Incubus, his mixed blood and his astounding talent for magic make him one of the greatest Mages that ever lived and one of the few qualified to be a Grand Caster. Like all the most supreme mages he possesses powerful Clairvoyance abilities. Merlin's, however, allows him only to see the present. 

He served first [Uther Pendragon](https://anilist.co/character/316370/Pendragon-Uther) and then his heir [Artoria](https://anilist.co/character/497/Pendragon-Artoria) as a counselor and court mage, aiding her during her reign. He, however, disappeared soon before the fall of Camelot into the mists of Avalon. There, locked in a tower, he is unable to die and observes the world through his clairvoyance.

Since he is not technically dead and registered in the Throne of Heroes, he couldn't be summoned as a Servant, however, the mischievous Merlin has a hobby of bypassing this rule through loopholes.

appearsIn.title: Fate/Grand Order Absolute Demonic Front: Babylonia

description: Jaguar Man is a low-grade Divine Spirit, worshipped in Mesoamerican civilizations of old as a symbol of war and death. It is often referred to as Nagual, a human being capable of shapeshifting into a Jaguar.

appearsIn.title: Fate/Grand Order Absolute Demonic Front: Babylonia

name: Enkidu
description:
Enkidu is known to be [Gilgamesh](https://anilist.co/character/2514/Gilgamesh)'s only true friend and much like him, they regard their friendship highly. 

While they may have the appearance of a human they're nothing more than a doll made of mud, shaped and given life by the Gods. Before assuming their current form and acquiring intellect and knowledge, they spent a long time roaming the forests and thus has a deep connection with nature.

The task given to them was to reprimand Gilgamesh tyrannical behavior and bring him back into the service of the Gods but the might of the two was equal and they developed a tight bond fighting together.

Said to have been trained in the arts of war by a Tengu when in the care of Kurama Temple, she is a master of the combat arts but her peculiar upbringing and natural talent made her impervious to the worries of the average soldier.

name: Ereshkigal
description:
__Height:__ 159 cm

Ereshkigal is the Goddess and ruler of the Netherworld in Sumerian Mythology. She and [Ishtar](https://anilist.co/character/135743/Ishtar) are sister goddesses, polar opposites representing life and death, thus holding a rival relationship.

She was assigned to oversee the Netherworld at birth and upheld her duty with utmost care but inevitably started envying the freedom and carefreeness of her counterpart Ishtar opposed to the utter solitude she was bound to endure. While her sister was revered and pampered Ereshkigal desired nothing more than for someone to see her as she truly is, to not be judged for being the avatar of death.

It is met by Fujimaru while it's alongside Mash and accompanies the two in their travels to different Singularities.

Unlike regular games, it is a game that tries to pursue realism to a fanatical point. As such, Hiroshi struggles to eke out a niche. native: シャルロッテ・ゼンフィス
description:
____Age____ 7 (Debut) 11 (Time Skip)
____Affiliation____ Camelot
____Aliases____ Weiss Owl

____Personality____
Charlotte is a curious individual, which led her to investigate [Haruto ](https://anilist.co/character/303772/Hart-Zenfis) and she noticed his odd behavior. While initially hesitant around Haruto, she grew to have immense faith in him and his abilities. Haruto introducing her to anime at a young age led to her becoming a chuunibiyo, a big fan of the magical girl genre, and imagining the capita was home to a massive conspiracy (which coincidentally turned out to be true).

name: Yellow Diamond
native: イエローダイヤモンド
description:
__Hardness:__ 10

The oldest gem, who mostly does patrol duty. They're partners with [Zircon](https://anilist.co/character/123401/Zircon). Yellow Diamond is cheerful yet mature, and feels responsible for all of their siblings.

Throughout their life, Yellow has had several partners—[Green Diamond](https://anilist.co/character/393651/Green-Diamond), [Ruby](https://anilist.co/character/393652/Ruby), [Sapphire](https://anilist.co/character/393650/Sapphire), and [Pink Topaz](https://anilist.co/character/393648/Pink-Topaz)—but they were all taken to the moon. Yellow struggles with low self-esteem and possible self-loathing for constantly letting their partners be taken by the Lunarians, and also questions why they bother fighting anymore.

name: Euclase
description:
__Hardness:__ 7.5

A kindly and knowledgeable elder gem who does patrol duty, secretary work, strategy planning, and other odd jobs. They seem to be partners with [Jade](https://anilist.co/character/123393/Jade). Euclase is kind, intellectual, and extremely perceptive. They're also good at math, and can recite any gem's age to the day on command. They have a strong sense of responsibility and often worry over the others.

name: Jade
description:
__Hardness:__ 7

A very serious gem who mainly works as [Sensei](https://anilist.co/character/123394/Kongou)'s spokesperson. They seem to be partners with [Euclase](https://anilist.co/character/123391/Euclase). Jade is responsible, hardworking, and takes things too seriously.

name: Wendelin von Benno Baumeister
native: ヴェンデリン・フォン・ベンノ・バウマイスター
description: Poor son of a nobleman who lives in a remote area far from the royal capital. Formerly, Shingo Ichimiya, a salaryman who works for a food-related trading company, woke up after taking a nap and became a small child in a different world. Since he could not succeed to the territory, he was aiming for independence with one point that he was blessed with magical talent in the situation of being stuck.
