name: Yuuki Anzai
description:
Anzai is the male protagonist of the Devils' Line series. He is a half-devil, half-human hybrid and a police officer who is a member of F Squad in the MPD Public Safety Division 5, responsible for combatting devil crimes. His occupation as a police officer utilizes his abilities as a hybrid.

Anzai was raised at ONLO orphanage in Hokkaido.

name: Tsukasa Taira
description: Tsukasa is the female protagonist of the Devils' Line series. She is a first-year graduate student at Keio University where she originally studied Humanities and Geography. She is a kind-hearted human girl who falls in love with Yuuki Anzai at almost first sight. Despite the difficulties of being in a devil/human relationship, she stays positive and is always trying to make it work. She cares about Yuuki and his suffering as a devil very much and is constantly looking for something she can do.

name: Naoya Ushio
description: A member of C Squad in Public Safety Division 5.

name: Johannes Kleeman
native: ヨハネス・クレーマン / 李 ハンス
description:
Johannes Kleeman is a devil/human hybrid who was raised at the same facility as Yuuki Anzai, although not a part of the same group. He is a rather carefree and blunt person, and not even blood bothers him. By drinking a little blood every morning and evening he can almost completely control his bloodlust. And because of this, his left eye is almost always transformed.

He is a part of the White Group 07 of the 15th Hybrid Birth Project at ONLO. These devils are called "Children of the Dark" by some. It seems that his departure from ONLO wasn't authorized.

name: Mayu Sumimori
description: A member of the terrorist group CCC, where she acts under the code name 11.

name: Nanako Tenjou
description: A sniper for the terrorist group CCC, where she acts under the code name 07.

name: Takeshi Makimura
description: A member of B Squad in Public Safety Division 5.

name: Kenichi Yoshii
description: A member of the terrorist group CCC, where he acts under the code name 09.

name: Kenichi Morisawa
description: A past devil lieutenant of Public Safety Divison 5.

name: Kirio Kikuhara
description: The leader of A Squad in Public Safety Division 5.

name: Adonis
description: Adonis is a human raised by a witch named Chloe.

name: Doroka
description: A young girl who was imprisoned in a prisoner's camp in the Lydia Empire. She is kind and has a noble spirit.

name: Siluca Meletes
description: Siluca Meletes is the main female protagonist throughout the series. She is a young mage that has a great amount of potential and talent, and wishes to stop the feuding of lords. She forms a contract with Theo, and possesses a cat familiar, who can travel through shadows and is the king of the cat kingdom.

name: Theo Cornaro
description: Theo Cornaro (テオ・コルネーロ) is the main protagonist of the series. A wandering knight who obtained a Crest from a Chaos Core. He comes from Sistina, a village ravaged by Chaos and oppressed by their Lord, Viscount Phederico Rossini. After rescuing Siluca from soldiers and telling her his goal to free his hometown, he forms a contract with her and together they fight to stop the feuding lords and end the Chaos era.

name: Cait Sith
description:
**Race:** Cat Familiar
 **Rank:** King of the Cat Kingdom

**Overview:**
Cait Sith is the cat familiar who is contracted with Siluca Meletes, he is also the king of the cat kingdom, and can also travel through shadows.

**History:**
His history is largely unknown, but at some point in time became the king of the cat kingdom and also made a contract with Siluca.

name: Tsunemi Chiba
description: Main vocalist for BECK, he is the key member that [Ryusuke](https://anilist.co/character/4170/Minami-Ryuusuke) needed to bring [Taira](https://anilist.co/character/308/Taira-Yoshiyuki) into the band. His attitude, style, and appearance was based on Zack De La Rocha from Rage Against The Machine and compared to [Koyuki](https://anilist.co/character/676/Tanaka-Yukio), his voice is more punk and rock oriented, like the majority of the band's songs. He also named the band Beck after staring at [Ryusuke's dog](https://anilist.co/character/141894/Beck) for a few moments. He also tends to pick his nose.

name: Maho Minami
description: Ryusuke's sister who is a talented singer with a strange relationship with Koyuki. At times she seems attracted to him, at others she brushes him off with little regard to his often ignored feelings.

name: Ryuusuke Minami
description: A Japanese character with a long history in America, he speaks fluent English, and frequently uses both Japanese and English in his conversations. He lives alone in a shack by the fishing pond. His skills and taste in music inspire Koyuki to take up the guitar. The band's creator, Ryusuke is BECK's lead guitarist. A once-younger Ryusuke and Eddie Lee stole the Lucille from the trunk of Syke's vehicle.

name: Yuuji Sakurai
description: The fourth member to join, he was also Koyuki's first good friend, sticking with him even when the school bully and his gang beat him up for breaking the silent treatment on Koyuki. He is the drummer, inspired by his brother, and replaces the original drummer of BECK who followed Ryûsuke from his original band, Serial Mama.

name: Yoshiyuki Taira
description: The first recruited member of BECK, Taira is the bassist, and the most talented band member next to [Ryusuke](https://anilist.co/character/4170/Minami-Ryuusuke). He plays Music Man StingRay bass. His attitude may sometimes come off as uncaring. He has been seen working as a traffic officer. As the story progresses, we learn that his father was a jazz musician that left him and his mother when he was young.

name: Yukio Tanaka
description: The main character, the series follows his rapid development from living an average life to becoming an outstanding guitarist. Being a weak individual lacking an authoritative presence , he cannot help but let others push him around, a possible metaphoric stereotype on the very proper and manner conscious Japanese society. Recruited as the last member of BECK, he serves as the second guitarist and vocalist, and has a very beautiful voice that is mostly used for Beck's slower songs. He owns a Fender Telecaster.

name: Eiji Kimura
description: Originally in Ryusuke's first band, Serial Mama, he turned into his rival, and his new band, Belle Ame, formed as BECK's competition was mainly succeeding through appeal for the band member's looks and not sound. Getting all the big breaks, Belle Ame seemed destined for greatness, until BECK destroyed their ride to fame, at the cost of being blacklisted in the music industry.

name: Masaru Hyodou
description: Masaru Hyodo is the chief instigator in a group who bully Koyuki during his middle school days. Hyodo is also a "technically" accomplished guitarist, but as Ryûsuke points out, doesn't have any real feeling or passion behind his playing. Hyodo's father is a famous musician, but his parents are divorced (Hyodo is his mother's maiden name).

name: Kazuo Satou
description: The lady who first gets Beck into Greatful Sound (chapter 23, page 10) (with some "help" from Leon Sykes" (chapter 24)) she is also the woman who gets the band into contact with their first label, the indie label "Lust For Life" (Beck: Mongolian chop Squad chapter 43, page 40-45).

name: Rikiya Kitazawa
description: Rikiya Kitawaza is a thug attending Koyuki's middle school and a childhood friend of Hyodo.

name: Kamui
description:
Kamui is a member of the Yato Tribe, the son of [Umibouzu](https://anilist.co/character/9876/Umibouzu) and older brother of [Kagura](https://anilist.co/character/674/Kagura). His excellent fighting skills helped him become Captain of the 7th Division of Harusame's Thunder Guns, the most powerful combat unit within the Harusame group and Overlord of Yoshiwara. Since defecting from the Harusame, he no longer holds these positions.

Kamui firmly believes that the Yato are to remain on the battlefield and shows his disapproval of [Housen](https://anilist.co/character/25666/Housen) staying locked up in Yoshiwara. Because of this belief, he shows no pity towards family or subordinates as a sign of weakness is unacceptable. He tried to revive the abandoned tradition of Yato clan's men killing their own parent to prove their strength, although failed to successfully execute it and only cut his father's arm off.  Despite this, he pays respect to the opponents he kills by sending them off with a smile. He doesn't kill children, and dislikes killing women because they may give birth to strong children.

name: Kotarou Katsura
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm (5'8")

Katsura is [Gintoki](https://anilist.co/character/672)'s former comrade during the Joi war. Even after the Amanto take-over of Japan, Katsura continues to resist the Amanto, and has amassed a band of followers.

He is a wanted man due to his involvement in terrorist activities against the Bakufu, and is constantly on the run from the Shinsengumi. Although his initial methods were originally more violent in nature (for instance, sending a bomb to an Amanto embassy), Katsura has gradually grown to believe that there are people important to him in Edo, and decides that he no longer wants to destroy the country, but believes there should be a way to change it without causing sacrifices.  Katsura seems to be highly respected by his followers, and has even been called the "Daybreak of the Joui Faction" by some. When people believed that Katsura had died during the Benizakura arc, even other terrorist groups tried to avenge his death. Since he is a wanted man, Katsura is often seen wearing disguises, although his identity is often still easily found out. 

Katsura seems to possess a rather outdated sense of humour, and sometimes refers to things from a past era, such as when he tried to buy a Famicon when people were queuing up to buy the OwEe (a parody of the Wii). He also seems to have a tendency to make up dramatic stories, which moves others to tears when they hear them (except Gintoki).

name: Tatsuma Sakamoto
description:
__Height:__ 181 cm

Sakamoto is a former member of the Joi. He is a good-natured man and optimistic to the point of being ridiculous, even in the most dangerous situations. His favorite phrase is "AHAHA! It must be _____". He also has a tendency to misspell names; he calls Gintoki "Kintoki". Gintoki often corrects him, citing that if he were named Kintoki, they would be in some kind of hentai anime (because 'Kin' from 'Kintoki' instead of 'Gin' would make the title 'Kintama', which means 'testicles' instead of 'Gintama', which means 'silver soul').  

Despite his goofy nature, Sakamoto is actually a successful businessman in the galaxy. He believes that business is a way of protecting his country. He has a private, well-equipped defensive business fleet. He believes that sacrifices should be made for the good of the community, which is why he chose to abandon his comrades on Earth to travel into space. Sakamoto is shown to be skilled with a pistol in an anime filler episode.

His name is based on the historical character Sakamoto Ryouma. He speaks in Tosa-ben, much like the inspiration for his character.

name: Umibouzu
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm
__Occupation:__ Alien Hunter

Umibouzu is Kagura and Kamui's father and one of the last members of the Yato clan. 

Like Kagura, he fights using an umbrella but is also shown to be strong in his own right.

name: Elizabeth
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm

Elizabeth resembles a giant white duck or a giant penguin and is [Katsura's](https://anilist.co/character/1533/Katsura-Kotarou) companion. Elizabeth was a present from [Tatsuma Sakamoto](https://anilist.co/character/2945/Sakamoto-Tatsuma), who presumably picked it up on his travels around space. Although many people consider Elizabeth to be insane and extraneous, Katsura has named the ambiguous avian "Elizabeth" and dotes on it. Elizabeth is something of a painter, and is surprisingly dexterous. Also, Elizabeth resorts to using signboards to "communicate", as well as an occasional means of attack. Elizabeth is also a skilled fighter, able to use signboards to fight off swordsmen.  

Although the true identity of Elizabeth is uncertain, it appears to be a man wearing a duck costume. In its first appearance, hairy legs are seen underneath her sheet and the body of a humanoid with glowing eyes is revealed as her mouth is opened just as it fell during another battle between [Gintoki](https://anilist.co/character/672/Sakata-Gintoki) and Katsura. Although Katsura seems shocked at what she really is, she has subsequently remained by his side. Episode 50 implies that the person inside Elizabeth is most likely the director (Gintoki was interrupted before he can finish being cut off at "Kanto-" ("Direc-"). Most of the characters seem to ignore this, or at least do not give it much thought, given at the episode was completely filler.

name: Mahiro Yasaka
description: The male protagonist of the story. Usually avoids close contact with Nyaruko and often stabs her with a fork. Since this is a parody anime, Mahiro is a tsundere. It is shown that Mahiro has feelings for Nyaruko, but doesn't like her aggressiveness.

name: Nyaruko
description: A Nyarlotephian, who has come to Earth on a mission to protect Mahiro. Nyaruko has a bright personality, as she is always shown to be happy and rarely down. She likes anime, manga, games, and superhero shows. She has perverted thoughts that usually revolve around Mahiro, whom she says to love.

name: Cthuko
description: A Cthuko (another alien species), who is Nyaruko's childhood friend from kindergarten and elementary school. Instead of thinking of Nyaruko as her enemy (because they're different species, and both Cthuko and Nyarlotephian are enemies), she loves her deeply. Kuko is usually quiet and blushes a lot. She has really perverted thoughts. Nyaruko calls her 'NEET', due to the fact that she loves games.

name: Hasta
description: A Hastur (alien species), who attended the same space kindergarden and space elementary school with Nyaruko and Chtuko. Despite Hastur's appearence, Hastur is actually a boy. Nyaruko and Cthuko call him "Hasuta-kun". He possess the power of air, and is known to be stronger than both Nyaruko and Cthuko, since he was the one who always stopped their fight during space elementary school.  Hastur is based on Hastur: The deity of the wind.  Hasuta (Shouen version in season 2) is voiced by Seki Tomokazu.

name: Yoriko Yasaka
description: Mahiro's mother who happens to work as a part-time deity hunter. She is a skilled fighter as well as an avid  gamer, she is adept in using ordinary common dining forks as her throwing weapon.

name: Takehiko Yoichi
description: A classmate of Mahiro's and best friend.

name: Ghutatan
description: Ghutatan comes to earth from the planet Ghatanothoa for Mahiro to take care of her as if he were babysitting her. She is kind of childish for an alien, as seen in episode 11 when the Nyarlathotepian trio chases Mahiro for her. She has a butler named Roy Fooger the Lloigor.    (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Shantak-kun
description: Nyaruko's pet. A female shantak (monster in Cthulhu mythos, a bird with horse's head and bat's wing). have many different forms including enlarging to stories high, a dog's size. or turn into different vehicles. According to Nyaruko, shantaks' eggs are precious and expensive food in space, despite Mahiro never accepts to eat them. Nyaruko arrived on earth by taking spaceship transformed from Shantak-kun.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Tamao Kurei
description: Another classmate of Mahiro's.  She is a member of the school's newspaper club and also very noisy. She is also called "Walking Speaker", and has a habit of gossiping and asking questions like a newsreporter. Tamao is also a close friend of Nyaruko's, telling her usually advices how to get Mahiro hers.

name: Isuka
description: A member of the Yith race who temporarily borrows Kurei Tamao's body. She later borrows the body of a stuffed animal.

name: Rumiko Chie
description: Rumiko is the female teacher of Keiichi's class, who is a parody character of Tsukihime's Ciel-Senpai (permission for her usage was given by Type-Moon). The seiyū for her character in the anime series is the same as the seiyū of Ciel from the Tsukihime anime. Going along with the parody, her favorite food is curry rice, just like Ciel, and will go to great and somewhat scary, lengths to uphold the honor of curry, which is shown in the Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Rei OVA, where she becomes enraged by Keichi's "offense" to curry. On a stronger note, she is seen wielding wooden T's, shapped, and held, in exactly the same fashion as the Black Keys from Tsukihime.

name: Yakumo Yuurakutei
description:
A legendary rakugo performer who is haunted by his past. He refused to take in any apprentices until he met [Yotarou](https://anilist.co/character/89343/Yotarou).

As a child, Bon had originally trained as a dancer until damage to his leg left him unable to dance. Bon's mother, a geisha, sent him to train as a rakugo performer under the Seventh Generation [Yakumo Yuurakutei](https://anilist.co/character/369125/Yuurakutei-Yakumo) alongside [Shin](https://anilist.co/character/89346/Yuurakutei-Sukeroku), a boy who shows up unexpectedly and is accepted on a whim. While he proved to be adept at the basics of rakugo, and possessed impressive potential to memorize stories, his performances were stiff and lacked emotion and passion. Shin, with his impressive love for rakugo, quickly overtook him. As an apprentice, he was given the name "Kikuhiko." In an attempt to find his own style, Kikuhiko began performing 'bawdy and erotic' stories and discovered his strong ability to personify feminine characters.

name: Sukeroku Yuurakutei
description:
Shin was the [Eighth Generation Yakumo's](https://anilist.co/character/89345/Yuurakutei-Yakumo) lifelong friend and partner growing up, and [Konatsu's](https://anilist.co/character/89707/Konatsu) father. Apprenticed under [Yakumo Yuurakutei](https://anilist.co/character/369125/Yuurakutei-Yakumo) alongside Bon, he was originally given the name "Hatsutarou," but rejected it to instead perform under the name "Sukeroku." As a shin'uchi, his unique and passionate style of performing quickly earns him a name and reputation in the rakugo community, but also strikes a nerve with the traditionalist members of the rakugo association.

Sukeroku and Kikuhiko made a promise with each other to ensure rakugo's survival as an art form together—Sukeroku would practice rakugo that changed to appeal to the public and Kikuhiko would practice rakugo that never changed and stayed true to its roots. This promise would go unfulfilled when Sukeroku died a tragic death at a young age, but his impact on rakugo as an art never faded.

name: Yotarou
description: An ex-convict, recently released from prison, who seeks out apprenticeship under the legendary Eighth Generation [Yakumo Yuurakutei](https://anilist.co/character/89345/) after witnessing his rakugo performance. He is taken in as Yakumo's first ever student, and is given the name Yotarou (rakugo slang for "fool").

name: Yakumo Yuurakutei
description: The Seventh Generation Yakumo Yuurakutei and master of Bon and Shin. While performing rakugo in Manchuria during World War II, he meets [Miyokichi](https://anilist.co/character/89577/Miyokichi) and introduces her to his students.

name: Yakuza Aniki
description: This man was Yotaro's direct superior in the yakuza. He is also the underling of the Oyabun. At the beginning of the series, he tries to convince Yotaro to rejoin the yakuza, but is convinced that Yotaro is better off performing rakugo after witnessing a moving performance.

name: Miyokichi
description: A mysterious woman who originally worked as a geisha, thanks to [Yakumo the 7th](https://anilist.co/character/369125/Yuurakutei-Yakumo)'s help. She normally supports [Kikuhiko](https://anilist.co/character/89345/Yuurakutei-Yakumo) by giving him encouragement and watching his rakugo performances.

name: Konatsu
description:
Konatsu is the daughter of [Sukeroku](https://anilist.co/character/89346/) and [Miyokichi](https://anilist.co/character/89577/), and Yakumo the 8th's ward. 

She normally fights back against what [Yakumo](https://anilist.co/character/89345/) says and wants, and will exhibit this sort of behaviour to anyone else she doesn't trust. She is also a great teacher of rakugo, although somewhat stern.

name: Kafuka Fuura
description:
A somewhat strange and exceedingly optimistic student who always sees everything in the single most positive light possible: the polar opposite of [Nozomu](https://anilist.co/character/3169/Itoshiki-Nozomu), who sees only the dark side of things and is constantly in despair. She often has bizarre, childishly optimistic explanations for grim situations, calling suicide by hanging "becoming taller" and the act of stalking "deep love." She enjoys giving whimsical nicknames to people (much to their annoyance), and has a strange obsession with aliens. Once she turned in a briefcase full of money to the police.



Kafuka Fuura is a pen name, taken from the name of author Franz Kafka, and is quite at odds with her sunny attitude. Her real name is has not been officially revealed; however,

name: Nozomu Itoshiki
description:
A high school teacher and the youngest son of the Itoshiki family. He always wears a hakama and kimono abroad, preferring flippant casual western clothing in his hometown. When his name is written horizontally it resembles zetsubou ("beyond hope" or "despair"), befitting his extremely negative, paranoid and pessimistic attitude.

He often shouts "I'm in despair!" and attempts suicide several times, though rarely with serious intent. Most of the main girls seem to have feelings for him, but only because they misunderstand what he said to each of them (during the episodes introducing them). 

His negative personality started blossoming when he was in his first year of high school when he "accidentally" joined a "Negative Club". He is based upon the main character from Dazai Osamu's No Longer Human, which is both Nozomu's and the author's favorite novel.

name: Chie Arai
description: The student counselor. If one supplies an alternate reading for the first kanji in her surname, her name is read "Niichie", a reference to Friedrich Nietzsche. She has an excellent figure and a large bust, which is admired by the local people during the swimming pool scene. She's often shown as a sadist rebuking various masochistic males, usually featured in the beginning of various episodes. Nozomu usually does anything she orders him to do (like getting Kiri Komori back to school) as he states her eyes are terrifying but he goes to her anytime he has one of his suicidal breakdowns brought on because of a random conspiracy theory.

name: Meru Otonashi
description:
A very shy girl who does not talk and only communicates via text messaging on her cell phone; she is notably and viciously abusive in her e-mails. Her family name, Otonashi, means "soundless", and her given name derives from the loan word "mail". Her e-mail address is "hazukashigariyasan", which means "full of shyness". She is called "MeruMeru" by her father

Aside from a few weak sounds and squeaks, she is essentially mute, and any attempt to speak will cause her to uncontrollably sputter in a horrific language. Her family also seems ridiculously rich, as her father is able to set up an audition for people to try and dub her voice in real time. In the anime, her voice actress changes every episode and is chosen at random, and is credited with, at most, a short sequence of nonsense characters  with the exception of episode six of Zoku, where she is voiced by Chiwa Saito.

name: Matoi Tsunetsuki
description: A girl with short, straight-fringed hair who stalks whoever she falls in love with. She is also known for changing her manner of dress to partner those of her current love interest. She falls in love with [Nozomu](https://anilist.co/character/3169/Itoshiki-Nozomu) after misinterpreting one of his statements as a confession of love, and follows him wherever he goes, much to his dismay; even dressing up in a kimono similar to Nozomu and performing many of the duties of a Japanese wife (walking three steps behind, always by his side, etc). She has admitted to having read through Nozomu's mail and disposing of them before he gets a chance to read them. Her name is a pun on tsune tsukimatoi, which means "always dangling after".

name: Harumi Fujiyoshi
description:
A fan of BL and cat ears, and the classroom's resident illustrator. She has an innate coupling instinct, imagining slash pairings between all sorts of (male) characters, her favorite couple being Pine × Napple; she has also imagined pairings between Nozomu and his friend with rather explicit content. Her tastes are considered unusual, even abnormal, which often puts her at odds with Chiri

 She possesses amazing athletic abilities, causing her to be recruited into various athletic clubs. Her three older brothers are all involved in the anime industry. Apparently, according to her mom, Harumi was an accidental child.

Her name is a combination of fujoshi (BL fangirl, sometimes romanized as fujyoshi) and Harumi, the previous site of Comiket before it moved to Tokyo Big Sight.

name: Kaere Kimura
description:
A returnee to Japan suffering from dissociative identity disorder. One is an ultimately Japanese woman named Kaede, a very gentle personality well-versed in Japanese culture. The other is a foreigner named Kaere who is disgusted by Japanese culture and touts the bizarre ways of the country she is from, which is America. Kaere is easily offended and constantly threatens to sue everyone. She unfortunately adopts the latter personality more often.

Her given name derives from Japanese kaere, the imperative form of the verb kaeru (to return, to go back), and also from Kaela Kimura, a Japanese idol. She provides many panty shots, often with strange images on her panties. It is interesting to note that she possessed a third personality, a balance between the two, until she came to this class, and the students triggered a psychotic breakdown.

name: Kobushi Abiru no Chichi
description: Kobushi Abiru's father is the sole survivor of the Japanese Special Operations Group "DESERT CRUSHERS", a unit so deadly that individual soldiers are trained to be capable of eliminating an entire enemy platoon with a single volume of Kimagure Orange Road. He is a master of torture.

name: Rin Itoshiki
description:
Nozomu's younger sister, a seventeen-year-old ikebana master. When her name is written horizontally it resembles zetsurin ("unequaled"), which describes her exceptional talent in various skills; however, calling her zetsurin evokes her fury, as the word is often used as slang for sexual prowess.

She has revealed her willingness to marry out of the Itoshiki family in the hope of abandoning her unwanted name. Rin eventually transfers to Nozomu's school and becomes a student in his class, after which she frequently faces the readers/audience with her backside (in a parody Shin-chan, who is also voiced by Akiko Yajima). She also happens to own a chocolate factory.

name: Kagerou Usui
description:
The actual class president of 2-He, who is ignored to the point of vanishing into thin air; only when his baldness is exposed does he become visible to others. In the anime, he has a major crush on [Abiru](https://anilist.co/character/3747/Kobushi-Abiru), but leers after most female students (especially [Kaere](https://anilist.co/character/3768/Kimura-Kaere)), who naturally do not notice he is there.

His name is a pun on the phrase kage ga usui ("overshadowed"), referring to his lack of presence. (The usui also refers to his thinning hairline.)

name: Tartah
description: Nolnoa's young assistant in the shop. He suffers from argentosis, a rare sight condition which makes him effectively colorblind and thus initially unable to use magic because certain effects rely on inks differentiated by their color. He becomes a dear friend to [Coco](https://anilist.co/character/129840/Coco), who helps him by teaching him magic with which to circumvent his disability.

name: Easthies
description:
A member of the Knights Moralis and the leader of a squad of five.

A strict and serious individual, he is pretty stern and does not care about trivial things such as his birthday. Work is his top priority, he is dedicated to his job of enforcing the law and has no interest for his appearance or personal care. He shows himself to be ruthless, ignoring the pleas of others and does not hesitate to take action as a Knight.

name: Ininia
description:
Ininia is an apprentice witch currently serving under a mysterious witch named Restis.

She is very lawful to her master, Lord Restis. Ininia talks in third person and is very aloof, barely showing any emotion. She also has a very simple view on friendship, viewing those as friends as ones that will be spared from her more harmful magic.

name: Pazu
description: Pazu is an investigator in Section 9.  Before joining Public Security Section 9, Pazu was rumored by various police circles to have been a gangster in several yakuza groups in Japan. Pazu is also a known chain smoker within the unit. Upon his first encounter with the Major, he remarked, "I never sleep with the same woman twice." He uses a folding knife in combat.  (Source: Wikipedia)

appearsIn.title: Ghost in the Shell: Stand Alone Complex

name: Terrorist
description: He controls the Robot-Geishas, which took the Foreigner Minister as a hostage.

appearsIn.title: Ghost in the Shell: Stand Alone Complex

name: Daido
description: A General Inspector in charge of police oversight committee irregularities.

appearsIn.title: Ghost in the Shell: Stand Alone Complex

name: Pavlo Zaitsev
description: Pavlo Zaitsev is a former Paralympic silver medalist and Batous's role model. After his loss in the Paralympic final his life went down the toilet and he worked as a close combat trainer for the army. But his actually job was espionage. Batou discovered this and then turned in his former idol.

appearsIn.title: Ghost in the Shell: Stand Alone Complex

name: Patema
description: The main character of Patema Inverted. She is a resident of a village that lives deep underground, and often challenges the rule that forbids leaving the village's limits. Throughout the movie, Patema is shown to have an inverted gravity in comparison to those who dwell on the surface, meaning she could fall upwards through the sky should nothing bound her to land.

name: Eiichi
description: Age's father.

name: Nia Honjou
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm
__Angel:__ Rasiel

She is the ninth Spirit to appear in the series.

name: Mukuro Hoshimiya
description:
__Height:__ 148 cm
__Angel:__ Michael

She is the tenth spirit to appear in the series. Mukuro speaks in an overly archaic style. She often speaks in a third person perspective by referring to herself as "Muku" (むく).

name: Ayaka Sajyou
description:
Ayaka Sajyou is a magus living in Fuyuki City attending school at Homurahara Academy. She is also a former student of the El-Melloi Classroom, having attended classes for about a month.

__In Fate/Prototype:__



__In Fate/strange Fake:__

name: Richard I
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm

Saber-class Servant summoned in the "True and False Holy Grail Wars" of Fate/strange Fake. His true name is Richard I, also known as Richard the Lionheart.

name: Wolf
description:
The master of False Lancer.

The Wolf is a silver wolf familiar of the magus originally planning to participate in the Holy Grail War. He was created with the purpose of being used as a catalyst to summon a Servant. The magus believes that he needs to summon a being more ancient than the Origin of Heroes, something that transcends Heroes who were "kings". He wishes to summon an existence Egyptians called "God", but his plan is ruined when the Wolf obtains Command Spells instead of him.

name: Assassin
description:
Summoned by [Jester Karture](https://anilist.co/character/87315/Karture-Jester) as an Assassin in the fake Holy Grail War in Snowfield. She is a former candidate for the position of Hassan-i Sabbah, the pseudonym shared by the leaders of the League of Assassins, the Hashshashin. She was known a particularly faithful girl in a certain country whose existence is referred to as "merely a story." She underwent intense training to earn herself a name, and she was pious to the point in attempting to prove her faith that she was labelled as a "zealot" with despise by even those who worshiped the same God. While their group could be called a company of fanatics, her convictions were so beyond the norm that they earned her that title. She did not hate those who disparaged her because she believed the reason she was despised was because of her own immaturity and that her conviction was not firm.

She wished to become the sect’s leader, which required that she acquire power that could be called Divine Miracles. These Miracles had some unique specifications in that they must all quickly and reliably snuff out the lives of heretics and infidels. The leaders in the past obtained their titles by achieving numerous miracles worthy of bearing the name of the Fallen Angel in the form of Zabaniya, so she continued her mad pursuit of self-improvement incessantly, seeking the miracles that were achieved by her predecessors.

name: Tsubaki Kuruoka
description: [Rider](https://anilist.co/character/87309/Rider)'s master in the fake Holy Grail War in Snowfield.

name: Faldeus Dioland
native: ファルデウス・ディオランド
description: An agent from the Magic Association sent to investigate the rumor of a Holy Grail War starting in the city of Snowfield, California. He is [Rohngall](https://anilist.co/character/87299/Rohngall)'s apprentice.

name: Tine Chelc
description: She is the Master of [Archer](https://anilist.co/character/2514/Gilgamesh) in the False Holy Grail War in Snowfield. Tine's people are an indigenous people who had apparently kept watch over the Snowfield region for a thousand years before, in the early twentieth century, they were driven out by the government and the group of magi looking to prepare the land for the False Holy Grail War. Tine participates in the War seemingly with the intent to return her people to their rightful place. She does not have a particular wish for the Holy Grail to grant.

name: Orlando Reeve
description: Orlando Reeve is the police chief of Snowfield and the Master of [Caster](https://anilist.co/character/218086/Dumas-Alexandre). He is a magus who has gone to great lengths to prepare for the Holy Grail War. He has known of the ritual, and he is disappointed in the government for their decision to advertise it to outsiders.

name: Tatenashi Sarashiki
description: Tatenashi Sarashiki is a 2nd year student at the IS Academy, Student Council President of the IS Academy, and the IS Representative of Russia. This is due her combat skills, which exceed the Cadet stage. She appears in Volume 5. She is also current Roommate of Orimura Ichika. She pilots the IS "Mysterious Lady a 3rd Generation type".

name: Chifuyu Orimura
description: Chifuyu is Ichika's older sister. She is 24 years old and is in charge of Ichika's class at the IS academy. She was the Japanese pilot for the first generation IS machines and was said to be the strongest IS pilot at one point before retiring. During her retirement, she looked after her brother and raised him by herself after their parents abandoned them. She deeply cares for Ichika as she sees him as her only family. Chifuyu was also the one who enrolled Ichika to the IS academy to keep him safe from other countries. Chifuyu once wielded Yukihira, a powerful IS energy blade that is now under Ichika's possession. Chifuyu was a close friend of Tabane Shinonono, the creator of the IS, which explains how their younger siblings became childhood friends.

name: Kanzashi Sarashiki
description: Kanzashi Sarashiki is a 1st year student at the IS Academy in Class Four, younger sister of the Student Council President, Tatenashi Sarashiki and the IS Representative Candidate of Japan. She appears in Volume 7.

name: Saki Ayase
description:
[Yuuta](https://anilist.co/character/200292/Yuuta-Asamura)'s step-sister and a second-year high school student. 

She became Yuuta's step-sister after her parents remarried. Because of her flamboyant outfit, she is considered a delinquent student and is not well-liked in class.

name: Yuuta Asamura
description: [Saki](https://anilist.co/character/200291)'s step-brother and a second-year high school student. He became Saki's step-brother after his parents remarried. He is a normal high school student but is somewhat distant from others. He loves books to the level of a print addict.

name: Akiko Ayase
description:
Saki's biological mother and Yuuta's mother-in-law. 
After her divorce from her ex-husband, she worked tirelessly and raised Saki by herself until she remarried.

name: Maaya Narasaka
description:
Saki's classmate. 
She's always cheerful and meddlesome, and when she can't stand to see Saki isolated, she gets annoyingly involved with her, and they become friends.

name: Tomokazu Maru
description:
Yuuta's classmate. 
He is almost Yuuta's only friend at school. He is also a member of the baseball team and an otaku.

name: Taichi Asamura
description:
Yuta's biological father and Saki's father-in-law. 
After divorcing his ex-wife for various reasons, he remarried Akiko Ayase. He has a good relationship with Yuta and Saki.

name: Shiori Yomiuri
description: University student. She works part-time as a senior at the bookstore where Yuuta works. As a caring senior, she supports Yuuta's "relationship with his younger sister".

name: Kei Hanada
description:
Kei Hanada is a classmate of Seishuu Handa. 

Due to idolizing and over-obessing Seishuu as a whole, Hanada decided to become Seishuu as well. However, the plan went out pretty badly when everyone in the "Handa Force", including Seishuu, realizes how bad the poem and Seishuu even said that he didn't even wrote a poem not even once, making Seishuu to get furious. And even though he fully copied the eyes and hairstyle of Seishuu, his hideous mouth makes it all the difference, that's why he puts a surgical mask to hide his mouth, mistakenly identified him as the real Seishuu to some people due to his identical dead-fish eyes and hair. But when everyone learned that he was a fraud, the girls and some students calls him as a "phony" or in some cases, "fake Handa'.

When it comes to taking tests, he's using Seishuu's real name instead of his real name.

name: Angelina Durless
native: アンジェリーナ･ダレス
description:
__Height__: 168 cm (5'7")  

Angelina is the widow of the late Baron Barnett, the queen of high society (which has nicknamed her "Madam Red" due to the color of her hair and clothes), and Ciel's aunt. When she's not invading Ciel's home in London unannounced or flirting with her many admirers, she actually makes a living as a rare, female doctor. She appears to serve mostly female and child patients. Though childless herself, she's told Ciel in the past that she considers him her own son, and appears to have been keeping watch over him since he reappeared after the fire. She has her own butler, Grell, and is constantly reprimanding him to be more like Sebastian.

name: Elizabeth Midford
native: エリザベス・ミッドフォード
description:
__Height__: 157 cm (5'2") - 162 cm (5'3") (Season 2)

Elizabeth (who demands to be called by the more affectionate "Lizzie") is Ciel's cousin and fiancée. She is the daughter of Ciel's aunt, Frances, and her husband, Marquis Midford.

Lizzie is strong-willed and cheerful, with a fondness for cute things. She has known Ciel since childhood, and the two appear to have been very close. Despite this childhood connection, though, Ciel has not told her the circumstances of his parents' deaths and his own disappearance. Lizzie takes this in stride, not pestering him for information and continues to attempt to restore the close friendship. She ran away from home to see Ciel at least once, in spite of her mother's fearsome personality— she may just be the only person in the series not at all terrified of the Marchioness. Her hobby, much to Ciel's chagrin, is to make everything and everybody "cute"; this involves everything from decorating the mansion with hearts and sparkly bunnies to putting old men in dresses ("just like Marie Antoinette!").

name: Soma Asman Kadar
native: ソーマ・アスマン・カダール
description: The 26th child of the King of Bengal, Soma came to England with his butler, Agni, in search of a missing servant from his household. When he was young, he received a palace, complete with attendants, from his parents. Among those servants was a woman named Meena, a cook, who he came to see as an older sister. However, one day, Meena disappeared from the palace, leaving Soma devastated.     Circumstances surrounding Meena's disappearance causes Soma to take his search for her to England, where he accidentally runs into Ciel and Sebastian in the East End. Though originally he orders Agni to fight on the side of the Indian thugs (calling them his "brethren") against Sebastian, when he hears that Ciel did nothing to provoke the thugs, he switches sides for the sake of honor. After the fight, he follows Ciel back to the Phantomhive manor and proceeds to make himself at home. He claims that as an acquaintance of his, under the customs of his home country, Ciel is now required to entertain Soma as a guest.

name: Yoshikazu Miyano
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm

He's really sensitive about his girlish features, and he's a hardcore fudanshi.

name: Shuumei Sasaki
description:
__Height:__ 183 cm
__Likes:__ Sweets

Sasaki is [Miyano](https://anilist.co/character/164752/Miyano-Yoshikazu)'s senior in high school. He's a 'bad-boy' who doesn't cause much trouble. He got introduced to BL manga through Miyano.

name: Tasuku Kuresawa
description: Miyano's friend and classmate. Has a girlfriend from another school, and is a member of the astronomy club.

name: Jirou Ogasawara
description: [Sasaki](https://anilist.co/character/164753/Sasaki-Shuumei)'s classmate and friend, he's a bad boy. He shares the same music taste as Sasaki, has a girlfriend, wears an ear cuff, and has blue-dyed streaks in his hair.

name: Gonzaburou Tashiro
description: Miyano's friend and classmate. He has bleached hair before he entered school but it not allowed to bleach it again.

name: Taiga Hirano
description: __Height:__ 175 cm - 178 cm

name: Masato Hanzawa
description: He's president of the student council.

name: Kyouji Shirahama
description: Tashiro's friend since middle school. He plays on the same basketball team as Kagiura.

name: Nao Makimura
description: A former classmate from Miyano.

name: Satoko Sasaki
description: Shuumei's older sister.

name: Mio Chibana
description: Mio is a 20-year-old freeter. After his mother's death, he briefly moves to Okinawa, where he meets Shun. Initially offended at Shun's attitude, he soon falls in love and pursues him romantically when he returns to Okinawa. Mio attempts to get better understanding of Shun's concerns, despite Shun constantly dismissing his advances.

name: Shun Hashimoto
description:
Hashimoto Shun, a gay novelist in the making, lived on the island Okinawa with his family. On Okinawa, he met a boy named Chibana Mio, who later left to pursue his studies for three years. When he returned, he confessed his attraction to Shun and developed a relationship with him.

Originally from Hokkaido, he moved to Okinawa to live with his grandmother after his parents discovered his sexual orientation.

name: Sakurako
description: Sakurako is Shun's childhood friend who has known he was gay since high school. Through an arranged marriage, she was also Shun's fiancée until he came out to his parents during the wedding ceremony. Despite this, Sakurako is still in love with him.

name: Eri
description: Eri is a woman who previously lived with Shun and his grandmother in Okinawa before moving out to live with her girlfriend, Suzu.

name: Oba-chan
description: Shun's grandmother. He stays at her place.

name: Suzu
description: Eri's girlfriend.

name: Oochi Fukuchi
description: Oochi Fukuchi is the commander of the Hunting Dogs special units and has the ability Mirror Lion.

name: Saigiku Jouno
description: Saigiku Jouno is a member of the Hunting Dogs. He possesses the ability "Priceless Tears".

name: Minoura
description: Member of the Japanese Police Force. Successor of Yasui-san whom Ranpo had worked with previously on cases.

name: Utena Tenjou
description:
Utena is a tomboyish, courageous and naïve character who lives to emulate the idealized prince figure from her childhood. She is forthright, honest, and friendly, and nearly all the girls in school adore her.

__Anime TV Series:__

 

__The Adolescence of Utena:__

name: Anthy Himemiya
description:
__Height:__ 157 cm

A mysterious and shy dark-skinned girl whose sometimes vapid expression and superficial politeness seem to mask something deeper. Many people project their wants or desires onto her, and she's often the target of their eventual rage or hate. Her "doormat" behavior belies a far more complex personality.

Anthy appears to house the Sword of Dios within her own body. At the beginning of a duel, she slips into a trance and the Sword manifests, protruding from her chest so that her champion may draw it from her. This Sword is said to be a key to reaching the goal of Revolution, and in her position as the Rose Bride Anthy is said to be the key to obtaining it.






Anthy appears to be an Asian Indian, possibly Tamil. She is noticeably darker than the other characters and wears a bindi mark or jewel.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Akio Ootori
description: Anthy's older brother, the acting chairman of the academy. Although barely present in the first season of the show, he later plays a pivotal role in the second and third seasons. His given name derives from the Japanese name for Venus, the Morning Star, which is identified with Lucifer.

name: Chuchu
description: Anthy's pet (whom she will only refer to as friend, but may be more properly described as a familiar). He is a small marmoset who acts as comedic relief. However, he also acts as an omen of bad fortune in certain episodes.  ChuChu is drawn much furrier by Chiho Saito in the manga than he is drawn in the anime, the anime itself making him look more like a mouse than a monkey.    Source: Wikipedia

name: Miki Kaoru
description:
__Rose Color:__ Blue 
Rose Bride: Kozue Kaoru 
Sword: Épée 
Drive to Duel: To find "that which shines"
Miki is a highly skilled and polite seventh grader who befriends Utena, despite their role as possible opponents in the duels. A piano player par excellence, Miki has fond memories of playing songs with his twin sister Kozue in his childhood, but her refusal to play with him in the present — the symbol of a much deeper rift — gives Miki a sense of loss. His crush on Anthy in the anime (but on Utena in the manga) develops when he realizes that they remind him of his estranged sister. In both adaptions, his drive to duel stems from a desire to find something to replace Kozue in his affections. All the females of the school, even older ones, idolize him, but Kozue threatens any girls who attempt to get too close to him. Likewise he is very protective of her, and so she tries to make him jealous by dating as many boys as possible. He is a member of the Student Council, his position appearing to be the council secretary. He frequently appears with a stopwatch in hand. Miki is also a member of the fencing club.     (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Juri Arisugawa
description:
__Rose Color:__ Orange
__Rose Bride:__ Ruka Tsuchiya
__Sword:__ Rapier
__(Anime) Drive to Duel:__ To disprove the power of miracles

The captain of the academy's fencing team, Juri is one of Ohtori's most highly respected students, and even the teachers appear to be in awe of her.



(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Touga Kiryuu
description: President of the Student Council, Touga is an arrogant and handsome young man whose desire to be powerful drives him to cruel and unscrupulous deeds. Although he says that he wishes to be noble, he has little empathy towards anyone, and his powers of manipulation are second only to Akio. He also shares his playboy attiude and has many female conquests. He is a childhood friend of Saionji, although their relationship took a turn for the worse at a point in their childhood that is the centerpiece of their respective personal journeys.

name: Nanami Kiryuu
description:
__Rose Color:__ Yellow
__Rose Bride:__ [Touga Kiryuu](https://anilist.co/character/753/Kiryuu-Touga)
__Sword:__ Scimitar (main) and Dagger (as main-gauche)
__Drive to Duel:__ Her big brother's honor, her own self-worth, and validation of her relationship with Touga (Anime)

Touga's little sister, the prototypical "queen bee" of the school. She is very fond of him to the point of their relationship having semi-incestuous edge, at least on her part. Nanami often makes various malicious attacks on students she deems inferior (or worse, those she suspects Touga is paying attention to).

name: Kyouichi Saionji
description:
__Sword:__ Sword of Dios, Katana
__Drive to Duel:__ To find something eternal, to claim Anthy as his Rose Bride, and to finally defeat Touga (Anime)

Vice-president of the Student Council and captain of the kendo team, and is the first duelist Utena fights. He is temperamental, egotistic, prone to angry rages, often cruel, and extremely possessive of Anthy. His belief that they are destined to be together no matter what drive him to be physically violent towards her and continue to pursue her even after their engagement is broken. He and Touga practice kendo together, but Saionji is clearly very resentful of Touga, and especially cannot bear to be humiliated by him (a fact which Touga shamelessly exploits). Saionji is less perceptive, intelligent, and skilled as Touga, and despite his best efforts can never seem to best him. He is regardless affected by this estrangement from his childhood friend.

name: Kozue Kaoru
description:
She's Miki's twin sister who feels overshadowed by his talent and dirtied by comparison with him. Kozue resents Miki's affection for Anthy Himemiya and is prone to acting out to grab her brother's attention, most notably by exercising loose sexual morals. Like Nanami, Kozue also seems to have an extreme brother complex. She is very protective of Miki and is the reason that he does not have a girlfriend (despite the affection of many of his schoolmates). 
Kozue considers herself a "wild animal," wanting to be freed from adult rules and restrictions (in reality, she is resentful of her father remarrying).     

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Rick Gladiatol
native: リック・グラディアートル
description: At the age of 30, he left his job as a guild clerk to pursue his dream of becoming an adventurer. After undergoing two years of "terrifying beyond hellish training" from his seniors from the Orichalcum Fist party, the strongest on the continent, he showed remarkable growth. The days of continuous death and resurrection during training have left him deeply traumatized.

appearsIn.title: The Ossan Newbie Adventurer, Trained to Death by the Most Powerful Party, Became Invincible

name: Reanette Elfelt
native: リーネット・エルフェルト
description: Reanette is a dark elf and Rick's assistant and companion who once achieved the legendary 9999 consecutive victories in an underground arena. She now wears a maid outfit and takes care of all the housework for "Orichalcum Fist". She meets Rick through a certain incident and invites him to join her party.

appearsIn.title: The Ossan Newbie Adventurer, Trained to Death by the Most Powerful Party, Became Invincible

name: Broughston Ashorc
native: ブロストン・アッシュオーク
description: Broughston is a warrior-monk orc who became an adventurer, and is known as "The Sage Beast" because of his monstrous physique and intelligence. He currently leads "Orichalcum Fist," and Rick looks up to him as his mentor. Despite his gigantic size, he is skilled in support magic, including healing magic, and can even resurrect the dead if they have died shortly after.

appearsIn.title: The Ossan Newbie Adventurer, Trained to Death by the Most Powerful Party, Became Invincible

name: Mizett Eldwarf
native: ミゼット・エルドワーフ
description: The young-looking half-elf, half-dwarf, (but over 50 years of age). He continues to develop weapons that cannot be made with the scientific technology of this world, and people say that he has access to technology from 1000 years into the future, earning him the nickname "The Thousand-year Workshopper". He is an invincible womanizer.

appearsIn.title: The Ossan Newbie Adventurer, Trained to Death by the Most Powerful Party, Became Invincible

name: Alicerette Draqul
native: アリスレート・ドラクル
description: A pure-blooded vampire girl. Nicknamed the "The Demon Child of Devastation", she is the continent's strongest super-genius offensive magician. Rick has been killed numerous times during training while she innocently toys around, unleashing tremendous offensive magic that carves into mountains and the earth. She is a glutton, which is difficult to believe given her appearance.

appearsIn.title: The Ossan Newbie Adventurer, Trained to Death by the Most Powerful Party, Became Invincible

name: Kelvin Urwolf
native: ケルヴィン・ウルヴォルフ
description: He is the three-time champion of the Fist King Tournament. The stronger his opponent is, the better he feels, and he enjoys fighting more than anything else. He has a special ability to determine the strength of his opponents and the truthiness of their words with his keen sense of smell.

appearsIn.title: The Ossan Newbie Adventurer, Trained to Death by the Most Powerful Party, Became Invincible

name: Linx Laulot
native: リンクス・ローロット
description: A very kind-hearted B-rank adventurer. As a late bloomer who changed career at the age of 24, he is encouraged by Rick, who became an adventurer even later than him, at over 30 years old. He actively participates in work and events, and is well-liked by those around him.

appearsIn.title: The Ossan Newbie Adventurer, Trained to Death by the Most Powerful Party, Became Invincible

name: Snape Resurrect
native: スネイプ・リザレクト
description: A middle-aged guy, and Geese's older brother. He serves as the chairman of the Western League Steering Committee for the Fist King Tournament, and was once active as a boxer. In contrast to his younger brother Geese, he has a gentle demeanor, but there are constant rumors that he has connections to the underworld.

appearsIn.title: The Ossan Newbie Adventurer, Trained to Death by the Most Powerful Party, Became Invincible

name: Geese Resurrect
description: A giant-bodied guy who born with exceptional fighting ability and skill. He is a dangerous man with extreme mood swings who cannot be stopped once he goes on a rampage, gave even his brother Snape a lot of trouble.

appearsIn.title: The Ossan Newbie Adventurer, Trained to Death by the Most Powerful Party, Became Invincible

name: Angelica Diarmuit
native: アンジェリカ・ディルムット
description: She is the eldest daughter of the Duke of Diarmuid, a distinguished family that unites the noble people of the north, and a second-class knight in the Royal Knights. She is known as "Flash Angelica" for her high-speed combat skills using the strengthening magic "Shunkyaku". Although she can be a little harsh in her words, she is a hard worker and shows a caring side towards her siblings.

appearsIn.title: The Ossan Newbie Adventurer, Trained to Death by the Most Powerful Party, Became Invincible

name: Momoko Koigakubo
description: Momoko is a 6th grader and Satsuki's best friend. She seems to fear nothing, even in very dangerous situations, and is very brave when it comes to helping Satsuki and the gang confront the ghosts. She also seems to have a psychic connection with Satsuki's mother. In the Spanish Dub, she was named as "Nicole"

name: Reo Kakinoki
description: Reo is Hajime's friend and has a big obsession with paranormal themes, and proclaims himself as a respected paranormal researcher. However, whenever Reo finds a clue pertaining to the existence of supernatural entities, it seems that the clue turns against him. Like Hajime, he tries to be brave but is actually just a coward.

name: Hajime Aoyama
description: Hajime is Satsuki's neighbor. He is always strong and courageous to help defeat the ghosts, but though he says that this is very brave, he is actually a coward. Despite this, he is one of the most reliable of Satsuki's friends and has saved her on more than one occasion. Hajime also has a naughty habit of flipping girls' skirts, and his constant victim is no other than Satsuki. This results in frequent comic moments. Throughout the anime, it seems that Hajime and Satsuki develop mutual crushes on each other (not that they'd admit it).    (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Amanojaku
description: Amanojaku is a powerful entity that, long ago, was sealed by Satsuki's mother in a tree in the mountains, but was finally released from his magic prison due to urbanization. However, he did not have his freedom long, as Satsuki sealed him (by accident) in the body of her pet cat, Kaya. At first, Amanojaku is hostile toward the kids and takes great pleasure in seeing them in trouble, but throughout the series he develops somewhat of a care for them, especially for Satsuki and Keiichirou.

name: Satsuki Miyanoshita
description:
Satsuki is the main character of the show. She moves with her father and her young brother Keichirou to the hometown of her deceased mother, where she finds that her mother confronted several evil entities that haunted the town, which included Amanojaku, and wrote all her supernatural experiences in a diary, which is entitled "The Ghost Journal."

Satsuki is very strong, brave, and determined, but sometimes bit moody, mostly because of Hajime trying to see her underpants. In the Spanish Dub, she was named "Claire". Her nickname in the Animax dub is Suki.

name: Keiichirou Miyanoshita
description: Keiichirou is Satsuki's young brother. He is easily frightened by many things and is seen crying sometimes, but he shows courage where it counts to help in defeating the ghosts. He creates a special friendship with the ghost Amanojaku.

name: Kayako Miyanoshita
description: Kayako is Satsuki's and Keiichirou's deceased mother. Through her diary it is revealed that she was an avid exorcist during her childhood. She possesses Momoko two times throughout the series to aid Satsuki against the Piano Ghost and Kutabe and once helped Satsuki and the others to escape from a powerful haunting called Anamnaneki. Her maiden name was Kamiyama.    (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Shinobu Matsuda
description: Shinobu is, in the beginning, featured as one of Satsuki's classmates. She seems to know black magic, as she teaches it to the other girls of the class so they can grant their wishes. However, the spells are actually a trap for the girls to have their souls stolen by the darkness, and Shinobu in reality is the Avatar of an evil deity called Yamime. In the end Satsuki learns that Shinobu was once her mother's classmate who mysteriously disappeared. Possibly upon her "second death", she was forever engulfed by Yamime. She re-appears in the 20th episode.   (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Hanako
description: Hanako is the ghost of a little girl that haunts the ladies' restroom of the old school building. She appears to be harmless and has no intention to scare people, for she only wants to play and make friends. She appears mainly in the 2nd episode, trying to call for help when her lair is taken over by Akagami-Aogami, and makes several cameos in the other episodes.

name: Sakata
description: Sakata is the teacher of the class where Satsuki, Hajime and Reo attend. Despite he doesn't believe in ghosts, he suffered many supernatural issues, as he was possessed, cursed and kidnapped by ghosts a couple of times.    (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Senpai
description: Senpai is a high school girl who is a skilled magician when no one is watching. However, she easily gets stage fright, is very embarrassed and clumsy, and often blunders her magic tricks when even one person watches her perform.

name: Joshu
description: He is an underclassmen and a member of the Magic Club.

name: Saki-chan
description:
A third year who has transferred to Tanashi High School. She is a gal who is good at street performance.

An extreme brother complex who loves her younger brother Ma-kun.

name: Masashi
description: Masashi is a transfer student and Saki-chan's younger brother. He and his sister join the Magic Club.

name: Onee-chan
description: A teacher at Tanashi High School and a senior sister. She loves to make fun of her sister. She is also an assistant teacher and an advisor to the magic club.

name: Madara-san
description: President of the chemistry club. Madara is a very intelligent student but does not believe in magic.

name: Mimura
description: Tejina-senpai's older sister's husband.

name: Bard
description: A member of a bandit group who hijacked a train headed towards Central City so that he could trade the safety of the passengers on board - most notably General Haruko - for the freedom of his group's leader. Originally a member of the military, he desired an Automail arm to increase his power. This use of automail for unnecessary procedure was prohibited by the State, and Bald was discharged and became an outlaw, seeking revenge on the military that disbarred him. His automail arm includes two gun barrels and a small knife blade. While hijacking the train, Bald was confronted by Edward, who disabled his arm and defeated the bandits, an exploit which won him permission to take the State Alchemist entry exam. He would later resurface in "Curse of the Crimson Elixir" inside the sewers of Eastern City, and then "Stray Rondo" to repeat the same crime, only to be put in jail yet again both times by the Elrics.    In the manga, he's actually part of rebels who against Amestris, possibly from one of the southern bordering country which area had been taken by Amestris during the war.    In the anime, the event actually is part of a flashback to before Edward became a State Alchemist. Defeating Bald allows the Elrics to take the State Alchemist examination after a grateful Hakuro refers them. In the manga, Edward is already a State Alchemist (and fifteen years old) and returning from Lior.

name: Charlie
description:
The man who introduces himself as Charlie was an enlisted soldier under the command of the Flame Alchemist, Roy Mustang during the Ishval Civil War. When the long fighting finally ceased, Charlie brought it upon himself to speak to his distant commander and thank him for all the work he had done to keep all the men beneath him out of harm's way.

(Source: Fullmetal Alchemist Fandom)

name: Shinri
description: Truth is the most commonly used name for the mysterious and ethereal being that sits before The Gate and addresses alchemists who have stepped into God's domain through the use of alchemy. It appears as a pure white, nearly formless being almost indistinguishable from the rest of the endless white expanse which surrounds the Gate but for a shadowy outline which causes Truth to reflect the shape of the person it is talking to, thereby supporting its claim to be another shade of that very person. When Edward and Alphonse Elric each appeared before the Gate, Truth took on the shape of a young boy and when Izumi Curtis appeared, Truth's shape reflected that of a young woman, appeared as a vigorous man to Roy Mustang, and a white version of Father's flask form.    Truth initially introduces itself as the being some people call God, the World or the Universe, at first seeming welcoming and jovial to its guests before calling attention to their hubris and opening the Gate, which forces them inside. At this point, Truth often smiles with an eerily wide and insane grin that is similar to that of the Homunculus Gluttony and Father.   When the alchemist in question returns from his or her sojourn through the Gate, Truth informs them of the necessary toll for accessing the Universe's knowledge and collects it, usually in the form of a body part which disintegrates off the alchemist and reappears on Truth's form.

name: Gluttony
description: Gluttony is the second homunculus to appear in the series, typically being in the company of Lust. He is a large, simple-minded homunculus whose thoughts rarely stray far from eating. He has powerful jaws, acidic saliva, and can and will eat almost anything. He particularly likes eating people, and the only way he can find enjoyment in a battle is if he believes he can eat his opponent afterwards. A running gag in the manga and anime is asking Lust (or any other Homunculi) if he can eat someone. He apparently prefers girls (as in to eat) and also seems to share a bond with his partner Lust.     There is no significant information pertaining to his role in the 2003 anime series.     __In the manga and 2009 anime series;__  Gluttony is the sixth Homunculus created by Father...       (Taken in part from Wikia)

name: Bradley-fujin
description: Mrs. Bradley is the wife of the Fuhrer, King Bradley. A kind and trusting wife. Though she rarely appears in either series, usually accompanying Selim, Mrs. Bradley's appearances usually fall under the category of comic relief as she speaks jovially of her familial life and romantic past with the Fuhrer.

name: Izumi Curtis
description:
__Nationality:__ Amestrian

Izumi Curtis, born Izumi Harnet, the teacher of [Ed](https://anilist.co/character/11/Elric-Edward) and [Alphonse Elric](https://anilist.co/character/12/Elric-Alphonse), agreed to train the brothers to hone their alchemical abilities after their mother died. She expands their training with a regimen of philosophy, martial arts, and living off the land. Her methods are derived from her own alchemy training: in the manga and second anime, she was forced to survive in the northern region surrounding Briggs Fortress for a month (although it turns out she succeeded by stealing supplies from the northern fortress), whereas in the first anime she was taught by [Dante](https://anilist.co/character/18880/Dante).

She thinks of the Elrics as her own sons, and although she severs her student-teacher ties with them after learning of their attempts with human transmutation (and similarly Ed's joining the State Military), she continues to do all she can to help them. She can be quite violent when punishing or sparring with the Elric brothers, so they tend to be deathly afraid of her.

Her claim of "I'm a housewife!" while confronting [Greed](https://anilist.co/character/351/Greed) was a favorite scene of Arakawa's to draw.

Izumi and her husband [Sig Curtis](https://anilist.co/character/10972/Curtis-Sig) were expecting a child years before the start of the series; however, their son was stillborn.

name: Subaru Uchimaki
description: A second year middle school student, and a member of the art club.  He's the main character of this series, and has a few small problems. He is mostly dense with girls but has a very close relationship with Usami.

appearsIn.title: This Art Club Has a Problem!
This Art Club Has a Problem!

description:
A second year middle school student, and a member of the art club.  She's the heroine of the story, and has relatively fewer problems.
She tends to display a calm and outgoing expression but may turn violent at times.

appearsIn.title: This Art Club Has a Problem!
This Art Club Has a Problem!

name: Buchou
description: The president of the Art Club that the above two are members of. He's taller than the other two, but also has more problems.

appearsIn.title: This Art Club Has a Problem!
This Art Club Has a Problem!

name: Colette
description: An underclassman who is also a member of the art club. She moved to Japan with her parents for their careers and has been there for around 7 years. She got so used to living in Japan that she decided to continue living there even after her parents returned home.

appearsIn.title: This Art Club Has a Problem!
This Art Club Has a Problem!

name: Sayaka Honda
description: A second year middle school student and a member of the newspaper club. She is Mizuki's friend.

appearsIn.title: This Art Club Has a Problem!

description: A second year middle school student and Mizuki's friend.

appearsIn.title: This Art Club Has a Problem!
This Art Club Has a Problem!

description: A member of the school faculty, and current adviser of the newspaper club. He was also the previous adviser of the art club.

appearsIn.title: This Art Club Has a Problem!
This Art Club Has a Problem!

name: Maria Imari
description: Maria Imari is a really cheerful girl who really enjoys manga and anime. Is a second-year student of Tsukumori Middle School. She has Chuunibyou.

appearsIn.title: This Art Club Has a Problem!
This Art Club Has a Problem!

name: Shizuka
description: Moeka's mother.

appearsIn.title: This Art Club Has a Problem!

name: Kazunari Usa
description:
Usa Kazunari is a high school freshman whose parents had to move away for work. He agrees to stay anywhere, as long as he could live on his own in peace and quiet.
Having grown up surrounded by his parents' eccentric friends, Usa feels that unique individuals tend to gravitate to him resulting in what he considers a disastrous three years in middle school where he gained a reputation for handling odd people. Although he initially balks at the idea of rooming with dysfunctional people, he decides to stay at the Kawai Complex and quickly adjusts to its residents' behaviors.

His favorite dish is salisbury steak.

appearsIn.title: The Kawai Complex Guide to Manors and Hostel Behavior
The Kawai Complex Guide to Manors and Hostel Behavior

name: Ritsu Kawai
description: Ritsu is a 2nd year high school student who lives in the same dorm with Usa. She is a seemingly shy girl who likes to read books. Her grandfather is brother to landlady of their dorm who views Ritsu as her relative. She is trusted with looking after the dorm when landlady takes a leave. She keeps multiple weapons around the house and doesn't hesitate to use them if one of the guys crosses into girls side of the house.

appearsIn.title: The Kawai Complex Guide to Manors and Hostel Behavior
The Kawai Complex Guide to Manors and Hostel Behavior

name: Tagami
description: Usa's friend at school.

appearsIn.title: The Kawai Complex Guide to Manors and Hostel Behavior
The Kawai Complex Guide to Manors and Hostel Behavior

name: Sumiko Kawai
description:
The manager of Kawai Dormitory and the sister of Ritsu's grandfather. She interviews potential boarders first to determine background and compatibility with the current residents. Wanting to be a perfect side character in a romantic drama, she sometimes practices on Usa by giving observations and comments that are meant to be of no value. Rather insightful, she knows just when to serve a resident's favorite dish for dinner.

She keeps a doll collection in her room.

appearsIn.title: The Kawai Complex Guide to Manors and Hostel Behavior
The Kawai Complex Guide to Manors and Hostel Behavior

name: Houjou
description: Houjou is one of the first employees Usa meets at his summer part time job. Going by the name Yamamoto at work, he appears to have assumed the "apprentice" character rather seriously and uses lyrical, explanatory notations to emphasize his words.

appearsIn.title: The Kawai Complex Guide to Manors and Hostel Behavior
The Kawai Complex Guide to Manors and Hostel Behavior

name: Shizuru Shirosaki
description:
Usa's somewhat perverted author roommate. Known for being a masochist, he specializes in bondage and can tie complex knots that are difficult to undo. He is good at crafting which he usually employs to while away boredom or make Mayumi feel better. When outside, he is usually marched off to the police station for being a suspicious character.

Caught sticking his head through a hole in a fence that surrounded a grade school, he is the third resident that Usa meets.

appearsIn.title: The Kawai Complex Guide to Manors and Hostel Behavior
The Kawai Complex Guide to Manors and Hostel Behavior

name: Mayumi Nishikino
description:
An office lady who has terrible luck with men, she is the fourth resident that Usa meets. She is always spiteful to everyone, especially those who have found romance or are about to find romance. She tends to drink alcohol heavily when depressed and nags when drunk. She is always on the lookout for something to use against Sayaka and considers Miharu a boxful of Sayaka's weaknesses.

She is particularly fond of interfering with Usa and Ritsu's relationship. Though she often expresses displeasure at their budding romance, she seems to be happy for them in her own way.

appearsIn.title: The Kawai Complex Guide to Manors and Hostel Behavior
The Kawai Complex Guide to Manors and Hostel Behavior
