description: Sayaka's classmate back in middle school.

appearsIn.title: The Kawai Complex Guide to Manors and Hostel Behavior

name: Tae Shinohara
description: Sumiko's friend and Usa's employer at his summer part-time job.

appearsIn.title: The Kawai Complex Guide to Manors and Hostel Behavior

name: Hayashi
description: She is Usa's former middle school classmate from West Junior High, where she was one of the oddballs who was associated with Usa. She later on changes her looks and attitude upon attending high school.

appearsIn.title: The Kawai Complex Guide to Manors and Hostel Behavior

name: Conan Edogawa
description:
**Height:** 174 cm (as Shinichi)
 **Relatives:** [Yusaku Kudo](https://anilist.co/character/9177) (father) & [Yukiko Kudo](https://anilist.co/character/20372) (mother)

At the beginning of the series, Shinichi is a 17-year old student at Teitan High School. He is already well-known as a brilliant young detective, the "Savior of the police force", for solving many difficult cases that the professionals could not. However, while investigating 2 mysterious men, he is spotted and forced to swallow an experimental poison known as APTX 4869. This results in his body shrinking to that of a 6 year old.

Shinichi comes up with the alias Conan Edogawa after Arthur Conan Doyle and Edogawa Rampo and pretends to be a distant relative of [Agasa](https://anilist.co/character/4162/)'s who places Conan in [Ran](https://anilist.co/character/1748/)'s care. Ran's father [Kogoro Mouri](https://anilist.co/character/1746/), owns a Detective Agency which Conan uses to his advantage to discover cases involving the Black Organization.

As Conan, Shinichi helps Ran's father solve cases by putting him to sleep and simulating Kogoro's voice using the special bowtie gadget Professor Agasa made for him. By solving cases one after the other, he helps build up Kogoro's reputation who will later on be referred to as "Sleeping Kogoro". He also spends a good amount of time with his Detective Boys fellows and solves many small cases with them and sometimes in the company of Professor Agasa.

name: Kogorou Mouri
description:
Kogoro is a private investigator, but he prefers to laze around his office all day unless his client is a beautiful woman. Kogoro attended Teitan High School, the same high school as his daughter [Ran Mouri](https://anilist.co/character/1748/Ran-Mouri) and [Shinichi Kudo](https://anilist.co/character/1742/Conan-Edogawa) , along with [Eri Kisaki](https://anilist.co/character/1744/Eri-Kisaki) _(his future wife)_, [Yukiko Fujimine](https://anilist.co/character/20372/Yukiko-Kudo), and through kindergarten to middle school attended the same schools as the actress Ruri Ujo and Eri. He then graduated from Beika University, where he was the ace of the judo team, though he was highly vulnerable to stage fright.

Some time after graduating, Kogoro became a police officer, working in the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Division One with [Inspector Megure](https://anilist.co/character/4253/Juzo-Megure), but while an excellent marksman he was not a particularly good investigator. According to [Ninzaburo Shiratori](https://anilist.co/character/9180/Ninzaburo-Shiratori) in [Movie 2](https://anilist.co/anime/780/Meitantei-Conan-Juuyonbanme-no-Target/), however, the duo were famous for the way they apprehended criminals. He also worked for some time under Inspector Yuminaga in the arson division.

name: Ran Mouri
description:
A childhood friend of [Shinichi Kudo](https://anilist.co/character/1742); daughter of [Kogoro Mouri](https://anilist.co/character/1746), a private detective, and [Eri Kisaki](https://anilist.co/character/1744), a lawyer. Her parents got separated when she was seven, and one of her biggest goals is to get them back together. Her best friend next to Shinichi is her classmate [Suzuki Sonoko](https://anilist.co/character/1749), who constantly teases her about her relationship with Shinichi.

After Shinichi's disappearance, Ran met [Edogawa Conan](https://anilist.co/character/1742), who was introduced by [Professor Agasa](https://anilist.co/character/4162) as a "distant relative" and asked Ran if she wouldn't mind taking care of him at her house. She and her father practically adopted him; Ran immediately came to think of him as a surrogate little brother. Little did (and still does) Ran know that "Conan" is actually Shinichi.

Ran's greatest personality trait is that she genuinely cares for those she loves. She is also patient, kind, and nurturing. Like Shinichi, she highly values justice to the point of idealism. To avoid making Shinichi choose between her and his important case (really an excuse because Shinichi has turned into Conan and can't return), she has decided to wait for him to finish it, trusting his promise that he will come back despite their separation causing Ran a lot of emotional pain.

name: Hiroshi Agasa
description:
Hiroshi Agasa is an inventor and Shinichi's next-door neighbor. He makes his living with a wide number of patents and inventions, including video games _(of which the Detective Boys are enthusiastic test players)._ While many of his inventions are useless or have even damaged his in-house research laboratory, Agasa has been successful enough to live in a large house and even rebuild it when necessary. He has been a friend of Shinichi and [Ran](https://anilist.co/character/1748/Ran-Mouri) since their childhood years. 
After Shinichi was shrunk by the APTX 4869, the first person he met and entrusted himself to was Agasa. After having been convinced that the little boy was Shinichi, Agasa was also the first one to advise Shinichi to exercise caution in his pursuit of the Black Organization. He also helped Shinichi in establishing his new identity as [Conan Edogawa,](https://anilist.co/character/1742/Conan-Edogawa) including constructing several gadgets which help Shinichi in carrying on his detective work surreptitiously. In order to perfect Conan's cover, he also enrolled him in Teitan Elementary and thus came to know the children who would form the Detective Boys. When Shiho Miyano fled the clutches of the Black Organization, she fled to Shinichi's house but collapsed from exhaustion near Agasa's doorstep.

name: Eri Kisaki
description:
__Relatives:__ [Kogoro Mouri](https://anilist.co/character/1746/Kogoro-Mouri) (husband), [Ran Mouri](https://anilist.co/character/1748/Ran-Mouri) (daughter), Mr. Kisaki (father)
__Occupation:__ Lawyer

Her real name is Eri Mouri. She began to use her maiden name again after she began living separately from her husband Kogoro Mouri. She also runs her law practice under her maiden name. In a recent hospitalization, her name was displayed as "Eri Mouri" on the door. She has one daughter, Ran Mouri. Eri has advanced skills in Judo, taught to her by Kogoro. 

The separately-living wife of Kogoro Mouri, Eri is a lawyer who often gets tangled in Kogoro's cases, usually serving as an extra pair of eyes when it becomes time to investigate a crime. Although she does not like Kogoro's attitude and personality _(especially his drinking and skirt-chasing habits),_ she still deeply loves and cares for him, often testing him to see if he still cares about her as well. 

Her personality suits her occupation as a lawyer. She is often very questioning, and gets herself involved in the investigation of cases along with Kogoro, much to his chagrin. She has a cat, a Russian Blue named "Goro," whom she cares for very deeply; in fact, Goro's name comes from "KoGORO" of Kogoro Mouri, since to her the cat and Kogoro both act very similar in some ways. Eri is also very close friends with her secretary, [Midori Kuriyama.](https://anilist.co/character/30371/Midori-Kuriyama)

name: Heiji Hattori
description:
Heiji is a high school detective, and the son of [Heizo Hattori,](https://anilist.co/character/30367/Heizo-Hattori) chief of the Osaka Police Department, and his wife [Shizuka Hattori.](https://anilist.co/character/41038/Shizuka-Hattori) Heiji wants to be a detective like his father since spending his childhood looking for lost cats in his neighborhood, and he is also very skilled in kendo and has become a favored tournament contender for his school. 

At one time during their childhood, Heiji had had the unfortunate idea of locking himself and his friend [Kazuha](https://anilist.co/character/3198/Kazuha-Toyama) together with a set of old handcuffs which had no key to unlock it; as a result they involuntarily had to spend time together even on some rather intimate occasions _(i.e., bathroom visits)_ before the cuffs could be removed. As a reminder of this 'closeness' and for good luck, Kazuha fashioned two identical lucky charms, each incorporating a chain link from the cuffs, which she and Heiji have been wearing ever since.

In the news, Heiji has been publicly declared the "Great Detective of the West", while [Shinichi Kudo](https://anilist.co/character/1742/Conan-Edogawa) is the "Great Detective of the East". As a result, Heiji showed up unannounced at the Mouri Detective Agency looking for Kudo, seeking to challenge his rival to a showdown of wits.

name: Kaito Kuroba
description:
The Phantom Thief Kid or The Magician Under the Moonlight (Kaito Kid) is a world-renowned thief who steals treasures and gems. He is sometimes known as Kaito Kid or 'International Criminal 1412'.

Despite the fact that [Shinichi](https://anilist.co/character/1742/Edogawa-Conan) (Conan) does not care much about investigating thefts, Kid can be considered his archnemesis, as he is the one criminal (besides some members of the Black O) he can not seem to catch.

Curiously, Kaito discovers Conan's true identity (non-canon, movies only), but keeps his secret, and sometimes Conan can even count on Kid's help to solve some of his cases. However, not even Kudo Shinichi knows about Kid's true identity.

Throughout the story, Kaito Kid and Conan have crossed paths but he has always managed to escape from Conan's clutches by his special skills.

name: Sonoko Suzuki
description:
Sonoko is [Ran Mouri's](https://anilist.co/character/1748/Ran-Mouri) best friend and is the girlfriend of [Makoto Kyogoku,](https://anilist.co/character/30368/Makoto-Kyogoku) with whom she currently is in a long-distance relationship. [Conan Edogawa](https://anilist.co/character/1742/Conan-Edogawa) sometimes has to knock her out with his stun gun watch to use her as his mouthpiece. Because of this, Sonoko has claimed to be a great high school detective in her own right, "Deduction Queen Sonoko". 

Sonoko Suzuki is the second daughter of [Shiro Suzuki,](https://anilist.co/character/50609/Shiro-Suzuki) head of the extremely wealthy family and large company, second only to [Renya Karasuma,](https://anilist.co/character/130839/Renya-Karasuma) and his wife [Tomoko.](https://anilist.co/character/130107/Tomoko-Suzuki) She has an older sister, [Ayako,](https://anilist.co/character/35748/Ayako-Suzuki) and an uncle, [Jirokichi,](https://anilist.co/character/30357/Jirokichi-Suzuki) who is often involved in trying to capture [Kaitou Kid.](https://anilist.co/character/1747/Kaito-Kuroba) She and Ran have been close friends since kindergarten. 

Her primary character traits are her impulsiveness, her temper and sense for romanticism. She often acts without thinking ahead, thereby usually dragging Ran _(and by extension, Conan)_ into her schemes or firing her mouth away with wild tales.

name: Kazuha Tooyama
description: [Heiji Hattori](https://anilist.co/character/1745/Heiji-Hattori) and Kazuha Toyama grew up together and are easily each other's best friend and mutual love interest. They have gone at the same school since they were in pre-school. Neither of them have been shown to have other close friendships outside of their relationships with [Shinichi](https://anilist.co/character/1742/Conan-Edogawa) and [Ran,](https://anilist.co/character/1748/Ran-Mouri) though Heiji does have a rivalry with fellow kendo practitioner [Okita.](https://anilist.co/character/128448/Soushi-Okita) They often spend time together, and Kazuha typically comes along when Heiji visits the Mouri's or vice versa, and is usually getting caught up with Heiji in criminal investigations. Kazuha and Heiji both wear twin good-luck charms that Kazuha made with pieces of the handcuff chain that stuck them together temporarily as children. Kazuha and Heiji have both shown jealousy when the other appears interested in someone else, even though they're not officially in a romantic relationship. Although, all their Jr. High School and High School classmates have commented that they're a couple. Their parents have known each other before they were even born. Making their families close.

name: Eliaria Jamil
native: エリアリア・ジャミール
description:
Heir to the Jamil dukedom, Eliaria is an 11-year-old girl who becomes Ryoma's close friend. Like Ryoma, she is a monster tamer and her body is gifted with large magic potential, but has difficulty controlling it, until Ryoma teaches her how to train herself properly.

(Source: Wikipedia)

appearsIn.title: By the Grace of the Gods
By the Grace of the Gods

name: Ryouma Takebayashi
native: リョウマ・タケバヤシ
description:
The main protagonist who lived an uneventful life as an office worker in Japan before dying in his sleep. Due to his diligent and kind behavior, he earns the grace of the gods who send him to another world as an 8-year-old boy where he lives in a forest for three years while polishing his skills and taming hundreds of slimes, making use of their multiple abilities in various tasks from combat and hunting to cleaning and crafting, until meeting the Jamil family who warmly welcomes him among them. Determined to live independently, he refuses to overindulge on their hospitality and looks for ways to make ends meet by himself.

(Source: Wikipedia)

By the Grace of the Gods

description: Employee of Bamboo Forest. Twin of [Callum](https://anilist.co/character/197884)

description: Captain of the soft tennis club, he was the only one on the team who earnestly tried to play in matches until he recruited Maki to be his partner.

name: Maki Katsuragi
description:
A transfer student, as well as a part-time worker, and the son of Aya Katsuragi and the latter’s ex-husband, Kenji Kyobate. Despite having no past experience in soft tennis, he joins the Shijo Minami Junior High boys’ soft tennis club and is quickly discovered to have a natural talent for the sport. He plays as the front player with Toma Shinjo as his partner. 

(Source: Stars Align Wiki)

name: Yuuta Asuka
description:
Manager of the boys’ soft tennis club. They are the younger sibling of Izumi and Hikari Asuka. 


(Source: Stars Align Wiki)

name: Taiyou Ishigami
description: Taiyu Ishigami is a clumsy boy with a shy personality who plays tennis to deal with anxiety. He can't decide anything by himself.

name: Haru Yoshioka
description: A quiet, shy, and unassuming high school student who has a long-suppressed ability to talk to cats. [From Wikipedia]

name: Hiromi
description: Haru’s best friend who, unlike Haru, seems to have things pretty planned out.

name: Toto
description: A statue of a raven who comes alive, much like the Baron. Though friends with Muta, he enjoys making cynical comments at the latter's expense.

name: Lune
description: Prince of the Cat Kingdom and, he is the entire opposite of his father, The Cat King. He is unaware of the schemings of his father; when he discovers his father's plan, he steps in to save the day.

name: Yuki
description: A beautiful white servant cat of the Cat Kingdom.

name: Naoko Yoshioka
description: She is the mother of Haru.

name: Neko Ou
description: The Cat King is fat and deranged and is instantly devoted to Haru and quickly becomes over-protective of her and refuses to listen to her protests at marrying Lune. When she tries to escape he gives chase, seemingly oblivious to her unwillingness to go through with the wedding.

name: Natoru
description: A determined cat who is endlessly running after Haru, he is a high-standing servant of the King and is blissfully ignorant of the havoc he wreaks in kidnapping Haru. He is a classic lackey and yes-man.  (In the original and most other dubs, Natoru has a distinct female voice.)

name: Natori
description: The Cat King's elderly and extremely loyal adviser, he is not entirely trustful of the King's arranged marriage and does his best to quietly stop it. Unfortunately, Natoru is constantly getting under foot and ruining his plans.

name: Aurora Suya Rhys Kaymin
native: オーロラ・栖夜・リース・カイミーン
description: The princess of the human kingdom. Kidnapped by the [Demon King](https://anilist.co/character/181143/Maou-Tasogare), she spends her days waiting for the heroes to rescue her. At least, that's how it was supposed to be...

appearsIn.title: Sleepy Princess in the Demon Castle
Sleepy Princess in the Demon Castle

name: Maou Tasogare
description: He kidnapped [Syalis](https://anilist.co/character/129563/Kaymin-Aurora-Suya-Rhys) in her sleep, so he has hardly ever seen her awake and has never had a proper conversation with her. He is always thinking of ways to make the hero get to him and gets worried if he is going to lose, he even puts weapons and tools to make the hero's quest easier. Apart from that he is a good leader for the demons of the castle, but even he can't go against Princess Syalis, and is shown to care for her to a certain point.

appearsIn.title: Sleepy Princess in the Demon Castle
Sleepy Princess in the Demon Castle

name: Harpy
description:
Having observed the daily lives of humans for such a long time as part of her duties, this soft, feathery demon girl longs for a human friend. She has great expectations of the Princess Syalis, the first human girl she has ever spoken with.

(Source: Sleepy Princess Wiki)

appearsIn.title: Sleepy Princess in the Demon Castle
Sleepy Princess in the Demon Castle

name: Yashiki Teshita Goblin
description:
The Castle Grunt Goblin believes himself to be the commonest of commoners. He hardly ever causes any trouble, but he often falls victim to the princess' schemes along with Quilladillo and Minotaur.

(Source: Sleepy Princess Wiki)

appearsIn.title: Sleepy Princess in the Demon Castle

name: SAI Nanami
description:
__Height:__ 181 cm

Sai Nanami is the son of the owner of Nanami Conglomerate and the older brother of [Ryusui Nanami](https://anilist.co/character/145097/Nanami-Ryuusui). While he is a prodigy in mathematics and is said to be "a million times" better than the average person (according to Ryusui), Sai's passion lies in coding, and he claims himself to be a programmer rather than a mathematician.

name: Nephelia
description: A beautiful elf [Zagan](https://anilist.co/character/181709/Zagan) bought for one million gold coins. She is wary of him at first but later on feels comfortable by his side, and is able to understand him despite when he cant properly express his feelings.

appearsIn.title: An Archdemon's Dilemma: How to Love Your Elf Bride
An Archdemon's Dilemma: How to Love Your Elf Bride

name: Zagan
description: A young but powerful mage who is one of the candidates to be a "demon lord." He is a handsome eighteen-year-old, that later on buys an elf slave due to falling in love with her at first sight.

appearsIn.title: An Archdemon's Dilemma: How to Love Your Elf Bride
An Archdemon's Dilemma: How to Love Your Elf Bride

name: Manuela
description: A clerk at the store where Nephelia and Zagan buy clothes. She has an easygoing personality.

appearsIn.title: An Archdemon's Dilemma: How to Love Your Elf Bride
An Archdemon's Dilemma: How to Love Your Elf Bride

native: シャスティル・リルクヴィスト
description: A woman who is a member of the Angelic Knights, a force of the Chivalric Order that dispenses justice against sorcerers in the name of God.

appearsIn.title: An Archdemon's Dilemma: How to Love Your Elf Bride
An Archdemon's Dilemma: How to Love Your Elf Bride

name: Barbatos
description: Zagan's partner in crime, that is to say, his only friend. He is also as powerful or even more than Zagan. He too is a candidate of becoming a demon lord.

appearsIn.title: An Archdemon's Dilemma: How to Love Your Elf Bride
An Archdemon's Dilemma: How to Love Your Elf Bride

name: Valefor
description: A young dragon who attacked Zagan to steal his powers because she desires strength.

appearsIn.title: An Archdemon's Dilemma: How to Love Your Elf Bride
An Archdemon's Dilemma: How to Love Your Elf Bride

name: Albert Hawke
description: He is the commander of the Knights of the Third Order. He is nicknamed the "Ice Knight" for his frigid demeanor. He became an ally of Sei Takanashi after she saved him from a mortal wound.

appearsIn.title: The Saint's Magic Power is Omnipotent

name: Johan Valdec
native: ヨハン・ヴァルデック
description: He is the director of a medicinal plants institute and the second son of Count Valdec.

appearsIn.title: The Saint's Magic Power is Omnipotent

name: Yuri Drewes
description: He is the grand magus of the Royal Magi Assembly. His only interest is in research related to magic and magical powers. He looks cheerful and passionate on the outside, but on the inside, he is a completely different man.

appearsIn.title: The Saint's Magic Power is Omnipotent

name: Sei Takanashi
description: Sei Takanashi is an office lady in her twenties who was summoned by the Saint Summoning Ritual. Her saintly powers enhance her abilities by fifty percent, due to her appearance she was not crowned as Saint. Accidentally making scenes with her research, she is on the verge of being found out as the saint. But after seeing her abilities she was finally been recognized as the Saint. She Likes to cook and make cosmetics in her spare time.

appearsIn.title: The Saint's Magic Power is Omnipotent

name: Jude
description: He is a researcher at the same institute for medicinal plants as Johan Valdec and is responsible for teaching Sei Takanashi.

appearsIn.title: The Saint's Magic Power is Omnipotent

name: Elizabeth Ashley
native: エリザベス・アシュレイ
description: She's marquis Ashley's daughter and the first prince's fiancee.

appearsIn.title: The Saint's Magic Power is Omnipotent

name: Leonhard
description: Leonhard is Corinna's grandson and the captain of a mercenary unit tasked with eliminating miasma and monster threats in Lord Klausner's domain. He is frequently admonished by his grandmother for his blunt manner of speaking.

appearsIn.title: The Saint's Magic Power is Omnipotent

name: Siegfried Slantania
native: ジークフリート・スランタニア
description: He's the king.

appearsIn.title: The Saint's Magic Power is Omnipotent

name: Corinna
description: A very experienced alchemist in charge of making potions for Klausner's Domain. She shows Sei the only known diary of a previous Saint to help her learn how to activate and use her "Saint's Magic". She frequently admonishes Leo, her grandson, for his blunt manner of speaking and lack of tact.

appearsIn.title: The Saint's Magic Power is Omnipotent

name: Rein Slantania
native: レイン・スランタニア
description: Rayne is the second prince of Slantania and the younger brother to Kyle.

appearsIn.title: The Saint's Magic Power is Omnipotent

name: Tenshu
description:
The owner of Western Restaurant Nekoya, a historic restaurant in the basement of a multi-tenant building in one corner of a shopping district. He inherited the restaurant from his father ten years ago. He is skilled at cooking not only Western cuisine, but Japanese, Chinese, and even desserts, among many other dishes.

(Source: Official Site)

name: Aletta
description:
A young demon girl who found Western Restaurant Nekoya while jobless and down on her luck, and ended up being hired there. Through the people she’s met at Nekoya, she’s found some job leads back in her own world, as well. She always looks forward to eating the master’s cooking on meal breaks.

(Source: Official Site)

name: Kuro
description:
The avatar of a black dragon who, like Aletta, works at Western Restaurant Nekoya. When she comes to the restaurant, she takes the form of an elf girl and uses her power of telepathy to speak to others. She has a bit of an obsession with chicken curry.

(Source: Official Site)

name: Victoria Samanark
native: ヴィクトリア・サマナーク
description:
The elder sister of the duke, and a brilliant sorcerer. Both her parents were human, but she was born a half-elf and chose the path of a sorcerer. Her favorite is pudding a la mode.

(Source: Official Site

name: Fardania
description:
An elven culinary researcher. She won't eat any foods that contain animal products. Inspired by Nekoya's cuisine, she travels around the world learning all she can about cooking. Her favorite is tofu steak.

(Source: Official Site)

name: Adelheid
description:
The first princess of the empire. While on sick leave at the palace villa, she began visiting Nekoya regularly and began to gradually recover. Her favorite is chocolate parfaits.

(Source: Official Site)

name: Sirius Alfied
native: シリウス・アルフェイド
description:
The heir to the Alfade Company. His grandfather Thomas, the former head of the company, introduced him to Nekoya. His favorite is meat sauce, but he struggles to replicate it.

(Source: Official Site)

name: Roukei
description: A young fisherman. He was caught in a storm at sea and was on the brink of drowning before the mermaid, Arte, saved his life.

name: Aka no Jou
description: A majestic scarlet red dragon goddess and a regular at Nekoya. She is always seen visiting Nekoya during closing hour when it is empty to order her favorite food, beef stew. She considers Nekoya and all the staff there to be a part of her clan and will protect them from all harm.

name: Yumeko Suzukiri
description: She is a Ranger and a member of Yellow Battalion, with the rank of Junior First Class.

name: Red Keeper
description: The leader of the Dragon Keepers and commander of the Red Battalion.

name: Blue Keeper
description: The Blue Keeper and commander of the Blue Battalion. Originally in a gang to raise money for an orphanage, he joined the rangers after Akabane blackmails him between jail.

name: Yellow Keeper
native: イエロー キーパー
description: One of the five Dragon Keepers and the leader of the Yellow Battalion.

name: Green Keeper
description: One of the five Dragon Keepers and the leader of the Green Battalion.

name: Kanon Hisui
description: Kanon Hisui is a Ranger and a member of Green Battalion, with the rank of Junior First Class.

name: Pink Keeper
description: The Pink Keeper and commander of the Pink Battalion who's also Hibiki's older sister, whom she obsesses over.

name: Kai Shion
description: Kai Shion is an Independent Ranger currently taking the Bailong Exam.

name: Nako Oshimizu
description:
**Height:** 168 cm (5'6") 

Nako is a cleaning maid and waitress working part-time at Kissuisō. She has a shy and timid personality, with a tendency to avoid unwanted social interaction. She is, however, confident about her swimming ability, having been swimming since she was three, she was nick named the "Kappa Girl". She attends the same high school as [Ohana](), [Minko](https://anilist.co/character/37212/Minko-Tsurugi) and [Yuina](https://anilist.co/character/39194/Yuina-Wakura).

name: Ohana Matsumae
description:
**Height:** 160 cm

She is an energetic and mostly optimistic school girl. She was born in Tokyo, but is sent to live at her grandmother's inn, Kissuisō, when her mother elopes with her boyfriend to avoid debt. At her grandmother's request, she works at the inn as compensation for her residency. Before she leaves, her best friend, [Kouichi Tanemura](https://anilist.co/character/39195/Kouichi-Tanemura), confesses to her. However, he runs off before she can answer him. Ohana now feels awkward whenever she thinks about him. Her desire to help others usually backfires or goes unappreciated. As a result of her mother's poor parenting, she became independent at a young age and grew up with the mentality of relying on herself only. However, since she was working at Kissuisō, she has realized how tough it is to go through life alone and begins to rely on others. She goes to the same high school as [Minko](https://anilist.co/character/37212/Minko-Tsurugi), [Nako](https://anilist.co/character/37215/Nako-Oshimizu), and [Yuina](https://anilist.co/character/39194/Yuina-Wakura).

name: Minko Tsurugi
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm (5'5")

Minko is an apprentice chef and resident at Kissuisō. She has a very cold demeanor, often telling [Ohana](https://anilist.co/character/36184/Ohana-Matsumae) to 'die' following their first encounter, though when this is considered too harsh by [Ohana](https://anilist.co/character/36184/Ohana-Matsumae), she settles for calling her a balut instead. Though she is hard working, she becomes passive when being scolded for her mistakes and is usually victim to [Ohana](https://anilist.co/character/36184/Ohana-Matsumae)'s mishaps. She displays great jealousy when [Ohana](https://anilist.co/character/36184/Ohana-Matsumae) is praised by other staff. She attends the same high school as [Ohana](https://anilist.co/character/36184/Ohana-Matsumae), [Nako](https://anilist.co/character/37215/Nako-Oshimizu) and [Yuina](https://anilist.co/character/39194/Yuina-Wakura)   

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Tomoe Wajima
description: Senior serving attendant at Kissuisō who likes to gossip.  Tends to be jealous of any younger girls/woman that have a boyfriend.

name: Tomoya Oshimizu
description: Nako's younger brother.

name: Mrs. Tachibana
description: Appears in episode 6.

name: Mana Oshimizu
description: Nako's younger sister.

name: Satsuki Matsumae
description: Ohana's mother, who works as a professional writer.   Satsuki is seen on bad terms with her own mother, calling her "the mother I've always hated".      Due to her boyfriend writing her name on his papers, the debt he falls into forces Satsuki to make a moonlight escape from her normal life. As a result, Ohana is sent to her grandmother's inn due to the not-so-motherly nature of Satsuki.  She has a surprisingly infamous reputation at the Inn, being the first topic at hand when staff members talk to Ohana for the first time.

name: Renji Togashi
description: Renji Togashi is 42 year old chef working at Kissuiso inn. He is Tohru's mentor and the Head chef. He gets nervous under pressure but is mostly calm and stern. He has an unusual taste in clothes.

name: Ayato Yorita
description: A student at Chidori High and a close friend of [Rintarou's](https://anilist.co/character/268677/Rintarou-Tsumugi), along with [Saku](https://anilist.co/character/272241/Saku-Natsusawa) and [Shohei](https://anilist.co/character/272240/Shohei-Usami). Ayato is rather friendly, and while he prefers to avoid situations involving violence, he is highly capable of defending himself and will readily fight should his friends be threatened.

appearsIn.title: The Fragrant Flower Blooms With Dignity

name: Kousuke Waguri
description: [Kaoruko](https://anilist.co/character/268676/Kaoruko-Waguri)'s brother.

appearsIn.title: The Fragrant Flower Blooms With Dignity

name: Hiyori Moritani
description: One of Haruka and Manabe's classmates. Unlike Haruka, Hiyori is a social girl. She's set to inherit her family's dojo, but she's not very enthusiastic about the idea. She has a crush on Manabe, so she tends to lash out at Haruka for getting his attention. She's also a bit of a tsundere.

appearsIn.title: The Troubled Life of Miss Kotoura

name: Haruka Kotoura
description: A girl with the power to read minds. Her power has caused her harsh experiences since she was a child, so she's closed off her heart to others. But the truth is that she's still just a normal, weak girl who longs to be with someone. Her heart begins to open after her encounter with [Manabe](https://anilist.co/character/73021/Manabe-Yoshihisa) and the others. Even though she can read minds, she's not used to experiencing sexual thoughts, so she's always getting flustered by Manabe.

appearsIn.title: The Troubled Life of Miss Kotoura

name: Yuriko Mifune
description: The president of the ESP Research Club. Her mother was a clairvoyant similar to Haruka, who would often assist in police investigations. However, she was accused of being a fake and hung herself, bringing shame to her family and horrifying Yuriko who believed in her. Ever since, Yuriko has been keen to prove the existence of psychics, finally having the answer in Haruka. At first she plans to use Haruka  for her fortune telling schemes, until Haruka got bullied and blame herself for Haruka's demise.

appearsIn.title: The Troubled Life of Miss Kotoura

name: Yoshihisa Manabe
description: A healthy young, high school boy who always has sex on the brain. Despite his loose appearance, he's a handsome man who hates twisted things. He's also generous, and doesn't mind Haruka's power at all. Though he does tease Haruka with his sexual fantasies, his love for her is clear and true, and he treasures her more than anyone.  (Source: ANN)

appearsIn.title: The Troubled Life of Miss Kotoura

name: Daichi Muroto
description: Daichi is the childhood friend of [Yuriko](https://anilist.co/character/73023/Mifune-Yuriko). When around the club members of ESP Research Club, he has a laid-back appearance and is usually seen reading a book. When he is alone with Yuriko, he tends to be more serious, and his eyes are visible.

appearsIn.title: The Troubled Life of Miss Kotoura

name: Gantetsu Ishiyama
description: A police detective. He appears to be familiar with the events that occurred surrounding Yuriko's mother, although he himself is skeptic of supernatural abilities.

appearsIn.title: The Troubled Life of Miss Kotoura

name: Zenzou Kotoura
description: Haruka's apparently wealthy grandfather. One of the few people to stick by her after Kumiko disowned her. He is slightly perverted, having dirty thoughts about his kinship with Haruka.

appearsIn.title: The Troubled Life of Miss Kotoura

name: Aki Tsukino
description: Ishiyama's detective partner who is a bit clumsy and usually hungry.

appearsIn.title: The Troubled Life of Miss Kotoura

name: Oshou
description: A monk who is a family friend at a shrine temple in Haruka's hometown. His encounter with Haruka has led to him taken an interest in esper abilities.

appearsIn.title: The Troubled Life of Miss Kotoura

name: Yuu
description: She was a kindergarten playmate of Kotoura Haruka.

appearsIn.title: The Troubled Life of Miss Kotoura

name: Shizuka Kagamihara
description: The mother of Nadeshiko and Sakura Kagamihara.

name: Hajime Shinshiro
aliases: リンの祖父 (Rin no Sofu; Rin's Grandfather)
description: Rin's grandfather, who passed his passion for camping on to his granddaughter.

name: Iku Sutou
description:
__Type:__ Masochist
__Occupations:__ First-Year High School Student, Baseball Club Member
__Debut:__ Chapter 33

**Girlfriend No. 009**

Iku loves baseball, to the point of spending hours recruiting for her team when it's on the verge of being disbanded. She is determined to do her best no matter what; because of this she's described as the embodiment of "stoicism" by Rentarou. Iku is also wildly masochistic, going so far as to train for hours until her body is in agony so she can enjoy the pain.

appearsIn.title: The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, REALLY Love You Season 2
The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, Really Love You

name: Mimimi Utsukushisugi
description:
__Type:__ Narcissist
__Occupation:__ Second-Year High School Student
__Debut:__ Chapter 39  

**Girlfriend No. 010**

Mimimi is very haughty and narcissistic, constantly complimenting herself and talking about her beauty. Despite her appearance of a naturally-beautiful rich girl, Mimimi actually works incredibly hard to provide for herself and keep herself beautiful. She works for herself to earn money, is frugal where appropriate so she can afford expensive, gorgeous clothing, and puts significant effort into her appearance. Though she puts a lot of value on outward appearances, Mimimi also recognizes inner beauty when she sees it.

appearsIn.title: The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, REALLY Love You Season 2

name: Meme Kakure
description:
**Type:** Self-Conscious 
**Occupation:** First-Year High School Student
**Debut:** Chapter 45

**Girlfriend No. 011**

Meme is extremely shy, to the point of wearing masks to hide her face in order to avoid drawing attention to herself. She strives to keep her face hidden no matter what. Meme also enjoys knitting, and spends time knitting a lot of little stuffed animals. She uses these stuffed animals for "misdirection", in which she runs away quickly and leaves a stuffed animal as a distraction so no one sees where she went. Meme wears a modest turtleneck beneath her school blazer, and dark pantyhose. She also wears a minimizing bra to conceal the size of her chest.

appearsIn.title: The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, REALLY Love You Season 2

name: Kamikaze
aliases: Earth's Strongest Swordmaster (地球最強の剣聖)
description:
__Race:__ Human
__Abilities:__ Superhuman Physical Prowess, Master Swordsmanship
__Occupation:__ Superhero, Swordsmanship Teacher
__Affiliation:__ Hero Association, Council of Swordmasters
__Level:__ S-Class Rank 4

__Personality:__
Atomic Samurai has a rather prideful and jocular personality as seen when he refused to shake Saitama's hand, telling him that he only acknowledges the strong, and telling Saitama that he would greet him properly only if he makes it to the higher ranks of S-Class. Atomic Samurai also enjoys his swordplay and makes a game out of it, often taunting monsters and showing off as he cuts them to pieces, Kamikaze also is straightforward to a humorous degree in many ways, and is incredibly confident and cocky.

__Abilities:__ Atomic Samurai is one of the top S-Class heroes. He is regarded as one of the most powerful of them, and the strongest backup hero in the Hero Association, he is also considered Earth's strongest swordsman. Atomic Samurai possesses extreme levels of speed, being able to cut his opponents to pieces in the blink of an eye using his sword.

name: Zombieman
description:
__Race:__ Human-Mutant
__Abilities:__ Regeneration
__S-Class:__ Rank 8
__Affiliation:__ Hero Association

__Personality:__ Zombieman is stated to be nihilistic, possibly due to the fact that he has "died" several times, therefore he is always calm. In addition, he prefers to work as a lone wolf and dislikes gathering, although he still respects common courtesy. However, he appears to have a sadistic side, since he enjoys killings that create rivers of blood, he is also shown to be a rather smart individual, with detective-like thinking. In comparison to the other S-Class heroes, Zombieman is more thoughtful and respectful.

__Abilities__: Zombieman possesses one of the best regeneration capabilities in the series. He is able to regenerate any part of his body no matter how severe the injury is, and he was able to heal his broken arms in an instant. He needs only a few minutes to recover from an extremely mutilated state and regrow his left arm, however this regeneration does not give Zombieman full immortality, as he will die if he is reduced to mincemeat. Zombieman has an incredible threshold for extensive physical activity, displaying one of the most impressive feats of stamina in the series and being able to fight for hours on end while his expedient recovery rate handles the more serious of injuries he suffers.

name: Amidamaru
description:
Samurai that died during the Muromachi period 600 years ago - now is Yoh's ghost companion. He is very powerful and wise but quite taciturn and extremely devoted to "Lord Yoh" ("Yō-dono" in Japanese). He was greatly known around the town of Funbari, where he had died 600 years prior after killing several hundred other samurai soldiers during a battle. He is the original handler of the legendary sword named "Harusame", meaning "Spring Rain", a sword forged by his best friend, Mosuke, who also appeared in the anime/manga as a spirit. This very same sword was reproduced as a "spirit sword" and used by Asakura Yoh during the Shaman Fight. The original was kept in a museum. His name is based on the Buddha Amitabha, the principal figure in the Pure Land Buddhist sect.    

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Lyserg Diethel
description:
__Race:__ Human / Shaman

A British Shaman and a traditional "dowser", whose parents were killed by [Hao](https://anilist.co/character/172/Hao-Asakura). Lyserg has dramatic interactions with all of the main characters at some point, and though he travels with them for a long time, he fights against [Yoh's](https://anilist.co/character/167/Yoh-Asakura) team more than once during the series.  

Lyserg is an intelectualy genius but he is blinded by the prospet of revenge for his family's murder. He has a generally kind heart, although he becomes a bit of an anti-hero.

name: Chocolove McDonell
native: チョコラブ・マクダネル
description:
Joco met his mentor, Orona, on a snowy night when he was young. Orona was among the crowd of people who circled around a victim who was being robbed. The police had the robber surrounded, but he threatened everyone by threatening to kill the victim. Orona stood out from the crowd and asked the police to give him a chance. Joco was watching him, and before he knew it, the robber was laughing his head off and was being carried off by the police.  

In the manga, the circumstances between Orona and Joco's first meeting are different. After killing a man on Christmas with his gang members from Shaft (the name of the gang, not a specific person or place), Joco walks alone on the streets, reflecting on the horrible murder of his parents on Christmas day years ago (this resentment of the day and humankind is why he shot the man mentioned earlier). After making a little comment, a stranger (Orona) appears and makes a pun with a sight gag using fake blood. After telling him to go away, Joco shoots his gun, but Orona dodges all his shots. Saying that he could not use laughter to help Joco, Orona uses his oversoul with Mic to punch him. The fact that Joco laughs at Orona's comment about using laughter to save the world and that Joco sees Mic forges a relationship between the two.  

His former master used to own a power spirit named Mic Jaguar (a takeoff from Mick Jagger), who was passed down to Joco when he died. In the manga, he gains a second spirit guardian named Pascal Avaf.

name: Yoh Asakura
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm  
__Birth Place:__ Izumo, Japan  
__Hobby:__ Listening to music and sleeping  
__Favorite Food:__ Udon Curry  
__Quotes:__ "Don't worry, it'll work out somehow."  

Yoh was born into the famous Shaman family, Asakura. He has a twin brother named [Hao](https://anilist.co/character/172/Asakura-Hao) who is a powerful reincarnation of the original HAO who keeps getting reborn. For this reason, Yoh is said to be the only one who can defeat his brother, and he himself is, as stated in the manga, a half of the original HAO, thus has many of the qualities of the reincarnation before him.

Yoh also has a fiance, named [Anna](https://anilist.co/character/170/Kyouyama-Anna), who he saved from her destructive power of Reishi (mind-reading put simply) which is helped by Hao's old cat friend, [Matamune](https://anilist.co/character/19120/Matamune). Matamune, however, dies drastically after saving Anna's life, giving the last bit of his energy to do this. When Yoh was 13, he joined the Shaman Fight, with the reason to make his life a more comfortable place, for both him and Anna.

Yoh himself is a pretty laid-back type of guy. He gets along with everyone around him, and making friends comes easy to him. Although he may not seem serious most of the time, he actually can get really serious when needed to be. Ironically, his twin brother, Hao is a bit like this as well, and many of Yoh's characteristics overlap with his as well.

name: Johann Faust VIII
description: Faust is a descendant of the original Faustus, a man who made a pact with the devil. In Shaman King, Faust the eighth was a lonely boy who had only one friend, named [Eliza](https://anilist.co/character/18342/Eliza). But Eliza suffered from a deadly disease that no cure, so Faust devoted his life to find one and evetually did it. He became a doctor, saved Eliza's life and married her. They lived together in their clinic in Germany until one night a burglar broke in and shot Eliza dead.  Broken Faust turned to his ancestor's black arts, necromancy, and now fights in order to become the Shaman King and bring Eliza back to life. His spirit is Eliza herself, and his medium is her skeleton, which is always tied to Faust's arm in a chain.

name: Anna Kyouyama
description:
Aggressive and decisive, Anna is a pragmatic person who appears cold and harsh. However, she has shown that she genuinely cares for those important to her. She is extremely dedicated to being "The Ultimate Shaman Queen" and the wife to [Yoh](https://anilist.co/character/167/Asakura-Yoh), the first friend that she ever had. She firmly believes that Yoh is destined to become the Shaman King, and believes her duty (as an Itako - a spirit medium) is training him extensively for it.

She is almost always seen wearing a red bandana; the bandana is usually worn on her head, but she starts wearing the bandana around her neck like a scarf and sports a pair of black sunglasses after departing for the Patch Village.

name: Manta Oyamada
description: An intelligent but worrisome teen who always carries a "dictionary/encyclopedia/compendium of all human knowledge", and has a sixth sense, meaning he can see supernatural beings, even though he is not a Shaman. He is very expressive and a bit panicky. His rather abnormal height has gotten him into trouble numerous times, once having been mistaken for one of the shy nature spirits, and being cut open and used as a hostage of sorts during Yoh Asakura's match with Faust VIII. In the anime, during the final battle with Hao, he actually becomes a Shaman and is able to merge with a spirit.

name: Ryuunosuke Umemiya
description: Ryunosuke Umemiya, usually called "Wooden Sword" Ryu, is a character in the anime and manga Shaman King. In the English anime, his name is Rio. A direct translation of his nickname reads "Dragon of the Wooden Sword". He is a Capricorn. He usually wears exaggerated 1970s fashion: white suits and dark shirts with oversized collars, cuffs and lapels, plus pointy shoes. His battle outfit consists of a vest-styled shirt that exposes his stomach and pants that occasionally puff out above the ankles. His crowning glory is a foot-long pompadour, which keeps getting lopped off by Yoh Asakura and others. Ryu's nickname comes from the fact he carries a wooden sword, or bokutō. In the English anime, he has a Hispanic accent.

name: Ren Tao
description:
Len is a Shaman from China, one of the few remaining members of the Tao Family, who after their years of serving as the guardians of the Forbidden City, became outcasts and condemned as witches and devils. Those two centuries of suffering were the fuel of the hatred En bared for those outside of their clan and even more for those of the Tao family who associated themselves with outsiders like his brother or Len's father (in the Japanese version, En is Len's father, in the English version, is his uncle).

Len was taught to hate and see the worst in people, with the Tao family Crest magically tattooed on his back by his uncle as a reminder of his "destiny" to be Shaman King so he can punish the world for what it did to the Tao clan. But that all changed when he met and fought [Yoh](https://anilist.co/character/167/Yoh-Asakura), whose laid back nature and friends convinced Len that En was wrong about people.

Ren is serious, logical, and quite aloof. He tries hard to maintain a tough and confident exterior, but deep down would risk his own life for his allies. He is a particularly impatient person with a short temper and isn't afraid to hurt the source of the anger. Because of how he was raised amongst dead corpses and spirits he began applying the survival of the fittest rule as a way of overcoming death. He is also an egotistical person and usually doesn't care that people think that he's overly proud.

name: Horohoro
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm

Horohoro is an Ainu from Hokkaidō, a prefecture in Japan. In the English anime, he is described as from "the Northern Woods" instead of from Hokkaidō. He is the older brother of [Pirica](https://anilist.co/character/15558/Pirika-Usui) and his guardian ghost is [Kororo](https://anilist.co/character/20242/Kororo), a small nature spirit. Horohoro is a tall boy and he is most commonly seen wearing a white and blue skiing outfit, black shorts and skiing shoes that can be attached to his snowboard. He has long light turquoise blue hair that when tied together with his headband (that has Ainu styled patterns on it) sticks up in spikes. 

Horohoro is good-natured and cheerful, but he gets serious in dangerous situations. He argues constantly with his teammate [Ren](https://anilist.co/character/171/Ren-Tao), and they do not seem to get along at all.  However, it is shown that he really does care for Ren, when he tells [Yoh](https://anilist.co/character/167/Yoh-Asakura)  that if he can't save Ren, he would never forgive him. Horohoro is also very secretive about his past not willing to talk about it even to his friends. In addition, he can also get very competitive, even going so far as to turn [Ryu's](https://anilist.co/character/12677/Ryunosuke-Umemiya) arms to ice and shatter them during the shaman fights.

His main goal is to save the Koro Pokkuru ("Minutians" in the English anime), a tiny spirit people.

name: Yumiella Dolkness
native: ユミエラ・ドルクネス
description:
A girl who reincarnated as the hidden final boss of the RPG otome game _Light Magic and the Hero_. She originally planned to live a peaceful life, but her "gamer soul" became fired up after her first time using her newfound magical powers in a dungeon, and she quickly became obsessed with leveling up.

Yumiella is stoic, logical, and has a phlegmatic expression; she struggles with social interaction, including understanding and building relationships. This, combined with her jet black hair that is feared and discriminated against in the kingdom, often leads others to be scared and distance themselves from her.  However, she never seems bothered by what others think about her, and isn't afraid to be herself. Even though she has problems expressing herself, she is truly a well-meaning and caring person.

appearsIn.title: Villainess Level 99: I May Be the Hidden Boss but I'm Not the Demon Lord
Villainess Level 99: I May Be the Hidden Boss But I'm Not the Demon Lord

name: Patrick Ashbatten
native: パトリック・アッシュバトン
description:
Patrick is a student at the Royal Academy and [Yumiella](https://anilist.co/character/208534/Yumiella-Dolkness)'s closest friend. He is the second son of a margrave and is skilled at battle tactics and wind magic. In the original game, _Light Magic and the Hero_, he was just a background character.

Patrick is a sincere, kindhearted, and level-headed person who often acts as the straight-man for Yumiella's antics. After he hears her reject another man by saying she "only likes people stronger than her", he begins to work hard at leveling up every day (even though he knows that Yumiella was only saying that as an excuse).

appearsIn.title: Villainess Level 99: I May Be the Hidden Boss but I'm Not the Demon Lord
Villainess Level 99: I May Be the Hidden Boss But I'm Not the Demon Lord

name: Ryuu
description: Ryuu is a dragon that [Yumiella](https://anilist.co/character/208534/Yumiella-Dolkness) raised from an egg.

appearsIn.title: Villainess Level 99: I May Be the Hidden Boss but I'm Not the Demon Lord
Villainess Level 99: I May Be the Hidden Boss But I'm Not the Demon Lord

name: Eleanora Hillrose
native: エレノーラ・ヒルローズ
description:
Eleanora is the daughter of Duke Hillrose, the leader of the radical nobles part of the anti-king faction. She has a crush on [Prince Edwin](https://anilist.co/character/313858/Edwin-Valschein) and tries to keep the women around him in check. She initially comes across as a stuck-up villainess type, but is actually just a naive lovestruck girl. Her "friends" use her as a scapegoat to pick on [Alicia](https://anilist.co/character/208535/Alicia-Ehnleit), though she is unaware that their actions make her look bad in Edwin's eyes.

Eleanora is the only other person that isn't afraid of [Ryuu](https://anilist.co/character/372403/Ryuu); she finds him cute and spoils him with treats. She befriends [Yumiella](https://anilist.co/character/208534/Yumiella-Dolkness) over their shared love of dragons and the fact that Yumiella isn't taking advantage of her, being able to be honest and open with her alone.

appearsIn.title: Villainess Level 99: I May Be the Hidden Boss but I'm Not the Demon Lord
Villainess Level 99: I May Be the Hidden Boss But I'm Not the Demon Lord

name: Alicia Ehnleit
native: アリシア・エンライト
description:
Alicia is the heroine of the RPG otome game _Light Magic and the Hero_. She is a rare light magic user, which allowed her to attend the Royal Academy despite being a commoner.

Alicia has an optimistic and cheerful personality that's characteristic of a protagonist. She enrolled in the academy so that she could use her magic to help others.

appearsIn.title: Villainess Level 99: I May Be the Hidden Boss but I'm Not the Demon Lord
Villainess Level 99: I May Be the Hidden Boss But I'm Not the Demon Lord

name: Edwin Valschein
native: エドウィン・バルシャイン
description: Edwin is the second prince of the kingdom and the main hero of the game _Light Magic and the Hero_.

appearsIn.title: Villainess Level 99: I May Be the Hidden Boss but I'm Not the Demon Lord
Villainess Level 99: I May Be the Hidden Boss But I'm Not the Demon Lord

name: William Ares
description: William is a short-tempered swordsman with a strong sense of justice. He is one of the three love interests in the game _Light Magic and the Hero_.

appearsIn.title: Villainess Level 99: I May Be the Hidden Boss but I'm Not the Demon Lord
Villainess Level 99: I May Be the Hidden Boss But I'm Not the Demon Lord

name: Oswald Grimsarde
native: オズワルド・グリムザード
description: Oswald is one of the three love interests in the game _Light Magic and the Hero_. He is skilled at magic and can use all four basic elements.

appearsIn.title: Villainess Level 99: I May Be the Hidden Boss but I'm Not the Demon Lord
Villainess Level 99: I May Be the Hidden Boss But I'm Not the Demon Lord

name: Rita
description: Rita is [Yumiella](https://anilist.co/character/208534/Yumiella-Dolkness)'s maid.

appearsIn.title: Villainess Level 99: I May Be the Hidden Boss but I'm Not the Demon Lord
Villainess Level 99: I May Be the Hidden Boss But I'm Not the Demon Lord

name: Ronald
description: Ronald is the new school principal who replaced the previous headmaster on the King's orders. Unlike his predecessor, Ronald is supportive of [Yumiella](https://anilist.co/character/208534/Yumiella-Dolkness) and acts as the messenger between her and the King.

appearsIn.title: Villainess Level 99: I May Be the Hidden Boss but I'm Not the Demon Lord
Villainess Level 99: I May Be the Hidden Boss But I'm Not the Demon Lord

name: Ren Amamiya
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm (5'9")
__Initial Persona:__  Arsène
__Ultimate Persona:__ 

The protagonist of Persona 5. He is a transfer student at Shujin High School and is infamous due to his criminal record. He was transferred to Shujin on probation by the court due to the alleged assault filed against him. During his probation, he lives in the cellar of Cafe Leblanc owned by Sakura Sojiro, which is also his acting guardian. 

Ren has a strong sense of justice, as noted by his fellow friends and confidants. He also has a strong will for rebellion, as noted by his Persona, Arsene. It is due to that strong will of rebellion that he could awaken his Persona and break free from the shackle of society. It is also noted by some people that Ren is very charismatic even though he appears as an unassuming and silent, sometimes airheaded person.

name: Futaba Sakura
description:
__Birth Name:__ Futaba Isshiki
__Height:__ 152 cm
__Arcana:__ Hermit
__Initial Persona:__ Necronomicon
__Transforming Persona:__ Prometheus
__Fusion Persona:__ Al Azif

A genius 15-year-old​ girl with otherworldly calculation and programming skills. Her interpersonal communication is extremely poor though, so she lives life as a shut-in with limited to no human interaction.

name: Gorou Akechi
aliases: Second Advent of the Detective Prince
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm (5'10")

Akechi is a high school student who conducts a detective business. His abilities as a detective have been widely acclaimed, since he not only has solved numerous cases but is also able to deal with people from the investigation agency smoothly. His handsome features draw public attention, and people comment on him as “The Second Advent of the Detective Prince.” He represents the Justice Arcana.

name: Ann Takamaki
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm
__Arcana:__ Lovers
__Initial Persona:__ Carmen
__Transforming Persona:__ Hecate
__Fusion Persona:__ Célestine

Ann Takamaki is a playable character from Persona 5. She is a student at Shujin Academy who lives a double life as a Phantom Thief. After being ridden with guilt of not helping her best friend Shiho Suzui who would fall victim to Suguru Kamoshida and would lose ties with her in the process, she would support her friends while facing, overcoming, and promising not to make the same mistake again.

name: Ryuuji Sakamoto
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm
__Arcana:__ Chariot
__Initial Persona:__ Captain Kidd
__Transforming Persona:__ Seiten Taisei
__Fusion Persona:__ William

Ryuuji is known as a disruptive "problem student" at school whose bad behavior causes all sorts of trouble for the teachers. His rebellious, mischievous, and disobedient nature are the perfect qualities to be a Phantom Thief. He is a bit short-tempered, easily taking offense from even the slightest of comments from others, and can sometimes even resort to violence.

name: Yuusuke Kitagawa
description:
__Height:__ 181.9 cm
__Arcana:__ Emperor
__Initial Persona:__ Goemon
__Transforming Persona:__  Kamu Susano-o
__Fusion Persona:__ Gorokichi

Yusuke is a very composed and collected individual, and upon further inspection, this extends to a sense of methodical intelligence and a highly observant nature. He acts with poise and elegance, displayed by his eloquent, poetic way of speaking. He is able to remain calm even in dire circumstances, but can also act dramatically at times; others have pointed him out as weird, and even Yusuke admits that he can be seen as eccentric.

name: Morgana
description:
__Height:__ 60 cm (Bipedal) - 50 cm (Cat, including tail)
__Initial Persona:__ Zorro
__Transforming Persona:__ Mercurius
__Fusion Persona:__ Diego

Morgana is an amnesiac that remembers almost nothing about his past or himself, believing that the cause is the distortions within Mementos. This causes him to lose his sense of self in the process and wishes to get it back. Despite his appearance of a mysterious cat-like creature, he believes himself to have been human. He theorizes the core of Mementos may have the answers, but access from most of it is blocked and he cannot go very deep. In order to achieve his goal, he began to investigate the Metaverse and checked on numerous Palaces for clues.

name: Makoto Niijima
description:
__Height:__ 164 cm 
__Arcana:__ Priestess
__Initial Persona:__ Johanna
__Transforming Persona:__ Anat
__Fusion Persona:__ Agnes

Makoto is a perfectionist who has a strong sense of responsibility. Like her previous Priestess counterparts, Makoto is intelligent, honest, and very hardworking. In truth, she is a very compassionate and understanding young lady who strives to ensure everyone is accounted for. She is Shujin Academy's student council president and lives a double life as a Phantom Thief.

name: Haru Okumura
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm
__Arcana:__ Empress
__Initial Persona:__ Milady
__Transforming Persona:__ Artarte
__Fusion Persona:__ Lucy

Haru has good communication and observational skills. She grew up with all the elegance and splendor. She finds it difficult to differentiate between those who truly value her as a friend and who merely want to use her for her family's status. After meeting and joining the Phantom Thieves, Haru becomes passionate and rebellious and eventually learns how to properly convey her mind and connect with others.

name: Konjiki no Yami
description:
__Height:__ 153 cm  

A dispassionate, withdrawn assassin, Golden Darkness is hired by one of [Lala](https://anilist.co/character/5511)'s arranged suitors, [Lacospo](https://anilist.co/character/71391) to kill [Rito](https://anilist.co/character/5510), until she breaks the contract, noting the true nature behind her target. Golden Darkness is currently staying on Earth, roaming around the city streets and Sainan High, with a motivation to continue her duty to assassinate Rito, although she has yet to accomplish this (hinting she only said this as an excuse to stay on Earth, which is then confirmed). Commonly referred as "Yami-chan", she spends her time reading books and magazines, while eating taiyaki (it is the only thing she eats on Earth since it is the first food offered by Rito, prior to spending a night at the Yuuki residence for a sukiyaki dinner). By her planet's calculations, she is 24 years-old, despite having the appearance of an 11-year-old (albeit a rather mature one), although this is only mentioned in the anime and has a weakness towards anything slimy.

Like Lala, Golden Darkness' physical abilities are exponentially stronger than a human's. She carries a unique ability to turn her body parts into various objects through use of nano machines circulating her body, ranging from swords to dragon heads. Unfortunately, excessive use becomes a hazard to her health.

name: Momo Deviluke
native: モモ・ベリア・デビルーク
description:
__Height:__ 151 cm

[Lala's](https://anilist.co/character/5511) younger sister and [Nana's](https://anilist.co/character/17363) twin; they are introduced when they have most of the characters in a virtual game world created by Lala that they subsequently modify. They claim they did this to determine the nature of their sister's friends and to test Rito's affection for Lala.

Momo has short hair and is generally sweeter than her twin, but develops a bad attitude whenever Nana takes credit for what she does; she shares a connection to plant life. She also has a strong attraction towards [Rito](https://anilist.co/character/5510) (similar to Lala's), stating how his facial expressions are lovely and even letting him touch her tail. At times, she would even sneak into Rito's bed at night and stating how jealous she was of Lala that Rito's hand was stuck to her tail. Momo and her twin are currently on Earth, running away from their studies.

Also, Momo has a special ability to talk to various alien plants. Which she summons through her phone that Lala made for her and her sister.

name: Mea Kurosaki
description:
__Height:__ 153 cm

Mea Kurosaki is a character from To-Love-Ru Darkness. She is sent to Earth to bring back the "old" Golden Darkness. It is revealed that she is Yami's younger sister as she was created by the same organization as her. At first she is found alone starring out the window until she meets Nana and becomes friends with her. She now views others as friends. It appears (in chapter 7) that she has sexual feelings towards Rito.

She is described by Yami as a "second generation" transforming weapon, making her abilities more advanced than her sister's. She has displayed several abilities Yami has never been shown to possess such as the ability to transform parts of her body into powerful energy weapons and even enter a person's (Rito's) mind while they sleep to extract information. The one similarity shown between the two is a preference for using their extremely long hair as a transformation medium.

Unlike her sister, Mea has never known anything in her life other than being a living weapon. Her first memories are of waking up in the rubble of the research station she was born in and meeting Nemesis, a living weapon from another project. She is there for very confused by her sister's choice to remain on earth living a passive life and though she does slowly come round to the idea she retains her opinion of herself as a living weapon and longs for her sister to embrace the idea herself.

name: Mikan Yuuki
description:
**Height:** 149 cm

[Rito Yuuki](https://anilist.co/character/5510/Yuuki-Rito)'s independent and reliable 11-year-old sister, Mikan takes care of the housework while their parents are away on business.

In contrast to her brother, she is very mature and does not hesitate to tease him, going as far as stating they aren't blood related, just for a laugh. Mikan also seems to have a certain lack of respect for Rito because of this (she hardly ever addresses him by his honorific as an older brother), but does answer him "Onii-chan" as thanks for trying so hard to take care of her when she develops a fever. Mikan may not show it, but she cares very deeply for Rito and misses his company, and states how they used to play together before [Lala](https://anilist.co/character/5511/Deviluke-Satalin-Lala) entered their lives.

Mikan grows quite attached to [Golden Darkness](https://anilist.co/character/5513/Konjiki-no-Yami), perhaps due to Darkness seemingly being the same age as her.

Mikan is very perceptive and seems to be able to read people's emotions, even their reactions, most of which is Rito's obvious anxiety around [Haruna](https://anilist.co/character/5512/Sairenji-Haruna) and [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/9530/Kotegawa-Yui)'s more than subtle feelings for him (Mikan even calls him a "playboy" for attracting so many girls).

name: Zastin
description:
Lala's personal bodyguard and the best swordsman of the planet Deviluke. He is currently Assistant Chief to Rito's father who is a manga writer due to an incident caused by Lala. Despite his skill with a sword, he has a horrible sense of direction, resulting in him being constantly lost (another running gag in the series).  

In To LOVE-Ru Darkness, he now works as a mangaka.

(Source Wikipedia)

name: Haruko Nitta
description: Mikan's homeroom teacher in her elementary school. She is shown to be a otaku and big fan of Mikan and Rito's father's work.  -Wikipedia-

name: Shizu Murasame
description:
__Height:__ 159 cm 

The ghost of a girl who died in the old abandoned school building 400 years ago, Shizu is sincere, kind, and very curious about the modern world, but has a severe fear of dogs, likened to [Haruna](https://anilist.co/character/5512/Sairenji-Haruna)'s level of fear to the supernatural. 

When frightened, she can emit blasts of mental stress, blowing apart various objects and surroundings, but is also capable of manipulating others through sheer willpower.

name: Nana Deviluke
native: ナナ・アスタ・デビルーク
description:
__Height:__ 150 cm

One of Lala's younger sisters, she is also the elder twin sister of Momo. Nana only appears to be more the mischievous of the two. She has an affinity for fauna. Both Nana and Momo are currently on Earth, running away from their studies. She didn't like Rito to begin with, but later warms up to him. She has tsundere characteristics.

Nana also has a special ability to communicate with various alien beasts and animals. She also uses an invention of Lala which enables her to store her friends in a virtual space and summon them at will.

Nana stated that she is the inferior twin, being flat. People say that she is the worser behaved of the two, even though Nana says it's because most do not know of Momo's dark side. Despite this, even after they argue, they make up again. Nana supports her Lala's relationship with Rito, even though she calls him a beast many times, this only helps Momo's harem plan in the end.

name: Uta
description:
__Height:__ 169 cm
__Occupations:__ Singer

Uta is the most beloved singer in the world. Her voice, which she sings with while concealing her true identity, has been described as “otherworldly.”

name: Shanks
description:
__Height:__ 199 cm (6'6½")
__Bounty:__ 

Red-Haired Shanks is a legendary and powerful pirate in the Grand Line, being the captain of the Red-Haired Pirate Crew. Furthermore, he is [Monkey D. Luffy](https://anilist.co/character/40/Monkey-D-Luffy)'s childhood hero. Overall, he is greatly respected by most of the characters, despite having a 'soft' and friendly nature and never appearing in actual combat  As a whole, he does not make many appearances in the series, although he appears in a majority of the opening or closing themes of the anime.  Shanks always wears a long black cape over his shoulders and until he met Luffy, wore a straw hat that he had worn for many years beforehand. He always wears trousers that are cut below the knee as well as a pair of sandals. The most striking thing about Shanks is the colour of his red hair, of which his nick-name 'Red Haired Shanks' comes from.  He has a missing left arm, that he had lost when he saved Luffy from a Sea King. Shanks and his crew are almost always seen partying and drinking alcoholic beverages whenever they make an appearance as the Captain's favourite pastimes are attending and hosting parties and banquets.  According to [Oda](https://anilist.co/staff/96881/Oda-Eiichirou), Shanks is the one character that resembles himself the most out of all the One Piece characters, because of his fun-loving partying nature.

name: Gordon
description: Gordon, is a large man with a large scar on his head. He is a man who seems to know about Uta and Shanks, but is still shrouded in mystery.

name: Koby
description: When he first appeared Koby was a small, timid, bespectacled boy with pink hair. He was slightly chubby and somewhat shorter than Luffy. After training with Garp, Koby became somewhat thinner and taller. He now stands nearly as tall as Luffy. He also gained a scar across his forehead above his right eye. He now wears a jacket with the standard Marine colors.   Personality  Koby is first introduced as a cowardly Chore Boy on board Alvida's ship. Through fear of being smashed by her Iron Mace, whenever she asked him who was the loveliest on the sea, he would reply, 'You are, Miss Alvida'. Eventually with the help of Luffy he found the courage to pursue his dream of leaving her and becoming a Marine.  The first time he appears to have changed is when he and Luffy arrive at the base Captain Morgan is at. Helmeppo holds a gun to his head, but he pulls together his courage and tells Luffy not to worry about him. After their mini-arc series, Helmeppo and he become good friends.  Koby values his friendship with Luffy a lot, as shown when even after their brief fight, he asks if they're still friends.  Abilities and Powers  In his first appearance he lacked any fighting skills. According to Alvida, the only reason why she kept him on was because he happened to be good at Navigation. He is seen during his mini-arc training alongside Helemeppo and Vice-Admiral Monkey D. Garp. He has since become strong enough to use Rokushiki, or at the very least, Soru.

name: Bartolomeo
aliases: Hitokui no Bartolomeo (人食いのバルトロメオ)
description:
__Height:__ 220 cm (7'3½")
__Affiliation:__ 
__Position:__ 
__Devil Fruit:__ 
__Devil Fruit Type:__ 
__Bounty:__ 

Bartolomeo is a Super Rookie and the leader of the Barto Club, his own Mafia family. He was a gladiator competing at the Corrida Colosseum for the Mera Mera no Mi.

name: Law Trafalgar
native: トラファルガー・ロー
description:
__Height:__ 191 cm (6'3")
__Affiliation:__ Heart Pirates,  
__Devil Fruit:__  
__Devil Fruit Type:__ 
__Bounty:__  

Trafalgar Law is the captain of the Heart Pirates​, a pirate crew from the North Blue. He is one of eleven pirates who has been referred to as "The Eleven Supernovas" on Sabaody Archipelago whose bounties are higher than 100,000,000 when the Straw Hats arrive in the place. 

Law is an extremely laid-back character, who is nearly always seen smiling (although not with a huge grin, like fellow Supernova Urouge). He also has a more reckless attitude when faced against other pirates that the World Government has labeled as a higher threat: For example, he casually asked X. Drake how many people he had slain in his very first appearance, and had no qualms about flipping his middle finger at Eustass Kid, the most wanted Supernova on the Archipelago (even smiling defiantly when doing so). However, he hates being ordered around. He is also unfailingly polite, usually referring to others as "Mr", and appears to be honorable enough to refuse taking credit that is due to others.

name: Rein
description: He is a Beast Tamer who originally had no other combat skills except weak fire and healing spells, which leads him to be expelled from the hero's party. However, upon meeting Kanade and making a contract with her, Rein learns that he can also obtain other skills from members of strongest races, which makes him stronger with each new contract.

name: Kanade
description: Kanade is a talented and powerful fighter from the Cat Tribe, the rarest of the strongest races. She left her hometown in search for adventure. After she meets Rein Shroud, she asks him to tame her, and Rein does so, making her his first companion.

name: Tania
description: Tania is a red dragon, a member of Dragon Tribe, and is traveling the world challenging worthy fighters until Rein and Kanade defeat her. After befriending them, she joins the party, making her his second contractual.

name: Luna
description: Luna, a Dryad from the Spirit Tribe, was sacrificed to Shadow Knight in order to protect their village. At Sora's request, Rein helped her and her older twin sister by defeating Shadow Knight. Along with Sora, decided to join his party, making them his third and fourth contractual.

name: Sora
description: Sora, a dryad from the Spirit Tribe, was given the job of protecting the forest and safeguarding the Shield of Truths. She gave the shield to Rein and others after they told her it was needed to defeat the demon lord. Noticing that she is sad, Rein asks her to tell the reason. Sora told Rein and others that her younger twin sister was captured by Shadow Knight as an offering to protect their village. Rein helped her and her sister by defeating Shadow Knight. Then, Sora and Luna decided to join his party, making them his third and fourth contractual.

name: Nina
description: Nina, a member of Demigod Race, was worshipped as a deity in her homeland until she is captured and sold into slavery, where she is put magic collar to restrain her and enslaved by Edgar Fromware. After being saved by Rein Shroud, she became his fifth contractual.

name: Stella Enplace
native: ステラ・エンプレイス
description:
She is the vice-captain of the Order of Knights. She created a rebellion group of female knights and formed an alliance with Rein Shroud to stop the misdoings of Edgar Fromware and his father.

After Edgar's downfall, Stella has been promoted to captain of The Knights when replacing her former mentor and captain, Jill Stregger.

name: Mina
description: One of the mages from [Rein](https://anilist.co/character/278661/Rein)'s former party.

name: Tina Hollee
description:
__Race:__ Human/Ghost
__Occupation:__ Maid

Tina Hollee is a ghost who had been haunting a mansion where she was killed by her previous master until Rein Shroud came and bought the mansion. She later becomes his sixth contractual after Rein helped her in arresting her murderer and now stays at Rein's residence as a maid.

name: Utena Hiiragi
description:
__Height:__ 154 cm

Utena is a shy and introverted girl who longingly admires magical girls, collects their memorabilia, and talks passionately about them. Her obsession with Tres Magia even reached to the point where she wished to fight alongside them, but that ultimately led to her being tricked by [Venalita](https://anilist.co/character/301180). At times, she can be simple-minded.

name: Kiwi Araga
description:
__Height:__ 149 cm

She became a member of Enormeeta to beat up magical girls, because she hated that they got more attention than her on social media. Although Kiwi was initially hostile towards [Utena](https://anilist.co/character/175746), after undergoing shock training, she became docile and developed a crush on Utena. Now she is content with Utena's acknowledgement alone. Kiwi frequently fantasizes about going to a love hotel with Utena. Despite appearances she is decent enough academically to help Utena avoid her grades deteriorating.

She and [Magia Sulfur](https://anilist.co/character/191859) instinctively have it out for each other. They immediately devolve to insults and fighting at every opportunity — even in their civilian forms, despite not recognizing each other due to recognition inhibition.

name: Korisu Morino
description:
__Height:__ 128 cm

Korisu is a quiet and reserved girl, and the youngest member of Enormeeta. She has a large collection of old toys that are precious to her.

Her theme is Alice in Wonderland.

name: Matama Akoya
description:
__Height:__ 155 cm
__Favorite Food:__ Sweet Rolled Omelettes
__Least Favorite Food:__ Coriander
__Recent Ambition:__ To Have A Video Of Her Singing Go Viral On Social Media

Matama is a cheerful girl. However, she is also quite narcissistic and very sensitive to criticism. She fears both [Lord Enorme](https://anilist.co/character/288448) and [Magia Baiser Utena](https://anilist.co/character/175746), finding them both similar in that they use sexual harassment as punishment. She is terrible at singing except when engaging in exhibitionism, a fact discovered when Utena made her perform in the nude on threat of [Nemo](https://anilist.co/character/255889) being harmed.

name: Nemo Anemo
description:
__Height:__ 151 cm
__Favorite Food:__ Takoyaki
__Least Favorite Food:__ Shiitake Mushrooms
__Something That Made Her Happy Recently:__ Pulled Three SSRs In A Social Game

Nemo is a snarky and crude girl. She is also quite arrogant, since she has a habit of taunting her opponents. She is also childhood friends with [Akoya Matama](https://anilist.co/character/255890). They have good teamwork when fighting together. However, they also argue often. In spite of this, they may have romantic feelings for each other.

name: Lord Enorme
description: Lord Enorme is cruel and remorseless, being the mastermind who caused the defeat and possible deaths of many magical girls. She is extremely arrogant and very self-entitled, believing that the world exists solely for the sake of being ruled by her. She takes pride in her actions, and does not hesitate to torture others for any reason, even her own subordinates.

name: Haruka Hanabishi
description:
__Height:__ 156 cm

Haruka is an extremely energetic and compulsive girl, always smiling and acting on her feelings. She cares a lot about Sayo and Kaoruko, admiring their strength and skill as magical girls. However, she is extremely naïve and gullible and seems to lack intelligence and common sense as well. Despite all this, Haruka is an extremely caring girl who cares about her friends and will go through any trial to protect them. When reflecting on being controlled by Baiser, she felt shame and regret over attacking Sulfur and Azul.

name: Venalita
description:
