Venalita is a mascot who recruits magical girls for Enormeeta.

He is shrewd and pragmatic, using whatever means necessary to recruit members into Enormeeta. He is also quick of mind, as he was able to successfully get Utena to forgive him for tricking her by making up a story about how his people are being killed by magical girls, and that he doesn't mind being labelled as evil as long as he can save them.

name: Sister Gigant
description: Sister Gigant is very submissive and obedient, following orders without question and not protesting punishment. She is also melancholy, as she is often seen crying and lamenting certain events. However, despite following Lord Enorme without question, her true loyalty is to Venalita.

name: Kaoruko Tenkawa
description:
__Height:__ 146 cm

Kaoroku puts on a calm and cool mask for the public, but in reality she is a crude, foulmouthed, and short-tempered girl. She is also the most intelligent and cunning member of Tres Magia. She is not hesitant to start conflict, and will goad and taunt others, whether as herself or as Magia Sulfur.

name: Terminus Est
description: Est is Kamito's contracted spirit. She is a powerful sword spirit. In elemental waffe form she transforms into a sword known as Demon Slayer, Demon King Killing Sacred Sword, or The Sacred Sword of Severian.

name: Ellis Fahrengart
native: エリス・ファーレンガルト
description: Ellis Fahrengart is a captain of the Sylphid Knights and a member Team Scarlet. She is the elementalist of the wind spirit Simorgh. Though she is armed with a sword, her main weapon is a lance which is an elemental waffe which her contract spirit transforms into.

name: Kamito Kazehaya
description: The main character of this story, who suddenly sees Claire while she's washing herself. He eventually becomes her slave spirit.

name: Rinslet Laurenfrost
native: リンスレット・ローレンフロスト
description: Rinslet Laurenfrost is Claire's childhood friend and self proclaimed rival. She is a Member of Team Scarlet and elementalist using the ice wolf spirit Fenrir.

name: Fianna Ray Ordesia
native: フィアナ・レイ・オルデシア
description:
Fianna Ray Ordesia is a member of Team Scarlet and the so called the Lost Queen. She is the contractor of the light spirit Georgios.

She excels in ritual Kagura, which have many uses such as combat support, resealing, driving spirits mad, etc.

name: Claire Rouge
description: Claire Rouge is the leader of Team Scarlet and an elementalist using the flame spirit Scarlet.

name: Greyworth Ciel Mais
native: グレイワース.シエルマイス
description: Greyworth Ciel Mais is a woman known for her epithet as the Dusk Witch. She is the headmaster of Areishia Spirit Academy who has invited Kamito to transfer to her school and compete in the blade dance where she promises him that she will give him information on the whereabouts of Restia, his original contract spirit.

name: Carol Nastassha
native: キャロル・ナスターシャ
description: She is Rinslet's personal maid who is be a bit clumsy at times.

name: Restia Ashdoll
native: レスティア・アッシュドール
description:
Restia is Kazehaya Kamito's contracted spirit. She is a high level darkness elemental spirit in the form of young girl.

In elemental waffe form, she transforms into a jet-black demon sword known as Vorpal Sword—the sword that pierces truth. She is capable of transforming herself to sword form on her own and being wielded by others without forming a contract.

name: Jio Inzagi
description: Jio Inzagi is one of the assassins who was trained at the Instructional School. He is the antagonist of the first arc of the anime Seirei Tsukai no Blade Dance. He is able to control at least over than sixteen sealed spirits.

name: Tron
description:
__Affiliation__ Village Bunnies, Demon Lord Kunai Hakuto, Satanists (former)
__Species__ Cambion (half demon)

A cute, melancholy-looking little girl dressed in black she and the image of a gothic lolita. Tron is very melancholic because of her stalking past that she suffered in the demonic kingdom and the human world, she once said that she had forgotten how to smile. After being saved by [Zero Kirisame](https://anilist.co/character/189442/Zero-Kirisame), she became more open and cheerful. Tron can fly freely, she also has superhuman strength due to her half demon blood. Her most remarkable ability and her ability to see a person's emotions and soul (human or demon),

name: Luna Elegant
description:
__Height:__ 153 cm

She is the youngest of the ‘Three Saints’. She has magical talent that is rare even among the saints. Because of that rare talent she grew up as if she were a rose among weeds. She is extraordinarily selfish.

name: Aku
description: Aku was cast out of her village as a sacrifice to the Devil King Greol; however, as she is being chased through the forest by Greol, she comes to a clearing where she encounters a mysterious man.   This man defeats the Devil King with a single knife, causing Aku to become frightened for her life.  The man assures her that she has nothing to worry, he introduces himself as Hakuto Kunai.  Aku repeatedly refers to Kunai as "Demon Lord", which he tries time and time again, to tell her that's not his name.  He eventually gives in and lets her call him the Demon Lord, as they begin their journey together.

name: Yu Kirino
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm

Genius doctor and scientist with sadistic tendencies and extreme short-temper. She loves little boys.

name: Organ
description: __Height:__ 155 cm

name: Killer Queen
description: __Height:__ 170 - 173 cm

name: Zero Kirisame
description:
__Race:__ Human
__Height:__ 180 cm

name: Isami Tahara
description:
__Race:__ Human
__Height:__ 182 cm

name: Yatorishino Igsem
native: ヤトリシノ・イグセム

name: Torway Remion
native: トルウェイ・レミオン

name: Matthew Tetdrich
native: マシュー・テトジリチ

name: Shamille Kitra Katvarnmaninik
native: シャミーユ・キトラ・カトヴァンマニニク

name: Haqua du Lot Herminium
native: ハクア・ド・ロット・ヘルミニウム
description:
__Height:__ 162 cm
__Job:__ Domestic Genius

Haqua is a fellow Spirit hunter and friend of [Elsie](https://anilist.co/character/14015/de-Lute-Ima-Elucia). A 300 year old demon, she is an outstanding honor student and the District Chief of Area 32 in Nagumo City. As a child, she always tried to be the best in everything she does hence her perfect record.

appearsIn.title: The World God Only Knows II

name: Kusunoki Kasuga
description:
**Class:** 3-A 
**Height:** 175 cm 

Kusunoki is a third year student at Keima's High School. As an initiate of the Ancient Martial Arts Kasuga-Style Life And Death Technique, she hates weakness and tells others of her hate for cute things; however, she secretly loves them. Keima meets her and asks to be her disciple for her style of martial arts. After some time, she finds herself getting flustered after staring at Keima. She believes that cute things are weak, and therefore she denies her "weakness". After Keima points out her denial, Kusunoki becomes more open to things which were once "weak".

appearsIn.title: The World God Only Knows II

name: Jun Nagase
description:
**Height:** 162 cm

Nagase is a graduate from [Keima Katsuragi](https://anilist.co/character/13468/Katsuragi-Keima)'s High School and now she's back as a Student Teacher, teaching in Keima's class. 

She admires the pro wrestler Jumbo Tsuruma and she was revealed to be quite innocent and naive. On her first day of teaching, Nagase noticed that Keima was playing games in class. Due to her strong beliefs she decided to take action and help him.

Its also revealed that she was Captain of a basketball team when she attended Maishima Academy High School (Keima's school) and that her team won the national game.

appearsIn.title: The World God Only Knows II

name: Dokurou Skull
description: Dokurou Skull is hell's branch chief of "counter measures". She assigned Elsie to capture spirits in the human world and sent Keima Katsuragi the contract letter.

appearsIn.title: The World God Only Knows II

name: Rin
description: Trapped in her beautiful, yet lonely days, she begins to wonder about the outside world, and why she is all alone.

name: Shigeru
description: A Japanese scientist and engineer.

name: Sakura Adachi
description: Adachi Sakura is a high school student. She is found skipping class on the second floor of the gym by [Shimamura Hougetsu](https://anilist.co/character/144718/Hougetsu-Shimamura) one day. The two of them gradually became friends and began to spend a lot of time together. Adachi had an extremely introverted personality. Before meeting Shimamura, she never had someone whom she can call a friend. Adachi was said to be cold toward other people and didn't attempt to make friends with other people in the past. She also gets very jealous when Shimamura is together with her friends, and as a consequence usually ends up running away.

name: Hougetsu Shimamura
description: Shimamura Hougetsu is a high school student. She met [Adachi](https://anilist.co/character/144717/Sakura-Adachi) while skipping class on the second floor of the gym in her school when Adachi accidentally walks in on her one day. (In both manga adaptations, it was Shimamura who walked in on Adachi in the gym when they first met instead of the reverse.) The two instantly took a liking for each other and began to hang out together all the time. Shimamura has tail-bone length, dyed brown hair, which she keeps out of her face with two clips on the right side. Her eyes are also brown. Despite playing basketball in middle school, Shimamura is on the shorter side. She has a slim figure. Shimamura tends to think of interpersonal relationships as bothersome since she feels that it requires too much effort to maintain a balanced relationship.

name: Yashiro Chikama
description:
Chikama Yashiro is a friend of [Hino Akira](https://anilist.co/character/167926/Akira-Hino), who met while they were fishing. Like Hino, Chikama makes her own sound effects, the most notably being the "breathing" sound for her space suit. In her introduction, she explains that she has come to Earth to find her brethren.

Chikama wears a full body spacesuit. It has childish design elements, such as hearts and star patches.

name: Taeko Nagafuji
description:
__Date of Birth:__ Unknown

Taeko Nagafuji is a high school student and [Shimamura Hougetsu](https://anilist.co/character/144718/Hougetsu-Shimamura)'s friend. She is introduced in Chapter 2, along with [Hino Akira](https://anilist.co/character/167926/Akira-Hino), in a bookstore with [Shimamura](https://anilist.co/character/144718/Hougetsu-Shimamura).

Nagafuji has straight, shoulder length hair and wears glasses. She has a very mature figure.

Nagafuji is described as having a very laid back personality. Though she sometimes just seems to be out of it.

(Source: Adachi and Shimamura Wiki)

name: Mizore Yoroizuka
description:
__Instrument:__ Oboe

Mizore is a second-year student who plays oboe. She is a very quiet and introverted girl, and despite seeming hard to interact with, she has friends like [Natsuki Nakagawa](https://anilist.co/character/88923/Nakagawa-Natsuki), [Yuuko Yoshikawa](https://anilist.co/character/88916/Yoshikawa-Yuuko), and - despite past relationship troubles - [Nozomi Kasaki](https://anilist.co/character/120724/Nozomi-Kasaki).

She likes practicing the oboe alone outside the classroom, and frequently arrives at school early, hours before the start of her classes, in order to practice. She's the only student to arrive at school even earlier than [Reina Kousaka](https://anilist.co/character/88710/Kousaka-Reina).

name: Akiko Oumae
description: The mother of Kumiko and Mamiko.

name: Haruka Ogasawara
description:
__Instrument__: Baritone Saxophone

A third-year high school student. She is the president of the brass band club, and also leads the saxophone section. She plays a baritone saxophone. She has a kind heart as she leads the Brass Band Club.

name: Steven Steel
native: スティーブン・スティール
description: The organizer of the Steel Ball Run race, and [Lucy](https://anilist.co/character/23651/Lucy-Steel)'s husband.

appearsIn.title: STEEL BALL RUN JoJo's Bizarre Adventure 1st STAGE

name: Sandman
description: Sandman is a participant in the Steel Ball Run race from a Native American tribe. Despite being ostracized, he hopes that winning the race will earn him the money to buy back his ancestor's land, and he quickly becomes one of the fiercest competitors in the race thanks to his running technique.

appearsIn.title: STEEL BALL RUN JoJo's Bizarre Adventure 1st STAGE

name: Pocoloco
description: A young man who participates in the Steel Ball Run race,  known for his incredible luck due to his stand's power.

appearsIn.title: STEEL BALL RUN JoJo's Bizarre Adventure 1st STAGE

name: Urmd  Avdol
native: ウルムド・アブドゥル
description:
Urmd Avdol is the alternate universe counterpart of the original universe's Muhammad Avdol.

Coming from Egypt, Urmd was said to have crossed the Sahara desert three times annually. Unlike the other contestants in the race, Urmd's choice of transportation was a camel, which made him a prime candidate for winning the race. Due to the camel's long legs, it had the ability to keep up with a horse's speed, but at the same time crush any other racers with its 800 kg body.

(Source: JoJo Wiki)

appearsIn.title: STEEL BALL RUN JoJo's Bizarre Adventure 1st STAGE

name: Mountain Tim
description:
Working as a cowboy and bounty hunter, Mountain Tim is announced as a leading competitor in the Steel Ball Run. During the first stages of the race, Tim becomes one of Johnny and Gyro's allies. He is also a Stand User and shifts through his lasso thanks to his stand, Oh! Lonesome Me.

Mountain Tim is a man of average to above-average height and average build. Handsome and light-haired, he later acquires a scar crossing his face.
He wears a stereotypical range of cowboy attire; his hat has a zebra print, while the clothing on his upper torso, his belt gun holster, and his scarf have a leopard print. He wears a sheriff's badge in the shape of a five-pointed star on his left side.

Oh! Lonesome Me enables Mountain Tim to separate segments of his or others' bodies and freely slide them along a rope. It also grants him superhuman control over the rope, freely and precisely manipulating it to grab small objects from afar for instance.
This ability to separate himself into little pieces as far as the rope goes grants Mountain Tim greater agility and flexibility. Launching himself along it, Tim may shoot enemies from odd angles; and through the process of splitting and joining himself and others back together, he may travel and escape through small spaces.

Possessing a mysterious mastery of equestrianism, horses tend to bow their heads in his presence.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

appearsIn.title: STEEL BALL RUN JoJo's Bizarre Adventure 1st STAGE

name: Osmond
description:
__Familiar:__ A Mouse, Motsognir

The headmaster of Tristain Academy of Magic, and an old lecher. Enjoys smoking.

name: Damien
description: Damien first appears in Season 4 Episode 1, Louise of the Holy Kingdom. He is either the brother of Jack, Jeannette, and Bleu by blood or by the strong bond they shared as Gallia Knights.  Damien is capable of commanding respect of his siblings, and seems to be the leader of their four person group. Little is known about his powers, except for his extraordinary gift of alchemy transmutation. He also use a ordinary wand.  In The Desert Elf, he can transform the ground into a deep pool of water using a thing that looks like odd trumpet with a button without showing excessive movement.  He can change the particles in the ground with his trumpet thing.Eg, rock to water.  Season 4 Tabitha hire them to help with fighting the Ancient Dragon back at the school. They setup a shield around the school to stop the smaller dragons from getting into the school.

name: Vittorio Serevare
native: ヴィットーリオ・セレヴァレ
description: Vittorio Serevare is the current Pope of Romalia, and holding the title of 'St. Aegis the 32nd', the 'Shield of the Founder', and took the throne three years prior to Saito's summoning.  He is kind-hearted in that he cares for orphans and trying to increase the welfare of the commoners, but has to deal with politicking with the nobles in the process. Despite his kindness, he has his ruthless streak in doing anything and everything that is necessary for Helkeginia. Even with his ruthless streak, Vittorio is not a heartless monster.

name: Bleu
description: Bleu is a member of the Gallia Knight Army, and brother to Damien, Jack and Janette.  He is capable of leaping great distances and performing impressive acrobatic moves. Just like his older brother Jack, Bleu is a capable fighter and strong with a sword. He's seen taking down two royal guards with one swipe. Also he is a mage, he use his sword as a wand.

name: Yuki Azumi
description: [Miki's](https://anilist.co/character/354442/Miki-Azumi) younger brother.

name: Tatsu
description: A boy who would tease Koyuki in middle school.

name: Akine Atagawa
description: [Manatsu Atagawa's](https://anilist.co/character/396044/Manatsu-Atagawa) younger sister. She went to middle school with [Yuki Azumi](https://anilist.co/character/394746/Yuki-Azumi).

name: Agnes Chevalier de Milan
native: アニエス・シュヴァリエ・ド・ミラン
description: Agnès Chevalier de Milan is the captain of the Tristain Musketeer Knights and her lieutenant is Michelle. As a child, Agnès was the lone survivor from the razing of her hometown, D'Angleterre. She believes that Lishman was behind the massacre, making him her enemy.

appearsIn.title: The Familiar of Zero: "Rondo" of Princesses

name: Irukukwu
description: Sylphid is a female wind dragon and Tabitha's familiar. Her real name is Irukukwu. She looks like a mother or an older sister of Tabitha when she is the human form, but she refers to Tabitha as "Oneesama," her older sister. While she is sensible, she is sometimes childish.

appearsIn.title: The Familiar of Zero: "Rondo" of Princesses

name: Quetzalcoatl
description:
**Faction**: Spectation

Quetzalcoatl often referred to as Lucoa, is a former dragon goddess and an old friend of [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970/Tohru). She was exiled from her seat after consuming cursed liquor that led her into a scandalous affair. As a member of the spectating faction, she does not interfere with any events involving the dragons or gods. She's by far the most powerful dragon in the series.

Quetzalcoatl appears to be laid-back and carefree who is rarely seen without a smile. She is wise, kind, and nurturing who often has advice for her younger kin. As a former goddess, she is better tuned to human customs, as seen when she explains to Tohru why Kobayashi was not receptive to Tohru's initial cleaning regimen. Despite this, however, Lucoa seems to lack some sense of dignity severely. She is not above using her body as a means of getting what she wants, as shown when she attempts to use her alluring figure as an offering to [Shouta](https://anilist.co/character/120973/Shouta-Magatsuchi), hoping to allow her to stay in his home.

Quetzalcoatl lives with Shouta but does not work for her stay. The two have a complicated relationship as Shouta sees Quetzalcoatl as a succubus or demon rather than a dragon. Quetzalcoatl will often try to get Shouta's attention, but due to her massive breasts, she often ends up flustering and embarrassing him instead.

appearsIn.title: Miss Kobayashi's Dragon Maid: Valentines and Hot Springs! (Please Don't Get Your Hopes Up)

name: Elma
description:
**Faction**: Harmony

Elma is a female dragon from the Harmony faction, the opposing faction of Chaos, which [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970/Tohru) belongs to. She adopts the name Elma Joui as her human alias after she finds that she is unable to return to her world. Elma is the only dragon of the main cast who lives on her own in the human world.

Elma usually takes the form of a human woman with short black hair, large breasts, blue eyes, and a long spiral unicorn-like horn (which she can freely hide). In the anime and [Elma’s Office Lady Diary](https://anilist.co/manga/100756/Miss-Kobayashis-Dragon-Maid-Elmas-Office-Lady-Diary/), her hair also has purple tips. At work, she wears round glasses. She also wears a business suit which consists of a white shirt, light blue tie, a loose blue sweater, a grey blazer, and a dark grey knee-length skirt with light grey socks and black heels. Her casual attire in the anime consists of olive-green skin-tight trousers, a light blue jacket, a dark blue vest, and a yellow scarf. Her first outfit, which she also wears in her world while in human form, consists of a light tan scarf with a dark blue (sometimes black) leotard. She wears a purple kimono with pink piping and a dark blue sash over the leotard, with the top pulled down. She has bandages around her legs and sandals. She can be seen with a cobalt blue and turquoise tail (which she can freely hide). Sometimes, she carries around a long, brown trident.

appearsIn.title: Miss Kobayashi's Dragon Maid: Valentines and Hot Springs! (Please Don't Get Your Hopes Up)

name: Fio Piccolo
description: Fio was in America, but went to Milan to help out her grandfather Piccolo. Her grandfather is the owner of Piccolo S.P.A., where they build seaplanes. Fio is very talented and skilled for her age, and most importantly, passionate about her work.  She greatly admires Porco Rosso. Her father was once a member of Captain Marco Paggot’s unit in the Italian Air Force, and she heard wonderful stories about him. Aside from helping Porco Rosso repair his plane, she also wants to help free him from his curse.  (Source: wingsee.com)

name: Donald Curtis
description: Donald Curtis, a confident ¼ Italian ¾ American pilot, is recruited in the Flying Pirates Alliance to take out their enemy Porco Rosso. His goal in life is to become a Hollywood star and become the President of the United States.

name: Porco Rosso
description: Born Marco Pagot, Porco was an ace fighter pilot for the Italian Air Force in World War I. A curse has since given him the appearance of a pig, leading to the nickname Porco Rosso (Italian for "Red Pig"). He now operates as a bounty hunter in the Adriatic Sea, fighting air pirates in his distinctive red sea plane.

name: Gina
description: The owner of the famous Hotel Adriano. It is said that everyone, flying pirates, spies, smugglers, all behave only when Gina is around. She has a beautiful voice, and often performs at her restaurant for her guests.    She is a childhood friend of Marco Paggot. At the wedding of her first marriage, to Belenldi, Marco was the best man. Belenldi was killed while on a mission with Marco, two days after their wedding. Gina’s married twice more, all pilots, but they too were killed.    During the day, she likes to read in her private garden. She has a bet with herself concerning Marco. If Marco should come visit her in the garden during the day, then they will fall in love. Marco has yet to come visit her during the day. Instead, he only visits her restaurant at nighttime. She continues to wait.

name: Mamma Aiuto Boss
description: A flying pirate who is tough on the exterior, but very soft on the inside. When he was kidnapping kindergarten girls from a passenger ship, he decided to kidnap all of them because he didn’t think it’d be nice for them to be separated from their friends. When Fio reprimanded him for dishonouring flying pirates, he quickly bowed his head in shame. He doesn’t like Porco Rosso because Porco Rosso always gets in his way. However, when Fio told him to stop bothering Porco Rosso, he listened.

name: Grandpa Piccolo
description: Owner of Piccolo S.P.A., builder of seaplanes. He is protective of his granddaughter Fio, and constantly warns Porco Rosso to keep his hands to himself. Actually, he does trust Porco Rosso, and agreed that Fio should go with Porco Rosso for his fight with Curtis. His sons have all left Milan to look for work in other cities. He still has a lot of female relatives left in Milan and he tries to help them out by hiring them to help rebuild Porco Rosso’s seaplane.

name: Ferrarin
description: Ferrarin is a mayor of the Regia Aeronautica. He oparates the red plane MC72.

name: Komachi Hikigaya
description: [Hachiman](https://anilist.co/character/67065)'s younger sister who is very different than her brother. She's cheerful and lively and is part of her school's student council.

appearsIn.title: My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU OVA
My Youth Romantic Comedy Is Wrong, As I Expected

name: Yoshiteru Zaimokuza
description:
Zaimokuza is a student from class 2C who suffers from adolescent delusions. He displays a high interest in historical shoguns, magic, and writing (despite the fact he is a terrible writer), and video game creation. He often talks like a movie narrator or with grandiose overtones. He sometimes refers to himself and those around him in the 3rd person and involves them in his fantasy/roleplaying scenarios. 
He sees Hachiman as a friend after being paired up with him during physical education lessons. While he is annoying, he has a group of otaku friends he's on good terms with. He aims to be a light novel writer.

appearsIn.title: My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU OVA

name: Mike Moriss
description: FBI Special Agent.

name: Emma Samanda
description: Emma is an FBI agent investigating the deaths of [Joe](https://anilist.co/character/326717/Higan)'s family and partners with [Moriss](https://anilist.co/character/326720/Moriss-Mike).

name: Mari
description: Wife of [Higan](https://anilist.co/character/326717) and mother of [Ren](https://anilist.co/character/326724).

name: Ren
description: Son of [Higan](https://anilist.co/character/326717) and [Mari](https://anilist.co/character/326723).

name: Yogiri Takatou
description: A high school student who gets trapped in the alternate world with Tomochika Dannoura. He has a power that he has kept hidden most of his life, the power to force instant death.

appearsIn.title: My Instant Death Ability is Overpowered
My Instant Death Ability is So Overpowered, No One in This Other World Stands a Chance Against Me! —AΩ—

name: Tomochika  Dannoura
description: Yogiri's classmate and travel companion who he protects. She isn't compatible with the Battle Song program.

appearsIn.title: My Instant Death Ability is Overpowered
My Instant Death Ability is So Overpowered, No One in This Other World Stands a Chance Against Me! —AΩ—

name: Kenja Sion
description: A sage who summoned Yogiri's class along with the bus to the alternate world. She herself was formerly summoned into the new world and became a sage at the end of her adventure, but due to her immense magical power her common sense has lapsed somewhat since.

appearsIn.title: My Instant Death Ability is Overpowered
My Instant Death Ability is So Overpowered, No One in This Other World Stands a Chance Against Me! —AΩ—

name: Mokomoko Dannoura
description: She is Tomochika's ancestor and guardian spirit. Although she is a ghost from the Heian period, she seems to be well versed in modern culture and is casually familiar with digital technology.

appearsIn.title: My Instant Death Ability is Overpowered
My Instant Death Ability is So Overpowered, No One in This Other World Stands a Chance Against Me! —AΩ—

name: Suguru Yazaki
description: A leader in the class. He calmly assesses the situation and plans a strategy to help everyone survive. However, he sometimes makes ruthless decisions, even if it means making some sacrifices.

appearsIn.title: My Instant Death Ability is Overpowered

name: Momoyo Kakinokizaka
description: A first year student at Geidai in the oil painting program.

name: Umino
description: A second-year high school student and a member of the art club. Likes to draw bishoujo characters. Knows a lot of funny manga.

name: Kinemi Miki
description:
__Height:__ 173 cm (5'8")

An oil painter who is so kind and optimistic that she's described to be as bright as the sun. Met [Ayano](https://anilist.co/character/211378/Aizawa-Ayano) in prep school and the two have been extremely close ever since.

name: Ayano Aizawa
description: A student at Tokyo University of the Arts (Geidai) in the oil painting program. She met Kinemi in prep school and the two have been extremely close ever since.

name: Maria Hanakage
description: One of art teacher in Tokyo's National University of Fine Arts and Music, Geidai. Despite of being teacher, she is an easy-going person and always talk casually to her students.

name: Jin Seon
description: Jin is the main protagonist and the son of the murderous CEO Dongsoo Seon. Jin is a scrawny teenager with pale skin, brown hair, and a blue right eye. Because of the "accident" during his childhood, Jin's left eye was substituted with a reddish-brown glass eye, which he hides with his irregular bangs. Due to his brutal nature, while dealing with bullies and other opponents, Jin will occasionally appear bruised and cut from his fights. Even though Jin wants to be righteous and well-meaning, he has a sociopathic side that emerges in times of intense stress or anger. When this trait shows itself, he shows no fear, uses rather a foul language, and his face turns dark and menacing. When provoked into an extreme rage, Jin shows no remorse or hesitation for any violent actions he may commit in this state. He is also prone to outbursts, breakdowns, or temporary lapses of fear when he is questioned about his father, hears mention of his father, or he notices his father in action.

name: Dong-Soo Seon
description: Dongsoo Seon is the father of Jin Seon and the executive CEO of G Corporation.

name: Kyun Yoon
description: Kyun is known to be a sociable butterfly and friendly, she has a lot of morality as well as common sense. However there are times where she can be quite cold when the time calls for it.

name: Jae-Hyeok Kim
description: Manny Kim is the 'alpha' of his school, being quite popular with everyone.  He comes from a rich family, gets good grades, and is quite good at fighting. He and Jin Seon have a very complicated relationship.

name: Saito Houjou
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm

[Akane Sakuramori](https://anilist.co/character/248384/Sakuramori-Akane)'s classmate and natural enemy. He has trouble getting along with Akane, always quarreling with her. He's smart and always places at the top of the class, but he lacks common sense in his daily life. Married Akane so he could succeed his grandfather to control the Houjou Group.

appearsIn.title: I'm Getting Married to a Girl I Hate in My Class
I Got Married to the Girl I Hate Most in Class

name: Akane Sakuramori
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm

Saito's classmate and natural enemy. When she's not talking, she's a model-class beauty, but when she sees Saito, she's always fighting with him. She has a strong competitive spirit, is hardworking, and has a family-oriented side. She has a dream that she wants to fulfill even if she has to marry Saito.

appearsIn.title: I'm Getting Married to a Girl I Hate in My Class
I Got Married to the Girl I Hate Most in Class

name: Shisei Houjou
description:
__Height:__ 142 cm

A cousin and classmate of [Saito](https://anilist.co/character/248386/Houjou-Saito). She has the appearance of a doll and an attractive cool expression. She is a good friend of Saito, who grew up with her like a brother and sister.

appearsIn.title: I'm Getting Married to a Girl I Hate in My Class
I Got Married to the Girl I Hate Most in Class

name: Himari Ishikura
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm

A classmate of Akane and Saito. She is gyaru, but despite her flamboyant appearance she has a warm personality. She cares about Akane and Saito, who fight all the time.

description: Saito's grandfather.

description: Akane's grandmother.

name: Maho Sakuramori
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm

A junior who transferred to [Saito Houjou](https://anilist.co/character/248386/Houjou-Saito)'s high school.

A girl who possesses both childlike innocence and a captivating aura. She's free-spirited and clingy, and she loves [Akane](https://anilist.co/character/248384/Sakuramori-Akane) very much.

appearsIn.title: I'm Getting Married to a Girl I Hate in My Class

name: Matsu
description: A computer genius and hacker that lives in a secret room of Izumo Inn, and was once mistaken for a ghost by Kusano. She becomes Minato's third Sekirei. She also likes to shorten people's names and substitute tan for san.   Matsu uses a vast network of satellites and spying devices to gather large amounts of information and has even succeeded in hacking the MBI mainframe computer. She refers to herself as the 'Wisdom' Sekirei. However, despite her high intellect, she is very perverse - she uses her resources to peep on people and often tries to 'experiment' with Minato and so most call her the 'Shameless' Sekirei.  Matsu serves primarily as Minato's unofficial 'strategist', rarely venturing outside of the Inn and using her vast network of information to aid him.  Matsu has the power to access and analyze any electronic device on a telepathic level, but does not have the power to control them. Her name means a "pine" literally.    Miya's nickname for Matsu is "Hentai-Glasses".              (Source:Wikipedia)

name: Musubi
description:
__Height:__ 161cm 
__Weight:__48kg 
__Three sizes:__ B 97 / W 58 / H 89 
__Personality:__ Musubi is very naive, positive and insightful, often says things she does not understand, and is probably the most 'childish' of Minato's Sekireis, even more so than Kusano. She is, however, very eager when it comes into confronting other Sekireis (to the point where her eyes gleam and sparkle at the prospect of fighting another) but never fails to be polite as she would usually asks for permission first before fighting them. __Abilities and Powers:__ Musubi plays a crucial part in Minato's team and is always seen participating in Sekirei battles due to her desire to fight strong opponents. Musubi's abilities are hand-to-hand combat which utilizes her greatly enhanced strength. This is enforced by the heavy combat gloves she always wears. Her attacks and techniques are mostly punches and kicks which are supported by her ridiculous strength. Something else notable about Musubi is that she also has a good amount of stamina and endurance evidenced during her first fight with Benitsubasa. She took several hits during that fight and was still able to stand up to Benitsubasa's surprise who thought that she went down after one hit. Even the Disciplinary Squads Ashikabi acknowledges her strength and came to the conclusion that Benitsubasa would have a hard fight without the Norito against Musubi. (Source: Wikipedia, Sekirei Wikia)

The heroine. Minato's first Sekirei.

name: Tsukiumi
description:
__Height:__ 165cm  
__Weight:__ 47kg  
__Sekirei No:__ 09  
__Three sizes:__ B 94 / W 57 / H 88  

She is Minato's fourth Sekirei and her power is water (derived from her name "umi" which means the sea). She contacted him over a dream saying that she would kill him, but when they finally met she was persuaded into becoming his Sekirei. ( ch.22-23) She says that she is Minato's legal wife. At the beginning, she wanted to be the strongest to demonstrate that Ashikabi were not necessary to win but later she confides to Miya that her only goal is to get stronger to protect and live together with her Ashikabi forever.  Tsukiumi is a Sekirei with a tsundere personality and the most aggressive of Minato's party and has a very short temper; she rarely smiles. She was introduced as the first Sekirei that wanted to become the strongest without the help of an Ashikabi. She even stated that she was willing to kill her future Ashikabi if she would ever react to him/her, due to her hate towards Ashikabis[4]. She changed a lot after getting winged by Minato and easily gets jealous when Minato comes in contact with other women, due to her feelings for her Ashikabi. She proclaimed herself to be Minato's legal wife which caused a rivalry between her and Minato's remaining Sekirei, in general Musubi with who she often competes to gain the right to be called 'Minato's legal wife'. Aside from this, she's gets along well with Minato's other Sekirei.  

(Source: Wikipedia, Sekirei Wikia)

name: Minato Sahashi
description:
__Height:__ 173 cm

19 year old student who's just found out he's failed his exam for the second time to get into college. He's currently lives in Tokyo with no close friends and he's down in the dumps, until he bumps into Musubi. Musubi changes his life when she decides that he is her ashikabi (patner) and becomes a winged sekirei. Not only that but he finds out that Musubi is a sekirei who must battle other sekireis within Tokyo. Now Minato must keep this a secret while he tries to handle a new life with Musubi.   __History__ Not much is known about Minato's past, except that Matsu states that he originally is a native from Wakayama and was raised by a typical family. He had top scores from elementary to high school. We also get to know from Yukari, that Minato would always help her out in the past when she would get lost in dark places like a forest, even though he as child feared those places himself. He would often carry her out.    __Personality__ Minato is highly intelligent, capable of devising ways on how to make better use of Sekirei abilities and is able to execute strategies in order to beat the opponent in Sekirei battles. Despite his capabilities, Minato is an insecure individual in the beginning who has a passive personality and often lacks the confidence to go against his own Sekirei when they decide on something.  (Source: Wikipedia, Sekirei Wikia)

name: Kusano
description: She is often called Kuu-chan but was referred to as the "Green Girl". She is Minato's second Sekirei. She calls him Onii-chan (Japanese term for 'Older brother'). She has power over plants-to make them grow. She does not like fighting or quarrels and she can be seen stopping them when they start. she said that she wishes to be Minato's wife when she grows up.     (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Kaoru Seo
description: Seo is a rough character that gets dominated by his two Sekirei Hikari and Hibiki.  He usually takes on odd jobs around the city just to survive, and is helpful at times even if his rough exterior doesn't show it.  He is an old friend of Miya's deceased husband, and is deathly afraid of her.

name: Yomi
description: Yomi is the first Sekirei that Musubi defeats.  She wields a Death Scythe and uses wind element.

name: Haihane
description: Haihane is a member of the Disciplinary Squad. She wears a tattered kimono over her bandaged body, has dishevelled grey hair and narrow eyes giving her a slightly Grim Reaper-like appearance.Even though she has dark or gothic appearance, it does not reflect her personality. She is more cheerful and calmer than Benitsubasa, who is a target of her teasing.    Her power is her gauntlets, that have scythe-like claws for the fingers.    Her Ashikabi is Natsuo Ichinomi.

name: Homura
description: Minato's sixth Sekirei. At first he was the self-proclaimed 'Sekirei guardian', he often interrupted Hikari and Hibiki's fights to side with the unwinged Sekirei. Homura is said to be a Sekirei prototype (his power and gender are unstable), however he continues to think and act as a male even after his body started becoming female. He lives at Izumo Inn as "Kagari", a popular host club entertainer and no one except Miya, Uzume, Matsu and Kazehana know his secret identity. He's later revealed to be Sekirei #6 and his ability is the basic element, "Fire". By the end of the second stage he was the last unwinged Sekirei. The MBI director sent a message to all Ashikabi that the last unwinged Sekirei was in the north area, and became hunted by them. Homura was been reacting to Minato, which caused 'him' great stress over his potential Ashikabi being male, although Homura almost kissed Minato once. Homura has left Izumo Inn to go after Minaka Takehito (game master and head of the MBI) in order to bring an end to the Sekirei game. After being cornered by other ashikabi who wanted to wing him, Homura decides to commit suicide by igniting his body with his own flames, but is saved in the last time by Minato and his Sekirei crew. Unable to accept Homura's will to sacrifice himself, Minato forcibly kisses him.  Source: Wikipedia

name: Akitsu
description: Akitsu, is a 'disused' Sekirei; Homura refers to her as 'Scrap Number'. She can't be winged by an Ashikabi or use the Norito (she is useless from MBI point of view). Akitsu's power is very strong, allowing her to fight on par with Sekirei like Homura (they have encountered each other 3 times so far). Despite the fact that she can't be winged, she considers Hayato Mikogami her Ashikabi because he took her in and she fears being thrown away again.  Like her power, Akitsu has a very cold and melancholic personality. She speaks very little in a neutral tone and appears to be forgetful because at one point it was noticed she wore no panties; it was first assumed she was ordered to do so by Hayato Mikogami, but then she revealed it was simply because she forgot to put them on. She also stated she was envious of Homura because for him it would still be possible to get winged and thus have an Ashikabi, something she can never achieve. She also appears to be polite and follow orders without hesitation. Akitsu also seems to posses some knowledge on subjects like the first generation Disciplinary Squad.  (Sekirei Wiki)

name: Aimi Tabata
description:
__Nationality:__ Japanese
__Occupation:__ High School Student 

Aimi Tabata is one of Hiyori's friends from school. Not much has been shown about her personality. However, it is known that she is kind and supportive of Hiyori. She seems to be reasonable, calm, and mature. She often worries for Hiyori when she falls asleep (due to her soul slipping out of her body).

name: Mayu
description:
__Race:__ Shinki

Mayu has a very honest personality and a strong sense of justice. During the time she worked for Yato, she couldn’t stand his attitudes because not only he always lazed around, but he also often talked about killing and didn’t seem to care about humans that needed his help. Because of this she complained a lot and always insulted and badmouthed Yato after she quit.

Despite her attitudes towards Yato, she also respects Yato and cares for him. She often gets worried whenever Yato got into trouble even when she is serving Tenjin. At one point she volunteered herself to help Yato, who was impure due to Yukine’s actions.

name: Aiha
description: Aiha (藍巴) is one of Bishamonten's Shinki. As a Shinki, she takes the form of a medieval suit of armour with a long skirt.

name: Ai Enma
description: The primary protagonist of the series. With long, flowing hair and red eyes, she is a spiritual entity with a tragic past, who lives in a world of eternal twilight with her grandmother, and is the one who receives and delivers vengeance on her clients' behalf. She normally wears a black seifuku, or sailor uniform (which is usually worn during winter months), but always wears a kimono with floral designs when delivering the vengeance of a client. Ai started her career as the Hell Girl by her own act of vengeance on the villagers who sentenced her to a sacrificial death. Her eyes turned red arguably at the point where Sentaro (her childhood soulmate who gave in under the villagers' pressure to bury her alive) gave the first shovel of soil onto her face. She broke out of her grave after a while, and took revenge on the entire village with her wrath, burning it to the ground. Her task of fulfilling other people's vengeance and ferrying people to Hell is her punishment, a task which she has performed for the better part of 400 years. Although this task is presented as atonement, it is unknown whether she will ever be freed of it. Since she has done this for so long, she initially seemed to have become emotionless, numbed, as is shown by her expressionless face. Wanyūdō noted she still had feelings, though, although she did not express them strongly, and it was later revealed that Ai had been ordered to close her heart by the Spider.

name: Hone Onna
description: Assistant of Enma Ai, and appears to be a beautiful woman in a kimono with its obi tied in front--the trademark of a prostitute. She becomes the red straw doll when necessary by tossing her red obi strap over her neck. Hone Onna, along with Ichimoku Ren, researches the people who make a contract and the ones they have a grudge against. Hone Onna usually infiltrates human society in casual clothing to investigate cases, on these occasions she tends to use the psudonym "Sone Anna". On certain occasions, she uses throwing knives as weapons; Hone Onna is apparently extremely skilled with these weapons. Her knives seem to carry some mystic charge, since they can be used to quickly dispatch supernatural enemies. Hone Onna also seems to have some skill as a contortionist, which allows her to squeeze into very small places. Getting out of those same places, however, is an area she is less talented in. Hone Onna seems to suffer from mild vanity; she can be quite offended when she is addressed as obaasan ('old lady' or 'auntie'; a Japanese form of address for any woman of middle age and above). She can expose the bones in her body, scaring the target of the grudge; the name Hone Onna actually means bone woman. In episode 8 of Futakomori she jokingly reveals that she is "200 years old". A flashback scene revealed that she was a Geisha originally named Tsuyu who was betrayed by a fellow Geisha Kiyo when attempting to escape.

name: Ren Ichimoku
description: An assistant of Enma Ai who appears to be a handsome young man with one eye covered by hair. He can manifest a single, very large eye that can be directed anywhere, allowing him to see through walls. This manifests as an eye on a wall. The large eye can also be used as a weapon, by projecting intense flashes of light. When so required, Ichimoku Ren becomes a blue straw doll by kissing a pendant he wears around his neck. He is sometimes referred to as "Moku" or "Ichimoto Ren".    (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Hajime Shibata
description: A former journalist who now earns money by blackmailing celebrities with evidence of their scandals. He began to investigate Jigoku Tsuushin merely out of interest, but becomes more heavily involved once he realizes that it's more than just a rumor and people are actually being dragged into Hell. Furthermore, his daughter Tsugumi seems to have a mysterious connection with Enma Ai that allows her to see anything significant that Ai sees. (Wikipedia)

name: Tsugumi Shibata
description: Hajime's daughter who often refers to him as "Hajime-chan". She sees Ai one day and has had a mysterious connection with her ever since. At first, she reports everything she sees through Ai to Hajime, but as the series progresses, she becomes more reluctant to do so as she begins to disagree with her father on whether they should try to stop Ai or not.       When first introduced, Tsugumi a 7 year old girl with brown hair and brown eyes. During this time, she would often braid her hair into two ponytails, with black hair bands and a red clip holding her bangs.        (Source: Wikipedia, Hell Girl Fandom)

name: Wanyuudou
description: Assistant of Enma Ai, who becomes the black straw doll with a red string around its neck, the string probably originating as the red scarf he wears in human form. He also frequently takes the form of a burning wheel on Ai's coach when she goes to the human world to claim a soul. The coach incidentally bears the same black flame-crest that appears on the chest of those people who contract with the Hell Girl. At all other times, Wanyuudou appears as an older man whose eyes remain mostly shut, wearing a fisherman's hat and fairly old-fashioned Japanese clothing. Despite appearing quite mild-mannered at most times, Wanyuudou possesses considerable skills in martial arts. Wanyuudou's name means "A wheel entering the road" a reference to the flaming wheel form he most commonly assumes. In episode 12 of Futakomori it is revealed that he is from the Samurai era and had been the driver for a princess' entourage, and failed to save them with all dying in the process. As a result, he became a yōkai terrorizing people in the form of a flaming wheel. It is Wanyuudou who first states he and his two colleagues owe Ai a grave debt because she saved them from falling into Hell. (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Remia
description: She is Myu's mother.

appearsIn.title: Arifureta: From Commonplace to World's Strongest Season 3
Arifureta: From Commonplace to World's Strongest

name: Suzu Taniguchi
description: One of the students from Japan who got involved in the Summoning Incident. She was part of Kouki Amanogawa's party during the training in Great Orcus Labyrinth and is also Ryuutarou Sakagami's girlfriend.

appearsIn.title: Arifureta: From Commonplace to World's Strongest Season 3

name: Ryuutarou Sakagami
description:
One of the students from Japan who got involved in the Summoning Incident, and ended up in Tortus along with his other classmates. He is the childhood friend of [Kouki Amanogawa](https://anilist.co/character/218390/Kouki-Amanogawa), [Shizuku Yaegashi](https://anilist.co/character/141266/Shizuku-Yaegashi) and [Kaori Shirasaki](https://anilist.co/character/132849/Kaori-Shirasaki); and was part of Kouki's party during the training in Great Orcus Labyrinth. He is also the boyfriend of Suzu Taniguchi.

(Source: Arifureta Wiki)

appearsIn.title: Arifureta: From Commonplace to World's Strongest Season 3

name: Miledi Reisen
description: An atavist and one of the leaders of the Liberators prior to them being wiped out.

appearsIn.title: Arifureta: From Commonplace to World's Strongest Season 3

name: Godou Kusanagi
description: The main character of the series and one of only 7 Campione. Originally a retired middle school baseball player, after his grandfather asked him to return a stone tablet to a friend in Sardinia named Lucretia Zola a series of events take place in which he kills the god Verethragna, a Persian god of Victory. Due to a curse, any god killed by a mortal, that mortal shall obtain the abilities of the killed god. These are the people known as Campione.  Godou obtains the abilities of Verethragna's 10 forms: The Wind, Bull, White Stallion, Camel, Boar, The Youth, Raptor, Ram, Goat and The Warrior.  Each of these forms give Godou a different ability; however each also has a condition for activation.  He's very uncomfortable with having Erica, Yuri and Liliana competing for his affection and even tries to distance himself from them, even though having a harem is one of the Campione's privilege.

name: Yuri Mariya
description: A part of the Japanese Magician's Society (History Compilation Committee) in an elite group known as the Hime-Miko. A miko with a strong Spirit Vision which allows her to obtain visions from objects.  Originallly fearful of Godou due to her previous encounter with the Campione Marquis Voban. She later opens up to and falls for him, becoming one of his allies.  Touma, her guardian often calls her "Princess."

name: Erica Blandelli
native: エリカ・ブランデッリ
description: A member of 'Copper Black Cross' - a magician organization based in Milan.  Holding the rank of Great Knight and the title of Diavolo Rosso she is a magic swordsmen that through coincidence meets Godou and assists him while he is in Sardinia.  Using her weapon Cuore de Leone an enchanted weapon summoned by her known as the king of lions.  Originally wary of Godou however becomes attached to him. Her personality likes to keep herself in control of her own situation thus she can be very forceful in her affection however she truly cares for Godou. Even allowing for other women to love him on the condition that in Godous heart SHE is always No. 1.  She sleeps naked and she also refers to herself as the "Red Devil."

name: Liliana Kranjčar
native: リリアナ・クラニチャール
description: A member of "Bronze Black Cross," a magician organization based in Milan. Known as Erica's rival, she also holds the rank of Great Knight. Wielding her sword Il Maestro, her swordsmanship is on par with Erica; however, her true strength lies in Witchcraft.  She has fairy-like beauty and a strong sense of duty. She falls for Godou and swears as a knight she will serve him for eternity. She also like to write romance novels in secret (though Erica knows and constantly blackmails her with them).  Liliana was a member of the magical association descended from the Knights Templar called Bronze-Black Cross, and a childhood friend and rival of Erica's, the pair having met at the age of two, and both of them earning their knighthood at the age of twelve. As part of the tradition, shortly after earning their knighthood, both traveled to gain Magic swords for themselves at the Saint Gilardino Monastery outside of Florence, Italy. There, they first encountered Salvatore Doni, just after he had become a Campione. While traveling with him, they encountered the retired Great Knight Saint Raffaello, the only knight to gain two swords from the Monastery, and one of Doni's teachers.

name: Verethragna
description: Verethragna is a battle-loving god and is willing to do anything to find a worthy opponent. He even went as far as to revive Melqart just so that he could fight him. He further gave one of his incarnation to Godou to test him and strengthen his opposition.

name: Ama no Murakumo no Tsurugi
description: Ama no Murakumo no Tsurugi (Sword of the Gathering Clouds of Heaven), also known as Kusanagi no Tsurugi (Grass-Cutting Sword), is a legendary black Japanese sword, and part of the Imperial Regalia of Japan. It was formerly the property of the former Heretic God Susanoo and considered a demigod.  Ama no Murakumo no Tsurugi is a demi-god of Steel and has shown the Authority of Wind control, and the ability to enhance the wielder to a point where they can surpass the abilities of a Great Knight. It can also possess its wielder when they are in the Netherworld. It's suggested that both of these require the power of Divine Possession to accomplish though.    (Source: Campione! Wiki)

name: Athena
description: The goddess of wisdom in Greek Mythology and the daughter of Zeus.  She is in fact a snake deity associated with Medusa and an Earth and Death Goddess.  Athena appears like a little girl due to being incomplete and seeks the Gorgoneion to complete herself and plunge the world into eternal darkness.

name: Perseus
description: Perseus is a Legendary Dragon Killer, a rouge god, the hero Perseus. He kills any dragons that he can find, not caring what the after math would be from destroying a dragon. According to him, slaying dragons is his duty. He rides on Pegasus. He uses a sword and a bow and arrow. He also posses the ability to seal the authorities of the god Verethragna.

name: Shizuka Kusanagi
description: Godou's little sister, who is in her 3rd year of middle school. Also a member of the Tea Ceremony Club along with Yuri.  Worried that her brother is becoming like their grandfather (a natural player), she is very strict with him to try prevent this. However it is also suggested that her being strict with her brother is actually a cover up for her jealousy as she may have a brother complex with Godou.

name: Lucretia Zola
description: Lucretia appears to be a playful sort, given to pranks of various kinds, though she appears willing to help people out when needed. She calls herself Godou's 'foreign wife,' but that appears more to be a joke than any actual romantic interest in Godou.  (Source: Campione! Wiki)

name: Rickert
description: Rickert was the youngest in the Band of the Hawk, being merely a child.

name: Nina
description: A young, reckless prostitute. Nina is a member of Luca's group of travelling prostitutes. During her time at Albion, she dated Joachim, a young refugee. At one time she was a member of a heretic cult group, who held orgies in a cave, worshipping the Goddess of Fire. During her ordeal in the cave, Nina contracted a disease similar to tuberculosis.  Soon after the Tower of Conviction was destroyed, she apologised to Luca for all the trouble she had caused, but soon left afterwards with Joachim, who survived the fall from the cliffs.

name: Zodd
description: Also known as Nosferatu Zodd, or Zodd the Immortal, an apostle who has lived for three centuries fighting countless battles in search of worthy opponents. Zodd has the ability to transform from his human-like form into a more menacing creature, resembling that of a minotaur with the face and tail of a tiger along with a pair of bat-like wings that he can retract and grow at will. Zodd first encountered and defeated Guts and Griffith during a castle raid, ultimately deciding to spare them upon realizing Griffith's crimson behelit and Guts' inevitable fate. Zodd has had a long standing rivalry with Skull Knight, along with Guts as he increasingly became a more capable opponent.

name: The Skull Knight
description: The Skull Knight is one of the most mysterious and prolific characters introduced in Berserk, a towering warrior dressed in full armor whose ornaments, especially his helmet, are shaped as parts of a human skeleton, hence his moniker, who rides a massive, ghostly black horse. Though ominous and macabre, he is an enemy of the Godhand and its acolytes, hunting down Apostles and devouring their Behelits; especially bitter is his rivalry with Zodd the Immortal, whom he was often showed to overwhelm with ease.   He wields a powerful sword that, when stuck down his throat, becomes a terrible, Behelit-coated blade capable of slashing rifts through reality itself, thus allowing the Skull Knight to move freely around the world or even between different dimensions.   This enigmatic knight saved Guts in more than one occasion, notably during the infamous Eclipse which saw Griffith become a member of the Hand of God or when Slan almost slaughtered him, though he never explained why, simply declaring that the Struggler (the way he calls Guts) has to keep following his fate. He was the wearer of the Berserker's Armor, and knew the witch Flora. During the duel between Griffith and Ganishka he suddenly appeared out of thin air through a dimensional rift, trying to land a fatal blow on the Hawk, only to see it diverted on the writhing body of the Kushan Emperor.

name: Liao Diao He
description:
He Liao Diao is the last known descendent of the Kyuumei Mountain Tribe, which was destroyed in the war with Yang Duanhe, king of the Qin mountains. As a result of this, she moved to Kokuhi village, a place of outlaws in which she eventually encounters and befriends Ying Zheng and Li Xin.

She becomes an expert in blowing poisonous needles using a hollow bamboo stem acquired following the defeat of the assassin Muta by Xin.  It is initially assumed by Xin, Zheng and Bi that Diao is a boy, however it is revealed early on that she is a girl after she is wounded in a skirmish with their pursuers.

She remains with Xin after they part ways with Zheng and she cares for their home during some of Xin's early campaigns before heading to strategy academy, where she is taught by Shou Hei Kun. Her expertise result in her eventual appointment as lead strategist of the Hi Shin Unit . One of the most notable displays of her strategic prowess was during the battle of Koku You Hill.

name: Xin Li
description: The hero of the story. A war orphan who aims to become the "World's Greatest General". He later meets Zheng Ying, the future first king that would rule all of China.

name: Zheng Ying
description: The young king of Qin who bears a striking resemblance to Piao. Later becomes Qin Shi Huang.

name: Lei Qiang
description: A member of a legendary assassin clan called "Chi You" that is exceptional in combat and uses the notorious Dance of Death. She fights with a sword named "Lu Seui".

name: Mu Li
description: One of the 3 great heavens generals of Zhao.

name: You Long
description: You Long is one of the squad leaders of the Hi Shin Unit. Later, a 100-men unit commander in Hi Shin Unit.

name: Jio Ba
description:
Jio Ba is a commander in the Duanghe Yang Army and one of the most notable warriors of the Chouga Tribe.

Ba Jio was the only survivor from his tribe after a battle at a very young age. After a few years of living in the wild, he became a beast in human form. This would lead to confrontation with Duanhe Yang when she was on her way to conquer neighboring tribes. After losing a fight against Duanhe Yang, she gave him an option of dying as a beast or becoming her companion. This led to him being accepted into her tribe and over time he was able to speak multiple languages and become a powerful warrior.

name: Qing
description: Qing comes from the same village as Xin, Dao Wei and Ping Wei.

name: Hu Lun
description: Po Lian's subordinate, one of Four Heavenly Kings.

name: Taiga Nagatoro
description:
Nagatoro's older brother.

It is implied that he had a hand in teaching Nagatoro to fight.

appearsIn.title: Don't Toy With Me, Miss Nagatoro

name: Takenori Akagi
description:
__Year:__ 3rd Year 
__Height:__ 197 cm 
__Jersey Number:__ #4 
__Position:__ Center 

Takenori Akagi is the captain of the Shohoku basketball team and [Haruko](https://anilist.co/character/8485/Akagi-Haruko)'s older brother. Despite at first not thinking too much of [Sakuragi](https://anilist.co/character/310/Sakuragi-Hanamichi) (who addresses him as "Gori" for gorilla due to his immense physical presence), he actually realizes Sakuragi's potential as a basketball player. Serious and disciplined, Akagi's dream is to lead Shohoku to the national championship. His determination is shown in the match against Kainan, where he played on despite a serious injury to his ankle. Akagi considers [Uozumi](https://anilist.co/character/12867/Uozumi-Jun) of Ryonan to be his biggest rival, though their rivalry is not antagonistic; indeed, there is respect that borders on friendship.  

Akagi differs from the other starters in two respects. First, he is the most academically talented out of all them and is considered a model student. After the loss to Aiwa knocks Shohoku out of the Nationals, Akagi leaves the team along with Kogure to study for the college entrance exams. In contrast, the other four had to beg their teacher to be given the chance to retake some exams they had flunked; they would otherwise have been disqualified from playing in the Nationals for having failed too many classes.

name: Hisashi Mitsui
description:
__Year:__ 3rd Year 
__Height:__ 184 cm (6 ft ½ in) 
__Shoe Brand:__ Asics 
__Jersey Number:__ 14 
__Position:__ Shooting Guard 

Before joining Shohoku, Mitsui Hisashi was an MVP for Takeishi Junior High. Despite having opportunities to join more prestigious high schools like Ryonan, he choose to go to Shohoku because of [Coach Anzai](https://anilist.co/character/12862/Anzai-Mitsuyoshi); Anzai had given him the courage to win in the Junior High tournament by encouraging him during the last seconds of the match. However, an injury to his left knee in a training session interrupted his basketball career. An imprudent early return to the basketball court reinjured the knee more severely, leading to a basketball hiatus of over a year.  Although he eventually healed, he was embittered by his exclusion from the court, and Mitsui quit basketball and became the leader of a gang. His gang got in a fight with Miyagi, and during the fight Miyagi beat Mitsui senseless before taking a beating himself. Afterwards, Mitsui attempted to ruin the basketball team by instigating them into fighting with his gang, as the team would have been banned from competition for fighting. In the end, Sakuragi's own gang - Yohei, Takamiya, Ohkusu and Noma - voluntarily took the blame for the fight, and Mitsui was filled with remorse when he saw Anzai again. He rejoined the team and vowed never to fight again.

name: Ryouta Miyagi
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm (5'6)
__Position:__ Point Guard (PG)

He joined the basketball team because of his love for the game in the first place. But soon it seems that he is also playing for the love of his life [Ayako](https://anilist.co/character/23827/Ayako), the team manager. Although Ryonan's coach asked him to join the Ryonan Basketball Team, Miyagi chose for Shohoku because of [Anzai](https://anilist.co/character/12862/Anzai-Mitsuyoshi). Miyagi is a problem kid, he gets into fights a lot and gets himself beaten up.

Miyagi is a smart but kinda rude person, who is only nice and sweet to Ayako. He tried to date other girls to forget Ayako, but he failed to. So he can be a very sensitive person too. Miyagi is a bit short-tempered sometimes and hates when people make fun of his height.

name: Kaede Rukawa
description:
__Height:__ 187 cm (6'2")
__Position:__ Small Forward, SF

Kaede Rukawa is Sakuragi's rival as well as almost his opposite; he is attractive to girls, skilled at basketball, and very cold and unfeeling. The only traits they share are that they are not academically inclined and good fighters. He regards Sakuragi as an idiot and both normally fight. Actually, he knows Sakuragi can put his talents to a better use, but is ashamed to see the immaturity with which he deals with things. His hobby is sleeping, and is usually seen asleep whenever he's not on the court; he can even ride his bike while asleep often crashing with objects when doing so. Waking Rukawa from a nap is considered unforgivable, since he will almost automatically beat up the culprit. Unsurprisingly, he has also been in his fair share of off-court fights, but can hold his own. Rukawa's goal is to be the best high school player in Japan, and he considers Sendoh of Ryonan to be his greatest rival. A fact being that he is often nicknamed the "super-rookie", the "ace of Shohoku", even.   

Rukawa is extremely good at basketball, and possesses a wide range of skills to complement his height, athleticism and drive to win. Despite being merely a first-year high school player, he is the undisputed ace of Shohoku's team. In the Kanagawa Interhigh Tournament, he was named one of the top five players, the only first year player so honored.

name: Hanamichi Sakuragi
description:
__Height:__ 189.2 cm
__Jersey Number:__ #10
__Position:__ Power Forward

At the beginning, Sakuragi was a slacker, always trying to ask girls out but getting constantly rejected (the 50th rejection occurring at the start of the series). He then met Akagi Haruko, with whom he fell in love immediately. This passion led to him joining the Shohoku basketball team. However, as a complete beginner, he was not able to keep up with the rest of the team at first despite his physical attributes (great height, athleticism, stamina, speed and leaping ability). He regards himself as a genius though, with self-confidence that borders on arrogance. His most recognizable trait is his red hair, though he shaves his head as reparation for an error that led to the loss against Kainan.  At first, Sakuragi was known for his poor basketball skills as a beginner; in his first few official matches, he fouled out every game. However, his basketball skills advanced throughout the series. First he developed his basic skills, such as dribbling and layups. Then, trained by Akagi, he became a formidable rebounder; his rebounding became his claim to fame throughout the latter half of the series. He also is seen more than once defining the match for Shohoku in the last seconds, for instance, by dunking a ball that Akagi would have missed in the league round match with Ryonan. His jump shooting was then developed by Coach Anzai, who had him make 20,000 shots in a week.

name: Yayoi Aida
description: Yayoi Aida is Hikoichi's older sister, who works as a reporter for a weekly basketball magazine. Even though her brother plays for Ryonan, she is mostly designated to cover Shohoku matches, in which she is always impressesed about Shohoku players' performances, as they mostly play stronger opponents like Kainan or Sannoh. In the National Championship though, she gets to watch Sannoh's exercise training routines. She is almost always accompanied by a bubbly trainee called Nakamura, who does the driving when they need to go from gym to gym even though he drives slowly, as he had just gotten his driving license.She also has a huge crush on Ryonan ace Sendoh.   (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Ryoji Ikegami
description:
__Year:__ 3rd Year 
__Height:__ 183 cm 
__Jersey Number:__ #5 
__Position:__ Small Forward

As pointed out by Taoka himself, Ikegami is the best defender in the team. In the last half of the Shohoku-Ryonan match he was asked to mark Mitsui and he did manage shut him down(only for some time). He leaves the team with Uozomi after the loss to Shohoku knocks Ryonan out of the National Championship run. Unlike Uozomi however, who starts to get emotional in encouraging his teammates to bring Ryonan further the next time around, Ikegami is cool and collected.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Kiyota Nobunaga
description:
__Year:__ 1st yr
__Height:__ 178 cm
__Jersey Number:__ #10
__Position:__ SF

Nobunaga Kiyota is what could be called the personification of arrogance (something like Kainan's parallel to Sakuragi, only slightly more skilled during the events of the Kanagawa Trials). He is always bragging about how he's the real star rookie of Kanagawa, instead of Rukawa. However, he tends to underestimate other teams, especially Shohoku, and this can lead to embarrassing situations, such as when Akagi flattened him with a dunk, and also when Sakuragi faked past him and scored. Kiyota likes to call Hanamichi "Red-furred Monkey" while Hanamichi calls him "Wild Monkey." Despite being so arrogant, Kiyota has a high level of respect towards his teammates, especially towards his captain Maki.    Kiyota is known for his leaping ability and ball-handing skills. Despite being only 178 cm, he can dunk and block shots quite regularly. He memorably dunked over Uozumi during Kainan's match against Ryonan despite Uozumi's height. Kiyota is the only starter for Kainan who is a 1st year.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Jun Uozumi
description:
__Year:__ 3rd Year 
__Height:__ 202 cm
__Jersey Number:__ #4 
__Position:__ Center  

Jun Uozomi is the team captain. He considers Takenori Akagi his rival, but has never managed to personally beat him, although Ryonan has beaten Shohoku on occasion. However their rivalry is not antagonistic; indeed, there is respect that borders on friendship. When Akagi was outplayed and discouraged in the match against Sannoh, Uozumi was able to restore Akagi's spirits. After the loss to Shohoku in the Kanagawa prefectural trials eliminated Ryonan from national competition, Uozumi left the team to train as a chef, since his family owns a ramen restaurant; Sendoh succeeds him as team captain. Sakuragi likes to refer to him as "Boss Monkey" because he is as well-built as Akagi, and even taller.  

Uozumi's size and power are unmatched in high school basketball. However, he started as a very weak player, and was ridiculed and bullied by his upperclassmen for only having height but very little of everything else. Ryonan's coach Taoka Moichi encouraged him to continue playing though, and eventually Uozumi developed into becoming a fearsome center. He is considered as one of the top centers in the Kanagawa prefecture. However, his bad temper and lack of control in game situations has led to serious consequences for his team on more than one occasion; during the second match with Shohoku, Hanamichi tricked him into committing four fouls and almost got him ejected.

name: Haruko Akagi
description:
__Year:__ 1st Year  

Haruko Akagi is the younger sister of Takenori Akagi and the love interest of Hanamichi Sakuragi who was responsible for uncovering his potential in basketball.

She is a kind, sweet and friendly girl with a captivating personality who is always around to cheer on the players, especially her brother Takenori Akagi, who is extremely protective of her and taught her the basics of basketball, and Hanamichi Sakuragi, whom she considers her best friend. Haruko often appears at matches together with Sakuragi's cohorts and her two best friends, Fujii and Matsui. She, like most girls in Shohoku, has a strong obsession for Kaede Rukawa, although he never reciprocates her feelings and, later , she acknowledges that he will not love her the way she wants him to and tries to let go of her crush, however unsuccessfully.

name: Takao Kasuga
description: A middle school student who has a huge love for literature and a crush on [Saeki](https://anilist.co/character/62797/Saeki-Nanako). It is because of his infatuation of Saeki that he steals her gym uniform. [Sawa Nakamura](https://anilist.co/character/62793/Nakamura-Sawa), an isolated loner in Kasuga's class witnesses him stealing the uniform. She then blackmails him into forming a contract, tying them together as "friends."

name: Sawa Nakamura
description: A classmate of Kasuga who is portrayed as alone, isolated, and aloof. She has no friends. Nakamura witnesses Kasuga stealing Saeki's uniform and blackmails him to become her friend and form a contract. She displays hostile and rude behavior toward Kasuga, but can often be seen enjoying herself when with him. Though she maintains a usually sane and calm demeanor, Nakamura has occasionally had emotional outbursts when expressing herself to Kasuga. It is hinted that her desire to "escape" with Kasuga stems from a desire to no longer be alone. Nakamura earnestly believes that even if Kasuga chooses to stay or leave her, she will ultimately be isolated.

name: Nanako Saeki
description:
Saeki Nanako is a smart, popular girl admired by many, but especially by a boy named Kasuga Takao. She accidently leaves her gym clothes on the floor and they are stolen by a mysterious "pervert".  Despite this, she manages to keep on smiling and manages to date her lover Kasuga. However everything starts to go downhill because of Nakamura's constant interfering.

Saeki's biggest problem isn't Nakamura herself, though. Struggling with her own loneliness, lust and confusion, she does what she thinks is best.

name: Aya Tokiwa
description: A tall girl in the same grade but different class than Kasuga. She looks strikingly similar to Nakamura and likes to read. The other high school boys admire her for her looks.

name: Yamada Masakazu
description: Friend of Kasuga.

name: Kouji Fujiwara
description: Tokiwa's boyfriend. He is a senior at North High.

name: Ai Kinoshita
description: Nanako's friend.

name: Ken Kojima
description: Friend of Kasuga. Kasuga is reluctant, but he asks about the sexual theme regarding Saeki frequently.

name: Irene
description:
Irene appears effectively exactly like Jolyne; besides wearing slightly longer hair, and a softer outfit consisting of a light, turtle-necked sweater cut above the navel, patterned by several heart-shaped gaps or holes.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

appearsIn.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Part 6: Stone Ocean

name: Ito Manabu
description: Manabu Ito is a rich medical student who is well-versed in the matters of human psychology and physiology. However, his greatest concern is in performing a surgery known as trepanation. To do this, he seeks the ideal patient, Nakoshi, who lives a life of balance. Nakoshi accepts to be his experimental guinea pig for money. Ito claims that the procedure involves drilling a small hole into the skull, and allows for a sixth sense to develop,

name: Susumu Nakoshi
description:
Susumu Nakoshi is a middle-aged man living in his car. Spending his time between a park full of homeless people and upper-class complex hotel, he is chosen by [Ito Manabu](https://anilist.co/character/8279/Manabu-Ito) to be an experimental guinea pig because he is neither an egocentric wealthy guy, nor a pitiful homeless man. He is "just between".

After the Trepanation, he is able to see the "monster" in each human being, things that frighten or obsess people. By studying the human nature and facing the other's fear, he'll try to understand his own person thanks to this strange and worrying 6th sense. When he is stressed or depressed, he jerks off and eats his own semen to prove if he is still "alive".

name: Nanako Nanase
description: Nakoshi's former lover from long ago. She was ugly, but he loved her more than any other woman he has ever met. According to him she was able to see homunculus too, albeit differently then him. Her drawings showed a person's true heart; Nakoshi's looked a pure white cloud.

name: Ken
description: One of the homeless who live in the park across the hotel. He is aware that Nakoshi is a pathological liar and believes he will live the homeless group soon as Nakohsi is stuck between two worlds.   Ken also knows that Nakoshi has a habit of driving off somewhere in his car and returning satisfied. He appears to care for Nakoshi's well being as he confronts him when he sees him "looking downward", a sign Nakoshi has given up. Ken tries to help by telling him its too early for him to do that.

name: Yukari
description: A high school senior going through a difficult phase in her life. A young underwear display girl, she likes karaoke and movies. Yukari is prone to shoplifting. She is part of a underwear peep show that also sells her underwear. Yukari and her mother do not get along. Nakoshi sees her homunculus as a symbolic sand monster, with the sand actually being words that relate to how she is feeling. She is addicted to drinking her own blood.

name: Ita
description: A homeless man who lives in the park across the hotel. If the group ever has food Mr. Ita personally cooks it for them. It  is explained that before he came to the park, Mr. Ita was a chef, which is why he is such a good cook. Nakoshi regularly sees him feeding pigeons. He appears to have a fondness for them, because if another animal other then a pigeon eats the food Mr. Ita will throw a rock at them. Nakoshi sees his homunculus as himself (Mr. Ita) encased in a egg.

name: Buntarou Mori
description: A transfer student, who after being talked into climbing the school building, discovered a sense of fulfillment upon reaching the top. After which he became interested in rock-climbing. He is a loner who says he doesn't need friends, and seems to have gone through something in the past. He would rather climb a mountain alone than with a partner.

name: Masao Oonishi
description: [Mori's](https://anilist.co/character/35510/Buntarou-Mori) teacher at school.

name: Yumi Shirai
description: Yumi is [Mori](https://anilist.co/character/35510/Buntarou-Mori)'s classmate in his new high school.

name: Mimiko Hasaba
description: Mimiko Hasaba is a character in Jujutsu Kaisen and Jujutsu Kaisen 0: Jujutsu High. She is an ally of Suguru Geto.

name: Takuma Ino
description:
__Species:__ Human
__Occupation:__ Sorcerer
__Affiliation:__ Jujutsu High
__Grade:__ Grade 2 Sorcerer

Takuma Ino is a grade 2 jujutsu sorcerer and a close associate of Kento Nanami who operates out of Tokyo Jujutsu High.

Takuma Ino is a genuine and cheerful person with a more positive outlook on things than most jujutsu sorcerers. He doesn't believe he's the smartest person around and has a lot of respect for Nanami. Whenever Ino finds himself in a tough situation, he asks himself what would Nanami do.

name: Noritoshi  Kamo
description:
__Cursed Technique:__ Blood Manipulation
__Grade:__ Semi-Grade 1 Sorcerer

He is a third-year at Kyoto Magic Technical College.

name: Larue
