description: A large, shirtless muscular man and an ally of [Suguru Getou](https://anilist.co/character/133699/).

name: Mei Mei
description:
__Height:__  173 cm
__Occupation:__ Jujutsu Sorcerer
__Affiliation:__ Jujutsu High
__Grade:__ Grade 1 Sorcerer
__Family:__ [Ui Ui](https://anilist.co/character/217290) (Younger Brother)

__Abilities__:


Mei Mei is a grade 1 jujutsu sorcerer who works independently and only in exchange for money. She is also the older sister of Ui Ui.

name: Akari Nitta
description: Akari Nitta is an Auxiliary Manager at Jujutsu High.

name: Fuji Suzuto
description: Fuji Suzuto is a first-year high school student at Kamome Gakuen that is briefly shown to be in Nene's class and is also depicted to be affiliated with the student council.

name: Kako
description: Kako is a supernatural who controls the past as one of the three Clock Keepers.

name: Mirai
description: Mirai is a supernatural who controls the future as one of the three Clock Keepers.

name: Masaru Katou
description:
__Height:__ 192 cm

Masaru Katou has a good personality; he loves to help people and easily cares for everyone. His parents are dead so he is responsible for his younger brother who he is fiercely protective of. Katou usually takes the position of being a leader because he has good authority, but is unable to hurt others which hinders his performance in the game of Gantz.

Masaru Katou was [Kei Kurono](https://anilist.co/character/2867/Kurono-Kei)'s childhood friend. They meet each other again the day they die because Katou was trying to help a drunk off of the train line, with Kurono reluctantly lending him a hand.

name: Daizaemon Kaze
description:
A tall and incredibly powerful martial artist who came from the countryside to Tokyo looking for a good fight. One of his signature moves is the "back attack", in which he thrusts his back against his enemies with incredible force, often sending them flying. He died against [Izumi](https://anilist.co/character/5518/Izumi-Shion) in the Shinjuku massacre. He seems to care about [Takeshi](https://anilist.co/character/15451/Koumoto-Takeshi), a young child who recently joined the game and admires Kaze as his "Muscle Rider" savior. On [Kurono](https://anilist.co/character/2867/Kurono-Kei)'s request, he uses his points to revive [Nishi](https://anilist.co/character/5519/Nishi-Joichiro). Gantz calls him "Countryside General," and later on "Muscle Rider." He has chosen to remain in the Gantz game in order to both continue testing his strength and fighting skills against more powerful enemies and to protect Takeshi. Despite his cold outlook, he does have a softer side - in fact, he wept when he thinks of how Takeshi dies at such a young age without ever having experienced love.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Tae Kojima
description:
She is [Kurono](https://anilist.co/character/2867/Kurono-Kei)'s first actual girlfriend, first dated on a dare. He actually falls in love with her, and they build a real relationship, Kurono appearing to be very protective of her.

  

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Kei Kurono
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm

Kei is a 10th grader summoned by Gantz, along with [Kato](https://anilist.co/character/3111/Masaru-Katou), after being hit by a subway train in an effort to help a hobo passed out on the tracks. 
Initially Gantz refers to Kurono as "Bitch" and "Loser", though he settles on "Kurono" as the series progresses.

name: Joichiro Nishi
description: Joichiro Nishi is a middle-school veteran of the Gantz world, having arrived there over a year before the beginning of the series. While running away from police officers after shoplifting, he fled onto an apartment building roof where he fell to his death.    Much like how Kurono started out, he is also selfish and has a Social Darwinist approach to life. Nishi is reluctant to reveal anything about the Gantz or himself, but he runs a web site where he posts information about it (carefully avoiding Gantz's rule about informing outsiders, which would in turn prove fatal). Gantz calls him "Mr. Nishi," which is rather interesting given how informally or derisively he refers to most of the other participants.

name: Hiroto Sakurai
description:
He is a psychic who receives instructions on how to unlock his latent powers from [Sakata](https://anilist.co/character/5522/Sakata-Kenzo) after attempting suicide. He is then encouraged by Sakata to kill his bullies who sexually abused him with the use of his powers, which he does. However, he later regrets it, realizing how it feels to be a murderer. When he and Sakata witness [Izumi](https://anilist.co/character/5518/Izumi-Shion)'s Shinjuku massacre, he insists in trying to stop Izumi and convinces Sakata to join him, arguing that it is a good opportunity to redeem themselves for the murders they committed themselves. While they do put up a good fight, Izumi still does manage to kill both, leading them to Gantz.

A phenomenal learner, he masters his abilities rather quickly. He dies in the fight against the Flame Oni, but is revived by Sakata. Gantz calls him "Cherry", taken from the Japanese Sakura and which is his online handle. He has a girlfriend named [Tonkotsu](https://anilist.co/character/72497/Tonkotsu) who he first met after he murdered the people who abused him. With her, he is seen trying to catch murderers using his psychic powers, in order to further redeem himself. After the mission in Osaka, Gantz names him "no longer a Cherry (Cherry is also the way Japanese address a virgin boy. No longer a Cherry in this term means that he is no longer a virgin)".

name: Reika Shimohira
description:
She is a beautiful, young and popular idol. Like almost everyone else, she is caught in the line of fire during [Izumi](https://anilist.co/character/5518/Izumi-Shion)'s killing spree in Shinjuku. She develops a crush on [Kurono](https://anilist.co/character/2867/Kurono-Kei) after seeing him in action during her first night as a participant in the game. Surprisingly enough, she proves to be a formidable opponent against the Aliens.   

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Jay Jay
description: JJ is an American martial artists visiting Japan. He is very quiet and thoughtful.   JJ stands at the back of the room and doesn't really say anything. He follows the prayer by the priest and that's all he does. After seeing Kato lift up two members of the room to demonstrate the strength of the suit, he challenges him, Kato accepting, and hits him hard to test out how strong he is. He did not put on a suit before they were all transferred to the temple, nor did he bring one along just in case.   He goes along with the others, running with them when the two large statues at the front of the temple come to life and chase them. When all the human size aliens start to appear he starts to fight them using martial arts. He takes a few down on his own. When Kato makes 2 groups he goes with Hojo's group. When most of the group runs inside at the end, to the final building with aliens in it, he goes along with them.

name: Gantz
description: Gantz gives out individual suits for each person there. The suits give them great strength, speed, jumping ability, and protection from harm. There are also three types of guns at the start, the controller, and a room with swords and two vehicles. Additional weapons and items are gained from the hundred point menu. When each person reaches a hundred points they are given three choices:  1. Get your memories erased and be set free to the normal world 2. Get a stronger weapon 3. Revive a deceased person within Gantz memory

name: Chihiro Rokuhira
description:
__Height:__ 170-175 cm

Son and apprentice of the master swordsmith [Kunishige Rokuhira](https://anilist.co/character/314803).

Wielder of the Enchanted Blade Enten, and a user of the Iai White Purity Style.

name: Hakuri Sazanami
description: Hakuri is a young man that was disowned from the Sazanami clan due to being perceived as weak. He witnessed [Chihiro](https://anilist.co/character/314801) and [Sojo](https://anilist.co/character/317244)'s battle in the streets of Tokyo from a nearby restaurant and was touched by the sight of Chihiro's bravery, regarding him as a samurai.

name: Norisaku Madoka
description: Appears to be in pursuit of Char, and has the ability to produce daruma dolls that can violently explode at the command 'Invincible.'

name: Makoto Kasahara
description: A member of the Anti-Cloud Gouger Special Forces, serving under Ikuto.

name: Uran
description: A sorcerer affiliated with the Hishaku, as per her hand tattoo.

name: Tamaki Sazanami
description: A member of the Sazanami Clan, and a member of the elite special defense group of the family known as the Tou, four elite sorcerers whose main function is to protect the clan leader.

name: Iori Yoshiura
description: Iori is a high school girl living in Kyoto.

name: Togo Shiba
description: Old friend of [Kunishige Rokuhira](https://anilist.co/character/314803), a former member of the Kamunabi, and a Seitei War veteran.

name: Shinigami
description: The grim reaper himself. He is by far the most powerful character in the series. He is a bit of a joker but when the time comes, he's all business. His number is 42-42-564 (shini-shini-koroshi), which literally means die-die-kill in Japanese. He has a special move called a “Direct Noggin Shinigami Chop” (which is normally shown when the Shinigami shows his hand, which is a large, flat, four-fingered hand appearing from his robe). This is both a joke and a real move. He constantly has to put up with Death Scythe’s antics when it comes to Maka or her progress. He seems to take on a more playful attitude when talking with his son, Death the Kid (he says he likes his son's three white stripes). Shinigami's soul wavelength is so large that it entirely covers Death city.

name: Noah
description:
A mysterious individual who has taken up [Eibon's](https://anilist.co/character/70837/Eibon) title because of the "brand recognition" it offers. His goal is to use the Book of Eibon to absorb and "collect" everything, which he feels in essence would make him "everything". He was described by [Mosquito](https://anilist.co/character/17816/Mosquito) to be an "avaricious collector", a description which Noah himself agreed with. He is obsessed with collecting anything he deems worthy of his collection, such as the magic tool "BREW", the shinigami [Death the kid](https://anilist.co/character/8455/Death-the-Kid) and even the [Kishin](https://anilist.co/character/15840/Asura).
After using soul perception on Noah, Death the kid described his soul response to be "calm to a fault", yet also "terrifying" like "a bottomless abyss of horrors"

This is not the same 'Eibon' that appeared in the anime. So far this character has only appeared in the manga and a game entitled "Soul Eater: Monotone Princess".
(source: wikipedia)

name: White☆Star
description: He is the father of Black Star and the leader of the infamous Star Clan.  Much like Black Star, he was very bent towards being the best and winning every battle.  In the past, White Star was put into a very similar situation as Black Star in his battle with Mifune.  They were both asked by Mifune about which path (path of a Warrior or path of a Demon) they'd rather take.  White Star did not answer, but Mifune was easily able to tell that White Star already took the path of a Demon.  Black Star simply said he'd make his own path.  White Star was slain in battle by Mifune.

name: Eibon
description: Eibon is an enigmatic sorcerer and former acquaintance, if not friend of Shinigami, who is revered for the creation of numerous Demon Tools, including Brew. As one of the eight Great Old Ones , his "wisdom" and very existence drives men to madness.  source - soul eater wikia

name: Free
description: A Werewolf and the last of the Immortal Clan, imprisoned by the Witch Order for stealing Witch Queen Maba's left eye. After being freed by Eruka Frog on Medusa Gorgon's orders, he renames himself in honor of his freedom and joins her group, acting as one of her operatives.

name: Harvar D. Éclair
native: ハーバー・ド・エクレール
description: Harvar D. Éclair is the demon weapon partner of Ox Ford and one of the top student at Death Weapon Meister Academy. As evident during the infiltration of the Arachnophobia castle, he is fiercely loyal to Ox and prioritizes his safety above all else while maintaining an ice-cold composure in battle, even when Ox does not.

name: Loki
description:
The Gods' representative in the eleventh round of Ragnarok.
He is a prominent deity in the Norse Pantheon, known as the God of Mischief.

name: Odin
description: Supreme god of Nordic.

name: Souji Okita
description: Captain of the first unit of the Shinsengumi.

name: Gong Chen
description: Chen Gong is a strategist from the Lu Bu's army. Like the rest of the Lu Bu's men, he is very loyal and passionate about him.

name: Yue Fang
description: Fang Yue was a general of Wang Kuang.

name: Kali
description: Kali is the Hindu goddess of death, time, and the end of the world.She is Shiva's second wife, who is participating in the fifth round of Ragnarök.

name: Sekishusai  Yagyu
description: Sekishusai Yagyu was a famous samurai who mastered the Yagyu Shinkage-ryū school of combat.

name: Koharu
description: [Torajirou](https://anilist.co/character/151205/)'s sister. She runs a donut stand.

name: Yuzuru
description: Yuzuru is Yuriko's husband.

name: Hirono
description: Hirono is a Yakuza belonging to the Kunimi Clan.

name: Nagai
description: Nagai is a police officer.

name: Sakurako Busujima
description: She is a student at Oumi Women's University and the coworker of Iori Kitahara and Naomi Otoya. She has a crush on Otoya Naomi.

name: Shiori Kitahara
description: She is a third year middle school student and the younger sister of Iori Kitahara.

name: Lloyd Frontera
description:
__Height:__ 181 cm

A drunkard whose family is in a mountain of debt. Su-Ho Kim, a civil engineer, is transmigrated into his body.

name: Javier Asrahan
description: The protagonist of the fantasy novel Iron Blooded Knight, who rises to the level of a sword grandmaster after several years of adventure. Javier Asrahan is a loyal knight of the Frontera family. He currently acts as the personal guard of [Lloyd Frontera](https://anilist.co/character/269308/Frontera-Lloyd) and accompanies him on nearly every occasion.

name: Alicia Magentano
aliases: 艾利西亞·特爾米納·瑪真塔諾

name: Arcos Frontera
description: Llyod's father

name: Marbella Frontera
description: Llyod's mother

name: Julian Frontera
description: Llyod's younger brother

name: Ppodong
description: Ppodong is a fantastical hamster capable of growing to gigantic proportions with the help of red sunflower seeds.

name: Bangul
description: Bangul is a fantastical snake capable of growing to gigantic proportions and processing dirt into either steel or volcanic ash.

name: Hamang
description: Hamang is a fantastical hippopotamus capable of growing to gigantic proportions after drinking a large quantity of water.

name: Ggoming
description: Ggoming is a fantastical bird capable of growing to gigantic proportions with the help of red sunflower seeds.

name: Gong-Ja Kim
description:
Gong-Ja Kim is an aspiring hunter who is jealous of the #1 ranker: the [Flame Emperor](https://anilist.co/character/211825/Yu-SoHa). 

Before entering the tower, Gong-Ja lived his life as an orphan. Even after entering, he was a below-average hunter who adored and worshipped higher rankers. This admiration later turned into envy though, and Soo-Ha Yoo became the main subject of Gong-Ja's jealousy. This below-average hunter's life changed when he received an S-Rank Skill Card for the toxic envy he developed. His gifted S-Rank Skill Card allowed him to receive the power of those who killed him.

name: Raviel Ivansia
description: She is the villainess of the story named "The Tale of Sormwyn Academy".

name: Anastasia Zelenska
description: Anastasia is the Guild Leader of Black Dragon.

name: Nisha
description: Nisha is the Guild Leader of the United Merchants.

name: Liaofan
description: Liaofan is the Guild Leader of the Heavenly Order.

name: Bambollina
description: Bambollina is the Guild Leader of Pantheon.

name: Patricia
description: Patricia is the Guild Leader of City Security.

name: Alha Korvus
description:
__Affiliation:__ Cleaners (Boss)

Alha is the boss of the Cleaners. He is strong, reliable and trustworthy, with strong characters like [Engine](https://anilist.co/character/266438/Enjin) even acknowledging his leadership. He also is charismatic and has the peoples best intentions at heart, welcoming [Rudo](https://anilist.co/character/266433/Rudo) immediately into the Cleaners because of his faith in his companions.

name: Bro Santa
description: Bro Santa is a Cleaner, and is the leader of 'Team Child'. He cares greatly for [Dear](https://anilist.co/character/306959/Dia-Santa) and watches over him, even though they are not related by blood. His vital instrument is his bandana.

name: Hyou
description: She is a member of the Hell Guard training camp.

name: Otto Adderoy
description: The twin brother of Epalte Adderoy. He is a Janitor from Danger.

name: Shikage
description: A member of the cleaners who uses their giver ability to shield Cleaner HQ from uninvited intruders

name: Helen
description: Number 22 in Clare's generation, Helen's specialty is attacking her enemies with her stretching arms, giving her a surprisingly long range of attack, as well as the ability to constrict the enemy. Hot tempered and aggressive, Helen mocked Clare because of her rank when she joined the hunting party, but she eventually grew to respect her later on.

name: Deneve
description:
Deneve is a defensive type Claymore, and thus sports powerful regenerative abilities.

She has a rather calm and empathetic personality, and is quite different from her friend [Helen](https://anilist.co/character/2732/Helen). She was part of the awakened-hunting squad led by [Miria](https://anilist.co/character/2702/Miria), along with Helen and [Clare](https://anilist.co/character/2188/Clare). Deneve is number 15 of the 78th generation

name: Cassandra
description:
Cassandra was Claymore No. 1 of her generation and is considered to be one of the eight most powerful Claymores of all time. During her lifetime, she was known as "Cassandra the Dust Eater".

She is one of the three Claymores revived by [Dae](https://anilist.co/character/73193/Dae) and the Organization in order to stop the uprising of the current warriors.

Cassandra seems to be self-conscious, modest, even shy, and is easily embarrassed, as seen when she blushed and averted her eyes when [Roxanne](https://anilist.co/character/45589/Roxanne) complimented her. She was also stubborn in refusing to allow other warriors to accompany her when hunting for Awakened Beings, most likely because of her technique, which often soiled her face and made her look as if she were eating dirt.

name: Alicia
description: The number one Claymore in the seventy eight generation, Alicia was specially designed by the Organization to work with her twin sister, [Beth](https://anilist.co/character/3244/Beth). In battle, Alicia's body awakens, while her sister Beth controls her, thus giving the Organization enough power to take on the most powerful awakened. Both Alicia and Beth have little personality, and know only to follow the orders of their superiors.

name: Riful
description:
__First Appearance:__ Volume 8 (Manga), Episode 15 (Anime)
__Former Rank:__ #1
__Type:__ unknown

Riful is the Abyssal One of the western territory. She was the number one in the first generation of female Claymores and the youngest ever to awaken. She presents herself as cheerful and polite, though she will instantly discard anyone who gets in the way of her goals. She lives with her lover, [Dauf](https://anilist.co/character/3337/Dauf), and she constantly attempts to force strong Claymores to awaken, often through torture, in order to increase her companions. She later focuses her interest on matching [Isley](https://anilist.co/character/3339/Isley) and [Priscilla](https://anilist.co/character/2624/Priscilla)'s power in order to stop them from advancing into her territory, and she finds the merged form of [Rafaela](https://anilist.co/character/3019/Rafaela) and [Luciela](https://anilist.co/character/3340/Luciela). She wishes to awaken the new being, and captures [Renée](https://anilist.co/character/13789/Renee) for that reason.

Riful's awakened form retains a feminine humanoid form, but one composed of fleshy strips. Her lower body is an immense mass of such strips, which are incredibly resilient and capable of lashing out at high speeds to ensnare or impale her opponents. Her enemies often attempt to attack the humanoid portion, though it simply splits into the strips when attacked.

name: Tesla
description: Claymore Number 16.  First Appearance: Chapter 139 - The Holy City´s Annihilation.

name: Miata
description:
__Rank:__ 4 [Clarice time]
__Type:__ Offensive

Miata is the current generations #4. She is known as Blood Eye by her peers. Her powers lie in her keen senses and brute strength.

Miata is a young girl with long hair which covers most of her face. She wears the standard Claymore uniform.

Miata is completely focused in battle and doesn't seem to get along with people she doesn't know. However she has now formed a strong, daughter-like attachment to [Clarice](https://anilist.co/character/3336/Clarice), most likely because she is still just a child. Outside of battle she acts very much like a young child, even going as far as mimic breastfeeding from Clarice.

name: Manaka  Yoshida
description: Manaka Yoshida is a friend and classmate of Touko Nanami and Sayaka Saeki. She is usually seen with Midori Igarashi.

name: Rei Koito
description: Yuu's older sister. Hiro's girlfriend.

name: Arrow
description: Arrow is the Primary Vice-Commander of the Knights of the Ashen Flame and serves as the Third Pillar's bodyguard.

name: Seiichi Osabe
description: He is a shy and insecure school student.

name: Seiko Osabe
description: She is Seiichi's mother. She is very overprotective with her son and will do anything for him. She is very manipulative.

name: Yuko Fukiishi
description: She is Seiichi's classmate and the girl he likes.

name: Shigeru no Haha
description: She visited the Osabe family with Shigeru almost every week. Like her son Shigeru, she has a sociable personality, but she thinks that Seiko was too overprotective of Seiichi.

name: Ichiro Osabe
description: Father of Seiichi and Husband of Seiko. Has little time for them due to his work.

name: Shigeru
description: Seiichi's cousin, a boy of the same age. Compared to Seiichi, he is more active and clearly says what he thinks. He visits the Osabe family with his mother almost every week and plays Videogames against Seiichi and beats him everytime.

name: Midori Kohakobe
description: Midori Kohakobe is a vampire and the number 1 maid at the maid cafe Vamps.

name: Killy
description:
Killy is the main character who is on the unenviable task to find a human with the Net Terminal Gene within the Megastructure to access the Netsphere. He is equipped with a Gravitational Beam Emitter (GBE), a petite but awesome weapon capable of creating holes miles long in the Megastructure. He is soon joined by [Cibo](https://anilist.co/character/3763/Cibo) in his quest.

Looking to be in his early to mid-20's (Once saying that his "growth period is over."), he is a glum looking person, never smiling (except madly when shooting on occasion) and has a slight slouch in his normal standing position, he isn't afraid to fight, and readily shoots the GBE. He also often shows superhuman strength and endurance, being thrown through solid walls and floors before standing right back up with no apparent injuries.

name: Cibo
description: Cibo is a main character in the manga BLAME! by Tsutomu Nihei. She is the head scientist of the Electronic Corporation in the Capitol and joins Killy on his quest for the Net Terminal Gene.    Killy 's first encounter with Cibo is in the lower levels of the Corporation in The Capitol, where she has been imprisoned for attempting to access the Net Sphere with an artificially created version of Net Terminal Genes. Her failed attempt to access the Net Sphere led to the appearance of the Safeguard, which destroyed the entire lab facility that Cibo was conducting the experiment in. The death and destruction resulting from Cibo's failed experiment led the governing body of the Corporation to convict and imprison her.    Cibo's first form is the decaying upper torso of a woman kept alive by machinery inserted into her body. She convinces Killy to take her with him by stating that he needs her hacking skills to access the files he is looking for. Afterwards, she acquires a human form and destroys The Corporation's President with Killy's help.    After the President's destruction, Cibo leaves the Corporation to travel with Killy because he is also exploring the City and is equipped with a GBE, the only weapon that can breach the Megastructure.

name: Ivy
description: Ivy is the leader of the contingent of Cyborgs attacking Toha Heavy Industries. He carries a massive weapon, which is essentially four swords, with two of them spring-loaded to swing out from the middle to bludgeon enemies. He is eventually defeated in a sword fight with Seu.    (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Sanakan
description: A high level agent of the Safeguard who first appears as a short, young girl with black hair. She appears to have a particular interest in wiping out the human tribe of Electro-Fishers, and seems to know Killy from the past.  Sanakan has 3 forms. First is a child form who later is stolen by Cibo and used until 10 years is over. The second one is Safeguard form. This form is her battle form, and this one can be revived many times. She uses a GBE like Killy, but it has a bigger shape, though not necessarily more or less powerful. Her third form, similar to the original form, is a humanoid like Killy. According to the manga, the Safeguard form of Sanakan does not possess a Sanakan soul, only a remote body controlled by the main Safeguard system, which is why, when Cibo hacks into the Safeguard system, all exterminators and the Sanakan Safeguard stop moving for a while. The real Sanakan, now protecting Cibo who brings Net Terminal Genes, is again killed by the silicon creatures. After dying (she is possibly in the net sphere), her leader warns her that if she goes back to base reality with Safeguard form (one possessing a Sanakan soul), and she is killed again, they can't revive her again. Sanakan finally has the same goal as Killy. She even helps Killy to destroy Safeguard, who tries to eat Cibo's core.

name: Iko
description: Iko appears as the thin, white wisp of a facial image. However, in the manga, it is suggested in a flashback of Dhomochevsky's that he had a corporeal shape once, but how he lost it was never explained. Most likely, he was unable to gain a new body as the Silicon Life on his level captured the Substance Conversion Tower on which he and Dhomochevsky depended. He acts as a guardian for Dhomochevsky, predicts the behavior of his opponents, and healing him if possible. He transfers all his power to Dhomochevsky in a last ditch effort to stop Davinel as well as Cibo's transformation into a Level 9 Safeguard.    (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Maeve
description: Maeve is Ivy's sidekick. The lower half of her body is sliced off by Seu in a fight. Later on, Ivy and some of his contingent discover the 'advanced' cyborg fused to a wall. They cut it out, wrench the cyborg's original head out and implant Maeve into the body. Later, as Maeve is about to execute Mensab/Mensierve, Seu attempts to kill her by throwing his sword and lodging it in her forehead. She seems almost indifferent to this, but before proceeding, she is killed by Killy who fires a Gravitational Beam through her heart. This happens just before the teleportation of Toha Heavy Industries.    (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Pcell
description: A Silicon Creature. She is one of Davine lu linvega's lieutenants (along with Schiff and Blon). Despite that most Silicon Creatures have some deformed features and a generally unbalanced appearance, PCell looks almost entirely human. Nevertheless she has very high combat capabilities and undoubtedly is one of the strongest opponents Killy and Cibo have to face.     Also, whether it was a history of previous unfriendly encounters or something more profound, but there seems to be something between her and Dhomochevsky.

name: Dhomochevsky
description: A special Safeguard who with his companion [Iko](https://anilist.co/character/33908/Iko) protects all the people on his level from Silicon Creatures regardless of Net Terminal Genes.

name: Blon
description: One of Davine Lu Linvega's henchmen. Blon is capable of creating worm-like creatures, possibly the same way the Safeguard use to 'download' common safeguards to any location. He can also release leech-like creatures, about a foot and a half long, which attach to a target's spine and render the target unconscious. Another of Blon's abilities is that he can use what is possibly alchemy to create radically different forms apart from his humanoid form. The first is a massive, metallic centipede-like creature which ravages Killy with multiple blades before Blon reveals his true form. As he finishes transforming into his humanoid form, Killy fires the Gravitational Beam Emitter at "Level 4" disintegrating all but Blon's head and the remains of his arms and legs. Several people believe that he dies here, but he actually appears later. His first defeat allows Pcell to detect the 70-kilometer long holes left by Killy's GBE. When Dhomochevsky, Cibo and Iko set out to find Killy and Davinel, Pcell appears to confront them at a large orbital transport hatch and minutes later, Blon appears in his third form at her command. The third form resembles a large, metallic, spider-praying mantis hybrid with Blon's face and his large chain-gun (Vulcan Cannon/Gatling Gun) on its left arm (where it is in Blon's humanoid form).

name: Davine lu Linvega
description: Leader of a contingent of cyborgs who Killy encounters late in the series. The level on which he's present allows provisional access to the Net Sphere to any person having normal human DNA. Davinel wants to access the Net Sphere and tries to obtain the DNA sample in Cibo's possession (which is Seu's). Afterward he is able to infiltrate the netsphere in Seu's form. However, he fatally underestimates the GA's agent who cleverly slows the connection speed, giving enough time for him to be unaware during the attack on him. However, he manages to steal the level nine safeguard data just before Dhomochevsky kills him. Linvega's gender has been up to debate; Iko first refers to him/her as male. However, the side comic BLAME! Academy depicts Linvega as a girl.    (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Kensuke Mitsui
description:
__Height:__ 172cm

One of Naoya's friends. A loud and perverted muscle-head. He has been friends with Naoya Nifuji since kindergarten.

appearsIn.title: Wotakoi: Love is Hard for Otaku

name: Geu Sonyeon
description: The boy who lost their parents live with one hope: that he can walk with the [girl](https://anilist.co/character/197692/Geu-Sonyeo) forever...until they come across adults who are trying to take that hope away.

name: Geu Sonyeo
description:
The girl who lost her father due to an infectious disease, contracted from someone on the bus who they ventured with.
Meets the boy unexpectedly on the bus, and together they walk on the path for as long as they can.

name: Soseolga
description: He is among the few who managed to escape the war, using a bus to travel from place to place in search of safety. He correctly diagnoses an old man as suffering from an incurable infectious disease, and succumbs to it himself shortly after the old man. In a wedding photo, his parents are shown to be of Indian descent.

name: Haebyeonga Namja
description: A man who lives along the seaside with his partner.

name: Unjeonsa
description: He drives the bus used by a group of people who managed to escape the war. A former soldier who saw his friends die in battle, he is a pragmatic but compassionate man of few words. He looks after the girl after her father leaves the bus.

name: Noin
description: He is among the few who managed to escape the war, using a bus to travel from place to place in search of safety.

name: Isanghan Namja
description: A man whom the boy and the girl meet on their journey. The girl takes pity and lets him follow them, while the boy feels uneasy about his presence and suggests they try to shake him off. He behaves in a manner resembling a chimpanzee (only makes high-pitched noises, snatches the children's supplies, eats raw meat, and doesn't seem to understand or respond in human language).

name: Sonyeoui Abeoji
description: After the war, him and his daughter are the only surviving members of their family. They manage to get on a bus with several other people, traveling from place to place in search of safety. He is a kind man who tries to take his daughter's mind off the gloom of their new lives.

name: Supsogui Sonyeo
description: She travels with a boy who seems to be around her age; both speak the same language, which the Boy and Girl don't understand.

name: Eolini
description: The child of the seaside couple.

name: Yotsuba Koiwai
description:
__Height__: 107 cm

She has a carefree and energetic personality, taking delight in simple matters even as she learns about all manner of things in her daily life. In Japanese, Yotsuba's dialogue is written without kanji, making it seem simpler and more child-like, and in a typeface that gives the impression of speaking with high intensity. Her energy is noted by other characters, especially members of the neighboring Ayase family. Her father says of her carefree nature, "She can find happiness in anything. Nothing in this world can get her down." However, when deeply frightened or upset, she does cry, and she has an unexplained fear of anything resembling a bullseye.

At the start of the series, Yotsuba is shown as having very little knowledge of the world around her, even for a young child. Things such as swings, doorbells, cicadas, and air conditioners all fascinate and confuse her, although she is not perturbed by her ignorance. She occasionally mispronounces new words and creates neologisms, such as "Yotsubox" as a portmanteau of "Yotsuba's Box", and often repeats, in incongruous ways, phrases spoken by adult characters around her.
Yotsuba is frequently shown drawing, though she is not as good an artist as she thinks she is, and she is an excellent swimmer.

The series provides few details about her life before its start.

name: Yousuke Koiwai
description: Koiwai is [Yotsuba](https://anilist.co/character/3568/Koiwai-Yotsuba)'s adoptive father. The circumstances of her adoption are obscure; he tells [Fuuka](https://anilist.co/character/7742/Ayase-Fuuka) that without intending to, he found himself taking care of her while somewhere overseas, but gives no other details. Though he acknowledges Yotsuba is a bit odd, he can be offbeat himself. He is depicted as something of a slacker; he habitually wears an undershirt and boxer shorts when working at home during the summer, and apologizes more than once for being irresponsible. He works from home as a translator, though what languages and materials he translates is unknown. Regardless of his skills as a parent, Koiwai tries to be a good father to Yotsuba.

name: Takashi Takeda
description:
A friend of Koiwai and Yotsuba, having known Koiwai since they were childhood classmates. Standing 2m10 (6 ft 11 in) tall, he dwarfs the other characters, especially Yotsuba.
He is always called by the nickname "Jumbo," and when Fuka learns his real name she calls it "common." He works at his father's flower shop, as Yotsuba discovers when she meets him there. He helps the Koiwais move in and frequently visits their house, where he is more or less treated as a member of the family by Yotsuba.

__Personality__: Jumbo has a dry sense of humor and is prone to deadpan quips, which sometimes confuse members of the Ayase family. At the same time, he is impulsive, and sometimes spontaneously organizes activities for the younger children, such as fishing and star-gazing.
As he does this, he enters a bizarre one-sided rivalry with Miura, including spending a single day in Hawai'i after he learns that she will be going abroad. He develops a deep infatuation with Asagi when he first meets her, but is too nervous around women to directly act on it. Instead, he tries to use Yotsuba's friendship with Asagi as a way of getting close to her, though his plans usually backfire.

name: Fuuka Ayase
description: The middle Ayase sister, Fuuka is in her second year at a local high school. She is the most responsible of the sisters, and during Yotsuba's first visit to her school, one student calls her "vice-president." She finds herself frequently helping the Koiwais, even though she does not intend to and is more flustered by their eccentricities than anyone else. Fuuka is often teased by the other characters, especially about her fashion sense and sense of humor. She is fond of making bad puns, which irritates Asagi, and wearing shirts with odd or interesting graphics (such as Chiyo's "father" from Azumanga Daioh, who also appears as a plushie in her room).

name: Ena Ayase
description: The youngest Ayase sister, Ena is a few years older than Yotsuba and her most frequent playmate. She is sensible for her age and tries to be responsible by recycling and limiting her use of air conditioning. Her attempts to spare Yotsuba's feelings sometimes lead her to make little white lies, such as praising Yotsuba's childish sketches or letting her believe that Miura's cardboard costume is a real robot named Cardbo (in ADV's translation) or Danbo (in Yen's translation) (ダンボー, Danbō), with consequences that rebound on herself and Miura. Ena likes drawing, something at which she is quite skilled, and playing with her teddy bears, either by herself or with Yotsuba. Ena is unsqueamish and even enthusiastic about such things as handling large frogs and gutting live fish.

name: Asagi Ayase
description: The eldest of the three Ayase sisters, Asagi lives at home while attending a nearby university. She is depicted as an attractive young woman who enjoys teasing people, especially her parents; her friend Torako describes her as a horrible person for teasing Ena. She is the best of her family at managing Yotsuba, and her mother claims she was much like Yotsuba when she was young. Asagi's irreverence may have come from her mother's teasing when she was a child—for example, when Asagi found a four-leaf clover, Mrs. Ayase asked for a five-leaf clover instead, which Asagi could not find.

name: Yasuda
description: Yanda, given name Yasuda, is a friend of Koiwai and Jumbo. Though mentioned in the first and fourth chapters, when Jumbo calls Yanda "no good" for making lame excuses for not helping the Koiwais move, he does not appear until chapter 30. He is somewhat childish, as shown by the tit-for-tat pranks he plays on Yotsuba, including bribing her with candy then taking it back when it does not work, eating her ice cream, and prank-calling  her, and is shown enjoying teasing Yotsuba and acting as her "nemesis". Koiwai refers to Yanda as his kōhai, but in what context he is Koiwai's junior is unknown. He is living from paycheck to paycheck, telling Koiwai that he eats instant ramen because he does not get paid until the end of the month, and only eating frozen meals the rest of the time.

name: Danbo
description: Cardbo is a "robot" that Ena and Miura make out of cardboard boxes in the fifth volume of the manga "Yotsuba&!". Hilarity ensues as Miura proceeds to fool Yotsuba into thinking that Cardbo is a real robot.    (source: Wikipedia)

name: Miura Hayasaka
description: A friend and classmate of Ena. She is boyish and brusque, in both her appearance and speech (this is very noticeable in the Japanese version; see gender differences in spoken Japanese). Sometimes, she can be too straightforward and insensitive, and she counters aggressively in a tsukkomi-like manner if she feels mistaken or made fun of. Because of this, Miura appears less kind and thoughtful than Ena, but she is aware of others' feelings. For example, she immediately notices Jumbo's infatuation with Asagi and uses it to her advantage. She is also extremely squeamish: when Jumbo takes the younger children fishing, Miura refuses to handle live bait, using salmon roe instead, and hides while Jumbo and Ena clean their catches; she is also terrified by a large frog Yotsuba catches. Miura often wears sports-related clothing (such as jerseys of the Los Angeles Lakers and Los Angeles Dodgers) and rides a unicycle. Jumbo once teases her by calling her Lamborghini Miura.

name: Hiwatari
description: A friend of Fuuka's, given name unknown, who is in the same homeroom. Her first official appearance is in chapter 45, when she visits Fuuka's home and recognizes Yotsuba from her trip to their high school in chapter 40. Hiwatari has a somewhat eccentric personality. She is normally called by her nickname Miss Stake (しまうー, Shimaū)  due to a "mistake" she made when she first introduced herself to her class (in Japanese, shimau used as an auxiliary verb can mean to do something by accident, hence the pun).

name: Kou Nakano
description:
Kou Nakano is an Ajin. 
Nakano is very considerate of others;  He was also concerned for Izumi, saying she shouldn't put herself in danger. He is also a bit clumsy compared with other characters and often doesn't know what's going on. As seen in the recent chapters, he is not good with coming up with plans and prefers to improvise instead. This results in him relying on Kei a lot with strategic plans, much to Kei's annoyance. 

it is revealed that Kō had first died when changing a light bulb. He stacked a bunch of magazines on top of each other, and tripped. After that, he was left paralyzed on the floor for days, but no one came. He then most likely died of dehydration. It is also pointed out that Kō had abusive, or at least neglective, parents.

name: Shinya Nakamura
description: Shinya Nakamura died in a motorcycle accident and afterward realized he was an Ajin, the first one to be found in Japan. He is responsible for the infamous "Flood Incident" which occurred right after.

name: Toto-sama
description: The main antagonist of Noragami, as well as  What lies underneath his mysterious appearance is a deep hatred for the gods and by extension, the humans who worship them after a tragic death of a loved one. He is a skilled manipulator and is very vocal about the heaven's injustice.

name: Kugaha
description: Kugaha is shown to be helpful and caring at first.

name: Kofuku Ebisu
description: Originally introduced as [Yato's](https://anilist.co/character/84677/Yato) girlfriend that he frequently shakes down for money, Kofuku is later revealed to be the infamous Binbougami - a Japanese Goddess of Poverty. She goes by the cover name "Kofuku Ebisu" in order to make it seem as though she is a god of fortune. She has a Shinki named [Daikoku](https://anilist.co/character/88691/Daikoku).

name: Daikoku
description: Daikoku is [Kofuku's](https://anilist.co/character/88241) somewhat overprotective shinki. He regards himself as Kofuku's husband.

name: Arahabaki
description: He is an indigenous Emishi god that was defeated by the heavens. Once reincarnated, the heavenly guard took control of his guidepost and chose his shinki. He made sure they were following the heavens and let him stand up on his own after they trained him to value and serve the heavens.

name: Yatagarasu
description: He is the three-legged crow god.

name: Kuraha
description: Kuraha is a current Regalia to Bishamon. His regalia form is a male lion with a scar on his right eye.

name: Jousuke Higashikata
description:
Seemingly a sailor who is amnesiac about all details of his personal life.  For some reason, he has 4 testicles.

The real identity of this character is unknown. The second chapter stated that the Jojolion protagonist's name  He was later given the name Jousuke by the Higashikata family, who took him in.

appearsIn.title: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken: JoJolion

name: Joubin Higashikata
description:
__Nationality__: Japanese

Jobin Higashikata is an antagonist featured in the eighth part of JoJo's Bizarre Adventure, JoJolion. 

Jobin is the eccentric eldest son of the Higashikata Family. He is married with Mitsuba Higashikata and has a son, Tsurugi. Beyond his job at the Higashikata Fruit Company, Jobin was formerly one of the members of the Rock Humans' Locacaca Organization. 

In his room, he keeps a large shelving unit full of display cases for exotic beetles. It is hinted that his fondness for beetles is the way they symbolize strength. He breeds beetles to make them fight and considers them to be gladiators when on the arena.

Jobin desires the power of the Locacaca, wishing to obtain it to rid his family of the Higashikata curse. This desire leads to him valuing the Locacaca and elimination of any in his way above everything else, even being unconcerned if Morioh itself were to be destroyed in the process.

Jobin is a Stand User and wields the mysterious Speed King. Little is known about Speed King's abilities other than its primary ability to store heat and temperature within a short localized point. This power can be weaponized and used to heat people's blood vessels, boiling the blood inside to render them unconscious or even kill them- when applied to the temples the heat can become so damaging the victim's eyes burst. Speed King is shown to be physically able enough to rapidly pummel enemies.

appearsIn.title: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken: JoJolion

name: Yasuho Hirose
description:
__Height__: 166 cm (5'5")
__Occupation__: University Student
__Stand__: Paisley Park

A young girl who lives in the town of Morioh in the new timeline of JoJo's Bizarre Adventure. After the events of the March 11th earthquake she finds a mysterious naked man lying under rubble and decides to save him.

appearsIn.title: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken: JoJolion

name: Tsurugi Higashikata
description: Tsurugi Higashikata, the youngest member of the Higashikata family, is the son of Jobin and Mitsuba Higashikata. Tsurugi's stand, Paper Moon King, allows him to transform objects into origami and create illusions.

appearsIn.title: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken: JoJolion

name: Rai Mamezuku
description: Rai Mamezuku is a reclusive plant appraiser secretly employed by the Higashikata Fruit Company. Rai is an eccentric, blunt, quick-witted, and analytical man who often comes across as cold-hearted. He is extremely antisocial, going to great lengths in order to stay isolated. His stand, Doggy Style, allows him to unravel his body into band-like cords.

appearsIn.title: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken: JoJolion

name: Joushuu Higashikata
description: Joshu is the spoiled third of Norisuke Higashikata IV's four children and eventually rubs shoulders with Josuke Higashikata without truly becoming a friend. He has an unrequited crush on Yasuho Hirose. Joshu eventually awakens a Stand, Nut King Call.

appearsIn.title: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken: JoJolion

name: Norisuke Higashikata IV
description: The current head of the Higashikata household and owner of the Higashikata Fruit Company. He is the father of Jobin, Hato, Joshuu, and Daiya Higashikata.

appearsIn.title: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken: JoJolion

name: Daiya Higashikata
description: Daiya is Norisuke Higashikata's youngest daughter. She is near-blind, and is an avid fan of progressive rock (in particular, Yes). She is extremely possessive of Josuke, and appears to be jealous of Yasuho for getting close to him.

appearsIn.title: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken: JoJolion

name: Hato Higashikata
description: Hato is Norisuke Higashikata's eldest daughter. She's a model of some renown, and is quite proud of it. She gets into fights with Joshuu regularly.

appearsIn.title: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken: JoJolion

name: Kei Nijimura
description: Kei Nijimura is the Higashikata family's housekeeper.

appearsIn.title: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken: JoJolion

name: Mini Yaemori
description: A streamer otaku who moved to the flat next to Kazuya and happens to go to the same college as him. Calls Kazuya "Master."

name: Kagali
description: Kagali is an elf that serves as secretary to Yuuki Kagurazaka.

appearsIn.title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime

name: Carrera
description: Carera was one of the demons convened by Diablo to serve Rimuru. She was originally an Arch Demon, but after being named by Rimuru she evolved into a Demon Peer.

appearsIn.title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime
That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime

name: Beretta
description: Beretta is a Greater Demon that was summoned by Rimuru to protect Ramiris to make up for destroying her previous golem. They incarnated in a golem made out of pure magisteel and have served her since.

appearsIn.title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime

name: Fuze
description: He is the Brumund Kingdom's Freedom Association, Guild Master.

appearsIn.title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime

name: Gelmud
description: A majin that served Demon Lord Clayman of the Ten Great Demon Lords. He wanted to make Orc Lord the new Demon Lord and manipulate him but instead was devoured by it.

appearsIn.title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime

name: Phobio
description:
__Species:__ Leopard Lycanthrope

He is one of the "Beastketeers" of the Demon Lord Karion. He is proclaimed to be the strongest warrior of the 3 "Beastketeers".

appearsIn.title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime
That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime

name: Roy Valentin
native: ロイ・ヴァレンタイン
description: A member of the Ten Great Demon Lords. In Kagali's prime, his strength was comparable to hers.

appearsIn.title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime

name: Brad Coleman
native: ブラッド・コールマン
description: Magic Police Officer.

name: Pon Torus
description:
__Height:__ 167 cm

Second-year student at Easton Magic Academy. He is in Orca dorm.

name: Wirth Mádl
description: The Third Fang of the Magia Lupus. Younger brother of [Orter Mádl](https://anilist.co/character/264316).

name: Ryoko Kashiwagi
description: A woman who resembles Reira, Shin seems to spend a great deal of time with her and she seems to favour sleeping with much younger men. When Shin first arrived in Tokyo, Ryoko took him under her wing and taught him about the adult world as well as how to get money from women. Shin came to view her as a foster mother of sorts and remarks that she does not resemble Reira as closely as he originally thought.     (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Miu Shinoda
description:
A placid and soft-spoken actress who shares a boarding house with Blast and [Yuri](https://anilist.co/character/22258/Matsumoto-Asami). She is 27, but her acting profile states that she is 23. Her name is often mispronounced "Myuu" by many people.

Miu wears long sleeves to hide the scars on her wrists from self-mutilation. Also, in volume 11 (the volume where she first appears), it's shown that she's a very good mahjong player (she claimed that she learned her skills by having special training for her role in a mahjong movie as a nameless rival).

name: Ren Ichinose
description:
Young son of Nana Komatsu and Takumi Ichinose, although it is not made clear who is his real father or if Satsuki Ichinose is his younger sister or not. He is close to his father, Takumi, and currently lives with him in London, England.

He bears a similar resemblance to his mother, and has inherited his namesake's, Ren Honjo's, talent for the guitar. Reira Serizawa is particularly close to Ren and will only sing, when he is playing.

(Source:Nana Wiki)

name: Sachiko Kawamura
description:
**Height**: 146 cm  

She works at the same restaurant as Shoji. Early on in the manga, Hachi once dreamt of Shoji two-timing her with a buxom, Prada-loving city girl named Sachiko (she thought of the name randomly). Ominously, it later turned out to be true, though the real Sachiko is nothing like "virtual" Sachiko. Interestingly, Hachi also plays with the idea of naming her unborn daughter Sachiko.

name: Ginpei Shiroboshi
description: Blast's manager. He talks in a very feminine way (unless angered), is openly gay, and he has a questionable interest in Yasu. In Nana's eyes, Ginpei is the second "baldie" related to Blast—the first being Yasu.

name: Takashi Asano
description: Hachi's first lover. A handsome, older, married man, Asano carried on a secret affair with Hachi that ended when he was abruptly transferred to Tokyo. Though Hachi believed that she was in love with him, she made the painful realization that he saw her as merely a "fling". Hachi encounters him again in Tokyo and, after resolving her own personal issues with him, tells him to stop cheating on his wife.

name: Shion
description:
President of Blast's Private Fan Club and a long-time fan of Yasu since his days in Brute. She keeps in contact with Mai and divides the fans by their interests in the members. Her devotion to Yasu is unfailing and she relays any news outside of Gaia's influence to him. When questioned about her financial situation, she replied to have some dependency from her rich "father"—though he is not biological. First seen in the story as a bobcut-haired groupie, later as a platinum blonde during her late teens, and re-introduced with curled black hair as an adult; Shion's only constant traits include the mole underneath her left eye and the tattoo on her right arm.  

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Natsuko Komatsu
description:
Hachi's mother. Kind and understanding, she is a model mother to her daughters, and Nana Osaki considers Natsuko to be cool. Hachi, however finds it weird since she thought that her family is nothing but "normal".    

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Reiji Kurose
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm

Due to his family situation and feeling tied down to his hometown by his responsibilities to support them, he gradually spiraled into depression. Occasionally, contemplating suicide.

name: Nagi Aoe
description:
__Height:__ 163 cm

Nagi Aoe is an idol that recently moved into [Kurose](https://anilist.co/character/170177/Kurose-Reiji)'s town, where she worked as a convenience store clerk. She has recently stepped down from her work as an idol.

name: Sakuko Akiyama
description:
__Height:__ 149 cm

Reiji's childhood friend.

name: Gen Minegishi
description:
__Height:__ 185 cm 

Reiji's childhood friend.

name: Yuri Shibasawa
description:
Reiji’s homeroom teacher.

Yuri is seen as nice and outgoing usually wanting her students to succeed and do their best.

name: Yuko Kurose
description:
__Height:__ 161 cm 

Reiji's mother.

name: Kousaku Esemori
description: The mysterious writer of Spring's Coffin. He is Nagi's husband and seems to know Reiji's mother from their school days.

name: Kazumasa Fukami
description: Reiji's stepbrother.

name: Majikaja
description: Majikaja, or sometimes just Kaja, is a Narehate living in the village Ilblu. They can understand and communicate using human speech, though they sometimes forget words, and sometimes refers to themself in third person.

name: Alice
description:
__Name:__ Alice/ B-Rabbit  
__Height:__ 150 cm  
__Affiliation:__ Pandora's Member  
__Base of Operations:__ Vessalius Mansion, Rainsworth Mansion, Pandora Headquarters  
__Occupation:__ Chain  
__Contractor:__ [Oz Vessalius](https://anilist.co/character/13835/Vessalius-Oz) 

The heroine of the story. Alice first appears as a chain that persuades Oz to form a contract with her in the Abyss. In fact, she is actually the infamous B-Rabbit (Bloodstained Black Rabbit), the strongest chain in the Abyss. 

Alice's goal is to find her lost memories, which play a major role in the story. She has a huge appetite and loves meat especially. She is hotheaded, loud spoken and says what she thinks without regard to the consequence. Despite this, she has a soft side, especially when Oz is involved. She hates when Oz leaves her alone, but to hide it she usually says, "I'm in a contract with you. You are my manservant, and as a manservant, what were you thinking, leaving me behind!?" or she just hits Oz and says, "Shut up".

name: Xerxes Break
native: ザークシーズ・ブレイク
description:
__Height:__ 177.5 cm (5'10")  

Commonly known as Break, he is a member of Pandora and a servant of the Rainsworth household. Break's appearance does not change from the ten year gap between Oz entering and leaving the Abyss. He has a legal contract with the Mad Hatter. Break is often seen with a doll on his shoulder, which he calls Emily. He adores sweets and cakes. From the outside, Break seems like a carefree character, never serious and always smiling. When needs be, however, Break shows his dangerous and evil side. Reim tells Oz that Break has not always been the way he is now. Before, after losing his eye, he was a bitter and angry person, never smiling. However, through the kindness of Shelly, Sharon's mother, he began to open up. He has sworn absolute loyalty to Shelly.

name: Gilbert Nightray
native: ギルバート・ナイトレイ
description:
__Height:__ 182 cm

Oz's best friend and loyal servant. To him, Oz is his most precious person, and he is willing to sacrifice anything for him. He was taken into the Vessalius family after being discovered in an injured state 15 years ago. He was invited by Oz to attend the coming of age ceremony as his friend. During the ceremony, he was controlled by a chain in the Baskerville's possession and forced to attack Oz. After regaining consciousness, Gilbert manages to see the face of one of the hooded people and for some reason jumps in the way of Oz's attack to protect him.

name: Sharon Rainsworth
native: シャロン・レインズワース
description:
__Height:__ 157 cm (5'2")

The Lady of the Rainsworth household. Sharon is a member of Pandora and looks like a thirteen year old girl, although she is chronologically 23 years old. Her appearance does not change from her first meeting with Oz to after he came out of the Abyss because she has a legal contract with a chain, the black unicorn Eques.   Sharon and Break have a close relationship. It is she who discovers Break after he was found in front of the Rainsworth household's gate to the abyss. When she was young, she used to call Break 'Brother Xerx', as he was like a big brother to her. She wants desperately to be of use to him, though believes she lacks the power to do so.

name: Oz Vessalius
description:
__Height:__ 164 cm (5'4")


A 15-year-old boy with blond hair and green eyes from the prestigious Vessalius family, whose father is the reigning lord. His mother was killed by the Nightray family, but despite this, he retains a bright, optimistic, and energetic personality. The story of Pandora Hearts starts when Oz turns fifteen. During the ceremony to celebrate this reaching of adulthood, he was dragged into the Abyss for the sin of 'existing'. There he meets the chain named [Alice](https://anilist.co/character/13836/Alice) and makes a contract with her.

name: Emily
description: Emily is Break's little doll who usually sits on him. She sounds like "click click click", which with addition to her freaky smile makes her really scary for Oz.

name: Glen Baskerville
native: グレン・バスカヴィル
description: Glen was the head of the Baskerville family 100 years ago. According to Lotti, Glen gave the impression that he liked being alone and was difficult to approach. Contrary to her beliefs, he was best friends with the loud Jack Vessalius and even told him about a secret passage so that he could sneak into the Baskerville house. Jack and Glen made a musical pocket watch together. Glen wrote the melody for it while Jack crafted it. The piece he wrote is called "Lacie".

name: Elliot Nightray
native: エリオット・ナイトレイ
description:
Elliot is the step-brother​ of [Gilbert Nightray](https://anilist.co/character/16211/Nightray-Gilbert) and [Vincent Nightray](https://anilist.co/character/17888/Nightray-Vincent). Elliot is the only remaining son of the Nightray couples and is the heir to the Nightray family.

Elliot is hotheaded, outspoken and always forces his opinions on everybody else. [Ada](https://anilist.co/character/21111/Vessalius-Ada), however, thinks he is a nice and dependable person deep down. He first meets [Oz](https://anilist.co/character/13835/Vessalius-Oz) in the Latowidge library where they get into a fight over a character in the novel series "Holy Knight" (Elliot spoils the ending for Oz's favorite character, Edgar). He hated the Vessalius family. He also doesn't like Ada calling his name and despises how the Vessalius seem to get away with anything just because they were heroes 100 years ago. He seems to be greatly annoyed by Gilbert, but in reality cares about him.

In recent chapters, however, Elliot's hatred towards Oz has dissipated, and the two of them have become good friends.

name: Ada Vessalius
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7")

Oz's little sister who adores him very much.

After 10 years, she attends Latowidge, a prestigious school for nobles, of which she is a prefect. She keeps in contact with Oscar via letter and causes Oz and co. to sneak into Latowidge as she wrote that she has found a person she likes.

name: Fang
description: Fang has spiky hair and a tattoo down the left side of his face. He was also a participant in the Tragedy of Sablier. Fang speaks politely and is the most rational of the trio. He wields a large blade.    (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Gen Tachibana
description:
**Height:** 195 cm

He is the father of [Marika Tachibana](https://anilist.co/character/66597/Marika-Tachibana) and holds the highest rank in the Police Department.

name: Hana Kirisaki
description: Hana Kirisaki is a world renowned business consultant who keeps much of the world's finances in balance, she is the mother of [Chitoge Kirisaki](https://anilist.co/character/48391/Chitoge-Kirisaki) and the wife of [Adelt Wogner Kirisaki](https://anilist.co/character/82935/Adelt-Wogner-Kirisaki).

name: Yui Kanakura
description:
**Height:** 167 cm

She is a childhood friend of [Raku](https://anilist.co/character/48393/Raku-Ichijou) as well as his current homeroom teacher. Yui is also the head of the Chinese mafia group, Char Siu. Yui is also in possession of a fourth key but has confirmed to Raku that she is not the girl he had made a promise with ten years prior.

name: Shinobu Honda
description: Honda is Marika's personal attendant and police escort. She monitors Marika and at times advises her to not overexert herself due to her frail condition.

name: I-Jin Yu
description: As the only survivor of a plane crash, Ijin became a mercenary in order to survive. 10 years later, he returned to his home country where his family was. As a former mercenary, he attends school and is currently a senior.

name: Da-Yeon Yu
description: I-Jin Yu's sister. She often gets bullied in school but is protected by her brother.

name: Yeon-A Shin
description:
Shin Yeon-A is Da-Yeon's friend. She transfers back to Da-Yeon & I-Jin's class after studying abroad for 2 years.



Shin Yeon-A is the granddaughter of the owner of SW, the biggest corporation in South Korea. She is almost always accompanied by her secretary and bodyguard Go Seok-Ju whom she grew up with.

name: Seok-Ju Go
description: Seok-Ju Go is Yu-Na Shin's secretary and bodyguard.

name: Seo-Ha Cha
description: Cha Seoha is Yu Ijin's friend. She is also a celebrity.

name: Hyun-Su Cha
description:
The main character of the story. An isolated, lonely teenager who is forced to move when his family dies in a traffic accident. He is eighteen years old and stopped going to high school due to unknown reasons. He spends his time trolling and tricking on internet, as well as playing various RPGs. He sold his old house and moved into Green Home apartments (room 1410) because the money left by his deceased family was insufficient for him to survive as an isolated person. He then proceeds to chose October 25th as a date to commit suicide.

 His weapon of choice is a handmade electric spear, powered by a large battery that he carries in his backpack.

It was revealed in chapters 81 and 82 that

name: Eun-Hyuk Lee
description:
Eighteen year old Hyuk Lee is the leader of the Green Roof Apartments Survivors and Eun Lee's older brother. He is also one of the deuteragonists of the series with the others being some of the Green Roof Apartment survivors.

Hyuk is an intelligent and level-headed young man with an affinity for leadership. He often plans the many missions the survivors need to undertake. He is unafraid to take risks and is pragmatic, such as accepting an infected human into their ranks, if it helps boost their success rates. He also was prepared to take underhanded measures to tip the odds in his favor. However, as other survivors have learned, Hyuk is extremely blunt in speech and often says things rudely or in a way that would draw their ire. Hyuk is aware of this trait and either uses it to energize people or to provoke people for his own enjoyment. Due to his video game playing habits, he occasionally offers explanations using video game terminology. Because of this and his bluntness, it often embarrasses his sister Eun. Despite this, Hyuk deeply cares about Eun. He notices her actions and is able to deduce that Eun has a crush on Hyun. Hyuk also possesses empathetic traits but masks it greatly for both survival and so that no biases are made when it came to decision making as a leader. However, if there is no harm to the survivors, Hyuk would let emotions and morality guide his decisions.

name: Ji-Su Yun
description: A girl who recently moved into Green Home apartments (room 1510) the same day as Hyun.

name: Sang-Uk Pyeon
description:
Thirty two year old Wook Pyeon, also called Mr. Mobster by some of the other residents, is a former police detective and a resident of Green Roof Apartments. He is fierce-looking and he appears to have a gangster manner. However, he calls himself a "good fella". He got fired for putting the son of an important person in hospital. 

Due to his background, he is more aggressive than others. He still uses physical force to keep others in line, such as Hyun Cha. Despite this, he means well and will selflessly put his life on the line to save others. He appears confident in his ability to live and does not see his acts as a sacrifice, believing he will be able to come back alive. This confidence is borderline reckless: initially, he preferred to fight monsters barehanded, despite their superior strength and unpredictable abilities. He has a strong sense of justice and keeps count of the monsters he killed.

name: Joon-Seop Shin
description:
Joon Shin, a very manipulative, amoral, and cruel man, is the leader of a gang of prison escapees and the final antagonist in Sweet Home.

He is a former drug dealer who was arrested by Wook Pyeon and sentenced to jail. During the Monster Apocalypse, he led a group of prisoners through a jail-break and stole a prison bus. 

He is clever enough to leverage the fake promise of essential resources to coerce the survivors into cooperation. He uses draconian methods to exert dominance over his gang and the survivors, such as threats of killing people who oppose him. He is, however, careful not to kill someone who may prove useful, such as those able to control their own monster. He is usually cold and calculating, but loses his temper when people disobey his commands. He also appears to hold a grudge against Pyeon as he was visibly enraged when challenged by Wook. Ultimately, Joon is selfish and isn't above abandoning his own gang if things go awry and is willing to turn into a monster in order to live.

name: Hyun-Shik Lim
description:
Hyun-Shik Lim is part of Joon Shin's criminal gang. He was arrested as a con artist. 

Hyun-Shik is a good actor and has working knowledge of psychology. He uses this to tell believable stories to manipulate other people into cooperating with the criminals, and presumably it is how he succeeded as a con artist before getting arrested. He is very proud of this ability and maniacally laughs about it when successful. He also appears to be the only one who genuinely cares for the other members of his gang,

name: Kim-ssi
description: The security guard of the apartment complex Hyun Cha lives in.

name: I-Hyun Jo
description: I-Hyun Jo is in the band of criminals who attempt to take over the apartment building. He is one of few half-monsters.

name: Du-Sik Han
description:
An intimidating man who looks to be in his 30s or 40s. He is slightly overweight but still muscular​ and sits in a wheelchair due to his missing left leg.
Du-Sik is quite skilled with engineering and mechanics, building many weapons/contraptions.

name: Gap-Su Seo
description: Gap-Su Seo is a member of Joon Shin's criminal gang. Out of all the members of Joon Shin's gang, Gap-Su is the most immoral and impulsive to the point of disobeying Joon's orders. He is willing to do many immoral things to others to satisfy his needs. He is also petty and vengeful. His impulsiveness and unreliability keeps him relatively low in the gang's pecking order, as he was the only gang member not given any important task to fulfill.

name: Thistle
description:
__Height:__ 130 cm

Thistle is the mage responsible for the creation of the dungeon on The Island and a jester who served in the court of King Delgal during the Golden Age. His actions make him the primary antagonist of the manga Delicious in Dungeon.

As the lord of the dungeon, the Lunatic Magician has a great amount of power over both the structure of the dungeon and the monsters that inhabit it. His lifespan has also been extended by the dungeon's power. He is incredibly loyal and protective of the king, and is willing to destroy anything he perceives as a threat to his throne or kingdom. The elf was present in the king's life since his birth and for major events such as his wedding and coronation.
  (Source: Dungeon Meshi Wiki)

name: Cithis
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm

Member of the Canaries, an Elf group sent to investigate the dungeon. She appears to be second in command to Misurn. Her magic specialty is unknown, but she offers to 'burn' an enemy at one point, and seems to use a tool that looks like a branch of lily of the valley flowers.

She was convicted for the use of ancient magic, incitement to murder, documents forgery and fraud. Sentenced for life.

Cithis' priority appears to be keeping Mithrun alive, due to his inability to remember to do so for himself after his desires were removed by a demon. She is seen often at his side, helping to point him in the right direction when he wanders off track as well as keeping track of his meal times.

name: Kaka Floke
description:
__Height:__ 190 cm (6'3")

Kaka is of the twins in Tansu's party. He is a tall-man.

Kaka and his twin sister Kiki were born into a nomadic clan, but one day they were left behind at a tavern as children, and were sleeping in a stable when Mr. and Mrs. Tansu found and adopted them. They grew up surrounded by gnomes.

name: Fionil
description:
__Height:__ 150 cm (4'11")

Fionil is a novice adventurer currently exploring the dungeon with Doni. She is a half-elf from the Northern Central Continent.

Fionil was originally hired by the western elves to report any changes that occurred on the island due to the dungeon. However, she was so moved by Doni's story that she decided to leave her job and join him as an adventurer.

name: Ayame Moriya
description: Younger sister of Karen and the new team manager for the Eimei High badminton team.

name: Karen Moriya
description: [Chinatsu](https://anilist.co/character/191241/Chinatsu-Kano)'s best friend and [Haryuu](https://anilist.co/character/225314/Kengo-Haryuu)'s girlfriend.

name: Hana Nishiyashiki
description: She's a student of Class 3-3 often seen together with Rinko Yanagigaura.

name: Sumire Inukai
description: She's Aoba High School's nurse.

name: Uma
description: Uma (우마왕) is a main character, and the King of the Minotaurs. She is the Monkey King's sworn "brother" and an extremely powerful fighter. After her battle with Lee Soo-Jin, Uma had lost her physical body, but became apart of Baek Seung-Chul as his charyeok.

name: Garuda
description:
Garuda is the former Master of the second Heavenly Realm and a former member of the Nine Kings. He passed through to the Human Realm when Ultio R open the portal.

(Source: God of High School wiki)

name: Gung-Do Nam
description:
Nam Gungdo was a participant of G.O.H Tournament. He was the runner-up in the regional tournament and thus was selected for the final rounds.

source: GoH-Fan Wiki

name: Itona Horibe
description: Transfer student who aims to kill [Koro-sensei](https://anilist.co/character/65643). He is the second assassin transfer student to arrive at Class 3-E, following the previous assassin, [Ritsu](https://anilist.co/character/74832). He initially served as the secondary antagonist, before ultimately joining Class E for good. After being abandoned by [Shiro](https://anilist.co/character/176246) and befriending [Terasaka](https://anilist.co/character/85809) and his gang, Itona has since become more mellow and humble, and is now able to admit people are stronger than him, while still retaining his brutal honesty. He has also shown to be a very observant and creative individual.

name: Manami Okuda
description: She is a student in class 3-E of Kunugigaoka Junior High School, taught by Korosensei.   Okuda is shy and rather introverted. She admits that she isn't really good with surprise attacks and expressing things in language. She excels in chemistry and capable of making poisons for assassinations.

name: Gastro
description: One of three assassins in Okinawa, along with Smog and Grip. He loves the taste of a gun so much that he uses it as a utensil.

name: Tomoya Seo
description: Tomoya Seo is a student in Class 3-A in Kunugigaoka Junior High School and one of the Five Virtuosos. He is also the Student Assembly Chairman.

name: Irina Jelavic
native: イリーナ・イェラビッチ
description:
__Occupation:__ Professional Hitman, Part-time Foreign Language Teacher 

She is a professional hitwoman who is hired to kill [Korosensei](https://anilist.co/character/65643/Koro-sensei) by becoming a part-time foreign language teacher in class 3-E. She uses her charms to seduce Korosensei, making him at first obeys to whatever she asks. However, her first assassination attempt was foiled when Korosensei able to suppressed her 3-men's attacks, ending in her humiliation and swore revenge. She teaches the students how to seduce people from other countries, so that with this method, they can learn foreign languages, and usually would punish male students who failed answering her questions during her lesson by kissing them.    

Irina is a deceitful, wily and beguiling individual; she frequently uses her charm to influence and manipulate her targets. She can easily befriend people, if she so chooses, and entice them to let down their defenses and become vulnerable to her. Seduction is primarily the technique she employs, and it is her area of expertise. Irina is a professional assassin who excels at handling infiltration and approaching targets. She possesses strong conversational skills in ten languages, and a proven track record of eleven jobs in countries all over the world.

name: Meiko Inoue
description: Meiko graduated from university two years ago and lives in an apartment in Tokyo with her boyfriend [Taneda](https://anilist.co/character/18351/Taneda-Naruo). She has no real goals or direction in life and stepped into society as a rather clueless person. She worked as an office lady, but soon grew unhappy and decided to quit her job. Having broken her routine, Meiko enjoys a sense of freedom, but her uncertainty soon returns and she, along with her boyfriend, must learn to embrace their unpredictable future.

name: Naruo Taneda
description: Taneda is Meiko's boyfriend and lives in an apartment with her in Tokyo. They support themselves through their jobs (Taneda is an illustrator in a press company), but both up and quit when they realise they just aren't happy. Taneda has a great passion for music and is a guitarist and vocalist in a band with his friends. After quitting his job he decides to try and make it in the music industry by going pro.

name: Katou Kenichi
description: Katou is Ai's boyfriend. He is still a college student because he had to repeat a year. He is the bassist of Taneda's band.

name: Ai Kotani
description: Kotani is Katou's girlfriend. She works as a sales clerk in a clothing store.

name: Jirou Yamada
description: Yamada is the drummer of Taneda's band. He works as a clerk in a drugstore.

name: Lili An
description: She is the daughter of the Water Tribe General An Jun-gi. Though she appears to be a confident and brave girl on the outside, she is actually a shy, caring person, who tries to hide her personality by acting and talking big to others. As a general’s daughter, Lili doesn't like to show her weaknesses to others, and once she does, she considers it as a disgraceful behaviour​.

name: Piccolo Daimaou
description: Piccolo Daimao is a character from the anime and manga series Dragon Ball, and appears from time to time in a couple flashbacks of Dragon Ball Z. He is introduced as a Mazoku in the story who once precipitated the Earth into utter chaos and pandemonium, giving birth to a brood of animal-like Namekians from within himself and converting a peaceful planet into a living hell. Later, it is revealed that he is the evil half and evil twin brother of Kami; the two were once a single entity. Piccolo Daimao's name is based on the instrument of the same name — hence, all of his sons share the names of various musical instruments. While he is named after a flute, the others are named after percussion instruments.  Piccolo Daimao came into being some 300 years before the beginning of Dragon Ball sometime after a powerful Namekian on Earth attempted to assume the position of guardian of Earth, he was neglected of the position due to the evil that occulted within. As a result, the Namekian concentrated and trained to relinquish the evil within; which conspired into producing two separate entities — if one should perish, the other would also. The concentrated evil being known as Piccolo Daimao. At first, the name "Piccolo" was a reference to the wind instrument, but then a revelation by Mr. Popo to Bulma meant it translated to "different world" in Namekian.

name: Toninjinka
description:
The Carrotizer Bunny is a human-like Rabbit with the ability to turn anyone he touches into a carrot, which gives him an upper hand despite being physically weak. After his and his henchmen's defeat, the trio are left on the moon by Goku to pound mochi. Their fate is in reference to the Japanese fable of a rabbit said to live on the moon and pound mochi. 

In the _Dragon Ball: Adventure Special_ guide book, Akira Toriyama said that since Jackie Chun destroyed the moon, the Carrotizer Bunny and his henchmen are now simply drifting through space (though after the moon returns, they seemingly returned to their prior role as seen in an extra page of _Dragon Ball Super_).

(Source: Kanzenshuu)

name: Oob
description:
