Oob is a child that was introduced in the World Tournament after Goku defeats Majin Boo. When Boo is killed, Goku wishes that he gets reincarnated as a good person so that he could battle with him once again. Oob is the result of this wish, hence his name. Goku decides to train Oob at the end of Z and GT begins with the completion of Oob's training. Oob grew up a young warrior/farmer boy. Oob got his particular powers because he was created from Boo. Oob later fuses with the original Majin Boo. This transformation doesn't affect his appearance much, but increases his power to the point of almost matching Bebi in power. He then later fights Super 17 and then later the evil dragons.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Yakon
description: Yakon is a character from the anime and manga, Dragon Ball Z. While his exact origins are unknown, Yakon's home planet is referred to as Dark Star (Ankoku) and is a land shrouded in darkness, giving him the ability to see in the dark. He is a monster controlled by Babidi, and is portrayed as one of his strongest followers (and was possibly intended to be placed on level 3 as Dabura claims that sending Yakon to level 2 is too drastic an action). He is a voracious monster with an apparently insatiable appetite as he greets the Z Fighters by asking which one he should eat first despite the fact that he had devoured two messengers Babidi sent him only minutes before. His power level is said to be at 800 Kili (a unit of measurement that is different from power levels displayed on the conventional scouters). As stated by Babidi, this is a level much weaker than Goku's power level of 3,000 Kili (as a Super Saiyan). Yakon sports a large, retractable claw in each of his forearms. According to the Supreme Kai, he is one of the most feared creatures in the universe and is one of the most powerful beings in his quadrant of the universe.     Dragon Ball Wiki

name: Uran
description:
Astro's cybernetic sister in the manga and anime series Astro Boy, as well as its many adaptions. She is a superhuman android with a naive, tomboyish personality.

She is the third robot addition to Astro's family, the first two being his parents. Uran is an extremely mischievous little girl who constantly lands her older brother in trouble. While lacking Astro's weaponry and propulsion systems, she is extremely powerful.

Like Astro, she is fully capable of experiencing human emotions (although she is somewhat immature), by being naughty or disobedient, even annoying.   

__2003 Series:__

Uran reappears in the 2003 series with the name Zoran, with a slightly altered look, including a more appropiate dress in order to appeal to more western audiences. She still retains her tomboyish personality and cheekiness, however is shown to be more adventurous (which instead often puts her in trouble). She is given the ability to communicate with animals and befriends a bird which she names Houdini, however is often jealous of her brother's powers (such as the ability to fly, as well as his popularity).

name: Aya Oosawa
description: Part of the popular crowd, her grades aren't great but she has good communication skills and has a lot of friends. Popular with the guys at school but she takes no interest in them.

appearsIn.title: The Guy She Was Interested In Wasn't a Guy at All

name: Mitsuki Koga
description: Has a quiet and reserved personality, her classmates mistake her for an anime otaku. She can be a little airheaded in certain circumstances.

appearsIn.title: The Guy She Was Interested In Wasn't a Guy at All

name: Megumu Narita
description: In the same class as Aya and Mitsuki. An easygoing and refreshing stud (self- proclaimed) who is popular and admired by many. He's reasonably well-liked by the ladies, so when he encounters a girl he can't easily charm, he can't get her out of his head (currently, he can't get Mitsuki and Aya out of his head, but more in the sense that he's watching over them). If someone says something mean to him, he'll smile while actually getting depressed on the inside. However, he bounces back ridiculously fast. As far as his club activities go, he's in the soccer club (but he's probably the type who gets invited to all kinds of clubs).

appearsIn.title: The Guy She Was Interested In Wasn't a Guy at All

name: Joe
description: Mitsuki's uncle. He doesn't have children of his own, so he's all-in on loving his niece. The ultimate doting uncle. He's always pursued what he loves, so he wants Mitsuki to be true to herself as well. When he was young, he worked hard to make a living from music, but now he's the owner of a run-down CD shop.

appearsIn.title: The Guy She Was Interested In Wasn't a Guy at All

name: Kanna
description: [Joe](https://anilist.co/character/305502/Joe)'s ex-girlfriend. She works as a stylist in L.A. Mitsuki looks up to her because she focuses on the things she wants to do and pushes hard towards them.

appearsIn.title: The Guy She Was Interested In Wasn't a Guy at All

name: Mao
description: Mao is another girl from Aya's inner circle. She always follows Chizuru wherever she goes and is secretly interested in Narita.

appearsIn.title: The Guy She Was Interested In Wasn't a Guy at All

name: Chizuru
description: Chizuru, along with Mao, used to be Aya's best friend. She doesn't like that Aya spends so much time with Mitsuki lately.

appearsIn.title: The Guy She Was Interested In Wasn't a Guy at All

name: Fujiyoshi
description: Fujiyoshi is a Deadman and a former member of Scar Chain. He died during the Deadman mass prison break. In the anime, he was named Matayoshi instead of Fujiyoshi.

name: Sorae Igarashi
description: Ganta's mother.

name: Bundo Rokuro
description: Chief of Intelligence for Scar Chain. His Branch of Sin takes the shape of a hexagonal shield with spikes on the side.    (Source: Deadman Wonderland Wikia)

name: Miya
description: Miya is a Deadman and a former member of Scar Chain. She died during the Deadman mass prison break. In the anime, she was named Harumi. Her branch of sin takes on the form of a ring, used as a projectile.

name: Wakabayashi
description: Wakabayashi is a Deadman and a former member of Scar Chain. In the anime, he was killed by Hagire Rinichirou in Toto Sakigami's body. In the manga, he was killed by Genkaku's gunfire.

name: Tokushirou Tsurumi
description:
Leader of the 7th Division and one of the antagonists of the series.

Tsurumi has an unpredictable, mildly histrionic and erratic behaviour. However, In the past, Tsurumi was normal and was even a brave Japanese officer who fought at the front during the Russo-Japanese war.

Receiving a shrapnel in the head and the general bitterness at the poor treatment his division has received after the war has made Tsurumi psychotic and violent, though some of his manipulative tendencies may have been present even before the injury. He is prone to threatening people and personally inflicting physical injury on his enemies but hides his brutal tendencies under a veneer of sophistication and sympathy. He also genuinely admires the macabre work of [Edogai](https://anilist.co/character/128972/Edogai-Yasaku) and develops a friendship with him. Tsurumi never becomes angry, but coldly manifests his rage with a brutal gesture, perhaps due to his brain damage.

Tsurumi aims to take over Hokkaido and is very ruthless in his methods. He kills anyone in his way or threatens his plan. He seems to still hold the men under his command in high regard but hates traitors. He has shown a level of care for his subordinates as seen when he tries to get [Nikaidou](https://anilist.co/character/127291/Nikaidou-Kouhei) to eat his food and provide prosthetic limbs for him.

Tsurumi is also a very charismatic and manipulative man that can sway the minds of other people with a powerful and explosive speech.

name: Tatsuma Ushiyama
description:
One of the Abashiri Convicts. Ushiyama is a pragmatic and serious criminal. Aiming to steal the Ainu gold, Ushiyama is focused on his mission and always threads with prudence, regularly offering reasonable advice to [Hijikata](https://anilist.co/character/125422/Hijikata-Toshizou).

He is also a womanizer. Ushiyama lusts after any beautiful woman he comes across and is very direct when he solicits sex. It is his main way of distracting himself. He claims that in a relationship, a man's penis is the most important factor, but says that it has to be "gentlemanly".

As a judoka, Ushiyama relishes fights and challenges. When he met [Sugimoto](https://anilist.co/character/124704/Sugimoto-Saichi), he was impressed favorably by his strength and befriended him. He likes to fight and had a great time clashing with Sugimoto, being disappointed when it was interrupted. Ushiyama is confident in his fighting prowess to the point he will challenge a (weakened) bear in combat and even briefly taunts it about spreading his legend among bears when he forces it to flee.

name: Otonoshin Koito
description:
Koito Otonoshin is a Second Lieutenant of the 7th Division.

Koito is a tall, dark-skinned man with dark hair. He has his side part slicked down to the left. His eyebrows are usually furrowed, with two larger sections towards the center, and furrow wrinkles up his forehead. His eyes are black, thin, and have deep eye bags.

Because Koito is from the Satsuma Province, which is located in the southern tip of Japan, his dialect slips out sometimes. This often happens when he is excited or nervous. However, this dialect cannot be understood by most Japanese speakers.

name: Kiroranke
description: An Ainu and an old friend of [Asirpa's](https://anilist.co/character/124701/Asirpa) father.

name: Shounen
description: It's the first human our main character meets. It is also the first human form our main character can transform into. His version of this boy is called 'Fushi'. The boys own name has never been mentioned.

name: Uroy
description: One of the guys [Fushi](https://anilist.co/character/136548/Fushi) meets on the island of Jananda.

name: Pocoa Uralis
description: [Bonchien's](https://anilist.co/character/138876/) younger sister.

name: Chabo
description: A boy who was put in a prison with [Bon](https://anilist.co/character/138876/Uralis-Bonchien-Nicoli-La-Tasty-Peach) because he stole. He was there to balance the weight.

name: Nand
description: He is one of the Jananda prisoners [Fushi](https://anilist.co/character/136548/Fushi) fought in the arena

name: Kazumitsu
description: A person living in the present era. [Aoki](https://anilist.co/character/204185/Aoki-Yuuki) and [Aiko's](https://anilist.co/character/204182/Aoki-Aiko) grandparent.

name: Hirotoshi
description: [Mimori's](https://anilist.co/character/204418/Mimori) brother-in-law

name: Jin-Hyeok Kang
description:
Kang Jin-Hyeok is the protagonist of [I’m the Max-Level Newbie](https://anilist.co/manga/137280/Na-Honja-Mallep-Newbie/).

description: He is a general manager at Awakened Association.

name: Alice Von Ataraxia
description:
As the previous head of the Ataraxia family, she was one of the top ten of the tower in the past. She was betrayed by her clan's taboo and was imprisoned with her family in the Corridor of the Fallen.



__Skills:__

name: Cheol-Sik Jang
description: He was a part of Ha-Na's group that wanted to cooperate with Jin-Hyeok to clear Labyrinthos on the 1st floor.

name: Gunsoo Shin
description:
He is the leader of the Crow Guild.

__Skills:__

name: Teresa Du Laurentia
description:
She is the youngest daughter of the european aristocratic family of Laurentia.

__Unique Ability:__


__Skills:__

name: Jong-Su Lee
description: He is a Paprika TV partner streamer and newtuber with over 500 000 subscribers.

name: Dai-6 Kikantou no Jinkou Chinou
description: An artificial intelligence that manages Main Tower No.6. Their main job is to be an intermediary between machines and humans.

name: Tomomi Nomiya
description: Nomiya was once the captain of his institute’s basketball team before he left school. Some time ago, he was involved in a motorbike accident while giving a girl a ride, leaving her severely injured. Burdened by guilt, he now visits her often. Determined to change his life for the better, Nomiya dedicates himself to helping others and does whatever he can to support a wheelchair basketball team.

name: Hisanobu Takahashi
description:
At the start of the manga, Takahashi is a typical high school alpha male-- captain of the basketball team, popular with girls, effortlessly smart, and a bully to other "inferior" students. In an effort to give his girlfriend a ride home after school, he steals a bicycle, is chased into traffic, and is hit by a garbage truck, rendering him paralyzed from the chest down. Realizing that his popular days are over, Takahashi feels that he has nothing to live for, and that he has dropped from an "A" class person to lower than an "E" class (Takahashi is obsessed with ranking the people around him - in ranks from A to E, with A being the best). Nomiya, a former teammate, is one of the few visitors Takahashi receives, and the visit is initially enough to upset Takahashi and inspire him to rehabilitate. After realizing he will never recover, however, Takahashi gives up and refuses to help himself, even going so far as to tell his mother to die and never come back. The hospital staff calls Takahashi's father, hoping that a visit to the country will help in his recovery, but Takahashi hasn't seen his father in eight years and the visit remains highly uncomfortable. After spending time with his father, Takahashi breaks down and admits that he has a lot of unexplored anger and resentment towards his father for abandoning the family.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Kiyoharu Togawa
description: Forced to spend all of his free time after school practicing the piano, Togawa was something of an outcast to the rest of his junior high classmates. During the last PE class of the first semester, Togawa agrees to race the 100M dash against the fastest boy in his class and nearly beats him, earning an invitation to the school's track team. Togawa soon dedicates his life to becoming the fastest sprinter in the nation, but just as his goal seems in reach, he is diagnosed with osteosarcoma and loses his right leg below the knee. Togawa spends much of his time after the amputation in isolation, feeling his life is over until meeting [Tora](https://anilist.co/character/33506/Tora-Katsuta), an older man with an identical disability. Tora, a cool jet-setting tattoo artist, serves as a mentor to Togawa and introduces him to the world of wheelchair basketball through his team the Tigers. Togawa is a fiercely competitive player, and once left the team because he felt the other players weren't as serious as he was. Missing the game, Togawa returns to the Tigers, yet provokes a team mutiny early in the series because of his often unrealistic expectations. Further conflicts arise when Togawa is offered a spot on the Japanese national team and is invited to join the Dream, the Tigers; arch-rivals. Togawa is rated a 4.5 on the wheelchair basketball point scale.

name: Shiratori Kazuo
description: A pro-wrestling heel working his way back to his feet after a traffic accident.

name: Hisayuki Takahashi
description:
Takahashi's father. During Takahashi's childhood, he was a typical salaryman who worked long hours and drove an expensive car. He also introduced his son to the world of basketball, hand-crafting a backboard and teaching him several techniques. Takahashi lived for playing basketball with his father, and was devastated when he abandoned the family 8 years before the story. Fed up with the salary man lifestyle, Takahashi's father moved to the country and is currently living a much simpler life making and selling pottery. After Takahashi's accident, his father has become responsible for his son's care, refusing to give in to Takahashi's outbursts and cynicism.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Fumika Honjou
description: Fumika is one of the few people who visit Takahashi in the hospital after his accident (perhaps because she feels somewhat responsible for what happened). Takahashi doesn't think very highly of her (ranking her a "C" at best), but is somewhat surprised to find that she still considers them a couple despite his condition. She tells Takahashi how her dog, Angelina, will also have to use a wheelchair-like device, and that just because someone is "damaged" does not mean their life is over.

name: Kumi Azumi
description: Azumi is Togawa's childhood friend.    At the time, it seems they liked each other a lot, Togawa promising himself to tell her "when [he] beats 11 seconds". Unfortunately, this race was the last one he participated to as the sarcoma in his leg prevented him from finishing it, thus, not beating 11 seconds. With him in the athletic class, she was the only one to stubbornly persist in visiting him, though his father close them up from anyone's eye, to protect his son.    After his meeting with Tora, he accepts her presence showing her his amputated leg, and she surprises him when she names the procedure, indicating him she did research about it.    She is the Tigers' manager, often playing the peacemaker between Togawa and his teammates, given he has temper.    She met Nomiya in driving school, where she admits she is trying to have her licence so that she can drive Togawa to games and practices.    She is shy and self conscious, though can get quite angry (in her thoughts) when Togawa doesn't acknowledge her efforts with dealing with him.

name: Yamauchi Hitoshi
description: Yama meets Togawa in the same time as Tora. He is also in the Tigers' team and introduces Togawa to it. Yama has an illness that makes him lose little by little the use of his muscles.     Yama was the manager of the Hanazawa Middle School track team before his illness prevented him from. He knows every national 100m race winner, even stating that the last one was won by Togawa as, before he stopped because of his leg, he "ran the fastest". He talks to Togawa about his illness (saying he will not live after 20) without being resentful, what Togawa doesn’t understand, being depressive after his own operation. Yama tells him that "nobody knows why we're alive. We don't have time to bother".    When Yama can hardly go out of his home, Togawa often visits him, always with a remainder of the Tigers, and Yama is always cheerful about it. He once assumed Azumi and Togawa were together, saying they were "a nice couple" and asking about their engagement, embarrassing them both.    As the disease progresses, Yama becomes very negative and bitter, making Togawa distressed. To help him, Togawa tells him how much of a hero he is to him, showing so much normality when he knew he was doomed, and helping him too.

name: Mitsuru Nagano
description:
A huge 190 cm tall wheelchair basketball player who originally schools Nomiya and Togawa when they try to hustle money on the basketball court. Since Togawa has never lost a game to another wheelchair basketball player before, he is inspired to rejoin the Tigers in order to get revenge on Nagano. Though Japanese, Nagano attends New South Wales University in Australia and calls everyone "mate." Impressed by Togawa's skills, Nagano eventually joins the post-mutiny Tigers.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Katsuta Tora
description: Tora is a tattooist and a player for the Tigers' team in its beginnings. He has a huge tiger tattoo on his back, reminding of his name which also means "tiger". He is the one making Togawa stand up for himself and fight in life after his amputation.    Tora is a jolly character full of strength. Like Togawa, he has a "rotation" for his amputated leg, but that doesn't seem to faze him. He meets Togawa while this one is performing a check for his operation, and knows already his name, barely introducing himself and telling Togawa to use a wheelchair before speeding away. When Yama takes Togawa to one of the Tigers' session, Tora's strength and speed astonish him, when he thought he could no longer feel anything that could compete with the feelings he had while running.    When Togawa comes back to see the Tigers after crying after Azumi, Tora states it's "good, excellent" (the crying after a girl, while Togawa tries denying everything), puzzling everyone, then makes Togawa drive a wheelchair, integrating him by making him chasing them while he knows Togawa isn't good with wheeling a chair, thus considering him equal to the rest.    He then brings him to his tattoo shop, where Togawa has a fright given that Tora's apprentices mistake Togawa for Tora and pounce on him.

name: Mina
description:
Mina is a little girl that was traveling with her mother, Alibaba, and Budel. She does like to hear stories about Dungeons and the treasures within them. In the manga, Mina and her mother are free citizens, but in the anime, they were slaves.  

(Source: Magi Wikia)

name: Amon
description: A djinn of stern and etiquette. In the 7th Dungeon's basement, in a city that spread out there, Aladdin and the others met Amon, a polite yet rigid djinn. He materialized in the form of a muscular, bearded old man with an intimidating air.   (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Masrur
description:
Height: 195cm  
Likes: naps  
Weakness: children  
Birth place: Dark Continent   

One of the eight generals. He uses the weapon household's vessel "Balalark Kauza." He is also a "Fanalis," like Morgiana. He does not speak a lot usually and is seen as emotionless and unfriendly. However, he is really kindhearted—he just doesn't show it often. His senior, Sharrkan often picks fight with him. However, he only listens to what Sinbad says.

name: Zaynab
description: Cadre of the 'Fog Troupe'. She uses the magical weapon 'Sword of the Scarlet Delusional Fog'. Although she is going out with Hassan, they often get into fights.   (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Titus Alexius
native: ティトス ・アレクシオス
description: Titus appears as a young, short boy in the Magnostadt arc. He has medium long blonde hair with two small, thin braids. His appearance is amazingly similar to that of the Magi, Scheherazade; for his parted fringe hairstyle, the shape of his eyes, the mole under his left eye and his earring on his left ear, which resembles grapes, are similar the headpiece Scheherazade wears.   He wears a loose sleeved, high open collared shirt with a cravat, and loose shorts with a front open slit and buttonable hems under his magician's robes. His cravat has an oval jewel embedded in it, and he wears knee high, fold over boots. He was mistaken for a girl by Aladdin because of his high voice and his big bottom.

name: Desir Herrman
aliases: Desir Arman (デジール・アルマン)
description:
__Magic Circle Rank:__ Tier 3 (Analysis Magic)

Desir Herrman is the central protagonist of A Returner’s Magic Should Be Special. After his return to the past upon the failure of clearing the Shadow World, he resolves to strengthen his allies so that the future doesn’t get repeated. In Hebrion Academy, commoners are frowned upon and put into the Beta class whilst the nobles are designated the alpha class, Desir is one of the commoners who hates the class system and wants things to change. As a result he and his friends set out to close the gap by showing the teachers and aristocrats that commoners can have as much potential as the nobles if given the right circumstances.

appearsIn.title: A Returner's Magic Should Be Special

name: Pram Schneider
aliases: プラム・シュナイザー
description:
__Circle Tier Level:__ 3 (Swordmage)

Pram is a member of Desir Arman's alpha party made of commoners.

appearsIn.title: A Returner's Magic Should Be Special

name: Romantica Eru
description:
__Circle Tier Level:__ 3 (Wind Mage)

When Desir Arman first meets Romantica after returning from the Shadow Labyrinth she exhibits a superiority complex due to her position as a noble which slowly decreases as the story progresses and she gets to know Desir Arman.

appearsIn.title: A Returner's Magic Should Be Special

name: Azest Kingscrown
aliases: アゼスト・キングスクラウン
description:
__Circle Level Tier:__ 4 (Swordmage)

Azest Jedgar F. Roguepalace was the firstborn of Gilltian Jedgar F. Roguepalace, the current emperor of the Hebrion Empire and thus the heir to the Hebrion throne. Initially Azest was a cold person and she tends to be uninterested about other people unless they consist of her close friends in the Desir group.

appearsIn.title: A Returner's Magic Should Be Special

name: Zod Exarion
description:
__Circle Tier Level:__ 7 (Sage)

Sage of Wisdom Zod Exarion is the Master of the Tower of Magic and the one and only Seventh-Circle magician in existence. He was known as the greatest mage in the world, the man who had singled-handily revived interest in magic. He also was one of the 100 people who fought against Bhromier Napolitan and one of the six who survived the battle.

appearsIn.title: A Returner's Magic Should Be Special

name: Swan Katarina
description: Swan Katarina is one of the four Royal Guard of the Hebrion Empire. She is also the best archer in the empire.

appearsIn.title: A Returner's Magic Should Be Special

name: Momoshiki Ootsutsuki
description: Momoshiki Ōtsutsuki was a member of the Ootsutsuki clan and the main antagonist in Boruto: Naruto the Movie.

name: Shikadai Nara
description:
A chuunin of Konohagakure, and the heir to the Nara clan. As a member of Team 10 with his team-mates [Chouchou Akimichi](https://anilist.co/character/121443/Chouchou-Akimichi) and [Inojin Yamanaka,](https://anilist.co/character/121441/Inojin-Yamanaka) he forms the seventeenth generation of the Ino–Shika–Chou trio. 

Shikadai is the only child of [Shikamaru](https://anilist.co/character/2007/Shikamaru-Nara) and [Temari Nara.](https://anilist.co/character/2174/Temari) Shortly after his birth, Shikamaru took notice of Shikadai's cry and suggested that the infant would be better off exploring the world with his friends. Being acquainted with [Mirai Sarutobi](https://anilist.co/character/131422/Mirai-Sarutobi) since his birth, the two developed a sibling-like relationship during their training days under his father. He would also regularly be practiced on by her for her genjutsu. As his parents continued to stay close to their childhood friends over the years, Shikadai ultimately came to know the various parents' respective kids well but grew especially close to [Boruto Uzumaki.](https://anilist.co/character/121439/Boruto-Uzumaki).

Shikadai takes after his father in several ways, like possessing a similar relaxed, unenthusiastic personality. He finds participating in activities to be very tiresome and is quick to shirk out of them as seen when he rejected an invitation from Inojin to train after school.

name: Jigen
description: Leader of Kara.

name: Eida
description:
In his plot to kill [Jigen,](https://anilist.co/character/130418/Jigen) [Amado](https://anilist.co/character/130417/Amado) heavily modified Eida with Shinobi-Ware, along with an unspecified amount of Outers with capabilities exceeding that of Jigen. The affects of her modifications left her forever despising Amado. Because of her superior might, Jigen had ordered for her disposal. [Boro](https://anilist.co/character/180513/Boro) was given the order. However, affected by Eida's powers, Boro could not bring himself to complete the task, and instead hid Eida in a remote location operated by his cult for his own uses. 

Eida is a very cold and distant person. She cares little for the events around her. This comes from having grown bored in the life that was forced upon her. With all people automatically drawn to her, her greatest desire is to find someone who will genuinely love her. Eida showed great interest in [Kawaki](https://anilist.co/character/130426/Kawaki) after he deceived [Isshiki Ōtsutsuki,](https://anilist.co/character/189948/Isshiki-Ootsutsuki) yet she also showed interest in [Boruto](https://anilist.co/character/121439/Boruto-Uzumaki) seeing him as cute and dreamy. It was because of Amado who gave her the ability to be irresistibly attractive to everyone that she hates him, accusing him of taking away her ability to be genuinely loved, and she expressed her desire to kill him for it.

name: Kinshiki Ootsutsuki
description: Kinshiki was a member of the Ootsutsuki clan, who served as a retainer for his son Momoshiki.

name: Tokio Kurohara
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm

The protagonist of Choujin X. Tokio is a second-year student at Tsuru High, and is a good friend of [Azuma Higashi](https://anilist.co/character/224490/Azuma-Higashi)'s. Following the events of the first chapter, Tokio became a Bestial Choujin.

As a small child, he and his classmates went on a field trip to a zoo, where they had to draw an animal that represented them. After Azuma got compared to a lion, Tokio's peers decided to mock him by comparing him to a vulture, an animal that has negative undertones associated with it. They continued to bully him until he broke down into tears before running away. Later, Azuma caught up to him and consoled him, pointing out a cool fact about vultures, which made Tokio see them in a more positive way. The event seemingly became a treasured memory for him, as his room can be seen decorated with a picture of a vulture.

name: Azuma Higashi
description:
__Height:__ 158cm

Deuteragonist of Choujin X. He is [Tokio Kurohara](https://anilist.co/character/224464/Tokio-Kurohara)'s best friend. Azuma is a short yet very athletic young man who is described as possessing rather attractive features. He has short white hair in a bowl cut, yellow eyes and can usually be seen wearing glasses.

Azuma has a very straightforward and heroic personality. Due to his father being an accomplished police officer, Azuma was raised with the mentality to always be ready to help people in need, no matter who they are.
Azuma and Tokio have been friends since childhood. Due to his father being an accomplished police officer and engraving the idea of justice into his head, Azuma would often protect his friend from bullies by fighting them, something that Tokio greatly appreciated.

name: Ely Otta
description:
__Height:__ 135 cm

She is upbeat, kind, determined, yet stubborn. She tries to help as many people as she can, but has been shown to be quite unforgiving in regards to people who've wronged her or anyone else. She also has a mature side, being rational and level-headed when talking about the reasoning behind her clearly set goals or dreams.
Ely is terrified of ending up just like her mother, so from a very young age she imposed several moral codes upon herself. She strongly believes that "All life comes from the soil" and "All that is borrowed must be returned". However, her mother's actions influenced her subconsciousness so much so that it became her Choujin power.

name: Maiko Momoma
description:
__Height:__ 161cm

[Simon](https://anilist.co/character/263736/Simon-Kagomura)'s partner and a student at Konpei High. Maiko is an amicable Keeper, helping [Tokio](https://anilist.co/character/224464/Tokio-Kurohara) and the others when they join Yamato Mori to learn more about the world of Choujin. Tends to keep Simon's overly serious and pragmatic nature in check.

name: Simon Kagomura
description:
**Height:** 175 cm

[Maiko](https://anilist.co/character/284978/Maiko-Momoma)'s partner. Simon is cold to those he doesn't usually speak to, and can be scary at times. He takes his job seriously and understands how terrifying the world of Choujins truly is. He also believes that being a Choujin is "inconvenient by nature".

name: Johnny Takeyama
description: A thug-turned-Choujin that [Tokio](https://anilist.co/character/224464/Tokio-Kurohara) and [Azuma](https://anilist.co/character/224490/Azuma-Higashi) encounter in chapter 1.

name: Kinako Kurohara
description: [Tokio Kurohara](https://anilist.co/character/224464/Tokio-Kurohara)'s sister

name: Hoshi Sandek
description: Yamato Prefecture's Choujin Protector. Second-in-command after Tsukiko Mado and the strongest member of Yamato Mori.

name: Chandra Hume
description:
__Height:__ 178cm

An antagonist and a powerful Choujin dedicating himself to "[Mother](https://anilist.co/character/318802/Sora-Siruha)". Appears to have awakened Eli's Choujin powers by way of infection with his own abilities.

name: Nari Tsumiji
description:
__Height:__ 164 cm

A minor antagonist sent after Tokio to discover his Choujin ability.

name: Kakeru Kurosawa
description: Quiet and introverted, Kakeru keeps to himself - especially as he has a dark secret. Spending each afternoon in the girls bathroom masturbating, he loves being able to picture doing perverted things with females who wouldn't normally look at him twice. With much to learn about life, Kakeru finds that friendship and romance are much more important than painting the inside of a toilet stall.    Kurosawa spends time at the school library everyday, reading. He reads many books. He is also camera-shy and does not socialize with others, preferring to be a loner.

name: Aya Kitahara
description: A shy girl who is isolated from the class. She is being bullied by Sugawa. Later she discovers Kurosawa's secret and asks him an unexpected request.

name: Keiji Nagatsuka
description: Kurosawa's friend. He was the first person to socialize with him in school. He is an otaku.

name: Magister Takigawa
description: One of the three "school idols" in Kurosawa's class who first comes across Kurosawa in the school library on a rainy day. She has a very energetic and accepting personality, easily becoming friends with Kurosawa, Kitahara, and the otaku of the class.  She plays a pivotal role in Kurosawa's development.

name: Kyouko Naitou
description: The schools number one idol and a classmate of Kurosawa. She works as a model for a popular magazine. She thinks of her self as a princess, often acts high-and-mighty. All of her best friends consist only of the pretty ones in class.

name: Erika Nishimoto
description: A classmate of Kurosawa and a member of the sports club, but she can't swim. She has good personality. Also she has been sitting next to Kurosawa since the 3rd semester of the 2nd year.

name: Maiko Sugawa
description: Bullies Aya Kitahara, smokes in the bathroom after school, and has a tsundere personality.

name: Ayumi Harada
description: Friend of Maiko Sugawa. Together, they relentlessly bully Aya Kitahara on a daily basis.

name: Shuuta Seki
description: The fattest kid in the class, he is part of the otaku clique headed by Nagaoka.

name: Nomiya
description: The teacher of the class.

name: Megumu Koyama
description: Megumu is an esper and a former member of Claw. He was part of the upper echelon called "Scar".

name: Mob no Chichi
description: Mob's Father.

name: Minori Asagiri
description:
Minori Asagiri is a middle-school girl and the daughter of a wealthy businessman.

Asagiri is very spoiled and very cruel. The first we see of her, she throws a tantrum due to dissatisfaction over lavish birthday presents. This is her true personality, according to her father, that existed before she was possessed by Mogami. Within the world Mogami created and trapped Mob in, she acts very similarly. She bullies, isolates and abuses Mob. Apparently, she does this because she wants to prove herself superior, and by preying on those who are weaker and can't stand up for themselves, she establishes her position. However, after being saved by Mob, she is brought to tears and resolves to become a better person because of him.

name: Haruto  Kijibayashi
description: He is a third-year middle school student and a member of the Telepathy Club.

name: Leanno
description:
Leano is Legosi's mother.
 

(Source: Beastars Wiki)

name: Rokume
description:
Rokume is a minor character in Beastars. She is the one and only security guard of Cherryton Academy.

Rokume has a very hesitant demeanor and, because she is always hidden, she does not usually socialize with anyone at all. Rokume is also easily excitable (especially with Legoshi's actions). Although she declared to be envious of Legoshi since according to her, she was born with the shame of having no limbs and only by hiding can she bear it.

(Source: Beastars Fandom Wiki)

name: Miguno
description: Spotted hyena who is part of the canine room 701 with Legoshi. He plays electric guitar with a vulture in a band called "The Leftovers".

name: Eado
description: Large Asian lion attending the same university as Haru. He is dating a mini rex rabbit named Ako.

name: Sheele
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3)

Sheele is one of the members of the Assassin's group, Night Raid. While she seems to be clumsy and ditzy on the surface, she's a very caring and sweet person. She bears the Teigu "Ecstasy", a huge pair of scissors that can cut through anything.

name: Gozuki
description:
Gozuki is the leader of the newly formed assassination squad of the Empire, the Elite Seven.

(Source: Akame ga Kill! Wiki)

name: Air
description: Air was one of three girls who were sold to Bach, due to their village being deeply in debt by the over taxation of the Empire.

name: Kubikiri Zank
description: Zank was once an imperial executioner. Possess the Imperial Arm Spectator, that has the form of a headpiece with a large eye attached to it. He was known for severing the heads of his victims. Night Raid was contracted to track him down and kill him.

name: Koutei
description: Koutei is the young ruler of the empire. He is shown to be a naive young boy who wishes to lead his people to a bright future. Unfortunately, due to the Prime Minister's influence, he is largely ignorant to the suffering of his people, and is actually contributing to the collapse of The Empire.

name: Numa Seika
description: Numa Seika was the Prince of the Northern Tribes. Know for his in combat and tactics abilities.

name: Tompetty
description: Tonpetty is a minor ally featured in Part I: Phantom Blood. He is a Ripple master who trained Will Anthonio Zeppeli as well as Straizo and Dire.

appearsIn.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Part 1: Phantom Blood

name: Doobie
description:
Doobie is a minor antagonist featured in Phantom Blood. He is a musclebound masked zombie that Dio Brando sics on Poco's Sister after she refuses to serve him. Doobie grabs the girl and rips her dress in an attempt to assault her, but his plan is quickly ruined by an anvil thrown by Jonathan Joestar.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

appearsIn.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Part 1: Phantom Blood

name: Dario Brando
description: Dario is the father of [Dio Brando](https://anilist.co/character/4004/Brando-Dio). An alcoholic and abusive man, he is primarily responsible for contributing to Dio's descent into evil. After a tragic misunderstanding, [George Joestar I](https://anilist.co/character/21956/Joestar-I-George) decides to give him a favor and adopts his son Dio into the Joestar Family.

appearsIn.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Part 1: Phantom Blood

name: Poco
description:
Poco was a cowardly boy who got bullied by other kids, but was protected by his sister. When confronted by her about when he was going to fight back and live on his own, Poco answered that he would do this "tomorrow", which causes her to slap him.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

appearsIn.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Part 1: Phantom Blood

name: Wang Chung
description: Wang Chan is a minor antagonist featured in Part I: Phantom Blood  personally as a human, Wang Chan has shown a greedy personality, selling a poison to Dio Brando without any regard for its use and heading back to the Joestar mansion to salvage for treasures and antiques. Upon becoming a vampire, however, he becomes entirely devoted to Dio's wishes.  Synopsis   Originally only known as the "Oriental Man", he owned a curiosity shop on Ogre Street. Wang Chang sold Dio the poison which Dio used in his murder of Dario Brando and his attempted murder of George Joestar, although Wang was not concerned with what the poison was to be used for. He told Dio, without much, if any, intent to provoke him, of a man in his own land who had a similar birthmark to Dio's who had had a harsh life, but in the end lived to be over 183.   Sometime after, he was was captured by Jonathan Joestar and taken to the the Joestar Manor. When he is used in an attempt to force Dio to go with the police, he again mentions his fortune telling, saying that Dio is far too lucky to fully have to give up this early. Dio uses George's blood to become a vampire, taking Wang Chan as his subordinate when the latter goes to search the Joestar manor for valuables.   Dio trusts him enough to be responsible for his head and implanting it onto Jonathan's body.

appearsIn.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Part 1: Phantom Blood

name: Jack
description:
Jack is a serial killer who meets Dio Brando and is transformed into a Zombie sent to fight the Joestar Group. He was inspired by the historical figure of the same name.

(Source: JoJo Wikia)

appearsIn.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Part 1: Phantom Blood

name: Senzaemon Nakiri
description: Senzaemon is headmaster of Tōtsuki Academy and [Erina](https://anilist.co/character/75284)'s grandfather. Known as the "Gastric Godfather", he has the tendency of stripping his upper body when he eats a good dish. Despite his appearance and reputation, he is reasonable and gives accurate commentary and assessment for the food he tastes without being overly critical to the losers.

name: Fumio Daimidou
description: She is the warden and guardian of Polar Star Dormitory.

name: Roland Chapelle
native: ローランド・シャペル
description: Roland Chapelle (Rōran Shaperu) is one of the stern lecturer in the Totsuki Culinary Academy, who was infamous for his extreme discipline. Earned the nickname as the Chef Who Never Smiles, Chapelle takes student's performance and presentation in a serious matter which every presentations counts as if it is their conduct in their future careers, not just in French cuisine but also others involves cookery. Whoever failed to reach his eligible standard shall faced his worst judgment upon them, making this veteran lecturer a judge, jury and even executioner in this prestige academy. He always has been this strict until Yukihira Soma, the Yukihira transfer student's resourceful and innovative cooking that made him smile for the first time with the impression Soma's version of Boeuf Bourguignon; making Soma is the first (and the only) rookie chef intrigued by this iron heart veteran.  As the professional lecturer with French Cuisine is part of his forte and pride, Chapelle is very serious upon his native dish and he is not tolerate any fools (student or anyone alike) making fun of it. It is also believed that rigid discipline meant 100% success, Chapelle has a concept that any student whom didn't pass with the flying colors are considered people who failed to prove their worth.

name: Kiyoshi Goudabayashi
description: Kiyoshi Gōdabayashi is a 91st Generation student of Tōtsuki Culinary Academy. He was the 76th president of the Chan RS before it was disbanded and destroyed as a result of a loss in a Shokugeki against Erina Nakiri.

name: Ikumi Mito
description: She is one of the student of Tootsuki Culinary Academy whom is also a former rival to Yukihira Soma. As the sole successor of the meat culinary expert of the Mito family for abundance knowledge about the meat culinary (especially beef and donburi), Ikumi is responsible to hold the pride of her family's name and like any other students in Tootsuki Culinary Academy, Ikumi is extremely prejudice upon the society classes and use high class ingredient to make a high standard dish.  It is said that Ikumi's rigid family rules and regulations had made her cooking skill more elegant and grace like playing piano. Using all graces of cooking by using the high grade materials as well as expensive, Ikumi can almost made the dish as elegant as it look to impressed her clients.

name: Yeo-Un Cheon
description:
He was a member of the Cheon Family and was the son of a female servant who worked at the Lord’s chamber and was not from the Six Clans. Although considered as an illegitimate son of the Lord due to a servant mother, he was still part of the Cheon family and he had the right to the throne but had an extremely low chance without support. 

He doesn't learn any martial arts in his early 15 years due to his oath with the Lord's wives from Six Clans. After entering the Demonic Academy, only then did he learn Martial Arts and have an unimaginable growth rate due to Nano Machine'a support.

name: Mun-Gyu
description: Gyu Mun is the female protagonist of Nano Machine. She is the granddaughter of Yun Mun, one of the elders of the Demonic Cult. She is a part of Yeo-Woon Cheon's team during their stay in the Demonic Academy.

name: Heo-Bong
description: He is Cheon Yeo-Un's first subordinate.

name: Hobeopga
description: The Great Guardian of the Heavenly Demon Divine Cult and Protector of the Heavenly Demon Order. He is famous across the Murim for his unparalleled speed and swift sword techniques that hundreds of masters have died to which earned him the title, the Dark King.

name: Baek-Gi
description: Coming from the Gentle Kick Clan, he is one of the most trusted followers of Cheon Yeo-Woon.

name: Wang-Heul Go
description: He is from the upper sect of the Magic Sword Sect and is a master of martial arts. He is the first of the six swords.

name: Sang-Hwa Ho
description: She is the first female warrior who joined Yeo-Woon Cheon in the Demonic Academy and one of his Six Swords. She joined him because of his strength and his character as a leader.

name: Maeng Seop
description: The Right Guardian of the Demonic Cult. His nickname is Crazy Blade, due to his drunkard-like and unpredictable blade skills. He is the first Teacher Yeo-Woon Cheon had in his martial arts journey.

name: Hwa-Myeong Lee
description: He is the head of the Demonic Academy.

name: Elisabeth
description:
__Race:__ Vampire

Elisabeth is one of the three monarchs of the Lawless City and the Queen of Vampires.

name: Quinton
description: A ferocious swordsman who has participated in the Bushin Festival many times.

name: Marie
description: Owner of a tavern in Lawless City where she also works as a bartender. She originally came to the city after being sold into prostitution at age 13.

name: No.665
description:
__Race:__ Elf

665 is a member of Shadow Garden's Numbers and is in a squad with [664](https://anilist.co/character/229662/No664) and 666. She has a calm personality and is good at providing support.

name: Akira
description: Codename #28 in the Japanese government's secret ESP project. An estimately 8 year old boy around whom the story revolves. Akira's power was so immense that he inadvertantly caused the destruction of Tokyo in 1988 and was secretly sealed afterwards in a cryogenic chamber underneath the destruction site.  *Manga Spoilers*

name: Koutei
description: The current Emperor fulfills the role expected of him. He is hated by his mother, the Empress dowager, for being the product of her rape. His most trustworthy relationship is with his brother, who manages small things behind the scenes for him.

name: Lakan
description: Lakan is a renowned strategist known for his nonchalant disregard of proper manners. His plotting ability causes fear even in the Emperor himself. He sees people's faces as a piece of shogi representing their worth, with a few exceptions like the woman he loved and his daughter. Currently heads the La clan.

name: Ruomen
description: Ruomen is a physician of the Inner Court, a physician in the red-light district, and Maomao's father.

name: Keiji Kiriya
description: A new recruit in the United Defense Force. He finds himself caught in a time loop where he wakes up one day in the past after having been killed on the battlefield. Through the training and battles he experiences in these loops he comes into his own as a soldier.

name: Rita Vrataski
description: A U.S. special forces soldier. Highly decorated and peerless in battle, she is seen as a hero by the entire world.

name: Shasta Raylle
description:
Shasta Raylle is [Rita](https://anilist.co/character/84787/Rita-Vrataski)'s mechanic.
She is MIT graduate that was able to skip a year, proving her genius. However, she is shy, easily frightened and taken by surprised.

name: Jin Yonabaru
description: Jin Yonabaru is [Keiji](https://anilist.co/character/84785/Keiji-Kiriya)'s colleague. He is talkative Corporal.

name: Bartolome Ferrell
native: バルトロメ・フェレウ
description: [Keiji](https://anilist.co/character/84785/Keiji-Kiriya)'s platoon sergeant. An overly fitness-conscious man who takes care of his subordinates.

name: Rachel Kisaragi
native: レイチェル・キサラギ
description: She works in the kitchen.

name: Arthur Hendricks
native: アーサー・ヘンドリックス
description: The platoon leader who held Special Forces together.

name: Junichirou Tanizaki
description:
__Height:__ 174 cm (5'8.5")
__Ability:__ Light Snow

He is a member of the Armed Detective Agency and the older brother of [Naomi](https://anilist.co/character/89209/Tanizaki-Naomi).

name: Ichiyou Higuchi
description: A beautiful and intelligent woman who wears pants. She belongs to a commando unit that answers to the leader of Port Mafia, and has authority over the military group "Black Lizard." She adores Akutagawa and calls him "senpai."

appearsIn.title: The Girl From the Other Side: Siúil, a Rún
The Girl From the Other Side: Siúil, a Rún

name: Chiyomi Ogawa
description: Ogawa is a classmate of Tomo and best friend of Mifune.

name: Akiko Tanabe
description: She is the younger sister of Tanabe Tatsumi.

name: Naoko Mifune
description: Mifune starts off as not the nicest person along with her best friend Ogawa, she tried to pick a fight with Tomo Aizawa, which was a bad idea. But since it was a misunderstanding they have since become somewhat friends.

name: Mu-Won Jin
description: The last descendant of the 4th generation leader of the Northern Heavenly Sect, Kwan-Ho Jin. With his supposed death 10 years ago, he reappears as the 5th generation leader of the Northern Heavenly Sect and given the title "The Northern Blade".

appearsIn.title: The Legend of the Northern Blade

name: Ha-Seol Eun
description: Eun Ha-Seol is a mysterious girl who came across Jin Mu-Won after being attacked by a unknown assailant. After recuperating from her injuries, she gradually began to open to Mu-Won while rebuilding her strength and took it upon herself to defend him when the Northern Heavenly Sect was under attack before being rescued by her master, the Witch of the White Night Seo Geum-Hyang.

appearsIn.title: The Legend of the Northern Blade

name: Soo-Cheon Dam
aliases: Lone Star of the Cerulean Sky
description: Dam Soo-Cheon, commonly known by his epithet Lone Star of the Cerulean Sky, is a martial master and the current family head of the Valley of No Return and a member of the Seven Lesser Heavens. He is the third son of Dam Jeok-Shim, a member of the Nine Skies. He, along with Seo-Moon Hye Ryung and Shim Won-Lee, created the Cerulean Dragon Society in order to allow young martial artists a great voice within the affairs of Murim.

appearsIn.title: The Legend of the Northern Blade

name: Mu-Sang Seo
description: Seo Mu-Sang is introduced as a member of the Third Mercenary Group dispatched by the Central Heavenly Alliance to keep guard over Jin Mu-Won and served as its Vice Captain and Second in command. He was also the chief strategist of the group.

appearsIn.title: The Legend of the Northern Blade

name: Kwan-Ho Jin
description: Known as the 4th generation leader of the Northern Heavenly Sect, Jin Kwan-Ho was unrivaled under the heavens and known by the title "North Wall". After decades of successfully defending the mainlands from the Silent Night, he was ultimately betrayed by his most trusted comrades and The Nine Skies. After giving up his own life with the request to spare his son, Jin Kwan-Ho unknowingly paved a horrible and treacherous path for his son.

appearsIn.title: The Legend of the Northern Blade

name: Hwang-Cheol
description: Hwang-Cheol is a former warrior of the Northern Heavenly Sect. Self defense is the extent of his martial arts, and as such, he was the weakest warrior in the sect. However, he is unmatched in his devotion and loyalty towards the sect. Even after the dissolution of the sect, he remained loyal to the sect, and by extension, loyal to Jin Mu-Won. After the dissolution of the Northern Heavenly Sect, he worked as a wandering merchant and would do his best to bring supplies for Jin during Jin's adolescent years in the ruined Northern Heavenly Sect, and also helped Jin with supplies during Jin's time, training in the Jeokam mountains..

appearsIn.title: The Legend of the Northern Blade

name: Mu-Seong Yong
description: Leader of the Iron Brigade.

appearsIn.title: The Legend of the Northern Blade

name: Hye-Ryeong Seo-Mun
description: She is known for her intelligence.

appearsIn.title: The Legend of the Northern Blade

name: Ji-U Seo
description:
He is a very bright and kind person who will go out of his way to help the people around him. His main ability is super speed. 

In the past, Ji-U had no friends because he was afraid that people would discover his powers and those they discovered would treat him like a freak. The first friend he made was a stray cat, which led to his adoration for cats today.

His mentor is Kayden Break, who started to live with him. He is friends with Ji-Seok Yu, U-In, and Su-Bin Lee.

name: Kayden Break
description: Kayden is a secret agent on the run, who finds himself stuck in the body of a fat old fluffy cat. The strongest unaffiliated person in the world, capable to crush even those trained by the groups, which had accumulated vast amounts of data in their systems over the years. He is teaching Jiwoo about the awakened world as his teacher and coach.

name: Ji-Seok Yu
description:
He is the younger brother of Ji-Yeong Yu, the CEO of Shinhwa Association.

He is one of the most powerful, if not the most powerful, awakened person in his age group in South Korea.  There are only a few teenage awakeners in Korea that are able to rival him. Like his sister, his awakened power is aerokinesis. 

He is friends with U-In, Ji-U Seo and eventually Su-Bin Lee.

name: Ji-Yeong Yu
description:
Being the leader of Shinhwa, Ji-Yeong Yu's responsibility is to teach new awakened ability users the basics and provide the most basic levels of support as well as keep the awakened world hidden from the normal world.

She is a famous highly ranked awakened wind ability user, the most powerful awakened in South Korea and has a good reputation. She's the older sister of Ji-Seok Yu.

name: U-In
description: U-In was a student under Dr. Delein, and has no known last name that is currently revealed. He is an independent awakener with no affiliation. His ability is telekinesis. U-In becomes friends with Ji-U, Ji-Seok and Su-Bin.

name: Su-Bin Lee
description: She is the granddaughter of the Awakened Union leader. She is on par with Ji-Seok in terms of power, making her quite strong. She is friends with Ji-Seok, Ji-U, and U-In. Her ability is cryokinesis.

name: In-Hyeok Gu
description: He is known to be in the top 20 in the ranks of awakened people in Korea, however, his rank is unknown. He is often seen with Ji-Yeong as they assist matters of Shinhwa together.

name: Seong-Ha Park
description: Seong-Ha Park’s past has not yet been revealed, however he is a strong awakener as he is considered to be in the top 20 ranks of powerful awakeners in Korea. He is part of the Awakened Union and has close ties to the leadership of the group as shown by how highly Su-Bin Lee regards him.

name: I-Seul Ju
description:
She is the student representative of Mir, an organization made up of awakeners that specialize in controlling animals. Her ability is also animal control. 

I-Seul has a white pet dog that is very big and loves hugs. His name is Duri.

name: Hyung-Suk Park
description:
__Height:__ 150 cm (4’11”) (Old Body), 178.5 cm (5’10”½) (New Body)
__Relatives:__ His mother, David, Dylan, and Sarah (cousins)

Hyung-Suk is a student in the fashion department of J High School. He has a unique ability in which he can transfer his consciousness in and out at will between two completely different bodies. He is a very kind and friendly person at heart, preferring to avoid unnecessary conflicts if he can, but will help those in need even in dangerous situations.

(Source: Lookism Wikia)

name: Bum-Jae Park
description: He is a student in the architecture department at Jae Won high school and Vice-leader of Burn Knuckle.

name: Chun Wang
description:
__Height:__ 182 cm (6’)

Olly Wang used to go to the same cram school as Sally Park and Heather. He was a smart kid whose immigrant parents pushed him to extreme lengths to be a good student. His parents were so overbearing that he felt like he was driven to insanity. 

Olly became obsessed with Eli Jang after witnessing him destroy Backdoor. He did anything to get Eli's attention, stealing from minors and even robbing his own house. When Gun decided to destroy Hostel, Olly advocated for them and Gun decided to let them go, on the condition that Hostel becomes one of the four crews.
His reckless behavior and choices can be attributed to the fact that he cannot feel pain or emotions. This inability to feel anything also contributes to his obsession with Eli Jang because he believes that Eli is the only one who has made him feel anything previously,

name: Charles Choi
description: He is Crystal's father and the CEO of HNH Group, a conglomerate company that own many smaller businesses. He one of the few people that know about Daniel and Crystal's secret.

name: Aru Lee
description:
__Height:__ 164 cm (5’5”)

Aru Lee is a graduate of PTJ Entertainment, and now an idol. She is also Udon's ex because she had cheated on him.

name: Jae-Yeol Hong
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm (5’7”)
__Relatives:__ Steve Hong (father), [Joy Hong](https://anilist.co/character/176782/Hong-Jae-Hye) (sister), Kitae Hong (brother)

Jae-Yeol is a student in the fashion department at Jae Won High School. He is an extremely quiet person who does not speak a word to anyone but is shown to be a strong fighter with a good sense of justice.

name: Se-Rim Park
description:
She is the leader of Hostel B and Warren Chae's best friend.

(Source: Lookism Wikia)

name: Jong-Geon Park
description:
__Height:__ 190 cm (6’2.9”)

Jong-Geon Park is a fighter of legendary status and the personal bodyguard of the HNH chairman's daughter, Choi Soo Jung.

name: Ji-Tae Kwon
description: He is a member of Big Deal, and second in command to Kim Gimyeong.

name: Sinu Han
description: Sinu Han is a minor character and the former leader of Big Deal. He was ousted from his position by Kim Gimyeong when he attempted to sell Big Deal to the Workers.

name: Kyousuke Yotsuya
description:
[Miko's](https://anilist.co/character/139631) younger brother.

Kyousuke is a young boy with short black hair. He is very protective of Miko, even going far enough to assume she has a boyfriend to be wary of.

name: Romm Shindou
description:
__Powers-&-Abilities:__ High-Level Spiritual Awareness, Aura Awareness
__Etymology:__ Romm's surname Shindou means "prodigy, wonder child" (神童).

He can see spirits and humans simultaneously, like one's reflection in glass and the scenery behind it.

He sells many items which interact with the far shore. He was given the name "Romm" by his former master, Mitsue Takeda, as part of the tradition of adding a 2nd name to apprentices.

Romm has been seen to be very bold, running a business geared only to those adapted to seeing spirits. Even though many have called him a fraud, Yuria Niguredou believes in his ways and has been roped into buying some of his products. He is also very mischievous, taking amusement in the unpredictable actions made by Miko Yotsuya. He enjoys teasing Mitsue Takeda.

name: Mamoru Yotsuya
description: Father of Miko and Kyousuke.

name: Shintarou Jagasaki
description: Jagasaki works as a night patrol in a town called Buppa. Although he has the authority due to his job, he seems to have lack of perseverance even towards some street thugs. His catchphrase is "shoot 'em up", while pretending his right hand is a gun.

name: Clarabelle Kawamoto
description: Jagasaki workmate.

name: Chiharu Matsuyamachi
description: He is the main antagonist of the Jagaaaaaan manga and one of the most powerful fractured human warriors seen thus far. He was infected with a frenzied tadpole and became the fractured human warrior "Hidarikki" and got the ability to grow and manipulate wood on his body and met his partner, The Hawk of Paradise Naraku.

name: Misogi Hakuto
description: Hakuto is 21-year-old student majoring in International Studies in Buppa University and founder of Hero Fractured Human's Group.

name: Yukimaru
description: Yukimaru is a Half-Fractured Human who is trying to take his revenge on Shintarou Jagasaki for killing his family.

name: Motomu Robahata
description: He was an ex-peep photographer who, one day, was infected with a frenzied froglet and became a half fractured human after watching the girl he liked have sex with another man, then proceeded to rape her in revenge.

name: Cale  Henituse
description:
__Relatives:__
- Deruth Henituse (father)
- Drew Thames (deceased mother)
- Violan Henituse (stepmother)
- Basen Henituse (younger step-brother)
- Lily Henituse (younger half-sister)


__Occupation:__ 

__Affiliations:__ Henituse Family, Roan Kingdom

 Cale‘s original personality was that of a spoiled brat. His mother died when he was very young and his father remarried and created a family he didn't like. He used to be a 'good boy', but he began acting 'trash'-y at the tender age of 8 and started drinking when he was 15. Though he liked to cause trouble, he still afforded respect to his family and the few people whom he saw worthy enough to be treated like human beings (such as his butler Ron). Cale never forced himself upon women and defended women as well, although he originally loved to drink every night until dawn. He also never beat up innocent people, only throwing (and always missing) his alcohol bottles at gangsters while drunk. 

The current Cale is just as lazy as the old Cale and wishes to live his life as the “trash” of the count's family in comfort. He has others do many things for him so that he does not have to get involved with the storyline, but somehow, he always gets involved in one way or another. He is still a very kind and gentle person to those he is close to and can be worldly-wise and generous. Sometimes he can give advice, motivate, or comfort people with his words without realizing it.

name: Choi  Han
description:
__Occupation:__ Swordmaster, 
__Abilities:__

name: Raon Mir
description:
A 6 year old black dragon (he was 4 years old at the beginning of the story) who started following [Cale](https://anilist.co/character/187471/Henituse-Cale) after he was saved by him from [Venion Sten](https://anilist.co/character/277605/Sten-Venion). He was imprisioned and tortured by Venion for the span of four years. 

Cale gave the Dragon the name Raon Miru, pure Korean for "Joyful Dragon" after the black dragon asked him to do so.

He possesses destructive impulses but looks out for his newfound family. 

Raon would give tear-soaked apple pie slices to Cale whenever Cale overused his powers or got hurt.

name: Ohn
description: Member of the Cat Tribe and Hong's sister. She was taken out of the streets by Cale Henituse.

name: Hong
description: Member of the Cat Tribe and On's brother. He was taken out of the streets by Cale Henituse.

name: Alver Crossman
description: Alver Crossman is the Crown Prince of the Rowoon Kingdom and the eldest son of Zed Crossman.

name: Ron Molran
description: A former assassin and the father of Vicross, Ron is currently the butler of Cale Henituse.

name: Lark
description: Member of the Blue Wolf Tribe.

name: Rosalyn
description: Former Crown Princess of the Breck Kingdom and an ally to Cale. She gave up her claim to the throne to pursue her aspirations of becoming a mage. Her goal is to become the master of the Magic Tower.

name: Taylor Sten
description:
The eldest son of the Sten family. 

He was originally the heir of the House of Sten, but was forced out after his legs became paralyzed due to having both his knees destroyed.

name: Vikir van Baskerville
description: The Hound of the Baskerville Clan who regressed after being cut down by the blade of the guillotine.

name: Aiyen
description: She first met [Vikir](https://anilist.co/character/309777) when he saved her from being sold as a slave in the auction.

name: Camyu Morgue
description: She was known as a Morgue Clan's Steel-Blooded Empress before [Bikir](https://anilist.co/character/309777)'s regression.

name: Akwilla
description: Chieftain of Ballack and mother of [Aiyen](https://anilist.co/character/309778). She is the person who gave Hugo a big scar on the bridge of his nose.

name: Dolores Quovadis
description: She's a saintess who is a living embodiment of goodness.

name: Hugo Baskerville
description: He is the Patriarch of the Baskerville family and the father of [Bikir van Baskerville](https://anilist.co/character/309777).

name: Chihuahua Baskerville
description: He is the office manager in Underdog City in the territory of Baskerville.

name: Yeon-U Cha
description:
__Height:__ 182 cm 

Yeon-woo is the main protagonist of the Korean web Novel, Second Life Ranker. Prior to entering the tower, he served in the army and later on went to take on the revenge for his younger twin brother. Yeon-woo later reawakened as a 'Dragon Human' becoming a 'player' after receiving the powers from the pocket watch of [Jeon-woo](https://anilist.co/character/165469/JeongWoo-Cha). He continues to climb the tower taking revenge on those who betrayed his brother and killed him.

He is a hard-working and determined person who greatly cherishes his family. Yeon-Woo was different from his younger brother who did everything effortlessly. He often had to try over and over again to solve a problem, but he tried not to show the efforts he made, pretending he was doing fine. Unlike his younger brother who could be categorized as a natural genius, all his achievements all came from being a hard worker through which he was able to achieve results that are reflective of his effort.

However, despite his rather advanced intellect and tactical genius, Yeon-Woo does indeed possess a childish side, where he was noted to possess a very bad sense of imagination when naming things and has a tendency of naming things with names usually though up by toddlers.

This is seen where he named the newborn Phoenix, "Chirpy" and when he obtained his Magical Dragon, he attempted to name it "Growl" and "Roar".

name: Jeong-Woo Cha
description:
Jeong-woo Cha is Yeon-woo Cha's younger twin brother. He was one of the strongest and the most famous high-ranker in the Tower before he was betrayed by his teammates leading to the events of the main story.

Jeong-woo was described by Yeon-woo as being a weak and introverted person who liked books, movies, and had a talent of not needing much work to succeed in most things. Furthermore, he also greatly valued his family, even leaving home in order to find a cure for his mother.

(Source: Second Life Ranking wiki)

name: Edora
description:
Edora is a member of the One Horn Tribe royal family. She is the daughter of the Martial King and the younger sister of [Phante](https://anilist.co/character/192568/Phante).

Unlike her brother, Edora is calm and collected. She speaks politely and does not like to waste her time with anything unnecessary. In essence, she is cold towards most people. However, after meeting [Cain](https://anilist.co/character/140547/YeonWoo-Cha), she developed romantic feelings for him; she began to blush and feel embarrassed when someone refers to both of them having a relationship.

(Source: Second Life Ranker wiki)

name: Phante
description:
Phante is a prince of the One-Horned Tribe and the one most likely to become the next King. He hails from the Cheonglam family with his mother being the tribe's current Psychic Medium.

(Source: Second Life Ranker wiki)

name: Nayu
description:
Nayu is the king of the One-Horned Tribe. He is commonly referred to as the Martial King and is one of the strongest people in the Tower. He is the only one among the Nine Kings that is capable of rivaling Summer Queen in individual might.

He is shown to possess a very care-free, mischievous and whimsical personality. Having become well known for being highly unpredictable in his actions by both his own Tribe's men and the other Rankers of the Tower. However despite his usually jovial disposition, Nayu has also shown the same immense blood-thirst, murderous intent and battle crazed craving as the rest of the One-Horned Tribe, a side of himself that he usually reveals in front of his enemies and his tribe's men in order to terrify or keep them in line.

Nayu as the Martial King was also shown to be highly intelligent and cunning when dealing with matters regarding the tribe's future, having been shown to be pragmatic and heartless enough to do the most dirties deeds in order to insure the tribe's prosperity and peace. 

However despite these traits, Nayu was shown to also have a very fatherly side to himself, as seen where he greatly enjoyed dotting and teasing his daughter Edora on her having successfully located a suitable marriage partner and was noted to be highly protective of her.

name: Yvlke
description: Yvlke is the Floor Guardian of the Floor 0, in other words the floor guardian of the tutorial. However, he also holds a special position as one of the leaders of all the Floor Guardians.

name: Yul
description:
Yul is a player that formerly climbed the Tower.

He is a determined boy. Although he is prone to cowering when bullied (like any boy his age), he is able to stand up for himself when he gets pushed too far.

(Source: Second Life Ranker wiki)

name: Doyle
description:
Doyle is one of the super rookies of the Tower. He was ranked 11th on the Tutorial's rankings before Yeon-woo Cha began his tutorial.

He is an extremely lazy young man such that he doesn't care about much outside of sleeping. He is also a clever guy but, due to his young age, he is still immature regarding certain matters.

name: Leonte
description:
Leonte was a high-ranker of Cheonghwado. He was dubbed the Fist God and was one of the clan's five leaders. 

Previously, he was a high-ranker and executive of Arthia, however, he defected to Cheonghwado when he realized that Arthia was bound to be destroyed, eventually. He was one of the five people that directly killed Cha Jeong-woo.

(Source: Second Life Ranker wiki)

name: Mikihiko Azuma
description: (debut)    Mikihiko Azuma is a mangaka that was serialized in "Shonen Three" ten years ago, but was cancelled very quickly. Back then, he wasn't a good mangaka; the only thing that his manga had were panty-shots, and a really bad story (according to Heishi). He brought his one-shot manga, Panty-Flash Fight, to Shonen Jump as a walk-in. He appears to be working either with or for another person (a younger male) who he contacts by cell phone.    (Source: Bakuman Wikia)

name: Kazuya Hiramaru
description:
__Birthplace:__ Kanagawa-ken, Japan   

Hiramaru was a salaryman​ that hated working. On hearing [Takagi](https://anilist.co/character/14552/Takagi-Akito) and [Mashiro](https://anilist.co/character/14545/Mashiro-Moritaka) talking about drawing manga on the subway and finding an abandoned copy of Jack, he quit his job to be a mangaka because he thought it would be less work for him. He is a different kind of genius compared to [Eiji](https://anilist.co/character/16596/Niizuma-Eiji) because he is talented even though he just started to write manga more in of a spur of the moment.

After teaching himself to draw manga in a very short amount of time, his manga, Otters 11 is serialized. He is hailed as a genius by [Koji Yoshida](https://anilist.co/character/38651/Yoshida-Kouji) who pushed for his serialization saying that Hiramaru had no real motivation to continue as a mangaka and failure would just make him quit.

Hiramaru is extremely lazy and immediately regrets getting serialized due to the amount of work to keep up a weekly series. He has said that he doesn't know why people have to work for a living and that he wants to sleep when he's tired and to eat when he's hungry. Due to his laziness, his editor, Koji Yoshida, often schemes to manipulate Hiramaru into working. Hiramura often tries to escape Yoshida to avoid working. His attempts to escape Yoshida is a long-running gag in the manga.

He is also a chronic hypochondriac and often makes incredible claims of illness.

name: Masahiro Mashiro
description: Masahiro Mashiro is the father of Moritaka Mashiro. He is the older brother of Nobuhiro Mashiro.

name: Shuuichi Moriya
description: (currently) Birthday: June 9, 1994  He is an assistant to Ashirogi Muto when they publish Perfect Crime Party. He is a year younger than Mashiro and Takagi. After he became a finalist in the Tezuka Award he decided to drop out of design school and concentrate on manga.  Moriya seems polite but it is revealed in his thoughts he has a very negative view on others. He can be quite snippy at times. Moriya believes manga should be about the art and creativity, and you shouldn't worry about popularity because you won't get anywhere if you do.  (Source: Bakuman Wikia)

name: Kouhei Oonishi
description: He is Gintama's editor.

name: Shoyo Takahama
description: Takahama was one of Ashirogi Muto's assistants, along with Ogawa and Kato, for Detective Trap. He did the figures, both sketches, and inks. Miura said he was the best artist of the new assistants he was in charge of. Originally, Takahama seemed very unsocial and didn't talk much at all. However, after coming to respect Mashiro's work ethic as a mangaka, he reveals his ambition to work at Disney and spends several nights discussing manga with Mashiro and Takagi.   He seems to be very enthusiastic about his manga, and grows frustrated with Miura after he feels that he is not letting him make the manga he wants. He respects people for their ambition and work ethic, as shown when he states that he has little in common with Ogawa and Kato because they are just happy with being assistants.    (Source: Bakuman Wikia)

name: Hidemitsu Ishizawa
description:
Ishizawa attends the same Junior High as Takagi and Mashiro. Ishizawa draws ecchi headshots of girls and brags about it. He later insults Mashiro's drawings. He is a large nuisance to the duo.   

(Source: Bakuman Wikia)

name: Urd Geales
description:
Urd Geales is a second progenitor of the vampires who resides in Russia. He is the current leader of the Progenitor Council.

(Source: Owari no Seraph wiki)

appearsIn.title: Seraph of the End: Vampire Reign

name: Seishirou Hiiragi
description: Seishiro Hiiragi is a Major General of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army.

appearsIn.title: Seraph of the End: Vampire Reign

name: Cheong-Myeong
description: Cheong-Myeong usually has a carefree nature and enjoys fooling around. However, when he has a goal, he sets his mind to it. Cheong-Myeong is intelligent, but often uses that to his advantage (but sometimes end up offending others). He enjoys drinking and indulges himself with food. Cheong-Myeong is sadistic and likes playing around with his seniors. He has confidence and doesn't waver in every situation and knows when he should retreat or run away.

name: Un Gum
description: Un Gum is a 1st ranked disciple of the Mount Hua Sect. He is the monitor of the White Plum Blossom Hall and trainer of the third class disciples.

name: Sama Seung
description: Sama Seung is an elder of the Zhongnan Sect.

name: Chun Ma
description: Chun Ma, also known as the Heavenly Demon, is the leader of the Demonic Cult.

name: Jo Gul
description:
__Height:__ 5'9

Jo Gul is a 3rd class disciple of the Mount Hua Sect. He's the second son of a merchant family.

name: Hyun Young
description: Hyun Young is the youngest of the three sages, and an elder of the Mount Hua Sect. He is the general manager of the Finance Office, and is involved in all matters of finance and economy.

name: Heo Jinin
description: Heo Do Jinin is the current sect leader of the Wudang Sect.

name: Cheongmun
description: Cheongmun, the Daxian Sword, is the 21st sect leader of the Mount Hua Sect.

name: Jin Geum-Ryong
description: Jin Geumryong is a second class disciple of the Zhongnan Sect and Baek Cheon's brother. He is the strongest and most prospective talent within the Zhongnan Sect.

name: Hyun Jong
description: Hyun Jong is the current sect leader of the Mount Hua Sect.

name: Yslat Han
description: He was a master of the game 'Pick Me Up' who went by the nickname of Loki and was ranked 5th in it. One day, he gets brought into the world of Taoneer as Han Yslat, a 1-star playable character.

name: Jenna Shirai
description: 1-star hero, who was summoned at the same time as [Han](https://anilist.co/character/298546). She learned archery from her father, who was a hunter.

name: Yvolka Strashur
description: She is a fire magician from a noble family.

name: Edith Callen
description: A 3-star hero, she was a member of the Maned Wolf Party.

name: Isel
description: Administrator of Taoneer. She is a fan of Loki.

name: Aaron Delkard
description: A 1-star hero, he was summoned up in the 3rd cycle of the draft.

name: Tel
description: She has many names, but the one she gave to [Han](https://anilist.co/character/298546) was Tel.

name: Yurneth Syd
description: The King's Eye. She is from Niflheimr where [Han](https://anilist.co/character/298546) was the Master.

name: Syris Agentheim
description: The King's Flame and Niflheim's only 4-star hero. She is from the Niflheim, where [Han](https://anilist.co/character/298546) was the Master.

name: Nihaku Geistfeld
description: The King's Bow. She is from the Niflheim, where [Han](https://anilist.co/character/298546) was the Master.

name: Jae-Hwan
description: Jaehwan is a young, South Korean male who was summoned to the Tower of Nightmares, a large construct consisting of 100 floors brimming with perilous monsters. Jaehwan's sole mission is climbing the Tower and saving humanity, which suffers from "Tower Impacts".

name: Mi-No Han
description:
__Ocupation__: Assassin
__Place of Birth__: Arkal, known as World 7651


Han Mino is a young woman who cleared a Tower of Nightmares
She is a 3rd Stage Adapter and works as an assassin for the Dark Forest Clan.

name: Cheong Heo
description: He is the doctor of the Gorgon Fortress. He is an awakened like Jaehwan. He is able to perform the "Undead Slash" which cures the spirit of those who are becoming Undead. He was part of the first Abyss expedition lead by Mulack Armelt

name: Sirwen Armelt
description:
__Place of Birth:__ Roots of the Tree of Imagery, Six Region

Siren is a pink-haired Nightmare (Dream Demon) known as the most popular streamer in Chaos. She works as a tower maker and was the apprentice of Mulack Armelt

name: Yu
description:
Yu is the main character of The Boxer. He becomes a professional boxer under the tutelage of the legendary [K](https://anilist.co/character/208937/K).
