Yu has a very dark and melancholic appearance, with unstyled jet-black hair that drapes down loosely on his head, distinctively coal-black eyes with even darker pupils and a wholly disinterested facial expression painted on his face with an equally 'dead' look in his eyes. He has a very skinny body which belies his deceptively athletic abilities.

Yu has a startlingly emotionless and disinterested persona, taking little to no interest in anything other than his pet cat. He is shown to be alarmingly apathetic, simply taking hits because he couldn't be bothered to dodge them and giving zero response when threatened by an obviously vicious person.

name: K
description: K is one the supporting characters in The Boxer. He is a legendary boxing trainer, having raised 5 boxing world champions. He is currently training Yu.

name: Yuto Takeda
description: Yuto is known as a positive person, always looking at the bright side. He's very motivated and doesn't give up despite all the obstacles he had faced. He's motivating not only himself but also those around him, helping them at the same time.

name: Josh
description: Josh (조시, Josi) was once a member of the Lions Boxing Club with dreams of becoming a professional boxer. However, after being annihilated by Yu, Josh gave up on his dream and currently works as a bartender.

name: Siha Lee
description: Siha Lee is a character in The Boxer universe. He was a boxing prodigy who was able to become one of the best boxers in Korea across all weight classes, being undefeated for 9 matches straight, with many top-ranking boxers unable to do anything against him, all of them suffering a crushing defeat by his hands. He was praised for his ability to memorize attack patterns, rhythms, timing, and everything about his opponents in a single round, using it all against them in the second round.

name: Fabrizo Santorino
description: Santorino Fabrizo bears the title of Middle Weight Champion. He is famous for using tricky moves and cheats.

name: Misaki
description: Misaki (미사키, Misaki) is the boxing coach of current light welterweight world champion Takeda Yuto.

name: Alma
description: Alma works as a Troubleshooter on Troubleshooters' Office on the surface with [Tao](https://anilist.co/character/185726/Tao), where they get paid for any work a client wants to be done, making their other work where they kill off calamities appear to be a secret job for him and [Tao](https://anilist.co/character/185726/Tao).

name: Tao Saotome
description: Tao is one of the main protagonists in Gokurakugai manga series. On the surface, she works as a Troubleshooter, where they are paid by clients who need any type of job done, making her and [Alma's](https://anilist.co/character/185725) other profession where they kill off calamities like a secret job.

name: Kanata Misumi
description: She was affiliated with an undisclosed organization within the realms of Gokurakugai District.

name: Memeko
description: Memeko is a part of the group that Yomi referred to as his family.

name: Jin Runcandel
description: The youngest son of Runcandel family.

name: Gilly McLauran
description: Jin Runcandel's nanny. In the past, she was a 7-star knight-level, boasting exceptional potential and skill enough to be called the next First Sword of the McLauran family. She cared for Jin more than anyone else, both in her past life and in her current one.

name: Ceres Endorma
description: The only daughter of Talaris Endorma.

name: Quicantel
description: The Silver Dragon of Time.The guardian dragon of the Olta Contractor. She and Murakan were lovers for approximately 500 years, 1000 years ago.

name: Valeria Heaster
description: Jin's magic mentor in his previous life. She is the sole survivor of the Heaster family, which was annihilated by Zipple.

name: Chiron Runcandel
description: Jin's father and the current head of Runcandel. He is the only true knight of the present age, the strongest knight, and the undisputed strongest human

name: Luna Runcandel
description: She's the 1st flagbearer of Runcandel also known as the White Whale. Despite being the strongest of all the Runcandel siblings, she has no interest in becoming the patriarch and has stepped away from the "Succession War".

name: Joshua Runcandel
description: The eldest son of Chiron Runcandel and  the 2nd flagbearer of the Runcandel. He was the most likely candidate for the next family head after Luna's announcement of relinquishing her position.

name: Shuri Runcandel
description: Originally witch Heluram's pet cat. Later made a pact with Jin, becoming Jin's cat.

name: Maki
description: Hina's best friend.

name: Kasumi Hazuki
description: Kasumi Hazuki is a first year college student at Meiji University majoring in Economics, Natsuo Fujii's next door neighbor at his apartment and an acquaintance of Misaki Ogura.

name: Shirou Fujimoto
description:
__Height:__ 177 cm (5'8")

Shirou Fujimoto was [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/24482/Okumura-Rin) and [Yukio](https://anilist.co/character/24734/Okumura-Yukio)'s guardian and was also considered to be one of the most powerful Exorcists in the world. He was thought to be the only man in the world that was able to sustain possession by [Satan](https://anilist.co/character/48449/Satan) himself and thus Satan was constantly after his body. Fujimoto had a familiar sith cat demon, which he called [Kuro](https://anilist.co/character/43187/Kuro), that Rin had inherited. He was a confirmed Aria, Dragoon and tamer and could possibly have been a Knight and a Docter as two of those who have studied under him have become these. He was said to be the strongest exorcist on the planet and was the only one to gain the rank of Paladin, the highest rank of the exorcists.

name: Noriko Paku
description: Noriko is Izumo's best friend but quits the cram school because she did not understand the classes and she was failing.

name: Kaoru Tsubaki
description: The Physical Education (P.E.) teacher in the cram school. Called by some students as "Ol' Sideburns", he is well known to abruptly cancel and/or leave class upon recieving a call from a woman currently identified only as 'Kitten', which is the name he calls her.     (Source: BlueExorcist.wikia)

name: Uwabami Houjou
description: is an Upper First-Class Exorcist at the Kyoto Branch Office and father to Mamushi, Nishiki and Ao Houjou.

name: Lucifer
description:
The King of Light and the strongest of the Eight Demon Kings. He is also the Commander-in-Chief of the Illuminati.

(Source: Ao no Exorcist Wiki)

name: Mamushi Houjou
description: Mamushi is a Middle First-Class Exorcist at the Kyoto Branch of the True Cross Order and Uwabami Houjou's daughter. Her sisters are Nishiki and Ao Houjou.

name: Ao Houjou
description: She is an Exorcist at the Kyoto Branch of the True Cross Order and Uwabami Houjou's daughter. Her sisters are Mamushi and Nishiki Houjou.

name: Makoto Okazaki
description: Makoto Okazaki is your run of the mill high-schooler, a perfect bullying target and a closet pervert. One night, on his way to return a DVD to a friend, he notices a person on a nearby rooftop. The person lunges at him and bites his neck, drinking his blood. The attacker, a beautiful girl, then asks him: "Do you want to die or become like me?" He decides to live...

name: Yukiko Gosho
description: Makoto's friend. She is antisocial and withdrawn from the rest of the group, she likes to eat lunch alone in a secluded place outside the classroom.

name: Nora
description:
Race: Vampire
Physical traits: A teenage girl, mysterious, charming, beautiful and cursed.

name: Yuki Ono
description: Shiraishi's boyfriend and Makoto's classmate.

name: Nao Shiraishi
description: Yuki's girlfriend and Okazaki's classmate.

name: Masami Sakurane
description: A cult leader, worshipper of vampires and the main antagonist of the series

name: Saku
description: A vampire living on earth for an unknown date.

name: Do-Heun  Chang
description: One of the members of the gang. He is known for his muscular physique but meek demeanor. Ken recruited Chang in a fight by using a variety of tactics to take him down. He loves his car and his hobby taking care of it.

name: Kae-Lyn Kim
description: The sexy weapon instructor during the mountain training.   She is the female member of the gang and also the "cleaner" of the Sun-Ken Group. She is a weapons specialist, mainly knife, and is obsessed with Ken.

name: Ken Kitano
description:
A high-school delinquent and the primary protagonist who drops out of school and leaves Japan in pursuit of his love, [Yumin](https://anilist.co/character/31889/Yoshizawa-Yumi). While in Korea he lives his life as a shut-in for an entire year being unable to find an actual job. After saving an old man from being killed by loan sharks, he was scouted and invited to join a local gang(gondal) to work under [Tae-soo](https://anilist.co/character/13825/Park-Tae-Soo) as one of his underlings.

After fighting against Tae-soo, he was offered the position of boss instead. He initially declined since he wanted to join the police force alongside Yumin but Tae-soo eventually manipulates him into taking the position.

His strength and sense of justice earns him the loyalty of his gang and the local community. As the leader of the Sun-Ken Rock Gang, he often hides his true identity from others (ex.: he tells Yumin he works at a video game company as a cover). Ken's parents were killed during a Yakuza war when he was 13.

The character design of Ken is heavily influenced from [Vash](https://anilist.co/character/162/Vash-the-Stampede) of [Trigun Manga](https://anilist.co/manga/30703).

name: San-ki Lee
description: The first member of Tae-Soo's gang after the death of Tae-Soo's father long before the story begins and one of Ken's henchmen. He is loyal to both Tae-Soo and Ken. An Ex Korean soldier, he often fights dual-handed with wrenches.

name: Tae-Soo Park
description: A Korean gangster and the true mastermind behind most of the gang's more underhanded actions. Originally the boss of the gang, he passed leadership over to Ken as he realized his potential and charisma. He serves as Ken's right-hand​ man, and has numerous underground connections and is in charge of handling the day-to-day business of the gang. He can be seen as the real evil behind the gang and is often doing dirty works for the gang, but his loyalty to Ken is unquestionable. He took over the gang after his father was killed. He was later put into a coma by Ban-Phuong's men.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: San-dae Yang
description: One of the original members of Tae-Soo's gang and one of Ken's henchman. He dislikes Ken and often While his loyalty is sometimes questionable, he is highly competitive and does not back down from a fight. He left his village when he was 16 after he had sex with a farmer's wife. Later on San-dae finds his hometown turned into a US Army Base and realizes that he can never go back to his previous life. His nickname comes from the fact that he uses an actual pickaxe in combat.   (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Yumi Yoshizawa
description: Ken's love interest, a girl that left Japan to become a cop in the department in charge of organized crime. Her true name is Yumi and she is actually Japanese.

name: Hui-Rin
description: The fifth lieutenant stronger. It has great strength and martial skills, and experience great struggles.

name: Bon-Fuu Kim
description: Born to a Korean father and Vietnamese mother. Bon-fuu's parents met during the Vietnam war when his father was a soldier who saved his mother as a child from getting shot by Korean soldiers. Later he felt guilty and returned to Vietnam to apologize.   Bon-fuu was trained by his father and learned martial arts and when his father died, Bon-fuu went to South Korea and fell in love with the Vietnamese girl Hae-yi. Their relationship was sadly short lived as she committed suicide shortly after when a bunch of Korean men tried to rape her one day she was home alone. This caused Bon-fuu to join the Mafia. His status is currently unknown after he defeated Ken.

name: Cherry Number Two
description: The third lieutenant stronger and twin sister of another Cherry. Like her sister, she has seduction techniques and expertise in martial arts. Her breasts are smaller than her sister.

name: Derrick Eckhart
description: __Height:__ 185cm

name: Penelope Eckhart
description:
Penelope is the adoptive daughter of the Eckhart family.

The protagonist, Siyeon Cha, transmigrates into Penelope's body after struggling with the Hard Mode of the game Daughter of the Duke - Love Project! and falling asleep. After years of abuse, the protagonist has become a cold-hearted and independent person. She can also be very sarcastic.

name: Callisto Regulus
description:
__Height:__ 188cm

The crown prince of the Empire of Eorka, Callisto Regulus is a cruel tyrant who treats humans like dirt. It is hinted that there may be an ill-fated reason for his disposition.

name: Ivonne Eckhart
description: Ivonne Eckhart is the true, biological daughter of Duke Eckhart, and younger sister of Derrick Eckhart and Reynold Eckhart. She is the heroine of the otome game Daughter of the Duke - Love Project! in Normal Mode.

name: Lulu Bell
description:
__Height:__ 166 cm

The blonde female Noah, who wears a black suit with a blue tie and often wears black shades. Originally appeared at the Noah Dinner Party with the first few revealed Noah.    She recently appeared in the manga again. Disguised as Andrew Nansen, she infiltrated the Order's headquarters to lead an invasion of a horde of Akuma after Allen and his friends' hard struggle in the Ark. She plans to re-obtain the "egg" and create Skulls out of the most intelligent scientists of the Black Order. After seeing Allen, she also decides to bring him to the Earl to fill the spot of the 14th. Unfortunately for her, the generals of the Black Order, Cross Marian, Cloud Nine and Winters Sokaro, have proven to be far too powerful for Lulu Bell and her high-ranking Akuma to handle. In the end, she tried to escape with the egg, but Allen was onboard and destroyed the egg, causing a massive explosion. Whether Lulu Bell survived the explosion or not is currently unknown.    Lulu Bell represents the "Lust" of Noah with the power of "Form".    In the anime adaptation, she often turns herself into a black cat to hide in the shadows or for spy purposes. She has cat-like qualities as well in her human form (for example, she licks her plate while drinking milk).    One of her main abilities as a Noah is the metamorphosis, in which she can transform herself into anyone or anything.

name: Bookman
description:
An old man who records the hidden history. He comes from the Bookman clan and doesn't have a name. Instead, he simply introduces himself as "bookman" during his first meeting with Allen. 

He refers to Allen as "The Destroyer of Time" as he believes that Allen is the only one who can defeat the Earl of Millennium. Bookman also mentions that a "Bookman" does not put himself in the frontline and he just happens to be on the same side as the Black Order. 

His anti-Akuma weapon is called Heaven Compass, which is a set of acupuncture needles. One of his moves is "Needles of Spells: North Crime" which impales the target with thousands of needles. His Innocence can also be used on a defensive technique called "Needles of Divine Protection: East Crime", making the needles encircle the target and protect it against external attacks. He also has some healing skills through acupuncture.

name: Zu Mei Chang
description: Zu Mei Chang is a metallurgist and Anti-Akuma Weapon manufacturer, as well as Head Chef of the Asia Branch of the Black Order. He is Bak Chang's great-uncle.  Formerly a great magician of the Chang clan who held a high position and wields a substantial power in the Central. He was the teacher of a younger Leverrier and one of the few people that addresses him as ‘Malcolm’. He’s also a master in culinary, and happens to be the master of Jeryy, the current Head Chef of the Headquarters. Even though he wasn’t directly involved in the ‘Second Apostle Project’, he couldn’t ignore his own guilt, he usually showed up in the research lab's kitchen to watch over the state of affairs.

name: Chaoji Han
description: One of three surviving crew members of Anita, Chaoji was seen reacting with Innocence, which was sent into the ark by Tiedoll when Lenali fell into the arc, and so was able to become an exorcist. Chaoji's Innocence, as of now still unnamed, is a pair of linked bracelets on his left wrist. The only power it has shown so far is to grant him superhuman strength on that arm, allowing him to pull the Allen, Lavi and Kanda all of out a bottomless pit they nearly fell into in with one pull, sending the three Exorcists flying.    (Wikipedia)

name: Cross Marian
description:
**Height:** 195 cm (6'4") 
**Affiliation:** Black Order 

[Allen](https://anilist.co/character/139/Walker-Allen)'s teacher, a scientist, and also one of the five Exorcist Generals. Currently, he has gone on a journey and has stopped corresponding with HQ for four years. Allen fears him, which is hinted from the fact most of his flashbacks that connect to his teacher end with some kind of traumatizing (usually humorous for readers) experience. He also has a habit of going into debt and making Allen work it off for him.

It is revealed by [Bookman](https://anilist.co/character/3154/Bookman) that Cross has the unique ability to convert Akuma, making them to work under his orders. The method of conversion is unknown though. Beside that, it's believed that Marian has the ability to control the Noah's Ark (an ability granted to him by a traitor of the Noah family, who was subsequently killed by [the Earl](https://anilist.co/character/858/Sennen-Hakushaku)), although it's unknown if this hypothesis of the Earl will turn out to be correct. Marian seems to be the only person the Earl is seriously worried about.

Marian is the only exorcist with two anti-akuma weapons. His first one is "Grave of Maria" which is a woman corpse that has a parasite type Anti Akuma weapon, She only serves Master Cross. The second one is "Judgement" which is a Giant revolver Gun and Crosses own Anti-Akuma Weapon.

name: Hiromi Hayakari
description:
Hiromi is a teenage girl from an all-girl school who meets [Hideo](https://anilist.co/character/37610) in the 'Sea of Trees' at the base of Mount Fuji. As first, she mistakes him for someone contemplating suicide and comforts him, after which the two become close friends.

She has a boyfriend who she simply acknowledges as Shinji, though she hasn't seen him since the outbreak.

name: Tsugumi Oda
description: A girl who befriends [Hideo](https://anilist.co/character/37610) and [Hiromi](https://anilist.co/character/78073) during their refuge at the Outlet Mall. Before the outbreak, she was a nurse.

name: Hideo Suzuki
description: Hideo is a down-on-his-luck mangaka who found work as an assistant after his own series was cancelled due to poor sales. He comes across as fairly timid and insecure, but often has spurs of confidence. He suffers from delusions and is very anxious, especially when in the dark. Despite Japan's strict laws on firearms, he owns a shotgun to which he has a license. This makes him a very desirable person to hang around with following the outbreak, but Hideo is very serious when it comes to the law and won't allow anyone else to even touch his gun.

name: Tetsuko Kurokawa
description: Hideo Suzuki's girlfriend

name: Iura
description: He is the behind-the-scenes ruler of the non-infected community holed up on the rooftop of an outlet mall and is highly insightful. Possessing a pistol crossbow, he has been executing rebels and those he does not like by dropping them to the ground where a large number of infected roam.

name: Asada
description: A blond man who controls the community based in the Sunrise 60 building in Ikebukuro. He claims to be able to pilot a small helicopter parked on the roof of the building, and has gained a voice in the community as the only means of escape from Tokyo.

name: Hanyuu
description: One of the survivors in the group near the school. Holed up in a shed, he takes turns with his sister, Fukiko, in protecting the main base. Their weapons of choice are crossbows. The two plan to go to Tokyo and take shelter in their grandmother's house, and don't trust the rest of the group.

name: Sango
description: Former recluse and ruler of the non-infected community at the outlet mall.

name: Tomabechi
description: A bearded man in Kurusu and his group's hideout. He is in charge of making weapons for the members. He is proficient in amateur radio and keeps in touch with other survivors.

name: Seinen
description: He is one of the survivors in Italy, who took refuge atop a high building. He muses that the cause of the outbreak is alien in nature and that the invaders are looking to occupy the planet without destroying it.

name: Ja-Hyeon Jo
description:
__Place of Birth:__ Incheon, South Korea
__Affiliation:__ Humming Bird Crew 
__Height:__ 178cm 

[Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/ja_hyuni/)

Ja-Hyeon is a member and ace of the Hummingbird Crew and a junior at Sunny High School.

He usually assumes a serious and emotionless expression. He appears cold hearted, but very much so cares about the friends he has and his little brother. His minimal expression of emotion doesn't allow him to articulate his feelings very well, but sometimes his few words mean a lot.

Ja-Hyeon is a well rounded cyclist. Throughout the competition, he is acknowledged as the ace of the crew. He is able to play as a defensive rider, supporting his crew during their races, as well as a offensive rider. Vinny noted that he enjoyed the "hunt" of attacking from the back.

His debut in the League of Street preliminaries helped him gain popularity in the biking scene in Korea and at his school.

name: Min-U Yun
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm
__Affiliation:__ Humming Bird Crew

Minu is quite a simple and good guy. He is loyal to his words and his friends and seems to be a rather pure guy. When people provoke him he most likely falls for it since he is very emotional and impulsive. Furthermore he is really tough and can endure some pain. He is quick to anger when someone he cherishes is threatened.

name: Yu-Bin Hong
description:
He cares deeply about his mom and does not tolerate anyone who disrespects his mother, not even her self-deprecation. His childhood sweetness does make an appearance once in a while. He displays a great deal of empathy, even while displaying it through hardened words.

Yu-Bin has a condition called Waardenburg syndrome which caused the color of his left eye and hair.

One of the few things Vinny is proficient at in cooking is Ramen. He often cooks a pot for his friends voluntarily and involuntarily.

name: Shelly
description:
__Height:__ 163 cm
__Place of birth:__ Manchester, England
__Affiliation:__ Humming Bird Crew

[Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/shelly_______x/)

Shelly has a crush on [Jay](https://anilist.co/character/137282/Jo-JaHyeon). She is the only female member of the Humming Bird Crew.

Because she stayed at England before coming to Korea her personality is perceived as very headstrong. She does not like it when people talk badly about her friends, especially Jay. Described as someone who can confidently express her thoughts and feelings. Although her words are harsh, it is because she never sugar coated her words with her friends. And with Jay, Shelly is very clingy and flirtatious.

name: Han-Nam Kang
description:
__Height:__ 188 cm
__Affiliation:__ Humming Bird Crew

[Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/hannam_x_jordan/)

Dom is a Junior at Sunny High School. He is the son of a gang leader. He is interested in making music in the future and works part-time as a DJ at his father's club, WD Club. He is quite the sneakerhead and spends his money on his collection.
Dom is caring towards his friends and others and does his best to get involved.

Dom is very good at sprinting and riding on straight distances. He is also good at hand-to-hand combat and wrestling

name: Owen Knight
description:
__Height:__ 193 cm
__Place of birth:__ Manchester, England
__Affiliation:__ Light Cavalry Crew

Owen Knight is the creator and member of Light Cavalry cyclist team. He joined Sunny High to stay closer with his childhood friend [Shelly](https://anilist.co/character/140299/Shelly) and fend off her feelings for [Jay](https://anilist.co/character/137282/JaHyeon-Jo).

Owen Knight is said to be close to the crews who spread street riding culture In New York. He was said to have followed them around and became friends with their members and cycled together. Then, in his freshman year of high school, he went back to England and formed a world-famous crew with his athlete friends called Light Cavalry.

name: Monster13
description:
__Height:__ 205 cm
__Place of birth:__ Jung-gu-, Seoul
__Affiliation:__ Monster Crew

Monster, is one of the favourites in the "League of Street" competition. He is the leader of Monster Crew. His team is expected to win the competition due to their raw power and speed.

He is an honest and fair cyclist who is dedicated to the sport. It is seen and mentioned that he works out all the time apart from sleeping and eating, he is addicted to working out and becoming a better version of himself. And he's seen sleeping in classes and only bringing workout tools in his backpack, he uses every opportunity to work out even when his teacher calls him out to the back he would use the chance to do squats while the classes continue.

name: Yu-Mi Lee
description: Leader of Team Tarantula.

name: Joker
description:
__Height:__ 201 cm
__Affiliation__: Sabbath Crew 

He's the undefeated champion in the underground cage fights scene. He seems to be doing it for the money to take care of his family. It is unknown how many siblings he has or if their parents are around but we know he has at least one younger brother, who went behind Joker's back to work at a construction site. He is protective over them, not wanting them to work, assumably in order for them to focus on getting their education.

He's mostly shown working closely with Wooin and are often seen together. It is assumed that they are good friends.

name: Wataru Ushiroda
description:
Wataru is part of the Adult Tomodachi Games. He appears in the first game, "Prison Game of Friendship", as "Prisoner Number 0011".

He is a very nonsociable and quiet individual, the only one having stayed alone during the before party.
During his time as a mart employee, he was seemingly used as a scapegoat for performance more than once. Their reasoning for this was because unlike himself, the others are "proper" human beings. He was blamed for failing to match the proceeds.

name: Sora Namiragawa
description:
Sora is a participant in the Adult Tomodachi Game. We see her participating in the Friendless Game.

She is an ex live streamer whose emotions are linked to her belly, she develops an insatiable hunger whenever overwhelmed by emotions (usually stress or anger). As a result, she does her best to keep a cool and level head.

name: Reika Araya
description: Reika is a participant of the Adult Tomodachi Game. She is the daughter of Nagi Araya. We see her participate in the Friendless Game.

name: Tsukino
description: An Observer of Tomodachi Game.

name: Tomie
description:
Tomie enjoys the effect her beauty has on men, and seeks to seduce them, but feels no emotional attachment to any of her lovers. Once she no longer has an immediate use for a man, she'll discard him, a pattern that has led to several of her deaths. She's also jealous when attention is given to other women, and works to break up established couples if presented an opening. Extremely self-centered, she thinks nothing of manipulating others for her pleasure.    

Little is known of Tomie's true background, not even her family name. It is not known how she gained her powers, or even if she was aware of them prior to 1986. According to witnesses, she aged normally to that point, and seemed a standard if very pretty and flirtatious girl. On a field trip to Inariyawa, a small mountain near her school, Tomie was pressuring a teacher she'd been having sex with to leave his wife and marry her, when a male classmate who'd become obsessed with Tomie accosted her. She taunted the boy, and in the ensuing scuffle, Tomie fell over a cliff. Believing Tomie dead, the teacher decided to cover up the accident by chopping up the girl's body with the aid of the boys of the class. It turned out she wasn't quite dead, so this became a particularly gruesome task. The class then scattered the body parts where they would, in theory, not be found.  Some parts were found, identified as Tomie's, and cremated. Her death was blamed on a psychopath, and a funeral was held.

name: Kazumiya
description: A classmate of [Kaname](https://anilist.co/character/137513).

name: Hakase Inukai
description: Hakase is a student at Otogi all-girls high school. She is a very calm and collected person with a lot of ambition. In addition, she is usually the one that takes the lead most often.

name: Mishio Usa
description: She is a 16-year-old girl attending Otogi all-girls high school.

name: Ryouhei Arisu
description:
__Specialty:__ Psychological (Heart)

The protagonist of Alice in Borderland. His alias is a reference to the main character "Alice" in Alice in Wonderland.
A 3rd year high school student with the hidden potential to be one hell of an analyzer; he looks at things from afar and checks every detail he can find. He keeps track of everything he learns so that he can find a way to put an end to this twisted game.

name: Yuzuha Usagi
description:
__Specialty:__ Physical (Spade)

The heroine of Alice in Borderland. Her alias which means "rabbit" in Japanese refers the White Rabbit in Alice in Wonderland.

She is a skilled mountaineer thanks to her father.

name: Daikichi Karube
description: Karube is an old friend of Alice back from his high school days like with Chota, who's a waiter in a bar where Alice and Chota get free drinks. He is very short-tempered and doesn't hesitate to use strength in critical situations, but he can be a great leader, is always optimistic, and has a strong will to live. It is known that he got stronger because of a hard childhood.

name: Shuntarou Chishiya
description: A ruthless medical student who would unscrupulously sacrifice other people to achieve his own goals.

name: Morizono Aguni
description:
__Specialty:__ Physical (Spades)

First appears in the Beach arc and the leader of the "martial sect" of the Beach residents.

name: Hikari Kuina
description: Hikari Kuina is a character first appears in the Beach arc and later revealed to be transgender. Originally, she specialized in Clubs, but after facing her troubled past with her stern father, she redefines herself as a Spades player.

name: Akane Heiya
description:
A character who first appeared in the special chapters.  She is the only survivor in her first game in the Borderlands, but suffered from multiple wounds, notably her left leg.  Her leg is later amputated and replaced with a Flex-Foot Cheetah. She carries a bow as her weapon of choice.


Specialty: Physical (Spade)


(Source: Alice in Borderland Wiki)

name: Ginji Kyuuma
description: Ginji Kyuuma is The King of Clubs and one of the 4 Kings in the Borderlands.

name: Mira Kanou
description: Mira is a neuroscientist trapped in the borderlands. She first appears in Chapter 18 as one of the executives of The Beach where she is ranked No. 7 with Hearts as her specialty.

name: Ouran Nakagawa
description:
A girl in her third year of high school. She is [Kadode](https://anilist.co/character/88566/Koyama-Kadode)'s best friend.

She has long black hair, which she often wears in twintails, secured by skull-shaped hairties. Ouran has an older brother, [Hiroshi](https://anilist.co/character/89578/Nakagawa-Hiroshi) who is a NEET. She likes to play video games along with Kadode.

Ouran is a very flamboyant character. She often rambles on about her goal to enslave mankind or lead the human race to destruction. However, despite her seemingly flamboyant and sociable personality, Ouran tends to only show her true self to her friends and family.

name: Kadode Koyama
description:
A girl in her third year of high school. She loves the iconic manga character [Isobeyan](https://anilist.co/character/208124/Isobeyan). She also has a crush on [her teacher](https://anilist.co/character/89581/Watarase-Naoki).

[Her dad](https://anilist.co/character/208125/Koyama-Nobuo) went missing during the initial appearance of the alien mothership over Japan. She appears to have a rocky relationship with [her mother](https://anilist.co/character/89585/Koyama-Manami), who's constantly worried about her own health and the A-Rays that were released when the aliens invaded.

name: Keita Ooba
description: He was a member of an idol group and also acted in some movies. He disappeared during the event of 8/31. When she was younger, Kadode was obsessed with him.

name: Ai Demoto
description: Kadode and Ontan's friend. Rin's bespectacled childhood friend.

name: Kenichi Kohiruimaki
description: Kiho's boyfriend who is into various subcultures.

name: Manami Koyama
description: Kadode's mother. She fears the negative health effects of the A-Lines.

name: Hiroshi Nakagawa
description: The chubby older brother of Ouran, harmless to all, who has a handsome face. He bemoans the "sad" world and is a neet who spends his days "monitoring" the internet.

name: Hikari Sumaru
description:
She works in the public relations department at S.E.S.'s Hujin Development Center.

She is in a relationship with Watarase, Kadode's teacher.

name: Futaba Takemoto
description: She decided to come to Tokyo in order to participate in the efforts to protect the invaders.

name: Ryou Ueki
description:
Ryou Ueki is Ritsuka's classmate. Ryou enjoys playing basketball and is close friends with Shogo.
Not as talkative compared to other students, Ryou enjoys playing basketball and is friendly to students from other classes such as Mafuyu.

name: Ayano Kasai
description: She is very honest and truthful about her feelings towards others, but get's jealous over other people's relationships. She's Uenoyama's classmate.

name: Saruogi
description: A kind yet awkward classmate. He joins the group for the field trip to Kyoto.

name: Risa Hayase
description:
Two grades younger than Izumi and Shikimori. Enrolled as a first year during their third year.

Shikimori is on the Public Morals committee in her third year. She instructs Risa to take off her hoodie and follow school regulations but she's not willing to listen. Despite her rebellious attitude, it turns out Risa knew Shikimori during middle school, although Shikimori herself doesn't remember.

name: Futaba Kuze
description: An impossibly naive girl who fell for Touma. She ends up befriending Ichinose in an attempt to learn more about him, but they end up becoming close friends with each other and Touma as well. She is very sweet and tries her hardest, but her natural clumsiness and naivete make it hard for her to befriends others in her class.

name: Masumi Itachi
description: Kuze's best friend. She is a dark and mysterious girl who is very protective of her smaller best friend. She is in a separate class but is often seen hanging around with the rest of the main characters. She intends to become a veterinarian.

name: Touma Mita
description: Ichinose's childhood friend and the most popular boy in their school, loved by everyone for his niceness, looks and being the school's baseball team's ace and captain. He gets close to Ichinose and Kuze once they end up in the same class. He is very kind-hearted and loud and cares deeply for his new found friends. His dream is of playing in the grounds of Koushien Stadium and become a professional baseball player.

name: Taichi Ichinose
description: An ordinary high school student. Ichinose used to be Mita's best friend, but they drifted apart during high school. They get closer again when they end up in the same classroom. He is usually shy and meek, but is known for being extremely nice.

name: Yokki
description: Taichi's friend.

name: Mami Yagihara
description: A girl that is within Touma's group of friends and grows upset with his newfound interest in hanging out with Futaba and Taichi instead of her. She is interested in Touma, but he does not reciprocate her affection.

name: Mon
description: Taichi's friend.

name: Omega
description: Taichi's friend.

name: Seiya Mita
description: Touma´s elder brother.

name: Zephyr
description:
Protagonist of the story "Doom Breaker".
Zephyr is the last human fighting evil in a world abandoned by the gods. When he is killed in battle by Tartarus, the god of destruction, all hope for humanity seems lost. But Zephyr’s fate is not sealed - the gods who find his battles entertaining have gifted him a second chance at life, as he is sent ten years into the past, back to when he was a slave instead of the most powerful human alive.

name: Altair Cayenne
description: The princess of the Kingdom of Cayenne on the continent of Aslan where the story takes place. Altair was Zephyr's lover in their previous lives, and Zephyr is strongly determined to save her this time around.

name: Ned Stryer
description: One of the official disciples of Jinryang of the East, the 9th-highest ranking Tartarus Worshipper. He worked under Mathias Grimmer, the 36th-highest ranking Tartarus Worshipper. Both infiltrated the Temple of Light, working as Inquisitors to hide their agenda.

name: Mercedes
description: The representative that shares the words of the gods. High level angel.

name: Anna Primrose
description: She is a sister of the shrine of light.

name: Polaris Cayenne
description: Polaris is the eldest prince of the Kingdom of Cayenne and Altair's eldest brother in addition to being the youngest cardinal in the Temple of Light.

name: Rian Ogent
description: He is the youngest son of the Ogent family and [Shirone](https://anilist.co/character/304076)'s friend.

name: Reina Ogent
description: She is the eldest daughter of the Ogent family. She is a genius musician with a kind personality, who knows how to use schema and swordsmanship.

name: Athanasia de Alger Obelia
description:
Athanasia de Alger Obelia is the main protagonist of the manhwa "Who Made Me a Princess" as well as the first princess and only heir to the Obelian Empire. After reading a book named "The Lovely Princess" on a shunned princess named Athanasia, the protagonist falls asleep with sleeping pills and finds herself in the infant body of Athanasia from the book.

Athanasia, also known as "Athy", is the daughter of the emperor [Claude de Alger Obelia](https://anilist.co/character/136776/de-Alger-Obelia-Claude) and [Diana](https://anilist.co/character/143634/Diana), a dancer he deflowered after meeting at a royal banquet. Claude's harem previously occupied the Ruby Palace, however, he massacred them when Diana died giving birth to Athy.

Athy makes her goal in her new life to avoid the execution of the previous Athanasia on her 18th birthday.

name: Claude de Alger Obelia
aliases: クロード・デイ・エルジェア・オベリア
description:
Claude de Alger Obelia is the current reigning emperor of the Empire of Obelia, and the father of the main protagonist in the popular manhwa "Who Made Me a Princess". He is a book character in "The Lovely Princess", and kills his oldest blood-related daughter, the original Athanasia de Alger Obelia. Claude has been shown to be ruthless and cruel, yet also warm and affectionate later on in the story. 

In the book "The Lovely Princess", Claude gains the throne by usurping and murdering his older brother, Anastacius de Alger Obelia. His name, Claude, refers to his illegitimacy to become heir, as heirs to the Obelian Empire have names which means "immortal".

name: Lucas
description: A royal magician working at the black tower and Athanasia de Alger Obelia's chosen playmate.

name: Ijekiel Alpheus
description:
Ijekiel Alpheus is the oldest son of the House of Alpheus. He is the male lead in _The Lovely Princess_, ending up as [Jennette](https://anilist.co/character/143630/Jennette-Margarita)'s fiance at the end of the original story. He is disliked by [Claude de Alger Obelia](https://anilist.co/character/136776/Claude-de-Alger-Obelia) and refers to [Athanasia de Obelia](https://anilist.co/character/143632/Athanasia-de-Alger-Obelia) as "Lady Angel" due to the circumstances of their first and second encounters.

(Source: Who Made Me Princess Wikia)

name: Jennette Margarita
aliases: ジェニット・マグリタ
description:
Jennette was the original protagonist of the book "The Lovely Princess" from the manhwa "Who Made Me a Princess", until the main protagonist of the series transmigrates into the body of Athanasia de Alger Obelia. She is a side character and views Athanasia with admiration.

(Source: Who Made Me Princess Wikia)

name: Felix Robane
aliases: フィリックス・ロベイン
description:
Felix Robane is a side character in the manhwa "Who Made Me a Princess", and serves as the main protagonist's personal guard. He is first seen in chapter six when Claude de Alger Obelia first meets Athanasia de Alger Obelia. He is assigned the role of Athanasia's personal guard when she is 5, and soon becomes quite close with her.

Felix's mother was Claude's nanny, and the two were raised as bosom brothers.

(Source: Who Made Me Princess Wikia)

name: Roger Alpheus
description: Roger Alpheus is Ijekiel Alpheus' father and the head of House Alpheus, the duke family who raised Jennette Margarita.

name: Anastacius de Alger Obelia
description: Anastacius is the older brother of Claude de Alger Obelia and originally the official crown prince.

name: Lilian York
description:
Lilian York is Athy's main caregiver, as well as being the head maid. Despite being aware of the Ruby Palace incident, she still volunteers to be Athy's nanny due to an admiration of Diana's free spirit.

The two share a close bond in both the book "The Lovely Princess" and the manhwa itself.  Lilian is shown to be a loyal and affectionate caretaker, with Athanasia reciprocating those feelings.

(Source: Who Made Me Princess Wikia)

name: Diana
description:
Diana is a dancer who died whilst giving birth to Athanasia. She is mainly depicted as "fairy-like" and graceful, and has no recorded contact with Athanasia in the manhwa other than brief dreams where Athy sees her mother interacting with Claude (and vice-versa).

In a sense, Diana saves Athy from death during the Ruby Palace massacre and secures her place as Obelia's next heir by giving her child the name "Athanasia", which Claude found humorous. Athy is often told she possesses similar traits to her mother in both looks and personality.

(Source: Who Made Me Princess Wikia)

name: Chun-U Han
description: Teacher who has mastered 9 styles of martial arts. With a mysterious past who seems to hold a grudge for the martial artists federation relating to the death of his master.  At the beginning of the story he seems to be a perverted middle aged man who came to the school going undercover as a teacher. After Shioon discovering his martial art skills, shioon bribes him with a video clip. Continuing Chun woo discovers Shioon's hidden potential and teaches foot and arm techiniques.As the story progresses, he shows more of his past and growing relationship with his new disciple.

name: Shi-Ho Lee
description: A very attractive woman who uses her sex appeal to make people do as she wishes. She can be very manipulative when she wants, making the likes of Alex carry out jobs which she would prefer not to do. Chun-Woo once claimed that there has never been a person that she has targeted that hadn't been taken in by her. She was a member of the Chun-Nyu-Moon (Heavenly Maiden Skill) and is very skilled at administering drugs, and has a in-depth knowledge of the human body and Ki system. With this knowledge, she has the ability to transfer Ki from one person to another. She drives a Mini Cooper S as her personal vehicle.

name: Shi-Woon Yi
description: A weak cowardly boy who is constantly being bullied until he encounters his new teacher using martial arts to defend himself. Shi-Woon begs him to teach him. After several instances where the cowardly boy shows he has heart and will fight with all his might, he becomes Chun-Woo's pupil.      (Source: Wikipedia, The Breaker: New Waves chapter 32,35-36, and 43)

name: Un-Wol
description:
He was the master of Chun-Woo Han and Ryuji. After achieving the Black Origin Threshold the Martial Arts Alliance banished him to a life of meditation and solitude in a cave while he tried to figure out a way to solve the problem of this technique. He was always calm and composed, and did not hold a grudge against the elders that exiled him. Despite almost never showing emotions, he is very caring as he expelled Ryuji as a disciple and killed himself to protect both Ryuji and Chun-Woo Han respectively. He is also very moral, as he told off Chun-Woo Han when his student made the wrong choices in using martial arts to hurt others.  

(Source: The Breaker wiki)

name: Kang-Sung
description:
Kang-Sung, also known as Sammoonryong (lit. Three Arts Dragon), is the curent chief of the Martial Arts Alliance. It is unknown how powerful Kang-Sung really is even with the title of Sammoonryong. Others say he did not pursue the title of Goomoonryong because of obligations to lead his clan.  He is a calm and righteous man who has his own beliefs that differ from Gi-Joo Song, Hyun-Tae, and the previous Alliance Chief. Though Goomoonryong killed his master and Gi-Joo, he doesn't believe in revenge. He initially admires Goomoonryong and tries his best to understand him, despite the fact that the Chief and his own master deemed him as their enemy. He is loyal to the Alliance and greatly values the traditions of the Murim, so when Goomoonryong mocks the relationship between master and student, he considers it as the last straw and is ready to fight him.  

(Source: The Breaker Wiki)

name: So-Chun Hyuk
description:
So-Chun Hyuk is the Assistant-Leader of the "Heavenly Way School" and a martial arts prodigy in the Murim world. He is one of the many characters in the series who start out as an antagonist to Shi-Woon, but later become an ally to him. He is the adopted brother of Jang Joon-Ho.  

(Source: The Breaker Wiki)

name: Won-Jae Hyun
description: He is a member of the Martial Arts Alliance and head of the One Moon School. His school has a large pharmaceutical company as a front for its existence. He is also Shi-Ho Lee's ex-boyfriend. Throughout the series he constantly tried to help and win the affection of Shi-Ho who he still loves.     (Source: The Breaker Wiki)

name: Joon-Ho Jang
description:
He is So-Chun Hyuk's so-called "adopted brother" who discovered Shi-Woon Yi. He has a great sense of respect and honor, therefore doesn't bow before others when he is told to, but he bows deep when he expresses his respect for the other person. He is also shown to be the type who would avoid conflicts whenever possible. This however does not apply when he can help others by confronting the danger itself. He is not very interested in the Murim's politics and just follows the orders given to him.  

(Source: The Breaker Wiki)

name: Mrs Yi
description: She had a stained relationship with her son and neglected him for work. After Shioon is rushed to the hospital, she blames herself for not protected him and starts paying more attention to her son.    In New Waves she becomes a CEO of the company where she works.   she lost her husband and Shioon's father

name: So-Sul Woo
description:
Jang So-Sul / Sun-Woo So-Sul is the former head of the Sun-Woo Clan, like her father. So-Sul is small and has a weak frame due to her unique body condition which makes her seem younger than she really is (a fact that greatly annoys her as Shi-Woon treats her like a little child). In the beginning, she cannot talk due to her unique condition; whenever she does, she is come over with a coughing seizure. But due to Shi-Woon Yi administrating his blood to her as a remedy and then massaging her body, she can now talk more due the vast amount of ki in Shi-Woon's blood.  Despite her appearance, and even her age (15 Years Old), she is incredibly mature, a trait that is shown in her almost aristocratic style of speech and her self-denial of a teenage lifestyle. She appears to be calm even when there is danger although it was revealed that she was afraid since she saw the same things in nightmares and was scared. She seems to be shy and the type that does not show her true desires and always acts as though she is forced to things that she actually wants to do, like when she played with Shi-Woon in the sand making castles.  

(Source: The Breaker Wiki)

name: Billy Bat
description: Ostensibly, a talking anthropomorphic bat that is the star of several detective comic book series throughout the 20th Century. His true nature and purpose comprise the central mystery of the plot. Francis Xavier himself once mentioned the Bat, himself unsure if the entity was an angel or demon or perhaps both. Zōfū, on the other hands, claims there are two bats, one white and the other black. When The White Bat appears, it always says confusing things, and when The Black Bat appears, it manipulates people to do bad things.

name: Kevin Goodman
native: ケヴィン・グッドマン
description: [Tony](https://anilist.co/character/82483/Tony-Goodman) and [Diane](https://anilist.co/character/82481/Diane-Goodman)'s son.

name: Jackie Momochi
description:
A nisei Japanese-American University girl in New York who was unwillingly influenced by Billy Bat. She is a descendant of the Momochi Clan of Iga-ryuu. Later on, she goes to Japan to investigate Father Xavier's first disciple, Yajirou.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Kevin Yamagata
description: Kevin Yamagata in 1949 is a nisei Japanese-American comic book artist drawing the popular detective series "Billy Bat." When he learns he may have unconsciously copied the character from an image he saw while serving in occupied Japan, he returns to Japan to get permission to use Billy Bat from its original creator.   Kevin's comics mostly feature anthropomorphicized animal characters, such as dogs or mice. Later on, his Billy Bat comic become a kind of prophecy, its various plotlines precisely predicting future world events.   Kevin's Japanese name is Kinji Yamagata (山縣金持). He is said by others to resemble actor Ryo Ikebe in both looks and personality. He was born and raised in Orange County, California on November 26, 1923, while his parents were both originally from Niigata.   (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Onuki
description: Onuki is a young detective who interrogates Tokyo Zofuu Karama after it has drawn graffiti on façace a house occupied by an American soldier. Nature rather helpful and nice, Onuki is loaded by Kevin Yamagata Zôfû to find him and his message (he must return to the United States, carrer against "those who would pull the strings of history"). Onuki fun to have received a dedication (representing the bat) Karama. He laughs when less hand receives a visit from Captain Finney, who wishes to embark Zôfû. Onuki comes to his defense and thus attract the wrath of Finney, who reproached him for his lack of appreciation for the Americans.

name: John Fitzgerald Kennedy
description: In the manga by Urasawa, Kennedy never appears in human form but in the guise of a dog running through the pages of comics drawn by Billy Bat Kevin Yamagata. This is indeed subject to recurring visions for Kennedy. In 1959, and he sees the speech "We choose to go to the moon" (three years before it is delivered) and seems aware of the conspiracy fomented against which the future President of the United States. Dreary Night Murders history, introductory first volume depicts Kennedy and Marilyn Monroe without naming them. But gradually as the plot progresses, the signs become more clear about the real identity of this dog innate charisma.

name: Francisco Xavier
native: フランシスコ・ザビエル
description: In Billy Bat, he appears as a child and as an old man on his deathbed. As a child, he visited a cave (presumably in Spain) and encountered the bat.

name: Kiyoshi Kurusu
description: A mysterious character working for a company called East Asian Industries. He is Finney's partner in the search for the legendary Scroll of Momochi. He and Finney presumably are the masterminds behind both the Shimoyama incident and the JFK Assassination. In Zofuu's manga, he makes an appearance as the character Karate Chop Man.

name: Tony Goodman
description: Tony is the heir to the Golden Cola Company. Fell in love with [Diane](https://anilist.co/character/82481/Diane-Goodman) and eventually married despite the objection of both their families. Tony is a major fan of Kevin's version of the Billy Bat comics.

name: Pesci
description: Pesci is a member of La Squadra di Esecuzione. He operates together with Prosciutto, who he refers to as his "big brother" (most likely in the yakuza sense). Although he appears timid, he is actually even more dangerous than Prosciutto, which the heroes eventually find out the hard way.  His Stand is named Beach Boy (ビーチ・ボーイ Bīchi Bōi). This Stand takes the form of a fishing rod with a skull-shaped reel. The line can phase through any non-living thing, and sense living things in the immediate vicinity. The lure can also be affixed to a single place to await a victim. When a victim touches that area, Beach Boy will hook them, and begin burrowing into their body, usually aiming for the heart (Beach Boy is sensitive enough that Pesci can tell precisely where in the body the hook is). Any attack on the line itself is reflected back to the attacker.  Source: Wikipedia

appearsIn.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Part 5: Golden Wind

name: Kurumi Haraga
description:
__Type:__ Hangry
__Occupation:__ Third-Year Middle School Student
__Debut:__ Chapter 24

**Girlfriend No. 007**

Kurumi absolutely loves food and possesses an extremely high metabolism. As such, she's almost constantly hungry, and she grows extremely cranky if she isn't eating the certain food that she happens to be craving for at the moment. Kurumi has a strong word-association when it comes to food. Almost anything can remind her of food, at which point she has to eat that food or else she will become irritable.

appearsIn.title: The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, Really Love You

name: Keel Lorentz
description: Chairman of SEELE, it is the ambition of Keel Lorentz that drives mankind towards instrumentality. Part cyborg, Keel's eyes and spinal-cord are aided by advanced machinery.

name: Kyouko Zeppelin Souryuu
native: 惣流・キョウコ・ツェッペリン
description: Mother of Asuka Langley Soryu. She was a scientist working for NERV before an accident during the testing phases of Evangelion Unit 02 left her hospitalized and mentally unstable.

name: Dagger
description: Dagger is one of the Carnies at Noahs Ark Circus, his Circus trick is a knife Thrower, he never misses his target and uses this to fight. When Ciel joins the Circus as Smile, Dagger helps train him up.  Dagger keeps a cheery mood thoughout the manga. He is closest with Joker and has a not-so-secret attraction to Beast, who makes it obvious that she prefers Joker.

name: Clause
description: Clause is Ciel Phantomhive's uncle who obtains drugs in order to assist Ciel with cleaning out corruption.

name: Johan Agares
description:
Johan Agares is the vice principal of Weston College.  

(Source: Kuroshitsuji Wikia)

name: Irene Diaz
description: An opera singer.

name: Frances Midford
native: フランシス・ミッドフォード
description:
Marchioness Frances Phantomhive-Midford is a noblewoman. She is the wife of Alexis Leon Midford, mother of Edward and Elizabeth, sister of Vincent Phantomhive and aunt of Ciel Phantomhive.  

(Source: Kuroshitsuji Wikia)

name: Diedrich
description: Diedrich is Vincent Phantomhive's long-time friend since they were both prefects at Weston College.

name: Jing Sun
description: Sun Jing is the main protagonist of Tamen de Gushi. She's a freshman, seventh class at Second High School. She's completely and utterly in love with Qiu Tong.

name: Tong Qiu
description: Qiu Tong is a main protagonist of Tamen de Gushi. She is a second year in class 3 of South High. Qiu Tong is pretty popular at her school, but despite that has only a few friends. She is the love interest of Sun Jing.

name: Fang Qi
description: Qi Fang is Sun Jing's best friend. He attends Second High and is in the same class as her.

name: Xiaonan Mo
description: Xiaonan Mo has a crush on Jing Sun. She attends Second High but is in a different class.

name: Xuezhang
description: Despite his intimidating appearance, Xuezhang is a good-hearted and stoic person who quietly wants his affections returned by his underclassman Qin Xiong.

name: Xiong Qin
description: Qin Xiong is the classmate of Sun Jing. He attends Second High and is in the same class as her (1st year, Class 7). Qin Xiong is the love interest of his Xuezhang (upperclassman).

name: Yui Kurata
description: Espion Guild (ex-member).

appearsIn.title: My Love Story with Yamada-kun at Lv999

name: Tomoya Taniguchi
description: Tomoya is a member of the Red Fox Team.

appearsIn.title: My Love Story with Yamada-kun at Lv999

name: Hasegawa
description: Akane's co-worker at the convenience store. He is part of the Espion Guild in FOS.

appearsIn.title: My Love Story with Yamada-kun at Lv999

name: Geon Lee
description: The 13th awakened person, not selected by a god. He was betrayed by the 12 Saints and left to die.

appearsIn.title: The Return of the Disaster-Class Hero

name: Wei Yang
description: One of the twelve saint with gods blessing.

appearsIn.title: The Return of the Disaster-Class Hero

name: Hugo Sudal
description: One of the twelve saints with gods blessing and Geon Lee's best friend.

appearsIn.title: The Return of the Disaster-Class Hero

name: Seong-Jae Cheon
description: Hugo Sudal's son and Cheon Yooha's younger brother.

appearsIn.title: The Return of the Disaster-Class Hero

name: Lukas Trowman
description: Lukas was captured in the abyss for 4000 years, than he saw Frey Blake who has poisoned himself and died. Lukas took over the body of Frey and thus escaped the abyss.

name: Isabelle Triznine
description: Trustworthy companion, she doesn't hesitate to follow [Lukas](https://anilist.co/character/185995/Lukas-Trowman) and to learn more about the way he uses magic.

name: Frey Blake
description: Westroad Academy's worst student and [Lukas Trowman](https://anilist.co/character/185995/Lukas-Trowman)'s new body.

name: Riki
description: The apocalypse of swords, a demi god.

name: Kasajin
description: He was part of [Lukas Trowman](https://anilist.co/character/185995/Lukas-Trowman)'s party that resisted the Demigods. He created the Magic Warrior King arts to fight against Demigods.

name: Iris Peacefinder
description: Iris Peacefinder is one of the Heroes of the Age of Light.

name: Ananta
description: Ananta is the Apocalypse who controls poison.

name: Junim
description: Lord is one of the most powerful beings in the world. He is recognized by the other demigods to be their absolute leader.

name: Yeong-U Sin
description:
__Country:__ South Korea

Sin Yeong-U is the name of the main character in real life, while Greed is the in-game name.

He was an unlucky loser in life. He entered into debt to buy the gaming capsule needed to play the game Satisfy. He experienced a hard life and was forced into manual labor jobs to pay off the enormous debt, but he still played the game despite not being good at it.

His in-game character called Greed found unusual luck in a legendary class change item (Pagma's Rare Book) during an S-class quest. But hidden beneath that luck was his level dropping to -1. This was due to the legendary class change, and the failure of an SS rank quest by dying. He struggled to survive and made money in the world of Satisfy as the first negative leveled legendary class player.

(Source: Overgeared Wiki)

name: Yu-Ra
description:
__Country:__ South Korea

Yu-Ra, known as the 'Blood Witch' and the 8th Servant of God Yatan, is a high ranked and powerful User.

Yu-Ra is a player best known for her beauty and support for the Yatan Church. She is a famous person who frequently appears on TV because of her beautiful appearance and outstanding abilities. Contrary to her creepy nickname of the ‘Blood Witch’, she was well loved and respected, as well as a target of envy. Thanks to her superb beauty, perfect gaming skills and ideal image in the media, she was praised by both men and women. It also transcended race. There were thousands of fan clubs created on overseas servers. At first glance, she was even more popular than Hollywood’s top actors.

Throughout her life, she had been praised by everyone she met for her beauty and intelligence. She is smart enough to see anything through with logic. She used her innate insight on her work, earning her a reputation of a talented person who could be used everywhere. In fact, her control skills were so great that despite being a Black Magician, known for having very weak defense and insufficient attack power, she was at one point able to reach to fifth place on the unified rankings.



(Source: Overgeared Wiki)

name: Jishuka
description:
__Country:__ Brazil 

Jishuka, the Bow Saint-Legendary Archer, also known as Godly Archer, is a high-ranked and powerful User. She is a Legendary Class holder, one of the main pillars and the Duke of Overgeared Kingdom.

name: Regas
description: __Country:__ United Kingdom

name: Marie Rose
description: __Race:__ Vampire

name: Lauel
description: __Country:__ United States

name: Euphemina
description:
Euphemina, the Mumud's Successor, formerly the Duplicator and the Earl of Eternal Kingdom, is a powerful User and a Private Ranker in Satisfy.

She is the first epic rated hidden class user. As a Duplicator, she secretly collects copies of high-grade spells from rankers and named NPCs. Because of her ability to cast these high-grade spells without chanting, people usually mistook her as having a legendary class and even stronger than Grid. Euphemina holds great pride in her looks. However, she has a complex about her short height and hates to be called a "kid".

name: Pon
description: __Country:__ Spain

name: Toon
description: __Country:__ Italy

name: Hana Midorikawa
description:
Hana is the secretary of the Underground Student Council, a vigilante school organisation. Hana is the fourth-best karate champion in the inter-high school championships. She is a subordinate and loyal friend of [Mari Kurihara](https://anilist.co/character/64861/Kurihara-Mari), the president of the USC.

Hana is of average height and slim with a medium bust. She has straw-coloured hair in a bob, and brown eyes. She is athletic and somewhat muscular despite her weight, as a third-grade Dan and the school's fourth best karate champion. She wears the standard school uniform in tandem with leggings and an undershirt.

Hana is a kind and shy individual, who enjoys brewing & drinking dandelion tea and has a love for four-leaf clovers. She can be very violent when angry, and expresses her anger with proficient karate attacks. She is somewhat reserved in comparison to [Meiko Shiraki](https://anilist.co/character/47117/Shiraki-Meiko) (the Underground Student Council's Vice-President), wearing underlayers when on guard duty. She is actually very shy and reserved, as shown when she is caught in compromising conditions by [Kiyoshi Fujino](https://anilist.co/character/46557/Fujino-Kiyoshi) a number of times. Hana is shown to be quite impressionable out of her tough exterior as in compromising or sexual situations, she faints and becomes mortified.

name: Meiko Shiraki
description:
Vice president of the underground student council, she is a voluptuous girl who roams around campus in an scantly outfit and whose reputation of being a sadist and a man hater is well known especially to the five boys whom she has mistreated during their detention. She is often seen with a horse whip that she uses to punishing detainees who disobeys her where [Takehito](https://anilist.co/character/64851/Morokuzu-Takehito) is her frequent victim. She is also quite strong and a capable fighter.

During her spare time she would do a hundred or more Hindu leg squats and push ups.

name: Mayumi Tanaka
description:
She belongs to the same class as [Chiyo Kurihara](https://anilist.co/character/64859/Kurihara-Chiyo) and [Kiyoshi Fujino](https://anilist.co/character/46557/Fujino-Kiyoshi), and is a member of the school's Go Club.

The friendly character of Mayumi Tanaka and her good friendship with Chiyo is shown when she expresses concern about Chiyo when gloomy. While Chiyo relies on her for advice and mental support as a good confidante, Mayumi is a non-confrontational person and tries to avoid fights - thus inadvertently depending on Chiyo for physical defense and/or protection. Though she does not seems antagonistic towards the boys, Mayumi is apathetic towards Chiyo's interest in Kiyoshi & the enrolment of the five first-year boys in the school. In contrast to Chiyo's love of sumo wrestling, Mayumi shows an interest in clothes and magazines. However, Chiyo is completely oblivious to her disinterest in sumo wrestling.

name: Bitch
description:
She is a third-year student in attendance at Hachimitsu Academy. She is the cavalry mount of the Aboveground Student Council's gyaru cavalry team within the Cavalry Battle.

Bitch appears to have a lack of mental inhibition, making her immune to the sight of Kiyoshi Fujino's nudity and capable of showering him with lewd insults with the other gyaru schoolgirls. She behaves in a very degenerate manner, offering to show Kiyoshi her chest to achieve her goal of eliminating Kiyoshi and the USC cavalry team. This behavior results in her extending the same offer to Anzu Yokoyama, suggesting that she derives enjoyment from her immodesty. However, her emotional outbreak at seeing Kiyoshi wearing striped panties demonstrates some limit to her indecency.

(Source: Prison School Wiki)

name: Suname
description: A girl from class C. She declared her love for Ryuu during the school trip, but he rejected it, saying that he liked another girl. She ended up believing that this girl is Chizu, being the girl that Ryuu has more intimacy. She ends up arguing with Chizuru because of it.

appearsIn.title: Kimi ni Todoke: From Me to You

name: Mr. Yoshida
description: Chizuru's father.

appearsIn.title: Kimi ni Todoke: From Me to You

name: Yoshiyuki Arai
description: The original home room teacher of Sawako's class. He and Pin have the same surname, but are not related. To distinguish between the two teachers Yoshiyuki Arai is called "Zen". "Zen" is an alternate reading of the kanji for "Yoshi". He seems to be afraid of Sawako and the rumors surrounding her as "Sadako". Because he is easily ill, students often believe that Sawako has cursed him. Arai is newly-wed.

appearsIn.title: Kimi ni Todoke: From Me to You

Jazz is a Gimel Rank and has the pickpocketing ability.

A cheerful guy who is often seen playing some kind of game. He himself admits that he is addicted to gambling as well as games, and even chooses a battler that allows him to indulge in his hobbies

name: Keitarou Fukuda
description: [Kenji](https://anilist.co/character/3442/Kenji-Endou)'s childhood friend nicknamed Froggy. He has been hiding out in America when he discovers that Kanna's mother has gone there to try to manufacture the vaccine for the outbreak of 2015.

name: Hattori
description: Fukubei is one of Kenji's childhood friends, but he barely remembers him at the class reunion. He lives with his three children and wife, who happens to be the member of the "Friend's" cult. Later, he decides to join Kenji to save the world

name: Yukiji Setoguchi
description:
The only female member of [Kenji](https://anilist.co/character/3442/Endou-Kenji)'s original group of friends, and also the strongest physically.

Yukiji currently (at the beginning of the story) serves as a drug dog handler for Narita Airport.  Takes care of [Kanna](https://anilist.co/character/9730/Endou-Kanna) in the year 2014.

name: Kakuta
description: A manga artist who got arrested for violation of the "New Youth Protection Guidelines".

name: Yuuichi Konno
description: Childhood friend of Kenji and his band, Konchi is a character who is very present in the flashbacks of the 70s, but which is secondary because we never see adulthood. We know he was part of the band child and he was close to Kenji and others. However, he moved in his last year at primary school and went to live in Hokkaido, that is what explains why one sees so little.  In 2000, he received a letter of Kenji who asked for his help but Konchi does not meet his childhood friend ... and it seems to regret in the year 3 Ami. It is indeed this year we (re) discover this character, which broadcasts the song Kenji loop on the radio from his position of Hokkaido.

name: Kars
description: Cars is the leader of the Pillar Men. He is intelligent, ruthless, and single-minded in his dedication to obtaining the Red Stone of Aja. Strangely, despite his apathy towards humans and willingness to kill them, he has been shown to be more compassionate for other living beings. In Switzerland, he sliced a car that was about to hit a puppy in half, and later on maneuvered himself during a long fall to miss a patch of flowers near the bottom of the cliff. Cars' power is that of light; he is able to produce bladed appendages from his arms and use these to reflect blinding light toward his enemies. He also has the same powers over his body that all the Pillar Men share.     He is named after the 80's new wave group The Cars.  (Source: Wikipedia)

appearsIn.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Part 2: Battle Tendency

name: Lisa Lisa
description:
__Birthday:__ 
__Age:__ 
__Height:__ 175 cm 

A mysterious Ripple user whom Joseph Joestar meets in Venice, Lisa Lisa reveals herself to be his friend Caesar Zeppeli's mentor. She trains Joseph in the ways of the Ripple and joins in the fight against the Pillar Men, as a powerful Ripple user in her own right.

appearsIn.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Part 2: Battle Tendency

name: Wamuu
description: Wamuu is introduced as a servant to both Esidisi and Kars. He is a very strong and honorable warrior who possess the power of the wind, and also reflexively attacks anyone who steps on his shadow. If he goes blind, he can grow a horn on his forehead and sense sound waves with it. He can also draw air into his body and blast it through the tip of the horn, creating a highly-destructive "wind scalpel". He is also extremely honorable, stopping himself from defeating a defenseless Joseph Joestar when he said that with a month to train he could beat Wham.     He is named after the 80s duo featuring George Michael, Wham!.  (Source: Wikipedia)

appearsIn.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Part 2: Battle Tendency

name: Messina
description:
Messina is a tall muscular man with short hair tied into a ponytail and a Fu Manchu mustache. He wears a long hat, a sleeveless tunic, and armbands.

Though much of Messina's personality isn't focused upon, he displays the characteristics of a stern, yet effective instructor to Joseph and Caesar. Despite this, Messina seems to have a sense of humor as he, along with Loggins, would often tease his disciples during their training.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

appearsIn.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Part 2: Battle Tendency

name: Tasuku  Kaname
description: Tasuku Kaname is a high school student at Shimanami High, who is troubled by his sexual orientation and his affection for his schoolmate Touma Tsubaki.

appearsIn.title: Our Dreams at Dusk: Shimanami Tasogare

name: Touma Tsubaki
description: Touma Tsubaki is a character from the manga Shimanami Tasogare, the ace of the Shimanami High volleyball club and Tasuku Kaname's crush. He and Tasuku are on the Health Committee together.

appearsIn.title: Our Dreams at Dusk: Shimanami Tasogare

name: Haruko Daichi
description: Haruko is a frequent visitor of the Lounge and a member of the Cat Clowder. After being commissioned by Anonymous, she renovated the Lounge with friends she met through a gay community on Twitter. She's living with her wife, Saki, who she met through that community.

appearsIn.title: Our Dreams at Dusk: Shimanami Tasogare

name: Natsuyoshi Utsumi
description: Utsumi is a friend of Haruko, who he met through a gay community on Twitter. He is a member of the Cat Clowder Vacant House Restoration Non-Profit and a frequent visitor of the lounge.

appearsIn.title: Our Dreams at Dusk: Shimanami Tasogare

name: Chaiko
description: Chaiko is an older gentleman who often hangs out around the lounge and enjoys playing classical music.

appearsIn.title: Our Dreams at Dusk: Shimanami Tasogare

name: Anonymous
description: Anonymous is the mysterious founder and owner of the Lounge. They are asexual and, as Kamatani Yuuki has stated, of indeterminate gender identity.

appearsIn.title: Our Dreams at Dusk: Shimanami Tasogare

name: Shuuji Misora
description: Misora is in sixth grade and prefers to dress as a girl whenever he's at the lounge. He is unsure about what gender he identifies as. He has multiple older sisters and is called Shuuji at home.

appearsIn.title: Our Dreams at Dusk: Shimanami Tasogare

name: Kabi Nagata
description: [Staff Profile]( https://anilist.co/staff/120310/Kabi-Nagata)

name: Yuka
description: A cheerful girl from a lesbian escort agency.

name: Aoi Hyoudou
description:
__Height:__ 153 cm 

Satsuki's nephew, the son of Satsuki's older brother, and a junior high school student who enjoys dressing like a girl. He likes "cute things", and being the center of attention.

name: Kanade Maki
description:
**Height:** 178 cm

The Vice President of the Student Council at Miyabigaoka High.      (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Nagisa Tsuwamono
description:
