Satsuki’s younger sister and Aoi's aunt, Nagisa is the manager of a beach house known as “Ocean House.”      (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Sakuya Ayuzawa
description: Misaki and Suzuna's father.

name: Tomikouji Ichitarou
description:
__Class__: 3-A  

He is a Miyabigaoka student and new classmate of Usui Takumi. He is a childhood friend of the Umekouji siblings. He uses a tablet to type words and communicate since he talks excessively when using his voice.

name: Maria Miyazono
description: years old  Height: 149 cm  Weight: 42 kg     A young and attractive English teacher at Seika High. She may have non-Japanese ancestry because of her name and the comments on her looks.

name: Tomu Umekouji
description: He is a Miyabigaoka student and new classmate of Usui Takumi. He is the older brother of Kaon Umekouji.

name: Alpha Hatsuseno
description: Alpha is the main character of the series. As an A7-M2 model robot, one of the few production prototypes, she is one of the first of the A7 series and was named "Alpha". She has an unusual affinity with machines and people. Unlike most characters with cheerful personalities, Alpha is sweet without being saccharine. Her pleasant disposition has won her several friends and loyal customers yet she is also capable of making deep insights and displays an unusual level of maturity during her more private moments. As the story progresses, she interacts more with her surroundings and the people around her, gaining more knowledge about life with her experiences.

name: Alpha Koumi'ishi
description: Director Alpha is an A7M1 model. Being the first of the A7 series, she is also named "Alpha". Since the robots usually inherit the name of their respective owners, it is possible that Sensei (or one of her relatives) may have been Alpha's owner. She also possesses a pendant identical to that of Sensei. Kokone once mentions that the A7M1 is also known as "the Phantom" although how she had earned the alias or what it even implies is never given. Besides this, not much is known about her origins or purpose.     She is currently the director of the stratospheric aircraft called Taapon that circles the Earth, observing the world's changes from above. It is hinted that she will be its last living passenger because she does not age, unlike the rest of the crew.    Director Alpha is shown to have a strong mental connection with Alpha Hatsuseno though neither of them seem to be aware of it.

name: Oji-san
description: A middle-aged man with a perpetual grin, he is Alpha's closest neighbor and a regular customer at her café. He runs a gas station and sells vegetables on the side. He is a grandfather-figure to Alpha and the actual grandfather of Takahiro. Ojisan refers to himself as a bum and seems to regret not pursuing a relationship with Sensei when they were younger. His real name is never given.

name: Koumi'ishi
description: An elderly woman, Sensei is a doctor for both humans and androids. She was involved in the development of the A7 series of robots and hosted Director Alpha at her home, possibly as Director Alpha's owner. When she was younger, she rode motorcycles, raced hovercraft, and was Ojisan's senpai from school. Her surname is Koumi'ishi (子海石, Koumi'ishi , lit. "child-sea-stone") but she is always addressed by just her title. Besides the pendant with her logo, both Alphas appear inherit her vision of "going and seeing".

name: Saetta
description: The young daughter of Makki and Takahiro. She is the last character to meet the Misago.

name: Maruko Maruko
description: A type A7M3 robot with a prickly personality. She is an artist who lives in Yokohama and works as a waitress and then shop clerk as a day job. She is unusual among robots for having changed her surname to one of her own choosing rather than adopting her owner's. Her given name is pronounced the same as her surname but spelled in katakana. She likes Kokone and is jealous of Alpha for "taking" her. Nai occasionally sends her sensory impressions, delivered by Kokone, which she uses in her art. Eventually, Maruko becomes good friends with Alpha and Makki.

name: Takahiro
description: The grandson of Ojisan, who lives with his grandparents. He meets Alpha at age nine and she quickly takes to him as if he were a younger brother. He is the first character in the series to meet the Misago. As he grows up, Takahiro becomes fascinated with engines of all types and eventually moves away in his mid-teens to work with Nai.

name: Kokone Takatsu
description: A type A7M3 production robot who works as a courier out of Yokohama. She is the first other robot that Alpha met when she delivered a package (containing a camera) and a message from Alpha's owner. They quickly become friends. Kokone is sweet, shy, and somewhat intellectual, but because of her job she has more experience with people than Alpha.

name: Matsuki
description: A girl a few years younger than Takahiro. She likes Takahiro and is initially jealous of Alpha. Makki eventually becomes close to Alpha after learning that the latter would never consider having a relationship with Takahiro because mortal humans move through time in a different way compared to the immortal robots. She is skeptical of Takahiro's stories of the Misago until she meets the wild-woman herself. In her early teens, Makki works for a while at Alpha's café before moving away to become a courier with Kokone's company. She later settles down at Hamamatsu with Takahiro.

name: Misago
description: An ageless wild-woman who lives in the inlets and bays near Café Alpha. She is always naked and eats raw fish caught with her short fangs and inhuman speed. She only shows herself to young children and shies away from contact with adults. She does not age and, according to omake material, doesn't understand how children grow up. According to Ayase, she existed decades before robots were created.

name: Ju-Heon Seo
description:
__Age:__ 38 (Before Regression), 23 (After Regression)

After getting betrayed by his own boss who feared his rising power and sent to a death mission, he gets help from a strange relic which sends him 15 years back in time, when tombs just started appearing.

name: Chloe Laurent
description: Chloe is a medic skilled at healing the injured and suppressing risks caused by relics. She can store relic risks inside bottles and use them.

name: Irene  Holton
aliases: アイリーン・ ホルトン
description: Irene Holton is the only daughter of the Holton Family. She was known as the Monarch of Destitution. Irene is an innocent girl that is at first reluctant to do anything. During the fight against the relic Hand of Midas, with the help of Seo Joo-Heon, she gained confidence and dominated the relic and seized complete control over it. After this event, she would gain more confidence and start to help Seo Joo-Heon in his every task.

name: Ilya Volgof
description:
Ilya Volgof was a member of TKBM's Team 13 under the command of Seo Joo-Heon.

He is the most skilled of the Aftermath Clean-up Crew which specializes in modifying memories and disbanding tomb raiding teams.

He is currently working for Kwon Hyuk Soo after quitting his job as a talented Russian exorcism priest at the Vatican in Italy and losing his girlfriend Galina to find a way to revive her without realizing that the Vatican executed her and used her as a sacrifice for Un-Known.

After he regained his memories, he betrayed Kwon Hyuk Soo but refused to rejoin the team which resulted in him being beaten up and forced to sign Seo Joo-Heon's contract.

name: Seol-A Lee
description:
Lee Seol-Ah was a member of the TKBM Tomb raiding team under the command of Seo Ju-Heon.She was a scout skilled at finding people and relics. She is currently working for the Chinese raiding group of Red Flowers. She attempted to thwart Seo Joo-Heon plan of selling the fake Nero's Relic which was presumed to be the relic of Julius Ceaser by destroying it with a B ranked dagger.

(Source: Tomb Raider King Wiki)

name: Jae-Ha Yu
description: Before the time rewind, he was (and still is) a specialist in relic restoration. He became known as the Fraud King, something which Chairman Kwon eventually became aware of. Jae-Ha met Joo-Heon through being on the same raiding team.

name: Julian Miller
description: Jullian Miller was framed by Seo Joo-Heon as the culprit and blackmailer attempting to steal the Julius Caesar relic.

name: Edward
description: Edward is a world renowned weapons and information merchant and illegal arms dealer.

name: Shigekiyo Yanguu
description:
A side character in Diamond is Unbreakable. Shigechi is a short and stocky teenage boy. Apparently bald, his crown is textured by short spikes, and he has thick, drooping earlobes. He has small, high eyebrows, and youthful features. His teeth are misaligned, and he is missing his left maxillary central incisor.

Introduced as a kid using his Stand, Harvest, to collect money throughout the town, Shigechi befriends Josuke Higashikata and Okuyasu Nijimura.

appearsIn.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Part 4: Diamond is Unbreakable

name: Akira Otoishi
description:
Akira was one of the many people Keicho Nijimura shot with the Bow and Arrow while trying to find a stand user capable of killing his mutated father. Akira was one the many lucky ones to develop a stand after which point he became interested in them and how to create them. To further his goal on studying them he needed the Bow and Arrow which he forcefully took from Keicho leading to Keicho's death. From there on he tormented several people, among them Josuke while trying to improve in the use of his guitar skills.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Wiki)

appearsIn.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Part 4: Diamond is Unbreakable

name: Han-Bin Ryu
description: Ryu Han-Bin was a normal person who just had been discharged from his mandatory military service, when he was transported to another world

appearsIn.title: Latna Saga: Survival of a Sword King

name: Leonhart
description: Leonhart is a powerful warrior from Latna Saga: Survival of a Sword King, initially part of the Heresy Inquisitors. Over time, he shifts his allegiance and becomes an ally to Ryu Hanbin. His strength and divine abilities make him a key character in the story.

appearsIn.title: Latna Saga: Survival of a Sword King
Latna Saga: Survival of a Sword King

name: Atisse Bennister
description: Atisse Bennister is a dragon with the ability of transform himself into a human and back to dragon. Among the dragons Atisse is considered very young due to the fact that dragons can live several thousand years as stated by Atisse. He is currently friends with Ryu Han-Bin and Ephyr.

appearsIn.title: Latna Saga: Survival of a Sword King

name: Kivye
description: Kivye is the envoy of the Goddess of Darkness Kivryelle. She was sent to Rathnia to search for Ryu Han-Bin in order to ask for his help in finding one of the four heroes, Barolt, for the sake of saving the world of Rathnia from Ormphlaus and defeating Zenovia and Garhan.

appearsIn.title: Latna Saga: Survival of a Sword King

name: Laude Roud
description: Laude Roud is one of the few persons Ryu Han-Bin first interacted with after his arrival to the Onprous City. He offered Ryu Han-Bin to join his party at the same time he mocked him about his level.

appearsIn.title: Latna Saga: Survival of a Sword King

name: Patault
description: Patault also known as The Sword King is one of the four heroes blessed by the Goddesses. He is a Valterian warrior and the strongest among the four heroes.

appearsIn.title: Latna Saga: Survival of a Sword King

name: Zenovia
description: Zenovia also known as Zenovia The Archmage is the current Queen of Mage Kingdom of Rune and one of four heroes blessed by the Goddesses. She is considered the strongest Rathnian mage.

appearsIn.title: Latna Saga: Survival of a Sword King

name: Hollian
aliases: The Trasncendentalist of Life and Death
description: Hollian also know as Hollian The Trasncendentalist of Life and Death is the current Queen of Allendia Kingdom. She is one of four heroes who were blessed by the Goddesses.

appearsIn.title: Latna Saga: Survival of a Sword King

name: Jean-Jacques Chastel
description:
__Race:__ Vampire
__Partner:__  Chloe d'Apchier

Jean-Jacques Chastel is a vampire who is shown to be a servant of Chloe d'Apchier in D'Apchier Family Castle at Silver Forest, Gévaudan.

name: Gilles
description: Gilles is a Vampire of the Crimson Moon and childhood friend of Noé Archiviste and Louis and Dominique de Sade.

name: Catherine
description: A young girl from a noble Vampire of the Crimson Moon family.

name: Fred
description: Fred is a Vampire of the Crimson Moon and childhood friend of Noé Archiviste and Louis and Dominique de Sade.

name: Yurine Hanzawa
description: Yurine is a laid-back and quiet young woman. She becomes [Ichikawa](https://anilist.co/character/174191/Kyoutarou-Ichikawa) and [Yamada](https://anilist.co/character/174190/Anna-Yamada)'s classmate in their third year, in Class 3-1.

name: Rin Kanaoya
description: The girl that accidentally hit [Yamada](https://anilist.co/character/174190/Anna-Yamada) in the face with a basketball.

name: Mamiya
description: Childhood friend of Nanjou. Wants to advance their relationship, but never seems able to catch his eye.

name: Lucifer Nigorikawa
aliases: Imaginary Kyoutarou (イマジナリー京太郎)
description:
Lucifer Nigorikawa is a figment of [Ichikawa](https://anilist.co/character/174191/Kyoutarou-Ichikawa)'s imagination in Boku no Kokoro no Yabai Yatsu.

Not quite a real "character" per se, Nigorikawa is an imaginary figure that Ichikawa conjures up to help himself deal with his emotional shortcomings. He is largely based off of Nigorikawa-kun, the male lead of [Yamada](https://anilist.co/character/174190/Anna-Yamada)'s favorite shoujo manga, Your Color's Octave. The "Lucifer" moniker and the associated black wings he sometimes sprouts are additions from Ichikawa's chuunibyou delusions.

name: Moriya-sensei
description: The teacher of Class 3-1. An energetic and high-spirited teacher that likes to move around a lot.

name: Oingo
description:
Oingo is a minor antagonist appearing in Stardust Crusaders.

As a part of the Egypt 9 Glory Gods, he attempts to assassinate the Joestar Group alongside his little brother Boingo. His Stand is Khnum, which allows him to disguise himself as anyone.

appearsIn.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Part 3: Stardust Crusaders

name: Vanilla Ice
description:
Vanilla Ice is the last Vampire created by DIO and one of the penultimate Stand Users the Joestar Group faces upon infiltrating DIO's Mansion. After the group is split up, he is sent to take out the team consisting of Avdol, Polnareff, and Iggy. Vanilla Ice is a Stand User controlling his void-based Stand ability, Cream, to battle.

His name is based off the famous ''rapper'', Vanilla Ice. His stand is named after the band, Cream.

appearsIn.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Part 3: Stardust Crusaders

name: Forever
description: Forever is a malicious orangutan in DIO's service who confronts the group in the South China Sea aboard a freighter. Said ship happens to be possessed by Forever's Stand: Strength.

appearsIn.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Part 3: Stardust Crusaders

name: Elrasla  Grilaroc
description: Elrasla Grilaroc more commonly known as Granny is an old woman who states that her level is the same as her age. She hit the level cap a long time ago. The sole successor of the Mushin Tensou style of martial arts.

appearsIn.title: The Rising of the Shield Hero

name: Mahouya
description:
She is an older woman who runs a magic book store at Castle Town of Melromarc. She was mentioned to be a witch by herself.

She gave magic books free of cost for Naofumi and his party to learn magic.

appearsIn.title: The Rising of the Shield Hero

name: Hickwaal
description: He is the accessory Merchant protected by the shield hero from Bandits and was also the founder and first president of the Hickwaal Company.

appearsIn.title: The Rising of the Shield Hero

name: Fitoria
description:
Fitoria is the queen of the Filolials, who rules over them all.

She has silver hair with thin streaks of light blue, cut in a short bob with three tufts of hair standing up vertically from the crown of her head, like cowlicks. Her eyes are red and her face is small and well composed. She's dressed in a red and white gothic lolita-style dress. She's about the same height as Filo.

appearsIn.title: The Rising of the Shield Hero
The Rising of the Shield Hero

name: Manabu Itagaki
description: The most recent addition to the roster, the charming Manabu has a prodigy's talent and was the captain of his high school's boxing team. Cheerful and a lover of bad puns, Manabu is a fierce outboxer with extremely high speed and reflexes and whose fighting style is uncanny in its resemblance to Miyata's. His most powerful technique is a furious hail of mid-power blows known as the Hedgehog or Porcupine, which was employed in an East Japan Rookie Kings showdown with his longtime nemesis, Kyosuke Imai. Outside of boxing, Manabu is employed as an assistant at the Makounouchi family's fishing business. Itagaki's character is based on former world champion Oscar de La Hoya for his prodigy-like natural ability and good looks, whom Itagaki has admitted to idolizing in the manga. His current record as the Rookie King of his class stands at 9 Matches 8-1-0 (W-L-D), with 6 KOs.

name: Yuuji Date
description: Eiji Date and Date Aiko's second son.

name: Nanako Itagaki
description: A 16 year old high school student at introduction, Nanako is one of Makunouchi Ippo's biggest fans. Because of this, she views Mashiba Kumi as a rival and competes with her at almost everything. She takes any chance to be around Ippo, and even tried to steal a kiss from him once when he was sleeping after a rough match, but she was interrupted by Kumi. Like her older brother Manabu she is very attractive, but she also has the same love for puns as the rest of her family. Imai Kyousuke is in love with her, but she tends to ignore his feelings as she has no interest in dating her brother's rival.

name: Miyata no Chichi
description: Ichiro Miyata's father and coach, and the one who passed on to him the love of boxing. He is a former a Japan and OPBF champion and considered a world contender when he was in his prime.

name: Charles-Henri Sanson
native: シャルル＝アンリ・サンソン
description:
Charles-Henri Sanson is one of the main characters and protagonist of Innocent series. Born in 1739 to Charles Jean-Baptiste Sanson and his first wife Madeleine Tronson, he was the fourth in a six-generation family dynasty of executioners.

Charles is described as a beautiful young man with straight long dark hair. Older Charles has longer and wavy hair that is usually always shown to be slicked back. He resembles his father more with large shoulders and rib cage, but still has soft facial features and hands. His complexion, hair reflexions and eye color is odd and changing from volume to volume but are generally a ghostly greyish, bluish, purplish shade except for two examples where it is white with green or brownish shadows.



__In the second part "Rouge":__


(Source: Innocent Wiki)

name: Marie-Joseph Sanson
native: マリー＝ジョセフ・サンソン
description:
Marie-Josèphe Sanson is the younger half-sister of [Charles-Henri Sanson](https://anilist.co/character/89944/Sanson-CharlesHenri) and one of the two main characters of the series. Born in 1751 to [Charles Jean-Baptiste Sanson](https://anilist.co/character/131350/Sanson-CharlesJeanBaptiste) and Jeanne-Gabrielle Berger Sanson.

Her looks are considered to be too unladylike as she tends to style her sun-blond hair in buzzcut and undercut styles. Usually shaving left side of her head or both sides. She even completely shaved her hair once. Despite her tomboyish appearance Marie is considered as a very beautiful young woman with blonde hair and piercing blue eyes. She has strong physical resemblance to her older brother Charles-Henri Sanson.

name: Subyss
description: Tormentor attached to the High Court of Justice.

name: Jean de Chartois
native: ジャン・ド・シャルトワ
description: The 14-year-old son of Earl Chartois.

name: Nicholas-Charles Gabriel Sanson
native: ニコラ＝シャルル・ガブリエル・サンソン
description: Little brother of the "Third Generation", Baptiste. Executioner directly controlled by the Palace of Versailles Administration of Justice.

name: Anne-Marthe-Dubut Sanson
native: アンヌ＝マルト・デュビュ・サンソン
description: Little sister of the first generation's second wife. The "Iron Law" of the Sanson family.

name: Charles-Jean-Baptiste Sanson
native: シャルル＝ジャン・バチスト・サンソン
description: Third head of the Sanson household.

name: Eugene Lionhart
description: Eugene Lionheart is the titular protagonist of the web novel Damn Reincarnation. In his previous life, he was known as Hamel Dynas, and was one of the Five Great Heroes who vanquished three of the five Demon Kings of the Devildom of Helmuth long ago. After dying in the castle of the Demon King of Incarceration, he found himself reborn 300 years later as a distant relative of his comrade, Vermouth Lionheart. Reborn into a collateral branch family of the Lionheart Family, the son of Gerhard Lionheart, he swore to finish the task his comrades could not: Kill all the Demon Kings.

name: Genos Lionheart
description: Genos Lionheart is the Black Lions’ Second Division Captain and a member of the Lionheart Family’s collateral branch, whose ancestor was Vermouth’s second son.

name: Melkith El-Hayah
aliases: Spirit Princess of the White Tower of Magic
description: Melkith El-Hayah, known as the White Tower Master, is the master of one of the Five Magic Towers in the Magic Kingdom of Aroth, namely the White Magic Tower. She has contracts with the Spirit Kings of Earth and Lightning.

name: Bermut Lionhart
description: Bermut Lionhart also known as Bermut the Great is a companion of Hamel and also the leader of the hero party that dispatched to defeat Demon Kings.

name: Gilead Lionheart
description: Gilead Lionheart is the Patriarch of the Lionheart Family as well as a member of the council. He is the husband of Tanis Lionheart with whom he fathered Eward. He also married Ancilla Lionheart, with whom he had a pair of twins, Cyan and Ciel.

name: Mer
description: Mer is Sienna Merdein's familiar and it's her duty to manage the floor of Akron on which Witchcraft is located. Her consciousness is located within Witchcraft.

name: Sienna Merdein
description: Sienna Merdein, also known as Wise Sienna, is a companion of Stupid Hamel and also the magician of the hero party that was dispatched to defeat Demon Kings. She is known as one of the greatest magicians in magic history.

name: Dominic Lionheart
description: Dominic Lionheart is the grandson of the Immortal White Lion Doynes Lionheart and the wielder of the Annihilation Hammer Jigollath. He is the leader of the First Division of the Black Lions.

name: Ciel Lionheart
description: Ciel Lionheart is the daughter of Gilead Lionheart and the twin sister of Cyan Lionheart. She is a member of the direct line of the Lionheart family.

name: Doynes Lionheart
description: Doynes Lionheart is a member of the Lionheart Family and leader of the Black Lions. He is a powerhouse who wields the Demonic Spear Luentos.

name: Machi Kuragi
description: Machi Kuragi is a fictional character and the school treasurer of Kaibara High School in the manga entitled Fruits Basket. Machi is a quiet and shy character, and appears to be sensitive and rather isolated. She appears in the Fruits Basket manga and drama CDs, where she's voiced by Yuki Kaida.    Machi is the half-sister of Kakeru Manabe. Manabe is very protective of her and can often be seen ordering her around, more out of brotherly love than sibling superiority.    Machi is a very quiet character, though she later begins to show her more stubborn side. She also appears to be quite humble towards Yuki and the other council members, often doing what ever they say and rarely speaking up for her own wishes—that is, if she has any. Despite all such things, however, Machi is a deeply kind and caring girl on the inside, as shown by her heartwarming reactions.

name: Tao
description: Tao is a  young man who possesses a genius-level intellect in computer programming and other technological fields. He was one of the less cold-hearted members of the DA-5 group, made by Dr. Iris, and is yet another a modified human. He is currently residing with Takeo and M-21 in Frankenstein's residence and is also working as a security guard in Ye Ran High School. He is "Number One" of the RK-4 which is a group of four formed by himself.

name: Krantz
description:
Krantz [is] a modified human who worked for the Union as the Leader of the DA-5, a special forces team created by Dr. Aris.  Krantz is the leader of DA-5. He was created by Dr. Aris. He is usually shown on the sidelines and doen't fight with weak opponents. 



(Source: [Noblesse Wiki](http://noblesse.wikia.com/wiki/Krantz))

name: Su-I Im
description: Suyi is an attractive young girl and a pretty popular pop idol who is also studying at Ye Ran High School. She first appeared in chapter 94, when she returned to school after doing a concert while being escorted by Hansu. She’s a friend of Ik-Han, Shinwoo and Yuna and often hangs out with them. The kids tend to avoid visiting crowded places, because people would stare at Suyi. She often joins the others in visiting Frankenstein’s house. Even though Suyi is popular, she prefers leading a normal life.

name: Seira J. Loyard
aliases: セーラ・J・ロイアード
description:
Race: Noble  
Occupation: student, Loyard clan leader  
Eye colour: Red 
Hair colour: Silver   

Seira has a rather quiet and shy personality. She usually doesn’t show emotion on her face and is very calm, but she does blush when being complimented. She learns to cook very rapidly and is soon responsible for making meals in Frankenstein’s house with the exception of ramen, which is Frankenstein’s personal project.   Seira is the last remaining blood descendant and the leader of the Loyard clan. Her soul weapon is the Death Scythe. Since the death of her family members, she has been under Gejutel’s care. She and Regis are very close and they have a mental connection, due to which they can sense each others presence. When she can’t feel this presence this means he’s either very far away, unconscious or dead.   (Source: Wikipedia, Noblesse Wikia)

name: M-24
description:
__Age:__ Unknown (>25) 
__Race:__ Human (modified) 
__Occupation:__ (deceased) 
__Eye Color:__ White 
__Hair Color:__ (bald)  

M-24 is a large, bulky, and muscular guy with purplish-tinted skin, who wears a black fedora with a gray turtleneck sweater, black jacket, and dark pants. Though he appears to be cruel and cold-hearted at first, it is later revealed that he can be very compassionate and caring towards others. He shares a very close relationship with M-21 because they were the only 2 remaining from their group. Together, they try to find out their comrades’ names. He even wished for M-21 to call him ‘older brother’ because he thinks that previously in his life, he had younger siblings.  M-24 was one of the first 100 humans (M-1 to M-100) that were experimented on by the Union. He is considered a failed experiment, like M-21, and he is dependent on pills from the union that prevent his body from deteriorating.  In time he has developed the ability of minor mind-control as a side effect of the experiments done on him. He helped M-21 to learn how he could withstand mind control by launching several attempts of mind control on him. He was also capable of producing ‘infected’ and control them.

name: Taze
description: Age: Unknown Race: Modified Human Affiliation: Union Occupation: Captain of Cerberus First Appearance: Chapter 231  Taze [is] a Modified Human who worked for the the Union as the captain of Cerberus, the personal guard and strongest military force of the 12th Union Elder. She is the personal bodyguard of the Elder and stays with him rather than with other Cerberus members.  Taze is very arrogant and ruthless when dealing with people other than the Elder, be it her allies or her enemies. She is overconfident about her own abilities and is quick to underestimate others.   Taze is way stronger than her fellow Cerberus agents. Her strength and speed are several times greater than those of her fellow members, marking her captaincy.   (Source: Noblesse Wikia)

name: Lutai
description: Age: Unknown  Race: Modified Human Affiliation: Union Occupation: Member of Cerberus First Appearance: Chapter 211  Lutai [is] a modified human who served the Union as a member of Cerberus, the personal guard and strongest military force of the 12th Union Elder.   Little is known about Lutai and his past other than the fact that he became a modified human and member of Cerberus, the personal bodyguards of the 12th Elder at an undisclosed point in the past.   Lutai is less violent and eager to attack others as compared to his partner, Ked. He, like the other Cerberus members, is arrogant about his strength and underestimates others. He has quite a chatty attitude and loves to have fun while fighting.   As a member of Cerberus, Lutai is very strong and skilled. He is one of the most powerful modified humans shown thus far, displaying highly destructive abilities that were capable of easily destroying car and seriously damaging large buildings.  Source:  [Noblesse wik](http://noblesse.wikia.com/wiki/Lutai)

name: Hansu Jung
description: Jung Hansu Race: Human Occupation: idol Hair colour: black Hansu is an idol and an acquaintance of Suyi. He appears in chapter 94 of the manga while escorting her back to school after a concert. She doesn’t really like him, but Shinwoo and the others wanted to meet him so she brought him along to do them a favour.      source: http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Noblesse_(manga) http://noblesse.wikia.com/wiki/Noblesse_Wiki

name: Goku Black
description:
__Race:__ Saiyan
__Universe:__ 10
__Manga Debut:__ “SOS from the Future” (Chapter 14, Volume 2)
__Anime Debut:__ "SOS from the Future: A Dark New Enemy Appears!" (Episode 47)

Goku Black (ゴクウブラック Gokū Burakku), usually referred to as Black, is the main antagonist of the "Future" Trunks Saga of [Dragon Ball Super](https://anilist.co/manga/86508/Dragon-Ball-Super/). Goku Black, alongside Future Zamasu, plans to eradicate all mortals, or what they referred to as the “Zero-Mortals Plan”. He is commonly mistaken for as [Goku](https://anilist.co/character/246/Goku-Son) but as his look-alike terrorizes the timeline of [Future Trunks](https://anilist.co/character/2707/Trunks).

name: Pu'ar
description: Pu'ar is a soft-spoken shapechanging blue creature and the constant companion of Yamcha. The name is revealed to be a pun on Pu-erh tea. Pu'ar is neither a cat or a mouse, albeit the series creator Akira Toriyama stated that he had drawn the character to look a little bit like a cat. Traveling alongside Yamcha, the two worked as a team robbing anyone traveling through the desert area in which they lived. Pu'ar has an innate ability of levitation or flight, and is nearly always seen simply 'standing' in thin air at about human head height.  Pu'ar has the unique ability to shapeshift into any form, even inanimate objects, and can hold that form for as long as desired; his strength is not increased by the change, however, and as such he is unable to turn into something that can be used up like fuel or food. Pu'ar graduated from the same shapeshifting academy as Oolong, although unlike Oolong, Pu'ar had completed all of the academy training and does not have Oolong's difficulties with maintaining a transformed state. Pu'ar shows up quite a bit in the beginning, but becomes less of a presence as the series continues. As the driving theme of the series is mostly about fighting, Pu'ar can do little more than react to the horrors of the latest supervillains in the story.  There is some debate regarding the character's gender. Despite being portrayed by several female voice actors, the character has been referred to with both male and female pronouns during the anime.

name: Gregory
description: Gregory is a little flying cricket and King Kai's motor-mouth pet. Gregory is very respectful of his master and always speaks highly of him, but he will talk trash to anyone he does not believe is better than him. King Kai called for him after Goku managed to catch Bubbles: the new goal was to hit Gregory with a heavy hammer.     Much later Gregory is killed when Semi-Perfect Cell blows up on King Kai's Planet.    Source: Dragon Ball Wiki

name: Jinzouningen 17-gou
description: Artificial Human #17, Android 17 in the English adaptations, is a fictional character who first appears in the Dragon Ball manga created by Akira Toriyama, as well as Dragon Ball Z and Dragon Ball GT.    Originally a human, he is constructed into a cyborg by Dr. Gero like his twin sister. 17 is a mass murderer in Future Trunks' timeline.    Number 17 is not an android created by Dr. Gero. He and his twin sister #18, were once human. How could they be twins if they weren't once human? Toriyama said Gero found them as a couple of hooligans. They existed before Dr. Gero, therefore, they are not robots. An android is a robot and a cyborg is a human with robot parts in them. Considering what he can do, #17 is probably about half human.    Now as to the motivation behind #17 killing Dr. Gero, that's subjective. While they didn't necessarily like being turned into cyborgs, once it was done, it couldn't be undone. It was Dr. Gero's strangle hold on their freedom, as represented by the "controller" device, that inspired #17 to kill him. Threat + Rebel = dead Gero. They were both rebels. You should never try to put a leash on a rebel.    Later, #17 and #18 drive around in a van with Android 16, looking for Goku. When they finally get to the Kame House, Piccolo tells them Goku is not there. He refuses to tell them where he went to, and thus Piccolo challes #17 to a battle.

name: Emanon
description: A mysterious girl who holds a 3-billion-year old memory, dating back to the moment life first appeared on Earth.

name: Narrator
description: A young student who likes sci-fi literature. In 1967 he met Emanon on the ship heading for his home in Kyushu.

name: Ema
description: Ema is Ryouzan's wife and mother of 1973's generation of Emanon. When she gave birth to next Emanon her mind and memory were wiped blank. She survived and gained new personality only thanks to dedication and support of her husband.

name: Seijirou
description: The father of the three Kawamoto sisters. He left them and their mother when Momo was still a baby to live with another woman.

appearsIn.title: March Comes in Like a Lion

name: Manabu Yasui
description: A six dan. Upon losing a match, he lost his temper, thus resulting in him divorcing his wife.

appearsIn.title: March Comes in Like a Lion

name: Miharu Kirisu
description: Miharu Kirisu is the younger sister of Mafuyu and an amateur skater.

name: Ruri Aoki
description:
__Height:__ 154 cm (5'1")
__Relatives:__ [Umi Aoki](https://anilist.co/character/328042/Umi-Aoki) (Mother), [Ruri no Chichi](https://anilist.co/character/328049/Ruri-no-Chichi) (Father), [Ruri no Sobo](https://anilist.co/character/328045/Ruri-no-Sobo) (Grandmother)

A first-year in high school who awoke one morning to find horns growing out of her head and learned that she was, in fact, half dragon. In the days and weeks since, Ruri has dealt with fire breath and other emerging dragon traits, all of which threaten to disrupt her life as an otherwise ordinary teen.

One of [Ruri](https://anilist.co/character/278064/Aoki-Ruri)'s friends.

name: Nene Odagiri
description: Nene is one of the seven witches and Vice president of the Student Council.

name: Ushio Igarashi
description: Ushio was actually Yamada's friend from their old school. They had both decided to put behind their gang related past by going their separate ways. By coincidence, they end up going to the same school and they can not seem to fit in any cliques, so they decided to stay together. Ushio also had a deep hate for girls but that changed when he met Odagiri Nene and kissed her. Her power made him fall deep in love with Nene and betray his best friend, Yamada.

name: Akane Kikuchi
description: Akane has been shown to be stoic, showing almost no emotion. She appears rather professional whenever she visits the Student Council. She is also rushed and not one for casual small talk. Despite this she is rather very polite and cooperative.

name: Kouta Ooyama
description: Ooyama is a second-year high school student who lives alone, but has to deal with Akutsu since she is constantly hanging out in his room after school and sometimes even stays the night. While he does want Akutsu to go home, he becomes flustered when he is around her. He is also concerned that she might stay at some other guy's place if she leaves

name: Riko Akutsu
description: Akutsu is Ooyama's delinquent classmate who constantly hangs out in his room to read manga, play video games, and eat snacks.

name: Reiko Akutsu
description: Mother of Riko Akutsu, and a former gyaru. She and her husband are always flirting and acting lovey-dovey at home, which results in her daughter not wanting to stay there and staying at other homes, especially Ooyama's.

name: Riko
description: A cat whose owner is Ooyama's landlady.

name: Aoi Ooya
description: Ooya is the landlady's 20-year-old daughter.

name: Hibiki
description: Hibiki is a year younger than Ooyama and Akutsu. She is a delinquent who initially tried to challenge Akutsu, but lost. Since then, she has looked up to Akutsu as a big sister and demands that Ooyama give Akutsu back to her. She and Akutsu used to hang out together in the same room.

name: Haha Ooyama
description: Ooyama's mother is a kind woman who shows up at her son's apartment. She was initially skeptical of Akutsu until she is convinced that Akutsu and her son are dating.

name: Youko Suzuki
description: Youko is one of Akutsu's friends since middle school. She has short brown hair in a ponytail and a large chest.

name: Misaki Tanaka
description: Misaki is one of Akutsu's friends since middle school. She is the shortest of the three girls and has short black hair with bunches.

name: Nao Kanzaki
description: Nao is a stupidly honest girl who sees herself trapped in the Liar Game after finding 100 million yen in a box along with a card. Now, she has to take care of the money for 30 days and try to steal another 100 million from his rival.   Nao's father is in the hospital and none of her friends believe her so she contacts Akiyama Shinichi to help her.

name: Shinichi Akiyama
description: Formerly a graduate student majoring in psychology, he is a "genius swindler" who took down a giant MLM scam named Shuuei to avenge his mother. He helps Nao when he sees the honest nature she had, just like his mother. Although he is not invited into the Liar Game, he enters by substituting for another player in Round II. By Round III he is respected (and feared) enough by the LGT players to become unofficial leader of the Southern Country, though he tries to keep things equal in the group. Yokoya, however, knows Akiyama had been manipulating his team mates and mocks him for it.

name: Norihiko Yokoya
description:
__Occupation:__  Ex-Coporate CEO (Drama)
__Abilities:__ Manipulation, Bribery, Intimidation

Yokoya Norihiko is the current main antagonist of the series, introduced in the Third Round's Northern Country.

He is a calm, darked-haired man who is fond of carrying mice on his person. Nearco accurately describes him as Akiyama's greatest rival, and Nao senses something odd about him early in the game.

name: Yuuji Fukunaga
description: A trans woman who first appears in Round II, where she poses as a woman named Hitomi (Hitomi is her friend for whom she substitutes as player No. 3). Sly and calculating and also a 5th degree black belt, Fukunaga is a skilled manipulator whose greatest weakness appears to be her desire for money and her bad temper. She greatly hinders Nao and Akiyama during Round II and the Revival Round, but has never been able to outwit Akiyama. However, Fukunaga cooperates with them well during Round III and even when she finishes the round debt-free, she chooses to continue in the tournament. To avoid revealing her skills during the mock stimulation, she sends Nao in her place, matching Solario's expectations. Though Fukunaga seems fond of Nao in her own way, she doesn't think of her as competent.

name: Teruo Tanimura
description: A lawyer that Nao first consulted when she she gets involved in the LGT. He gives her the idea of using a scam artist to win the game, and is the one to direct Nao to look up Akiyama. It isn't revealed until later that he is actually part of the LGT working to make sure players don't unexpectedly give the money from Round I to the police. After Round II, he shows up at Nao's home to tell her about Akiyama's past, and to manipulate her to return to the LGT in Revival Round. He is later seen monitoring Revival Round I with Leronira, and shows up at Nao's home again to inform her of Revival Round II.

name: Leronira
description: One of the hosts of the Liar Game. He wears a suit, has dark hair, and an ornate mask covers his face. He hosts Round II in person, hosts via a television in Revival Round, and hosts Round III with Nearco. Though he admires Akiyama and Fukunaga for their brains, he admits in being most interested in how Nao plays the games.

name: Nearco
description: One of the hosts of the Liar Game. He looks exactly the same as Leronira, but has a different mask. He first appears in Round III, which he co-hosts with Leronia. He admires Yokoya, describing him as a fearsome individual, and can not understand Leronira's interest in Nao. By the end of Round III he, too, is curious at how she will play. His mask has a long moustache.

name: Solario
description: One of the hosts of the Liar Game. He looks similar to the previous hosts, except his mask has a sun on his right eye. He hosts Revival Round II via a television, and seems to already know the backgrounds of players he haven't seen before. Unlike Nearco, he is quickly interested in Nao when she realizes the objective of Revival Round II before he expected.

name: Forli
description: One of the host of the Liar Game. He is the main dealer for the Pandemic Game.

name: Alsab
description: Dealer for the Fourth Round in Musical Chairs.

name: Airen Farreira
description: A boy who sleeps to run away from reality. People mocked him, calling him a deadbeat, but he had no wish to change. Until one day, he dreamt of a swordsman... It was a dream about a talentless man who had been training by swinging his sword for decades.

appearsIn.title: The Lazy Lord Masters the Sword

name: Izumi Ishiguro
description: Koyuki's childhood friend, he eventually was left to choose between her and Maho, though by the time he reached his decision, the two girls also reached one of their own, luckily a similar conclusion.

name: Momoko Ogasawara
description: Koyuki's music teacher at school, she gets to know Saitou through Koyuki and they start to develop a relationship through the series.

name: Marco
description:
Marco has the mental age of a kid, but possesses a monstrous strength that is far beyond any ordinary human being. 

Due to his ruthless and savage upraising by his father, Marco was conditioned to turn into his bloodthirsty Rodem persona whenever he was stabbed with a needle, turning him into a being that would mercilessly kill everyone in his path.However, since Marco joined Madarame Baku's side, he has avoided his intent to kill, even when reverting to his Rodem persona.

name: Baku Madarame
description:
Baku is known as a genius gambler, he is a legend in the underworld.

During gambles, there are many instances where he intimidates and tosses around his opponents as if he is eating them. And even outside of gambling, he is prone to danger and likes to take risks in everything. His true feelings towards people are unknown and a mystery. However, he seems to treat people based on what he sees through his judgments. He shows his disgust towards people like [Kaji](https://anilist.co/character/134946/Takaomi-Kaji)'s mother who selfishly trample on others, but on the other hand, he shows kindness to people like [Marco](https://anilist.co/character/75228/Marco) who have been living in solitude. Baku considers his friends and allies very important.

name: Kaji Takaomi
description:
Kaji Takaomi was originally a very ordinary man before he met Madarame Baku with a typically trusting personality. But as he went through and experienced many life-threatening situations, his mentality strengthened. He grows and becomes more courageous against dealing with people like yakuza and Kakerou.

Kaji hates the idea of killing his opponent in a gamble.

name: Hikoichi Yakou
description:
Hikoichi is an older gentleman with grey hair, a well-kept mustache, with his most distinguishing feature being his eyebrows which curl at the outer sides. Like a gentleman, he uses honorifics and is polite to anyone. However, he shows his savage side to satisfy his curiosity or during battles.

He has a twin brother called Yakou Jouichi.

name: Kyara
description:
Kyara was an intimidating-looking individual, with a notably muscular frame, a mop of wild black hair and a generally menacing facial expression. He has chemical burn scarring around his left eye from chemicals being accidentally splashed on him during one of Usogui's Kakerou games.

_Terrorist of the Abandoned Mine Arc:_


_Bull's Womb Arc:_


_Protoporos Arc:_


_Untouchable Line:_


_Duel for the Antidote:_

name: Souichi Kiruma
description:
Kiruma Souichi  is the current Royal Leader  of Kakerou and one of the most important characters of Usogui. 

Souichi has the view that due to "God's will" or "destiny", he will keep on winning gambles. Though his behavior often fluctuates, and he is capricious enough to not know what to do at times, he often resorts to childish behavior, making jokes or refusing to take orders from others.

Souichi feels immensely pressured by his duties and thus feels a need to be "perfect."

name: Kadokura Yuudai
description:
Kadokura Yuudai is the #16 Referee of Kakerou.

 

Kadokura is a tall man with a distinguishing appearance with the most noticeable thing being his black hair set in a large pompadour (a style he has had since his delinquent days). As with all Referees, Kadokura dresses in a formal black suit with a noticeably long blazer jacket; he also wears a pair of unique white gloves which have a multitude of bumps on the backhand.

name: Ikki Sadakuni
description:
Sadakuni Ikki was an international terrorist. He earned a Kakerou membership by defeating five members, two of whom had their lives taken as compensation.

His exclusive Referee was Mekama Kirou. The reason for all these gambles was to make enough money to pay for a rocket launcher and more artillery to start a revolution by destroying Tokyo's stock exchange district.

name: Shion Nowa
description: Nowa Shion is Kakerou referee #6. He is married to Nowa Mitoshi's daughter, Nowa Mirei, and is the father of Nowa Mitora.

name: Yuusuke Midara
description: Midara Yuusuke is the 28th ranked referee of Kakerou. He loves seeing people who look down on others getting crushed more than anything. He also has a habit of creating bubbles with his spit. Midara loves seeing arrogant and powerful people be destroyed.

name: Kinue Hayase
description:
__Height:__ 138 cm
__Occupation:__ Housewife

She has light brown hair that curls at the tips and brown eyes. She wears a headband that has a dog footprint on and she usually is seen wearing an apron. She is very short, has a small body, and can be easily mistaken for a child, even though she is 42 years old. She is also the mother of Makabe Masamune.

name: Kabuto
description: Serial killer that can sense parasites.

name: Akirumo
description: Police officer running the parasites investigations. Is under orders of Chief Urashima Kanzaki.

name: Mitsuyo
description: Old Lady that helps Izumi Shinichi at the end of the story.

name: Nakai
description: Secretary of Mayor Hirokawa Takeshi.

name: Okura
description: Police officer that work at Fuusan Police Station

name: Makiko Hayase
description: Student of Sakurazaki Middle School. Meet Shinichi on a boat and asks for his help.

name: Ryouko Tamiya
description: Shinichi's substitute math teacher. She is infected with a parasite.

name: Su-Ho Seong
description: Sung Suho displays little interest in things that bore him and don't get his blood pumping, especially his education. He also likes to get physical against any bullies who are stupid enough to pick on him and has an intense desire to surpass his father, who always easily defeats him in their sparring matches.

name: Dong-Suk Hwang
description: Hwang Dongsuk is a C-rank Hunter and the older brother of [Dong-Su Hwang](https://anilist.co/character/136075/DongSu-Hwang).

name: Eun-Seok
description: Former Korean S-Rank Hunter.

name: Beru
description: Born from the Ant Queen on Jeju Island, The Ant King becomes the main threat during the Fourth Jeju Island Raid.

name: Dong-Wook Ma
description: Ma Dong-Wook (마동욱) is one of the 10 S-Rank hunters of South Korea and the guild master of Fame Guild.

name: Tae-Shik Kang
description: B-rank Hunter and An inspector working for South Korea's Hunter Association, Monitoring Division.

name: Jong-Su Park
description: Jongsoo Park is a Korean A-Rank Hunter and the Guild Master of the Knights Guild.

name: Esil Radiru
description: Esil Radiru, or Elisa Radiru, is a daughter of the Radiru chief and an Aristocratic Demon found at the S-Rank Demon's Castle Instant Dungeon.

name: Shiraho Suzuran
description: One of Yuzu's friends.

name: Manji
description:
Manji is the protagonist of the Japanese manga series Blade of the Immortal. In the story, he's known infamously both as the "Hundred Man Killer" for the number of men he's killed by the beginning of the series, and "Mister Twelve Blades" for the number of weapons he carries. He is most easily identified by the manji symbol he wears from which he derives his name and the scars across his face, and as the title of the manga implies, he's been given immortality by the means of the Kessen-chu, which prevent him (for the most part) from dying.



(Source: Wikipedia, boti.fandom.com)

name: Taito Magatsu
description: Among the Ittō-ryū's finest swordsmen. Of peasant origin, he became a swordsman to avenge his sister, who was killed as a child by a samurai. Taito is one of the few swordsmen who has fought Manji and survived. He has also fought by Manji's side as well. He can be considered a kenshi, a swordsman who is not from the samurai class. His lover of sorts, a prostitute named O-ren was killed by Shira. He quit the Ittō-ryū, although he is still friends with Anotsu. He ends up following Manji around due to the fact he knows Shira is after Manji. Although they argue a lot, Manji and Taito have a relatively friendly relationship. In the end Manji allows Taito to find Shira, and despite how much Shira wants to kill Manji, he lets Taito take him. Eventually Shira loses the one hand he had left to Taito and presumably falls to his death. Later concerned by something Shira said, Taito goes to meet up with Anotsu and eventually rejoins the Ittō-ryū. Taito's weapon is a gladius-like triple-sectioned sword named Grand Turk. The main blade is a gladius, the second is a smaller, shorter sword hidden in the handle, the last is a spear-head like dagger hidden within the second blade. The sword is curiously missing a sword guard. First appears in Conquest part 1, first named in Fanatic part 1.

name: Kagehisa Anotsu
description: He is the leader of the Itto-ryu and an equal of Manji. This emotionally cold young man has prodigious skill with the sword, and leads the Itto-ryu. He runs Itto-ryu in order to form a dojo dedicated not to form and rules, but to the simple test of superior lethality. He was brought up by his abusive grandfather (a swordsman disgraced by the Asano dojo -the dojo of Rin‘s family). Anotsu is as pragmatic and shrewd as he is deadly, although he isn't as inhuman as originally believed. He even allows Rin to live after she attacks him. He has two weapons. The first, his main weapon, is a Nepalese-based axe named Kabutsuchi (Head Hammer). The other is his rarely used sword of the same name.   (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Makie Otono-Tachibana
description: Master swordswoman and in love with Anotsu. Said to be Anotsu's match and saved his life with her deadly abilities when they were children. Born into a samurai family, Makie and her mother were disowned and cast away from the family by her father, Harukawa, when Makie's older brother committed seppuku after Makie was revealed to have inherited the family's famed talent and he was unable to defeat her in combat. She initially chose the path of the sword to avenge her mother's disgrace, but ended up becoming a geisha when Anotsu bought her freedom because she neither had the nerve to become a prostitute like her mother nor commit herself completely to becoming a swordfighter because she does not have the nerve to kill when her concentration in battle is broken. Defeats but does not kill Manji, apparently turning her back on Anotsu. Later found living alone, having bound her hand in an attempt to destroy her own skill in combat after her father's humiliating death. She reappears in Last Blood, having followed Anotsu since he left Shirakawa when she realized his body was weakening, and destroys the men under Iriya who were pursuing Anotsu. After Iriya's death, she leaves with Anotsu and Magatsu. As said by Anotsu, she is the only one that can beat him. Her weapon, a double bladed three-section-staff, is named Haru-no-Okina (Old Man of Spring). She conceals her weapon in a hollowed-out shamisen, a mandolin-like instrument. She first appears in Dreamsong Part 1.

name: Rin Asano
description: The sole survivor of an Ittō-ryū massacre at Anotsu's hand and heir to her father's sword school, the "Mutenichi-ryū". She has mediocre swordsmanship skills but an intense desire to avenge the brutal death of her family. To aid in this quest, she hires Manji as a bodyguard. It is worth noting that she kisses a sleeping Manji in the fourteenth volume and has shown on numerous occasions that she develops feelings towards him. They are as of now largely unreciprocated.   At the beginning of the series she is portrayed as somebody who is trying to act mature, but is still very childish - as the series progresses she steadily "grows up" and loses much of her naivety. Rin is constantly torn by doubt over the righteousness and validity of her mission and fears becoming a hypocrite as Anotsu claims that she is more like the Ittō-ryū, especially when he remarks that she chose to use throwing knives instead of a sword like the "Mutenichi-ryū" teaches.   Rin has three weapons, a Chinese sword named Kutoneshirika which she carries in a Toju (purse-like scabbard of sorts), a Tantō type dagger and a set of small throwing daggers named Ogunchu (Golden Wasps). Even though she is only mediocre in terms of fighting ability, Rin is still more skilled with weapons than most women of that time period and the fact that she carries a small arsenal of weapons with her makes her somewhat unique.

name: Hyakurin
description: A female assassin and a lieutenant in the Mugai-ryū. Hyakurin was the wife of an abusive samurai, Hayakawa Kakōsai Genkei, who was obsessed with trying to gain fame by training Matsuhiko, their sickly son, to become a strong swordsman. She later kills her husband to avenge the death of her son by his father's hand and is then arrested and sentenced to death. Her case came to the attention of Kagimura who subsequently recruited her into Mugai-ryū. Hyakurin's most unusual physical trait is her blonde hair (concealed frequently under a wig), which she maintains by bleaching it with a strong chemical as a compulsive desire to remove bloodstains from it. While her skills with a sword are unremarkable, she has an extensive knowledge of poisons. This knowledge carries over into her choice of weaponry, a collapsible wrist mounted crossbow with poisoned bolts named Burafuma (Little Steps). The crossbow also possesses two blades such that when the weapon is collapsed, Hyakurin can use it to stab her opponents. After volume 11, Beasts, her skills are impeded after having her arm broken. She later becomes pregnant and ends up "retired" from the Mugai-ryū because a deal between Habaki and Giichi when Giichi earns his freedom. She has no desire to keep the child because she believes she will be reminded of Shinriji's death and the faces of the Ittō-ryū men who raped her. She first appears in Dark Shadows part 1.

name: Makoto
description: Member of the Itto-ryu.

name: O-Sei
description: A ordinary geisha hired as bait on the Kagehisa's plan to reveal the infiltrated agent of the Mugai-ryū at the Itto-ryū´s HQ.

name: Kagimura Habaki
description: The leader of the Shogun's Banshu samurai, the Bangashira, and secret leader of the Mugai-ryū. He simultaneously invites the Ittō-ryū to become an official sword school while directing the Mugai-ryū against it. Kagimura also masterminded and took part in the massacre that occurred during a feast welcoming the Ittō-ryū into the Banshu. Abayama's comments imply that he is incredibly skilled with a sword, as evidenced by his attack on Manji in Trickster, volume 15. He first appears in Dark Shadows part 1.   (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Tanpopo
description: Tanpopo is a Kunoichi of the Rokki-dan alongside Meguro. As a student of Master Sori, Tanpopo is considerably much more talented at art than Meguro. Her real name is "Urara".

name: Masaki Izawa
description: An experienced boxer who hangs around the streets as a delinquent, called the 'Charisma of the streets'. He supports Yuu in his development as a fighter. He uses his own customized version of Boxing and Karate for street fights.

name: Yuu Kamishiro
description: Yuu is a very nervous boy, who was bullied severely, eventually cutting school and becoming a hikkimori. Eventually, he tries to grow stronger by practicing boxing from a book, and by repetition develops a powerful one-two. Beginning to get into fights with delinquents, Yuu finds a sense of place and satisfaction on the streets, but must defend himself against stronger opponents to survive.

name: Shougo Midorikawa
description: A delinquent skilled in karate (he deliberately avoids gaining a blackbelt to escape the notice of police). He challenges Yuu, but is beaten, and hunted by his previous gang. He tries to team up with Yuu to fight them, but ends up becoming his friend, and teaching Yuu about kicks and body rotation.

name: Iwado
description: The main character Yuu often comes to him for advice

name: Mai Izawa
description: She is Masaki's little sister and seems to have feelings for Yuu.

name: Kang-U O
description: __Height:__ 178 cm

name: Li Nie
description:
__Race:__ Human
__Soul Realm:__ Red

After dying at the hands of the Sage Emperor, Nie Li wakes up back in his thirteen year old body. Given a second chance to save his loved ones, he is determined to stop Sacred Family from betraying Glory City, and causing the attack that not only destroyed his home but killed all his friends and family.

Nie Li is a member of the Heavenly Marks Family, a declining and weak aristocratic family. His initial talent is considered by others to be poor and is lacking in culture and social position. However, he retains all the knowledge he gathered while roaming the Divine Continent in his past life. Using that, he plans to cultivate himself to far greater heights in this life and defeat the enemies he makes along the way. He has a very calm and determined personality. Though his appearance is that of a thirteen year old, he truly has the mind of someone far older and more experienced. (Due to the rebirth).

__Abilities and Equipment:__

name: Yan Gu
description: One of the six elders that sit on the council at the Alchemy Association and also the current president.

name: Han Ye
description:
__Soul Realm:__ Cyan

Ye Han is the adoptive son of Ye Zong, making him a member of the Snow Wind Family.

name: Yang Xiao
description: He is a son of one of the tribes elders of the Heavenly Fate Plateau and the leader of a hunting party

name: Lanruo Huyan
description: A childhood friend of Chen Linjian and fellow student at the Holy Orchid Institute. She is a member of the Huyan Noble Family and daughter to Huyan Xiong.

name: Linjian Chen
description: A slightly older student in the Holy Orchid Institute genius class and the direct descendant of the major Divine Family. He is very gifted and is being groomed to take over as the Divine Family's patriarch from the current patriarch, Chen Zhenlong. Though it is never directly stated, Chen Linjian is most likely Chen Zhenlong's son.

name: Ninger Xiao
description:
__Race:__ Human
__Soul Realm:__ Green

One of the students in the fighter apprentice class with Nie Li. She is a member of the noble Winged Dragon family. One of the main motivations behind her strong determination in training is her wish to escape from an arranged marriage between her and the Sacred Family's Shen Fei, who she despise and hate.

She is described as having shoulder length black hair and a slim figure The Manhua varies from this by showing her with long brownish orange hair. She is a cold and anti-social beauty. Her personality is that of a serious student, unyielding woman with a strong determination. She is very grateful to Nie Li for giving her the ability to oppose her arranged marriage with her newfound powers and for curing her of the Arctic disease before the worst happened. She was the first woman to start loving Nie Li in his rebirth life.

__Abilities and Equipment:__

name: Xin Yang
description: The director of the Alchemy Association. She is described as a beautiful and talented alchemist. She was orphaned at a young age and used her own skill and hard work to rise to the position of director. Because of her beautiful looks she is often not taken seriously. Because of this she often feels very isolated and lonely.

name: Ling Yun
description: She is a waitress at Old Man Yun’s Congee Shop in the Heavenly Fate Plateau. Her father is the owner and cook.

name: Lang Xiao
description: He is the third strongest on the Heavenly Fate Plateau, a 5 star gold fighter who wields duel hammers. He is a cruel and vicious man that has many thugs that follow him.

name: Mari Yoshizaki
description: An "angel-like" beautiful high school girl with a certain secret she has been hiding from everyone.

name: Yori Kakiguchi
description: A classmate of Mari, she seems to have some kind of relation with her.

name: Hideaki Amachi
description:
__Height:__ 213 cm

Creator/author of Gintaman under Jump Editor Konishi's charge in Gintama world and the second caricature of Gintama's mangaka, Sorachi Hideaki as a gorilla, this time totally naked without T-shirt.

name: Uchino
description: She is in love with Elizabeth.

name: Enari
description: Pinko's son.

name: Eiji Urashima
description:
__Height__: 5'6"

Urashima Eiji is a normal university student at first glance. However, it turns out his biological father was a serial killer. One day he realizes that he sometimes has blanks in his memory of a few days.

appearsIn.title: My Dearest Self With Malice Aforethought

name: Kyouka Yukimura
description: Eiji's Girlfriend.

appearsIn.title: My Dearest Self With Malice Aforethought

name: Kiichi Urashima
description: Eiji's adoptive father, he adopted him after the incident with Hachinoi Makoto, Eiji's biological father. Kiichi was Makoto's volunteer probation officer, his actual job was being a novelist and scriptwriter.

appearsIn.title: My Dearest Self With Malice Aforethought

name: Momoi
description: Inspector in the police force.

appearsIn.title: My Dearest Self With Malice Aforethought

name: Yashiro Sai
description: The leader of the prostitution ring called "SKALL".

appearsIn.title: My Dearest Self With Malice Aforethought

name: Saruwatari
description: S-Prefecture Police Chief, Momoi's superior.

appearsIn.title: My Dearest Self With Malice Aforethought

name: Kashiwagi
description: Eiji's close friend.

appearsIn.title: My Dearest Self With Malice Aforethought

name: Vlad
description: An orphan living in Schoarra's slums. Despite his lowly birth, his appearance bears resemblance to nobility.

name: Haven
description: A clerk working for Captain Hoover. He's a close childhood friend of Vlad and Jemina.

name: Anna
description: A prostitute at the Smiling Rose. She's a close acquaintance of Vlad's, who helps her after she is abused by a customer.

name: Ramund
description: An old knight, and one of the most powerful of his era.

name: Ragmus
description: Count Vayezid's advisor.

name: Portley Cannor
description: A squire and a friend of Vlad.

name: Zayar
description: Josef's knight. He is one of the strongest knights in the north, and becomes Vlad's mentor when he comes under Josef's wing.

name: Captain Hoover
description: One of the five bosses who rule over the slums of Schoarra.

name: Kade
description: A knight serving Josef. He has excellent tracking abilities.

name: Gott
description: He has worked under Vlad during his days as a mercenary, later becoming a stable boy for the Vayezid family.

name: Minoru Tanaka
description: A middle schooler who chooses to use the Death Note for a different, unique purpose.

name: Shuuichi Aizawa
description: Aizawa is an intelligent, respected member of both the NPA and Task Force. He takes his work very seriously and chooses to work strictly within the law. Out of all the members in the Task Force, Aizawa is the most overtly skeptical, questioning L's basis for his conclusions and expressing the most doubt in them, and often finds himself clashing and opposing many of L's ideas and actions. He has a wife, [Eriko](https://anilist.co/character/84531/Eriko-Aizawa), and two children, including [Yumi](https://anilist.co/character/84527/Yumi-Aizawa), his daughter, and his baby son, whose name is unknown. Due to him rarely being able to visit home during his work on the Kira case, his personal life and relationship with his family becomes strained.

name: Touta Matsuda
description:
__Height:__ 174 cm (5'8")

Recognized as the most outspoken member of the investigation team, Matsuda possesses an enthusiastic yet impulsive and naïve personality, often lacking the seriousness required for his work. Compared to his colleagues in the task force, he stands out as notably inexperienced, often being perceived as the weakest link within the group. Despite his evident shortcomings and lack of experience, Matsuda proves to be valuable and, at times, indispensable to the investigation. He is not afraid to take dangerous risks, going out of his way to support the team.

While the majority of the Task Force sees [Kira](https://anilist.co/character/80/Yagami-Light) as a malevolent serial killer, Matsuda frequently questions whether Kira's actions could be construed as performing good deeds. This skepticism grows, particularly as more people seem to align with Kira's ideology. Matsuda displays a certain level of understanding and sympathy towards Kira's followers. However, his ultimate loyalty remains with the Task Force, and he is unwavering in his commitment to solving the Kira Case alongside his fellow officers. His allegiance is especially strong towards [Soichiro Yagami](https://anilist.co/character/1927/Souichirou-Yagami), whom he views as a mentor.

name: Anthony Carter
native: アンソニー・カーター
description:
Anthony Lester is the Captain of a special force squad, and is now the SPK's number 2 and its operation leader. 

He can be seen as [Near's](https://anilist.co/character/464/Nate-River) guardian and personal assistant, similarly to what [Watari](https://anilist.co/character/2179/Quillsh-Wammy) was to [L](https://anilist.co/character/71/L-Lawliet). He is an extremely honest person who has Near's complete trust, to the point he's comfortable with revealing some of his thought and plans to Lester. Lester also helps Near with actions he is not used to doing, such as booking a flight on a plane. He is often called "Commander Lester", and he is unable to match Near in intelligence and analytic skill despite being very intelligent himself. Nevertheless, being trustworthy, athletic, and a quiet person make him very useful to assist Near.

appearsIn.title: The Max Level Hero Strikes Back!

name: Perserk von Palan
description: Void Demon

appearsIn.title: The Max Level Hero Strikes Back!

name: Iyo Yamaguchi
description:
__Height:__ 169cm (5'7)

Yamaken's little sister who enrolls in haru's school.

name: Andou
description: An underling of the Yoshida household, he is doing a variety of jobs for them such as acting as a chauffeur or being a "bodyguard" (He's actually there to keep watch on Haru).  He is pretty laid back though, skipping out on work from time to time.  Andou also plays eroges and likes to flirt with highschool girls.

name: Minarai Seishokusha
description: A porcelain ranked adventurer who is a two person party with Rookie Warrior

name: Ushikai Musume no Oji
description:
His family runs a dairy farm just outside of town for several generations. When his younger sister married, she moved out of the Dairy Farm to her husband's village, leaving him the sole heir to the farm.

He is the uncle of Cow Girl and the landlord of Goblin Slayer.

name: Senshi
description: An adventurer in a newbie party that was tasked with a goblin slaying quest.

name: Goblin Slayer no Ane
native: ゴブリンスレイヤーの姉
description: Was the sole loved one of Goblin Slayer during his childhood. Her death is the primary circumstance that triggered Goblin Slayer's obsessive trait to kill all the Goblins.

appearsIn.title: Goblin Slayer Side Story: Year One

name: Gally
description: Found in the scrapyard below the floating city Tiphares by the Hunter Warrior [Daisuke Ido](https://anilist.co/character/6545/Daisuke-Ido), Gally soon becomes a Hunter Warrior herself, hunting for bounties throughout the scrapyard city. Having no recollection of her past, Gally's only link to her memories is her "Panzer Kunst" a martial art style for cyborgs that she somehow remembers. While trying to live her life and protect those dear to her, she is eventually caught up in the struggle between the utopian society of Tiphares and the suppressed surface dwellers.

name: Zapan
description: Zapan first makes an appearance when Daisuke Ido and Alita in her new Berserker Body visit Bar Kansas. Although there are many other hunter-warriors present, Zapan is the only one who is named, revealing that he was one of Ido's patients. When Ido proposes that the hunters band together and go after the infamous criminal Makaku, Zapan makes an exception, claiming that hunter-warriors are lone wolves and that Makaku is none of his business. He claims that to be a professional involves carefully choosing one’s prey and minimizing risk. This does not sit well with Alita, who questions Zapan’s rationale as a disguise for cowardice. This provokes a fight with the hunter-warriors, as Alita refuses to back down. During the fight, Alita manages to get ahold of Zapan from behind, manipulating his arms and legs and using him to slice up the other hunter-warriors before sending him and the other fighters out of the bar in a heap. He manages to escape Makaku when the latter arrives at Bar Kansas.

name: Jasugun
description: The undisputed champion of Motorball and the brother of Shumira. Jashugan once had Desty Nova perform reconstructive brain surgery on him after he sustained massive brain damage in an accident, and this also augmented his brain, helping him become the Motorball champion. As a drawback, the brain reconstruction surgery makes him suffer spasmatic attacks from time to time, and as they increase his hour of death draws closer.  With the help of Ido and Shumira, he is restored in time to accept Gally's challenge on the Motorball court.

name: Makaku
description: Living most of his life in the sewers of the Scrapyard, Makaku was attacked with a flamethrower and would have died had it not been for Desty Nova's intervention, turning the dying man into a worm like cyborg. With his new body, Makaku gained the ability to hijack other cyborg bodies by jacking into their spinal column. Because of an endorphin addiction, he sought to eat human brains, and thus, a bounty was placed on his head.

name: Kaos
description: Radio host and son of Desty Nova, Kaos is very fragile, and can only see in infared wavelengths, and speak and hear Radiowaves. He is also an expert at Psychometry, the ability to read the "memories" of inanimate objects, allowing him to see the visions of the past by touching old relics, and even learn swordsmanship by touching a katana.

name: Lou Collins
description: Acting as Gally's operator when she is a TUNED agent, utilizing a satellite to provide Gally with intelligence and combat support. The two eventually become friends, but she is disposed of by the GIB for causing a ruckus and disabling the Gally clone AR2 and saving the life of the original Gally. Gally swears to return the favor and save her friend, a mission that eventually lead her to the space city Ketheres.

name: Den
description: The leader of the Barjack army, Den believes that Tiphares' control over the Scrapyard and it's surrounding areas is the cause to the suffering of the surface dwellers, and leads the Barjack in hope of destroying Tiphares.

name: Ido Daisuke
description: A Cyberphysician and Hunter warrior who once lived in Tiphares, Ido finds the broken [Gally](https://anilist.co/character/2308/Gally) in a junk pile in the Scrapyard, restores her and raise her like a daughter. In the beginning, Ido keeps his second job as a bounty hunter hidden from Gally, but she eventually finds out, and joins Ido in his hunts.

name: Yugo
description:
Yugo was an orphaned teenager and later bounty who was involved with Vector. He was the first man who [Alita](https://anilist.co/character/2308/Gally) fell in love with. Yugo was known for being very stubborn when it came to his goals and aspirations. Despite this, he was also an honest person, admitting to any crime he was a participant in instead of trying to deflect or deny it. 

(Source: Battle Angel Alita Wiki)

name: Figure Four
description: A fisherman from the coast village Alhambra who traveled to the Scrapyard to see Tiphares, Figure was working as a Railway mercenary when he met Gally during a mission to protect a train from bandits. He travels with Gally for a while, and the two falls in love.

name: Yuu
description: An orphan who killed three people - mother, kid and a man. He is in prison (death row) waiting for his death to the point that he attempted suicide numerous times.

name: Juri Mutou
description: The daughter of a very famous pianist who had to stop playing after giving birth to her. She believed she had no hope in the future due to a dark past - until she met Yuu.

name: Monica
description: She is Juri's aunt. She lost her child in a motorcycle accident. She couldn't bear the grudge anymore after the killer committed suicide in prison and joined the clergy. She meets convicts on death row and tries to take care of them.

name: Fable
description:
A mysterious man labelled as the "Genius of Killing". With his favourite gun, Night Hawk, in his hands, he's a hitman that can take down any enemy in a single shot. His origins and real name are both unknown.

Seems to very much love watching the comedian, Jackal Tomioka.

name: Ryou Kuroshio
description: Ebihara's subordinate. Looks up to Akira Satou.

name: Hiroshi Suzuki
description: Outwardly, he looks like a young delinquent in his early 20s. In fact, he is a veteran assassin of nearly 40 years who has been working behind the scenes for 20 years and has changed his appearance with plastic surgery.

name: Youko Satou
description: Youko Satou is the pseudonym for the getaway driver for the hitman known as Fable. She masquerades as Fable's sister as a part of the operation given to them by their boss.

name: Matsu
description: An arms dealer with a long history of association with the Maguro clan. On the side, he is the owner of a snack bar. He also runs a corpse disposal and information agency, and is involved in the rare animal smuggling business. Has a daughter named Sakura.

name: Yuukari
description: Hitman who is a member of the "Fable" group , worked in China for few years.

name: Susumu Asami
description: An assassin of the organization and a subordinate of Yamaoka's protege.

name: Houjou
description:
Houjou is a student who shares the same class as [Takagi](https://anilist.co/character/120800/Takagi) and [Nishikata](https://anilist.co/character/120799/Nishikata). She has a mature personality which contrasts with her classmates. Every time she sees someone immature, she would say how immature of them.

Despite her maturity, she is often endeared by [Hamaguchi](https://anilist.co/character/163023/Hamaguchi)'s clumsy personality.

name: Hamaguchi
description: Hamaguchi is one of [Nishikata](https://anilist.co/character/120799/Nishikata)'s friend. He seems to be interested in [Houjou](https://anilist.co/character/163024/Houjou).

name: Sumire Takagawa
description: Sumire Takagawa is one of [Takagi](https://anilist.co/character/120800/Takagi)'s and [Nishikata](https://anilist.co/character/120799/Nishikata)'s classmates. She is a close friend of Takagi.

name: Ed Rothstaylor
description:
He was originally the successor to the Rothstaylor family, a ducal family, but was excommunicated from the family after insulting the princess and lost his surname. 

Due to his past life experience, he has a very serious and cautious personality. Compared to other characters, he acts cold, does not easily give affection to others, does not easily share his worries, and does not easily trust others.

name: Janica Faylover
description:
She is the top student in her second year and is a spirit master who handles spirits.

A girl who seems to be the embodiment of kindness and innocence. She also wants to live up to the expectations of those around her.

name: Lucy Mayreel
description:
She is lazy and only does things she wants to do. Supposedly she became lazy because she was too strong before even arriving to the academy.

The greatest genius at her job and a powerful mage who has reached the pinnacle of the strongest bloodline in the world. She was born with remarkable magical talent that caught the attention of the great magician Glockt from an early age.

name: Lortelle Kecheln
description:
The heroine of the game "Sylvania's Failed Sword Saint". The adopted daughter of the owner of the Elte Trading Company, also known as the Golden Daughter. She is one of the 6 main characters in the original story of the game.

In the original game, she was directly related to most of the bad endings, and was said to have been a nuisance character who angered many users, calling her the "bad ending maker".

name: Clarisse
description: She was a saint and the highest ranking figure in the Telos Church. She entered the academy disguised under the name Kylie Eckner.

name: Phoenia Elias Kloel
