description: She is the third princess of the Chloe Empire.

name: Cain Blood
description:
__Height__: 192 cm

The Boss of African-American youth gang Black Sabbath. Referees Ash's fight with Arthur and later supports Ash and his gang in the war against the Corsican mafia.

name: George Scott
description: He acts as Ash Lynx's lawyer to set Ash free from jail through his connection with Max Lobo.

name: Alexis Dawson
native: アレクシス・ドースン
description: Alexis Dawson is a pathologist at the University of California.

name: Karluk Eihon
description: He is a calm person with lots of patience - doing what his wife Amira asks him to so as not to make her worry. He adores her very much.

name: Amir Halgal
description: Amir comes to be the bride for Karluk. She is very capable of hunting and managing house chores. She is nice and calm person, and overprotective to Karluk

name: Akunbek Eihon
native: アクンベク・エイホン
description: The head of Eihon Family.

name: Sherine
description: Sherine (シーリーン Shiiriin) is Anis's avowed sister.

name: Seleke
description: Karluk's older sister. She lives in her parent's house together with her husband and children. Seleke sems to be on very good terms with her mother and Amira.

name: Talas
description:
A young nomadic woman living with her mother-in-law. Introduced in chapter 12. Married into her current family at age sixteen, but in a few years became a widow of all its five sons as per tradition, which dictates that a widow with no children marries one of her husband's brothers. Since her father-in-law also died, she helps and keeps company to her mother-in-law instead of going back to her own family. She becomes romantically involved with Mr. Smith.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Henry Smith
description: An English traveler and researcher living with the Eihon family. He has been researching the customs, language, and culture of the tribes and peoples. He left the Eihon family to return to England after being warned of rising tensions in the region with the Russians. It is hinted that he might be an English intelligence officer sent to Central Asia as a part of the Great Game. After leaving the Eihon family, he was captured by the Russian military under suspicion of spying, but was later released with the help of Amira and Karluk.

name: Yusuf
description: Seleke's husband. He lives in Eihons' household together with his wife and children.

name: Baimat Halgal
description: Amir's middle brother.

name: Rostem
description: Karluk's youngest nephew.

name: Yang Yu
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm

Second-year Art major. Came out as gay in junior high.

name: Huan Li
description:
__Height:__ 196cm

College freshman majoring in Design.

name: Yi Xiao
description:
__Height__: 170cm

A first-year Design major.

name: Huanwen Chu
description:
__Height__: 180cm

Second-year Art major. In charge of public relations.

name: Jianyu Zhang
description:
__Height__: 162cm

A second-year Art major.

name: Bai Sheng Xuan
description: He's from QingDao

name: Takeru Minakata
description: A charming gambler who joins Akira & Co in Volume 9.

appearsIn.title: Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead

name: Izuna Tokage
description: Izuna was a student in High School before the outbreak. When the outbreak started she was bitten on the thigh, but didn't turn into a zombie. She started travelling with a scientist, Tsuru, who was trying to develop a vaccine, and was acting as her guardian. In the end she decided to travel with Akira's group but they plan on returning to the lab where Tsuru is.

appearsIn.title: Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead

name: Kanta Higurashi
description: He is a former NEET and the leader of his group, consisting of people he found during the apocalypse's first days.

appearsIn.title: Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead

name: Touko Kanbayashi
description: She is a former municipal office worker that was a part of Kanta Higurashi's group.

appearsIn.title: Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead

name: Flop O'Connell
native: フロップ・オコーネル
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm (5'9")

Flop O'Connell is a merchant in the city of Guaral and the older brother of Medium O'Connell.

name: Eugard Vollachia
native: ユーガルド・ヴォラキア
description: Eugard was the sixty-first emperor of the Sacred Vollachia Empire and the former lover of [Iris](https://anilist.co/character/258804/Yorna-Mishigure) until the two of them were betrayed, leading to his beloved's death and causing him to descend into madness. At an unknown time during or after his reign, the story of his relationship was adapted into a famed tale called Iris and the King of Thorns.

name: Sylphy
aliases: Hyaku Hachi Juu Shi-ban (百八十四番)
description: 184th wife of Regulus Corneas.

name: Rigel Natsuki
description: Natsuki Rigel  is the non canon son of Natsuki Subaru and Rem.

name: Moguro Hagane
description: Eighth of the Nine Divine Generals.

name: Wrath
description: Wrath, formerly known as Sasajima Kyouya, is one of the students that reincarnated. After reincarnation, he found himself reborn as a Goblin in a Goblin Village with the special skill to create weapons.

appearsIn.title: So I'm a Spider, So What?
So I'm a Spider, So What?

name: Agner Ricep
native: アーグナー・ライセップ
description: Agner Ricep is one of the demon commanders. He is the leader of the Demon Lord's First Demon Army.

appearsIn.title: So I'm a Spider, So What?
So I'm a Spider, So What?

name: Riel
description: Riel plays the role of the "cool-beauty" of her sisters, often holding back from doing any activities other than observing them from a place nearby. She is just as strong and capable as her sisters, though, so one shouldn't let her ladylike appearance fool them.

appearsIn.title: So I'm a Spider, So What?

name: Buirimus
description: Buirimus is a summoner and part a scouting unit from the Renxandt Imperial Army. Not only does he have great ability as a summoner, he is a skilled leader and a first-class warrior.

appearsIn.title: So I'm a Spider, So What?

name: Kazuha Hitachiin
description: She's Hikaru and Kaoru's grand-mother from their mother's side. She's very talented in Ikebana (flower arrangement).

name: Kanako Kasugasaki
description: Kanako was well-known for changing her hosts every now and then.  She did this to spite her fiancé into paying attention to her. However, it wasn't successful until Tamaki got wind of their situation and decided to help out.

name: Anna Anjou
description:
A high school student and a gyaru in the same class as Seto, whom she teases and flirts with constantly.

Outside of school, she hangs out with Seto or helps out with her mom at the hair salon. Her dream is to become a stylist and she has a surprising talent when it comes to hairdressing.

name: Toyoda
description: Friend to [Anna Anjou](https://anilist.co/character/129382/Anna-Anjou) and potential love interest to [Inuyama](https://anilist.co/character/181512/Inuyama). Cold and mean looking, but is actually kind and into cutesy things.

name: Inuyama
description: Seto's best friend. He enjoys drawing and sports.

name: Komaki
description: The school nurse with a soft spot for Seto.

name: Chita
description: Anna and Toyoda's friend.

name: Yeon-Ha Yu
description: Yu Yeon-Ha has a gift for doing business and is one of Kim Hajin's trusted characters.

name: Spoil
description: Spoil is the UMA that represents spoiling and decay.

name: Phil Hawkins
description: Negator no. 4 of the Round Table. He has a quiet and nonchalant personality.

name: Creed
description: Creed is a large, muscular man with a cross-shaped scar on his face.

name: Autumn
description: Autumn is the Concept-Type UMA that embodies the season of Autumn.

name: Boh
description: One of [Nico Vorgeil](https://anilist.co/character/167315/)'s assistants, the No. 3 scientist after [Mico](https://anilist.co/character/321801). Somewhat interested in Mico, but his jealousy over her being No. 2 is the more prevailing feeling.

name: Betty Alfred
description: Billy and Veronica's daughter. Loves her parents very much.

name: Top
description: Member no. 7 of the Round Table.

name: Un Anno
description: The reclusive author behind Fuuko's favorite manga *To You, From Me*.

name: Himari Kino
description:
Himari is a very joyous, cheerful girl and often likened to a puppy by other characters. 

She is able to instantly befriend anyone, even hard to approach characters like [Shiho](https://anilist.co/character/215602/Izumi-Shiho). Himari is always wanting the best for her friends and cheering them on in whatever they pursue.

name: Yori Asanagi
description: A third year high school student who sings while playing guitar at the school rooftops and loves collecting cat merchandise. She is also a part of the "SS Girls" band in which she is positioned as the guitarist and vocalist.

name: Hajime Amasawa
description: She is a third year high school student and Laureley's drummer.

name: Ayaka Kohara
description: Ayaka is in the same club as Miki. She has been in love with Miki ever since she joined the club.

name: Miki Mizuguchi
description: She is part of the brass band club who indirectly helps [Himari](https://anilist.co/character/167670/Kino-Himari)'s and [Yori](https://anilist.co/character/167671/Asanagi-Yori)'s relationship by collecting information.

name: Shiho Izumi
description: She is a third-year high school student and the main vocalist for the band Laureley.

name: Momoka Satomiya
description: She is a second year and President of the Culinary Research Club, she is also Laureley's bassist.

name: Mari Tsutsui
description: She is a third-year student and drummer in SS GIRLS.

name: Kaori Tachibana
description: She is a third-year student and keyboardist in SS GIRLS.

name: Aki Mizuguchi
description: Aki is a third year high school student and the bassist for the SS Girls. She is best friends with [Yori](https://anilist.co/character/167671/Asanagi-Yori) and was one of the first people to encourage her to pursue [Himari](https://anilist.co/character/167670/Kino-Himari).

name: Kourou
description: Koro appears in episode seven and has a strange habit of pursuing rainbows just like his father used to do.

name: Michihi
description: Shirou's wife. She has disappeared in the fog after she had a fight with him.

name: Tagane
description: A women who makes inkstones. Once she had a fiance but he died afer he got a inkstone that she made.

name: Maho
description: A boy who lost his hearing and has four mysterious horns on his head. He lives with his grandmother since his mother death who had the same horns as Maho.

name: Biki
description: (Appears in Episode 02)

name: Shige
description: A girl whose broken, haunting voice attracts a mushi called Yasabi to her village, which paralyzes its residents.  She became aware of the effect of her voice at an early age, and vowed to never speak again.

name: Nami
description: A young girl living in the village who takes an interest in Shirou after he helped her.

name: Jodio Joestar
native: ジョディオ・ジョースタ
description:
__Stand:__ November Rain

Jodio is a small-time gangster living in Hawaii with his big brother [Dragona](https://anilist.co/character/298896) and his mother [Barbara Ann Joestar](https://anilist.co/character/298906). He is a Stand user that wields November Rain, allowing him to create localized drops of rain that can crush his opponents.

appearsIn.title: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken: The JOJOLands

name: Dragona Joestar
native: ドラゴナ・ジョースター
description:
__Stand:__ Smooth Operators

Dragona is [Jodio Joestar's](https://anilist.co/character/298895) older sibling and works alongside him as a gangster in Hawaii. They are a Stand User that wields Smooth Operators, a colony Stand that can displace anything.

appearsIn.title: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken: The JOJOLands

name: Paco Laburantes
description:
__Stand:__ The Hustle

Paco is a gangster working in the same gang as Jodio and Dragona Joestar. They are assigned to the same team in order to steal a diamond. Paco is a Stand User possessing The Hustle, an integrated Stand that allows him to grab objects with his muscles anywhere on his body.

appearsIn.title: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken: The JOJOLands

name: Usagi Alohaoe
description: __Stand:__ The Matte Kudasai

appearsIn.title: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken: The JOJOLands

name: Charming Man
description:
__Stand:__ Bigmouth Strikes Again

He is introduced as an antagonist who stalks Jodio Joestar and his allies to try retrieving the Lava Rock. His Stand lets him disguise with his surroundings and confuse his enemies' perceptions.

appearsIn.title: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken: The JOJOLands

name: Acca Howler
description: Head of the HOWLER company.

appearsIn.title: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken: The JOJOLands

name: Bobby Jean
description:
__Stand:__ Glory Days

An agent and investigator affiliated with HOWLER. He works together with Lulu.

appearsIn.title: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken: The JOJOLands

name: Lulu
description:
__Stand:__ Bags Groove

A young girl who works for HOWLER and uses her Stand to inflict illness upon anyone that touches the company's original land deeds. She's paired up with Agent Bobby Jean, whom she often begs to buy her various items and even demands he adopts her.

appearsIn.title: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken: The JOJOLands

name: Meryl Qi
description:
Principal of the school Jodio and his group attend, as well as the proprietress of a fashion boutique called Iko Iko. Both of those occupations, however, are a cover-up for her real nature as a crime boss that Jodio and his group work for.

According to Jodio, she has a handsome husband and child at home.

appearsIn.title: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken: The JOJOLands

name: Kyouka Izumi
description: Kyouka is an editor at Weekly Shounen Jump working with Rohan Kishibe. When she hears about the millionaire village where accepted residents suddenly become rich, she decides to try to buy a property at the village. Rohan accompanies her to the millionaire village to get inspiration for his one-shot.

appearsIn.title: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken: The JOJOLands

name: Aselle
description: A shy person from [Ronan](https://anilist.co/character/311221)'s home village, who has a rare talent for magic.

name: Iril
description: [Ronan](https://anilist.co/character/311221)'s older sister. She wished for him to go the academy.

name: Ichi
description: Ichi is the first known male witch and the contractor of the legendary Majik King Uroro.

name: Desscaras
description: Desscaras is a powerful magic user in this world where Majik, a living force, grants power through difficult trials. She is confident and skilled, often taking charge of dangerous missions like confronting [King Uroro](https://anilist.co/character/344557/Uroro), a destructive Majik. Despite her serious nature, Desscaras sometimes dismisses caution, preferring to handle matters on her own.

name: Kumugi Harvest
native: クムギ・ハーヴェスト

name: Gokuraku Kagami
aliases: Kagyaku no Gokuraku (苛虐のゴクラク)
description:
Infamously known as Gokuraku the Brutalizer, he is one of the main members of Team Desscaras as their Special Adjunct. Gokuraku is an augmented human and a notorious criminal in the land of Kagami for repeatedly attempting to kill slumbering Majik Bakugami.

He is officially listed as a dangerous individual by the Mantinel Witches Association due to his relentless and violent attempts to acquire Majiks. He wishes to become a witch to acquire Bakugami, and so he challenges and beats up any Majik he encounters. True to his title, he brutally beat up the Majik he encountered repeatedly to clear their trials, but due to not having any magic power, he's unable to acquire them even though he fulfilled the conditions to clear them. He formed an alliance with Ichi, the first known Male Witch, to acquire Bakugami, taking the trial together with him by enduring the accumulated grief in the latter's place. He succeeded in clearing the trial, allowing Ichi to acquire Bakugami. He then officially joins Ichi's group as a special adjunct of magic item crafter.

After joining Team Desscaras, Gokuraku received a new upgraded right arm, legs, and several connected upgrades in his outfit. These included combat abilities are known as Hidden Tech. It is later revealed that he is the younger brother of Princess Richia Kagami, making him the First Prince of Kagami country.

name: Uroro
aliases: Chouetsu Tokuka Mahou (超越特化魔法)
description: An exceptionally dangerous Majik with the unique ability to amplify any magical effect to its maximum potential. Uroro is a powerful and malevolent being in the natural world, notorious for his history of destruction and deep-seated hatred for humanity.

name: Monegold
description: A high-ranking witch of the Mantinel Witches Association.

name: Circos
description: Monegold's secretary.

name: Shirabedonna
description: A witch of the Mantinel Witches Association and the club supervisor of the Witches' Research Club.

name: Jikishirone
description: A girl that after spending a decade in a coma, was possessed by the Prophecy Majik and became the Oracle Witch, one of the highest-ranking Witches of the Mantinel Witches Association.

name: Danpei Tange
description: Danpei is Joe's serious, cautious and responsible mentor who gets him started in his boxing career. He is fond of sake, being overly cheerful when drunk which contrasts with his strict everyday self. He is also very polite when talking to people who hold higher ranks than himself, something that annoys Joe, who doesn't care for such things. Before meeting Joe, it is stated that Danpei used to be a boxer himself. However, after the loss of one of his eyes, we learn that he was forced to give up on his own boxing career, aiming to become a coach instead. But due to his violent, strict, passionate, and even desperate approach to training his boxers(who couldn't take it and abandoned him for better gyms), he became jobless and eventually a homeless alcoholic.  After meeting Joe and claiming that he has massive potential for the sport, he gives up on drinking due to the former's aversion to alcoholism (only drinking on special occasions) and vows to train him to be Japan's or even the world's best boxer, with the hope of a better tomorrow for the both of them.

appearsIn.title: Ashita no Joe: Fighting for Tomorrow

name: Tooru Rikiishi
description:
__Gym:__ Shiraki
__Weight Class:__ Welterweight
__Style(s):__ Hybrid, Brawling Style
__Stance(s):__ Orthodox Stance, Brawling Stance
__Trainer:__ [Shiraki Youko](https://anilist.co/character/46051/Shiraki-Youko) (minimal)

Rikiishi and [Joe](https://anilist.co/character/11804/Yabuki-Joe) first meet in the juvenile detention center, where Rikiishi was introduced as a boxer who was sentenced to the juvenile detention center because he had punched an member of the audience half to death after they had claimed that the match was rigged in Rikiishi's favor, enraging him.

appearsIn.title: Ashita no Joe: Fighting for Tomorrow

name: Joe Yabuki
description:
The protagonist of the story. He is known for his long bangs and for always wearing a worn out beige coat and a red flat cap.

Not long after birth he found himself in many orphanages and facilities. However, he quickly grew tired of the boring life and frequently escaped, eventually finding his way to the Doya Town the story takes place in. Joe is rude and quick to fight, but he can also be very frivolous at times. Because of his rough upbringing he is a delinquent who likes his solitude, but he later grows to appreciate his new friends and rivals. He is not very good at understanding women, and essentially only treats them nice out of giri.

He is a bantamweight and his specialties include the cross counter and the No Guard stance. He has extraordinary punching strength, fortitude, and fighting spirit, often standing up after taking killer blows and has been known to counter cross-counters (a double-cross), possessing a raw, natural talent for the sport. He has even countered double crosses with a triple-cross, implying he has high-level technical abilities. Following his fight with [Rikiishi](https://anilist.co/character/20185/Rikiishi-Tooru), he begins to better develop his guarding.

appearsIn.title: Ashita no Joe: Fighting for Tomorrow

name: Youko Shiraki
description:
Yoko Shiraki is a young woman born to the Shirakis, a very wealthy family who is known for their activities in the boxing field. She is the main female protagonist in Ashita no Joe.

She is very polite, graceful and kind to other people, always acting exactly as expected from a daughter born to a family with a higher rank, donating to charities from time to time. As so, she clashes in both appearance and personality with most of the other characters who know nothing but poverty and hardship.

One of those characters is Joe who is the first to remark that her so called 'kindness' is completely fake, implying her sympathy for the poor is merely a way to make herself feel superior over those who have nothing to eat. She is often very shocked by his actions but as time goes on she comes to be the one who understands him best. She is disliked by Joe as an 'evil woman' who tries to control his life by always having something to do with most the situations he finds himself in later in the series.

appearsIn.title: Ashita no Joe: Fighting for Tomorrow

name: Kanichi Nishi
description:
Nishi is Joe's best friend, sparring partner and later he also becomes Joe's trainer. He is a juvenile delinquent. He first meets Joe in a juvenile jail, where they fight each other and Joe defeats him. Nishi later meets Joe at the correction house where they become friends.

Nishi's personality changes drastically from an arrogant juvenile delinquent to calm worker at a grocery store. He takes a liking to boxing after watching Joe's match against Rikishi in the detention center.

When Joe comes back to Namida Bridge he is surprised to find Nishi at the Tange boxing gym, Nishi joins the gym to learn boxing and to continue being with Joe. Nishi is an averagely good boxer. He was the only useful sparring partner Joe had in the entire story. Nishi has a crush on Noriko Hayashi, who is the daughter of his boss at the grocery store.

appearsIn.title: Ashita no Joe: Fighting for Tomorrow

name: Guerilla
description:
He was one of the prisoners at the Juvenile detention center. He used to be the leader of the sixth dormitory until Joe arrived. 
He came to see Joe's match with Jose Mendoza.

appearsIn.title: Ashita no Joe: Fighting for Tomorrow

name: Tamako Hayashi
description: She is the mother of Noriko and the wife of Seishichi

appearsIn.title: Ashita no Joe: Fighting for Tomorrow

name: Carlos Rivera
description: Carlos Rivera is a Venezuelan bantamweight boxer who ranked #6 in the world. The reason he is called a "A King Without A Crown" is because there is a rumor that the world champion is too afraid to fight him. [Yoko Shiraki](https://anilist.co/character/46051/Shiraki-Youko) brings Rivera over to Japan to help [Joe](https://anilist.co/character/11804/Yabuki-Joe) recover.

appearsIn.title: Ashita no Joe: Fighting for Tomorrow

name: Raeliana McMillan
aliases: レリアナ・マクミラン
description: Reincarnated as only a side character dying in the hands of her fiancée, Raeliana Mcmillan is the badass main female character who is determined to live her life and not die as she was destined to do so. In a moment of desperation, she goes to Noah Wyknight and offers him a contract for an arrange marriage, to avoid her doom by canon fate.

appearsIn.title: The Reason Why Raeliana Ended Up at the Duke's Mansion

name: Noah Wynknight
aliases: ノアボルスティア・ウィンナイト
description: The famous Duke of Wynknight and the main male protagonist of the story. In the original timeline, he ends up with Beatrice but due to Raeliana changing the original timeline to avoid her fate, he fell for Raeliana instead. He's Siatrich's younger brother.

appearsIn.title: The Reason Why Raeliana Ended Up at the Duke's Mansion

name: Adam  Taylor
description: A highly skilled young knight who serves Noah. He is very quiet and outwardly stoic, particularly with those he does not trust. He is very gullible and likes sweets.He is discriminated against for his Alasa heritage.

appearsIn.title: The Reason Why Raeliana Ended Up at the Duke's Mansion

name: Siatrich Newreal Chamos
aliases: シアトリヒ・ニューリアル・チェイモス
description: Noah's older half-brother and the king of Chamos. One of his legs is completely paralyzed. He is a womanizer and has a meddlesome and talkative personality. While he seems careless, he is quite cunning.

appearsIn.title: The Reason Why Raeliana Ended Up at the Duke's Mansion

name: Hugo
description: A Vodyanoi and Angelica's Familiar.

name: Alice Swayne
description: Sorcerer and Renfred's apprentice.

name: Gabriella
description: Gabriella is a Nun who works at the church where Simon is and currently oversees Elias.

name: Spriggan
description: A Faerie that serves the faerie queen, Titania

name: Jade Ariel
description: An Ariel and an acquaintance of Chise.

name: Rahab
description: Mage who served as Lindel's magic teacher. She is fond of giving names, having chosen Lindel's and Elias' names.

name: Lizbeth Sargant
native: リズベス・サーガント
description: Lizbeth Sargant is a Sorcerer and aged matriarch of the Sargant family.

name: Ho-Bin Yu
description: Ho-Bin is a boy from a poor family who gets bullied at school - until a lucky incident that leads him to become famous on NewTube.

name: Ji-Hyeok U
description: Cameraman and classmate of Hobin Yoo. He used to be Pakgo's cameraman before the fight during his gaming stream was released to the public.

name: Ga-Eul
description: Video editor of Ho-Bin Yoo. She is one year younger than Ho-Bin and Ji-Hyeok.

name: Yu-Won Kim
description:
Yuwon Kim is the protagonist and main character of Leveling with the Gods.
After losing the war against the Outer Gods, Chronos uses his power to send Yuwon back to the past to change the result of the war. After his regression, his only goal was to get stronger and gather his past allies to annihilate the Outer Gods.

name: Zeus
description:
A high ranker who alongside his two brothers is the leader of the giant guild 'olympus'.
His goal is to break through the top of the tower into whatever lies beyond, he considers no price to greater to achive this.

name: Onii-san
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm

"Onii-san" is one of the main characters of the story. His birth name is unknown. He never formally introduces himself to Sachi, so she just calls him "Onii-san". He has light colored hair and always wears a face mask.

name: Sachi
description: "Sachi" is a high school student. In the beginning of the story, her real name is unknown, as she is only referred to as "XXX-San" on television and by two former classmates who recognize her on the street. "Onii-san", her kidnapper, gives her the name "Sachi", which comes from the word happiness in Japanese, in replace of the name she had during her old life.

name: Hijiri Matsubase
description:
__Height:__ 164 cm

He is a detective who works for Sachi's mother with Yashiro. People often assume he's a middle schooler because of his height.

name: Miho Satou
description: She is a young woman who works at a diner.

name: Ryotarou Yashiro
description: Hijiri's assistant.

name: Shin Katagiri
description: He is Sachi's former Middle School teacher.

name: Sachi's Mother
description: She is one of the main reasons Sachi happily went home with Onii-san.

name: Tsugumi Hitotsugi
description: Tsugumi appears to be a happy person but unfortunately, part of her happiness stems from her decision to kill herself to escape from her stressful life and abusive husband.

name: Takane Takamine
description:
__Occupation:__ Student Council President

She is a perfectionist and wants to be the best at everything. She has an ability called "The still untouched, unknowing maiden. (The eternal aisle)". Every time she takes off a piece of underwear she can make what was done into something it wasn't.

name: Koushi Shirota
description: Once he is introduced to Takane Takamine, he is soon told that he will become her "closet", in which he has to replace her underwear once she has used her ability.

name: Ellie Evergreen
native: 絵梨依・エバーグリーン
description: Takashi's old childhood friend

name: Koyo Aoba
description: Koyo Aoba is a family member of Shimon Famiglia. He, along with his family, transferred to Namimori after an earthquake hit their area because it is relatively earthquake free. The Shimon Famiglia has been invited as guests to attend the Vongola Inheritance Ceremony.   He first appeared with Ryohei when they were stuck on answering difficult questions. He uses boxing gloves as his choice of weapon just like Ryohei. Both of them also have the same temper as seen when they quickly get angry and none of them wants to stop the fight. Koyo Aoba is sensitive over his contradictory name (Aoba meaning green leaves and Koyo meaning red leaves) saying that he has been told about that many times since he was born. He also states that no matter what his name means, they are still the same leaves. He is later seen at the school's rooftop with the other transfer students along with Tsuna's Guardians, watching Hibari fight Adelheid. Koyo even encourages Adelheid to "Defeat the Nami student." He appears to be surprised that Hibari did not waver at Adhelheid's beautiful underwear showing attack. Koyo also shocked along with Rauji that Hibari's attack pushed Adelheid back across the rooftop. But, fortunately, Tsuna (who is pushed by Reborn) stops the fight by coming between Hibari's and Adelheid's attack. Koyo is then surprised along with Rauji and Enma that Reborn could talk fluently. Reborn says that the Shimon are the Vongola's guests for the Inheritance Ceremony.

name: O
description: A mysterious being introduced in the series as the one who distributes boxes. Always refered as they. They love playing with the protagonist Kazuki Hoshino.

appearsIn.title: The Empty Box and Zeroth Maria

name: Kazuki Hoshino
description: A completely ordinary high school student who loves idle chatter with his friends and Umaibōs, a Japanese snack. One day, he somehow suddenly antagonizes Aya Otonashi — even though he has never met her before. She threatens to “break” him.

appearsIn.title: The Empty Box and Zeroth Maria

name: Daiya Oomine
description:
A self-centered and arrogant student who dyes his hair silver and wears three piercings in his right ear. He is also the class president and a shrewd friend of Kazuki’s.


(Source: Baka-Tsuki)

appearsIn.title: The Empty Box and Zeroth Maria

name: Maria Otonashi
description: An antisocial beauty with a resolute personality. She transfers into [Kazuki Hoshino](https://anilist.co/character/87513/Hoshino-Kazuki)'s class on March 2nd—right before the end of the school year. Immediately upon her arrival, she announces her intent to “break” Kazuki.

appearsIn.title: The Empty Box and Zeroth Maria

name: Ruka Hoshino
description: Kazuki's elder sister.

appearsIn.title: The Empty Box and Zeroth Maria

name: Yuuri Yanagi
description: A timid and shy girl who is a close friend of Iroha Shindou.

appearsIn.title: The Empty Box and Zeroth Maria

name: Koudai Kamiuchi
description: A frivolous and jolly freshman who appears to be very fond of girls.

appearsIn.title: The Empty Box and Zeroth Maria

name: A
description: An artificial personality that belongs to the 'Wish-Crushing Cinema',  She acts as a guide as the movies are being screened.

appearsIn.title: The Empty Box and Zeroth Maria

name: Kokone Kirino
description:
A bright and beautiful girl who cares a lot for her friends, but can sometimes be meddlesome. She and Daiya have known each other since childhood, and their mutual verbal abuse has become legendary among their classmates ever since. She loves showing off her bust size.  
(Source: Baka-Tsuki)

appearsIn.title: The Empty Box and Zeroth Maria

name: Mother Kamiuchi
description: Kamiuchi Koudai's mother. Raised him on her own after his father abandoned, upon finding out that she was not going to abort him. While raising him, she tried to teach him that "Violence can't solve anything!" and that he should "Never use violence".

appearsIn.title: The Empty Box and Zeroth Maria

name: Ji-A Han
description: A 32 year old freelancer who still doesn’t have a full-time job.

name: Min-Cheol Jin
description: A programmer and childhood friend of [Ji-A Han](https://anilist.co/character/266483).

name: Na-Ri Ju
description: Staff member of Café 2nd along with [Si-U](https://anilist.co/character/300190/SiU-Lee). Flirted incessantly with [Min-Cheol](https://anilist.co/character/266484/MinCheol-Jin) before discovering he was married to [Ji-A](https://anilist.co/character/266483/JiA-Han), but later apologizes and becomes a proper acquaintance and coworker of Ji-A's afterwards.

name: Si-U Lee
description: Staff member of Café 2nd, alongside [Na-Ri](https://anilist.co/character/300191/NaRi-Ju). The more capable worker of the two.

name: Ji-Min Han
description: Jia's younger sister.

name: Yeon-Ji Choi
description: Sang-U's eldest sister. She's very elegant, put together and mature, but also tends to gets a kick out of teasing her brother.

name: Su-Yeon So
description: Min-Cheol and Sang-U's manager.

name: A-Yeong Jo
description: A rookie reporter and a big fan of Ji-A's during her days as a popular author. She's keen on seeing Ji-A return to writing.

name: Sang-U Choi
description: A friend and coworker of Min-Cheol.

name: Yeon-Ju Choi
description: Sang-U's second-oldest sister. Popular romance novelist and an influencer.

name: Alexander Anderson
native: アレクサンド・アンデルセン神父
description:
Alexander Anderson is the trump card of Iscariot - section XIII, the secret organization of the Catholic church created to fight the undead.

Little is known about his background, other than his many nicknames and victories, and his biotech regeneration. Anderson first meets [Alucard](https://anilist.co/character/601/Alucard) on a mission in Northern Ireland, and their paths cross many times afterwards. Anderson is seemingly possessed by the thought of defeating Alucard... How far is he willing to go in order to defeat his foe?

name: Kei Yonagi
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm
__Affiliation:__ Studio Daikokuten

A high school girl who's all alone to raise her twin siblings, [Rui](https://anilist.co/character/158800/Yonagi-Rui) and [Rei](https://anilist.co/character/158921/Yonagi-Rei), ever since their mother died and their father left home. Her greatest talent is acting; however, her very immersive approach, based on her own intimate memories, leads her to often get lost in character and blur the line between fiction and reality.

name: Chiyoko Momoshiro
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm
__Affiliation:__ Stars Agency

She is recognized as the hottest young actress of her generation. She is nicknamed "Angel of Stars" because of her beautiful image both in film and in real life. Her type of acting is to create a 'mask' of herself that the audience wishes to see. She doesn't delve into emotion to fit her role, because for her the important thing is her look to others. She said that her acting is the complete opposite of Kei Yonagi's acting.

(Source: Act-Age Wiki)

name: Akira Hoshi
description:
__Height:__ 173 cm
__Affiliation:__ Stars Agency

- __Favorite Food:__ soba (this isn't publicized because it doesn't fit his image as an actor)
- __Dislikes:__ junk food, violence, and dirty jokes.
- __Favorite Movies:__ Spiderman 2, The Dark Knight, and Captain America: The Winter Soldier.

Akira is famous for his many roles, including Ultra Masked Man, the hero of a popular Sunday morning cartoon. Although he is the son of Arisa Hoshi, a former famous actress, he is not considered by her to have inherited his mother's talent. Conscious of his perception by many as "not a worthy successor to his mother", Akira intends on proving himself as a real actor.

From a young age, Akira was able to become a child star. He thought it was because of his own skill, but soon realized his success was only due to the influence of his mother. At the age of 10, Akira tried to overcome this by studying advanced acting for several days, but could not follow through. He grew up to be a star, but his inferiority complex and feeling of emptiness towards his acting remained. Although Akira comes off as cool and suave at times, this is merely a facade.

(Source: Act-Age Wiki, edited)

name: Sumiji Kuroyama
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm
__Affiliation:__ Studio Daikokuten

He works as a director and is the founder of Studio Daikokuten.

Although he had won various film festival awards overseas, Sumiji was not famous in Japan as a director. He founded Studio Daikokuten for the purpose of making a single film in the future. After discovering [Kei Yonagi](https://anilist.co/character/126858/Kei-Yonagi)'s talent from an audition, he invites her to his studio and guides her to become an actress who will leave an imprint on the history of acting.

name: Araya Myoujin
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm
__Affiliation:__ Tenkyu Theatrical Company

He is recognized as the "monster of the theatre world". He is nicknamed "The Chameleon" because he can take on many faces for his roles. Sumiji said that he has the complete version of Kei's acting. He can delve into a character deeply then conscientiously convey his role through his emotion and body language. Although he admitted that he can't delve into character as fast as Kei can. He is an eccentric weird person with a unique world view and behavior.

name: Takemitsu Karasuyama
description: Actor affiliated with Gekiza Theatrical Company. Starred in the movie "Death Island" and the play "Princess Iron Fan".

name: Riku Oogami
description: He is an actor who was affiliated with Stars Agency but then leave it when he was 16 years old and went overseas for acting career.

name: Hanako Yamanoue
description: A novelist and artist, who is the author of Princess Iron Fan, and director of Team B of the Princess Iron Fan play, which includes Kei Yonagi and Riku Ogami.

name: Yifan Zhuo
description:
Zhuo Yifan was the Magic Emperor or can also be called a Demonic Emperor. Because he had the (Nine Serenities) Ancient Emperor's book the Book of Nine Secrets, he was targeted by all the attending experts and was even betrayed and killed by his student Zhao Cheng.

Then his soul enters and comes back to life in a family servant boy named Zhuo Fan. Because the Magic of the Heart (Heart Demon) of the previous owner was holding him back, he must unite the child's memories and cannot ignore the family and the mistress he serves.

name: Shen Yan Long Jiu
description: Head of Qianlong pavilion.

name: Mu Dan
description: Master of Mu Dan Tower, 13th of the Hua Yu Towers.

name: Ningxiang Xue
description: A young daughter of the Xue Family, which was a subsidary family of Hell Valley. She was to be used as a cultivation Furnace, before Zhuo Yi-Fan saved her.

name: Yan Pang
description: Pang is the chief guardsman of the Luo family.

name: Caiqing Qin
description: She is the master of Qing Hua Tower, 1st tower of the 15th Hua Yu Tower.

name: Jingtian Li
description: He is a martial arts fanatic.

name: Qingcheng Chu
description:
Previous head of Huayu's Building

Part of the Six Dragons and One Phoenix of the Seven Families and the only female.

name: Ian Paige
description: A powerful mage in his past and current life, Ian has a mature mindset befitting his true age in the forties-fifties, as well as an inner ruthlessness concealed by his courteous behavior.

appearsIn.title: The Return of the 8th Class Mage

name: Ragnar Greenriver
description: An Emperor and Ian's friend.

appearsIn.title: The Return of the 8th Class Mage

name: Vanessa Paige
description: Mother of Ian Paige.

appearsIn.title: The Return of the 8th Class Mage

name: Douglas Hamon
description: In Ian's previous life he was a royal alchemist--the greatest in the empire's history.

appearsIn.title: The Return of the 8th Class Mage

name: Hailey Greenriver
description: The 3rd Princess of the Empire.

appearsIn.title: The Return of the 8th Class Mage

name: Hayden Greenriver
description: The Crown Prince of the Greenriver Empire and a playful idiot.

appearsIn.title: The Return of the 8th Class Mage

name: Ouma Tokita
description:
Having grown up in the lawless territory known as The Inside, the young Ohma was found and adopted by [Tokita Niko](https://anilist.co/character/189945/Niko-Tokita), who taught him his style of martial arts; the Niko Style. Ohma is a man of above-average height and has an extremely athletic build. His most notable trait is his mop of messy, dark hair that has been compared to seaweed. In addition, Ohma possesses a narrow gaze that exudes both confidence and general indifference.

Ohma is a rough, yet well-meaning individual. He was initially rather arrogant, which often surfaced whenever he fought. During his fights, he was condescending and often belittled and provoked his opponents. A defining trait of Ohma is his lust for battle; ever eager to fight against those who are strong. Despite this love for fighting, he will not fight those that refuse to fight him. Such was the case when [Kazuo](https://anilist.co/character/143838/Yamashita-Kazuo) and his son had done so on separate occasions. That being said, he was also short-tempered and can be quite violent. He was willing to physically assault [Hideki Nogi](https://anilist.co/character/143856/Nogi-Hideki), his employer, when the latter refused to make him Nogi Group's representative fighter, before being stopped by [Sen Hatsumi](https://anilist.co/character/143858/Hatsumi-Sen).

name: Kazuo Yamashita
description: He is the CEO of the Yamashita coop.. He is a weak old man, however he is never scared to say his opinion out loud.

name: Minoru Takayama
description: Takayama Minoru is a personal bodyguard of Katahara Metsudo, holding the position of Metsudo's left-hand man. He was once the top candidate to be the sixth Fang of Metsudo.

name: Suekichi Kaneda
aliases: Oumono Kui (大物喰‚ The Giant Killer)
description:
Kaneda Suekichi is an affiliated fighter within the Kengan matches. He represented Ginokuniya Bookstore during the Kengan Annihilation Tournament after stealing the affiliated fighter's spot from Himuro Ryo.

Suekichi has a soft, polite demeanor that hides his fiercely cunning and calculating side. From an early age, he has had a colossal thirst for strength due to his relatively weak physical constitution.

name: Saw Paing Yoroizuka
description:
Saw Paing is a Burmese fighter with a lean and tall physique. He arguably appears much younger than he is, with a youthful and hairless face and spiky, voluminous brown hair and hazel eyes. True to his personality, he often sports a determined and enthusiastic expression with wide eyes and a perpetual grin.

Saw Paing is the polar opposite of his self-proclaimed rival, Gaolan Wongsawat while the latter is calm and apathetic, Saw Paing is hot-blooded, brash, and easily excitable. He is a frequent shouter and yells loud enough to drown out the announcer on the mic in a crowded stadium. His adoptive father, Sanemitsu, casually states that Saw Paing is not a very intelligent person, though he does have (a certain degree of) common sense. Despite his hot-blooded nature, Saw Paing is surprisingly understanding, such as delaying fights with Gaolan if the latter has an appointment.

His rivalry with Gaolan is seemingly one-sided; after Kaolan beat him in a cross-border match at age 16, he frequently sneaks across the border to challenge him to a rematch, even climbing up Kaolan's high-rise apartment to do so, much to the latter's annoyance.

name: Adam Dudley
description: Adam Dudley, also known as The Emperor, is an American street fighter who represented "Boss Burger" during the Kengan Annihilation Tournament. After the tournament, he stayed in Japan, becoming an affiliated fighter within the Kengan matches. Adam's personality becomes readily apparent in his first appearance. He is very vulgar in the way he speaks, typically throwing profanity into nearly every sentence that leaves his mouth.

name: Sayaka Katahara
description: Katahara Sayaka is the daughter of Katahara Metsudo, half-sister of Katahara Retsudo, and announcer for the Kengan Annihilation Tournament. In the two years since the tournament, Sayaka has become a Kengan Association official, playing an integral role in the Kengan Association administration.

name: Shunka Hiyama
description: Hiyama Shunka (檜山 瞬花, Hiyama Shunka; "Shunka Hiyama") is the CEO of Wakasa Life Insurance and a member of the Kengan Association.

name: Katsumasa Hayami
description: Hayami Katsumasa is the CEO of Toyo Electric Power Co. and head of the Society of a Hundred, the formerly largest faction within the Kengan Association.

name: Zaha Sanko
description: A 14-year-old hunted by the entire universe for possessing the bones that grant any wish.

name: Avakian
description: The Package of Darkness that Sanko bears. Somewhat different from your usual luggage.

name: Shimada Death
description:
Shimada Death is an ominous living phantom that consumes death, a mysterious creature born from the world of Darkness, known as the God of Death. Shimada met Zaha as a child and understood there will be a lot of death happening around him due to his curse, which means free meals for him. Since he was uninterested in Zaha's bones, he left a positive impression on him and they became friends. When Zaha's spaceship was ready, they started traveling together.

Shimada is usually wearing a large, tattered coat with a red mask.

name: Mitamura
description: The martial arts master of M1, M2, and M3. For years, Mitamura had been training young boys throughout their lives in the ways of martial arts, though one day Dr. Ichigaki poisoned him in secrecy. His disciples, gravely upset, were willing to do anything for his health, and Dr. Ichigaki took three of his students, En, Ryo, and Kai, and turned them into killing machines at his command. Kurama, finding this out through one of Dr. Ichigaki's henchmen, healed Mitamura. Although the three felt their master should not see them for the crimes they committed, Genkai explained that she had given them the choice to be purified or not, and Mitamura easily forgave them.

name: Mitsunari Yanagisawa
description: Mitsunari Yanagisawa is a human who develops superhuman powers as a result of the demon plane hole opened by Sensui. His power is "Copy" which allows him to copy the appearance, memories, attributes, abilities, and spirit print of anyone he touches.   (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Zeru
description: Zeru is the "Captain" Of Jolly Devil Six. His power is based around fire (火炎術), his only attacks he uses are Fire Aura, and a fire blast attack. He seemingly punches Hiei through the stomach, then shoots a fire blast at him, yet again seemingly killing him. Then Hiei appears behind Zeru, stunning him as he doesn't realize that a fire-based attack won't work on other fire demons. Thus he is killed by the infamous Black Dragon Hell Fire (Jao Ensatsu Koku Ryu Ha) (referred to as Dragon of the Darkness Flame in the English version). Upper C class demon.

name: Shura
description: Is the cloned son of Yomi. He is created so that Yomi will have a better chance of winning. Despite this, Yomi truly loves him and trains him in earnest.

name: Ja-Ha Lee
description: Ja-Ha dreamt of becoming a Martial God but fell off a cliff while running from the Demonic Cult after stealing and swallowing the Jade of Heaven. He then awakens and finds himself back in his 20s. He becomes a powerful and extremely deadly master martial artist infamous for his unpredictable and benevolent mindset, ruthlessness, and utter insanity.

name: Koutarou Natori
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm (5'9")

Natori is a member of the product development team at Lilia Drop, a company that manufactures makeup and bath products that are tremendously popular with women. He is the project planner for all the soaps the company makes.

Natori-sans' sense of smell isn't inborn (like perfect pitch, etc.) He got better through practice, so he's a bit less sensitive when he's dozing or too tired to concentrate. He likes animals but sometimes has a hard time at zoos.

name: Asako Yaeshima
description:
__Height:__ 156 cm (5'4")

Asako is an office lady who has a complex about her excessive sweating. She works in the accounting department at Lilia Drop, a company that manufactures makeup and bath products that are tremendously popular with women.

As a child, she was called "Aseko." (Ase means sweat.)

Asako likes looking at cute outfits in fashion magazines and has a weakness for cute furnishings and knick-knacks.

name: Korisu Ichise
description:
__Height:__ 152 cm (5')

Ichise works closely with Natori in the product development team.

name: Kanade Natori
description: Koutarou Natori's mother. During Koutarou's youth, she lost her vision.

name: Yuzuka Natori
description: Koutarou Natori's sister. She is a senior in college.

name: Shintarou Natori
description: Koutarou Natori's father.

name: Urasawa
description: Urasawa is a real estate property agent.

name: Kensuke Takarada
description: A passionate wedding planner who used to be on his high school's baseball team albeit he was a permanent benchwarmer.

name: Jin Ookura
description:
__Height:__ 187 cm (6'2")

Ookura is Yaeshima's manager at Lilia Drop.

name: Suzumura
description: Suzumura is Natori's colleague.

name: Teria Wang
description:
One of the two-second-year prefects of the Black Dogs dormitory, and Kochou's twin sister. She is known as the Engineering expert, with expertise regarding machinery. Despite their small stature, they are actually 14 years old, having skipped grades because of their intellect. However, Teria only joined so that she could be by her sister's side. Teria is shy and timid but is willing to step up to the challenge to help others. As Romio continues to help her, Teria falls in love with him and is pushed by her sister to be more proactive with him.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Shuna Inuzuka
description: Shuna is from one of the branch Inuzuka families.

name: Hasuki Komai
description:
Romio's right hand and childhood friend. Initially timid and withdrawn as a child, she meets Romio when he praises her for her intellect after assisting him with his homework. Her interaction with Romio made her become more outgoing and passionate with others by the start of the series. She is grateful for Romio's friendship and as a result, falls in love with him. She is the only one on the Black Dogs side to know about Romio and Juliet's relationship, after Romio confesses the truth to her. While she initially disapproved, Romio convinces her to keep his relationship with Juliet a secret.

She currently ranks 2nd overall in terms of academics for the 1st year, only behind Juliet. Because of her academic prowess, she often runs intense tutoring sessions to prevent her fellow "Black Dogs" from failing, especially Romio. She also has a younger brother named Kougi.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Teruhiko Sawatari
description: Sawatari is a doctor working at Takahara Academy.

name: Anzu
description: She is Tokio's classmate and good at dancing.

name: Hiroyasu Abiko
description: Hiroyasu is a high-ranking member of the Takahara Academy. He is also the designer of the academy.

name: Melissa Podebrat
description:
After dying in a car accident, Han Da Young finds herself in the body of the villainess from a popular novel called "All the Men that Loved Her". She is determined to live as a jobless rich girl and making sure that the heroine of the novel does not get taken advantage of by the useless male leads.

Melissa has a very unique personality. Rather than repent for the deeds of her body's previous owner or fulfill the role of a villainess, Melissa initially sets out to live out the rest of her days as a pampered daughter of a duke—this is due to the constant studying and work she had to endure during her previous life.

Of course, Melissa does not get to enjoy her luxurious and relaxing fantasy for long, as she realizes the unsettling circumstances of the novel's original four love interests. Melissa makes it her job to protect the female lead from the influence of these characters, showing her resilience and unwavering disposition to do what she feels is right. She has no tolerance of the male leads' antics and is willing to beat them up if the situation befits it.

Melissa has no reluctance to do whatever she feels like doing. This also applies to her inclination and appreciation of her people, as shown in her continuing willingness to raise Yona Whitefall's pay and strong resolution to find a way to restore Nine Forton's fangs and tongue.

Melissa is also very independent.

name: Yuri Elizabeth
description: Yuri Elizabeth is the protagonist of the novel “The Brats I Love”. She was adopted into the Elizabeth family because of her magical ability.

name: Nine Forton
description: Nine is Melissa's shy butler and a werewolf. He was rescued from the streets by Melissa, making him really loyal to her.

name: Jack Forton
description: Jack Forton is the strongest member of the werewolf clan (after Mizen Forton, the clan leader). He is second-in-command of the Forton household. He hates humans. The scar on his face is one that was left by Nine.

name: Kartena Voxy
description: Cartena is Melissa's sword instructor, and a former knight for the imperial family. She initially mistook Melissa's intentions to learn swordsmanship for wanting to join the knights.

name: Yona Whitefall
description: Yona is a maid motivated by money. She is from a fallen noble house.

name: Jake Podebrat
description: Jake is a sniper with stalkerish tendencies. He is the younger brother of the main protagonist, Melissa Podebrat.

name: Duke Podebrat
description: He is the father of Melissa Podebrat and Jake Podebrat

name: Ian Basilios
description: Ian is considered a very handsome man, and because of his good looks, he has fooled around with a lot of women. He is a selfish, shallow person, who used to be very cruel to Melissa, his fiancée,

name: Peacock Melody
description: He is a billionaire who pines after Yuri.

name: Enkrid
description: Enkrid is the protagonist of The Knight Only Lives Today. He possesses a curse which turns him back in time every time he dies to a “wall”.

name: Jun-Ho Seo
description: Famously known as "Specter", he is one of the Five Heroes and also cleared the 1st Floor. He fought against the Frozen Queen and successfully killed her, but was then frozen for 25 years in order to absorb the nucleus.

name: Si-Eun Cha
description: Secretary and manager of Seo Jung-Ho. She's working under Association.

name: Ju-Ha Gong
description: Member of the Dokkaebi guild.

name: Pil-Ho Choi
description: CEO of Myungho Group which is the number one Korea company.

name: Chae-Won Son
description: Virtuous Moon guild master.

name: Shou Naruse
description:
Shou Naruse is very straightforward and arrogant. He doesn't care what other people think of him. He is very tall and he has piercings on both of his ears. He is the ace player of the Ryuhoku High's basketball team and has been a basketball player since he was 6 years old. He was tall since he was a kid so he was considered as the "most important player" in their team even though he plays the game with little effort. 

He likes his manager, [Yuki](https://anilist.co/character/88601/Machida-Yuki). When he first met Yuki, a girl pushed him which caused his hand to land on Yuki's breasts, and said that her breasts "were really big". The two then encountered each other more since Shou joined the school's Basketball Team where Yuki is the manager. He started following Yuki more since he was interested in her. He said that he could understand Yuki and "see through her". He was the only one who found out that Yuki had a crush on [Kido](https://anilist.co/character/88861/Kido).

name: Yuki Machida
description:
Yuki Machida is the manager of the Ryuhoku High basketball team. She has always been mature ever since she was a little kid and also has a crush on the captain of the team, [Kido](https://anilist.co/character/88861/Kido). Yuki thinks of him as her "first love". He was the reason why Yuki joined as the manager of the basketball club in the first place. Her interest on him later faded away when she found out that Kido was going out with someone else which also results her to gradually develop feelings for [Shou](https://anilist.co/character/88600/Naruse-Shou).

Yuki is a serious and stern girl. Her stern-looking face explaining why many of the younger members of the team is afraid of her. She is very responsible and can sometimes be a bit uptight. She has long red straight hair which is tied into a ponytail when in gym or managing the team and is loose during school hours. She is mostly seen in her gym clothes as the manager or her school uniform.

name: Kido
description: Kido is the ex-captain of the Ryuhoku High's Basketball Team. Yuki Machida refers him as her "first love", as she was the reason why she signed up as the basketball team's manager in the first place. He already has a girlfriend named Rina.

name: Shizuka Hakamada
description: Shizuka Hakamada was Shou Naruse's childhood friend. They were in the same basketball team during their elementary days. He currently plays for Misuzu Academy. Shizuka has short black hair and is tall like Shou, although when he was little, he was called "shrimp" by his fellow teammates, indicating that he must've been short compared to the others. He was always envious of Shou ever since they were in the same elementary basketball club. Shizuka seems to be really shy when girls touch him or try to talk to him for long, he even goes as far as avoiding them by any cost when they try to get near him. Shizuka met Yuki when Ryuhoku High had their first match against Misuzu Academy. When he found out that Yuki likes Naruse, he told her it was a bad idea. He doesn't want Yuki to date Naruse. Naruse warned Hakamada by saying that Yuki belongs to him.(Source: Namaikizakari Wiki)

name: Rina Hashino
description: Rina Hashino is Kido's girlfriend. She is described as very cute by a lot of people. Yuki Machida was jealous at her at the start because she was the one who stole Kido's heart.(Source: Namaikizakari Wiki)

name: Himiko Himeno
description:
Himiko Himeno is girl who is signing up to be a new manager for Ryuhoku High's Basketball Team, replacing Yuki Machida because she is already a third year and will graduate soon. She admires Yuki and wishes to be like her. 

She is a small girl with short black hair which is tied in pig tails. She wear glasses. She's very shy and also a first year.(Source: Namaikizakari WIki)

name: Yuna Sunohara
description: She is a new employee at the place Machida works part-time

name: Daitouryou
description: President of the United States.

name: Mayu Nozaki
description: He is the younger brother of [Umetarou](https://anilist.co/character/87269/Nozaki-Umetarou) and the older brother of [Yumeko](https://anilist.co/character/282112/Nozaki-Yumeko). Mayu is a middle school student, and is affiliated with the judo club.

name: Iwanbou
description: Iwanbou is a fat oaf who uses his immense size, his strength, and his ability to entrap weapons in his flab. He is very stupid, and, apart from taking part in the battle of Aoiya as well as grinning like an utter idiot, he doesn't say anything, and he doesn't do anything. He was last seen on a cliff outside of Kyoto.    As revealed in the Jinchūuu or "Revenge" arc of the manga, Iwanbou is in reality a mechanical puppet, a primitive mech, if you will, controlled by Gein, the puppetmaster. Gein reappears in this arc as one of the six comrades in a more dangerous form of Iwanbo and plays a major role in Enishi's revenge.    (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Kenji Himura
description: SPOILER WARNING      He is Kenshin and Kaoru's son who appears at the end of volume 28. He likes to climb things but cries whenever he can't get down. He loves his mother but doesn't like his father. (He likes to pull Kenshin's hair)    In Samurai X: Reflections, he is still a toddler, but some scenes skip to the when he is fifteen years old and trains with Hiko. In the OVA time line, Kenji grows up without Kenshin's presence. He watches as his mother mourns his father's continued absence. Kenji grows to resent his father's selfishness and his mother's continued depressions.     At age 15, he runs away to Kyoto to train under Hiko Seijuro XIII in the art of Hiten Mitsurugi Ryu. Kenji displays a lot of promise as a student, just as his father had 30 years before, but Hiko decides to honor Kenshin by not passing the school on to Kenji. Hiko basically keeps Kenji busy until Myoujin Yahiko shows up to take him home.    Kenji refuses to leave, saying that he wants to experience true strength and surpass his father's legend. Yahiko and Kenji duel. Kenji shows his promise and his genius, but Yahiko uses his beliefs and experience to conquer the teen. After Kenji is subdued, Yahiko passes on the Sakabatou to him. Kenji then returns to Tokyo with Yahiko to be with his dying mother.    At the end of the OVA, we see Kenji with a girl named Raikoji Chizuru. Kenji now wields the Sakabatou and seems to be at peace with his father.

name: Yumi Komagata
description: Komagata Yumi was an oiran, a courtesan (in short the highest rank of prostitute) in Yoshiwara, formerly an akasen. Because of that, she is beautiful, intelligent, dignified, well-cultured, and was brought up in a comfortable life. She was always interested in social issues and occurrences in Japan, and became reviled at the Japanese government's stance regarding prostitutes (according to the government they were no better than cows or horses). She came to love Makoto Shishio with an utmost passion, which he returned. Thus, she joined Shishio's conspiracy to bring down the Meiji government. She is constantly concerned about Shishio's medical state.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Asuka Kyouju
description: Father of Asuka Ryou. He's a famous Archeologist who discovered the demons' existence. Later, he merged with a demon before committing suicide.

name: Miki Kuroda
description:
Mikiko Kawamoto is a supporting character in the original Devilman manga. 

In the 2017 anime adaptation, _Devilman Crybaby_, Miki Kuroda is on the running track team along with Akira Fudo and Miki Makimura.

name: Maegawa
description: He is a devil who killed his wife and son.

name: Agwell
description: Is a devil sent by Sirene to attack Akira.

name: Hachirota Hoshino
description: Everyone simply calls him "Hachi" (Japanese for "eight" or "eighth") or "Hachimaki"; because he wears one during his EVAs). His dream has always been to own his own spaceship, but between the cost of purchasing one and his low-paying, seemingly dead-end job, Hachi struggles with even deciding whether or not to pursue his dream. Hachi's father is a renowned engineer, a source of much ambivalence to Hachimaki. Much of Hachi's drive is summed up in "bigger, faster, and further". However, this drive makes him conflicted about his own relationship with space. Loud and brash, Hachi has difficulty expressing himself adequately, especially in romantic matters.      It should be noted that Hachirota's back-story is portrayed slightly differently in the anime than in the manga.

name: Ai Tanabe
description: She is the newest member of the Debris Section. She is the adopted daughter of a death metal band leader turned engineer and an elementary school teacher. Tanabe did not speak until she was three years old. She is bright and earnest, but mostly unsure of herself. As a newcomer to space, the Debris Section and to extra-vehicular activity all at the same time, she has to slowly learn the ropes from everyone else. She believes that love, or "ai" (possibly a pun intended on her name being the Japanese word for love) is the solution to every problem. Kind and sweet, she is willing to do almost anything to help others. However, her kind spirit also masks a drive to become better than she is.    (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Fee Carmichael
description: Fee Carmichael is the American pilot of the "Toy Box", the debris-collecting ship used by the main characters of PlanetES. She was born in Richmond, Virginia, and the daughter of a prominent lawyer. Even more loud and brash than Hachi, Fee often becomes violent at others' actions and inaction, but she always means well. Being a heavy (and slightly ashamed) smoker, she has difficulty finding places to indulge her habit in space, as smoking is a strain on life support systems and is thereby restricted to designated smoking rooms. This often makes her quite irritable, especially after all smoking rooms are shut down as the SDF began planting bombs in them. In the anime, she is able to get around this with an enclosed personal "smoker's seat" (which is prone to inadvertent sabotage). Married with a young son, Fee lives in Florida when not in space, which is not very often.

name: Goro Hoshino
description: The Chief Engineer of the Von Braun Jupiter Exploration Spacecraft of PlanetES and Hachimaki's father. He is portrayed as an eccentric genius, and seeks to constantly irritate his eldest son. Plays the part of the "dirty old man". He was a pioneer in space exploration, as he was on a mission to build a human settlement on Mars.    source: Wikipedia

name: Kyutaro Hoshino
description: Hachirota Hoshino's younger brother, he also displays a strong interest in space travel, and hence spends most of his time attempting to construct a working, miniature rocket, so as to prove his talent in that particular field.    He maintains a shaky relationship with Hachirota, openly displaying disrespect for him. However he develops significantly throughout the series, especially after encountering Yuri Mihailokov.

name: Colonel Sanders
description: He is colonel from U.S. Army's space intelligence agency.

name: Werner Locksmith
native: ウェルナー・ロックスミス
description: The CEO of the Jupiter Mission and Chief Designer of the Von Braun Jupiter Exploration Spacecraft. Seemingly cold and heartless, he is portrayed in the anime and manga as someone without sympathy and believes that the ends justify the means. This implies getting the Von Braun to Jupiter no matter what the cost is, human or monetary.    source: Wikipedia

name: Nono
description: A 12-year-old girl who, along with three other children, is a "Lunarian", born and has lived her whole life on the Moon. Due to the effects of lower gravity, she appears to be twice her age due to her height. Her physiology is always examined as part of a study on the effect of being born and raised on the Moon. Once the study is finished, she wishes to only visit the Earth because she considers the Moon to be her home.

name: Yuri Mihalkov
native: ユーリ・ミハイロコフ
description: Yuri Mihalkov is the Russian member of the Debris team of Planetes. Calm, stoic, kind and compassionate, Yuri often acts as the level head of the group. It is often speculated that Yuri's name is a reference to Yuri Gagarin and Nikita Mihalkov. In the anime, Yuri and the Debris Section Office Staff are responsible for looking after the ISPV 7's resident animals.

name: Danshaku
description: An Alien from Retikle, who is trying to fit in with the humans.

name: Sayo Komura
description: Kaede Komura's Mother

appearsIn.title: The Girl I Like Forgot Her Glasses

name: Yi Jian
description:
__Height:__ 182 cm

Jian Yi is a loud, boisterous individual who is constantly adding light and humour to situations, despite his not-so-happy background. Yi has been friends with [Zhan Zheng Xi](https://anilist.co/character/121621/Zhengxi-Zhan) since childhood and continues to be close with him.

name: Cheng He
description: He Cheng is  Tian's older brother and he works under Jian Yi's father.

name: Qiu
description: Brother Qiu is very tall, muscular, and has a tattoo on his right arm. His hair is an off white/light grey.

name: She Li
description: She Li is one of the main antagonists in 19 Days and is an enemy to Mo Guan Shan as well as He Tian.

name: Yu-Jeong Kim
description: [Jae-Hyeon](https://anilist.co/character/305628)'s childhood friend.

name: I-Na Seo
description: She was a famous top ranking magician before [Jae-Hyeon](https://anilist.co/character/305628)'s regression.

name: Seong-Eun Yu
description: The guild master of the Yeonhwa Guild. She is a top level healer known worldwide.

name: Hel
description: The daughter of Loki and the god of death who rules over Helheim, the world of the dead among the nine worlds of Norse mythology.

name: Jae-Sang Lee
description: Jae-Hyeon's senior at Milles Academy. He grew up as the youngest son of an S-class raider family, but unlike his other brothers, he had no talent for combat. Instead, he made a name for himself as the greatest alchemist.

name: Medaka Kuroiwa
description:
The male protagonist of the show, Kuroiwa is a monk-in-training that enlisted to a Tokyo public school in an attempt to "steel his heart" and get himself rid of all worldly desires, in line with his religion. This attempt is later conflicted by Kawai Mona, however, as she continually shows him affection in order to make him fall for her.

Typically stoic, he ripostes to Mona's usual charms with a cold scowl, not to give in to desire, but his struggles and true emotions are often revealed as he blushes and reacts love-struck away from Mona's view.

Because of his time as a monk, he gets easily excited from things others around him might consider normal, such as a school festival or a concert, often staying around and losing focus when he admires such activities.

appearsIn.title: Medaka Kuroiwa is Impervious to My Charms

name: Mona Kawai
description: Mona, in her own words, has got the looks, the personality and is the "complete package". She is like the queen bee of the school and is idolised by the entire student body - except for Medaka who is totally indifferent towards her. This annoys her and she decides to make Medaka fall for her through her charms.

appearsIn.title: Medaka Kuroiwa is Impervious to My Charms
Medaka Kuroiwa is Impervious to My Charms

name: Tomo Nanba
description: Mona's childhood friend. She has a mature and fun personality.

appearsIn.title: Medaka Kuroiwa is Impervious to My Charms

name: Tadashi
description: Main character of the Gyo manga. In the beginning of the manga, it shows that he loves scuba. He has a girlfriend named Kaori and an uncle named Koyanagi. He noticed something was funny when Kaori said he had bad breath, although he brushes his teeth twice a day.

name: Kaori Sawahara
description:
Tadashi's girlfriend. She has an extremely sensitive nose and becomes very jealous when Tadashi is near other women. Due to her overly sensitive nose, she seems to be able to sense when the creatures are coming. 

In the anime, she is the main character rather than Tadashi.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Oowaki
description: Owaki is the main character of The Enigma of Amigara Fault. He comes to search the Amigara Fault after witnessing the display on television and meets another hiker on the way, Yoshida. He quickly becomes attached to Yoshida and wants to keep her safe and out of danger.

name: Ms. Yoshiyama
description: Assistant of Doctor Koyanagi, she cares for him and tries to help him.

name: Sazuku Koyanagi
description: Tadashi's uncle. He is an inventor and has an assistant, Ms. Yoshiyama (manga only). He tries to figure out what makes the fish move. He once smelled a human corpse, relating the stench to the stench of the creatures.   (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Ha-Yan Park
description:
**Height:** 160 cm (5'3")

A girl who conceals her identity as one of the strongest pureblood vampires in order to live normally as a college student. However, she cannot ignore injustice caused by others of her kind. She is infamously known as the 'White-Haired Vampire' by other vampires.

name: Eun-Tae Hwang
description: A handsome, talented and extremely perceptive police detective who is nicknamed the vampire-hunting 'Ghost' due to his excellent record of arresting vampires. He is currently investigating about a certain pureblood vampire.

name: Minerva
description: The Goddess of wisdom and poetry and the fifth goddess to be revealed in the series. While [Shiori](https://anilist.co/character/15449/Shiomiya-Shiori) is her host, unlike her older sisters, Minerva is able to exist outside of her host with her own body, a young 5-6 year old girl who looks similar to Shiori. When Minerva takes over Shiori's body, her body shrinks and hair grows longer. Like her host, Minerva is shy and loves reading books.

name: Nora Floriann Leoria
native: ノーラ・フロリアン・レオリア
description:
**Height:** 167 cm

Nora is a senior demon from the era of Old Hell, who was in the Runaway Spirit Squad before the Great Sprit Escape ten years ago. As an older model, her body is more buxom than those of newer demons, such as Elsee and Hakua, who are flat-chested. She is arrogant and disdainful; however, her skills are exceptional above others, she has the ability to look through other people's heart and great physical strengths as well. She became the recipient of the Great Demon Medal—after Elsee—for capturing seven spirits in half-term. Nora is partnered with a young man named Ryou who apparently shows very little promise in ability to draw out runaway spirits.  Nora's methods of drawing out runaway spirits leans on the side of lethality. This includes attempting to kill Keima so Tenri's gap in her heart would be filled, regardless of like or dislike towards him.

name: Hinoki Kasuga
description: Kusunoki's older sister. Back from America. A not so ordinary woman, claims to be a designer with a western taste of style and an Actress. Left the dojo 5 years before she came back. She usually carries a megaphone at hand. She is the first adult woman for Keima to capture. She returns to the dojo paints it pink embarrasses her younger sister Kusunoki and defeats her in a duel.

name: Yukie Marui
description:
__Job:__ Gokult Partner

Yukie is a 54 year old saleswoman and is still currently single. However, she is also Haqua's human partner in capturing escaped spirits. Yukie loves to practice Tai Chi Chuan in her spare time and she always likes to offer stuff to others. She spends her day walking to nearby towns, delivering and selling the drink Gokult to other people.    Yukie is seen as useless by her partner Haqua because even though they managed to discover 15 escaped spirits, Yukie could not get a single one of them to come out in the past couple months, even when she's visiting them daily. However that was proved to be wrong later on as Yukie was able to capture 4 spirits in one week.    (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Lune
description: Lune is a horned devil from old hell and also an executive agent of Vintage within the Runaway Spirit Squad who oversees other fellow Vintage agents. She is a very moody person as she can easily switch from quiet to happy to angry. She despise humans but is not allowed to harm them so she instead scares them by cutting herself which she seems to enjoy doing.

name: Fujidera
description: The chairman of the Library committee.

name: Haegolbyeongsa
description:
He is a skeleton who has the ability to return to a specific point in time every time he dies.

Skeleton was just a regular Skeleton Soldier minion placed under the Demon Lord Baal.
His past as a human remains unknown. His grave where his remains are buried had no clues about his past. The tombstone of his grave had been scratched so bad that they can't even see his name on it.

appearsIn.title: The Skeleton Soldier Failed to Defend the Dungeon

name: Rena
description:
She grew up in a Orphanage where she was raised by Headmaster Slime. Having been raised by a Non Human specie she showed no untrustworthy towards Skelly.

She despises humans because of what happened to her in the past. She was living a hard life having to kill another person at the young age of 10 years in order for her and her younger sister Haley to live.

appearsIn.title: The Skeleton Soldier Failed to Defend the Dungeon

name: Rae Rubia
description: She is the the necromancer who summoned Skeleton Soldier.

appearsIn.title: The Skeleton Soldier Failed to Defend the Dungeon

name: Isaac Bel'Homet
description:
He is the mage who's been tormenting the Chandler Household for the past 300 years. He has been brainwashing the heir of the household by giving them an option of Obeying him for his protection.

When the direct heir of the Chandler Household reaches the age of 25. He heads past the barrier in the basement, not on his own volition to the Mage who's been in slumber for centuries. Then he links his body to the Mage's coffin, offering his life force until the day he dies.

He is the Lord of the Golden Dawn and high priest of Malphas in charge of the kings tabernacle.

appearsIn.title: The Skeleton Soldier Failed to Defend the Dungeon

name: Purson
description: One of the 16 Demon Lords. His form is of a bipedal-lion riding a Bear

appearsIn.title: The Skeleton Soldier Failed to Defend the Dungeon

name: Malphas
description: One of the 16 Demon Lords. He has the form of a Crow adorned with Jewels all over his body.

appearsIn.title: The Skeleton Soldier Failed to Defend the Dungeon

name: Kai Yang
description:
__Species:__ Human (Former) 

Yang Kai was a trial disciple in High Heaven Pavilion and the ninth Young Master of the Yang Family which was of the Eight Great Families of Nine Continents. 

One day, he stumbled upon a Black Book,

name: Qing Zhu
description: Introduced as a proud and innocent member of Dragon Island, Zhu Qing first meets Yang Kai during an incidental encounter in the Southern Territory of Star Boundary. During this hostile introduction, Zhu Qing ends up being suppressed by the latter's exceedingly powerful Dragon Source. This leads to them experiencing numerous events and trials together through which they eventually fall in love.

name: Yan Su
description:
__Species:__ Human (Phoenix Cultivation Bloodline)
__Body Type:__ Ice Crystal Jade Body

Su Yan was an elite disciple of High Heaven Pavilion when Yang Kai was still at the rank of trial-disciple. She eventually marries Yang Kai to become his first wife, and then becomes a follower of Yang Kai's High Heaven Palace in the upper realm.

name: Yan Yang
description: She is an Artifact Refiner in the Artifact Refining Pavilion of Heavenly Fate City for Shadow Moon Hall on Shadowed Star. Unfortunately, because she labels herself as an Origin Grade Artifact Refiner, her business suffers.

name: Ning Chan Xia
description:
__Race:__ Human
__Body Type:__ Medicine Holy Body

Xia Ning Chang was also a disciple of High Heaven Pavilion when Yang Kai was still a trial-disciple. After seeing Yang Kai's determination on the path to enlightenment in the Martial Dao, she would develop feelings for him. She would later on become the second wife to Yang Kai and accompany him on his travels. Xia Ning Chan has an extremely shy, innocent, and gentle personality which is shows many times throughout the manhua.

name: Mo Na Ye
description: A powerful strategist for the Ink Clan Army and is considered by Yang Kai to be the craftiest Ink Clansman he has ever encountered.

name: Yue Xue
