description: Xue Yue is originally the 3rd Young Master of the Heng Luo Chamber of Commerce. Forced since childhood to pretend to be male due to her Dragon Marrow Phoenix Body, Xue Yue lives a cruel life of lies, leading to the development of a bitter and even cruel disposition.

appearsIn.title: 66,666 Years: Advent of the Dark Mage

name: Sarah Welton
description: Jamie's little sister.

appearsIn.title: 66,666 Years: Advent of the Dark Mage

name: Sears Bell Welton
description: Jamie's mother.

appearsIn.title: 66,666 Years: Advent of the Dark Mage

name: Argento Welton
description: Jamie's father

appearsIn.title: 66,666 Years: Advent of the Dark Mage

name: Yuuma Motoki
description:
__Height:__ 174 cm
__Year:__ 1st Year
__Jersey Number:__ 29
__Position:__ FW

A first-year high school student and member of Tokyo City Esperion FC. He was promoted from the Esperion Junior Youth team. He plays the forward position, and even though he is a first-year, he has the ability to be a first team regular. He has known [Anri](https://anilist.co/character/272621/Anri-Kaido), the daughter of the president of Kaido Denki, Esperion's main sponsor, since childhood, but it seems that she hates him.

name: Shun Aoi
description:
__Height:__ 180cm

Shun is a supporting character in [Ao Ashi](https://anilist.co/manga/107279/Aoashi/) and the main protagonist in its spin-off, [Ao Ashi: Brother Foot](https://anilist.co/manga/136600/Aoashi-Brotherfoot/). He is the oldest child of [Noriko](https://anilist.co/character/239921/Noriko-Aoi) and the older brother of [Ashito](https://anilist.co/character/133818/Ashito--Aoi), and he currently works a part-time job. Shun has recently been scouted and accepted to play soccer for the J-League team in their family's home prefecture, AC Ehime.

name: Noriko Aoi
description: The mother of [Ashito](https://anilist.co/character/133818/Ashito--Aoi) and [Shun](https://anilist.co/character/239920/Shun-Aoi), and the owner of the family's store. She currently resides in Ehime with Shun while Ashito is away in Tokyo.

name: Asuka
description:
Sayuri's childhood friend and underclassman one grade below her. A member of the swim team, she is athletic and has short hair and a dark complexion. Asuka tries to support Sayuri and her romantic feelings for Tsubasa as much as she can.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Hyeon-U Kim
description: Hyeon-U Kim is more powerful than just about any human or monster on Earth. Now that he’s free, he’s determined to find out who was behind his imprisonment, even if that means he has to kill hordes of monsters.

appearsIn.title: The Advanced Player of the Tutorial Tower

name: Balrog
description: Balrog is the boss of the Tutorial Towers who resides on the 100th floor. He's the final monster that acts as a gatekeeper to the portal. Those who defeat him can exit the tower and become hunters. However, 70 out of 95 hunters are killed by Balrog, making him the hardest monster in the tower. Balrog will always respawn when a new group of trainees appear.

appearsIn.title: The Advanced Player of the Tutorial Tower

name: AV
description: AV is the guide of Hyeon-U Kim, sometimes Hyeon-U Kim feels like she's his daughter.

appearsIn.title: The Advanced Player of the Tutorial Tower

name: Gwi-Ei
description: She is the second climber that Hyeon-U Kim met.

appearsIn.title: The Advanced Player of the Tutorial Tower

name: Seo-Yeon Lee
description: Seo-Yeon Lee  is a first-generation hunter and the guild master of the Arang guild. She, along with Si-Hyeon Kim and Seok-Gwan Han, cleared the tower together along with Hyeon-U Kim.

appearsIn.title: The Advanced Player of the Tutorial Tower

name: Hanarin
description: She is the second disciple of Hyeon-U Kim

appearsIn.title: The Advanced Player of the Tutorial Tower

name: Mu-Wol
description: Cheonma is a climber.

appearsIn.title: The Advanced Player of the Tutorial Tower

name: Kang-Hyeon Lee
description: Kang-Hyeon Lee is an 18th-generation Korean hunter. He was deemed a very powerful candidate behind Hyeon-U Kim.

appearsIn.title: The Advanced Player of the Tutorial Tower

name: Seok-Gwan Han
description: Seok-Gwan Han is a hunter that cleared the tower with Seo-Yeon Lee and Hyeon-U Kim. He is currently the guild master of the Goguryeo Guild.

appearsIn.title: The Advanced Player of the Tutorial Tower

name: Akane Ousaki
description:
__Relatives:__ [Shinta](https://anilist.co/character/264106/Shinta-Arakawa) (Father), [Masaki](https://anilist.co/character/264105/Masaki-Ousaki) (Mother), [Arakawa Shiguma](https://anilist.co/character/264107/Arakawa-Shiguma) (Rakugo Master)
__Affiliation:__ Arakawa School
__Occupation:__ Rakugoka (Zenza)
__Height:__ 158cm (5'2")

She is the protagonist of Akane-Banashi series. She is an apprentice of [Shiguma Arakawa](https://anilist.co/character/264107/Shiguma-Arakawa).

She is usually unconcerned about her studies preferring to use that time to improve her skills, she is determined to achieve her goals. It has been shown that she is very kind to the people around her, taking affection for them despite only having known them for a short time.

According to [Guriko](https://anilist.co/character/279367/Guriko-Arakawa), he is usually pessimistic most of the time, due to this nature he usually learns everything related to the story he wants to interpret, making his attitude change during his presentations to a more self-confident personality.

name: Ikken Arakawa
description:
__Affiliation:__ Arakawa School

He sat for the exam for Shin'nuchi 6 years ago. He is currently a famous personality in the world of rakugo and outside of it, since he usually shoots movies and television series. He is the judge for the Karaku Cup alongside [Issho](https://anilist.co/character/278459/Isshou-Arakawa) and [Ryujaku](https://anilist.co/character/283889/Ryujaku-Sakaki).

name: Jumbo Ozaki
description:
__Occupation:__ Student 
__ Debut:__ Chapter 1 (Child), Chapter 11

As a child he used to be annoying and made fun of his classmates. During his youth he is usually more friendly and respectful with people.

name: Natsuru Nanao
description: An 11-year-old sixth-grader, Natsuru is the ace player of the school's soccer team. He lives alone with his mother. He doesn't get along well with the new soccer coach and decided to skip the summer camp. He instead stayed at the Suzumura's house and went to the Bon festival with them.

name: Rio Suzumura
description: An 11-year-old sixth grader, Rio is the tallest girl in Natsuru's class. She secretly lives alone with her little brother, Yuuta, in a rundown house. She is amazingly responsible and has gone through unbelievable things. She let Natsuru stay over at her house when he decided not to attend his summer camp and later went to the Bon festival with him.

name: Ritsuko Nanao
description: Natsuru's mother. She works as a light novel author and has a very friendly relationship with her son to the point that she sometimes allows her son to rub her breasts. Her husband has already passed away due to cancer.

name: Yuuta Suzumura
description: Rio's younger brother. He lives alone with his sister in a rundown house. He is a very cheerful kid who has curiosity in almost everything.

name: Suzumura
description: Rio and Yuuta's father who is a fisherman currently catching crabs in Alaska. He comes home every few months.

name: Gaku Yoneda
description: Gaku Yoneda is a human who was selected by the angel Muni to be a God candidate. He is the last God candidate to be revealed in the series.

name: Mirai no Oba
description: The abusive aunt of Mirai Kakehashi.

name: Manami Yumiki
description: She is an agent and the partner of Masaya Hoshi and helps Mirai and the others gather all the remaining God candidates.

name: Shuji Nakaumi
description:
Shuji Nakaumi is a human who was selected by the angel Ogaro to be a god candidate.

(Source: Platinum End Wiki)

name: Mimimi Yamada
description: An amateur model who was arrested for the murder of several female middle schoolers.

name: Shizuku Hoshikawa
description:
__Height:__ 167 cm

Shy girl who avoids speaking with others, she's constantly haunted by her past of having bullied a friend. In secret, she wrote a novel expressing her innermost feelings she has never shared with anyone. Although she had planned to erase herself along with her novel when she finished writing, it didn't work out that way because her classmate [Kaori](https://anilist.co/character/204142) borrowed her novel after noticing it by chance. Having read it, Kaori asks when her next novel will be. Everything changes from then on, as they agree to go out until summer ends.

name: Kaori Asaka
description:
__Height:__ 149cm

Cheery and energetic, she accidentally stumbled upon her classmate Shizuku's novel when she approached her. After borrowing the novel in order to read it, she has started take an admiration towards Shizuku and asks when her next novel will be. Distraught to know she wasn't planning to write another one, Kaori asks to go out together so she can be inspired to write a new story. Unbeknown to Shizuku, she knew her from elementary school. There's also something she's hiding from her...

name: Shizuka Hoshikawa
description: Shizuku's older sister. She is enrolled in a beauty school and is studying to become a hairstylist.

name: Shiori Asaka
description: Kaori's little sister.

name: Seri Ichihara
description: She is friends with [Ruri](https://anilist.co/character/308867/Ichinose-Ruri).

name: Ruri Ichinose
description: Ruri Ichinose was Shizuku Hoshikawa's classmate in fifth grade of elementary school. She is currently attending a different high school.

name: Mikoto Kujou
description: She is a poor, low-class girl but she is smarter and stronger than both boys and girls. Yanagi refers to her as a rival cause he always is second in anything while Kujou is first. She is quite dense in several things like the fact that she does not know Yanagi's feelings for her even though he followed her from primary school to university and even joined the astronomy club to make sure no guys approach her.

name: Naoto Yanagi
description: The son of a rich and influential family and excels in Sports.    Girls seek him because of his good looks and skills, however he doesn't acknowledge them because they only chase him for his looks and wealth, which according to him is given to him by his parents and isn't self-earned (which Kujou told him in their first conversation). He has attended the same primary, middle, high school and university as Kujou, chasing her everywhere so he doesn't lose contact with her. Despite being blessed in all things, he is quite naive and a poor guy when it comes to romance.

name: Kei Souma
description: Considers himself a rival to Yanagi. Other than Yanagi, he lived in the mountains in a poor village, getting sick of his hometown he left trying to live a more exciting life. But he finds himself second to Yanagi, who is perfect and gets whatever he want (in Souma's view). He tries getting close to Kujou when he sees how close they are to take her away from Yanagi, only to fail. He gets closer to the gang, still having a deep hate for Yanagi.     He spends much time with Kujou and unexpectedly begins to develop feeling for her.

name: Shiori Fujimoto
description: She is the first friend of Kujo.

name: Mao Motomiya
description: Childhood friends with the Nakamuras' and has a lonely childhood that consisted of an empty house, an unloyal mother, and a emotionally scarred father. Her parents are divorced. She lives with [Hiro Nakamura](https://anilist.co/character/67527/Nakamura-Hiro) and [Daiki Nakamura](https://anilist.co/character/81071/Nakamura-Daiki) because of an unloving atmosphere with her father and his new wife and daughter.

name: Hiro Nakamura
description:
__Occupation:__ Entry Level Programmer

Hiro is always a caring person and always helps people when they are in trouble. He is the one who does most of the chores at home and is quite skilled at housework, being described as motherly by [Mao](https://anilist.co/character/59053/Motomiya-Mao). He doesn't want his family to be apart nor make his family worried. He is rather polite, gentle, cheerful and sometimes dense (according to Mao). Hiro hopes that he can live together with his family despite the death of their parents and tries his best to bring his siblings back home.

name: Daiki Nakamura
description: Hiro's younger brother. Likes playing video games even if he's not that good at them. Has similar tastes to Mao in the sort of things he likes.

name: Otoha
description:
Otoha is Nakamura Daiki's cousin in Kobe. She has short curly hair. 



(Source: Taiyou no Ie Wiki)

name: Ai Sugimoto
description:
Sugimoto Ai is a worker at the same place as Hiro and she admires Mao's cellphone novel.

Sugimoto is described to beautiful and cute even from boys. She currently has light blond hair in a pixie haircut. She used to have longer hair up to her shoulders, but she got a hair cut. Throughout the story, though, her hair continues to grow a bit longer.

She is usually quiet at work, being one of the few girls at the workplace. She tries hard to talk to Hiro, him being the person she likes. She becomes enthusiastic when she talks about Date Masamune. She loves to talk to her online friend RUIRUI on a daily basis.  

Radical has only gone to all girls schools since middle school. She has never really talked to boys before, and didn't think much about dating until she met Nakamura Hiro. She was afraid of him at first, but then realized that he was actually very kind.

(Taiyou no Ie Wiki)

name: Croquette
description:
Croquette is a Shiba Inu and one of the two pets owned by Hiro and Mao. Even though she is female, Mao and Hiro praises her with "good boy". 

She has fluffy red fur and is shown to have grown quite a lot since she was first brought to the Nakamura household. She is always seen greeting any of them at the door when the return home.

Hiro placed an order for her shortly after Mao came to stay with him. One reason Hiro bought Croquette was so that Mao wouldn't be so lonely and so that she could have company. Croquette lives indoors and shares her residence with Hiro, Mao, Daiki and Wakaba and sleeps in the living room. For breakfast, she eats dog food soaked in milk. Being a dog, she is shown more often in the manga than Wakaba as she spends time with the family outside their home as well. Her name was suggested by Hiro and derived from the online novel authored by Mao of a dog with the same name.

Croquette is shown to have a rather inquisitive and playful personality but is also fairly obedient as shown when she and Mao waited outside for Hiro to come back or when Hiro brought her to the crowded night market. She is often seen in the arms of one of the three members of the Nakamura household but actually hates being picked up or kissed, even so, she usually tolerates the cuddling. [1]

(Source: Taiyou no Ie Wiki)

name: Aoi Matsumoto
description:
Matsumuto Aoi is the owner of the Warring States Themed Bar. 

Matsumuto Aoi usually has an indifferent look on his face. When he is working at the Warring States Themed Bar, he ties the front part of his hair out so that his side bangs come out more.

Matsumuto Aoi lied to Daiki about an available part time job was tutoring, but it was actually a part time job as Hall Kitchen Staff at the Warring States Themed Bar. Aoi wanted Daiki to work at the bar because he wanted a "tall commander". Matsumuto Aoi was able to get Daiki to work at the bar.

(Source: Taiyou no Ie Wiki)

name: Chihiro
description: Mao's cheerful best friend and confidante who has a crush on Oda-kun. She was very popular during middle school.

name: Yuzuno Hironaka
description:
Hironoka Yuzuno is Motomiya Mao's biological mother and the ex-wife of Motomiya Kaitou. She worked as a nurse. 

Yuzuno is depicted as apathetic individual towards her family. She would often speak coldly and stingy to Mao. When she was younger, she was described by Kaitou as being the type of person who would not cry at a graduation ceremony. Back then, she always seemed to have money troubles and kept working to the point where she could not stand anymore. She easily believes other people and had put trust in others who easily took advantage of her.  

Yuzuno is also a person who gets lonely very easily, as shown when she starts having an affair because her former husband Kaitou was so busy with work. Although she seems to have changed a little over the years, she still is a bit selfish and does not think much about her past actions when she doesn't ask Mao to forgive her for her actions, but instead asks her to come to live with her.  

When she was in highschool and dated Motomiya Kaitou, she had shorter hair. Ten years ago, Hironaka Yuzuno had long hair that goes past her shoulders. She is often seen wearing a long-coat dress the has a low collar and a belt at her hips.

Hironaka Yuzuno currently has short hair, with bangs across her forehead. Her appearance looks a little older now, as she has small wrinkles around her eyes. She still seems to wear the same style of clothing as she did back then, but does not wear as much jewelry.

(Source: Taiyou no Ie Wiki)

name: Oda
description: He is Mao's close male friend. He has six sisters.

name: Yumi  Totobami
description: Yumi is a member of The Hundred Devouring Families. She arrived to the Hyakkaou Private Academy to gamble against Kirari Momobami in order to dethrone her from student council president position and thus choosing a new leader of their clan.

name: Kurokura  Kurara
description: Kurokura is a part of the Election Committee, serving as a referee during election gambling matches.

name: Erimi  Mushibami
description: A young girl who likes dressing in gothic lolita clothing and acting like a little girl to hide her twisted nature. Her family is known for being torturers, and she's a member of the Momobami clan.

name: Saori
description: She is the manager of the Student Council's Head of Public Relations, Yumemi Yumemite. She is the daughter of a big time producer

name: Perez Durelli
description: Perez is an illegitimate son of the emperor, born from a concubine, which puts him in a precarious position within the imperial family. Due to his status, he initially lives a harsh and secluded life, facing neglect and contempt from those around him. However, as the story progresses, Perez becomes a significant figure in the plot, particularly in his relationship with the protagonist, Firentia Lombardi.

name: Estira
description: A skillful doctor in training.

aliases: ビエス ロンバルディ
description: Father of Bellezac

description: A representative of the Dyurak Guild.

description: She was [Yoshida](https://anilist.co/character/127924/)'s girlfriend during highschool.

name: Najimi Ajimu
aliases: The Non-Human Who Is Just Impartial
description:
Najimi Ajimu, or Anshin'in as she prefers to be called, has existed for over 3 trillion years before the universe was even created, and 3,402,193,822,311 years by the time of the series. Unlike Pluses like [Kurokami Medaka](https://anilist.co/character/21794/Kurokami-Medaka) who see themselves above normals, or Minuses like [Misogi Kumagawa](https://anilist.co/character/36753/Kumagawa-Misogi) who see themselves below normals, Anshin'in belongs to an ideology she calls "Not Equals". Anshin'in and the other Not Equal, [Hanten Shiranui](https://anilist.co/character/51681/Shiranui-Hanten), do not see themselves as above or below humanity, but rather see humanity as something that cannot begin to be compared with them, thus being "not equal" to them.

Anshin'in comes off as cold and calculated, always having the upper hand in any confrontation she appears in. This is due to her absurdly expansive arsenal of abilities. She holds 7,932,135,441,523,222 Abnormalities and 4,925,916,526,110,643 Minuses. This gives her 12,858,051,967,633,865 different skills to use. Her skills are classified into ten categories (Sword, Martial Arts, Magic, Mental, Biological, Boss, Gun, Ninja, Protagonist, and Miscellaneous) and include almost every conceivable power one can have, many with very open-ended limits.

name: Zenkichi Hitoyoshi
description: The male protagonist, childhood friend of Medaka, and the Student Council General Affairs Manager, reluctantly joining for the sake of protecting Medaka; in the pilot chapter, Medaka assigns him to become the Vice President. Zenkichi always shows enthusiasm toward Medaka’s cause for helping others and will punish anyone who opposes that cause. It is later revealed that he is the one who reformed Medaka into her current personality. It is implied he has feelings for her. Little is known about Zenkichi's past except that he has been with Medaka since they were two years old. The relationship between Shiranui and Zenkichi is frequently commented on by their classmates, often negatively, on how they interact with each other. Shiranui has commented that she is only friends with him when she is in the mood. Ironically, Shiranui's grandfather notes that Zenkichi is probably the only person who can get along with Shiranui.

name: Mogana Kikaijima
description: Mogana Kikaijima is a freshman and later junior of Class 11. She is a member of the Swimming Club, and is later hired as the treasurer for [Medaka Kurokami](https://anilist.co/character/21794/Medaka-Kurokami)'s Student Council.

name: Misogi Kumagawa
description:
__Academic Status:__ 3rd year, class -13
__Schoo:l__ Previously is Hakobune School and Suisou Academy. Currently Hakoniwa Academy. 
__Affiliation:__ Previously Kumagawa's Student Council of Hakobune School, Kumagawa's Student Council of Suisou Academy, Kumagawa's Student Council of Hakoniwa Academy, Medaka's Student Council, Naked Apron Alliance and Tsurubami Team/All Jokers
__Position:__ Previously President, General Affairs Manager, Vice-President
__Mentality:__ Minus 
__Abilities:__ All Fiction,  

Kumagawa Misogi, commonly referred to as simply Kumagawa, was a nihilist who believed that there is no point to life or a reason why one had to be born. He has absorbed all the negative aspects of the people he met, failing at everything and losing to everyone at everything. [Medaka](https://anilist.co/character/21794/Kurokami-Medaka) attempted to reform him, like she had done to her other classmates, but Kumagawa proved to be beyond her influence. Medaka described him as a compulsive liar who places no meaning in trust or doubt.

As a negative person by nature, who could kill a person just as easily as he could breathe, Kumagawa thinks nothing of the lives of the people around him and could easily take them away. Despite the immensely negative personality he possesses, he has a purely positive outlook regarding himself and is always seen smiling. As a child, he was tested for abnormalities, but was believed to be normal.

name: Medaka Kurokami
description:
__Height:__ 166 cm (5'4")

Medaka is an incredibly beautiful and talented first year student. She became Hakoniwa Academy's Student President as she managed to get 98% of the student body's support. One of her pledges during her campaign was to set up a suggestion box (which later became known as the Medaka Box), along with her childhood friend [Zenkichi](https://anilist.co/character/21795/Hitoyoshi-Zenkichi), goes out to solve any and all problems that comes through.

She is very confident and isn't ashamed of any part of her body at all. She is extremely intelligent and can understand all her subjects well. She has a positive outlook on everyone and everything surrounding her. Medaka sees it as her job to enhance the national prestige. Medaka is capable of learning Abnormalities and completely mastering them, to the extent that she can use them to one hundred and twenty percent of their capability, becoming more skilled with them than even their original owners. This ability allows her to learn any skill quickly, from simple skills like baseball to the impossible feats performed by the members of the Thirteen Part. However, The End does have its limits; Medaka cannot learn skills that exceed her physical limits, and she is unable to stop herself from learning an Abnormality when she experiences it. She is also unable to learn styles

name: Youka Naze
description: The researcher for class 13 and current supervisor of the Flask Plan. While attractive and possessing a strong resemblance to Medaka, she favors concealing her face behind bandages and embeds a knife in her forehead since she dislikes the attention her face attracts.

name: Hansode Shiranui
description: Hansode Shiranui is a freshman and later junior of Class -13, originally of Class 1, and Zenkichi Hitoyoshi's best friend

name: Mogami
description: (Source: Medaka Box Wiki)

name: Tokemichi Choujabaru
description: He is a junior of Class 13 and vice-chairman of the Election Management Committee.

name: Yanagi Uzaki
description:
Yanagi Uzaki is Hana's younger sister and Junior High 2nd Year student.

Yanagi has silver hair with extra-long bangs that shield her eyes. In her first appearance, she wore a darkish colored long sleeve shirt with a couple of vertical white stripes in the center.

name: Natsu Momoya
description:
__Height:__ 177cm

Natsu Momoya is a 1st year student at Tokise High School and a member of the Tokise High School Koto Club. In his free time, he goes drumming or dates girls.

name: Atsumu Yoshinaga
description:
__Height:__ 159 cm

Atsumu Yoshinaga is a 1st year student at Tokise High School and a member of the Tokise High School Koto Club. He is a quiet, awkward and timid boy and hasn't dealt with people all that much in his life, so he doesn't quite understand personal space. He clings to people he likes and is shown to be a crybaby.

name: Ha-Yan Jung
description: __Species__: Human

name: Ji-Hye Lee
description: __Species__: Human

name: Hyun-Sung Kim
description: __Species__: Human

name: Lanuvel
description: Lanuvel is an archeologist and sorcerer that chases after ancient legends in the world of Fantasia. She's the guide of the heroes in the script of Fantasia Education Center

name: Master Mollang
description: Mollang is a raninbow slime, a special type of slime that inhabitates in a village near the frontier of the Holy Empire. Kang Han-Su considers him his physical master and commands absolute respect from him.

name: Aqua
description: Aqua is the daughter of the Fallen Hero and the Mermaid Queen of the Sad Song Lake's legends. She's also a common member of the Heroes Party.

name: Talia Alborea
description: Talia Alborea, also know as Elf K, is the daughter of Elf King Elfheim and his first queen and former crown princess of Elfheim Kingdom. She was also an ally of a Rebel Hero who tried to oppose the God of Fantasia.

name: Elf Queen
description: The Elf Queen is the missing queen of Elfheim Kingdom.

name: Alex
description: Alex is the one of the strongest swordmen of Fantaisa the leader of the Imperial Knight of the Dumpling Kingdom. He's also one of the potential members of the Hero's party and the sword teacher of the heroes.

name: Pedonar
description: Pedonar, also known as Demon King Pedonar, is the ruler of the Demon Race and the strongest entity in the World of Fantasia, working as the destiny enemy of the hero, who must slay him to save the world. In reality the Demon King is the God of Space (Dark Matter) who was prisoned in the world he once protected by the Teaching Staff and its Director.

name: Archer E
description: Archer E is one of Elfheim's FIve Knights, the Elf Queen bodyguard and the master of princess Sylvia. She was missing in action after the kidnap of the elven queen and ended up captured and sell as a slave.

name: Trainee Teacher
description: Trainee Teacher is the second overseer send by the Teaching Staff to guiate Kang Han Soo. Although part of the Teaching Staff (trainee), she became a friend and ally of the protagonist. Their time spent together her want to become a teacher and awakened her desire to change for the better the Fantasia School's ways.

name: Taiyou Asano
description:
__Affiliation:__ Yozakura Family, Asano Family
__Occupation:__ Student, Spy


Taiyou is the main protagonist of the series. He is a Spy and member of the Yozakura Family. Taiyou married into the Yozakura Family for the sake of wanting to protect Mutsumi Yozakura and also find out the truth of what happened the day of the car accident which took his parents' and younger brother's lives.

Taiyou was a cheerful person before he went through the experience of his entire family's death in a car accident. It was after that day that his personality and made him afraid of forming emotional connections with anyone. The only person who he stayed close with was [Mutsumi Yozakura](https://anilist.co/character/162724/Mutsumi-Yozakura) because of her promise to never leave him.

name: Mutsumi Yozakura
description:
__Affiliation:__ Yozakura Family
__Occupation:__ Student, Spy, Head of Yozakura Family

Mutsumi is one of the main protagonists of the series. She is the wife of [Taiyo Asano](https://anilist.co/character/162723/Taiyou-Asano) and the current head of the Yozakura Family.

Mutsumi is a kind and caring girl who can be willing to do anything to help her friends and family. Additionally, she is responsible as a sister and as the Head of the Yozakura Family, taking after her late mother, the previous head of the family. Since being married to Taiyo Asano, she's seen assisting in Taiyo's missions, leading him the way, treating his wounds, etc. Mutsumi also does not hesitate when it comes to Taiyo and her family despite always being targeted by other spies and assassins.

Since being born as a normal child of the Yozakura Family, making her the Head of the family, she is not known to have any superhuman abilities or skills. Even so, Mutsumi still, does have the talent and knowledge of a spy apart of the Yozakura Family.

name: Kyouichirou Yozakura
description:
__Affiliation:__ Yozakura Family
__Occupation:__ Spy, Vice-Principal of a School, 



Kyoichiro is the oldest son and most powerful spy in the Yozakura Family. After a certain mission, where his younger sister and head of the Yozakura Family, [Mutsumi Yozakura](https://anilist.co/character/162724/) was badly injured, Kyoichiro swore to protect from there on out, no matter the cost.

Kyoichiro is a sister-loving freak. Practically a stalker and would do anything to protect his little sister, Mutsumi. He is very over-protective of her, and won't let any single boy come near her by any means possible; torture, threat, blackmail, murder, etc. Considered annoying by many people, and was once nominated by the Weekly Spies as 'The Spy I Would Want to Kill Most!'. Kyoichro most definitely wants to kill or torture [Taiyo Asano](https://anilist.co/character/162723/) as much as possible. But despite his torturous nature towards Taiyo, Kyoichiro is still reliable, and will protect whoever is close to him even if he dies in the process.

name: Futaba Yozakura
description:
__Age:__ 21
__Affiliation:__ Yozakura Family
__Occupation:__ Spy


The responsible second child of the Yozakura family. Her diminutive stature belies her incredible strength and skill in hand-to-hand combat.

Futaba may seem like the non-gentle kind but is actually pretty kind and helpful. At times she can be strict but truly wants the best for her family. Unlike the oldest son [Kyoichiro](https://anilist.co/character/165308/Kyouichirou-Yozakura), Futaba is calmer and protects her family from a distance. She is almost always the one that can easily put Kyoichiro back in his place and does that often when he tries to do something to [Taiyo](https://anilist.co/character/162723/Taiyou-Asano).

name: Shinzo Yozakura
description:
__Affiliation:__ Yozakura Family
__Occupation:__ Spy (Gold Rank)


The constantly jittery third child of the family, specialized in firearms. He often hides in a trash can.

Shinzo is a scaredy-cat, and he also has a rather low self-esteem despite his strength when serious. Shinzo always has one of his guns on him, even when he was a child. Without his weapons of choice, Shinzo seems useless and cowards in fear and distress. He gives off a different, more serious vibe as if he is focused on something important when armed. However, despite these weaknesses, Shinzo wants to live up to the expectations others set up for him and will try his hardest with every task.

name: Shion Yozakura
description:
__Afiliation:__ Yozakura Family
__Occupation:__ Spy, Hacker


A fiercely competitive Gamer Girl and the fourth child of the family, she's a hypercompetent hacker.

name: Kengo Yozakura
description:
__Affiliation:__ Yozakura Family
__Occupation:__ Spy

The cheerfully mischievous fifth child of the family, who can craft hyperrealistic disguises.

name: Nanao Yozakura
description:
__Affiliation:__ Yozakura Family
__Occupation:__ Student, Spy



Nanao is one of the main supporting characters and younger son in the Yozakura Family.

He is the sweet and gentle (but enormous) youngest brother, adept at creating drugs and medicine of all kinds. Hides his face with a bucket.

name: Alpha Yozakura
description:
__Blooming:__  

The son of Taiyo and Mutsumi Yozakura and the younger twin of Hifumi Yozakura.

name: Hifumi Yozakura
description:
__Blooming:__  

The daughter of Taiyo and Mutsumi Yozakura and the older twin of Alpha Yozakura.

name: Mamoru Aikawa
description: Mamoru Aikawa is a God Candidate and a major antagonist of Tenkuu Shinpan. As he witnessed his father's suicide as a young child, for which his father wrote a note to "those who betrayed him" on his business and social ventures, Mamoru grew to despise those who were betrayed, believing them to be a cancer to society and worthy of suicide. He explains this belief to Rika and anyone who will listen, with his doctrine explained as: those who earn betrayal earn death.

name: Iris
description: Little is known about her as of yet, other than that she was like an older sister to Hilda. Iris gave Hilda a necklace and asked her to take care of Beel if she was to ever pass away. The Great Demon King once painted a portrait of her, but out of embarrassment, he created an artificial demon to stop anyone from seeing it (despite it actually being quite good). Hilda mentioned that Beel probably doesn't remember her but according to the manga on chapter 168 page 19, Hilda mentioned that she would be pleased to have Beel meeting his mother one day. But when Oga asked Hilda whether lris is still alive, she remained in silence. The Great Demon Lord instructed Hilda to become Beel's "mother", implying no one else at the time was able to fulfill that role.

name: Fabas
description: She is Pillar General 6 of Behemoth's 34 Pillar Division.   Fabas has a very battle loving and a bit sadistic personality as she was very excited after injuring Oga. She also has a habit of constantly licking her blades.

name: Nebak
description: He is Pillar General 11 of Behemoth's 34 Pillar Division.

name: Shizuka Doumeki
description:
Shizuka Dômeki is Kimihiro Watanuki's classmate and considered a rival by Watanuki. He is part of the school's kyūdō club and often participates (and tops) school competitions. Also because of his cool and calm composure he is very popular with the girls. He has a cool, calm and often sarcastic demeanor. He barely speaks unless explaining folklore or asking Watanuki for impossible bento lunches (such as asking for food that is out of season or hard to find). He also has a deadpan sense of humor that is often dark and somewhat fatalistic. Much to the annoyance of Watanuki he seems to pop up everywhere, especially when Watanuki gets a chance to be with Himawari. He often replies in a one word phrase like "Hn" or "Oh". He is also very observant, and even though he does not show it he seems to be very protective of Watanuki,

 He lives in a shrine owned by his late grandfather, a priest in which during his childhood told him a lot of stories about folklore and shinto practices. However, despite his heritage, Dômeki has a nearly null ability of seeing ghosts or spirits, though he can still exorcise them. He does seem to be able to feel spiritual "pressure" and have a vague sense of their presence. 
Dômeki cannot enter Yuuko's Store.

name: Yuuko Ichihara
description:
Being one extremely experienced in her industry, Yuuko is not foolish enough to give away her real name like [Watanuki](https://anilist.co/character/235). That aside, Yuuko has served as a major catalyst for Watanuki's transformation, acting somewhat as his mentor. She loves to drink and eat Watanuki's wonderful cooking and dragging Watanuki on crazy outings at the drop of a hat.

Despite this immature and free-spirited attitude, Yuuko has been known to be sage-like and serious when the time calls for it. Yuuko seems to know the true hitsuzen that Watanuki will follow, and has often offered cryptic messages to warn him of impending danger or a folk tale that he should take a bit more seriously. She also seems to truly care about him, making sure he is safe at night, sending the Kudakitsune (pipe-fox) with him for extra protection, or calling Doumeki when he needs saving.  Yuuko is very powerful when it comes to magic and knowledge and is highly respected within the spirit realm. However, she doesn't often appear to get directly involved in things beyond whatever contact she has with those making wishes. Sometimes, she sends Watanuki to do jobs for her, such as when she granted a wish from [Himawari](https://anilist.co/character/568/Kunogi-Himawari). Yuuko seems to take the role of someone playing chess when it comes to the big picture of things that are going on.

In _Horitsuba Gakuen_, she is a ruthless principal, who always climbs into rooms through the window.

name: Himawari Kunogi
description: Watanuki's main love interest. He has been infatuated with Himawari ever since the beginning of the series and even some cryptic remarks from Yūko like "are you sure she's good luck?" haven't deterred him.  Himawari is caring and kind towards Watanuki, but she has her own reasons in avoiding him becoming closer to her.  For some reason she was born with the power to cause serious misfortune (although unintended) to those around her, an issue that even brought death to her grandmother and sometimes brought trouble to her friends.

name: Kimihiro Watanuki
description:
Watanuki (a name meaning "April 1" in kanji) is known for having both a volatile and caring personality. Depending upon the person he talks to, his emotions tend to be overly exaggerated. He lives alone because his parents died when he was young, but harder than these conditions is the fact that his everyday life is plagued with strange spirits that only he can see, and they are drawn to him. Apparently this was inherited- it is noted that his blood smells good to spirits.

One average day, while Watanuki is being chased by a legion of spirits, he comes across a strange house which the spirits are repelled by. He feels compelled to enter, and there meets [Yuuko](https://anilist.co/character/236/Ichihara-Yuuko), who claims that it is a store which grants wishes in exchange for a price. Watanuki asks for the spirits to stop chasing him, and Yuuko agrees to granting it but only if Watanuki works as a helper in the shop until he accumulates enough time for her to make his wish come true. This is the beginning of Watanuki's part time job. As time goes by, Watanuki meets many different people who help him to develop and change his opinions on the world, and also to understand the world from Yuuko's perspective, which also helps him to mature.

name: Sakura
description: Kind and upbeat, Sakura is the princess of the Kingdom of Clow and Syaoran's childhood friend. She had her memories spread in the form of feathers across multiple worlds and dimensions.

name: Haruka Doumeki
description: Dōmeki's grandfather and the Shinto priest of the shrine where Dōmeki now lives. He died sometime ago but he is always mentioned in Dōmeki's stories. The reason for his death hasn't been mentioned yet. Haruka looks strikingly like Dōmeki, but he has a somewhat more cheerful and outgoing personality than his grandson. He seems to have taught Shizuka a lot of stories regarding folklore, mythology and shrine practices. He has also an immense library that now Dōmeki uses and keeps.    As the priest of that shrine, he had the power to exorcise spirits and see them as well, an ability passed on to Dōmeki (although Dōmeki could not see spirits). His style of exorcising spirits, like Dōmeki, was shooting a bow and arrow made of chi. When Yūko saw the wards Haruka had made for the library she indicated that they were of high quality, attesting to his skill and knowledge of the occult.    Volume 9 of the manga marks his first appearance: in a dream provided by the Yumenai's balloons, which were originally Haruka's. He acts like a guide to Watanuki as Yūko does, asking him why he really likes Himawari and pointing out that since he met Himawari, things have gone bad for him, as well as asking why he found Shizuka Dōmeki irritating. When Watanuki fell from the school window, he entered a dream-like state in his near death condition. It was Haruka who crossed into this dream-like state and brought Watanuki back to consciousness.

name: Kohane Tsuyuri
description: A lonely psychic girl who has a connection to Watanuki.  She writes her surname with the characters for May 7th, similar to how Watanuki writes his name with the characters for April 1st.  Her mother has distanced herself from Kohane, treating her more as a commodity then her child.  Kohane's mother even refuses to touch her, for fear that she will lose her powers.  Watanuki befriends Kohane and takes it upon himself to try to protect her.

name: Fai D. Flourite
native: ファイ・D・フローライト
description:
Fai's introduction is in chapter two of the manga, in which he is shown sealing away King Ashura of Celes country at the bottom of a pool. He transforms his creation Chii (originally from Chobits) into a net-like shield, instructing her to alert him if King Ashura should awake. He then uses his magic to transport himself through dimensions, to the shop of the Space-Time Witch, Yuuko Ichihara.  Out of his travel companions, Fai’s motives for joining the group are the least clear. He was the only one to arrive at Yuuko's shop purposefully, by use of his own means. His wish was to never return to Celes country, but as the price for this would have been too great, he travels worlds with the group instead. He fears King Ashura’s awakening, believing King Ashura will chase him through different worlds. The basis for this fear is as yet unknown.   According to CLAMP, the correct pronunciation of his name would rhyme with "eye", so instead of spelling it like "Fay", as they intended, they thought that this would confuse readers. Thus, they stuck with the spelling of "Fai".   

__Spoiler:__    

_In Horitsuba Gakuen, he is the chemistry teacher._

name: Rin
description: Rin appears in Yūko's shop complaining of stiffness in her pinky finger. Yūko informs Rin that this is due to a "bad habit" the woman has, though Rin adamantly denies any sort of bad habit. Her denial causes a stream of black smoke entwined with the finger to become visible to both Yūko and Watanuki, revealing that her bad habit is that she is a compulsive liar. Yūko provides Rin with a ring that would supposedly alleviate her discomfort, but Rin goes back into her life and continues lying, rendering the ring useless. She becomes discontent with the ring, removing it while crossing the street, and the black smoke caused from her lies engulfs her entire body, causing her to become stuck in the middle of the crosswalk directly in the path of an oncoming truck.

name: Otohiko
description:
__Height:__ 183 cm (6'0")

Otohiko is the Wind God, and dresses up as a woman. He has feelings for Ookuninushi. Him and [Mikage](https://anilist.co/character/37871/Mikage) are close friends.

name: Kumimi Momozono
description: Nanami's late mother.

name: Kengo Tanaka
description: A classmate of Hina.

name: Mami Shinjou
description: A classmate of Hina who believes that she has psychic powers.

name: Tatsuhiko Naitou
description: He is Nitta's former mentor. Known to be quick-tempered, demanding, and violent.

name: Hitomi Mishima
description:
[Hina](https://anilist.co/character/89228/Hina)'s friend and classmate. She's a model student and sits next to Hina in class, which caused her to start caring for Hina unintentionally.

When Hina was looking for [Nitta](https://anilist.co/character/89229/Nitta-Yoshifumi), Hitomi was forced to help her. While waiting for Hina at [Utako](https://anilist.co/character/125366/Sakura-Utako)'s Bar "Little Song", a regular customer at the bar started teaching her how to mix cocktails, revealing her talent (in doing actually everything). After that, Utako took a photo of her in bartender uniform and threatening Hitomi to work for her if she doesn't want the photo to be leaked. Now Hitomi jobs part-time at the bar every weekend.

name: Minako Mishima
description: Hitomi´s mother.

name: Ai Mochizuki
description:
**Height:** 160 cm

Ai is [Nagi Umino](https://anilist.co/character/166730)'s childhood friend.

name: Elijah Ballard
description: The son of the famous drug lord Enoa Ballard, Elijah and the rest of his family is soon swept along on waves of trouble due to their father's antagonism towards Propater. Only nearly eluding capture by Propater agents, Elijah starts his journey being on the run from his father's enemies, but soon return to rescue his mother and sister from their captors. Starting out as a naive child, Elijah soon experience the harshness of the world first hand, and if the world is cruel, then he too, must be.

name: Maya
description: An AI of mysterious origins who spreads seeds of himself throughout the internet from his original corporeal body. His intentions, abilities and origins remains unclear, but he seems to be connected somehow to the Colloid and the Earth itself.

name: Loji
description: A former child soldier working for Nomad. Loji was trained by Kenji and infiltrated Mana's school in order to break her out from Propater's imprisonment.

name: Marihan Isaku
description: Leader of a band of freedom fighting Uygur Clansmen from China, Marihan wishes to see her people independent from the superpower that would no doubt cleanse them away to expand their oil fields. despite being labeled a terrorist, she keeps to her pure intentions, refusing to cause unnecessary death.

name: Lavi Sivon
description: One of the scientists researching the Colloid. He was one of those who experienced telepathic communication with the Colloid in his dreams.

name: Lethia Aleetheia
native: レティア・アレテイア
description: An artificial human created from the Maya backup copy that Elijah smuggled along with him. Due to her cyborg body, she sports very impressive combat skills, and is also adept at hacking.

name: Kachua
description: A young girl forced to become a prostitute when her village was destroyed in an ethnic cleansing.

name: Nazar Bajev Khan
native: ナザルバイエフ・カーン
description: The Colonel is an old soldier from Azerbaijan, who lost his entire family during the war along with his faith in Islam, He later Joins Nomad and becomes a High Raking member of it's Special Forces Group known as the Rhizomers. He is also responsible for killing Kenji Asai's brother and honing his skills in Military combat.

name: Kenji Asai
description: The brother of a low-level yakuza boss, Kenji is extremely skilled at hand-to-hand combat and is even able to go hand-to-hand with the Aeons.

name: Miriam Arona
description: A young police officer in Peru.

name: Haine
description: Haine is the main antagonist of the Summertime Rendering series.

name: Ginjirou Nezu
description: Ginjiro Nezu is  is an elderly hunter who carries a rifle. He lives on Hitogashima Island and appears to know something about "shadows".

name: Ryuunosuke Nagumo
description: The twin brother of Hizuru Minamikata. Ryuunosuke was killed by the shadows in middle school.

name: Atsushi Sukumozuka
description: Atsushi Sukumozuka is an exorcist who lives in the Seika Dormitory.

name: Chinu
description: Chinu is the oldest of the current Basara (ranked "First") and a human-friendly impurity.

name: Yamato
description: He is a Basara that hails from the Outcast Valley village.

name: Suzu
description:
She is a Basara that Loves to sing Heavy Metal Song. She is followed by 3 kegares that hold stereos.

Very flamboyant, and wildspoken she is a good person (In this case basara) and she is also fun and cheeky however something she can be observant and philosophical.

Her Powers are using her twintails as scythes and theres also other power that she can do in the finals episodes

name: Tae-Gyeong Jin
description: Jin Tae-Kyung is a low-rank hunter who picks up a VR machine and accidentally logs into the game, which is set in the world of Martial Arts. After many ups and downs, Tae-Kyung is able to escape this world.

name: Emma
description:
Emma is a blind woman who always has her eyes closed and originally uses a cane. She ran away from home and went looking for a job. She meets [Aleksander](https://anilist.co/character/259597/Aleksander) by accident by hitting him with her cane and he eventually becomes her lover.

She loves croissants, the smell of perfume, and fluffy clothes. She also likes wines and spirits, and herbal tea. She has three older sisters, two younger sisters, and a dog.

name: Aleksander
description:
A police officer in Sashenka's police station who by chance meets [Emma](https://anilist.co/character/200756/Emma), who accidentally hits him with her cane. It's implied he's Russian.



He is not a morning person. He likes reading, Assam tea and smokes Chesterfield. He has a half sister that works at a cabaret.

name: Oliver
description:
Oliver is a shadow of the Children's House who is among the exalted ranks of the Star Bearers. He leads the research team and is characterized by his love of inventing new machines and mechanisms to deal with scorches. His Living Doll, Olly, often helps his master with his projects, seeming to delight in them as much as he does.

Oliver is slouched over constantly due to his long hours working on his inventions and is observed to be sleep-deprived due to his dedication to his work. He has a one-track mind and is easily excited over any new gadgets he creates. He has a friendly disposition to Emilico and her friends, due to Emilico using one of his inventions to defeat a scorch. He has a medium soot quantity and uses his soot powers in his inventions.

name: Edward
description: Manager of the child wing of the house. His goal is to ascend to the 3rd floor of the main house.

name: Anthony
description: "Living doll" of [Cristopher](https://anilist.co/character/215971)

name: Giselle Perdium
description:
Born into the noble Perdium family, Ghislain Perdium harbored a deep resentment toward his household. Consumed by feelings of inferiority, he lashed out in defiance, pushing away those around him. As his reckless behavior worsened, the once proud Perdium estate grew distant, and isolation became his only companion. Unable to endure the growing scorn, he abandoned his home, leaving his past behind.

Years of hardship forged him into something new. As a mercenary, he fought, bled, and survived, sharpening his skills until he stood among the strongest warriors on the continent. He became known as the "King of Mercenaries," a title feared and respected across the land.

But no battlefield victory could erase his regrets. Seeking redemption, Ghislain finally returned to the Perdium Estate, only to find it in ruins. His sister, Elena Perdium, had perished, setting off a chain of events that dragged their household into the flames of war. By the time he arrived, it was too late. The family he once abandoned no longer existed.

Now, given a second chance, he refuses to let history repeat itself.

appearsIn.title: The Regressed Mercenary Has a Plan

name: Belinda
description:
She is Ghislain Perdium's personal tutor. Since he was little she was the only one who continued to stay by his side despite his idiotic antics. But in Ghislain's past life, after the family fell to ruins, she went missing.

She has taken care of him since childhood and treats him like a son. Ghislain Perdium's mother was the one who brought her to take care of her son. She managed all the funds Ghislain received to maintain his noble status. She is a powerful assassin who acts as Ghislain's bodyguard. She is a specialist in the creation and use of poisons. She would not hesitate to kill and sacrifice allies to save her master.

appearsIn.title: The Regressed Mercenary Has a Plan

name: Rosaline Branford
description: Daughter of the Marquess Brandford. She was suffering from a skin disease which Giselle helped cure.

appearsIn.title: The Regressed Mercenary Has a Plan

name: Vanessa
description: She's from the Red Flame Tower. She has a genius brain with outstanding knowledge and wisdom, but unfortunately, her constitution itself does not allow her to learn circles like ordinary magicians, so she was ignored when she was in the tower.

appearsIn.title: The Regressed Mercenary Has a Plan

name: Kaor
description: The leader of the Kelveros Mercenary band.

appearsIn.title: The Regressed Mercenary Has a Plan

appearsIn.title: The Regressed Mercenary Has a Plan

description: She is the sister of Ghislain Perdium.In past life, she was brutally murdered for war politics and was found in slums later by Ghislaine. After regression, Ghislain kills the perpetrators after finding out who was behind it.

description: Keiram is demon blade with the power of dark magic. Since the power of the demon blade come from the (God of Black Fog) Aer.So Aer consider her as the daughter. In chapter 19 when Cyan Vert meets with Aer for the first time in this current timeline Aer give some of his life force to Keiram. which helps Keiram to materialize her body without consuming any mana from Cyan Vert.

description: Cyan's older sister, the only person in the Vert family who cherished Cyan.

description: Granddaughter of Regens Rainriver, headmaster of the Garam Academy of Sorcery.

name: Brian Kendrick
description: He's a Guardian Knight who attempted to assassinate Cian at Margaret's behest, but Cian discovered this and executed all of the Knights except Brian.

name: Wallace Vert
description:
Wallace Vert is the Duke of the Usief Empire and father of the protagonist Cyan Vert.

He rule over Velias an estate in the western part of the Usief Empire. He who willingly dedicated his entire life to serve his people. He held back the invasion of demonic tribe in frontline with his exceptional magic power and military strategies. For maintaining peace for the entire continent, he consider this as his duty despite no on forcing him to do so. even if the demon kings army were to kill him.

appearsIn.title: The Reborn Young Lord is an Assassin

name: Naoko Kirino
aliases: Pumpkin Night (パンプキンナイト)
description:
Naoko is a cheerful, childish and intelligent girl, she has a passion for Halloween and was shown to be very excited when she was crowned the "The Pumpkin Queen", she also has a strong personality and isn't willing to give in to anyone, she'll do what it takes to have her way.
Because of the trauma, Naoko has become a psychopathic, sadistic and ruthless girl, killing mercilessly her bullies and innocent people.
She also mispronounces other people's names on purpose (e.g Chaki, Kachuya, Nyaruto, etc).

(Source: Pumpkin Night Wiki)

name: Sakurako Amamiya
description:
She is a childhood friend of [Ageha Yoshina](https://anilist.co/character/10478/Ageha-Yoshina). Although she used to have a kind and cheerful personality, she is now known in class as the "Ice Queen"—super cool and anarchic. While Ageha’s internal monologue refers to her as an "untouchable girl," she is actually being bullied by the other girls in the class.

She primarily fights using weapons like swords and *kusarigama* (sickle-and-chain), enhancing her physical abilities with "Rise" in combat. When facing ordinary humans, she may use blunt weapons (such as tonfas) to avoid killing them.

While skilled in the use of "Trance," its effectiveness is limited against opponents versed in PSI—who can easily block it—so the combination of weapons and "Rise" sees more frequent use.

name: Asaga Hiryuu
description:
__Height:__ 187cm

He is a first-year male student at Chikyuwa High School, distinguished by his largeframe and spiky brown hair. He possesses physical strength to match his imposing build.

He has a thoughtful and calm personality.

After his junior, [Tatsuo Mana](https://anilist.co/character/13810/Tatsuo-Mana), went missing following an involvement with "Psyren," he became a "Psyren Drifter" himself in order to search for him. His PSI ability excels in "Burst" (physical force); he manifests and manipulates dragon-like tails and wings.

name: Kabuto Kirisaki
description:
He has a cheerful, carefree personality and dislikes both trouble and violence; his specialty is running away. He also possesses keen eyesight and a sharp eye for reading people.

He is a feminist who treats men and women very differently. He looks up to his uncle, the journalist Toji Kirisaki, affectionately calling him "Ojiki" (Boss/Uncle).

He became a "Silent Drift" after picking up a red telephone card, though initially, he could not bring himself to accept this new reality. His PSI ability is "Menace"—a form of precognitive vision that allows him to foresee future dangers. Since he skips basic PSI training, he is not particularly useful in other areas.

name: Oboro Mochizuki
description:
A male actor. He becomes affiliated with Psyren after finding a red telephone card.

While he markets himself as having a calm demeanor for his work, in reality, he is curious and self-centered. He detests boredom and prioritizes having fun above all else.

He possesses a talent for handling PSI and is a user of the rare healing ability known as "CURE." However, his performance with CURE is relatively low-level compared to other users.

name: Ageha Yoshina
description:
__Height:__ 168cm

He is short-tempered, impulsive, and a bit of a goofball. At the same time, however, he possesses good situational judgment, insight, and self-control; he also has a cold-blooded side that allows him to calmly and unhesitatingly carry out a decision—even if it involves murder—once his mind is made up.

Restless and frustrated with his life, he sought an outlet by taking on requests from acquaintances for a fee of 10,000 yen, resolving their issues primarily through violent means.

After obtaining a red Psyren telephone card—and learning that his childhood friend and classmate, [Sakurako Amamiya](https://anilist.co/character/10479/Sakurako-Amamiya), had gone missing while in possession of an identical card—he used the card himself to become a "Psyren Drifter" in order to search for her.

name: Nemesis Q
description: This is the "person" responsible for the Psyren game. They decide when the game will begin, how many points will be lost and makes sure that everybody follow the rules.

name: Nozomi Sugita
description: A young man, who entered Psyren at the same time as Ageha. He along with the others refused to believe, what Ageha told them and decided to go out on their own, heading for the Siren Tower. When they arrived, they got attacked by a tavoo. In the meanwhile Ageha was on his way to the Siren Tower, because he thought that if they died, it would be his fault. He finds Nozomi as the last survivor of the group, and while both of them are trying to escape together, they are attacked by another tavoo, causing Nozomi's death.

name: Fubuki Yoshina
description: Fubuki Yoshina is Ageha's sister. She is 24 years old. Fubuki often punishes Ageha for coming home late or getting in trouble at school, her punishment usually in the form of tying him up. She has a big crush on pop-idol Oboro Mochizuki, and praises Ageha for bringing him home one day. The primary caretaker of Ageha upon his entry into Primary School. Fubuki Yoshina is Ageha's abusive, overbearing sister, and the daughter of astronomer Asuka Yoshina.   In the altered future, she lives in Tenju's Root and is married to Ian, and also has a son with him named Marco. (Psyren Wikia)

name: Junas
description: The second member of W.I.S.E. introduced, he has the appearance of a young teenager and wears a distinctive black helmet with a fin on the crest. He appears to be a swordsman, with the ability to materialize swords. He along with Dholaki appear along with Miroku in his declaration of war in the second version of the future and it is assumed he was there in the unchanged future. It is later revealed that he has a job has a janitor in a disbanded orphanage in order to look for Caprico to convince her to join WISE. It is later revealed that he was part of project "Grigori" and was known as #05. His PSI ability is called "Bishamon-Mura" and takes the form of hundreds of fragile swords that float in the air. When they break the pieces drop down and cut the enemy to pieces. He also has shown ability "Bishamon-Tsubute" by using a knife medium, he stabs/slashes towards an enemy and more solid knives to penetrate or to slice at enemies. He lead the assault on Tenju's Root, and nearly kills Ageha if not for the timely intervention of Asuka, who manages to injure him using the newly discovered PSI ability known as Nova.

name: Frederica Tenjuin
native: 天樹院 フレデリカ
description: Frederica has a wicked temper to match her strong fire-based abilities. She is often flying in to rages when someone does she doesn't like, especially insulting her or Marie. She dislikes outsiders and is loud-mouthed and inconsiderate. As a child she is often referring to herself as a spy codenamed "Sexy Rose". Frederica does have a nice side to her. She tells Marie she'll protect her during their fight with the W.I.S.E and she gives Ageha some encouragement when gets upset about Hiryuu and Oboro. Her best friend is Marie, who calls her "Fuu-chan". She spends most of her time hanging out with Marie, but will spend time doing other things like playing video games with Kyle and yelling at him for not taking it easy on her.

name: Alice
description: Alice is a young, carefree girl who is the 431st guest of the manor. She expresses that she despises lies and carries herself in a nonchalant way through a journey said to be "tantamount to suicide"

name: Hebi
description: Serpent is the head of the manor. He holds a very clear goal, to obtain 666 guests and have them all attend the "party." He is a reoccurring character throughout the manga and is depicted as sly, trying to keep Alice from leaving the manor while withholding information as to what it is really all about.

name: Hisashi Suou
description:
__School:__ 8th Year University student 
__Karuta Society:__ No society - Super A Class 
__Height:__ 180 cm 
__Hobby:__ Karuta 
__Favourite Song:__ Poem #2 The spring has passed And the summer come again

The reigning Master. He possesses the most intuition out of all the current karuta players, and has 28 one-syllable cards.  [Wikipedia] ; For the silk-white robes, So they say, are spread to dry On the "Mount of Heaven's Perfume."  Suoh started Karuta during university, and became Meijin within 3 years, and has held the title for 4 consecutive years. Everyone acknowledges his god-like abilities, but he is on constant lookout for someone stronger than himself. He is a solitary genius who always suffers from hunger, and is hard to become excited. It is his 4th time repeating a year at university.  Personality: The current Meijin is a weirdo? At first glance he may look like a typical university student, but in reality he is tall, has a questionable beard, an extremely quiet voice, and loves Japanese confectionery. His personal favourite idol is “Kyokotan” (Yamashiro Kyouko) who is a professional Karuta reader. He once asked her for a recording of her reading the poems, after offering her a gift of confectionaries. He is a man who wants to only fight strong people, and so he rarely makes an appearance at tournaments. In an interview, he has started that he wants to quickly be Meijin 5 years in a row, become an eternal-Meijin, then retire.

name: Natsusou Tsukuba
description: Akihiro Tsukuba's youngest brother and a member of the Shiranami Karuta Society.

name: Kouki Shiroyama
description: A member of Hokuo Academy Karuta Club. He wears strange spiral hair clips.

name: Akio Kitano
description: He is the chairman and coach of the Suihoku Karuta Society.

name: Yuuka Okkotsu
description: Granddaughter of [Yuta Okkotsu](https://anilist.co/character/129571/Okkotsu-Yuuta) and [Maki Zenin](https://anilist.co/character/134167/Zenin-Maki). A Jujutsu Sorcerer in training, Yuuka wishes to show that she deserves the favor of her household.

name: Tsurugi Okkotsu
description: Grandson of Yuta Okkotsu and Maki Zenin. A Jujutsu Sorcerer in training, Tsurugi aims to show that he does not need the favor of his household.

name: Marulu Yelvori
native: マルル・ヴァル・ヴル・イェルヴリ
description: An extraterrestrial belonging to the Simurian race, Marulu is a representative of his people - who are planning to emigrate to Earth as refugees. His most notable feature is the third eye in the middle of his forehead (covered with a patch when he needs to blend among humans), and powers that are similar to Jujutsu Sorcerers.

name: Cross Yelvori
native: クロス・ヴァル・ヴル・イェルヴリ
description: A dispatch officer of the Simurian refugees who have come seeking a home at Earth, Cross is the younger twin brother of [Marulu.](https://anilist.co/character/374243/Marulu-Val-Vol-Yelvori) Unlike his older brother, who believes that they can coexist with humanity, Cross believes the only way their people will be safe is by going to war with Japan.

name: Ui Ui
description: Ui Ui is a sorcerer and the younger brother of Mei Mei.

name: Satsuki Shishio
description:
__Height:__ 179 cm

Yukichi's friend and Suzume's teacher. He gave the nickname "Chun-Chun" to Suzume. He is a bit of an oddball because outside of his profession as a teacher his appearance changes to accommodate the fact; his hair is messy, he wears big glasses and his clothes and manner of speech are more suited to that of a cheerful, somewhat weird teenager. He retains some of his nature while in his role as a teacher and discards anything that is considered unprofessional, claiming he knows the line between work and outside, but that line begins to blur once he starts spending time with Suzume.

name: Suzume Yosano
description: Suzume grew up in the countryside most of her life until her father's work made him and Suzume's mother leave the country. They leave her in the care of her uncle who lives in Tokyo and owns a restaurant. She meets Shishio randomly at the bus stop and discovers that he is her uncle's friend and her teacher. She is obsessed with an occurrence that happened when she was in elementary school, in which after getting lost on the way home, she saw a shooting star in the middle of the day. She has bad grades and frequently skips class due to her obsession with once again seeing that star.

name: Daiki Mamura
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm 


His exterior is cool and aloof but he is actually extremely shy when girls make any physical contact and blushes profusely. When Suzume discovers this, she "blackmails" him by threatening to tell other people his secret. Despite his frustration and annoyance at her, he agrees and thus makes his first female friend. He finds it hard to talk to girls because in his house there are only men; Suzume teases him for being simple when he tells her. Eventually, it becomes slightly easier for him to talk to them thanks to Suzume's not-so-subtle prompting.  Mamura is normally very quiet and uninterested in his surroundings but gradually begins to notice everything about Suzume. He also has a gentle and caring side to him that he rarely shows to others. Yuyuka has a crush on him.

name: Yuyuka Nekota
description:
**Height:** 156 cm 

Suzume's friend and classmate. She has an unrequited love for Mamura. Initially, she believes Suzume likes Mamura so Yuyuka tries to get close to him using Suzume, but her plan falls through when Suzume confronts and reprimands her for her actions; shortly after they become friends.  Yuyuka's true personality is very blunt and unforgiving which she believes would cause friction with people, which is why she hides behind a "cute" exterior that is friendly and outgoing in order to make friends. Suzume is the first friend she makes who knows her true personality.

name: Samejima
description: Samejima is a woman who lives in the apartment next to Satsuki Shishio and she is also his girlfriend where she seems to be interested in Shishio despite her not knowing his name.

name: Tsubomi Kashima
description:
__Height:__ 162 cm

Tsubomi is a confident and beautiful woman. She is extremely perceptive when it comes to relationships and has even surprised Suzume, Shishio and Mamura with the knowledge behind her actions.

name: Tsurutani
description:
Animal in her name: <鶴> Tsuru (Crane)
Occupation: Student  One of Suzume's classmates.

name: Togyuu Minagawa
description:
__Height:__ 177 cm

Minagawa initially comes across as a playboy character. He likes Yuyuka.

name: Nana Kameyoshi
description: Height: 154 cm Weight: 43 kg  Favorite food: Fizzy drinks Interests: Baseball, karaoke Animal in her name: <亀> Kame (Turtle)  Occupation: Student  Suzume's classmate.

name: Kotetsu Sarumaru
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm

Suzume's friend and classmate.

name: Saika  Gasai
description: Adoptive mother of Yuno Gasai and the wife of Ushio Gasai. A minor character with major relevance, she serves as the direct cause of Yuno's descent into insanity.

name: Karyuudo Tsukishima
description: This man loves and values his dogs more than himself; as shown when he cooked them steak and give them thirty-year-old wine for dinner, while he himself was content with eating cup ramen.     He is named after Diana —the Roman goddess of hunting.   (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Ushio  Gasai
description: The adoptive father of Yuno Gasai and the husband of Saika Gasai. A minor character with major importance, he serves as an indirect cause for Yuno's descent into insanity.

name: Maruo Kaido
description: Maruo dreams of becoming a manga protagonist as he punches his way into the monstrous world of the Ayashimon Yakuza.

name: Urara
description: Urara is the deuteragonist of Ayashimon. She is an oni Ayashimon who is the founder and kumicho of the Urara Family, which consists of only her and Maruo Kaido. She is also secretly the illegitimate child of the late first chairman of the Enma Syndicate, Kio.

name: Juu Ichigou
description: Number 11 is a member of the Onmyo Bureau.

name: Doppo Akari
description: Doppo Akari is the second chairman of the Enma Syndicate. He is the primary antagonist of the current arc in Ayashimon.

name: Ten
description: Ten is an Ayashimon who was formerly an involuntary worker for a gang of scammers. He later becomes a part of the Urara Family.

name: Tamao Ichinose
description: She is a mermaid and a president of the Swimming club.

name: Tenmei Mikogami
description: Mikogami is a mysterious exorcist who is an old friend of the bus driver (and having the same creepy eyes as the latter) and the headmaster of Yokai Academy. He is always seen hooded beneath his garments and possesses extremely strong, anti-demonic powers, having the ability to seal Tsukune's ghoul nature using a "Holy Lock". He also has enough magic to create other dimensions sucha as the paradise he created for unstable and endangered beast-monsters.

name: Mako Yakumaru
description: Mako Yakumaru is disquised as a school nurse sent in to assassinate Midou Kusasbi after failing to kill Tsukune. Mako uses Moka against Tsukune and his friends byinjecting her her with a hypnotic fluid to force Moka to kill Tsukune. The tactic fails and she is forced to use a number of bystanders to Tsukune. Mako Yakumaru makes her appearance in the second season of the anime in episode 4 and designated as the actual school nurse, rather disguised as one.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Woo-Jin Kim
description: The main protagonist of _Kill The Hero_.

name: Jin-A Lee
description: Phoenix Guild's player, O Se-Chan's friend.

name: Ji-Hu Yang
description: Messiah Guild's member.

name: Se-Jun Lee
description: Messiah Guild's master.

name: Sin-Hye Park
description: Messiah Guild's member.

name: Yong-Wan Park
description: Phoenix Guild's leader.

name: Ken Tsukahara
description: Messiah Guild's player.

name: Ludger Cherish
description: A fake professor at Ceoren Academy.

name: Flora Lumos
description:
__Relative(s):__ Kaden Lumos(Father), Kamal Lumos(Brother), Katrina Lumos(Sister)

Flora is a second-year student who is a genius among the students at Ceoren Academy. Although she is a very outstanding student, Flora is treated very poorly within her family just because she is born out of wedlock.

name: Grander
description: A true vampire who has lived for over 1,000 years and is Ludger's teacher.

name: Elisa Willow
description: Elisa is the president of Ceoren Academy and a sixth-circle mage. She suspects that Ludger Cherish has switched places with the real Ludger and has infiltrated the academy, despite her suspicions, she highly regards his abilities and character as a professor.

name: Marie Ross
description: Marie has been working at Ceoren Academy for over 20 years as a pharmacology professor.

name: Chris Benimore
description: Chris is a professor at Ceoren Academy who teaches conjuration. He is someone who discriminates against other social classes and uses tricks in duels, but does not discriminate against patients.

name: Celina
description: Celina is a new spirit professor who likes fairy tales.

name: Erendir von Exilion
description: The 3rd Princess of the Exilion Empire and currently a sophomore. She is friends with Rene.

name: Merilda
description: Merida is a new professor at Ceoren Academy who teaches charms and visions. She is a part of the Curses and Benediction Department.

name: Terinna Lyonhowl
description: Terinna is the commander and the Security Bureau's lord protector of the Nightcrawler Knights.

name: Jae-Gu Song
description:
__Height:__ 179 cm (5'10)

Song Jae-Gu is the main protagonist of the series. He is a first year at Wild's High and also the first male student to be enrolled into the former girls-only school after its conversion to a co-ed institution. He is currently not ranked. While he uses no materials, he's being taught boxing.

name: In-Gwi Yun
description: Known primarily as Queen, In-Gwi is the heroine in the series, an S-Class ranked second-year student and the current Wild's League champion. She is a mixed martial artist, proficient in nearly every form of martial arts, where she helps spar with each of the school clubs. Her initial encounter with Jae-Gu leads to misunderstanding, due to a bad experience with a boy in her childhood. She nevertheless quickly develops feelings for Jae-Gu, who does not fawn over her like everyone else.

name: Mun-Yeong Lee
description: Lee Mun-Yeong is an S-class Wild's High School second year student, where she is the president of the boxing club and Queen's best friend and confidante. She is loud, rambunctious, and outgoing, as opposed to the reserved personality that Queen shows. However, when she is fighting seriously, she becomes a very powerful and frightening opponent, well-deserving of being Queen's best friend. She has a friendly rivalry with Choi Dal-Dal over martial arts and the attention of the series' protagonist, Song Jae-Gu.

name: Dal-Dal Choi
description: Choi Dal-Dal is a cute and bubbly young woman. She is the president of the Taekwondo club in Wild's High and has a friendly rivalry with Lee Mun-Yeong over martial arts and the attention of the series' protagonist, Song Jae-Gu.

name: Mi-Nam Lee
description: Lee Mi-Nam is a first year student at Gura High where he is training for Wild's League. He's a member of the boxing club.

name: Go-Seul Lee
description:
__Height:__ 162 cm

Lee Go-Seul is a first year student at Wild's high, like Song Jae-Gu. She is a member of the Wushu club and, while at first glance she appears weak and clumsy, her personality changes once she steps into a ring or is challenged. While clearly preferring armed combat (she walks around with a veritable arsenal in her bag) she is also adept at unarmed combat as well, giving her the appearance of a being a strong contender against even Queen.

name: Han-Gyeol Kim
description: Kim Han-Gyeol is one of Jae-Gu's former schoolmates. He often bullied Jae-Gu in his past school and when he noticed that Jae-Gu was attending Wild's High began to torment him again. He is a freshmen at Gura High and specializes in kickboxing.

name: Hye-Sin Kim
description: Kim Hye-Sin is a student at Gura High and is an aggressive young woman. She was the former two-year kickboxing champion until Queen defeated her. She is a Gura School second year student, where she is training for a rematch against Queen in the future.

name: Yeo-Jeong Kim
description: Kim Yeo-Jeong first appears alongside her fighting companion, Kim Jun-Gu, as guest fighters in the Wild's High League. Her opponent in the guest match is Choi Dal-Dal, whom she loses to. After her defeat, she is allowed to enter Wild's High and attend classes.

name: Charles Wilds
description: Charles Wilds is the Board President of Wild's High and the man who recruited Song Jae-Gu into the school with the promise of a three year scholarship as long as he attended. He made the decision to change the school from an all girls school to be a co-ed one.

name: Sera Kang
description: She is a member of the Mil-Yang Clan and is currently the clan's head. She had initially gained a grudge against Shi-Woon Yi because Goomoonryong had killed her grandfather until today, where the two are friends-in-arms, and love interest of Shi-Woon Yi  She is a young, slender girl with ears that stick out of her long, black, straight hair. She is often wearing formal attire. Other clothing she had worn would be general clothing, whether it'd be a long or short-sleaved shirt with shorts or skirts. In her initial introduction with her meeting with Shi-Woon, the latter had remarked his first impressions of her to be "a very beautiful, kind-looking young lady."  She has a very forward personality and with her expression-less face, it is hard to determine what her true intentions are. Sometimes, she may be seen wearing glasses, generally and probably for reading intentions, as seen when doing paperwork or helping teach Shi-Woon.  (Source: The Breaker Wiki)

name: Jin-le Kwon
description: A redheaded girl (inherited from her father) born to an American father and a Korean mother. During her early life, she lived with her mother in America. However, following a plane crash which resulted in her mother's death, her maternal grandfather took her in. She was trained in the Sun-Woo Clan's martial arts, and is said to be amongst the top five for her skills.  At the start of New Waves, she is guarding Shi-Woon from other Schools that want to exact revenge on him for actions committed by the Nine Arts Dragon.
