After Shi-Woon is introduced to the four elders of the Sun-Moon Clan, she is transferred into the Nine Arts School where many believe she is a delinquent due to her red hair and mannerisms. Although she is meant to protect Shi-Woon, her grandfather has stated to her that she should not interfere in any attacks until he is half-dead as to inspire fear in Shi-Woon, making him an easier puppet to control. She gradually develops feelings for Shi-Woon.  After she runs away from the Sun-Woo Clan, Jin-Ie was discovered by Ji-Woo Li, one of the leaders of S.U.C. who killed her cat, but was saved by Joon-Ho Yang who later finds her a job at a maid café with Ji-Gun Yoo's help, much to her chagrin.

name: Jeon Jang-Il
description: He was a Sun-Woo Clan elder who became Shi-Woon Yi's teacher after Chun-Woo Han. Although his goal was originally to stop the fight between Shi-Woon and Ji-Gun Yoo by exhausting him through an extreme training regime, he later warmed up to Shi-Woon after he reminded him of the previous clan head with his determination.  (Source: The Breaker Wiki)

name: Tae-shin
description: Tae-shin is a member of the Sun-Woo Clan. He is one of Jinie's two friends who came to save Shioon's life from Ji-Gum's gang.

name: Jae-kyu Kwon
description: He is the second-in-command of the Sun-Woo Clan, Head of the Elder Council of the Sun-Woo Clan and grandfather of Jin-Ie Kwon. He is extremely dedicated and loyal to the Sun-Woo Clan. Elder Kwon gave up the opportunity to form his own clan even after the Sun-Woo Clan's ruin and chose to stay with the clan. He regards anything that could be a danger to the clan as a threat which must be eliminated. Despite being seemingly arrogant, he is also extremely perceptive as he could identify that So-Jung Chan was attempting to corner the Sun-Woo Clan by asking about their new Ganju as Shi-Woon, and attempted to silence him immediately.  (Source: The Breaker Wiki)

name: Ha-ill Gang
description: He is a prominent character and member of the Sun-Woo Clan, being a somewhat close friend of Jin-Ie Kwon. He is a top master of Sun-Woo and a skilled fighter, as he had been hailed to be quickly recognized in the Murim World. Despite his youthful appearance, he is at least in his mid to late twenties or early thirties as he was seen to be presumably around ten years of age before Jinie was even born. This mistaken impression may also have been helped with the style of fashion he employs.

name: Hikaru Kiyomiya
description: He is a friend of Masachika since middle school.

appearsIn.title: Alya Sometimes Hides Her Feelings in Russian
Alya Sometimes Hides Her Feelings in Russian

name: Nagi Aiza
description: Nagi is Takeshi's little sister who pretended to ask for tutelage from Hiroko in order to scout her brother's rival, Kousei.

name: Koharu Seto
description: Daughter of Hiroko Seto, Koharu is generally a happy and cheerful child who adores her mother. Koharu has been shown to be quite shy and hesitant around others when she first meets them, but eventually warms up to them and begins to consider them as her family, as seen when she drew a picture of Nagi Aiza playing the piano with Kousei Arima.

name: Mamori Anezaki
description:
__Height:__ 162 cm (5' 4")

Sena's overprotective and motherly childhood friend. Mamori's mother met Sena's mother in a cooking class, and Mamori and Sena have been friends ever since. Her mother is half-Japanese, half-American which makes Mamori 25% American and 75% Japanese. Mamori has been protecting Sena from bullies since primary school, to the point that Sena has grown up never having to stand up for himself. Mamori joined the American Football club to watch over Sena and prevent any bullying by the other members (particularly Hiruma). Despite her joining the American Football club just to protect Sena's claim, she eventually becomes an excellent manager who knows the rules inside and out and makes up strategies for the team (since she has trouble with computers, she does it all on paper—super-analog). She memorized all of american football rules in just 1 night and is able to answer Hiruma's question to the smallest detail. A lovely girl, Mamori excels in all her studies except art, which she is horrible at, and helped Sena with his high school entrance exam. She is also a member of the school's disciplinary committee. Though she is constantly butting heads with Hiruma, she eventually sees a softer side to the Devil Bats' quarterback.   Her favorite food is Italian food and creampuffs. She is kind of a "creampuff-maniac" since her personality drastically changes when the topic is about creampuffs (as seen in the anime and in manga chapter 206).

name: Youichi Hiruma
description:
Hiruma usually acts in a vulgar, bizarre, threatening manner so as to intimidate or disturb those around him into getting what he wants. He has a cunning, goal-oriented mind and does not seem to care what means he uses to accomplish those goals. His sense of morals is lax at best, but he is quick to find the moral flaws of others, which he keeps recorded in his "Book of Threats" or "Devil's Handbook", and uses this information to blackmail everyone from students to figures of authority into placing him in a position of power. He has little respect for authority and has in fact usurped authority over Deimon High School well before the series begins and know authority of a vice principal, using his power in the school to give himself beyond-perfect scores in all his classes and divert funds to the American football club as he desires. Besides blackmail, Hiruma can often intimidate others into taking the action he wants by waving around his vast arsenal of firearms. Even without having to take direct action, Hiruma's mere reputation is enough in some instances to make the majority of the student body fear him and bow to his authority. 

Despite his penchant for blackmail and breaking seemingly every school rule without consequence, Hiruma adheres to the rules of American football without exception while playing.

name: Sena Kobayakawa
description:
__Height:__ 155 cm (5' 1")
 
The main character of Eyeshield 21. Initially a bullied gopher, his speed was discovered by Hiruma as he was literally forced into joining the football team at Deimon. However, he soon grows to love the game he plays as he masters both the Speed of Light Pace and further techniques as he gains the confidence to become a successful player. At different times throughout the anime and the manga he will often, through emotions, tap into the "Speed of Light Pace", but the problem with this is every time he does that he will often overextend himself causing himself to faint. As time went on, he got to the point where he can run the "Speed of Light Pace" at will. After the Death March he develops the "Devil Bat Ghost" where he learns to cut without stopping, the "Devil Bat Hurricane" where he incorporates a spin to the "Devil Bat Ghost" and the "Devil Stungun" where he uses one arm to block.

name: Ryokan Kurita
description: Position: Center / Defensive Tackle / Long snapper  Jersey: 77  40 yard dash: 6.5 seconds  Bench Press: 160 kg (352 lb)  Height: 195 cm (6' 4")  Weight: 145 kg (319 lb)  Graduated From: Mao 13th Middle School  2nd Year Student (Grade 11)    The largest and strongest player in the Deimon American Football club. Kurita lives in a temple with his father, who is the director of a Buddhist sect. His father believed that to grow up big and strong, a young boy had to eat a lot, but unfortunately it seems he has overfed his son. Kurita, as his name would suggest, has a head shaped like a chestnut. He is a very sweet, kind-hearted individual and the only thing bigger than his body is his heart. He became Sena's second friend after entering Deimon High School. When playing, Kurita shouts his kiai "Funnuraba!" when exerting extra effort. Before coming to Deimon, he attended the Shinryuji school, but was forced out because Kongo Agon was chosen over him for the special athletic scholarship, so he came to Deimon High along with Hiruma and Musashi. Like Hiruma. Kurita is crazy about American football and tries to encourage everyone to join though he does not go to the same extremes as his demonic compatriot. He can get so worked up that he's been known to begin morning practice as early as 2:00 AM.   His "apprentice" is Komusubi, who practices with him whenever he can. His biggest dream is to compete in the Christmas Bowl.

name: Tarou Raimon
description:
**Position:** Wide Receiver Split end / Cornerback  
**Jersey:** 80  
**40 yard dash:** 5.0 (as of the start of the Kantou tournament)  

Monta is the wide receiver of the Deimon Devil Bats American football team. He resembles an ape, particularly a chimpanzee, in many ways; indeed, his simian similarity is the character's running joke throughout the manga. Although he is as short as Sena, his large hands, arms (that are noticeably longer than his legs), acrobatic moves, and leaping ability make him a very effective receiver; he can even catch Hiruma's bullet passes with one hand. He has a habit of posing every time he makes a spectacular catch for a touchdown, rolling after the jump, and breaking out of the roll by kneeling and pointing upwards with his index finger. He also has the habit of attaching 'Max' to nearly everything he does (suffixing his phrases with MAX! in the Japanese, and prefixing them with MAXI-! in the English), since he believes that one should give 100% effort in all endeavors.   He was named Monta after Sena mistook his name as Rai Montarou. He begins to like being called 'Monta' after Hiruma tells him the nickname 'Monta' was supposedly derived from Joe Montana. Monta does not know that Joe Montana is a quarterback, not a wide receiver. Monta has a crush on Mamori. He's always trying to win her heart, often failing miserably, because she always gives more attention to Sena.

name: Gen Takekura
description:
__Position:__ Kicker/Linebacker  
__Jersey:__ 11  
__40 yard dash:__ 5.6 seconds  
__Bench Press:__ 90 kgs  
__Height:__ 177 cm (5' 9")  

The place kicker for the Devil Bats and one of the original three members of the team (along with Hiruma and Kurita). He is often mistaken for an older person (even though he is only 17), since he initially has a bit of stubble and has a buzz-cut. He leaves the team during the spring season of his freshman year, due to the fact that his father had become seriously ill. As a result, he was forced to drop out of school and take over as the construction foreman of Deimon High. Though he desperately wants to get back into playing, he refused to rejoin the Devil Bats. However, after meeting with Sena and Monta and seeing how determined they are to get him back on the team, he agrees, but only if they become a strong team. In the manga, Musashi makes his comeback during the game against Seibu, when his father hit him for abandoning his team. In the anime, however, he does not rejoin the team until the game with the Bando Spiders. He has a running rivalry with the kicker of the Spiders Sasaki Koutaro who, according to Hiruma, has never missed. Musashi has an incredibly strong right leg which helps the Devil Bats on kickoffs, often pinning their opponents deep or forcing them to down the ball deep in their own territory, or in their end zone for a touchback.

name: Hayato Akaba
description: Akaba is the tight end for the Spiders and the team's captain. He is obsessed with music and often plays his electric guitar and uses musical metaphors to state his opinions. While playing Akaba wears a blue eyeshield and he introduces himself to Sena as "the real Eyeshield 21".   He was offered a place on the Teikoku team, and accepted because of the team's strength and his father transferring to Kansai. After a confrontation with teammate Kotaro, Akaba changed his mind and decided to return to Bando. Because of the school's policy, Akaba was forced to sit out for six months from the beginning of the school year so he could not play with the team until the match against the Devil Bats. Instead, Akaba served as an adviser and instructor to his teammates, teaching them the blocking techniques he created through painstaking research.   After the game against Deimon, Akaba gives his blue eyeshield to Sena (in the anime he returns Sena's original green eyeshield to him) and states that Sena deserves to be called "Eyeshield 21".  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Maruko Himuro
description: Hakushu's manager, Himuro, is a serious-looking third-year student with short black hair. Himuro is Marco's inspiration for playing American football, for he became smitten with her in middle school and, in an apparent attempt to woo her, he vowed to show her "the morning sunshine after a victory" by winning the Christmas Bowl. She came to admire his optimism and ambition, and at some time afterward, the two were in a close relationship, though it is unclear how intimate they were. He now calls her by the nickname "Maria", which she dislikes. Because Himuro is two years Marco's senior, the player realized that his first year in high school would be his only chance to make good on his promise. After witnessing many players injured by Gao's strength, Himuro came to despise Marco's determination to win at any cost, and they grew apart, though she remains with the team.   (Source: Eyeshield 21 Wikia)

name: Riku Kaitani
description: Position: Running Back/Safety  Jersey Number: 29  40-yard dash record: 4.5 seconds  Bench Press: 60 kg  1st Year Student (Grade 10)  40-yard-dash: 4.5   An extremely fast grey-haired boy and happens to be the one who taught Sena how to run. When Riku was in elementary school, he saw Sena being bullied and he used his speed to save him. After that Riku taught Sena that if he could run fast, he would never be bullied again. Sadly, Sena used his speed to be a gopher, (though it's ironic that being a gopher is what helped build up his speed). Riku soon left Sena's school because his family needed to move, but he and Sena meet again later in the series. Like Shin, he was able to quickly deduce Sena's identity as Eyeshield 21.   (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Riko Kumabukuro
description: Daughter of "Bomberhead" Kumabukuro, who declares she's not like her father at all. A cute and determined reporter, she's the one who interviewed aces of Kantou tournament (with Agon trying to flirt with her). A running gag through the anime series is that when she gets two excited, she starts looking like a miniature version of her father.   (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Aria Roscent
description:
After Aria’s mother Carin Roscente married Count Roscente, Aria became the stepsister of Cain Roscente and Mielle Roscente. Having received a second chance in life, she begins to develop various schemes to get ahead of Mielle, as well as humiliate her and destroy her reputation in ways that parallel Aria’s downfall in the original line of events. Having been quite frank and spoiled after her initial rise in social standing (among other things, refusing to eat vegetables, deeming them commoner food she had more than enough of), Aria now learns to put on a mask and behave in more efficacious ways with regards to her public image.

In doing so, Aria makes various allies, who lead her to experience sincere kindness and affection for the first time in her life. She also catches the attention of Asterope Franz, who respects her due to her sharp intellect and hopes to recruit her as one of his advisors, forming quite a close relationship with him. She remarks herself that she might not have become such a sinister individual had she received such warm and welcoming treatment in her original life. Nevertheless, Aria remains determined to pay back Mielle and does not even consider abandoning her desire for revenge.

name: Asterope Franz
description:
Asterope is the Crown Prince of the empire. He goes by "Asher" to avoid telling Aria he's part of the royal family. He first meets Aria when he's in town investigating the casino case and she's retrieving her repaired hourglass.

Asher is described as an exceptionally tall young man with short black hair and highly handsome facial features. He has an angled face, pale skin, and ears that redden when embarrassed. Although Asher’s build is rather slender overall, he has very wide shoulders. Most prominently, his eyes have a distinct blue color which is commonly remarked upon in the novel.

name: Mielle Roscent
description: Mielle Roscent is the half sister of [Aria Roscent](https://anilist.co/character/168283/Aria-Roscent).

name: Lohan Croa
description: Lohan is the young king of the kingdom of Croa, and a close acquaintance of [Asher](https://anilist.co/character/175473/Asterope-Franz).

name: Carin Roscent
description:
Carin is [Aria](https://anilist.co/character/168283/Aria-Roscent)'s biological mother. She's a former sex worker who is now married to [Count Roscent](https://anilist.co/character/355799/Count-Roscent). Because she was born a commoner, other nobles look down on her and Aria, though she doesn't care what others say about her.

Carin is a confident woman who cares deeply for her daughter. She does not truly love Count Roscent, and only married him so that she and Aria could escape poverty and have a better life.

name: Cain Roscent
description: Cain is the firstborn son of House Roscent. He is [Mielle](https://anilist.co/character/216776/Mielle-Roscent)'s older brother and [Aria](https://anilist.co/character/168283/Aria-Roscent)'s half-brother. Because Aria and her mother were commoners, Cain dislikes and looks down on them. In Aria's first life, he was the one who cut off her head.

name: Roscent Baekjak
description: Count Roscent is [Aria](https://anilist.co/character/168283/Aria-Roscent)'s adoptive father who married her mother, [Carin](https://anilist.co/character/355787/Carin-Roscent). He is also the father of [Mielle](https://anilist.co/character/216776/Mielle-Roscent) and [Cain Roscent](https://anilist.co/character/355784/Cain-Roscent).

name: Jessie
description: Jessie is [Aria](https://anilist.co/character/168283/Aria-Roscent)'s maid. She is a kindhearted and loyal servant who genuinely cares for Aria.

name: Annie
description: Annie is [Aria](https://anilist.co/character/168283/Aria-Roscent)'s maid. She was initially sent by [Emma](https://anilist.co/character/355791/Emma) and [Mielle](https://anilist.co/character/216776/Mielle-Roscent) as a spy, but Aria soon brings her over to her side.

name: Sarah Loren
description:
Sarah is [Aria](https://anilist.co/character/168283/Aria-Roscent)'s private tutor and the only daughter of Viscount Loren. She is kindhearted and an expert at embroidery.

Sarah is one of Aria's closest friends and allies. Though Aria initially only gets close to her because she knows from her first life that she gets married to [Marquis Vincent](https://anilist.co/character/355805), a powerful figure in the aristocratic party, she ends up truly caring for Sarah as well.

name: Yukari Hayasaka
description: Yukari is the heroine of the story, a high school student who is tired of the meaningless and repetitive life that has been forced upon her by her uptight mother. She eventually models for Paradise Kiss after being "kidnapped" by Isabella and whisked away to Paradise Kiss' "atelier". She is often referred to, inexplicably, as "Caroline" by Miwako.  Yukari begins the series as a pretty faced, yet rather unattractive in personality, high school senior that studies dutifully for university entrance exams. When she meets the ParaKiss crew, she begins to discover new depth to her personality and life.

name: George Koizumi
description:
George (real name Johji) is an eccentric, handsome, and extremely charismatic student of Yazagaku who has extraordinary talent with a gift for fashion design, haute couture in particular. Despite his cold demeanor, he has extravagant ideas on everything, most of which are not accepted by the general public. He wants Yukari to become an independent woman, as well as a girl that will take responsibility for her own mistakes. 

His appearance is loosely based on Brian Slade of Velvet Goldmine, and several references to the film are made by him in the manga. He has distinctive blue hair and eyes, making Yukari humorously question if he is an alien. The lifestyle that he lives is top-notch; he lives in a loft apartment and drives a vintage Jaguar, but because his mother was merely a mistress, he rarely sees his father. Regardless, his mother dryly complains that he looks and acts just like him.

name: Arashi Nagase
description:
Miwako's boyfriend and a student of Yazagaku who also works with George to run Paradise Kiss. He is the son of a musician and a guitarist in a punk band. He tends to act rough, but can be very caring. He also has quite an assortment of facial piercings. Son of Kanzaki Risa, who is a good friend of Mikako Kouda, also from Gokinjo Monogatari.    

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Miwako Sakurada
description: A student of Yazagaku who works with George to run their own brand, Paradise Kiss. She is the younger sister of the creator of the Happy Berry brand, Mikako Kouda, who was the protagonist of Gokinjo Monogatari. She is very sweet and cute, and tends to act in a rather childlike manner.

name: Isabella Yamamoto
description: Isabella is the mother figure to the members of ParaKiss. This tall Yazagaku student is the epitome of high class and femininity. Isabella inspired George's very first dress during childhood and often had the habit of taking every piece of clothing that he finished. Isabella encourages Yukari when she needs it the most, whether it be regarding George or her abandoned studies.

name: Hiroyuki Tokumori
description: Son of Gokinjo Monogatari character, Hiroaki Tokumori a.k.a "Toku-chan". Yukari's classmate, as well as the object of her affections at the beginning of the story. He is very intelligent and handsome.

name: Alice Yamaguchi
description: Miwako's niece, her sister's daughter with Tsutomu. She is in third grade, and just as perky as Miwako. In the anime, she only makes a brief appearance. Alice has the same eyes as Tsutomu.

name: Tsutomu Yamaguchi
description: Mikako's friend from early childhood who lives next door, also goes to Yazagaku. He has been in love with Mikako for a long time. He searches for his passion and a hobby, eventually becoming an apprentice to Mikako’s father and learning to be a photographer. He bears an eerie similarity to Ken Nakagawa, a character from "Tenshi Nanka Ja Nai”, who is also the lead singer of the popular band Manbou - often leading to several accounts of rabid fangirls and mistaken identity. He is frequently referred to as a monkey (usually by Mikako). He forms Akindo, a street market shop/club, with Ayumi and the others. He also appears in "Paradise kiss" as Yukari Hayasaka's photographer.

name: Yasuko Hayasaka
description: [Yukari](https://anilist.co/character/429/Yukari-Hayasaka)'s mother.

name: Kozue Shimamoto
description: She runs a modeling agency and is friends with [Yukino Koizumi](https://anilist.co/character/55095/Yukino-Koizumi).

name: Daemon
description:
Daemon is a cyborg. He is the member of Kara and brother of [Eida](https://anilist.co/character/220447/Ada)

Daemon is a very energetic and mischievous child. He enjoys playing with others and is fiercely protective of his sister. Once engaging in battle, he is very sadistic and remorseless.

name: Himawari Uzumaki
description:
Himawari is the second and youngest child of [Hinata](https://anilist.co/character/1555/Hinata-Hyuuga) and [Naruto Uzumaki.](https://anilist.co/character/17/Naruto-Uzumaki)

Himawari is a cheerful, considerate, and kindhearted individual. She is shown to adore her family, excited to see when her father comes home, hopes to make her late cousin [Neji](https://anilist.co/character/1694/Neji-Hyuuga) happy by bringing him flowers to his grave, and enjoys visiting her maternal family whenever possible, as it is revealed Himawari is close with her [aunt](https://anilist.co/character/12563/Hanabi-Hyuuga) and [grandfather](https://anilist.co/character/15039/Hiashi-Hyuuga) from her mother's side. She also seems to care especially about her [older brother](https://anilist.co/character/121439/Boruto-Uzumaki) and vice-versa, to which she is always hopes to play with him whenever possible. Himawari has a very close attachment to her parents, as she refers to them as "Mama" and "Papa".

Himawari is very mature despite her age, helping her mother with chores. She also takes after her paternal grandfather being patient, supportive, and understanding of her often-absent father and his Hokage duties, but yearns for him to be home sometimes.



(Source: Boruto Wiki)

name: Delta
description:
Delta (デルタ, Deruta) is an "Inner" from the organisation Kara.

(Source: Naruto Wiki)

name: Matsuri
description: Matsuri is an evolved, self-aware God Tree produced by Code's Ten-Tails after one of his Claw Grimes ate Moegi Kazamatsuri and transformed into a tree.

name: Konohamaru Sarutobi
description:
Konohamaru named after the village he lives in: Konoha, is the grandson of the Third Hokage and by extension the nephew of Asuma Sarutobi. Konohamaru usually hangs out with his two friends, Udon and Moegi. Together, they call themselves the "Konohamaru Corps" ("Konohamaru Ninja Squad" in the English dub). 

In Part II they are teamed together under the leadership of Ebisu, Konohamaru's former tutor.  At the start of the series, Konohamaru feels unacknowledged due to his status as the Hokage's grandson. As such, he frequently attempts to defeat his grandfather in battle so that he can become Hokage himself and earn the recognition he desires. Once meeting Naruto Uzumaki, Konohamaru realizes that he can't become Hokage by simply attacking his grandfather and will need to train hard to accomplish this goal.

name: Koji Kashin
description: Koji Kashin is an "Inner" from the organization Kara that's in charge of the sector on the outskirts of the Land of Fire.

name: Taiga Hirasawa
description: A highschooler and member of the drama club who wants to become japans top actor. As a child, he was a big fan of superheroes and wanted to become a hero that protects girls.

name: Yuu Arima
description: A freshman in highschool and member of the drama club as a dancer.

name: Fukumaru
description: Taiga’s friend who attended the same middle school as him.

name: Tetsu
description: A friend of Taiga’s.

name: Tsukuyo Tsukuri
description: The founder of Utopia Inc. and a genius creator, she serves as the World Creative Administrator responsible for creating Shangri-La Frontier. So deeply is she committed to preserving the integrity of the game's world that she often disregards game balance, tending to design titles of such extreme difficulty that they become virtually impossible for anyone to clear. Consequently, she frequently clashes with [Ritsu Amachi](https://anilist.co/character/313438/Ritsu-Amachi), the individual tasked with adjusting the game's balance.

name: Rust
description:
A formidable player who long held the number one spot in Nephilim Hollow. Prompted by [Sunraku](https://anilist.co/character/271367/Rakurou-Hizutome) inadvertently letting slip that Shangri-La Frontier also features robots, they make their return to the world of Shangri-La Frontier. 

They possess information regarding a Unique Scenario linked to the Unique Monster known as Ctarnidd of the Abyss.

name: Donshuku no Daija
description: Massive poisonous snake that is the area boss monster of The Rampant Forest near Firstia. Players must defeat it in order to reach Seondil.

name: Tsukuyomi
description:
Tsukuyomi is the deity​ who rules over the Moon, and is the one who took on the job of transferring [Makoto Misumi](https://anilist.co/character/138137/Misumi-Makoto) from Earth to the other world. Tsukuyomi also gave his blessing of power to Makoto and later helped him after the [Goddess](https://anilist.co/character/221535/Megami) dropped him to the Wasteland in her world.

Tsukuyomi is a humble individual who helps those he believes he is capable of helping, as long as he thinks it is the right thing to do. Whenever he helps others, he usually does his utmost to achieve the best possible results.

name: Patrick Rembrandt
native: パトリック・レンブラント
description: Patrick Rembrandt is the owner of the Rembrandt Company.

name: Ema
description: Ema is the secretary of Makoto Misumi and acts as the supervisor of Asora.

name: Hibiki Otonashi
description:
Hibiki Otonashi is a recurring character in this series. She is one of the Heroes that was summoned by the Goddess to her World.

Hibiki is said to be highly calculative and socially flexible in a way that best suits her for political positions. As a Hero and adventurer she excels at fast, close range combat and works to improve her weaknesses in long-range techniques and strategies to become a more well rounded fighter and combat leader. She tends to be biased towards positions she is born into and has difficulty acting outside of those. For example, she arrives on the hyuman side of the hyuman-demon conflict and under the influence of the Goddess, thus views positions counter to these as incorrect or less just positions. As such, she sees the demon race as simply an anti-Goddess rebellion group and believes there's no other way but to sacrifice the freedom of one side into order to achieve the greater good.

Hibiki's motivation for coming into the Goddess's world was to challenge herself. In her previous world, she was born into a successful family and was talented in ways to where she never had difficulty meeting the goals and expectations of the people and positions around her. She would have lived a life where she could attain anything, and she was bored. In the Goddess's world: war, magic, other intelligent races and otherworlders -- in addition to the different social and political landscape -- challenged her.

name: Rinon
description: She is Toa's younger sister.

name: Psyche Polly
description:
__Height:__ 156 cm (5' 1")

__Background:__

name: Medea Belial
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5' 6")

As a reputable, high-ranking noble, Medea possesses a certain level of haughtiness. Though she exhibits proper grace and savoir-faire in public as the duke's daughter, she is also known to have an unpleasant temper. Medea often treats those of lower class, typically ordinary civilians and servants, with contempt and condescension. Many find it difficult to associate with her, believing that her terrible personality will cause her trouble in finding a suitor. Since childhood, Medea is disciplined and diligent in her aspirations to become an individual worthy of being recorded in history. She is extremely intelligent and has extensive knowledge on a wide breadth of subjects, including literature and political affairs. [Eros](https://anilist.co/character/159254/Eros-Orna-Vasilios) once mentioned that Medea is so sharp that she can read an entire situation from a single sentence or glance. She is also thoroughly trained in the art of swordsmanship and taught the fiercest warrior of the empire, [Helio](https://anilist.co/character/159251/Helio-Travium).

__Background:__

name: Dekis Belial
description: Dekis is a supporting character of Your Throne and a former lord of the House of Solon (Belial). He is the son of Thesion and the older brother of Medea.

name: Bertie
description: Bertie is a maid serving Medea's family.

name: Helio Niccolo
description:
__Height:__ 177-185 cm (5' 8"- 6' 1")

Helio Niccolo is one of the main characters of Your Throne. He is the young Marquess of the House of Niccolo and the childhood friend of [Medea Solon](https://anilist.co/character/159252/Medea-Belial).

name: Lin
description: Lin is Psyche's maid.

name: Perion Sob Vasilios
description: He is the cardinal of Temple of Vasilios.

name: Count Polly
description: Count Polly is the father of [Psyche Polly](https://anilist.co/character/159250/Psyche-Polly)

name: Nana
description: She was a maid in the House of Solon and the unofficial caretaker of [Medea Belial](https://anilist.co/character/159252/Medea-Belial).

name: Irene Adler
native: アイリーン・アドラー
description: Irene Adler is a former theatre actress and prima donna who would later retire.

name: Graham Dunderdale
description: Duke of Dunderdale, viceroy of India

name: Adam Whiteley
native: アダム・ホワイトリー
description: He's a member of the parliament, belonging to the House of Commons. Has a strong sense of justice and believes in equality.

name: Lunia Aden
description: The eldest daughter of the Aden family and Alisha's half-sister.

name: Miriam El Ras
description: The second princess of the Kingdom of El Ras.

name: Yuel
description: A druid from the Avelorn Forest.

name: Tatez Valtazar
description: The final boss of 'The Legend of Arhan'. He has a base in the Demon Realm in the northern part of the continent.

name: Risa Hoshizaki
description: She is Rika Hoshizaki's sister.

name: Do-Hwa Cheon
description: A punkish, hard-drinking party girl in Practical Entomology. She's unusual in that she was merged with a scorpion, an arachnid, rather than an insect and was subject to numerous tests and studies before being allowed to join the class.

name: Hye-Seong Cha
description: He is a student in NEST, enrolling in Jun Ji's class in hoping to acquire Cinderella.

name: Yoi Takiguchi
description:
__Height:__ 169.5 cm

A first year student in high school. Known as the female prince of the school. She works at her family's ramen shop.

name: Kohaku Ichimura
description:
__Height:__ 183 cm

Yoi Takiguchi's senpai. The male prince of the school.

name: Asami Takiguchi
description: Yoi's older sister.

name: Nobara Tone
description: A friend of [Yoi's](https://anilist.co/character/205878/Yoi-Takiguchi) since middle school. She is a fan of Boy's Love and handsome men, but until recently the closest thing in her life has been Yoi, until another "Prince" appears.

name: Hasegawa
description: [Kohaku Ichimura's](https://anilist.co/character/233970/Kohaku-Ichimura) ex-girlfriend.

name: Shun Kuwabatake
description: [Kohaku's](https://anilist.co/character/233970/Kohaku-Ichimura) friend and classmate. He is a voice of reason compared to Kohaku and [Sentarou](https://anilist.co/character/379526/Sentarou-Akane).

name: Kotobuki Hibiya
description: One of Yoi's friends from school. She has a cheerful personality.

name: Shiki Ichinose
description: Shiki is an oni whose powers manifest after an attack by the Momotarou results in the death of his adoptive father. Biologically, he is one of the eight children of Kishin and inherits the Fire elemental attribute. His Blood Eclipse Release manifests as various guns, a reflection of his past interest in them. The tremendous output of his power generates severe aftereffects, such as causing blood to rain from the sky.

appearsIn.title: Tougen Anki: Legend of the Cursed Blood

name: Naito Mudano
description: The teacher of Shiki's class. A taciturn, strict man, he is a highly-skilled fighter respected as such by both the oni and the Momotarou. He often travels on roller skates instead of walking. His Blood Eclipse Release manifests as an umbrella.

appearsIn.title: Tougen Anki: Legend of the Cursed Blood

name: Hayate Todoroki
description: An Oni and the Captain of the Kikoku Unit. He is a Child of the Kishin, with the elemental attribute of wind.

appearsIn.title: Tougen Anki: Legend of the Cursed Blood

name: Ousuke Momokado
description:
__Height:__ 177 cm

An officer in Tokyo's Momotarou branch, and Tsukuyomi's partner. A bloodthirsty man, he solely seeks the thrill of the fight and challenges oni such as Mudano with the hopes of defeating powerful opponents. His Momotarou power allows him to use his bacteria to copy the ability of any ability he sees within a 24-hour period. He is eventually defeated by Ikari, but survives after being recovered by other Momotarou.

appearsIn.title: Tougen Anki: Legend of the Cursed Blood

name: Ikari Yaoroshi
description:
A classmate of Shiki at Rasetsu Academy. He's short-tempered, but has a pure side when it comes to love.

(Source: Official Site)

appearsIn.title: Tougen Anki: Legend of the Cursed Blood

name: Rokuro Kiriyama
description: A student in Shiki's class. He is extremely averse to all uncomfortable situations, a result of him losing his oni girlfriend to an illness. His Blood Eclipse Release manifests as paper fans and a dancing outfit, having been a dancer in the oni village he grew up in.

appearsIn.title: Tougen Anki: Legend of the Cursed Blood

name: Shinya Momoiwa
description: A captain in Tokyo's Momotarou branch. His Momotarou ability allows him to peer into the vision of up to 36 people for 24 hours. He is also capable of making a target see his vision, as long as his bacteria is present on them. Due to the non-combative nature of his power, Momoiwa was often deemed by fellow Momotarou as being unable to advance highly, causing him to become obsessed with status and begin using underhanded tactics—including breaking Momotarou policy by putting the lives of humans in danger—to advance through the ranks. He targets Shiki with the hopes that killing Enki will further advance his rank, and resorts to manipulating Mikado and torturing Kougasaki to do so. Momoiwa is eventually killed after Kougasaki uses his oni power to slit his throat.

appearsIn.title: Tougen Anki: Legend of the Cursed Blood

name: Jyuuji Yusurube
description: A student in Shiki's class. Though he generally appears collected and intelligent, he is actually a massive pervert who frequently tries to lose his virginity, to no avail. His Blood Eclipse Release manifests as sonar, which activates by seeping into cracks and traveling relatively far distances.

appearsIn.title: Tougen Anki: Legend of the Cursed Blood

name: Kuina Sazanami
description: A student in Shiki's class. Though usually appearing brash and tough, she has a motherly fetish that causes her to uncontrollably dote on people she sees as weak and is attracted to. Sazanami soon forces Kiriyama into a relationship under this pretense, much to his dismay. Her Blood Eclipse Release manifests as kickboxing gloves.

appearsIn.title: Tougen Anki: Legend of the Cursed Blood

name: Kouchou
description: The mysterious headmaster of Rasetsu Academy. Though he and Mudano have a good relationship, he rarely speaks to him in person and is almost always covered from head to toe in traditional Japanese garb; his real appearance is that of an androgynous man with blue skin, white hair, and tattoos all over his body.

appearsIn.title: Tougen Anki: Legend of the Cursed Blood

name: Shou Hazama
description: The protagonist of the series.

name: Kuraishi Masashi
description: Director of the Kanayama Prefectural Police Department and Yamada's former superior. He is Akumetsu's second victim. Unlike the justice-driven Yamada, Masashi only cared to earn career points for traffic violations and minor crimes, while allowing a vicious street gang called Blossom to roam free, and ignoring the pleas from the citizens. Akumetsu forces him and the police to perform their duties as law officers by taking Masashi as an hostage and, under threat, force his men to perform their duties in stopping the bikers. He had his left hand's fingers blown off first, then his head destroyed by a point-blank shot from Akumetsu.    (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Shina Nagasawa
description:
A schoolgirl and Shou's best friend who is forced to prostitution because her father has been left bankrupt through aggressive financial strategies used by the banks. As she had begun to be degraded by a perverted old minister, Akumetsu comes into the fray and kills the minister. She recognizes him and says part of his name, which one of the officials overhears.  On her return to school she is surprised to see Shou alive, but is offered no explanation until the killing of Nakanoshima, when she is confronted by the official and Shou walks in on them. Shou tells them about his supposed powers and intimidates the official. The official runs, and Shina breaks down. Shou informs her that he saved her father from becoming a criminal (in a desperate need for money), lying to him that he was dating her, and handcuffing him to a streetlight in the process.  Currently, Shina has remained in school, abandoning her decision to work as a prostitute.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Shintarou Murase
description: Shintarou is the Prime Minister of Japan.     A weak and indecisive man who believes he is on the highest office of Japan thanks to sheer luck, he was visited by Akumetsu and given a simple, yet chilly ultimatum: since he believed in the Prime Minister's plans, Akumetsu offered him to take upon himself the task of killing all those who he deemed evil, that is, all the corrupt personnel of the Japanese political and economical world.     In the meantime, he gave Prime Minister Murase one month to succeed in his restoration plans, or be faced with Akumetsu's wrath and killed himself if he failed ("failing" including also his resignation from his office or lack of will to accomplish his plans, much to his dismay). It was Murase who coined the nickname Akumetsu, because when he first saw Shou with his mask and an intimidating black suit, he called him an akumetsu, a destroyer of evil.

name: Kuronuma
description: A teacher at Shou's school, who is inspired by Akumetsu, and attempts to kill Congressman Tsuruta. However, his botched attempts endanger and kills innocent bystanders, which does not fit in with Akumetsu's 'one-man one-kill' policy. He is confronted by Shou and is later used as a human weapon to murder Tsurata. Dubbed as Akumetsu #2, Kuronuma is shot by the police, while the wheelchair he was on impales the corrupt congressman. Just seconds before he dies, his head is blown up like any other Akumetsu. As a teacher, he was strict yet ridiculed, and believed in a society still capable of changing itself.    (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Hiroki Nakanoshima
description: Leader of the Cabinet and the Prime Minister's former corrupt rival. He is Akumetsu's third victim. He is shown at the funeral of the aforementioned official. Akumetsu, however, jumped out of the commissioner's coffin, and cross-examined Nakanoshima on national television and delivered his ideals and accusations; including his views on Japan's failing economy. Nakanoshima is, at first, thrown to the special forces bodyguards, until Akumetsu proceeds to break through every one of them (without killing them), despite being shot several times along the way. Akumetsu then takes Nakanoshima with him off a rooftop, and kills him by dragging him in a suicidal jump (performed as a wrestling take down move).  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Hideki Horikiri
description: Former Director of the Ministry Health and Welfare's Pharmaceutical Affairs Bureau, as well as Former Board Chairman of a Semi-Government Medicine Facility. His crimes included gross mismanagement of blood constituents, malpractice, and financial monopolizing over pharmaceutical drugs, but mostly, his indifference at the introduction and misuse of Hepatitis C-laced fibrinogen concentrate, which eventually killed, among others, one of Shou's best friends. Horikiri and other fourty-two people deemed responsible were ambushed by an analog amount of Akumetsu while driving their cars and, wounded, were transported via fake ambulance to an abandoned hospital, where they were put to death by means of that same infected fibrinogen they distributed. Horikiri himself died after three days of agony.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Iwasaki Shouzou
description: The Main Metropolitan Bank's Consultant and Akumetsu's first victim. He was the perverted official whom Shina had to degrade herself in front of. He was forced to admit to his crimes toward Japan's failing economy, before being killed by Akumetsu with an axe to the head.    (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Masami Iwata
description: A juvenile delinquent member of the bike gang Blossom, who was never convicted of a brutal murder of an elderly citizen during a mugging. Since there was no police investigation, Iwata was allowed to enroll in high school.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Driver
description: B+ rank villain of the Gadam Vilzone.

name: Rose Tail
description: One of Don King's eight commanders.

name: Min Ryu
description:
He lost his parents when he was young and was living with his younger brother, Ryu Won, working part-time as the head of a boy. However, he suffered from school violence and was exploited by his part-time job boss. 

Then, with the start of the Death Game, his life changes completely. Afterwards, through his 99 regressions,He reaches the final round of 20, but fails because he is the only player left and the requirement for round 20 is 5 people. He eventually decides to aim for a perfect strategy based on the information from his regression as he enters the 100th time.

appearsIn.title: The 100th Regression of the Max-Level Player

name: Won Ryu
description: Ryu Min's younger brother and is in the third year of middle school. He appears to be taller than Ryu Min. He is a fan of Seo A-Rin. His parents passed away early and he is left with his older brother, so he trusts Ryu Min.

appearsIn.title: The 100th Regression of the Max-Level Player

name: A-Rin Seo
description: A celebrity next door to the protagonist. She was mentioned from the beginning as she was a very popular and famous actor. She originally had a soft personality, but she changed after becoming involved with Black Scythe

appearsIn.title: The 100th Regression of the Max-Level Player

name: Kyung-Rok Ma
description:
He looks gentle as the eldest son of one of Korea's leading conglomerates.

He is also the sponsor of Seo A-Rin.

appearsIn.title: The 100th Regression of the Max-Level Player

name: Juri Min
description: Ryu Min's classmate. She had a crush on Ryu Min, but couldn't get to tell him. Juri Min also has a bad past; her father failed in business, her mother divorced and left home, and she is in debt, leaving her father to make a living by working at a convenience store.

appearsIn.title: The 100th Regression of the Max-Level Player

name: Taguchi
description: He was a subordinate of Madoka.

name: Nana Mifune
description:
Nana Mifune was a girl who became Collector for the Alien.

Nana is a nice smart girl. She had realized she got the recommendation only because Shuichi declined it. She likes Shuichi and when he looked depressed, she tried talking to him to see if there is something she can do to help him.

(Source: Gleipnir Wiki)

name: Julian
description: He is a runaway slave who has chosen to use his freedom to raise his adoptive sister Diana.

name: Diana
description: Diana is the daughter of Mira and the adoptive sister of Julian.

name: Angvall Selma
description: She is a female solider and Titi's guardian. She is also the accommodator of Julian and Diana.

name: Mira
description: Mira was a former slave who was close to Julian. She provided Julian with a new purpose in life by entrusting him with the care of her newborn daughter Diana.

name: Arkos
description: Arkos is the son of the king and serves as a defender of the country's western border.

name: Titi
description: Titi was raised by [Angvall](https://anilist.co/character/337336/Angvall) after the latter found her abandoned on the battlefield as a child.

name: Lukas
description: Lukas is a young man of average height with short dark hair and a scar around the left side of his neck. He wears a dark V-neck shirt with matching pants and shoes and has bandages wrapped around his arms.

name: Ji-Han Han
description: Han Jee-Han (한지한, Hanjihan) also known as "The Gamer" is the main protagonist of the manhwa The Gamer. Jee-Han has recently discovered that he has a Natural Ability called The Gamer. This ability makes him experience his life in a game-like setting which was derived from his gaming addiction.

name: Sung-Ah Hwan
description: Hwan Sung-Ah (환성아, Hwanseong-a) is a second year High School student and Ability user currently going to the same school as Han Jee-Han. She is Hwan Sung-Gon's daughter.

name: Horutipia Aholting
description: Horutipia Aholting is an European Natural ability user hired by Hwan Sung-Gon to kill all the cleaners coming after him and his daughter. He is a druid warrior that supports his coworker: Lolikiano Mistream.

name: Jung-Suk Han
description: Han Jung-Sook is the mother of Han Ji-Han. She is the only person with an unknown level and class even after Jee-Han used Observe on her. Jung-Suk is a responsible mother and she often goes to the fitness centers although this may only be a front.

name: Shi-Yun Kwon
description: Kwon Shi-Yun (권시연, Gwon shi-yeon) is the tritagonist of The Gamer and a High School student who transferred into 2nd Year Class 8. She hails from the Yunhonmoon clan, the clan that opposes but is currently allied with Chunbumoon.

name: Seon-Il Shin
description: Shin Sun-Il (신선일, Sinseon-il) is Han Jee-Han's childhood friend and a member of Year 2 Class 8. He is also the heir of one of the ruling martial arts clans of the Abyss in Seoul region called Chunbumoon. He is the deuteragonist of the series.

name: Sung-Gon Hwan
description:
Hwan Sung-Gon (환성곤, Hwangseon-gon) is a mysterious Natural Ability user who is came to soul collecting Soul Stones to save his daughter, Hwan Sung-Ah. He recently got instated as a replacement Chemistry teacher and he has connections to the Irregular Magician.

He is extremely powerful summoner and fighter. His rank in Abyss is SSS.

name: Se-Yeong Pung
description: Poong Sae-Young (풍세영, Pungseyeong) is a member of Chunbumoon and an Olympic Medalist in Women's Taekwondo. She is also the cousin of Shin Sun-Il and granddaughter of Shin Sun-Oh and heir to a unique branch of martial arts within the Chunbumoon.

name: Lolikiano Mistream
description: Lolikiano Mistream, the Witch of Slaughter is a powerful sage from Europe who specializes in killing weak opponents and devil summoning.

name: Kouichi Haimawari
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm (5'8")
__Occupation:__ Vigilante, 
__Quirk:__ Slide and Glide (allows the user to project a repulsive force from their hands and feet)

Koichi has an easy-going, mild-mannered personality. He is very generous and does not seem to expect anything from other people in return. He dreams of being able to become a recognized hero and is shown to enjoy the vigilante work that he does. He is very willing to do the less glamorous jobs, such as cleaning up trash and does not seem to think that these are negative aspects of being a hero or vigilante. 

His costume consists of his regular clothes in conjunction with an All Might-haired hooded jacket, a black mask covering his face, red sunglasses, and protective bike gear.

Unbeknownst to Koichi, he and Kazuho share a history. Koichi had once saved Kazuho when she fell into a river. He would give the drenched Kazuho his limited edition All Might hoodie and run off to his entrance exam for a high school that specialized in superheroics. Because he chose to save her, Koichi ended up missing the exam and returning to his hometown.

name: Oguro Iwao
description:
__Height:__ 185 cm (6'1")
__Occupation:__ Vigilante
__Quirk:__ Quirkless

Knuckleduster is an individual with a strong sense of justice and drive to do the right thing. He prefers to punch first and ask questions later, as he is willing to beat up people he deems to look suspicious on the slim chance that they may be villains, forcing his teammates to hold him back before he goes too far. Despite this, he has proven to be more intelligent and smart than he seems to be at first.

name: Kazuho Haneyama
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm (5'2")
__Occupation:__ Vigilante
__Quirk:__ Leap (allows the user to leap at very high and large distances)

Pop☆Step is a very logical and intellectual person; she acts as the brains of the vigilantes. She appears to act like a more moderate tsundere, mocking and insulting her allies despite clearly caring for [Koichi](https://anilist.co/character/126087/Haimawari-Kouichi). As an Idol, she loves singing and performing, despite not being particularly skilled or talented in either. 

When Kazuho wants to use her Quirk and express herself as her alter ego Pop☆Step, she paints a black mask, ties her hair in pig-tails, and dresses in a succubus themed one-piece black leotard with a heart-shaped opening in the center of the chest and a smaller one in the back, where it is located just below two bat wings.

name: Taishirou Toyomitsu
description:
__Height:__ 250 cm (8'2") (Fat form)
__Quirk:__ Fat Absorption

In his fat form, Taishiro is a big round man, easily towering over other adults. In this form, his mouth is big, and his nose is smaller, which alongside his odd body proportions, give him an odd look. After burning through his fat, however, it is revealed that he is quite muscular, and his body adapts conventional proportions.

His hero costume consists of black pants and an orange zippered hood, which has the initials of his alias on the front of Fat Gum. Alongside them, he also wears gloves, metallic boots, and a mask that covers his eyes and his forehead.

name: Tsunagu Hakamada
aliases: Fiber Hero: Best Jeanist (ファイバーヒーロー ベストジー二スト)
description:
__Height:__ 190cm (6'3")
__Quirk:__ Fiber Master

Pro Hero, ranked in the top 4. He is the recipient of the "Best Jeanist" award for eight consecutive years.

Tsunagu is an elegant man with flamboyant tendencies. He believes very strongly that people with influence must maintain a positive appearance both physically and socially. Tsunagu often uses metaphors referencing jeans, denim, and various other sewing and fabric-based phrases, often inspiring his recruits with speeches, telling them to keep their life straight like their jeans. Tsunagu takes the role of being a hero very seriously. He is selfless, brave, and charismatic, and he aims to spread a sense of a peace to all people, no matter how dire the situation.

Tsunagu's Quirk "Fiber Master (ファイバーマスター)" allows him to freely manipulate the threads in any nearby piece of fabric. He has power over all types of cloth, but his Quirk works best with denim and is less effective on sweats. Fiber Master also works on other types of fiber not related to fabric, such as carbon fibers. He primarily uses this power to restrain his targets, either by using their own clothing against them, or simply unravels portions of his own clothing into strings.

name: Kurogiri
description:
__Affiliation:__ League of Villains
__Quirk:__ Warp Gate

Kurogiri has a level-headed personality, which often serves to ground Tomura Shigaraki's immaturity. He is intensely loyal to both All For One and Tomura. He is very polite and well-spoken, even to enemies.

name: Souga Kugizaki
description: Leader of a trio of delinquents.

name: Rojiya Yonegaga
aliases: Manhole no Rojiya (マンホールの路次也)
description: Yakuza member affiliated with the Abegawa Tenchu Kai.

name: Yuu
description: One half of the underground idol duo *FeatherS*, alongside her twin sister Miu.

name: Rin Yaritezawa
description: Sophomore at Naruhata Women's College.

name: Ernst Zimmerman
native: エルンスト・ツィマーマン
description: The interim president of the Federal Republic of Giad.

name: Shiden Iida
description:
Shiden Iida is the captain of the Brísingamen Squadron, also known as the Queen's Knights, which was the group that led the defense of the Republic during the large-scale offensive held by the Legion. Her Personal Name Cyclops originates from her heterochromia, as she appears to only have one working eye.

Following the rescue of the Republic by the Federacy, her squadron volunteered for the Eighty-Sixth Strike Package. Shiden and the Brísingamen Squadron are now in charge of defending the mobile headquarters—Vanadis.

name: Yuuto Crow
description: Yuuto Crow, Personal Name Verethragna, is the captain of the 1st Armored Group's Thunderbolt Squadron. He is a handsome young man with crimson eyes and tan skin, and is a veteran Processor who, like Shin and Raiden, served on San Magnolia's Eastern Front prior to joining the Federal Republic of Giad's Eighty-Sixth Strike Package. Yuuto is known by others for his extreme expressionlessness and curt, nearly robotic way of speaking. Despite his outward coldness, Yuuto is regarded as a good leader who remains levelheaded during combat and cares for his comrades.

name: Yoko Higuchi
description: Height: 165 cm  Occupation: Porn Actress Hometown:  Status: Alive BIM Type: Blazing gas Kill(s): 0  She can tell if a person is lying by facial expression and eyes. She is part of the Togo's Team.

name: Heitarou Togo
description:
Height: 170 cm 
Occupation: Cop 
Hometown:  
Status: Alive 
BIM Type: Homing, Timer and Shield 
Kill(s): 0

Heitaro Togo is the leader of a group of 4 people including himself. He seems to be knowledgeable about how to corner and trap their target.

name: Tsuneaki Iida
description: Iida is a game programer.

name: Shiki Murasaki
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm  
__Occupation:__ Nurse 
__Hometown:__ Chiba 

Shiki Murasaki  is a former player from a previous round of the real-life Btooom! game. After having been betrayed by Masahito Date, she has been living on the island ever since.

While seemingly simple-minded and even kind in the past, Shiki admits (a medical professional having sworn to do no harm) to committing cruel acts in the past. Her experiences with Masahito Date and the Btooom! game have jaded her, leaving her to assume a cynical approach to life, especially toward men, whom she regards with extreme distrust. She, however, after her experiences with Himiko and Ryōta Sakamoto, has opened up to others, revealing an emotional yet compassionate side to her.

name: Kenya Uesugi
description: Height: 173 cm  Occupation: Employee of a company Hometown:  Status: Alive BIM Type: Cracker Bomb Kill(s): 0  Part of Togo's Team and Fan of Yoko.

name: Si-Eun Yeon
description:
__Height__: 158 cm (5'2")
__Shuttle Patch Website Ranking:__ 

The central protagonist of Weak Hero. Currently a first year at Eunjang High School in Class 1-5, and also attends Hero Cram School in the afternoons. Known by the epithet of "Eunjang's White Mamba", he is notorious for his extremely dirty fighting tactics and uncannily reserved nature.

name: Hu-Min Park
description:
__Height__: 181.6 cm (5'11.5")

Ben Park, also known by his epithet Big Ben, is the deuteragonist of Weak Hero. Currently, in his first year at Eunjang High School, he is in Class 1-8 and is considered by many to be the strongest in the school. A talented and powerful fighter, Ben Park is infamous for his physical strength, currently ranked 2nd on the Shuttle Patch website.

name: Hyeon-Tak Go
description:
__Height:__ 173 cm (5'8")

Alex is hot-headed and short-tempered, known to power through his fights on pure guts and grit alone. He has mellowed out somewhat after middle school and ignores the trash talk that once enraged him.

Despite his temper, he is very caring towards his friends, especially exhibited when he expressed concern for Gray when he was hospitalized.

name: Ga-Yol Jin
description:
__Height:__ 188 cm (6'2")

A man of few words, Gerard appears at first glance to be a mostly silent and antisocial individual, rarely interacting with others and not speaking unless first spoken to. However, it appears that his quiet personality is mostly a result of his lack of friends, as when seen with Ben Park, Gray Yeon, Alex Go, etc. he freely interacts with them and can carry a conversation easily. 

On occasion, Gerard has even been shown to attempt active interaction with his friends. Gerard is quite sensitive of his hair, becoming comically irritated whenever he is teased about it by his friends. However, he refuses to change it. He also carries several eccentric habits, such as when Rowan found him sleeping in a flower bed. 

Despite all his quirks, while fighting, Gerard has shown himself to be a capable and level-headed opponent, able to maintain a cool head in the midst of battle and only retaliating against his attackers when things go too far.

name: Tae-O Jin
description:
__Height:__ 169 cm (5'6.5")

Teddy Jin is a secondary character of the Webtoon Weak Hero. He is a student in Class 1-1 of Eunjang High School. He was an infamous bully from Seong-Il Middle School. Initially, a supporting antagonist of the Eunjang Arc, his fight with Gray Yeon has humbled Teddy into becoming an ally of Gray taking on a more anti-heroic role. Following the Hyeongshin Takedown Operation, Teddy has become a reluctant ally of Ben Park's Gang.

name: Su-Ho Ahn
description: Stephen Ahn was Gray Yeon's classmate and best friend in Byuksan Middle School. He was a model student and an unfortunate set of incidents lead to him being hospitalized and caused Gray to eventually end up enrolling at Eunjang High School.

name: Ju-Yang Im
description:
__Height:__ 182 cm (5'11")

Rowan Im is a recurring character in the webtoon Weak Hero. After coming back from living in Australia, Rowan now studies at Eunjang High School in Class 1. He is old friends with Eugene Gale.

Rowan is considered to be an airhead and exaggerator of the highest degree. He is also an avid admirer of power, worshipping those stronger than him. He loves talking and often exaggerates about his accomplishments or the accomplishments of others. However, his bravado and loyalty to his allies make him a worthy friend.

name: Jun-Tae Seo
description:
__Height:__ 166 cm (5'5.5")

Eugene Gale is a secondary character in Weak Hero. He is a first year student of Eunjang High, of Class 1-5. Eugene is Gray Yeon's closest friend in Eunjang High and a member of Ben Park's Gang. Eugene is an absolute fanatic of the delinquent gang's in Yeongdeungpo. Though he has no fighting capabilities, he possesses a wide variety of knowledge regarding the delinquent gang's of Yeongdeungpo, making him the gang's info broker.

Eugene is quiet and a rather distant person to new people or people who seem “like a bully," but the opposite to people he feels comfortable around. He is a kindhearted person as he is often buying drinks for the group or Eunjang High students after a fight. Eugene is very compliant person, especially to “bullies” known from the past as a shuttle or aka an errand-runner.

name: Ji-Hun Bae
description:
__Height:__ 183 cm (6')

Jimmy Bae is a supporting antagonist of the Weak Hero. He is a first year at Yoosun High School. He is the head of Yoosun High and a member of the Yeongdeungpo Union.

name: Hak-Ho Ji
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm (5'10.5")

Jake Ji is a supporting antagonists in Weak Hero. He is the leader of Daehyeon High School and originally considered the second strongest delinquent of Yeongdeungpo.

Despite being number 2 in the Yeongdeungpo Union, Jake's personality is similar to Ben Park's. Both of them being extremely strong, outgoing and often take things lightly, but if angered, they're almost invincible. Jake is also the leader of his own gang that is similar to Ben Park's Gang, and is very protective of his friends.

name: Gyu-Hwan Han
description: Gyu-Hwan Han is the main protagonist of Shotgun Boy and a student at Yeongchan High. He is the school outcast who stumbles upon a major secret.

name: Seong-Bin Yu
description: The bully of Gyuh-wan Han.

name: One
description: The main non-human antagonist of Shotgun Boy. He is the de facto leader of the variants experimented on by the MM Corporation.

name: Shin-Yeong Kang
description: Gyuhwan's classmate who's good at archery and an outcast in their grade.

name: Suyeon Kim
description: The homeroom teacher of Class 1 at Yeongchan High

name: Zero
description: Zero is one of the variants.

name: Jayden
description: A foreign teacher at Yeongchan High

name: Eun-Yu Lee
description:
A young girl, who is Hyuk's little sister. She is quite childlike and even a liar. She is part of the Helping Squad. She has a crush on Hyun.

Shortly after being born, Eun and Hyuk's mother died. Only a few years later, their father's company goes bankrupt and the two are left at an orphanage, and their stay becomes permanent when their father dies in an accident. At the time, Eun was still very young; however, she did not appear to take the events well as she started an underage smoking habit. She and Hyuk eventually move to Green Home.

name: Darin Arnschent Kurumiya
native: 来宮・ダリン・アーシェント
description: She used to be professor Boil's assistant. Little is known about her and she spends her stay at the shrine in the basement carrying out her research. She often harasses Furuya and Rea for information about zombification, as much to her despair she is bewildered as to how Rea is able to maintain her condition.   As a child, she was daughter to a researcher and spent most of her time around other zombies which lead to her apathetic and anti-social nature. Because of this, she sees zombies as the only friends she'll ever need.

name: Ranko Saouji
description:
__Height__: 163 cm (5'3")  
__School__: Sanka Girls' High School  
__Class__: Second Year Student  
Chihiro's cousin. She is a student of Sanka Girls' High School. She also likes zombie-related things. Although she's openly competing against Rea and knows of her zombification, they've become good friends.

name: Baabu
description: Chihiro's dead cat who has been revived by him.

name: Jogorou Furuya
description:
__Height:__ 118 cm (3'10")
He is Chihiro's grandfather, who suffers from breaks of dementia.

name: Rosalie
description: Little zombie-girl. Most perfect sample at ZOMA.

name: Ichie Shinoda
description:
__Height:__ 143cm

Furuya Mero's Classmate and friend.

name: Leo Cornelia
description: A Female Knight who has never been treated as a woman.

appearsIn.title: How to Treat a Lady Knight Right

name: Fooly Dent
description: A wizard in love with [Leo Cornelia](https://anilist.co/character/134000).

appearsIn.title: How to Treat a Lady Knight Right

name: Fleur Baranova
description: She is [Miss Leo](https://anilist.co/character/134000)'s junior and a member of the Imperial Knights.

appearsIn.title: How to Treat a Lady Knight Right

name: Forte
description: She is a shaman who took part in the Grand Tournament.

appearsIn.title: How to Treat a Lady Knight Right

name: Sariela
description: Sariela is a fortune teller who likes to tease [Fooly](https://anilist.co/character/134076) and [Leo](https://anilist.co/character/134000).

appearsIn.title: How to Treat a Lady Knight Right

name: Phileo III
description: The King

appearsIn.title: How to Treat a Lady Knight Right

name: Helga Wagner
description:
Helga "Berserk Blade" Wagner is the second strongest knight right after [Leo](https://anilist.co/character/134000).
Despite her frightening behavior she is shy and admires Miss Sacred Sword.

appearsIn.title: How to Treat a Lady Knight Right

name: Irmgard
description: She's destined to be the next Demon Lord.

appearsIn.title: How to Treat a Lady Knight Right

name: Anri Dent
description:
Anri is [Fooly](https://anilist.co/character/134076)'s sister. She likes eating sweets and she is jealous of [Miss Leo](https://anilist.co/character/134000).
For this reason she usually challenges Leo.

appearsIn.title: How to Treat a Lady Knight Right

name: Randa
description: She is a martial artist.

appearsIn.title: How to Treat a Lady Knight Right

name: Masaki Anzai
description:
__Height:__ 170cm (5'7")

A first-year student at Furin High School in Class 1.

(Source: WIND BREAKER Official Website)

name: Jou Togame
description:
The second-in-command of Shishitoren. Donning monk's working clothes and a pair of Japanese geta, Togame's eyes hide behind a pair of sunglasses as he talks at a slow tempo and pace. He possesses a cruel and unforgiving personality. He faithfully carries out Tomiyama's belief that weaklings don't belong in Shishitoren even if they were already members of the group. He antagonizes Sakura by calling him "Othello-kun" after the popular board game. 

(Source: WIND BREAKER Official Website)

name: Taichi Kawasumi
description: Kawasumi is a 15 year old student who attends Shuudai High. He is childhood friends with Ryosuke, and he is most attracted to the popular Suiren. Kawasumi is particularly talented in karate as he can easily defeat 3 attackers at the same time, and he was also the champion of a particular tournament (chapter 18).  Kawasumi was first seen as the only man who did not look Suiren's way. His first real encounter with her was when he saved her and her things from a senpai. Since then, the attraction between the two grew; Kawasumi would only talk to Suiren and Suiren, in return, would try her best to converse only towards him. By eating with each other on the rooftop, secretly going to the cultural festival together, and walking home with each other, their relationship developed.

name: Suiren Shibazeki
description: Suiren is a extremely cute and very quiet girl. Because she's so cute, she gets a lot of attention from both boys and girls. In elementary school, Suiren was bullied by the boys who liked her, so she doesn't know how to get along with boys anymore. She went to an all-girls middle school, but the girls were drooling over her as well, and got overly excited whenever she talked or smiled. Suiren started speaking less and less and her expressions slowly disappeared.

name: Meguna Sotomura
description: She became Suiren's classmate and friend in her second year of high school. She has a boyfriend and loves to talk about love and romance. Despite her flashy appearance, she is very sensitive and considerate of her friends' feelings.

name: Mina Ozaki
description: A volleyball club member who is dating Ryousuke.

name: Yuri Kudou
description: Sayuri originally attended the same middle school as Kawasumi and Ryosuke, and she is now Suiren and Aya's newest and closest high school friend.  She fully supports Suiren's relationship with Kawasumi, and she along with Aya try to form plans for them to get together.  It is hinted that Sayuri has someone that she likes (they work in the same cafe) but his details were never mentioned.

name: Aya Shimizu
description: Aya is the cool and almost emotionless childhood friend of Suiren. They've been with each other since elementary school, and she is also acquainted with Suiren's parents.   Since they've been with each other for so long, Aya can understand Suiren's thoughts and emotions without her voicing them out. Aya also acts as her spokesperson.

name: Atohira
description: Atohira is an upperclassman and a fellow karate club member of Taichi Kawasumi during middle school. He is Ichi's friend.

name: Ichi Kawasumi
description: Taichi Kawasumi's older brother and Atohira's best friend.

name: Koharu Shinkawa
description:
Koharu is a second year upperclassman, and likes Kawasumi. She considers Suiren her 'rival'.

(Source: Hibi Chouchou Wiki)

name: Ryousuke Takaya
description: Ryousuke is Taichi Kawasumi's childhood friend and fellow member of the karate club. He is less accomplished than his friend. He has a younger brother and harbors unrequited feelings for Suiren.

name: Miwa Inuzuka
description:
**Height:** 166 cm (5'5")

She got her hair styled like [Shiina Ringo](https://anilist.co/staff/103213) in order to fuel her creative process. Likes the fine arts and literature, but also enjoys more niche, sub-cultural hobbies.

name: Saeko Sawatari
description: Whether concerts or theme parks, she just like things that stimulate her. She dresses like she doesn't really care. Despite that, women love her.

name: Yuria Washio
description: A student at a technical school studying to become a beautician.

name: Tamaki Shishio
description: A first-year who came to the band club's welcome party, she kind of resembles Shiho

name: Rika
description: The crazy girl of the club. She's uninhibited when it comes to sex and is occasionally an airhead

name: Mikkun
description: He is the vocalist of Miwa and Saeko's band. Extremely pessimistic but cheerful, he is good at singing

name: Tsuruta
description: Fell in love with Miwa at first sight

name: Usshi
description: The one with the most common sense. She has anxieties about her lack of romantic experience.

name: Shiho Kumagai
description: She and Miwa went to the same high school and were both in the tennis club. Shiho currently lives in Okinawa

name: Takahito Tougo
description:
Takahito was a student at Saint Isidore University and the leader of the Melee Fight Crew. When the outbreak occurred, he took it upon himself to step up and enforce strict rules to the remaining survivors. He was a supporting character in the Gakkou Gurashi! series.

(Source: fandom.com)

name: Renya Kougami
description:
Ren was the first student in Saint Isidore University to encounter the School Life Club members. He was a member of the Melee Fight Crew and a supporting character in the Gakkou Gurashi! series.

(Source: fandom.com)

name: Touko Deguchi
description:
Touko is one of the girls, including Hikako Kirai and Aki Hikarizato, that School: Live Club and Ruu Wakasa encountered after fleeing from their unnamed pursuers. As the Fallen Crew club president, her job is to make everything, and anything they do, fun.

She is the Leader of the "Degeneracy Club", later Renamed "The Circle", and is the most notable Gamer in the series, even getting yelled at in Vol.10 for "spewing her Gamer Brain" onto others.

(Source: fandom.com)

name: Takashige Shiromoto
description: Takashige was a student at Saint Isidore University and a member of the Melee Fight Crew. He was a supporting character in the Gakkou Gurashi! series.

name: Sino Uhara
description:
Sino is a supporting character in the Gakkou Gurashi! series. She is a student at Saint Isidore University and a member of the Melee Fight Crew. Though shy by nature, Sino is the primary "zombie killer" of her group, as she is considered very important by her teammates.

(Source: fandom.com)

name: Bo-Ta Ma
description: Bo-Ta is a drifter who tries to survive the post-apocalyptic waters of the earth.

name: Ri-Ta Ma
description: Ri-Ta Ma (also translated as Li-Ta Ma) is one of the main protagonists of Leviathan. The daughter and youngest child of former Harpoonist Te-On Ma and his wife Narisa, and the younger sister of Bo-Ta Ma, Rita is a young drifter who tries to survive the post-apocalyptic waters of the earth with her brother and their protector, Kana.

name: Kana
description: Kana is one of the main protagonists of Leviathan. She is a three-star Harpoonist from the ship Busan Union who becomes the guardian and mentor for the siblings Bo-Ta and Ri-Ta Ma, the children of her idol Te-On Ma.

name: Te-On Ma
description:
Te-On Ma is the father of the series' main protagonists, Bo-Ta and Ri-Ta Ma. Though he is only active during the opening arc of Leviathan, Te-On is a pivotal character whose actions and personality continue to influence the lives of his children.

He was a legendary Harpoonist of the Bosun Union ship, and the only known member to have become a Six-Star Harpoonist before leaving the Union.

name: Sonia
description: Sonia is a former Harpoonist from the Floating City and a former member of the explorer team led by the late Jako Gusto, alongside her partner Gongtae Park, as well as a former resident of Port Oasis. She becomes an associate of the Bo-Ta and Ri-Ta Ma, as well as Kana, joining on their journey.

name: Il-Deung Na
description: Il-Deung is a student who is obsessed with studying and has ranked number one in the whole entire school. He sits next to A-I in class.

name: A-I Yun
description: A-I is a girl living alone with her younger sister. She works hard in school and tries to make enough money to afford living expenses. She despises people who lack responsibility, but her life changes when she meets the magician.

name: Lala
description:
__Species:__ Dullahan

Lala is the seventh resident of Kimihito's house.

name: Kuroko Smith
description:
Ms. Smith is Kimihito Kurusu’s Cultural Exchange Coordinator. She checks up on Kimihito and his wards on a regular basis, constantly reminding him that any violation of the Cultural Exchange Between Species Bill will result in his arrest and the deportation of the exchange program participants.

Smith's given name is never used in the series and has only been revealed in official merchandise.

name: Zombina
description:
__Species:__ Zombie (formerly Human)

A undead Commander and apart of special task force made up of extraspecies girls, known as MON (Monster of a Neuro).

name: Yu-Jin Han
description:
__Age__: 30 (pre-regression), 25 (post-regression)

Han Yu-Jin is a stat F-rank Hunter. He dedicates his childhood to raising his younger brother Han Yu-Hyeon. When Yu-Hyeonn eventually Awakens as an S-rank Hunter and later sacrifices himself to save his brother's life, Han Yu-Jin goes back in time to prevent his death.

name: Yu-Hyeon Han
description:
__Age:__ 25 (pre-regression), 20 (post-regression)

Han Yu-Hyeon is one of the strongest Korean S-rank Hunters, and the leader of Haeyeon Guild. He is the younger brother of Han Yu-Jin, for whom he sacrificed himself in the original timeline.

name: Ye-Rim Park
description: Park Yerim is the second female S-class hunter in Korea, who awakened with the help of Han Yu-Jin, her legal guardian after severing her ties with her abusive uncle & aunt. Before the regression, she had originally awakened as an A-class hunter. She is contracted with Han Yu-Jin, and is currently a member of Haeyeon Guild.

name: Myeong-U Yu
description: Yu Myeong-U is an F-class awakener who receives an SS-rank skill that allows him to craft any type of weapon or armor that enhance the user's abilities. As Han Yu-Jin played a major role for helping him achieve the skill, Yu Myeong-U is forever in debt to Han Yu-Jin, resulting in becoming best friends.

name: Peace
description: Peace was found by Han Yu-Hyeon in a dungeon, and due to his fire-attributed skills, he was taken by him to tame it. Though, he failed to do so, he planned to kill Peace instead, until Han Yu-Jin took him under his wing and successfully tamed him.

name: Hyeon-Je Seong
description: A natural-born S-Class hunter and the guild leader of the Seseong Guild.

name: Inukai
description:
Sigil: Speedster
A player in Darwin's Game. He practices boxing.

name: Youta Shinozuka
description: Shinozuka Youta is one of Sudou Kaname's friends.

name: Hideaki Kanehira
description: Kanehira Hideaki was the leader of the clan Kanehira Insurance Union.

name: Miralupa
description: "The Emperor, Younger Brother" of Dorok. He has paranormal powers as his father did, and therefore, he is the one who actually rules the Empire. He is a ruthless ruler, and feared by his people.    (Source: nausicca.net)

appearsIn.title: Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind

name: Namulis
description: "The Emperor, Older Brother" of Dorok. He doesn't have a mystic power, and had been virtually locked up in the palace for 100 years. Near the end of the story, however, he leaves the capital, Shuwa, and starts taking charge of things. 100 years of boredom seems to have affected his psyche rather badly, and now he wants to have some "excitement", which is a bad news for Nausicaä and everyone else.    Source: nausicaa.net

appearsIn.title: Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind

name: Charuka
description: The Commander of the Dorok Army. He is very loyal to Miralupa, and fears that Nausicaä might be the "Blue Clad One", who is supposed to destroy Miralupa and the Dorok Empire.
