After meeting Nausicaä in person, Charuka convinced himself that Nausicaä is not an enemy of the empire. He is a fair and practical person, and cooperates with Nausicaä to save his people.     Source: nausicaa.net

appearsIn.title: Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind

name: Ketcha
description: Ketcha is an acolyte of the Holy One and a member of the Mani Tribe.

appearsIn.title: Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind

name: Toeto
description: The furry and lovable fox-squirrel companion of Nausicaa. Found accidentally by Lord Yupa, but seemed to grow towards Nausicaa easily. Resides on Nausicaa's shoulder or amongst her cleavage.

appearsIn.title: Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind

name: Chiaki Uchimura
description: He's a friendly boy from class 2-4 and is not a member of any school clubs.

name: Alice Himemiya
description: In class 2-7 and the cooking club.

name: Kimihito Onizuka
description: Kimihito is a loner and doesn't have very good social skills. He has an interest in rapping.

name: Chiba Sayaka
description:
She is a student in class 2-7 who is in the Library Committee. Sayaka is described as grown up and mature for her age, although her own selflessness can sometimes gets the better of her. 
She has a crush on Youichi, even though he is a teacher.

name: Haruka Saejima
description: In class 3-5 and the karate club.

name: Mai Toujou
description: She is a student in class 2-7 who is in the Library Committee. Mai is really bad at expressing herself that she gets nervous and becomes rigidly harsh against others,

name: Urushi Yaotome
description:
__Grade:__ 3rd Year of High School
__Height:__ 149.7 cm

She's one of the two members of the shogi club and the Self-proclaimed president of it.

appearsIn.title: When Will Ayumu Make His Move?

name: Ayumu Tanaka
description:
__Grade:__ 2nd Year of High School
__Height:__ 178 cm

He's one of the two members of the shogi club.

appearsIn.title: When Will Ayumu Make His Move?

name: Sakurako Mikage
description: Mikage Sakurako is a shy classmate and childhood friend of [Takeru Kakuryuu](https://anilist.co/character/191059/Kakuryuu-Takeru) and [Ayumu Tanaka](https://anilist.co/character/127464/Tanaka-Ayumu). She spends a lot of time with Kakuryuu Takeru.

appearsIn.title: When Will Ayumu Make His Move?

name: Takeru Kakuryuu
description: Takeru is a childhood friend of Ayumu Tanaka and Mikage Sakurako, whom he spends a lot of time with.

appearsIn.title: When Will Ayumu Make His Move?

name: Maki
description: Urushi's Best Friend. She constantly teases Urushi when it comes to Ayumu.

appearsIn.title: When Will Ayumu Make His Move?

name: Rin Kagawa
description: Rin Kagawa is a junior (kouhai) of Tanaka Ayumu, Kakuryuu Takeru and Mikage Sakurako. She attends the same middle school as all of her seniors, and also in high school. She was in the former Kendo Club in middle school and joins the Shogi club due to following Ayumu's steps. She loves to compete in any competition especially Shogi and Kendo with her senpais, especially Ayumu and Takeru.

appearsIn.title: When Will Ayumu Make His Move?
Even If You Slit My Mouth
Even If You Slit My Mouth

name: Mikoto
description: Mikoto is a side character and Miroku's brother.

appearsIn.title: Even If You Slit My Mouth

name: Yu-Seol Baek
description:
He is a 10-year-veteran of the game Aether World and exclusively plays as the trash character Baek Yuseol due to their identical name and appearance.

Although he is a veteran player of Aether World, Baek Yuseol is quite uninterested in the plot and would often skip important story cutscenes. His attention mainly goes towards the PvP and Alchemical Engineering side of the game.
After being transmigrated, Baek Yuseol tries to minimize his involvement with the main characters of the game.

appearsIn.title: Blink Master of the Magic Academy

name: Flame
description: It is mentioned that she have an open personality with everyone, care about their friends, and would save them without expecting anything in return.

appearsIn.title: Blink Master of the Magic Academy

name: Bi-Yeon Adolebit Hong
description:
She is one of the main characters in the game. She and the main female protagonist always have arguments.

Originally, she had a cold and hateful personality, with complexes and low self-esteem. However, as the story progresses, she change completely.

appearsIn.title: Blink Master of the Magic Academy
Blink Master of the Magic Academy

name: Yu-Seong Ma
description: He is recognized as the most prodigious first year at Stella Academy, a genius of the century due to his talent

appearsIn.title: Blink Master of the Magic Academy
Sometimes Even Reality Is a Lie!
Sometimes Even Reality Is a Lie!

name: Miruku Amakawa
description: Nanami's first friend outside of Kaoru.

appearsIn.title: Sometimes Even Reality Is a Lie!

name: Shouko Ousaka
description: Nanami's mother and housewife.

appearsIn.title: Sometimes Even Reality Is a Lie!

name: Otokonoko
description: The innocent boy half-human half-abomination. Isolated in a cave since Birth.

name: Miki Kirishima
description: The wife of Seiichi Kirishima and a former mother. She holds a bitter emotion against her husband after their only son's death.

name: Yuuhi Amamiya
description: The main character of the story. A reclusive, glasses-wearing college student who initially refuses Noi Crezant's request to help save the world. The reason behind his unsocial nature is his grandfather, who raised Yuuhi and believed that having friends was useless. Eventually, he changes his mind in order to help Samidare Asahina, who he usually refers to as Princess.  His ability is called domain control. He can exert a weak telekinetic force on a small bubble of air, just enough to hold himself above the ground for a few seconds or slow down an enemy's attack. Although his overall combat skills are much weaker than that of most of the other characters.

name: Samidare Asahina
description: An enthusiastic young girl, and one of the protagonists, though she does not appear to have an animal partner. Her body is extremely strong, enough to do a hundred push-ups with Amamiya on her back or destroy a golem in one blow. She wants to save the Earth from the Biscuit Hammer, but her reason for doing so is so she can eventually destroy the world herself.

name: Yayoi Hakudou
description: Hakudou is a calm girl that likes anime and her favourite hobby is doing cosplay. She made a contract with Shea, the 'snake knight'.

name: Hanako Sorano
description: The Mantis Knight.

name: Lance Lumiere
description:
The Mouse familar. His knight partner is Kusakabe Tarou.

(Source: The Lucifer and Biscuit Hammer Wiki)

name: Subaru Hoshikawa
description: The Rooster Knight.

name: Yukimachi Tsukishiro
description: The Turtle Knight

name: Shea Moon
description:
The Snake familiar. His knight partner is Hakudou Yayoi.

(Source: The Lucifer and Biscuit Hammer Wiki)

name: Anima
description: Animus twin sister. She is the creator of the beast knights and with their help tries to prevent Animus from destroying the Earth.

name: Akitani Inachika
description: The Swordfish Knight.

name: Minami Sagami
description:
Minami is the leader of the second most influential clique in class 2F, and holds a grudge towards [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/67069/Yuigahama-Yui), who she was friendly with in their first high school year, for being in the superior clique.

She volunteered to be event organizer for the cultural festival in order to promote her worth without the actual ability to do such job, and thus requested help from the service club.

appearsIn.title: My Youth Romantic Comedy Is Wrong, As I Expected

name: Roxana Agriche
description:
The name Roxana means "bright, sun, sunlight, sun god, day, dawn". She was named by her father.

Roxana Agriche is the main character of the Roxana series. She is the daughter of [Lante Agriche](https://anilist.co/character/207017/Agriche-Lant) and [Sierra Agriche](https://anilist.co/character/207016/Agriche-Sierra), and the biological younger sister of [Achille Agriche](https://anilist.co/character/287117/Agriche-Achille).

Roxana is a very cunning individual who has developed the ability to manipulate or deceive others in order to survive or obtain what she wants. While she is always poised and mellow-voiced, she is also able to cut others with her words.

name: Sierra Agriche
description: [Achille's](https://anilist.co/character/287117/Achille-Agriche) and [Roxana's](https://anilist.co/character/207021/Roxana-Agriche) Mother.

name: Lant Agriche
description: Lant Agriche is the head of the Agriche family. He is a cruel man who will not hesitate to kill his own children if they decide to turn their back on him or are not useful to the family. He views his children as his dogs who should follow his every order.

name: Jeremy Agriche
description: Jeremy is childish and very reckless. He gets very angry when someone tries to harm his sister Roxana Agriche. Because he grew up in a loveless house, he craves his older half-sister's affection and gets easily jealous when someone takes her attention away from him.

name: Dion Agriche
description:
Deon is very intelligent and ruthless, even compared to the other Agriche children. He rarely shows emotions unless it is involving his half-sister Roxana Agriche, but has shown to be as sadistic as his parents when he attacked Cassis Pedelian.

Dion is Lant and Maria's child. Like all children of the Agriche, he went through the same education. He is responsible of the death of Achille Agriche.

name: Sylvia Pedelian
description: The heroine of the original novel. Cassis Fedelian's younger sister. She is in favor of Roxana and hopes to connect her with her brother.

name: Luzak Castro
description: Luzak Castro is the heir of the Castro family. He has a phobia of women. He gets easily provoked by Jeremy and is quick to threaten bodily harm.

name: Navier Trobi
description: Empress of the Eastern Empire.

name: Henry Ales Lazlo
description: Emperor of the Western Empire (formerly Kingdom).

name: Sovieshu Trobi Victo
description: Emperor of the Eastern Empire

name: Rashta Iskua
description: Mistress of Emperor Soveishu.

name: Koshar Trobi
description: Koshar is the older brother of Navier.

name: Kaufman
description: Grand Duke Kaufman is a Prince from the desert Kingdom of Luipt and a knowledgeable magician.

name: Rou
description:
__Affiliation:__ Goblin Community, Parabellum
__Rank:__ Colonel/1st in the Goblin Community

Rou, whose former name was Tomokui Kanata, was a human with an esper ability. One day, he was killed by someone whom he regard as a sister and a stalker. Later, he woke to find out he was reincarnated as a goblin, a monster species considered to be of the lowest class. His memories as a human remained with him, however, and he had a second chance at life, Rou was determined to live his life to the fullest.

name: Felicia Timiano
description:
__Job(s):__ Peddler, Cook, Tailor

Felicia Timiano is a cook and a tailor like her twin younger sister [Alma Timiano](https://anilist.co/character/305960/Alma-Timiano). She is a former member of the merchant association Star God Pavilion.

She is gentle and a worrywart, however, she becomes scary when she gets angry.

name: Fuu
description:
Fu is one of the goblins from [Rou](https://anilist.co/character/133061/Rou)'s generation. Like Me, she at first is one of the minor members of Rou's group, 

She seems to linger around after a hunt, snacking on and collecting meat that seems spoiled to others. She has an unusual laugh.

name: Mi
description:
__Affiliation:__ Goblin Community, Parabellum 
__Rank:__ Major/3rd in the Goblin Community
__Corp:__ Tirard

Joined Rou's party after Kichi. She is the head of the Tirard Corps, dealing with long range weapons such as slingstaffs, bows, and cross-bows. Mi has an easy-going personality and has always wanted to be with Rou. She has been praising and complimenting Rou ever since they first spoke.

name: Sato
description:
Sato was a goblin from the previous generation before [Rou](https://anilist.co/character/133061/Rou). She was with the group of older goblins and hobgoblins that captured the 5 female humans.

Sato is a joyous one, sometimes mocking Sei. But when she draws her sword she is unstoppable. 
She has the habit to spend a lot of money to acquire Swords.

name: Kichi
description:
__Affiliation:__ Goblin Community, Parabellum
__Rank:__ Lieutenant Colonel/2nd in the Goblin Community

Kichi is Rou's first goblin friend. He lacks intelligence but makes up for it with brute strength.

name: E
description: E is the Head of the logistical support group Pleasure and leader of the mining group. She was the first goblin to ask [Rou](https://anilist.co/character/133061/Rou) to train them. She was also placed 4th in the very first hierarchy tournament.

name: Ji
description:
Ji was the first to become a Cleric amongst those in Parabellum, 

Ji became a cleric upon ranking up into a Hobgoblin, which is a class that specializes in healing and protection abilities.

name: Alma Timiano
description:
__Job(s):__ Peddler, Cook, Tailor

Alma Timiano is a cook and a tailor like her twin older sister Felicia. She is a former member of the merchant association Star God Pavilion.

She is gentle and shy. However, she becomes scary when she gets angry.

name: Jii
description:
Jii was a goblin who managed to live until he attained the age of 20, a great elderly among goblins.

This pervert whose lust for younger girls, regardless of their race, and can't be satisfied even at his ripe old age.
That aside, he had shown to be very caring of his kin and a wise counselor.

name: Wada
description: Shun's old classmate. Shun used to have a crush on him.

name: Nozomi
description:
Nozomi is a soft-spoken and shy friend of Yuka who would have been introduced around episode 6-7, but only appears in the manga for unknown reasons, although some theories are that they couldn't find a fitting voice for her, or that they didn't know what to do with her since the manga was still ongoing. She has a psychological bladder problem because of her father frequently physically abusing her when she was a child for wanting to become a singer and therefore wears diapers. Kouta first encounters her while walking to the store (not realising they both know Yuka), and both are embarrassed when the wind blows her skirt up. They later meet at the inn, and Nozomi is revealed to have a great talent for singing, wanting stay at the inn in order to apply for a music school without her abusive father learning about it. Nozomi is the person who sings the song "Elfenlied", while teaching Nyū how to sing.    

(Source: Manga & Wikipedia)

name: Kurama
description:
He is the chief of research, aged in his mid-30's, of the diclonius children in the research containment facility. He is also the surrogate father of Nana and biological father of Mariko. 

(Source:Wikipedia)

name: Kakuzawa Kyouju
description:
He is the son of Chief Kakuzawa and also a watered-down diclonius with smaller horns and no vectors in his mid-30's. When he and Kurama were younger, they both went to university together and it was Kakuzawa that originally got Kurama involved in the research on Diclonius. He ends up, coincidentally, being the lecturer for a course at the university in which Kouta and Yuka are enrolled.  

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Shirakawa
description: Is a scientist that works very closely with Kurama. Though her personality on the surface reflects a business-like demeanor, she holds a secret affection and genuine concern for Kurama.

name: Anna Kakuzawa
description: Anna is a Chief Kakuzawa's daughter. She looks up to him in a similar fashion to Nana and Kurama's relationship. She was good at running and struggled to meet her father's expectations, for he considered her "superior" due to her Diclonius heritage.  She underwent an operation on her father's request, to make her "more superior". The results of the operation have increased her mental capacity and therefore she can predict estimates of what the future may be. However the operation has turned her into a giant deformed Diclonius. Her previous self is seen in a number of flashbacks.

name: Majime Yamashita
description: [Shijima](https://anilist.co/character/136264/Tsukishima-Shijima)'s classmate. Cheerful and not diligent at all, contrary to her name. Was apparently born with a sunny-side egg on her head.

name: Shijima Tsukishima
description: Was a shut-in for two years before entering high-school, during which two stalks of Shimeji mushrooms grew on her head. Can't be bothered to do anything and is a pessimist.

name: Sumida Senpai
description: A second-year student and a member of the Hole Digging Club. She does not like to talk, and communicates by writing in her sketchbook most of the time.

name: Ayaka
description: Classmate of Shijima and Majime. Vocalist and Pianist of the light music club

name: Mogawa Sensei
description: Teaches art at Shijima and Majime's school, and is the advisor for the hole-digging club. Often sinks into a depressive spiral of thoughts, and loves drinking.

name: Yoshiko
description: Classmate of Shijima and Majime. Bassist in the light music club

name: Shijima no Ane
description: Lives together with Shijima as something of a parent figure. She quit university and is currently focusing on some sort of incomprehensible research.

name: Yomikawa Senpai
description: Likes to read. Can't carry anything heavier than a book even though she is on a hole-digging club.

name: Kirishima Miyama
description: Yoshino's fiance. His grandfather is the president of the Miyama group, a yakuza organization in the Kantou region.

appearsIn.title: Yakuza Fiancé: Raise wa Tanin ga Ii

name: Yoshino Somei
description: Her grandfather is the leader of the Somei yakuza group from the Kansai region. She came to live in Tokyo due to an arranged marriage.

appearsIn.title: Yakuza Fiancé: Raise wa Tanin ga Ii

name: Shouma Toriashi
description: Shouma Toriashi is an old friend of [Yoshino's](https://anilist.co/character/127205/Somei-Yoshino) and his adopted relative. Currently he's a university student.

appearsIn.title: Yakuza Fiancé: Raise wa Tanin ga Ii

name: Masato no Aniki
description: Masato's older brother.

name: The Talon
description: Leader of the Sea's Talons. Cold and sadistic, this pirate doesn't hesitate to torture her prisoners if it means keeping them under her control.  Mihaya reveals that his father and brother have relations to the Sea's Talons and with that information leads Zen and his group to the Talon's hiding place.

appearsIn.title: Snow White with the Red Hair

name: Hisame Lugis
description: Hisame Lugis is an acquaintance of Kiki Seiran and Mitsuhide Rouen. He is the second son of Count Lugis, who decided he wanted to marry Kiki at age eleven to raise his social status by becoming the consort of the next head of the Seiran family. With the additional benefit of removing himself from his older brother's command by becoming part of a different Earldom.

appearsIn.title: Snow White with the Red Hair

name: Trow
description: A suspicious woman Shirayuki and company meet at an inn. She knows Obi from a previous job they did together. Torou secretly asks Obi for help on a mission and he agrees. After they complete their mission she remarks that he's changed.

appearsIn.title: Snow White with the Red Hair

name: Yuzuri
description: A botanist from Lilias who becomes a friend of Shirayuki's

appearsIn.title: Snow White with the Red Hair

name: Kirito
description: A boy from Lilias who befriends Ryuu

appearsIn.title: Snow White with the Red Hair

name: Mikaze
description: Introduced as the general of the "Lions of the Mountain" and is later revealed to be Shirayuki's father.     When Zen confesses that he is in love with his daughter he disapproves but only jokingly. Mikaze departs from them knowing his daughter is in good hands and is working hard towards her future

appearsIn.title: Snow White with the Red Hair

name: Hyuse
description: Hyuse is a character in the manga and anime series World Trigger. He is a Neighbor from Aftokrator who after being caught in a battle with [Jin](https://anilist.co/character/89014/Jin-Yuuichi) ends up stranded/abandoned on Earth.

name: Replica
description: Replica is Yuuma's Guardian. He often guides him and give him advices. However, he does not interfere with Yuuma's decision. He also assists him during battles like preparing him certain seals to make Yuuma's attack more complicated.

name: Raijinmaru
description: Raijinmaru is a resident in Tamakoma Branch and Youtarou Rindou's pet capybara

name: Kazuaki Ouji
description:
Ouji is an Attacker and the leader of Ouji Squad (B-rank #5).

He is a perceptive and scheming individual. He also has a habit of giving others weird nicknames. He acts in a princely manner, appearing to be a purposeful reference to his surname, as he was the one to request Kittaka to make the icons he uses in his explanations, which depict him as a handsome guy with a prince's crown. This also reflects on his interests, with some of his favorite things being omelettes, croissants, horses, and chess.

Ouji is the best combatant of his squad, being a competent fighter and a masterful strategist. His mobility is top-level and his swordmanship is skilled enough to take two points by himself and almost defeat Yuma. His overall skill and technique granted him a place as a candidate for the away-mission test.

name: Moribayashi-sensei
description:
A teacher at Osamu and Yuma's school.
(Source: World Trigger Wikia)

name: Rudbeckia de Borgia
description:
__Height:__ 161 cm (5'3")

Romagna’s princess, nicknamed 'Angel of Sistina'. She is Iske’s wife and the illegitimate daughter of Pope. Abused in both past and current lives.

appearsIn.title: How to Win My Husband Over

name: Iske van Omerta
description:
__Height:__ 195 cm (6'5")

Paladin of Brittania, successor to Omerta duchy. Rudbeckia’s husband.

appearsIn.title: How to Win My Husband Over

name: Cezar de Borgia
description:
__Height:__ 188 cm (6'2")

He is the first son of Pope de Borgia, the older brother of Enzo de Borgia and the older adoptive brother of Rudbeckia. 

In Sodom and The Holy Grail, he was cruel and abusive towards his sister Ruby who he would use to further the church's political ambition alongside the Pope.

appearsIn.title: How to Win My Husband Over

name: Elenia Van Omerta
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm (5'8")

Iske's younger sister.

appearsIn.title: How to Win My Husband Over

name: Freya Van Furiana
description:
__Height:__ 169 cm (5'7")

name: Onigiri
description: Team: Kogarasumaru  Road: Smell Road    One of Ikki's childhood friends, Onigiri (オニギリ, Onigiri?) is also part of Kogarasumaru. His head is in the shape of an onigiri. Onigiri is a pervert and characterized as a pig. He has an unusual way of using his perspiration, usually during overall perverted moments, to create illusions. He also has a strange way of using his AT by sitting upside down on it (to the chagrin of his female schoolmates whose skirts he tends to look up while doing this). This way of riding proved to be very dangerous, for both Onigiri and his opponent, as he flails his legs back and forth(doing damage if he's close enough), but can also fall off, landing directly on the point of his head and streaking on the ground until he stops (this, however, is never shown, only an image of an actual onigiri in said position). He is in the same class as Ikki, and follows the "Smell Road." (the authenticity of this road is arguable, since one can't really tell if this was just another one of Oh!Great's jokes. However stated by Akito/Agito in Kyoto, there are "hundreds" of roads. But out of those only 8 roads can be called Road of King.) He can also go as fast (or possibly faster) for short spurts than Ringo, when the right motivation is present. At chapter 171 Onigiri is seen trainning with his friends in order to get stronger than before, most of his techniques have the ability to affect the enemy's senses, create illusions.

name: Issha Mihotoke
description: Team: Kogarasumaru  Former Team: Night King   Known as Buccha to his friends and teammates, Issa Mihotoke (御仏 一茶, Mihotoke Issa) is a level E AT user who uses his immense strength as his weapon. Before he became part of Kogarasumaru, he was the leader of the team Night King (夜王 Yaou) which was broken up after Buccha lost a Parts War with Ikki. Buccha is often characterized as a tank. He attends Higachu Junior High School. He appears to be obese, but his body is only ten percent fat. His size is actually caused by a large amount of blood pooling in his gut from overeating. He also has the ability to manipulate that blood and send it to his muscles, causing him to temporarily have a slimmer, cut figure and even cause his limbs to become longer. He also has a semi-split personality similar to that of Akito/Agito. When not in a fight is simply cares for food and relaxing. But when the topic of battle comes up his other half takes hold, and he becomes a devastating killing machine. He can also dance. He uses brass knuckles-esque gloves in combat, which combined with his superhuman strength is truly devastating his character design is based on the wrestler Abdullah the butcher note the three lines on his forehead, and his nickname "Buccha".   (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Kazuma Mikura
description: Team- Kogarasumaru  Status- Flame King  Road- Flame Road   known as Kazu to his friends, is a childhood friend of Ikki who becomes influenced to take up AT and join Kogarasumaru. He is originally bullied by Ikki as a child, and he often feels like others are more important than himself, especially compared to Ikki's natural talent. In the manga, Kazu owns a dog named Chiwa. He takes up running at a later point, which eventually leads to him being an exceptionally fast AT rider. As he shows signs of following the Flame Road, Spitfire takes an interest in him and eventually proclaims Kazu to be the next Flame King. He is given the Flame Regalia before Spitfire's death, Kazu soon discovers this during his challenge to be the hero who saves the fallen from hell. Kazu soon realizes that he truly wants to fight against Ikki and they began their battle. Kazu fights an amazing battle against Ikki. Though it seems that Ikki had gained the upper hand, he left the fight a draw. Kazu was very satisfied with how he had become close to Ikki's level. It has been revealed that Kazu has adopted not only Spitfire's techniques, such as Afterburner, but also Aeon Clock's Time Manipulation, which he has been taught by the advanced training program left in Spitfire's ATs. Kazu has recently copied a trick called "Flame Lens" from his opponent. This allows him to create an illusion of himself and Agito and win them their fight.

name: Itsuki Minami
description:
__Height:__ 167cm
__Team:__ Kogarasumaru
__Road:__ Wing
__Road Status:__ Sky King candidate,  
 
Known as Ikki (イッキ?) by his friends, and also known as Babyface, is a free spirited AT rider that has a natural affiliation for being in the sky. He is introduced to ATs by Noyamano family, whom he lives with due to his parents' deaths. He eventually forms Kogarasumaru, and takes on the Trophaeum. Ikki is often characterized as a crow due to a small crow, Kū, using his hair as a nest.  Ikki is able to see the Wing Road, and his peers often consider him to be the best candidate to become the next Sky King. He possesses two passive traits known as Hawk Eye and Trick Pass, which allow him to easily survey an area and utilize any part of it. Both are considered attributes necessary for a candidate to be Sky King. 

He trains under Sora to better utilize the wind, and he eventually obtains the incomplete Wind Regalia. He is able to use it to move quickly and fly, though he is unable to properly use its destructive power. The regalia is stolen by Sora and Nike, who are revealed to be antagonists harboring a grudge against Sleeping Forest. This leaves Ikki despondent and depressed, until Kazu reveals a message left behind by Spitfire after his death. Spitfire questions if Ikki has really "lost his wings," which leads to Ikki to be proclaimed the "Storm King of the Hurricane Road" by his Principal in Chapter 169.

name: Ringo Noyamano
description: Team- Sleeping Forest Status- Thorn Queen Road- Sonia Road  Ringo looks like your everyday junior high school girl. However, she is actually the successor of the legendary Storm Riders team, Sleeping Forest . She is also the current Thorn King (Queen) of the eight 'Kings' in the AT world. Ringo is in love with Ikki but does not dare to tell him. She helps Kogarasumaru in times of trouble under the guise of Croissant Mask (Croissiant Kamen). Ringo is a King Class AT user. Ringo is determined to show Ikki the "fear" of flying through the air, because she doesn't want to see him suffer the same fate the last 'Wind King' did. To this end she was even willing to brutally attack him using her 'Thorn Regalia'. During the battle she seems to have total control of the fight as Ikki is completely out-classed. But Kururu Sumeragi saves Ikki with a mid-air installation of the Bagram prototype cores. Ikki then becomes more than a match for Ringo. The fight then seemingly ends in a draw with Ikki carrying Ringo back home. After that battle Ikki leaves the Noyamano residence, but not before Ringo finally reveals her feeling for Ikki and kisses him goodbye. Later in the Tower of Tropheum, Killik reveals the true purpose of Ringo as leader of Sleeping Forest. Due to the final battle for the Sky King takes place where not only the air is incredibly dense, and the atmosphere is giving off the feeling of crushing you, Ringo is completely immune to it.

name: Kururu Sumeragi
description: Kururu Sumeragi is the leader of the current Tool Toul To and Pledge Queen. She has very messy hair, and uses pins in attempt to keep it kempt. She always carries tools around in her clothing. She is Ikki's Tunner and wants to get to know him better personally and in order to tune him better. Although shy around Ikki at first, she becomes devoted to him after witnessing his anger over Simca's attack. She does not wear ATs, but as the leader of Tool Toul To, she is a true genius in repair, construction, and maintenance of ATs. In Ikki's battle with Ringo, Kururu identified the sound of Ikki's ATs, arrived at the battle in time to intercept Ikki as he was falling towards the river, and rebuilt his ruined ATs in midair in less than three seconds. She originally rebuilds the Wind Regalia for him, though it is stolen and given to Sora. During the Fight with White Wolf Clan, Kururu wants to show Ikki her power as a tuner by helping out the other team. Afterwards, Ikki asks her to create the new Storm Regalia for him, a request which she gladly accepts.    It quickly becomes evident that Kururu has feelings for Ikki. During the talk with Kilik and betrayal of Sora, she ran to him and tried to confort him.Later on, she appeared along with Simca and Ringo (under the guise of Croissant Mask) after Kogarasumaru's special training.

name: Agito Wanijima
description: Akito Wanijima and Agito Wanijima are two personalities that make up the Fang King, of the Bloody Road. They are originally part of the Wind SWAT team, in which they are treated like a tool by their older brother, Kaito. Ikki eventually saves them, and they join Kogarasumaru. They switch who is in control by using an eye patch. Akito is innocent and non-violent. He becomes attracted to Ikki, much to Ikki's discontent, and often tries to kiss, bathe, and sleep next to or with Ikki. He states he was the original Fang King until he became disgusted with himself and became unable to use AT. Agito then appears and starts using ATs, while following his own violent and bloodthirsty nature. He tends to swear a lot and uses four hooks dangling from straps on his legs to battle and tear people apart. When equipped with the Fang Regalia, he releases a pressurized "Fang" through the instantaneous acceleration and braking of the A-T's wheel motors, vacuuming and compressing air into a piercing shock wave. As the manga develops, Agito grows to respect Ikki and his strength. In some scenes in the manga, Agito is shown to be very weak while sleeping, so much that the guys put him in some very humorous scenes because of his weakness. It is also learned that Akito had been acting as Agito's tuner up until now. However, he wasn't able to fully hear his own biorhythm, only allowing him to keep his other half's A-T and Regalia barely operational.

name: Thor
description: Thor like the other members of Sleipnir, Thor has a nickname: "Asgard Mjollnir". He assists Loki's plan by tricking Agito into firing a Bloody Blade Fang into Onigiri's plane. He later reveals that the members of Sleipnir are Brain Chargers in an attempt to goad Lind into battle.    When he faces off against Agito in the match against Kogarasumaru, he wears some form of body armor reminiscent of Nue's Thunder Regalia. His armor is a pair of A.T. gloves called "Mjollnir" which emits steam to be compressed into a vacuum. So far, he has shown only a few major tricks encompassing of creating vacuums. He is, however, able to dissipate Agito's Bloody Blade Fang by simply thrusting his arm into it, dissipatting the fang with a vacuum. his gloves like Agito's A.T.'s need 0-100-0 energy crated by running thus easly deafted if crippling his legs as Agito did in there fight. His R.E.A.D. level is 174, the second highest among Sleipnir's members. As a Brain Charger, Thor has access to their innate abilities as well. The  gloves actual purpose in battle is much more sinister than suffocating an enemy within the vaccum. When a target is ensared within the vaccum orb the external preasure drops to 0. This dramatically reduces the boiling point of any present liquids within the orb. The main target of this technique is blood.

name: Freya
description: The only female member of Sleipnir, referred to as the "Spring of Life". Freya has cat-like ears on the top of her head, a fact which confuses Kazu somewhat before the match with Kogarasumaru. She also makes cat-like noises and gets angry when Kogarasumaru examines the planes, though she is berated for this by Loki. Like Loki, she carries around a sword, albeit a slightly smaller one. In the match against Kogarasumaru, it is her plane that runs out of fuel first, so she escapes by transforming her sword into some sort of special AT umbrella, allowing her to seemingly drift on the air. Freya seems to be also be able to use the umbrella as a shield, as seen when she deflects a barrage of fangs fired by Agito. Later, she's seen attempting to fend off Onigiri on her new plane. Amusingly, she even has her own fanclub, though composed mostly of overweight otakus(similar to Onigiri). After her opponent Onigiri was taken out by Ikki and Agito, Freya proceeds to join Loki on his plane. Standing beside him and over Ikki's exhausted body, she sings:     "Where did we come from? Who are we? Where are we going?" as Loki requests that Ikki answers these questions.     Later, she teams up with Loki against Ikki and Buccha, mostly acting as support. When Ikki activates his Null Wind technique, she finally falls victim to Onigiri's trick and becomes unconscious, forcing Loki to save her and forfeit the match to Kogarasumaru.

name: Inuyama
description: The leader of the stormriders team: Rez-Boa-Dogs. He challenges Ikki because he had their sticker, which was stolen by Simca. He preferes to hurt himself to hurting his team mates.

name: Jihan Seong
description: He possesses a rare "nameless" talent, which made him get another chance at beating the "Battle Net" game when humanity was about to be wiped out. Regressing back to when he was addicted to gambling and drinking, he now tries to make things different.

appearsIn.title: The Martial God Who Regressed Back to Level 2

name: Gayeong Lim
description: Divergent Guild's prominent prospect.

appearsIn.title: The Martial God Who Regressed Back to Level 2

name: Se-Ah Yoon
description: Seong Jihan's niece. She's the daugher of Seong Jihan's brother-in-law, Yoon Sejin, and Seong Jihan's sister.

appearsIn.title: The Martial God Who Regressed Back to Level 2

name: Sejin Yoon
description: Seong Jihan's brother-in-law and Yoon Se-Ah's father. Also known as the "Sword King", he was Korea's pride and honor, which resulted in a rather fanatical fan club of his being formed. He left Korea for Japan, resulting in him being branded as a traitor by some.

appearsIn.title: The Martial God Who Regressed Back to Level 2

name: Minerva Orland
native: ミネルバ・オーランド
description: __Race:__ Human    __Affiliation:__ Sabertooth  __Occupation:__ Mage  __Team:__ Team Sabertooth  __Base of Operations:__ Sabertooth Guild  __Relative:__ Jiemma (Father)  Minerva is a Mage of the currently strongest Guild in Fiore, Sabertooth. She speaks in highly formal language. Befitting her formal speech, she is also very mature and wishes that the people around act accordingly. Minerva speaks in an archaic, old form of Japanese.  (Source: Fairy Tail Wikia)

name: Virgo
description:
Maid Spirit Virgo. She initially had a contract with [Everlue](https://anilist.co/character/31151), but after he was arrested the contract broke. She handed her key to [Happy](https://anilist.co/character/5188) and told him to give it to [Lucy](https://anilist.co/character/5186). She is then called by Lucy to help them out of a situation.

She explains that since she's a spirit, she takes the form that her master desires, so when she was bound to Everlue, she had a big woman form, according to her masters likes. When shes bound to Lucy, she takes a more visually appealing form

name: Jellal Fernandes
native: ジェラール・フェルナンデス
description: Jellal is a young man whose most prominent features are his blue hair and a red tattoo above and under his right eye, which he has had since his childhood. He is introduced under the alias of Siegrain, a young member of the Magic Council and can be considered the main antagonist of the series.

name: Hatsu  Takagi
description: A girl suffering from 'Kokuhaku disease', having only a limited number of heartbeats before she dies. She refrains from activity, and keeps to herself. She learns to enjoy her time alive as a result of meeting Hato.

name: Hato  Iijima
description: A boy who is inspired to show Hatsu the joys of life despite her 'Kokuhaku disease', spends time taking her places and giving her new experiences.

name: Yoshinori Kiyota
description: Tomoko's Classmate.

appearsIn.title: No Matter How I Look at It, It's You Guys' Fault I'm Not Popular!

name: Asuka Katou
description:
Asuka Katou (加藤 明日香 Katō Asuka) starts as a background character and Tomoko's high school classmate in her second and third year. In Tomoko's third year, she forms a friendship with Tomoko. Her full name is revealed in the third year of high school.

Katou initially appears a glamorous and popular girl outside of students who know Tomoko. She has a mother from whom she seems to have inherited her looks, and Chapter 140 reveals that she has an older brother who was in college when she was in middle school. Tomoko first materially interacts with her when Katou notices her staring at her as she sits behind her in her make up mirror. She quickly offers to apply make up to Tomoko's eyes. For her part, Tomoko first derisively wonders if Katou expects to be the "Class Mom." Katou does work to include Tomoko in social activities. She also seems to quietly understand others. For example, she quickly disarms Yoshida's defensiveness by immediately complimenting her on her cute animal bag during the trip to the amusement park. On the train on the way home from that school trip, Tomoko awakens to find that she has been sleeping, and drooling, with her head on Katou's lap. She is mortified, but Katou happily assures her that she did not want to disturb her until her stop. Tomoko inwardly concludes that she is more of a "mom" than "a real mom."

In more recent chapters, Tomoko fears that she will offend Katou with her real personality.

appearsIn.title: No Matter How I Look at It, It's You Guys' Fault I'm Not Popular!

name: Megumi Imae
description: The Student Council President of the School Tomoko attends.

appearsIn.title: No Matter How I Look at It, It's You Guys' Fault I'm Not Popular!

name: Mako Tanaka
description:
Mako Tanaka is Tomoko's second and third-year​ classmate in high school. They become friends through Yuri. Her nickname is "Makocchi", though Tomoko inwardly calls her "Crazy Lesbian."

Mako is Tomoko's classmate and Yuri Tamura's bestfriend. She has a falling out with Yuri when she decides to accept an invitation from Minami to join her group during a field trip. They reconcile; however, Yuri often remains aloof around her. Mako subsequently makes the effort to become friends with Tomoko since she seems to be friends with Yuri. As is her habit, Tomoko stereotypes this friendliness and inwardly calls her "Crazy Lesbian/Lesbo" though she will admit it is only a nasty nickname rather than a belief.

(Source: watamote.fandom)

appearsIn.title: No Matter How I Look at It, It's You Guys' Fault I'm Not Popular!

name: Rinko Yoshitaka
description:
__Birthday:__ April 1st
__Occupation:__ Teacher

name: Ryou Arase
description: Rinko's student and something more

name: Sakota
description: He's Ryo's friend and classmate, and Nishino's on-and-off boyfriend.

name: Arase Sobo
description: Ryo Arase's grandma.

name: Mako Arase
description: She's Ryo's older and hopeless sister.

name: Kurokawa
description: He's a teacher at the school, alongside Rinko and Hifumi.

name: Hifumi Igarashi
description: She's Rinko's coworker, another teacher at the school.

name: An Yoshitaka
description:
She's Rinko's younger sister. She's 5 years younger than Rinko.

When they were younger, Rinko had to take care of her when she got home from school.

name: Mika Nishino
description: She's Ryo's classmate and Sakota's on-and-off girlfriend.

name: Hieta
description: He's Ryo's coworker at the store.

name: Hao Asakura
description: Asakura Hao is the main antagonist in Shaman King and the most powerful shaman in the entirety of the series.

name: Ye-young Min
description: Min Ye-young was a quiet and reserved healer before she meets Sunghoon. Sunghoon recruits her and has her sign a shady contract to work with him indefinitely. Under Sunghoon's leaderships she rapidly grows in confidence and skill and later converts to a damage dealer as a world class martial artist and even develops an undodgeable and unblockable attack that bends space and time to always hit its mark.

name: Ye-Rim Seong
description:
One of the highest awakened people in the nation. She works as a celebrity too.

She is known to have two skills, Physical Enhancement and Flame Magic.

name: Jin Kyung
description: Jink-Yung was a fan of the idol Group, "Oh My Lady". After he calls himself a Pedophile on live TV by mistaking the word, he receives huge backlash from the viewers. His public life was effectively ruined and he spends his time inside his own room unable to leave the house because of his deep rooted fears, when suddenly one day he is summoned by an Apprentice Summoner - Maina Haze - to defeat a monster.

name: Benny
description: A young slave who served Elleyra, however decided to stop that and follow Ai and Jinkyung on their adventure.

name: Ai Haze
description: A rookie summoner who by chance invokes Jinkyung, who thanks to his incredible power, recruits her to stop the demons of the North.

name: The King
description: The king at first glance looks like a womanizer sitting on the throne, however it is later known that he feigns that attitude so as not to show his true intentions.

name: Twin Summoners
description: These are powerful summoning sisters who meet Elleyra, but not even she is a match for these sisters. In addition, they "protect" the Divine Beast so that the prayers of the people reach it and it can speak with God (because it is said that because someone pure has the ability to communicate with God directly).

name: Ayka
description: She is a former combatant and survivor from the North, who lost all her companions and her left eye to that place. After that event, he decided to form a group to help the people of the demons, but they do not support the king and those who follow him. She had a magic dagger called Shelcon, but after witnessing the great power of Jinkyung she handed it to her. The Shelcon works by using the mana of the person who is holding it.

name: Gria
description: It was called "The Wandering Sword". He was kidnapped and turned into a demon by the alchemists.

name: Lau
description: A boy who met the Divine Beast by accident, but he only sees any girl, after meeting her he will help her get to the place where she wanted to go.

name: Ronian
description: A magician from the North of Kailiteon, thanks to this character he introduces us to the subject of mana and how magicians are no longer so common and they all became summoners.

name: Beatrice
description: Beatrice is a thief from the Abyss guild, who wishes to steal the Divine Beast. Guild Abyss serve Gardon, the lord of darkness, and use his Guul Nadol as weapons (an object that possesses great power), she possesses the Gardon's Shadow. Unlike Shlecons, it could be used regardless of the user's abilities or whether there was mana nearby. This dagger contains the Lord of Darkness Gardon's power. The wielder of this weapon cannot be seen by anyone when they are in the shadows.

name: Satoko Kirigaya
description:
Satoko is a noblewoman from a wealthy family. As she comes of age, she is expected to find a husband. However, she has a serious heart condition that makes it difficult to find a suitable match. Because of this, she tells every potential suitor about her illness so she does not deceive them, but many proposals are rejected because of it. 

One day, while out in town, she is kidnapped by men who intend to kill her. Then [Shinpei Gotou](https://anilist.co/character/298762/Shinpei-Gotou) appears. In order to save her life, she proposes marriage to him.

name: Yoshiyuki Terada
description:
Terada is a teacher at Tomoeda Elementary School. 

Through the fourth grade and part of the fifth-grade year, he is the homeroom teacher of Sakura Kinomoto and every other recurring elementary student character. Terada appears to teach a variety of subjects, including physical education.

name: Takashi Yamazaki
description:
__Grade__: 4th - 6th 

Takashi Yamazaki is a student in Sakura Kinomoto's class, and the only male student in the class to be referred to by name before the introduction of Syaoran Li. The character is named after film director, Takashi Yamazaki, who is a friend of the series creators, CLAMP. Throughout the series, Yamazaki's defining trait is his ability to fabricate highly detailed fake stories and histories about practically any subject. While most of his classmates see through these fabrications, Sakura and Syaoran often believe them. 

Fellow classmate [Chiharu Mihara](https://anilist.co/character/7134/Chiharu-Mihara) often interrupts his stories so others know when he is lying, and proceeds to punish him for lying by pretending to strangle him or by dragging him away by his collar. While the two often seem to be arguing, they are actually a couple and have known one another since kindergarten. She is the only girl in the series that he addresses by her first name.

In the Cardcaptors English adaptation, all hints of his relationship with Chiharu are removed. Instead, they are said to be cousins and the Chiharu's joking strangling of Yamazaki is considered to be sibling rivalry.

name: Elise De Clorance
aliases: エリーゼ・ド・クロレンス
description: Elise De Clorance is the princess to which Dr. Song, the youngest female professor at the leading College of Medicine in Korea was  reincarnated into after meeting an untimely death over the ocean. Enlightened with the medical knowledge of a master surgeon, is this her chance to mend her past relationships and heal an ailing empire, or is fate sealed to repeat itself?

appearsIn.title: Doctor Elise: The Royal Lady with the Lamp

name: Linden De Romanoff
aliases: リンデン・ド・ロマノフ

appearsIn.title: Doctor Elise: The Royal Lady with the Lamp

name: Kanna
description:
__Height:__ 157 cm

[Koharu](https://anilist.co/character/342735/Koharu)'s mentor. She's known to be laid-back and often runs away from fights between cupids. However, she will do anything to let Koharu succeed.

name: Ena
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm

A cautious, yet strong-willed cupid. Having a fair amount of experience, Ena is determined to make sure the job of matchmaking is done well.

name: Chiyo
description:
__Height:__ 149 cm

A reckless cupid who loves fighting other cupids more than anything. Her energetic nature seems to land her in trouble a lot.

name: Koharu
description:
__Height:__ 159 cm

A shy, inexperienced cupid, mentored by [Kanna](https://anilist.co/character/342734). Despite being new to the job, her insight gives her amazing matchmaking abilities.

name: Aki Tamaki
description: [Koharu](https://anilist.co/character/342735/Koharu)'s best friend from high school. Aki is bold and brutally honest, unafraid to express her opinion. She confessed to Koharu right before the latter died.

name: Amahiko Suzuki
description: Suzuki Amahiko is a cynical boy who gets depressed easily, mostly thanks to his uncaring foster parents and being alienated in school.

name: Kyoko Sakaki
description:
A one-eyed teacher in Suzuki's class. She got her injury when she tried to save Kimura Arie from a rapist at Nijigahara field. Since then, she stopped trying to get involved with children's problems at all. She married a teacher named Hatori from the same school.

(Source: MAL)

name: Maki Arakawa
description:
Arakawa Maki is a girl that studies at the art school and works part-time in Prism cafe. Komatsuzaki Kouta is her first love since childhood. However,​ she couldn't make him fall for her, because he is obsessed with Kimura Arie and can't love anyone else.

(Source: MAL)

name: Arie Kimura
description:
Kimura Arie is a childhood friend of Komatsuzaki Kouta. She had been in coma since the day her classmates pushed her into a well.

(Source: MAL)

name: Shop Manager
description:
The manager of the supermarket where Mr. Kimura and Komatsuzaki Kouta work at. He used to be an elementary school teacher.

(Source: MAL)

name: Hatori
description:
Hatori is a teacher at Suzuki's school. He is in love with his coworker Sakaki.

(Source: MAL)

name: Hayato Wakamatsu
description: Wakamatsu is a bully who has been extorting money from Takahama. After a fight with Komatsuzaki Kouta, he gets wounded by a knife which leaves a scar on his right cheek. In the present time, he works as a police officer.

name: Makoto Higure
description:
Narumi's older brother. He is the owner of Prism Cafe.

(Source: MAL)

name: Yuu Aikawa
description: Honest, straightforward, and friendly. His childhood friend is Mitsuki, whom he cares a great deal for, and he takes it upon himself to protect her at all costs. Mitsuki is also the only person that Yuu completely trusts within the group. Yuu found himself inside the hospital after receiving a blow to the head from a wrench inside the bathroom at the karaoke bar. He also seems to be the only person who has caught a glimpse of the wolf. He's the only one who doesn't have a bar code tattooed on his skin which, the group discovers, are the keys to unlocking the network of doors keeping them trapped in the building. When his lacking a bar code is revealed, he is accused of being the wolf and is restrained for a time while the atrocities unfold around him, all the while maintaining his innocence. The story unfolds mainly from Yuu's perspective, and since he is very righteous and the only individual, besides Mistuki, who doesn't throw accusations around, it is safe to assume he is the main protagonist. Whenever someone in the group dies, Yuu takes it very hard, and often times winds up blaming himself in some way.

name: Haruka Akechi
description: This happy, fun-loving, and flirtatious girl turns into a scared, obsessive, and paranoid participant of the game. As the "Rabbit Doubt" advances, she seems to descend to madness, flinging accusations out left and right. She is the one to note that Yuu doesn’t have a bar code and believes him and Mitsuki to be the wolf after she learns Mitsuki's information is on file, when she should have only been an accidental participant. She ties Yuu up after attacking Mitsuki and locking her in the bathroom, then she disappears after claiming she can't trust Hajime either. When the others learn of Eiji's past as a gang member, and that he was involved in a fight that led to the death of one man, the others suspect Haruka of being Shōjo H and briefly of being the wolf, and that there may be a connection between them after all. Yuu finds her head severed after finding a room filled with rabbit heads, stakes, and ropes.   Haruka's bar code is on her chest.

name: Rei Hazama
description: The youngest of the players. She was involved on a hypnotism TV show, but after it was reported to be a scam by relentless reporters, she tried to commit suicide by walking out in front of a vehicle. She then had a change of mind at the last moment and wound up paralyzed instead of dead, so she is confined to a wheelchair. It’s because of her past that Rei is shy and tends to be nervous around others. She is harassed by Eiji at first, but when Yuu comes to her rescue, she is grateful and reveals the truth to him. Eiji overhears and reports it to the rest of the group who is shocked, but accepts it right away.        Rei's bar code is on her thigh.

name: Eiji Hoshi
description: This 18 years old boy is aggressive, abrasive, and sometimes violent. He has a smoking and drinking habit for which he is chastised by Mitsuki, a cop's daughter, who refuses to let him indulge in either vice while under the age of 20.

name: Mitsuki Houyama
description: She was not one of the original players and only tagged along to be with Yuu, whom she seems to have a crush on. She gets jealous when other girls are friendly with him. As the horror that develops, she is constantly seeking reassurance and protection from Yuu. She is the daughter of a cop, which contributes to her strong sense of morality, and her mother died when she was young. Yuu found her crying and promised to protect her, and they have been close since. She is the most emotional of all with a weak constitution, screaming or fainting at the first sign of danger or injury. Mitsuki wants to believe in the good of everyone in the group, giving everyone the benefit of the doubt and she tries to do the right thing, even under the deadly circumstances.    Her barcode was on her neck.

name: Hajime Komaba
description: A medical student attending university, he is the last of the players to be presented. He didn’t meet with the others because he was lured by a false text message to a different meeting place at a different where he was abducted separate from the group. He reveals to Yuu that the text message apparently came from his phone, which Yuu denies having any knowledge of. Cool and collected, he is the most level-headed of the players and appears to have the best understanding of what is going on. He stumbles across most of the clues and comes up with most of the deductions, which causes him to be suspected of being the wolf on a few occasions. He is the one that concludes all the events following the “Rabbit Doubt” game and assumes the role of the leader, since he seems to be well informed. His primary concern is survival, and he is indifferent to whether or not his accusations offend another player, or a decision he makes ultimately leads to their death. He knowledge of medicine helps him solve the mystery behind the death of a man they stumble across and briefly believe to be the wolf, as well as assists Mitsuki when she becomes injured. He seems to be the antithesis to Yuu's personality.   His bar code is on his arm.

name: Lucia
description: Joshua's mother.

name: Chii Nishikata
description: Daughter of Nishikata and (née) Takagi. She hates green peppers, but loves to tickle her father. At the beginning of the story, she goes to kindergarten.

name: Ooshiro
description: He is a childhood friend of Chi.

name: Hikikomori Seijin
description: The make-believe characters working in the NHK (Nihon Hikkikomori Kyokai) in Satou Tatushiro's fantasy during his anti-social years. In Satou's imagination, this group of blue goblins with pink sleeping caps are part of a conspiracy that tries to ruin his life.

name: Shougo Kawada
description: Boy #5 Shougo Kawada, portrayed as a loner within the class ranks, is a transfer student. He is put in Class B about two months before the program takes place. He is the winner of a previous program, some three years prior.

name: Kazuo Kiriyama
description: The manga's primary antagonist, Kazuo Kiriyama is a ruthless killer, who is also a savant with no feelings of remorse. He also possesses a genius level I.Q., mastering things such as playing the violin in minutes, and has an uncanny ability to adapt to situations quickly.  His starting weapon is a Ingram MAC-10 Uzi.

name: Shinji Mimura
description: Boy #19 Shinji Mimura uses his intellect to invent an escape plan.

name: Noriko Nakagawa
description: Girl #15 Noriko Nakagawa is the story's primary female character and Shuuya's first companion. She is a quiet, reserved girl. She is shot in the lower leg by Yonemi for attempting to help Nobu, and also gets ill. Although she does not realize it, she manages to keep Shuuya sane.

name: Shuuya Nanahara
description: Boy #15 Shuuya Nanahara is the primary protagonist. He has witnessed a good deal of troubling events throughout his life. His father was killed by the government for struggling against the regime, and his mother died when he was in third grade. When the rest of his family rejected him, Shuuya was put in an orphanage. He is willing to trust others, not wanting to take part in the Battle Royale program. He tries several times to rally fellow students in an attempt to escape, but fails. Consequently, he narrowly escapes death at the hands of his classmates, on several occasions. Shuuya is a self-proclaimed "rock star", listening to and playing rock 'n' roll music, even though it is banned. Shuuya's favorite artist is Bruce Springsteen. After the death of his best friend Yoshitoki, he vows to protect Yoshitoki's crush, Noriko, in his stead.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Mitsuko Souma
description: Girl #11, Mitsuko Souma (相馬光子 Sōma Mitsuko?) is beautiful and seductive on the outside yet inside, she's a hollow shell, having been left damaged after suffering years of physical and sexual abuse from her stepfather. She is said to be the most beautiful girl in school with her angelic face, shapely body, and seductive smile which is referred to in the novel as her "fallen angel's smile." She uses her sexuality to her advantage throughout the series. Similar to Kazuo Kiriyama, Mitsuko suffers from childhood trauma, and she is the leader of her own gang, which consists of Hirono Shimizu and Yoshimi Yahagi. She manages to kill a total of nine students, becoming the second most dangerous opponent in the Program, before being killed by Kazuo Kiriyama.

name: Yoshio Akamatsu
description: Boy #1 Yoshio Akamatsu is the first student to leave the school where they are briefed in all versions of the series.  The novel describes Yoshio, the largest student in Class 3-B, as "the timid type." Prior to the game, many students targeted Yoshio with pranks and insults.    (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Ryouko Anno
description: The superintendent of the Charity House, a Roman Catholic orphanage. She acts as guardian to Yoshitoki and Shuuya. In the manga and novel, the teacher (Sakamochi in the novel, Yonemi in the manga) says that he raped her when she objected to her charges being selected for the program.

name: Yonemi Kamon
description: Yonemi Kamon is a government employee who is the administrator of the current Battle Royale program. He briefs the students on the rules of Battle Royale. He is a vile and sadistic man, as he kills two students because they annoy him. He is also overtly lecherous. He also claims to have killed parents who objected to their children's placement in the program, as well as having raped Yoshitoki's guardian.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Chisato Matsui
description: Girl #19 Chisato Matsui is one of the class of third-year students at Shiroiwa Junior High School in Shiroiwa, Kagawa Prefecture. The novel describes Chisato, a member of a non-distinct group of girls referred to by the novel as "the neutrals," as "always quiet and withdrawn." Chisato is a petite girl with long hair. She had a crush on Shinji Mimura and in the Manga, she and Yuka were apparently "Boy crazy".    (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Doug
description: An A/0 ranked Twilight who engages in battle with Nicolas. Despite his youthful appearance, Doug is an adult and works with the Paul Klee guild.

name: Veronica
description: The mysterious Twilight woman who once resided with Nicolas and Worick.

name: Uranos Corsica
description: Mysterious member of the Corsica family.

name: Joel Raveau
description: Benriya's elderly neighbor and frequent customer. Joel is also the grandmother of Constance Raveau.

name: Delico
description: A D/0 ranked Twilight and member of the Monroe family.

name: Hae-In Sin
description: A musician and self-proclaimed fan of Long Afternoon's.

appearsIn.title: My Bias Gets on the Last Train

name: Yeo-Un Lee
description: A college student and big fan of the indie band Long Afternoon.

appearsIn.title: My Bias Gets on the Last Train

name: A-Reun Han
description: A close friend of [Yeo-Un](https://anilist.co/character/358013/YeoUn-Lee)'s from his early college days.

appearsIn.title: My Bias Gets on the Last Train

name: Hyeon-Jae Seong
description: A popular indie singer and songwriter. He's interested in bringing [Hae-In](https://anilist.co/character/358012/HaeIn-Sin)'s talents to a wider audience.

appearsIn.title: My Bias Gets on the Last Train

name: Yu-Ju Oh
description: The owner of the café [Yeo-Un](https://anilist.co/character/358013/YeoUn-Lee) works at.

appearsIn.title: My Bias Gets on the Last Train

name: Sin-Yeong Won
description: A student and part-time worker at the café [Yeo-Un](https://anilist.co/character/358013/YeoUn-Lee) works at.

appearsIn.title: My Bias Gets on the Last Train

name: Hyeon-Seung Sin
description: [Hae-In](https://anilist.co/character/358012/HaeIn-Sin)'s uncle. He is a live sound engineer and the owner of the studio Hae-In plays at.

appearsIn.title: My Bias Gets on the Last Train

name: Senmu
description: [Shouta's](https://anilist.co/character/120973/) father and managing director at Kobayashi's company. He is a mage.

name: Kimun Kamui
description:
Kimun Kamui is the father of Kanna Kamui

In his human form, Kimun is a large set man with black hair. While in his dragon form he takes on a large, bear-shaped appearance, with two horns coming out the top of his head.

name: Zitri de Lobilia
description: She was the legitimate heir to Lobilia family, but she lost her parents in her uncle's scheme, was falsely accused and banished from her family.  She became a maid for the Lienhaber and later, the direct servant of Nox, who saved her life. She is quite capable and has a fondness for Nox, even becoming jealous when he's with another woman.

name: Eleanor de Rivalin
description: The only daughter of Rivalin family, a merchant family with great wealth and leverage on the entire continent.

name: Luna
description: The head of the largest criminal organization, Lunatic.

name: Penelope von Ackheim
description: A princess nicknamed the "Cold-Blooded Princess".

name: Elina
description: She's a half-elf. A skilled potion maker, but prone to drunkenness and a total idiot in everything but potions. Still, her potion-making skills are second to none, so Nox brought her to his side.

name: Theo von Lienhaber
description: Head of Lienhaber family.

name: Noa von Trinity
description: She's a headmaster of Elidein academy.

name: Chiyo
aliases: The All-Mother Black Goat with a Thousand Young
description:
**Height:** 168 cm

A mysterious, kind and cheerful girl that Yuu accidentally summoned. She grants Yuu the wish of becoming his elder sister.

As Chiyo herself states she has been revered as a goddess, demon and monster during her existence but only Yuu has mistaken her for an angel.

name: Yuu Hasunuma
description: A young boy who has been forced to live among close and distant relatives ever since his parents died in an accident when he was young. He lived his entire life detached from the loving embrace of a family, thus prompting his wish to have Chiyo as his sister.

name: Kenshirou
description:
Kenshirou is the 64th successor of the "Hokuto Shin Ken" style. He has seven scars on his chest in the shape of the "Hokuto Shichisei ", or Big Dipper, that were put there by [Shin](https://anilist.co/character/16419/Shin).

A strong and mostly stoic character, Kenshiro is compelled to punish evil-doers and can perform feats not possible for most people. His mastery of the ancient martial art Hokuto Shinken allows him to kill or cripple with a mere touch. The results tend to be very messy -it usually causes parts of the victim to explode- but the art also includes several other means of killing. He can also use this art to heal or to alter people's behavior. Later in the series Kenshiro learns parts of other martial arts.

When angry his spiritual powers reach their peak, normally culminating in the dramatic destruction of his shirt and jacket (which, despite the obvious lack of a wardrobe or clothing store, are always replaced in the next episode or story arc) to expose his muscular torso.

His catchphrase is Omae wa mō shindeiru (おまえはもう死んでいる), meaning "You are already dead", which he usually says before a villain's head is about to explode.

After surviving the nuclear war, he tries to live in peace with his fiancee Yuria, until Jagi instigates Shin, a jealous rival from the Nanto Seiken school, to challenge, then defeat Kenshiro. Shin then engraves the iconic seven scars on Kenshiro's chest and leaves him for dead.

name: Rei
description:
Rei ("Ray" in Viz's English manga) is the successor of Nanto Suichouken, which is said to be the most elegant of the Nanto Seiken styles. He represents the "Star of Justice". Rei is introduced in the manga as a ruthless chauvinistic mercenary-for-hire of shifting allegiance whose sole purpose is to kill "the man with seven scars," whom he believes was responsible for kidnapping his sister Airi. Rei is hired alongside Kenshiro by Mamiya to protect her village against the Fang Clan. After Airi is found and rescued by Ken, Rei becomes Kenshiro's closest ally and supports him for a few story arcs.   

  

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Jagi
description: Jagi is the third of the four Hokuto brothers. Deceptive and evil, Jagi stops at nothing to win and frequently uses dirty tricks during battle. After a botched attempt at killing Kenshiro, he is left with a hideously disfigured head as a reminder of his failure. Consequently, he hides his head by wearing an iron helmet. Harboring a severe hatred for Kenshiro, Jagi deliberately sets into motion a few of the story arcs. After his death, Jagi (quickly forgotten) is usually unaccounted for when the Hokuto Brothers are mentioned.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Kuro-Yasha
description: Kuro-Yasha is a short dwarfish man who worked as a servant of the main Hokuto bloodline. He wields two long claws in battle. He assists Kenshiro and Hyoh, but dies fighting Kaioh's elite army. (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Akashachi
description:
The father of Shachi and captain of a pirate band called "Sōdō no Shachi" (双胴の鯱). After being defeated by Kenshiro, he reluctantly transported him to the Land of Asura. Akashachi gives Kenshiro the mission of finding his long-lost son, Shachi. In the past, Akashachi set foot on Asura with a hundred of his men but they were slaughtered by the young Nameless Asura. Akashachi escaped, having lost his right eye and leg in the carnage, leaving Shachi behind.

Akashachi and his men appear in Kenshiro and Shachi's hour of need, trapping Kaioh with a series of grappling hooks and burning him with a drum of sulphuric acid. As Kaioh descends into the water, Akashachi plans to finish him with a harpoon strike but he is killed by Kaioh's hidden crossbow. In his last moments, he is reunited with Shachi, who wears his eye patch after his death in memory of his father.

name: Hyui
aliases: Kaze no Hyui (風のヒューイ)
description:
Hyui of the Wind is the leader of the Goshasei's Wind Army and uses a style which allows him to slice using manipulate wind pressure. In the manga, Hyui faces Raoh immediately after his first appearance and is quickly defeated. Before dying, he tells Raoh that the rest of the Goshasei will come looking for him and Ken. In the TV series, Hyui encounters Kenshiro as well prior to fighting Raoh. He also has a younger brother in the TV series named Shion.  

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Kai
description:
One of the three Viceroys of the Sava Kingdom and the eldest son of Asam. He was born under the sign of the Red Emperor and bears a close resemblance to his father. Kai competes with his two brothers for the crown, but they finally put aside their conflict after learning that their father is dying. Kai is later killed when he is struck from behind by one of the bandits threatening the kingdom.

(Source: Hokuto Renkitōza wiki)

name: Diamond
description: A Kingsman who specializes in bōjutsu and wears clown-like makeup. Kenshiro confronts him while he's trying to execute a villager for fun. Kenshiro kills him with the Koushu Hagan Ken (Face Breaking Fist). In the anime series, he is the Jack of Diamond.

name: Juuza
description: Juza of the Clouds (雲のジュウザ, Kumo no Jūza) is the childhood rival of Raoh and a martial art prodigy who uses a self-styled martial art (我流の拳, Garyū no Ken) that suits his free-spirited personality. A childhood friend of Yuria, Juza fell in love with her as they grew up, but his hope of pursuing a relationship with her was shattered when he learned that they were half-siblings from the same father. Afterwards, Juza began living a care-free life of promiscuity, indifferent to the cause of the other Goshasei until he learns the true identity of the Last Nanto General. Juza challenges Raoh to a fight and manages to stall him for a while by stealing his steed, Kokuoh-Go, but is eventually defeated in one of Raoh's most grueling battles.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Uighur
description: The fearsome warden of the Cassandra prison and one of the most powerful underlings of Raoh.

name: Run Elsie Jewelria
native: ルン・エルシ・ジュエリア
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm

A childhood friend of Lala, infamously known for wearing girl clothing during his play dates with Lala. At first he arrives on Earth to win back Lala, but soon becomes jealous due to her relationship with Rito. As Ren is from Planet Memorze, he can change gender in both mind and body upon sneezing; as a girl she goes by the name Run. Run likes Rito, while Ren is in competition (albeit rather one sided) with Rito for Lala's hand in marriage.

name: Honekawa
description: The homeroom teacher of Rito's class.

name: Aya Fujisaki
description:
__Height:__ 157 cm

The bespectacled Aya is weak-willed and became associated with Saki after she and Rin protected her from bullies when they were kids.

name: Taizou Motemitsu
description: A member of the baseball team.  He always acts suave, yet he is constantly rejected by women.

name: Du-Jun Kang
description: The son of a rich family and the CEO of a company. He is always cool and calm and has a plan, but when it comes to Hui-Won's business, he goes out of his way without hesitation.

name: Hui-Won Jang
description: The female protagonist of the story. Irritated by the bragging of a long-time crush and friend, she ends up getting pregnant after a one-night stand at an upscale bar.

name: Se-Hyeon Kang
description: Du-Jun’s niece and Hui-Won’s student.

name: Min-Uk
description: Hui-Won's childhood friend, and Mi-Ran's boyfriend.

name: Mi-Ran Hwang
description: Hui-Won's friend and Min-Uk's girlfriend.

name: Ji-Hun Lee
description: Student teacher shadowing Hui-Won, and a former classmate from her college.

name: Yuka
description: Miruchi and Yuka, during the middle of the series, are grade-school students and good friends of Chiyo-chan, but were separated when Chiyo  advanced to high school. Occasionally, though, the three would meet on the way to school and exchange stories about their experiences. Near the end of the series, though, both Miruchi and Yuka had advanced to middle school and proudly showed-off their new uniforms to Chiyo, as well as Sakaki (who was walking with Chiyo at the time).    If one were to look closely, Miruchi resembles a younger Minamo Kurosawa (Nyamo), while Yuka is a younger double of Yukari Tanazaki.    Absolute Anime

name: Maya
description: Maya is an Iriomote cat (kitten actually) who the girls meet on their class trip to Okinawa on the Iriomote island. Surprisingly he seems to like Sakaki a lot. When Maya's mother dies he searches for Sakaki and eventually finds them and saves Sakaki and Chiyo from Kamineko and his gang. Chiyo then offers to keep Maya at her place until Sakaki moves out and is able to keep Maya at her own place - and Sakaki names the kitten Maya as an abbreviation of 'Yamamaya', a term used by Iriomote natives.    (Image credit: Wikipedia)

name: Leon Dragonia Lionheart
description:
Owner of the sacred lion's heart and guardian of the Holy Grail.

He acts as the king of the world he lives in. On the surface, he has created a new guild called Pantheon.

name: Yakt Spinner
description: For 1,000 years, under the orders of humans, he sealed the devil's artifact, the Jewel of Wisdom, and protected it so that no one could take it. Leon recognized him as a dedicated and honorable knight, and he became the Knight of the Holy Grail.

name: Han Hari
description: She is an A-rank hunter who was first known as a member of the Korean Government Hunters Association when the dimension to which Leon belonged first opened as a gate. She uses a combat method that combines sword techniques and fire attributes.

name: Beatrice Aligiere Spero
description:
The mage queen of the Kingdom of Spero. 

Although she cannot follow the mandatory nature of divine law, she possesses the highest level of magical abilities and, as a solitary queen, provides significant mental support to Leon.

name: Demera
description: Goddess of life and abundance. Among the gods of the pantheon, she was the first goddess to wield her power on Earth.

name: Dae-Seong Gu
description:
A D-rank hunter.

He first meets Leon during the Hunter Association's promotion exam and later applies to become one of Leon's Knights. While training with Leon, he is told that becoming a knight requires dedication and honor, not status and rank, and he completes the soldier training course hoping that he too can become one.

name: Caldron Anouve
native: コルドロン・アヌーブ
description: Headmaster of Rigarden Magic Academy.

name: Logwell
description: Adjutant of the fire faction.

name: Marze
description: Member of Gohtia who works with Headless.

name: Tomoka Kase
description: A popular and handsome girl in the class next door to [Yamada](https://anilist.co/character/125397)'s. She's the ace of the track and field club.

name: Yui Yamada
description: A quiet girl who is in charge of greenification. She's poor at sports and singing.

name: Mikawa
description: Yamada's classmate and best friend. She's in the tennis club. She can't handle the sight of blood well.

name: Akane Inoue
description: Akane Inoue, also known as Inoue-senpai, is a graduate and former member of the track and field club at Yui Yamada and Tomoka Kase's high school.

name: Chibiusa
description:
Chibiusa's real name is actually Usagi, but she is nicknamed Chibiusa to distinguish her from [Usagi](https://anilist.co/character/2030/Tsukino-Usagi). She is usually very upbeat, extroverted and outgoing. Though she started out socially awkward, she quickly became popular with her classmates in the 20th-century.

Chibiusa's dream is to one day become a real lady, to have her own prince, and to be friends with everyone she knows. Meanwhile, she is a fairly ordinary little girl; she likes pink and red, pudding, pancakes, and rabbits. Her favorite school subject is drawing, while her least favorites are language classes.

name: Haruka Tenou
description:
Haruka is a stubborn, protective individual, but is also strong-willed, capable, charming, and occasionally even doting. She is formally introduced in the third story arc, although she appears in silhouette alongside [Sailor Neptune](https://anilist.co/character/2829/Kaiou-Michiru) in the final episode of [Sailor Moon R](https://anilist.co/anime/740/-R/). When transformed, she is known as Sailor Uranus, and is part of the group known in Fanon as the Outer Senshi.

Haruka is a racecar driver, even though she is barely sixteen years old when she appears. However, the timing of her birthday to the Japanese school year means she is one grade ahead of the Inner Senshi.

name: Hotaru Tomoe
description: With people who do not know or understand her well, Hotaru is extremely shy and socially awkward, due to her powers and intelligence, but only at first. With her close friends and family, she is a sweet, gentle, young woman with great warmth and spirit. She tends to be independent, having been alone and taking care of herself for quite some time. Hotaru grew up very much alone, sick, and an outcast, shunned by her classmates who were frightened of her. It was not until she met [Chibi-Usa](https://anilist.co/character/2827/Chibiusa) that she, at last, had a true friend.

name: Michiru Kaiou
description: Introduced in the third story arc, Michiru fights alongside her partner and lover Haruka in defending the Solar System from outside threats. In both versions of the story, she is elegant, sophisticated, capable of sharp anger, and sometimes cold. She is fully dedicated to her duty as a Senshi. Her Senshi alter-ego is Sailor Neptune, one of the "four soldiers of the outer solar system". As Sailor Neptune, her element of influence is the sea(not with water in general as Sailor Mercury's powers are); as with many of the other Senshi, this element is closely associated with her planet, which is named for the Roman sea god, Neptune. She is one of the Senshi who has natural psychic powers, alerting her when danger is near. She seems to be a character with a very deep understanding of things, sometimes even surpassing the other Outer Senshi due to her unnaturally high psychic endowments. Michiru's wavy aqua hair and turquoise eyes are intended to evoke images of her element.

name: Setsuna Meiou
description:
Sailor Pluto is the soldier who guards the gates of time and acts as [Chibiusa's](https://anilist.co/character/2827/Chibiusa) guardian. 

After the events of the second story arc, she leaves the gates of time to temporarily live as a human being, joins the rest of the Outer Senshi, and becomes a university student studying physics.
