Even in her civilian form, Setsuna is the oldest of the Sailor Team, around her late teens or older. Her personality has been described as distant and somewhat lonely, however, she does consistently display warmth and affection toward Chibiusa. When she reincarnates, she becomes more friendly, but is still not very emotional, although there are moments in the manga where she expresses much more emotion than the anime.

Sailor Pluto is much darker in her initial form in the manga, identified as the "Guardian of the Underworld" with very dark skin and a black sailor uniform. She is also stated to be the daughter of Chronos, the god of time. She is a ruthless soldier who follows rather exacting laws, executing any intruders who dare violate the underworld in search of the Gates of Time

name: Youko Shiragami
description: Youko is a classmate of [Asahi](https://anilist.co/character/89084/Kuromine-Asahi) and the daughter of a human and a vampire. Though she has long canine teeth, many other typical vampyric characteristics are downplayed, such as only getting tanned in sunlight or feeling guilty when entering a room uninvited. She has a Kansai accent, but speaks in honorifics so as not to expose her teeth. While initially coming across as haughty, her true personality is bubbly and absent minded. Her dream is to become a cool beauty, but has yet to accomplish this goal. Though initially friendly with Asahi, she develops romantic feelings for him, but keeps them to herself because she believes Asahi to like [Aizawa](https://anilist.co/character/89085/Aizawa-Nagisa). She is also often hungry, due to not being able to eat lunch for fear of revealing her teeth.

appearsIn.title: My Monster Secret: Actually, I Am…
They Are Still Being Shaken This Morning

name: Akane Koumoto
description:
Koumoto Akane is the principal of the school [Kuromine](https://anilist.co/character/89084/Kuromine-Asahi) attends. Though young in appearance she is actually thousands of years old. Despite her age and power she actually behaves very immaturely and is obsessed with snacks.

She is a devil; however, the only indication of this are the two large horns that grow out of her head which she has passed off as a fashion accessory that can be removed at any time, but in reality she uses an illusion to make it look like she can remove the horns.

appearsIn.title: My Monster Secret: Actually, I Am…

name: Nagisa Aizawa
description: Nagisa is a classmate of [Asahi](https://anilist.co/character/89084/Kuromine-Asahi) and [Yōko](https://anilist.co/character/89018/Shiragami-Youko), and is also a small alien in a robotic exoskeleton. Initially the love interest of Asahi before the series began, she turned him down believing that her secret would be discovered if she started a relationship with him.

appearsIn.title: My Monster Secret: Actually, I Am…

name: Asahi Kuromine
description:
He is a second-year high school student who has trouble keeping secrets, earning him the nickname of "ana no aita zaru" (A bag full of holes), or "anazaru" for short.

One day, he discovers that his crush, [Youko Shiragami](https://anilist.co/character/89018/Shiragami-Youko), is secretly a vampire and, as a result, must try to keep her secret to avoid her having to leave school.

appearsIn.title: My Monster Secret: Actually, I Am…
They Are Still Being Shaken This Morning

name: Mikan Akemi
description: She is a childhood friend of [Asahi Kuromine](https://anilist.co/character/89084/Kuromine-Asahi) and constantly bullies him.

appearsIn.title: My Monster Secret: Actually, I Am…

name: Akari Koumoto
description: Akari Koumoto is Asahi's classes' teacher and former delinquent. Akane is her ancestor, and while she does not retain any demonic powers, her previous lifestyle allows her to reign in Akane's misbehavior.

appearsIn.title: My Monster Secret: Actually, I Am…
They Are Still Being Shaken This Morning

name: Shiho Shishido
description: Shiho Shishido is Yōko's childhood friend and a wolfman. Initially appearing as Shirō, an intimidating man with sharp teeth, upon seeing the moon (or an image of), he transforms into Shiho, a busty charismatic female pervert. A second glimpse of the moon transforms Shishido back.

appearsIn.title: My Monster Secret: Actually, I Am…

name: Cheong-Ryeong
description: A blue-rank spirit bound to Mok Gyeong-Un as his familiar spirit. Unwilling to give him her name, Mok Gyeong-Un gave her the name Cheong-Ryeong, meaning blue spirit.

name: Vermilio
description:
__Height:__ 152cm (5')
__Power level:__ 78

One of the Four Heavenly Kings of the Empire. Has a hair-trigger temper, but is big-hearted underneath. The serious one of the group, she usually gets caught up in Helck and Piwi's shenanigans.

She can use fire and summoning magic and excells at fighting several enemies simultaneously.

name: Helck
description:
__Height:__ 200cm (6'7")
__Power level:__ 99

The titular human hero Helck. He is the older brother of the hero Cless. Immensely strong, reliable, and capable, Helck seeks to become the champion of demons and destroy the humans.

name: Piwi
description:
Piwi is a round pure green fluffy bird like creature.

Piwi is raucous and very ignorant. Yet, he has been described with a "cute" personality. He is very carefree, sometimes even oblivious to the violence that occurs around him.

name: Asta
description: Asuta is full of curiosity, so she takes interest in lots of things. She is very cautious about her surroundings and always takes extra precautions to ensure success, such as using tools that her natural abilities can already accomplish. She is quick to jump to a conclusion if it means something poses as a possible danger.

name: Rococo
description:
Rococo is a very cheerful person. She enjoys taking care of everything flawlessly apart from warfare. She is a pacifist in favor of living together with the humans.

She greatly reveres Azudora and would gladly give her life for Azudora's sake.

name: Iris
description: Sister of Augis.

name: Alicia
description:
Alicia is a close friend of Helck. She is a mercenary that Helck met on his journey to Edil's home. She comes from a long line of mercenaries. She was told that one of her ancestors was a hero that fought demons before the current Human Empire was founded.

(Source: helck.fandom.com)

name: Ista
description:
__Height:__ 168cm (5'6")

Ista is very caring of her older sister and her well being. She loves her sister deeply.

Ista feels uncomfortable at the sight of blood, especially when she was little. She is a very clumsy girl, a crybaby, a coward, and a worrywart. However, despite these traits, she is a hard worker and her willpower is superior to even Hyura's. She loves her sister more than anything else.

Her dream is to serve the Red Heavenly King, Vamirio, whom she greatly admires.

name: Hyura
description:
Hyura is the current First Brigade Leader of Tooru Castle. She was one of the final four contestants for the next Demon King to replace Tooru.

(Source: helck.fandom.com)

name: Aya-sensei
description: The school nurse. [Kurose](https://anilist.co/character/393707/Ao Kurose) and [Haimiya](https://anilist.co/character/389167/Mio-Haimiya) often hang out in her infirmary.

name: Yuuga Aida
description: He is a second-year student and a member of the light music club, where he serves as the drummer of WATERMELO.

name: Kon Kurino
description: She is a third-year member of the light music club, where she serves as the bassist of WATERMELO.

name: Sora Kurose
description: She is the older sister of [Ao](https://anilist.co/character/393707/Ao Kurose).

name: Umi Kurose
description: She is the younger sister of [Ao](https://anilist.co/character/393707/Ao Kurose).

name: Koyuki Shiu
description: She is the older sister of [Mashiro](https://anilist.co/character/402360/Mashiro).

name: Un-Seong Hyeok
description: Un-Seong Hyeok is the sole disciple of Nok Yu On - the world's strongest spearman and the master of the Spear Master Sect. Under his mentorship, he reaches Transcendence Level and attains great mastership of the spear.

name: A-Yeong Cheon
description: Cheon A-Yeong is the Divine Maiden of the Cult of Heavenly Demon and the daughter of its former leader, Cheon Hwi.

name: Tae-Ryang Gwan
aliases: Great Demon of The Champion Blade
description: Tae-Ryang is a former trainee from the Cave of Latent Demons and is currently the Captain of the Charred Dragon Unit.

name: Un-Ji Baek
description: Un-Ji Baek is one of the former trainees of Cave of Latent Demons and a member of the Charred Dragon Unit. She's in love with Un-Seong Hyeok.

name: In-Hyo Sang
description: In-Hyo Sang is presented as the leader of the Cave of Latent Demons early in the story.

name: Hwi Cheon
aliases: The Demon Of The Twin Stars And One Demon
Leader of the Cult of Heavenly Demon
description: Hwi Cheon was the previous Heavenly Demon, leader of Cult of Heavenly Demon.

name: Mariko Higuchi
description: A Proxy scout for the firm. She knows much more about Kano than he does, and they are linked through an event that happened years before the beginning of the manga. She is also in charge of securing contracts and gathers the paperwork needed to satisfy the association.

name: Hiroshi Kano
description: Hiroshi Kano is special.  Unfortunately its a schizophrenic kind of special. Kano-san talks to a woman no one else can see, and complains about a phone that no one else can hear.  Despite these idiosyncrasies, he has been able to survive in a future war torn Japan, with the help of his "sixth sense".  This ability allows Kano-san to usually avoid danger.  Recently the Japanese government has passed the Vengeance Act.  A law which allows vengeful victims to try and kill the felons that wronged them.  If the victim does not want to do this personally, a proxy can be hired to do the job for them.  Unemployed, Kano-san gets a job at a proxy enforcement agency...

name: Masaki Mizoguchi
description: He is a proxy working at the same firm as Kano, although he has been there much longer than his coworkers. He is constantly trying to hunt his coworkers, most notably Kano, who weirds him out due to his bizarre abilities. To him it's important that he hunts the zebras that represent everybody who isn't him. He is either married or has a girlfriend that he abuses regularly who has lost touch with reality.

name: Ichiro Yamada
description: One of the proxies hired by the proxy firm along with Kano. It took him three tries to pass the exam required to become an enforcer, done by memorizing the entire book, whereas everybody else got a list with answers on it from various scouts. Initially optimistic, he grows jaded when he realizes the truth behind the enforcements.

name: Kotomi
description: Kotomi works at an unlicensed bar in the eastern district called Captain Miita. She and Iwasaki contact each other through texting.

name: Shibazaki
description: Shibazaki gets abused a lot by others except for his friend Iwasaki Toshio. Even though people take advantage of him, he is a kind person and has a positive outlook on life. He joins a vengeance enforcement to serve as Iwasaki's bodyguard.

name: Toshio Iwasaki
description: Iwasaki Toshio is an ex-convict that becomes the target of a vengeance enforcement.

name: Bobby
description: Bobby serves as a bodyguard for Keita Tanaka.

name: Hisae Iwao
description: An unsuccessful bodyguard.

name: Keita Tanaka
description: Keita Tanaka is a representative of the militia organization "National Self-Defense Group" (later renamed to "Asia League Freedom Alliance").

name: Col Tote
description: A boy saved by Lawrence at the river checkpoint. A naive but clever lad. He strives to become a priest to save his village.

name: Itto Ogami
description:
Ogami Itto seemed to have a very cushy life during Edo-Era Japan, for he had been the Shogun's official executioner (Kogi Kaishakunin). A position so powerful, the term "Second" meant that Itto was only second to the Shogun as far as metering out death to unloyal feudal lords throughout the 60 regions of Shogunate controlled Japan. In fact, the Shogun's symbol of the Hollyhock crest was a noticable part of Ogami's court attire, thus deeming his stature as indeed being the Shogun's final say over his people. The Kogi Kaishakunin was highest of the three positions given to certain clans of samurai under the Shogun to root out corruption amongst the feudal lords who answered to his Highness about the land. The second clan were the Yagyu who assassinated anyone caught doing treasonous deeds. The third clan were the Kurokawa. Shinobi (ninja) sent to spy on daimyos (lords) and report back to the Shogunate.

Ogami won his exulted position, by protecting his Highness during the contest to choose the Executioner. The opponent, Gunbei Yagyu, disarmed Itto but blatantly pointed the tip of his sword at the Shogun in his victory over Itto. Ogami seeing this as a direct threat to his Highness stepped in between the sword and the Shogun and thus won the slot of Kogi Kaishakunin. This did not bode well with the ancient patriarch of the Yagyu, Lord Retsudo.

name: Daigoro Ogami
description: The son of Ittō and Azami, Daigorō becomes a stronger warrior as the story progresses.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Retsudou Yagyu
description:
The leader of the Yagyuu clan, Retsudou tries everything in his power to ensure that Ittou dies.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Abe Tanomo
description: The Shogun's kuchiyaku (food taster), who is personally responsible for inspecting the food that is served to the Shogun for any sign of poison. Because of this, Abe no Kaii is an expert on poisons and, thus, an expert on poisoning others. He is assigned to help Retsudo kill Itto by the Shogun, but secretly schemes behind their backs to kill both Itto and Retsudo thus allowing him to become the force controlling the Shogunate behind the scenes. Unlike Retsudo, who is at least a Bushi and holds himself to certain standards of honor, Abe no Kaii holds nothing but disdain for the warrior code and will stoop to use any tactics to get what he wants and is also a gutless coward who always thinks of himself first.

name: Shougen Mukai
description:
Mukai was the retainer of a clan that had been disbarred for crimes against the Tokugawa and whose lord had been ordered to commit seppuku. Ogami, then still working as the kogi kaishaku for the shogun, had participated in the execution, acting as second for the disgraced lord. 



Makabe is now a ronin eking out a meagre existence fishing by the banks of the river where his lord had died. He has taken the name Hoozuki, after a plant that continues to bloom even after it has been uprooted, and lives in quiet peace.

name: Sakon Shino
description:
Headless Sakon was once a Master Swordsman who gave up his social standing as a samurai to live as a street performer simply because he could not abide being a complacent part of the inherent injustice of the aristocratic class system in which he lived. 

He challenges Itto to a duel not because Itto has a contract in which he is tangled up or because he cares about the price on the Lone Wolf's head, but entirely because he is concerned for Daigoro and wants the boy to grow up with a proper father, whether it is Itto or himself, and cannot talk Itto into giving up his life as an assassin.

name: O-Yuki
description: O-Yuki is a female fighter who has gone on a killing spree through the ranks of a feudal lord.

name: Teru Kurebayashi
description:
__Height:__ 156 cm

Teru is left all alone when her brother died with only the cell phone her brother gave her to keep her company. It is with this cell phone that she discovers the friend her brother left her in the one that calls himself DAISY. Teru's feelings for DAISY become that of a brothers as he is always there in the shadows, protecting and encouraging her through messages and sometimes physical acts (i.e. throwing tennis balls at bullies from afar, hacking the school computer system at her request), however their relationship has never gone beyond the bounds of Instant Messaging. At the beginning of the manga she is being bullied by the student council and after being maliciously drenched with a hose a mysterious ball flies onto the scene scaring the bullies off. As she tries to return the ball she accidentally throws it through a school window. This results in her meeting with the school Janitor, Tasuku Kurosaki, who demands payment for the window, however hearing Teru is financially incapable of paying for the window he makes her work it off, making her his "Slave" getting her to do his janitorial duties in his place. As the manga progresses, Teru's once negative feelings towards Kurosaki grow into something more romantic. However her suspicion grows that Kurosaki is in fact her beloved ally DAISY and that the phone her brother left her might be more than it appears.

name: Tasuku Kurosaki
description:
__Height:__ 181cm
__Favorite food:__ Potato salad with ham and corn. (No apple or mandarin! nothing too sweet or sour; hates tomatoes)

Kurosaki works as the school janitor. He is also a computer hacker.
He is a drinker, smokes a lot, is violent, dangerous, scary and calls Teru his servant. He is quite good-looking as well. He does not display his emotions normally but when he gets angry, he can be very terrifying. He swears at times, and likes to eat. He is an excellent cook, but usually commands Teru to cook. However, he can be protective of Teru when she is in danger. And yes, he is in love with her.

name: Souichirou Kurebayashi
description:
Souichirou Kurebayashi is the deceased brother of the main character, Teru Kurebayashi. Little is known about him other than he was a very talented computer engineer and led a team of engineers that included Tasuku Kurosaki and Riko Onizuka, he supposedly made some software that would sell for a very high price before his death which mysteriously disappeared, this has brought suspicion on the phone he left his little sister, many believing the software was left to her as a sort of uninformed inheritance. He shoved the role of DAISY onto his friend Kurosaki and potentially convinced him using some form of guilt as Kurosaki has openly admitted that he was in some way responsible for Souichirou's death though the contribution is unclear. It was thought that Souichirou was the one who named DAISY after his sisters favorite flower, the blue daisy, however DAISY has admitted to taking on the name after discovering it was the name of a deadly bomb. It is Kurosaki’s codename that he used to hack into illegal government services. Even though Kurosaki stopped hacking, DAISY is still known to be a "genius hacker", thus causing many troubles for Teru when a "fake DAISY" appears.   

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Chiharu Mori
description: Initially introduced as the attractive school nurse, Mori appears to be air-headed woman who often makes blunt thinly-veiled insults against Teru. However, Kurosaki gradually becomes suspicious of what Mori is capable of when she tries to use Teru to expose DAISY.     (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Masuda
description:
Masuda is the manager of Ohanabatake, a Western style tea house, often seen wearing a bandana and apron. Both Kurosaki, Riko, and a number of characters refer to him as "Master". Despite his cordial demeanor and tendency to tease Kurosaki about his relationship with Teru, the Master can be surprising frightening; Kurosaki admits that the Master is far scarier than he is. He is fully aware of Kurosaki's activities as DAISY and has watched over Kurosaki, even before either of them became acquainted with Souchirou Kurebayashi.  

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Riko Onizuka
description:
Riko Onizuka was a member of the team Teru's brother led as well as his previous girlfriend; she has a good friendship with Tasuku Kurosaki and often subtly serves as his adviser on his situation with Teru. She is the current housemate of Teru as well as Kurosaki's neighbor. She is also the current school councilor at Teru's high school.    

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Akira
description: Akira is a black haired boy who looks very much like Souchiro (Teru's older brother). He is around Teru's age, has slanted eyes, and is about 170 centimeters tall. His build is lithe, like a cat's. He also carries around a yo-yo. He also has extraordinary arithmetic skills and he has the ability to decipher a complex code just by simply looking at it.

name: Haruka Sawaguchi
description:
One of Teru's classmates and friends, Haruka acts as the leader of sorts in Teru's group of friends and encourages Teru's relationship with Kurosaki. She is the first friend that Teru confides in with her knowledge that she is aware that Kurosaki and DAISY are the same person. Haruka is frequently the first to come to Teru's defense at school, often leading their other friends to join suit. She is a member of the school's art club, track team, and ghost club.  

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Kazumasa Andou
description:
The Chairman of Teru and Kurosaki's high school, Andou is a former colleague of DAISY and Teru's brother. He initially appears as the substitute janitor for Kurosaki. While he appears as a comic character who often appears from odd, small, and dark places like vents and garbage cans and enjoys being beaten up, Andou is serious whenever matters concerning DAISY arise and acts as the group's leader during investigations. His nickname, Andy, came from Souichirou.   

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Masumi Takeda
description:
One of DAISY's former co-workers, described as persistent, but not terribly cunning. He comes to Teru's school as the new PC instructor and administrator for information management, but in truth hopes to get close to Teru to obtain her cell phone, believing it contains unreleased software Souchirou had been designing before his death. While his first attempt is thwarted by Kurosaki, Takeda choses to stop harassing Teru because of her resolve and kindness after his second attempt. He subsequently becomes an infrequent ally to DAISY.  

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Seol-Jin Heo
description: Seol-Jin is Initially an outcasted and bullied loner in his place of origin, South Korea, with low self-esteem and a love for webtoons. He was then suddenly transported into the world of one of his loved webtoon to embark in a journey to becoming the world’s number one ranked player.

name: Excalibur
description:
She’s an ego sword made by Arthur given to Heo Seol-Jin.

When in Ego Weapon form, Excalibur's appears like a huge sword with a broad, blue shining blade and a black handle and a golden ring that connects both the handle and the blade.

name: Pastis
description: He's a member of Heo Seol-Jin's party and a pretty rambunctious guy.

__Height:__ 171 cm

The main protagonist of the story. Haruka, a bonfide loner, as well as his classmates were all surrounded by a magic circle. To avoid the world transfer, he escaped out of the classroom, but failed. This resulted in his transfer getting delayed and because of this, the skills that he could choose on a first-come, first-serve basis were only leftover skills. Failing to notice Haruka was missing, God decides to grant him all of the skills that were unchosen. 

One of the unchosen skills he receives is titled "Loner." The bearer of that title is not permitted to join a party.

She is also a part of the main group Haruka has kept close to.

name: Karura Hiougi
description:
__Height:__ 151 cm (4'11")

Karura Hiougi was originally introduced as an antagonist, but she is now a recurring character. She is a tengu who controls the yokai in Kyoto under the Western Forces that serve the Yoinozaka Family.

Initially, Karura is seen as possessive, obsessive, and a bit manipulative. She never gives up when she wants something or someone. After being rejected by [Kogarashi](https://anilist.co/character/126834/Fuyuzora-Kogarashi), her personality mellows out but is still very ambitious of her goals. As the story progresses, it's revealed that she's actually quite shy after stalking Kogarashi Fuyuzora for so long. She can only be more forward with her feelings if angered, pushed in a corner, or gets "caught in the moment".

appearsIn.title: Yuuna and the Haunted Hot Springs

In actuality, she is a sweet and shy girl that lives a troubled life due to the misunderstandings caused by her scary look. After transferring to a new school, she meets [Yuu Usami](https://anilist.co/character/141494/Yuu-Usami), who slowly but steadily changes the way she looks at herself.

She loves reading books, and often resides in a quiet, solitary spot in the school library. Aoi Tokujira was named the "Thorn Princess" for her tendency to hurt any guy who approaches her. It's later revealed that she has a fear of men, and that her best friend is a girl named Botan.

description: Ichihashi is the leader of a gang that originally tormented Tobio's group. Following the Yabako bombing incident, he received severe damage to his nerves and was forced to live the rest of his life using a wheelchair.

name: Kazuki Kohori
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm (5'2")

A young student who works part time with Risa in Ikebe. He is notably shorter than her, although slightly taller than Otani (158 cm.), and has distinctive black hair with a red streak. Risa soon discovers that he is also an avid Umibouuzu fan. He very soon develops feelings for Risa, who admits to herself that she finds him 'cute'. Against her better judgment, Risa attends an Umibouzu concert with Kohori which leads to her temporary breakup with Otani. He even tells Ōtani that he is in love with Risa, which causes Ōtani to slug him.

name: Mimi Yoshioka
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm (5'7")

Ootani's next door neighbor. She is in love with Ootani, and brings him milk every day so he could reach her height, about the same as Risa's. Since Ootani does not not have feelings toward her but he does have feelings for Risa, Mimi becomes jealous of her. She acts accordingly two-faced between them both-- acting sweet towards Ootani, yet acting sour to Risa behind his back.

name: Takahito Koizumi
description: Risa's younger brother and main character in the Lovely Complex Deluxe one shot and Lovely Complex Two.

He is one of the fourth group of subordinates to be named by Rimuru Tempest. As the right-hand man of the deceased Orc Lord, he was given the same name as him, as a memento and token of appreciation, similar to how Rigur was named after his older brother.

As an Orc King, he is the leader of the Yellow Corps, that acts as both the last line of defense for Tempest as well as the main team of the country's Department of Construction and Manufacturing. Later on, he was given the Title of a "Lord" as one of Rimuru's Twelve Patrons.

name: Ririsa Amano
description: Ririsa is a beautiful first-year student who joins the manga club. Due to her passion for cosplay, she recruits Okumura to be her photographer. Like Okumura, she is also a fan of Liliel. She was first inspired to become a cosplayer when she visited a cosplay event. Though initially oblivious, she starts to slowly fall in love with Okumura later on.

name: Mikari Tachibana
description: Mikari is a first-year student who is [Okumura](https://anilist.co/character/169256/Masamune-Okumura)'s childhood friend and [Ririsa](https://anilist.co/character/169257/Ririsa-Amano)'s classmate. A gorgeous and popular model, she has had a crush on Okumura since they were young, though he has never noticed.
One of the Four Heavenly Queens of Cosplay. She considers [Mayura](https://anilist.co/character/321628/Hanyuu-Mayuri) her greatest rival.

name: Mayuri Hanyuu
description: One of the Four Heavenly Queens of Cosplay.

name: Noa Ebisu
description: A first-year high school student who suffers from extreme communication disorder. Cosplays under the name "Nonoa" and is attracting attention as one of the rising stars of cosplay alongside Ririsa Amano. Famous for having a stoic expression while cosplaying, due to her communication disorder, with people calling her an "ice queen" as a result

name: Marina Abe
description: Vice president of the student council and Okumura's childhood friend.

name: Yoki Hoshizuki
description: One of the Four Heavenly Queens of Cosplay.

name: Claire François
description:
**Height:** 157 cm (5'2")

Claire François is a proud noble who in the original [Revolution] is the villainess who bullies the heroine. 

Claire is prideful with a competitive side to prove her worth as well as her family name. Her threatening behaviour conceals her fragile heart that comes from her childhood experiences. Becomes more prone to jealously as people she cares for may leave her. Her arrogant personality is mainly influenced by her father doting on her in her childhood more than anything.

appearsIn.title: I’m in Love with the Villainess

name: Rae Taylor
description:
**Height:** 162 cm (5'4")

An ordinary office worker who finds herself in the body of the protagonist of her favorite otome game, Revolution. She aims to become a couple with her favorite character, [Claire François](https://anilist.co/character/149900/Claire-Franois).

Rae deliberately plays herself up as being a foolishly happy-go-lucky girl who is obsessed with gaining Claire's affection. However, in reality, this is more of a coping mechanism brought about by her early experiences with exploring her sexuality. She is actually far less open with her true feelings, often bottling them up and covering it with humor.

appearsIn.title: I’m in Love with the Villainess

description: Manaria Sousse is the first crown princess of the kingdom of Sousse. She is a distant relative of Claire. She is the world's first confirmed quad-caster who possesses the highest aptitude in every element.

appearsIn.title: I’m in Love with the Villainess

description: The second heir within the Bauer Kingdom's royal family. Thane is often stoic and feels his abilities are inferior to his brothers, giving him a complex about it. Thane is considered as the least popular capture target within the game.

appearsIn.title: I’m in Love with the Villainess

**Height:** 154 cm (5'1")

Lene is the eldest daughter of a wealthy merchant family, Aurosseau. She loyally serves Claire François as her personal maid. Lene seems very patient, and comes off as meek and subservient, but in reality, she just knows how to handle Claire very well after years of serving her.

appearsIn.title: I’m in Love with the Villainess

description: Lilly is a meek and shy girl who is highly knowledgeable about the Spiritual Church and her religion. She often stutters and refers herself as "Lilly" when she speaks. In addition, she is prone to be easily startled and accidentally insult others whenever they act inappropriately.

Misha is Rae's best friend and roommate at the Academy. She is a noble from a house that fell from grace and became impoverished. Despite the Jur family's struggles with money, she still holds some reputation. She is accepting of her position and, rather than hold onto the noble status, portrays herself as equal among people with common background. This allowed for Rae and Misha to form their longstanding friendship.

Gamin Yoon ("윤가민") is the main protagonist of the manhwa, Study Group. He is a high school student with a dream of entering a 4-year university and becoming a college student. He is the foundeTo hell with circumstances, I create opportunities of Yusong Vocational Engineering High Study Group.

name: Shinya Kiritani
description: A veteran player who has top class combat ability. He defeats the last boss in the online game "The New Gate" and releases tens of thousands of players that had been trapped inside. After defeating the last boss, he gets swallowed up by a strange light and he finds himself inside the game, 500 years into the future.

name: Schnee Raizar
description:
A High Elf and Shin's first support character, Schnee is an NPC from the Game Era. Currently, she is the acting manager of the Moon Shrine.

Created by Shin early in the game, Schnee was modeled by combining Shin's preferences. Due to her association with High Humans, she was revered by the inhabitants of the world.

name: Tiera Lucent
native: ティエラ・ ルーセント
description: Tiera Lucent is an Elf and the salesclerk of the Moon Shrine. An aspiring alchemist, she was expelled from her village at a young age when her hair turned black due to a curse.

name: Sety Lumiere
description: Shin's #5 support character, a high pixie mage and alchemist.

name: Alice Carroll
description:
__Height:__ 145 cm 

A girl introduced in volume 3, Alice is a trainee for Orange Planet, a company who currently holds the first place in the water guide business. She first appears as a very standoffish, snotty young girl; however, exposure to [Akari](https://anilist.co/character/378/Mizunashi-Akari)'s mood begins to lighten her up as the series progresses. This does not stop her from telling the other girls to be quiet when they argue, however.  

She is just a trainee when Akari and [Aika](https://anilist.co/character/380/Granzchesta-S-Aika) are apprentices, but is already showing a talent for rowing that might surpass both of them (in fact, this is the reason why she was scouted by Orange Planet despite her age). Despite this (and the fact that Akari and Aika are from rival businesses), she often joins the two in joint practice sessions, and she sincerely enjoys their company.

Alice speaks in a very deadpan manner, and tends to use the word dekkai (でっかい - meaning "huge") often in the course of speaking. Aika also commonly addresses her as "Kohai-chan" (後輩ちゃん - or "junior" said in a friendly manner).

name: Akira Ferrari
description:
__Status:__ Prima
__Place of Birth:__ Aqua
__Height:__ 168 cm

Akira is one of Neo Venezia's three Water Fairies, and is Aika's supervisor with the Himeya company. She is nicknamed the Demon Instructor for her strict training regimen as well as her loud and brusque personality. She is particularly harsh with Aika, in spite of the fact that the girl is her employers' heir, though she does so since she honestly thinks that there is potential in her. As such, she is the only Himeya employee who does not fawn on Aika, though even the latter admits that it is only due to Akira's strictness (and honesty) that she has been able to become a good undine. As a prima undine, she is known as "Crimson Rose" (真紅の薔薇).

Akira is famous for her conversational skills as well as her intimate knowledge of the sights to be seen in Neo Venezia. She has a lot of admirers among her customers, though surprisingly enough these are more female than male (which seems to bother her a little, as she considers herself very feminine).

Akira and Alicia's relationship mirrors Akari and Aika's, though Alicia is far more teasing when Akira is around. This isn't that much of a surprise, as Akira and Alicia are childhood friends. However, Akira is still galled that Alicia became a Prima earlier than her, despite the fact that Alicia initially became an undine to tag along with her.

name: Alicia Florence
native: アリシア・フローレンス
description:
__Status:__ Prima
__Height:__ 165 cm

The only other undine with Aria Company, Alicia is one of the Three Water Fairies of Neo-Venezia, known by the title "Snow White". At the start of the series, she is the most popular undine in the city, noted especially for her graceful rowing style. She was promoted to Prima at 15, the youngest ever to do so. Like [Akari](https://anilist.co/character/378/Mizunashi-Akari), she is relaxed and easy-going, but she also likes to tease others, especially her childhood friend [Akira](https://anilist.co/character/381/Ferrari-E-Akira). Her favorite phrase is "ara ara" and she frequently giggles, to Akira's annoyance. According to [Grandma Akino](https://anilist.co/character/10711/Ametsuchi-Akino), she is an excellent undine because of her ability to enjoy everything.

name: Athena Glory
description:
__Status:__ Prima 
__Birth Place:__ Aqua
__Height:__ 170 cm

The third "Water Fairy", who works for Orange Planet and acts as Alice's mentor. She tends to be a total airhead who does not really pay attention to anything (in the anime, she once rowed under a bridge and forgot to duck), but genuinely cares about Alice. She was a trainee undine with Alicia and Akira, and often joined them in joint practice sessions much like Akari, Aika, and Alice do now. Athena has a beautiful singing voice, which she uses to entertain her customers and also to help Alice when she is in some kind of trouble. Athena has a strange laugh, it usually comes out sounding as though she is angry. She came to know Alicia and Akira when they were still trainee undine and practised together back then. She tends to be quiet most of the time but happy to join in having fun. Her appellation as a prima undine is "Seiren" (denoted as "Heavenly Voice").

name: Aika Granzchesta
native: 藍華・S・グランチェスタ
description:
__Birthplace:__ Aqua
__Height:__ 160 cm

The first friend [Akari](https://anilist.co/character/378/Mizunashi-Akari) ever made on Aqua, Aika is an undine for Himeya, the oldest and currently second-ranking water-guide company in Neo-Venezia. As the only daughter of its owners, she is also Himeya's heir, but does not enjoy the distinction that much, as she feels that she is fawned upon too much by the company's employees. 

Aika often speaks in an open and blunt manner, and goes out of her way to cut off Akari's many idealistic comments with a preemptive "Embarrassing remarks are not allowed!" (Hazukashii serifu kinshi!). Despite their contrasting personalities, she gets along quite well with Akari, and later with [Alice](https://anilist.co/character/382/Carroll-Alice). She is very proud of her undine abilities, and tends to be very competitive in this aspect. She also worships [Alicia](https://anilist.co/character/379/Florence-Alicia), and finds any excuse to go over to Aria company and spend time with her. Aika once said that if it was not for the obligation to her family, she would join Aria company. Aika has feelings for [Al](https://anilist.co/character/14141/Pitt-Albert).

name: Akari Mizunashi
description:
__Height:__ 155 cm

A native of Man-Home, Akari is a happy and easy-going person, who we rarely see angry or upset, a quality which she shares with her supervisor. She is best described as a romantic and seems to find enjoyment in things or events that other people might think humdrum and mundane. Akari often says "Hohe" or "Hahi", which is her short version of "wow".

While she is not quite as skilled in rowing as [Alice](https://anilist.co/character/382/Carroll-Alice), nor is as familiar with the history of the city as [Aika](https://anilist.co/character/380/Granzchesta-S-Aika), her carefree and laid-back manner often endears her to the many people she encounters. As such, she seems to make friends very easily and can hold a warm conversation even with complete strangers, a fact that causes her to be labeled as 'mysterious' by her closest friends Aika and Alice. She also accidentally learned how to row back on the gondola back when she was at Man-Home, which Aika states, "Akari is almost invincible when she rows backward" (from the anime and the manga).

She is frequently writing letters about her adventures on Aqua to an unnamed person back on Man-home (revealed in the last chapter of the manga); in the anime, these letters are directed to [Ai](https://anilist.co/character/12388/Aino-Ai).

name: Maa
description:
Maa is one of the four major cats in the Aria storyline was adopted as a stray by [Alice](https://anilist.co/character/382/Carroll-Alice) in the first season. She named her "Maa-kun" because all the cat said was "Maa". Because of Maa's incredibly small blue pupils, she was made Orange Planet's new president, thus everyone now refers to her as President Maa (Maa-shachou).

Maa is the smallest of the company cats. She is mostly white with patches of black and brown fur. She has a great affinity for biting President Aria's belly and does so whenever she can much to President Aria's dismay.

name: Cait Sith
description: A very large cat who has powers in black magic. He has been the head of the cat kingdom in Aqua for at least 100 years and is implied as the spiritual guardian of Aqua.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Atora Monteverdi
native: アトラ・モンテヴェルディ
description: An Undine from Orange Planet who often works special traghetto gondolas as she strives to become a Prima Undine. Like Anzu, she failed her Prima exam, but unlike Anzu, she didn't have the courage to try again, arguing that she felt the Orange Planet examineer is too strict and wouldn't give them a chance. After working together with Akari and witnessing her skills, she has a change of heart and vows to try again and again until she passes, much like Anzu was (and is) doing.

name: Ai Aino
description: A girl from Man-home. Initially, Ai came to Aqua to explore in a rather negative attitude because her elder sister often boasted to her how good Aqua is, only to find that it was boring. However, meeting & befriending Akari & friends changed Ai's mindset. Ai became the recipient of Akari's letters, and through Akari's mails, Ai started to love Aqua more than ever. Whenever time permits, Ai would pay a visit to Akari in Aqua.

name: Hyeon Lee
description:
+Occupation: Dark Gamer, Student
Known Relatives: Lee Ha-Yan (sister), Grandma
Profession: Legendary Moonlight Sculptor, Necromancer, Warrior, Warrior of the Sun
Alias: Karichwi (Orc form), Art Hand (Dwarf form), Deorol/Clongy (Lich form), (Crow / Raven form), (Bone Dragon form), (Chaos Warrior form), (Ice Troll form), Gold Bug (Dark Gamers), Deruger (Monster form), (Hummingbird form), (Portu Kingdom Archer form), (Barbarian form), (Pony form), (Giant Asian Black Bear form), (Griffon form), Squashy Wriggler (Underground Monster form), (Monkfish form)

Lee Hyeon is a high school drop-out with an enormous debt inherited from his deceased parents. Upon placing his gaming avatar from the game "The Continent of Magic" on an auction, the news spreads nationwide, and a fierce competition to win Hyeon's avatar breaks out. The price is eventually raised to ₩3.1 billion won (around 2.76 million US dollars). However, the great majority of this sum is soon taken by loan sharks who show up to collect the debt owed by his father. He's then left with only ₩90 million won (around 80 thousand US dollars)... ₩60 million of which goes to pay for a small house for his grandmother and sister to live in. The loan sharks leave with a challenge to Lee Hyeon to make the same amount of money in five years to get his revenge on them.

name: Hyeon-Do An
description: A 50 year old legendary master swordsman known throughout Korea, An Hyeon-Do is the head of the best and largest sword Dojang of South Korea.

name: Da-In
description: Da-In is a high-level Shaman player in Royal Road. She has exceptional skill due to her unusual style of training, and she is Weed's first love. In the real world, she went through a high-risk medical surgery.

name: Hye-Yeon Lee
description: She is the younger sister of Weed and she is the main reason behind his actions to make money, as he wants to pay her college fees.

name: Hyo-Rin Jeong
description: Jeong Hyo-Rin, is a player in Royal Road and a friend of Weed. In the game she plays the Dancer class. In real life she is a successful and worldwide known singer who plays the game to relieve the stress of being famous and single.

name: Ji-Hun Choi
description: Choi Ji-Hun is the son of a rich businessman and plays the gamer character of Zephyr, a quiet and peaceful fisherman.

name: Maximilian Calypse
description:
Maxi is abused by her father and compared to her half sister in every way, she is told that she is to marry a knight and she does so fearing the same treatment. She has almost no self esteem, and due to the abuse she suffered she has developed a stutter, something she is very self conscious about. 

Maxi's speech impediment is based off of the original author's own personal experience with having a stuttering speech depending on mood and level of excitement. Something the author discussed during a special interview for the manhwa released in December 2021

name: Kurogane
description: Kurogane is serious and extremely perceptive, being able to quickly discern Syaoran's fighting ability (along with Syaoran's blind right eye) as well as Fai D. Flourite's true nature and fighting capabilities. While he seems rather irreverent, he is also very loyal. He is likely the most experienced fighter in the group and wiser than he appears. He becomes Syaoran's sword fighting teacher, presenting the boy with the same philosophy he believes in: a sword is used to cut only when needed and not used to cut anything if it is not necessary. While serious, Kurogane is very easily irked by others, especially by Mokona Modoki and Fai, who keep calling him ridiculously cutesy nicknames such as "Kuro-puu", "Kuro-wan-wan" or "Kuro-rin". However abrasive and ruthless Kurogane may seem, he has a compassionate nature and a desire to protect. An example of this would be how Kurogane continually questions Fai on his actions and character, and lets the wizard know that he should stop hanging onto his past and embrace the future with his new companions. Or, Kurogane's own statement that "If someone wants to take away the ones I want to protect, I'll kill them too".  His compassion and protective nature is especially clear when his actions early in the series are compared to his actions later on. He had straight out told Syaoran in their first world, the Hanshin Republic, that the quest has nothing at all to do with him.

name: Syaoran
description: Syaoran is Sakura's childhood friend. After Sakura's memories were scattered around different worlds and dimensions, Syaoran made a vow to get them back no matter what.

name: Sakura
description:
[Spoilers may follow] 
Original Timeline

In Syaoran's flashback, it is revealed that he gave his name to Sakura as "Li Syaoran", the same name as his father. It is also revealed that Sakura's mother was Nadeshiko, and that Fujitaka was Sakura's father, not Clow Reed. In chapter 191, Syaoran tells Sakura that she looks exactly like his mother (Clone Sakura) and shares the same name as his mother as well, to which Sakura responds "But.. My name..", thus hinting that, like Syaoran, Sakura is not her real name.
An emphasis seems to be put on how "Syaoran" and Sakura cannot touch. Due to the cleansing before her birthday, Sakura is not able to be touched. At the beginning of Tsubasa - in the tube, "Syaoran" and Sakura are separated by glass; not able to touch. However, cover of volume 23 and the splash page of chapter 183 has them holding hands.

At the end of chapter 193, Sakura takes "Syaoran" up to the top of the castle, to show him the stars. Her eyes suddenly go blank, and her body rises up in the air - she hears the sound of bells coming from the ruins (like chapter 1). In chapter 194, a page is shown of what Sakura is seeing in the future, which includes "Syaoran" running towards her desperately in the ruins. Returning back to the present, "Syaoran"'s running figure is reflected in her eyes (she is still seeing the future); and she screams out "SYAORAN!!". Sakura falls down suddenly, to "Syaoran"'s horror.

name: Syaoran Li
description: Mysterious person kept asleep in a liquid chamber at Fei Wong Reed's palace, with his left eye covered by a piece of cloth, his hands and arms by binding spells and wearing clothes marking Fei Wong Reed's bat symbol.

name: Mokona Modoki
description: A replica of a dimensional god Mokona made by [Clow Reed](https://anilist.co/character/3612/Reed-Clow) and [Yuuko](https://anilist.co/character/236/Ichihara-Yuuko). Soel was created specifically for [Sakura](https://anilist.co/character/127/Sakura), as a countermeasure for certain events foretold to happen in her journey by Clow Reed. It is "the thing" given to the Tsubasa crew as a means to travel between dimensions. Soel is more energetic and cheerful than her counterpart, Black Mokona, Larg. Soel likes to tease the Tsubasa team members, especially Kurogane. Soel's main functions include dimensional travel, universal translator and communicating with Black Mokona. It is later revealed that these functions are part of her "108 Secret Skills." Soel bears an earring on her right ear, while Larg has one on his left ear.  In Horitsuba Gakuen, she is a twin with Mokona. (This is not the same Mokona which appears in CLAMP's other work, Rayearth.)

name: Caldina
description:
Caldina is a dancer who speaks with an Osaka accent (which is translated as a deep Southern accent in the English dub, due to the translations including words like "y'all"), wears extremely skimpy clothing, and has an endless passion for money (several notable similarities to Naga from Slayers).    Zagato hires her as an assassin after his other minions fail; in addition to her dancing skills, she is an accomplished illusionist and hypnotist. In the anime she has great affection for Ascot, whom she treats as a naïve younger brother, and she joins him in deserting Zagato.

It is revealed in the second manga series that she is native to Chizeta. It's also been shown that Caldina is incredibly good at cards and other games of chance. Romantically, Caldina becomes involved with Lafarga in both versions of the series.

name: Maru
description: Maru is one of the two girls that led Watanuki into Yūko's shop. It isn't stated whether the girls were created by Yūko, Clow Reed, the both of them, or someone else entirely, but since they have no souls and cannot leave the shop, it can be assumed that they were created there.

name: Seong-Yun Han
description: The main character who goes by the nickname 'Hunter' in Tower of Trials.

name: Ha-Yeon Lee
description: She's a member of the White Silver Guild. She first met [Seong-Yun](https://anilist.co/character/298422) at the Tower of Trials.

name: Cheolhyeorui Gunju
description: A challenger who died on 47th floor of Tower of Trials.

name: Hakgeomseon Baek
description: She is an administrator who took an interest in [Seong-Yun](https://anilist.co/character/298422) and made an additional contract with him.

name: Catherine Bennett
description: She is a famous hunter from America also known as "The Witch of Hellfire".

name: Gin
description:
Gin is a member of the Black Organization and a main antagonist of the series. He is the organization member who gave Shinichi Kudo the experimental poison APTX 4869 which turned him into [Conan Edogawa.](https://anilist.co/character/1742/Conan-Edogawa) He is frequently paired on missions with [Vodka.](https://anilist.co/character/6306/Vodka) In the English manga, he was first introduced as Melkior, but later was reverted to Gin. This is likely due to the fact that Conan is often reminded of the Black Organization by references to alcohol. 

Of the high ranking members of the Black Organization shown, Gin is the most loyal: he follows the boss' orders most closely and virtually never acts against the Organization's greater interests. He is also one of the Black Organization's most dangerous operatives; Conan miscalculating his intelligence, abilities, and speed of response have resulted in several very close calls and awry plans.

Gin is a merciless and efficient assassin. He has no compunctions about killing or threatening fellow teammates. Fitting his icy personality, Gin's displayed range of emotions so far is relatively limited. Wearing a threatening smirk, he enjoys hunting traitors, watching the plans he has concocted succeed, and cornering his targets. Although he seems to take satisfaction with taking out someone personally, Gin is also satisfied with orchestrating a target's death even if he does not pull the trigger himself.

name: Chianti
description: A member of the Black Organization who serves as an assassin and replaces Calvados. She has a butterflywing-tattoo on one of her eyes. Along with Korn, Chianti does not appear to like Vermouth.

name: Hideo Akagi
description: Hideo Akagi plays for the soccer team Tokyo Spirits. He has a younger brother named Mamoru. His parents died two years prior to the current timeline.

name: Fusae Campbell
description: Fusae Campbell Kinoshita is Agasa Hakase's long lost love and an accessory fashion designer with a ginkgo leaf-themed brand.  Fusae Campbell is of Japanese-American descent and has the unusual feature (for a Japanese) of blond hair. Feeling self-conscious about this (presumably aided by some teasing from intolerant schoolmates), she became very timid and came to wear a low hat to cover her hair.  When she was in fourth grade, Fusae met Agasa Hiroshi, who helped her overcome her timidness. The two became very fond of each other, especially since Agasa did not ridicule her for her hair color, but Fusae soon had to move away before she could confess her feelings for him. In a letter she left, she promised that once every ten years she would wait for Agasa at "the place of memories" (the ginkgo trees behind Teitan elementary school) until he met up with her, but the hints she left were too complicated for Agasa to crack, and it was not until 40 years later the two were finally reunited with the help of the Detective Boys. By that time Fusae had become a successful fashion designer, with a ginkgo leaf being her trademark signature (because Agasa had commented on her hair looking like ginkgo leaves in the fall).  While the two parted inconclusively because of mistaken conceptions about the other, they did recognize each other, and Agasa was able to make his feelings known to her. Whether the two will meet anytime soon remains to be seen.

name: Heizo Hattori
description:
Heizo Hattori is the highest ranking officer at the Osaka Prefectural Police Headquarters; he is Superintendent Supervisor _(Rank 2)._ Heizo is the father of the high school detective [Heiji Hattori,](https://anilist.co/character/1745/Heiji-Hattori) and is sometimes very supportive of his son's desire to be a detective. Heizo has sometimes lent his son a hand in solving a tough case. Though he has a hard exterior, Heizo is very caring for his son, family, and friends. At the Osaka district, he is very close with Goro Otaki and Ginshiro Toyama. It is due to his friendship with [Ginshiro Toyama](https://anilist.co/character/30375/Ginshiro-Toyama) that his son, Heiji, originally met Toyama's daughter, [Kazuha.](https://anilist.co/character/3198/Kazuha-Toyama) His wife is [Shizuka Hattori.](https://anilist.co/character/41038/Shizuka-Hattori) He is one of the most avid admirers of [Sleeping Kogoro.](https://anilist.co/character/1746/Kogoro-Mouri)

He has a very serious attitude and seemingly cold, especially when he punched his son in front of many people hard enough for Heiji to fall down. But it was revealed later on that he merely punched Heiji for his son to be more aggressive in solving the case and using Heiji as a bait, although he apologized later on. He also is supportive of his son's career as a high school detective but also, as a caring father, he is also cares for his son's well-being.  

Heizo possesses a very sharp intellect and observation skills.

name: Eisuke Hondou
description:
Eisuke is Ran's new classmate. The two met shortly following the Black Impact incident in which the  apprehended a member of the Black Organization via a fluke accident in which Eisuke appears very curious about.  His deductive skills are not very impressive, though Detective Moore has offered Eisuke the opportunity to visit his agency at any time. Eisuke seems to have impecable timing throughout his short time in the series as he is accident prone.  Eisuke is suspected of assisting the Black Organization; however, it is unclear as to who he works for or if he is actually a member of the Black Organization. For instance, in one case, Eisuke broke down in tears because he was "unable to solve the mystery." Though suspicions regarding Eisuke's true identity for Case Closed enthusiasts increases as Vodka says to himself "Hondou... Hondou... Hondou..." This incident combined with Eisuke's similarities to Rena Mizunashi has led Conan to believe that the two are related; however, viewers may infer that the Black Organization's relation with Eisuke goes deeper. In File 604, It is revealed that Rena actually is Eisuke's sister Hidemi, who is a  agent like their father Ethan. After Mizunashi returns to the Black Organization, the  tries to get Eisuke to enter the witness protection program. However, Eisuke returns in File 619, and has refused to be protected by the . Surprisingly in File 621, 

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Eru Aharen
description: She is Aharen Reina's younger sister

name: Ai Aharen
description: [Reina](https://anilist.co/character/121703/Reina-Aharen), [Eru](https://anilist.co/character/277332/Eru-Aharen) and [Ren's](https://anilist.co/character/256826/Ren-Aharen) mother.

name: Nephteros
description: A mysterious girl who looks like Nephilia.

appearsIn.title: An Archdemon's Dilemma: How to Love Your Elf Bride

name: Kasane Fuchi
description: An extremely ugly girl constantly tormented by bullies, in her youth, for her appearance and the fact that her mother was an incredible beauty. Despite her appearance she can act with amazing skill and grace. But due to the torment she faced as a child and her own sense of inferiority, she cannot act in front of anyone as herself. She received a tube of lipstick as a keepsake from her mother before she died. This tube has magic that allows Kasane to take whatever she wants if she kisses it while wearing the lipstick, usually the face of another person. While wearing another persons face, she loses her sense of inferiority and can act nearly flawlessly.

name: Kingo Habuta
description: Sukeyo and later Kasane's manager. He is one of the few people who knows the truth of Kasane's and Sukeyo's appearances and how they changed. He greatly admires both of their acting skills. He begins to help Kasane on the request of her mother before she passed away, and now he hopes to make Kasane into an actress as well known as Sukeyo, and hopefully even better. He was originally a director and he had cast Sukeyo.

name: Nogiku
description: Nogiku is the stepsister of Kasane and the daugher of the woman whom Sukeyo Fuchi was taking on the appearance of. After the death of Sukeyo, Nogiku's father sexually, emotionally and physically abused her, forcing Nogiku to speak, dress and act like Sukeyo, and refusing to call her by her name. Once she learns of Kasane's existence and the truth about her own mother, Nogiku kills her father and escapes from home to search for Kasane and avenge her own mother's death. As opposed to Kasane, who sees beauty as a blessing, Nogiku believes that her beauty and likeness to "Sukeyo" has brought her only misfortune and lead to her being treated as a plaything by men, to be used and discarded afterwards.

name: Iku Igarashi
description: The president of the Acting Club at Kasane's high school. She becomes Kasane's first friend.

name: Neena Tanzawa
description: An actress that Kingo arranges for Kasane to swap faces with. She desires fame but lacks sufficient acting skill and suffers from Sleeping Beauty Syndrome.

name: Mu-Geuk Geom
description:
He is the second son of [Wu-Jin Geom](https://anilist.co/character/346843/WooJin-Geom). He was an incompetent young master who could not properly compete with his older brother and was easily deprived of the position of successor. However, when he lost everything, from his father to everyone around him, he decided to use The Great Regression Technique. After many years, he gathered all the necessary materials for the regression technique and decided to return to the past to take revenge on Moogi Hwa.

After being able to reach the past, his goal would be to kill the one who deserves to die and save those who should not die. Because he lost everything to Hwa Moogi, he has a vengeful side, but more than anything, after losing everything to Hwa Moogi, he looks back and says he has no good memories, and tries to get closer to his father by talking to him, for his own good.

name: Cheon-Pa Gu
description: Cheon-Pa Gu, the Blood Heaven Blade Demon, is a one of the Eight Demon Supremes of the Heavenly Demon Divine Cult.

name: Yeon-Rang So
description: She's one of the Eight Demon Supremes of the Heavenly Demon Divine Cult.

name: Geugaksoma
description: He's the Demon Lord of the Valley of Wicked in the Heavenly Demon Cult. The demons of the Valley of Wicked call him the "Faceless Guest".

name: Lee-An
description: Lee-An is a Mu-Geuk's Bodyguard.

name: Go-Wol
description: A man who was bound by shackles.

name: U-Jin Geom
description: Woojin Geom, the Heavenly Demon, the Strongest of This Era, the Cult Lord of the Heavenly Demon Divine Cult.

name: Dae-Ryong Seo
description: Dae-Ryong Seo is a a special investigation officer.

name: Nyaki
description: __Race:__ Catkin

appearsIn.title: Failure Frame: I Became the Strongest and Annihilated Everything With Low-Level Spells

name: Seon-Jae Choi
description: Seon-Jae is a part of Sillim-Dong, working under Eun-Seong. He is described as a strange person by Do-Wan Ha as he is often seen conversing with or roleplaying as animals or even food. Eun-Seong on the other hand has described him as "Strongest".

name: Eun-Seong Han
description: Sillim-Dong Representative

name: Si-Yeon
description: Borame-Dong Associate

name: Se-hoon Kang
description: Borame-Dong Deputy

name: Seok-Yung Jung
description: Bongcheon-Dong Representative

name: Se-Hui Sin
description: Borame-Dong Associate

name: Henri Sanson
description: Eldest son of Charles-Henri Sanson.

name: Johannes
description: The executioner of Dieppe under Louis XIII.

name: Georges Danton
description: A leader of the French Revolution.

name: Marie Nicole Leguay d'Olivia
native: マリー・ニコル・ルゲイ・ドリヴァ
aliases: マリー・ニコル・ルゲイ・デシニー
description: A French prostitute known in history as one of the participants of the famous fraud known as the Affair of the Diamond Necklace.

name: Louis Antoine de Saint-Just
native: ルイ・アントワーヌ・ド・サン＝ジュスト
description: Close friend of Robespierre.

name: Pierre Hoffer
description: A German disciple to the perfumer Belmond.

name: Gabriel Sanson
native: ガブリエル・サンソン
description: The second son of Charles-Henri Sanson.

name: Ho-Jae Lee
description:
__Age__: 26

Former pro-gamer who entered hell difficulty of the tutorial.

appearsIn.title: Father, I Don't Want this Marriage
Father, I Don't Want this Marriage

name: Jin-Hyeok Song
description: The main character of PIGPEN. He washes ashore an unknown island with no memories of how he got there or who he is.

name: Mi-Nu
description: Minu is a member of the mysterious family found on the island in PIGPEN. He is responsible for taking care of physical jobs on the island such as woodchopping, but otherwise keeps to himself due to disliking talking to others. He is very devout to his family, and is especially protective of his sister Romi.

name: Ro-Mi
description: A member of the family found on the island in PIGPEN. She takes a special interest with the protagonist upon his arrival.

name: Yu-Mi
description: A member of the mysterious family on the island in PIGPEN. She is the youngest member, and is often a cause for trouble in the family.

name: Elric Mervinger
description: The sole heir of the prestigious magic family Merbinger. Though he possessed innate talent, he had too much talent, and as such, could not learn magic. However, he then received a blessing left by his ancestors!

name: Demiurge
description: The Guardian of the Seventh floor of Nazarick, with the form of a demon wearing glasses. Demiurge is very intelligent, but is also considered the most evil NPC on Nazarick. He greatly enjoys the suffering of others, made clear by his vicious experiments on prisoners. He's in charge of tactics and defenses of Nazarick. Among the Guardians, he gets along the best with [Mare](https://anilist.co/character/89126/Bello-Fiore-Mare), since he understands the more cunning side of the Dark Elf.

name: Aura Bella Fiora
native: アウラ・ベラ・フィオーラ
description: One of the Guardians of the Sixth floor of Nazarick, alongside her twin brother [Mare](https://anilist.co/character/89126). She's very energetic and extroverted, in contrast with her brother. Aura is a 70-year-old Dark Elf. Despite constantly fighting, she and Shalltear are quite close. Aura specializes in beast-taming and fights with a long, bladed whip.

name: Zain
description: A wizard and childhood friend of [Caph](https://anilist.co/character/179365/Cuff).

appearsIn.title: The Duke of Death and His Maid

name: Walter
description: Walter is the second male child born in his family. Since his older brother was cast out of the family, he was appointed the new head of the family. When it comes to the subject of his older brother, he has a severe second-born complex, to the point where he gets depressed even at the mere sight of the number two.

appearsIn.title: The Duke of Death and His Maid

name: Viola
description:
Viola is [Duke](https://anilist.co/character/132920/Bocchan)'s younger sister.

Viola is the youngest child in the family and is in love with [Rob](https://anilist.co/character/132924/Rob), Duke's servant. She loves old men and sweets.

appearsIn.title: The Duke of Death and His Maid

name: Takayanagi
description: A high school teacher specializing in ethics.

name: Ban
description:
__Height:__ 166 cm (5'5")

A dragon familiar [Nico](https://anilist.co/character/207345/) summons in chapter 135.

She is carefree, lazy, and would prefer spending her time laying around than doing any work. Despite this, she is very loyal to those she forms a contract with.

name: Momo Kuramochi
description:
__Height:__ 174 cm  (5'9")

She is a witch specializing in teleportation magic. Every time she uses her magic she loses weight, so she needs to eat a lot. She has a parakeet, [Cheke](https://anilist.co/character/297657/), as a familiar.

name: Cheke
description: [Momo's](https://anilist.co/character/296520/) familiar.

name: Momo Momomori
description: A member of the Shio-chans, Momo seems to be very polite and respectful in her manner of speech. However, she is in reality an extremely perverted himejoshi. When Tres Magia was training, she created a hot spring near Sulfur and Magenta to entice them into bathing. She secretly joined them and listened to their conversation.

name: Sayo Minakami
description:
__Height:__ 161 cm

Sayo is a calm and composed person, part of which is attributed to her being a shrine maiden. As shown in the flashback leading to her making the decision to become Magia Azul, she is also a brave person who does not hesitate to help others.

Due to being restrained and tormented by Schiavo multiple times, Sayo began to develop masochistic tendencies. Her masochism and obsession with "fighting" with Enormeeta has gone to the point where she shows envy when [Magenta](https://anilist.co/character/191857/Hanabishi-Haruka) or [Sulfur](https://anilist.co/character/191859/Tenkawa-Kaoruko) get the chance to fight them but she does not, as seen when she glares enviously and drools after seeing Magenta without her panties after the latter fought [Nero Alice](https://anilist.co/character/191858/Morino-Korisu).

name: Randa Tada
description: Berserga is abjectly infatuated with Imitatio. She is also unstable, prone to sudden violent outbursts, proclaims herself to be completely emotionally deadened towards everyone other than Imitatio, and is perfectly ready to point a blade at her crush if she starts getting visibly excited by other girls, with Imitatio being forced to try to talk down the enraged Berserga rather than order her to cool it.

name: Suzune Inukami
description: She has excellent grades, is good at sports, and is the student council president that everyone admires. She was summoned to the Kingdom of Ringle as a hero and has an aptitude for lightning-based magic. To Usato, she was like a flower of Takamine, but after she was summoned to another world, she began to reveal her "true self''.

appearsIn.title: The Wrong Way to Use Healing Magic

name: Seiichirou Kitano
description: The main protagonist, a boy whose face inspires terror and despair in other people's hearts, but whose true nature is that of a kind-hearted boy. His gentle and caring actions mostly frighten those around him, and he's used to getting hit for no apparent reason at all, so he developed speed and reflexes which allow him to absorb the power of the blows; although he has no martial arts skill and doesn't like violence, this in itself is enough to make any skilled fighter lose their will to fight, so he's technically unbeaten.

name: Ryoko Koiso
description: The daughter of the Koiso-style kobujutsu karate master, initially set on fighting each and every high school delinquent, and convinced that Kitano is evil and very strong. After fighting him, however, she discovers his true nature, and little by little she becomes more or less his girlfriend.

name: Seikichi Kuroda
description: The former "guardian" of Hekikuu high. He's been a slave to the previous guardian for most of his high school life, and he thought he could enjoy being the guardian in his last year of school, but he is forced to resign soon after meeting Kitano. He's the most delinquent-like of the group, skipping lessons to smoke and provoking fights. Although he usually gets beaten up  by others (Koiso Ryoko, Takehisa, other delinquents), he isn't physically weak - he is big and has a strong punch. The fact he is constantly defeated lies in his mind - he is easily scared and has tendency to panic. He is also simple-minded enough to be manipulated.        Kuroda desperately tries to reserve a leftovers of his dignity by acting like a guardian before Ogisu and his sempais. Also he has one-sided crush on Ryoko.        Ooshita and Tokiyama are his two lackeys/friends. Both of them have rarely been referred to by their actual names. Koide, the class president's assistant calls it a "miracle" that he was able to obtain their full names. As the story progresses, they realize Kuroda's weakness (and strengths, rarely good, though), but they kept on being loyal to him.        Another piece of trivia from the author himself, Kuroda serves as a pivotal character at the very start of the series, when the author experienced a writer's block.     Wikipedia

name: Yuji Takehisa
description:
The strongest delinquent of Hekikuu high, previously expelled for beating up one of the teachers: after being defeated by Kitano, he proclaims himself his "little brother". He sports spiked bleached hair and has no eyebrows.
After claiming loyalty to Kitano, he becomes less delinquent-like. He doesn't get into a lot of fights anymore (although he doesn't lose any of his fighting skill), nor does he skip classes, staying calm most of the time. His old, hot-blooded self, comes to the surface when someone tries to harm Kitano or himself. At the end of the series, when confronted with the fact of Kitano being "normal" -Takehisa's old comrades had come and asked him to join up in order to beat up Kitano- he proclaimed that whether or not Kitano is a delinquent, he is still Takehisa's best friend. He then proceeded to beat up his old comrades with a smile on his face.

(From Wikipedia)

name: Ikuko Hirayama
description: Koiso's best friend, and the only "normal" friend of Kitano. She's very sensitive, and she's the only one to openly notice how much being friends with Kitano has changed Koiso and Shirataki.        Her name has come to one of the series' running gags, with Kuroda repeatedly calling her Koiso Ryoko's Friend #A. Her first name is first used about one-fourth into the story, and her family is not revealed until the very end of the series. The author had even thrown a contest to let the readers guess the family name (only one reader has correctly guessed what her surname is).    Wikipedia

name: Takashi Ogisu
description: Dyes his hair bright red and calls himself "the fighting master". Previously unbeaten, he is defeated repeatedly on the very day he steps in Hekikuu high, a serious blow to his self-confidence. When Ogisu first meets Kitano, Kitano mistakes his red hair for blood and runs toward him, so he ends up scared and running away. He's sure that Kuroda is Hekikuu's guardian, and that Kitano is the number 2, and Kuroda told him that he could fight him only after he beat Kitano; although Koiso makes him think that he defeated Kitano once, in the end he gets beaten up once again. After meeting Shirataki, he gets beaten up by her several times; then, out of humility, he decides to learn the secrets of the Koiso-style kobujutsu and joins the Koiso dojo. At the end of the series, he realizes that he was still a powerful fighter, but was simply overshadowed by Kitano's invincible forces.        In the end, he's the only one to respect Kuroda, and Kuroda uses him as his subordinate, hoping to use his strength to protect him whenever he's in trouble.     Wikipedia

name: Ikuno Shirataki
description: Daughter of one of the special guidance counselor, her mission was to beat up Kitano, but after being defeated by Koiso she becomes their friend. It's the very first time for her to be able to talk to people normally without anyone fearing her, even after on her first day of school she knocked out a lot of people, so behind her cold appearances she cares for everyone. That doesn't mean she isn't ready to fight everyone at any time.

name: Suda
description: President of the Hekikuu High School Student Body.

name: Satomi Ooguma
description: An eccentric girl with a crush on her younger classmate, Kanda, who she wrongly believes to be a boy.

name: Mizuki Kanda
description: A boyish girl who ends up in a relationship with her older classmate, Ooguma, who believes her to be a boy and wants her to work at a cross-dressing cafe.

description: Kanda's friend

name: Naoya Teshigawara
description: Teshigawara is the class' "mood maker".   He is usually superficial in nature. He is shown to have a sympathetic side, since he was the first one to talk to Kouichi, who was still not used to the surroundings.

name: Hiroki Dan
description:
Hiroki Dan is the main antagonist of "Trace: Kasouken Houi Kenkyuuin no Tsuisou" and the main protagonist of his spin-off "Brutal: Satsujin Keisatsukan no Kokuhaku". He is a highly ranked police investigator and a serial killer. 

Dan is part of the Investigation Division Unit 1 and the son of a former police superintendent General.
He seeks out criminals who could not be convicted by the law, and kills them. According to his own testimony during a confession in a church, he admits to doing this mainly to perform good deeds so that he can see his deceased friend again in heaven. 

He strongly tends to extremes and not only kills his victims, but makes them suffer in the most heinous ways. Dan even takes pleasure in it, so much so that he often doesn't notice that his victim has long since passed away. In the end, he photographs each of his victims and then keeps the photo in a photo album.

name: Seo-Ha Moon
description: Son of a chaebol family, who suffered from a disability and trauma after a car accident while going to an amusement park with his first love when he was 9 years old.

name: White Step
description: Despite the fact he's a human, his power is overwhelming. He is the mentor of Staz and Wolf during the training arc.

name: Goyle
description: Goyle (ゴイル部長) is the Police Chief of his division under King Wolf. He is the boss of Beros. As a member of the Acropolis police, he is in charge of maintaining peace and order. His anger, which can get somewhat out of hand, manifests into a demon creature from inside him, called "Angry" or "Spear-head of Fury", which is one of his dispensations. He is somewhat friendly with Braz.

name: Rasutisumoon
description:
**Race:** Dragon

Rasutisumoon is the daughter of Doraim and Graffaloon, who requested her to serve as a diplomat in Hiraku's village. She later takes charge of the village's diplomatic relations.

name: Krad
description:
__Class:__ Warrior

Party leader of Dragon's Roar

name: Tatsuya Himuro
description:
__Height:__ 183cm 

One of the main players of the Yosen High basketball team, Himuro was the one who introduced and taught Kagami about basketball in the United States. Originally around the same level of skill as Kagami, he has since apparently evolved to equal the members of the Generation of Miracles. Cold and perpetually collected, he is said to be willing to do anything to fulfill his objectives.  Himuro has a strong bond with Kagami, because he was in fact Kagami's first friend after Kagami moved to the States. Kagami addresses Himuro as his big brother. They also share the same ring, which they always wears on their neck as a pendant.

name: Kouichi Kawahara
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm 
__School:__ Seirin High
__Number:__ #15 
__Position:__ Center 

He is a first year small forward at Seirin High. Kawahara is just as determined to win as the other players at Seirin. Even if he's just sitting on the bench he still cheers for the team.

name: Papa Mbai Siki
description:
**School:** Shinkyo High

He is an exchange-student from Senegal and is over two meters long, towering over his teammates and opponents. Due to his extremely long build, he can block his opponents with no trouble. Due to him being an exchange student, he does not speak fluent Japanese.

name: Kousuke Wakamatsu
description:
__Height:__ 193 cm
__School:__ Touo Academy 
**Number:** #6
__Position:__ Center
__Talent:__ Rebounding

Second-year regular and center of the Touou team, Wakamatsu is easily agitated and extremely loud. Being a player of notable stature, he performs commendably on the defensive, and scoops up rebounds with relative ease. He despises Aomine and frequently expresses his distaste for the latter's lackluster attitude and special treatment within the team, both out of personal jealousy and concern for their team's longevity.

name: Alexandra Garcia
native: アレクサンドラ=ガルシア
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm

Alex was a WNBA player who had to retire because of an eye disease. Later on, she taught basketball to [Kagami](https://anilist.co/character/18770/Kagami-Taiga) and [Tatsuya](https://anilist.co/character/36977/Himuro-Tatsuya). However, Kagami went back to Japan, so Alex only finished training Tatsuya.

name: Chan Kang
description: ‘Kang Chan’! During the African war, he was called ‘God of Blackfield’, the black land’s God, by his enemies who were terrified but in awe of him. However, during a mission to kill Masallan, the brain behind SISS, the group of sunni supporters, Kang Chan was killed in action by an unknown bullet shot from behind him. As his vision got blurry, he saw his thirteen team members, who had absolute faith in him, getting killed one after another. As Kang Chan was awaiting death after being shot by a traitor, he was saved by a mysterious power and woke up 3 years later in South Korea. However, he was in the body of another ‘Kang Chan’, a 19-year-old high school boy who was being bullied at school.
