name: Erika Sakura
description: The school's popular No. 1 girl who is acknowledged by everyone. She can't stop being bothered by [Kuzumi](https://anilist.co/character/129619/Kuzumi) who she loves but won't admit because of her high pride. It may seem that she is playing around, but she is a serious innocent girl who's having a one-sided love.

appearsIn.title: Kuzumi-kun, Can't You Read the Room?

name: Kuzumi
description: A plain, dull and strange boy. He never talks and no one have ever heard his voice except his friend, [Haruna](https://anilist.co/character/169205/Chiba-Haruna). He's a weird boy who doesn't read the atmosphere at all, therefore makes [Erika](https://anilist.co/character/129620/Sakura-Erika) so frustrated. He sits at the corner of the class.

appearsIn.title: Kuzumi-kun, Can't You Read the Room?

name: Haruna Chiba
description: One of Kuzumi's only friends. Possessing an intimidating demeanor, he is often misunderstood to be a violent delinquent. In reality, he is kind, polite, and caring individual. He is ferociously loyal to Kuzumi and supports Erika's attempts to get closer to him. He has a good relationship with Yukko, being one of the few who isn't afraid of him.

appearsIn.title: Kuzumi-kun, Can't You Read the Room?

name: Narita Wakana
description: A big admirer of [Erika](https://anilist.co/character/129620/Sakura-Erika). Due to her appearance and love for books, she is often mistaken to be a libertarian assistant. Like Erika, she has a crush on [Kuzumi](https://anilist.co/character/129619/Kuzumi).

appearsIn.title: Kuzumi-kun, Can't You Read the Room?

name: Yuuko Ichikawa
description: One of Erika's close friends. Despite her calm and icy personality, she can read Erika like a book and immensely enjoys watching her antics concerning Kusumi. Yuuko often tries to keep Erika in line and pushes her to deepen her relationship with Kusumi. She has a good relationship with Haruna and harbors feeling for him.

appearsIn.title: Kuzumi-kun, Can't You Read the Room?

name: Juri Yokota
description: A always joyful and girly type character who likes gossip. She has been a friend of [Sakura](https://anilist.co/character/129620/Sakura-Erika) and [Ichikawa](https://anilist.co/character/169207/Ichikawa-Yuuko) since the first year of Highschool. She is rather slow but can be quite perceptive if it comes to her friends. She has a thing for [Misaki](https://anilist.co/character/169209/Misaki-Tooru), but would never say it out loud.

appearsIn.title: Kuzumi-kun, Can't You Read the Room?

name: Tooru Misaki
description: The school's most popular guy. He has a crush on [Erika](https://anilist.co/character/129620/Sakura-Erika) and cannot comprehend why she likes [Kuzumi](https://anilist.co/character/129619/Kuzumi). Competent and competitive, he is frustrated in his inability to beat Kuzumi in anything.

appearsIn.title: Kuzumi-kun, Can't You Read the Room?

name: Horou
description:
__Age__: Unknown (Hundreds of millions, possibly billions of years old)
__Race__: Old Deus

Horou is the Goddess of Doubt and Trust, and the creator of Ex-Machina. She was the first and therefore oldest conscious being in the world and the self-declared representative of the Old Deus, but her possession of the Race Piece has yet to be determined.

name: Ino Hatsuse
description:
A werebeast and Izuna's grandpa. He is protective of Izuna and dislikes it when she is close to Sora and Shiro. According to Miko, Hatsuse has thirty wives, much to Sora's chagrin. 

Hatsuse acts in a formal manner, being friendly around guests and officials. However, if he's around rude or condescending people, he will usually reciproctate their attitudes back. Hatsuse also is very perverted, telling many dirty jokes while not on a job. He was also banished from his tribe due to having experiences with every woman in his tribe. As he has 30 wives, he wishes for polygamy to be legal in the Eastern Union; which is one reason why he works under Miko.

name: Tilvilg Nýi
native: ニーイ・ティルヴィルグ
description: Til is a handicapped dwarf with weak magic abilities.

name: E.G. Mine
description: E.G. Mine is a violent man who wears a suit that resembles a sphere and contains control threads for deploying lethal spikes. Further manipulating these threads, Mine can hurl them towards an enemy.    from wikipedia

name: Hoppered the Gauntlet
description: Hoppered the Gauntlet is a man who wears a set of armor to cover his degenerated and vestigial legs, while using his large arms to move. The armor acts like a top and he uses a shield to propel himself at high speeds. He seeks to kill Vash to avenge a mute and blind woman detached from the world, killed during the destruction of July. During his final battle, he sees Vash's memory of July, has a revelation that he has made the wrong choice, and he is killed after turning against the Guns. The anime does not feature his backstory, and instead has him just wish to make Vash suffer. He is killed by the explosion of the energy core after jumping onto it.    from wikipedia

name: Marilyn Nebraska
description: Marilyn Nebraska appears in Trigun Vol. 2 ch. 11. She is the only Nebraska daughter and looks as pretty normal for a Nebraska kid. She has apparently no skill aside from her big mouth, which even her mother points out. She and her family was hired by Morgan to dispatch of an old couple in possession of a rather valuable parcel of land. The money would've gone to bail out her brother [Gofsef](https://anilist.co/character/296200) and her father from jail. She flees the fight when Chinpei is shot out of the air.  (Source: Trigun Wikia)

name: Midvalley the Hornfreak
description: Midvalley the Hornfreak is a violent musician who is able to use his saxophone, Sylvia, to synchronize sound waves with pain, causing physical damage. He also is capable of neutralizing sounds by playing counter-frequencies. He and his band originally just kill for money until being found by Knives, who kills all except Midvalley. He dislikes both Legato and Knives, which leads him to try to kill Legato, though he is quickly killed himself. Legato uses Midvalley's body to attack Hoppered, and it is buried with his saxophone on his gravestone afterward. He has a smaller role in the anime, mainly acting as Legato's bodygaurd until fighting Vash, and killing himself after overloading his saxophone.    from wikipedia

name: Kirara
description: Kirara is the nekomata companion of [Sango](https://anilist.co/character/1355/Sango), the youkai exterminator that hails from a mountain village of other exterminators. Kirara usually appears as a tiny and cute feline no larger than a kitten with cream-colored fur, black ears, various black markings, large red eyes, and two tails, but her true form is a large saber toothed tiger-like youkai.

name: Tsubaki
description: Tsubaki was a young miko (Shrine Maiden) in training like Kikyo when she was alive. She studied under a priest at a Shinto shrine as an apprentice and she and Kikyō were rivals, sometimes battling side-by-side to defeat yōkai, Tsubaki always attempting to better Kikyō using her own holy power. While Kikyo and Kaede were traveling the countryside to visit small villages and help slay yōkai, Tsubaki laid a curse on Kikyo, telling her that as a miko she must abandon her heart, for if she ever fell in love with a man she would lose her holy powers and suffer an untimely death answered by Kikyo's cool denial.

name: Goshinki
description: Naraku's third detachment. Goshinki has the ability to sense the thoughts of others, which enables him to outmaneuver Inuyasha and break Tessaiga by biting it. However, breaking Tessaiga caused Inuyasha to transform into his berserk yōkai state, after which Goshinki could no longer read his thoughts, and Inuyasha killed him. Sesshoumaru, realizing that Goshiki had broken Tessaiga, took his fangs and had the sword Tokijin made from them; Tokijin, filled with Goshinki's malice, is too powerful and malevolent for anyone but Sesshoumaru to handle. ("Goshinki" means "Mind Reading Devil.")

name: Ayame
description: The wolf girl who is in love with Koga. Long ago, Koga made a promise to marry her, yet he fails to fulfill his promise. She has red hair that are always in two ponytails with an iris in it, green eyes, has white wolf fur draped over her shoulders, a necklace (most likely emerald), and red-and-blue armor. She seems to be an allusion to San.  She doesn't appear in the manga.

name: Matsushima
description: Nothing is known of Matsushima's history other than she has earned honors as a veteran police officer at the Tokonosu station.    In episode 12 of the anime, Matsushima is briefly seen walking in front of the bulletin board in front of Taiei Shopping Town.

name: Asami Nakaoka
description: A young traffic enforcer, Asami is in charge of guarding the Mall and protecting the group of survivors sheltering there. She also speak in a third-person speech pattern, such as replacing "I" in her sentence with her name instead, though this is because police in Japan refer to themselves in the third person (though she has yet to master this). Easily scared and intimidated by others, Asami's authority quickly waned amongst the survivors until Kohta and Takashi intervened by handing her a standardized police firearm and building up her confidence. She developed a liking for Kohta after he helped her subdue a civilian who was about to sexually assault Shizuka. Asami later accompanies Takashi to help obtain blood plasma for a sick survivor, and is forced to mercy kill Tamaru when he is bitten by "them". Asami firmly believed that her superior officer, Matsushima, who had left for the police station for help, would come back until she is shocked and horrified to see a zombified Matushima walking towards the mall, utterly shattering her self-optimism. After running to the mall's roof while she was greatly upset, Asami was kindly praised by the same old couple that she helped in helping the old woman in having the blood transfusion, allowing her to rekindle her spirit. Asami is encouraged by Kohta into coming with him and his friends, which she gladly accepts.

name: Tetsuo Tosu
description: A salary man who writes mystery novels during his free time.

name: Kasen Tosu
description: The wife of Tetsuo Tosu

name: Battler Ushiromiya
description:
Battler is the son of [Rudolf](https://anilist.co/character/14043/Ushiromiya-Rudolf) and his first wife [Asumu](https://anilist.co/character/259608/Ushiromiya-Asumu), and is generally considered to be the main protagonist of the series. 

He is extremely stubborn, and is afraid of "shaky" transportation, fearing he might fall off a boat.  At first glance, he appears to be hotheaded, cocky, and even a little perverted. However, he has a heart of gold he isn't afraid to show when the situation calls for it.

appearsIn.title: Umineko When They Cry Episode 1: Legend of the Golden Witch
Umineko When They Cry Episode 8: Twilight of the Golden Witch
Umineko When They Cry Episode 2: Turn of the Golden Witch
Umineko When They Cry Episode 3: Banquet of the Golden Witch

name: George Ushiromiya
description: Eva and Hideyoshi's twenty-three-year-old son. He is the oldest of Kinzo's grandchildren, and an exceptional and diligent young adult. He was brought up by Eva specifically with the family headship in mind, and is also a skilled martial artist like his mother. He worked at his father's company as an apprentice throughout college, and respects his parents greatly, though he admittedly finds his mother overbearing. George is admired by everyone in his family, especially his cousins, who view him as their older brother and peacemaker. In his youth, however, he had been jealous of their more independent and impulsive lifestyles, particularly Battler, as unlike him, his mother made him do various things in his youth in order to shape him into the next head. As a result, he put up a more condescending mask towards his cousins, but has since outgrown this inferiority complex to a certain degree. He is in love with the maid Shannon and proposes to her (or at least intends to) in every game. Believing that his romance with a servant would be frowned upon by his family, however, he is fully willing and prepared to face the consequences.

appearsIn.title: Umineko When They Cry Episode 1: Legend of the Golden Witch
Umineko When They Cry Episode 2: Turn of the Golden Witch

name: Natsuhi Ushiromiya
description: Krauss' wife. Born into a family of Shinto priests, Natsuhi discarded her old life when she married into the Ushiromiya family. She is a very proud woman who holds her new family's name in high regard, and is in charge of managing the family head house and family conferences. Unfortunately for her, all of her efforts are often undervalued by her husband, and she is often afflicted by headaches. She holds a bitter rivalry with Eva, who mocks her for not being related to the Ushiromiya family by blood. As a mother, Natsuhi is incredibly strict towards her daughter Jessica, but only out of concern that she becomes an ideal heiress to the Ushiromiya family.

appearsIn.title: Umineko When They Cry Episode 1: Legend of the Golden Witch

name: Jessica Ushiromiya
description: Krauss and Natsuhi's eighteen-year-old daughter. She is an energetic young girl, serving as the student body president at her school, and even leading a rock band. If her father inherits the family fortune, she will become the heiress to the Ushiromiya family, although the family's patriarchal hierarchy denotes her future husband will become the next head. Jessica is tomboyish, feisty, and rebellious, much to the dismay of her mother, who insists she act more refined and ladylike. She dislikes her parents at times for the pressures they place on her regarding the family inheritance, which she has no interest in. However, she still shows concern for them deep down. She was born with weak bronchi, and occasionally suffers from asthma attacks.

appearsIn.title: Umineko When They Cry Episode 1: Legend of the Golden Witch
Umineko When They Cry Episode 2: Turn of the Golden Witch

name: Maria Ushiromiya
description: Maria is Rosa's daughter, and is the youngest of the cousins. She has a habit of uttering 'uu-uu' at times, which frustrates Rosa greatly. Maria is also rather stubborn, and believes things easily, which isn't uncommon for someone her age. She has an interest in the occult, like her grandfather. She carries around a bag which is filled with occult items, such as a scorpion charm which wards off evil. She idolizes witches, and believes that they are there to bring people joy and happiness. In Maria's notebooks there are sketches of witches, and the witches are beautiful, fantastical creatures. It upsets Maria greatly when someone denies the existence of witches, especially Beatrice's existence. At certain times, Maria undergoes a personality change, and begins to laugh in an unnerving fashion. When she is in this mode, she acts rather condescendingly with regards to things about the occult, and will often call people like Battler 'stupid' for having little to no knowledge of such things.

appearsIn.title: Umineko When They Cry Episode 1: Legend of the Golden Witch
Umineko When They Cry Episode 2: Turn of the Golden Witch

name: Toshiro Gouda
description: Gohda is the head cook of Kinzo's mansion. Unlike the other servants in the mansion, he has been hired by Krauss and Natsuhi. Because of this, his rank is very low. He is extremely proud of his culinary skills. His previous employ was at a hotel, and due to his experience, he is ostentatious and looks down upon Shannon and Kanon.

appearsIn.title: Umineko When They Cry Episode 1: Legend of the Golden Witch
Umineko When They Cry Episode 8: Twilight of the Golden Witch
Umineko When They Cry Episode 3: Banquet of the Golden Witch

name: Rudolf Ushiromiya
description: Kinzo's third child, and Battler's father. After his wife Asumu's death, he immediately remarried with Kyrie, leading to a falling out with his son, who ran away from home for six years. Rudolf is still known to chat up young women from time to time, though this does not seem to disturb Kyrie. He is an avid lover of Western films and an impressive marksman. He seeks Kinzo's fortune to settle a court case in America.

appearsIn.title: Umineko When They Cry Episode 1: Legend of the Golden Witch

name: Chiyo Kumasawa
description: Kumasawa is a part-time worker who assists with domestic chores in Kinzo's mansion. She often shirks her responsibilites and likes to tell stories and jokes, especially outrageous ones involving mackerel. (from wikipedia)

appearsIn.title: Umineko When They Cry Episode 1: Legend of the Golden Witch

name: Kyrie Ushiromiya
description: Rudolf's second wife. She is also one of Rudolf's business partners, always assisting him in shady dealings and keeping him in line when he gets out of hand. Kyrie and Battler have bonded more as close friends with a sibling-like relationship rather than mother and son, with Battler going as far as always calling her "Kyrie-san." She is well versed in game theory and is known for her "flip the chessboard" mentality, influencing Battler in this regard. She had actually dated Rudolf long before his first wife Asumu, who she envies for marrying Rudolf while she was still going out with him.

appearsIn.title: Umineko When They Cry Episode 1: Legend of the Golden Witch

name: Terumasa Nanjou
description: Nanjo is Kinzo's personal physician and close friend. He is also Kinzo's opponent in chess.

appearsIn.title: Umineko When They Cry Episode 1: Legend of the Golden Witch

name: Mako Wakamiya
description: Mako Wakamiya is the main female protagonist in the story, and she's known for being considered as very mature and is looked up to by her fellow classmates. She's an eager member of the Public Morals Committee, and her personality is quite timid despite her energetic behavior that is shown through the story.

name: Shinichi Honda
description: Shinichi Honda is the main male protagonist in the story, and he's known for being overly energetic and straightforward with other people, having truthfully rejected several love confessions from potential love interests. He's also a member in the school's Kendo team.

name: Dong-Tae
description:
__Rank:__ A-Rank

Dongtae is the main protagonist of DICE. He starts off as a timid kid with bottom of the barrel rankings on every aspect of his life. Whether it be looks, intelligence, height, it was like Dongtae rolled "ones" for all of his attributes. Constantly bullied and incapable of approaching his crush Eunju, Dongtae is rescued from a spiral of despair by becoming a Dicer. His main goal is to get the final dice and make a world fair for all.

name: Eun-Ju
description: Eunju is a female protagonist of the series and Dongtae's love interest. In terms of dice points, she would be a full "six". Initially depicted by Dongtae and everyone that she is the prettiest girl in the whole school, it is often overlooked that Eun-Ju never saw herself as someone special.

name: X
description:
X is the main antagonist of the series. He is a supernatural entity who controls the production and distribution of Dice and sets the quests Dicers must complete in order to gather them. He also sets and changes the rules of the game as a whole.

(Source: Dice Wiki)

name: Tae-Bin
description: Tae-Bin is the love interest of Eun-Ju. A transfer student to Dong-Tae's school and classroom, and sitting next to him, Tae-Bin is a Dicer and was initially Dong-Tae's polar opposite. He quickly became one of the most popular students in the school.

name: Mio
description: Mio is one of Dongtae's classmates that became a Dicer in the chaos that occurs at their school.

name: Mu-Yeong
description: Mu-Yeong is a Dicer and was Taebin's former mentor, and the person who gave him his first Dice. He seems to currently be the most powerful A-Ranker

name: Choe-Hyeon
description: Choe-Hyeon is a student in the protagonists' school, though one grade lower than him. He keeps his A-Ranker skill hidden until the final battle royal, though he has shown a co-operative stance towards Dong-Tae.

name: Ji-Eun
description: Ji-Eun had something embarrassing that happened to her, because of this she seeks the ultimate dice to change her past. She also hides her face with a mask due to the events of her past.

name: Seok-Sun Jeong
description: Seok-Sun Jeong is a student of First Private High and also an A-rank Dicer. He's dating Na-Ni Kim.

name: Na-Ni Kim
description: Na-Ni Kim is a student of First Private High and also a Dicer. She isn't able to attend school, because of her illness. She's also dating a fellow classmate, Seok-Sun Jeong.

name: Kuranosuke Koibuchi
description: Kuranosuke is the son of a rich political family. He uses the alias "Kurako" in front of the other Amars to hide his gender. He enjoys cross-dressing, to the chagrin of his family.   Unlike the rest of his family, he does not find politics interesting at all and desires to get into fashion. He is constantly looking for the address of his mother, who gave birth to him after having an affair with his father, hoping to see at least once more the wardrobe she kept with so much passion.   After meeting Tsukimi, helping her rescue Clara, he constantly starts paying her visits, finding her more interesting than anything else in his life. Throughout his life he has always been popular with pretty girls and thus, he almost cannot believe it when he starts realizing he may have feelings for Tsukimi.

name: Tsukimi Kurashita
description: Tsukimi is an otaku girl who lives in Tokyo and wants to be an illustrator. Influenced by her late mother, she has a love for all kinds of jellyfish and is quite knowledgeable about them. She is the only resident of Amamizukan who knows Kuranosuke's true gender. Like the other Amars, she has a fear of stylish people and will usually petrify in their presence. Tsukimi has a pet spotted jellyfish named Clara.   Whenever she gets a make-over from Kuranosuke she becomes beautiful and Shū falls for her. She reciprocates Shū's feelings but she is led to think that he is in love with another person. She grows to be very comfortable around Kuranosuke when he is cross-dressing to the point she nearly forgets his actual gender, but conversely she gets very nervous whenever he is in his normal "boy" state in front of her.

name: Jiji
description: Jiji is one of the Amars who is obsessed with mature, old men.   (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Keiichirou Koibuchi
description: Shuu and Kuranosuke's father, whose delivery is nearly always deadpan.

name: Shuu Koibuchi
description: Shuu is Kuranosuke's half-brother and a personal assistant to their father. Due to catching his father cheating with Kuranosuke's mother at a young age, he has a phobia of women. However, after first seeing Tsukimi all dressed up, he starts becoming attracted to her, though he cannot recognize her whenever she wears her normal clothes.

name: Chieko
description: Chieko is one of the Amars who is the the manager of Amamizukan. She is obsessed with dressing in traditional Japanese clothes, such as in a kimono, and collects traditional Japanese dolls. Her mother is the owner of the building, but is rarely present as she is a groupie of Bae Yong Joon.

name: Clara
description: Tsukimi's pet jellyfish, who sometimes goes into "explanation mode".

name: Banba
description: Banba is one of the Amars who is obsessed with all kinds of trains. Her 'afro' hair is actually a natural perm.   (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Mayaya
description: Mayaya is one of the Amars who is obsessed with Records of Three Kingdoms.

name: Kana Nakamura
description: A science teacher. She is interested in finding out more information about Nano and Hakase.

name: Manabu Takasaki
description: Yukko, Mai, and Mio's teacher. Has a crush on Sakurai-sensei but always fails trying to make a move on her.

name: Tamamura
description: She works at a coffee shop.

name: Kousuke Oura
description: He is a Vice Principal of Tokisadame HIgh School.

description: **Fetish:** Backs

description: **Fetish:** Hair, Washing Hair

description: Second-year high school girl with a smells fetish.

description: Fetish: Short Height

description: Fetish: Hair

description: **Fetish:** Hands

description: __Fetish:__ Legs

description: **Fetish:** Sound, Voices

name: Mitsuki Yoshiwara
description: Tatsu Yunoki's co-worker and superior.

name: Kotoha Hatsushima
description: Kotoka's mother.

name: Ihwa
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm 
__Affiliation:__ Nameless

Ihwa is the main protagonist and tritagonist of the aptly named webcomic series, Hero Killer. 
After her sister Yeon was killed by corrupt heroes, Ihwa sets out to avenge her by killing as many heroes as possible. She would join the villain organization known as the Nameless and works with [Engen](https://anilist.co/character/252729/Engen), the Smiling Man and legendary villain as they work together to destroy the Hero Clan.

Ihwa's gift is the ability to steal, borrow, and absorb the Gift of another Gift user. She has two categories of her powers - temporary and permanent. The temporary 'borrowed' gifts she gains from contact with the gift user and can be used for a limited amount of time any time after obtaining them. She can use these gifts simultaneously with other gifts. Permanent gifts are obtained whenever Ihwa kills the user, she must be directly responsible for their death. She can then use the gifts for an unlimited amount of time, but only within the limits of her EST, and only one at a time. She must also understand how to use the gifts by observing the original user. Ihwa's power has grown stronger per use, and the duration of these abilities has also increased.

name: Engen
description:
__Height:__ 189 cm 
__Affiliation:__ Nameless

Engen, also known as the Smiling Man, is the deuteragonist of Hero Killer.

He is the leader of the villain organization known as the Nameless who was once a central figure of the major conflicts from the previous era that fought in both the War of Inheritance as an heir to the throne of Nera and as its second king during the Great War, afterward he went into hiding and somewhere along the way saved [Rachel Sinclair](https://anilist.co/character/308061/Rachel-Sinclair) and organized the survivors of the war. While not all of his motives are clear, he wishes to defeat The Iron Witch, the mysterious woman who gave him his iconic scar, and destroy the Hero Clan.

Engen is a stoic, calm, and collected man at nearly all times, which shows an aura of mystery. However, Rachel says that this is just a front and he's quite crazy, which he used to be more open about in his youth, although it still surfaces from time to time. According to [Chain](https://anilist.co/character/328674/Chain), Engen has always had a creepier side to his personality even in his youth, but he has become more twisted as time passed.

A first-class villain, Engen is incredibly ruthless as he won't hesitate to kill his opponents and isn't against harming a great number of bystanders when necessary.

name: Bishop
description:
__Affiliation:__ Hero Clan 

Padrius Encilion, or more commonly known as Bishop, is one of the Elders, the nine strongest individuals in the world and a powerful hero currently affiliated with the Hero Clan. He is the ruler of District 16: Cloud Garden.

Bishop on the outside is a polite, positive man, especially around guests or in public. In the past and his younger days, he used to openly display it with a sinister looking demeanor. Aside from that Bishop has shown himself to be quite wise and pragmatic.

name: Yushin
description:
Yushin, also known as the Ghost of Dust City, is an infamous Villain and extremely powerful swordsman who was once a member of the Elders, the nine strongest Gift users in the world but lost his position after being defeated at the hands of a young swordsman known as the Skysword in a one-on-one duel. He is Hero Killer's former teacher and caretaker that fostered her after her older sister Yeon's death.

Yushin is a very quiet man that speaks in a formal manner. However, in his youth, he was known to be wilder and acted in a more aggressive attitude with scenes of him radiating an air of potent bloodlust while smiling/smirking with a sadistic look on his face even during heights of danger.

name: Victoria
description:
__Affiliation:__ Hero Clan 

She is one of the Elders, the nine strongest individuals in the world and the poster child of the Hero Clan as the strongest hero.

Victoria has a rather laid-back attitude due to her immerse power and how typically easy it is for her to win fights. Like most characters in the series and as an Elder, she has little to no value of human life and is brutally sadistic whenever she feels like it.

name: Ijincheon
description: Ijincheon, also known as the Sword Hunter, is the Executioner of the Silver Forest of the Four Swordsmen and a former disciple of the first late Executioner, as his youngest pupil. He was once known by the nickname of "The Incompetent One" due to his nonexistent abilities with the sword and being the weakest one of the Executioner's students, but he never once gave up on his dream of becoming a strong swordsman.

name: Baekji
description:
__Height:__ 162 cm 
__Affiliation:__ Nameless

Baekji is a member of the Nameless as the group's information gatherer and tactician.

Unlike other Nameless members who have a slightly soft side, her tendencies are biased towards evil.

name: Raxfer Sinclair
description:
__Affiliation:__ Hero Clan

Raxfer Sinclair is the son of the Elder, Reagan Sinclair and one of only 3 of his children that have been recognized by his father.

Raxfer is seen as a polite and friendly man when meeting new people or talking with other fellow heroes. However, upon seeing unapproved actions or villains, he attains a menacing aura and twitches his hands while standing silently. He can stay surprisingly calm even when a knife was being held against his throat.

name: Sharpshooter
description:
__Affiliation:__ Hero Clan 

Kirine, also known by her codename Sharpshooter, is a member of the Hero Clan and the former disciple of Chaos.

name: Rachel Sinclair
description:
Rachel is an upbeat, energetic and friendly member of the Nameless.

She always seems to be happy and carefree even in dangerous situations. She has the ability to control plants and create them from the surfaces near her.

Abilities:

name: Clementine
description:
__Race:__ Human 
__Affiliation:__
- Slane Theocracy (Former)
- Black Scripture (Former)
- Zurrernorn

__Family:__ Quaiesse Hazeia Quintia (Brother)
__Occupation:__ Warrior 

Clementine was a sadistic psychopath, obsessed with inflicting pain and torture on others. As a former member of the Black Scripture, Clementine was extremely confident in her abilities. She would go so far as to declare herself unbeatable until her unfortunate encounter with Ainz, who proved to be much more powerful than her. Before Clementine went rogue, she once held the position of 9th Seat in the Black Scripture. Besides betraying the Scripture, she also stole the magical Crown of Wisdom from one of the Six Miko Princesses of the Theocracy. Because of that, she has chosen to flee from her homeland and join Zurrernorn for protection.

name: Kanade Toramaru
description: The top delinquent in the school, who's also in love with protagonist, Unoki.

I Belong to the Baddest Girl at School

description: Fuyuhiko's mother.

appearsIn.title: I Belong to the Baddest Girl at School

appearsIn.title: I Belong to the Baddest Girl at School

name: Tzuka
description: A girl Toramaru often fights with

appearsIn.title: I Belong to the Baddest Girl at School

name: Toramaru no Haha
description: Kanade's mother.

appearsIn.title: I Belong to the Baddest Girl at School

name: Anpu
description:
Anpu shows up a couple of times and is also part of the “everyone else loves me so why doesn’t Saiki” brigade. After being saved by Kusuo, he starts to visit his house to make Kusuo pet him. He once got Kusuo (disguised as Sai) to aid him in trying to woo a female cat Pushi. Later on, Kusuo pets him after Anpu saved him from a chasing cockroach.

(Source: Saiki Kusuo no Psi Nan Wikia)

name: Metori Saiko
description: Metori Saiko is the scion of the top-notch Saiko Conglomerate. He later transfers to PK Academy after falling in love with [Kokomi](https://anilist.co/character/90109/Teruhashi-Kokomi) when he was in the city. His defining traits are being rich and smug.

name: Riki Takeuchi
description: Riki Nendo's deceased father.

name: Kazuya Ikemi
description: He was first introduced as Michael (Mr. Ike) by Uryoku when Kusuo runs into them performing a street show. After failing their act, Ike wasn't given the money he was promised because they didn't earn anything from passersby. He continued to be Uryoku's assistant afterwards.

name: Un-Hwi So
description: He is the third son of Ikyang Soga.

name: Red
description:
Red is very much the quintessential hero; brave, kind, and outgoing. He is capable of feats of agility, and is always willing to help others, with or without the help of his Pokémon.

Red is an exceptional Pokémon battler, able to utilize his Pokémon's moves and natural talents in unique ways.

Red is sometimes slow to pick up on sensitive matters. He is the last of the original seven Pokédex holders to learn of Yellow's true gender identity.

name: Green Okido
description:
Green has a serious, calm, and focused personality in everything he does. Although Red and Green were once bothered by each other because their personalities are so opposite, they ended up resolving their differences.

Green and his Strike were trained by Shijima of Tanba City when he was a child. Thus, Green has some cursory knowledge of martial arts, and his Strike knew Generation II techniques.

name: Blue
description:
__Current Team:__ 

Blue is a sneaky, cunning, intelligent, but also very kind trainer. She often uses her looks to her advantage, but is also a very skilled battler. At the start of her journey, she stole a Squirtle from Professor Oak, and encounters Red and Green many times as she travels Kanto in the RGB chapter.

name: Yellow
description: Yellow was first introduced into the series in chapter 42 where she begins her role as the main character until chapter 90 when Gold takes the spotlight.  Yellow was born in Viridian Forest and her birthday is on the March 3. When first introduced in the series, she was 14 years old.  Yellow has a carefree personality and doesn't like to battle since she doesn't like to hurt other Pokemon. She chooses not to evolve her Pokemon, which are Rattata, Caterpie, Doduo, Omanyte, and Graveler. She also partners up with Pikachu for most of the time she is the main character.  Yellow, being born in the Viridian Forest, possess a skill to heal and communicate with Pokemon. Thus, Yellow was acknowledged by Professor Oak as "the healer" and was given a Pokedex.

name: Gold
description:
Gold grew up in a home full of baby Pokémon. His neighbors in Wakaba Town refer to his family as the "Poké House". He usually wears a pair of goggles and travels on a scooter. Instead of throwing/kicking his Poké Balls, he uses a billiard cue to shoot them out, allowing for tactical maneuvers and deployments of his Pokémon. Gold's hobbies include gambling, skateboarding, and trying foods from different cities. His favorite idol/DJ is [Kurumi](https://anilist.co/character/34132/Kurumi) from the Kogane Radio Station.

[Dr. Yukinari Okido](https://anilist.co/character/17783/Ookido-Yukinari) noted that Gold is even more reckless and stubborn than [Red](https://anilist.co/character/7035/Red). He likes playing billiards, but sometimes he may use his Pokémon to cheat. Gold's mother has described him as "careless". Gold also tends to lie or exaggerate at times, in a bid to make himself seem more impressive, and other people around him notice it. He also seems to exhibit a one-track mind at times, being an ardent fan of pretty girls like Kurumi, [Mikan](https://anilist.co/character/18908/Mikan) and the Kimono Girls, but failing to recognize [Matsuba](https://anilist.co/character/31689/Matsuba) or the Johto Elite Four.

Despite his negative traits, Gold is also noted for his moments of ingenuity, formulating plans and executing them spontaneously while appearing to slack off.

name: Silver
description: As a child, Silver was kidnapped by the Masked Man along with several other children. There, he met and befriended a young girl named Blue. After spending several years being trained by the Masked Man, Blue led an operation for her and Silver to escape the Masked Man when his guard was down. After successfully managing to run away, the two began to work together to put an end to the Masked Man's ambitions.

name: Crystal
description:
Crystal is an expert in capturing Pokémon, a skill she developed when she was young. After an accident during her childhood that left her arms broken, Crystal learned to kick Poké Balls with her feet. Although by now her arms have been completely healed, Crystal has retained the habit of kicking her Poké Balls instead of throwing them.

Crystal is very dedicated to her task of completing the Pokédex and has faith in her Pokémon and their ability to help her. Though she can be insecure about herself when she fails, with encouragement she is able to pick herself back up and restore her confidence in herself.

name: Ruby
description:
Ruby has a great passion for Pokémon Contests. While he's an excellent battler, he only fights when necessary or when no one takes notice. He believes that Pokémon battles are barbaric, and get his Pokémon dirty — something that he does not like.

Ruby is skilled at sewing and knitting. He makes clothes for all his Pokémon to wear, and even made [Sapphire](https://anilist.co/character/12530/Odamaki-Sapphire) the clothes she wears for much of her adventures. He is nearsighted, and he has a pair of glasses to correct this, though he was originally too vain when it came to wearing them often. His other hobby is photography. He has a photo album of all of his Pokémon's biggest moments — such as evolutions or Pokémon Contest victories.

Besides necessities, Ruby also has a "Makeup Box" and "Sewing Box" in his backpack, for his Contest appearances. Ruby has a pair of Running Shoes made by the Devon Corporation which he received from his father for his eleventh birthday. They are extremely powerful and useful, and propel Ruby along the ground with bursts of compressed air.

As part of his training, Ruby is able to discern a Pokémon's nature in a few seconds. This has helped him to distract enemy Pokémon by using the target's favorite flavor of Pokéblock.

name: Sapphire Odamaki
native: オダマキ・サファイア
description: Sapphire is a Pokémon Trainer and the daughter of Dr. Odamaki. She often assists her father with his fieldwork and years of doing so have given her various skills such as heightened physical strength and senses. Due to constantly being surrounded by nature, she has come to dislike the idea of beautifying Pokémon instead of leaving them in their natural state.

name: Emerald
description:
Emerald is a Pokémon Trainer born somewhere in the Hoenn region. Due to the loss of his parents at a young age, he was moved between his family members and was constantly bullied by his cousins due to his short height and tendency to rely on the help of Pokémon to get objects from high places. These events led to Emerald developing a complex about his height and a dislike of Pokémon. To get over his height issues, he used hair gel to style his hair upwards and wore various gadgets and clothing to make himself look taller than he actually is.

The constant moving from family member to family member led to Emerald developing the ability to determine a Pokémon's birthplace. If a Pokémon goes on a rampage, Emerald can calm it by surrounding the Pokémon with a "seal" of soil from its birthplace. The Pokémon is then calmed by a sense of nostalgia.

Emerald claims to not like Pokémon themselves, but he likes Pokémon battles. As he does not train his own Pokémon, he borrows the Pokémon he uses from Crystal. Despite these claims, he is very close to Latios and Latias, who call him "Em".

name: Hiyori Shiina
description:
Hiyori Shiina is one of the students of Class 1-C who is a loner.

She's a quiet girl, though sometimes she is seen occasionally smiling. She always carries books with her in her bag in case she meets someone who shares the same interest in literature as her. Since nobody in class 1-C is into literature, she doesn't have anyone to talk to. She always speaks politely. She dislikes how the classes are competing with each other, wanting everyone to be friends.

name: Mako Amikura
description: Mako Amikura is one of the students of Ichinose’s class.

name: Ryuuji Kanzaki
description:
__Height:__ 174 cm (5'8½")

Apart of Class 1-B and Honami Ichinose's right hand man. Not much is known about Ryūji, but he appears to be a diligent student who behaves seriously and he is a very helpful person as shown when he aided Honami Ichinose in the case of Ken Sudō. He is a friendly person as he does not look down on D-Class and gets along with them.

name: Hwa-Jin Na
description: He works in the Ministry of Education.

name: Han-Rim Im
description: Han-Rim works in the Ministry of Education. She is of relatively short stature, with dyed red hair, and is extremely skilled at martial arts.

name: Youzou Ooba
description: Plagued by a maddening anxiety, the terrible disconnect between his own concept of happiness and the joy of the rest of the world, Yozo Oba plays the clown in his dissolute life, holding up a mask for those around him as he spirals ever downward, locked arm-in-arm with death.

name: Jirou Azuma
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm

A peculiar high school student that has basic training as a ninja and the unfound ability to speak to animals. Jirou Azuma, the grandson of [Toshimasa Azuma](https://anilist.co/character/146845/Azuma-Toshimasa), is a cocky kid with a heart for animals. Should Jirou find an animal being bothered or in need of help, he will rush over and fight the people causing trouble. Eventually, he meets a wounded [Ragou](https://anilist.co/character/137545/Ragou) and brings him in to help him recover. The two butt heads a bit though Jirou does care for him. Upon a near death experience, Ragou fuses with Jirou to save him, creating an unheard of event between both mononoke and humans.

Though Jirou is quite cocky at times, he is oddly clever sometimes. He is definitely not the smartest fighter, but he may occasionally purposely take damage to defeat someone else. In general, he tries his best when fighting, even if he can't control his own abilities and ends up getting clobbered.  After fusing with Ragou, Jirou gets an immense power up and is able to use Ragou's power.

When Jirou and Ragou are fused, they become a human mononoke hybrid. Though Jirou cannot directly use Ragou's power himself, Ragou can work with Jirou and augment him with his immense power. The two bug each other, though they also care a lot for the other.

name: Ragou
description:
__Height:__ 32 cm

The Black Sun, a legendary mononoke that has lived for over a millennia, renowned for raw power beyond any other: Ragou. Taking the form of an adorable pure black cat, Ragou may seem to not be much, though he very much is. Contained within that ball of fluff is power that exceeds any other mononoke could ever dream of having. Mononoke chase after Ragou to have his power or to join forces with him, though he wants no part of it. After being randomly set free from a sealing stone, Ragou ran away and ended up being found by [Jirou Azuma](https://anilist.co/character/137304/Azuma-Jirou). Jirou noticed an injured Ragou and took him in, with the two later fusing together to save Jirou's life.

Though Ragou, with his immense power, may seem like he'd love to use it and would rule over others, that is not the case. In general, he'd just like to live on his own without anyone wanting to use him for his power. Upon meeting Jirou, Ragou begins to rethink his mindset and opens up to people more, no longer preferring isolation. With Jirou, the two make snarky remarks back and forth, but at the end of the day, they care for each other.

name: Reiji Kirihara
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm

The youngest son of the once well renowned Kirihara Family: Reiji Kirihara. Once training to be a swordsman with his twin brother, Shinji, under their father's teachings. Now, among a family in ruin, Reiji stands out on top, working as an Onmitsu for the Bureau.

Compared to other members of the Black Torch elite squad, Reiji presents himself to be much more calm and collected, rarely letting other emotions get the best of him. Similar to Ichika Kishimojin, Reiji has a distaste for Ragou and Jirou Azuma at first, though they get closer over time. Though Reiji seems to be somewhat of a gentleman, he is easily excited and flirty towards women.

name: Ichika Kishimojin
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm

A promising shinobi from a peculiar bloodline known as the Kishimojin Family: Ichika Kishimojin. Having a heart of justice and a burning aggression towards mononoke, Ichika is a perfect member for the Bureau.    Though she can act as a spy for the Bureau, she is more than capable of combating against a mononoke. 

Initially, Ichika may come off as cold and harsh to others, especially mononoke, though she will warm up to others overtime. When she first meets [Jirou Azuma](https://anilist.co/character/137304/Azuma-Jirou), she doesn't like him for his fused mononoke state with [Ragou](https://anilist.co/character/137545/Ragou). Later, the three form a friendly bond.

name: Monjumaru
description: An eerie looking mononoke outfitted like a beast that resides in Avidya Forest. Wielding a large scythe, Monjumaru exudes a frightening aura to unwelcome persons. Though he gives off such an aura, he isn't actually that bad. He simply protects the forest with Ibuki, his wife. The two are lovey dovey and have been for 200 years.

name: Takeru Inui
description:
A member of Black Cloak, one of the Bureau's elite squads. Takeru gives off the vibe of a delinquent, though he is very much the opposite of one, being responsible and a pretty serious guy. With his partner, Banri Himezuka, he is often pushed around by her and gets told off for his antics. 

Takeru cares for his family deeply, and has had several combat related jobs prior to being in the Bureau to support them. All of his earnings get sent to his mother and three younger sisters. Even though he is resilient and seemingly only caring about combat, he does have hobbies that wouldn't be expected, such as cooking and tending his kitchen garden.

name: Touko Kusumi
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm

The chief of special operations division 1. Touko sports a somewhat harsh personality.

name: Banjuurou Tokieda
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm

A gentleman that acts as Touko Kusumi's lieutenant. Banjuurou is, as expected, a kind gentleman that protects Touko. Though he usually acts as a chauffeur, he is easily capable of participating in combat. As a chauffeur, he usually transports Touko around, though he'll deliver others as ordered. Banjuurou has worked as an assassin and spy for many years, until he wound up working for the Bureau.

name: Ryousuke Shiba
description:
__Height:__ 183 cm

Ryousuke is the Chief of Special Operations Division 2 in the Bureau of Espionage. He is the founder of the special operations espionage squad, Black Torch.

name: Banri Himezuka
description:
A member of Black Cloak, one of Bureau's elite squads. Banri, partnered with Takeru Inui, often follow Touko Kusumi as bodyguards. Despite her small stature, Banri is a very capable bodyguard that can rival some mononoke. As a kid, she had gained an attraction to martial arts because of an action movie and began to train in order to become strong like the characters in the movie. 

With Banri's partner, Takeru, the two are a formidable duo. Though they get along in combat, she gives him tough love daily, often kicking him for things she finds annoying about him. The two also go out to a bar together, though it's always after Banri is rejected by Touko. When this happens, Banri ends up dragging him there and drinks heavily, becoming a crying drunk mess or lectures him harder.

name: Rita
description:
__Height:__ 156 cm

Rita is a former assassin who currently works at the Kindergarten Noir under [Erina](https://anilist.co/character/293693/Winkler-Erina)'s orders. She is the teacher of the dandelion class along with [Doug](https://anilist.co/character/289106/Doug) and [Hana](https://anilist.co/character/293694/Hana-Bradley).

Rita is known for her friendly and approachable nature, especially when it comes to interacting with the children at the Kindergarten Noir. She is physically strong, which allows her to easily participate in any play activities the kids want to engage in, making her adaptable to various physical games. While she may appear confident in handling tantrums from the children, there are moments when she becomes anxious and unsure of how to handle them. In the past, she held a grudge against Doug for his boastful nature and occasional teasing.

name: Doug
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm

Doug is a former swindler and a known womanizer. He spent his life scamming people until he was hired by [Erina](https://anilist.co/character/293693/Winkler-Erina) to work at Kindergarten Noir. He is the teacher of the dandelion class along with [Rita](https://anilist.co/character/289105/Rita) and [Hana](https://anilist.co/character/293694/Bradley-Hana).

Doug grew up alone and abandoned, having to fend for himself and live through tough times. As a result, he developed a strong defense mechanism that made him self-reliant and determined to do whatever it takes to survive without relying on others. Despite his challenging past, Doug has a playful and teasing side to his personality. He's known for his swindling abilities, which landed him a 20-year sentence, and is now serving at Kindergarten Noir for over a year, which is a stark contrast to the life he have endured during his formative years.

name: Hana Bradley
description:
__Height:__ 153 cm

She is a bomb expert and former assassin associated with her family. She is currently a kindergarten teacher and in charge of the dandelion class with [Rita](https://anilist.co/character/289105/Rita) and [Doug](https://anilist.co/character/289106/Doug).

name: Luke Smith
description:
__Height:__ 191 cm

Luke is a former UK cop who works as a kindergarten teacher at Kindergarten Noir, in charge of the chrysanthemum class with Silvia.

Luke is a serious person and although he may seem cold and distant, he is actually a collaborative person and a good leader, he is one of the strongest recruits in kindergarten. Luke often treats others coldly by saying hurtful things about them. Luke is a lover of shojo manga since he is always seen reading one and most love advice comes from shojo manga, having this love for romance he tends to try to make Doug and Rita's romance take his time even if he has to force them.

name: Silvia Scott
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm

She is a former smuggler who currently works in Kindergarten Noir in charge of the chrysanthemum class with [Luke](https://anilist.co/character/310037/Smith-Luke) and [Yoshiteru](https://anilist.co/character/334879/Ikeda-Yoshiteru).

name: Una Mauri
description:
__Height:__ 138 cm

She is a kindergarten teacher in Kindergarten Noir in charge of the violet class with [Mack](https://anilist.co/character/330828/Freeman-Mack). She is considered the strongest recruit in kindergarten.

name: Natsuki Inomoto
description: Aside from managing his family's goldfish shop alongside his brother, Natsuki is one of the many assassins that operate in Asakusa.

name: Koinzell
description: Koinzell is a new name taken by one of the falsely-labeled Lances of Betrayal, Ascheriit. Back in his youth he was an orphan who was accepted as a student in Ms. Gleaa's school of swordsmanship, where he accomplished such feats, especially the learning of the infamous Black Wing sword technique, that made him the new heir of the title of Blade Master, an ancient honour for those deemed true master swordsmen. He then became one of the fourteen youths chosen to carry the Emperor's spears and end the war with Wischtech, and was also one of the four to accomplish their mission, only to be betrayed and brutally murdered by their fellow companions, those who became known as the Seven Heroes. After having his left eye gouged out by Glenn, his best friend, and his body minced to pieces, he was left for dead but managed to survive by feeding on a fairy, which regenerated him at the expense of mixing his human blood with that of the faeries, thus giving him the appearance of a feminine child with pale hair and skin and red eyes. Koinzell is regarded as one of the best fighters in the series, due to not only to his swordsmanship, which include the fabled Black Wing, but also because he can create massive black chainswords from his right wrist. He is shown to be usually cold, and very brutal and ruthless when hunting down those who betrayed him, but can also be very caring, often putting himself at risk for others.

name: Ato Kusharundo
native: アト・クシャールンド
description: Ato is the third princess of the Kusharundo clan. She looks up to her brother, Kurato, and by dressing up as a boy, she could fight alongside him. After she witness Koinzell kill her brother, she couldn't accept the fact that he died and sought revenge for Kurato. She wore "The Black Dress of Vengeance" to seek revenge and tried to kill Koinzell, but eventually, she realized that Koinzell helped put Kurato out of his suffering and joined him on his quest.     Her arsenal of weapons include a long Dual Bladed sword and various Magical Talismans.

name: Peepi
description: Peepi is a young elf girl whose village, Miruel Mirael, is slaughtered. She attempts to escape by smuggling herself to another area, though she is caught, and saved by Köinzell. Though she has the choice to join another village, she decides to stay with Köinzell. Her real name has yet to be revealed.

name: Altea
description: Altea is a smuggler who runs a tavern under. She acts tough around the patrons, though it is really just to hide her weak personality. She is a close friend of Vid, who introduces Köinzell to her. She agrees to smuggle them after Köinzell agrees to have sex with her, though the smuggling plan soon falls short. Her business is destroyed, and she decides to travel with Köinzell, especially because he reminds her of a close friend.

name: Ikfes
description: A slave knight serving under Glenn, his swordsmanship is almost on the same level as Koinzell. He's been studying under Ms. Gleaa for 5 years and was told if he killed the Hero Slayer, he'd regain his title as Imperial Royalty. He wants to defeat Koinzell and the 'Black Wing' technique in a fair fight, so as to strengthen his own skill.

name: Elseria Rahnclave
native: エルサリア・ランクレーブ
description: The daughter of the Imperial Elector, Aleczalt Rahnclave, and a knight of the Seven Lances. She first meets the main character, Koinzell, at the town of Jullas Abllas. It is also there that her view of the once traitor and enemy to the empire changes into something more. The Rhanclave family is one of the eight families that have the power to elect a succeeding emperor. It is also said that the Rhanclave family is over 1000 years old and specializes in fighting. She also has a strong sense of justice as her reason for joining the Seven Lances was only to protect the people and the emperor.

name: Shouichi Kosakai
description: One of Moguo's henchmen.

name: Shizuka Saeki
description: She's the roommate of Nana in the headquarters of the management camp. She asks Nana to follow two rules. The first one is that she has to use the bottom bunk. The second one is that she can't cause any fights because she will also be held responsible.

name: Souta Saitou
description: One of Moguo's henchmen.

name: Hikaru Daichi
description: His ability is gravity manipulation.

name: Yuuka Sasaki
description:
__Talent:__ Super Strength. Disabled when her animal allergies act up.

Close friends with Shinji Kazama.

name: Kayena Hill
description: Kayena Hill is the first princess of the Eldyme Empire. She is the most beautiful woman in the Eldyme Empire, and is often praised for her beauty. Her beauty is such that it puts famous paintings to shame.

name: Raffaello Kidrey
description:
Raffaello Kidrey is the heir of the Kidrey Dukedom. He is one of the most handsome men and highly sought after bachelor in the Eldyme Empire along with Regef. 

At first glance, Raffaello can come off as a cold, powerful, and stern knight which adds up to his masculine charm, but deep down he's a warm and kind person who cares about others. Since he was a powerful military warrior ever since his youth, he's skilled at swordsmanship, combat, and strategic thinking. Since he survived in the battlefield for many years and came out victorious, he's presumed to be a great tactician with high intellect.

name: Henberton Gillian
description:
Henberton Gillian is the eldest son of Viscount Gillian.

He is obsessed with collecting beautiful things, and thus has a mad obsession with Kayena Hill who he believes is the most beautiful "thing" he has ever seen which will be a fine addition to his collection.

name: Regef Hill
description: Regef Hill is the first prince of Eldyme Empire who aims to become the next Emperor. In contrast to his angelic demeanor and handsome face, he's a person whose cruel disposition is unmatched.

name: Julia Evans
description: Julia Evans is the famous daughter of the Evans Family. She is often called the most beautiful woman in the east.

name: Susan Lepore
description: Susan Lepore is the second daughter of Count Lepore. She is known as the viper with a sword in her mouth. She is smart and has a lot of talent, but she easily writes people off as insignificant. She does not mince her words, so she is not very popular in the social world.

name: Ethel Lindbergh
description: Ethel Lindbergh is the illegitimate son of Emperor Esteban.

name: Vera Lexton
description: Vera Lexton is a court lady and Kayena Hill's first lady-in-waiting. She is quite perceptive and sensible, and is a very ambitious person who works hard to achieve her goal.

name: Olivia Grace
description: Olivia Grace is the eldest child of Viscount Grace. She is clever, observant, loyal, and considerate, but she’s also self-reliant, brave, and strong.

name: Jannon Evans
description: Jannon Evans is the eldest son of Marquis Evans and heir to the Evans marquisate. He is calculative and strategic. However, he is also very arrogant. Jannon is Prince Regef Hill’s lieutenant and one of the key figures of the Imperial Prince’s faction.

name: Nanoka Koyanagi
description: Nanoka is an eccentric girl that always says the truth with a very direct way of talking. She is also smarter than other kids her age. She has a different way of looking at various things in the world because of her love for reading books.

appearsIn.title: I Had That Same Dream Again

name: Abazure
description: A cheerful young lady whom Nanoka meets while she was trying to save a cat. She addresses Nanoka as 'Young Lady' or 'Young Miss'.

appearsIn.title: I Had That Same Dream Again

name: Minami
description: A gloomy high school student Nanoka found at the roof of an abandoned building trying to commit suicide. She likes writing stories in her notebook. 'Minami' is actually the name of her school.

appearsIn.title: I Had That Same Dream Again

name: Hiroto Ikuta
description: A freeter. He works part-time at a fishing place. He has no girlfriend, but old ladies seem to really like him.

name: Natsumi Kobayashi
description: An art student at a university in Tokyo. She lives with her cousin [Hiroto](https://anilist.co/character/253838/).

name: Akari Yokoyama
description: [Natsumi](https://anilist.co/character/253841/)'s friend and a student at the same department as her. She was born in Fukuoka, and just like Natsumi, she was unable to make any friends after entering university.

name: Yomogi Tachibana
description: She works in real estate and is annoyed by [Hiroto](https://anilist.co/character/253838/)'s carefree attitude.

name: Hanae Wada
description: An eccentric but kind old woman with gray hair and glasses. She met [Hiroto](https://anilist.co/character/253838/) by chance and started having dinner together every Monday and Thursday. After her death, she gave Hiroto the house she had been living in.

name: Hideki Noguchi
description: A friend of [Hiroto](https://anilist.co/character/253838/)'s since high school who runs a furniture store. He has been married for one year and is about to become a father.

name: Ho-Yeol Lee
description:
__Level:__ 55 (at start of series)
__Class:__ Demon Hunter
__Background:__ Successor of a great family
__Affiliation:__ Mage's Tower

The last surviving Demon Hunter in the world after the Arkshan Base was destroyed.

Lee Ho-Yeol awakens as his Arcana character "Granfel Claudi Arpheus Romeo" who he created at the height of his cringelord phase in the second year of middle school. After assimilating with his character, he struggles to control Grandfel's aristocratic personality and behavior. Because of this, Ho-Yeol's true self is sometimes depicted as a separate entity attached to his physical body like a ghost.

name: Kousuke Kanzaki
description: A high school calligrapher. He idolizes Seishuu and started calligraphy professionally after seeing an exhibition of his. He got the first prize in a calligraphy competition.

name: Iwao Yamamura
description: Yamamura is a very proud man he loves fishing and/or anything sea related, and himself. He seems to have a god complex, during episode four he makes Seishuu Handa write his boat name as"Yuigadokuson-Maru" meaning "I am Holy" or "I am God". Miwa Yamamura tells Seishuu that her father doesn't tolerate failure and is very frightening when he is angered.

name: Kanchou
description: The director of art exhibitions.

name: Yumi Oomura
description: Yumi Omura is a girl who works at the Japanese pub, My Pleasure, alongside Hideki. She is the daughter of the club's owner. It is initially implied that Yumi was interested in a relationship with Hideki, but as the series progresses it is revealed that she initially approached him because he also worked at Club Pleasure, and that she thinks of him as a big brother. Throughout most of the series Yumi has an inferiority complex toward persocoms, and becomes upset at any mention of a human-sized persocom.

name: Atashi
description: Atashi is a strange creature resembling a rabbit who is the main character of Chi's favorite book series "A City With no People."

name: Kaede Saito
description: In Chobits manga and anime, Kaede Saito is the sister of Minoru Kokubunji. How can she be the brother of Minoru Kokunbunji, when her last name is different than those of her brother's?

name: Yuzuki
description: Yuzuki is a persocom created by Minoru Kokubunji roughly two years before the start of the series. Yuzuki was created to resemble, physically and mentally, Minoru's late sister, Kaede, who had died from an illness two years earlier. Yuzuki was programmed with all of the data that Minoru could remember about his sister; what she liked, what she disliked, her habits and behaviors�everything. However, Minoru still realizes that no matter how realistic she may be, she is still only a persocom that is following her programming. Yuzuki, despite not having the same processing capacity as a persocom like Chi, also seems to possess an awareness of her own limitations.

name: Yumi
description: Ueda's persocom. Ueda originally bought her because he was not so good with math.

name: Taichi Sagawa
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm
__Specialty:__ Part-time work

Taichi is one of the main protagonists of the I Hear the Sunspot series. He agrees to take notes for [Kouhei Sugihara](https://anilist.co/character/161621/Sugihara-Kouhei) on the condition that Kouhei brings him lunch every day.

His friends describe him as loud, emotional, and constantly hungry. Moreover, he's very comfortable in social situations. He has the affinity for understanding people.

name: Kouhei Sugihara
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm
__Specialty:__ Lip-reading

Kouhei is the main protagonist of the I Hear the Sunspot series. He's a college student who is often seen by himself and misunderstood due to his hearing disability. Due to the strange and hostile treatment from the other students has made Kohei reserved and lonely.

Due to his hearing impairment, he's become distant and reserved. While he's hearing has deteriorated over the years he still can hear and finds people with high-pitch voices, fast talkers and gossipers annoying.

name: Ryouko Sugihara
description: Kouhei's mother. Ryouko owns her own business where she gives cooking classes and is an author.

appearsIn.title: Mr. Paper Bag is in Love
Mr. Paper Bag is in Love

name: Saito
description: Among the members of Section 9 he is regarded as one of the least cyberized. He can handle any automatic firearm with deadly accuracy and precision, but his primary role is as the unit's tactical sniper. His left eye was replaced with the "Hawkeye", a prosthetic eye that interfaces with satellites to allow for shots of incredible accuracy. He is also valued for his ability to think like enemy snipers; on two separate occasions his ability at determining sniping locations impacted Section 9's actions.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Borma
description: Borma is Section 9's resident explosives specialist. He is the only Section 9 operative with similar height and enhanced strength to Batou, though his optics are clearly a different color and might therefore be another model with different capabilities. Both his eyes and his baldness are his trademark features.  In addition to his role as Section 9's explosives specialist, Borma often handles the task of rear support. In most assignments, he's the only member to carry heavy weaponry. He also works as the team's resident cyberviral warfare expert, often developing vaccines for viruses within minutes of their creation. He is usually teamed with either Saito for sniping duties, Pazu for general operations and Ishikawa for cyberweb research and viral warfare.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Operator
description:
The Operators are designed to handle various tasks within the government agency Public Security Section 9, such as operating computers, carrying equipment within the agency's building, and even crewing aircraft.

Physically they are gynoids, seen wearing office lady-style suits. In one episode, additional Operators are seen coming out of the walls to replace disabled units during a particularly strenuous task, suggesting that Section 9 has many in backup and that the units are switched regularly. Their physical appearance is of a female wearing an office lady's suit. They have brown hair tied in a pony tail with brown eyes. It should be noted that they happen to be some of the most advanced Operators in the series besides Proto who is a prototype bioroid.

name: Shoutarou Fuwa
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm

His real name is Shoutarou. He keeps it hidden because he finds it as a very old and traditional name. His natural hair color is brown but he later bleached it blonde. He is a typical stuck-up star and is also very ruthless. Shō had no qualms about tricking Kyoko into going with him to Tokyo so she could be a free servant for him. He also had even fewer qualms about being extremely cruel to her when she discovered this. Shō eventually figured out that Kyoko was in L.M.E., and was surprised to see her transformation. It is also revealed that he has more feelings for her than he originally thought, though most of these lean toward a general possessiveness for Kyoko, who had been his constant companion and servant since childhood.

name: Kyouko Mogami
description:
__Height__: 163 cm
__Company__: LME
__Affiliations__: Dark Moon, Box "R", Lotus in the Mud

Kyouko's life has always known only one aim-- to please others. Be it her mother who didn't care much for her, or Sho's family, who took her in after she was abandoned.
Suddenly, childhood friend Sho asks country bumpkin Kyouko if she wants to go to the city with him. He aims to be a big star and wishes for her support. When he commits an unthinkable crime to Kyouko's frail self-esteem, he awakens another side in her.  She changes from being an innocent girl to a woman full of the desire of revenge towards the man that used her like a stepping stone; but she didn't know that, in her way to making him suffer and cry at her feet, she would begin a whole new life into the show business and find herself having a great talent and love towards acting.  Now Kyouko is some sort of cute, joyful, and full-of-purpose woman...while also being a "woman who holds grudges" and acts in some crazy and unexpected ways, although she is still not able to recognize her own value and talent, and even less the way other people see her. 

__In the manga__:  While not aware of her talent,  Kyouko is very protective of her love life as she is also very dense with people's word with her. She's afraid to love again due to Fuwa Shou abandoning her. Tsuruga Ren as her senpai is in very close relationship to her and might as well be in love with her.

name: Ren Tsuruga
description:
**Height:** 190 cm

Ren is, in outward appearances, an extremely nice and polite star. However, he shows his true self whenever he deals with Kyoko. Although at times teasing, he harbors an unrequited love for Kyoko. As the story progresses, flashbacks reveal a past with Kyoko when she was smaller, however, Kyoko is still unaware of this. She cannot reconcile the sweet "fairy-prince Corn" with Ren's current personality. Interestingly, at the age of twenty, Ren has lived a large portion of his life in America. In fact, he began his acting career in the US albeit disastrously. Although he gained experience, he was fired so often that he has lost count in contrast to the staunch and disciplined actor he is today. Fortunately, his past in America is unknown to the public as Tsuruga Ren is only a stage name.

name: Matsushima
description: Matsushima-san is the head of LME’s Acting Section. Actors and actresses under LME are being handled by him.

name: Yuusei Ishibashi
description: He is one third of LME's popular talento trio, 'Bridge Rock', who are the hosts of  a new variety show; which features the character Bo (aka Kyoko).  Though all of Bridge Rock share the same surname, they are not related.  Their name is taken from Ishi (rock) and Bashi (bridge), flipped round.

name: Itsumi Momose
description: Itsumi is a popular new actress, who plays the role of 'Mizuki' in Dark Moon.

name: Jelly Woods
description: Jelly Woods, first seen in chapter 113, appears as a tiny woman who looks very young although she seems to be much older. Her actual name, only known by those close to her, is Ten and Jelly Woods is actually her business name. She works for LME and is aware that Tsuruga Ren is not native Japanese, but she does not know that he is the son of Hizuri Kuu. Jelly is president Lory's girlfriend, something he does not deny, and always calls him darling. She works as a beautician and hairdresser, in the world of cosmetics she is known as "the witch" and only close friends are allowed to call her "Ten". -copied from Skip Beat Wikia

name: Shoko Aki
description: Shoko Aki is Sho Fuwa's manager. Since he and Kyoko spilt he's been living at her place. Actually he was already living at her place most of the time even when he was still living with Kyoko. He also constantly flirts with her. Shoko Aki herself wanted to become an actress, but decided she didn't have the talent for it.(act.85.) But she still wanted work that was connected with Show Biz, and got a good job as a manager. Shoko and Kyoko actually get along okay.

name: Kimiko Kamio
description: Kamio Kimiko is a popular veteran actress under LME.

name: Mimori Nanokura
description: A young actress who starred in Sho's music PV alongside Kyoko. Sho calls her Pochi. She also goes to the same school as Kyoko. She fawned over Sho, reminding Kyoko of her old self.

name: Su-Hyeon Kim
description: Su-Hyeon Kim is currently a high school student in West Gangbuk-Seo High and the Top Dog of West Gangbuk. Every day he faced relentless bullying from his classmates, leading him to wish his life was more like RPG quest game he plays. Suhyeon's wish is granted when a quest prompt pops up in real life with an easy quest and an enticing reward.

name: Guk-Ja Yang
description:
__Height__: 174cm

He is Su-Hyeon Kim's best friend and the current No. 2 of West Gangbuk High.

name: Ha-Jun Gu
description:
_Height_: 186cm

The former No. 1 of West Gangbuk high, currently No. 3.

As a child, Ha-Jun wished he had been alone. His mother had raised him for a short period before running away, which left Ha-Jun as the sole target of his father's abuse. He learned how to block before he even knew how to multiply, and studied in order to survive.

In that setting, he taught himself boxing using a magazine in order to beat his dad, a goal he accomplished once he became a middle schooler, feeling no regret for it.

name: Jae-Ha Han
description:
__Height__: 181cm

Top Dog Of East Gangbuk High.

name: Chae-Rin Baek
description: 2nd-year student at West Gangbuk High.

name: Yun Jo
description:
__Height__: 194cm

Yun Jo is the main antagonist of North Gangbuk High and one of the strongest individuals in Gangbuk.

name: Si-Gyeong Ryu
description:
__Height__: 184cm

He is the No.3 of East Gangbuk High.

name: Daniel
description:
__Height__:188cm

He is the No.2 of North Gangbuk High.

name: Ha-Ru Seong
description:
__Height__: 167cm

They are currently the No.7 of West Gangbuk High, but were previously the No.39 of North Gangbuk High. Despite claiming to be male, due to their appearance they are treated as a female by most characters.

name: Aya Asagiri
description: At school she gets tacks put in her shoes, glue put on her desk, her head shoved in a toilet, and even worse than that. At home, her older brother who is stressed from trying to live up to their father's expectations ties her up, strips her, and beats her to relieve his stress. All Aya thinks about every day amidst the hell that is her life is dying. But one day a strange website called "Mahou Shoujo Site" pops up on her computer. The next day, the bullies at her school push her past the limit once again, but this time things go a little differently.

name: Tsuyuno Yatsumura
description:
__Height:__ 5'0"

She is a magical girl with the power to stop time. She tells Aya information about the magical girls and allies with her so they can be safer together. Unlike Aya, she does not have a problem using her power to injure or kill people who she dislikes.

She was born in a city called Kanagawa, her hobbies are sleeping, gaming, and swimming, her advantages are that she's friendly, fit and takes the initiative. Tsuyuno doesn't like meat or waking up in the morning, but does like vegetables, games on her phone, honey, yogurts, cute things and advertising mascots.

name: Kayo Komura

Thanks to her compact-shaped staff obtained by an Administrator, she can copy the staffs of the Magical Girls when she touches their hands or touches any part of their bodies and use their abilities, although she has a limitation, that is that she can only use alone once the ability of each copied staff, Best friend of Sakura

description: Augustus is a specter. He has become something akin of a herald of Gracefeel's and protects the seal of the High King.

Stagnate is a malice goddess associated with undeath. She is the adversary of William and becomes particularly interested. She obverse his journey and aids him despite them being foes.

 She is mischievous and cunning. She adores humans and wants to eternalise heroes who shine the way for others. She feels remorse and ashamed of how her Echo acted in his final moments.

name: Brad Burns
description: Around 14 years ago, Brad and his little brother Luke were left by their father. They eventually found themselves in New York City, in the biggest slum in the world, The Five Points. There they met Gene McDowell, the founder of the Grave Diggers, a gang, who helped them. Now Brad is working for the Grave Diggers as their hitman known as "Grim Reaper" using a gunknife, while Luke don't know about his job and is searching information for his father Edward King.

__Height:__ 176 cm

Gorou is Kibikino's editor and childhood friend.

You is Fumi's bubbly childhood friend, classmate, and confident. She has an individual and unique fashion sense.
