name: Ryou Narushima
description: The protagonist of Shamo. As a child he was considered a genius, until one day he snapped and stabbed his parents to death. After being sent to juvenile prison, he learns karate to defend himself.    Ryo Narushima is consistently depicted as being unrepentant for the murder of his parents and is shown repeatedly committing morally repugnant crimes such as assault and rape. Though capable of redemption (as evidenced by his care-taking of his sister and various small charitable acts shown throughout the manga) ultimately Narushima is depicted as a Byronic hero spiraling into darkness, his chances at reform slowly ebbing away as he gives in to more and more of his depraved and brutal tendencies.    A minor theme throughout the manga is society's morally-based stratification, how it condemns young criminals like Narushima, and how that condemnation forces Narushima to the fringes of society making his chances of true reform and redemption even more remote.    Various supporting characters within Shamo act as dramatic foils to Narushima, with Naoto Sugawara being the primary example of this. Famous, rich, and beloved for the same abilities that make Narushima a social pariah, Sugawara's presence can be seen as an example of society's cognitive dissonance towards violence. Narushima is reviled for his violent traits, while Sugawara is praised & rewarded for using those same traits in a slightly different context.

name: Natsumi Narushima
description: Ryo Narushima's younger sister and only sibling.

name: Shizuka Uesugi
description: The only person in the world who mastered the Hatsugouryuu Aiki Jujittsu to the highest level.

name: Yamazaki
description: A gangster who was Ryo and Toukichi's boss. Former high school baseball player.

name: Kenji Kurokawa
description: A jailed man who nearly assassinated Japanese Prime Minister decades ago, was sent to the reformatory to teach the youngsters karate every week. He discovered Ryo's talent and taught him self-defense.

name: Kouhei Fujiyoshi
description: A good-natured young man around the same age as Ryo, who end up working together in the gang under Yamazaki's direction.

name: Third
description: One of the members of the black dogis.

name: Ju-Gyeong Lim
description:
__Height:__ 169cm (5'6) 
Ju-Gyeong is the main protagonist of the story True Beauty. Through YouTube, she masters the art of makeup, changing her look completely. 
At school, she mains her "pretty girl" image by faking her personality, such as lying about her music preferences and eating small portions during lunch. At home, she sheds her image and revertts to her "geeky" self, spending her time reading comics, listening to rock music, and eating fatty foods like fried chicken. Later in the series, she persues her dream of working in the beauty industry, and becomes a popular influencer online.

name: Su-Ho Lee
description:
__Height:__ 6'1 
Suho is very studious in academics, unlike Ju-Gyeong and Seojun, and spends most of his free time studying. He is a talented cook and generally stays away from social media. He was best friends with Seojun in middle school.

name: Seo-Jun Han
description:
__Height:__ 187 cm (6'1)

Seojun Han is at first a bad-tempered reserved former K-pop trainee. He has a sister, who befriends Ju-Gyeong, which leads him to become best friends with Suho and Ju-Gyeong. He has great piano skills and is known as a great singer, prompting many idol companies to scout him.

name: Joo-Heon Lee
description: Jooheon Lee is the widowed, famous actor and the father of Suho Lee and Selena Lee. He works in both Korea and Japan. He also had a relationship with his co-star from one of his movies.

name: Su-Jin Kang
description: Sujin Kang is an antagonist of True Beauty. Despite her posts on social media, her life is not as what it seems. Sujin often criticizes Jugyeong's makeup skills secretly. She pretends to be Jugyeong's friend but she secretly dislikes her. She is very gorgeous. She may know that Jugyeong’s ‘real face’ is actually not her real face.

name: Hee-Yeon Shin
description: Heeyeon Shin is a supporting character in True Beauty and an idol under ST Entertainment.

name: Selena Lee
description: Selena Lee is a makeup artist who Jugyeong has admired since high school.

name: Min-Ah
description: Min-Ah is a supporting character in True Beauty and one of the girls who regularly bullied Jugyeong during middle school.

name: Go-Woon Han
description: Gowoon Han was initially introduced into the story as a co-worker of Jugyeong Lim, who had just started working at a convenience store. Later, it was revealed that Gowoon is a junior at the same school where Jugeyong studies and also the younger sister of Seojun Han.

name: Aiden Kim
description: Aiden Kim is a supporting character in True Beauty trying to make a debut through the reality television survival show, Pick Pick Boys. Which he later did, in a group called PVC short for Perfect Visual Club. Although he as stated that PVC was struggling. He was also a trainee under ST Entertainment, before leaving to join his new agency after debut. As well as a senior student at Je-Rim Arts High School when first introduced. In the later chapter's it is revealed that he joined the TV program "Prince of Prince" to boost PVC's exposure to the general public.

name: Sora Ko
description: She was saved by HCLW once and when she sees him being beaten down she helps him out. She holds him in high regards even though he's a complete jerk.

name: Dark
description: Heart hitter's boss, Dark. His Grandfather owns a World scale corporation "Giga" and he is looking for him. He decided to hire HCLW to Power Level him.

name: Yeollepjeonsa
description: Former top ranked player of Lucid Adventure.

name: Won-Ho Gong
description: The player who controls Hardcore Leveling Warrior.

name: Heart Heater Vermillion Qeentharin
description: A loan shark and former Dragon Knight. Doesn't like idiots. People can get special high-ranking requests from him.

name: Zero
aliases: 루시드 어드벤쳐의 조정자 (The Moderator of Lucid Adventure)
description:
Zero also known as The Master Black Smith, was the Moderator of Lucid Adventure and one of the main antagonists of the Season 1. She started out as a mere tool without an identity that was used to create the world that Han Gun-Jae envisioned, but during her research of the human world, she changed. Her goals became to destroy the Gods and destroy Lucid Adventure.

She was responsible for resetting Hardcore Leveling Warrior's stats and tried to regain her former power to destroy Lucid Adventure and the Real World.

At various points in the past, Zero had used other characters to attack the Gods. She was one of the Gods that picked a team in order to become the Absolute God of Lucid Adventure, backing Team Open Your Mouth, Here Comes the Healing. After the death of Han Gun-Jae, Zero revealed herself and ended up fighting both God of Combat and Gods of Time and Space. She was killed when Yopi used his Last Card to summon 'The Creator' who killed her and the Gods. In her final moments she laughed maniacally and mocked the Gods for trying to save humans who ended up killing them.

name: Cocomori
description:
Cocomori is a player in Lucid Adventure. She is a former member of Giga and currently a member of the Grass Roots Guild. After her team got knocked out of the Combat Tournament during the Siege Round, she was discarded by Han Soo-Ah and has sworn to get revenge on her.

She joined the Grass Roots Guild to participate in the PvP Round and to get her revenge on both Han Soo-Ah and Giga.

(Source: Hardcore Leveling Warrior wiki)

name: Taek
description: Taek, also known as Grand General Taek, was a player in Lucid Adventure. He was the Grand General of Yopy Land and one of Yopy's confidantes.

name: Chukbogui Sin
description:
God of Blessings is one of the Gods of Lucid Adventure. The God of War seems to think he is dead. According to Choco Bibi, he is a bearded pessimist.

(Source: Hardcore Leveling Warrior wiki)

name: Jin-Hyuk Cha
description:
Cha Jin-Hyuk, also known as Tempest in Lucid Adventure, is a member of Master Swordsman's Guild. He was a member of the Zara Guild before it was disbanded.

(Source: Hardcore Leveling Warrior wiki)

name: Mizuki Suzushiro
description: The main character of the series. Mizuki is a really girly-looking guy who is greatly annoyed by how everyone keeps mistaking him for a girl all the time. One day, the trickster goddess decides to mess with him because she's bored and Mizuki wakes up with breasts and a missing part of his anatomy.

name: Loki Asgard
description: The Norse goddess of trickery. Loki has decided to turn her eye to the mortal world for a new form of entertainment. She decides to have some fun by turning the girly-looking guy Mizuki into an actual girl. She is 700 Years Old.

name: Takeru Ichimonji
description: Mizuki's best friend who has known him since they were kids. Takeru is the only one who treats Mizuki as a guy, but after his friend turns into a girl, things begin to get confusing for him as he finds himself more and more attracted to Mizuki.

name: Yumeko Fujiwara
description: A ditzy but kind girl who Mizuki has a crush on, but she has a crush on Mizuki's childhood friend, Takeru.

name: Mizuki's Father
description: Mizuki's strict father who always told him he had to be manly. It turns out he has a big secret regarding why he always wanted Mizuki to be manly...

name: Akihiko Suzushiro
description: Mizuki's older brother. Cares deeply for his younger brother and they both get on well together. Tries to keep their father under control.

name: Reiji Asao
description: A guy in Mizuki's class. After suddenly appearing, he falls in love with Mizuki and wants to confess his feelings. Secretly, he's a pervert.

name: Nanatarou Yamada
description:
Mizuki's roommate and the heir to a lingerie company. He knows Mizuki is physically female, but not that he was gender bent and he decides he wants to make "her" his wife.

In the past, Nanatrou was bullied over his father's line of work. However, after a certain recent event, he had a change of heart and is now obsessed with it. He insists that he must wear any lingerie before he can put his seal of approval on it, and is seen as an exhibitionist by those around him due to him being in his underwear on a semi-regular basis.

name: Tamako Daikawa
description: Introducing herself as Yamada's fiancée, Tamako was studying abroad in the UK until deciding to return to Japan to see Yamada again. Yamada, however, wants nothing to do with her, going so far as to publicly proclaim his love for Mizuki in a desperate bid to get her to give up.

name: Tetsu  Misato
description: He is a third-year in high school, who begins working part-time under his father's housekeeping agency to save up money due to personal circumstances. He is assigned to work at the Karasawa Estate, where he soon becomes friends with and the personal housekeeper for the daughter of Tetsu's employers, [Shizu](https://anilist.co/character/156990).

name: Shizu Karasawa
description: She is the only child of [Tetsu](https://anilist.co/character/136088)'s wealthy employers who lives on an estate on the hill and is secreted away, where she is forbidden from leaving her house. This is because she is claimed to have dissociative identity disorder.

name: Ryou Misato
description: She is a third-year in middle school and [Tetsu](https://anilist.co/character/136088)'s younger sister.

name: Chihiro Ueno
description: He is the captain of the soccer club and [Tetsu](https://anilist.co/character/136088)'s childhood friend.

name: Akira Misato
description: She is the mother of [Tetsu](https://anilist.co/character/136088), [Ryou](https://anilist.co/character/324425) and [Suzu](https://anilist.co/character/324429), as well as the wife of [Toru Misato](https://anilist.co/character/324424). Eight years prior to the story, she was in a car accident and ended up in a coma.

name: Shinobu Karasawa
description: He is [Shizu](https://anilist.co/character/156990)'s great-grandfather and was also the first head of the Karasawa family who passed away more than 20 years ago. He was calm and enjoyed gardening.

name: Sakura Komikado
description: She is [Harumichi](https://anilist.co/character/324421)'s stepdaughter who had been searching for him for the past ten years.

name: Harumichi Komikado
description: He was a kind, caring and athletic man who enjoyed body building.

name: Suzu Misato
description: She is an elementary school student and [Tetsu](https://anilist.co/character/136088)'s younger sister.

appearsIn.title: Legend of an Asura - The Poison Dragon

name: Remina
description: A mysterious living planet from another dimension that devours worlds and stars.

name: Tsuneo Ooguro
description: A Nobel Prize-winning scientist who discovers a planet from another dimension, which he names "Remina" in honor of his daughter [Remina](https://anilist.co/character/21006/Remina-Ooguro).

name: Naoya Gouda
description: Naoya Gouda is the president of Remina’s official fan club.

name: Kentarou Iwai
description: [Remina](https://anilist.co/character/21006/Remina-Ooguro)'s fan.

name: Akira Momose
description: A beautiful girl who has returned to the countryside with careful plans to be united with her crush Hajime. She excels academically, but is not good at sports. Super clumsy and spineless.

name: Hajime Kugayama
description: A boy living in the countryside. He respects Akira as a 'concept'. Fairly athletic. Super dull & headstrong.

name: Sachiyuki Tokinaga
description: Tokinaga is a young male veterinarian who belongs to the Anti-God Science Institute, Anti-God Weapon Development Department, Biotechnology Section.

name: Waka Kamikura
description: Kamikura Waka is a high school girl who has the eyes of a "God". Waka is originally from Saga prefecture, and came to Tokyo in the hopes of meeting a god. When she was in her third year of middle school, she suddenly received the eyes of a god for reasons unknown to her.

name: Nyababa
description: An artificial being belonging to the Anti-God Science Institute, Anti-God Weapon Development Department, Biotechnology Section. Combining the loveliness of a cat, the curiosity of a mouse, the sense of rhythm of a parakeet, and the intelligence of a human, it looks like a fat cat with wings.

name: Obikawa Kiyoshi
description: Obikawa is a resident in Tsurukame Villa along with Tokinaga and the landlord Ikari-san.

name: Kanan Zebul
description:
Kanan Takakiyo, at first glance, is an ordinary teenage girl who is president of her high school's public morals committee. However, this is all a facade - her true identity is Kanan Zebel, a thousand-year-old demon who is the daughter of [Beelzebub](https://anilist.co/character/321160/), the Great Demon of Gluttony. Eager to consume human souls, she descended to the human world and used hypnotism to convince an ordinary family that she was their firstborn - all so that she could find a student to consume. 

Her search brought her to [Youji Kyougi](https://anilist.co/character/282075/), her kohai in school who mistakenly believes she wants to go out with him. Unfortunately, there is one caveat to her plan... she has never been in a relationship before.

name: Youji Kyougi
description: A high school boy one year Kanan's junior. Kanan has chosen him as a target to devour his soul, but he mistakenly believes that she's confessing to him and becomes her boyfriend. Aggressively in love with Kanan.

name: Ami
description: Kanan’s childhood friend and loyal maid. As a succubus, she often takes… snack breaks daily.

name: Jeanne
description: Jeanne is one of the Lord's servants who descended from Heaven and is on a mission to protect Kyougi from demons.

name: Lilim Zebul
description: Lilim is the mother of Kanan, Miel, and Miltie, as well as the wife of the Great Demon Beelzebub. She is afraid of men who are not her husband.

name: Miel Zebul
description: Miel is one of Kanan's younger sisters and the youngest child of the Zebel family. She is deeply fond of her oldest sister but gets a rush whenever she witnesses moments of proximity between Kanan and Youji.

name: Milch Zebul
description: Milch is one of Kanan's younger sisters and the middle child of the Zebel family. She’s always interested in Kanan’s things, including her new boyfriend. The brattiest of the bratty little girls.

name: Beelzebub
description: He's the father of Kanan, Miel and Miltie as well as the husband of Lillum.

name: Nadeshiko Masurao
description: She's a classmate of [Kyougi](https://anilist.co/character/282075/Kyougi-Youji) as well as his childhood friend. She doesn't like it when people call her Masurao because it comes off as manly.

name: Yi Bei
description: The titular Demon Queen. At the start of the story she was betrayed by one of her servants, lost her powers and was quickly defeated. She is forced to pose as a human and Xiang Ye's wife, "Yi Bei".

appearsIn.title: My Wife is the Demon Queen

name: Xiang Ye
description: The protagonist. He is a normal teenager living alone when he is accidentally summoned into another dimension to aid the deposed Demon Queen Isabella Osa. He pretends to be Isabella's husband for her protection. Although he is initially viewed as worthless and feeble by everyone, Xiang Ye quickly proves himself in unique ways.

appearsIn.title: My Wife is the Demon Queen

name: Sophisas
description: Sophisas is the Leader of the White Dragon Knights, one of the seven knightly orders of the Human Kingdom. He is also the patron to Xiang Ye and Isabella Osa.

appearsIn.title: My Wife is the Demon Queen

name: Wadley Aisi
description: Wadley Aisi is the head mage at the Royal Academy. Her actual age is not stated in the story though she is thought to be in her 30's.

appearsIn.title: My Wife is the Demon Queen

name: Alex Ayr
description: Alex Ayr, also known as Eli is a major character and the top member of the combat class. He is close friends with the main character, Xiang Ye.

appearsIn.title: My Wife is the Demon Queen

name: Penny Tols
description: Penny is a member of the royal family and student at the Royal Academy enrolled in the Archery class. Not much is known about her nor her motivations. While she is a member of the royal family it is unclear if she has a dragon form like her siblings. While her brothers do not treat her well, her father Tols Angus seems to hold her in better regard than his sons.

appearsIn.title: My Wife is the Demon Queen

name: Aisha Yuri
description: Introduced during the Tournament Arc as a mage and the top assistant of magic teacher Aisi.

appearsIn.title: My Wife is the Demon Queen

name: Dorona
description: Dorona is the head swordswoman at the Royal Academy and teacher to Isabella who she agrees to mentor after seeing her talent. She also seems to have an antagonistic friendship with Wadley Aisi.

appearsIn.title: My Wife is the Demon Queen

name: Jingji Nuwang
description: She was introduced during the Tournament Arc in the first round. She was hostile towards Xiang Ye and the rest of the group at first blaming them for burning her forest down. She could not be defeated, but she became friendly upon discovery of who Isabella actually was.

appearsIn.title: My Wife is the Demon Queen

name: Tols Angus
description: He is the regent of the Human Tribe because of the king's young age and he's the most powerful warrior in the human kingdom's military. He once fought on equal footing with the former demon king George Osa.

appearsIn.title: My Wife is the Demon Queen

name: Yuva
description: Yuva is a young man sent to the Dragon's Tower to help rescue the Princess.

name: Lilicen
description: Lilicen is a fire mage who was saved by [Yuva](https://anilist.co/character/333217/Yuva) inside the "Dragon Tower" and has now joined him on the quest to save the princess.

name: Eriquo
description: A soldier of the Kingdom's Royal Guard and good friend of [Lilicen](https://anilist.co/character/336647/Lilicen). Originally part of Vice Captain [Rudeum](https://anilist.co/character/368306/Rudeum)'s squadron to save the princess, now the leader of the newly formed Royal Guard Battalion 7th Squad. Considered to be the best archer in the Kingdom.

name: Minsabelle
description: Minsabelle is the captain of the Royal Guard. She was the one who lead the mission to rescue the Princess from the Dragon's Tower. She is the younger sister of the King and possesses the blood of a Dracomorph, however she is unable to transform. She is estimated to be over 100 years old.

name: Rudeum
description: Vice Captain of the Royal Guard. He and [Captain Minsabelle](https://anilist.co/character/368307/Minsabelle) later forms the 7th Squardron of the Royal Guard Battalion and entrusts [Eriquo](https://anilist.co/character/368309/Eriquo), [Yuva](https://anilist.co/character/333217/Yuva) and [Lilicen](https://anilist.co/character/336647/Lilicen) to rescue the Princess.

name: Calix
description: A soldier of the Royal Guards and fellow squadmate of [Eriquo](https://anilist.co/character/368309/Eriquo).

name: Garamuna
description: Garamuna is a Nyabilian (race of cat like people) and Parliamentary Guard stationed near the tower. She and Lilicen both attended the Royal Academy and have some sort of rivalry-like relationship.

name: Saki Hananoi
description: Saki Hananoi is a popular highschool student and Hinase Hotaru's boyfriend.

name: Satomi Satomura
description: A college student who works part-time at the same bookstore as Hotaru.

name: Souhei Yao
description: Went to the same elementary school as Hotaru.

name: Keigo Kurata
description: A high school student on the basketball team. Hibiki Asami's boyfriend.

name: Hibiki Asami
description: A high school student. Hotaru Hinase's friend since middle school.

name: Tsukiha Shibamura
description: A high school student in the kendo club. Friend of Hotaru Hinase and Hibiki Asami.

name: Krystal Nokanatika
native: クリストル・ノバティ・ノカナティカ

name: Nephrites Lomka
native: ネフリティス・ロムカ
description: The shut-in elf princess bearer of the Rings of Wind.

name: Saphir Maasa
description:
Saphir is one of the twin princesses of the water country of Maasa. She takes on the roll of becoming Ring Princess and gives Satou the Ring of Water to help save her country from Empire influence and so her sister Saphira can be with Marse. She becomes his 4th wife.

She has strong magic powers but has a lazy personality.

name: Granart Needakitta
native: グラナート・ニーダキッタ
description: The current princess and the strongest of the cat people bearer of the Rings of Fire.

name: Amber Idonokan
native: アンベル・イダノカン
description: The Princess of the Earth Ring.

name: Morion Nokanatika
native: モーリオン・ノバティ・ノカナティカ
description: Hime's younger sister.

name: Alabaster
description:
Alabaster, the Great Sage. Called Gramps by Satou and Hime.
Was able to create a portal to Earth, taking Hime with him to protect her and the Ring of Light.

Is very knowledgeable about the Ring King, the Abyss, magic, and the world.



Was involved with Sumaragdi at some point in his youth and the two were in love. He left to spare her the pain of seeing him grow old, since she will live much longer, being an elf.

name: Changge Gu
description: Gu Changge is the main character of the I Am The Fated Villain series.

name: Qiuhan Lin
description: She has tremendous talent towards alchemy even when compared to the geniuses in the Upper Realm.

name: Mei Yin
description: Yin Mei is the Holy Maiden of the Nine-Tailed Celestial Fox Family.

name: Mingkong Yue
description: She's Gu Changge's Fiancée in the Upper Realm.

name: Xian'er Gu
description: The Youngest Young Supreme of The Upper Realm and The Little Princess of The Ancient Immortal Gu Family. Gu Changge's cousin

name: Yan Ji
description: Yan Ji is an expert from the Upper Realm with the cultivation of the Great Sacred Realm. Her species was hunted down to the brink of extinction and left with no choice, she turned into a remnant spirit to hide. She was then awoken by Ye Chen, and thankful for his help, took him as a disciple.

name: Sheena Totsuki
description: Because of her class number, she is in the same room with [Mimi](https://anilist.co/character/198884/Kagari-Mimi) and is partnered with her. She hates war and anyone getting hurt, and has doubts about her mission as a weapon. Her magical power is low, and she can only use magic to move a book by floating it in the air...

appearsIn.title: I Want to Love You Till Your Dying Day

name: Mimi Kagari
description:
__Height:__ 143 cm

A mysterious girl who came to [Sheena](https://anilist.co/character/198883/Totsuki-Sheena).

She is said to be the school's immortal secret weapon. She possesses unimaginable power despite her young appearance and innocent words and actions, and she has no reservations about killing her enemies. She has the ability to revive herself even after being injured to the point of losing her original human form.

appearsIn.title: I Want to Love You Till Your Dying Day

name: Omi
description: The homeroom teacher for Class 14, to which [Sheena](https://anilist.co/character/198883/Totsuki-Sheena) and the others belong. Despite her detached demeanor, she truly cares about her students.

appearsIn.title: I Want to Love You Till Your Dying Day

name: Heather
description: An upperclassman from class 16. She is roommates with a classmate named [Esta](https://anilist.co/character/380872/Nino-Esta).

appearsIn.title: I Want to Love You Till Your Dying Day

name: Seiran Lizzy
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm

She is a serious person with a strong sense of justice. Whenever one of her classmates behaves in a frivolous manner, she scolds them. But every time she does so, [Ali](https://anilist.co/character/229291/Maud-Ali) calms her down. She shows glimpses of a strong connection with Ali that goes beyond friendship.

appearsIn.title: I Want to Love You Till Your Dying Day

name: Ali Maud
description:
__Height:__ 152 cm

She has a calm personality, always smiling, and is more mature than the other students. She has a bold personality and expresses her thoughts directly, which makes [Seiran](https://anilist.co/character/229290/Lizzy-Seiran) worry about her.

appearsIn.title: I Want to Love You Till Your Dying Day

name: Halfred Anhalt
native: アンハルト・ハルフレズ
description:
__Height:__ 148 cm

[Mimi](https://anilist.co/character/198884/Kagari-Mimi) and [Sheena](https://anilist.co/character/198883/Totsuki-Sheena)'s classmate.

When younger, they disliked wearing the hand-me-down skirts from their older sisters, and asked for their brother's shorts instead, leading them to be criticized for not acting "like a girl" and causing problems for their family. At present, they are still figuring out their identity, and about relationships. They are intrigued by Mimi and Sheena's bond. Their favorite food is anything easy they can carry to their room.

appearsIn.title: I Want to Love You Till Your Dying Day

name: Esta Nino
description:
__Height:__ 158cm

An upperclassman from class 16.

Esta puts on a cheery demeanor and is kind to both her juniors and classmates. She would often ignore her own health and lets others have priority when it comes to getting treatment, regardless of how bad her own condition might be.

She is roommates with a classmate named [Heather](https://anilist.co/character/402132/Heather).

appearsIn.title: I Want to Love You Till Your Dying Day

name: Fran
description: The school nurse at the school [Sheena](https://anilist.co/character/198883/Totsuki-Sheena) and her friends attend. She is skilled in healing magic and is indispensable to the school. She’s always looking out for [Mimi](https://anilist.co/character/198884/Kagari-Mimi).

appearsIn.title: I Want to Love You Till Your Dying Day

name: Min-Su Kim
description:
__Height:__ 176 cm
__Affiliation:__ Destruction Force Warrior → Independent
__Epithet:__ Sword Warrior
__Abilities:__ Exceptional swordsmanship and superhuman physical abilities
__Blessing:__ Goddess Seraphine's blessing
__Holy Relics:__ Durandal sword, armor
__Family:__ Kim Sung-chul (father), Lee Hyun-jung (mother)


Pre-Fallen Hero: Kim is a young-boy that is empathic, deterministic, strong-willed, kind, and helpful. The other world's heros noted that Minsu was humble and very soft-spoken. Minsu was determined to see the other world's salvation and was very selfless in this regard.
Post-Fallen Hero: He is an extremely depressive, nihilistic, thoughtless, cold-hearted, genocidal, and cynical individual who lost almost all of his humanity.

name: Jeong-Su Park
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm
__Affiliation:__ Resistance Forces
__Epithet:__ The Spear Warrior, The Warrior of Revolt, The Warrior of Warriors
__Ability:__ Grants excellent spearmanship and superhuman physical abilities
__Holy Relics:__ The World of Creativity, the Spear, Magic Armor, Didantium, the Transformation Belt, Martial Arts, Chronos, and many other sacred relics
__Family:__ Park Da-bin (younger sister)
__Appearance:__ Episode 2

Jeong-Su Park was once a normal boy who lived a good life, with a good family. However, it takes a big turn when the world is now being taken over by the Sword Hero. His family tried to evacuate from Seoul only to end up being killed by the Sword Hero, Jeong-Su is taken to another world where he spends his time solo battling against all sorts of threats without needing the allies by his side.

After successfully defeating the demon lord, he eventually resurrects the demon lord and even gave him a potion that turns him far stronger. Only to end up killing the demon lord for the second time, his only ally understands very clear that his revenge purpose must be very important. Eventually, she decides to help him, at the same time, telling him that he must not lose his humanity to despair and vengeance to become a monster.

name: Ye-Som Ma
description: She is the hero Ma Ye-Rin younger sister.

name: Do-Hun Lim
description:
__Affiliation:__ Resistance Forces
__Epithet:__ Time Warrior
__Ability:__ Warhammer that increases mass at the cost of superhuman physical abilities and longevity
__Holy Relic:__ Retirement Chronos
__Family:__ Im Do-won (Father), mother

An old warrior with a white beard and a helmet with an X-shaped notch. He is currently only 19 years old, but when he went to another world, he was an ordinary 18-year-old student. The reason he, who was ordinary at 18, suddenly aged in just one year is that he fought as a warrior of time, dedicating his life to it. After defeating the Demon King, when he returned to Earth, he had only 6 years left to live. His appearance as a middle-aged man is briefly revealed in a flashback, and apart from having a beard, he resembles his father a lot.

name: Eui-Ho Jeong
description:
__Height:__ 202 cm
__Affiliation:__ Destruction Force Warrior
__Epithet:__ Iron Arm Warrior
__Ability:__ Transcendent strength and durability, Syrum-008

He is a warrior with an iron arm and belongs to the destructive force led by the Sword Warrior.

name: Tae-Il Choi
description:

He was the Combination Warrior and one of the Resistance Warriors who sided with the South Korean government against the 9-Warriors. However, he was killed at some point before the main story began.

name: Hwa-Rang Hong
description:
__Height:__ 185 cm
__Affiliation:__ Destruction Force Warrior
__Epithet:__ Vampire Warrior, Exorcist Warrior
__Ability:__ Blood manipulation
__Holy Relic:__ Hammer and chisel

He is a vampire warrior and a member of the destructive force led by the sword warrior Kim Min-soo . His area of ​​control is Chungcheongnam-do. 

Although he has a light-hearted atmosphere, according to Jeon Seung-woo's comments, he rules with a cruelty that rivals that of Baek Ha-na, and he actually has a cruel personality that kills citizens without mercy when he is offended.

name: Ye-Rin Ma
description:
__Height:__ 152 cm
__Affiliation:__ Resistance Forces
__Epithet:__ Magic Warrior
__Ability:__ Various magic, servant horse Nyancaron
__Holy Relic:__ Sweet Crystal
__Family:__ Ma Ye-Som (younger sister), 

She is known as one of the warriors who stood on Minsu Kim's side and brought down the Republic of Korea, but she is actually a warrior of the resistance forces opposing him.

name: Ha-Na Baek
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm
__Affiliation:__ Destruction Force Warrior
__Epithet:__ Warrior of Faith
__Ability:__ Faith through fear

She is one of the warriors of the destructive force who stood on the side of the warrior of the sword, Kim Min-soo , and destroyed the Republic of Korea . If Hans is the embodiment of the crowd psychology of human society, and Damian is the angelic form of faith, Baek Ha-na is the devil, the fearful side of faith.

native: カグラ・ボールドウィン
description: She is one of the main female characters of TenPuru. She came to Japan with Mia Christoph, they have been best friends since childhood.

name: Yugo Hachiken
description: The main character of Silver Spoon, he enrolls in Yezo High, an agricultural school, to get away from his parents. He is hard-working and intelligent, but he struggles in competing in grades with some individuals who have grown up in agricultural backgrounds, which affects his pride. He joins the equestrian (horses) club to become closer to Mikage Aki, who he has a crush on. Seeing those around him striving towards their goals, he acknowledges his own lack of a goal and tries to find one.

name: Aki Mikage
description: A member of the equestrian club, she loves horses and grew up on a farm. She is expected to eventually take over the family farm, however she remains uncertain if that is what she herself wishes to do.

name: Shinnosuke Aikawa
description: Shinnosuke's goal is to become a veterinarian however, he first has to overcome his dilemma with the practice of euthanasia on animals.

name: Tamako Inada
description: Round like an egg as her name implies (tamago means egg in Japanese), Tamako is a 1st Year Dairy Farming Program student who is not afraid to speak her mind. She excels in accounting and is obsessed with micromanaging money.

name: Yui Mitsuya
description: A coworker who started working at the same time as Tateishi. She works in the planning department. She has an unyielding spirit and a sharp tongue... at least it seems that way, but in truth she loves Tateishi way too much.

appearsIn.title: I Have a Crush at Work

name: Masugu Tateishi
description: An employee of the accounting departmenf of Tsuda sweets. He's methodical, industrious, and a bit of a pushover. He loves Mitsuya way too much.

appearsIn.title: I Have a Crush at Work

name: Yue Ayase
description:
__Seat Number:__ 4

Yue is Nodoka's best friend, and is often seen around both her and Haruna. She's short and at times has a blunt way of speaking to people, but is generally a friendly person. She likes to read but (ironically) doesn't like to study, and is one of the Baka Rangers (a name for the 5 worst students in Negi's class). When she finds out that Negi is a mage she gets excited about learning magic herself.  At first she shows no romantic interest in Negi, but as time goes by she finds herself developing a crush on him. However she doesn't want to hurt Nodoka, so she tries to keep it bottled up as much as she can. She's supportive of Nodoka and wishes her the best of luck when it comes to her and Negi's relationship.  Yue became the 5th person in Negi's class to make a Pactio with him, following Asuna, Nodoka, Setsuna, and Konoka.

name: Negi Springfield
native: ネギ・スプリングフィールド
description: Negi Springfield is the teacher of Mahora Girls' Jr High School class 3-A (formley 2-A) with formely 31 students,now reduced to 30. Negi Springfield is the son of master mage Nagi Springfield, famously known as the legendary "Thousand Master" and princess Akira of the Ostian Empire in the magic world. At present, Negi has formed 11 temporarily pactio with his students(Asuna, Nodoka, Setuna, Konoka, Yue, Haruna, Chisame, Kazumi, Kaede,Ku Fei,and Chachamaru) and 1 temporarily pactio with Theo, which gives him the artifact that allow him to use any of his partner's artifact.     Negi specialize in Wind spells and Lightning spells(His father's specialty) though he is initially lacking in battle experience. He later trains under Ku Fei in Martial Arts to make up for his weakness in close combat, advancing very quickly(Even learning how to do instant movement, otherwise known as Shundou), and applies a strong magical barrier around himself to avoid damaging his frail body. He eventually becomes a master of using delayed spells as a battle tactic. Due to the training he had with Evangeline and Jack Rakan, his magic and combat capability increases exponentially. Negi also learns and improves upon Evangeline's "Magic Erebea", which absorb offensive spells into his own body. He also came up with a new spell: "Spell Synthesis: Lightning God Lance Titan Slayer" which is a new high class lightning spell.

name: Albert Chamomile
native: アルベール・カモミール
description: A perverted lingerie stealing (once again a throw back to the typical manga male stock character archetype), chain-smoking, talking ermine, (though he has a long, and prehensile tail), that Negi freed from a trap when he was five years old. Since then, Chamo has been going to Negi whenever he ran into trouble.  Chamo cares strongly for Negi and will fight to protect him, but he is not above using him to try to make a fast buck. Chief among those methods is attempting to make probationary contracts between Negi and as many of his students as possible, since the act nets him 50,000 Ermine Dollars per contract.  Chamo often acts as Negi's trusty advisor in most things, though there are times his judgement and/or advice leaves much to be desired. He is skillful at analyzing dangerous situation and coming up with countermeasure when most of the others are in state of panic, but his plan usually have big flaws in it, a point that he often admits blankly. He is also quite good at analyzing individual strength and character, and puts them in good use during times of need.  He normally suffers Asuna's wrath whenever his schemes are discovered or he is caught in one of his perverted acts.  As a side note, being turned into an ermine is one of the punishments that Negi's magic academy gives, however Chamo is not a mage turned into an ermine, but actually a type of elf/fairy/Cait Sith (which he says he is very proud of). (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Sister Shakti
native: シスターシャークティ
description: Sister Shakti is a mage teacher, who heads the Mahora nun patrol squad. She seems particularly skilled in combat and uses floating crosses in battle. Both Misora and Cocone are under her guidance at the church on Mahora's campus.    Source: Wikipedia

name: Chisame Hasegawa
description:
__Seat Number:__ 25

Chisame Hasegawa is the grumpy, unsocial computer hacker of the class, intentionally isolating herself due to her dislike of freaks and weirdos. However, Chisame secretly lives a double life as the famous web idol Chiu, where she can be popular without putting up with the local idiots.

She likes small, powerful devices, such as sub-notepad PCs, but dislikes useless people and unexpected events.

name: Asuna Kagurazaka
description:
__Affiliations:__ Art Club  

As one of the main characters of the series, Asuna has been known to have quite a short temper and frequently her actions are a bit rash, but at the same time, has some aspects that display her maturity, especially when it comes to doing the right thing. Although at first she really detests Negi, over time she becomes like a big sister role model to him, as she does resemble Negi's cousin, Nekane, in a way.

name: Konoka Konoe
description: __Affiliations:__ Fortune-Telling Club, Library Exploration Club

name: Evangeline Athanasia Katherine McDowell
native: エヴァンジェリン・A.K.・マクダウェル
description:
__Seat Number:__ 26
__Clubs:__ Go Club, Tea Ceremony Club
__Height:__ 130 cm (4'3")

Evangeline is a centuries-old true blood vampire, cursed to remain at the school by [Nagi Springfield](https://anilist.co/character/4912/Springfield-Nagi). Initially an antagonist for [Negi](https://anilist.co/character/146/Springfield-Negi) due to his father's actions, she eventually becomes an important teacher and guide for the young mage and his allies. However, Eva remains a cruel, powerful mage in her own right, yet with the sensitivities of her former human life. Evangeline, having the reputation of a coldblooded killer, is feared in the magic side of the world. The legends surrounding her have gained her many monikers such as the Advent of Evil, the Apostle of Calamity, the Doll Master, and the Gospel of Darkness.

In UQ Holder, a semi-sequel set 70 years into the future, she takes on the form of a tall woman and the alias Yukihime. She is the foster mother to Touta, Negi's grandson, and is the leader of UQ Holder-- an organization comprised of immortals and other monsters that aid their brethren and outcast humans.

name: Nodoka Miyazaki
description:
__Seat Number:__ 27

Class 2/3-A's resident bookworm, Nodoka is of the quiet but kind variety, harboring romantic feelings for her homeroom teacher, Negi Springfield. She has since confessed her feelings to him, but not much progress in their relationship has been made; they still remain friends. Nodoka is the second person to establish a probationary contract with Negi and gain a pactio card (it occured during the field trip to Kyoto). Her artifact is a book that can show one's thoughts in picture diary format.

name: Setsuna Sakurazaki
description: Setsuna is a Shinmeiryu swordswoman from Kyoto who was taken in by Eishun Konoe, Konoka's father and the leader of the Kyoto Mage Association. She is childhood friends with Konoka and her protector.  Setsuna spends the beginning of the series being relatively cold to Konoka, wishing to protect her from the shadows due to not forgiving herself for being unable to save Konoka when she almost drowned when they were kids. She does eventually open up to Konoka after the Kyoto arc and begins calling her "Oujo-sama" and "Kono-chan".  Setsuna's pactio, Sica Shishikushiro is a wakizashi which she can summon and multiply at will to strike targets like missiles. Due to her training she's also skilled in anti-demon arts and is the one who taught Negi how to create shikigami from paper.  Setsuna is a hanyou like Koutaro, in particular a crow. She was expelled from her people because white wings are considered a bad omen, and it was implied by Evangeline that she is an albino using hair dye and contact lenses to appear human.  A running gag within the series is that Setsuna and Konoka appear to have romantic feelings for one another, yet Setsuna will deny it whenever she and Konoka are stumbled upon in romantic situations or asked about her preference.

Father-kun was sent by God to protect the innocent, his main mission is to protect [Imuri Atsuki](https://anilist.co/character/284738/Imuri-Atsuki) from different demons sent by [Satan](https://anilist.co/character/305829/Satan) himself.

name: Vergilius
description:
Vergilius, is the Witch of Gluttony. He is one of the strongest witches of his Sabbath, despite only having been a witch for a decade.

His former, human name is unknown, and he wants to kill God.

appearsIn.title: Make the Exorcist Fall in Love

name: Rofocale
description: The gatekeeper to Lucifer's Gehenna.

appearsIn.title: Make the Exorcist Fall in Love

name: Mammon
description: Mammon is the Demon Lord of Greed and part of the Seven Deadly Sins.

appearsIn.title: Make the Exorcist Fall in Love

name: Dante
description: Mr. Priest's master, and a former friend of Vergilius.

appearsIn.title: Make the Exorcist Fall in Love

name: Lucifer
description: The Demon Lord of Pride. He is the strongest of the Seven Deadly Sins.

appearsIn.title: Make the Exorcist Fall in Love

name: Leviathan
description: Leviathan is the Demon Lord of Envy and one of the Seven Deadly Sins.

appearsIn.title: Make the Exorcist Fall in Love

name: Babylon
description:
The Warp Blighted, whose joints are unnaturally flexible, allowing him to fit through even the smallest of spaces, like a rodent, earning him the name "Babylon the Giant Rat." A master of martial arts that utilizes his body's flexibility, he is recognizable by his small eyes that conceal his emotions. During combat he will laugh in a way that antagonizes his enemies. Though he seems aloof, much like the rest of the guild, he cares greatly for his companions, and is known for keeping a cool head, as well being a reliable decision maker.

(Source: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability Official Site)

appearsIn.title: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince So I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability

name: Talia
description:
The Pain Blighted, whose ability allows her to link with anyone she sees, at which point she and her target will share any injuries either suffers. Given the nature of her power, she often harms herself as a tactic in battle, earning her the name "Talia the Hundred Pains." She has a self-sacrificing personality where she will endure pain willingly for the sake of her friends. She loves gossip, and often takes care of Ren as the only other girl in the guild. 

(Source: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability Official Site)

appearsIn.title: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince So I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability

name: Crow
description:
With the ability to imbue his words with mana, he is the Curse Blighted. Because anything he says will be affected by his mana, he normally wears a bird-like mask, which has earned him the name "Crow the Dark Raptor." During battle, he uses his Cursed Speech in order to support his comrades. His inability to speak freely, due to his curse, made him seem introverted and gloomy for a long time, but, with Lloyd's help, his powers are now under control, and he seems much more cheerful. 

(Source: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability Official Site)

appearsIn.title: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince So I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability

name: Mizuki Aikawa
description: Mizuki is a quiet girl, who has lived a privileged life. She feels extremely pressured by her mother to be something she doesn't want to be, and seeks refuge in the kindness of her best friend [Mako](https://anilist.co/character/296924/Igarashi-Mako).

name: Mako Igarashi
description: Mako is a happy-go-lucky girl who lost her mother when she was 10 due to a car accident, and her father became an disabled through the same accident. As a result, she has to work hard during her part-time job to pay for her father's debts and medical bills.

name: Gtacs
description: Gtacs is a powerful mage and the leader of a Salamanders Mage Group.

name: Coper
description: A beta tester that appears in the third story of Volume 8. He teams up with Kirito to complete a quest.

name: Thinker
description:
He is trapped in the dungeon under the Black Iron Castle by a faction leader named Kibaou. He is later rescued by Kirito and Asuna in during the Morning Dew Girl arc events after he was thrown into a hidden dungeon.  

(Source: SAO Wiki)

name: Quinella
description: Quinella was the actual ruler of the Underworld as the highest minister of the Axiom Church.

name: Skuld
description: She is one of the NPCs that are part of the Excalibur mission.

name: Souta Aoki
description: Aoki is a high school student with a pure heart. He possesses an extremely kind personality and a naive nature. He is secretly in love with Hashimoto at first. However, due to certain misunderstandings he begins to get closer to Ida, his new friend.

name: Kousuke Ida
description: Ida is a high school student who belongs to the volleyball club. He has an orderly and direct personality, often saying what he thinks. He is unfamiliar with love and doesn't understand the "feeling of falling in love with someone". However, for reasons unknown to himself, he begins to arouse feelings for Aoki.

name: Mio Hashimoto
description: Hashimoto is a high school student and Aoki's classmate. She possesses a gentle personality and charming smile, but is also shy and withdrawn. Hashimoto accidentally lent Aoki an eraser that had "Ida-kun ♡" written on it, creating a romantic mix-up between Aoki and Ida.

name: Hayato Aida
description: Aida is Aoki's best friend. He possesses a flirtatious and kind nature, as well as being very self-assured. He doesn't have a very close relationship with Ida, but after exchanging a few words, he discovers that he is a good person. He initially tries to romantically set Ida up with Hashimoto. However, Aida subsequently begins to develop a great friendship with Hashimoto.

name: Hopachai Apachai
native: アパチャイ・ホパチャイ
description:
A 28-year-old master of Muay Thai and is known as the "Death God" of the Muay Thai underworld fighting circuit.

Apachai has been fighting life or death battles in underground Muay Thai fights since he was a teenager. Later, he was an enforcer for a cruel pirate who accidentally fed Apachai while he was starving in a harbor in Thailand. He served this man faithfully until [Hayato Fūrinji](https://anilist.co/character/3079/Fuurinji-Hayato) brought his misdeeds to Apachai's attention. The two of them then defeated the pirates, and Apachai has been at the dojo ever since.

name: Miu Fuurinji
description:
__Martial Arts:__ Furinji Style Martial Arts

The granddaughter of Hayato Furinji and the daughter of Saiga Furinji, the leaders respectively of Ryozanpaku and Yami's One Shadow Nine Fists. Miu came into Hayato's care when his son murdered several of his friends and his wife, sparing Miu by accident. Thereafter Miu learned martial arts from her grandfather.

Although attractive, smart, athletic, and kind, Miu is often clumsy among her fellows.

name: Hayato Fuurinji
description: Miu's grandfather and the undefeated elder of the Ryouzanpaku Dojo, who is said to have beaten 500 Shaolin masters to near death. His kicks have speeds that are still a blur even when viewing a replay of it at 1/1000 of the normal speed. If necessary, he is able to intimidate the other masters in order to maintain peace. Even using just 0.0002% of his power, he can easily overwhelm both Ken'ichi and Miu at the same time and rip a tree in half.

name: Akisame Koetsuji
description:
__Height:__ 180cm 

Koetsuji Akisame is the philosophical Jujitsu master and doctor of Ryozanpaku who was an old friend of Miu's father, Fuurinji Saiga. He was also the the first master willing to train Kenichi (though he is the least considerate to Kenichi's feelings). Despite his seemingly small physique, he is actually known for having his muscles built to perfection. He also has very good insight on people, often knowing if they are troubled or hiding something; he sometimes even knows what a person is thinking, which scares Kenichi. He has no trouble using his friends as guinea pigs to come up with new techniques.   Akisame is also capable of speaking fluently in Russian.

name: Shigure Kosaka
aliases: The Prodigy of Swords and Weapons
description:
__Height:__ 159cm
__Martial Arts:__ Kosaka Style (All Weapons)

Shigure is a mysterious person and a slow talker. She is also a master of all types of weapons and believes that weaponry should be seen as an extension of the body: simply relying on the weapons strength alone will not make you a master of it. She was initially viewed as a loner, often avoiding interaction with the other residents of the dojo, besides Apachai. However, later in the series, she begins to open up to Kenichi and the others, and even partakes in certain daily rituals (e.g. dinner) with them. She teaches Kenichi how to use weapons and also got him past his fear of people using weapons against him.  It was implied by Kensei that Shigure worries about Kenichi when he is not around because she believes that he got into something dangerous, meaning she has possibly grown a liking for Kenichi. She even allows Akisame to tell Kenichi of her past, saying that it is okay simply because he's Kenichi.   Out of all the masters, Shigure trains Kenichi the least. Her actions subtly suggest that she yearns to have him as a disciple, and is disappointed with Kenichi's reluctance to use weaponry (along with his perpetual fear of her). Thus far, she has taught Kenichi mostly practical abilities, such as swimming and rope tying.  It is revealed that Shigure was raised deep in the mountains along with her father, who was an expert at both crafting and wielding weapons.

name: Kensei Ma
aliases: The Master of All Chinese Kenpo
description:
__Height:__ 158cm 

Kensei is the lecherous master of all Chinese Kenpo, who prefers to fight using soft forms and currently the second oldest of the six masters of Ryozanpaku.  He is short, balding, and always tries to take revealing pictures of beautiful women (including Shigure and Miu), which often earns him the wrath of the pair, though it does not stop him. Despite his present attitude, he was actually a charming and handsome young man in his youth, and was very popular with women.   Kensei and Kenichi develop a very close relationship, though Kensei mistreats Kenichi comically like everyone else does, Kenichi sees him as a father figure. He also knows Kenichi better than the others due to the fact that he is usually the one who ends up convincing him to cooperate with their plans, such as when he convinced Kenichi to move into Ryozanpaku, and also will occasionally swindle him into buying the perverted pictures he takes (Though in the D&D arc, Kenichi states that he all he ever receives are pictures of Tochumaru posing). Though he is a perverted and sly old man, Kenichi still admits that he never doubted his training methods or his beliefs as a master, this shows how much his bond with Kenichi and him are as master and disciple.  Under all of this however, he is shown to be a very kind and wise person at heart who seems saddened at the violent uses of Martial Arts in the world, wishing the world could be more peaceful.

name: Shio Sakaki
description:
__First appearance:__ Battle 7
__Height:__ 192cm 
__Type:__ Dou
__Type:__ Katsujin Ken
__Martial Arts:__ Karate (specializes in Mutenkendoku-style)

A 30-year-old master of karate who claims to hold 100 dan. Little is known about Sakaki's past; but he has mentioned that he used to travel the world and fight, and he also at one point belonged to a group that consisted of himself, a French martial arts master named Christopher Eclair, and an Englishman named Mycroft; but left them when their activities brought harm to the innocent, and later buried them alive.

name: Kenichi Shirahama
description: A first year high school student, who likes botany and reading How to... books. He was initially viewed as a weakling by the rest of his school, and was ranked as the weakest student. In order to become strong enough to protect others, he becomes a disciple of the Ryouzanpaku Doujo, and eventually lives there, so he can fully embrace his masters' teachings.

name: Shiratori
description: First appearance: Battle 12 Type: Sei Type: Katsujin Ken Martial Arts: Taekwondo  Shiratori is Kisara's principal lieutenant, and joined Shinpaku when she did. He is known for his long blonde hair. He has never been seen actually fighting during her time in Ragnarok, but since He was ranked the same as Tsuji Shinnosuke was under Kisara during the Ragnarok arc, it is assumed that Shiratori was as just as strong as Kisara at that time.

name: Aisha
description: * First appearance: Battle 235 * Type: Sei * Type: Katsujin Ken * Martial Arts: Capoeira  Aisha is the only female member of the Capoeira Team during the D of D tournament. She harbors romantic feelings towards her team leader. At the same time, she completely disregards the feelings that her teammate, Silvio, has for her.  Aisha first appears and defeats an entire team all by herself. Later, during their team's match against Shinpaku Alliance, Niijima exposes Silvio's crush on her, much to both of their embarrassment. Silvio is knocked out of the ring after Niijima berates him for his vain love for Aisha and is thrown out by Ukita.  Eventually, Eliot and the unnamed teammate are defeated by Siegfried, leaving only the leader and Aisha left. Aisha starts fighting Kisara and has the upper hand due to their great difference in measurements. When Kenichi and Shiratori vocally bring this up, Kisara becomes comically pissed off and imitates Miu's movements, knocking Aisha out of the fight.

name: Arez Schaur
description: A talented magician of the magic tower; Daphne Schaur's older brother

name: Koyuki Honami
description: She's the president of Nanahama High School's Aquarium Club. Her peers see her as out of reach, and by behaving in line with that impression others have of her, she feels a little smothered and lonely.

appearsIn.title: A Tropical Fish Yearns for Snow

name: Konatsu Amano
description: She's a high school first-year student who transfered into Nanahama High School. While she was having trouble blending in with those around her, she met Koyuki, the sole member of the Aquarium Club and later joined the club.

appearsIn.title: A Tropical Fish Yearns for Snow

name: Kaede Hirose
description: She's Konatsu's classmate. She has a cheerful personality and she has a lot of friends. She's friendly even to Konatsu who arrived as a transfer student.

appearsIn.title: A Tropical Fish Yearns for Snow

name: Dora-chan
description: A pixie dragon that Mukouda took as his third familiar. Despite his very small stature, he is very strong when it comes to combat. Dora can use all kinds of elemental magic, such as fire, wind, water, earth and thunder.

appearsIn.title: Campfire Cooking in Another World with My Absurd Skill

name: Ranma Saotome
description: Training with [Genma](https://anilist.co/character/9913) at Jusenkyou in China, Ranma was thrown into a spring called Nyanniichuan. He emerged as a young girl, according with the spring's curse. When splashed with hot water, he changes back to a boy, but when splashed with cold to room temperature water, he turns into a girl again. As for our well-built 16-year-old hero/heroine, the martial arts is his life. He also possesses a rather large and easily wounded ego, believing his physical strength to be his only virtue. Whenever his pride is damaged, Ranma feels the need to rectify the situation, even when it's not necessarily in his best interest to do so.

name: Akane Tendou
description:
**Occupation**: Material arts student, sports
**Weapon**: Large, wooden mallet.

Akane Tendo is the youngest of [Soun Tendo](https://anilist.co/character/9215/Soun-Tendo)'s three daughters and one of the heirs to the Anything Goes School of Martial Arts.

While Akane is generally shown as compassionate and helpful towards anyone in trouble, she's also a vulnerable, stubborn, relentless, and very short-tempered girl. She frequently becomes angry and jealous, and is apt to hit Ranma, often a reaction to Ranma's own bad traits like his smart mouth and insensitivity, but also due to rampant paranoia and willingness to generally believe the worst of the situations she finds him in. Despite her temper, Akane has a more prominent gentle side. She has come to the aid of her rivals, even consistently feeling compassion towards or helping people who try to make her life miserable. Most of her flaws can be attributed to insecurities about her own attractiveness, skill, or lack of traditionally feminine talents.

name: Orochi
description: The Eight Headed Orochi is a large dragon that lives in Ryugenzawa. The moss from his body is what creates the Water of Life that Shinnosuke needs to live.

name: Sayuri
description: Akane's friend

name: Cologne
description: Cologne is the great-grandmother of Shampoo. She accompanies Shampoo on her return to Japan, and opens the Cat Café in Furinkan. She is a contemporary of Happosai, and well over one hundred years old. She calls Ranma "bride-groom" and "son-in-law" due to her attempts to have him marry Shampoo, and just to watch him become enraged. She is a grand master of martial arts, and occasionally teaches Ranma and his rivals new techniques. She gets around by pogoing on a gnarled wooden staff that she sometimes uses as a weapon.  She is the grand master of the Chinese Amazon martial arts, allowing her to manipulate water and ice, create whirlwinds using an opponent's aura against them, shatter inanimate objects with a simple touch, and touch pressure points to make a person feel like they are burning with even the slightest amount of heat. Cologne is knowledgeable in several other disciplines such as arcane lore, cooking, Chinese mythology, and magic artifacts.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Tatewaki Kunou
description: Tatewaki Kuno is an upperclassman at Furinkan High and was the big man on campus – at least until Ranma came along. Hailing from a very wealthy family, he is also captain of the kendo club and wields both his fortune and sword with equal ease. Given to spouting off Shakespearesque poetry (he quotes Confucius in the Japanese original), he is madly in love with Akane. He also falls for Ranma’s female half and never realizes that she is really his mortal enemy in girl form. He once overhears her called by name, and attempts to write it down for future reference, but never makes a connection and continues to refer to her as a "goddess in pig-tails" for the entire series. (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Nodoka Saotome
description: Nodoka is Ranma's loving mother. She hasn't seen him and Genma in over a decade though, when they left on their training trip. Stating that a doting mother would hinder Ranma's training, Genma made a contract with her to raise Ranma as "man amongst men", and if he failed, he and Ranma were to commit seppuku. However, because Ranma's curse makes him a woman half the time, they spent most of Nodoka's appearances hiding from her as Ranko Tendo and her pet, Mr. Panda. Nodoka's heart was constantly broken by knowing that she wanted nothing more than to see her son again. Eventually in the manga, she did meet Ranma and Genma and discovers their curses. However, she was more accepting than they expected. Mostly because she eventually began to suspect that Ranma and Ranko were, in fact, the same person.  (Wikipedia)

name: Happousai
description: Soun and Genma trained during their youths with the evil and perverted Happosai. The little man is THE master of Anything Goes Martial arts (Musabetsu Kakutō Ryū). He is also a panty thief and lecher beyond belief. In return for training, he berated and cajolled his two unwilling students into helping him with his panty raids and peeping expiditions. More often than not, they would end up humiliated or injured in the process. Once they had finally finished their training (ie: escaped) they were able to get on with their lives. That is, until Happosai returned to select the next Anything Goes master.   What he found when he reached the Tendou Dojo was Ranma. Disgustingly enough, Happosai leched onto girl-type Ranma, even though he knows Ranma is a boy.   Taking up residence at the Tendou Dojo, he began extending Ranma's training. He also began to expand his panty raids into the surrounding neighborhood, as well as the Tendou girls' bedrooms.   Happosai is a tiny, yet immensely powerful martial artist. He usually wears a purple coverall, or occasionally a green bathing suit. When on his panty raids, he often wears a scarf as a mask. He is bald, with white fringes and a white moustache.   Happosai is a master martial artist and deceptively strong for his size. His only real weakness is his perverted nature. Happosai would leap in front of a speeding train for a pair of girl's panties.

name: Mousse
description: Mousse is a long-time friend of Shampoo, though she might not view it that way. He has been in love with her for most of his life, but she finds him annoying at best. He can't see very well without his glasses, often mistaking someone for something else. He comes to Nerima in search of this "new fiancé" that Shampoo has, and he stays to attempt to woo his sweetheart. Shampoo rebuked his advances when they were children and this still holds true by Amazon law, even if he manages to defeat Ranma in combat, but he remains persistent. Now a waiter at the Cat Café, he turns into a duck thanks to his own Jusenkyo curse. When in human form, his clothes contain weapons of drastic proportions, including needles, chains, swords, bombs, household appliances, and just about anything else imaginable. In duck form, Mousse can hide knives in his feathers.       (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Mama
description: She worries deeply about her son who never wants to go outside and play.

name: Chikan Otoko
description: The protagonist of Chikan Otoko. Molester man is a pet otaku with no friends. One night on his way back home, he is mistaken as a stalker of Miss Understanding.

name: Kanchigai
description: Mistakes Molester Man as a stalker. However, she later comes to understand the circumstances, and becomes friends with him.

name: Kansai
description: Kansai is friends with Miss Understanding and Yamaoka, and best friends with Loli. She cares deeply for her friends and goes out of her way to help them.

name: Loli Kyonyuu
description: Friends with Miss Understanding, Yamaoka, and best friends with Kansai. Works at the same family restaurant as them.  Named as such by Molester Man due to her short stature and large bust size.

name: Megane
description: A man who helps Molester man and Miss understanding throughout the beginning of the manga, however he falls off later on. He gives Molester Man a crab.

name: Yamaoka
description: Friends with Miss Understanding, Kansai, and Loli. Works at the same family restaurant as them.

name: Sachiko
description: She is Molester Man's onahole that manifests into a human form.

name: Takakazu Abe
description: An auto-mechanic experienced in homosexual sex, he often spends his time on a park bench looking for partners, and then having sex with them in the nearby public washroom which is famous for being a meeting area for homosexual men. In Chikan Otoko he is the manager of a family restaurant where the main characters love interest work at. He is shown to have the same personality as the first manga he appeared in.

name: Boon
description: A Japanese middle school student in "It Seems Boon was Being Bullied", but a high school student in "Tsunbaka".

name: Sousuke Mihara
description: Sousuke is a first year student and the only male member of the three person Third Newspaper Club. He can usually be found sleeping in the Third Newspaper Clubroom, or in the company of the club's third year member and president Sasaha Sahara. He holds great respect for his senior and club mate Momoe Okonogi.

name: Minato Okiura
description: Minato is a third year senior student who Sousuke and Teiichi suddenly meet one day during the course of their investigation into a mystery. She is a member of the art club. Minato sports a hairstyle with twin pigtails.

name: Sasaha Sahara
description: A third year student who is the Third Newspaper Club's president.

name: Ryouka Takamatsu
description: The school infirmary's doctor. 15 years ago, she was also a student in the school.

name: Yuuto
description: A first year student who sits in front of Teiichi in class. He is a close acquaintance of their classmate Haruka Yoshizawa from before middle school.

name: Taengi
description: Hyeon-U's pet.

name: Marik Ishtar
native: マリク・イシュタール
description: The holder of the Millennium Rod. Marik's family has guarded the tomb of the pharaoh for generations. He attempts to obtain the three God Cards through his secret organization, GHOULS, and become Pharaoh himself. Marik seeks to send the Pharaoh's soul into the darkness in which he had to spend his childhood.

name: Bobasa
description: Bobasa is a comic relief and a member of an Egyptian cult that protects the Millennium Items. He has the Scales and the Key.

name: Renzoku Bakudanma
description: In Episode 14 of "Yu-Gi-Oh!", when Anzu realizes that Yugi is her mysterious crush, Anzu invites him on a date to an amusement park, intending to put herself in danger to see Dark Yugi. But she finds herself in real danger when a mad bomber challenges Dark Yugi to a twisted game of balloons and explosions.     (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Kouga Amagi
description: Konoha's older brother, and grandson of Mitsugai Amagi. Both academically and sports-inclined, especially soccer. However, although he is popular with girls, he doesn't really know how to act around them, and Jin says he is "so honest, it hurts." Due to his attraction to an anime 'Ginga Choujin Alphasz', Kouga has developed a strong sense of justice since young. Urged by his encounter with Jin during a fire accident (caused by a Player) to become a hero of justice.      (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Konoha Amagi
description: A girl who has known Jin since they were children and harbors feelings for him. As daughter to Amagi Corp's president (Kouga's sister), she is unaware of the fact that Jin is Zet. They originally met when she and her mother were secretly giving out food to the homeless. Since then, due to many complicated events, they are now relatively close friends.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Jin Kanzaki
description: The main protagonist. A mysterious young man bearing a circular lump on the back of his left hand, Jin was a result of the Z.E.T. Project by the Amagi Corporation to create the perfect being to fight and destroy the escaped Players. Jin is able to transform a creature known as "ZET", a mutant possessing superhuman abilities, but often mistaken for another Player. The transformation is slow, though it may be accelerated due to extreme rage and conditions.The source of his strength appears to be the mysterious lump on his hand.   (Source: ytv ENGLISH)

name: Hanako Tanaka
description: A tomboyish teenage girl. She has had constant headaches since she was born, leading her to go to the nurse's office quite often as a result. Because of this, students thought she was just slacking off, and was bullied by them, leaving her traumatized and unwilling to go to high school. After this, her parents started becoming apathetic to her, forcing her to run away. She met Jin as he was living in the slum she ran away to.

name: Mitsugai Amagi
description: Founder of, and ex-CEO of the Amagi Corporation who believed in a distinct divide between the rich and the poor.  In the pursuit of his dream to create the perfect artificial humans, he initiated the N.E.T. Project, but it eventually led to the escape of his creations, named 'Players'. Having a heavy sense of responsibility for the incident, Mitsugai then commenced Project Z.E.T. to set things right, though once again his plans were foiled by the betrayal of Kanzaki. He then became hell-bent on retrieving ZET back after countless failures to create a new one.  Mitsugai's methods were often hard-handed, but after the destruction of his laboratory a second time by Players, he seems to have softened up, now giving Jin a choice of either becoming ZET or living as a normal human, though it is unknown if this is just a facade or not.  (source: Wikipedia)

name: Jirou Nakata
description: A former scientist of Amagi Corp. and an expert in researching the creation of the Players

name: Seizou Amagi
description: Son of Mitsugai, and father to Kouga and Konoha. Current CEO of the Amagi Corporation. Was named to be one of the masterminds of the Player Project by Jirou, but he feigns ignorance to all the various secret Projects under Amagi Corp.  (source: Wikipedia)

name: Seiji Haitani
description: Third-generation player, is the brain of EVOL. Haitani is a difficult character to understand, tricky, fake, cold, while reserving for Zetman some confidence in its potential, it is possible that, from time to time, deems it unnecessary to its purposes. Not afraid to let the world know the existence of EVOL and uses any means necessary to achieve its purpose.

name: Mayu Hashimoto
description: A teenage girl who is a fan of Kouga's. In the manga, she had a history of prostitution. She and many other women were invited to a "party hosted by Kouga," but created by Jirou Nakata as a way of bringing Kouga to his side.  Manga spoiler

name: Hayami
description: An executive in Amagi Corp. and assistant to Seizou, he supports Kouga's actions as Alphas to the fullest.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Theo Fumis
description: Young halfblood boy who loves books and wants to see the world.

name: Sedona  Bleu
description:
An Overseer who is part of an elite group of conservators, known as Overseers.
Comes from Aftzaak the capital of books and works in the Protections office branch.
Happens to befriend the young halfblood on their journey to the remote village.

name: Hodaka Saotome
description:
__Class:__ 1-D: Fashion
__Debut:__ Chapter 1

A first-year student reluctantly attending Moteshiro Prefectural High School. He is the only male student enrolled there and, as such, is frequently bullied by many of his 359 female schoolmates. Hodaka is initially shown to be both somewhat gullible and something of a pushover, as his classmates manage to coerce him into becoming a member of the class committee alongside his classmate, [Kasumi Takae](https://anilist.co/character/188748/Kasumi-Takae). Shortly afterwards, he finds himself being blackmailed by Kasumi, only to eventually be rescued by [Hanako Kuzuryuu](https://anilist.co/character/183999/Hanako-Kuzuryuu). Following this incident, he resolves himself to keep going to school no matter what his classmates do to him, simply wishing for his time there to be uneventful.

name: Hanako Kuzuryuu
description:
__Class:__ 1-B: Business
__Debut:__ Chapter 1

The titular character of the series and a first-year student attending Moteshiro Prefectural High School. Though she first appears rather hostile towards [Hodaka Saotome](https://anilist.co/character/183998/Hodaka-Saotome) after he first bumps into her, Hanako eventually steps in to save him from being blackmailed by [Kasumi Takae](https://anilist.co/character/188748/Kasumi-Takae). From then on, she becomes his friend and is rather protective of him.

Hanako is shown to be rather straightforward and confrontational, as she dislikes people who use tricks to prey on others. She's infamous among delinquents and troublemakers both inside and outside of her school, often being referred to by them as _Kuzuhana_ and _The 100 Slayer_.
