name: Ciel
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm (5'5")

Ciel is first presented as a senior attending the same school as the main protagonist [Shiki Tohno](https://anilist.co/character/2212/Tohno-Shiki), where she is the president and only member of the tea ceremony club, and also good friends with [Arihiko Inui](https://anilist.co/character/8830/Inui-Arihiko), [Satsuki Yumizuka](https://anilist.co/character/3263/Yumizuka-Satsuki) and Shiki himself. Her outward demeanor is that of a calm, friendly, and peaceful person. However, Ciel's true character is later revealed as the story progresses. 

She is a member of the Burial Agency, a secret organization within the Catholic Church made up of skilled assassins, feared even within the Church itself, known for showing no mercy and willing to do whatever it takes to get their task done even to the point of using forbidden magics and creatures. Her objective in Tsukihime is that of hunting down the heretic vampire [Roa](https://anilist.co/character/2218/Valdamjong-Roa-Michael), which while being a direct order from the church is also her own vendetta. In Melty Blood she has been ordered by the church to hunt down Roa.

name: Arcueid Brunestud
native: アルクェイド・ブリュンスタッド
description:
__Height:__ 167 cm

Arcueid Brunestud is the main heroine of Tsukihime, being the eponymous Moon Princess (月姫, Tsukihime).

Arcueid is a mysterious vampire princess. She lacks some vampiric qualities, such as that of needing to consume blood to survive (though she suppresses the desire), and being nocturnal. She seems to be quite knowledgeable about many things, but is portrayed as very naïve when it comes to modern ideas.

name: Akiha Tohno
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm

[Shiki](https://anilist.co/character/2212/Tohno-Shiki)'s younger sister and the current head of the Tohno family. She is very prim and proper and carries a grace and nobility about her.

name: Shiki Tohno
description:
__Height:__ 169 cm 

Shiki is the main character of the Tsukihime series. He is a kind, honest, if not slightly playful second-year high school student. He is anemic and is prone to fainting, but he tries his best to live a normal life. He has the Mystic Eyes of Death Perception (Chokushi no Magan), allowing him to see the "Lines" and "Points" that enable him to kill all things using the highly effective assassination techniques hidden in his subconscious. Despite being constantly surrounded by death he has a greater appreciation for life than most people and would never take a human life.

name: Arihiko Inui
description:
__Height:__ 174 cm

Inui Arihiko is Tohno Shiki's classmate and best friend. When Shiki was living with the Arimas, he often used to hang out with Arihiko. He has a competitive attitude against Shiki; Arihiko wants to get a girlfriend before Shiki does. As the player moves through the story, the player will discover that sometimes, Shiki cannot grasp how he became friends with Arihiko in the first place, since Shiki believes Arihiko has a "weird personality"; Yet at one point in the game, when Shiki collapses in class due to his condition, Arihiko is the one who loudly informs the teacher that Shiki is sick and needs to be excused. Arihiko then proceeds to help a physically-weakened Shiki to the medical office, thus demonstrating a personality trait that might, depending on the player's subjective perception, serve to explain why Shiki continues to be friends with Arihiko despite Arihiko's sometimes-callous behavior.

name: Michael Valdamjong
native: ミハイル・ロア・バルダムヨォン
description:
Nicknamed "The Serpent" for his reincarnation ability, Roa was a priest of the church that sought immortality and tricked [Arcueid](https://anilist.co/character/2213/Brunestud-Arcueid) into drinking blood hidden within a rose, causing her to go berserk and wipe out almost all the True Ancestors, and also turning Roa into one of the most powerful Dark Apostles, to the point where he was strong enough to defeat Altrouge Brunestud when she tried to "teach him a lesson" as the rest of the Dark Apostles saw him as a upstart. 

His original body was finally defeated by a coalition comprised of Arcueid and the Burial Agency, and he has been re-incarnating ever since then. By the time of Tsukihime he has already re-incarnated 17 times and been destroyed by Arcueid each time as she seeks to gain her stolen power back, and perhaps to achieve some measure of revenge. Roa has 2 requirements for choosing the host of his next reincarnation, his family must have a high social standing so he would be born into luxury, and a body with a high potential. His last host was [Ciel](https://anilist.co/character/2214/Ciel), who was chosen in haste and thus was born into a bakery's family but instead had a body with an extremely high physical and magical potential. Can be considered a friend or acquaintance of [Nrvnqsr](https://anilist.co/character/4264/Chaos-Nrvnqsr).

name: Hisui
description:
__Height:__ 156 cm

The younger of the two twin maids in the Tohno mansion, Hisui is a childhood friend of [Shiki](https://anilist.co/character/2212/Tohno-Shiki). She wears a western maid uniform and attends to Shiki when he comes back to the Tohno mansion. Her name, Hisui, is the Japanese word for jade, referring to her eye color.

name: SHIKI Tohno
description: SHIKI Tohno is Roa's 18th incarnation and can be considered "the real Shiki Tohno." SHIKI is not to be confused with Shiki Tohno; though both of them are named Shiki, the kanji in their names are different.

name: Kohaku
description: The older of the two twin maids in the Tohno mansion, Kohaku, along with [Hisui](https://anilist.co/character/2216/Hisui), is a childhood friend of [Shiki](https://anilist.co/character/2212/Tohno-Shiki). She wears a Japanese kimono and is always seen to be smiling and cheerful, being especially gifted with medicine. Her name, Kohaku, is the Japanese word for amber, referring to her eye color.

name: Satsuki Yumizuka
aliases: Ultimate Satsuki (アルティメットさつき)
description: [Shiki's](https://anilist.co/character/2212) classmate, who has had a crush on him since middle school. She takes a slightly larger role in Tsukihime the game and Melty Blood.

Mo Xuanyu was described as a lunatic by everyone who knew him, due to a combination of factors including his homosexuality, his interest in demonic cultivation, and the eventual mental break he suffered at the hands of his abusive family following his expulsion from the Lanling Jin Sect.

name: Fang-Fang Huang
description: He is an effeminate first-year student who debuts in chapter 23 of the second serialization. Fang-Fang is a Chinese yōkai whose father is the leader of a major Triad organization, and entered Yokai Academy to recruit powerful subordinates. He is a Yasha, and can summon other monsters to fight on his behalf, though only one can be summoned at a time and a major drawback to it is that they are summoned at random. He is occasionally accompanied by a giant panda, which he claims is his servant. His abilites are inherited from his father; however, he is also a powerful martial-artist, which his mother is. Fang-Fang is particularly interested in recruiting Tsukune, having heard of his taking out a human Yakuza group and mistakenly believing that he, not Gin and Haji, was responsible for destroying Fairy Tale's 7th Branch. When he first asked Tsukune to join, he accidentally painted himself as a homosexual. He has often had nosebleeds from the girls, suggesting he is not homosexual.After witnessing Inner Moka's power, he decides that Tsukune and Moka are an "invincible partnership" (also assuming without basis that Inner Moka is Tsukune's wife), and wishes to recruit them both. Recently, he knows of Moka's rosario when he heard a "creak" from the seal, and in chapter 28, he leaps for joy as he has friends over to his house for the first time.

name: Kokoa Shuzen
description:
__Height:__ 149 cm (4'8") 

Kokoa Shuzen is the younger half-sister of Moka Akashiya, sister of Karua Shuzen and stepsister of Akua Shuzen. Bearing a similar appearance to Moka with her green eyes, except for her orange hair and her "uncool" vampire attitude, she arrives as a first-year student at Yokai Academy during the second serialization and anime adaptation. Like her sister, Kokoa is also a vampire, but her powers are not sealed and does not carry the same level of supernatural strength that Moka possesses. To compensate for it, she has a pet bat named Kou that can transform into a variety of weapons and wields it with enough strength to make herself formidable.  Kokoa despises Moka for sealing away her inner personality, whom she adores and loves. Before Moka left to study at the academy and prior to her receiving the rosario, the sisters often clashed with one another, although Kokoa could never defeat Moka in a duel. She constantly attacks Moka, in hopes of drawing out the "Inner Moka", and feels angry that Tsukune has the ability to unlock Moka's true nature and begrudgingly accepts the presence of her sealed sister; though this softens to simply accepting both Mokas as her sister. Unlike Moka, Kokoa harbors a deep-seated fear of their older sister Kalua Shuzen. Known as the kindest amongst their family, Kalua continuously babies Kokoa and has a "smile of an angel", something Kokoa is frightened of as she is somewhat insane.

name: Kuyou
description: Head of the Student Police Committee, he enforces the group's rules with an iron fist. He is a kitsune, with many fire-based abilities, and can take on a hybrid form between his human and yōkai appearance.    from Wikipedia

name: Mawang
description: Demon King, he is an individual that only can be killed by a hero. He is also responsible for managing the demon realm's safety, and due to his long lifespan he has mastered all weapons techniques and arts. Furthermore, he was also the one that recruited Deon Hart, a human that he misheard as Demon Arut to become the specialized Zero Corp's Commander after witnessing Deon "kill" the Hero.

name: Eiji Busujima
description:
Eiji is an honest, straightforward and active young man whose actions often leads into misunderstandings due to his physical appearance, which causes his lack of friends. He is an ex-delinquent who joined the Literature club along with Nanako Yukishiro.

Hi is the older brother of [Hanabi Busujima](https://anilist.co/character/182636/Hanabi-Busujima).

name: Nanako Yukishiro
aliases: The Girl Who Calms the Waters
description: Nanako Yukishiro is a vibrant, cheerful high school girl. Nanako, however, carries one peculiar trait, instead of verbal communication, she pens senryu poems to express her thoughts and feelings. Nanako is outgoing, always wearing her heart on her sleeve.

name: Koto Ootsuki
description: Eiji's Childhood friend and an acting older-sister. Ootsuki Koto is mischievous and playful, often hanging out around Nanako and Eiji, teasing them every now and then. She often gives Nanako advice whenever Nanako asks for help. She is the president of the "Modern US army combative" club.

name: Komachi Akashi
description: Komachi loves literature. She harbors a crush on Eiji after he defends her from schoolyard bullies back in Middle School. Since then, she has greatly changed her appearance and strives to become the perfect delinquent to get Eiji's attention. Although she is pretending, she changes her attitude, to the way she dresses. She even goes as far to always wear a wig.

name: Asako Kura
description: Advisor of the Karai High Literature Club and a big airhead.

name: Amane Katagiri
description:
President of the literature club.

 She is close friends with Nanako and Eiji. Katagiri Amane is a hard working, diligent girl and quite the hopeless-romantic. She cares for her club members and even helps them when they have a problem.

(Source: Senryuu Shoujo Wiki)

name: Yoshihiko Yukishiro
description: Nanako and Hiro's father. He is often paranoid about his daughter's wellbeing.

name: Kino Yakobe
description: Yakobe Kino is a member of the Art Club. She is a shy and honest girl. Much like Nanako, Kino likes to use a sketchpad to show her expressions and communicate. She gets nervous whenever she sees a person eye-to-eye. Kino is best friends with Tao and even went on a trip together.

name: Tao Hanakai

name: Marcos Garcia
native: マルコス・エリングラッド・ガルシア
aliases: マルコス・E・ガルシア
description:
__Nationality:__ Gran Mexico
__Mars Ranking:__ #9 
__Height:__ 174 cm 
__Surgery Base:__ Huntsman 

Born in the cartel-dominated North of Gran Mexico. He lived with his mother for a long time, knowing nothing about his father, other than that he was a gangster. At the age of 6, he met Alex at his mother's former workplace.  

Has experience with nearly part-time jobs, but always started skipping work a few days (or minutes) after payday. Went along with Alex's plan, hoping to find honest work and Sheila.

He loves fried chicken, dislikes customers who order tobacco under an alias (especially Sagittarius), and enjoys playing the guitar in his free time.

name: Akari Hizamaru
description:
__Nationality:__ Japan 
__Mars Ranking:__ #6 
__Height:__ 177 cm 
__Surgery Base:__ Bagworm (Psychidae) 

Akari Hizamaru is a Japanese boy and a martial artist. After the death of his childhood friend, he chose to join the Annex Project to find the cure of the deadly A.E. virus that afflict the Earth. He is also one of the few people who were born Post-Surgery and inherited the Mosaic Organ.

He was born with a densely muscled build, likely inherited from a member of Bugs II crew (one of his parents had the bug surgery). He is trained in Martial Arts at dojo run by diretor of orphanage (although it was described as "karate" in the foreign underground ring, it is actually an old form of Jui-Jitsu).

He loves anything filling, has a strong dislike for cockroaches, and enjoys illustration and reading. He considers August 2 as his birthday.

name: Michelle Davis
native: ミッシェル・K・デイヴス
description:
__Nationality:__ United States 
__Height:__ 164 cm 
__Surgery Base:__ Blast Ant Paraponera 

The only daughter of [Donatello K Davis](https://anilist.co/character/68659/Davis-K-Donatello), the captain of Bug II. Like [Akari](https://anilist.co/character/81849/Hizamaru-Akari), she did not have many friends due to her genetics. Her mother is healthy. According to researchers, her ground state is more insect-like than Akari's. Worried over how her mother once looked at her music player, she said, "Girls shouldn't be listening to this stuff all the time," and added Canadian pop. E Cup, but somewhat firm.

She enjoys anything filling and has a strong dislike for overly peppy college students.

name: Alex Stewart
native: アレックス・K・スチュワート
aliases: アレックス・カンドリ・スチュワート
description:
__Nationality:__ Gran Mexico 
__Mars Ranking:__ #12 
__Height:__ 186 cm 
__Surgery Base:__ Harpia (Type of Bird)

Moved to his father's hometown in northern Gran Mexico at age 7, following his mother's death and met Marcos there. Has greatly admire major leaguers ever since he saw one of their games with his parents. Worked as paper boy when he was 12 years old, but made only meager wages.  

Joined the Annex Project for Sheila and to get his American citizenship. Throws with his right hand and bats with his left.

He loves pizza, dislikes owners who don’t tame their dogs, and has a talent for spotting photoshopped images on DVD covers and similar media.

name: Shokichi Komachi
description:
**Nationality:** Japan 
**Height:** 187 cm

description:
Liu Yiwu  is a Chinese officer in Annex I. He was appointed as the leader of the Sino-Asian Squad #4 when they crashed on Mars. Liu is a very tall man with black hair and a large beard. He has black eyes and always wears glasses.
While at first he was the least characterized officer in the Annex, usually staying in the background and not standing out too much (despite being the tallest person in the Annex), after his betrayal was exposed, he revealed his confident and ruthless personality. He has shown to be tolerant of his subordinates minor blunders (such as Hong's), but he also has showed respect to a fallen adversary (Alexander Asimov).
Liu was born in a less-affluent, abandon area but despite this he entered the military after graduating at the top of his college class thanks to his hardworking attitude and connections. At the age of 24 he married the daughter of a high official and after his hard work in the army he was chosen for the Annex Project. It is revealed later that Zhang Ming-Ming was his crush and childhood friends.
Liu is an officer and also be considered one of the strongest members of Annex I despite his low M.A.R.S Ranking. After receiving his M.O. Operation Liu gained the powers and abilities of the blue-ringed octopus, allowing him to make use of the extremely potent tetrodotoxin which causes paralysis. description: Tsubaki's elder sister. She considers it her duty to raise her brother properly in place of their deceased mother, and refuses to consider getting married until he graduates and finds a job. She spends her time housekeeping. Tsubaki's occasional strange behavior from the effects of Urabe's saliva sometimes makes Youko worry about her brother.

name: Kouhei Ueno
description: A bespectacled friend and classmate of Tsubaki. He and Oka have been dating for about a year, but try to keep it a secret from their classmates. Only Tsubaki and Urabe (and later Hayakawa) are aware of their relationship. He often fondly recounts to Tsubaki his experiences with Oka; Tsubaki in turn gets romantic ideas to use on Urabe from Ueno's stories. He also seems to possess a possessive style as he won't take Oka to the beach because other guys will see her in a bikini and jealous when other guys talk to her.

name: Momoka Imai
description: A media idol who looks almost identical to Urabe, except that she has brown hair and a much smaller breast. She makes an appearance in Chapter 37, and seems to have much more in common with Urabe than one would expect, though more energetic. Like how Urabe uses scissors on people, she kicks, though she wears restraints, however both are located where their panties are. She sought out Urabe in hopes she will agree to her plan of switching between model and student, however Urabe completely turns her down. After accidentally knocking her out (and Urabe cutting off all of her clothing), she discovers the difference in their breast sizes, seeming to have a changed her mind after discovering this. After seeing Urabe and Tsubaki's bond, she goes with her promise and lets go of her plan to switch places, however not before stealing Urabe's uniform and going to make Tsubaki taste her drool. It is revealed she wanted to become a "normal" girl due to an incident with a boy she had a crush on before she became famous. Then after being discovered and becoming famous, she finally gained up the courage to confess her feelings to him, but before they kissed he asked if he could tell his friends he was dating a famous girl. Realizing he only liked her because she was famous, high kicked him in the head.   (Source: Wikipedia)

Although everyone else in the club laughed at him, Matsuzawa was astonished to find someone else who shared her taste in movies, and she began developing a crush on him.

name: Yuzuki Eba
description:
__Height:__ 155 cm

Yuzuki moved from Tokyo to her father's hometown. She is staying with the Kirishimas, who are her father's acquaintances. She has a sociable personality and gets along with others easily. She confesses that she likes Haruto, but it does not prevent her from helping [Haruto](https://anilist.co/character/17402/Kirishima-Haruto) get closer to [Nanami](https://anilist.co/character/17403/Kanzaki-Nanami).

name: Haruto Kirishima
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm

The male protagonist of the series. He has a reserved personality, which causes him to become perturbed by Yuzuki and his sister's actions. He has a very strong sense of responsibility and consideration for others. He became a member of the school cooking club because he thought that Nanami would also join.  Before the series, he always lived in his hometown. He met a lost Yuzuki during the festival while they were children; he took care of her and told her that if she ever had problems she could come see him again. Entering in middle school he secretly had a crush on Nanami.  At the beginning of the series when Yuzuki had come to his house, he was irritated with her and did not remember meeting her before. But he becomes protective of her and they become good friends. Thanks to Yuzuki he gets closer to Nanami and finally confesses his love to her, but Nanami replies that she wants them to stay friends and tells him that she wants more time to think. Yuzuki also confesses her love to him, saying that he'll fall for her eventually, but she believes that first he'll end up with Nanami.

name: Rin Eba
description:
__Height:__ 148 cm 

Itsuki's younger sister and Yuzuki's step-sister, who is a year older than her. She is quite fond of her older brother, and is irritated by Yuzuki, saying that she acts nice just for attention. She has also been known to tell lies in order to make Yuzuki upset. She seems to mischievous and loves to cause trouble. She shows a slight interest in Haruto.

name: Nanami Kanzaki
description:
__Birthplace:__ Hiroshima 
__Height:__ 161 cm 

She is Haruto's classmate and love interest since middle school. She has a modest personality and is somewhat insecure as she once stated that she felt like an outsider with Haruto, Yuzuki, Takashi, and Akari.

name: Chisa Miyanaga
description: Eba Yuzuki's student in high school where she is a teacher who had a love for Haruto.  She did not know her teacher and her love were related. After the misunderstanding solved and the acceptance that she could not with Yuzuki, Chisa understood and asked if Eba still give it to her classroom with her sensei answered: Of course it does. The two became friends after that.

name: Ayano Fujikawa
description: Yamato's aunt, who is the landlady of the women’s dormitory and public bathhouse. She lets Yamato stay rent-free and pays him for cleaning. She seems to be close with her tenants and is even proud of their accomplishments. She often cooks meals for her nephew and Suzuka. Yamato's mother revealed that her marriage was an elopement. Even though her husband is deceased, she continues to wear her wedding band.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Narumi Kanzaki
description: He is Nanami's elder brother. He was introduced as Akari's love interest, but he likes Yuzuki. He is the captain of the baseball club and forced his younger sister to became its manager. He has recently been spending time with Yuzuki and even asks her to go to the Kouyasai although Yuzuki responds to this in a joking manner. After he overhears Haruto asking Yuzuki to go with him to the Kouyasai, he gives up on her and even encourages their relationship as he is seen forcing Haruto to accompany Yuzuki to the train station on the day of her departure back to Tokyo. As of the latest chapter, he has graduated from High School.  (source: Wikipedia)

name: Mina Nagoshi
description: Haruto's high school classmate in Tokyo. When Haruto asks her out to a festival visit at Yuzuki's school, she interprets it as a date and starts criticizing him, but later begins to feel sympathetic and mistakenly believes Haruto likes her, leading to confusion. She later gives up, and tells Haruto she is dating someone from another class, although she occasionally reappears from a distance, and misinterprets more of Haruto's actions. At college, she meets Haruto as a member of their Outdoor Circle, whose leader thinks she's a bit strange. Haruto updates her on his current life and tries to tell her about Yuzuki, but, due to a bad choice of words, along with Mina's misunderstanding and Haruto never mentioning Yuzuki by name, Mina believes Haruto wants to date her, and was displeased when Haruto never called her.

name: Shiho Amagi
description:
__Height:__ 164cm 

Shiho is the head chef at the Haruto's part-time summer job in chapters 62-65.  She immediately catches Haruto's attention with her beauty but soon shows her serious side once work begins. She takes work very seriously because she wants to become a professional chef. She believes the quality of the food for the customer must not be sacrificed because they are in a rush. Food must be cooked right and taste the same everytime it is prepared.   In the kitchen, Shiho is strict and complains about and orders Haruto around to push him to his limits of tolerance. She develops trust in his abilities when letting him cook but puts him down every time she makes him return to washing dishes after messing up. However, during his time there, in and out of work, she repeatedly shows a kinder side by offering him a snack to refresh his energy and compliments him for his endurance and dedication. Shiho develops quiet, one-sided feelings for Haruto after observing him work, admiring his integrity in cooking, and dedication to Eba. She becomes flustered when Haruto compliments her cooking and skills and says she is jealous of Eba. In the end, Shiho remains quiet of her growing feelings and wishes Haruto luck on his long-distance relationship, believing they can last a year with ease.

Ryuunosuke Mogumo's childhood friend who frequently takes care of them. Kotone is very attached to Mogu and doesn't want them to be anything besides a girl, directly clashing with Tetsu and how he supports Mogu being non-binary.

name: Satori Iwaoka
description:
__Height:__ 173 cm (5'8")

Tetsu's older sister and the owner of the maid café "Question". She is a transgender woman.

appearsIn.title: Love Me for Who I Am

name: Sakura Mogumo
description:
__Height:__ 155 cm (5'1")

Ryuunosuke's younger sister.

appearsIn.title: Love Me for Who I Am

name: Ayumu
description: Satori's friend who is also a transgender woman. Ayumu loves makeup and skin care, and is the one who taught Satori how to do makeup in the past. She's a dependable person and a mentor to Mei.

appearsIn.title: Love Me for Who I Am

name: Kame-chan
description: A photographer who helps taking Ten-chan's pictures when he is cosplaying.

appearsIn.title: Love Me for Who I Am

name: Na-Ri Yu
description: Na-Ri Yoo is the little sister of [Da-Hee Yoo](https://anilist.co/character/246583/DaHui-Yu).

name: Si-Rin Cha
description:
__Affiliation:__ Team DO (Former)

She has had a talent for games since childhood, and because of that talent, she doesn't get along well with others.

From her days as a promising player before her pro debut, perfect self-management, schedule and training, and high performance to match, she has done everything. Even so, it is said that she could not find a smile on her face. However, thanks to Song Eun-Sa, whom she met while preparing to become a pro gamer, she realizes that her talent is a gift. As soon as she debuted, she won the championship, so she is a top-tier player called the Empress. As she is a rare female player in her industry, her popularity is at an all-time high both at home and abroad.

name: Nokoru Mitsuhashi
description: A systems engineer who is currently working from home. He is Izumi Natsu's neighbor.

name: Natsu Izumi
description: An outgoing graduate student studying archeology. She is the neighbour of Nokoru Mitsuhashi.

name: Mahiro Oyama
description: He was a hikikomori neet and loner, until he woke up one morning as a little girl thanks to his [younger sister](https://anilist.co/character/130823/Oyama-Mihari) drugging him.

name: Mihari Oyama
description: [Mahiro](https://anilist.co/character/130822/Oyama-Mahiro)'s little sister. A genius scientist that skipped grades and is now attending college. She is responsible for drugging Mahiro, turning him into a young girl.

name: Kaede Hozuki
description: Kaede is a close personal friend of [Mihari](https://anilist.co/character/130823/Oyama-Mihari). They became friends in middle school. Mihari has progressed further in the academic system than Kaede, but they still are close, and see each other regularly.

name: Chitose Azuma
description: Chitose is [Mihari](https://anilist.co/character/130823)'s senpai from their college. She is supposedly related to [Nayuta](https://anilist.co/character/190203) in some way, whether it be by blood or some other way is yet to be confirmed.

name: Miyo Murosaki
description:
Miyo-chan is a classmate of Mahiro in middle school. She is friends with [Mahiro](https://anilist.co/character/130822/Oyama-Mahiro) and [Asahi](https://anilist.co/character/130824/Ouka-Asahi). Miyo-chan is somewhat quiet and shy, and many times does not express herself verbally. However, she likes to hug and embrace her girl school friends, and takes a great interest in them and their activities.

She has become particularly interested in Mahiro, although she is younger then her by a couple of years. Miyo-chan seems to be socially interested only in girls, and limits her time and attention to only select girls.

She gives the appearance of showing her love and affection as a Shoujo Ai or Yuri shipping (girl with girl relationships). As such, Miyo-chan is always quick to ascribe a Yuri motive to any two girls talking or playing around with one another, as she likes to watch, on the side, such social interplay. But when another girl interacts or shows an interest in her, Miyo-chan, she is also quick to assign a Yuri motive, where in reality, no such Yuri shipping probably exists.

name: Rido Kuran
description: Rido Kuran is a pureblood vampire, Senri Shiki's father, elder brother to Haruka and Juri Kuran. Shizuka Hio was his fiancée. He is the main antagonist of the story. According to Asato Ichijo, he is the true head of the Kuran family. Secretly aided by the Ancient Vampire Council and the Hunters' Association, Rido manipulates events from the shadows by transferring his soul to other bodies and taking control. Rido possesses eyes of two different colors (crimson and blue), and when his soul is transferred to a different body, that body has eyes of two different colors.

name: Sayori Wakaba
description: __Height__: 162 cm    Yuuki's dorm-mate and best friend since junior high, Yuuki often refers to her as Yori-chan. Yori seems to be one of the few girls who is not interested in the Night Class. She finds them a bit scary and stated that she would prefer someone from the day class. Yori is also very observant, as she notices a lot of things that happen to Yuuki, especially when she gets hurt or is very depressed.  Yori's part in the story is relatively small. She spends a lot of time worried about Yuki not geting enough sleep and having nightmares. She teases Yuki when Ichiru reveals that Zero  has feelings for Yuki and confirms Yori's suspicions, although the whole matter isn't clear to Yuki.

name: Shizuka Hio
description: The pureblood vampire who bit Zero; even her fellow vampires are uneasy around her. She is called "Mad Blooming Princess" by her fellow vampires. A manservant whom she loved (a former human vampire; said to have never fallen to Level E) was killed by a Kiryu vampire hunter. In retribution, she attacked the Kiryu family, killed the parents, turned their son Zero into a vampire, and took Zero's twin, Ichiru, in as a devoted servant.

name: Maria Kurenai
description: Maria Kurenai is a very distant relative of Shizuka Hio. She allows Shizuka to possess her body in exchange for being allowed to drink Shizuka's blood, which would strengthen her sickly body. Due to Shizuka's untimely death, this promise is never fulfilled. She seems to be fond of Ichiru, hugging Zero when she mistakes him for Ichiru, and asks Yuki to tell Zero that if he sees Ichiru, to tell him Maria wants to see him again.

name: Asatou Ichijou
description: Asato Ichijou often referred to as Ichio, is Takuma's grandfather and a member of the Vampire Council. He wanted to become Kaname's guardian after the death of Kaname's parents, but Kaname did not accept. He allows Takuma to attend Cross Academy for the purpose of spying on Kaname. His age and demeanor brings fear to many vampires, though Aido and Ruka openly confront him when Asato implies his desire to drink Kaname's blood.

name: Gang Ryong
description: Disciple of Dokgo Ryong, the Absolute One.

name: Ye-Mong Hong
aliases: The Ice Jade Empress of the Fan

name: Yong-Bi
description: Yong-Bi is a senior member of the old Murim, being a part of the Sage Forest. In the past, he was a bounty hunter and once served as the Black Lancers' Lord Commander and as a general under the Grand General's Command (대장군부, Daejang-gunbu), the most powerful military organization in the country which was under the direct command of the Emperor.

name: Ga-Ryeong Jin
description: Jin Garyeong is the current Lady of the Baekma Valley having inherited the position from her mother.

name: Nana Chigusa
description: Nana Chigusa, Student of Class A, part of the track team and Student Council VP, is a very popular and beautiful girl. With so much riding on her, a teacher suggests she find a way to take a breather. When she is given Kaoru's toys to hold on to as a punishment by Kaoru's mother, she inadvertently locks herself into the leather outfit therein, starting the story...

name: Kaoru Sugimura
description: Kaoru is a 17-year-old virgin whose main hobby is S&M; in particular, the purchase of S&M gear since he doesn't have a partner. Nana is his perfect next door neighbor. The two have been close since the first grade due to the fact they both have single parents who work a lot. Kaoru is secretly in love with Nana and likes to fantasize about her in tandem with his S&M gear. One day his mother decides to get rid of all his gear and asks Nana to hold on to it overnight so Kaoru won't be able to find it and hide it. Later that night Nana inadvertently locks herself into one of Kaoru's leather outfits that she had been trying on "for size" and is forced to ask Kaoru for help unlocking it...

name: Hiroshi Yagami
description: The student council president. At the start of the story his grades are just a bit better then Nana's but she starts to over take him after finding a way to relieve stress. He is in love with Nana but has yet to tell her and she appears to be unaware of the fact. He does not even consider Kaoru an obstacle to Nana, despite them being childhood friends, until his sister tells him there is something going on between them (for a price). It also doesn't help his chances that Nana's best friend has a massive crush on him.

name: Shinobu Chigusa
description: Nana's mother. She is chief of the police security department and is well respected. Unfortunately this makes her a very busy woman and is almost never home. Still she loves her daughter very much and will drop work for a bit when she truly needs her. It appears that Nana as learned many of her personality traits from her and there are many similarities between the two of them. This includes their inability to cook almost anything. A few years back she and Nana's father got divorced. It is unclear why or what he is doing now. Despite not being around she understands how much Kaoru cares for Nana and has entrusted him to look after her in her absents.

name: Yukari Mutsuka
description: Nana's best friend and is on the student council with her. She has made no secret of her distaste for Kaoru and has trouble getting his name right. This may be intentional as she had no problem getting it right when she was afraid she had offended his "girlfriend" after bad mouthing Kaoru. She has a massive crush on Hiroshi, but has not made her feeling on that clear to anyone other than Nana. She has a small dog named Hiro. She is seen walking him sometimes as a minor plot device.

name: Waka Sugimura
description: Kaoru's mother. She loves her son but still angers him from time to time. She will often enter his room without knocking, prompting him to yell at her. She will also clean up his room sometimes and tells him off for buying all that “junk” in the mail. It looks like she is a widow. Although she is not a busy as Nana's mother, she is often away at work.

name: Ryouko Tachi
description: A girl Kaoru meets one day while he's on one of his early morning stamina building runs.  Kaoru mistakes her for a boy until she mentions participating in a heptathlon, the female version of a decathlon. Annoyed at the misunderstanding and/or her lack of an obvious chest, she shows him her modest cleavage as proof of her gender.

name: Mitsuko Tachibana
description: Tachibana runs the SM store that Kaoru frequently shops at. She has vast knowledge of SM and teaches Nana about various things involved in the life style. Often seen being sort of a mentor to both Nana and Kaoru.    Little is said about Tachibana in the main series of Nana to Kaoru, however in the spin off 'Arashi' more in revealed. She majored in Japanese history at Todai,  studying culture and customs since the Meiji period. She even went to grad school.

name: Kikuko Yagami
description:
Hiroshi’s big sister. Like her brother, she is very intelligent and was the student council president before him.

She has more then just book smarts going for her. She is able to read people and was able to tell something is going on between Nana, Kaoru, and Tachi by the way they acted around each other but is frustrated for being unable to tell exactly what it is.

name: Lily
description:
An overworked succubus. Despite her impersonal approach to her job, she ends up taking a liking to [Kuroki](https://anilist.co/character/144667/Tsutomu-Kuroki) and becomes emotionally invested in their relationship.

According to [Shet](https://anilist.co/character/158806/Shet), she has terrible taste in clothes.

name: Tsutomu Kuroki
description:
An overworked but good-natured Japanese office worker that [Lily](https://anilist.co/character/144666) takes a liking to. Due to his mid-level position, he's often forced to relay information from higher-ups to his juniors and aid them in communicating with their seniors, which makes it harder for him to do his own job in time, often forcing him to do unpaid overtime. 

Much to Lily's frustration, most of his requests for her are extremely down-to-earth (and often related to his nostalgic memories from early childhood) rather than sexual in nature.

name: Shet
description:
[Lily](https://anilist.co/character/144666)'s coworker from the lesbian department, which was created in order to extract life force from women as a result of declining birthrates. According to Lily, she speaks like an old man when discussing the women she chooses.

She seems to be afraid of cats.

name: Maha Kachou
description: [Lily](https://anilist.co/character/144666)'s supervisor and [Shet](https://anilist.co/character/158806)'s coworker. A lazy and easygoing succubus who naps a lot, to the point of neglecting her work duties. She's also responsible for watching over potential future clients, making sure they don't get into pornography too early in their lives.

appearsIn.title: The Mortifying Ordeal of Being Seen
The Mortifying Ordeal of Being Seen

name: Kiriha
description:
Kiriha is a tsukumogami of a double-woven obi of pure silk.

In her human form, Kiriha appears as a young girl with long light blue hair. She has light skin, red eyes, and pointed ears. She retains the same scent of Sakura that was always present on her as an obi as well.

Kiriha is a straightforward and eccentric tsukumogami with a very unusual personality. She's boastful and self-centered, mostly impulsively acting based on how she feels with little concern over the consequences. Kiriha is bossy and likes to be the one in charge of making decisions, disliking following orders from others. Despite the fact that she is a mostly selfish individual in daily life, Kiriha is extremely loyal and is perfectly willing to trade her own life for the sake of those she cares the most about.

As a tsukumogami she fights alongside her owner, providing advice and support to her user even in the heat of the moment, and insists on making victory the primal objective without being concerned over her own safety. However, Kiriha heavily dislikes the idea of being used as a tool rather than as a partner. This is why she hates to be forcefully ordered with her true name.

name: Kazuya Kagami
description: Kazuya Kagami is the son of [Kanaka](https://anilist.co/character/128859/Kagami-Kanaka) and Kazuaki Kagami and younger brother of [Kasumi](https://anilist.co/character/128860/Kagami-Kasumi). Partnering with [Kiriha](https://anilist.co/character/126355/Kiriha), the tsukumogami of his mother's kimono obi, he works as Kamioka's exorcist. His sister refers to him under the petname Yakkun.

name: Kukuri
description:
Kukuri-Hime-no-Kami, better known simply as Kukuri, is the resident God of the Land of the Hakusan Shrine. She is one of many gods known as Kukuri, with this incarnation residing over Kamioka. She guards over the region, dispersing curse and assisting [Kazuya](https://anilist.co/character/126356/Kagami-Kazuya) in his job as an exorcist.

Due to her status as a God of the Land, Kukuri doesn't age, regardless of how much time passes. Instead, her appearance is tied to the amount of power she possesses, boasting a youthful but adult aspect when at full strength but rejuvenating when her power decreases. Some traits are consistently carried over, such as her green hair and blue eyes. She always sports the same attire consisting of an orange haori, a kimono jacket, and a pair of black hakama, divided trousers that extend all the way to the ankles. As well as a white bandana. Because of certain circumstances and, after her test to appoint Kazuya as the new Exorcist of Kamioka; Kukuri suffered a drastic change in looks that resemble that of a very young girl. In her daily life when not attending her duties as the Local God, she's also seen wearing all different kinds of casual clothing typical of girls of her physiological age.

name: Shinobu
description: Shinobu is a needle tsugumomo and member of Mayoiga.

name: Kyouka
description: Kyouka is a flute Tsugumomo that was member of Mayoiga. She was part of the Mayoiga Revolt, participating in the premature assassination attempt of the God of the Land of Kamioka Kukuri. During the Madarai Revolt, she entered a temporary contract with Kazuya Kagami, but later becomes one of his official partners.

name: Mimane Miyou
description: Mimane Miyou is a mirror tsugumomo and member of Mayoiga.

name: Chisato Chikaishi
description: Chisato Chikaishi is a childhood friend and classmate of [Kazuya Kagami](https://anilist.co/character/126356/Kagami-Kazuya).

name: Akito  Ashimine
description: Akito Ashimine is a scissor tsugumomo and sworn sibling of Arumi Ashimine and Hifumi. He and his sister Arumi joined the tsukumogami paradise Mayoiga after having spent decades being abused by cruel owners, and dedicated themselves to the organization in order to live free from humans.

name: Hibito Nanba
description: An extraordinarily talented astronaut, he was chosen to be the first Japanese person to go to the moon. He is known as the "Samurai Boy" in America, where he is very popular. He really wants Mutta to become an astronaut. He can play the guitar.

name: Mutta Nanba
description: He went to work for a car design company after graduation. When a manager insulted his younger brother, he gave him a head butt and was fired. After he gets a message from Hibito, he decides to try and become an astronaut.

name: Sharon Kaneko
description: __Height:__ 165 cm

name: Ena Kitamura
description: __Height:__ 163 cm

name: Michiko Komachi
description: JAXA's "mother."

name: Kenji Makabe
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm

One of Mutta's fellow applicants in the astronaut program, whom he befriended 10 minutes after finding out they are the same age. He often cheers Mutta up.
Dedicated, calm and supportive, he resides with his wife and daughter. He's almost always in formal attire and with a smile on his face.

name: Tamura
description: Appears in episode 2.

name: Yasushi Furuya
description:
__Height:__ 156 cm

One of the candidates for becoming an astronaut. Works with chimpanzees and always says what's on his mind out loud.

name: Cesar de Lehman Klein
description: The first prince, and a maid's son.

name: Canaria  Easter
description: She came from a household of aristocrats that had no power.

name: Jax Bernard
description: One of Ceasar's faithful subordinates.

name: Evgenia Paraim
description: The Empress and Noah's mother.

name: Miller Krauss
description: A mercenary and Caesar's closest confidant. One of Caesar's faithful subordinates.

name: Ethan Turner
description: Canaria's personal guard and Cesar's friend.

name: Oscar Heindel
description: Oscar is Empress Evgenia's aide.

name: Raya Vronhilt
description: Third son of a fallen noble family. One of Caesar's faithful subordinates.

name: Masha Pierre
description: Masha is an errand boy in noble society, who knows the tastes of all noble ladies. He helps Caesar pick a gift for Carnelia.

name: Yutaka Tachibana
description: A tsundere high school girl that becomes less tsun as each day goes by.

appearsIn.title: Ichinichi Goto ni Dere ga Fueteku Tsuntsuntsuntsuntsundere-chan

name: Keita Takahashi
description: Tachibana's classmate and the second main character.

appearsIn.title: Ichinichi Goto ni Dere ga Fueteku Tsuntsuntsuntsuntsundere-chan

name: Hitoshi Tachibana
description: Father of Yuu Tachibana and Hiro Tachibana.

appearsIn.title: Ichinichi Goto ni Dere ga Fueteku Tsuntsuntsuntsuntsundere-chan

name: Raven Balt
description: A former noble that fell to ruin after his household was accused of treason. He joined the Devil's Army as an ultimatum, where he survived a decade on the battlefield of demonic monsters. Driven solely by the goal of obtaining freedom and restoring his household to its former glory.

appearsIn.title: Duke Pendragon: Master of the White Dragon

name: Allen Pendragon
native: エレン・ペンドラゴン
description: The current heir of House Pendragon. Because of his failure to form a pact with [Soldrake](https://anilist.co/character/261207/Soldrake), he entered a prolonged coma for three years. He was timid around people, preferring to keep himself shut in his room. He lacked talent with the sword and other martial arts, and was considered a laughingstock for these reasons, bringing decline to the Pendragon name. For reasons unknown, [Raven](https://anilist.co/character/261210/Raven-Balt) woke up as him one day.

appearsIn.title: Duke Pendragon: Master of the White Dragon

name: Soldrake
description: The Queen of Dragons and the guardian deity of Ancona Forest. She has entered pacts with heirs of the Pendragon household for generations. The Pendragon's prosperity is linked to their pacts.

appearsIn.title: Duke Pendragon: Master of the White Dragon

name: Elkin Isla
description: He is Raven's knight and a Cavalier of Valvas. He pledged his allegiance to Raven after losing against him in a duel. He has a spirit that can tame and control griffons.

appearsIn.title: Duke Pendragon: Master of the White Dragon

name: Irene Pendragon
native: アイリーン・ペンドラゴン
description: Allen's younger sister.

appearsIn.title: Duke Pendragon: Master of the White Dragon

name: Elena Pendragon
native: エレーヌ・ペンドラゴン
description: Allen's mother.

appearsIn.title: Duke Pendragon: Master of the White Dragon

name: Luna Seylord
description: The adopted daughter of Count Seylord.

appearsIn.title: Duke Pendragon: Master of the White Dragon

name: Hiro Momose
description:
A first-year student in Class C at Narukino High School and a member of the Support Club.

During middle school, her clumsy and timid nature led her to be taken advantage of by delinquents; she was bullied and treated as a so-called “shuttle.” Because of that experience, she strongly dislikes delinquents. Upon entering high school, she resolved to put her past behind her and lead a normal, peaceful school life. After joining the Support Club, she becomes entangled with Ichikura when she discovers his secret—that he was once a delinquent himself—despite being a perfect model student who excels at both sports and academics.

She has a kind and pure heart—she can’t just walk past people in trouble without helping them. She’s also very honest and always speaks her mind. Momo’s ideal type is someone who is pretty, smart, athletic, fun, affectionate, and keeps their promises. When she gets excited, her voice tends to get really loud. She isn’t very good at studying.

appearsIn.title: Glasses With a Chance of Delinquent

name: Dan Ichikura
description:
A first-year student in Class C at Narukino High School and the president of the Support Club.

Diligent and quiet, Ichikura’s a model student in the same class as Momose. With his black curly hair and glasses, he has a neat appearance and is seen by those around him as the typical straight-A student. However, during his middle school years, he made a name for himself as a notorious silver-haired delinquent. At the time, he was famous for his fighting skills and was treated as a problem child. 

Striving to keep the promise he made to Momose—“I won’t fight anymore”—he appears somewhat intimidating and aloof on the surface, but in reality, he is a classic tsundere: highly responsible, kind-hearted, thoughtful, and always looking out for others. He also possesses a righteous and admirable character, never hesitating to step in and help when delinquents bully the weak. He generally seems to like cute things and seems to enjoy kissing.

appearsIn.title: Glasses With a Chance of Delinquent

name: Happy Girl
description: A girl that wishes that time would stop, so she could preserve her happy moments.

name: Shinigami Dog
description: A shinigami that takes on the form of dog.

name: Horita Tomotsugu
description: Horita is a boy who is quick to lose interest in things. He proposed to his college friend Yuriko to quit her indie band and go pro with him. She declined his offer at first, but after some incidents happened, she agreed. However, he didn't stay in the band for long and became an office worker through his father's connections later.

name: Yokoyama
description: Horita's friend. He becomes a manga assistant. His girlfriend breaks up with him, because she will be working in another prefecture and they won't be able to keep up the long-distance relationship.

name: Gloomy Girl
description: A high school girl taken hostage by Bear Bandit.

name: Noh Mask
description: A loner girl in class. Everyone calls her "Noh Mask" behind her back. Okazaki Sato is her only friend, but they don't talk at school.

name: Tamotsu
description: Endo's friend who dreams of becoming a photographer. Just like Endo, he fails his entrance exams for college.

name: Hozumi
description: The leader of the bullies that have been extorting money from Noda. He is the student body president of the school where Mariko works.

name: Sato Okazaki
description: A girl that used to be a loner and crybaby. Since middle school, she has worked hard to become a popular girl, even if she has to wear fake smiles.

name: Yuriko Togawa
description: Togawa Yuriko is a 23-year-old girl who quit college for "various reasons." Her friends seen her as a tomboy on whom they could always rely. She had feelings for Horita, but he never saw her as a woman. After her house was burned down by her neighbor, she decided to pursue a music career.

name: Seo-Cheon Ju
description: Seo-Cheon is the main protagonist of the story. In his past life he was an elder of the Mount Hua Sect that survived the "Age of War".

name: Hye Dang
description: Known as the Poisonous Phoenix of the 5 Dragons and 3 Phoenixes, Dang Hye is an elite that stands above all the other young prodigies in her generation. Not only is she exceptionally beautiful, she is also an extremely formidable martial artist from the Dang Clan.

name: So-Wol Nak
description: Top genius of the 4th generation Mount Hua Sect. The granddaughter of the Iron Blooded Blossom Sword.

name: Chiyome
description:
She looks like a ninja, a beast race with animal ears and a tail. A descendant of the Jinshin clan. She has infiltrated various places to release the oppressed beastmen, gathered information to rescue them. She met [Arc](https://anilist.co/character/161637/Arc) and others when she was looking for information in a place elven were hold captive. She's looking for the whereabouts of her brother, Sasuke.

"Chiyome" is not her real name, but one of the names inherited by excellent ninjas from generation to generation. Her real name is Mia.

name: Goemon
description: One of Chiyome's tribe members.

name: Thanatos Sylvius Hilk
description: He is the Pontiff of Holy Hilk Kingdom, and the mastermind behind the suppression and eradication of the Elves and Beastmen, along with destruction of many Kingdoms.

name: Zahar Baharov
description: He's a knight accompanying Ril

name: Akiko Hayashi
description: At the start of the series, Hayashi Akiko is a third-year high school student whose dream is to become a shoujo mangaka.

appearsIn.title: Blank Canvas: My So-Called Artist's Journey

name: Kenzou Hidaka
description: The teacher of the extramural art class which Akiko attends, known for his rough, pragmatic teaching style. He treats all of his students the same, whacking them with a bamboo sword when they mess up and making them repeat sketches until they get them right, in some cases for years. He is usually referred to as "sensei."

appearsIn.title: Blank Canvas: My So-Called Artist's Journey

name: Futami
description: Akiko's friend who suggests that Akiko starts going to Hidaka Kenzou's art class.

appearsIn.title: Blank Canvas: My So-Called Artist's Journey

name: Ha-Neul Yeon
description:
__Height__: 173 cm (5' 8.5")

Has been part of the photography club since his first year in high school. His hobby is taking pictures of his crush, Chan-Il.

name: Hyeon-Un Baek
description:
__Height__: 182 cm (6')

Chan-Il’s friend and the one who discovered Ha-Neul’s collection of photos.

name: Chan-Il Seong
description:
__Height:__ 185 cm (6'1)

Has been part of the photography club since his first year in high school, and is currently receiving lessons from [Ha-Neul](https://anilist.co/character/215421/Yeon-Ha-Neul).

name: Ri-In
description: A friend of Cirrus and the sister of Da-In.

name: Fiona
description: The final boss in the original novel. Being the illegitimate child of Count Green, she was subjected to a miserable childhood. However, unbeknownst to anyone, she carried a great talent for magic, which would earn her renown as a great mage. For unknown reasons, the author one day wakes up as her.

name: Abel Heylon
description: Duke of the North. He's Siegren's mentor and Fiona's benefactor. Though cold to outsiders, he shows a much warmer side of him to his allies, and especially Fiona, whom he regards as his daughter, even insisting on her calling him "father".

name: Siegren
description: The bastard child of the emperor, born to a commoner mother. He is Abel Heylon´s disciple.

name: Koushou Shinogi
description: The younger brother of Kureha, he fights using a technique called cord cutting which involves cutting your opponents nerves so they can't move. He does this because he was over shadowed by his older brother, Kureha, who always came to his rescue when they were children. Shinogi fought Baki in season 1 and was knocked out. In the Maximum Tournament, he fights his brother in round 1 who gives up after seeing Shinogi's resilience. In round 2, he fights Gouki Shibukawa and though he breaks Gouki's fake eye he still loses.    Source: wikipedia

name: Shouhei Toba
description: As a pro wrestler, it was very important for him to not disappoint his fans who loved him. Formerly, he used to treat pro wrestling as a form of game to entertain other people. After meeting with his master Rikigouzan, he started to look at wrestling differently and took it very seriously. When his master was murdered in a street fight, Toba found that his fighting workout were weak, and he started to training very hard. He decided that real pro wrestling should never lose, neither in the ring nor in the street. He very much appreciates Kanji Igari, with whom he had a competitive and friendly relationship. He also admitted to envying Kanji for having a less damaged body despite them being around the same age.

name: Yuujirou Hanma
description: The father of Baki and Jack Hanma. He is the strongest creature in the world, and is known to have mastered all styles of unarmed combat. His repertoire apparently includes all of the well-known fighting styles (such as karate, boxing, taekwondo, judo, jujutsu, wrestling, street-fighting, and so on) as well as some more esoteric ones (such as the udonde or uzunde style, an actual system used in the Motobu style of karate). He has been fighting on the battlefields, using only his bare hands, since the age of sixteen, when he fought against both American and Vietcong in the Vietnam War. Since then, it appears that he has obtained respect from the American forces, and has begun fighting as a kind of mercenary for them. It is said that when he stopped fighting for survival but for pleasure the image of the demon's face appeared on his back.

name: Kanji  Igari
description:
Kanji Igari is an old pro wrestler known all over the world. He loves the audience during his fights and the audience loves him. Extremely unusual is how the crowd can give him motivation and strength. He is in his definitely best condition when people watch him and shout his name, and many fighters can confirm this phenomenon. Even when in the locker-room he seems to be a resigned old man, after entering the ring he becomes a powerful star.

He's known for the cunning side of his personality. No one ever knows what to expect from him in his fights and often uses the worst of psychological plays. For example, before the 3rd match in the Maximum Tournament, he realizes he could lose and goes so far to kneel and cry, begging Baki Hanma to let him win, but this is simply one of his means of psychological warfare to make Baki underestimate him. He is well known for fighting dirty, going as far to kick Baki in the balls, as well as pretend to give up so he could sneak attack him and even going so far as to hire an actress who looked enough like Baki's mother Emi Akezawa to try to psychologically hurt Baki out further. At the same time, he is very honest with himself. He knows his weaknesses and limits. Igari uses these tricks mainly when he has to do that. However is he is not unable to fight fairly: a good example is his great duel with the former yokozuna named Kinryuuzan, although he knew that he had to use something more in case of a fight with Baki or Sikorsky.

name: Kiyosumi Katou
description: A top student of Doppo orochi, who left the dojo after having enough of Doppo's "weak" training regime and trained around the world. He returns to Japan after finding out the Underground tournaments. Katou's attitude is best described as arrogant, but usually being the butt of a joke; especially around Doppo, Katsumi, Tokugawa, and Baki, however, it is shown that he truly admires and cares for Doppo    (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Yasha-zaru
description: While training in the mountains Baki encountered this simian yasha. It is said that it stands 9 feet tall. Warriors who went to face the beast were never seen again. He was able to fight Ando and injuring him despite being struck by Ando's ax. In his rematch with Baki, its eye was gouged out only to be eaten by him afterwards. In the end Baki won his fight with him showing Baki a sign of respect. It was revealed that Yujiro killed the Yasha Ape's wife. In return, Baki returned the skull of his wife as a sign of respect. Likewise, he gave Baki one of his fangs as a gift. It's shown that it is a docile creature and only fights to survive. As Baki departs, it reveals that he was raising three children on his own. Later, it is revealed that he is murdered by Yujiro, who then showed his head to Baki. Baki's battle, and victory, against the Yasha Ape is his first fight after gaining near-death concentration

name: Toshiya Misumi
description: At first Toshi is a mentally fragile weak little boy who can't stand up for himself. He cries for everything and nothing. After he meets Mon, who shows him without mercy how a man could be if he fights for everything he wants, Toshi starts to transform. He becomes a devil with a fanatical thirst for destruction.

name: Mon
description: At first Mon is a violent killer faithful only to his own eruptive desires.  He meets Toshi, the exact opposite of himself. After they spend a long time together and Toshi becomes more and more like Mon and even more evil, he collapses and is no longer able to kill. Almost at the same time he meets Maria and starts to grow strong feelings for her. Because of Maria, Toshi starts to distrust him but even in his weakened condition  Toshi is no match for Mon.

name: Higumadon
description: A human-eating creature that resembles an enormous brown bear. It destroys everything in its wake as it journeys south from Hokkaido.

name: Takeshi Iijima
description: Iijima, also named "the greatest hunter" served in many wars and survived each time. Even though he returned after each war, his mind never really did. His primarily targets are Mon and Misumi but then he unavoidably faces Higumadon.

name: Hinako Uno
description: She's a kind and extroverted office lady who can be clumsy sometimes, and has a bit of low-self-esteem.

name: Asahi Sato
description: A dependable, reserved, and introverted office woman. Her coworkers are scared of her cold and intense stare. She's five years older than Hinako.

name: Subaru Sato
description: [Asahi's](https://anilist.co/character/244850) younger sister.

name: Fuuka Yokoyama
description: Asahi's classmate from high school and "one and only friend."

name: Hayato Kasukabe
description: A Tokyo U student who returned to his Grandmother's café following her passing; now interim manager.

appearsIn.title: The Café Terrace and Its Goddesses

name: Ouka Makuzawa
description: Vocational student, studying fashion design.

appearsIn.title: The Café Terrace and Its Goddesses

name: Riho Tsukishima
description: A second year college student, and the oldest of the main cast. She's a former child actress who was once regarded as a child genius, but her popularity gradually declined as she grew up. Riho is the most calculating and devious of the girls, putting more thought into managing the cafe than the owner, [Hayato](https://anilist.co/character/208525/Kasukabe-Hayato), himself.

appearsIn.title: The Café Terrace and Its Goddesses

name: Akane Hououji
description: Part-time worker for the café. Writes music for her band.

appearsIn.title: The Café Terrace and Its Goddesses

name: Shiragiku Ono
description: A second year who attends the same college as Riho, and is the oldest of the main cast along with her. She is a talented cook who specializes in Japanese cuisine. Has a smell fetish.

appearsIn.title: The Café Terrace and Its Goddesses

name: Ami Tsuruga
description: An energetic third-year high school student in the karate club, she works part-time at the Café. Her fighting style consists of moves from the Street Fighter series and other popular works.

appearsIn.title: The Café Terrace and Its Goddesses

name: Akane no Haha
description: The head of the Hououji family and Akane's mother. She visits the café to force Akane to take up the family business, but after some dialogue, she gives up on this plan. She holds a curious connection to Hayato's grandmother, which is why she expresses no worries in leaving her daughter in his hands.

appearsIn.title: The Café Terrace and Its Goddesses

name: Ririka Chiyoda
description: An upcoming idol and social media sensation, she was recruited as staff for the rival café, "Family." However, following her internet mishap, she was forced to switch careers and became a YouTuber.

appearsIn.title: The Café Terrace and Its Goddesses

name: Mao Takasaki
description: A part-time worker and an amateur model. She was one of the staff members for the rival café, "Family".

appearsIn.title: The Café Terrace and Its Goddesses

name: Moemi Souya
description: A third-year college student and an experienced cook who was recruited as staff for the rival café, "Family."

appearsIn.title: The Café Terrace and Its Goddesses

name: Motoko Aoyama
description:
__Height__: 175cm (5'9")

Motoko Aoyama is a 15-year-old high school girl who is very formal and into kendo, to the point that her room resembles that of a samurai's (complete with a suit of armor). She claims lineage to a school of demonslaying swordsmen and also displays a prodigious competence with her katana. She can often wreak great damage to boulders or other objects using nothing more than her wooden practice sword. Motoko is very terrified of her sister, Tsuruko, whose skill far exceeds her own, and has a phobia of turtles that is left unexplained for the majority of the series. She disapproves of Keitaro early on, on the basis of him being a letch and a weakling, but later develops a grudging respect and eventually a hidden affection for him (much to her chagrin). She is at first uncomfortable with her femininity, partially because her sister left her sword for a husband, partially because of her height: she is the tallest person in the house, 3 cm taller than Keitaro (171cm). She later becomes more open due to Keitaro's influence. Whatever her feelings for Keitaro happen to be at a given time, she still frequently threatens or attacks him with her sword.

name: Mitsune Konno
description: She is a scheming freelance writer (and is conspicuous in her lack of writing). A model example of a parasite single, Kitsune lives to enjoy the easy life, and frequently scams others by any means possible. She is frequently drunk, and bottles can be found hidden all over her room. Her greatest joy seems to be teasing Keitaro, even though she clearly cares for him. She is a school friend of Naru and tries her best (or worst) to make Keitaro and Naru get married. In order to maintain her finances, she often bets on horse races. In the anime, Kitsune speaks with an Osaka accent, which seems to imply a connection between her sly, money-minded personality and a common stereotype about people who hail from that region.

name: Shinobu Maehara
description:
__Height:__ 152 cm (5'0")

Shinobu Maehara is an extremely shy young girl, though she does develop more confidence as the story progresses. She is aged 12 at the start of the story, and has short black hair, with one strand of hair subtly sticking out. In the Anime she first appears in episode 1. She is later introduced in episode 2 where we learn that her parents are divorcing and she is expected to leave town with one of them, but she prefers to become a resident at the Hinata apartments. In the manga she is already a resident at the apartments when Keitaro arrives there.  She is in seventh grade at school, but because of her shyness she does not know her fellow pupils well. In the anime even on the eve of her intended departure she hadn't told them she was leaving. Yet later on she will gain more friends from her class as seen in episode two.  She has incredible culinary skills, possibly learned from her mother who had run a restaurant, or possibly she is just naturally adept. She consistently downplays her ability, but is pleased when her cooking is praised by the Hinata residents - especially when Keitaro says "My life would sure be a lot nicer if I could look forward to eating great food like this every day". She has a tendency to sometimes put clothes that were supposed to be washed in the pot, and food ingredients in the washing machine (called "wash curry"), although she has only been shown doing this twice.

name: Naru Narusegawa
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm (5'6")

Naru Narusegawa is a 17-year-old student and resident of the Hinata Inn that can be described as "one fuse short of a cannon" because of her extremely fiery temper and tendency to be very physical, mainly with Keitaro whenever she feels he's acting perverted. Of all the girls in the Hinata House, she is victimized the most by Keitaro's clumsiness which often results in her being naked, exposed in some fashion, or lying in very suggestive positions. Throughout most of high school she studied hard and became Tops in the nation on the college practice exams in order to get into Tokyo University. Because of her intense study regiment she became majorly short-sighted and has to wear thick "coke-bottle glasses" when not wearing her contacts.

name: Kaolla Suu
description: An immigrant who resides in the Hinata house in the town of Hinata hot springs. She is a very energetic and innovative youth that is always doing something and can manufacture the most amazing things at a whim. Let's not mention her room, it's a jungle in there!!

name: Keitarou Urashima
description:
__Height:__ 171 cm (5'7")  

Keitarō Urashima is a 20-year-old cram-school student who is desperately trying to get into Tokyo University in order to fulfill a childhood promise he made to a girl 15 years ago. This proves to be very difficult since he has terrible luck, bad studying habits, and can't grasp the material as well as others leading him to fail the exam three times making him a third-year ronin. His grandmother later grants him ownership of the Hinata Inn, a girl's dorimatory. His clumsiness lands him into deep trouble with the girls at the Hinata Inn as he is prone to accidentally seeing them naked or tripping and touching them inappropriately. Despite his flaws, he is well-meaning, friendly, and very determined, traits which eventually wins all of the girls' hearts.

name: Tsuruko Aoyama
description:
Tsuruko is Motoko's older sister and the one currently entrusted with the keeping of their family's Shinmeiryuu tradition. She is not active in running the school, having given up the life of the sword for marriage, and it is her duty to hand the school over to Motoko's care when the time comes.    

Though Motoko has lived in fear of Tsuruko for years, Tsuruko has Motoko's best interests at heart and her only real wish is for her sister to be happy on whatever path she chooses to walk. Unfortunately, she has a habit of trying to kill her sister when she lies to her (when she tried to take Motoko back to Kyoto and, to prevent this, she pretended to be engaged with Keitaro) or does not tell her the full details of a situation (when Motoko omitted that she flunked the Todai admittance exam).  Like her sister, her sword techniques are centered around the destruction of evil, using ki attacks with her slash, some of them hurting only evil beings, but mostly slashing through rocks, people or larger objects.

name: Tamago Onsen
description: Tamago Onsen lit. "Hot Springs Egg" or also called Tama-chan is a flying turtle in the Love Hina series. Tama-chan was given to Keitaro by Mutsumi as a gift. Keitaro points out that the turtle is male, but the girls are convinced he is a 'she' and so 'he' is referred to as 'she' throughout the manga. She is an 'onsen kame' or hot-springs turtle, and like others of her species. Su, Mutsumi, Seta, and (later in the series) Keitaro appear to have the ability to speak with Tama-chan, and Su occasionally develops the urge to eat her, though sometimes it is just to tease Shinobu (in the manga, it is said on a side note that Su drops this habit in order to wait for Tama-chan to reproduce).

name: Masayuki Haitani
description: Masayuki is one of Keitaro's childhood friends, and is (apart from a few physical differences) almost exactly like Shirai. He is taller and enters a university before Shirai or Keitaro.

name: Natsumi Otohime
description: On a trip to Mutsumi's home, Keitaro and Naru are welcomed by Mutsumi's Mother, Natsumi Otohime. They are very alike, almost like Sisters in looks, except Natsumi is in fact drawn as if a centimeter taller and has different clothes.    Mutsumi and Mrs. Otohime's Personalities and opinions are the same, they want Naru and Keitaro to be together... If Naru persists in declining, Both the Otohime's will Take Keitaro for themselves!

name: Ryang Seo
description:
Cheon Ha-Jin was an assassin of Divine Justice Alliance and is one of the Ten Great Masters. He was known as Dam Sa-Yeong's faithful hunting dog. He was later killed by Gwak So-Gyo, the Queen of Soaring Beauty.

After dying, Cheon Ha-Jin reincarnates to the body of Seo Ryang, the third prince of the Heavenly Demon Cult and a student of the Demon Lord, who fell victim to qi reflux and spent six months in a coma.

name: Cheon-Sang Lee
description: Lee Cheon-Sang is the Ninth Great Heavenly Demon of the Heavenly Demon cult. Grandmaster of the Demonic Path and the lord of all demons.

name: Dong-Pil Ma
description: Ma Dong-Pil is the team leader of the Third Defense Team in the Heavenly Demon Cult and  is one of the strongest masters in the Defense Team. He is described as talented, experienced, and honest. He was assigned to be Seo Ryang's bodyguard in the Bamboo Forest of Solitude.

name: Yeo-Rin Hong
description:
Hong Yeo-Rin  is the daughter of the Red Serpent, one of the seven houses of the Demonic Path and the younger sister of the fourth prince. She has been working as a demon warrior for the Hall of Joy.

Hong Yeo-Rin is renowned for her strength and intelligence, she is recognized as a fotmidable figure by the Demon Cult in the martial arts realm.

name: Dam Mu
description: Mu Dam is the grand guardian of the Defense Team of the Heavenly Demon Cult.

name: Wi-Mun Hong
description: Hong Wi-Mun is the fourth prince of the Heavenly Demon Cult and a student of the Demon Lord. He is the son of the Red Serpent, one of the seven houses of the Demonic Path.

name: Hong-Ryeon Wi
description:
Wi Hong-Ryeon is the captain of the Ruthless Demon Barbarians and is the youngest and most aggressive among all the combat unit captains. She joined the Demon Cult to find a way to survive after her family was destroyed when she was still a child.

Hong-Ryeon received bribes from the fourth prince which lead her to meeting Seo Ryang.

name: Evan
description: Alon's bodyguard.

name: Yutia
description: The sin of Wrath.

name: Deus Macallian
description: The sin of Sloth.

name: Lyne Groph
description: The sin of Greed.

name: Seol-Rang
description: The sin of Pride.

name: Radan
description: The sin of Gluttony.

name: Kallia Zenonia
description: She is the eldest daughter of the Count Zenonia.

name: Loria Altia
description: She's the third daughter of the Duke of Altia.

name: Elivan
description: The protagonist of the game "Psychedelia".

name: Umagon
description: Umagon (Ponygon in English dub) is a mamodo who resembles a small horse, donkey or a sheep according to Kiyomaro's friends. Umagon can only speak "Meru meru mee". Umagon's real name is "Schneider," as it is revealed in the flashbacks that his mother calls him so. Umagon is seen many times throughout the series following Gash Bell around, but he was not officially introduced until episode 23.   His human partner is Kafka Sunbeam.  In the manga, Umagon discovers Gash at the end of his trip in England, but the anime introduced Umagon in Japan earlier to show him off while following him and Kiyomaro to England to follow with manga continuity.

name: Parco Folgore
description:
Parco Folgore is a superstar and film hero from Milan, Italy. 

He normally spends his time touring the world, giving concerts, and meeting his fans - especially the ladies, who love him. However, he and [Kanchomé](https://anilist.co/character/16871/Kanchom) have come to Japan for a special purpose - to defeat [Zatch Bell](https://anilist.co/character/3893/Bell-Gash) and [Kiyo Takamine](https://anilist.co/character/3894/Takamine-Kiyomaro). 

  

Folgore has two hit songs, "Chichi wo Moge" (translates to "Groping Breasts"; changed to "Hey Hey Let's Dance All Day" in English versions), and "Muteki Folgore" ("Invincible Folgore" in English), the latter of which has the unusual ability to revive him if it's sung by Kanchomé. He also frequently plays an "invincible super spy", 00F, in his films; this character has his own theme song as well, "00F's Theme".

name: Brago
description: Brago is a teenaged mamono with a rough, antisocial attitude. Not much is revealed about his life or personality, other than he resents weakness and especially requiring a human's help to win the demon kingship. He is extremely strong, often defeating other mamono teams without even requiring the use of spells.  His personality softens a bit after meeting with Sherry; Brago is even seen helping a human child. He continues to look down on weaker opponents, however, doing whatever it takes to defeat them. He has a rabid appetite, like most other mamono, once seen eating an entire alligator whole. While he has reluctantly teamed up with Zatch, he isn't above harming Zatch to protect him from greater force, such as kicking Zatch in the groin so he could block a more powerful attack from Maestro with his foot (an action that embarrassed both Sherry and Kiyo).  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Megumi Ooumi
description:
__Height:__ 167 cm

Megumi Ooumi is an old pop star and The Keeper Of The Book to a 6-year-old mamodo, [Tio](https://anilist.co/character/8315/Tio).

She is often seen in video games or doing concerts but despite all this remains a normal girl. Megumi first met Tio when she found her injured on the docks. At first, Tio had kept harshly to herself when they'd first met, saying that Megumi would only get hurt helping her fight off mamodo. They eventually started to get along and Tia came to trust Megumi.

name: Kiyomaro Takamine
description:
__Height:__ 5'11"

Kiyomaro is a genius junior high student (Middle school student in Japan) who doesn't have any friends because people around jealous of him being too smart. He is soon given Gash to care for by his father. Gash makes Kiyomaro believe in himself and together they fight other mamonos to become the King of Mamonos.

name: Kanchomé
description: 1 of the 100 mamono king candidates. He is Folgore's partner, who seems weaker than Gash, but only because his spells are more based around deception and transformation of form. He is dubbed "crybaby" by those around him. He is extremely loyal to Folgore and sings Folgore's songs all day. He has an "endless pocket" filled with all kinds of candy, but despite that he will always try to take candy that is nearby, which has caused him problems.

name: Tio
description:
__Power:__ Strong Shields and Healing.

1 of 100 mamono children chosen for the battle to decide the next king. Tio's power respond towards how her heart feels.

name: Gash Bell
description:
__Race:__ Mamodo
__Spellbook Color:__ Red 
__Spellbook Power:__ Lightning Spells 

Gash is Kiyomaro's partner. He was discovered by Kiyomaro's father wounded and unconscious in a forest in England. Gash had no recollection of who he was or where he had come from. 

Gash is overly cheerful, possessing a strong sense of justice but he is clueless about most the world around him and often gets in trouble when not being supervised by someone. He is also initially unaware of the fact that he can shoot lightning out of his mouth through the use of his spellbook.

name: Sherry Bellmont
native: シェリー・ベルモンド
