description: Sherry is Brago's partner, Is a young Swiss woman she comes from a prosperous family and lives in a mansion with her butler, Albert (Jii in Japan), but is frequently seen travelling abroad to fight other mamodo teams. Initially, she states she has no interest in the kingship or in the battle, and that she is only fighting to free her onetime best friend, Koko, from the influence of an evil mamodo named Zofis.

name: Reycom
description: While at work, a man named Hosokawa spotted Reycom eating fish inside a warehouse. Reycom became attached to Hosokawa and when Hosokawa lost his job, Reycom convinced Hosokawa to use his blue spell book. Afterwards, Hosokawa used the Reycom's spells to fulfil his every want and need.  Hosokawa treats Reycom as nothing but a weapon instead of a companion and Reycom doesn't care. Reycom was the second Mamodo that Zatch and Kiyo went up against in the anime. He is cold hearted and likes mindless destruction. His two spells, Gikor and Freezudo, are ice-based.

name: Ted Reynolds
description: The master of the Jean Company on the north bank of Kerube.

name: Lud Kiemann
description: The chief of the Kerube branch of the Rowen Trade Guild.

name: Elsa Schtingheim
native: エルサ・シュティングハイム
description: The church deaconess of the the village of Tereo, successor of the late father Franz.

name: Evan Gyoam
description: A young miller who's romantically involved with Elsa.

name: Annetta Elva
description: Younger sister of Griselda Elva.

name: Griselda Elva
description: One of five guardian knights of Mormeratta - also known as the Equites. Elder sister of Anetta Elva.

name: Albrecht Widehen
description: Albrecht is the Commander of the Royal Emrik Knights. He is the Uncle of Terion.

name: Leonard Friedehilt
description: One of Hildegar's oldest friends, Prince Leonard is the only son of former King Valdekis and Queen Dowager Lestrephia. Born with a frail constitution, much of his youth was spent in the territory of Rovency, or at the palace in Emrik. This sheltered upbringing, along with his lack of political power and his habit of spending his days drinking & fooling around with women, has resulted in him being nicknamed the "Prince in Name Only."

name: Lindia Widehen
description: [Terion](https://anilist.co/character/377850/Widehen-Terion)'s younger twin sister. Clever and outspoken, she is next in line to head the Widehen family and act as warden of southern Mormeratta.

name: Biblia Gakuenchou
description: Master Biblia is a Paladin-Class mage and is the headmaster who presides over the Biblia Magic Academy.

name: Chiaki Asami
description: A freshman politician determined to oust the elder statesmen currently in power.

name: Akira Houjou
description: An ambitious young man working his way up through the ranks of the Yakuza. His goal: to radically reform Japan from the bottom up.

name: Tokai
description: Violent yakuza of the Sagara group.  Admirer and sometimes pesterer of fellow yakuza Akira Hojo.    Likes to have sex with random women in toilets.  Mostly non-consensual.

name: Ji-Yeng Wong
description: Scheming Hong Kong Don who betrayed his allies and shot Hojo.

name: Masanobu Miyamura
description: Reserved Takeyama leader and faithful friend of Hojo's.

name: Murata
description: Experienced, pragmatic Sagara Alliance leader who advises Hojo.

name: Shinichirou Sengoku
description: Asami's ally. A bitter freshman Diet member. He inherited his father's position after he committing suicide.

name: Hideaki Ibuki
description: Kobe Sanno Alliance's second in command.

name: Norimoto Isaoka
description: Corrupt Liberal Democratic Party (L.D.P.) secretary general who hates Asami.

name: Mariko Kumakura
description:
**Height:** 155cm (5'1") 

Initially just a reserved girl, Mari comes into her own when she suddenly is swept up into a whirlwind friendship with a popular classmate, Akko.   She gets her hair cut off, and from that moment, it seems Mari begins to shed her closed up and shy personality.   Despite being dowdy, Mari comes to enjoy things like shopping for cute clothes and dressing up, though mostly this is because of Akko's encouragement.    Mari has a good family life in contrast to Akko, having both her parents there for her (probably more than she'd like) and a younger brother who she gets along with most of the time.  She also becomes good friends with Sugi and Tamamin, though she is surprised to learn that girls would be so open as to casually kiss each other without having any emotion behind it. She is a bit flustered around them and their energy, but she considers the two to be her very good friends.  Mari eventually falls in love with Akko and suffers internally because of it. She does not know what to do with her feelings for her best friend and she especially is even more confused because Akko is a girl.   

(taken from the character profiles in vol.05)

name: Akiko Oohashi
description:
**Height:** 158 cm (5'2") 

Akko is not far away from being the image of the "typical teenage girl". She loves shopping, goes to mixers, and enjoys hanging out with her friends immensely. She is a little on the wild side (as compared to quiet girls like [Mariko](https://anilist.co/character/15456/Kumakura-Mariko)), though she mostly just enjoys having a good time.

She develops a strange fascination with Mari and eventually befriends the quieter girl, much to Mari's surprise. Her charisma and honest, forthright nature captivates those around her, and she easily makes friends, as Mari observes.

name: Narumatsu
description: Mariko and Akiko's home-room teacher. The girls often stress her out, but she's always willing to be there for them with advice whenever she is able.

name: Chiharu Kuno
description:
**Height:** 162 cm (5'4")

Mariko and Akiko's classmate. She has a boyfriend named Ouji, and often mentions him while chatting. She likes to collect cellphone emoticons.

name: Tamami Sekine
description:
**Height:** 150cm (4'11") 

Tamami is a cute and funny girl who is best friends with Sugi. She is also a major otaku who is often seen talking or buying manga. She draws doujinshi from time to time, some including people she knows personally including their homeroom teacher Naru-chan-sensei.  Despite having a physically affectionate relationship with Sugi, neither she nor Sugi have romantic feelings for one another. It is heavily implied that by the end of the manga, she has begun dating Harada   

(taken from the character profiles in vol.05)

name: Satoko Sugiyama
description:
__Height:__ 167cm (5'6") 
__Weight:__ 50kg (110bs) 
__Hobby:__ Improving her appearance  
__What she wants the most:__ a soul-mate OR authority (most likely a reference to another Morinaga work, Koi no Susume) 

(taken from the character profiles in vol.05)  

Sugi-san is the sexy, mature girl in the group of friends Mari joins. She juggles boyfriends, gives relationship advice, and seems vaguely above it all and ia somewhat detached - except when it comes to Tamamin (Sekine Tamami). The two of them kiss - allegedly for fun - all the time, yet she seems to think that girl-girl relationships are impossible.   Despite being a carefree hedonist, Sugi is the only person to notice what is going on between Akko and Mari, and it raises her concern as a friend. In fact, she realises that Akko is in love with Mari even before Akko has a clue about it herself. She is concerned by this because she sees her two friends clearly wanting one another but not knowing how to express that, thus making them unhappy.   Being astute to people's emotions, she tries to support her friends without revealing anything to them, knowing that it's best they work it out and figure things out for themselves.

name: Urara Taguchi
description:
**Height:** 155cm (5'1") 

Mariko and Akiko's classmate. She doesn't like her own name, and always avoids mentioning it.

name: Kurokawa
description: Kurokawa is also one of the first employees Usa meets at his summer part time job. Going by the name Saionji, he often speaks of guardian spirits which greatly reminds Usa of Hayashi.

appearsIn.title: The Kawai Complex Guide to Manors and Hostel Behavior

name: Chinatsu
description:
An elementary school student who becomes attached to the Kawai Dormitory residents after Shirosaki found her wallet during a temporary falling out with her friends. She can be quite frank with her observations and can be unsparing when she speaks her mind. She has a fondness for pudding and, in Shirosaki's point of view, has the makings of a sadist.

(Source: Wikipedia)

appearsIn.title: The Kawai Complex Guide to Manors and Hostel Behavior

name: Sayaka  Watanabe
description: A college student staying at Kawai Dormitory. She is the last resident that Usa meets. Sweet on the outside but loves to cause trouble for others, she has a penchant for leading men on. She loves to fondle Mayumi, much to the latter's resentment.

appearsIn.title: The Kawai Complex Guide to Manors and Hostel Behavior

name: Roland Wimbledon
description: Roland Wimbledon is the King of the Kingdom of Graycastle and the leader of the Witch Union. His true identity is Cheng Yan, an engineer from modern day China, who somehow wakes up in the body of the original Roland after both of them died. After realizing this was real, he decided to live in this new world according to his morals and ideals.

name: Anna Wimbledon
description: Anna Wimbledon is a witch from Border Town, and the first witch Roland meets.

name: Soraya Zoen
description: Soraya Zoen is a witch of Witch Union and former member of the Witch Cooperation Association.

name: Isabella
description: Isabella was one of the Church's Pure Witches. After Zero's defeat, she was put under house arrest to help Agatha. Later, she becomes the acting pope to help Roland. Towards the end of the story, she returns back to Neverwinter and joins the Witch Union.

name: Veronica Gilen
description: Nightingale is the first witch from the Witch Cooperation Association to come into contact with Roland.

name: Lightning
description: Lightning is a witch from the Fjords, who had joined the Witch Cooperation Association, before leaving to help Nightingale. She is a member of the Witch Union and founder of the Neverwinter Exploration Group.

name: Mystery Moon
description: Mystery Moon is a witch of Witch Union and former member of Witch Cooperation Association.

name: Scroll
description: Scroll is a witch and a member of the Witch Union. She was one of three Witch Cooperation Association founders.

name: Agatha
description:
Agatha is a survivor of the Witch Federation and is currently a member of the Witch Union. Agatha usually busies herself in chemical laboratory for acid production or making components for weapons.
After the battle of Divine will, she and Isabella researched on the new project of transforming humanity with magic, with the help of Eleanor.

When Nightingale and Roland are busy, Agatha is typically called in to help assess new witches.+

name: Nana Pine
description: Nana Pine is a witch from Border Town. She is the daughter of Tigui Pine.

name: Fuyou
description: A mid-rank consort, princess of a distant land. She became the Emperor's middle consort against her will.

name: Anshi
description:
Anshi, the Empress Dowager, is the wife of the previous Emperor, mother to the current one.

She joined the inner court at 10 years of age as the attendant to a consort and unwillingly got the previous Emperor's attention with her childish innocence. He jumped her and, at 11, she gave birth to the current Emperor.

Her relationship with the previous Emperor was cold, for she was disgusted by him while he feared her ever more adult (dominant) presence. Later in life, she found him making advances on underage maid and in a pit of rage, she raped him, resulting in her getting pregnant with the second prince.

name: Lahan Ani
description:
He is among the more ordinary members of the La Clan, but he is still very capable compared to the average person. This "ordinariness" gives him an inferiority complex towards his younger brother Lahan. Like his father, he specializes in farming and specifically really likes potatoes.

Despite his seemingly rough exterior, he is actually a very kind person. Maomao takes pity on him because he is too nice for his own good, which makes it easy for others to take advantage of his hard working nature. It is easy for Lahan to get a rise out of him, and despite his expertise in farming, he will vehemently object to being called a farmer.

name: Yarite Baba
description: Once a high ranking courtesan herself, the Madam is now the runner of the Vergidris Hall.

name: Tianyu
description: A curious apprentice physician in the outer court.

name: Leslie Salvatore
description: Leslie Shuya Salvator formerly Sperado is the main protagonist. She is known as the Black Saint and is the only daughter and lady of the Salvator family. She is the former second daughter of the Sperado family, and was born to be a sacrifice for her older sister, Ellie de arne Sperado.

name: Acela Salvatore
description:
Acela Benkan Salvatore is known as the Monster Duchess as well as a powerful swordsman and magician. She quickly adopts Leslie after seeing the power of the Black Saint.
She is Sairaine's wife.

name: Konrad Altera
description: Eldest son of Duke Altera and Ruenti's friend. He is a paladin knight of the Tesentraha temple. Konrad entered the temple when he was around seven years old.

name: Bethrion Salvatore
description: Duchess Salvatore's eldest son.

name: Ruenti Salvatore
description: Duchess Salvatore's second son, Bethrion's younger brother.  He becomes Leslie's teacher.

name: Frit Altera
description: Konrad's little brother.

name: Sairaine Salvatore
description: A mercenary and Acela's husband.

name: Bibi
description: U-Jin's familiar, a succubus.

name: Ji-Won Do
description: Jae-Min's older sister.

name: Sunny
description:
Sunny (Sani) is one of the "Four Heavenly Kings" (四天王, shitennou), he is first shown as having great strength, like Toriko, shown carrying a Regal Mammoth with one arm, although this is just a clever trick due to the fact that he was actually using his monstrously strong hair, each of his strings being strong enough to lift nearly 50 pounds. He is Rin's older brother. 

He is a quiet, pretty boy who judges the "beauty" of people's actions and speaks in an elegant, almost flirtatious manner. He has a way of "hitting" without even touching the target, mainly related to his "sensor" talent that allows him to know the physical state of those around him. His "sensor" is actually made up of thousands and thousands of super fine hairs that can reach a maximum length of 7.6 m (25 feet). Sunny's body has a very high body temperature and a strong sense of touch. 

When touched with his hair or any part of his body, it is as if Sunny tastes what he touches. He strives for "harmony" in his dishes, which means perfect use of ingredients, perfect handling of food, and most importantly, producing perfect taste. He seems to be slightly in love with Komatsu (or at least his skills since they seem to produce the "harmony" that Sunny seeks in his meals).

name: Coco
description: The "Gentleman" of the "Four Heavenly Kings" ((四天王, shitennou), he is good friends with Toriko. While Toriko mostly relies on his brute strength, Coco prefers using stealthy techniques and cunning strategy to subdue aggressors. He is also strong defensively; he is immune to five hundred different kinds of poison. He earns most of his living by working as a fortuneteller, and his fortunes have a 97% accuracy rating, this has also made him extremely popular with women and results in him being mobbed by costumers when he is in public.  He also has the ability to see non-visible spectrum's of light and can read electromagnetic auras in order to predict an animal's next action. He, and the other Four Heavenly Kings, were trained by Ichiryū, the President of the IGO. He is 27 years old.

name: Komatsu
description: A five-star chef who works for Hotel Gourmet, part of the prestigious IGO (International Gourmet Organization). Komatsu is 25 years old, the same age as Toriko.  He is timid but greatly interested by what he finds in his travels with Toriko. As a result, he tries to overcome his fear and does his best to help. It is shown that he is a highly skilled and competent chief capable on carrying out delicate procedures such as the removal of a puffer-whale's poison sack. He is also able to create delicious plates from any food giving to him and he has such a large knowledge of foods that he knows which foods would work well together. He is also very observant, being easily able to discover edible organisms in the area. His skills didn't go unnoticed since he has impressed all three of the "Four Heavenly Kings".   Toriko noted he has skills even higher than five-star class, Coco who was surprised since Komatsu's skill is most likely world class and Sani seems to be in love with the way Komatsu works as a chef since it produces the "harmony" in food that Sani holds in such high regard. Because he is otherwise normal, he'll write a will whenever he come along on Toriko's hunts. He is also currently the only chef to successfully recreated the Century Soup. He keeps a baby Wall Penguin as a pet that contains the key ingredient for the soup in it's saliva.

name: Zebra
description: One of the "Four Heavenly Kings" he is in jail for an as of now unknown crime. He is said to be the best at disrupting IGO's food order. Although not officially seen, he is described as the most savage of the Four Heavenly Kings, as proof of this he single handily caused all the scars on Match's body. It was later revealed the person who captured Zebra is Yosaku the Saiseiya, along with Teppei's assistance. He, and the other Four Heavenly Kings, were trained by Ichiryuu, the President of the IGO.

name: Toriko
description:
__Height:__ 220 cm
__Hors-D'oeuvre:__ BB Corn
__Soup:__ Century Soup (Komatsu's Version)
__Fish Dish:__ 
__Meat Dish:__ 
__Main:__ GOD (Has yet to acquire it) 
__Salad:__ 
__Dessert:__ Fruit of Rainbow
__Drink:__ 

A Bishoku-ya with an abnormally large appetite (a food serving for 500 people could only get him 1/10 full). Toriko is 25 years old, the same age as [Komatsu](https://anilist.co/character/19942/Komatsu). He is known as one of the "Four Heavenly Kings", and his nickname is "The Glutton". Despite having a huge appetite and massive power, he doesn't indiscriminately kill and eat any animal; he only kills those animals he decides to eat. He has immunity to seventy different poisons, created by injecting himself with a near fatal dose of each poison and causing his body to create antibodies. He also has an animal-like sense of smell. He has adopted the Battle Wolf's new born pup and named it [Terry Cloth](https://anilist.co/character/19943/Terry-Cloth). Like the other Kings, Toriko started of as a chain animal.  Hunting Method: Toriko relies on his sheer monster-like strength to capture his targets.

name: Jirou
description: FULL COURSE MENU Hors-D'oeuvre: Hundred Leaf Clover  Soup: Magma Consomme  Fish Dish: Royal Land Shark  Meat Dish: Ashurasaurus  Main: E.T. Rice  Salad: Grana Lettuce  Dessert: Oasis Melon  Drink: Doham Spring Sake   A retired bishokuya who's always drunk. He was Setsuno's partner in old days and he was one of Acacia's students (with the others being Ichiryuu and Bishoku-kai boss). He's also Teppei's grandfather.

name: Teppei
description: A famous Saiseiya under the tutage of Yosaku and the grandchild of Knocking Master Jiro.

name: Acacia
description: The greatest bishoku-ya in human history and bishokushin (Gourmet God), as well as the combo partner of Frohze, he discovered countless ingredients all over the world. Including the Gourmet Jellyfish from which he discovered the Gourmet Cells, and is the first and only person to find the ingredient GOD, taking a long time to do so and only able to discover it in his final years. Distributing GOD to the leaders of every nation, he manages to end a centuries-long war between all the nations of the world, and bring about the current Gourmet Age. Near the end of his life, Acacia took three disciples: Ichiryu, the current president of the IGO, the "Knocking Master" Jiro, and Midora (the boss of the Bishokukai). While he did teach them many hunting techniques that were to become the basis of their greatness in their present day, he told them nothing about GOD, sensing that in the same way how it was used to end a war, it would be used to begin another.    Being called the "Bishokushin", or Gourmet God, Acacia is worshipped by the people of the world. His golden statue is located in a gigantic temple called the "Gourmet Temple", which is visited by roughly 9 billion people every day, trying to get lucky and successful in their lives.     (source: Toriko.wikia.com)

name: Zonge
description:
__Height:__ 182 cm

Zonge is a Bishoku-ya that Toriko and Komatsu first meet on their way to Gourmet Fortune. His presence is mostly for comic relief, as his cowardly nature and ineptitude in battle contrast strongly with the carefree way with which Toriko handles his environment.  He wields an axe in battle. Zonge is one of the weakest hunters and one of the luckiest, able to survive the most dangerous places with luck. Notably, he mentions his skills in terms of RPG's.

name: Boogieyuz
description: The Fifth Branch Chief (The Food Preparation Team and "Trained Team") of the Bishokukai. He has a motif of being like a hermit crab, "lodging" in other creatures and manipulating them like puppets with his skelatal abilities.

name: Yae Saotome
description: Saotome Yae is a local female High-School boxing-talent considered to be the next promise in Japanese boxing.

name: Houzuki
description: Appears in episode 10.

name: Misuzu
description: A huge powerful bull youkai with many followers. He acknowledges that Natsume Takashi is a worthy holder of the Book of Friends and offers himself as Natsume's bodyguard in place of the "useless" Madara.

name: Tsuyukami
description: Tsuyukami was one of the wandering spirits who sought residence in an old shrine. His powers tied to it, human prayer would give him strength. By the time he visits Natsume to regain his name, however, most of the people who prayed to him had already passed on, leaving only one; an elderly lady by the name of Hana.

name: Kogitsune
description: Really adorable kitsune child who befriends Natsume in the seventh episode of the first season, after being rescued from other yokai, who bullies him due to his gentle and shy nature. Because of this, he takes a great liking to Natsume, who also rejects to have his name for the Book of Friends and instead tells him they are friends. Occasionally he heads off to visit him and due to his inexperience as a kitsune needs a potion to turn into a human child for a while.

name: Digimortal
description: Digimortal is an otherwise unnamed assassin who does work for a resistance/terrorist organization seeking to undermine and ultimately destroy the Inquisition Branch of the Church of Transfiguration. He has apparently undergone extensive cybernetic modification which grants him extreme physical quickness and strength. In Digimortal, he has been hired to assassinate Lord Halogen Übler of the Inquisition and both of the High Inquisitor's bodyguards, the sisters Tolaris and Lataris. Contrary to his rather somber appearance, Digimortal's helmet displays a wicked grin to anything standing before his scythe (all information was collected directly from the manga).

name: Denji Kudou
description: Former member/test subject of Kegen Hall. Fused with an organism known as the gauna.

name: Lataris
description: Tolaris twin.

name: Halogen Übler
description: Halogen Übler is a lead research scientist and member of the Church of the Transfiguration. 50 years before the setting of the manga, he underwent extensive cybernetic modification when he joined the ranks of the Inquisition. Since that time, he has strongly strengthened his position within the Church of the Transfiguration, and has become deeply involved in their human trafficking and black market activities in order to further the goals of the Inquisition. His activities have resulted in Übler being targeted by an unnamed resistance/terrorist organization, and a lone assassin in their pay only known to others as "Digimortal" (all information was collected directly from the manga).

name: Tadohomi
description: She is a high ranking agent of the origanization Kegen Hall.

name: Nayuta
description: She is used as a weapon by Kegen Hall.

name: Sakijima
description: He is an officer of the Punitive Ministry Forces.

name: Ayuta
description: A girl in a wheel chair.

name: Tolaris
description: Lataris twin.

name: Touta Konoe
description:
Number 7 of UQ Holder's immortal squad, Numbers. Touta is a cheerful and optimistic 14 year old boy with many dreams. He was raised by Yukihime after his parents died. After being mortally wounded while protecting Yukihime, he drinks her blood and is transformed into an immortal vampire. His weapon is the Gravity Blade, a sword that can have its weight increased or decreased thousands of timesfold according to the will of its user (actually a adjustable dial). His grandfather was Negi Springfield, a legendary magician and Negima's protagonist.

(Source: Wikipedia, edited)

name: Kuroumaru Tokisaka
description: Number 11 of UQ Holder's immortal squad, Numbers. A 14 year old who comes from a tribe of demi-humans (Yatagarasu) where children are born genderless, but can choose to become male or female during a ceremony on their 16th birthday. Kuroumaru currently wants to become male, and thus identifies as and presents himself as a boy. He has romantic feelings for Touta, but denies it to everyone who points it out, claiming he only wants "male friendship" with Touta. He is a practitioner of the Shinmeiryuu, a sword style also seen in Ken Akamatsu's previous series.

name: Ikkuu Ameya
description:
No. 10 of UQ Holder’s immortal squad, Numbers. Unlike the other members who achieved immortality through supernatural means, Ikkuu obtained his through science. At the age of 13 he fell into a coma for 72 years-- to keep him alive, he was turned into a cyborg. Although he is legally 85 years old, he still has the mentality of a 13 year old, and prefers to use the body of a 24 year old.

He is the son of the head of the Ameya Concern, a company that builds robots and spaceships. It can be assumed Ikkuu's family and the Concern are responsible for his robotic body, but this has yet to be confirmed.

name: Chachamaru Karakuri
description:
__Seat Number:__ 10 
__Constructed:__ January 3rd, 2001
__Activated:__ April 1st, 2001
__Clubs:__ Tea Ceremony Club, Go Club  

Chachamaru Karakuri is a two-year-old robot created by Satomi Hakase to serve Evangeline and protect her during time where the spell binding her weakens her. She is initially without any real emotions, but after spending time around Negi, she begins to have feelings for him, and show emotions. She spends most of her free time helping people and rescuing stray animals. She strongly fears the idea that she is nothing more than a soulless doll and that she does not have a soul.

She is skilled in hand to hand combat, and she is equipped with rocket fists, laser emitters, magic-powered thrusters that can allow her to fly for fifteen minutes, and a tool to undo binding circles. Her body has been upgraded several times, and she is later given a completely new body that looks completely human, unlike her original body's easily detectable parts; she even has a chibi body designed to disguise herself. The upgrade also allows her to transform her arms into swords and guns.

She likes having people wind her up and serving tea

name: Karin Yuuki
description:
Number 4 of UQ Holder's immortal squad, Numbers. She is very devoted to Yukihime after having been saved by her in the past and is jealous of Touta's close relationship with her. Her immortality is said to come from divine origin, as all her wounds heal instantly instead of just regenerating fast like in most immortals. Because of it she was branded as a witch and hunted when she was a small child centuries ago.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Albireo Imma
description: Albireo Ima  is one of Nagi's former companions. He entered the fighting tournament during the Mahora school festival under the assumed name "Ku:Nel Sanders" and went largely unnoticed until he approached Asuna and was recognized by Evangeline. He appears to have information on not only Nagi's whereabouts, but also on Asuna's forgotten past. Albireo appears to be a perverted fellow, as his taste in making Evangeline wear costumes made apparent in recent chapters. He's also a cunning and shrewd man, akin to Nagi Springfield, and is considered as one of the two natural enemies which Evangeline has (he takes great delight in verbally tormenting her, even calling her Kitty), the other one being Nagi himself. Albireo Ima has a strong affinity towards gravity elemental magic.  An interesting fact revealed in the latest chapters is that Albireo has his very own Pactio card, which means that he, in addition of being a powerful mage, is also a Minister Magi. His artifact is a series of books, with an accompanying bookmark, that can be used to transform into a specific person, using all their skills and abilities. His present Pactio is with Nagi, but he has had at least ten contracts with other mages in the past, all of whom are dead.

name: Ayaka Yukihiro
description:
She is currently the 3-A class president and is among the highest scorers on school exams, where she was last seen as ranked 4th in her whole grade. She and Asuna seem to hate each other, with the two often getting into fights, but it eventually becomes clear that they merely have an odd, but surprisingly close friendship that neither is willing to admit to. She is the girl most overtly fond of Negi, though she stands by the position that she is only interested in Negi because he "needs a mother figure". Though she is highly intelligent, she can often be clueless in relation to the events surrounding her. Thus, many of her classmates incorrectly think of her as a fool (even if they won't say so out loud).

(Source: Wikipedia)

description:
__Race:__ Human
__Class:__ Farmer

Park Se-Jun is the protagonist of The Top Dungeon Farmer who had been dreaming of going into the dungeon. He was transported to the 99th Floor of the Black Dungeon after forcibly jumping into the Vanishing Phenomenon and was regarded by the administrator as a mistake. There he earned the class of Farmer.

name: Dong-Shik Kim
description:
__Race:__ Human
__Occupation:__ Hunter
__Guild:__ Phoenix Guild

name: Teo
description:
__Race:__ Cat
__Occupation:__ Peddler


Teo is a cat from Granier Village who impulsively becomes a peddler after being rejected by the cat he had a crush on. Right after becoming a peddler, he was scammed by another peddler who sold him "special" products and gave him a map that showed the new Seed Store member's location. This led him to the 99th Floor where he met Park Se-Jun and signed a contract with him as business partners to sell the crops to other hunters.

Teo is gullible and he also has lucky paws that itch if he's near a special item.

name: Beh
description: __Race:__ Crimson Grizzly Bear

name: Aileen Pritani
description:
__Race:__ Black Dragon
__Occupation:__ Black Dungeon Administrator

name: Kazuki Itou
description: Itou Kazuki is a normal highschooler with an untidy nature who relies very much on his younger sister to keep his cleaning in check. As a result, when his younger sister is threatened, he stands up for her. When the strange lolita begins to stalk him and his sister, Kazuki shows himself to be brave and determined character but she soon begins to get under his skin...

name: Remina Kanbe
description: The strange lolita girl who has been stalking the protagonist.

name: Hikari Itou
description: Sister of Kazuki.    She is persecuted by the "goth lolita" for being Kazuki's true sister.

name: Nemesis
description: Nemesis is a sadistic, demanding girl who is responsible in giving orders to Mea. She uses Mea as her spy to look after Yami's changes and recent life. In addition, Nemesis is the one behind the plans to make Yami return to her emotionless-assassin's life again. Claiming that she knows that one day, Yami will return to her real path naturally, she decided to live in the human world and tries to be friends with everyone; in refusal of Momo and Rito. Like the other girls, she also seems to have sexual feelings towards Rito and plans to train him as her 'pet'.

name: Ryouko Mikado
description:
__Height:__ 171 cm 

The school doctor who also happens to be alien (she has pointed ears). She dresses rather provocatively even when on the job and helps out aliens on Earth in various manners, usually those dealing with medical care.

name: Kenichi Saruyama
description: Perverted male best friend of Rito. Later on falls in love with the female version of Rito called Riko.

name: Jack Valantier
description: The third child of the Valantier family, Jack Valantier. The protagonist of the story.

name: Hana Agaya
description: An illustrator and Machi's junior, she's a lesbian who tried dating in her school days. She was the one to propose the fake marriage with Machi.

appearsIn.title: I Married My Best Friend to Shut My Parents Up

name: Machi Morimoto
description: An office lady who lives under her parents' expectations. In order to escape her parents' nagging, she fakes a marriage with Hana.

appearsIn.title: I Married My Best Friend to Shut My Parents Up

name: Tsubasa Ichinose
description: The main character of Ichinose Family's Deadly Sins. Before the accident, he used to be part of the soccer club.

name: Kakeru Ichinose
description: He's the father of Tsubasa Ichinose.

name: Shiori Ichinose
description: She's the sister of Tsubasa Ichinose.

name: Minako Ichinose
description: She's the mother of Tsubasa Ichinose.

name: Kozo Ichinose
description: He's a grandpa of Tsubasa Ichinose

name: Sachie Ichinose
description: She's a middle-aged woman, grandma of Tsubasa Ichinose

name: Souta
description: A mysterious man that enters the family all of a sudden

name: Inori Yuitsuka
description: A 5th grade elementary student who loves figure skating so much she used to practice it in secret. Though she greatly lacks academic skill, when she's in the rink she's like a different person.

name: Tsukasa Akeuraji
description: He is a former figure skater and now the coach of [Inori Yuitsuka](https://anilist.co/character/197151/Inori-Yuitsuka).

name: Shinichirou Sonidori
description: Head coach at Meikou Wind FSC and father of [Riou Sonidori](https://anilist.co/character/197158/Riou-Sonidori).

name: Yuudai Jakuzure
description: [Ema Yamato](https://anilist.co/character/209214/Ema-Yamato)'s coach. He is a former mens' singles who was strong enough to participate in the free skate in several national events before his retirement. He was born in Osaka and in his junior years, he won several tournaments in the Kansai block. He is a free-wheeling man, when he encounters a problem, he prefers to take it slow and formulate a plan instead of using guts and attitude to tackle it. As a coach, he attempts to dress as close to an elementary school teacher as possible around his students.

name: Yuuna Yagi
description: Yuuna is the 3rd best skater at Meikoh Wind FSC and is [Shinichirou Sonidori's](https://anilist.co/character/197159/Shinichirou-Sonidori) primary student. She joined the club after seeing his Olympic performance and has a secret crush on him. Before events, she mentally builds herself up while sitting alone with a puppet.

name: Hikaru Kamisaki
description: An orphan who was picked up by [Jun Yodaka](https://anilist.co/character/197164/Jun-Yodaka) and currently lives with [Rioh Sonidori](https://anilist.co/character/197158/Riou-Sonidori) and his mother. She is [Inori's](https://anilist.co/character/197151/Inori-Yuitsuka) rival who she promised with that they would compete against each other in the All-Japans.

name: Kakeru Uobuchi
description: Kakeru is a jump obsessed maniac since his days as a professional athlete, he taught himself a quadruple lutz with no outside instruction. He is like a "cheat code" as a coach, helping skaters pull off any jump they request, but he goes around to all the clubs so will also power up skaters' rivals. He loves helping skaters pull off jumps for him in person and is a great fan of [Shinichirou Sonidori's](https://anilist.co/character/197159/Shinichirou-Sonidori) jumping.

name: Mayuka Korenaga
description: Mayuka is Daiki's older sister. Her existence is also kept low profile until a certain point where it is found that she is actually the girlfriend of the unobtainable Ren Ichinose. She has a job which is in the modelling business which she pursued for what she thought was Ren's sake and she is currently studying for extrance exams to university. After chapter 7, she has her own story arc entitled Strobe Edge: Another Light which is set when her parents are separated and where she meets Ren for the first time. As the series progresses, she becomes wary of Ninako's relationship with Ren but remains friendly toward her. She eventually realizes how much her relationship with Ren is strained: she is almost always busy and has to cancel their dates.   In chapter 19

name: Yuutarou Terada
description: Yūtarō, nicknamed "Yū" and "Tera" by his peers, is one of Ren's friends at school and is both sagely and mature. Unlike Ga-chan, he tends to be more realistic and is often holding back Ga-chan's matchmaking attempts so as not to trouble Ren. In middle school, he attended the same cram school as Sayuri Uehara, and they began dating. However, they broke up abruptly when Sayuri believed Yū was cheating on her. Yū regrets hurting Sayuri and realizes their relationship failed because of lack of communication, but knows they cannot return to the way they were. Instead, he encourages her to make peace with Daiki when troubles appear in their relationship, and moves on from her once she has done so.    (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Keisuke Toda
description: The leader of a cheerleading squad. He is a senior of Ninako and helped her out a lot by listening to her worries. He has a very cheerful and active personality.

name: Daiki Korenaga
description:
Daiki is Ninako's childhood friend whom at the beginning of the story is shown to have feelings for her. H

is parents divorced when they were in middle school. Due to his parents separation, he decided to live with his father, he grew attached to Ninako, which explains his feelings for her, and his relationship with his older sister, Mayuka, somehow grew weak.

name: Manabu Miyoshi
description:
**Height:** 165 cm
**Weight:** 53 kg
**Favourite musician:** Arashi
**Favourite food:** chicken

Manabu, more commonly known as "Ga-chan" to his peers, is one of Ren's carefree friends. His cousin owns a café, where he works. He notices Ren's feelings for Ninako early on and desperately tries to pair them up.

name: Mao Sugimoto
description:
Mao is a student junior to Ninako and the others. In middle school, she dated Takumi, but only used him to get close to his best friend, whom she had a crush on. Ninako eventually discovers that she is the cause of strain between Takumi and Ren when Mao enrolls in their high school. Despite that she initially chased after Ren, she tells Takumi that she fell in love with him while they were dating and is willing to compete against his affections for Ninako in order to be with him again.    

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Takeshi Nakazato
description: Nakazato Takeshi is the leader of the Myogi NightKids. He made his first appearance at the race in Akina where Keisuke Takahashi of the RedSuns is to race against Takumi. Surprised that Takumi could defeat Keisuke, Takeshi decides that he is going to be the one to challenge and defeat the "Akina downhill specialist", and that the RedSuns are next on his list.  He is an intelligent and skilled driver, notably recognizing Takumi's the gutter hook technique while observing the Eight-Six's first battle with Keisuke's FD. However, his downfall is his anger and emotions getting in the way of his mind, resulting in poor throttle control. He also races all-out and usually fails to consider tire wear, so in the end, he loses the race, sometimes crashing his car. He is very good at acceleration and is known for his grip driving philosophy. His previous car was a Nissan Silvia (S13), with which he used drifting techniques. He changed to the R32 after a devastating loss to a white (or rather silver) R32 on his home course of Myogi. Following the defeat by the Skyline, his philosophy changed, favoring grip driving techniques over "weak" and "showy" drifting techniques. He also believed that no matter what skill a driver has, a car will not run beyond its capabilities.

name: Sayuki
description:
Sayuki is Mako's co-driver/navigator.

Sayuki is a cheerful, outgoing girl and she is always looking for good looking guys like the Takahashi brothers. She also developed a crush on Takumi, finding him cute and invited him to a pool after his race against Mako and Sayuki. As navigator, she gives out instructions to Mako when they're racing (when to brake, what drifting technique to use etc.).

Her last name is unknown.

name: Bunta Fujiwara
description:
__Car:__ Subaru Impreza WRX STI Coupe Type R Version V (GC8) (color: Sonic Blue Mica in anime/Gunmetal Gray Mica in manga)

Bunta Fujiwara is the owner of a tofu shop in Akina, and the father of [Takumi](https://anilist.co/character/2819/Fujiwara-Takumi). He used to be the No.1 downhill racer in Mt. Akina years ago, but he no longer races, preferring to guide Takumi's racing development. He is the original driver of the mysterious AE86 that holds the record of the fastest downhill time at Akina. Bunta has a unique way of training his son to drive; every morning when Takumi delivers tofu, Bunta gives Takumi a cup of water. The cup of water is placed in the drink holder; Takumi must not spill even a drop of it while he is driving. This is ostensibly to prevent breaking the tofu in the boot, but it forces Takumi to drive very smoothly. As for Bunta, he is still considered the fastest downhill racer in Akina. We see proof of this early in the series as he pushes the Trueno with [Yuuichi](https://anilist.co/character/37062/Tachibana-Yuuichi) in the passenger seat lighting a cigarette while drifting around a corner.

name: Kai Kogashiwa
description: Kai Kogashiwa is a street racer from Tochigi prefecture, and a son to a legendary Downhill ace and Bunta's rival, Ken Kogashiwa. Ken taught Kai in the racing world from a young age, participating in karting competitions which made him specialized in midships (colloquial term for mid engine, rear drive). Before his transition to street racing, Kai was the fastest motorcyclist on Irohazaka. It can be seen that Kai's specialty on Irohazaka is similar to Takumi on Akina as he lives at Lake Chuzenji (which is at the top of Irohazaka) and takes the road during his daily commute to the bottom.  Kai had challenged Takumi on the Emperor's home course of Irohazaka. Kai had defeated Seiji Iwaki of Emperor and wanted to defeat Kyoichi as well, but set his sights on Takumi after Sudo's defeat. Kai uses a trick taught to him by his father to overtake Takumi by jumping a turn in a break in the guard rail on 33rd corner. However, he spins out on the final straightaway after his car loses traction from landing on leaves on the side of the road and was defeated.  Kai reappears as an opponent for Project D in Kanagawa prefecture. Kai represents the downhill ace for Racing Team Katagiri against the Eight-Six. However, he spins out at the last sector costing him the race.  Originally, Kai drives his father's Toyota SW20 MR2 but later switches to a silver Toyota MR-S ZZW30 (3rd Generation MR2 Roadster), leaving the SW20 to his father.  (Source: Initial D Wiki)

name: Murasaki
description: A Caucasian, bespectacled man who constantly wears a suit. He is apparently the one responsible for the appearance of the Drifters, using them as a means to right the wrong of the Offscourings' conquest of the magical world. He is often seen sitting in the middle of the door corridor, smoking, and reading a newspaper that gives news of the events relating to the Drifters. In the corridor he is associated with and accompanied by light.

name: Adolf Hitler
description: The infamous Führer and Chancellor of Nazi Germany. Though it is unknown whether he is/was a Drifter or Offscouring, Hitler ended up appearing in the current world fifty years before the current storyline and inspiring the local humans through speeches at a tavern to rise up and form the Orte Empire. He mysteriously committed suicide soon after, however, his followers continued to revere him as the "Father" of their country long after his death.

name: EASY
description: A young woman with long-black hair. Apparently at odds with Murasaki, she is responsible for the Offscourings, an opposing force similar in origin to the Drifters. In the corridor she is associated with and accompanied by darkness.

name: Naoshi Kanno
description: During a battle with the Black King, with the Drifters' side under attack by dragons, World War II fighter pilot Naoshi Kanno is transported into the world in his plane. He decides to attack the dragons when their attacks remind him of the US bombing of Tokyo.

name: Saint-Germi
description: A nobleman who owns a quarter of the Empire and was Hitler's closest ally in its formation. It is said that the Empire could not have existed without his "betrayal," and as such he is free to live as he pleases without criticism from any of his peers. Despite this position however, he is not loyal to the Empire and knows that its demise is near; as such, he plans to reach out to the elves and the Drifters that accompany them. As a side note, in spite of the fact he is well over fifty years old, as the Orte Empire was formed fifty years before the current storyline, Saint-Germi appears as a youthful drag queen with an effeminate personality. Likely the Count of St. Germain as a Drifter or Offscouring.

name: The Sundance Kid
native: ザ・サンダンス・キッド
description: Harry Alonzo Longabaugh, better known as Sundance Kid, is a well known American Wild West outlaw specialized in train and bank robbery. A notorious member of the Wild Bunch Gang, Butch Cassidy's partner and now a Drifter fighting against the Black King.

name: Alester
description: A comrade and subordinate to Count Saint-Germi alongside with Flemi, Alester seems to share his master's non-traditional sexual orientation (additionally Alester only likes elder men), eccentric behaviour and a habit to wear an outrageous makeup. Plus to this he is actually an experienced fighter specializing in dual swords technique.

name: Luigi Claes
description: Katarina's father and Keith's adoptive father. A duke as well as the current head of the Claes family.

appearsIn.title: My Next Life as a Villainess: All Routes Lead to Doom!

name: Susanna Randall
native: スザンナ・ランドール
description: Suzanna Randall is the fiancée of Geoffrey Stuart. Though the two don't like each other, they maintained the status quo as betrothed. According to Selena Burke, she is praised as the most intelligent woman in the country.

appearsIn.title: My Next Life as a Villainess: All Routes Lead to Doom!

name: Ritsuka Hara
description: Landlord of the apartment [Koduka](https://anilist.co/character/143660) lives in. She is good at cooking.

appearsIn.title: I Can't Believe I Slept With You!

name: Chiyo Koduka
description:
__Likes:__ Alcohol and games.

Currently unemployed, previously worked at a game company.

appearsIn.title: I Can't Believe I Slept With You!

name: Judar
description:
(first appearance), 23 (now)
__Height:__ 173 cm (5'8")
__Occupation:__ Magi, Magician, Oracle
__Affiliation:__ Al-Thamen (former), Kou Empire (now)

Judar is one of the four Magi in the current era and a Magician who specializes in Ice Magic. He is the former Oracle of Al-Thamen and the Kou Empire after siding with Hakuryuu to aid him in taking over Kou Empire. According to Hakuryuu Ren, the name "Judar" was given by Al-Thamen, and his real name is unknown. He is the one of the main antagonist of the series. "Judar" in arabic means argument, debate, controversy.  

(Source: Magi Wikia)

name: Vittel
description:
Vittel was a part of the Assassin's Guild from the Parthevia Empire and later became an ally to Sinbad. 
He has light pinkish-purple hair and dark red eyes. He also has a scar on his face across his nose which cause is unknown.

name: Aum Madaura
native: 大聖母（オーム・マドーラ）
description:
The leader of a set of Pirates who robbed ships and their valued contents near the Aktia Kingdom's port. The pirates were mostly made up of young children she kidnapped and brainwashed with her Magic Tool, Holy Mother Halo Fan.

Aum (أُمْ) means mother in Arabic

name: Fukuda
description: Nakano's coworker.

name: Saki Kasukabe
description:
She is Kousaka's girlfriend. Fashionable, violent, confident, occasional smoker, and not at all attracted by the sexual charms of anime characters, Saki is not an otaku in any sense of the word. 

She follows Kousaka into Genshiken, and is eventually blackmailed by the first Genshiken chairman into joining the club. Surprisingly, Saki actually saves Genshiken from being shut down on two separate occasions, though her motives have more to do with revenge and guilt than becoming more of an otaku.

name: Makoto Kousaka
description:
Unusually handsome and cute, Kousaka is actually one of the most hardcore otaku in Genshiken. He loves hentai games and is undefeatable when it comes to video games, particularly the fighting genre. As Saki's boyfriend, Kousaka is largely responsible for Saki learning to be patient when it comes to dating an otaku.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Harunobu Madarame
description:
The second president of Genshiken, Madarame is personally chosen by the first Genshiken president to be his successor, though Madarame shows the most leadership and initiative even before formally appointed as president. He is a Gundam fan and arguably the most hardcore otaku out of all of Genshiken.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Chika Ogiue
description: Ogiue is a blunt, self-hating fujoshi and amateur artist whose inner turmoil is the focus of much of the second half of Genshiken.  Ogiue hails from the Tohoku region of Japan in the northeast, and as such frequently tries to hide her accent while she attends college in the Tokyo area.  When put under pressure though her accent tends to slip through.  Her eyesight is incredibly bad, and requires the use of contact lenses or glasses.    Ogiue is a fan of yaoi and boys' love, and her taste in doujinshi stems from a preference for shounen series.  Among the series she likes are Scram Dunk (Slam Dunk), Haregan (Fullmetal Alchemist), Reass Mood (Code Geass), and Wotaru (Wataru).    (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Kanako Oono
description: Raised in the United States since the third grade, she graduated from an American high school, joining the Genshiken at the beginning of the Fall term. Normally soft-spoken and easily embarrassed, Oono is surprisingly upfront when it comes to one of her two main passions: cosplay. With a nice figure and large bosom, Oono and her cosplaying (using costumes sewn personally by [Tanaka](https://anilist.co/character/2510/Tanaka-Souichiro), whom she begins dating) quickly become Genshiken's main attraction at student fairs. Oono's other main passion is yaoi involving muscular, middle-aged, exceedingly bald men.

name: Kanji Sasahara
description:
The third president of Genshiken. At first in denial about his otaku nature, Sasahara eventually accepts and embraces it. He loves hentai PC games despite not owning a computer until volume 3. When Sasahara assumes the title of Genshiken president from Madarame, his first decision is to push the club's initiative, and establish their own booth at Comic-Fest. While Sasahara is pretty much the "normal" otaku, his unwavering loyalty to a single character (Kujibiki Unbalance character Ritsuko Kübel Kettenkrad aka "The Chairman") makes him stand out from the others. Even the dōjinshi created by Genshiken under his leadership is a Ritsuko-themed one. Sasahara gives up being president during his senior year in order to focus on studying and finding a job, and passes the title on to Ohno.  While Sasahara starts off as a quiet, reserved member of Genshiken, he transforms into a somewhat stronger-willed individual, especially during his presidency. While not completely confident in himself, he is able to find a job as a manga editor and even fight back his own doubts in order to confess his feelings for Ogiue. As of the end of the manga, Sasahara is still dating Ogiue, and accepts the fact that she is using him as a direct model for dōjinshi. Sasahara also helps Ogiue by providing criticism and being an unofficial editor for her work in general, despite the possible risk to their relationship.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Shodai Kaichou
description: This character is the first club president, whose name is never revealed. He is eerily quiet and very stealthy, moving from place to place like smoke without anyone noticing (scaring Saki in particular), although he seems largely harmless on the surface. He appears to have a vast amount of knowledge about the college and many of the students, although he denies having hidden cameras or any other means of spying on them. He has been head of the Genshiken longer than most care to remember; some indications go back as far as 1987. He often stands on top of buildings, staring into the club room. He leaves his position as President to work on his graduate thesis, implying that he is working on his PhD. He begins the custom of the current president personally choosing his or her successor. The titles for the first 12 episodes of the anime can be interpreted as the "research" he has conducted on unsuspecting fellow club-members, as titles from after his departure are far more mundane.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Mitsunori Kugayama
description: The stuttering, heavyset Kugayama is Genshiken's only artist until Ogiue's arrival. He generally lacks the motivation and commitment to create a full-fledged doujinshi.

name: Kaminaga
description: Very beautiful and talented, she is admired by Hato by artistic ability. Hato is extremely similar to when he uses a wig similar to her hair, and can be easily confused.  She began an affair with the older brother of Hato and will marry him soon.

name: Haraguchi
description: A "phantom member" of the Genshiken, Haraguchi rarely shows up at the club room, and when he does, it is almost always bad news. He is a member of the Manga Society and Anime Society as well, but has paid his club dues for none of them.   Called "Haraguro" by those who are unfortunate enough to know him, he is roundly disliked by everyone in all three groups, and only grudgingly tolerated by his much-touted connections among semi-professional manga artists. However, as he tends to intimidate others into submission, few are willing to voice their complaints in public.

name: Rion Akagami
description: Rion is a pretty, athletic girl who is considered the school's number one idol and the ace of the Gymnastics Club. She is Akira's childhood friend and had a crush on him.

name: Miina Isurugi
description:
__Height:__ 132 cm 

The fake Miina Isurugi, real name Heijirou, is a young actor who, prior to the plane crash, was hired to dress up as the real Miina Isurugi. He is one of the very few children on the plane and worked as a child actor before the plane crash.

name: Shirou Mariya
description:
**Height:** 146 cm  Weight: 38 kg
**Class:** 3rd Year, Class 4   
**Family:** Father , 3 Older Sisters, 1 Little Brother

he first person Sengoku met after waking on the island. Mariya is (was?) one of the best students from their school. He's not very sociable, nor is he strong physically, but with his vast knowledge he's proven himself to be really reliable and useful. He never parts with his laptop (after fans made it into infinite-battery one, it was finally revealed it's charged with a foot-pump charger) the main use of which is identifying animals with an "extinct animals pictorial encyclopaedia" and creating the island's map.

name: Kanako Oomori
description:
**Height:** 165 cm 

She is a plucky young flight attendant who survives the crash. She acts as the group's medic. Even though, at first, she is seen as not very smart (she failed her flight attendant test 16 times before passing as the storyline begins) she is actually quite intelligent, knowing all the chemicals that could be used for first aid and more serious wounds. Being with Akira gives her the courage to survive and protect the others to the best of her ability.

name: Akira Sengoku
description:
__Height:__ 151 cm 

The main character of the series, a Japanese schoolboy. He seems to be a bystander who reacts to events rather than choosing his own destiny. He is regarded by his fellow students as a lazy good-for-nothing. He is not much of a reliable guy but in times of peril he springs courageously into action that helps the group survival, and eventually making him the leader of the group. He also seems to have a crush on Rion but can't express his feelings to her since they are childhood friends.    (Wikipedia)

name: Kouichi Yarai
description: 3rd year, class 4, is a tough kid from Akira's school who appears to dominate the other boys. He has some of the qualities of a natural leader. While the others are panicked from these new surroundings, Yarai finds this world as "living a life without boredom."   The son of a wealthy business man with many mistress's and is therefore  ignored by his father, never having actually met him. His mother died when he was a young child, and he was sent to his Aunt, who also later died. He is devoloping a mother/son? relationship with sensei.

name: Motoko Kurusu
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm

She is the teacher of the Akira class. She is in group with Yarai.

name: Yuki Sakuma
description:
__Height:__ 156 cm	  

She's one of Akira classmates and also the class president of his class (3rd year, class 4). After the plane crashes and the survivors scatter around the island, she sticks with Arita and his group. Being the class president, she's constantly annoyed by Akira's childish personality and laziness but she has stated that they are still good friends.

name: Shizuka Hatsuse
description:
__Height:__ 157 cm
__Class:__ 3-? 

Shizuka Hatsuse is one of the females that started out in Takashi's Group. She was the vice president of the school student council and has photographic memory, giving her near perfect memorization.   Shizuka appears to be a logical girl and is seen stopping Takashi Yamaguchi's outrageously long speeches. She seems to have a high sense of pride mainly because of her position as vice president when she was at during her time in school. She's relatively smart and is able to match things that appear in her memory easily. She takes caution of what people say to her and readily follows Akira Sengoku without objection. Shizuka despite her position is a fairly kind girl, worrying about her friends beforehand using her intelligence to try and formulate different plans to help her friends. She also isn't afraid to put herself in danger for her other friends also seen taking options first before her friends. She uses her vast knowledge to also explain and help her friends understand all types of different things thanks to her photographic memory. Doesn't waste time when it comes to helping others and she realizes when the plans they come up with are dangerous or inefficient, so she spends her time trying to formulate things more effectively instead.

name: Ji-Won An
description: The best hacker from Glory.

name: Suiko
description: She is a martial artist and a user of the Void Fist. She is the younger sister of Suiryu.

name: Bad
description: Bad (バッド, Baddo), also known by his hero alias Metal Bat (金属バット, Kinzoku Batto), is the S-Class Rank 15 professional hero for the Hero Association. Metal Bat is a young man with black hair styled in a pompadour, and dark eyes that emphasize his hot temper. Metal Bat has a great deal of confidence in himself, stating that he did not care whether a threat is a Demon or Dragon level. Like [Saitama](https://anilist.co/character/73935/Saitama), he doesn't care about his rank, and accidentally kills his enemies faster than he intended.

name: Sodachisugita Pochi
description: Overgrown Rover, or Rover for short, is a Dragon-level Mysterious Being and a member of the Monster Association. Its role is to guard the Monster Association headquarters from intrusions.

name: Geryuganshoop
description: Geryuganshoop was an alien, a general of the Dark Matter Thieves, and the right-hand man of Boros.

appearsIn.title: Backstabbed in a Backwater Dungeon: My Party Tried to Kill Me, But Thanks to an Infinite Gacha I Got LVL 9999 Friends and Am Out For Revenge

name: Pereshati Lapileon
aliases: 佩雷莎提 拉菲雷昂
description: Pereshati Zahardt is a countess. She was murdered by her familly due her father's fortune and ended up travelling back in time. She signed marriage contract with the Grand Duke Lapileon in effort to stay alive.

appearsIn.title: My In-Laws are Obsessed with Me
My In-Laws are Obsessed with Me

name: Mugi Nekozane
description: A strange girl that is very fond of cats. Appears somewhat apathetic and expressionless towards her peers, often keeping to herself, but after meeting [Minato](https://anilist.co/character/328502/Seno-Minato) she begins to open herself up more.

appearsIn.title: Learning to Love My Cat-like Classmate

name: Minato Seno
description: A fairly timid boy that sits next to Nekozane in class. Due to Nekozane usually sleeping in class Minato doesn't initiate contact with her at first, but after interacting with her for the first time and seeing a different side to her he tries to get to know her better.

appearsIn.title: Learning to Love My Cat-like Classmate

name: Naoto Takada
description: Minato's friend.

appearsIn.title: Learning to Love My Cat-like Classmate

name: Momoka Usagihara
description: A close friend of [Mugi's](https://anilist.co/character/328499/Mugi-Nekozane). Momoka dislikes [Minato](https://anilist.co/character/328502/Minato-Seno) at first, seeing him as a stalker that's after her friend, but she later realizes his motivations are pure and becomes less vitriolic towards him, though she harbors mixed feelings about his closeness with [Mugi](https://anilist.co/character/328499/Mugi-Nekozane).

appearsIn.title: Learning to Love My Cat-like Classmate

name: Eri Kawasaki
description: Owner of the cat cafe.

appearsIn.title: Learning to Love My Cat-like Classmate

name: Kiyomiya
description: Member of the photography club.

appearsIn.title: Learning to Love My Cat-like Classmate

name: Reika Sata
description: Kyouya's older sister.

name: Ga-Jang No
description: No Ga-Jang is the main protagonist of Peerless Dad. He is the adopted son and disciple of Mo Wei and the successor of the Trillion Blows Art.

name: Seo-Hyeon No
description: She is the youngest children of Noh Gajang. She is extremely intelligent and has a great talent for martial arts, surpassing her older siblings and apparently any child of her age.

name: Seo-Mun Mira
description:
Seo-Mun Mira was Noh Ga-Jang's first wife. She died as soon as she gave birth to the triplets. Noh always found traces of nobilty in her based on the way she acted and behaved, yet no clue was found.

She always brought happiness to his household until the day she died giving birth.

name: Satsuki Tachibana
description: Childhood friend of [Watari](https://anilist.co/character/209143/Watari-Suzushiro) and [Naoto](https://anilist.co/character/209142/Watari-Naoto), "Suzu"shiro. She has come back into their lives after six years.

name: Naoto Watari
description: Naoto Watari's life has revolved around his little sister. He forgoes club activities for the sake of spending time with her, leading many of his peers to label him a siscon. But as long as his sister's happy, Nao is willing to shut out any unwelcome comments about himself.

name: Suzushiro Watari
description: Nao's little sister

name: Tamayo Watari
description: Aunt of Nao and Suzushiro

name: Takuya Seo
description: A socially awkward, unassuming otaku high school boy who loves the girls' anime “Kiramon.” Nicknamed “Otaku-kun.” He tends to speak rapidly when talking about Kiramon. He's good at drawing but struggles with academics and communication. He has an aversion to gals. Through a series of unexpected events, he becomes involved with his classmates, the gals [Kei Amane](https://anilist.co/character/322471/Kei-Amane) and [Kotoko Ijichi](https://anilist.co/character/322472/Kotoko-Ijichi).

appearsIn.title: Gals Can’t Be Kind to Otaku!?

name: Kei Amane
description: The cool gal in [Takuya's](https://anilist.co/character/322478/Takuya-Seo) class. One of the top beauties in her grade. Has strong likes and dislikes, especially dislikes vegetables. Tall and skilled at basketball, but not part of any club activities. Despite her intelligent looks, she's not particularly good at studying. As for Kiramon, she insists she only likes it for her little sister-like friend [Sayu](https://anilist.co/character/392458/Amamiya-Sayu) and isn't an otaku... but...?

appearsIn.title: Gals Can’t Be Kind to Otaku!?

name: Kotoko Ijichi
description: A cheerful gal who is [Takuya's](https://anilist.co/character/322478/Takuya-Seo) classmate. She has excellent communication skills and is good at studying, but not so good at sports. She tends to get close when talking. She is the third of five siblings, with two older brothers and two younger brothers. Because she has so many siblings, she often acts as a mother figure and takes care of her younger brothers.

appearsIn.title: Gals Can’t Be Kind to Otaku!?

name: Marnak
description: Though he usually seems like a good priest, he shows a radical side that mercilessly kills wrongdoers and enemies.

name: Bupaeui Eomeoni
description: She is the god that Marnak worships and she cannot say anything except the word "murder."

name: Dacia Irmel
description: The heroine of the fantasy novel The Corrupt Priestess.

name: Pridya
description: As one of the three unique priests and masters of the Blue Flame in the Seonghwa Church, the Mother of Corruption gives him four and a half out of five fingers.

name: Kazuya Nachi
description: An upperclassman of Fuuka and Yuu. He originally wanted Fuuka to join the school's track team, which he was the captain of, but he was later persuaded to join Fuuka's band instead. He plays the drums.

name: Yuu Haruna
description: Yuu Haruna moved to Tokyo and started high school there because his parents were moved to America for business. He lives with his 3 sisters [Hibiki](https://anilist.co/character/120933/Haruna-Hibiki), [Mayu](https://anilist.co/character/120932/Haruna-Mayu), and [Chitose](https://anilist.co/character/120929/Haruna-Chitose). He uses Twitter often and posts about his life whenever he gets the opportunity. On his first day he meets [Fuuka](https://anilist.co/character/120752/Akitsuki-Fuuka) on the street where she bumps into him and falls over, with the way Yuu was standing with his phone in his hand checking Twitter Fuuka believes he was attempting to take a picture of her exposed panties while she was on the ground. She takes his phone and breaks it and they later find out they're in the same home room class the next day.

name: Sara Iwami
description: A senpai at the same school as Yuu and Fuuka, she is the younger sister of Hisashi.

name: Fuuka Aoi
description: She is first seen after the Hedgehogs' concert playing one of their songs on the street. We later find out that she is in a band and is going to play at the Denkou Rebellion as well.

name: Makoto Mikasa
description: A friend and classmate of Fuuka and Yuu. He has both British and German heritage in addition to Japanese. Mikasa is popular and well liked by everyone in class and considered to be very good looking. He appears to be particularly close to Fuuka, but not in a romantic way, as he is openly homosexual.

name: Hibiki Haruna
description: Yuu's second-oldest sister who attends college.

name: Koyuki Hinashi
description:
An up and coming idol whose CD "reached the top of the charts in just one week." She is a childhood friend of Yuu. She calls Yuu "Niko-kun" and he refers to her as "Tama-chan."

Fuuka is a big fan of her music, to the extent that listening to one of her songs makes her emotional enough to cry. One of Koyuki's songs was used as the theme for a popular movie ("Half & Half," a clever reference to another manga by the same mangaka.)

Though his sisters tease him that she would never respond to him if he contacted her now that she is famous, in reality she sent Yuu a message on Twitter.

name: Chitose Haruna
description: One of Yuu's three sisters. She refers to herself in the third-person.

name: Suzuka Asahina
description: A talented female high jumper from Yokohama that was scouted by many famous high schools because of her skill. While in Tokyo, she lives in Ayano’s dormitory, next door to Yamato. She is a serious athlete that puts a lot of pressure on herself to perform so she does not disappoint others.

name: Fujiwara no Sai
description:
A spirit from the Heian era of Japan and mentor of [Hikaru Shindou](https://anilist.co/character/90/).

Once the Go instructor to the Emperor, Sai continually plays Go, his goal being to one day play the divine move. Sai's ghost had previously possessed the real-life figure, Honninbou Shuusaku, who became a renowned Go player. He is an extremely emotional person, who often acts childish and has great mood swings. While playing Go however, his behaviour changes completely as he controls himself and his emotions to play to the best of his ability.

Sai has a high sense of honor, abhorring cheating and bullying.

name: Hikaru Shindou
description: Hikaru is a sixth grader in elementary school. An important factor in the development of Hikaru's passion for Go was an encounter early on where Hikaru becomes the rival of Akira Toya. At first, he thinks that Go is just for oldsters and he is annoyed at Sai's demand to play, but little by little his passion for Go increases as he plays more and more. From being a member of a school Go club to being an insei and finally becoming a professional Go player (at 14 years old) a year after Akira, Hikaru matures throughout the course of the series. Throughout the series, Hikaru gradually gets taller because the manga volumes are around when he is getting older and playing Go at the same time. Hikaru is often portrayed wearing clothing having the numeral "5". This is a pun on the Japanese common name for five: go. His birthday is September 20th. Part of his strength is his ability to read far into the game very fast, and to make seemingly stupid moves. These moves in fact lure the opponent to doing stupid moves, which Hikaru then traps them by.

name: Akira Touya
description: Hikaru's biggest rival and Kaio Middle School student. The son of Koyo Toya, Akira is already a very strong Go player when Hikaru first begins playing and is amazed by Hikaru's seemingly impossible strength. Since his first game with Hikaru, Akira has been obsessed with discovering the secret behind his strength. Akira has faced Hikaru again and won, but still sees a lot of strength within him. As the series progresses, they continue to play each other, but it always ends in an argument.

name: Tetsuo Kaga
description: President of Haze Middle School's Shogi club. Kaga hates Go and prefers Shogi better because his father forbade Shogi and forced him to play Go from an extremely early age, and he could never please the old man no matter how well he did, because he always loses to Akira. He also says he hates Go because Akira is better than him, while keeping a completely detached attitude towards the game. He still plays Go from time to time to keep his skills limber. He along with Kimihiro has graduated from Haze Middle School.

name: Seiji Ogata
description:
A Go professional 9-dan and student of Touya Kouyo. He first took notice of Hikaru when the latter explained a go move during a children's tournament that even professional Go players would take some time to see (which was actually Sai's doing) and later, as the rivalry between Hikaru and Akira emerged, catalyzed its development for several times, such as helping Hikaru to be accepted into the Insei test and occasionally reporting Hikaru's progress to an uninterested and disillusioned Akira. After the Net game between Touya Kouyo and Sai, Ogata also became obsessed with playing Sai and constantly nagged Hikaru. Unbeknownst to him, his request was finally granted just before Sai disappeared, during a game with Hikaru when he was too drunk to notice Sai was playing.     

Ogata is one of the best young Go pros of Japan, having been the challenger for many titles throughout the series and finally winning the Gosei and Judan titles when Touya Kouyo retires. He's frequently after the Honinbo title Kuwabara currently holds and this sparks a rivalry between them.

name: Dake
description:
Dake is called in to stop Mitani from cheating at Go. He first plays with his less dominant hand and makes bad moves on purpose. Then he gets serious and Mitani learns his lesson (and loses all his money). 

He is a very strong player and it was stated that he didn't need to cheat to beat Mitani, but just did so to make a point.

name: Yeong-ha Ko
description: A prodigious Korean Go player who is internationally considered Korea's finest young professional. Despite his age he's played in the fifth round of the prestigious Kuksu title (the equivalent of the Honinbo title in Korea) and is later selected to be the Korean captain in the Hokuto cup. He's a friend of Hong Suyong, who admires his strength and hard works and looks up to him like an older brother. However, he's also rather outspoken, arrogant and childish, as regarded by Suyong's uncle, the kind "who will react to attitude with attitude". He's frequently seen reading a notebook of game records.

name: Kouyou Touya
description: Akira Toya's stoic father. As the holder of five titles (Meijin, 10-dan, Tengen, Gosei and later Ouza), he's regarded as the best Go player in the world, and, among the Japanese, is believed to be the only player capable of holding his own against the Go Saint Shusaku (aka Sai). Like Sai, his ultimate goal is to reach the Kami no Itte (Divine Move), and Sai, recognizing his strength since the first times he returned to the living realm, wholeheartedly desired to play against him.

name: Atsushi Kurata
description:
First mentioned as a prominent 4-dan player, Kurata doesn't make an appearance until later in the story as a 6-dan. Despite being only in his early twenties, Kurata (together with Ogata 9-dan) is widely considered as one of Japan's best professionals and has been the challenger for multiple titles (although he has not win a single one). One of Kurata's most prominent abilities is his keen 6th sense, something he believe that above all else, will present solution to the problem. 

Although good-natured, Kurata is overbearingly confident and takes a liking to signing autographs, which he often adds would-have titles to his names and is fond of passing around to fans (or who he thinks his fan, like Hikaru - much to the boy's dismay). One of the rare successful Japanese players in international Go tournaments, Kurata is referred to as "Japan's Ahn Tae-seon", another similarly famous young player in Korea (later selected as team manager for Korea representatives in the Hokuto cup). Ironically, Kurata holds a rivalry with Ahn Tae-seon in person after he lost to the Korean player in the Samsung cup's quarter final (more precisely, when Ahn Tae-seon amiably and rather bluntly asked him if he had been in a slump) and is particularly competitive when the other man is concerned.

name: Gennosuke Fujiki
description: Fujiki Gennosuke is a one armed samurai from the Kogan school. Fujiki is very loyal to his master, he is also rumored to be the strongest disciple in Kogan's dojo.

name: Seigen Irako
description: Irako Seigen is introduced as Fujiki's opponent. He is a blind samurai with a very strange and terrifying sword technique.

name: Iku
description: The concubine of Kogan. When she was younger she was consistently taunted with a Children's Song and the masses fled at her approach. This public scorn only increased her dependence on her husband.

name: Mie Iwamoto
description: She is the daughter of Kogan Iwamoto. The successor of the clan is supposed to marry her according to tradition.

name: Kogan Iwamoto
description: Leader of the Koga clan who suffers from dementia, but tends to snap out of it from time to time, especially during the winter period. He is very cruel, skilled, and proud.

name: Yuna Ichihara
description: __Height:__ 154cm

name: Tatsuya Iguchi
description: Tatsuya is the top chief of Kamaekite, the school to which Hiroshi transferred to during the 2 school semester. Tatsuya is know by various names: The Inhumain, the idol, etc... He is one crazy madman who enjoys using his authority over the school students. He put Hiroshi to the test once he arrived at school. He is usually accompanied by 3 of the schools most dangerous guys.

name: Atsushi Tanzawa
description:
The 7th Gen. Head of the biker gang Kilihito.

Has the face and body structure of a female. Incredibly competent fighter.

Known for his playful, carefree attitude and being brought to tears easily, but will seldom forgive anyone who may hurt his friends or anyone in Kilihito - his punishment will be swift and merciless.

name: Kaname Abe
description: Kaname is the vice head of Kilihito

name: Yoshiki Tsurumaki
description:
Current leader of Kyoranki
A charming man who radiates charisma. Created 'Kyoranki' to take back 'Kilihito'.
18 years old. Has a criminal record.

name: Kai Rakuzaki
description: Rakuzaki Kai is the strategist and cameraman of Kyoranki. Formerly a member of Kilihito, he and the 6th Generation leadership were overthrown by the 7th Generation leadership after the death of Minagawa Jousuke.

name: Kenzou Shimohara
description: Youngest of the 3 Guevara brothers

name: Eiji Kakuta
description: Kakuta Eiji is the Captain of Kyoranki's Special Attack Forces. Formerly a member of Kilihito's 6th Generation, Nikaku was overthrown and sent to juvenile detention with other members of the Leadership. Due to a workout addiction, he has an absurdly large muscles.

name: Ikki Kakuta
description: Kakuta Ikki is the Captain of Kyoranki's Guard Squad. Formerly a member of Kilihito's 6th Generation.

name: Shuuya Meguro
description:
Captain of the Guard. Always wears sunglasses.

Childhood friends with Taguchi Masaru, they rose through the ranks of delinquents together starting in middle school, getting transferred out of 13 different schools until the 14th school, where Tanzawa Atsushi and Abe Kaname ruled.

Protects and worries for Taguchi, even now. Is one of a very few people that are friends with Taguchi, and understands him deeply.
