name: Keiji Imai
description: At 16 years old, he's one year younger than Tatsuya. Fell for Kaname's manliness and follows him around like a groupie. Got into an argument with Tatsuya the first time they met, but later became his friend after Tatsuya saved him. Idolizes Kaname.

name: Kogami Kii
description: A normal high school freshman, doesn't want to get involved in anything bothersome or build up unneeded stress.

name: Kaede Sayano
description: In the same year as Kii. Along with Ootsuki, she cruelly bullied Tsukune.

name: Wataru Himeji
description: Himeji is a deaf classmate of Kogami.

name: Shirogane Shinobu
description: Shinobu is the son of Sou Shirogane, the president of the Wahre Liebe Pharmaceutical Company.

name: Hanzawa Yoruka
description: Sophomore student

name: Hanakai Mikano
description: Mikano is a high school student. She has a brash manner of speaking and doesn't bow to bullying. She has been friends with Shinobu since they were kids.

name: Rintarou Akuta
description: Rintarou Akuta was a police officer before the magical girl attack where his sanity had slipped by the time he met the survivors from the high school, who sought refuge in the mall where he was apparently working.

name: Miki Otsuki
description: Sayano's best friend.

name: Keito Makabe
description: Keito is an employee of Wahre Liebe Pharmaceutical Company, where he is tasked with researching and developing new drugs.

name: Haze
description: Haze, a cute, loyal, heartwarming side character and love interest of Jared, serves the role of a maid for Jared and has been serving him for over a decade.

name: Makoto Nasuno
description: Gender: Male

name: Ryou Watari
description: A closeted trans man who can only express himself through his clothing. He's creative and artistic, but has trouble expressing it. Jin encourages him to be his partner on the creation of an apparel brand.

name: Chihiro Oda
description: Itsuka's childhood friend

name: Jin Satou
description: He's a new classmate from Ryou's class. He should be in 3rd year, but he's repeating 2nd year due too having many absences. He is passionate about clothing and wants to form a brand with Ryou.

name: Yutaka Kashiwabara
description: Ryou, Jin and Itsuka's classmate. He is Tsubasa's cousin, and edits their YouTube videos.

name: Chika
description: Ryou's best friend, who he has a crush on.

name: Itsuka Toudou
description: Ryou and Jin's classmate, and the sole member of the photography club.

name: Hinata-sensei
description: A passionate teacher that cares for Ryou's wellbeing.

name: Tsubasa
description: A popular YouTuber that makes videos about fashion, make-up and LGBTQ+ issues. Yutaka's cousin.

name: Mizuki Momose
description: Ryou's coworker and friend. An art student that works part-time at an Izakaya.

name: Joe
description: Has been running a clothing brand for over 20 years

name: Rinn
description: Rinn is a girl from a rural Niederland village, after her village is attacked, she happens upon the sword Gram containing the spirit of prince Siegfried.

name: Siegfried
description: Siegfried, sometimes referred to simply as Sieg, is the recently deceased prince of Niederland. His spirit inhabits his sword Gram, now wielded by Lynn and accompanies her on their journey.

name: Dietrich von Bern
native: ディートリヒ・フォン・ベルン
description: Dietrich von Bern is the prince of Bern.

name: Lyngheid
description: Lyngheid also known simply as Lyng is a dragon and twin sister of Lofn.

name: Lofnheid
description: Lofnheid or known simply as Lofn is a dragon and twin sister of Lyng.

name: Arthur Pendragon
native: アーサー・ペンドラゴン
description: Arthur Pendragon is the center of the idol group KRT13 from Britain. He and his group enter the Rosengarten Schlacht with the goal finding additional members to form the perfect idol group.

name: Gawain
description: Gawain is a member of the idol group KRT13 from Britain and a participant in the Rosengarten Schlacht.

name: Beowulf
description:
Beowulf is the king of Götaland and a returning participant in the Rosengarten Schlacht. He is well known and loved within Burgundy.

Beowulf is an enormous man, several times larger than the average person. His body has enhanced durability which allows him to fight with his schlong while remaining unscathed most of the time. Beowulf is extremely strong, capable of wielding a giant sword with just one hand and defeating monsters with his hard-on alone. He possesses a power that Orochi describes as the might of the gods dwelling within him.

name: Mjinn
description: Mjinn is an artificial intelligence created by Morgiana, residing in the electronic devices of Persia's Arabian Nights. She aids her owner Aladdin in the Rosengarten Schlacht.

name: Hagen
description: Hagen is the army general of Burgundy and Siegfried's killer.

name: Kuroko Koumori
description:
An ex-serial killer, now national executioner. Koumori Kuroko loves cute girls, sex, and annihilating her targets. Even though she is now a hired assassin by the Japanese police force, she has a record of murdering 715 people in the past since her childhood.

She has a girlfriend but actively flirts and sleeps with other women. She occasionally goes on dating sites to find said women.

name: Hinako Tozakura
description: A lighthearted and innocent yet bold girl who owns and drives her Murcielago like a psychopath. She is Kuroko's partner.

name: Ran Sabiura
description:
She's a buff underground fight champion and bartender. She won the Destoroyah tournament.

First appearance: Chapter 44, volume 7.

name: Toki Tomura
description: Reiko's girlfriend. She lives in Reiko's house and does the housework and cooking.

name: Chiyo Yanaoka
description: Kuroko's girlfriend.

name: Kaori
description: A Japanese woman who happens to be the head of the Chinese Mafia Black Company. She took over the role of her husband, Wang Jian, when he died. Eventually she escapes her role as the boss and goes to live with Reiko and Toki, and joins Reiko on her various jobs.

name: Reiko Kuchiba
description: A cold, businesslike sniper who carries out assassinations on any target, good or bad.

name: Rinko Asagi
description: A young girl whose father is the president of Asagi Electric.

name: Yukari
description: Satori Hyoue's maid.

name: Tougo Mitsurugi
description: The lieutenant detective in charge of keeping Kuroko in check.

name: Ayako Nakano
description:
__Height:__ 159 cm

A third-year high-schooler who has had telepathic powers since she was 5. She's quiet and reclusive as a result and doesn't have any friends initially, because she's afraid of what people would think of her if they knew. She is grossed out by Hayato's constant thoughts regarding her.

name: Akira Yashima
description:
Height: 184 cm
Hobbies: cycling, gaming, reading manga
Talent: can hold his breath for a long time
Favorite subject: English, art, and history
Least favorite subject: none
Future dream: traveller

One of Hayato's closest friends. He has a girlfriend whom he cycles with. He enjoys playing the "word chain" game.

name: Manami Azuma
description:
Height: 148 cm
Talent: handstands
Favorite subject: music, mathematics, biology, PE
Least favorite subject: English and history
Dislikes: being called croissant
Future dream: School teacher

A cute and fashionable third-year student. She's in love with her childhood friend, Hayato, and is fiercely protective of him, causing her to have no female friends. Her inner thoughts are often far more rude and sinister than her outward attitude and actions.

name: Hayato Toda
description:
__Height:__ 176 cm

A popular and handsome third-year student who is madly in love with [Ayako](https://anilist.co/character/126460/Nakano-Ayako). Spends all day imagining lewd things about her, which annoys Ayako greatly. 

He is the star of his school's soccer team. Is childhood friends with [Manami](https://anilist.co/character/126465/Azuma-Manami), but doesn't see her anything more than just a friend.

name: Kiyoshi Shimizu
description:
Height: 190 cm
Hobbies: weight lifting
Talent: getting animals to like him
Favorite subject: biology, modern literature, PE
Least favorite subjects: home economics
Future dream: professional soccer player

A first-year student who plays goalie for the school soccer team. Falls in love with Ayako and takes an up-front approach to getting her attention. He's hardworking, sincere, and allergic to cats.

name: Momiji Toda
description:
Height: 164 cm
Hobby: tennis
Talent: observing her big brother
Favorite subject: science
Least favorite subject: music
Favorites: potato chips, home, tiger, the movie Home Alone
Recent worry: Her girlfriend wants their relationship to be kept secret.
Future dream: She's still thinking about it.

She has a personality similar to her brother's, coming off as emotionless. Though, underneath that, she is a nice, average person.

name: Riku Azami
description: Riku Azami lived with an abusive father and a drug addicted mother. He was taken to the orphanage when his father committed suicide. He soon sought after boxing to learn how to protect the ones he loves.

name: Kyousuke Tokorozawa
description: Kyousuke Tokorozawa is a ex-boxing champion. He made Riku interested in boxing.

name: Yuki Naeshiro
description: Yuki Naeshiro grew up with Riku in the same orphanage house.

name: Shinji Baba
description: Shinji Baba is an old man and the owner of the famous Baba Boxing Gym. He used to train Kyousuke Tokorozawa and now is training Riku Azami.

name: Kaede Hyoudou
description: Kaede Hyoudou is a prodigy boxer, son of a former world champion boxer of the same name. Upon seeing Riku's fight, he got interested in him and "tasting" his punches.

name: Kazuma Tsubaki
description: A Japanese boxer who is the current lightweight Japan champion. He trains at Hyodo Gym.

name: Yuichi Mihara
description: A Japanese boxer ranked 5th in the lightweight division and training in the Hyodo Gym.

name: Toshihide
description: A half-human-half-mermaid that likes playing underwater piano.

name: Shiju
description: A mermaid that wants to learn piano.

name: Toshihide
description: A boy who suddenly woke up as a girl.

name: Rie
description: [Toshihide's](https://anilist.co/character/374495/) girlfriend.

name: Kenji
description: [Nayuta's](https://anilist.co/character/290547) older brother and protector.

name: Nayuta
description: A girl born with horns and strong magic powers.

name: Mitsuko Ehara
description: A high school student attending an art school and [Anzu's](https://anilist.co/character/374513/) older sister. After Anzu wins first place for a nude portrait of Mitsuko that is displayed at the school entrance for the entire year—much to Mitsuko’s embarrassment—Mitsuko spends the rest of the school year trying to get back at her sister by creating an equally humiliating nude portrait of her.

name: Anzu Ehara
description:
[Mitsuko's](https://anilist.co/character/374511) younger sister who she always strives to be like. Her painting of Mitsuko nude *(drawn from imagination)* won the school art competition and was hung at the school entrance all year.

*Note: The manga translates her name as "Anzu", the anime translates her name as "Kyoko"*

name: Akira
description: [Rie's](https://anilist.co/character/374504/) brother.

name: Kakihara Masao
description: A sadistic and insane man from the pits of hell with one thing on his mind "who is Ichi" and "where can I find him?"

name: Jijii
description: Jijii is a very short, old man and the leader of a small band of exiles bent on destroying the notorious Anjou gang and making as much money as possible. To do this, he has taken a young man under his wing, whom he calls Ichi. Jijii has implanted false memories in Ichi's mind, which cause him to go psychotic. Jijii, in a sense, had made this cowardly young man into the ultimate killer.

name: Shiroishi Hajime
description: On the surface, Shiroishi is just a simple-minded guy who works at a metal shop and enjoys stopping by the red light district. At night Shiroishi becomes Ichi the Killer. When pushed to the brink emotionally, Ichi becomes a sadistic monster capable of ripping men to shreds. At first Ichi only kills when his guardian, Jijii, pushes him to. After awhile, fueled by an insatiable violent perversion, Ichi begins to grow in ways Jijii hadn't dared to hope.

name: Jirou
description: Jirou, one of the twin brothers from the Ato yakuza family, is known for his inhuman strength. Towering and brutal, he dominates opponents with ease, often engaging in deadly displays of power to outshine his brother.

name: Saburou
description: Saburou, the other twin, is skilled with a short knife. While not as physically imposing as Jiro, he compensates with speed and precision, dispatching foes with ruthless efficiency. His sadistic nature and rivalry with his brother often lead to reckless acts of violence.

name: Inoue
description: An excommunicated member of the Anjo family and a current member of the Old Geezer's group, Inoue is also a heroin addict that has undergone plastic surgery to remain hidden in Shinjuku.

name: Gou Iwakura
description:
__Sentence:__ 3 years

A man of few words, he possesses both strength and an extraordinary aura of intimidation. With his youth seemingly contradictory to his prowess in combat, as well as the gunshot wound on his back, he hails from a mysterious background.

name: Yoshiaki Maeda
description:
__Sentence:__ Indefinite  

An ordinary boy who wouldn't look out of place anywhere, he was imprisoned on false charges. Although cowardly, with no stomach for fighting, he appears to have a sense of justice.

name: Mitsuru Yamanoi
description:
__Sentence:__ 2 Years 6 Months 

Always with a calm and collected demeanor, he passes judgment with a precision bordering on cruelty. With his high intellect, he tends to look down on those around him. He also goes by the nickname "Noiman."

name: Masafumi Yoshioka
description:
__Sentence:__ 2 years 3 months

Although seemingly aloof and condescending, he is a sly fox who is always hiding a knife somewhere. Contrary to his dignified appearance, he is always ready for a fight.

name: Shinpei Hanabata
description: Hanabata is introduced in Chapter 8: Daydream Killers. He is accompanied by his best friend, Kasahara Yuuji, and his son, Hanabata Riku.

name: Yuuji Kasahara
description: Kasahara is introduced in Chapter 8: Daydream Killers along with Hanabata Shinpei. The two have been best friends since childhood. Kasahara has the accent that is common to the people from the Kansai region of Japan

name: Kiyoharu Hitotsukabuto
description: Head of the Shouran Academy, filling the role of the leader. Although he controls the delinquents with power, he is also shown to have mercy. It is said that he can "see" two seconds into the future.

name: Chae-Rin Eun
description:
A woman who appeared in the world of a novel after dying. She became the main character - Chaerin Eun, a "drop-dead gorgeous" girl who was only liked by her admirers. She lives a comfortable life inside the novel, until the day on which Jeha was supposed to confess to her comes.

She tries every way to live a normal life again. After living and dying around 400 times, she meets a mysterious extra who dies in front of her afterward. After reviving, she promises herself to find her helper and dedicates her time, life, and resources to help the classmates.

name: Se-Yeong Jin
description: Eun Chae-Rin's classmate and bully. Se-Yeong is in love with Chae-Rin and wants to create a rift between her and Jeha.

name: Mihui Yang
description:
__Height:__ 148 cm

A student in Class 2-3. Mihui runs a MeTube channel called HuiHui TV.

name: Jin-Hui Choi
description:
__Height:__ 164 cm

A student in Class 2-3. Skilled in kendo, Jinhui has won a national kendo competition.

name: Chae-Ram Han
description: Chae-Ram is the eighth student that Chaerin becomes able to see, when she kills Ms. Lee. Chae-Ram is a capable gymnast who was able to scale the side of the school building to another floor and jump onto the shoulder of a monstrous zombie. She seems to be aware that Chae-Rin cannot see their faces, and that she's lying about being from the future.

name: Ji-Hyeon Jung
description:
Ji-Hyeon is the seventh student Chae-Rin is able to see, when she takes Chae-Rin's side against Ms. Lee.

Ji-Hyeon is kind and considerate. She is on the volleyball team, but otherwise is not mentioned much in the original novel. However, Chaer-Rn learns that the day before the zombie incident, she sprained her ankle. She is also a singer who uploads her songs to MeTube.

name: Se-Eun Ham
description: She is the first person other than Je-Ha that Chae-Rin becomes able to see. She is a "rumor amplifier," who can make any gossip seem realistic and spread it around. In the original novel, she spread rumors about Chae-Rin and Je-Ha. Chaer-Rin takes advantage of Se-Eun's talents to convince the other class members she is telling the truth about the zombie apocalypse.

name: Sin-Bi Yun
description:
Sin-Bi  is the third student in the class that Chae-Rin becomes able to see, after Chae-Rin confronts her about the voodoo dolls.

She usually takes the bus to school, but Chae-Rin texts her to get a car ride instead to avoid becoming infected. In timelines where her infection was not prevented, she infected the rest of the class. She is good at making things with her hands and used to make voodoo dolls and leave them in Chae-Rin's desk. She is friends with Ju-Ri Ma.

name: Ha-Na Do
description: Ha-Na is the class president. She and Seon-Yeong Kim are the fourth and fifth students Chae-Rin is able to see, becoming visible to her at the same time when she recognizes their strengths.

name: Ri-Na Song
description: Ri-Na is the tenth classmate that Chae-Rin is able to see, after Chae-Rin promises to take her to Min-U Ha. The most violent girl in the class and the main bully of Chae-Rin in the original book. She is incredibly strong and is shown to defend herself easily against the zombies on many occasions. She loves the classic Chinese novel Romance of the Three Kingdoms and idolizes the character of Lu Bu. She is in love with Min-U Ha, who she calls her "little pop rock".

name: Yuu Ayase
description:
Yuu is a 17-year-old boy with a short stature. He possesses striking red hair and red eyes. Despite being described as average, his most notable feature is his handsome and beautiful face, which he inherited from his mother, Subaru Ayase.

Yuu is a naturally kind and caring boy, always willing to help the Mikadono Sisters and those in need, even if it means butting into their business. He approaches life with extreme positivity and proactivity, often going above and beyond to lend a hand. However, the sisters sometimes see his kindness as a weakness and tease and scold him for it, yet still find it appealing and fascinating.

Since childhood, Yuu has been scorned for being talentless despite being the son of Subaru Ayase. As a result, he is very self-aware of his capabilities and incompetence. Despite his low self-esteem, he strives to excel in housework and cooking, where he can shine. His cooking skills are unrivaled, and he accommodates the sisters' extreme diet choices with ease, much to their astonishment. However, he occasionally pushes himself too hard and ends up getting sick.

appearsIn.title: Dealing with Mikadono Sisters Is a Breeze

name: Kazuki Mikadono
description: Kazuki is the eldest of the Mikadono Sisters. She possesses outstanding acting and singing skills, capable of flawlessly portraying roles that are deemed impossible by others, and she also has incredible ticket-selling power, as every performance she appears in is sold out. Despite being part of an all-female theater group, she specializes in male roles due to her deep voice and polished appearance, which makes her extremely popular among women as a prince figure. However, she internally feels a compulsion to lead and help others without relying on anyone, in order to live up to her image as everyone's prince. Despite her perfectionist image, she surprisingly has a picky eating habit.

appearsIn.title: Dealing with Mikadono Sisters Is a Breeze

name: Niko Mikadono
description: Niko is the second eldest of the Mikadono Sisters. Despite her small stature of 150cm, Niko is a karate athlete who overwhelms her opponents with immense strength, winning numerous medals. She has exceptional physical abilities since childhood, dominating various martial arts competitions, and her robust and charismatic personality reflects her strict attitude towards herself and others. However, she also has a shy side and has a tendency to enjoy cute and bright things.

appearsIn.title: Dealing with Mikadono Sisters Is a Breeze

name: Miwa Mikadono
description:
Miwa is the youngest of the Mikadono Sisters. She is a high school girl with a unique two-tone short cut, with the top of her head being blonde and the rest of her hair being green. Like her sisters, she also has golden eyes.

Miwa is a genius shogi player with an IQ exceeding 180, occasionally winning in shogi and chess competitions and leading her team to victory in international mathematics competitions as the youngest female representative. However, her outstanding genius often isolates her from others, as she lacks interest in mundane conversations and people tend to keep their distance from her. Moreover, her genius is predominantly focused on her intellect, so her physical abilities are mediocre compared to Yuu's.

appearsIn.title: Dealing with Mikadono Sisters Is a Breeze

name: Guideau
description:
A feral, violent girl with long fangs and the eyes of a beast. A witch's curse can be seen in the form of a rose tattoo on her collarbones.

Guideau currently works for the Order of Magical Resonance, a group that works by magic, for magic and of magic. Her partner is Ashaf.

name: Ashaf
description:
A soft-spoken man with delicate features, a coffin strapped to his back, and an entourage of crows.

Ashaf currently works for the Order of Magical Resonance, a group that works by magic, for magic and of magic. His partner is Guideau.

name: Phanora Kristoffel
native: ファノーラ・クリストフル
description: Ashaf refers to her as "the greatest necromancy specialist the Order of Magical Resonance has to offer."

name: Johan
description: Phanora's assistant.

name: Izana Shinatose
description: Shinatose is a Guardian pilot and quickly becomes [Nagate's](https://anilist.co/character/22249/Tanikaze-Nagate) best friend, constantly following Nagate and teaching him about the life inside Sidonia. Izana is a new third gender that originated during the hundred of years of human emigration into space.

name: Nagate Tanikaze
description: The series main protagonist who was created by his grandfather deep inside Sidonia, thus he did not undergo the special genetic treatment to develop the ability to perform photosynthesis and must eat on a daily basis like a regular human for nutrition. Despite having a hard time adapting to Sidonia's way of life and getting in trouble constantly while being rejected by the other humans due to not being aware of the laws and attributes of the new culture, he eventually becomes the spaceship's ace pilot after saving the day on several missions.

name: Tsumugi Shiraui
description:
A gauna/human hybrid created by Kunato Developments for fighting against the Gauna. Similar in size and appearance to a guardian, but having a gauna-like appearance, her prowess in combat is rivaled only by Nagate's. She becomes friends with Nagate and Izana, usually interacting with them at their house by a tentacle she sneaks by the vent system while her main body stays at her hangar. 

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Shizuka Hoshijiro
description: She is a Guardian Pilot who is ranked number 2 among the trainees. She is the first Sidionian who [Tanikaze](https://anilist.co/character/22249/Tanikaze-Nagate) became friends with. She is also his classmate and fellow squadron team mate.

name: Hou Honoka
description:
One of the 11 Honoka sisters who are all Guardian pilots. They are long haired albino females who appear identical due to being human clones.
(Source: Wiki)

name: Ro Honoka
description:
One of the 11 Honoka sisters who are all Guardian pilots. They are long haired albino females who appear identical due to being human clones.

(Source: Sidonia no Kishi Wiki)

name: Benisuzume
description: Story spoiler:

name: Kobayashi
description:
The mysterious young female captain of the Sidonia spaceship who commands the Guardians into attacking the enemy Gauna aliens. Known to most just as The 28th Generation Captain, her face appears concealed behind a Japanese Kabuki mask most of the time.

Source: Wiki

name: Drake Khet
description:
__Nicknames:__ 1 in 7 Billion (용냥이), Drakie

Ranked No.1 in the Archers ranking and has mastered the unconventional "Archer" class. He was the indisputable #1 on PK rankings, with many players recognizing him as the "True World Rank #1". Drake is especially fond of PVP in Deus Ex Machina and does not hesitate to fight against a player. He uses a crossbow and a dagger for close combat, but is also able to set up traps.

appearsIn.title: I Get Stronger the More I Eat

name: Ruwanda Bailey
description: Ruwanda is the son of Miranda, a murderer. He was a lonely child raised in captivity. Sometimes, his behavior turns into that of a killer but with the mind of a child.

name: Ivan
description: A boy born and raised in the slums. Ivan was sold off by his father due to his crippling debt. Ivan soon became obsessed with money, believing his family could become whole once more if he simply had enough money. Due to his father’s poor habit of drinking till he passed out, Ivan happened to pick up the same drinking problem.

name: Macaro
description: Macalo grew up in a wealthy family, a result of one of her parents being a doctor. She doesn't feel guilty when killing animals as she hunts.

name: Midwinter
description: Midwinter is the boss of an organization who asks Ruwanda to do jobs for him. He conducts himself in a gentlemanly manner.

name: May Glickman
description: May Glickman is a loyal man who, despite being an assassin, has a remarkable sense of camaraderie. He returned to the hitman organization after leaving for three years.

name: Miranda
description: Miranda is Ruwanda's mother and a murderer. After abandoning Ruwanda, she relied on private tutors and sitters to raise him.

name: Will
description: A psych worker at the orphanage. He was worried about Rwanda.

name: Kevin Glickman
native: ケビン グリックマン
description: He is the adopted son of May Glickman. May loves him very, very much.

name: Takumi Aterazawa
description: A forthright twenty-year-old university student who is childhood friends with Miu, Takumi fell in love with Ayako after witnessing her declaration to adopt Miu ten years ago. Living next-door, he frequently visits the Katsuragi family and also acts as Miu's tutor at Ayako's request. After ten years of diligently keeping his love secret, he finally confesses to Ayako.

appearsIn.title: You Like Me, Not My Daughter?!

name: Ayako Katsuragi
description: A kind and somewhat dense thirty-four-year-old housewife who works from home, Ayako is a successful editor and frequent intermediary between clients and creators at LightShip. Following the tragic accidental death of her sister, she takes responsibility for Miu's upbringing by adopting her and has been a devoted mother since. Between raising Miu and her career, Ayako has never been free to pursue a romantic relationship.

appearsIn.title: You Like Me, Not My Daughter?!

name: Miu Katsuragi
description: A mischievous fifteen-year-old in her first year of high school, Miu is Ayako's adopted daughter. Having long been aware of Takumi's feelings and wishing for her mother's happiness, she encourages Ayako to date him.

appearsIn.title: You Like Me, Not My Daughter?!

name: Satoya Ringou
description: A young and fashionable man with childish features. He has a trendy dress sense and enjoys wearing shiny accessories and painting his nails. As a university student who shares classes with Takumi, the pair become fast friends and confide in each other.

appearsIn.title: You Like Me, Not My Daughter?!

name: Yumemi Oinomori
description:
A charismatic editor that worked for a famous publisher, Yumemi became independent ten years ago and founded her own publishing company, LightShip. As CEO, she is Ayako's employer. Yumemi is an amorous woman with a masculine manner which has led her to divorce three times--each a result of cheating on her spouses. Despite earning a high salary, most of her wealth goes into paying alimony to her ex-husbands.

Yumemi is fond of Ayako and encourages her to find love.

appearsIn.title: You Like Me, Not My Daughter?!

name: Tomomi Aterazawa
description: Tomomi is the mother of Takumi Aterazawa and the neighbour of the Katsuragi's, Ayako and Miu. She is supportive of a relationhip between her son and Ayako.

appearsIn.title: You Like Me, Not My Daughter?!

name: Tatsuya Kaname
description:
Madoka's little brother. He's 3 years old and goes to kindergarten.  

(Source: Puella Magi Wikia)

appearsIn.title: Can You Just Die, My Darling?

name: Mika Hanazono
description:
Hanazono Mika, is Kamishiro's childhood friend and high school classmate.

She is a young girl of medium height, slender body, brown eyes and light brown hair. Many kids at her school consider her attractive. She is usually dressed in school uniform.

She is a very kind young woman who generally cares for others, a gesture she acquired as a child. After the collapse of the school building she acquired partial amnesia and became somewhat distracted.

appearsIn.title: Can You Just Die, My Darling?

name: Akito Nishibashi
description: He is a teammate of [Taku Kamishiro](https://anilist.co/character/124970/).

appearsIn.title: Can You Just Die, My Darling?

name: Yuuna Hayashi
description: A member of C.I.D.'s "Zero Squad". As such, she is entirely void of emotions, and remorselessly kills those infected with "Id".

appearsIn.title: Can You Just Die, My Darling?

name: Senichi Sasaki
description: Chiho's father.

name: Amane Ooguro
description: Amane Ooguro is the niece of [Miki Shiba](https://anilist.co/character/83461) who was the temporary shop owner of "Ooguro-ya".

name: Riho Sasaki
description: Chiho's mother.

name: Camio
description: Camio Is the Minister of the Demon World and the Deputy Demon King during Satan's absence.

name: Toshirou Kamiya
description: Toshirou, a young man suffering from poverty, discovers a glimmer of hope through Transfloration. After undergoing the surgery, he can now hear the voices of spirit blossoms.

name: Yomiko Hourai
description: An employee of the government- run Transflora Medical facility and a childhood friend of [Toshiro](https://anilist.co/character/305110/Toshirou-Kamiya)'s. She loves eating more than anything.

name: Mine Yatsuka
description: Police inspector. She is also [Akira](https://anilist.co/character/330907/Akira-Yatsuka)'s aunt.

name: Shinichi Tasaki
description: Police inspector who worked to find Ivy.

name: Jin Hiragishi
description: An employee at the national transfloration institute. A section chief known as the "Chief of None", meaning he is not tied to overseeing a particular section. [Yomiko](https://anilist.co/character/305111/Yomiko-Hourai) and [Toshirou](https://anilist.co/character/305110/Toshirou-Kamiya)'s boss.

name: Outarou Kuudai
description: A brilliant scientist who worked in Antarctica and invented the transfloration technique. He'll do anything to satisfy his curiosity.

name: Kaori Kamiya
description: [Toshiro](https://anilist.co/character/305110/Toshirou-Kamiya)'s mother.

name: Saeko Kanaeno
description: Former border guard. She now works as Akira's bodyguard.

name: Ii
description:
The Nonsense User, a boy that drastically plays down his abilities, yet inevitably solves any mystery he encounters. Ii is an abnormal person. A "defective product." Unable to express much emotion, he is often seen with a neutral expression; however, Ii is able to express some emotion in some circumstances. At the beginning of his second year in junior high, he joined the ER3 System and went to Houston in America for 5 years and later returns to Japan at the age of 19. Upon return, he begins to attend Rokumeikan University in Kyoto. Ii is "friends" with [Tomo Kunagisa](https://anilist.co/character/29594/Kunagisa-Tomo), though he refuses to admit he has any and instead calls them acquaintances. Also known as the "mirror image" of [Hitoshiki Zerozaki](https://anilist.co/character/34293/Zerozaki-Hitoshiki), he is believed to be what Ii would be like if he didn't hold back. 

Tomo is helped out by Ii at times, having a friendly relationship overall. The two are similar, being unable to fully express emotions, though Tomo can only truly express happiness. Despite this, she and Ii had an incident a few years back that she never wishes to happen again. The incident is believed to be Ii leaving Tomo for 5 years. 

As the mirror image of Hitoshiki Zerozaki, the two are unable to harm each other as they can both predict the other's moves. Their relationship is a strange one, as both of them are vastly different yet so similar to one another.

name: Tomo Kunagisa
description:
The technological genius Blue Savant and heiress of the Kunagisa household. Tomo is a young girl who is well versed in computer engineering, capable of crafting computers that are much more powerful that anything on the market. Most known for being the leader of Team, a collection of genius hackers. Due to Tomo's renowned computer genius, she is invited to Wet Crow's Feather Island by Iria Akagami. Tomo brings Ii with her, to help her get around. 

Tomo stands out like no other, having blue hair and eyes due to recessive genes. Her hair may get even darker if she refuses to wash it, becoming ultramarine, which can happen often as she hates taking baths. Due to this, Ii usually just throws her into a bathtub. Ii also tied up her hair in many ways, from braids to quadtails. Tomo herself enjoys fun, though she is not the best at being sociable, as she rarely listens to others besides the task at hand. Unlike most people, Tomo thinks somewhat backwards. Ii describes her thinking as instead of building a sand castle with what's needed, Tomo simply has a whole pile of sand and removes what isn't needed. Additionally, she is nearly incapable of expressing anything other than happiness, besides a tad of minor annoyance.

As the leader of Team, Tomo bears the title of "Walking Wrath." She manages all of Team, and will get assistance from the other members for whichever goal she has in mind.

name: Maki Himena
description:
One of the geniuses invited to Wet Crow's Feather Island for her ability as an esper and fortune-teller: Maki Himena. As a fortune-teller, she often provides her abilities for politicians and corporate clients. Generally, Maki is seen as cynical towards others at times, primarily Ii. When it comes to Ii, she cannot help but dig into him, as she despises people who push responsibility onto others.

Though she will pick on some for their personalities, Maki isn't inherently bad. She has no trouble with having an enjoyable time with others, such as Shinya Sakaki when the two drink together. When waking up, Maki is not too energetic in the morning due to low blood pressure.

As a fortune-teller and esper genius, Maki is capable of knowing almost everything about nearly any person, whether she wants to or not. Gifted with retrocognition, precognition, and telepathy, it's nearly impossible to keep secrets around Maki, unless being one of the few who she cannot read and disrupts everything. Even if she wanted to, she cannot stop her ability of knowing everything about almost everyone. She describes her ability as being in a room full of televisions that she cannot turn off or change channels.

name: Jun Aikawa
description:
The fierce Desert Eagle coated in scarlet. The unstoppable Laughing Red Tigress. Humanity's Strongest: Jun Aikawa. Renowned for her prowess in anything and everything, Jun is the most powerful person in the world. Her occupation is that of a contractor and will take any job, no matter how trivial or illegal it may be, so long as money is involved. Those that call her by her last name are considered her enemies, thus she insists friends to refer to her as Jun. Her abilities are practically limitless as a Multidisciplinary Master. [Ii](https://anilist.co/character/29593/Ii) and Jun initially meet by pure chance and their fates become intertwined.

With a strong sense of justice and a wild personality, Jun can be a lot to handle for the average person and especially Ii. He is particularly bothered by Jun's hatred for leaving things half-assed. On top of that, Jun is a rather arrogant individual. Despite this, she does value her friends and trusts them greatly. A majority of the people that hear her name fear it, as many over-the-top stories exist about her feats. Though some of the said feats may be completely wrong, Jun is a very intelligent woman and is considered to be a genius among geniuses. 

As Jun is known both for her abilities and her mind that is like no other, she is said to be Humanity's Strongest. Being the Multidisciplinary Master,  she is a master of disguise, sound imitating, lock picking and mind-reading.

name: Kanami Ibuki
description:
An esteemed painter without any fixed style who was once blind: Kanami Ibuki. After miraculously having her vision restored, she became a painter as a way of portraying the beauty she witnesses. Along with her prior blindness, Kanami has bad legs and is unable to walk around much, if at all, thus she sits in a wheelchair-like apparatus. Since she was blind, she's had a caretaker, Shinya Sakaki. Once her vision returned, Shinya taught Kanami how to paint, though was swiftly surpassed by her.

Kanami is a rather quiet person, keeping herself neat and tidy, though she is more than capable of talking, even arguing, with others. She doesn't get along well with others and can easily hate other people, though she hates Akane Sonoyama the most. Besides that, Kanami can have calm conversations with Ii or apologize if she goes too far.  When conversing with Ii, she often says, "You didn't know?," as a catchphrase.

Kanami is a harsh artist, and will not hesitate to destroy a piece she's made. If the art's audience cannot describe what makes it good, she considers it worthless and simply shrugs it off. 

Akane and Kanami often verbalize how much they hate each other even with the slightest of mention. Kanami, however, respects Akane's position, but hates her as a person. On the contrary, Akane hates painters but doesn't particularly hate Kanami herself.

name: Shinya Sakaki
description: The attendant that came with Kanami Ibuki to Wet Crow's Feather Island as her caretaker: Shinya Sakaki. A friendly man that assists Kanami when needed, though she can be stubborn. He cares for Kanami greatly, yet does speak ill of her personality towards others. He considers himself and Ii to be similar as they both aren't geniuses and are companions of actual geniuses, though the similarities end there. Originally, Shinya was the one that taught Kanami how to paint after her vision was restored.

name: Iria Akagami
description:
The heiress to the Akagami Foundation who is exiled on Wet Crow's Feather Island: Iria Akagami. A girl that is absolutely fascinated by geniuses, wishing to be around them for their impressive minds. As such, she invites geniuses from all around the world to live with her for periods of time. On top of letting others live on her estate, Iria also pays them a hefty amount to live there, should they accept. Upon learning about Jun Aikawa, she becomes utterly infatuated by her and believes she is a genius among geniuses.

Iria is emotionally immature and not too sophisticated as her position and wealth may suggest. At times, it's not rare to see Iria pull tricks for her fun. Besides that, she has not too much trouble being social and friendly, though she can give others the cold shoulder at times. When it comes to Rei Handa and the Chiga triplets, she considers them family and loves them very much.

name: Yayoi Sashirono
description:
A genius chef that has been an attendant of Wet Crow's Feather Island for the longest out of anyone else: Yayoi Sashirono. Acting as the island's main chef, she makes exquisite meals that are rumoured to be impossible to recreate even with a recipe. When Yayoi was younger, she opted to become a chef as she has phenomenal tasting and smelling abilities, able to discern much more flavours and scents than the average person. On top of that, she is able to figure out a person's  from tasting their sweat. 

Unlike most of the other island residents and guests,Yayoi herself is down to earth and exuberant. Despite her great abilities as a chef, she is not arrogant whatsoever and just enjoys cooking.

name: Akari Chiga
description:
The eldest of the Chiga triplets, Akari acts as one of the four maids on Wet Crow's Feather Island. As with the other maids, Akari has vowed to serve Iria Akagami, despite anything that happens.

Contrasting Akari's twin sisters, she has a somewhat unstable personality. Normally, she is alright and acts like a proper woman, though she is known to get violent when things go awry. Despite this, she is quite sharp of a person.

name: Akane Sonoyama
description:
A genius scholar, known as one of the Seven Fools in the ER3 System: Akane Sonoyama. Proud of her abilities in mathematics and English, Akane strives with her intellect; however, she doesn't do well in yojijukugo. In her younger years, she became a champion in a Karate tournament, making her capable of defending herself with ease. 

Akane is relatively friendly towards others, regardless of their intellectual ability, though this doesn't stand if they're painters such as Kanami Ibuki. Unfortunately for Kanami, she faces the brunt of Akane's hatred for them, as she considers them to be, "worse than thieves." Though this can concern others, such as Ii, Akane does have a good sense of humour. Additionally, she smokes and is quite anti-feminist. 

As a member of the Seven Fools, Akane has higher intellect than a majority of other geniuses. Despite this, she considers Fraulein Love and Assistant Professor Hewlett to be the second and first smartest people in the ER3 System, respectively. The depths of her ability aren't entirely known, though she is capable of playing Shogi against herself in her head.

name: Ki-Bong Kim
description: He was trapped in the Awakening Test for 3000 years.

name: Kang-Hwi
description: He likes to follow Kim Ki-Bong around.

name: Kira Aso
description: Kira Aso is only interested in painting. She doesn't have many friends and she is extremely shy. She lives with her mother, because her father died. One day she meets Rei Kashino, a well known womanizing slacker. Kira is entranced by Rei's beauty and expressions, and decides to paint him.

name: Rei Kashino
description: An extroverted playboy, Rei rides motorcycles in a professional circuit. He only entered high school because he made a deal with his father that if he did he could move out of the house. He and his father do not get along. He had a twin brother, Sei, who committed suicide the day before their birthday.

name: Kurasawa
description: A student in Kira's art club who drives much of the plot of the second volume. He  has a lot of technical skill as an artist, but as Rei observes, lacks emotion in his art. Kurasawa lashes out, recognizing the truth in this due to his lack of inspiration. Under pressure to perform well at an upcoming citywide art competition and desperate, he steals Kira's drawing of a mother and child to base his painting on. After he wins Kira attempts to confront him, but he dismisses her claims, calling it a coincidence. Enraged, Rei beats him up in his own classroom and attempts to break his fingers, but is stopped by Kira.

name: Shiori Sakurazawa
description: Shiori is a girl from Rei's past.

name: Masao Kirishima
description: A bisexual effeminate sociopath who was often bullied by his only friend, Yuji Aoki. Rei had saved Masao from being beaten to death at one point in time, but barely remembers this event as the action was impulsively taken when Rei was still in shock over Sei's death. Soon after this incident, Masao kills Aoki. Masao is rather obsessed with Rei throughout the series, but to be more specific he is obsessed with the brutal side he saw when Rei saved him. Throughout the series Masao tries to convince Rei to let that brutal side of him take over and to become just like him. He strongly starts to dislike Kira after he sees that she is trying to nurture the good side in him, which is the exact opposite of what he's trying to do.     Masao is proven to be extremely manipulative throughout the series. To get close to Kira and Rei he tricks them by acting very innocent, pure, and naive. And when later on in the series he gets admitted into a psychiatric hospital, he completely fakes getting better and feeling emotions just so he can get out.

name: Harumi Sugihara
description: Kira and Rei's classmate. She sleeps with Rei once and, having strong residual feelings for him, becomes antagonistic toward Kira once she begins spending time with Rei. She harassess Kira, jostling her desk so she cuts her hand and later stealing her shoes, eventually getting violent. She threatens to smash Kira's fingers with a dumbell so she will have to stop drawing, but when Kira says that she can relearn drawing with her other hand or even her feet because she can't lie and say she doesn't have feelings for Rei, Harumi is unable to follow through.    Harumi comes to terms with Kira and Rei's blossoming relationship and gives Kira her blessing, deeming her an acceptable match for Rei. She and Kira become good friends and she provides support for Kira through the ups and downs of her relationship with Rei and her troubled home life. Harumi later becomes Tatsuya's girlfriend.

name: Takayuki Kashino
description: Rei's 'father' and the president of a multi-million dollar electronics company, Mr. Kashino is sterile. His wife cheated on him with his brother because he was infertile.  he accepted Kira as His Daughter In Law

name: Shoko Kashino
description: Rei and Sei's mother who died while they were both a young age. At the beginning of the series, Rei doesn't really seem to have much of an attachment to her, saying that him and Sei only really relied on each other and always have.

name: Akihiko Kashino
description: Rei and Sei's real father who died in a racing accident.

name: Sei Kashino
description: Rei's twin brother and a sensitive artist, Sei committed suicide during their last year of junior high. Rei was raised to protect him, and thus blames himself for his brother's death.

name: Gorilla
description: The protagonist featured in _1-nichi Go ni Shinu Gorilla_, who is shown to be a gorilla, and has stated he will die the next day.

name: Zheng Luo
description:
__Race:__ Human
__Eye Color:__ Gold
__Age:__ Unknown

Luo Zheng is a faithful and loyal friend and family member who treats others with as much compassion as is shown towards himself. Reacts vengefully and aggressively towards those who would mistreat his friends, family, or himself. Takes pride in his accomplishments in a way that is borth humble and visible, he would also go through any lengths for his little sister Luo Yan .

He was the young master of the previous head of the Luo Clan, After the death of his father the Zheng branch of the Luo Clan became mistreated by the rest of the clan where Luo Zheng was forced to act a slave/punching bag to the other martial artists of the Luo Clan. One day he finds a book left from his father which he tried to burn but in the process gains the power of the 9 dragon cauldron and black fire which tempers his body into a weapon.

appearsIn.title: Principles of Heavens: Zen’s Cultivation of Immortality

name: Yan Luo
description:
__Race:__ Human

The younger sister of Luo Zheng was labeled as a genius at a young age and then sent away at the age of thirteen in order to train and study to further develop her abilities. She possesses the extreme purple yin physique hence why she has such great talent and was held captive by Cui Xue, the east heretic king, for a special cultivation technique because of her body cultivation type.

appearsIn.title: Principles of Heavens: Zen’s Cultivation of Immortality

name: Yudie Ning
description:
Years Old
__Race:__ Human
__Eye Color:__ Red
__Hair Color:__ Brown


Ning Yudie is the current Lord of Cloud Temple and the first love interest of Luo Zheng. She was adopted by the previous Lord of Cloud Temple.
She eventually becomes the bride of Luo Zheng and gives birth to a child called Luo Nian.

appearsIn.title: Principles of Heavens: Zen’s Cultivation of Immortality

name: Youqin Xi
description:
__Age:__ Unknown 
__Race:__ Human
__Eye Color:__ Gold
__Hair Color:__ Silver/White

Luo Zheng encountered her in his attempt to prevent Cui Xie's endeavor to capture the final person with the purple mist (she possesses the black purple mist, rarest grade of purple mist) physique for his demonic array cultivation.

appearsIn.title: Principles of Heavens: Zen’s Cultivation of Immortality

name: Xiaoqiao Shi
description:
__Race:__ Human
__Eye Color:__ Gold

appearsIn.title: Principles of Heavens: Zen’s Cultivation of Immortality

name: Suzu Kanade
description: An Ayakashi Maiden who is the childhood friend of [Matsuri Kazamaki](https://anilist.co/character/175063/). She is one of few who can see ayakashi, and is often very friendly to them. However, her maiden status makes her a target for ayakashi with ill intentions.

name: Matsuri Kazamaki
description: A young boy who, along with his childhood friend [Suzu Kanade](https://anilist.co/character/174838/), can see ayakashi (a type of spirit). After he learned about Suzu's status as an Ayakashi Maiden from his grandfather, he became an exorcist ninja in order to protect her from harm.

name: Shirogane
description: A powerful ayakashi and the king of the ayakashi. He is after Suzu Kanade, wanting to consume her to increase his power.

name: Rochka
description: A snow spirit from Russia that tries to take the title of King of the Ayakashi.

name: Haya Ninokuru
description: She is Soga's younger sister who is still in training to be an exorcist ninja.

name: Soga Ninokuru
description: Soga Ninokuru is a ninja exorcist from the Ninokuru family and considers Matsuri Kazamaki as his rival.

name: Seigen Kazamaki
description: He is a ninja exorcist from the Kazamaki family and the grandfather of Matsuri Kazamaki.

name: Matoi Kazamaki
description: She is the mother of Matsuri Kazamaki. She also uses the pseudonym of Ibuki Yamase (山瀬いぶき). She specializes in wind magic. She works as a teacher in Kazamaki's school.

name: Lucy Tsukioka
description: Lucy is a classmate and friend of Suzu Kanade. She's a more silent and shy type, but she loves taking postworthy pictures of everything. She is usually always with Yayoi Toba.

name: Kong no Coach
description: Kong Wenge's coach. He is fluent in both Japanese and Chinese, and also acts as a friend and an interpreter to Kong.

name: Obaba
description: Obaba is an old chainsmoking woman who acts as Peco's mentor. She also owns the local table tennis dojo Tamura of which Peco and Smile are frequent visitors. She is close friends with Jou Kozoimi since her youth, when both were renowned table tennis players.

name: Ota
description: Team captain of Katase, known for his unusual hairstyle. He helps run the family appliance store and is often occupied with odd jobs after school.

name: Wenge Kong
description: Wenge Kong (nicknamed China by everyone else) is an extremely skilled table tennis player who travelled to Japan to start anew after he was kicked out of his home team in China. Originally his intention was to beat the local hero 'Dragon', but he finds new worthy opponents after meeting Peco and Smile.

name: Koemushi
description: A weird creature who calls itself "Dung Beetle" (Coemushi) and becomes the children's tutor after Kokopelli's disappearance. It is able to communicate verbally, and is usually very sarcastic. It responds to the children's call, which includes Kana even though she didn't sign the contract. It is able to teleport the children, as well as others from the outside world to the cockpit, and vice-versa. However, it cannot teleport directly between two places, and must go through the cockpit beforehand. Between battles, it can be seen conversing with an unknown entity.    (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Kunihiko Moji
description: A boy whose great intuition helped some of the previous pilots to defeat their enemies. Moji was kind and insightful, often ready to give advice and wisdom to his comrades when they needed it. The other children often came to him for advice. He had two childhood friends: a girl named Tsubasa, and a boy named Nagi, who had a heart disease. Upon checking, Moji found out that his heart was a perfect match for Nagi. After his victory, Moji has Dung Beetle transport him to a hospital where Nagi could receive his heart. His chair was a plastic chair with a metal frame back that curved around into a semicircle, which was the same chair in the hospital's room where Nagi was being kept.  In the anime he was the first to realise that the enemy were not just robots after an exchange of mind games with his opponent.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Daiichi Yamura
description: Daiichi was a hard-working and responsible boy despite his gruff "no-nonsense" exterior. He dedicatedly took care of his three younger siblings: Yoshi, Futaba, and Santa. He accepted this task because their mother had died much earlier, and their father abandoned them for unknown reasons three years ago. Their uncle on their father's side made up for his brothers disappearance by renting a home for the four siblings to live in, and paying for all expenses. Daiichi earned his keep by working as a mail and newspaper boy, and for his uncles landscaping business on his days off. He chose to live separately from his uncle with his siblings so that his father would have a place to return to if he ever decided to. When he and the other main characters first got involved with Zearth, he was the first to express any doubts and the first to try to leave the "game" before the group learned the truth of their involvement. His chair was not actually a chair, but a mere floating cushion, and he was lightly teased by a few of the other kids for this lack of imagination. During the fourth battle, Daiichi refused to move until the citizens had sufficient time to escape, a practice later adopted by all future pilots. When the battle began, Daiichi's will to protect his family gave him the strength to subdue Drum long enough to carry it to the bay where no one else could get hurt.

name: Maki Ano
description: The adopted daughter of an anime otaku, she was expecting a baby brother. Her battle begins the night after her mother enters labour. During the battle, she discovers that the robots that they have been fighting are in fact piloted by humans of Alternate Universes, and that the battles are the method for choosing which ones survive, and which ones don't. With every victory, 10 billion people from another universe die. As she finishes her battle, she uses Zearth's powers to see the birth of her baby brother. In the manga her chair is a baby cot, but is changed to a rocking chair in the anime version. Later is revealed that Maki's family was not informed of her fate, and continue to look for her hoping that she may be alive.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Mako Nakarai
description: Nakama was a girl who focused all or her energy on living honestly and being an active benefit to the community in hopes that others would see her as a responsible and dependable person. Despite this, the well-known fact that her mother is a prostitute and her humorless, over-responsible attitude left her no friends. Ever since elementary school any kind of hatred or dishonesty tortured her, so much that she couldn't even raise a clenched fist at all of the kids who bullied her, constantly having to keep to her duty and not protest in the slightest. Regardless, she looked up to her mother, and hoped to be able to stand proudly like she does. Nakama would even go so far as to give her mother the money she would make doing needlework. It was her mother's idea that she go to the nature school so that she would finally make some friends. Ever since the first battle she had secretly been making uniforms for herself and the other pilots but when she found out that she would be the fifth pilot she was hard pressed for time and money to complete them. She felt the quickest way to attain the necessary money was to prostitute herself and managed to convince her mother's pimp to arrange a John for her. Much to her surprise, the man she met was an old acquaintance of her mother's who drove her home after buying her dinner. Her mother, having found out about the plan gave Nakama her needlework money that she had been saving so that she wouldn't have to resort to such drastic measures.

name: Kanji Yoshikawa
description: Jun's schoolmate and friend. Before his fight begins, he reveals to Jun that despite seeing him hurting Kana, he did not intervene because his sister asked him not to. He also reveals to him a secret that makes Jun start to change his point of view about her, and asks him to watch out for Machi. Kanji's opponent is by far one of the strangest who appeared in the manga as it first launches itself into the sky then lands in a very far away place - Hawaii to be exact, then starts to fire powerful shots to a cannon orbiting the Earth which redirect them at Zearth. After Japan attempts to defeat the enemy with a nuclear bomb and fails, Jun suggests to Kanji to use the lasers to target the enemy. Although Kanji could not directly target the enemy, a human soul could be used as a target, and Seki immediately volunteers. Dungbeetle teleports Seki and 22 soldiers to where the enemy is, and Seki valiantly reaches the enemy in time for Kanji to fire, thus defeating it. His chair was a folding chair that often spun and flipped when he sat in it. After the victory, Kanji requests Dungbeetle to teleport him to the top of Chutenro tower where he contemplates who the next pilot will be in his final moments.  Kanji's role in the story is far more elaborated in the anime series.

name: Chizuru Honda
description: After killing Kako Isao, she completed his battle. Chizu was relatively calm and a bit quiet, yet particularly disgusted by the one-track minds of her male classmates. Her chair was black and fancy, carefully designed, shapely, and looked very old. While at school Chizu was in love with her teacher, but was being deceived. He lured her into a date and then blackmailed her to being gang-raped by his friends. For this reason she began to carry a knife with her at all times. During the combat she revealed she was pregnant and used Zearth's power to kill all of the men who assaulted her except the teacher, because her older sister, who was in love with him too, stopped her. After her death, the rest of children figured that Chizu's baby (who died with her) was also listed in the contract, which means that one of them, besides Kana Ushiro, was not bound to it.  Just like Kako's story, Chizu's scenario had a lot of changes in the anime version. She was seduced by her teacher just like in the manga, but instead of being blackmailed by him, he sold some pictures of them having sex which ended appearing on the internet. Despite having the faces digitally altered, they were identified by her classmates, which led to him being punished by the school's principal. He begged for Chizu's forgiveness, and just after she accepted his apologies, she discovered he was also dating her older sister. After Kako's death, she was chosen to assume his place.

name: Masamitsu Seki
description: Masamitsu Seki is one of the officers who befriended the children and assumed one of the empty places in Zearth's group. He joined the military thanks to his fascination with Idol Defense Force Hummingbird.

name: Kako Isao
description: Kako was a spoiled and self-centered coward with a severe inferiority complex. He acted as an errand boy for a group of bullies to avoid being the subject of their abuse, and his parents would let him get away with just about anything, much to his older sister's chagrin. Kako’s only "friend" was Kirie who also went to his school. Kako would constantly boss Kirie around since it made him feel less like a loser especially since Kirie would take this abuse without complaint. Kako in fact made Kirie accompany him to the nature school for this very reason. It was here that Kako developed a strong crush on Chizu. When he first entered the game Kako was excited, hoping that his piloting Zearth would make him famous, but upon learning the price of piloting, he suffered a mental breakdown and hid in his room.    (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Waku Takashi
description: Waku was an energetic and confident young boy who acted like a stereotypical shōnen main character. He was previously a talented soccer player and is considered popular. He wanted to become a professional player and his friends thought he had the talent for it. However, he found out that his salary-man father was a soccer player just like him in his youth and even played at the national level. The fact that someone just like him didn't make it shook Waku's resolve and he stopped playing soccer. If he had not quit the team he wouldn't have been at the summer class and become a pilot. He was chosen to become the first pilot of the children. After the battle with Bayonet, they celebrated on Zearth's shoulder. When Ushiro patted Waku on the back he fell off the side into the ocean. They thought that Ushiro accidentally pushed him but he actually died a moment before when his time as a pilot ended. His chair was a simple plastic folding chair. In the manga the number of casualties is unspecified, but in the anime there are 2,343 casualties.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Leo
description:
__Race:__ Human

Leo is one of the kids who were granted immunity by the Pope because he was the one who designed and who led the project in order to build the ark. He uses crutches to walk or is carried by someone else because he has bad legs which he had since he was a baby.

name: Kerry
description: An information broker in the Prison District.

name: Ran Uruma
description:
Ran is a young and willful girl with too much power and too little wisdom.

She is a big fan of Mr. Pudding, a five-minute anime that airs on weekday evenings. She likes oden, morning glories, her family, her friends, knitting, her Mr. Pudding doll and her science class. Meritocracy is valued by the sorcerers, and as a child Ran was picked on for being unable to control her own powers.

name: Zen Uruma
description: Ran and Jin's father. He is the leader of the sorcerers and head of the Black Crows. As a child, he was a small but powerful troublemaker, and he was the youngest to be admitted to the Black Crow Army. He trained under the leader at the time but fled after numerous run-ins. He later returned to the Crows and got married. Zen's broad connections and the insights cultivated during his youth led him to become the most popular person in the village. He worries about not spending enough time with his family. He likes miso, oden, kotatsu, plum wine, bonsai, the smell of ink and collecting hydrangea blossoms.

name: Jin Uruma
description: Ran's older brother. He does what he can to keep his little sister safe. He has a special coat that allows him to transform into a wolf. He specializes in physical enhancement and possesses more physical ability than he knows what to do with. He's the Uruma family's watchdog. Jin wants to battle the big guys but is forbidden to do so by order of his boss (Zen).

name: Nio Gekkoin
description: Even as a young sorceress, Nio could control her magic as well as an adult. Her mother Gekko's training ensured that Nio's magic and daily life were both disciplined and beautiful. Though traditional magic has long been handed down through the Gekkoin family, Nio is more interested in theoretical magic. She feels somewhat burdened by her mother.

name: Shizuka Uruma
description:
Ran and Jin's mother. She is considered the most powerful sorceress around. Her work keeps her away from home for long periods of time. 

She was stillborn as a child and had been laid to rest when an elder sorceress took her in and raised her with love and care. Shizuka's magic is controlled by her emotions rather than logic or theory, and it doesn't bother her that this style is becoming obsolete. Her family is her reason for living.

name: Sango Sumeragi
description:
Sango works as lady Shizuka's assistances. She has a crush on Jin and even makes a yukata for him.

A sorceress of thread and an expert at creating barriers with woven rope. As a child, Sango felt deeply anxious after falling asleep next to a naked man (a boy, rather), so she vowed to one day become his wife. She was a very impressionable five-year-old. After that, she threw herself into wifely training, and eventually her feelings of anxiety turned into feelings of love. Her skills at keeping house, sewing, and cooking are unquestionable. She's now focusing on learning about parenting and singing traditional Japanese songs.

name: Makoto Hibi
description:
An only child whose parents own a flower shop. Hibi ostracizes Ran alongside the rest of his classmates, but privately worries about her and wishes to become friends. He believes in magic and finds out about Ran's secret.

His parents have many friends so he grew up surrounded by adults. Hibi knows the names of flowers well. He has to work in the store for his allowance, and right now he wants a skateboard.

name: Outarou Mikado
description:
Rich young man that loves to play with girls. He has feelings for Ran but doesn't know that she is 10 years old.

Throughout high school, his life consisted of school, family, and studies. In college, he dabbled in a range of activities, never realizing that the reason he found them boring lay within himself. He likes Ran, silk linen, cheese, tree shade, and the unexpected.

name: Tamao Tachibana
description:
Ran's sorcery instructor whom initially was only forced into doing it by Shizuka. She later revealed having been born without any magical abilities whatsoever, but in spite of the fact that she's incapable of using actual magic, she is noted among the magic community for being the best there is in regards to magic-research.

It was her physical strength as a sorceress that helped her survive and thrive. As a child, the first powerful sorcerer she met was Zen Uruma. She was blown awway by his powerful magic, which gave meaning to her life. She likes magic, sake, sushi, futons, Master Zen, powerful magic, and sorceresses and sorcerers who are wise.

name: Ryouko Tennouji
description: Jin's classmate. She also has a crush on him.

name: Yuzuru Shino
description: __Voiced by__: Jun Fukuyama (Drama CD)    A third-year high school student who entered Houka Academy though an archery scholarship. Despite his good looks and stoic air when he draws a bow during archery, his personality is careless and casual. Due to this, girls who ask him out become disappointed and dump him after realizing that he is not the person they thought he was.

name: Touji Seryou
description: __Voiced by:__ Nakamura Yuuichi (Drama CD)    A first-year high school student who is part of the archery club though he does not attend practice very often. On Mondays, he will go out with the first person who confesses to him. However, at the end of the week, he will say: "I couldn't fall in love with you. Let's break up." Although he abruptly ends relationships like that, he retains his popularity because he will earnestly devote himself to his partner of the week.

name: Mitsuki Haruno
description: She works at a cafe called "words cafe". She's in the same class as Asakura.

description: He's the ace of Hojo High's basketball team and [Mitsuki's](https://anilist.co/character/145889/Haruno-Mitsuki) childhood friend whom she thought was a girl but is actually a guy.

name: Seong-Hun Cha
description: The secretary of Tae-Mu Kang.

name: Mavis Vermillion
native: メイビス・ヴァーミリオン
description:
Mavis has very long, wavy, pastel yellow-blonde hair that reaches down to her feet with a small ahoge; large green eyes with no pupils; peachy skin and a slight child-like build. As a consequence of using an incomplete version of a grand Magic when she was thirteen to save [Yuri Dreyar](https://anilist.co/character/126471/Dreyar-Yuri), her body was no longer able to grow or mature from that point onwards. By the time [Precht](https://anilist.co/character/38961/Gaebolg-Precht) encased her body in a Lacrima, though, Mavis was biologically twenty-four.

Regarding her usual clothing, Mavis wears a frilly, pink layered robe with a red ribbon tied in a bow around her neck. Around the chest are three blue diamond patterns with two blue triangles above. Each series of these is outlined in a hot pink. She wears wing-like adornments around her ears and small hoop earrings. She also seems to prefer going barefoot.

Mavis is The First Master and the founder of the Fairy Tail Guild. Mavis is kind and protective of Fairy Tail. She cares, guides and protects the guild whenever it's possible. She seems to be quite cheerful as she's smiling and happy most of the time. Mavis can also be quite carefree and reckless.

As a child, Mavis worked for the "Red Lizard" Guild, where she would either clean the guild's floor, the members' clothes or even make food. She was forced to pay back her parents' debts to the guild and contribute to the guild that sustained her.

name: Zera
description:
Zera was a young girl who was the daughter of Zeeself, the Guild Master of Red Lizard. 

(Source: Fairy Tail Wiki)

name: Zeref
description: The legendary dark mage Zeref is a human wizard known to history as the strongest and most evil mage to ever walk the earth. He lived over 400 years ago, but even to the present day his legacy continues in the form of other dark wizards and dark guilds who worship Zerefs power. In fact most dark guilds were founded and operate under the pretense of reviving Zeref, and helping him to conquer the world. Not only was he an incredibly strong mage, but he was also regarded as a genius, and he used his immense intellect to try to research and discover new magic, regardless of his status as the most powerful human alive. He is also responsible for the creation of tens of thousands of demons by means of his living magic, and these demons continue to roam the earth, leaving trails of destruction behind them. Aside from living magic, Zeref was also a skilled user of death magic.

name: Precht Gaebolg
description: Hades is the leader of the Grimoire Heart Dark Guild, whose goal is to unseal Zeref. He seems to be calm and confident man who shows no signs of fear to his enemies, especially Makarov. He was described by Makarov as a "great Master who taught harmony and led the Guild to the proper path."

name: Yuri Dreyar
description: Yuri Dreyar was one of the founding members of Fairy Tail. He was also the father of [Makarov Dreyar](https://anilist.co/character/5333/Dreyar-Makarov) and was a treasure hunter alongside [Precht](https://anilist.co/character/38961/Gaebolg-Precht) and [Warrod](https://anilist.co/character/126472/Sequen-Warrod).

name: Warrod Sequen
native: ウォーロッド・シーケン
description: Warrod Sequen is one of the Ten Wizard Saints and among them, he is ranked fourth in terms of strength of the Four Gods of Ishgar and the Wizard Saints in general. He was also one of the founding members of Fairy Tail, and now serves as one of the eight members of the reformed Magic Council, alongside the other Wizard Saints, barring [Makarov](https://anilist.co/character/5333/Dreyar-Makarov) and [God Serena](https://anilist.co/character/131381/God-Serena).
