name: Szayel Aporro Grantz
native: ザエルアポロ・グランツ
description:
__Height:__ 185 cm (6'1")   
__Symbolizes:__ Madness   
__Number:__ 8   
__Hole location:__ glans penis (亀頭)    

Szayel Aporro is [Yylfordt Granz's](https://anilist.co/character/1154/Grantz-Ilforte) younger brother, although Szayel is much stronger. The remains of his hollow mask take the form of rectangular-framed glasses that give him a scholarly appearance. His arrancar outfit is slightly different from others in that he wears a shorter hakama that exposes a type of sock covering his shins. His shirt is somewhat different from other arrancar as well, as most arrancar have some form of jacket instead. The sleeves are unnecessarily long, covering the majority of his hands, and it has extra seams on the chest area. In his later appearance he also dons a cape. Szayel is the scientist of the Espada, developing various spiritual equipment for use by the arrancar. Using various methods, one of which involves implanting a subject with rokureichū (a data-gathering device), he is able to analyze the spiritual power of an opponent through those that person has defeated. He is also adept at creating devices that can manipulate and suppress spiritual power, as evidenced in his battle with Renji Abarai. Much like Mayuri Kurotsuchi, he is quite sadistic and seems to view others as little more than research material.

name: Ichika Abarai
description: She's the daughter of Rukia Kuchiki and Renji Abarai.

name: Jirou Sakuranosuke Shunsui Kyouraku
description:
__Height:__ 192cm (6'3")
__Rank:__ Captain of the 8th Division   

Kyoraku is a laid back and flamboyant man, evident in his style of dress and general attitude. He wears a straw hat and a pink flowered haori over his captain's uniform. Although his haori and obi sash are cheap, his pinwheel hairpin is very expensive. In his off time, he can be seen drinking sake and napping. Other times, he likes to chase after women, which is noted by Yasochika Iemura of the 4th Squad when commenting in his diary. In particular, he often flirts with his lieutenant, Nanao Ise, whom he calls 'my Nanao-chan' (little Nanao).

He is close friends with 13th Division Captain Jushiro Ukitake, with whom he graduated from the shinigami academy and works with often.  Kyoraku tends to use a more familiar speech style than most other characters in Bleach. He generally refers to his fellow captains and shinigami by their first name followed by an honorific, and is the only character who dispenses with honorifics when addressing General Yamamoto, calling him old Yama (Yama-jī). Even Ukitake, who was also taught by Yamamoto, does not do this.

Kyoraku is a peace-loving man who will always try to talk his way out of a fight. However, he does not wish to insult his opponents by not fighting, either, as he explains to Chad. Since he has achieved the rank of captain, it is implied that he must be a powerful fighter, but the true extent of his abilities has not been seen in the anime.

name: Ikkaku Madarame
description:
__Height:__ 182cm (6'0") 

Ikkaku Madarame is the 3rd Seat of the 11th Division in the Gotei 13. His captain is Kenpachi Zaraki.  In terms of his attitude, Ikkaku is a stereotypical 11th Division member — violent, fight-loving, and rude. This has been noted by Tetsuzaemon Iba, among others. He loves fighting so much that he is unwilling to travel anywhere without a sword, resorting to carrying a wooden one when posing as a student at Ichigo Kurosaki's school. However, Ikkaku does have a sense of loyalty and responsibility unlike many of the lower-ranked 11th Division members, and is fiercely loyal to his captain, under whose command he wishes to die.  Ikkaku shares many personality traits with his division's captain, Kenpachi Zaraki, which explains why they seem to have so much respect for each other.

name: Shinji Hirako
description:
__Height:__ 176 cm (5'9")
__Shikai:__ Sakanade

Shinji Hirako is the former captain of the 5th Division, preceding his lieutenant [Sousuke Aizen](https://anilist.co/character/1086/Aizen-Sousuke). He distrusted Aizen from the day they met, and thus made him lieutenant so he could keep an eye on him. Shinji's character is somewhat comical, adding a bit of levity to situations that are otherwise serious. He seems to like annoying his associate, [Hiyori Sarugaki](https://anilist.co/character/1158/Sarugaki-Hiyori), which usually earns him a slap from one of her sandals. He also appears to have a history of referring to cute girls he meets as his 'first love', complete with a deadpan look on his face despite the obvious lie (he apparently never did this with Hiyori, further annoying her).

name: Iori Souma
description:
__Height:__ 183 cm

He is a fifth-year dentistery student at a national university in Tokyo.

name: Jin Seno
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm

He is a second year student at a private university in Tokyo.

name: Sanae
description: Yuuki's college friend.

name: Ricardo Inoadenn
description: Hillis' and Gabrielle's elder brother.

name: Diego Inoadenn
description: The former head of the Inoadenn family.

name: Fumi Hashimoto
description: The adopted son of the Hashimoto household. He got the name Fumi (letter) from the director of the orphanage because he climbed into a mailbox.

name: Chiho Wada
description: Yoneko's daughter and Fumi's classmate.

name: Yuriko Hashimoto
description: Shun's mother.

name: Hashimoto
description: Shun's father.

name: Yoneko Wada
description: She got Chiho from a previous marriage.

name: Bianca De Arno
description: The eldest daughter of Gustave De Blanchefort of the prestigious Count Blanchefort family. Born in a noble status, firm and strict, educated and strong under a father who strictly observes the dignity and etiquette of a nobleman, she is a typical aristocratic girl with a keen personality.

name: Zachary De Arno
aliases: The Count of Blood and Iron
description: Lord Zachary is the count of Arno and madame Bianca's husband. He's known as the Count of Blood and Iron due to the way his silver hair glistens like a well-forged sword when soaked with the blood of his enemies on the battlefield.

name: Sauveur
description: He's one of three Count Arno's loyal commanders.

name: Gaspard
description: He's the commander of Arno’s military force.

name: Yvonne
description: Yvonne is Bianca's personal maid.

name: Vincent
description: Vincent is the head butler of the household of Arno.

name: Takeru Amaya
description: Amaya is one of the deuteragonists of Kamisama no Iutoori. He is violent, sadistic, brutal, blood-lusting, savage, and tyrannical individual who actively takes pleasure in the destruction of everything around him to an extreme extent.

name: Shun Takahata
description: The main character of the story. Finds life to be boring.

name: Akira
description: He was a boy who lives in a slum in the eastern city of Kugamayama. He is an orphan boy, and little is known about his childhood apart from the fact that he lived on the streets, and had to fend for himself for most of his childhood.

name: Alpha
description: Alpha is the first character to be introduced after series Protagonist Akira. She is a holographic AI, and is shown to have lime green hair, with blue eyes and a white/black dress. She can change her appearance at will, since she does not have a real body and is a hologram.

name: Elena
description: Elena is a veteran Hunter.

name: Shiori
description: She is a maid and a soldier under by the lion steel corporation, and Reina's bodyguard.

name: Shizuka
description: Shizuka is a Weapon Shop owner.

name: Sara
description: Sara is a veteran Hunter.

name: Yumina
description: Yumina (ユミナ) is a young Hunter, and a member of Drankam.

name: Reina
description: Reina is a member of Drankam and a member of a rich family. She first encounters Akira while on a mission to wipe out the Yatara Scorpions infesting a ruin, being a temporary part of Katsuya's squad.

name: Ryeong So

As a commanding officer, she is hard on those under her command to help assure that they are prepared.

description: A 35-year-old novelist who lives alone. She is deeply introverted, and has not communicated with her relatives for a long time due to arguments with her [mother](https://anilist.co/character/387235) and [sister](https://anilist.co/character/363293). Took in her sister's orphaned daughter, [Asa](https://anilist.co/character/189957).

name: Emiri Nara
description: [Asa's](https://anilist.co/character/189957/Asa-Takumi) classmate and best friend.

name: Airi Sezaki
description: She places heavy importance on her social standing, and puts lots of effort into maintaining popularity and a clean image around her classmates. However, most of this behavior is an act, as in private with Hinako she reveals her true self, putting Hinako through varying degrees of suffering for her own amusement, being an perverted, sadistic and manipulative person,

name: Ichika Miyazono
description: Originally friends with Airi Sezaki. Has lived life believing that TV and movies were far more interesting than reality and wishing that life wasn't so boring.

name: Aoi Nanakura
description: One of Airi and Hinako's classmates and also part of Airi’s friend group.

name: Yoshimi Matsushita

name: Sana Machiya

name: Yuuko Hyoudou
description: One of Airi and Hinakos's classmates, also part of Hinako's friend group.

name: Aoyama
description: Another friend of Kino and Haga who is nearly, but not quite, as negative as Nozomu. In the manga, Aoyama was also given the responsibility to become the substitute 'Mr. Despair' which he keeps up for a couple chapters before quitting because he 'can't help but see a little bit of hope in everything'.

name: Mikoto Itoshiki
description:
The third son of the Itoshiki family, with an uncanny resemblance to Nozomu. He is a doctor in his private "Itoshiki Clinic". When his name is written horizontally, it resembles zetsumei (絶命, zetsumei "death"), which explains why his hospital is rarely visited by town's residents.

He has a tendency of losing control of himself whenever his name is brought up, especially if he is referred as "Zetsumei-sensei" ("Dr. Death").

name: Kiri Komori
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm

A beautiful, fair-skinned girl whose looks are hidden behind her long hair and the blanket she wears most of the time. She is a hikikomori, but [Kafuka](https://anilist.co/character/3170/Fuura-Kafuka) believes her to be a zashiki-warashi. [Nozomu](https://anilist.co/character/3169/Itoshiki-Nozomu) and Kafuka unintentionally frighten her out of her home during an attempt to persuade her to resume attending her classes, and she now takes up permanent residence in school. She also falls for Nozumu when he was judging her as a good double suicide partner. She spends most of her time in an unused room, but turns up every now and then in odd places such as school lockers or toilet cubicles. Her name is derived from komorikiri, which means "always stays indoors".

name: Kanako Oora
description: A very open-minded girl that can not refuse to entertain new ideas and let other people express their ideas, even if it means possible negative effects on herself or her property. Her name derives from the phrase "ōraka na ko" (大らかな子) which means "big-hearted girl". She usually wears her hair in a pony tail restrained by a big ribbon and keeps her hands buried inside the sleeves of her school uniform; possibly because it is a size or two too big for her. The zipper on the side of her skirt is always open.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Ai Kaga
description:
A shy, insecure girl who constantly apologizes for trivial matters and things she didn't even do. At one point she tried to become a tsundere. She seems to like Red King Crabs, receiving a printed t-shirt of it from Kino and buying a box of it at a convenience store.

Her name in Eastern order sounds like kagai (加害, "perpetrate"), and is most likely borrowed from former Morning Musume member Ai Kago.

name: Jun Kudou
description:
Jun is described in episode 4 of the second season as "Genius Storyteller. There is no story he can't tell. Good-looking guy". His stories usually drive other characters to tears even though some of his stories have a mocking purpose. He has previously checked out every book in the library [Nozomu](https://anilist.co/character/3169/Itoshiki-Nozomu) wants to read, and lives with his grandfather (a reference to [Seiji Amasawa](https://anilist.co/character/534/Amasawa-Seiji) in [Whisper of the Heart](https://anilist.co/manga/35228/)).

His name comes from the bookstore "Junkudo-Shoten" and Jun Kudou, its founder.

name: Shiori Honda
description: A high school English teacher. She was once an aspiring guitarist who was very passionate about starting a band; however, the one that originally sparked her interest, her brother, left her family in debt after taking a 20,000,000 Yen loan. His disappearance caused Shiori Honda to lose interest for the music industry and become a more recluse, timid, and plain individual. After being haunted by the ghost of Jimi Hendrix who noticed her musical talents, she is slowly re-discovering her passion for music.

appearsIn.title: SHIORI EXPERIENCE: Jimi na Watashi to Hen na Ojisan

name: Natsuki Hashiba
description:
__Height:__ 171 cm
__Class:__ 1-3

Natsuki is a shy boy with a good heart and dreaming nature. He's energetic, delusional, and like a girl when it comes to affairs of the heart. On the day his heart gets broken, he meets a mysterious girl who he can't stop thinking of.

name: Keiichi Katakura
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm
__Class:__ 1-3

Keiichi is an boy who knows what he wants. And what he wants is the ultimate masochist girlfriend who he can realize his sadistic fantasies with. Will he ever find her? Or will he have to raise one from scratch? His older brother is a teacher in their school.

name: Tomoya Matsunaga
description:
__Height:__ 177 cm
__Class:__ 1-3

Tomoya is not only popular among girls, but he's also a player. A narcissistic guy who flirts and constantly and steals the hearts of many girls in his school. But what if there is one who doesn't fall for his good looks? He's a bit overprotective of his younger sister.

name: Tsuyoshi Naoe
description:
__Height:__ 169 cm
__Class:__ 1-3

An otaku and unpredictable guy. Tsuyoshi looks like he's only interested in otaku stuff, so how come he's the only one of his group of friends with an actual, stable relationship?

name: Chiba
description: Natsuki's classmate and captain of the girl's volleyball club.

name: Yukiko Asai
description: Yukiko is always full of energy and positive thinking, which makes her quite an odd couple with her boyfriend Tsuyoshi. She loves cosplaying and has very good interpersonal skills. She goes to a different school than all the main characters.

name: Anna Kobayakawa
description: Anna is a polite girl who's good at studies and who lives at her own pace. That is, until she meets Natsuki and finds herself spending more and more time with him. She's usually accompanied by her best friend Mari.

name: Nozomi Matsunaga
description: Nozomi is Tomoya's little sister who will do everything to reach the heart of her love interest. Unfortunately for Tomoya, she falls in love with the last person he would want her to.

name: Mari Tsutsui
description: Mari is a tsundere girl who loves her best friend Anna and truly hates men. But above all, she hates Natsuki, who tries to steal Anna from her and Tomoya, who for some reason seems to be interested in Mari.

name: Darcia
description:
Darcia is the Dark Elf mother of the protagonist, [Vandalieu](https://anilist.co/character/274306/Vandalieu). She worked as a D-class adventurer, before being assassinated. Thanks to her son, she is able to stay in the world of the living through one of her bone fragments.

Darcia has a soft and mellow personality, and acts my pace based on what thought is currently in her mind.

name: Vandalieu
description:
Vandalieu (formerly Amamiya Hiroto, D-01) is a person who attracts misfortune his entire life.

Vandalieu is described as having a soft personality. "He tends to prioritize his emotions and makes decisions without paying any regard to the benefits or losses to himself."

name: Hiromichi Kojima
description: Kojima is the cleanup batter in the professional baseball team, Saikyou Saitama Lycaons. He is defeated by Toua during his time at the training camp as he challenged Toua to avenge his relief pitcher, Nakane. After his defeat, he goes into the forest to train himself mentally against Toua but as he is training he injures his wrist. Even with the injury he challenges Toua to a rematch with the bet that if he wins, he takes Toua's hand. He wins the match as he gets hit by the pitch making it a deadball, Toua admits defeat and Kojima makes Toua join the Lycaons. (source: wikipedia & manga)

name: Toua Tokuchi
description:
__Height:__ 183 cm (5’11")

Toua is a successful gambler, and a pitcher in the game One Outs. After losing a game of One Outs for the first time , he joins the Lycaons with an odd contract, the One Outs contract, that decides Toua's pay based on his performance. As the Lycaons' famed star pitcher, he can pitch entire games without giving up a single hit.

name: Itsuki Takami
description: One of the cleanup batters in the team "Chiba Mariners", he is known to be a prodigy in baseball and his eyes have the best in motion vision in the baseball world. He is the best player in the team and is able to think of counters against Tokuchi's fastballs, until he is outwitted and his team loses.

description: Arisa's high school friend.

name: Wataru Toda
description: Wataru is a high schooler who loves movies. He met Chiharu, a school colleague, in a movie related store, and both shared their love for "Black Flash", an underground production. From there, he started hanging out with Chiharu and going to the movie theater two or three times a month.

name: Richard
description:
With a birth of great pain, Richard was born intersex (a general term used for various conditions in which a person is born with reproductive or sexual anatomy that doesn't seem to fit the typical definitions of female or male). Richard has heterochromia iridium, making his left eye yellow and right eye purple.


Richard's mother saw him as a monster and despised him. Leaving him to be loved by his father, who was oblivious to his wife's hatred. Richard himself is a tormented child, fearing abandonment and suffering from strange visions of Joan of Arc, who tells him that he is a demon to be feared.
Richard grew up beneath his older brother's skill and expectations. He was often training to make up for his fragility. Despite his weakness, others treated him as part of the family, excluding his mother. Due to his mother's neglect, Richard grew up with a deep love and longing to be by his father's side.

He wishes to become greater through his training while waiting for his father to become king.

name: Henry VI
description:
Henry VI is the head of the House of Lancaster. A devout Christian who hates war and killing. He yearns to be a shepherd and meets Richard III in the forest, and they are drawn to each other without knowing each other's true identities. Henry VI is married to Margaret, and he is the father of Edward of Lancaster. Henry is most well-known as a cowardly man. However, this cowardice is mistaken as he hates war and therefore will not lead his armies, which leads his wife, Margaret, to do so for him.

He is also shown to be relatively weak in strength, and he often runs away from the castle in disguise as a shepherd.

name: Catesby

description: A young man who wishes to enter the underground fighting scene in order to attain greater fighting strength. He has some history with [Tokita Ohma](https://anilist.co/character/137446/Tokita-Ouma).

name: Ryuki Gaoh
description:
__Height:__ 180cm

Ryuki Gaoh is a mysterious individual who suddenly appeared wanting to enter the Kengan matches.

name: Hideki Nogi
description:
Nogi Hideki is the CEO of Nogi Group and the current chairman of the Kengan Association.

Nogi Hideki is an esteemed looking gentleman, always seen wearing the finest threads. He has black hair that is slicked back and wrinkled yet experienced facial features.

Nogi is a shrewd individual with an experienced and cunning air about him. He has a good eye for noticing other person's useful qualities and manipulating them to benefit himself. As an experienced member of the Kengan Association, Nogi has a perceptive eye in regards to the fighting environment, being able to perceive and recognize the actions and movements of the fighters he observes. He is also sharp and cunning enough to outmaneuver and outwit an Association member of Hayami Katsumasa's level.

name: Gaolang Wongsawat
native: ガオラン・ウォンサワット
aliases: Thai God of War (タイの闘神)
description:
A professional boxer and the personal bodyguard of Rama XIII. During the Kengan Annihilation Tournament, he participated as the affiliated fighter for Yato Trading Co.During the Kengan Annihilation Tournament, he participated as the affiliated fighter for Yato Trading Co. Two years later, he entered the Kengan Association VS Purgatory Tournament as a representative for the Kengan Association.

Gaolang is a well-defined muscular brown-skinned Thai man with long straight black hair, which he ties into a ponytail that hangs over his left shoulder, thin discerning eyes and a small gem on his forehead. 

He is perpetually calm and expressionless, contrary to the common depiction of Nak Muays(Muay Thai practitioners) as hotheads. He is incredibly analytical when it comes to combat, and tends to catch details that other fighters miss.

He is a patriotic Thai with matchless loyalty to his ruler, Rama XIII, and would not have taken part in the Annihilation Tournament without his command, as he disparages the tournament for being a mere freak show. However, he came to greatly respect Kaneda Suekichi's determination and willpower during their fight, calling him a true warrior. Gaolang has a great desire to fight a truly powerful foe to the death.

name: Liu  Dongcheng
native: 劉リウ 東ドオン成チャン
description:
Liu Dongcheng is an A-list Purgatory gladiator that fights in the Kengan Association VS Purgatory Tournament.
Liu is a short young man with fairly long black hair styled into a ponytail. He is shown wearing a black chángshān with white pants.
Liu is a calm individual who is very confident on the Purgatory gladiators' power, even looking down on people who question it like Alan Wu. He also has a sarcastic and provoking side.
He also seems to follow his father's will to the point that it can even influence his own actions.

name: Gensai Kuroki
description: Gensai Kuroki is a renowned assassin in the criminal underworld and the affiliated fighter for Motorhead Motors in the Kengan Annihilation Tournament.

name: Rama XIII
description: Rama XIII is the political and economic ruler of the Kingdom of Thailand, who considers Gaolang Wongsawat to be his most trusted subject.

name: Taiju Yurikawa
aliases: ゆリかわ たぃじゅ
description: Yurikawa Taiju (百合川 泰樹, Yurikawa Taiju; "Taiju Yurikawa"), also known as "Brutal Lily" (ＢＲＵＴＡＬ ＬＩＬＹ, Furūtaru Rirī), is an affiliated fighter within the Kengan matches and part of the New Generation.

name: Juurouta Arashiyama
description: Arashiyama Juurouta is an A-list Purgatory gladiator that fights in the Kengan Association VS Purgatory Tournament. As one of the Two Kings of Purgatory, Juurota is an incredibly powerful judoka considered on par with Rolón Donaire; champion of Purgatory's Ultimate Gladiator Playoffs.

name: Nozomi Aizawa
description: A high school second-year. Aizawa works up the courage to confess to [Azuma-kun](https://anilist.co/character/132829/Azuma-Shirou), the guy she has had a crush on for so long, but things do not work out as planned. She is a somewhat optimistic girl with stalker-like tendencies.

name: Shirou Azuma
description: An argumentative boy who looks like a class representative, making his poor grades and hatred of studying shocking. He is ruled by logic and has four aunts, whose behavior left him with harsh opinions of women. He loves to read novels and even tries to write them himself.

name: Marin Hamada
description: Aizawa's close friend. She is the president of the literature club.

name: Tamaki Kazuomi
description: A high school second-year. Tamaki is the most popular boy in school. Ever since he had a certain conversation with Azuma and Aizawa, he's sported a different hairstyle.

name: Suzu Ichinomiya
description: Suzu is in her third year of high school and is Azuma's youngest aunt. She grew up with Azuma and Keisuke and usually ordered them around a lot and still does currently.

name: Kyouka Narumiya
description: She is one of the Class A's trainee soldiers.

name: Velou
description: Velou is a starry eyed young boy whose dream is to become a talented huntsman. Even though he isn't particularly good at hunting, he still tries his best to achieve his dream. He finally gets an opportunity to see how the real world of hunting is when the mysterious huntress Grimm comes to Kasoka Village to help exterminate the werewolf hiding nearby.

name: Grimm
description: Grimm is a huntress capable of transforming between an adult and a child version of herself, who works for the Hunters Guild.

description: A fellow camp participant who has a fear of leftovers.

name: Tsuyoshi Kinugawa
description: One of the bullies who targetted [Kiritaka.](https://anilist.co/character/337649/Kiritaka-Nagare) He specializes in physical violence.

appearsIn.title: They Are Still Being Shaken This Morning

name: Nayu Himeori
description: A girl from Rikudou High School who takes the train to the Seomi station every morning at the same time hoping to sit next to her crush.

appearsIn.title: They Are Still Being Shaken This Morning

name: Kai Miura
description: He is a boy who stands out due to his lemon colored hair and pierced ears, and he became the center of a group of popular people. He acts coldly to almost everyone, but for some reason he cares about [Uka.](https://anilist.co/character/182176/Uka-Ishimori)

name: Uka Ishimori
description: In middle school she was given the nickname "stone" and afterwards she became a withdrawn girl who had forgotten how to cry or laugh. By coincidence, she met [Kai](https://anilist.co/character/162041/Kai-Miura) after enrolling at Hachimitsu High School.

name: Ayumi Endou
description: [Uka's](https://anilist.co/character/182176/Uka-Ishimori) first friend with a cheerful and friendly personality. She has had a crush on [Satoru](https://anilist.co/character/245535/Satoru-Seto) since kindergarten.

name: Satoru Seto
description: [Kai's](https://anilist.co/character/162041/Kai-Miura) friend and a mood maker. He is close childhood friends with [Ayumi](https://anilist.co/character/245534/Ayumi-Endou) and is oblivious to romance.

name: Nano Iwakawa
description: A girl who copies Uka's demeanor to try and win Kai over.

name: Tomoya Takamine
description: [Kai's](https://anilist.co/character/162041/Kai-Miura) friend. He is always smiling, but has a mysterious side where no one knows what he is thinking.

name: Serina Kanno
description: [Kai's](https://anilist.co/character/162041/Kai-Miura) ex-girlfriend. She became famous starting from the entrance ceremony, with an amazing physique everyone wants.

name: Tao Oikawa
description: One of Uka's classmates.

name: Moka Shiraishi
description: One of Uka's classmates.

name: Remi Kojima
description: A girl who used to bully Uka.

name: Haruko Hirukoma
description: Liliko is about twenty and has accomplished a lot in the world of beauty. She is a model, singer and actress but can´t handle a thing without her assistant Hada. Though almost everybody envies her she is nothing more than a visual lie.

name: Deborah Seymour
description: Deborah is described as a cold, calculating, and cruel woman by most people. She is the daughter of Duke Gorgias Seymour, a genius mage, and Marian Seymour. She is the younger sister of twins Rojard Seymour and Belec Seymour and the older sister of Enric Seymour.

appearsIn.title: The Perks of Being a Villainess

name: Isidor Bisconti
description: Isidor is a highly skilled swordsman and heir to the Bisconti family, one of the most prestigious ducal families in the Asteia Empire. He is described as one, if not the most handsome man of his time by both women and men. He has complete confidence in himself and his abilities. According to Deborah, he does not appear in the novel she knows.

appearsIn.title: The Perks of Being a Villainess

name: Belec Seymour
description:
Belec is a talented mage, the twin brother of Rojard Seymour, the older brother of Deborah and Enrique Seymour, and the son of Gorgias and Marian Seymour.
Potential successors to the ducal Seymour family are born as twins in each generation. He is therefore in competition with Rojard since his birth for the place of head of the family.

appearsIn.title: The Perks of Being a Villainess

name: Gorgias Seymour
description: Gorgias Seymour is the head of the ducal Seymour family, father of Deborah, Enrique, Belec and Rojard Seymour as well as husband of Marian Seymour, the now deceased Duchess Seymour. He is a talented mage as well as one of the most powerful men in the Asteia Empire.

appearsIn.title: The Perks of Being a Villainess

name: Mia Vinoche
description: Mia is the protagonist of the original novel. She is a pretty young woman with pink hair and light blue eyes.

appearsIn.title: The Perks of Being a Villainess

name: Enrique Seymour
description: Enrique is the youngest of the Seymour family, he is the little brother of Deborah, Belec and Rojard Seymour. He is described as a genius mage having mastered advanced stages of magic at a young age.

appearsIn.title: The Perks of Being a Villainess

name: Philap Montes
description: Philap is heir to House Montes, one of the four duchies of the Empire of Asteia. He is a talented mage and one of the suitors of Mia Vinoche, the heroine of the original novel. He hates Deborah Seymour because of her "horrible" character and will do anything he can to stop her from approaching Mia.

appearsIn.title: The Perks of Being a Villainess

name: Kanon Oikawa
description: She was diagnosed with Sensorineural hearing loss when she was five years old. She isn't entirely deaf; if she has a hearing aid, the room is quiet, and she can see the other person's lips, she can hold on a conversation.

appearsIn.title: The Moon on a Rainy Night

name: Saki Kindaichi
description: She accidentally runs into Kanon on her way to a piano lesson, and they eventually meet again as classmates.

appearsIn.title: The Moon on a Rainy Night
Demon King of the Royal Class

name: Natsuo Ishidou
description: Natsuo Ishidou is the series' main protagonist. She is naturally talented at everything she does. Having lived with this ability her whole life, she cannot understand why other people cannot do things which she can do. This has given her a condescending attitude against her opponents, who she goads and teases during their match and after Natsuo's inevitable victory. She is also ruthless when fighting, whether or not the fight is a serious one.  Natsuo has come to the realization that people with the ability to be the best without even trying have the hardest time, since they don't have anyone to bond with and their whole life is one big competition. She is lonely and yearns for someone who can defeat her and give her something to actually work for. However, she doesn't voice her loneliness.

name: Yuzuko Mawatari
description: Yuzuko is Natsuo’s main rival throughout the story. Born in Japan, she moved with her parents to Brazil. While there she became an exceptional MMA fighter under the training of Mario Cordeiro. She is the captain of the budding MMA club at the Natsuo’s high school and is close friends with Mario Cordeiro daughter, Ringi. It is two early fights with Yuzuko that drive Natsuo to become an MMA fighter. Yuzuko has no talent, but makes up for this limitation with pure tenacity and a single-minded focus on moving forward. As a result, Yuzuko often comes off as "creepy" by others, who are disturbed by the level of enjoyment she derives from MMA.

name: Sanae Sawamura
description: Sanae is the captain of the karate team. In the year previous to the events of the series, she went to the National Karate Competition and placed second, raising the near-defunct karate team into recognition. She has declared an unofficial war on the MMA club and has convinced the other karate team members to do the same. She and Natsuo were childhood friends, but ever since Natsuo left the karate team on the basis that no one on the team was good enough, she has acted coldly toward Natsuo. This feeling accentuated after she saw Natsuo fighting with Yuzuko and drew the conclusion that Natsuo had joined the MMA club.

name: Ringi Cordeiro
native: リンジィ　コルデイロ
description:
Ringi is the daughter of world-renowned MMA champion Mario Cordeiro. She has lived in Brazil for most of her life, but returned to Japan to visit Yuzuko, her childhood friend. She is an amazing fighter, even to the point that Yuzuko suggested that Natsuo would be a good match for her. When fighting, she maintains an air of naivete, blurting false weaknesses to get her opponent into an opportune position. She oversaw the sparring rematch between Nasuo and Yuzuko, immediately seeing Natsuo's natural talent in the sport. Ringi has then been eager to have her sparring match with Natsuo ever since.

(Source:Wikipedia)

name: Mario Cordeiro
description: Mario is the father of Ringi Cordeiro. He is a legendary MMA champion who has never lost a match in over 500 fights. He considers Yuzuko to be his surrogate daughter.

name: Mai Ganeko
description: Mai is a member of the karate team. She claims to be the only person who knows Sanae's dark past, and she hates Natsuo with a passion. It is heavily implied that she has a crush on Sanae.

name: Kei Ninomiya
description: Kei is Natsuo's friend from the volleyball team, and possibly Natsuo's only friend.

name: Karin Kontani
description: Karin is Natsuo's trainer at the MMA gym, and a fighter herself. Her record is 22-1, and she is considered one of the strongest women in Japan. She takes an interest in Natsuo after watching her fight with Sanae. She wishes to fight and defeat Ringi Cordeiro.

name: Haruka Kirido
description: A trainee also learning MMA at Tanekada's gym under the tutelage of Karin. Also a freshman like Natsuo, Kirido was originally trained for Judo before shifting to MMA.

name: Kanna Aizawa
description: A model and a friend of Himari. She is one of the few people who knows that Tenichi works for Himari as her house cleaner.

name: Matsumaru
description: He is Nonoka former manager.

name: Sasaki-kun
description: A student who has a crush on his teacher [Kawaguchi](https://anilist.co/character/374507/Chieko-Kawaguchi).

name: Chieko Kawaguchi
description: A homeroom teacher.

name: Kuwano
description: A former classmate of [Chieko](https://anilist.co/character/374507/) that she had rejected.

name: Ibuki
description: Student council president who has a deep crush towards [Yuri](https://anilist.co/character/374500/), although he has trouble confessing.

name: Shikaku
description: The famous "Hitman Shikaku".

name: Yugeru
description: An immortal vampire bored of life and wanting to die.

name: Zazie the Beast
description: The most mysterious of the Gung-Ho Guns. His portrayal in both the anime and manga are drastically different.    In the anime, Zazie uses the identity of a young boy named "Beeb" as a disguise. He can control sand-worms with a high-frequency device he wears on his head.    The anime never exactly gives a clear explanation as to what Zazie was. It can be theorized that Zazie was a malevolent entity that took control of the boy whenever it needed to, that he was in fact a much older man who only looked like a young boy, or that he was actually a child assassin driven to the brink of insanity by his association with the Guns.    In the manga...       His Gung-Ho Gun number is 12 in the manga, and 4 in the anime.    Info - Wikipedia

name: Leonof the Puppet-Master
description: Leonof the Puppet-Master is an elderly man who controls a large number of puppets with an elaborate system of strings. He can manipulate them to look like real people, and uses them to do horrible things to people close to Vash. His real name is Emilio, having known Vash during his childhood. His love interest dies sometime after, and he goes into puppet making to mend his broken spirit.     from wikipedia

name: Elendira the Crimsonnail
native: エレンディラ・ザ・クリムゾンネイル
description: The thirteenth Gung-Ho Gun and the most powerful, also referred to as "lost" number 13. She shoots giant red nails from a large briefcase that transforms into a crossbow. Like Vash, Elendira often acts childish and flippant, as well as flamboyant and sometimes extremely arrogant. She is a trans woman, and normally wears feminine clothing and a pillbox hat similar in style to fashions internationally popularized by Jacqueline Kennedy Onassis. However, underneath her outer garments she also wears restraining armour, and after disabling it, she is able to move at an even more inhuman speed than she is usually capable of. She seems to dislike Legato and fires a nail into Legato's torso in a conversation with him after arriving on a Zeppelin. It is also hinted that she holds some jealousy of Legato, commenting that Legato's lack of a number in the Gung-Ho Guns implies that Legato is on a whole other level from the Gung-Ho Guns, including Elendira herself.    The only manga Gung-Ho Gun who does not carry one of the broken coins, Elendira did not appear at all in the anime.

name: Livio
description: Livio the Double Fang is a childhood friend of [Wolfwood](https://anilist.co/character/722/Wolfwood-Nicholas-D) and the final member of the Gung-Ho Guns from the Eye of Michael. He wields the Double Fangs, two small cross-shaped machine guns strapped on his arms that fire from both ends.

name: Tesla
description: The sister of Vash and Knives.

name: Ugaki
description: A detective who works for the Demi-Human Crimes Division.

name: Himari Takanashi
description:
Hikari's twin sister, who is an ordinary human. She is much more serious than her sister, both as a person and a student. She often tries to make her sister act more mature, but is unable to. Despite their constant bickering, they care about each other and have many similarities such as similar tastes in food and fashion.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Kurz
description: A young German boy who is also a detective working under Ugaki. He is immune to the charms of succubi.

name: Zashiko
description: Zashiko is a Zashiki-Warashi, a spirit that is primarily mentioned in tales from northeastern Japan. Legends say that a house where a Zashiki-Warashi lives will have happiness. She lives with Yoko Takahashi and can only be seen by her.

name: Fran Madaraki
description:
Fran Madaraki is an artificial creation and one of the most advanced, made by the greatest surgeon in the world, Dr. Madaraki Naomitsu. She's not human, but instead a creature akin to Frankenstein's Monster, and her body is able to add or lose pieces, like up to six arms or cut the lower half of her body without pain or danger. Fran has a fraction of the Dr's ability, but it's still able to raise the dead (If they have been dead less than 24 hours), create genetically altered creatures, rebuild complete human bodies in a matter of minutes and other medical miracles. She says that her abilities are nothing compared to Dr. Madaraki's and talks about him with admiration and perhaps love. She lives and takes care of the Madaraki estate, taking care of the Dr's experiments and home, and always waiting for his return.

Fran doesn't understand humanity very well. She tries to explain and understand concepts like love with medical and logical terms or disguises herself as a high school student and goes to school to interact with other people. At the same time, she usually doesn't understand motivations of greed and power, acting too innocently in some cases. She's very empathic and may help people without asking for pay or let other doctors steal her creations if it benefits humanity. She cares and remembers each and every person she had ever helped.

name: Veronica Madaraki
description: Assassin bioweapon created by Dr. Madaraki for his own protection. In addition to her naturally high combat ability, she is trained in the handling of explosives and the setting of traps in the field. A large, X-shaped stitch marks her face. Because she was created after Fran, Veronica calls her “elder sister”.    She wields a huge guillotine blade in her right arm and a sharp sword in her left. She also has sharpened daggers sticking out of the pommel. She follows her own battle etiquette: “To murder while causing as little suffering as possible”. In opposition to Fran, who believes that “regardless of the shape or form, if it can function as a living organism it is good”, Veronica supports the notion of “rather a painless death than a painful life”. She is the antithetical existence to Fran.    She seems to be very protective of Fran, and will not hesitate to eliminate anything that threatens her, although Fran stops her most of the time because of her beliefs.

name: Youka Izumiya
description: It's hard to be a girl! Youka catches the eye of two students, Itou Kimimasa and Hittori Tsubasa. They fight over her constantly, it seems, and she just can't figure out which boy to choose! Fran figures that "splitting" her through "mitosis" will solve the problem...

name: Misaki Moriya
description: A dear friend of Misae Tsuji. Afraid that her marriage to a older "playboy" was a mistake, she tried to prove it to Misae by having a affair with him. After Misae figured out her betrayal, they both competed and Misaki stole all of her jobs away from Misae. Eventually, she had "troubles with her boyfriend" and committed suicide infront of Misae.     Her face takes shape out of the swollen veins on Misae's stomach while she is "pregnant". Later it evolves and mutates into another form.     * One Manga . com

name: Tajima Kouichi
description: Tajima was confessing his love to "Kaneda-san" when she absentmindedly walked in front of a oncoming vehicle. Desperate to help her, he calls for help and Fran comes in. He pleads for her to help "Kaneda-san" and she agrees. Although his crush had a body of a caterpillar after the reconstructive  surgery, he still had the heart to develop a relationship with her.     *One Manga . Com

name: Miyako Shidou
description: A elderly woman who seeks a doctor that will give her eternal youth. She currently houses clones of younger girls that are willing to aid her in her goal. Fran introduces a "reverse growth hormone" training program for her that does make her younger but she "assassinates" Fran before the treatment was over. She takes the program into her own hands and things turn for the worse. After Fran revives, she explains why.

name: Nezura-san
description: "Nezura-san" was formerly a student who takes sleeping pills in the forest, in hopes of finally getting some sleep. He awakes as just a brain, a pair of eyes and a tongue in a vessel in Fran's lab.     Fran uses his body and it's parts because she thought he committed suicide - and that wasn't the case. She provides a sort of a mascot costume that makes up for his lost body. He escapes the lab and soon meets Mai, a little girl from a abusive home, and they both become friends.

name: Kouryuu
description: A official who comes to check on Fran's progress. Raised in a sterile environment all her life, she acquired a sort of phobia to all things "filthy". When the collection of lab roaches demand the body of their instigator to be destroyed (to nourish the second generation), everyone turns to Director Kouryuu. After her associates and the roaches run after her and catch her in the nearby forest, they are all burned in a fire. The two men were revived as well as the Director, who gained artificial skin. Fran tells her what it was made out of and she goes crazy.

name: Etou Susumu
description: Fran discovers him in the forest. He tells Fran that he was going to kill himself and his girlfriend to preserve their relationship but only got halfway. Fran decides to revive his girlfriend by removing the head and modifying her so she evolves from a head, to a head with "finger legs" and, eventually, to a bigger body.

name: Okita
description: The head of a handsome young man with the body of a cat.     He often works along with Fran, supporting her or making fun of her. When attending parties he attaches a human body to his head, thus taking the form of a perfectly normal adult man.     During operations when Fran goes too far, Okita is sometimes bewildered, but in general he supervises them in silence.     Very rarely does he fall in love with female cats.

name: Shou Iketani
description:
__ Height:__ 153 cm  

Shou Iketani is the tennis club captain and one year older than Utsumi and Yuki. Shou is the reason Utsumi joins the tennis club in the serial manga because he has a crush on her. In the one-shot version,​ he merely observes her playing tennis.

name: Yuki Kurokawa
description:
__Height:__ 161 cm  

Kurokawa Yuki is on the tennis team and the one who caught Utsumi watching them secretly. After being confronted by Utsumi, Yuki reversed the accusations right back at him, demanding a pure reason for his sneaky actions. Utsumi gives in to Yuki that he has a crush on the tennis club captain Shou. Knowing the situation, Yuki wanted to help... by tricking him into joining the tennis team.

name: Seiji Utsumi
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm  

Utsumi has a crush on Shou Iketani, the tennis club captain. He's content with just looking at his beloved senpai from afar until one day he is caught by Yuki, who then "forces" him to join the tennis club to impress Shou and help him win over her heart.

name: Mother Iketani
description: Shou's mother. She is kind and understanding towards Seiji.

name: Eri Takiguchi
description:
__Height:__ 163 cm  

Introduced as Yuki's friend and after causing initially some misunderstanding(s) between Utsumi and Shou, Eri becomes one of Utsumi's friends.

name: Father Iketani
description: Shou's father. He is very protective of her.

name: Guy
description: A guy who supposedly works as a recruiter for a modeling agency. He picks up Oonuma and asks her to become a model.

name: Tsukasa Izumi
description:
__Height:__ 164 cm  
__School Grade:__ 2nd Year Student 

Tsukasa Izumi is a classmate/friend of [Seiji Utsumi](https://anilist.co/character/29682/Utsumi-Seiji) and [Tetsuya Kouno](https://anilist.co/character/30005/Kouno-Tetsuya).

name: Mei Yuasa
description: A 19-year-old photography student who started out at a vocational school where Kirishima-sensei was teaching. She currently still attends there but also takes Kirishima-sensei's photography classes on Sundays.  Her photography work is very original and she is very motivated to create new works.

name: Manim
description: Madam is the new wife of the village minister. She is initially seen as a beautiful bride, but then is suspected to be a fox when her husband falls sick and the Indangsu river  does not allow pass of ships. She is found and saved by Cheong in the river when she falls off a boat that her brother uses to catch 'the golden turtle' which they gift to the minister instead of a dowry. She invites Cheong to the mansion to help care for the minister, and the two begin to share a deep bond, becoming romantic over time.

name: Sim-Cheong
description: Sim-Cheong is a beggar girl. She lost her mother when she was only 7 days old, and lives with her blind father, who she provides food for through her begging.

name: Ppaengdeong Eomi
description: A single mother whose son was severely burned in a fire that broke out while she was working. She looks after [Shim Cheong](https://anilist.co/character/147644/Shim-Cheong) and is a fortune teller.

name: Makoto Ariga
description:
Makoto, known as Mako for short, is a trans girl who first appears when the cast is in sixth grade. She is Shuuichi's closest friend, and is an only child whose parents run a bakery.

Mako is unusually mature for her age. She's a calm and rational thinker with good listening skills, which helps her to give good advice to her friends, and to get along well with her peers. She is also a romantic who dreams about being in a relationship with a cool, adult man.

name: Saori Chiba
description: Saori, nicknamed Saorin, is a girl who is a fifth grader in Shūichi's class at the beginning of Hōrō Musuko. From early on, she takes an interest in encouraging Shūichi to cross-dress, even going so far as to buy him an expensive dress for his birthday which he later returns, much to her displeasure. Saori finds it difficult to associate well with most others, and as such has very few friends, though she becomes close friends with Shūichi. She tends to tell others what is on her mind, disregarding how others may take what she says. As Saori grows up, she gradually becomes more standoffish and stoic; she even has bad relations with her teachers. Despite her self-centered attitude, she remains popular among the boys in her classes because of her physical attractiveness. She is a sensitive girl whose temper sometimes gets the better of her when reprimanding bullies that tease Shūichi because of his femininity and cross-dressing. As she has feelings for him, Saori is often emotionally affected by circumstances involving Shūichi. Due in part to this influence, Saori converts to Christianity to seek forgiveness for her previous actions, though she only attends mass when feeling guilty of her behavior.

name: Shuuichi Nitori
description:
Shuuichi is a young trans girl who is one of two main protagonists. She is a fifth grader at the beginning of the series. As she grows up and hits puberty, she becomes increasingly concerned about the way her body is changing.

Shuuichi has an honest and dutiful personality that generally makes it easy for her get along well with others, though she can also be quite sensitive at times. She is often described as cute, and is able to pass as a girl due to her feminine appearance and physical build; she enjoys wearing cute clothes, which her friends encourage. Shuuichi later becomes interested in writing stories, and joins the drama club as a writer.

name: Yoshino Takatsuki
description:
Yoshino, the other protagonist, is a tall, masculine child who at the beginning of Wandering Son is a fifth grader in Shuichi's class. Otherwise known as Takatsuki-kun by their classmates, with an honorific used mainly with boys, Yoshino wishes to be a boy. Yoshino usually refrains from dressing in traditionally feminine clothes, such as skirts or dresses. Despite this, Yoshino's mother insists on buying such clothes for them. Shortly after becoming friends with Shuichi, Yoshino gets a boyish haircut, taking on the appearance of a boy their age, especially when Yoshino is dressed in a male school uniform. Like Shuichi, Yoshino becomes increasingly concerned and resentful about undergoing puberty, such as at the beginning of menstruation or the growth of breasts. Yoshino goes to buy a chest-flattening garment to escape the necessity of wearing a bra. Like Shuichi, Yoshino shows signs indicating gender dysphoria, though later stops thinking that way due to personal exposure to modelling.

Yoshino prefers to dress and act like a boy, but usually abstains from anything which would draw attention, such as going to school in a male uniform after entering junior high. However, Yoshino does on occasion dress in a male school uniform and go to neighboring cities while dressed as a boy; during one such time, Yoshino enjoys being hit on by an older woman. Yoshino wants to look "cool" and wears clothes which are not girlish.

name: Fumiya Ninomiya
description: Fumiya is a boy one year older than Saori whom she first meets when she starts going to church. He takes an early interest in Saori, and he tries to get to know her better so as to become her boyfriend. Fumiya is a talkative boy whom Saori is easily annoyed by, especially when he brings her flowers from his parents' flower shop. After meeting Shūichi, Fumiya becomes jealous that Saori has an interest in him, especially when he is a cross-dresser, which Fumiya feels is gross. However, Fumiya lies to Saori and Shūichi, telling them he likes to cross-dress as well, in an effort to gain Saori's favor. This strategy backfires, as only Shūichi is interested in hearing more.

name: Momoko Shirai
description: Momoko is a childhood friend and classmate in junior high school of Chizuru; she is nicknamed Momo. She constantly hangs around Chizuru and is visibly annoyed when Chizuru socializes with others, or even if someone simply sits too close to her.  Momoko inevitably starts fighting Saori, who does not particularly respect Chizuru, when they talk.

name: Maho Nitori
description: Maho is Shūichi's older sister by one year who shares a room with him, and at the beginning of Hōrō Musuko, she is in the sixth grade of elementary school. Maho is a big fan of a teen model named Maiko, and because she deeply desires to meet her, Maho sends in her photo to a modeling agency and is soon hired as a young model in the same agency as Maiko. Maho shows a large interest in clothes, and spends a lot of her money on new apparel. After she starts to become recognized as a model, Maho enjoys the added attention from being asked her autograph by complete strangers. While initially starting out slow in modeling, Maho soon gains confidence in her abilities, and becomes friends with Maiko and two other models, Anna Suehiro and Tamaki Satō. In contrast to her younger brother, Maho is very out-spoken and tends to be rough with Shūichi, even hitting or slapping him on some occasions. Maho is very displeased about Shūichi's cross-dressing, and gets angry and annoyed when she finds Shūichi dressed as a girl. Maho often forces things on Shūichi with little consideration of his opinion. Once in junior high school, Maho becomes attracted to her classmate Riku Seya, and eventually starts dating him.

name: Anna Suehiro
description: Anna is a teen model who is a good friend and classmate of Maiko; she is similarly well-known and experienced in modeling. From early on, Anna makes it clear that she disapproves of Shūichi dressing as a girl, and even calls her a freak. Anna initially tells Maho she has no interest in her "weak" brother because of her femininity, though later dates Shuuichi for a time after she asks her out. Furthermore, Anna's opinion of Shuuichi's cross-dressing also changes, saying that it actually suits her, and the two even go out together on a date with Shuuichi dressed as a girl. She feels Shuuichi is an interesting person, and once says she is like a cute little sister. Anna spends a lot of money on clothes, and enjoys modifying them.

name: Satomi Nitori
description: Shuichi's and Maho's mother. She is very kind and has a big-hearted, generous nature.

name: Yuki
description:
Yuki, born Hiroyuki Yoshida, is a tall and attractive trans woman living with her boyfriend Shiina. She takes an early interest in Yoshino when she believes Yoshino to be a boy, though remains on good terms with Yoshino even after learning of Yoshino's assigned sex, and gives Shuichi and Yoshino helpful advice when they are troubled. Despite the differences between their situations, Yuki sees much of herself in Shuichi: when they were growing up, Shiina was the only friend who stood by the young Hiroyuki, as she was called then, while girls teased her and the boys bullied her to change. Yuki always keeps up a positive attitude, and runs a gay bar. Since her transition, she has not been on good terms with her parents, who run a uniform store.

Yuki is the main character of Takako Shimura's short story "Hana", in the collection Boku wa, Onna no Ko, in which her family—which consists of her father, mother, brother, and sister-in-law—also appears; Yuki is revealed to be a fan of Keiji Sada, a Shōwa period actor.

name: Qi Lin
description:
__Horoscope:__ Aries
__Class:__ Grade 10 Class G
__Likes:__ Any sort of milk beverage, pop music, gaming
__Dislikes:__ Piano
__Best subject:__ Nothing, especially poor in Arts (but her lowest record is 4 marks for Maths)

name: Cang Shu
description:
__Class:__ Grade 10 Class A
__Likes:__ Milk, chocolate, classical music, chess
__Dislikes:__ Fish with bones (any food that makes her ungraceful when eating)
__Best subject:__ Everything, especially Arts

name: Hang Wang
description: Class C's Wang Hang. In a one-sided rivalry with Cui Xin.

name: Keiichiro Katsuragi
description:
Keiichiro Katsuragi is a man of tradition, who is from a super elite family whose grandfather and father are both former Prime Ministers.
 What's more, the Katsuragi family has a "tradition"

name: Yuuri Hasegawa
description: Yuuri is a sophomore at St. Margaret High School for Girls. She is a Gyaru who follows new fashion trends, but she falls in love with [Keiichiro](https://anilist.co/character/212825/Katsuragi-Keiichiro), who lives in a completely different world to hers.

name: Shinobu Kasuga
description: An agent working for the Katsuragi family's secret service.

name: Shoutarou Katsuragi
description: Keiichirou's older brother.

name: Takaihito
description: Second Prince of Japan.
