name: Masamune Kazama
description: Kazama is a single 23 year old man who's still clinging to the memory of his past lover, [Youko](https://anilist.co/character/72919/Tsukamoto-Youko).

name: Youko Tsukamoto
description: Youko is the mother of Koharu, and the past lover of Masamune.

name: Shuu
description: Koharu's friend.

name: Katagiri
description: Co-worker of Kazama.

name: Lambdadelta
description:
She is also known as the Most Powerful Witch in the Universe before losing to [Bernkastel](https://anilist.co/character/11840/Bernkastel-Frederica) and is feared by most other witches, including [Beatrice](https://anilist.co/character/10285/Beatrice). She is quite childish and holds a grudge against Bernkastel for finally beating her in their last game, although she actually cares for her.

Her "Magic of Certainty" allows her to kill anyone without fail as an absolute result, which bends the basic rule of Umineko magic requiring a risk. Like Bernkastel, she is a Voyager. She wishes for [Battler](https://anilist.co/character/14040/Ushiromiya-Battler) and Beatrice to fight against each other for eternity as a part of a larger plot to have Bernkastel lose against her.

She has lived for a thousand years. As a witch, she embodies the concept that 'hard-workers are rewarded', and is very respected even by human beings. She doesn't flee from the human concept of witch. Hence, the power of hers, who is a being respected by human beings, is immeasurable. However, she is whimsical about whose efforts she will reward and, in many situations, the person who can please her more will be able to receive her smile.

Her tremendous and swiftly fierce power makes any kind of witch surrender in a moment. However, she seems to be reckless and it was thoroughly read by Bernkastel.

appearsIn.title: Umineko When They Cry Episode 8: Twilight of the Golden Witch

name: Frederica Bernkastel
native: フレデリカ・ベルンカステル
description: A mysterious witch who appears to [Battler](https://anilist.co/character/14040/Ushiromiya-Battler) following the first game, providing advice and telling him she will support him in his endeavors to solve the mystery of the witch [Beatrice](https://anilist.co/character/10285/Beatrice). Although an ally to Battler, Bernkastel has a twisted personality and refers to herself as the "cruelest witch in the world", and is only interested in Beatrice's game as a chance to escape her own boredom. She is known as the Witch of Miracles, and she has the power to reset any situation and realize a goal, eventually securing victory even with a 0.0000000000001% probability, so long as it is not zero. Initially stoic, cold, and calm, she slowly reveals herself to be just as impish and cruel as her rival, [Lambdadelta](https://anilist.co/character/10196/Lambdadelta).

appearsIn.title: Umineko When They Cry Episode 8: Twilight of the Golden Witch
Umineko When They Cry Episode 3: Banquet of the Golden Witch

name: Ange Ushiromiya
description: [Rudolf](https://anilist.co/character/14043/Ushiromiya-Rudolf) and [Kyrie](https://anilist.co/character/18673/Ushiromiya-Kyrie)'s daughter, and [Battler](https://anilist.co/character/14040/Ushiromiya-Battler)'s sister.

appearsIn.title: Umineko When They Cry Episode 8: Twilight of the Golden Witch
Umineko When They Cry Episode 8: Twilight of the Golden Witch

name: Beatrice
description: The Golden Witch and Endless Witch. She is affectionately referred to as "Beato" (ベアト). A witch who has lived for over a thousand years, she is said to appear as a cloud of golden butterflies, and has the power to summon higher demons among the seventy-two pillars to serve her. It is said that humans can summon her to have their wishes granted in exchange for compensation, though she often acts whimsically. She is the one rumored to have given [Kinzo](https://anilist.co/character/14041/Ushiromiya-Kinzou) ten tons of gold and served under him as the alchemic advisor to the Ushiromiya family.

appearsIn.title: Umineko When They Cry Episode 8: Twilight of the Golden Witch
Umineko When They Cry Episode 2: Turn of the Golden Witch
Umineko When They Cry Episode 3: Banquet of the Golden Witch

name: Erika Furudo
description: The main antagonist and self-proclaimed intellectual rapist of End of the Golden Witch and Dawn of the Golden Witch. She is a young detective introduced in End of the Golden Witch. A blue-haired girl estimated by [Genji](https://anilist.co/character/21086/Ronoue-Genji) to be about [Jessica](https://anilist.co/character/14044/Ushiromiya-Jessica)'s age, 18, she's highly intelligent and possesses a photographic memory.  She's quite polite in public and shows a deep interest in mysteries. In reality, she's quite ruthless and cunning and only solves mysteries, so she can sneer at those who pose them. She does, however, possess a serious inferiority complex, since she emotionally breaks down whenever things aren't in her favor.

appearsIn.title: Umineko When They Cry Episode 8: Twilight of the Golden Witch

name: Cornelia
description: Cornelia is an aide in Eiserne Jungfrau, and a third-class priest. She wears a cleric-like uniform and appears as a girl with red eyes and bobbed brown hair decorated with yellow ribbons. She has a strong sense of justice, but despite her cold exterior shared by her comrades, she is quite hot-blooded in nature.

appearsIn.title: Umineko When They Cry Episode 8: Twilight of the Golden Witch

name: Eva Ushiromiya
description: Kinzo's second child. Under normal circumstances, she would have lost her place in the Ushiromiya family when she married, though she managed to retain her name on the family register when she had her husband Hideyoshi adopted into the family and gave birth to Kinzo's first grandchild, George.  Eva is cheerful and mischievous, but also sinister and greedy. She is hostile towards her older brother Krauss, and rallies the other siblings against him in their fight for the family inheritance. She also looks down on Krauss's wife Natsuhi for not being related to the Ushiromiya family by blood. Because she believes George to be the rightful head of the Ushiromiya family, she is cruel towards the servant Shannon, as she suspects her of being his lover.   Despite her insidious personality, however, she treasures her husband and son more than anything, but fears that she is too domineering towards them. She is skilled in various martial arts, and said to be excellent at cooking.

appearsIn.title: Umineko When They Cry Episode 8: Twilight of the Golden Witch
Umineko When They Cry Episode 3: Banquet of the Golden Witch

name: Yoh Komiyama
description:
A high school senior of Haruna's who is a year older than her. He knows the ways to impress men from a girl's point of view. Thus, he becomes Haruna's coach to make her more popular among guys.

Despite being known as a hottie and being popular among girls, he does not acknowledge this fact. He is quite embarrassed about his popularity. He gets shy easily especially when he is praised.

During his childhood days, he was a difficult child. He never smiled in photographs. He does not like to be the centre of attention. Apart from that, he is cold and does not talk much. However, he is actually a kind person at heart.

He played basketball in middle school.

name: Haruna Nagashima
description: Shortly after entering high school, Haruna becomes determined to find a boyfriend under the influence of all the shoujo manga she reads. She accidentally meets Yoh after a failed attempt at being "picked up" by guys and asks him to coach her on how to be more attractive. After some prodding, Yoh finally accepts to teach her under two conditions; one: she mustn’t cry, and two: she cannot fall in love with him. She eagerly accepts, and the two start training. Yoh helps her on a day to day basis, giving her advice on what to wear every day and how to act around guys.   Haruna is a tomboy and star athlete. She acts in a direct manner and would do anything for her friends. Sometimes she can be a bit airheaded, specifically when it comes to social cues and interpreting interactions with others. Haruna has driving ambition and when she wants something she goes after it with fervor. She is a big idealist.

name: Fumiya Tamura
description: Yoh's friend, also known as "Fumi". He's a bit on the slow side, not getting some things straight even if it is right before his eyes. Haruna had a crush on him because of his caring personality, but when he announced he and Asami were going out, Haruna had finally decided that her heart was really set on Yoh's all this time. His caring demeanor was suddenly vicious when Asami was being harassed by a man to get him jealous, noting that he suddenly becomes angry when women and children are being harassed. Asami admits she only went with the man because she felt Fumiya didn't notice her enough, only to be surprised when he grabs her and kisses her. Fumi is a really nice guy. Fumiya is a second year, the same as Yoh.

name: Yui Asaoka
description: Yoh's friend. He has a part-time job at a restaurant, and like Fumiya, he is calm and caring (fortunately, he has some common sense and is not as dense as Fumiya). Yoh says that ninety percent of what Asaoka says is out of kindness and that whomever goes out with him would be happy because of all the kind words he says.    (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Miyabi Jouhou
description: Akito Jouhou's older sister. During Yoh's time in cram school, she develops a crush on him and plots to break him and Haruna up multiple times. She is bitter towards beautiful people do to her younger brother's beauty and the words of her parents.

name: Akito Jouhou
description: Akito is a male first-year student at Haruna Nagashima's school. He is the younger sibling of Miyabi Jouhou and he later on becomes a good friend and confidant of Haruna's.

name: Asami Komiyama
description: Yoh's little sister and Haruna's close friend. Assa is attractive and admired by boys, but rather superficial. She is conceited and confident, yet becomes insecure easily if she feels unappreciated. She clings to Yoh and Haruna, always needing to be with Yoh and refusing to go certain places unless Haruna accompanies her.

name: Leona Matsuzaka
description: Matsuzaka is a former softball pitcher from a team of which Haruna played against in middle school. She arrived to Haruna's school due to her father's sudden transfer. She gives off a charm that she uses against boys to do what she wants (such as trying to get a male students seat number in order to sit next to Haruna).

name: Mami Takahashi
description: Haruna's best friend since middle school. She is notably calm and collected, being able to read Haruna like an open book. Their friendship is a close one and Haruna has described how Mami first became her friend by helping her with her pitching. She has a part-time job at a video rental shop and was the softball captain of their team. Haruna often has a very high opinion of Mami believing that she is 'amazing'. She describes Mami as kind, clever and calm, which is often replied to by the statement that Mami is a 'nice girl' or a 'good girl'. It has been revealed too that Mami extremely values her friendship with Haruna, even going to the extent of saying that she 'betrayed' Haruna for not believing and trusting in Haruna's pitch, which had lost them that game in third year.    Mami has proven at several times, that she is highly perceptive, especially concerning Haruna. Haruna, in turn, demonstrates her affection for Mami by trying to help her find her own love. This has led to a date with Asaoka because of their similarities. Her relationship with Asaoka and their friendship is uncertain, though they seem to have a common understanding of each other.    (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Renako Amaori
description:
**Height:** 158 cm (5'2")

At school, Renako acts bright and sociable. However, while she enjoys talking with her classmates, this is only a front, and her "true self" is gloomy and negative.

In middle school, Renako declined an invitation to go out with her classmates, causing them to reject her. Renako spent the rest of middle school as a hikikomori as a result of this. Because of what happened to her in the past, she has trouble declining invitations and requests from her classmates.

appearsIn.title: There's No Freaking Way I'll be Your Lover! Unless...

name: Mai Ouzuka
description:
**Height:** 167 cm (5'6")

Mai is gifted academically and athletically, and [Renako](https://anilist.co/character/196166/Amaori-Renako) describes her as the pinnacle of beauty. Mai is arrogant and forthright, owing to her status as the school's Madonna. Though she is polite in general, when she is alone with Renako, she is very open and persistent with her desires. She has a tendency to act on a whim. 

The day after meeting Mai, she confesses to Renako. Renako declines, but Mai persists. They both agree that when Mai wears her hair down, they are in "lovers mode," and when she ties it up, they are in "friends mode."

Mai's mother is an internationally renowned fashion designer, and Mai is one of her models. As a result, her family is very wealthy.

appearsIn.title: There's No Freaking Way I'll be Your Lover! Unless...

name: Satsuki Koto
description:
**Height:** 165 cm (5'5")

Satsuki is a blunt, serious, and headstrong person. Despite her beautiful appearance, she has a cold personality and an unapproachable aura that makes it difficult to connect with her.

appearsIn.title: There's No Freaking Way I'll be Your Lover! Unless...

name: Ajisai Sena
description:
**Height:** 158 cm (5'2")

She is sometimes referred to as an "angel" because of her easygoing personality.  Sena's parents frequently leave her home to care for her two younger brothers, Kou-kun and Kii-kun. Although she loves her brothers, she grows resentful of the restrictions it places on her freedom as she is left to look after them on a more regular basis.

appearsIn.title: There's No Freaking Way I'll be Your Lover! Unless...

name: Kaho Koyanagi
description:
**Height:** 153 cm (5'0")

As the group's mascot, Kaho has a playful and fun personality. She enjoys making jokes and has the ability to control the mood of the group. She is referred to as "everyone's little sister" because of her childish personality.

appearsIn.title: There's No Freaking Way I'll be Your Lover! Unless...

name: Haruna Amaori
description: She is Renako's younger sister. She is a second-year junior high school student and a member of the badminton club. She is naturally extroverted and athletic, unlike her older sister.

appearsIn.title: There's No Freaking Way I'll be Your Lover! Unless...

name: Ryang-ha Son
description: He is a hitman wanted by at least 20 organizations for singlehandedly taking down the Hong Kong triads. Since meeting [Chateau](https://anilist.co/character/157017), he stalks and brokers her information in exchange for spending time with her.

name: Chateau Dankworth
native: シャトー・ダンクワース
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm

Chateau is a newly recruited bounty hunter working for Ritzland Support. She is reluctant to trust [Ryang-Ha](https://anilist.co/character/157016/) and constantly rejects his romantic advances.

name: Euripedes Ritzland
native: エウリペデス・リッツラン
description: __Height:__ 197 cm

name: Nagyunn
description: Nagyunn is the main character in The Ember Knight. After his twin brother Najin is murdered he vows to avenge him and to do this he assuming Najin’s identity.

name: Fadiyan
description: Fadiyan is a Knight with the alias "White Doe" who is responsible for training apprentices. Her exact affiliations and history are unknown.

name: Najin
description: Najin is the main protagonists's brother in The Ember Knight. After rescuing civilians from a fire that burned through their hometown he became a Knight's Apprentice. Soon after his immense talent became well-known and he became considered the strongest candidate. He is killed in a conflict with a mysterious masked group.

name: Yulnia
description: Yulnia is a Knight Apprentice from Firjul. As a child, she was often criticized by her father for not being strong enough, which drove her to work harder to become stronger. At some point, she rescued Nuljin and made him her subordinate.

name: Marsha
description: Marsha is a Knight Apprentice from Litinsia. In the past, she met Najin and developed an extreme attraction toward his strength. She is currently considered the most promising Knight Candidate and the strongest Knight Apprentice.

name: He Jiang
description: A girl from the Tang Dynasty.

appearsIn.title: My Wife Is from a thousand Years ago

name: Qing Xu
description: A boy from the present day.

appearsIn.title: My Wife Is from a thousand Years ago

name: Hao Qin
description: Qin Hao is a friend of Xu Qing and a police officer

appearsIn.title: My Wife Is from a thousand Years ago

name: Fukumaru
description:
**Height:** Roly-Poly
**Favorite Food:** Super Miracle Chrunchies

A kitty who loves his daddy. He follows his daddy everywhere... even into the bathroom, naturally. Fukumaru is a 1-year-old cat that, because of his appearance, is never adopted from a pet store and grows lonely until he gets adopted by [Kanda-san](https://anilist.co/character/129634/Kanda-Fuyuki).

(Source: Character Profiles, Vol 3)

name: Fuyuki Kanda
description:
**Height:** 180 cm
**Profession:** Music Teacher

A middle-aged cat fancier. He has long, narrow eyes, so when he is being quiet, he looks scary. He's had a complex about it since he was a boy. Kanda-san is the elderly man that adopted Fukumaru despite most people calling him Ugly. He likes soba noodles and fish.

name: Momiji Sato
description:
__Height:__ 159 cm (5'3)

An employee at the pet store where Fukumaru used to live. Always worried about Fukumaru, she always made a point of keeping Fukumaru's spirits up - waiting for someone to buy him.

Momiji works 4 part time jobs; yet still has energy for her friends. Her dream job is to be a veterinarian.

name: Fukumaru no Haha
description: Fukumaru's Mother. Her constant wish is for Fukumaru and her other kittens to be happy.

name: Chako
description: The young Chiba Inu (?) of Kobayashi-san.

name: Moja
description: A maine coon that used to live in the same pet store as Fukumaru. He loves eating anything topped with bonito flakes.

name: Natsuhito Kobayashi
description:
**Height:** 185 cm

Kanda's best friend. He prefers dogs, but he loves all animals and want to pet any living creature in sight. He doesn't know when to give up, so cats tend to dislike him. He likes fried shrimp and sweets.

(Source: Character Profiles, Vol 3)

name: Masato Moriyama
description: Moriyama's little brother and Hibino's acquaintance. The Moriyama brothers have low opinions of each other.

name: Marin
description: Fukumaru's big sis. She has a calm personality. A kitty who loves her owner, Hibino. She follows him everywhere... even into the bathroom naturally. She used to belong to Hibino's mother, until his mother grew bored of her, and she was forced on HIbino.

name: Kanade Hibino
description:
__Height:__ 179 cm

A pianist who sees Kanda as his rival. When Hibino's mother forces him to take in her cat, Marin, he and Kanda meet once again.

name: Nanoha Aoba
description: She is secretly dating her best friend, [Chidori Fujimiya](https://anilist.co/character/210152/Fujimiya-Chidori).

name: Chidori Fujimiya
description: She is secretly dating her best friend, [Nanoha Aoba](https://anilist.co/character/210151/Aoba-Nanoha).

name: Eon Green
description: Eon Green is an immortal and has adapted herself to the N5S virus. She is parentless and lives with [Kozlov Grebnev](https://anilist.co/character/3973/Kozlov-L-Grebnev) in her grandfathers house in the MSCF in south district 17 of J9O. She has a super-regenerative healing factor. She is taken in to custody of the Public Health Department by a patrol officer. She carries some sort of spore in her that can turn all drones back to normal humans.

name: Zouichi Kanoe
description: Zouichi is a synthetic human created by the Toha Heavy Industries and is on a mission to find people that have adapted to the N5S virus. He meets [Eon Green](https://anilist.co/character/3974/Eon-Green) in the MSCF, Mass Security Containment Facility, in south district 17 of 9JO, where he has been dispatched. His weapon is similar to the Gravitational Beam Emitter in Blame!. He rides a 4000XLA Toha Industries Motorcycle. It comes equipped with a large rifle, possibly a coilgun, and an axe for close combat. His A.I. is [Fuyu Kanoe.](https://anilist.co/character/3969/Fuyu-Kanoe)

name: Kozlov L Grebnev
native: コズロフ・Л（レーフヴィチ）・グレブネフ
description: Kozlov is a bear that walks like a human and talks. He lived with [Eon Green](https://anilist.co/character/3974/Eon-Green) and tried to protect her when the patrol officer came to get her. He befriends both [Zouichi](https://anilist.co/character/3968/Zouichi-Kanoe) and [Nishu](https://anilist.co/character/3970/Nishu-Mizunoe) after a short unfriendly start with both. He saves the A.I. [Taira Hinoto](https://anilist.co/character/3972/Taira-Hinoto) from falling in to the hands of DRF. He loses parts of his body through the manga.

name: Nishu Mizunoe
description: Nishu is a female synthetic human that makes contact with [Kozlov Loewic Grebnev](https://anilist.co/character/3973/Kozlov-L-Grebnev) in former Izhits Co. and is on a mission to find Loew Grigorievic Grebnev, one of original founders of the DRF, Data Recovery Foundation. She has similar weapons and vehicle to [Zouichi.](https://anilist.co/character/3968) Her A.I. is [Shin Mizunoe.](https://anilist.co/character/3971/Shin-Mizunoe)

name: Shin Mizunoe
description: Shin is an A.I. personality like [Fuyu](https://anilist.co/character/3969/Fuyu-Kanoe) who acts as [Nishu](https://anilist.co/character/3970/Nishu-Mizunoe)'s partner.

name: Kardal Spindal
description: Kardal Spindal is a young woman that works for the Public Health Department. She can cover herself in a semi-organic body suit that can be used for both offense and defense, and also possesses some form of telekinesis. She is first seen taking Yion Green with her from the MSCF.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Higaide
description: An extremely powerful patrol officer working under General Narain. He is highly proficient in the use of bladed weapons and combat techniques, as demonstrated when he is chosen by General Narain to execute a spy in a duel, and has even succeeded in killing Toha Heavy Industries' agent Hinoto Gou. He has also shown impressive agility, dodging a fully charged Gravitational Round Emission, and destroying multiple "War-Engines" (large battle mecha with enormous destructive capability) in a single battle.    Source: Wikipedia

name: Funipero
description: Child of the Recreator. She is an existence that Nyaldee needs to become the true lord of the Recreator.

name: Taira Hinoto
description: Taira is the female AI that belonged to the now-deceased Toha Heavy Industries Synthetic Human Gou Hinoto. She was sent into orbit by Gou, and later fell down to Earth and was saved from DRF forces by [Kozlov Loewic Grebnev](https://anilist.co/character/3973/Kozlov-L-Grebnev) at the former Izhitsa Co.

name: Fuyu Kanoe
description: Fuyu is the holographic A.I. personality of the large black motorcycle ridden by [Zouichi](https://anilist.co/character/3968) (4000XLA Toha Industries Motorcycle). She assists Zouichi with situational analysis as well as advising him on strategies. Like the other AI's, she is pre-programmed with emotions.

name: Sael
description: Sael acts as the "youngest" of the Puppet Taratect sisters. She is also the most robotic, typically doing nothing until she is ordered to do so. Despite this, aspects of her personality do show her to be bold and dutiful.

appearsIn.title: So I'm a Spider, So What?

name: Anna
description:
Anna is a half-elf attendant who has served the royal family for successive generations of kings. She is like a foster parent of Schlain and Sue, and she serves as a maid and guard for them alongside her colleague Kleava. As a first-class magic-user, she is an attendant who will fight to protect royalty in time of need.

(Source: Kumo desu ga, Nani ka? Wiki)

appearsIn.title: So I'm a Spider, So What?

name: Aurel Stadt
native: オーレル・シュタット
description: Aurel Stadt is an imperial court wizard. Second only to Ronandt in magic ability among the humans, and Ronandt’s Apprentice No.2. She was originally the daughter of a low-ranking noble.

appearsIn.title: So I'm a Spider, So What?

name: Arin Choi
description: Second daughter of the Truth Choi clan.

name: Imyeonui Jibaeja
aliases: The Ruler of the Other Side
description: She is the guardian constellation of the secret black market and Kim Hyeon-O's second disciple.

name: Buri Gamyeon
description: She is the patron saint of the Bentrick family, the first family in England, and the first disciple of Kim Hyeon-O.

name: So-Yeon Yu
description: Eldest daughter of the Dawn Yu clan.

name: Se-Hyeok O
description: The eldest son of the Early Oh clan.

name: Adelia Bentrick
description: Clan head of Bentrick clan.

name: Lillia
description: Valhalla labyrinth monster instructor.

name: Jun-U Choi
description: Appearing at the start of the series as a timid, gloomy and lonely guy, Jun-U thinks of himself as an 'outsider' and rarely ever felt that he fit in with the others at school. During the progression of the series, he is described as a selfless person, as he always goes out of his way to help the ones dearest to him.

name: Ha-Min Park
description: Ha-Min usually an intimidating demeanor but shows empathy for those that are close to her. She is extremely intelligent and is the top-scoring student in the school due to the fact that she spends lots of time at cram school. Ha-Min is also quite popular but she usually ignores anyone that tries to talk or befriend her because she doesn't care about expectations of her. It also makes her uncomfortable to interact with strangers. She is very observant as well, solving mysteries using her quick wit and intellect.

name: Tae-Yang Lee
description: Tae-Yang is reckless and hot-tempered, but also will swallow his pride if he thinks he has made a mistake. He is shown to trigger at the slightest irritation, and won't hesitate to beat someone up, even when he's outnumbered. He is called "reliable" by Joowoon because of his dedication to help his friends. Even though he is always ready for a fight, he won't start fight for no reason.

name: Yu-Ri Lee
description: Jun-U's friend from middle school

name: Han-Sol
description: She's the best friend of Yoon Sungah.

name: Jong-Hwa Yu
description: Jun-U's friend

name: Ro-Sa Park
description: __Superpower:__ Superhuman-strength and Teleportation.

name: Do-Ryeong Han
description:
__Superpower:__ Telekinesis and Self-regeneration

Member of the SP police.

name: Sei
description:
__Superpower:__ Clairvoyance

Member of the SP police and popular Metuber with 500k subscribers. She doesn't like Do-Ryeong due to his popularity. Her secret skills include: dodging while being super annoying and hitting while being super annoying.

name: Jun-Gi Gi
description:
__Superpower:__ Shapeshifting

Member of the SP police. He has a strong obsession with numbers and symmetry.

name: Diana Yu
description:
__Superpower:__ Superhuman

Ro-Sa's parental grandmother. When she was younger she was a SP criminal.

name: Gil-Bae Choi
description:
__Superpower:__ Life Disintegration

Chairman of the Bureau of Special Abilities. He is in love with Ro-Sa's grandmother Diana.

name: Chun-Hyang Kang
description:
__Superpower:__ Fire

Member of Honorary SP Police with her twin brother Mong-Ryong.

name: Mong-Ryong Kang
description:
__Superpower:__ Water

Member of Honorary SP Police with his twin sister Chun-Hyang.

name: Seon Jang
description:
__Superpower:__ Fluidization 

Member of the SP police and the twin's mentor.

name: Ma-Ri Baek
description:
Ma-Ri Baek is the main female protagonist in the webtoon. She is a vampire but regularly attends school without any of her schoolmates knowing her true identity. Ma-Ri is shown to be very quiet and lacking in emotion. She also turned down multiple boys without hesitation, thus earning her the nickname "Ice Princess".

She seems to have had friends in the past, but whenever her true identity as a vampire was revealed, no one wanted to stay with her since they feared they'd be bitten. This resulted into Ma-Ri being regarded as a monster, which is probably why she keeps her real identity to herself.

name: Jae-Min Jeong
description: Jae-Min Jeong is the main male protagonist. He is a handsome teenager who is known to be the school's most popular student. Jae-Min seems to have a hatred for women and acts very cold towards them. At one time, he even yelled at them just because they touched him.

appearsIn.title: No Matter What You Say, Furi-san is Scary!
No Matter What You Say, Furi-san is Scary!

name: Minato Furi
description: Minato is Youko Furi's younger brother.

appearsIn.title: No Matter What You Say, Furi-san is Scary!

name: Kaho Maeda
description: Kaho is Youko's close friend. Despite she was afraid of Youko at the beginning, Kaho accidentally found out about her love and began to support her.

appearsIn.title: No Matter What You Say, Furi-san is Scary!

name: Nagisa Furi
description: Nagisa is Youko Furi's younger sister.

name: Bete Loga
description:
__Race:__ Werewolf
__Height:__ 183 cm (6'0")
__Affiliation:__ Loki Familia
__Level:__ 6
__Skills:__ Úlfheðinn • Fenris Wolf • Solmani
__Magic:__ Hati
__Weapon:__ Flosvirt • Dual Rolan

Bete Loga is a first class adventurer and an executive member of the Loki Familia. He was the former captain of the Vidar Familia until they left the city. Bete was born to the leader of a clan of Werewolves and had a sister named Luna along with a childhood friend named Rene, who he later got in a relationship with. However, his whole clan was killed by a monster when he was 12, and he traveled to Orario where he eventually became the captain of the Vidar Familia. When he was 16, he temporarily left the city as a Level 3 to kill the monster that killed his clan, succeeding in doing so after a day of fighting. Unfortunately, he discovered upon his return that his Familia had failed their recent dungeon expedition, resulting in the deaths of the vice-captain, who he used to be in a relationship with, along with several others while others that survived gained wounds fatal for an adventurer. The Vidar Familia subsequently left the city, though he stayed behind, and later joined the Loki Familia after an incident with Finn and Gareth at a pub.

Bete has a rough personality and a slight superiority complex. He completely hates the weak, especially those that don't do anything about their weakness, and is not afraid to express his opinions about it. He can be an idiot who can't read the atmosphere.

appearsIn.title: Is it Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon?

name: Luca
description: He was raised by a band of mercenaries, where he served as their bugler. After being saved by the Pontiff, he agrees to become the leader of the Papal States' branch-hexed, in exchange for help in achieving his dream of becoming a maestro. His power allows him to turn sound into light, which he uses in battle to command troops.

appearsIn.title: The Bugle Call: Song of War

name: Zoe
description: A branch-hexed under Luca's command and the Papal States' trump card. She has a mutual affection for Luca. She believes the Pontiff is her mother. Her power allows her to obtain her future self's strength, but she falls asleep afterwards as a consequence. She is 27-years-old but has the mind of a 9-year-old due to overuse of her power.

appearsIn.title: The Bugle Call: Song of War

name: Touka
description: The Pontiff is the head of the Spire Church and ruler of Termi, the Holy Capital. He rallies and manages the Branch-hexed, including Luca. His goal is to protect their Spire, defeat the Erin Empire, and kill a Branch-hexed named The Garland.

appearsIn.title: The Bugle Call: Song of War

name: Poppy
description: A branch-hexed under Luca's command. Her power gives her telekinesis. Her telekinesis is very weak but has a large radius, allowing her to use a bow and arrow to hit enemies at a distance with high accuracy.

appearsIn.title: The Bugle Call: Song of War

name: Demi
description: A branch-hexed under Luca's command. Her power gives her exceptional eyesight that she can share with others.

appearsIn.title: The Bugle Call: Song of War

name: Miura
description: A branch-hexed under Luca's command. His power allows him to run incredibly fast, but he can't move at top speed on his own because it's too fast for him to understand where he's going.

appearsIn.title: The Bugle Call: Song of War

name: Dae-Gun Kwon
description:
Dae-Gun Kwon is a high school dropout who used to work in a convenience store.

After beating up some miscreants during his shift at the convenience store it is revealed that he was the leader of Incheon area which was said to be in the age of blood, was wiped in just a week by him alone. 

He is then later selected as the lead of a project called 'Iljin in charge of Iljin' where he was going to be used to tackle and stop the problem of bullying in Geumryong High School.

name: Itsuki Ayukawa
description: Ayukawa is a 26-year-old architect who has been in wheelchair since a traffic accident during his 3rd year at the university.

name: Tsugumi Kawana
description: Kawana is an employee at the interior design company "Cranberries." She is a kind, shy and affectionate young woman who was in love with Ayukawa in high school but never confessed.

name: Miki Yukimura
description: Ayukawa's ex girlfriend from high school.

name: Aoi Nagasawa
description: Ayukawa's caretaker who is in love with him.

name: Fan Mo
description:
__Race:__ Human

Mo Fan is a 16-year-old high school student. In his first awakening, he awakened two elements which was a rare occurrence yet no one saw.
Originally Mo Fan was a genius high school student that came from a world where magic does not exist. 


__Abilities/Stats:__


__Contracted Beasts/Mounts:__

name: Apas
description:
Apas, is the third daughter of the true medusa and that of a human girl and the one most likely to succeed her due to her high purity blood line, which allow her to take human form and disguise the fact that she is a medusa, although she is capable of taking the traditional medusa appearance.
She originally ran a large clan of snake like species in Egypt that ran a racketeering scheme with the Egyptian government for young human girls to eat.
After she was discovered by Mo Fan, she initially feigned ignorance, but when the truth was finally revealed. She intended to make Mo Fan her slave, but he was saved by the Nine Spectral Empress. She was then given the choice of death or enslavement. She chose the latter.
She continually voices her displeasure at the lifestyle is forced to endure and often quarrels with both him and Ling Ling.
After Mo Fan and Co. avenged the death of her mother at the hands of her elder sister Eurielle, she became more reasonable and friendly to those around her.
Despite her steadfast and arrogant attitude, she is quite easily bought off with womanly things like food or fashion.

name: Tutu Ai
description:
Ai Tutu is a friendly girl with a flirty and mischievous attitude. She is very confident, often putting herself or Mu Nujiao in uncomfortable positions due to her quick actions. She is the younger sister of Ai Jiangtu, a young prominent military mage.

Ai Tutu is good friends with Mu Nujiao. She meets Mo Fan when browsing for a new apartment. She convinces Mu Nujiao to live together with Mo Fan in the apartment.
Ai Tutu impersonates Mo Fan at a high risk team competition as she wants to experience the adoration Mo Fan naturally gets. She tarnishes Mo Fan's name due to inability and expects Mo Fan to blow up in anger, however he is most calm about the whole situation. He later defends Ai Tutu as the teammates she participated with as they yelled and insulted her harshly.

During the Kraken Invasion she was with Mu Nujiao when Mo Fan came with Azure Dragon and when Mu Nujiao recognized him, she teased her saying it's not the time to be thinking about him.

name: Jangtu Ai
description:
Ai Jangtu is the captain of the Chinese national team and older brother to Mo Fan's roommate Ai Tutu.
He is a member of a prominent military family that regularly sends out parties to hunt down monsters solely to drive down their numbers.
His military upbringing brought him great amount of experience, resources, training, maturity, dedication to his cultivation and strictness. Which he uses to full effect when leading the Chinese national team

Despite his military upbringing, he bares a strange similarity to Mo Fan. They are both students of Zhang Kong, they both nearly killed those who offended their sisters and have no issues declaring war with anyone who tries to interfere, they have no issue condemning people to their deaths should the offense warrant it, they have similar levels of ego, rage and they both dive in head first into dangerous situations without really knowing whats going on.

name: Ningxue Mu
description: Mo Fan's Childhood friend. When Ningxue and Mo Fan were much younger, Ningxue asked Mo Fan to run away with her to which Mo Fan agreed to. They were quickly caught and were separated for a long time, during which Ningxue's hair turned from black to the white it is currently.

name: Chikuwa
description: Chikuwa is Ena's pet dog.

name: Clyde Barrow
description: A smooth and intelligent thief who RJ meets after setting out on his own. The two meet after Clyde hears what he describes as an eerie sound from RJ's guitar. Clyde picks RJ up, bringing him along to use as distraction in order to rob an old man during a party. Clyde is based on the real Clyde Barrow, a famous gangster in American history who acted along with his lover, Bonnie, during the Depression era.

appearsIn.title: Me and the Devil Blues: The Unreal Life of Robert Johnson

name: Robert Johnson
description: He always dreamt to be a talented blues-man, instead of working on plantations. And one day his dreams came true. But what was his price?

appearsIn.title: Me and the Devil Blues: The Unreal Life of Robert Johnson

name: Ike
description: The being Robert Johnson makes a deal with to gain his genius as a bluesman. An enigmatic person, he appears and disappears at the drop of the hat, usually to give Johnson advice, or as he puts it, a warning.  Although he gives off the impression of being a supernatural being, such as the Devil, Ike himself states that he is not the Devil.  Ike is based on Isaiah "Ike" Zinnerman, who was rumored to have learned supernaturally to play guitar by visiting graveyards at midnight. It is said that Johnson learned his guitar styles from Ike as he was becoming the legendary bluesman he is known as today.

appearsIn.title: Me and the Devil Blues: The Unreal Life of Robert Johnson

name: Niina Miyamoto
description: [Uehara](https://anilist.co/character/324905/Yuuki-Uehara)'s classmate who enters into a fake relationship with him so they can write better manga.

name: Yuuki Uehara
description: A high school student that dreams of becoming a mangaka.

name: Ren Shiori
description: A mangaka that chose [Uehara](https://anilist.co/character/324905/Yuuki-Uehara) as her assistant.

name: Kian
description: One of the friends of Eli, he fights for him.

name: Ria
description: Ritrel's sister, she is a specialist of medicinal plants.

name: Chris
description: His family died because of poverty. He is now one of Eli's men. His weapon is a whip

name: Plue
description:
The strange creature that [Haru](https://anilist.co/character/3749) discovered, Plue is the Rave Bearer, and is able to sense the presence of the other Rave Stones. Plue's nose also has the ability to destroy dark brings. Plue is quite fond of sweets - especially lollipops. Plue hates pudding. He has the ability to utilize the rave of conflict which powers him and Haru up.

Plue has since shown up in Fairy Tail as one of [Lucy](https://anilist.co/character/5186)'s stellar spirits (Nicola, Canis Minor) and quickly named Plue and has been noted to only agree to be summoned on Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Hamrio Musica
description: Musica is the leader of a band of infamous thieves known as the Silver Rhythm gang that reside in Punk Street. He owns and pilots a flying ship called the Advent. He has long brown hair (in the beginning of the series, but later wears it in a shorter, black, spiky style), has three distinctive piercings above his left eyebrow, and is always wearing a skull necklace that he uses as a weapon in conjunction with his silverclaiming abilities. He first meets Haru Glory and Elie in Punk Street when Haru is there looking for Musica the Blacksmith to fix his broken sword. Elie mistakes him for Musica the blacksmith. He helps Haru rescue Elie from Lance but decides not to join Haru's Group.    Musica and Haru's paths soon cross again when Musica helps defeat an assassin sent to kill Haru and Elie, and also helps Haru defeat Shuda and his subordinates. He then officially joins Haru. Musica's power helps Haru's group greatly, as do Musica's fighting skills. He's equal with Haru and the two make a formidable team. He became Haru's good friend, helping him in his search for the Rave Stones, while searching for the Silver Ray. Musica is also very loyal; when one of his subordinates, Snake, got caught during a robbery, he turned himself in to break both of them out. He never once doubts Haru and is always there when he needs him. Musica has a weakness for beautiful women, and will flirt with any beautiful girl he meets.

name: Elie
description: Elie is one very lively, bubbly, optimistic girl whose usual outfit is a tight fitting midriff top and a mini skirt. She has a hot temper, as shown when she destroyed a casino for a bet loss. She first met Haru Glory at the casino when she was about to win roulette but Plue jogged the table and moved the ball. She ends up joining them after Haru saves her. When she revealed to Haru that she was actually looking for her memories and is in search of someone who can tell her what her name is, when her birthday is, or who her parents are, Haru promised her that they will find it together. Elie has an undying love for casinos and always drags the group to the casino when there is one. She closely resembles Resha Valentine, the creator of the Rave.

name: Bony The Starfish
description: Bony is a rather small starfish that has been serving loyally under Flemia for many years. Bony is generally seen as your average starfish, but with a mustache and two small curly hairs on each side of his head. During the beginning of the Star Song Festival, Bony would be the one to introduce the Queen of Mildesta, Flemia; this would also be the first time Bony was shown in the series. Throughout the Star Song Festival, Bony would generally be seen resisting death while Plue continuously tried to eat him. After Haru and the others effectively say their final farewells to the people of Mildesta, Elie would hand a present to Haru as to celebrate his 17th birthday. Haru opens the present and his rather surprised to find Bony within it. Bony steps out of the present and tells Haru that he will be their guide throughout their journey to the Iima continent -- Bony will elaborate every safe passage throughout the Eastern Sea. Following this point, Bony would remain as a party member of Haru and the others (generally as a joke character). However, Bony would be confronted with many personal conflicts throughout his journey with the Rave Master such as being continuously eaten by the sleeping Lazenby.

name: Ruby
description: Ruby is a pink penguin (sentinoid, penguin-type) who owns a massive floating casino. Ruby likes to use his wealth to buy rare treasures. When he learns Drew is using his cash for evil ends, he is almost killed by Drew, but Haru saves him, and he decides to join his side. He is the only person to know who would be the third Rave Master if Haru dies. Ruby also has a tendency to blab out plans that the Rave Warriors have decided on during battle, making them entirely useless. He recently learned how to use "Wind" magic from the bell given to him by his father. The bell was actually named "the Holy Bell" and it was a weapon used by Dalmatian of Knights of the Blue Sky. It can turn into a magic sword, and use "Magic Reflection", "Twister", and "Air Ball" (from the videogame).

name: Belnika
description: Belnika is a kind girl and has a personality very similar to Elie only much more shy. She was experimented on so that she could have magical powers.

name: Haru Glory
description: Haru is a teenage boy who grew up on a small island called Garage Island. His father left him with his mother and sister to find Rave when he was young. Soon after, his mother died and he was left alone with his sister.  His destiny takes a turn when Shiba gives him the Rave stone, passing on the powers of the Rave Master.  He first fished Plue the Rave bearer out of the ocean, and soon met Shiba, the Rave Master. Haru was chosen as the second generation Rave Master by Rave. When he realizes the true threat that Demon Card are to the world, he then promised Shiba that he will complete the collection of Rave and end all of Demon Card's evil. He then sets off to find the pieces of Rave to restore peace to the world.  He's like his father, Gale Glory, never giving up in a battle, no matter the circumstances. He is not afraid to die for the protection of the planet. Along the way, he found good friends and allies, each having their own goals, yet were bound together thanks to him and helping each other along the way. He is very friendly and has a lot of energy. He is always there for his friends. He promised to protect Elie and when his friends are hurt, he gets really mad and get very motivated to protect them, gathering a rush of great strength.

name: Griffon Kato
description: Called Griff by his friends, he mostly praises Plue and calls him 'Master Plue'. He looks like a strange blue blob, with eyes and arms. He is close to Plue in size but with the ability to speak. Griff has limited shape-shifting abilities; such as inflating portions of his body and elongating his limbs. He is also a voyeuristic character, and in a couple of episodes he is seen spying on Elie. He is the cartographer of the group. He has been described as a pervert.

name: Java Let Dahaka
native: ジャヴァ・レット・ダハーカ
description: Let is a Dragonrace, a race of dragon people who reside in the Mystic Realm. When Let was first introduced, he was an evil warrior who worked for Demon Card as a guardian for King. He only wanted to fight until Haru defeated him and showed him the path of justice. His initial appearance in the story is of a human with a lizard like face. In the fight against Jegan he performs Dragon trial and takes the appearance of a human. Soon, he joined Haru in hope of bringing peace to the world.

name: Julia Line Dragoon
native: ジュリア・ライン・ドラグーン
description: Julia is Let's girlfriend, somewhat of a feisty blond who's loud, rowdy, and not above beating people up to get her way, which is a polar opposite to the cool and calm Let. She can be usually found at a bar and can turn into a dragon the same as Let. a A sisterly figure to Haru's party.  Julia in her dragon form was under the control of Jegan back then. As Jegan loves her and witness her failed the dragon ritual, he put a dark bring on her to keep her by his side.

name: Seiji Sanada
description: A 27-Year-Old office worker who finds himself in his younger self back in his second year of high school. He gets a second chance to confess his feelings towards his World History Teacher Hiiragi Sensei.

appearsIn.title: I Time-Traveled and Confessed to My Teacher Crush

name: Haruka Hiiragi
description: Haruka was Seiji's World History Teacher back in High School. He had a crush on her but never confessed at the time. After being given a second chance to confess, she reciprocates his feelings.

appearsIn.title: I Time-Traveled and Confessed to My Teacher Crush

name: Sana Sanada
description: Seiji's younger sister.

appearsIn.title: I Time-Traveled and Confessed to My Teacher Crush

name: Hatsumi Hiiragi
description: Haruka's younger sister.

appearsIn.title: I Time-Traveled and Confessed to My Teacher Crush

name: Kazuhiko Amamiya
description:
__Height:__ 179 cm

A police detective known to his colleagues as Yousuke Kobayashi; an inoffensive family man tracking down a serial killer who mutilates his victims by severing their limbs. When the killer sees Yousuke on television he claims to recognize something in the detective and mutilates Yousuke's girlfriend. Yousuke eventually tracks down the killer at which point a new personality called Shinji Nishizono, an arrogant and callous psychopath, emerges and shoots the killer.

From this point onward, the personality of Yousuke is replaced by Kazuhiko Amamiya, a cool-headed, serious criminologist who is arrested and imprisoned for the murder of the serial killer. Kazuhiko's personality fluctuates several times during the course of the story, most commonly switching between Kazuhiko Amamiya and Shinji Nishizono in the early chapters.

It is usually clear to the reader which personality is in control at any given time as Kazuhiko Amamiya is near-sighted and wears glasses, whereas Shinji Nishizono does not require glasses.

name: Miwa Isono
description: Miwa is the younger sister of Machi. She is initially introduced as a schoolgirl with a forceful personality who occasionally helps Machi and Amamiya in their cases. As the series progresses, she becomes more important as revelations about her role in the conspiracy that runs through the book are revealed.     She is later revealed as a new generation bar-coder who carries a crucial alternate personality for the formation of Lucy Monostone. Her last seemingly important role was to transfer the personality of Kazuhiko Amamiya to Nishizono Tetora.

name: Machi Isono
description: An intelligent female criminologist who runs a private consultancy firm. She employs Kazuhiko Amamiya upon his release from prison and invites him to live in the large apartment which serves as home to herself and her sister as well as the headquarters of her business.

name: Tetora Nishizono
description: In appearance, a young teenaged version of Kazuhiko Amamiya, Tetora Nishizono also carries the psychopathic personality of Shinji Nishizono, although the personality of Shinji is far more dominant in Tetora.

name: Teu Mimegumi
description: Gakuso staff.

name: Lucy Monostone
native: ルーシー・モノストーン
description: A deceased former American pop star and terrorist, Lucy Monostone is thought by the mysterious corporation at the heart of the conspiracy to be the perfect killer. While genetic engineering can recreate Monostone's body, the challenge appears to be recreating his soul in order for the ultimate murderer to be reborn. It seems that this can only be achieved by combining a number of personalities, representing the different parts of Monostone, into a single vessel.

name: Hisashi Shimazu
description: A person who killed the girlfriend of Yousuke Kobayashi. Was later killed by Kazuhiko Amamiya from a gun shot directly to the head.

name: Tooru Sasayama
description:
A good-hearted but relatively inept police detective who assists Kazuhiko and Machi. He often uses their criminal profiles to appear more skilled than he actually is (as he feels he lacks the "life experience" to comment on others). In truth however, he cares a great deal about his troubled colleagues and works to assist them in any way he can.

The character also appears in the Kurosagi series as an older man who is bald, scarred and missing a leg. The older Sasayama no longer works as a detective (due to his injuries) and instead directs Shinjuku's Social Welfare Office. This Sasayama is particularly grouchy, cynical and miserly.

Bridging the gap between the two is Sasayama as he appears in the Tantei Gishiki series. While bald and scarred like he appears in Kurosagi, this Sasayama still works in the police force. His rank however, is much higher than that of the bumbling young Sasayama in MPD Psycho (he's since risen to the rank of police chief).

name: Kikuo Toguchi
description: A journalistic photographer who often works along Sasayama at the time of the beginning of the story. He plays an important role in revealing the existence of the Shinji Nishizono personality to Machi Isono. His most recognizable feature is his eyepatch that often contain different pictures such as an eyeball, a smiley face, a barcode, (etc.) on its surface. After he learns that he has cataracts in his remaining eye, he reverts into the killer that all of the bar-code samples ultimately become.

name: Saya Oota
description: [Oota](https://anilist.co/character/89788/Oota)'s sister, who goes to same school as [Rino](https://anilist.co/character/89792/Rino-Tanaka). She is a shy person with an unusually small voice. She belongs to the Volleyball Club.

name: Jeong-Min Choi
description: A viciously bullied, and depressed high school student from a poor and abusive family. She has a good heart but when at her wit's end, she can take desperate and dangerous actions.

name: Si-Yun Baek
description: A mysterious man who enters Jeongmin's lucid dreams.

name: Ju-Hyeon Ha
description: The main leader behind Jeong-Min’s bullies. However, they used to be friends in primary school but she was ultimately forsaken by Jeong-Min. Her reason for bullying is unknown, but her nature seems to be twisted...

name: Yun-Jae Kim
description: He is kind to his comrades and friends, but he is cruel and merciless to enemies. He is calm and quick to adjust to situations and also won't hesitate to kill people that try kill other "innocent" players.

name: Ikebe Kyoto
description: A former member of the baseball team who had once made it to Koshien. Though he seemed uptight and strict at first, often lecturing Kawato over the smallest details, he later warms up to Kawato. When the team starts playing again, Ikebe becomes their coach, lending his expertise.

name: Tomochika Wakana
description:
__Height:__ 179 cm
__Position:__ Catcher
__Throw:__ Righty / Righty
__Throwing record:__ 97 m

A foul-mouthed first-year, who drifts through his life without passion. From baseball, he gets a newfound passion to live his life and chase a dream with his friends.

name: Murayama Yoshio
description: former captain of the baseball team from 43 years ago, when the team went to Koshien. He harbors a resentment for the current baseball team as he views them as tarnishing the legacy he left behind, and is willing to do anything to get them all expelled. However, after witnessing their first game against Yoga Daiichi, he starts to regard the baseball team more positively. When Yoga Daiichi's coach threatens to press charges of assault against Kawato for hitting him during their game, Murayama takes the blame for Kawato and resigns.

name: Tetsuro Yufune
description:
__Height:__ 186 cm
__Position:__ First Baseman
__Throw:__ Righty / Righty
__Throwing Record:__ 100m

Member of the baseball team.

name: Shoji Akaboshi
description:
__Height:__ 177 cm
__Position:__ Right Fielder
__Throw:__ Lefty / Lefty
__Throwing record:__ 115 m

A skilled player who was also well-known in middle school and dreamed of being able to compete in Major League Baseball. At first, he seemed arrogant, claiming he only needed high school to learn English and refusing to join the baseball team as he viewed them beneath him. However, he was practicing with a university team in secret, something Yagi and Aniya accidentally found out. When he was convinced to join the team, he discovered they were all as or even more talented than he was, leading him to work much harder for his spot on the team.

name: Shinobu Imaoka
description:
__Height:__ 152 cm
__Position:__ Left Fielder
__Throw:__ Righty / Righty-Lefty
__Throwing record:__ 76 m

name: Keiichi Aniya
description:
__Height:__ 181 cm
__Position:__ Pitcher
__Throw:__ Righty / Righty
__Throwing record:__ 123 m

name: Kiyooki Hiyama
description:
__Height:__ 174 cm
__Position:__ Shortstop
__Throw:__ Righty / Righty
__Throwing record:__ 90 m

name: Kouichi Kawato
description: Kouichi Kawato is a 24 year old single and an enthusiastic modern Japanese teaching teacher. He is accepted at the Futagotamagawa Gakuen High School and is assigned to class 1-B. Little did he know that all of the members of the baseball club reside in this class and that they gained delinquent status after the school and tournament expulsion.

name: Toru Mikoshiba
description:
__Height:__ 154 cm
__Position:__ Second Baseman
__Throw:__ Righty / Righty
__Throwing record:__ 83 m

The team's captain. Though non-violent and intelligent, he is often affected by nervousness and insecurity. He is often emotional and cares deeply for his teammates and their coach.

name: Minoru Soramoto
description: Minoru is a high school boy with light brown hair and purple eyes, he is a simple and normal person, but sensible and realistic. Because his parents abandoned him and leaving him with all their debts, he now lives with the next door neighbour, who paid all his debts and invited Minoru to live with her in her apartment. Now she spoils him by filling him with luxuries, much to his annoyance, because he is afraid of being turned into a good-for-nothing who always has to depend on her. He is in the basketball club of his Institute, although he does not stand out too much. Sometime after he starts living with Onee-san, he starts to develop feelings for her.

appearsIn.title: She's Adopted a High School Boy!

name: Shiori
description:
**Height:** **Age:** **Occupation:** 

At first, Shiori is [Minoru](https://anilist.co/character/147620/Soramoto-Minoru)'s neighbor, who decides to take him in her apartment after he was abandoned by his parents, in addition to paying off the debts left to him. She feels an obsessive but at the same time innocent love for Minoru, to the point where she cannot touch him or get very close to him, since according to her, she is happy enough breathing the same air that he breathes. Onee-san always spoils Minoru, granting him a dream life, full of luxuries such as delicious food, comfort, clean clothes, and not allowing him to do things that require effort, which Minoru does not like, as he does not want to become a " good for nothing".

appearsIn.title: She's Adopted a High School Boy!

name: Tamahiko Shima
description: A young man born into a wealthy family in Meiji 38. A year before the manga starts, he was in a car accident that resulted in his mother dying and the loss of complete use of his right arm. He was given his family's mansion in Chiba, and a bride was purchased to assist him for ¥200,000.

name: Yuzuki Tachibana
description: Tamahiko's bride. She was purchased for ¥200,000 by Tamahiko's father.

name: Ryoutarou Atsumi
description: Ryou's younger brother.

name: Midori
description: Yuzuki's best friend from her all-girls school.

name: Tamako Shima
description: Tamahiko's little sister.

name: Hikaru Shiratori
description:
__Height:__ 170cm

Born in Meji 38. The twin brother of Kotori Shiratori.

name: Tamao Shima
description:
__Height:__ 169cm (5'6")

Tamahiko's younger brother. He was born in Meiji 41.

name: Kotori Shiratori
description: A famous singer.

name: Tamaki Shima
description: Tamahiko's older half-brother.

name: Tamayo Shima
description:
**Height:** 166 cm (5'5")

Tamahiko's older half-sister.

name: Soichiro Arima
description:
Smart, attractive, athletic, and talented like Yukino, Soichiro Arima becomes Yukino's rival at school. Very handsome and popular, Soichiro excels at kendo and becomes a national champion. He is at first smitten by Yukino, unaware that she secretly hated him and constantly tried to compete with him. After unwittingly discovering that Yukino is not the model student everyone thinks she is, Soichiro blackmails her into doing his school work so he can spend more time with her. After resolving the issue and becoming each other's first true friend, they eventually fall in love.

Arima has alot of issues with his past. He is scared that his family will hate him and reject him like they once did. However, because of that, he decided he had to become a perfect person. But, with Yukino's help he realizes his parents accept him for who he is and that he should love all sides of himself and show his real personality proudly to everyone.

appearsIn.title: Kare Kano: His and Her Circumstances

name: Yukino Miyazawa
description:
Smart, attractive, athletic and talented, Yukino Miyazawa appears to be the model student. Both her male and female peers express their admiration for her, often asking her for help and commenting about her model features and characteristics. 

However, her "perfect" exterior hides the fact that everything she does is done solely to receive praise from others. She has been this way since she was a little girl - a self-professed "queen of vanity", Yukino once practiced playing her recorder until she vomited blood. With all this praise, however, she never realized that she never had a real friend aside from her family and was considered by her peers as a kind of semi-approachable "guest". This all changes when Yukino meets Soichiro Arima, another model student who beats her high school entrance exam score, and is even more popular and athletic than Yukino. Yukino is envious of her rival Soichiro, and works hard to top his grades. When Soichiro confesses that he has a crush on her, she rejects him and laughs about it afterwards. But her observant sister Kano points out that Yukino's rivalry with him is born of admiration. This revelation is useless, however, as Yukino accidentally lets her guard down and Soichiro discovers that she is a slob at home. Soichiro uses this to blackmail her to spend more time with her.

appearsIn.title: Kare Kano: His and Her Circumstances

name: Tsukino Miyazawa
description: The middle daughter of the Miyazawa family, Tsukino seems to be goofier and more laid back than her sisters. Tsukino tends to tease Kano, the youngest daughter.

appearsIn.title: Kare Kano: His and Her Circumstances

name: Tsubasa Shibahime
description: Tsubasa Shibahime is a girl who loved Soichiro Arima ever since they attended middle school together. Although she studied hard so she could attend Hokuei High School with Soichiro, a bad skateboarding accident prevents her from starting school with everyone else.

appearsIn.title: Kare Kano: His and Her Circumstances

name: Hiroyuki Miyazawa
description: Hiroyuki is the husband of Miyako and the father of Yukino, Kano, and Tsukino Miyazawa. He comes off as overly protective of his three daughters and acts very much like a child.

appearsIn.title: Kare Kano: His and Her Circumstances

name: Yusuke Takashi
description: Takashi-san is Maho's 28-year-old dentist boyfriend.

appearsIn.title: Kare Kano: His and Her Circumstances

name: Pero Pero
description: The white, adorable, wiggley dog of the Miyazawa family.  This character plays a secretly very large role in this series, and shows up in (almost) every scene at Yukino's house. He is often seen eating, sleeping, or sitting on the heads of his owners.

appearsIn.title: Kare Kano: His and Her Circumstances

name: Kano Miyazawa
description: The youngest of the three Miyazawa daughters, Kano is known for her shōjo manga and novel obsessions. She uses the knowledge from her love stories to help out Yukino when she is in a psychological pinch.

appearsIn.title: Kare Kano: His and Her Circumstances

name: Takefumi Tonami
description:
As a fat, sickly, and spoiled child, Takefumi was constantly picked on in elementary school. He was somewhat protected by the tomboy Tsubaki, who, while protecting him from other bullies, would bully Takefumi herself. When he asked Tsubaki why she paid attention to him, she told him that a teacher had asked her to look after him. After hearing this, Takefumi is humiliated as he had never been in his life; he is humiliated because he had believed that he was somehow special to Tsubaki, but he realized that she did not care about him at all, and was just obeying a teacher's request. 

He transferred to a school in another city but returns years later to attend Hokuei High School with the other characters. When he returns to Tokyo, he had lost weight, become healthy, tall, handsome, and completely unrecognizable. He intends to take advantage of the fact that no one recognizes him to get revenge on Tsubaki. Although he butts heads with Yukino at first, she recognizes that his efforts to transform himself are similar to her own obsession with her image, and they share a mutual, albeit begrudging, admiration. He later realizes that his feelings for Tsubaki are actually love, and that the source of his seeming hatred for her was because he felt rejected by her. After he realizes this, he finds out that Tsubaki likes him, too, and they become a couple.

appearsIn.title: Kare Kano: His and Her Circumstances

name: Reiji Arima
description:
Reiji Arima is Soichiro's estranged father.

Reiji was the illegitimate but favored son of the Arima patriarch whose mother tried to drown herself and take Reiji with her. Reiji kicked her in the face to save himself, a horrific memory that haunts him for the rest of his life. Although a talented musician, he grows to lead a life of a delinquent and is seduced by a beautiful gold-digger named Ryoko, who gets pregnant. Reiji names it Soichiro after his brother [Shouji](https://anilist.co/character/253606), but has nothing else to do with the child.

Years later, Reiji learns Ryoko was abusing his son and had abandoned him. Unable to care for him, Reiji gives the child to Shouji then moves to New York City. There he becomes a famous jazz pianist. 

He only appears in the manga. In the anime, it was only mentioned that Soichiro was abandoned by his parents to evade a massive amount of debt.

appearsIn.title: Kare Kano: His and Her Circumstances

name: Red Siberian Kai
native: レッドシベリアン・改
description:
Great Red Siberian is a monster of the beast species and is the Demon King's faithful dog.
Great Red Siberian values discipline and wants Princess Syalis to act like the hostage she is. He has served the Demon King for a long time and enforces the Demon Castle rules through his troops of Red Siberians.

(Source: Sleepy Princess Wiki)

appearsIn.title: Sleepy Princess in the Demon Castle

name: Yuuma Mukai
description:
**Height:** 170 cm (5'6")

Mukai Yuuma is the main protagonist of Real Account Part II.

name: Marble
description: The organiser of the death games and mascot for Re-Aca.

name: Ataru Kashiwagi
description: The protagonist of the first part.

name: Koyori Kanda
description: A third year middle school student that loves cats.

name: Ayame Kamijou
description:
**Height:** 161 cm

The female protagonist of the second part.

name: Yuri Kashiwagi
description: Kashiwagi Ataru's sister.

name: Ruriri Ichijou
description: A 28-year-old man who was popular in the Internet under the name Yuriko, until her real appearance was revealed.

name: Masahide Eniguma
description: The president of the Real Account corporation.

name: Imari Uzuki
description: Imari is a tech genius introduced in the 2nd part of Real Account. He is saved by Nanako Yuzuhara and goes on to play a pivotal supporting role for Yuma Mukai in the subsequent death games.

name: Aiji Hoshina
description: Hoshina Aiji is a character in Real Account I. He takes pleasure in "madness." Aiji appears cute and innocent at the beginning, but purposely killed the judges in the second game for his very own enjoyment. He had his debut in the third chapter, however his name was revealed in chapter 6.

name: Charteris Kartazen
description:
__Height:__ 188cm (6'2")

Kartazen Empire's Second Prince. Befitting the prestige of one granted the Golden Blessing, he has everything from looks, to wealth, to outstanding swordsmanship.

name: Rosentine Arzen
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm (5'4'')

Daughter of the duke of Argent with the ability to see ghosts. In her past life, she was able to see ghosts as well and got bullied severely because of it.

name: Reria
description: He's a Baron

appearsIn.title: The Strongest Sage with the Weakest Crest

name: Dogiel Melkia
description: The feudal lord of Melkia

appearsIn.title: The Strongest Sage with the Weakest Crest

name: Lake Hildesheimr
description: Matthias's brother

appearsIn.title: The Strongest Sage with the Weakest Crest

name: Giluas
description: He's an examinator for Matty's group to determine whether they can rank up in the guild

appearsIn.title: The Strongest Sage with the Weakest Crest

name: Edwart
description: The Second Royal Academy's Principal.

appearsIn.title: The Strongest Sage with the Weakest Crest

name: Touka Scott
description:
Touka is the main character in the Yuusha ga Shinda! manga. He's a farmer from Cheza village, the same as his childhood friend, Yuna Yunis. Touka has a thigh fetish and loves putting kneesocks on vegetables he harvests to engage his fantasies. Touka's simple life changes when a demon attacks his village. Touka digs a pitfall trap and baits it with cooked bacon in order to kill the demon and protect the village. However, the demon dislikes bacon so it continues to destroy the village until the Hero arrives and defeats it. The hungry Hero is lured into the pitfall trap by Touka's bacon and falls to his death.

To avoid blame for the Hero's death, Touka convinces the villagers to bury him in secret and pretend the Hero is missing. Touka believes his plan has worked until he wakes up the next morning in the Hero's body. One of the Hero's companions, a necromancer, has transferred his consciousness into the Hero's dead body and captured his original body so that he'll be forced to take up the role of the Hero. Unfortunately for Touka, this does not stop the decay of the Hero's body and Touka ends up walking around as a skeleton.

name: Sion Breydan
description: A famous hero who saved the world from monsters. He is accidentally killed at the start of the series.

name: Anri Haysworth
native: アンリ・ヘイズワース
description: Anri is one of the companions of the Hero. She is a necromancer. After the Hero's death, Anri transfers Touka's consciousness into the Hero's body so Touka can continue the Hero's work.

name: Yuna Yunis
description: Yuna Eunice is from Cheza Village and she is Touka's childhood friend. She has a crush on the Hero and she considers Touka a pervert.

name: Kyle Ozment
description: Kyle is one of the companions of the hero. After the hero's death he attempts to take his place as hero.

name: Esel Borgnine
native: エセル　ボーグナイン
description: Ethel's first appearance is in front of Hell's Gate in chapter 1. She's an infamous bandit and master trap maker. She's 29 years old.

name: Doto Burns
description: The mayor of Moalan. He begins his mayoral career focused on fortune, but later comes to love the people of his town... and kneesocks,

name: Ciruela Carmen
description: One of the strongest four warriors in the kingdom.

name: Leland Tallman
native: リーランド・トールマン
description: Director of the orphanage located at the royal capital.

name: Shuri
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm

The youngest son of the Emperor, he rules over Saikoku (western Japan) which includes Chugoku, Shikoku and Kyuushuu. In the early parts of the story Shuri stands out as brutally cruel to those who do not obey him, because he is responsible for the destruction of Byakko Village and the murder of [Tatara](https://anilist.co/character/17180/Tatara). Later he meets [Sarasa](https://anilist.co/character/4330/Sarasa), unaware that they are enemies, and falls in love with her.

Though he is merciless to his enemies, Shuri is a capable ruler and very proud of his realm. He has a big-hearted, free-spirited personality and is generally quite personable, though he tends to be overly competitive. Shuri is an expert swordsman.

name: Sarasa
description: The protagonist of this series. She takes the name of her murdered twin bother Tatara, who was known as the child of fate. As Tatara, she wields the sword of Byakko and leads the survivors of Byakko Village. Even among her allies few people know she is a girl.  Sarasa hopes to create a land that is fertile, full of flora, and free of strife. Though she is quick to cry and psychologically weak in some respects, over the course of the story she develops undeniable skills in leadership and swordplay, and becomes the central figure of the Tatara Army.  Because of visiting hot springs she has met a curious young man named Shuri, who has become her only outlet for being completly herself as Sarasa. But at the moment she does not know that Shuri is her hated enemy The Red King.

name: Yuna
description: Bashō-sensei's assistant whom Shuri meets in Okinawa. She is bold and tomboyish but likes to be relied upon, and treats Shuri like a younger brother. She is a childhood friend of Nakijin, and also capable in karate. Yūna is engaged to the President of Okinawa, Asato, who is also her surrogate father.      Yūna's name comes from the Okinawan name of Hibiscus tiliaceus, a tropical plant.   (source:Wikipedia)

name: Ginko
description: Ginko holds the title of the "white king" but is in fact a woman. She is also the one who put together the elite spy group, "The Four Virtues". Not much is known about her until the later volumes of the manga. In the anime, the white king is only briefly mentioned as the king who resides in Kyoto with the emperor.

name: Hayato
description: A boy from the city of Daizaifu in Kyūshū, Hayato becomes one of Tatara's first allies. He is the successor to the sword of Suzaku, but specializes in the use of bow and arrows. Hayato is scatterbrained, but because he gets the others out of many dangerous situations, he becomes a sort of mascot figure for the Tatara Army.

name: Senju
description: Shidou's fiancee, a young noblewoman. Senju is made of sterner stuff than her delicate looks would suggest. She truly loves Shidou even though their marriage was arranged, and they have a rush wedding before Shidou goes into battle with Tatara at her urging.

name: Nachi
description: The son and heir of the head priest of the Kumano Shinto shrine. Nachi runs across Sarasa while hunting the largest whale in the seas in his region. Nachi is a merchant with a bold, optimistic personality, and he speaks with a strong regional accent.  Nachi is a member of the Tengu youth organization with his friend Hijiri, and serves as second in command. He is knowledgeable about survival skills, and comes to Sarasa's aid numerous times.

name: Yuzan
description: Professor and former slave. Revolutionary

name: Kakujii
description: A Byakko villager; he instructs Tatara, and later Sarasa, in swordplay. He plays a surrogate father role for Sarasa, and she places a great deal of trust in him. Kakujii originally came from a fishing village in the Tohoku region, but was thrown into Abashiri Prison after rebelling against the Black King, who rules there. He later escaped, and eventually ended up in Byakko Village.

name: Ichimatsu
description: He is one of the Black King's top three generals. However unlike the other two, Ichimatsu is loyal only to the Purple Lady (wife of the Black King).

name: Jin Haiba
description: He's a high school physics teacher. His students tease him about being lazy and smelling of nicotine.

name: Mikoto Ochiai
description: Top of the class. When she wants to jump off the school roof, her physics teacher [Jin Haiba](https://anilist.co/character/172764/Haiba-Jin) hurries to her rescue and asks her: "Love me before you die." Her feelings for the sloppy teacher begin to rise.

name: Akira Ajikawa
description: Mikoto's friend.

name: Kazuma Takamine
description: First year high school student.

name: Tsukasa Ochiai
description: Mikoto's older brother who is overprotective of her. Has known Jin for a long time.

name: Atsuto Udou
description: Mikoto's friend and Nazuna's older brother. He was about to commit suicide, but was stopped by Mikoto. Due to his poor family situation, he works multiple part-time jobs.

name: Nazuna Udou
description: Mikoto's friend and Atsuto's younger sister. She is lazy and sharp-tongued, but also has a caring side for her friends.

name: Kaoruko Itami
description: Mikoto's friend. She's a klutz who often gets hurt by accident.

name: Mitsuki Ochiai
description: Mikoto's older brother. Twin brother of Tsukasa. Passed away due to a certain incident.

name: Cub
description: A small-time peddler and heavy addict. Used to any kind of hallucinogenic trip, he is able to feel the happiness through the ecstasy of the drug, while at the same time hypocritically hating who gave birth to that society that has forced him to live this way.

name: Ango
description: A specialist in fire and water classes, and the main character of the chapters about Summer group A. He was the top student of the project, and a Ryou's rival. He and Ryou reluctantly respect each other. Ango is attracted to Ayu and friends with Koruri, Mayu, Nobara, and Shigeru.

name: Arashi Aota
description: A 17-year-old male who is Hana's (a member of Spring group) boyfriend. He was the first person who was kind to Natsu, and in general, he's a very nice guy. He loves to swim. "Arashi" means "tempest" and "Aota" means "green paddy".

name: Takahiro Aramaki
description: The main character of the Winter group. Takahiro was a high-school baseball player, described as the best pitcher for 50 years, who led his team to victory at Kōshien. He is attracted to Mitsuru, but when he realizes she prefers Fubuki, he helps the two get together. Taka means "hawk"

name: Natsu Iwashimizu
description: A shy, awkward, and withdrawn 16-year-old girl. Natsu has difficulty expressing herself and was always put down at home and bullied in school. She becomes essential to the team's survival by observing and writing down what they discover, such as which foods are edible. She has conflicting feelings for Arashi, knowing that he has a girlfriend. She is picked on or rather, teased by Semimaru frequently. Natsu means summer and iwashimizu means water trickling from rocks.

name: Hana Suguruno
description: Hana Suguruno is a 17-year-old female and the girlfriend of Arashi Aota. Overwhelmed with sadness when she woke up and thinking that she would never meet Arashi again, she almost let herself get killed in the harsh days. That is, until she found out that Arashi was possibly one of the survivors, and once again struggles to meet the love of her life. She is very beautiful, strong-willed and tomboyish, and learned everything about wilderness survival from her father. "Hana" means "flower" and "Suguruno" means "burning of fields to make way for new crops".  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Ayu
description: Known as Madonna for her beauty, Ayu is the best specialist in the plant class. She is sometimes bullied by other girls for her appearance. Ayu means "sweetfish".

name: Momotarou Nobi
description: A 12-year-old genius from Sendai. Momo means "peach", taro means "oldest/first son", and nobi means "wildfire".

name: Fubuki Samejima
