description: A member of Team Winter. Fubuki is a high school baseball player from Hiroshima who is famously referred as the best shortstop of the century.

name: Mitsuru Kagurazaka
description: A member of Team Winter. Mitsuru is a celebrated performer of the Japanese dance world. As a high school junior, she is a big fan of high school baseball, and knew of Fubuki and Takahiro even before the three met as part of Team Winter.

name: Doppo Orochi
description: A karate master and head of the shinshinkai-kan.One of the only people in the world able to stand toe-to-toe with Yujiro. He whips his students into shape by fighting them regularly, and practices all of his karate techniques at least one thousand times daily. A very devoted karate practitioner, and a mentor of Baki's. Also the instructor of Katou and father of Katsumi. He fought Yujiro, who gouged his eye out and killed him. However, Doppo was revived by Kureha. He eventually fights the escaped American convict Dorian in the 'Search of our Strongest Hero' manga series. Dorian manages to cut off Doppo's hand with a strange wire-cutting technique in which he uses a wire blade projected from a lighter. Doppo later avenges this loss when he, Katsumi, and Retsu track Dorian down. Shortly after this however, Dorian escapes from the hospital and uses an explosive that is implanted into his hand to blow off part of Doppo's face.  This however, does not kill him, but leaves many scars on his face.    (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Iron Michael
description:
A great champion claimed as No. 1 in the history of boxing. The strongest boxer, also known as Iron Michael.

(Source: baki-anime.jp)

name: Chamomile Lessen
native: カモミール・レッセン
description:
He was born on the same island as Guevara, and he was the bodyguard of Bosch. He shows his extremely high physical abilities and Guevara's strength to Bosch, who was against Guevara founding an independent country.

(Source: baki-anime.jp)

name: Gerry Strydum
native: ゲリー・ストライダム
aliases: キャプテン・ストライダム
description:
A captain and later general in the US Army and Yuujiro Hanma's companion and comrade-at-arms. He developed an admiration for Yuujiro, and now he travels, fighting with him on the battlefields across the world. He somewhat understands Yuujiro's mentality and mentions that he is the only person to bring the United States to its knees. However, it is often seen that Strydum cannot stand situations in which Yuujiro abuses his brutality and ruthlessness. He seems to know him well and understand his wild way of thinking, but he usually disagrees with his actions. Strydum is also a friend and mentor of Baki's, who keeps him up to date about Yuujiro's whereabouts. 

(Source: Baki Wiki)

name: Kouji Kagami
description:
__Height:__ 173 cm

A former weak villager who has reached the "highest level" that no one has ever reached before. Due to a past incident, he believes that demons and humans are the same, and currently spends his days earnestly saving money for a certain purpose.

name: Alice
description:
__Height:__ 144 cm

A demon girl born into the demon race who wishes to coexist with humans. Inheriting the ideas of her father, the Demon King, she begins to work towards realizing her ideals after meeting [Kagami](https://anilist.co/character/373000/Koji-Kagami), who does not hate demons.

name: Takako
description: A martial artist who owns a club and a bar. She once aimed to defeat the Demon King, but after being saved by the demons, she distanced herself from conflict. She has known [Kagami](https://anilist.co/character/373000/Koji-Kagami) for a long time, and they have built a cooperative relationship.

name: Rex
description: After his parents were killed by monsters, he aspires to become a hero and take on the mission of defeating the Demon King. However, after meeting a mirror, he begins to notice distortions in the world.

name: Menou
description: __Height:__ 185 cm

name: Tina
description: A young monk traveling for training. Raised in an orphanage in the royal capital, she seeks to repay the kindness of those who supported her by becoming a priest and helping others. She is hardworking and polite, but can't help but make comments when something mysterious happens.

name: Krull
description: The third princess of the Kingdom of Hexaldria, formerly known as Japan. Born as a sage, she underwent rigorous training from an early age to defeat the Demon King. She was raised to believe that demons were evil, but she also possesses the flexibility to believe in the truth she sees with her own eyes.

name: Paruna
description: A magician from the royal capital. He is usually carefree, but has the talent to act calmly and swiftly in emergencies. After a certain incident, he harbors a deep hatred for demons.

name: Emma
description: Emma is quite an anomaly for her time; her glasses -- something a person of her station would never have afforded -- is symbolic of her character traits as well.  She can read, is educated somewhat, is reserved and even naturally refined, though this is often misread as "quiet" or "shy".  She is shy as well however, and speaks little of herself or indeed at all.    Orphaned, she started life on her own as a flower girl -- someone who sells flowers that they could find underfoot near the flower seller's stalls.  No living was remotely possible on what even a successful flower girl could make and most of them turned to prostitution as soon as they were remotely old enough.  Kelly Stownar rescued Emma from this fate, or worse, by taking her in as a maid-of-all-work.  Mrs. Stownar taught Emma all she needed to know to have a trade in life and survive.

name: William Jones
native: ウィリアム・ジョーンズ
description:
The male protagonist of the story.

 He is the eldest son of the "House of Jones", a very wealthy merchant middle class family that is attempting to rise into the gentry. As his father's heir, he is under tremendous stress to not only take over the family business but also marry a girl from another wealthy family, preferably into the peerage. 

He developed feelings for Emma after their first meeting. He often intercepts her coming from Covent Garden on Regent Street. In the manga, William had told his father about Emma but his father had never seen Emma (different with the anime).

name: Arthur Jones
native: アーサー・ジョーンズ
description: Arthur is William's younger brother and is about to graduate from Eton. He's practical and somewhat grumpy, and objects very sternly to William's relationship with Emma. He also hints at the fact that he has to work since William will inherit the family estate.

name: Collin Jones
description: William's youngest brother, a timid and shy kid. He always seems on the verge of bursting into tears, and the slightest jar can make him start to whimper.

name: Hans
description:
A sullen young footman in the employment of the Mölders household. His father was a wandering clockmaker who passed on his mechanical skills to his son. His taciturn behavior may be as a result of his regretting his father's rebellious nature, which eventually lead to a nomadic and impoverished lifestyle. The unstable lifestyle of his childhood leads him to appreciate the quiet security of his current profession. He respects Emma for her strong, quiet spirit and grows protective of her as and when he notices her in her vulnerable moments. 

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Richard Jones
native: リチャード・ジョーンズ
description: Richard Jones is William's stern father. He is very conscious of his place in the class system - rich, yes, but it's "new money" (earned through business success) rather than "old money" (inherited from aristocrat ancestors). While he wants to overcome this distinction by having William "marry up", he has no tolerance whatsoever for the idea of Emma "marrying up" into his family. This despite some uncomfortable facts about his own history.     Source: http://hellsing.comicgenesis.com/emma/

name: Adèle
description: A cool and dark-haired beauty, Adèle is the head maid of the Molders household. She is a member of the staff retained from the original household in Germany. Though quick to bring the rest of the staff into line, Adèle is also quick to appreciate the quality of Emma's work.    (Reference: Wikipedia Japan)

name: Monica Mildrake
native: モニカ・ミルドレイク
description: Quite the opposite of her younger sister, Monica is an assertive, straightforward and unpredictable young woman who tends to tell others what is on her mind, disregarding how others may take what she says. Unlike many other women of her upbringing and social status, she is rather masculine: she is skilled in horseback riding, while others usually sidesaddle; she walks around in a top hat and carries a cane and overall she is far from being a lady.     She is married to Frederick Mildrake - a clueless and naive man. She doesn't have feelings for him, but as she stated herself, Frederick was more passionate than the other admirers, which is why she decided to marry him. Nevertheless, despite her self-centered attitude she has a softer side as well, which she usually shows exclusively to her younger sister, whom she is fiercely protective of.     She started having a strong dislike for William after learning that he is a potential suitor for Eleanor. Monica believed that William is not the right person for Eleanor, because he wasn't able to value her more than Monica herself does. She also thought that William's ultimate desire was to profit from the marriage, and therefore - his behavior was shameless and insulting to Eleanor and the Campbell family.     After witnessing William's proposal to Eleanor she becomes distressed and decides to go on a trip to India. During the trip, Monica takes a liking in traditional clothing and accessories.

name: Tasha
description: Housemaid of the Mölders household, who Emma considers as her closest friend. Emma first met Tasha at King's Cross railway station where she was leaving for Haworth along with her mistress Dorothea Mölders. Tasha later shared the same carriage as Emma, after learning that Emma was a maid, she suggested to her to apply for employment at Mölders household in Haworth, which was short of staff. After Emma is employed there, she and Tasha shared a servant's quarter and they became close friends.

name: Christina Wako Yamato
native: 大和・クリスティーナ・和子
description:
Partially French Producer at Eagle Jump.
Christina looks stoic outside but she tends worry a lot and she's a little bit of a crybaby. She easily blames herself to things she have no control over, easily embarrass and have a fear of being touch.

(Source: Wikia)

name: Hotaru Hoshikawa
description: Aoba and Nene's friend from high school.

name: Momiji Mochizuki
description: A rookie at Eagle Jump who joins the character team. Joins at the same time as and is friends with [Tsubame Narumi](https://anilist.co/character/123370/Tsubame-Narumi).

name: Alice Douglas
description: A noblewoman who takes Hanako on as her personal maid after finding out that she is trying to find Victor Franks. Alice fears that rumors surrounding her once having an affair with her governess will cause disgrace to her family.

name: Hanako Kujo
description: An aspiring novelist who travels to England in hopes of meeting her favorite author, Victor Franks. She instead finds herself as a personal maid to the noblewoman Alice Douglas.

name: Edward
description: A nobleman who is arranged to marry Alice. He hopes their marriage will do away with any of the rumours surrounding Alice and is suspicious of her relationship with Hanako

name: Eliza McGovern
native: イライザ・マクガヴァン
description: Hanako's colleague teacher and Alice's former tutor. She is also the one with whom Alice had a love affair. She separated herself from Alice in order to retain her aristocratic look and to save her from being publicly shamed. She is sent to Japan under the guise of promoting woman's education.

appearsIn.title: My Life as an Internet Novel
My Life as an Internet Novel

name: Dan-I Ham
description:
Ham Dan-I is the main character of My Life as an Internet Novel. On the first day of her middle school life, she finds herself in the world of a web novel, where she is the plain childhood best friend and neighbor of beautiful Ban Yeo-Ryeong. Despite her persisting disbelief, she follows Yeo-Ryeong to Ji Jon Middle School, where she meets the Four Heavenly Kings of Ji Jon. Over time, she becomes actual friends with Ban Yeo-Ryeong and the Four Heavenly Kings.

Due to also believing that her friends are main characters in a web novel while she is a supporting role, Dan-I often sees herself as an outsider. As a result, she keeps her problems and anxieties to herself, despite her friends asking her to confide in them.

appearsIn.title: My Life as an Internet Novel
My Life as an Internet Novel

name: Chun-Yeong Yu
description: One of the four male leads of the web novel that Dan-I was transported to. He is quiet and seems difficult to get along with, but is caring in his own way.

appearsIn.title: My Life as an Internet Novel

name: Eun-Hyeong Kwon
description:
Kwon Eun-Hyeong is one of the Four Heavenly Kings of Ji Jon Middle School. He is the kind class president of Class 1-4. He is a model student, well-loved by teachers and students.
When Eun-Hyeong was five years old, his mother and Yoo Cheon-Yeong's mother got into a car accident on a rainy day. Cheon-Yeong's mother was driving and was unharmed, but the garbage truck that hit them demolished the passenger seat where Eun-Hyeong's mother was. This incident gave him trauma and created an intense dislike for rainy days.
His father works for Cheon-Yeong's father's company as a reporter.
Eun-Hyeong is self-sufficient and independent, having taken care of himself from a young age. He is friendly and polite with strangers. He has a kindly and supportive personality; he is basically the "mom friend" of the group and takes care of everyone. But he does not shy away from confrontation. He can easily demand apologies and respect from bullies, or beat up thugs. He is very protective of his friends. He is also highly skilled in martial arts.

appearsIn.title: My Life as an Internet Novel

name: Hye-Hil Kim
description:
Kim Hye-Hil is one of the twins in Class 1-8. She is from Seokbong Middle School. She has a boyfriend from her middle school, who goes to the same high school with her, Lee Ji-Han from Class 1-4.

As described by Dan-I, Hye-Hil seems to have an "aura of someone aloof and cut off from the world around her." In reality, she is a well-studied, well-spoken, confident, and direct person.

appearsIn.title: My Life as an Internet Novel

name: Hye-U Kim
description:
Kim Hye-U is one of the twins in Class 1-8. He is from Seokbong Middle School.

Despite his looks, Hye-U is actually a snarky and friendly person. He is a loner type, despite his affability, and spends most of his time playing video games late into the night. He is very intelligent and it is reflected in his grades as he is always at the top of his class, even beating his sister who is the better student.

appearsIn.title: My Life as an Internet Novel

name: Yeo-Dan Ban
description:
__Height__: 183 cm

Ban Yeo-Ryeong's older brother.

appearsIn.title: My Life as an Internet Novel

name: Akane Matsunaga
description: Akane is Aoi's twin sister and Seiji's niece. She is energetic and active. Has a cute smile and keeps looking forward. She can be told apart from her brother because her bangs look shorter than Aoi's.

name: Aoi Matsunaga
description: Aoi is Akane's twin brother and Seiji's nephew. He has great concentration skills, like an adult, yet he acts like a spoiled child. Aoi can be told apart from Akane because he seems to have longer bangs then her.

name: Seiji Matsunaga
description: Aoi and Akane's uncle and legal guardian. He's a television announcer. When the twins' mother died, their father(his brother) abandoned the twins in his care and ran away.

name: Shiharu Nakamura
description: Aoi and Akane's babysitter. She dreams to one day open a nursery. After her mother's death when she was five, she was taken care of by the child welfare establishment.

name: Nao Hayami
description: First appearence is in chapter 3. He is the second oldest at the orphanage and has a very short temper. (Noticed when Shiharu is making the twins Christmas presents, he calls it stupid and glares at everyone.) Later on in the story, he appears to have a tiny ammount of feelings for Shiharu.

name: Takeru Miyagawa
description: One of Seiji's childhood friends and neighbor. He is a college student with a childish, cheerful, and carefree personality.He has two younger sisters, Nanami and Mana. He is often seen playing with Mana and the twins, Aoi Matsunaga and Akane Matsunaga. He often drops by at Seiji's place.

name: Rio Yoshii
description: A cheerful girl with a short-temper. She is very protective of Shiharu, her best friend. She has feelings for Takeru, childhood friends of the twins' uncle, Seiji Matsunaga.

name: Kouichi Matsunaga
description: He is the brother of Matsunaga Seiji and the father of the twins, he is dissapeared the day his wife died and left his kids Matsunaga Aoi and Matsunaga Akane to his brother Matsunaga Seiji.

name: Camute de Volphric
description: He's the next emperor, who still needs to awaken his power as a Wolf descendant to ascend the throne.

name: Adriana Von Gwinelle
description: The original protagonist of the world Rainelle incarnated.

name: Miel
description: A master elementalist. Originally a slave, he was freed from slavery with the help of Rainelle and also became a disciple of Myrddin, eventually earning a marques title.

name: Llywelyn de Volphric
description: Camute's younger brother and the third prince of the empire. He was mentioned as a strong heir to the throne since he was the only royal who had awakened his power.

name: Namuel Schalmalt
description: Camute's cousin and a model magician.

name: Galenus Del Windsor
description: Camut's knight escort. He possesses a huge loyalty to Camut.

name: Vuphelos
description: One of the imperial magicians. From a young age, he wanted to be the pinnacle of mastering all the truth, and then he even came into contact with the power of the devil.

name: Myrddin
description: The chief imperial magician.

name: Seo-Won Jin
description: Mr. Jin is a Maths Teacher at Garam Highschool. He has a fear of dogs.

appearsIn.title: A Good Day to be a Dog

name: Hae-Na Han
description: Miss Haena is a Literature Teacher at Garam Highschool. She has a family curse that turns her into a dog at midnight,

appearsIn.title: A Good Day to be a Dog

name: Yul Choi
description: Yool is a student at Garam Highschool.

appearsIn.title: A Good Day to be a Dog

name: Bo-Gyeom Lee
description: He is a teacher at Garam Highschool. He is also Mr. Jin's best friend and Miss Haena's crush.

appearsIn.title: A Good Day to be a Dog

name: Chae-A Yun
description: Miss Yoon is a Literature Teacher at Garam Highschool. She and Miss Haena don't really get along based on teaching differences. She also has a crush on Mr. Jin

appearsIn.title: A Good Day to be a Dog

name: Yu-Na Han
description: Yuna is Miss Haena's sister. She is also affected by the dog curse whenever she kisses someone of the opposite sex.

appearsIn.title: A Good Day to be a Dog

name: Jouji Habu
description:
A mountaineer with a natural talent for rock wall climbing who has conquered many difficult spots in Japan, including Mount Tanigawa's Ichinokurasawa demon slab.  However, because of his lack of recognition he was unable to travel abroad due of financial difficulties. He is uncooperative and very passionate and stubborn about mountain climbing, so his climbing partners wouldn't last long with him.

In 1979, he slipped and was injured while attempting to climb the Grand Jorasses alone in winter, but survived owing to his tremendous mental and physical strength. In 1984, he participated in the Everest winter expedition. Dissatisfied with the climb, he descended the mountain and disappeared.

name: Makoto Fukamachi
description:
A 40 year old Japanese mountaineering photographer and climber. In 1993, he lost one of his companions in an Everest expedition and considered quitting mountain climbing. Shortly after, in a shop in Kathmandu, he finds a Pocket Autographic Kodak camera who supposedly belonged to George Mallory, an English mountaineer who went missing on Mount Everest during an expedition in 1924. 

While searching for the origin of the camera, he encounters a mysterious mountain climber who the nepalese call Bikha Sanp, who Fukamachi realizes may very well be [Jouji Habu](https://anilist.co/character/140187/), a legendary Japanese mountaineer who disappeared from the scene several years ago. Unfortunately for Fukamachi however, Bikha Sanp refuses to talk to him and leaves with the camera in tow. Fukamachi feels strongly compelled by Jouji Habu's life and starts to chase after him.

name: Adolf Kamil
description: A Jewish-German boy who considers himself Japanese. Lives and works in his family's bakery in Kobe.

name: Adolf Kaufmann
native: アドルフ・カウフマン
description:
A half-Japanese, half-German boy living in Kobe. His best friend Adolf Kamil is an Ashkenazi Jew living in Japan. 



(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Acetylene Lamp
description: First Appearance: 1948 – Jungle Kingdom  Acetylene Lamp is widely known for the running-gag candle that appears in the dent in the back of his head. This came about from the image of one of Tezuka’s childhood friends who has similarities that the character shares. Acetylene Lamp is one of Tezuka’s more used villains. He generally plays more important roles such as Inspector Tomobiki, a role in Black Jack and the widely best role, Acetylene Lampe from Adolf and Drake Lamp from the 2003 Astro Boy. He also shares lesser important roles such as the conductor of the Marine Express in Undersea Super Train Marine Express.  In his earlier years, Lamp generally was pointed out by his long face and large round eyes, he was later fitted with thick round glasses, adding to his now signature appearance. Though considered a villain, Lamp has played nearly every kind of role, from minor assistant to big time propaganda activist.

name: Sohei Toge
description: A Japanese reporter sent to Germany to cover the 1936 Olympics only to find his younger brother murdered. He then proceeds to investigate who killed his brother and why, leading him into a dangerous web of espionage during World War II. He was born and raised in Niihari, Ibaraki (now Tsuchiura).

name: Hamegg
description:
Hamegg is one of [Osamu Tezuka](https://anilist.co/staff/96938)’s most widely used character actors.  Motivated by greed, he is extremely dishonest and a true coward – character traits that make him perfect as a cringe-worthy villain.  He is usually cast alongside [Acetylene Lamp](https://anilist.co/character/33515) (in a partnership Tezuka thought worked particularly well) as a henchman or lackey to another star, such as [Duke Red](https://anilist.co/character/31681), Skunk Kusai or Marukabi Boon.

His roles run the gamut from lighthearted comedy to darker, more violent characters, and oftentimes the parts he plays involve elements of both.

As one of Tezuka’s oldest characters, he appeared for the first time in Tezuka’s early amateur work, The Old Man’s Treasure Island (1945).  Of course, with a repetoire as large as his, he has had many memorable performances, including as Secret Police Inspector Akabane in [A Message to Adolf](https://anilist.co/manga/31695) (1983-85), the hunter in [Jungle Emperor](https://anilist.co/manga/31771) (1950-54), and numerous ones in [Astro Boy](https://anilist.co/manga/30728) (1952-86).

In another example of Tezuka using English words in pun-like fashion, Hamegg’s name is directly lifted from a popular breakfast combination.

name: Benito Mussolini
native: ベニート・ムッソリーニ
description: He was an Italian politician who led the National Fascist Party and is credited with being one of the key figures in the creation of fascism.

name: Kuklo Mansel
description: Kuklo is the main protagonist of the Attack on Titan prequel Before the Fall. He is the son of Heath and Elena Mansel and miraculously survived when his heavily pregnant mother was swallowed whole by a Titan.

appearsIn.title: Attack on Titan: Before the Fall

name: Sharle Inocencio
native: シャルル・イノセンシオ
description: Sharle Inocencio is the daughter of the late merchant, Dario Inocencio, and the younger sister of Xavi.

appearsIn.title: Attack on Titan: Before the Fall

name: Jorge Pikale
description:
Jorge was the Commander of the Survey Corps. He stepped down from his position to become the trainer of the next batch of recruits. He was also believed to be the first human being to kill a Titan by using the prototype Three Dimensional Maneuver Gear, earning him the title 'Jorge the Hero.'

(Source: Shingeki no Kyojin Wikia)

appearsIn.title: Attack on Titan: Before the Fall

name: Gloria Bernhart
native: グロリア・ベルンハルト
description:
Gloria is a member of the Military Police Brigade, and is the commanding officer in charge of the Shiganshina District. She arrested Kuklo after he and the Survey Corps returned from their expedition outside the Walls.

(Source: Shingeki no Kyojin Wikia)

appearsIn.title: Attack on Titan: Before the Fall

name: Angel Aaltonen
native: アンヘル・アールトネン
description: Angel Aaltonen is a great weaponsmith, also being called as "King of Inventions" (発明王), from Shiganshina District and the person credited for the creation of the Three Dimensional Maneuver Gear, an invaluable asset in fighting the Titans. He's also the one who found out about Titans weak point in the nape.

appearsIn.title: Attack on Titan: Before the Fall

name: Xenophon Harkimo
native: ゼノフォン・ハルキモ
description:
Xenophon is an inventor who manages a workshop in the Industrial City located within Wall Rose.

(Source: Shingeki no Kyojin Wiki)

appearsIn.title: Attack on Titan: Before the Fall

name: Carlo Pikale
description:
Carlo is the commander of the Survey Corps. He, along with Sorum Humé, were the first to discover Elena Mansel's infant son.

(Source: Shingeki no Kyojin Wikia)

appearsIn.title: Attack on Titan: Before the Fall

name: Elena  Mansel
description:
Elena was the mother of Kuklo, and the widow of Heath Mansel. She was a prominent figure in a Titan Cult, and was devoured after helping a Titan enter Wall Maria.

(Source: Shingeki no Kyojin Wikia)

appearsIn.title: Attack on Titan: Before the Fall

name: Rosa Carlstead
native: ローザ・カールステッド
description:
Rosa is a recruit of the Survey Corps and the daughter of Sorum Humé and Maria Carlstead.

(Source: Shingeki no Kyojin Wiki)

appearsIn.title: Attack on Titan: Before the Fall

name: Sorum  Humé
description: Solm is a member of the Survey Corps and childhood friend to Angel and Maria, as well as her fiancée. He is an experienced fighter, well-built and handsome.

appearsIn.title: Attack on Titan: Before the Fall

name: Jung-Woo Ha
description: The Main Protagonist of the Manhwa, _Reverse Villain_

name: Kaio  Yo
description: Kaio Yo is a skilled fighter with Kaio rank. Yo claims to primarily practice Kongoken, a form of strength and endurance training used in many martial arts. According to Yoh himself, he claims to have a "diamond" body, which he trained to withstand strikes from wooden swords, chains, being run over by a heavy loaded truck and being shot by an old fashion cannon ball. His strongest feat is staying conscious after standing under a waterfall in the midst of a typhoon.

appearsIn.title: Baki: The Search of our Strongest Hero

name: Chiharu Shiba
description: Leader of the Kurenai racing gangs, he is a street fighter that doesn't seem to feel pain. He fights Hatanaka Kouhei in round 1 where he severely breaks his own arm as a form of intimidation before viciously beating Kouhei. In round 2 he fights Ian McGregor with shadow bonding and nearly defeats the boxer. Shiba wins by breaking both of McGregors hands with his rock hard skull. Though he wins he is unable to continue due to injury. He is replaced By Andre who proceeds to throw him through the ceiling after a disgruntled Shiba confronts him and demands to know why he's being replaced by Andre in the tournament. After recovering from that, he is struck in the throat by Jack Hammer and knocked out. He's last shown (still injured), riding with his gang. Shiba makes a surprise return in the Son of Ogre series. At the request of Hanayama Kaoru, Shiba is to be Baki's training partner for the upcoming fight with Yujiro. Kaoru says Shiba must be Baki's partner because Shiba is weak. Baki is reluctant to fight Shiba at first, but finds a reason of his own when Shiba keeps on attacking him at various times throughout the day.

appearsIn.title: Baki: The Search of our Strongest Hero

name: Keechi Ando
description:
Once a friend of Yujiro's. Ando is a mountain of a man, comparable in size to the yasha ape. he lives as a hermit secluding himself deep in the woods on a treacherous mountain. Few could even survive the journey to his home, much less eke out a life there. But because of Ando's physical and mental strength, he thrives. His trains by eating a lot and chopping logs with his heavy ax.

(Source: Wikipedia)

appearsIn.title: Baki: The Search of our Strongest Hero

name: Ryuukou  Yanagi
description:
The smallest of the convicts physically, he is later being shown as the most deadly. He is the only convict whose crime is known, that he killed a dozen men in prison as a test bed for his new skill. He uses a special martial art called Way of the Void (空道, Koudou). In this style he practices Vacuum Palm, Whip Strike, Poison Hand and many others. Yanagi is also very good at using weapons, such as a rope sickle during fight with Baki Hanma, or the Bagh Nakh during fight with Goki Shibukawa. 

(Source: Baki Wiki)

appearsIn.title: Baki: The Search of our Strongest Hero

name: Shobun  Ron
description: Shobun is a tallish asian middle-aged man with muscular build. He has short black hair, a very thin mustache, and very thin eyebrows. He always keeps a non-enthusiastic look on his face, which helps him trick the opponent into thinking he doesn't care about the match by combining it with his Hand Pocket technique. He is dressed in a white Chinese suit and greyish boots.

appearsIn.title: Baki: The Search of our Strongest Hero

name: Warumono-san
description: Leader of an evil organization set out to destroy Earth. On his days off, however, he indulges in plenty of Earth pleasantries, ranging from food to looking at his favorite animal, pandas.

name: Akatsuki Red
description: Red ranger is known to be terrible with directions and has a strong sense of justice to defeat the General. His missions always ends up in ceasefire due to the General's off day.

name: Souten Blue
description: After his dad became a ranger, Blue ended up being chosen as a new ranger by Black.

name: Shinonome Pink
description: One of the rangers of the Ranger organization. Despite her role to defeat the evil organization as a ranger, she dreams to be a magical girl.

name: Yoiyami Black
aliases: Twilight Black (トワイライトブラック)
description: The oldest of the current ranger group and the one who assembled the members. He is shown to look sleepy and uses difficult language. He always seems to be busy, and has the role as a guardian.

name: Keiji
description:
A battle-hardened rooster who who travels from place to place, never wanting to be tied down (since he is a self-proclaimed "migratory species"). With exceptional strength and a mighty voice, he seeks to defeat any Kijū that he can find. 

He is bothered when women are brought to tears because of his actions, and has disdain for children.

name: Keisuke
description: Keiji's younger, crested half-brother who matches him in strength. He joins Keiji on his quest in order to rescue their father after he is captured by demons.

name: Shiage Hamazura
description: Level 0 and former Skill-Out with his best friends [Komaba Ritoku](/character/40145) and [Hattori Hanzou](/character/39988). A former lackey, grunt, chauffeur, and informant of ITEM, he delved into Academy City's darkness and turned into an anomaly that disrupts Aleister Crowley's plans and calculations time and time again.

name: Elizard
description: She is the Queen of England and the mother of Rimea, Carissa, and Villian. She carries a replica of the Sword of Mercy, Curtana, which allows her to send Telesma to the knighthood and people within the extent of England's territory. The Original Curtana grants its wielder power equal to that of the Chief of Heaven's Army, Archangel Michael, as long as its wielder is within the territory of England. Her replica, Curtana Second, can use 20% of the Original's power.

name: Xochitl
description: Xochitl is a member of the Aztec magic cabal known as Return of the Winged One. Originally a girl who was not used to hurting people, her life turns around in during their cabal's attack in Liberal Arts City, where she played a supporting role but then disobeyed some commands. As punishment, she is merged with an original grimoire and is then sent out to deal with Etzali, her senior in the cabal, who has defected.

name: Yobou Banka
description:
He is an esper of unknown level who is a part of SCHOOL. Little was shown about him, however he didn't show any hesitation when dispatching a comrade who had failed instead of saving him when he had the chance. 

His most distinctive feature is that he has a metallic goggle on his face yet it's not just covering his eyes; it's surrounding his entire head just like Saturn's rings. Plugs are inserted into it all around, and countless cables connect them to a machine at his back. Lastly, due to his usage of electronic weapons, it is unknown if he has an ESP ability that has no direct use as combat or if he just doesn't have an ESP ability at all. 

(Source: Toaru Majutsu no Index Wiki, updated by Aezile of Toaru Majutsu no Index Club)

name: Carissa
description: She is the the second princess of the Royal Family and the second eldest of Queen Elizard's daughters. She launches a rebellion and overthrows her mother, but faces opposition against her younger sister and her allies. Her forces and her allies, the Knights of England, fight against Villian's forces and her allies, Necessarius, for the throne, which sparks the English Magic Civil War. During the civil war, it is revealed she carries the sword "Curtana Original," which grants to the wielder the overwhelming power of the Archangel Michael.     Of the three princesses, she possess the aspect of "Military Affairs."

name: Patricia Birdway
native: パットリシア・バードウェイ
description: Patricia Birdway is the younger sister of Leivinia Birdway and is a supporting character through the various Toaru Majutsu no Index novels. Her appearance is somewhat similar to her older sister, as she has short blonde hair and blue eyes. She wears a track suit consisting of a light-blue jersey and spandex slacks, along with a white vest. She also has headphones hanging from her shoulders. She is apparently not involved in the magic side and isn't aware that her sister is the leader of a cabal. She is close to her sister as she knows various things about her.   (Source: Toaru Majutsu no Index Wiki)

name: Hanzou Hattori
description: He's the current temporary leader of Skill-Out, after Komaba Ritoku's death and Hamazura Shiage's absence.  He is the agile type of fighter and not very big. He usually wears black clothes decorated with white cross patterns.  Hattori Hanzou is kind of a frivolous character. According to Kuruwa, a kunoichi who is familiar with Hanzou, he is a descendant of a ninja family (the Fuuma clan, though translations differ on the exact clan), who supposedly left when offered the place of becoming the head of the family and strike back at the Koga ninjas. His views on ninjas is that they should just hide in the flow of history, not be out in the open like Kuruwa suggests. He's seems to be pretty informed, even having knowledge of cases such as the Gemstones.   In SS2, after being caught by Yomikawa Aiho in an incident when he, Shiage, and Komaba robbed an ATM, he fell in love with her.

name: Eumenes
description:
An intelligent young boy from Cardia who has been troubled with a bad dream of a woman killing soldiers since childhood.



(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Philip 2-sei
description: The king of Macedonia. Introduced in the story claiming to be Antigonus,a merchant from Perinthus, coming to Cardia to look for Hieronymus (the Younger). First meets Eumenes outside the gates of Cardia. Impressed by the latter's performance in gaining entrance to the city, he impetuously asks Eumenes to come and work for him.

name: Barsine
description: She is the wife of Memnon(the governor of Troius). Is shown to be very intelligent since she saw through what Eumenes was making faster then Aristotle.

name: Aristotle
description: He was a Greek philosopher and polymath, a student of Plato and teacher of Alexander the Great.

name: Charon
description: A minor character in Historiē. He was introduced to be Eumenes' slave in Chapter 6: The Library Room (2), who accompanied him to the school.(Source: Historie Wiki)

name: Thrax
description: Thrax is a Scythian slave. He is the slave of Theogeiton, who appears several times while mistreating him. From what Theogeiton says, one can conclude that Thrax has only shortly been made a slave and is therefore not yet obedient.

name: Ron Kamonohashi
description: A talented detective and the student with the highest grades in Detective Training Academy BLUE's history. As his detective license was revoked after an incident five years ago, he has partnered up with [Totomaru Isshiki](https://anilist.co/character/193587/) to still be able to solve cases.

name: Totomaru Isshiki
description: Totomaru Isshiki, frequently shortened to Toto, is a police detective of the Metropolitan Police Department. He helps [Ron Kamonohashi](https://anilist.co/character/191539/) investigate cases by pretending to be the one who solves them.

name: Winter Moriarty
native: ウィンター・モリアーティ
description: Fourth child of the M. Family.

name: Mylo Moriarty
native: マイロ・モリアーティ
description: Current head child and first child of the M. Family.

name: Mofu Usaki
description: Mofu Usaki is world-renowned neurosurgeon who does surgeries on a microscopic scale and undertakes at least 800 surgeries a year. She also stars in the liveshow "Lie or Truth? ESP!!"

name: Amamiya
description: Amamiya is the leader of the First Investigative Division of the Metropolitan Police Department and Totomaru Isshiki's superior.

name: Spitz Fire
native: シュピッツ・ファイア
description: Tracking instructor at B.L.U.E

name: Finn Fennec
description:
The locked room instructor at BLUE and the world's expert on locked room studies.

She is one of the few people in the world who holds a S-rank detective license. With her "Phoenix touch" ability, she has found 5,000 hidden rooms, 3,000 illegal constructions, and 10,000 tricks of physics so far.

name: Douki-chan
description:
__Height:__ 156 cm
__Special Skill:__ Delusions

Works at a Tokyo company. Does her job with diligence; the company's rising star. However, she's quite inexperienced in love. She worries daily about how to approach Douki-kun, her love interest.

name: Douki-kun
description: The coworker of Douki-chan, Kouhai-chan, and Senpai-san, all of whom has romantic interest in him.

name: Kouhai-chan
description:
__Height:__ 159 cm
__Special Skill:__ Cosplay

A girl who's always giving off a comfortable vibe with her smiles. Junior to [Douki-chan](https://anilist.co/character/186587/Doukichan) in her department. Has large and powerful _assets_ that attracts men. Lots of men in the office want to get with her. Douki-chan has decided herself that she's her rival in love.

name: Senpai-san
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm
__Special Skill:__ Body movement

A woman who has a mature atmosphere. Was a senior to Douki-kun at his university and is currently a member of a company partnered with his. A free spirit that loves alcohol. [Douki-chan](https://anilist.co/character/186587/Doukichan) has decided herself that she's her rival in love.

name: Jung-Woo Hwang
description: Hwang Jung-Woo is the young lord of the Hwang Family and a powerful young martial artist, who in his previous life was renowned but feared as a martial god of the dark arts.

name: Seo-Yeon Hwang
description: She is the sister of Hwang Jung-Woo, and seems to have a brother complex. Her personality is very upbeat and giddy, but she is not to be underestimated. While seemingly naive, she is very mature for her age and she has reached a high cultivation level. She is very tomboyish and her girly side is mostly cultivated by the forceful pushes of her mother and maid servants. She is 3 years younger than the protagonist, and hold a very strong sense of justice.

name: Yeon-Ha Joo
description: She is the princess, daughter of Joo Yoon-Ho, the Emperor. Her personality seems to be very soft and gentle but her mind is deep and mature

name: Komichi Akebi
description:
Class 1-3, student number 1.

A girl who has a strong yearning for sailor uniforms due to a certain reason. She has a bright and straightforward personality, and is really looking forward to school life. She is very good at sports.

(Source: Official Site, Translated)

name: Ayumi Togeguchi
description:
Class 1-3, student number 10.

She is careful not to speak in a dialect. Because of this, she doesn't talk much in class. However, when she gets emotional, she sometimes can't stop herself.

(Source: Official Site, Translated)

name: Ai Tatsumori
description:
Class 1-3, student number 8.

A girl who aims to be the best at everything. She is the head of the school. She hates to lose and has a strong desire to improve.

(Source: Official Site, Translated)

name: Kei Tanigawa
description:
Class 1-3, student number 9.

She is a brilliant student who passed the entrance exam to the prestigious Shoume Gakuen. After meeting Komichi, she becomes interested in taking selfies.

(Source: Official Site, Translated)

name: Tomono Kojou
description:
Class 1-3, student number 6.

She has a quiet and gentle personality, and loves to read. She started talking to Komichi when she borrowed her handkerchief.

(Source: Official Site, Translated)

name: Riona Shijou
description:
Class 1-3, student number 7.

She had been learning hard tennis all her life until she started studying for her exams. She has a certain complex.

(Source: Official Site, Translated)

name: Touko Usagihara
description:
Class 1-3, student number 2.

She has good communication skills and a cheerful personality. She knows a lot of rumors about her classmates.

(Source: Official Site, Translated)

name: Riri Minakami
description:
Class 1-3, student number 13.

She is a good swimmer and speaks in a Kansai dialect. She doesn't talk much in class, but seems to be comfortable talking to Komichi.

(Source: Official Site, Translated)

name: Minoru Ookuma
description:
Class 1-3, student number 3.

Likes rational things and phenomena. She is especially fond of living things. Since coming to Robai Private Academy, she has been interested in Komichi.

(Source: Official Site, Translated)

name: Neko Kamimoku
description:
Class 1-3, student number 4.

She always looks sleepy and often dozes off in class, which the teacher often cautions her about.

(Source: Official Site, Translated)

name: Beniyutaka Shidare
description: Convenience store manager across the street from Shikada store.

name: Hajime Owari
description:
An intelligent woman who has trouble keeping a job due to her laziness and other personality quirks. 
She ends up working at Shikada Dagashi in exchange for room and board.

name: Makio Fujiyama
description:
__Height:__ 181 cm

Makio is the ace player for her school's volleyball team.

name: Yuki
description: Yuki is a former elite assassin who abandons her violent past and asks to be employed as a maid by high school student [Hitoyoshi Yokoya](https://anilist.co/character/321802/Hitoyoshi-Yokoya). Having been raised solely to kill, she possesses overwhelming combat ability—particularly with knives—but lacks basic experience in ordinary daily life. As she adjusts to her new role, she gradually learns about trust, warmth, and what it means to live peacefully.

name: Riko Yokoya
description: Hitoyoshi's younger sister.

name: Luca
description: He's an Imperial Guard trainee.

name: Heilas Kustoria
description: He is one of the most powerful soldiers of the Accretia Empire and holds the position of Captain of the Imperial Guard. He is also the head of the Kustoria family.

name: Kinuan
description: He's a martial arts instructor.

name: Jizel Kustoria
description: Daughter of Heilas Kustoria.

name: Ilay Kartika
description: He's from the same batch of cadets as Luca.

name: Grace
description: She's a member of La Vie en Rose. She was once a Royal Guard cadet as an Irregular from the Lower District, but dropped out midway.

name: Lillian Ramones
description: She's a little sister of one of the cadets that were in the same group as Luca.

name: Barbara
description: She's a dorm leader of the academy.

name: Gilda
description: She grew up in an orphanage. Kinuan has sponsored her studies after discovering her talent for mechanical engineering.

name: Danan LeBeau
description:
A member of the Hero's party with the sign of the 'Martial Artist', Danan is the singular weapons master of his generation and joined on assumption that this was the fastest route to the Demon Lord's defeat. While Gideon was in the party, Danan respected his skills as a strategist.

(Source: Official Site)

appearsIn.title: Banished from the Hero's Party, I Decided to Live a Quiet Life in the Countryside

name: Mido
description:
Nao's husband and Tanta's father, Mido is a human rather than a half-elf. He has given up adventuring for carpentry. While not a skilled craftsman as Gonzo, he is quick with numbers and works well as in a supporting role. Even Gonzo will speak his praises when he's not around to hear them.

(Source: Official Site)

appearsIn.title: Banished from the Hero's Party, I Decided to Live a Quiet Life in the Countryside

name: Azami
description:
First appeared in Shinigami Record. Presumed to be Shion's mother and Mary's grandmother. She is Medusa and her hair grows as snakes. Each of the snakes possesses a unique ability.   

Because she herself has an immortal body, she thinks of humans as, “dull creatures that die easily.” However, at one time, she fell in love with a young man who was the first human to not fear her, and created a family with him. Humans’ life spans are short, so fearing that she’d be alone again, Azami used the powers of the snakes to create a never-ending world.

name: Hiyori Asahina
description: First appeared in Heat-Haze Days. A girl that visits the city to take summer courses with Hibiya. For this reason, she came to stay at her sister’s house, and fell in love with Konoha in one day, who happened to be staying there as well. On August 15, she becomes involved in a certain incident with Hibiya. Her favorite animal is a cat.   (Source: Vocaloid Wikia)

name: Oscar François de Jarjayes
native: オスカル・フランソワ・ド・ジャルジェ
description:
Born the last of five daughters to the Commander of the Royal Guards, [General François Augustin Regnier de Jarjayes](https://anilist.co/character/8150/de-Jarjeyes-Regnier), she is raised by her father as if she were a boy in order to take his place and command the Royal Guards serving at Court after he retires. At the age of fourteen, as soon as her training in the basic military skills is complete, Oscar is given the task to protect the [Dauphine Marie Antoinette](https://anilist.co/character/1701/Antoinette-Marie) when she arrives at the French Court.

Despite being raised as if she were a boy and dressing in males' clothes, Oscar is open about being female. Even as she embraces her femininity, she uses her male position to gain freedoms that she could never have as a lady of the court.

name: André Grandier
native: アンドレ・グランディエ
description: The friend of Oscar and the grandson of her nanny, André and Oscar learned the arts of fencing and horsemanship together when they were children. As they grew up, Oscar became the Dauphine's guard and the class gap between them widened.   He has been described as a "true working-class hero" by Helen McCarthy.

name: Marie Antoinette
native: マリー・アントワネット
description:
Marie Antoinette married the Dauphin to seal the alliance between his grandfather Louis XV and her mother, Empress Maria Theresa of Austria, when she was 14. After her marriage, she realizes that Madame du Barry, King Louis XV's mistress, is against her. The princess, horrified by what she had heard about du Barry, decides to never speak to her. Meanwhile, she meets Count von Fersen, who becomes her lover.    

Madame du Barry, always plotting against Marie Antoinette and Oscar, fulfils her desire to be greeted by her. After the death of Louis XV, Madame du Barry is condemned to die. Marie Antoinette, after several conflicts with her husband, starts feeling lonely. Fersen, who had left France on Oscar's advice, returns. Rumors swirl about the Queen and the Count, and Fersen leaves again. A depressed Marie Antoinette befriends the Duchess de Polignac. Polignac leads Marie Antoinette to her downfall.    

Marie Antoinette is described as a "lively, silly girl of shoujo manga".

name: Hans Axel von Fersen
native: ハンス・アクセル・フォン・フェルゼン
description: A handsome Swedish aristocrat who comes to the court of Versailles and becomes involved in a forbidden romance with queen Marie Antoinette.  He was Oscar's best friend. It is revealed in the series that Oscar also has strong feelings for Fersen.

name: Rosalie Lamorliere
native: ロザリー・ラモリエール
description: Rosalie is the adoptive daughter of a commoner named Nicole Lamorlière. She is described as "a stereotypical good girl, sweet, obedient and timid". Her biological mother is the Duchess de Polignac, referred to as Martine Gabrielle. Nicole tells Rosalie the truth when she is dying after being hit by a carriage. Rosalie swears that she will kill the person in the carriage that killed her mother. She tries to kill Oscar's mother, Lady Jarjayes, because she thought Lady Jarjayes was in the carriage, but Oscar stops Rosalie. Oscar decides to help her, and she teaches Rosalie the art of fencing, manners, history, and other courtly skills. Rosalie comes to admire and love Oscar greatly.

name: Alain de Soisson
native: アラン・ド・ソワソン
description: Alain was the sergeant of the Company B, the troops assigned to Lady Oscar's service in the National Guard. He accepted Oscar at first, and even befriended André and smuggled him in the troops, but after learning the truth about her he violently rejected her leadership. Oscar had to fight him to win Alain and the group's respect back, since they refused to be ordered around by a noble. After losing to Oscar and begging her to save the life of a companion who was about to be executed, which she did, Alain forgave Oscar and became fiercely devoted to her, even falling in love with her in the manga; still, he knew he couldn't fight against her feelings for André.    (Source: wikipedia)

name: Bernard Chatelet
native: ベルナール・シャトレ
description: Newspaper reporter from Paris. Followed Robespierre like a shadow. (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Jeanne de la Motte
native: ジャンヌ・ヴァロア・ド・ラ・モット
description:
Jeanne Valois de la Motte, descendent of Valois family, daughter of Nicole Lamorlière and adoptive sister of Rosalie Lamorliere. While she grew up in poor conditions, Jeanne is aware that she is of noble birth. She eventually grew tired of living in horrible conditions and was able to work her way into the home of a wealthy woman who was aware of Jeanne's noble family.

While she gained pity from Marie Antoinette, the money she gave Jeanne, according to her, was not enough for her lifestyle. Finally at her breaking point, Jeanne decides that she actually wants to become queen of France and plotted to frame Marie Antoinette, when she finds out about the diamond necklace that the late king was making for Madame du Barry was finally finished, that's when she devised a plot that would become the most famous crime in French history, the Affair of the Diamond Necklace.

name: Bocchi Hitori
description:
__Height:__ 145 cm (4'9")

Hitori Bocchi (meaning "all alone"), is shy and has extreme social anxiety. A kind person and clumsy at times. She cries frequently, her legs cramp when she gets nervous, and she faints from happiness and excitement. It's challenging for her to talk with new people. Bocchi, however, wants to be able to have fun interacting with friends. She does everyday things in quirky ways, doing things like making scripts for daily conversations, only for it to fail. Her favorite food is rice with natto (finely crushed).

name: Nako Sunao
description: The first friend Bocchi makes upon entering middle school. She has a tough appearance but is actually kind and supportive of Bocchi. Her name is derived from sunao na ko (素直な子, "honest child").

name: Kako Kurai
description: The public morals officer in Bocchi's school. Her name is derived from kurai kako (暗い過去, "dark past").(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Aru Honshou
description: The vice representative in [Bocchi](https://anilist.co/character/128986)'s class. She often puts on an appearance to hide the fact that she is actually somewhat of a loser. Her name is derived from honshou aru (本性ある, "having a true nature").

name: Sotoka Rakita
description: [Bocchi's](https://anilist.co/character/128986/Hitori-Bocchi) classmate who comes from another country and considers herself to be a ninja. Her name is derived from soto kara kita ("came from outside").

name: Ino Kawai
description: The homeroom leader of Bocchi's class. Her name is derived from kawaii no (かわいいの, "the cute one").

name: Peko Onaka
description: Bocchi's classmate who loves sweets. Her name is derived from onaka pekopeko (お腹ペコペコ, "very hungry").

name: Hanako Yamada
description: Bocchi's classmate who is a member of the school tennis club.

name: Ito Kurie
description: Bocchi's classmate who is student librarian. She is shy same as Bocchi. Her name is derived from kurieito (クリエイト, "create").

name: Mayo Ojousa
description: Bocchi's classmate who comes from a rich family.

name: Beatrice Redden
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm (5'2")

A classic Yandere, therefore she is stronger and more skilled than most girls. Bibi exhibits psychopathic traits, is bubbly and clingy and considers most people to be beneath her.

name: Amelia Park Lee
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm (5'2")

A student with a timid personality.

name: Camilla Connor
description: A softie despite her tough exterior.

name: Joy Park
description: Amy's aunt who she lives with. She works at a publishing firm in the next town over.

name: Peter Dales
description: Peter is the most popular guy in school who Bibi has a crush on. He's an extremely outgoing and friendly people-person.

name: Nana Nekota
description: Nana is one of Camilla's friends. She is Jean's cousin.

name: Gabriella Robinson
description: Gabriella is one of Camilla's friends.

name: Jean Mayday
description: Jean is one of Camilla's friends. She is Nana's cousin.

name: Sophia Connor
description: Camilla's mother.

name: Nanami Takahashi
description:
__Height:__ 155cm

Also known as Nana-chan is a girl who confesses her love too easily, pretty clumsy, and looks very cute. She takes a while to sort out her feelings, and is confused by what her heart tells her and what she knows to do. At the beginning of the anime, she decides that she will not become a lovestruck idiot over Yano like two thirds of the school, and fails as she becomes more and more curious of him.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Masafumi Takeuchi
description:
__Height:__ 178cm

One of Yano's close friends. Unlike Yano, he's kind and considerate, and tends to offer advice to Nana when she's having problems with Yano. Take slowly relives his unmistakable feelings for he once loved Yano's girlfriend, and begins to do so with Nana as well.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Motoharu Yano
description:
**Height:** 174 cm  

A popular boy at his school, and most girls have a crush on him. He is an extreme flirt, and he mainly thinks about perverted things.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Yuri Yamamoto
description:
__Height:__ 158cm

Yuri Yamamoto is the younger sister of Nana, Yano's late girlfriend. She is a quiet person, and very unsociable.

name: Nana Yamamoto
description:
**Height:** 161cm

Nana Yamamoto is the older sister of [Yuri Yamamoto](https://anilist.co/character/1166/Yuri-Yamamoto) and [Motoharu Yano](https://anilist.co/character/413/Motoharu-Yano)'s first girlfriend. She is the exact opposite of Yuri and has a similar personality to [Nanami](https://anilist.co/character/1164/Nanami-Takahashi). She is called Nana-san by most people to distinguish her from Takahashi Nanami. She dies in a car crash with her ex-boyfriend a year before the series takes place.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Taka-chan
description: Taka-chan is one of Nanami's best girlfriend together with Mizu-chin.

name: Akiko Sengenji
description: Birthday: 28th September  Akiko Sengenji became Yano's classmate when he transferred school in Tokyo from Hokkaido leaving Nanami behind. She had grown feelings for Yano even though Aki-chan knows that Yano loves Nanami, and he just sees her as a friend.

name: Astraea
description:
__Height__: 159cm 
__Species__: Angeloid  

Introduced as the "Delta Angeloid: Close Combat Type". She is something of an airhead and has limited intelligence, due to having low processing power to be able to have high combat abilities and emotions. She weighs 48 kilograms, stands at 159cm, and her wing type is stated to be "Not Variable" and "Super Acceleration".   Astraea has been described as having greater battle capabilities than Ikaros, and possesses two equipments: the super-oscillating photon blade 'Chrysaor', and a shield said to surpass the defensive power of Ikaros' 'Aegis', 'Aegis L'. However, unlike 'Aegis', 'Aegis L' is unable to cover every angle possible, only being able to block certain directions at a time, and it covers about half the area of 'Aegis' in terms of angles. Astraea's weak point is that she was made entirely for close-combat, and thus is extremely disadvantaged against opponents with long-range weapons or attacks, as she has no ranged attacks whatsoever.

name: Man of Judas
description: Called "ZERO = Mascchettiano" or "That guy/man" in Sora no Otoshimono he is an internationally wanted, Class-S criminal with a whopping $9.9 billion on his head. He's killed 20,000 people in three years. And he's been apprended zero times.  He is just reffered as "That guy" or "pigeon guy" by Sakurai Tomoki and he always appears in summer when there is a festival, were he always has one prepared already with the name of "JUDAS" at the top. He is always shown with pigeons reffering how he is introduced in the JUDAS manga (a big cluster of pigeons over him).  Also he likes to torture Tomoki with the president and he always ruins Tomoki's attempts to win a prize in any of the hosted tournaments.

name: Yoshitsune Hououin
description: Tsukino's brother and student of the prestigious Sorami Private Academy (a school for the rich and a neighbor to Sorami Junior High school). Like his sister, he is arrogant and is usually delivering sarcastic remarks regarding Sorami Junior students. He is a skilled violinist.

name: Seiren
description: Seiren is an "Underwater Combat Angeloid, Type Eta" built by the man of Synapse that appeared in chapter 45 of the manga. Her appearance in the manga was brief, as she was impaled in the back by one of Chaos' wings before being devoured and absorbed by her just after she was ordered by the man of Synapse to kill Tomoki and Ikaros. Her appearance is based on the sirens of Greek mythlology.

name: Hiyori Kazane
description: Hiyori is introduced as a second-year student at Tomoki's school. She has feelings for Tomoki and joins the New Continent Discovery Club just to get closer to him.

name: Remilia Graupner
native: レミリア・ローゼ・グラウプナー
description:
The villainess's body has two souls: *Emi Kobayashi* & *Remilia Rose Graupner*. Because of Emi Kobayashi's knowledge of the game world of 「The Star Maiden And The Knight of Salvation」she changes the course of Remilia's life and establishes wonderful reputation for her as the duke's daughter.

The true Remilia was perfectly content to watch Emi live a happy life for the sake of both of them. However, when [Pina](https://anilist.co/character/306778/Blanche-Pina) undoes all of Emi's work, Remilia's soul reclaims control of her body in order to exact revenge.

name: Pina Blanche
description: The original main character of an otome game who is destined to save the world from the demon king and the villainess Remilia with help from her friends Willard, Claude, David, and others.

name: Angel
description: The demon king who makes a deal with the villainess [Remilia](https://anilist.co/character/285802/Graupner-Remilia).

name: Hiiro Okamura
description:
Height: 180 cm (5'11")
Race: Humas (Human)
Hiiro is one of the 5 people from Earth who were transported to Edea by the First Princess Lilith.

He is extremely smart and logical, but he only cares for himself, and only does things if offered a reward, or if it would benefit him in some way, even when an innocent person's life is on the line. Hiiro doesn't care about the different races, and is one of the few people (if not the only person) who doesn't discriminate between them. He also has a great love of books, as well as the food that is in Edea.




(Source: MAL)

appearsIn.title: Konjiki no Word Master: Yuusha Yonin ni Makikomareta Unique Cheat

description: She is one of the four heroes summoned to Edea to save the Humas from the threat of the Evila.

native: ミュア・カストレイア

A young Gabranth who thinks of Hiiro as an older brother.



(Source: Konjiki no Word Master Wikia)

description: She is one of the four heroes summoned to Edea to save the Humans from extinction at the hands of the Evila.

appearsIn.title: Konjiki no Word Master: Yuusha Yonin ni Makikomareta Unique Cheat

name: Arnold Ocean
native: アノールド・オーシャン
description:
Arnold was a victim of slavery. His ears, the pride of a beastman, had been taken away eternally just because his master happened to be in a bad mood. He was able to rid of the magic lock crest and fled and had someone that knew about the cruel treatment of slaves kill his master. With the death of his master, Arnold officially became free. After he got his freedom, he became a travelling cook.

Arnold was under Rarashik's tutelage after Judom forced her to.

(Source: Konjiki no Word Master Wikia)

appearsIn.title: Konjiki no Word Master: Yuusha Yonin ni Makikomareta Unique Cheat

name: Taishi Aoyama
description:
A student summoned to be a hero. Taishi has long brown-dyed hair, an earnest expression, and a gentle aura. He is tall and handsome so he is overwhelmingly popular with the girls.

(Source: Konjiki no Word Master Wikia)

appearsIn.title: Konjiki no Word Master: Yuusha Yonin ni Makikomareta Unique Cheat

name: Shuri Minamoto
description: She is one of the heroes summoned to Edea to protect the Humas. She trained hard to become a hero and save people.

appearsIn.title: Konjiki no Word Master: Yuusha Yonin ni Makikomareta Unique Cheat

description: She is a well known young adventurer on the Humas Continent.

appearsIn.title: Konjiki no Word Master: Yuusha Yonin ni Makikomareta Unique Cheat

description:
**Height:** 167cm

She is the current Demon Lord of Xaos.

appearsIn.title: Konjiki no Word Master: Yuusha Yonin ni Makikomareta Unique Cheat

name: Liliyn Redrose
description: She is strong enough to make a dragon shake in fear.

appearsIn.title: Konjiki no Word Master: Yuusha Yonin ni Makikomareta Unique Cheat

name: Tarou Jimi
description: The homeroom teacher of Class 1-A. A man completely dedicated to being a teacher and fulfilling a teacher's duties, nothing more.

name: Nagisa Ootsuki
description:
Mashiro, who sits next to her, bothers her in a number of ways, and in order to improve herself, she pushes herself to confront Mashiro and "like" her.

She had previously been unable to make it in time for her preferred school's entrance exam after helping a girl (Mashiro) who had collapsed, so she took an exam for a nearby private high school instead and enrolled there. When she reached high school, she changed her hairstyle and switched from glasses to contact lenses. 
Her family consists of her parents, younger brother, and two younger sisters.

name: Mashiro Komiyama
description:
Her personality is bright and friendly, yet she is a frail person who needs to rest in the infirmary whenever she feels ill. She isn't particularly good at studying. 
She knows that people are worried about her health and she does her best to handle things on her own despite having a weak body. Her parents are her only family members.

name: Mizuki Nanjou
description: She is the student council president. She is in love with the school nurse and sees Nagisa and Mashiro's connection when she first met them in the school infirmary. She provides Nagisa helpful advice based on her own love life.

name: Riri Kuori
description: She is the vice president of the student council. She is in love with Mizuki Nanjo, the student council president, but she has problems convincing Mizuki, who is in love with the school nurse, to accept her feelings; as a result, she can occasionally come on to Mizuki too hard.

name: Ami Uda
description: Nagisa and Mashiro's classmate. She has an outgoing and outspoken personality. Nagisa and her friends refer to her as Uda-chan, whereas Uda refers to Nagisa as "Naginagi" and Mashiro as "Mashirochi". She dresses casually for school. The vice president of the student council, Riri Kuori, and her are close friends.

name: Akari Hayama
description: She's the school nurse. She is normally a cool person, yet she is always willing to support students that ask for for help. Mizuki's feelings for her extend beyond the teacher-student relationship.

name: Shizuku Ootsuki
description: Nagisa's little sister. She dearly loves her older sister Nagisa, and when she first met Mashiro, she and Saki competed to determine who was closer to Nagisa.

name: Saki Ootsuki
description: Nagisa's little sister. She dearly loves her elder sister Nagisa, and when she first met Mashiro, she and Shizuku competed to determine who was closer to Nagisa.

name: Yuka
description: Nagisa's cousin. She thinks Nagisa is a very different person now than she was before.

name: Cárcel Escalante de Esposa
aliases: 卡賽爾・埃斯卡蘭特・德・艾斯波沙
description:
__Height:__ 192 cm (6'3")

- Spends the next decade and a half avoiding the marriage at all costs!
- Thinks that [Inés](https://anilist.co/character/289711/Valeztena-de-Perez-Ins) is in love with him

appearsIn.title: The Broken Ring: This Marriage Will Fail Anyway

name: Inés Valeztena de Perez
aliases: 伊尼絲．瓦萊斯特納．德．貝雷茲
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7")

- Belongs to one of the highest-ranking families in the "Grandes de Ortega."
- She settled for the heir to [Duke Escalante](https://anilist.co/character/289710/Escalante-de-Esposa-Crcel) solely because he was the most handsome
- Always has a bored, uninterested look on her face

appearsIn.title: The Broken Ring: This Marriage Will Fail Anyway

name: Shizuka Kusunoki
description:
__Height:__ 153cm

A classmate who attended the same junior high school as Shizuki. Although she was a quiet, unassuming girl back then, she successfully reinvented her image upon entering high school and now attracts attention as the most beautiful girl in her grade. 

In reality, she struggles with conversation and making friends, but she is trying to change and adopt a more positive outlook.

appearsIn.title: Kusunoki’s Flunking Her High School Glow-Up

name: Keisuke Shizuki
description:
__Height:__ 170cm 

A high school boy who worked on improving himself after a heartbreak in junior high and successfully reinvented his image upon entering high school. 

Although he aims for a peaceful school life, his inability to ignore people in need often lands him in troublesome situations. Due to the trauma of his past heartbreak, he feels physically unwell whenever he makes eye contact with a beautiful girl.

name: Kazutaka Hyoudou
description: Wealthy socialite and president of the powerful financial consulting firm "Love Emperor", not to mention owner and sponsor of underground gambling tournaments like those onboard Espoir. Hyōdō Kazutaka is believed to be seventy years old and worth several hundred billion yen. Driven mad by wealth, conventional hobbies fail to entertain him, so he funds gambling tournaments to watch the destitute of society struggle against overwhelming terror and despair.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Lilith
description:
One day, a suspicious maid suddenly appeared in front of Yuuri. Characterized by her jet-black hair, tan skin, and piercing purple eyes. She is very suspicious to Yuuri because she doesn't like to talk about herself very much and she tends to keep things secret.

(Source: Official Site)

name: Satoru Furuya
description: Furuya is a right-handed power pitcher who throws a fastball and forkball. His main objective is to improve his stamina and control. [Eijun Sawamura](https://anilist.co/character/22998/Sawamura-Eijun) is his rival.

name: Haruichi Kominato
description: A first-year second baseman of the team, Haruichi is a naturally talented, all-rounder baseball player. Despite his small stature and frail appearance, he has pinpoint precision while batting the ball, able to hit it as wide and as far as he pleases, and control where the ball lands. He also is extremely talented at defense, able to catch a ball in the air and throw it while still floating. He is often noted to have amazing baseball sense, able to decide in a split second where to hit the ball, what to watch for, and when to steal. His ability in baseball exceeds his older brother’s, Ryousuke Kominato, who is first-string player and also a second baseman. The only thing lacking is his stamina, which he works hard on improving.

name: Kazuya Miyuki
description:
__Height:__ 179 cm (5'10")
__Position:__ Catcher
__Bats:__ Left
__Throws:__ Right

Miyuki Kazuya is a second year student of Seidou High School and the best catcher of the baseball team. He was already a noted catcher on his first year and nationally known for his skills. Miyuki was scouted by [Rei](https://anilist.co/character/89415/Takashima-Rei) when he was still a first year on his Junior High.

name: Eijun Sawamura
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm (5'9'')

Eijun Sawamura comes from the prefecture of Nagano where he played baseball at Akagi Junior High. After their last match, he was scouted by [Takashima Rei](https://anilist.co/character/89415/Takashima-Rei) that decided his new journey being a first-year high school student of Seidou High School in Tokyo. He is a left-handed southpaw relief pitcher who throws with his feelings and is never ashamed to show everyone what is on his mind. For his teammates, he is known for being hotheaded and loudmouthed person that usually comes off as obnoxious, but they often get inspired by his strong will and unwavering spirit in crucial situations.

name: Norifumi Kawakami
description: A second year in Seidou High School and a reserve ace pitcher of Seidou baseball team in the first string. Kawakami is a sidearm pitcher with an excellent control.

name: Rei Takashima
description: She is the Assistant Director of Seidou High's baseball team. She scouted Eijun and invited him to the Seidou Baseball Team.

name: Tesshin Kataoka
description: Kataoka Tesshin is known as a strict coach, but he also praises his players and says reassuring things to them from time to time. Everything he does is for the benefit of the team, and he spares no effort in doing so. If he wants his players to make a significant step forward, he himself takes part in training.

name: Wataru Kariba
description: A first year student of Seidou High and a catcher of the second string team.

name: Naoyuki Zaizen
description: Chris' rival from junior high. His teammates appear to have a lot of respect for him

name: Goldou Kinmekki
native: ゴルドー・キンメッキ
description: A swordsman who participated in the God of War Tournament.

name: Lambda
description: Member of Shadow Garden, and one of The Numbers (No. 11). She is in charge of training new recruits.

name: Claudia
description: An elite staff member of the Magic Swordsmen Association who becomes the leader of Association's task force.

name: Toki Ninomae
description:
__Height:__ 183cm (6')

Toki Ninomae is the vice president of the class committee. He is well-liked by his classmates and is considered very handsome.

appearsIn.title: Fall in Love, You False Angels

name: Otogi Katsura
description: Otogi Katsura is the president of the class committee and is known as the school's "perfect beauty."

appearsIn.title: Fall in Love, You False Angels
