appearsIn.title: Fall in Love, You False Angels

name: Miko Sonoda
description:
__Height__: 159cm (5'2.6")

Sonoda Miko is a high school student who, due to unknown reasons, moves in with her uncle, not knowing that he runs a boarding house. Miko appears to be a girly-girl who also has cooking skills, though she makes curry almost every day.

name: Jun Matsunaga
description:
__Height__: 180cm (5'10.9")

Matsunaga is a designer who is a resident of a boarding house that is owned by Miko's uncle. Matsunaga appears to have anger management issues as he takes out his anger toward other people and objects a lot. Despite his hotheadedness,​ he is shown to be tender and caring toward the people he cares about, especially toward Miko.

name: Ryou Houjou
description:
__Height__: 175cm (5'8.9")

He is one of the tenants of the shared house. He is a quiet college student who does not have a girlfriend. He likes sweets and dislikes high school girls.

name: Kentarou Suzuki
description:
__Height__: 172cm (5'7.7")

One of the tenants of the shared house. He is a bar-tender who loves alcohol, women, and games. He hates sweets.

name: Natsumi Kobayashi
description: She is one of the former tenants of the shared house. She dated Matsunaga for a short while but they broke up. She still likes him. She's now Miko's homeroom teacher.

name: Asako Onuki
description:
__Height__: 169cm (5'6.5")

One of the tenants of the shared house. She's a nail artist and is like a big sister. She is bad at cooking.

name: Akane Hattori
description:
__Height__: 156cm (5'1.4")

She's one of the tenants of the shared house. She's an enigma. She also has a boyfriend. She is good at dancing and loves eating.

name: Ricchan
description: One of Miko her schoolfriends

name: Maho
description: One of Miko her schoolfriends

name: Harumichi Bouya
description: In essence, Harumichi Bouya is a lone wolf that is shy; however, he will always help his friends, and through the many battles he wins, he gains even more. His non-brawling days consist of him chasing girls, dreaming of girls while sleeping, or having fun with his friends. Harumichi attended Suzuran High School, a school notorious for its' amount of delinquents. At Suzuran, Harumichi Bouya once stood at the top of the food chain and is known as one of the The Four Kings of his generation for his fighting prowess.

name: Yasuo Yasuda
description: A pretty average kid who some how ended up at Suzuran even though he doesn't like fighting and often gets picked on.  He ended up becoming Bouya first underling and friend after Bouya saves his skin, because he became enamoured with a picture of Yasu's sister.

name: Megumi Hayashida
description: Regarded as the strongest man in Suruzan history, Rindaman goes to Suzuran High with Bouya. He is known for being taciturn and aloof, but Bouya brings out a more emotional side in him. Rindaman is positively huge - even a head higher than his peers - and is feared by all. He skips school for work more often than not, and so he is a rare sight around Suzuran; but that doesn't hurt his reputation.

name: Hiromi Kirishima
description: Part of the trio that make up anti-Bandou faction at Suzuran.  He seems to be a bit smarter then the average Suzuran student and often has plans, and like to psychoanalyze others.

name: Toshiaki Honjou
description: Part of the trio that make up anti-Bandou faction at Suzuran.

name: Makoto Sugihara
description: Part of the trio that make up anti-Bandou faction at Suzuran.  Normally he doesn't speak at all but Bouya often makes him angry and he becomes quite talkative.  The Godfather Trilogy are his favorite movies.

name: Gunji Iwashiro
description: Senior at Suzuran in Hana's first year, and the leader of the Iwashiro Faction. Very calm and cool-headed. He and Yonezaki can be said to be the foils to Zetton, Hideyoshi and Masa's loud personalities. Remained in the city to continue the family business.

name: Saburou Hanazawa
description: A lone wolf, and the strongest senior of Suzuran in Hana's first year. A pervert and a happy-go-lucky kind of guy. Was a senior who supported Hana. Currently studying to become a teacher, planning on returning to Suzuran as one.  Zetton is one of the 4 apostles. (Zetton, King Joe, Kosei Nakajima and Takeda).

name: Hideyoshi Katou
description: Senior at Suzuran in Hana's first year, and the leader of the Hideyoshi Faction. Proud and brash, seems to have luck with the ladies, a fact that the other seniors are not very happy about. Nicknamed Mad Dog. Left for Tokyo when he graduated, along with Masa.

name: Maruyama Kenichi
description: One of two brothers from Kurosaki Industrial.  They like to get crazy hair cuts, wear flashy clothes, and joke around.  Don't underestimate them though, together they rule their school and are part of the Kurotaki Alliance with Bulldog.

name: Satsuki Kitaouji
description: Athletic and energetic, she loves to be seen with Manaka and is the most confident in her love for him. Completely open with her feelings and not afraid to show her thoughts (or her body for that matter), Kitaouji stands out because of her alluring body. She is a G-cup (the running joke is that her breasts are so big, they weigh her down) and her blouses occasionally pop open when she is emotional. Manaka and Kitaouji have a lot in common (including their tastes in TV shows and manga and their academic records) to the point that Manaka even said that if she were a guy, she would be the boss and he would be her most loyal friend. If any of the girls could be labeled as a tragic figure, it would be Kitaouji; despite her total devotion and physical, almost forceful, advances, Manaka constantly rejects her. His rejections crush her to a moving degree. At the end of the manga, she becomes the hostess of a relation's restaurant. Associated with the North ("Kita").

name: Junpei Manaka
description: The main character in the story. An overall nice guy attending middle (and later high) school who gets caught up in many embarrassing but endearing romantic situations. Although his thoughts on girls can get quite perverted on occasion, his gentleness and kindness, as well as his selflessness at times, is what attracts girls to him. His dream is to make films as a director. While not academically gifted, he has great talent with cinematography that gradually develops as the story progresses.

name: Yui Minamito
description: A neighbor and childhood friend of Manaka until she moved away to the countryside. Only one year younger than Manaka, she is very much like a younger sister to him. She has a very strict father. She is fond of chocolates and cake, and has a bad habit of sleeping naked. As a fellow student of Oumi Academy, she looks up to Nishino as a role model, and is infatuated with Okusa. In her second year of high school, after an argument with her father over her living with Manaka and his family, she decides to live in an apartment on her own even though she still has trouble cooking for herself. She still prefers to sleep in Manaka's bed when given the chance. Associated with the South ("Minami").

name: Tsukasa Nishino
description: Her idol-caliber face, fair hair, and straightforward personality make her very popular at school. With her looks, she attracts literally dozens of admirers but turns down each and every one. Flighty and hot-tempered at the start of the manga, she develops a far more mature attitude after entering Oumi Academy.

name: Aya Toujou
description: Reserved and timid almost to a fault, Toujou is the mystery girl Manaka has been seeking out (the girl with the strawberry panties). She excels in studies but is not very noticed at her middle school because of her large glasses and unattractive hairstyle. Her beauty was only brought out after she started wearing contact lenses and letting her hair down. Her career goal is to become a novelist. A gifted writer, she manages to win several prestigious awards for her compositions despite her youth. She is also the script writer for the movies of the Film Studies Club, and was the first person Manaka shared his dreams with. During the final school festival, she was considered by the Astrological Research Club's "Love Sanctuary" attraction to be the best person suited for Manaka. Associated with the East ("Tou").

name: Amachi
description: A true ladies' man, Amachi is the perfect gentleman, with a face to match. He is Manaka's rival for Tojo's affections, although he does not pose too much of a threat (It's apparent that she prefers Manaka). Like Okusa, Amachi has herds of girls flocking to him, and he seems to have a compulsive necessity in helping women in need. After meeting staunch resistance to his approaches on Tojo, Amachi gives up his horde of girls as a sign of devotion to Tojo, but later returns to them after news breaks out that Tojo is not going with Manaka or him to the final school festival. Amachi once challenged Manaka to a swimming race, (which he won of course) but Tojo dived into the water to save Manaka from drowning from exhaustion, despite the fact she could not swim. After seeing Tojo in her swimsuit, He had a nosebleed (comically) that was so bad, that Manaka had to walk her home instead of him. He also managed to recognize Tojo even with her hair braided and glasses on.    Found @ Wikipedia

name: Rikiya Komiyama
description: Close friend of Manaka since middle school, frequently made fun of because of his peculiar, octopus-like looks and his desperation in finding a girlfriend.

name: Shiori Kurokawa
description: Manaka's math teacher and advisor to the Film Club. Beautiful and a frequent drinker, she is the classic irresponsible adult archetype, tending to spend the prize money of the Film Studies Club on frivolous pursuits like visits to the salon. Despite this, she is quite supportive of the club, being one of the original founding members and the main female protagonist in the club movie that inspired Manaka to push through with his directorial dreams.

name: Kozue Mukai
description: A student in the cram school Manaka and Toujou attend during their second year of high school. Although she has an attractive body, she has a chronic fear of males, freezing up and even cowering in terror in their presence. Ironically, she also tends to have very vivid romantic fantasies with those she fears. She quickly falls in love with Manaka, the first boy she feels comfortable enough to talk to. She appears to be an extreme version of Toujo; she is far more shy and reserved, and falls over just as often.

name: Misuzu Sotomura
description: Tough and pretty younger sister of Hiroshi. A no-nonsense person, Misuzu installs herself as vice-president and assistant director of the Film Studies Club. One of the few female characters in the story who does not fall for Manaka; she can not stand his indecisiveness with women. When they first met she found Manaka interesting because he was critical about movies. She plays down Manaka's role in the club, but later admits (to herself) that Manaka's accomplishment in building the club from scratch is truly remarkable whereas she is just "all-talk". Idolizes Toujo for her writing ability.

name: Libertia Rham Triel
description: Princess Libertia is part of the Vance family. She is the daughter of the notorious villainess, Lisian Vance. She suffers from an incurable illness called "Raphaelis", an illness that directly affects the soul.

A straightforward and refreshing newcomer to the PR department. His natural friendliness brings out the awkward kindness in his supervisor, Kannawa. A hobby of his is collecting Plastic Figure models.

name: Azusa Kannawa
description:
__Height:__ 163 cm
__Birthplace:__ Ooita Prefecture

Azusa is cool and competent but clumsy. She is easily misunderstood, but is actually sensitive and compassionate, and is sincere in her approach to both her work and her junior staff. A hobby of hers is gaming.

name: Miho Hotta
description:
__Height:__ 163 cm
__Birthplace:__ Chiba Prefecture

 A member of the PR department and a classmate of Kamegawa. She is cheerful, sociable, and caring. Her hobbies include sewing and walking.

name: Ritsu Kankaiji
description:
__Height:__ 183cm
__Birthplace:__ Tokyo

She is in the planning department and is a colleague of Kannawa. One of her hobbies is playing basketball.

description: Etoile is the main protagonist of the original story of the book.

description: She is the maid of Ripley.

appearsIn.title: The First Night With the Duke

description: She's the daughter of Ripley and Zeronis and the twin sister of Henry.

name: Yunifer Magnolia
description: A woman who suddenly found herself in the body of Yunifer, the villainess of the original novel. She's a water mage who works at a clinic.

name: Ishid Lucrenze
description: Captain of the Order of the White Night and Archduke of Lucrenze. He owns the heavenly sword Ciergo and is one of the five fire mages currently alive. He is also known as the Knight of the Crimson Flame.

name: Raelle Carnia
description: Raelle is a powerful water mage and the heroine of the original novel.

name: Cassian Rovattia
description: Cassian is the crown prince of Rovattia and is Raelle's ex. He was raised alongside of Ishid.

name: Frau Magnolia
description: Count Frau Magnolia is Yunifer's father.

name: Raya
description: Raya is Ishid's bird. She's highly intelligent, and she's still growing.

name: Michael Sonoff
description: Michael is a young count and a wind mage. While attending the academy, he ousted his father and became count at the age of 19. He graduated at the top of his class.

name: Martha
description: Martha is Yunifer's coworker at the clinic.

name: Conrad
description: Conrad is a member of the Order of the White Night.

name: Rosie
description: Rosie is Yunifer's maid.

name: Junpei Takeda
description:
Takeda Junpei is a high school student that lives his days being bullied by Shouta Kido and saved by his childhood friend Tatsumiya Noriko. But one day, they’re all summoned by “God,” who cruelly claims that he’s going to relieve his boredom by sending them to a dangerous world of fantasy.

Each of them is given a “job” and stats, and while Kido’s are amazing, Junpei is but a jobless weakling. With that, they begin new lives, but Junpei is soon betrayed and sacrificed to a labyrinth full of abnormal monsters. Now seething with anger, he fights tooth and nail to escape the labyrinth for revenge.

name: Yuki-onna
description: She has an appearance of a very beautiful woman with a smooth, white complexion, fitting her Snowy profile. She has long hair with a mix color of black and white. She often wears a white kimono. She really cares about [Masayuki Muroi](https://anilist.co/character/266166), who she thinks is too kind for a human.

name: Tae Shimai
description: An old woman who lives with a ghost cat in a small port town. Although she is over eighty, she is in good health and is relied on by the townspeople.

name: Sera Himeura
description: She is an otaku with no friends who enjoys anime and manga as well as being a hero, trying to save the world.

name: Kokage Fujinami
description: She is a tsundere street kid. She sells drugs for free.

name: Yume Furusuna
description:
__Occupation:__ Student (former)
__Height:__ 153 cm
__Weight:__ 48 kg
__Affiliation:__Asami Elementary School
__Hobbies:__ Stalking, going to the library

Yume Furusuna is the instant bullet of "Time", and one of the main characters of Instant Bullet.

A master of faking smiles. She carries a gun, and has the means to have herself instantly admitted to a high-level university. Because Kuro, Moroki and Kokage gave her the "reason for existing" that she had lacked since she was a child, she harbors feelings of affection for them. Everything she does is for Kuro Fukase's sake, but the strain in her mind caused by her experiences as a child, the limits placed on her visions of the future, and her role as the Witch are clear for anyone to see.

name: Kuro Fukase
description: He is a very pessimistic person with no friends who wishes the world would just be destroyed.

name: Toiro Ayakura
description: An old neighbor and childhood friend of Kuro. The catalyst of Kuro's cynicism. Iroha's older sister.

name: Iroha Ayakura
description: Little sister of Toiro, old neighbor and childhood friend of Kuro.

name: Ochiai-san
description:
Ochiai-san is a woman in her late 20s, a few years older than Sawatari-kun. She is a divorced woman who has suffered from psychological abuse in her previous marriage, which has left her with trust issues and a shy, crying nature. Despite her past trauma, Ochiai-san is an excellent cook, but she never takes pride in her culinary skills. She has long hair that she is unable to change, her hair color to come back quickly. 

She works at local supermarket.

As a neighbor of Sawatari-kun, Ochiai-san had never received compliments or praise until she met him. She found it hard to believe that someone like Sawatari-kun could genuinely be nice to her, but over time, she begins to trust him. Through their interactions, Ochiai-san slowly learns to overcome her past trauma and eventually falls in love with Sawatari-kun.

Because of her traumas, she is not confident enough to make first move to confess to Sawatari-kun, but Yuika-chan is here to help.

name: Sawatari-kun
description: A kind person who lives next door to Ochiai-san.

name: Yuika-chan
description: Sawatari-kun’s younger sister. Loves talking about romance.

name: Asa Asada
description: Asa, a little girl living in the Port of Nagoya alongside her parents and her eleven siblings (with a twelfth about to come) is commonly forgotten by her own family, mistaken with her sisters by neighbours, and feels like she doesn't have an identity of her own. She blames it to her name being the dullest of the family, since the only reason for it was being born early in the morning. The day her twelfth sibling is about to be born, she is kidnapped for being mistaken with a doctor's child as Isewan Typhoon destroys her beloved town. The kidnapper, Kasuga, regrets his actions and protects Asa from the disaster. With most of the city flooded and filled with debris, and the wellbeing of the Asada family unknown, she now has to work with Kasuga which happens to be an ex-bomber pilot from World War II to rescue citizens and find her family, as she ignites her passion for piloting and, for the first time, wants something for herself.

name: Kasuga
description: Former Air Force soldier who will teach Asa to fly in an airplane

name: Shouta Hayata
description: Asa's childhood friend. He's one year older than Asa. He comes from a family of runners and trains to qualify for the 1964 Olympic marathon team.

name: Minoru Jissouji
description: Former instructor at a gunnery school in Yokosuka during the war. Kasuga attended some of his lectures while serving in the Imperial Japanese Army Air Service.

name: Jun Suzuki
description:
**Role:** Bassist
**Instrument:** Bass Guitar

Jun is [Azusa](https://anilist.co/character/21173/Azusa-Nakano)'s and [Ui](https://anilist.co/character/19571/Ui-Hirasawa)'s classmate who often hangs out with the latter. Jun is generally a playful and easygoing girl, but she is sometimes rude without realizing it, compelling [Azusa](https://anilist.co/character/21173/Azusa-Nakano) to reprimand her. [Ui](https://anilist.co/character/19571/Ui-Hirasawa) tries to get her to join the light music club but ultimately fails due to a strange visit to the club room. However, she starts to regret it when she hears about all the activities the club does. She has a pet cat and plays the bass. 

Jun has an older brother, Atsushi Suzuki, nicknamed Acchan by her. He plays the bass at a university and helps Jun on "secret training sessions" because she apparently "still sucks at bass".

name: Ui Hirasawa
description:
**Height:** 154 cm 

Ui is [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa)'s younger sister, who begins the story as a third-year junior high school student, but later enters [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa)'s high school the following year in the same class as [Azusa](https://anilist.co/character/21173/Azusa-Nakano). Unlike her older sister, Ui is mature, responsible and handles household chores well, though she still shares a strong relationship with [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa) and has a great deal of love and respect for her older sister. Despite being a year younger than [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa), she is nearly identical to her with her hair down and is even once able to fool the club. She possesses some of her sister's musical gift, and has a great talent for playing the guitar—she became capable of playing with the rest of the light music club band after only a few days of practice ([Yui](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa) was sick, so Ui dressed up as [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa) to help the band out). She takes particularly good care of [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa) and strives to look after her even at the risk of her own health. Ui is actually considered as the ultimate groupie for her sister's band and supports them with all her heart. She occasionally provides a narrative to the story.

name: Megumi Sokabe
description: Megumi was the president of the student council before [Nodoka](https://anilist.co/character/19570/Nodoka-Manabe) succeeds her in her third year, and she is also the president of [Mio](https://anilist.co/character/19566/Mio-Akiyama)'s fan club. She stalks [Mio](https://anilist.co/character/19566/Mio-Akiyama) during her last few days in high school because she wanted to see [Mio](https://anilist.co/character/19566/Mio-Akiyama) one more time. The band offers her a song as a graduation gift.

name: Rasen Mayton
description: Rasen is a child born between a maid and the head of the Mayton Family, and a side character that appears in the novel written by Cha Sung-Min. He is the youngest child in the Maytons who was executed at the age of 17.

name: Persha Mayton
description: Persha is a 7th-circle mage whose traits are fire, water, and earth. She has a forceful, atrocious, and cruel personality. Persha's hobby is body mutilation.

name: Seroin Mayton
description:
__Relative(s):__ [Decatra Mayton](https://anilist.co/character/338843/Decatra-Mayton) (Father), [Soso](https://anilist.co/character/338845/Soso) (Stepmother), [Persha Mayton](https://anilist.co/character/290990) (Stepsister), [Ibelia Mayton](https://anilist.co/character/338847/Ibelia-Mayton) (Stepsister), [Carlton Mayton](https://anilist.co/character/338837/Carlton-Mayton) (Stepbrother), [Rasen Mayton](https://anilist.co/character/338836/Rasen-Mayton)  (Stepbrother)
__Affiliation(s):__ Mayton Family (4th son)

name: Decatra Mayton
description:
__Relative(s):__ [Soso](https://anilist.co/character/338845/Soso) (4th wife), [Persha Mayton](https://anilist.co/character/290990) (Daughter), [Ibelia Mayton](https://anilist.co/character/338847/Ibelia-Mayton) (Daughter), [Seroin Mayton](https://anilist.co/character/338844/Seroin-Mayton) (Son), [Carlton Mayton](https://anilist.co/character/338837/Carlton-Mayton) (Son), [Rasen Mayton](https://anilist.co/character/338836/Rasen-Mayton) (Son)
__Affiliation(s):__ Mayton Family (Head)

Decatra only ever loved the maid, Soso. She is the sole recipient of his genuine love.

name: Kassin Sade
description:
__Relative(s):__ Karssia Sade (Father)
__Affiliation(s):__ Sade Family (2nd son)

Kassin is the main character of Swordsmaster Sade by Cha Jung-Min and is destined to fight the Maytons. He is the 2nd son of House Sade. Kassin was filled with curiosity and the habit of trying to satisfy it became the foundation of his growth.

name: Noa
description: Noa was a pretty well-known mage in the Dorothy Kingdom before being in charge of the Leaf Hall.

name: Magner Grandel
description:
__Relative(s):__ Rosaline Grandel(Niece)
__Affiliation(s):__ Grandel Family(Second-in-Command)

Magner is the younger brother of the head of Grandel Family and the uncle of Rosaline. He also never married and stayed single after the encounter with Mai.

name: Rudia
description: A mage of Hairan and a member of the Fire Clan. She is super simpleminded, loyal, and a daddy's girl.

name: Larvian
description: Larvian is a highest-ranking mage with an ice trait and a librarian at Starlight Library. She has a cold but pure—sometimes ruthless—personality. Although Larvian doesn't show it, she loves chocolates.

name: Sakura Kanou
description: Sakura is Sumire's younger sister who attends the same high school as Sumire though her grades are horrible. She can unconsciously flirt with people, and like her sister, she hates snakes.

name: Yuri Koigakubo
description: Yuri is the twenty-nine-year-old homeroom teacher of Ryūji's class (though she turns thirty in the fifth volume of the light novels). She likes to do things at her own pace and is timid towards Taiga's way of speaking out. Since her twenties are almost over, Yuri is in a hurry to get married soon and she even tries to dress well so as to be able to get into a relationship quicker. After she becomes thirty without getting married, she develops a twisted and depressed personality, which does not help that when Taiga talks about her, she emphases her single status.  She is fairly concerned over the well-being and grades of her students and tries her best to help them. During the Winter, she banned Haruta from Christmas Activities to get him to study for exams.

name: Hisamitsu Noto
description: Hisamitsu is a male student in Ryuuji's class who wears glasses. He was also in Ryuuji's class the previous year and is on good terms with him. Noto begins to develop feelings for Maya Kihara which become more apparent following an argument they had during the class winter ski trip.

name: Yasuko Takasu
description:
Yasuko is [Ryuuji](https://anilist.co/character/12295/Takasu-Ryuuji)'s thirty-three-year-old mother, though she refers to herself as eternally twenty-three.

Soon after Ryuuji was born, her husband died which left her to raise her son by herself. She works at a hostess bar named Bishamonten Kuni where she goes by the name "Mirano" and single-handedly supports her two-member family financially. However, she has a childish personality and since she works, she entrusts the household chores to Ryuuji. She instantly takes a liking to [Taiga](https://anilist.co/character/12064/Aisaka-Taiga) and already regards her as a member of her family.

name: Yuushin Hirose
description:
__Height:__ 190 - 192 cm

He is Hiyori's classmate. Unlike Hiyori, he is the tallest student in the class. He decides to sit in the back of the class so he won't disturb his classmates. Hirose is handsome, outgoing and begins to help Hiyori on the question of her shyness.   He is the person who gives to Hiyori the nickname 'Hiyorin'.

name: Hiyori Nishiyama
description:
__Age__: 15 - 16
__Height__: 140 cm - 142 cm

Hiyori has a height of 140 centimeters and is very shy. She is referred as cute by her classmates, specially by Natsuki and Yuushin. Her best friend is Ritsuka, who she has met since kindergarten. Her nicknames are Hiyo (used by Ritsuka) and Hiyorin (used by Yuushin and other classmates). Hiyori admires Yuushin because he can make friends easily, while she can't. Later, she falls in love with him. Hiyori also has a cat named Pui-pui, which was found by Yuushin in the school grounds.

name: Hiroshi Tanaka
description: Class Representative. Appears in two manga by Moe Yukimaru. According to some rumors, he has a pretty handsome face which he hides under his glasses. Tanaka is diligent and multi-talented.

name: Misa
description: Hiyori's classmate. She's 147cm tall.

name: Natsuki Aizawa
description:
__Height__: 167 cm  

Natsuki is Hiyori and Yuushin's classmate. She loves cute things and is one of the classmates that thinks Hiyori is cute. She has been classmates with Yuushin in all of her middle school years. It is revealed that Natsuki had a crush on her homerooom teacher back in her last year in middle school, but when she learned that he was married, she felt heart broken, and so cut her hair. Natuski decided that she will only grow her hair when she has found someone that she loves.

name: Reina Matsushima
description: Reina is Hiyori's second year classmate, but is a year older because she is a returnee from the United States. She is a happy go lucky girl, and isn't afraid to speak her mind. She sits beside Yuushin in class, and has also confessed to him. She considers Hiyori as her rival and comrade, because they were both 'rejected' by Yuushin, although Hiyori has not yet given Yuushin a direct confession. She also told Yuushin that Hiyori and Kou looked good together, but that would be impossible because Hiyori has feelings for Yuushin.

name: Ritsuka Nakano
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm 

A 15-years-old girl and Hiyori's best friend. She is the first person who encouraged Hiyori to become more sociable and start going again to school. Hiyori calls her Ri-chan. Her most notable feature are her red twintails. She is also a part of the archery club, and prefers a guy who "will not die even if an arrow pierces his heart." A extra side story reveals that Ritsuka was very popular with boys in middle school and wondered what it would be like to love someone and to have a boyfriend. A boy confesses to her and she goes to te fireworks festival with him. However he says something about Hiyori that Ritsuka finds rude and hits him on the face with her bag. She runs to Hiyori's house and says that right now Hiyori is the one she loves (implying it as friends)and says to Hiyori that if she ever falls in love, Hiyori will be the first to know.   

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Kou Nitobe
description:
__Height__: 159 cm

Kou is one of Hiyori's classmates in her second year, and sits beside her in class. He has a similar personality and height with her, causing him to be constantly teased with Hiyori during his first year. When he first met Hiyori, he disliked her because he thought that she had a calculating personality, and believed that Hiyori was an attention-seeking girl. He eventually becomes one of Hiyori's good friends. He also does not enjoy school trips. He later meets Ri-chan, Hiyori's best friend and finds her weird and notice that she eats a lot. Hiyori thinks that Kou and Ri chan would look good as a couple.

name: Kisaki Tominaga
description:
__Age__: 15
__Height__: 170 cm  

Attending a prestigious girl's school. Yuushin's stylish, outstanding childhood friend. She confessed to Yuushin when they were young.

name: Yamato Akitsuki
description:
The main protagonist of the story. He moved from his home in rural Hiroshima to his aunt’s dormitory in Tokyo to change himself. While checking out his new high school, he sees a beautiful high jumper practicing and falls in love at first sight. By chance, she happens to be his next door neighbor, Suzuka Asahina. Yamato is clumsy and has a carefree attitude, which often gets him into comprising situations. When the need arises, he can become focused and determined. He is exceedingly clueless when it comes to girls and their feelings. Although not the best in academics, he discovered a natural gift as a sprinter, and joined the track and field team. 

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Miho Fujikawa
description:
Ayano's daughter and Yamato’s younger cousin by two years. She is very attached and protective of Yamato to the point of being jealous of Suzuka. Occasionally, she reminds Yamato of his childhood promise to marry her to cheer him up or as a joke. During the time skip, she became a high school student, moved into Suzuka's old room, and became the track manager. When Suzuka moved back to the apartments, she was forced to give up her room and move back in with her mother.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Yuuka Saotome
description: A boisterous busybody college student from rural Akita that lives in Ayano’s dormitory. She likes to drink and usually ends up in Yamato’s room with her best friend Megumi. She has been known to take pictures of Yamato in compromising positions so she can blackmail him later. Even though she considers her relationship with Yamato to be “master and slave” [6], she often tries to help him with his relationship problems and has admitted that she worries about him. He also seems to be one of the few people she can be vulnerable with. In fact, Yamato is the only one that she has told about her one sided love for Sasaoka, who she has liked since high school. She had confessed to him fifteen times, but Sasaoka took it as a joke because she never seriously followed through. These rejections had a profound impact on her life, driving her to change her appearance and her dating behavior. Before Sasaoka left for the United States, Yamato took her to the airport so she could finally convince him of her feelings. Even though she finally got through to him, he revealed he is already engaged to be married next year. She took this rejection well, claiming that she felt refreshed and not as devastated as she originally thought. After thanking Yamato, she proclaimed she will become a better woman and find an even better man. She has since returned her appearance to the way it was when Yamato first met her.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Miki Hashiba
description: Miki is a first year high school student and member of the school field and track team as a sprinter. She is best friends with Suzuka Asahina and later Yamato. Before they began attending the same high school, Miki had often encountered Suzuka during track meets and disliked her because Suzuka came off as cold and aloof. However, once she realized that Suzuka's distant nature resulted from her perfectionist tendencies and dedication to her sport, Miki came to respect Suzuka and they became friends. Although initially attracted to Yamato Akitsuki, upon realizing he was infatuated with her best friend Suzuka, she immediately puts a hold on her own feelings. Miki is extremely loyal to her friends and will do anything to help them. She meddles constantly in their affairs and can be quite incessant in forcing them to confront their feelings. When asked what is most important to her in life, her answer was simply, "Friends!"

name: Hiroshi Sasaoka
description: A salesman for the sports equipment company “Adriex”. One of his jobs is to recruit Japan’s top student athletes to study abroad and train in the United States, for which all expenses are paid by his company. He also happens to be Yuka’s crush from high school, but, much to her displeasure, he still treats her like a younger sister. In the latest chapters, his company is transferring him back to the United States for the next 5 to 6 years. Before leaving, Yuka finally convinces him of her feelings for him. Unfortunately, the relationship is not possible because he is engaged to be married next year. When home making his wedding preparations, he was contacted by Suzuka about any employment opportunities for Yamato. He states their is an opening in an affiliate company and he would be willing to give him a recommendation.  (Wikipedia)

name: Yui Amami
description: One of the girls in the group date that Yasunobu tricked Yamato into going on. She took a liking to him and her feelings only grew when Yamato began working at her family's cafe, which was the only place of employment that Yamato could find that allowed him to work one day a week. After Yamato and Suzuka broke up, she visited Yamato to try and cheer him up. Seeing the state he was in, she tried to comfort him both physically and emotionally, but found that he did not reciprocate her feelings. She was later on invited by Yasunobu to celebrate Yamato and Suzuka's marriage held by their friends, which made Yamato nervous until Yasunobu reassured him that she was not the type to hang on forever. Later on she was in attendance at their wedding ceremony. Yui and her father made cameos in chapter 90 of A Town Where You Live.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Yasunobu Hattori
description: Has been friends with Yamato since they were kids. They often met whenever Yamato came to stay with his aunt Ayano; however, Hattori would frequently get Yamato in trouble, since Hattori would take advantage of the fact that Ayano's dormitory also contained a women's bath. He is a ladies' man that, according to Yamato, prefers perverted stuff over eating. He dreams of dating all the girls in the world and the legalization of polygyny in Japan. Yasunobu is often giving relationship advice to Yamato, with rather amusing results, due to the latter's being clueless and tendency to screw up. Even though he sometimes gets Yamato in bad situations, he usually has Yamato’s best interests in mind. Much to Yamato and Miki's surprise, Yasunobu has been a straight "A" student during high school. Yasunobu and Miki recently have made cameos in Chapter 67 of A Town Where You Live where they were meeting each other during Haruto's class trip to Tokyo.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Nana Shirakawa
description:
__Height:__ 164 cm

A popular singing idol who has been Honoka’s best friend since middle school. Most are surprised to discover this because it is unexpected that someone as timid as Honoka would have such glamorous acquaintances. Even though Nana's famous, she considers Honoka to be her only friend because she treats her normally. Because of this she is very protective of her.    (Wikipedia)

name: Suzue Asahina
description: Suzue Asahina is Suzune and Suzuka's mother.

name: Sakiko Kawada
description: A friend of Sho. She is a sixth grader from class 3 and she has a brother, Takeshi, in the third grade. When everyone else doubts Sho, she sticks up for him. After the Nation of Yamato Elementary is formed, she seems to be a cook or a server when it is meal time.

name: Sho Takamatsu
description: Sho Takamatsu is the main character. He is in the 6th grade and is a notorious prankster.    Sho is noble and brave, and rather selfless. He consistently refuses to sacrifice anyone for the good of the rest. Even though he started the story by fighting with his mother, he loves her a lot and frequently cries out to her. He is good friends with Ikegaki and Otomo, and later becomes good friends with Sakiko, Gamo, and the other officials. (source: Wikipedia)    Sho keeps a track of everything that happens in a notebook in the hopes that it will be found someday and help solve the mystery of what happened to the school and its children.

name: Nishi Ayumi
description: Nishi is a fifth grader and has long, light-colored hair. She has bad legs and isn't capable of walking normally and will use a crutch to help her walk. She is very insecure, believing she brings bad fortune to everyone around her. She's good friends with Nakata, whom she's known since second grade. She develops a special connection with Sho.

name: Ootomo
description: Ootomo is a sixth grader and fellow classmate of Sho. The class representative of class 3. He is very brave and athletic, extremely pragmatic, and sometimes abrasive. He is placed in charge of the health and welfare of the students and develops a friendship/rivalry with Sho.

name: Emiko Takamatsu
description: Emiko is Sho's mother. She scolds him regularly for being childish and irresponsible about his studies and future prospects. Although she is harsh on Sho, she loves him deeply. After the school's disappearance, she refuses to believe her son is dead.

name: Gamou
description: Gamou is a fifth grader and the smartest student in the whole school, with an IQ of 230. He has a natural aptitude for science and often explores possible explanations for their situation. He is incredibly loyal to Sho.

name: Ikegaki
description: Ikegaki is a sixth grader and fellow classmate of Sho. He is extremely brave, hot-headed, and determined. A very good friend to Sho and always has his back. He is placed in charge of the overall defense of the school.

name: Kami no Ko
description: The protagonist who turns from a sociopathic child into more and more of a Messiah.

name: Kouhai
description:
A virgin guy that now that he is in college wants to try getting a girlfriend. He talks with senpai because she is smoking hot and he wants to try it "just for showing how cool I am".
He tends to be very pushy, but his heart is really kind.

name: Senpai
description: A heavy smoker. College student that is very diligent in all what she does.

name: Baito-chan
description: Works in the same place as senpai. Hates Kouhai because she adores Senpai and doesn't think he deserves her.

name: Tenchou
description: Manager of the café. He doesn't have a very good memory, so he calls people by appearance, like the cigarette for Senpai (Tobacco-chan) or the hair for Part Timer-chan (Blondie-chan).

name: Mocchan
description: She is the grandaughter of the Tenchou. She doesn't like how tall she is because people always told her that she was "too tall". Very shy.

name: Namajime
description: An overly serious guy that started working at the café later on.

name: Hina Hongou
description:
__Height:__ 161 cm

Hina is a normal 17 year old high school girl. But she's also the adopted daughter of Takahashi, who was the boss of the cult "The Army of God", that wanted to go to war against the Government and developed Chemical Bio-Weapons.

Now Hina is living a normal life, except she loves fighting and got recruited by Nozomi into an underground fighting circuit for women.

name: Hana Mitani
description:
__Height:__167 cm

She's Nozomi's and Ichika's friend from middle school and also a owner of the underground fighting organization for women.

She was forced to take over a independent Yakuza group and is now the current head of the declining Jinguuji Yakuza family, inheriting the role after the sudden death of the previous boss. Before that she was just a Hostess.

name: Ichika Iori
description:
__Height:__171 cm

She's Nozomi's childhood friend since elementary school and also a owner of the underground fighting organization for women.

Ichika used to be a Detective with the "Anti Organized Crime Unit", but got "reassigned" to the "Juvenline Division" after beating her Boss half to death. In reality they just want to keep her on a leash to restrict her and keep her close.

She believes that the world is a man's world so she tried keeping her mouth shut and letting her actions speak.

name: Nozomi Tenma
description:
__Height:__ 162 cm

Nozomi is a 27 year old former professional cage fighter.

She had to retire because she found out that she has a detached retina and couldn't continue as a professional anymore.
She then started underground fighting, but then got fired because her fights were "boring".
But then she comes across the idea of creating a underground fighting organization for women and is a manager of said organization.

She's also the caretaker of Hina Hongou because she's the only one who has at least a bit control over her.

name: Sara Yukihira
description: Yukihara Sara is a complete masochist and narcissist. She thinks of martial arts as cute, and she doesn't want people to think of her as a murderer.

name: Chiroru Sasaki
description:
__Heigh__t: 167 cm

Chiyoru Sasaki is the "Overseer Star", also known as the "Eighth Star". She is a mysterious and sadistic figure who sits cross-legged while ordering others to entertain her, with an expression of unhinged excitement.

name: Yuu Hazuki
description:
__Height:__ 182 cm

Yuu Hazuki comes from a "certain lawless area" that is famous in the underworld. Her real name is unknown there is a high possibility that she doesn't have a name in the first place.

name: Chiaki Itsuki
description:
__Height__: 164 cm

Chiaki Itsuki is a Fancy Fight fighter and teamfighting specialist, forming the duo "Darlings of Slaughter" with Kagura Miyabi.

name: Miyabi Kagura
description:
__Height__: 166 cm

Miyabi Kagura is a Fancy Fight fighter and teamfighting specialist, forming the duo "Darlings of Slaughter" with Itsuki Chiaki.

name: Beatrice de Médicis
native: ベアトリス・ド・メディシス
description: Mother to [Falma](https://anilist.co/character/161669/Falma-de-Mdicis) & [Blanche](https://anilist.co/character/278209/Blanche-de-Mdicis) and husband to [Bruno](https://anilist.co/character/278208/Bruno-de-Mdicis)

name: Kana Ienaga
description:
__Height:__ 152 cm
__Affiliation:__ Kiyojuji Paranormal Patrol

Kana is [Rikuo](https://anilist.co/character/12953/Nura-Rikuo)'s childhood friend and neighbor. She is an easily frightened girl who doesn't like the idea of yokai, yet ironically she often becomes embroiled in yokai-related incidents. She is hinted to have some affection for Rikuo, as she becomes jealous when she sees him spending time with [Tsurara](https://anilist.co/character/16599/Oikawa-Tsurara), and undeniably falls for his "night" form after he rescues her. She often worries about Rikuo's mental health, and is rather keen at noticing when he is upset over something but trying to keep it hidden.

appearsIn.title: Nura: Rise of the Yokai Clan

name: Yura Keikain
description:
__Height:__ 143 cm
__Clan:__ Keikain House
__Affiliation:__ Kiyojuji Paranormal Patrol

Yura is an onmyoji of the Keikain House who specializes in shikigami. She is able to maintain four at once, impressing both [Nurarihyon](https://anilist.co/character/23307/Nurarihyon) and fellow onmyoji. She was trained by [Akifusa](https://anilist.co/character/31433/Keikain-Akifusa), who raised her to see yokai as evil. She seeks to complete her training by defeating Nurarihyon and then inheriting leadership of the Keikain household. After spending time with [Rikuo](https://anilist.co/character/12953/Nura-Rikuo) and being exposed to his yokai form, she begins to see how yokai are similar to people in that they are not all good or evil. She is a frugal girl who doesn't mind eating food that has fallen on the floor and is glad her shikigami don't require food. Her stomach growls at inopportune moments, but she doesn't seem to mind.

appearsIn.title: Nura: Rise of the Yokai Clan

name: Rikuo Nura
description:
__Height:__ 148 cm (human); 175 cm (yokai)

Rikuo Nura is 3/4 human and 1/4 yokai.

He is the son of Rihan and Wakana Nura and grandson of Nurarihyon and Yohime. He is the third and current head of the Nura Clan.  Due to having yokai blood in his lineage, Rikuo has two forms: one in which he takes a human form, and another where his yokai blood takes over and he becomes a full yokai. The former is frequently called his "day" form, whereas the latter is called his "night" form, as originally he was only able to maintain it during darkness.  Rikuo was originally reluctant to accept his yokai blood and his role as the successor to the Nura Clan because he was teased at school for talking about yokai. As he ages, he realizes he has the ability to protect both humans and yokai because of his heritage, and acknowledges himself as the third leader of the Nura Clan.  Rikuo has officially exchanged sakazuki with Zen, Kubinashi, Tsurara, Jami, Kappa, Kurotabo and Aotabo.

appearsIn.title: Nura: Rise of the Yokai Clan

name: Tsurara Oikawa
description:
__Height:__ 150 cm  
__Clan:__ Nura Clan, Tsurara Clan  
__Affiliation:__ Kiyojuji Paranormal Patrol  

Tsurara is Rikuo's trusted attendant. She follows him to school under a human guise known as Tsurara Oikawa. She is a Yuki Onna yokai. Around the Nura House, she sometimes acts as a cook who makes delicious but usually chilled or cold food.

She is fiercely loyal to Rikuo and will do anything for him. She gets visibly jealous when Rikuo mentions Kana and loves Rikuo deeply, though it is not clear if her love is romantic.

appearsIn.title: Nura: Rise of the Yokai Clan

name: Kurotabou
description:
__Height:__ 195 cm 
__Clan:__ Nura Clan  

Kurotabou is called "The Assassin and Destruction Monk" and is often seen with Aotabo, as the two are known as the assault officers of the Nura Clan.   Kurotabou was originally part of Rihan's Night Parade. Kurotabou looked after Rikuo when he was a child and often fell victim to his pranks.

appearsIn.title: Nura: Rise of the Yokai Clan

name: Awashima
description:
__Height:__ 169 cm (male); 159 cm (female)
__Clan:__ Ōshū Tōno Family  

An Amanojaku yokai who normally chops the firewood. She/He is a type of demon who turns into a female at night. The female form of Awashima can dance like a heavenly nymph. His/Her name comes from the name of the second child of Izanagi and Izanami in the Kojiki, Awashima no Kami, who was neither male nor female.

appearsIn.title: Nura: Rise of the Yokai Clan

name: Te no Me
description: Te no me is a small yokai of the Nura Clan. He has a weird-looking forehead and his eyes are located in his palms. As one of the yokai who travels with Rikuo to Kyoto, he spends much of the ride snacking and drinking sake with Ko Oni, Sannokuchi and Natto Kozo.

appearsIn.title: Nura: Rise of the Yokai Clan

name: Miyakohime
description: Height: 157 cm Weight: 46 kg  Miyakohime is a princess who was brought to Osaka Castle 400 years ago under the pretense of becoming Hideyori Toyotomi's concubine. Until she was five years old, her hair wouldn't grow and she threw herself into the sea in despair. After paying her respects to the golden Buddha statue which had sunk there, she was gifted with the most beautiful hair in all of Japan. She died when her heart was eaten by Hagoromo Gitsune.

appearsIn.title: Nura: Rise of the Yokai Clan

name: Yukari
description:
__Height:__ 130 cm 
__Clan:__ Ōshū Tōno Family  

A Zashiki Warashi yokai, she seems to be the only child in the village.

appearsIn.title: Nura: Rise of the Yokai Clan

name: Kuramayama no Dai-Tengu
description:
__Height:__ 190 cm 
__Clan:__ Kyoto Yokai  

The Great Tengu of Mount Kurama is an aged yokai who was Hagoromo Gitsune's right-hand man 400 years ago. During the battle between her forces and Nurarihyon's, he fought against Gyuki. His place has since been usurped by Minagoroshi Jizo, who rewrote the memories of the rest of Hagoromo Gitsune's forces to forget that the tengu was ever among them. As a means of revenge, the Great Tengu of Mount Kurama decides to prevent Nue's birth and strikes a deal with Gyuki in regards to Rikuo's training in Kyoto to assist in the process. However, when he begins to feel that the training is taking too long, he sends his underlings to retrieve Nenekirimaru on their own - which ultimately proves unsuccessful.

description: The main character of the story. He was a grand master ranked third in the world named Gu Fei Yang, who then reincarnated as Li Yunxiao.

description: Tianshui Nation's Blue Jewel Academy Instructor.

description: The sect master who accepts Han Jue as her disciple.

appearsIn.title: Lucky Me: I Secretly Cultivated for 1,000 Years

name: Scarlet El Vandimion
native: スカーレット・エル・ヴァンディミオン
description: Eldest daughter of the Duke of Vandimion, from a young age Scarlett was known for her overly violent behavior - to the point where others called her the Mad Dog Princess. While she now normally bottles up her emotions to please her family, sometimes she still needs to let loose...

appearsIn.title: May I Ask for One Final Thing?

name: Nanaka
description: A young spy and slave for Godwin, who was sent to pose as a maid for House Vandimion. Nanaka is a male beastkin who is often confused as a girl due to his androgynous figure and gender-neutral name. After Scarlet removes his enslavement curse, he sides with her in return.

appearsIn.title: May I Ask for One Final Thing?

name: Leonardo El Vandimion
native: レオナルド・エル・ヴァンディミオン
description: [Scarlett](https://anilist.co/character/255701/El-Vandimion-Scarlett)'s older brother as well as [Julius](https://anilist.co/character/359260/Von-Pallistan-Julius)' attendant and best friend. He worries about his sister's well-being and psychological state, often wishing she would act (and live) like a normal woman at her age, and would often have stomach pains and shriek towards the heavens whenever he hears of his sister's vigilante antics. He's also a founder of the Crown Investigatory Office, albeit reluctantly, since he only wants to keep a close eye on his sister.

appearsIn.title: May I Ask for One Final Thing?

name: Julius Von Pallistan
native: ジュリアス ・フォン・パリスタン
description: The first prince of the Kingdom of Pallistan. Unlike his brother, Julius stands calm, charming, and interested in strange things. He does not wish to be a mere figurehead for the masses and desires to understand his people of the kingdom he will eventually lead. He's the first to notice [Scarlett](https://anilist.co/character/255701/El-Vandimion-Scarlett)'s hidden personality and would often tease and observe her to witness this core of her being rise to the surface. In fact, he enjoys watching her beat up those who offend her due to an underlying desire to see the petty and obtuse brought to ruin. He is a free-spirited sort who is not fond of empty flattery from the aristocracy.

Hong Seol is the main protagonist in the Cheese in the Trap series. She is the oldest daughter in her family and also the most hardworking. She is a very observant person, even admitting herself that she over-analyzes every single little detail. She is a part of the Tastes and Looks alongside her friends Bora Jang and Euntaek Kwon.

Hong Seol has been independent her whole life, never needing to rely on anyone. That is until she met Yu Jung, a senior that goes to her college. Their relationship starts off on the wrong foot but as the story develops, so does their relationship.

name: Chakuro
description:
Chakuro is a passionate and curious thinker who seems to always ask questions about the world around him. Some of the most occurring questions he asks are 'how do mud whales float?' and 'why are feelings important?' His obsession with writing is seen as an illness by his grandfather and himself. As an archivist, Chakuro writes objectively which is a contradiction to his expressive behavior. His writings are relied on by the council members.

Chakuro is very expressively emotional. It is pointed out that he often cries in funerals when they are not supposed to.

(Source: Children of the Whales Wikia)

name: Lykos

Birthday: December 6

When she was seven years old, her parents enrolled her in a military academy.

name: Sami
description:
Sami is Suou's younger sister and Chakuro's childhood friend. Unlike Suou, she is one of the Marked and can wield thymia. She is a naive and innocent girl who is always worried about Chakuro.

In the year 90, Sami and Suou lost their mother.

name: Shuan
description: Even among the vigilante corps, composed of the strongest thymia wielders, he is considered the strongest. He is always smiling, but his true feelings are unknown.

name: Ginshu

name: Natala
description:
Natala was a member of the Empire's assassination group Group of Terror appearing in the prequel series Akame Ga Kill!: Zero until his death. He is now serving as one of Kurome's main corpse puppets.

Natala is one of the members of Kurome's group of assassins. He died some time before the main story and his deceased body was reanimated by Kurome using Yatsufusa.

He is later use in a battle against Night Raid, defending Kurome from her enemies. After the battle, Natala became one of the last two puppets, the other being Dooya.

Natala wielded Trisula. Mine mistakenly thought it was a Teigu, but it is in fact a Shingu. Because the weapon's design allows it to expand and contract at will, its style of killing is to cut the opponent's body in two. Natala bifurcated Chelsea with this weapon.

description:

Najasho is a member of the Empire's Assassination group (former group of Akame). He is the leader of the Elite Seven and is called "Chief" by the members.

name: Kurome
description: Kurome is a member of the Jaegers, and the younger sister of [Akame](https://anilist.co/character/63351/Akame). Like her sister, she has a big appetite and is often seen eating, usually candy. She stubbornly refuses to share her candy with even her comrades. Kurome wields an offensive Teigu like her sister, in the form of a sword named "March of the Dead: Yatsuhusa", which allows her to enslave up to 8 enemies killed with the Teigu. Also like her sister, she is extremely skilled in the art of the sword and assassination.

name: Yan Xiao
description:
__Species:__ Human
__Hair Color:__ Blue
__Eye Color:__ Blue/Grey
__Body Physique:__ Three Thousand Star Constitution

Xiao Yan from Battle Through Heavens (Doupo Cangqiong) was a the genius of the Xiao family until his mother passed away and he lost his cultivation prowess. He aims to take back his glory and reach the pinnacle of the cultivation path where no one can stand against him, the rank of Dou Di. Xiao Yan practices the Flame mantra Dou Qi training method and as such can quickly cultivate up the ranks and conquer his enemies one step at a time.

name: Chen Yao
description:
Yao Chen has long white hair and wide red eyes. His skin is very pale and has a tall, lean figure. Have great pride, protective and benevolent.

He was abandoned by his own clan, Yao clan because he born with a very thin amount of Dou Qi in his blood.

He founded Falling Star Pavilion along with Feng Zunzhe before going out to adventure. In the past, Yao Lao traveled the world with his friends who were all Dou Zun.

He won the first place in a competition held by Pill Tower and asked to join the inner circle of Pill Tower but he turn down the chance and also an elder of the Pill Tower holds romantic feelings towards him.

He spent 8 years waiting for the Bone Chilling Flame.

He was the most respectable and skilful alchemist in the whole southern region of the Central Plain. He is the master of the Yao Wang, Han Feng and Xiao Yan's mother, Gu Wen Xin, but been betrayed and killed by his disciple Han Feng who got the help from Spirit Hall. After his death, his first disciple Gu Wen Xin seal his spirit in a ring to keep him safe from Han Feng. After Gu Wen Xin passed away, she give the ring to his son, Xiao Yan.

appearsIn.title: Dou Po Cangqiong: Yao Lao Chuanqi

name: Lin  Cai
description: Medusa/Cai Lin is the queen of the Snake-People Tribe and [Xiao Yan's](https://anilist.co/character/146584/Xiao-Yan) first wife. She has the ability to bewitch any man that has a weaker cultivation than her, this is how she exerts her power over the other snake people as queen, due to it being a passive ability she doesn't have full control over it and as such when she is naked the power can happen without her will. As she is one of the snake people she can resist most poisons and toxins.

Nalan Yanran was the former fiancee to Xiao Yan but the engagement was called off after he had lost his cultivation. She is a cold person to people she does not know the strength of and people who are weaker than her, but will respect people who are stronger than her.

__Species__: Human

She is a young woman who spent her childhood in the Xiao Clan. She is a very talented fighter that could be considered a genius. She has a crush on Xiao Yan since childhood, and although Xiao Yan was called a cripple she stood by his side. Her true identity and past are secrets that only the really strong can know.

name: Riku Aibetsu
description:
Riku Aibetsu is the one of the main protagonists of Phantom Seer. She is a Beckoning Hand for Phantoms.

She is a very cheerful, empathetic person with a strong drive to help those in need. Because of the "power" she believes she possesses to sense danger, she's always managing to save her friends before random dangerous incidents, causing her to become a well-liked person around the people at her school. When it turns out that this power was simply a result of her being a Beckoning Hand for phantoms and she's actually been endangering those around her, Riku shows first a great sadness and regret that, despite her helpful intentions, she's only been hurting people more, and then a new drive to carry on being helpful even though her talents and hopes don't line up.

She has also been shown to be very self-sacrificial, willing to take the fall for Iori Katanagi when she realizes that a phantom wants to attack them, and offering to be the bait when she and Iori are attempting to save Tomoka Fujisaki.

name: Yayoi Katanagi
description:
Yayoi Katanagi is one of the main protagonists of Phantom Seer and is the elder sister of Iori Katanagi. She runs an elite Shaman group called Nabari.

She is a woman of tall stature and picturesque beauty. She has long, dark hair which seems to flow in an almost prehensile fashion. Her eyes are completely covered by what appeared to be Talismans, adding even more mystery to her already enigmatic appearance.

name: Iori Katanagi
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7")
__Affiliation:__ Nabari
__Occupation:__ Shaman, Student (2nd Year)

Iori Katanagi is a powerful shaman and the protagonist of Phantom Seer.

He is initially presented as being very selfish in character, stating immediately to Riku Aibetsu that the rumours about him going out of his way to help others were false when she first questions him about them and telling her that he only ever does things for himself. He's often rude when talking to others, sarcastically complimenting people without a care for what they'll think of him as a result, and becoming angry when he's made to do things he doesn't want to do.

Iori's shaman powers are based on shadows and are channeled through the Shadow Demon, Ongyoki.

name: Senjudoji
description:
Senjudoji is a phantom that once killed someone that Iori Katanagi was trying to protect. Because of this, Iori adopted his close off personality and has wanted to kill Senjudoji ever since.

(Source: MyAnimeList)

name: Kenma Oigawa
description:
Kenma Oigawa is a Shaman who likes helping people in need of assistance or whenever they've been captured or haunted by a phantom.

He is shown to be an serious-minded individual with a no-nonsense persona when it comes to interacting with others. He is often well-spoken, polite, and respected among his peers. Kenma also dislikes those who slack off, which explains his disdain towards Iori's personality.

Despite his mature and rule-abiding behavior, Kenma genuinely desires to help others, feeling great pleasure whenever he does a good deed.

name: Chihiro Kurose
description:
__Height:__ 177 cm (5'9")
__Affiliation:__ Koreikai
__Occupation:__ Shaman

Chihiro Kurose is a Shaman and the self-proclaimed "Young Star of The Shaman World".

Fitting to his appearance, Chihiro is a flashy shaman who cares deeply about his looks for the sake of others having an good impression on him. Chihiro tends to flirt with many women he comes across, often coming off as a Casanova most of the time. It is also shown that he harbors feelings towards Yayoi, often trying to impress her with his flashy shaman abilities. Despite his cavalier attitude, he is deeply dedicated to his obligations as a Shaman and is quite perceptive when it comes to reading the emotions and intentions of others.

Chihiro's shaman abilities mainly revolve around his power to control flames using a lighter he keeps in his coat pocket.

name: Yojiro Satake
description:
Yojiro Satake is a Shaman who specializes in gathering information on phantoms and is Iori Katanagi's kohai.

He is depicted as a casual broker who informs his fellow shamans of the tasks they need to handle when dealing with the enemy Phantoms. He usually keeps the group updated about jobs, brokering information between them, and cleans up their messes whenever an exorcism is fully performed. Other than that, Yojiro is fine with the job he has to take on for the sake of his shaman comrades.

name: Kanzaki
description: Kanzaki is a counselor at the school that Iori attends.

name: Tsumuji  Komachi
description: Tsumuji Komachi is a classmate of Iori Katanagi and Riku Aibetsu.

name: Computer Kenkyuukai Buchou
native: コンピュータ研究会部長
description:
He is the President of the Computer Research Society Club, which shares a room adjacent to the SOS Brigade. The President is never given a name other than "Computer Society President" or variations upon that term.

He and his club had the misfortune of being targeted by [Haruhi Suzumiya's](https://anilist.co/character/251/Haruhi-Suzumiya) blackmail, being forced to give away their best computer and wire the Brigade's clubroom for an internet connection. He hasn't yet forgiven this, and frequently checks the SOS Brigade website to see if they are putting the computer to use (which they haven't), making him the primary cause of their hit counter's steady rise. He has a passion for computers (duh) and along with the other four members of the Computer Society, helped developed their own basic science-fiction strategy game titled The Day of Sagittarius III (there is no Day of Sagittarius I or II, they just thought the III would sound cool). It is hinted he is one of [Yuki Nagato's](https://anilist.co/character/249/Yuki-Nagato) secret admirers.

name: Okabe
description: The teacher of Haruhi and Kyon's classroom.

name: Aura Carpa
description:
Height: 1,70m

The queen of the Carpa Kingdom, wielder of Time-Space Magic and wife of [Zenjirou](https://anilist.co/character/166871).

name: Zenjirou Yamai
description:
Height: 1,72m

After being summoned to another a world, Zenjirou Yamai a japanese salaryman meets [Aura Carpa](https://anilist.co/character/166655), Queen of the Carpa Kingdom, who asks him if is willing to marry her.

name: Kaito Miyama
description: A third-year college student and game lover, caught up in a Hero Summoning. His parent died in an accident when he was a child. He has lived without much human interaction, so his communipower is low. he has a calm personality, but he can be assertive without being afraid to speak up. He thinks of himself as an ordinary person, but in fact, he holds quite a strange fate in his hands.

appearsIn.title: I Got Caught Up In a Hero Summons, but the Other World was at Peace!

name: Kuromueina
description: Kuromueina is the first demon Kaito met, and one of the Six Kings. In truth, she is the strongest member of the Six Kings, with the others being individuals she raised. She is the half body of Shallow Vernal, who split her soul, at the same time as she created the world. Kuro was created with purpose of observing the world and coming to a decision whether to destroy it, or Shallow Vernal, who created it.

appearsIn.title: I Got Caught Up In a Hero Summons, but the Other World was at Peace!

name: Yuzuki Hina
description: She has greaves-type Heart Tool that allows the her to run freely on walls and in the air. It has no offensive capabilities, but it works extremely well with the speedy Hina, making it extremely versatile.

appearsIn.title: I Got Caught Up In a Hero Summons, but the Other World was at Peace!

name: Isis Remnant
native: アイシス・レムナント
description: Isis Remnant is one of the Six Kings. She is the Death King and among of all the six kings, she is feared the most by humans and demons.

appearsIn.title: I Got Caught Up In a Hero Summons, but the Other World was at Peace!

name: Mitsunaga Seigi
description: He is the new hero who has been chosen among humans

appearsIn.title: I Got Caught Up In a Hero Summons, but the Other World was at Peace!

name: Lilia Albert
description:
Lilia is an earnest and honest person. This makes her extremely bad at lying. She wants to appear as a refined noble lady but is rather tomboyish in nature. 

When her half-brother Ryze had rose to the throne, some people secretly argued that Lilia should be the one to take the throne as she was extremely talented. Having grown tired of others talking about how she should take the throne, she chose to abandon her title as princess and worked all the way to Knight Captain of her own platoon. Unfortunately, Lilia and her platoon were caught up in a trap setup by some nobles. This caused her childhood friend, Sieg, to receive a fatal injury that made her lose her voice. This had made her feel extremely guilty. At some point she became Duke Albert. Lilia was in charge of the hero summoning that summoned not only a hero but also 3 others.

appearsIn.title: I Got Caught Up In a Hero Summons, but the Other World was at Peace!

name: Shallow Vernal
description: She does not portray any sort of emotion within her intonations as described by Kaito, however after their first meeting, she began to steadily display her emotions outwardly through small body gestures such as the angle of her lips as noted by him. Though that being said she is capable of smiling naturally when undergoing extreme state of happiness displayed through some moments within the story.

appearsIn.title: I Got Caught Up In a Hero Summons, but the Other World was at Peace!

name: Lunamaria
description:
When Lunamaria is working, she acts befitting of a maid. However, her real personality is rather childish. This is shown through her tastes and actions, which mostly involves teasing those close to her. Lunamaria loves her mother Noir deeply. 

Lunamaria is capable of using most weapons, as she was trained to do so by her mother.

appearsIn.title: I Got Caught Up In a Hero Summons, but the Other World was at Peace!

name: Emma Spring
description: Mother of Aries. She adores her daughter, whom she raised alone.

appearsIn.title: Imaizumi Brings All the Gals to His House

Imaizumi Brings All the Gals to His House
Imaizumi Brings All the Gals to His House

name: Makoto Kowata
description: Makoto is a witch in training. She is a gentle person who likes doing things at her own pace. She has a poor sense of direction and will get lost rather easily. Her goal is to become a full-fledged witch, thus she transfers to the high school in Aomori. She is currently a freeloader living with the Kuramoto family.

name: Chito
description: Chito is Makoto's familiar, a black cat.

name: Chinatsu Kuramoto
description: Kei's little sister and Makoto's cousin. Originally wary of Makoto and thought of her as strange when they first met, she quickly came to like her after Makoto took her flying on a broom. She is fascinated with magic and eagerly watches Makoto when she does something that involves witchcraft or something supernatural. She also enjoys sweets.

name: Kei Kuramoto
description: He is Chinatsu's older brother and Makoto's cousin/classmate. He is good at cooking and doing housework which is not typical of boys his age. He does not do well when the topic of ghosts are brought up. He is often described as a girly boy.

name: Towa Inukai
description: A witch that specializes in fortune telling and is also Akane's friend. Due to an incident that happened in the past, she now has a face, ears, and tail of a dog and furry skin, and she can only return to her full human form at night. She has been looking for a way to contact Akane for a year to find a cure and return her to a human form permanently. Due to her half animal appearance, she wears a cloak that covers her face and body so she doesn't draw attention. Kei admits that she is his type of girl when in human form, and even Akane admits that she is very cute.

name: Anzu Shiina
description: She's a junior high school student with a passion for archaeology. She also helps out at her mother's café.

name: Sayo Kazuno
description: Makoto's senior and fellow witch

name: Akira
description: Akira is a witch who works at the Hirosaki division of the Witches' Association.

name: Ming Ming
description: Tomoe's familiar

name: Tomoe Nihei
description: The "witch of the cloth", referred to by Akane as the strongest person in the wizarding world.

name: Mitsuko Kongou
description:
__Height:__ 163 cm
__Classification:__ Esper
__School:__ Tokiwadai Middle School
__Esper Power:__ Aero Hand
__Power Level:__ 4

Mitsuko Kongou is a transfer student and heiress to Kongou Airlines. She is a Level 4 esper with an ability called "Aero Hand" which allows her to create a powerful gust of wind to propel any objects she touches like a missile. Mitsuko shows pride in herself despite being a new student in the school but shows ignorance of common routines such as finding directions and kitchen-related work. She is usually seen carrying a fan that she usually uses for her ability and has a pet boa constrictor named Ekaterina.

name: Rikou Takitsubo
description: She is the member of underground organization ITEM. Her power is the LV4 AIM Stalker. She can detect and memorize the AIM of any esper on earth. She usually use it to locate the target person for her team. Rikou has a potential to become Level 5.

name: MISAKA 10031
description: She is a Misaka Mikoto clone that appears in both Toaru Majutsu no Index and Toaru Kagaku no Railgun. Originally having a small role in Toaru Majutsu no Index, her character was later expanded in Toaru Kagaku no Railgun. She is the 10031st clone to be produced and killed by Accelerator for the Level 6 Shift experiment, she is also the first clone Kamijou Touma meets.   She looks the same as Mikoto, although for emphasis her eyes are drawn in a different way. Goggles and blue-striped panties are common to all Misaka clones and Misaka 10031 is no exception to this.   She has the same personality as most clones, with emotions that have been surpressed as they weren't beneficial to the experiment. Despite this, she still feels pain and is hurt when Mikoto drove her away when she tried to cheer her up, because of this she was a little saddened.  Another slight hint of personality is shown when behaves seriously when confronting Mikoto and Touma about having "robbed" a vending machine, she seriously recited every legal article that the couple ignored while committing the "felony", expressing dissappointment on them for engaging in such activities. Unfortunately 10031's nagging was cut short by Mikoto's aggressive personality which dragged her out of the scene to question her about the situation.   She is killed by Accelerator, and her remains are cleaned up by MISAKA 10032.

name: Seike Taroumaru
description: Seike is a powerful esper that can control the coefficient of friction and is a member of Scavenger.

name: Heaven Canceler
description: Often mentioned as "the Frog-Faced Doctor" by Touma, he is an exceptionally gifted and benevolent physician who can cure any illness and heal any injury, even if it is terminal. He is only unable to heal specific brain-related injuries, such as the "Imagine-Breaker Boy's" damaged memories and Accelerator's computation ability. However, in the latter case he was able to configure Accelerator to control his powers with support from the Misaka Network. This medical genius also manages the life extension devices for the ruler of the Academy City, Aleister Crowley, while also supporting the foundation of the city itself.

name: Su-Ryong Baek
description: In his previous life, he was the best instructor in the Blood Cult. After dying, he was reincarnated as Suryong Baek, a frail man who works at a small academy in the country side. However Suryong Baek knows how to fix his weak constitution, and to do so he needs both money and training. Thus he decides the best way to achieve his goals is to become the greatest teacher in a prestigious martial arts academy!

name: Harou
description: 11th Hero.

name: Zaybi
description: Captain of the 7th Northern Mage Squad. He is [Harou](https://anilist.co/character/293025)'s older brother.

name: Rinri
description: Rinri is a human from Land of the Lawless and the leader of the Lawless group, Kyokai.

name: Tiancheng Zuo
description:
__Species:__ Evolved Human
__Height:__ 178 cm

Zuo Tiancheng is the main protagonist of The Last Human series. He is an evolved human that died once on an alternative timeline and come back to life ten years into the past. He is determined to reunite again with who was his lover in his past life and save all the friends that lost the first time that he lived the Apocalypse.

name: Shang Biao
description: Shang Biao is an evolved being, the pet hamster of Luo Lansha and a member of Tian Cheng's group.

name: Lansha Luo
description:
__Species:__ Evolved Human
__Eye Color:__ Amber
__Hair Color:__ Blonde

Luo Lansha is an evolved human, companion and friend of Zuo Tian Cheng and the daughter of his mentor, Luo Ren Hang. She's also the owner of Shang Biao. Lansha has an outgoing personality, being an easygoing and sincere person to the people she meets and trusts. On the other hand, she's brave and has a practical intelligence that has let her overcome many dangerous situations and she keeps her loyal friends close to her heart. She also has the speed type evolved pattern.

__Abilities:__

name: Fei Gao
description:
__Species:__ Evolved Human
__Eye Color:__ Blue
__Hair Color:__ Blonde

Gao Fei is one of main characters of The Last Human Series. He is the best friend of Zuo Tian Cheng, an evolved human and the sniper of their group who also has the ability to manoeuvre his 3 throwing knives around at will to cut down his enemies. Gao Fei has a cheerful and honest personality, usually having a calm demeanour but being pretty expressive when something happens. He is a mental type evolved human which is gifted at both detection and gunman ship.

__Abilities:__

name: Renhang Luo
