appearsIn.title: A Dating Sim of Life or Death

name: Yurea Kusora
description:
An A-rank "capture" target Ryou almost literally bumps into while pursuing Akamine.

Yurea is the granddaughter of the owner of Kusora Companies. She is first introduced as an A-grade conquest target, but later becomes a recurring character.

appearsIn.title: A Dating Sim of Life or Death

name: Eve
description:
Eve is an artificial human who was created to be the first in a line of super soldiers, having had her DNA fused with nanomachines she has the ability to change her body's shape and genetic make-up. She was raised to be emotionless, and as a result, things that are considered normal are new to her.

She first met Sven and Train when Sven had wanted to save her while the Chronos has sent Train to kill her and destroy all the research data used in her creation,choosing to spare her life being one of the reasons Train left the organization. In the anime she is driven berserk by her creator and ordered to attack Train, while in the manga Train prevents the process from taking place. At the beginning of the series, Eve is wary of Train claiming he smells like blood, having given Train the bell he wears on his neck after reading that bells allow you to know where a bad cat is. They eventually develop into rivals over the position of being Sven's partner, and Train gives her the nickname "Little Princess".  

Her hobby is reading books of varying degree of difficulty; she can memorize any book she reads after reading it once, usually confusing the others by using complicated words she's learned, and her power to transform becomes more refined the more she learns.

name: Train Heartnet
native: トレイン・ハートネット
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm

Also known as Black Cat and the main protagonist in the story, he starts as a ruthless assassin but learns compassion from [Saya Minatsuki](https://anilist.co/character/4232/Minatsuki-Saya).

  He always wears a bell around his neck to remind him of what he once was and could once more become. In the manga, he already has the bell from book one. In the anime, Eve gives him the bell from the fable of the Black Cat.  His gun was made just for him by Chronos, called Hades. He also has a soft spot for women and children, especially when tears are shed.

name: Sven Vollfied
native: スヴェン・ボルフィード
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm

Former IBI detective, Sven is now a sweeper, and [Train](https://anilist.co/character/42/Heartnet-Train)'s partner. He also takes [Eve](https://anilist.co/character/44/Eve) in as a sort of daughter after the events at [Torneo](https://anilist.co/character/21599/Rudman-Torneo)'s place. Sven's outlook is much calmer and more logical than Train's; he often has to use his brain to win battles since he doesn't possess the Black Cat's pure physical power. He follows a strict "gentlemen's code", which often makes him seem older to other characters.

The Forseeing Eye (under the eyepatch) allows him to glimpse into the future at the cost of great mental strain. In the manga, it eventually evolves into the Glasper Eye which can manipulate time. He otherwise fights with a briefcase filled with gadgets.

name: Rinslet Walker
native: リンスレット・ウォーカー
description:
__Height:__ 167 cm
__Occupation:__ thief-for-hire

Her actions are always in line with her beliefs. She is very independent and won't do anything she doesn't want to. Sensing a commonality between herself and [Train](https://anilist.co/character/42/Heartnet-Train), she harbored an interest in him since Sapidoa. A world class thief also known as Rins who she works for everyone, from the government to mob bosses. She likes disguises, shopping and tarrot card reading. She claims she can steal anything and manipulate any man. She sometimes works alongside Train and [Sven](https://anilist.co/character/43/Vollfied-Sven). She always comes out with money in her pockets, regardless of how it might have gotten there.

name: Silphy Deacroft
native: シルフィー・デアクロフト
description: In the manga    Silphy is another one of the sweepers that forms the Sweeper Alliance. Her specialty is body combat. She battles Deek Slasky, but he manages to deliver an attack that continually freezes her until she turns into a complete ice statue. However, while the ice is still spreading through her arm, Sven appears and fights Deek, damaging so that his Chi is not strong enough to maintain the spell, saving Siplhy.    In the anime    The same, except she does not battle Deek, as he doesn't appear, and she is attacked by Preta instead, who Sven fights to save Silphy.    Source: Wikipedia

name: Lloyd Goldwynne
native: ロイド＝ゴールドウィン
description: Sven's partner who was a clairvoyant.

name: Kevin McDougall
description: Kevin McDougall is a sweeper that together with Train, Sven, Eve, River, and other sweepers, forms the Sweeper Alliance. He handles two revolvers, and his looks are those of a cowboy, except with a bit of "urban" style. In the manga, he helps Eve after she battles with Leon by carrying her. He is stabbed by Touma, but manages to survive.

name: Deek Slasky
description: He wields the power to control ice. He can attack using shards of ice, create an ice barrier around his body, or even freeze his enemies with his touch. He joins the Apostles after they help him escape from prison after murdering four girls in his freezer.    from wikipedia

name: Miki Mamiya
description: Younger sister of [Nao Mamiya](https://anilist.co/character/126972) and childhood friend of [Yuu Narumi](https://anilist.co/character/126969).

description: She used to date Nao when he was still a boy.

description: He is a man who loves women so much he wants to become one.

name: Yao Ha Ducy
native: ヤオ・ハー・デュッシ
description: A dark elf who is over 300 years old. She seeks the JSDF's aid when the same dragon that attacked Tuka's village moves to the forest where her tribe lives, becoming a threat to them. After the dragon is vanquished, she joins Itami's party as well.

name: Shino Kuribayashi
description: A female soldier and member of the Third Recon Team. She is a veteran and has a badge for hand-to-hand combat.

name: Tyuule
description: Zorzal's sex slave and the former Queen of the Warrior Bunny Tribe. Her tribe was at war with the Empire in the past, but realizing they could not win, she gave herself up to Prince Zorzal as his slave in exchange for him sparing her tribe. However, Zorzal did not keep his word and brutally slaughtered and enslaved her people while lying to the survivors that Tyuule sold them out to save herself which gain her tribe's hatred. Upon learning the truth, Tyuule swore revenge to bring down the Empire by appearing submissive to Zorzal while secretly manipulating him.

name: Giselle
description: One and the youngest of the Twelve Apostles serving the god Hardy. A deity of the dragon folk, she considers herself a rival to Rory Mercury and is responsible for waking the Flame Dragon. Renowned glutton.

name: Masaaki Azumi
description: Azumi is Ruka's father.  He works at Enokura Aquarium and lives apart from his family.

name: Kanako Azumi
description: Ruka's mother

name: Mayumi Santou
description: The daughter of a wealthy family, Mayumi suffers from a mental illness whereby she must be given specific instructions at all times as to what to do or say; otherwise, she will be crippled by indecision and unable to do anything for herself. If she is not given instructions, she will constantly ask what she should do. Her father has hired several maids to look after her but they always resign, as they cannot deal with Mayumi's incessant questioning.

name: Nico Kashiwagi
description: Nico is a singer and songwriter. Impressed by Tatsuhiko Hirayama's first published piece on animation, she asks him to animate a music video for her.

name: Tatsuhiko Hirayama
description: Tatsuhiko is a college student, independent animator, and former bass guitarist for the now defunct punk band Chic. Impressed by his first published piece of animation, which becomes an overnight sensation, musician Nico Kashiwagi asks him to animate a music video for her.

name: Luck Franzen
native: ラック・ロック・フランゼン
description:
An S-rank adventurer who told his teammates to leave him behind after monsters attack in a dungeon. He comes back ten years later, now younger, having beat all the monsters in the cave. Upon his return, he discovers he was made a hero and has had a statue erected of himself in the middle of the royal capital.

He meets up with his old friends, deciding to start over again, as an F-rank Adventurer, named Lock. He joins up with two other F-rank adventures, one a fireball caster, Ario, and an archer, Genie. Along the way he also meets a B-rank Adventurer, Sia.

appearsIn.title: I Became a Legend after My 10 Year-Long Last Stand

name: Eric Mendirival
native: エリック・イムガルト・メンディリバル
description: Former leader of the Hero Party, Eric was born a chosen one from the royal family. His swordsmanship is S-rank, and his holy sword is SS-rank. After Luck's sacrifice, he was elected king for his achievements in defeating the demon army. He used his wealth and prestige to erect a statue of Luck and to spread word of his heroics around the country.

appearsIn.title: I Became a Legend after My 10 Year-Long Last Stand

name: Goran Morton
description: Former S-ranked member of the Hero Party, Goran is an exceptionally strong fighter who can use fire magic with his greatsword. He is the current grandmaster of the Adventurer's Guild and the strongest warrior still active. Surprisingly, he's also very dexterous and does all of the housework.

appearsIn.title: I Became a Legend after My 10 Year-Long Last Stand

name: Celliss Morton
description:
[Goran’s](https://anilist.co/character/376524/Goran-Morton) only daughter. Although an F-rank warrior, her skills and combat abilities inherited from her father make her the equivalent to a B-rank. 

Also inherited her father’s personality, as she mistook Luck for his illegitimate son when she first met him. After learning the truth, she became Lock’s (self-proclaimed) first disciple.

appearsIn.title: I Became a Legend after My 10 Year-Long Last Stand

name: Sia Wolcott
description: A B-ranked warrior. As the daughter of the wolf beastmen’s chieftain, she is skilled with hunting vampires, as their allure doesn’t work on beastmen.

appearsIn.title: I Became a Legend after My 10 Year-Long Last Stand

name: Nina Tulle
description: She's Eina's younger sister and a student of the School District. She is the leader of the 3rd Squad of Baldr Class.

appearsIn.title: Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon?

name: Yuusuke Fujisaki
description:
__School:__ Kaimei High School 
__Class:__ 2-C (chapters 1-209); 3-C  (chapters 210-288)
__Affiliation:__ Sket Dan
__Special Attack:__ Fujisaki Valencia

The founder and leader of the Sket Dan, nicknamed Bossun (ボッスン).

Bossun is known for his enthusiasm for helping others solve their problems and is quite idealistic. Given a proper backstory and relationship to his client, he's willing to go to such lengths to find even lost candy wrappers if the situation calls it. Despite his idealism, he acts childlike and is socially awkward, especially with female interactions and being filmed. One particular trait is his inability to pick up even the most obvious social cues, and he becomes easily depressed and self-conscious when insulted or being left out.

When left with nothing to do, Bossun normally would laze around or play jokes. Typically, his activities range from childlike behavior like playing with toys to being bored and reading manga. If faced with a strange situation, such with weird clients, he sometimes plays as the straight man with [Himeko](https://anilist.co/character/17245/Hime-Onizuka), and he may initially refuse the request if it's too absurd. Despite this, Sket Dan always accepts the request eventually.

Regardless of his shortcomings, Bossun is deeply analytical when facing problems and has no trouble thinking about plans.

name: Hime Onizuka
description:
__School:__ Kaimei High School
__Class:__ 2-C (chapters 1-209); 3-C (chapters 210-288)
__Affiliation:__ Sket Dan
__Weapons:__ Hockey Sticks (Valkyrie, Cyclone, Kunpuumaru)

Himeko is the violent "yankee"-girl with a soft spot for cute things. She is the fighter/brawn and tsukkomi to the Sket Dan. In her past she was called "Legendary Yankee Onihime (鬼姫)" which became a symbol of "power and fear". Himeko seems to now have "calmed down" from her days of being the Onihime and has become the second-chief to the Sket Dan.

name: Sasuke Tsubaki
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm
__School:__ Kaimei High School 
__Class:__ 2-F (chapters 1-209), 3-C (chapters 210-288)

He is the vice president of Kaimei High School's student council.

He has a strict personality when it comes to people abiding to the rules. He is also strong when fighting especially in close combat, but only displays such brutality when needed. He takes great responsibility for his actions, has a great sense of justice, and is shown to dislike foul play. Though he has a stiff attitude, he is also shown to be very caring especially towards his friends. His stiff composure can be interrupted when others tease him and when he competes with [Bossun](https://anilist.co/character/17244/).

name: Soujirou Agata
description:
__School:__ Kaimei High School (chapters 1-205); National Tokyo University (chapters 205-288)
__Class:__ 3-A (chapters 1-205)

He is the president of Kaimei High School's student council. 

A very charismatic, laid-back individual, who seemingly does nothing as President. He entrusts most responsibilities to the Vice President, [Sasuke Tsubaki](https://anilist.co/character/19462/Sasuke-Tsubaki). His IQ is around 160. His ability to read and understand people is used to manipulate them to do what he wants, such as motivating Bossun into competing with him seriously. This same ability is why he has the complete loyalty of Student Council members, Sasuke and [Daisy](https://anilist.co/character/38995/Kikuno-Asahina). His performance in the Gachinko Vivage Battle's "Pixie Garden" match with Bossun shows that he is a good strategist, who learns quickly, and is adept at lying. He has a tendency to forget things he's said, such as the bet he pretended to make with Bossun to get him fired up.  Despite his keen observation skills and ability to plan ahead, his ability to think rationally becomes compromised when [Saaya Agata](https://anilist.co/character/40524/Saaya-Agata) (Soujirou's younger sister) is involved. He is the epitome of an overprotective brother, even going so far as to try and help Saaya's love life (with often disastrous results).

name: Shinba Michiru
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm
__School:__  Kaimei High School; Private Institution Meikyou University
__Class:__ 3-C

He is the manager of general affairs for Kaimei High School's student council.

He is generally a calm person who serves as a balance in the student council. He can cook at a professional level and tends to think of himself as a ladies' man. He has an extremely low tolerance for alcohol – so much so that even just the smell of it can make him drunk.

name: Kikuno Asahina
description:
__Height:__ 163 cm 
__School:__ Kaimei High School 
__Class:__ 2-G (chapters 1-209), 3-C (chapters 210-288)

She is the secretary of Kaimei High School's student council.

As described by Switch, Daisy is generally a girl who is the embodiment of cool and calm. She retains her intimidating atmosphere no matter what emotions she states she feels. Often, when upset, she grabs a plush toy and repeatedly rubs and mutters into it. She also seems to favor collecting said stuffed toys. She does not like asking for help and this causes some unwanted trouble. It is somewhat cured, however, because now she occasionally asks Tsubaki for help. She blames herself and does not like it when people get hurt.

She has an unusual habit of destroying or damaging anything that 'irritates' her, often causing the rest of the Students Council members to restrain her from doing so. She often pokes people's eyes when she is angry, irritated, or embarrassed

name: Mimori Unyuu
description:
__Height:__ 154 cm 
__School:__ Kaimei High School
__Class:__  2-F (chapters 1-209); 3-C (chapters 210-288) 

She is the treasurer of Kaimei High School's student council.

Mimori comes across as a rather flighty young woman. She is almost always smiling and also seems a bit bad at reading the atmosphere. As she is from a very wealthy family, she often tries to solve problems using money. She honestly doesn't believe it to be showing off, however, and thinks it perfectly normal to completely refurnish the girls' restrooms, draw lots using solid gold sticks, and refurnish walls with gold plating. Despite her frivolous use of money, Mimori is still very polite and possibly the only main character who speaks using keigo.

name: Kiri Katou
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm 
__School:__ Kaimei High School
__Class:__  1-D (chapters 1-209); 2-? (chapters 210-288) 

He is a first year student at Kaimei High School who is descended from real ninja. He becomes the General Affairs Manager for the student council after [Michiru](https://anilist.co/character/27404/) steps down.

He likes doing things on his own or with his own way and hates taking orders from others. He has a tendency to speak bluntly and act spontaneously. After he acknowledges [Tsubaki](https://anilist.co/character/19462/), he becomes fiercely protective of the latter and less adamant about working alone, now choosing to follow whatever Tsubaki wants him to do, which includes working together with the rest of the Student Council.

name: Hani Usami
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm
__School:__ Kaimei High School
__Class:__ 1-B (chapters 1-209); 2-? (chapters 210-288) 

She is a first year student at Kaimei High School who takes over as treasurer of the student council after Mimori becomes vice president.

She has a personality disorder where she has two personalities: one who hates men (Usami), and one who hates women (Bunny). In her Usami mode, she is very reserved and does not answer to men directly. Compared to her Bunny mode, she is very promiscuous. It is possible to swap her personalities by having a man touch her to activate Bunny mode or having a woman touch her to activate Usami mode.

name: Reika Inukai
description: Haruma's friend and crush since their high school days. He's long suppressed his feelings for her once she started going out with Shuuji, but has continued to keep in touch with the couple long into adulthood.

name: Haruma Sakuraba
description: An average salaryman who leads a dull life.  He holds a big inferiority complex due to being compared to his former next door neighbor, Shuuji, his whole life.

name: Shuuji Inukai
description: Haruma's childhood friend whom he's always been compared to by his environment, and the source of his inferiority complex.

name: Takumi Ebihara
description: A world famous painter. Acquainted with Reika.

name: Kai Itoigawa
description: Miyu's childhood friend and a former underclassman of Reika and Haruma from highschool. He was a friend of Shuuji.

name: Miyu Shirato
description: Kai's childhood friend, she's a strong supporter and close friend of Reika. Due to petty reasons, she has a low opinion of Haruma.

name: Yoshiko Kamoshita
description: Haruma's coworker at his new job. Has a mysterious connection to Shuuji.

name: Qing Chu
description:
__Age:__ Unknown
__Species:__ Spiritual Human
__Eye Color:__ Gold
__Hair Color:__: Brown
__Cultivation Type:__ Golden Freedom

300 years ago, Qing entered the fairy world where he became a sword expert cultivator. As he was nearing the realm of eternity, he went through the hall of time and space and returned to Earth at the age of 17. However, it isn't the world he knew but a world where the gender roles we're reversed both in a mental and physical aspect, because of this fact he became angered and is trying to make his way back home to the world he knows.

appearsIn.title: Sword King In A Women's World

name: Ziyan Tang
description:
__Age:__ Unknown
__Species:__ Human
__Hair Color:__ Pink
__Eye Color:__ Pink

Tang Ziyan is the girlfriend and to be fiancee of Chu Qing after the events with the Li family. Ziyan has a serious competitive attitude but will respect the people who can be considered better than her. She is the next in line to become the Tang family patriarch.

appearsIn.title: Sword King In A Women's World

name: Huahua Chen
description:
__Species:__ Human

Huahua is an information broker. She helps out Chu Qing if he needs any type of info on a person. This leads to them both becoming emotionally invested in one another to the point where she becomes Chu Qing's girlfriend. Huahua is now the technical directer at Chu Qing's mothers company.

appearsIn.title: Sword King In A Women's World

description:
__Age:__ Unknown
__Species:__ Human
__Hair Color:__ Black
__Eye Color:__ Orange/Yellow

Chenxi is born as the second daughter to Qingmei in the Ye family and is next in line to become the patriarch to the Ye family. (One of the big three families). She is one of Chu Qing's girlfriends and hold him close to her heart.

appearsIn.title: Sword King In A Women's World

name: Meng Zui
description:
Zui is the Founder and Owner of Drunken Dreams. She's one of the 10 Great Experts in Jinmen City.
Later on, by signing a marriage certificate, Zui becomes Chu Qing's wife. They might be expecting a child soon. She had Qing's family brought to live in her company.

appearsIn.title: Sword King In A Women's World

name: Zhai  Yu
description:
__Age:__ Unknown
__Species:__ Human
__Hair Color:__ Grey
__Eye Color:__ Gold

Yu is the successor of Shizhen Auction House. He meets Chu Qing who introduces him to his golden spiritual rock to put up for auction. He is a member of the Zhai family and manages the auction house, due to the bond shared from countless transactions with Chu Qing, Yu helps out whenever he is asked to, be it physical or financial.

appearsIn.title: Sword King In A Women's World

name: Xiao Chu
description:
__Species:__ Human
__Hair Color:__ Pink/Grey
__Eye Color:__ Brown

Chu Xiao is the biological elder sister to Chu Qing, She is considered lazy and lets herself get in debt where she is held at ransom so Chu Qing has to save her on multiple occasions. Xiao becomes an employee at the Ye family pharmaceutical company as to stay out of trouble and pay back her debts.

appearsIn.title: Sword King In A Women's World

name: Ephtal
description:
This is the current Ephtal, who has been reincarnated twice. He has set his sights on the path of magic and is aiming to enroll in a magic academy.

He retains the memories and magical prowess from his previous life 400 years ago as the Sage and Thunder God Emperor Ephtal; his power is so extraordinary that it would be called a “miracle” by modern standards. However, just as in his past life, he lacks a natural aptitude for magic. Yet he possesses a passion more single-minded than anyone else’s, striving to overcome this handicap through hard work and determination.

While kind to others, he detests dishonesty and is a man with a passionate heart, deeply committed to duty and compassion.

appearsIn.title: From Overshadowed to Overpowered: Second Reincarnation of a Talentless Sage

name: Anastasia
description: A young girl who was rescued by Ephtal while being subjected to unjust treatment as a slave, and who ends up joining him on his journey. She is reserved but strong-willed, and refers to Ephtal—who saved her—as “Lord Ephtal,” placing deep trust in him. She possesses a talent for magic that even he acknowledges, but due to her background and circumstances, she harbors a secret she cannot reveal. She quietly matures as she watches Ephtal’s back.

appearsIn.title: From Overshadowed to Overpowered: Second Reincarnation of a Talentless Sage

name: Merlin
description:
After the Demon King was defeated, she was found by Ephtal in the Demon King’s castle—which was on the verge of collapse—and raised by him from infancy. As her background suggests, she is a descendant of the Demon King’s clan. She possesses exceptional aptitude for water and wind magic, and is both hardworking and highly ambitious. As his top disciple, she deeply admires Ephtal and often takes reckless actions out of concern for his safety.

As a faculty member at the Magic Academy, she instructs her students rigorously, yet she understands her master’s ideals and resolve better than anyone else and continues to support him on his path as a mage.

appearsIn.title: From Overshadowed to Overpowered: Second Reincarnation of a Talentless Sage

Kishou Arima is a famed Special Class Ghoul Investigator known as the CCG's Reaper. He is undefeated as a Ghoul Investigator and at some point was formerly partnered with [Take Hirako](https://anilist.co/character/136023/Hirako-Take).

His investigative skills and prowess in combat has led many investigators such as [Koutarou Amon](https://anilist.co/character/88407/Koutarou-Amon) to admire him.

name: Aki Sasada
description:
(Jack), 32 (Tokyo Ghoul:re)

Aki is the childhood friend of Taishi and Ryou's girlfriend.

name: Uruka Minami
description: Minami Uruka is a second-year student at Seishin Senior High School. She is a classmate of Kishou Arima and Taishi Fura.

name: Yakumo Oomori
description: A white-haired brute with sharp lizard eyes. Yamori is ghoul who is as scary as he looks. Normally in a entirely white suit and black dress shirt, he resembles a typical gangster.

name: Itsuki Marude
description: Itsuki is a Special Class Ghoul Investigator. He is the commander of the 11th Ward Special Countermeasures Unit and Chief of Division II.

name: Ryou
description: Ryou was the childhood friend of Taishi Fura and Aki Sasada.

name: Nimura
description: Part of a military helicopter crew. He and his crew were separated from their group while heading out for a mission. While searching for supplies and fuel in an abandoned town, they come across Teru and Ako.

name: Iwada
description: Part of a military helicopter crew. He is the pilot of the helicopter. He and his crew were separated from their group while heading out for a mission. While searching for supplies and fuel in an abandoned town, they come across Teru and Ako.

name: Teru Aoki
description: After watching a bright light in the horizon, the train where he and the rest of his classmates are riding, has a terrible accident.  Only three survive!  Teru desperatly clings to hope that someone will come to save them , but when help doesn't arrive, he decides to search for his own way out, having to deal with the ever-growing insane Nobou and the injured Ako.

name: Ako Seto
description: One of the three survivors form the train crash. She is injured from the crash, and Teru is the one to take care of her.

name: Nobuo Takahashi
description: After the train crash, Nobuo, Teru, and Ako are the only survivors. Loosing himself in the desperation of being alone and the darkness that consumes the place, completed with the help that never comes, Nobuo gets crazier by the minute.

name: Ooike
description: Part of a military helicopter crew. He and his crew were separated from their group while heading out for a mission. While searching for supplies and fuel in an abandoned town, they come across Teru and Ako.

name: Yamazaki
description: Part of a military helicopter crew. He and his crew were separated from their group while heading out for a mission. While searching for supplies and fuel in an abandoned town, they come across Teru and Ako.

name: Chinatsu  Miura
description: The youngest of the three Miura brothers. An elementary school student. His joy and childish innocence brings the brothers together and lifts their spirits. Despite his happy exterior, the family's financial situation still troubles Chinatsu, but he tries to hide his sadness from his brothers.

name: Chiaki Miura
description:
The eldest of the three Miura brothers and the protagonist. He takes on the responsibility of taking care of his siblings following their father's death. After several failed attempts to find employment, fate seems to be on Chiaki's side when he receives a job offer from a mysterious man on his way to an interview. Unbeknownst to Chiaki, this job would take him on the strangest adventure of his life. 
He cares deeply for his brothers and will do absolutely anything to make sure they are happy.

name: Chiharu Miura
description: The second oldest brother of the Miura family. A serious middle school student who speaks his mind freely. He is frustrated with the poverty he and his brothers live in and with Chiaki's inability to find a job. According to Chiaki, he worries much more than a middle schooler should.

name: Jelly E. Fish
native: ジェリー・E・フィッシュ
description:
One of the top members of SILF. 

A woman shrouded in mystery who is very protective of her identity. She is normally cool and collected, but wastes no time in punishing those who go against her or stand in her way. She is almost never seen without her electronic cigarette.

name: Nagisa Ooshima
description:
A member of the National Police's Justice Department and professional Hero. She has incredible strength and is an avid drinker. 
Despite the implications of her job title, she acts cruelly towards whoever she views as an enemy. This causes some to question her mental stability.

name: Tadano Hyoichiro
description:
A Chief of Intelligence for the Administrative Section of Justice's 2nd Department, a program set up by the National Police's Department of Defense. He is the one that finally gives Chiaki an employment opportunity. 
A idealistic man with a strong sense of justice, duty, and punishment. He is also very perverted, but he prefers to keep this hidden.

name: Pao Asahiyama
description:
One of the members of SILF's Team #7. A person that has a "special ability."

He cares a lot about those who are close to him, such as his fellow team members, but has a very intimidating aura around those who threaten him or his allies. He has a strong moral compass despite being a part of SILF. 

Ends all of his sentences with "pao."

name: Ryuu Hoshi
description:
The leader of SALF's Team #7 who believes wholeheartedly in the shady organization's core mission. 
A confident man who's suave personality proves to be a mere facade. Women, beware.

name: Jun Mihono
description: A cute, cheerful girl who moved into the same apartment as Chiaki and his brothers. She is a huge fan of cosplay. Despite her exterior, she exudes a creepy aura that might spell trouble for Chiaki...

name: Bartender
description:
The owner and bartender of Chiaki's favorite yakitori restaurant. He is a kind man who doesn't hesitate to help out his loyal customers. His actual name has not yet been specified.
Bald. Looks strikingly similar to Bruce Willis.

name: Yuning Xia
description:
__Eye Color:__ Blue
__Hair Color:__ Silver
__Martial Arts:__ Dragon Martial Arts
She is the daughter of the Northern Guardian Lord. Her title of "Princess" was stripped from her after partaking in dishonourable behaviour with  Xinghe during the fighting tournament. As such she has now become a part of the Azure feather family in Blue Carp Town.

name: Shangguan Xuan
description:
__Race:__ Demon+
__Eye Color:__ Green
__Hair Color:__ Black
__Martial Arts:__ Unknown

She is the mentor of Ye Xinghe and has reached the Celestial realm of cultivation which mean her lifespan has been  prolonged. Shangguan Xuan helps Ye Xinghe in his effort to break through the 9th Heavenly Realm of cultivation.

name: Xueyun An
description:
Eye Color: Brown
Hair Color: Brown
Martial Arts: Flame Martial Arts

In the Heavenly Academy, she tries to protect Ye Xinghe against the bullying by Liang Yu. Since she is of noble origins she is initially coveted by Liang Yu amongst all the other students there. She scores second on the entry exam in terms of innate magic power and hence becomes a pupil of Vice-Principal Xu together with Ye Xinghe and Liang Yu. She states to Vice Principal Xu that her ambition is to roam free among the land unfettered by familial affairs.

She slowly becomes passionate with regards to Ye Xinghe but because of her pre-existing arranged marriage, she sometimes tries to deny her own feelings about it and is ambivalent about the situation. Her best friend and confidant is Xia Yuning a princess which is the daughter of the Lord of the Northern Mansion (responsible for the security of that border of the Zhou Empire).

name: Yu Liang
description:
__Eye Color__: Purple
__Hair Color__: Black
__Martial Art__: Flame Martial Arts

As a member of the Dark Moon Family he starts out bossing around other students the moment he arrives at the academy. He considers his clan's lineage to be superior to the commoners there. He takes a particular hard stance against Ye XingHe since he belongs to a vassal clan of his family. So he basically demands Ye XingHe to  bow down to him. An order which Ye XingHe defies against the feudal tradition.

name: Yu Ming
description: She is an eminent swordsman.

name: Itsuki Akiba
description: Loud, reckless, and shameless, and seems to be a complete opposite of Iori, including her affinity towards wearing boyish clothing and having a short haircut.

name: Izumi Isozaki
description: Izumi Isozaki is two years younger than the other characters and is very much like Itsuki Akiba. However, she isn't as shy in expressing her emotions, especially her love for Ichitaka Seto. In fact, she announces her love to pretty much everyone she knows. Also, she's more daring and is quite superstitious when it comes to love. She constantly tails Seto, and on more than one occasion, had tried to seduce Seto to go to bed with her in order to prove her love. Izumi persists in attempting to obtain Seto's love and says that she will try whatever it takes to get him to be with her. She is introduced half-way through the manga, where she meets Seto on the beach on their summer vacation, and after that, she discovers that they go to the same school. She falls for Seto after he defends her from her overly-aggressive boyfriend, and tricks him into going on dates throughout the series. She is determined that he is her soulmate, and she wants him to be her boyfriend.

name: Ichitaka Seto
description: Seto has a shy nature. Due to past experiences with girls he is afraid to tell the one true girl he loves how he feels. As the years go by, Iori and himself become better friends but nothing more. With the help of his good friend Teratani, Seto hopes to one day change that and win Iori over forever.

name: Iori Yoshizuki
description: Iori is prim, proper, and friendly, not to mention gorgeous. She's a young lady who's easy to like and get along with.

name: Nami Tachiba
description: Nami is a classmate of Ichitaka, Iori, Teratani, and others, and is generally the mood-maker of the group whenever they are all together on a trip, school project, etc. She is very energetic and cheerful and loves to express herself, though her tomboyish and carefree attitude can make others feel awkward at times. She comes from a very rich family, as it is evident halfway through the manga when the group comes over to her house to organize a group project. Some interpret her as a  female pervert, since she has tried to get people to sleep together and has shown off her body numerous times.

name: Yasumasa Teratani
description: He is Ichitaka's best friend who seems to think himself a pro with the opposite gender despite his somewhat nerdy appearance and lack of success with girls. He is often found giving Seto encouragement and good advice. Though sometimes his help is unwarranted and sometimes ends up in a bad situation, he means well with his actions and is bummed when Seto doesn't succeed. Ichitaka spends a considerable amount of time through the story continuing to ask for advice, but as the story progresses he learns to not rely so heavily on him. He is generally interpreted as well-meaning but is also a jerk and a pervert, and not exactly the smartest person in the series.

name: Marionette King
description: A former senior in Ichitaka's high school, he is the main recurring villain of the manga. A sexual deviant, he tries to take advantage of Iori no less than three times throughout the manga with various schemes, but is foiled by Ichitaka every single time. After his unsuccessful first attempt he is expelled from the school, after his second attempt he becomes a drug addict on the verge of insanity, and plays a major role in the manga's final story arc. "Marionette King" is his Internet handle, and his real name is never mentioned in the manga (although in the Is Pure OVA, his real name is finally mentioned - Samejima).

name: Aiko Asou
description: Although her name does not begin with an "I", the "Ai" from "Aiko" represents an "i" sound in Japanese, indirectly marking her as an "i."  She is Gemini, quite ditzy, scatterbrained, and is prone to losing or misplacing her possessions, but is also very nice, kind, and unbelievably cheerful, even in bad situations. She also has an uncanny resemblance to Iori Yoshizuki, save for a mole under her left eye. Her close resemblance to Iori causes Seto some complications when she is introduced three-quarters of the way through the manga. She, as well as Seto, fall in love with one another at a later point after they meet. Asou realizes this is a potential problem for Seto and decides to move away in order to keep Seto's and Iori's love intact.  One of the series' running gags is the odd similarities between the women who get in the way of Ichitaka being with Iori. Not only do they all have I names (or AI in the case of Aiko Asou), but they all appear very similar in appearance. Izumi looks like Iori when she has long hair and like Itsuki when she has cut it short. Aiko also looks like Iori but this time more of a near perfect double with the exception of a mole on her cheek.

name: Jun Koshinae
description: He is a friend from Ichitaka's class. He is first introduced in Volume 4, during a school trip to Kyoto, when he is paired with Iori. At first he appears to be a threat to Ichitaka, for he seems to be in love with Iori, but eventually, it turns out that he is a homosexual and is in love with Higemi-sensei, their teacher. Because Higemi-sensei is paired with Ichitaka, Koshinae requests for a trade, bringing the happy Ichitaka back to his crush. From that point on, Jun becomes one of Ichitaka's best friends, and an important listener when he isn't comforted with the advices he got from Teratani. Though he hates physical aggression, he is a very adept martial artist when need be.

name: Yuuka Morisaki
description: Yuka is another classmate of Ichitaka/Iori's, and along with Nami, is one of Iori's closest friends. Though she doesn't stand out too much among the rest of the group, she seems to be the only one that Iori can talk deeply to about her issues in life. She (to everyone's surprise) develops a crush on Teratani halfway through the manga, though when he ends up rejecting her those feelings turns into that of contempt. She doesn't exactly hate Ichitaka, but is put off by his timidness. In the end, she supports him all the way.

name: Chiemi Honda
description: Nobuaki's girlfriend who helps him on several occasions.

name: Nobuaki Kanazawa
description: Nobuaki acts always trying to help others, was the first to try to end the game finding Ousama, always doing everything to help his best friend and his girlfriend.

name: Yuki  Ichihara
description: Yuki is a college student. She acts, behaves and dresses as a boy which is why she is usually mistaken for a boy.

name: Shou Nemoto
description: An old friend of Yoshiki (Yuki).

name: Rina Okamoto
description: Rina Okamoto is a talkative first-year high school student and the youngest among the game participants. She seems to recognize [Shinomiya's](https://anilist.co/character/42138/Ryuhei-Shinomiya) face, though the reason is unclear.

name: Hiroyuki Sakurai
description: Hiroyuki Sakurai is the being of "Envy", represented by the rabbit. Due to a series of events, a lie from two years ago leads him to accidentally kill his own brother, something he deeply regrets. He is then drawn into the game of Judge, where he struggles to find a way for everyone to survive. Despite his sin, Hiroyuki has a strong sense of justice and tends to face problems head-on without much thought.

name: Ryuhei Shinomiya
description:
Ryuhei Shinomiya is a short-tempered and violent freeter who constantly maintains an intimidating attitude.

He is a freelancer. In the game, he wears a horse mask.

name: Hayato Takizawa
description: Hayato Takizawa is always calm and composed, analyzing situations carefully. He is a university student enrolled in the law faculty and is critical of [Hiroyuki’s](https://anilist.co/character/52123/Hiroyuki-Sakurai) actions.

name: Ringo-chan
description: The Student Council President of Sanada East High. She is full of pride and has a short temper. But she is a bit of an airhead, which leads her to getting tricked very easily, like mistaking Karasawa's snoring for a cat's meow and standing on a step ladder in the Sanada North High Student Council Room to connect an internet cable to a intentionally misplaced router just so the Council could look at her panties from underneath. The Sanada North High Student Council has given her the nickname "Ringo-chan." She's actually popular and is usually hit on, much to her ignorance.  (Source: Wikipedia)

appearsIn.title: The Daily Lives of High School Boys

name: Yanagi
description: The bespectacled and tomboyish girl of the group. She is good academically and proficient in karate. Full of crazy ideas and prone to violent outbursts. She was once part of the elementary school's strongest warriors to fight against Archdemon. After the battle, she was selected to monitor Habara.  (Source: Wikipedia)

appearsIn.title: The Daily Lives of High School Boys

name: Yassan
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm (5'5")  

A girl who wanders the river bank in search of her fated encounter, which is an act followed by her own literature, where she meets a man with the power of wind. She is careless and won't have anyone break her moments when she is in the act. She takes an interest in [Hidenori](https://anilist.co/character/50691) and goes as far as to chase him around the city just to tell him that the boy she was walking with, [Takahiro](https://anilist.co/character/57187), is just a friend.

appearsIn.title: The Daily Lives of High School Boys

name: Toshiyuki Karasawa
description: A classmate who tends to wear a baseball cap. He lives next door to the Funky High School Girls and is a target of their harrassments.

appearsIn.title: The Daily Lives of High School Boys

name: Yoshitake no Ane
description: The faceless, short-hair older sister of Yoshitake who does not get along with her brother. Strong and violent, she is the ringleader of the girls who shave off Motoharu's beard. She is also highly concerned about not getting a boyfriend. She has a crush on Hidenori's older brother, Yuusuke.

appearsIn.title: The Daily Lives of High School Boys

name: Habara
description: One of three main girls of High School Girls Are Funky side-story. She has an older brother.   Called "flat chest" by Yanagin. Attends Sanada West High School, acquainted with Literary Girl. Habara has relatively common sense, often to serve as the straight man of horrendous behavior of Ikushima and Yanagin.   In her childhood she was known as Archdemon, a bully that even male students feared. Therefore, to beat Archdemon a group was formed by the children who could withstand her violence. At the end of the fierce battle everyone along with Archdemon was beaten except the masked kid, Rubber Shooter. Habara lost her bloodlust when she was beaten and Yanagin was forced to watch over her so she wouldn't go back on a rampage. She's very remorseful of what she did when she was young.   It is implied that Habara is still dangerous.

appearsIn.title: The Daily Lives of High School Boys

name: Kim Bu-Jang
description: Kim Bujang, also known as Code 66, is a retired military man and a father to Minji Kim.

name: Min-Ji Kim
description: The daughter of Kim Bu-Jang.

name: Yo-Han Seong
description: He was a childhood friend of Mira and Zack, as well as the leader of God Dog.

name: Han-Su Seong
description: [Tae-Hun's](https://anilist.co/character/193930/TaeHoon-Seong) father

name: Jin-Cheol Park
description: Father of Da-Bin Park.

name: Juugo
description: Juugo is the largest of the three members that comprise Sasuke Uchiha's new team, Snake (which is now Hawk). Juugo was being held at Orochimaru's North Base, which is also where most of Orochimaru's secret research was conducted. Suigetsu can't stand Juugo and comments that one of the reasons he had to retrieve Zabuza Momochi's sword was because of him. Karin notes that Juugo is mentally unstable, a view confirmed by images of Juugo muttering to himself over who he will kill next, which he determines by gender.  Juugo is the means behind Orochimaru's development of the cursed seals. Sometime in the past, Juugo purposely sought out Orochimaru to cure him of his "impulses". Juugo has trouble controlling his rage, which unexpectedly causes him to transform into a berserk demon (much like a cursed seal does to its user). Upon examination, Orochimaru was able to isolate enzymes in Juugo's blood as the cause of this change.

appearsIn.title: Naruto: The Seventh Hokage and the Scarlet Spring

name: Shin Uchiha
description: The clones of [Shin Uchiha](https://anilist.co/character/129323) are named after him.

appearsIn.title: Naruto: The Seventh Hokage and the Scarlet Spring

name: Karin
description:
__Height:__ 162.6 cm (II)

Karin is a former subordinate of Orochimaru who assisted him in his experimentations and was left in charge of one of his bases while he was away; and was also the only one loyal to Orochimaru to remain even though his current status is questionable. Sasuke Uchiha recruits her as a member of Snake. While Sasuke admits she may be troublesome, he also notes that her special abilities make her useful. She also seems to have a liking for Sasuke, implying to Sasuke that a team consisting of the two of them would be much better than one with Suigetsu or Jugo. Suigetsu noted that something once happened between her and Sasuke though what this means remains unclear, since she punches Suigetsu before he can finish his sentence.  Karin's special ability allows her to track specific individuals through chakra, seen when she is able to discern that Jugo is not among a crowd of prisoners through the standard concentration pose for molding chakra. It also allows her to pick up chakra from long distances and notice changes in an individual's chakra.

She has a small chest and likes to grope boobs. She met [Harumi](https://anilist.co/character/136405/Harumi-Hana) on a rainy day when she lent her an umbrella.

description: First year student in the same school as [Chiaki](https://anilist.co/character/136404/Ichihara-Chiaki). They both are in the Archery club. She is the neighbor and childhood friend of [Touka Momose](https://anilist.co/character/136407/Momose-Touka).

description: A classmate of [Chiaki](https://anilist.co/character/136404/Ichihara-Chiaki). After witnessing [Hana](https://anilist.co/character/136405/Harumi-Hana)'s and Chiaki secret groping sessions once, she developed a habit of voyeurism and liking of girl-girl relationships.

name: Touka Momose
description: She is the classmate of [Hana](https://anilist.co/character/136405/Harumi-Hana). She appears to be a refined lady, but in secret, she likes small boobs. She has a crush on [Kana Kashiwagi](https://anilist.co/character/136406/Kashiwagi-Kana), who is her childhood friend and neighbor. Considers [Chiaki](https://anilist.co/character/136404/Ichihara-Chiaki) a threat and a rival because of Kana's admiration towards her upperclassman.

description: [Hana Harumi](https://anilist.co/character/136405/Harumi-Hana)'s mom. She has had an instant crush on [Chiaki](https://anilist.co/character/136404/Ichihara-Chiaki), when she visited Hana. She has mistaken Chiaki for Hana's lover and seems to be fine with Hana having Chiaki as a romantic partner.

appearsIn.title: Breasts Are My Favorite Things in the World!

description: [Chiaki Ichihara](https://anilist.co/character/136404/Ichihara-Chiaki)'s cousin. She is a sculptor who is famous for creating beautiful breasts.

description: Professor in charge of the Summoning Department.

description: Phoenix, one of the three mythical beasts.

appearsIn.title: The Legendary Hero is an Academy Honors Student

name: Fiora
description: Phoenix, Firina's daughter.

appearsIn.title: The Legendary Hero is an Academy Honors Student

name: Leina Plove
description: Leo's mother and the lady of the House of Plove. After losing her powers in an accident, she abandoned the Zerdinger name and left the family, wishing to live a normal life. Before losing her powers, she was known as the "Flame Witch". She is the current owner of the "Flame Storm" weapon, which Celia possesses.

appearsIn.title: The Legendary Hero is an Academy Honors Student

name: Chloe Mueller
description: A student from the Northern Magic Tower, she ranked first in the Northern region during the entrance exam.

appearsIn.title: The Legendary Hero is an Academy Honors Student

name: Eliza Hergin
description: Heir to the House of Hergin, a powerful heroic family in the northern part of the continent.

appearsIn.title: The Legendary Hero is an Academy Honors Student

name: Happy
description: Happy is an Akita dog and the narrator of the first part of the story. As a puppy, he is left in a box on the side of the road and picked up by Miku, who names him "Happy" and pleads with her parents to keep him. After several years of living with the family, the father sets out on a roadtrip and takes Happy with him. Happy enjoys the times when he and father go out on walks and father talks to him.

name: Otou-san
description: Father is an older man who agrees to his daughter's pleas to keep the newfound puppy, Happy. Despite having chronic heart issues, he still smokes; it is hinted that his eyesight is deteriorating as well. As Miku grows up, rifts appear in the family due to the father's illness and his detached approach towards their lives, culminating in an impromptu road trip with Happy after his wife demands a divorce.

name: Soujirou Yui
description: He is a skilled swordsman and talented at whatever he sets his mind to. But he lacks self-confidence and has a low self esteem .

name: Chiyo
description: She has a dignified face but when she is facing Soujirou her face slips up . Moreover, she has good athletic abilities .

name: Makoto Koga
description: A high school student who confesses his feelings to Meguro-san . He is senior to Meguro-san by a year

name: Kanzo Mogi
description:
One of the most dedicated members of the investigation team. Little else is known of him. 

He remains mostly silent. This silence is marked when he refuses to answer Near's questions about the Japanese Investigative Team, even when he is clearly affected by the theories that Near was presenting to him.

name: Hideki Ide
description: Hideki Ide is one of the few police officers who remains with [Souichirou Yagami](https://anilist.co/character/1927/Souichirou-Yagami) during the Kira Investigation. However, he swiftly leaves when begins to disagree with L's methods of investigation.

name: Stephen Loud
description:
Stephen works for Near as part of his investigation team, along with Lidner and Rester, and later plays an important role in stopping Kira. When suspicions arise towards Mikami, Near assigns Gevanni the task of following him, studying his methodic lifestyle, and finding his connections to the Death Note. Before the final showdown with Light at the warehouse, Near has Gevanni steal both the fake and real Death Notes from Mikami, and tampers one of the fake's pages. 

He also creates another fake, replacing the real one, that is later used as Light's ultimate downfall, and ends up being Near's key to proving Light's identity as Kira. While looking for the SPK members's real names, Mikami views his real name as Stephen Loud through his Shinigami Eyes.  

In the one-shot chapter set three years after Light's death, while he didn't have any speaking lines and much any involvement in the short story, he did appear in one panel alongside Rester and Lidner. This suggests that he may still be working with them under the new L, Near

name: Youko Akimoto
description: Youko is Haru's mother. She remarried and took her new husband's last name.

name: Rio
description: Rio is an acquaintance of Rui's.

name: Mogari Shishikuno
description:
__Height:__ 174 cm

While unable to see ghosts, Mogari has the ability to forcibly exorcise them by consuming them. By touching or being touched by another person with spiritual powers, like [Kaoru](https://anilist.co/character/328366/Kanzaki-Kaoru) or [Koutarou](https://anilist.co/character/328365/Tamon-Koutarou), he can temporarily borrow their own spiritual abilities and share that gift among those who are spiritually sensitive. Hailing from a lineage of spiritual mediums, he had to choose between training in the Akita Mountains or enhancing his skills by exorcising spirits in Kamakura. Opting for Kamakura, he sought a youthful experience.

name: Eugene Korekishi
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm

Since childhood, Eugene was hailed as a prodigy by those around him. He deeply admires his grandmother, who treated him as the only normal child among them. However, because of his grandmother's promise to return to him as a ghost to meet him after her death remains unfulfilled, Eugene has firmly decided not to believe in ghosts.

name: Kaoru Kanzaki
description:
__Height:__ 171 cm

Since childhood, Kaoru has had a natural ability to see spirits, leading to distressing encounters as these spirits latch onto him upon realizing his gift. To ward them off, he deliberately changes his appearance by dyeing his hair and adopting a flashy style. He's an otaku at heart, with 'Slam Dunk' holding the status of a life bible for him.

name: Koutarou Tamon
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm

Tamon possesses the unique ability to solely hear spirits' voices. His spiritual gift has led to discomfort among regular humans, making it difficult for him to maintain eye contact and causing physical unease. Conversely, he can hold ordinary conversations with unseen spirits whose voices he hears. He opts for peaceful exorcism by conversing with spirits he can communicate with.

name: Charles De Noir Mamoru
native: シャルル・ド・ノワール・守
description: Charles De Noir Mamoru is the advisor for the Phantom Busters and a chemistry teacher. He has the appearance and behavior of someone with chuunibyou ("eighth-grader syndrome").

name: Sorato Ichimiya
description: Student council president. People around him think of him as a super realist, but he actually loves the occult. When he debuted in high school, he played the role of a clear-headed and cold-hearted character, so now he can't admit that he likes the occult. He recommends Phantom Busters.

name: Yoshiki Nika
description: Yoshiki is a member of the student council and seems to have an important position within it. He is also in competition with [Sunao Usami](https://anilist.co/character/407910/), who he considers his rival.

name: Sunao Usami

name: Nobunaga Oda
aliases: Demon King of the Sixth Heaven
description:
__Height:__ 152cm

Demon Archer is the Archer-class Servant in the Strange Tales of the Imperial Holy Grail of Koha Ace. She is one of the Servants of the Protagonist of the Grand Order conflicts of Fate/Grand Order.

Haughty and self-confident, she possesses a flexible way of thinking that loves new things and is not bound by conservatism and common sense.

name: Souji Okita
description:
__Height:__ 158cm

Sakura Saber is the Saber-class Servant of Kohaku in the Imperial Capital Holy Grail Strange Story of Fate/KOHA-ACE. She is one of the Servants of the Protagonist of the Grand Order conflicts of Fate/Grand Order.

Okita has both the facet of a cool-headed manslayer, as well as a cheerful side that is fond of children. Although she is essentially a cool-headed manslayer, towards those who pardoned that mentality, Okita borders on being openly friendly as if they were members of the same organization. During her lifetime, since she had nearly no relationships in regards to love affairs, she is poor at exchanging conversations in that area.

name: Akagi Kanata
description: Kanata is from a declining magus family. His grandmother possessed Magecraft but kept to herself and eventually died when he was six. His father did not have Magic Circuits, so Kanata was raised as a regular boy, is untrained in magecraft, and does not know much about it.

name: Fujimiya Tsukumo
description: Tsukumo Fujimiya is a magus participating in the Imperial Capital Holy Grail Strange Story of Fate/type Redline.

name: Mori Nagayoshi
description:
A warrior from the Warring States period. He was the son of Mori Yoshinari, the esteemed retainer of the Oda Clan, and his younger brother [Mori Naritoshi (Ranmaru)](https://anilist.co/character/256446) was famous as [Oda Nobunaga's](https://anilist.co/character/127210) own attendant.
He was a fierce warrior, and using the skills with a spear he inherited from his father (who was dubbed "Sanza the Attacker"), he ultimately earned the nickname "Oni Musashi" for his many military exploits. 
He was an extremely violent-tempered person.

name: Reiji Magatsu
description: A consultant magus from the Imperial Army, 24 years old. He comes from a family of magi who communicate with spirits.

name: Maxwell no Akuma
native: マックスウェルの悪魔
description: Maxwell's Demon, Class Name Caster, is the Caster-class Servant of the [Fuhrer](https://anilist.co/character/208376) in the Imperial Capital Holy Grail Strange Story of Fate/KOHA-ACE. He is the Servant of [High Priest Makuzu](https://anilist.co/character/259649) in Fate/Grand Order.

name: Li Shuwen
description:
A master of martial arts who fundamentally keeps the morality of the innate goodness of man, but at same time also accepts evil. As a Servant, Shuwen's morality had deviated from the general common sense, but his humanity itself is that of a "sensible person" that esteems rationality. He does not see great difference in justice and evil, but if someone's behavior offends his rationality, he will bring swift and inevitable death. At a first glance this would seems as an act of chivalry, but since the chivalry of China is "pick up a sword out of passion", his way of thinking is the exact opposite. Rather than rational, Li Shuwen's character is something better described as being close to that of modern people. Li Shuwen was someone who simply (not purely) sought for strength, but it has been said that, in his late years, he discovered the valor of the strength of conviction, one's way of life, instead the strength of violence. He acknowledges that he is a kind of professional killer rather than a martial artist, but that is neither a self-depreciation nor a boast. Given that he often learned, often fought and often murdered in his previous life, he really does not carry any regrets or grudges.

Since he was summoned as a Servant, he swings his wicked fists as the concealed weapons of his master Julius without hesitation. He starts to find the Holy Grail War enjoyable as Hakuno and Hakuno's Servants manage to survive his attacks.

name: Lanlan Fang
description:
Lanlan Fang is the Master of Lancer in the Imperial Capital Holy Grail Strange Story of Fate/type Redline.
The Master of Lancer replaces the role of Caren Kotomine in Fate/KOHA-ACE.

name: Overseer
description:
The unnamed Overseer is the individual appointed by the Holy Church to oversee the Holy Grail Wars of Japan in the world of Fate/type Redline.
The Overseer's role of providing information for Tsukumo Fujimiya is similar to that of Ciel in Fate/KOHA-ACE providing information for Akiha Tohno.

name: Tsutomu Mukae

name: Nishimi Kaoru no Chichi
description: Kaoru's father. He's a sailor.

name: Yurika Fukahori
description: Yurika is a sophomore at Higashi High. Though the daughter of a well-to-do family, Yurika has a spunky personality and is brimming with curiosity. Her birthday is February 10th and is in the art and kendo club. She becomes acquainted with Kaoru and the gang after Sentaro helps her out by chance. And then, through them, she meets college student Junichi...

name: Junichi Katsuragi
description: Sentaro idolized Junichi, whom he affectionately calls "Brother Jun". In fact, the friendship between Junichi, Sentaro, and Ritsuko goes way back to when they were kids. "Brother Jun" goes to college in Tokyo now, but whenever he comes home, he always stops in at Welcome Records and jams on the trumpet, playing jazz with Sentaro and whoever else is around.

name: Ikuto Tsumura
description:
Ikuto has aspired to be a fashion designer and self-taught himself since he was at least seven years old, but is forced to put his dream on halt due to his financially struggling family. As the oldest child and only son, Ikuto helps his mother take care of his sisters and handles most of the housework and initially refuses to go college in lieu of full-time employment to support his sisters. After befriending Chiyuki and getting a part-time job at Yanagida's studio, Ikuto begins working towards his dream of being a fashion designer, though his financial situation causes him some setbacks.

Despite not having any formal training or experience, Ikuto is very intuitive, hard-working, and a quick learner with a natural talent as a patternmaker. Ikuto's innate talent puts him on par with older aspiring fashion designers in the college-level Geika festival, though Ikuto is noted to have trouble with designing Haute couture by himself since he is used to making ready-to-wear clothes. While typically humble, polite, and mild-mannered, Ikuto gradually becomes more assertive, confident, less self-sacrificing, and develops a healthy ego as he becomes more involved in the fashion world. Ikuto has a special relationship with Chiyuki, crediting her as the reason for creating the opportunity that allowed him to pursue his dream, and their relationship is rooted in mutual feelings of kinship, respect, support, and friendly rivalry.

name: Chiyuki Fujito
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm (5'2")

A model for her father's company "Mille Neige". While praised to be blessed with good looks, the proper body proportions, and her father's connections and wealth, Chiyuki lacks the minimum height requirement to be a runway model. Despite this, she dreams of being in the Paris Fashion Week as the representative of her father's company and aims to be a top model, regardless of her short height and what other people think of her.

Chiyuki is an energetic, charming, and strong-willed girl who speaks her mind and has a strong competitive spirit, especially when trying to prove her worth as a model to people that are dismissive of her. However, she can also be pushy and selfish at times, though her stubborn and blunt nature can be a source of encouragement and motivation to people like Ikuto or Kokoro due their lack of confidence. Aside from being the first person outside his family to support his dream of being a fashion designer, Chiyuki serves as a source of knowledge for Ikuto to understand the fashion industry and is essentially Ikuto's de facto muse. His presence is a source of strength and hope for Chiyuki, as he is one of the few people that looks past her height to see her talent, and she is protective of him in return.

name: Hazime Yanagida
description: An up-and-coming fashion designer in charge of a brand of the same name. He attends Paris Fashion Week with the hope of establishing his brand on a global scale.

name: Fumiyo Niinuma
description: She writes for a clothing magazine and loves to read.

name: Seira
description:
__Height:__ 171 cm (5'7")

A famous model. She's considered sort for a runway model.

name: Yuriko Tsumura
description: Yuriko is the kind and loving mother of Ikuto, Honoka, Aoi, and Ichika. Ever since her husband died when her children were young, Yuriko has been the sole provider for her family and her tendency to overwork herself has led her to be hospitalized many times. Despite the hardships she endures, Yuriko remains positive for her children's sake and maintains a playful sense of humor, especially towards Ikuto.

name: Kokoro Hasegawa
description:
__Height:__ 181 cm (5'11")

A young aspiring, hard-working fashion designer, first-year student at the Geika Institute of Fashion, and part-time model at "Bon Rouge". She has a shy, submissive, and meek personality, and is rather self-conscious about her height, though she became less bothered by it when she was scouted in high school.

Despite being talented as a model, Kokoro dislikes the nuances the job includes, but her feelings of debt towards her manager Igarashi and her lack of confidence prevents her from quitting. Upon befriending and working alongside Ikuto at Yanagida's studio, Kokoro gradually begins to be more courageous and challenging herself due his encouragement, though she is still prone to self-doubt and worries.

name: Youko Takaoka
description: Takaoka is the Headmaster of the Geika Institute of Fashion and takes great pride in her school. Behind her preppy and happy-go-lucky demeanor, Takaoka has a sharp eye and is supportive of all her students, including Ikuto, whom she greatly encourages to attend the school to nurture his talent.

name: Kenji Fujito
description: Chiyuki's father. He is the owner of Mille Neige and is also the one who recognized Tsumura's talent

name: Too Ayano
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm (5'11")

The adoptive child of the famous designer Mai Ayano and Ikuto's rival. Toh is originally from France and an orphan that lived on the streets until he was two years old. Having been personally trained by Mai for over 20 years, Toh is a prodigious fashion designer and patternmaker, skilled in all areas to flourish in the industry, and is considered the greatest senior student during his time at the Geika Institute of Fashion.

Ambitious and a self-proclaimed narcissist, Toh harbors a strong fixation to surpasses his grandmother through his own efforts.

Due to people downplaying his skills as Mai's heir to her company and his abilities far surpassing his peers, Toh is noted to always be alone, though he is friendly with many of his people. Upon noticing Ikuto's natural skills as a patterner, Toh takes a special interest in him.



(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Dr. Saruta
description: Like Dr. Ochanomizu, Saruta is visually identifiable by his large nose, though in his case it is grotesquely spotted. Where Ochanomizu generally appears in light and uplifting roles, Saruta is quite the opposite. His two main roles in Tezuka manga are both in extremely important series: Black Jack and Phoenix. In Phoenix, he is arguably an over-arching protagonist for the series as a whole, alongside its title character. He appears in every story, sometimes in a main role, sometimes in a peripheral one, sometimes with a new name and barely recognizable in his character, but always present and important. He is also distinguishable by the sheer amount of suffering he undergoes over the course of his many lives and deaths, as he demonstrates both the darker sides of human nature and the human capacity for perserverance and transcendence.  In Black Jack, he is featured as Dr. Honma Jotaro, once a skilled and famous surgeon later thrown out of the medical community due to jealousy and doubt about his research, who saved young Black Jack as a child, was Black Jack's principle father figure during his life, and inspired him to become a doctor. Since Saruta is the character in Phoenix who best understands the system of reincarnation, life and death, it is appropriate that in Black Jack Dr. Honma is the figure who most frequently reminds Black Jack about the power of nature and the inevitability of death.      (Source: tezukainenglish.com)

name: Gaou
description: One-eyed and one-armed young man Gao, an ancestor of Saruta, turns into a murderous bandit when he is rejected by his village.

name: Rock Holmes
description:
Rock is a recurrent character in Osamu Tezuka's manga series, and he is an important part of Osamu Tezuka's Star System. Rock is a young boy with shiny dark hair. He first appeared in the manga series Detective Boy Rock Holmes, as a child detective. While most of other Tezuka child characters stayed the same age, Rock grew up throughout the years and his character was reused for more mature "roles" in Tezuka's manga, where he gradually developed a darker personality.

Often cold and brutal, his character tends to be used as an antagonist, who later, in works such as Phoenix, kidnapped and murdered people. In this older form, Rock is often wearing a three-piece suit, a striped tie and dark sunglasses, the last of which became something of a trademark for him.

Best known to American audiences for his dark and violent roles in the Metropolis movie and second volume of Alabaster, Rock is sometimes good, sometimes evil, but always determined, absolute and charismatic.

(Source: Wikipedia, Tezuka)

The club was later overtaken by Zera, who Tamiya dissaproves of for his cruel means of ruling. Tamiya is level-headed and thinks of others before himself. He also has a little sister, named Tamako. His character is named after Jirou Tamiya, a Japanese actor and television host.

name: Hiroyuki Tsunekawa

He has a very charismatic personality and is also an expert player at the board game chess.  His character was based off the Roman Emperor Elagabulus, who was infamous for his lewd and ungoverned acts of rule.

name: Raizou Ichihashi
description: Raizou is a member of the Litchi Hikari Club. He is extremely effeminate, and uses a speech pattern fitting that of a Gyaru.  According to the LHC 4-Koma series, Raizou enjoys reading books (such as Anne of Green Gables) and also wears Fundoshi - traditional Japanese men's underwear.

name: Katsuya Tabuse
description: Dafu is one of the original members of the Litchi Hikari Club, alongside [Tamiya](https://anilist.co/character/30934/Tamiya-Hiroshi) and [Kaneda](https://anilist.co/character/30936/Kaneda-Riku). He's extremely loyal to Tamiya.

He is a kind and compassionate person at heart, and strongly supports his younger brother's relationship with [Ayumi](https://anilist.co/character/258203/Ayumi-Yurino).

Called an "ice" elemental by members of the Game Creation Club after misspeaking, and has also been referred to as the "little sister" element. (Source: Wikipedia)

Hino has a bubbly personality and is known to add in sound effects, whether they're needed or not. She also enjoys fishing, though she often complains about not having any school fishing friends.

Ryuuji's family are nice, normal people, who appear quite wealthy, who totally disapprove of his 'bad behavior', however his elder sister Yoko allows him to stay at her home when he needs to.
