Tamon is the "Sexy and Wild" member of the popular idol group F/ACE. He moved to Tokyo at 16 to audition as an idol with the dream of wishing to make people all over the world smile. His image color is red.

name: Utage Kinoshita
description:
__Height:__ 154 cm (5'1")

Utage is a high school student who lives and breathes for her favorite idol, Tamon Fukuhara. She works part-time as a housekeeper so she can afford her fangirl lifestyle.

name: Yuina
description: One of [Utage's](https://anilist.co/character/318789/Utage-Kinoshita) otaku friends from school who is a big fan of [Tamon](https://anilist.co/character/318692/Tamon-Fukuhara). She is an artist and switches between yumejoshi and fujoshi tendancies.

name: Asuka Inoue
description: Utage's homeroom teacher. She's a beautiful, cheerful new teacher and is very popular among students. She's a fan of F/ACE and Natsuki.

name: Yamato Kinoshita
description: Utage's younger brother and Homare's twin. He doesn't understand Utage's obsession with idols and prefers to study instead.

name: Toshikazu Sakaguchi
description: Ouri's father and a famous actor.

name: Ouri Sakaguchi
description:
__Height:__ 177 cm (5'10")

Ouri is a member of the idol group F/ACE with a princely persona. His image color is blue. He is the youngest member of the group and was born into a family of entertainers, starting his career at 7 years old as a child actor and has many long-time fans. His refined appearance and delicate nature create a unique feeling of transparency within the group.

name: Izumi Shiraishi
description: The president of the company which manages F/ACE and their producer. She treats them harshly in order to make the group into a hit.

name: Lufas Maphaahl
native: ルファス・マファール
description:
__Level:__  1000
__Species:__  Heaven-Winged

The strongest being who once unified Mizgarz and was feared as "The Black-Winged Overlord". Was sealed after a battle with The Seven Heroes, but was summoned back into the world 200 years later.

name: Sei Minamijuuji
description:
__Level:__  15
__Species:__  Human

An ordinary high school boy who, after Lufas' resurrection, was brought to Mizgarz via a hero summoning ceremony. With an extremely average body and no special skills at all, he sets out to defeat the Demon Lord and Lufas, both of whom threaten humanity.

name: Dina
description: A blue-haired girl who the resurrected Lufas met at her former base, the Tower of Mafahl. She claims to be Lufas's loyal retainer and has been waiting for her return for 200 years.

name: Majin Ou Orm
description: The ruler of the demons. After Lufas' sealing, he won the battle against the Seven Heroes and cursed their bodies, taking away their powers. Since then, he has intensified his armies' offensive against humanity and continues to threaten their existence.

name: Aries
description:
__Level:__  800
__Species:__  Magical Beast

A one-of-a-kind monster called the "Rainbow Sheep", who was taken in by Lufas and made the first member of her Twelve Heavenly Stars, representing the **Ram** constellation. In spite of his feminine human form, he is male.

name: Mars
description:
__Species:__  Demon

One of the Seven Luminaries, the Demon King's elite force. Has Fire affinity, and aims to kill the Seven Heroes to win the Demon King's favor.

name: Alioth
description:
__Species:__  Human

One of the Seven Heroes, and one of Lufas' closest friends. Widely known as the "Sword King" Alioth, who sealed Lufas away 200 years ago.

name: Aigokeros
description:
__Level:__  800
__Species:__  Demon Lord

A demon who faithfully serves in Lufas's Twelve Heavenly Stars, representing the **Goat** constellation. He is feared by all as the "Demon Lord Aigokeros". His anthropomorphic form is that of an elderly butler, and although he is loyal to Lufas, he can also tend to run amok.

name: Banri Shiunji
description: She is the eldest sibling of the Shiunji family and is the only one who has already moved onto university. She is a first-year college student and an aspiring nurse.

name: Minami Shiunji
description: She is one of the youngest Shiunji siblings, along with her twin brother [Shion Shiunji](https://anilist.co/character/265473/Shion-Shiunji). She is a first-year high school student, who is a triple champion of the middle school tennis tournament and is expected to be a future Olympian.

name: Seiha Shiunji
description: She is the second oldest Shiunji sibling, second only to her older sister [Banri Shiunji](https://anilist.co/character/265474/Banri-Shiunji). She is a third-year high school student, who is the valedictorian of her school and the Science Club president.

name: Kotono Shiunji
description: She is the youngest sibling of the Shiunji family and the only one that's still in middle school. She is a third-year middle school student, who is the type of innocent girl that has a peaceful and shy personality.

name: Ouka Shiunji
description: She is one of the third-oldest Shiunji siblings, along with her "twin" brother [Arata Shiunji](https://anilist.co/character/265472/Arata-Shiunji). She is a second-year high school student, who excels in both class and sports, ranking second in the entire high school and the frontrunner for the next student council president election.

name: Iris Lana Armelia
native: アイリス・ラーナ・アルメリア
description:
__Eye color:__ Blue
__Hair Color:__ Platinum-Blonde

__Relatives:__
- Bern Tashi Armelia (Younger Brother)
- Mellice Reese Armelia (Mother) 
- Louis Dan Armelia (Father) 
- Gazelle Daz Anderson (Grandfather)

Iris Lana Armelia is the female protagonist of Koushaku Reijou No Tashinami. Her memories and personality were fused with a modern-day 30 year old Japanese lady (unnamed) who died from a car accident. She is the Duke's daughter and became the Feudal Lord Representative of her father's territory after having her engagement with the Second Prince, Edward Tom Tasmeria, annulled.

Iris has a petite and slim figure. Her hair is long and is platinum blonde. She wears a beaded circlet under her bangs. Her eyes are clear sky blue. She wears an assortment of gowns for any occasion, but they all have shades of blue in some way.

She was a worker in financial department as an accountant but her life "ended" when a drunk driver ran her over with their truck and she wakes up to find herself being accused of harassing the baron's daughter as Iris, the game character who was supposed to be the antagonist. After leaving the trial, she had to confront her father, the duke of Armelia, so she won't end up what she was fated to get as a punishment in the original game. In the end, she was placed as a person acting as the fief lord and became the creator of a successful conglomeration.

name: Dida
description:
Dida is one of Iris Lana Armelia's guard and a childhood friend of Ryle.
He is one of the seven orphan children picked up by young Iris from the slum.
He is a person who gets happy easily when praised or flattered and has an easy-going nature, his abilities are guaranteed. He likes to call Iris a Princess.

name: Tanya
description: Personal maid of Iris, the proxy of the Duke of Armelia. Picked up as a child by Iris when she was about to die. Very loyal towards her, even developing a one-hit-kill technique in order to protect her. Has very good investigating skills.

name: Ryle
description: Ryle is one of Iris' personal guards and childhood friend of Dida.

name: Alfred Dean Tasmeria
native: アルフレッド・ディーン・タスメリア
description: Alfred Dean Tasmeria, also known as the Dean, is the first prince of Tasmeria who first appears as an assistant of Iris Lana Armelia. He signs up to work for the Azuta Corporation and helps out Iris with economics.

name: Mina
description: Mina is the teacher and caretaker of all the orphans in Armelia Fief.

name: Moneda
description:
Moneda is one of the seven orphan children picked up by young Iris from the slums.
He became the Vice-Chief accountant of the Commerce Guild, before being asked to manage the new institution: the Bank.

name: Rehme
description: Rehme is one of the seven orphan children picked up by young Iris from the slums.

name: Louis de Armelia
native: ルイ・ド・アルメリア
description: Louis de Armelia is the Duke of Armelia and also the current Prime Minister. He comes from a long line of Prime Ministers.

name: Cao Cao
description: Cao Cao is by far  one of the greatest leaders in the Three Kingdoms Era. One might question his methods or call him "cruel", but even so his cold tactics allow him to fully utilize his armies and accomplish his objectives.

name: Yu Xun
description: Courtesy name Wenruo. Xun Yu is the second member of the Eight Enigma, genius military advisors handpicked by renowned veteran strategist Sima Hui 'Shujing'. Although as well-versed in warfare as any of the Enigmas, Xun Yu's true strength is diplomacy. From the beginning days of Cao Cao's faction, his benevolent ministry, as opposed to Guo Jia's 'Darkness Ideology' in military affairs, has helped fortify Cao Cao's rule. Thus stems his nickname, 'Zhang Liang', a homage to a famous advisor who aided Liu Bang in the construction of the Han dynasty.    Unlike Guo Jia and Jia Xu, the two Enigmas whose aim is Cao Cao's eventual rule, Xun Yu works toward the restoration of Imperial Han. Believing Cao Cao to be the only one able to achieve this, Xun Yu pledges his loyalty to him, even after Cao Cao's ambitions manifest in Guo Jia's favor. Xun Yu's greatest feats to date are the recruitment of thousands of Yellow Turban's troops and the Emperor's capture, both of which have contributed monumentally to Cao Cao's faction, elevating him to the status of most influential warlord of the land.

name: Yu Guan
description: Courtesy name Yunchang. Guan Yu is an oath brother to Liu Bei and Zhang Fei, him being the second oldest. He is one of the most powerful warriors of his era, rivaling the likes of Lü Bu and Sun Ce. When he was temporarily serving under Cao Cao, Guan Yu played a vital role as his bodyguard and also briefly tipped the balance of power on the battlefield.  Guan Yu is a man of honor and righteousness, as well as a devoted follower of his oath brother Liu Bei. He will punish a man for his wrong, but also respects him for his right. Unfortunately this idealism makes him vulnerable to manipulation, either by friend or foe.  (Source: ravagesoftime.wikispaces.com)

name: Fei Zhang
description: Courtesy name Yide. Zhang Fei is an oath brother to Liu Bei and Guan Yu, him being the youngest of the three. He is among the most powerful warriors of his era, and is more sneaky than people would assume. When not overshadowed by the Eight Geniuses, he takes on the role of a capable military advisor.  Zhang Fei is more Machiavellian than his second oath brother Guan Yu. He's not afraid to play the fool, make deals under the table, injure or manipulate his oath brothers if it means accomplishing the goal, which is to help Liu Bei rise to power.  (Source: ravagesoftime.wikispaces.com)

name: Jia Guo
description: Guo Jia is the fourth member of the Eight Enima, genius military advisors handpicked by the renowned veteran strategist Sima Hui 'Shujing' from his students. He's praised as the 'King of strategic decisions', a nod to his ability to account for virtually every scenarios possible in his plans. Like his close friend, the Third Enigma Jia Xu, Guo Jia is also a proponent of the 'Darkness ideology', which hails actions of utmost cruelty, rather than of benevolence, as the ultimate mean to pave way for peace and prosperity. This, while perpetuates his fame as Cao Cao's 'darkness', also strains his relationship with his upperclassman and comrade, the Second Enigma Xun Yu.    Much to his despair, Guo Jia is afflicted with a terminal illness (possibly tuberculosis), which dooms him to a premature death. Guo Jia has long since resigned himself to fate, reluctant to enter anyone's service, until Jia Xu persuades him to join Cao Cao, a warlord they both deem worthy of serving. Since his entrance, Cao Cao's influence has expanded vigorously, soon to equal that of the Yuan clan.

name: Yu Zhou
description: Zhou Yu is the fifth member of the Eight Enigma, genius military advisors handpicked by renowned veteran strategist Sima Hui 'Shujing' from his students. Of all the Enigma to have made an appearance, Zhou Yu's goal strays the furthest from their common ideal: rather than striving to bring peace to the land, he pledges loyalty to his sworn brother, Sun Ce, and dedicates his genius to the resurrection of the fallen Sun clan, which implies his intentions to found the future Wu kingdom independent of Imperial Han. For this, he's greatly disliked by the Seventh Enigma Zhuge Liang, who likens him to Sima Yi, another man of staggering brilliance but without noble ambitions (coincidentially, they also look nearly identical).    Zhou Yu's strength lies in troop deploying and counter-espionage, the later of which was the basis for his ingenious scheme to turn Yuan Shu's men against each other, tremendously diminishing Yuan Shu's force. Thanks to this, Sun Ce was able to escape safely to the Eastern region and fight to regain it, laying the foundation for the Wu kingdom.

name: Xu Jia
description: Courtesy name Wenhe. Jia Xu is the third member of the Eight Enigma, genius military advisors handpicked by renowned veteran strategist Sima Hui 'Shujing' from his students. He's also arguably the most notorious among the Eight Enigma, due to his favorite sacrifical strategy, which twice has killed his lords for the sake of eliminating the common enemy (Lu Bu). As best friend of the Fourth Enigma Guo Jia, Jia Xu is a fervent believer in the 'Darkness ideology', the belief hailing actions of utmost cruelty, rather than of benevolence, as the ultimate mean to pave way for peace and prosperity. This causes his rupture with the way of justice Shujing taught, which he deems obsolete, and his premature graduation from the school of Shujing.

name: Liang Zhuge
description: Courtesy name Kongming. Zhuge Liang is the seventh member of the Eight Enigma, genius military advisors handpicked by veteran strategist Sima Hui 'Shujing' from his students. As the recipient of the title 'Crouching Dragon' (臥龍;  _Wòlóng _), one of the two titles conferred on the best of the Enigmas only (the other being 'Fledgeling Phoenix', conferred on the Sixth Enigma Pang Tong), Zhuge Liang's ability to predict the outcomes of battle is praised by his master as godly. It's noted that he's also proficient in the art of shamanism.     Zhuge Liang is a man who strongly upholds traditional values (and equally dislikes men who trample on such values, like Sima Yi), and like his friend Pang Tong, dreams of restoring Imperial Han's golden era. For a long time Zhuge Liang's choice of master has favored Liu Bei, but as he's incessantly torn between achieving his goal and hesitating to realize the bloodshed inevitably meant to follow, he has retreated into hermitage.

name: The Eighth Genius
description: The last of the Eight Genius. There has been much debate over who is the last Genius, and theory abounds.

name: Huo Liaoyuan
description: Courtesy name Zilong, adopted at the same time he took on the name Zhao Yun. Liaoyuan Huo is the leader of the Sima clan's notorious assassin squad, the Crippled Legion, and is best friend with the clan's young head, Sima Yi. Besides prodigious fighting skills, he has the unique handicap of inability to feel pain, making him one of the strongest warriors in the story. Unlike the amoral Sima Yi, Liaoyuan Huo is regarded to be a very righteous man who values justice, and, despite their strong friendship, hates Sima Yi's indifference to the world's chaotic state. He's also discontented with the life of an assassin, but nevertheless stays unwavered in his loyalty to the clan and commitment to his comrades, whom he treasures.          The 'huo' (火, lit. fire) of the series title (火鳳燎原, Huǒ Fèng Liáo Yuán, lit. Fiery Phoenix Burns Steppes) refers to Liaoyuan Huo.

name: Percival
description: Percival is the son of Ironside and grandson of Balgis, and is the main protagonist of the sequel, Four Knights of the Apocalypse.

appearsIn.title: The Seven Deadly Sins: Four Knights of the Apocalypse

name: Donny
description: Donny is a member of the Katz Street Troupe. Donny is a tall teenager, with long red hair and is a bit burly. Donny wears a white button-down shirt, which leaves part of his chest uncovered, and black pants with some kind of pockets on the sides, and a pair of light-colored boots. Donny used to train as a Holy Knight apprentice under his uncle Howzer alongside his friend Edlin. However, seeing that he lacked the strength to become a Holy Knight, Donny dropped out of training and joined the Katz Street Troupe alongside Katz and Elva.

appearsIn.title: The Seven Deadly Sins: Four Knights of the Apocalypse

name: Nasiens
description: Nasiens is a mysterious person Percival meets at Echo Gorge. Nasiens is a young person with short light brown hair and yellow eyes. Nasiens has a great interest in plants, wanting to be a herbalist like his adoptive grandfather Ordo was. He gets very excited when making new discoveries, liking to experiment with everything around him.

appearsIn.title: The Seven Deadly Sins: Four Knights of the Apocalypse

name: Anghalhad
description: Anghalhad is a girl Percival meets at Sistana. Anghalhad is a young girl with long, fluffed pale cyan hair and turquoise eyes. She wears a white frilly dress with a magenta blouse along with socks and heels. She carries a dotted umbrella which hides a rapier in the center.

appearsIn.title: The Seven Deadly Sins: Four Knights of the Apocalypse

name: Lancelot
description: Lancelot is the son of [Ban](https://anilist.co/character/77605/Ban) and [Elaine](https://anilist.co/character/86681/Elaine). He is also a Holy Knight of Liones, and one of the Four Knights of the Apocalypse.

appearsIn.title: The Seven Deadly Sins: Four Knights of the Apocalypse

name: Galand
description: Galand is a demon who is a member of the Ten Commandments, a group of elite warriors of the Demon Clan handpicked by the Demon King himself. He was sealed away along with the rest of the clan in the Coffin of Eternal Darkness until he was set free by [Hendrickson](https://anilist.co/character/86679/Hendricksen).

appearsIn.title: The Seven Deadly Sins: Four Knights of the Apocalypse

name: Melascula
description: Melascula is a warrior of the Demon Clan, serving directly under the Demon King as the Faith of the Ten Commandments.

appearsIn.title: The Seven Deadly Sins: Four Knights of the Apocalypse

name: Zeldris
description:
__Height:__ 152 cm (5'0")

Zeldris is a demon who is a member of the Ten Commandments, a group of elite warriors of the Demon Clan handpicked by the Demon King himself. He was sealed away along with the rest of the clan in the Coffin of Eternal Darkness until he was set free by Hendrickson.

appearsIn.title: The Seven Deadly Sins: Four Knights of the Apocalypse

name: Arthur Pendragon
native: アーサー・ペンドラゴン
description:
Named the king of Camelot after pulling a sword from the stone that hundreds of holy knights could not.

Arthur is a polite, young man who is still adjusting to his role as king. He takes his responsibilities very seriously, but usually undertakes them with a smile and has a very warm, and happy-go-lucky demeanor.

He marched toward the kingdom of Liones with an army of illusions created by [Merlin](https://anilist.co/character/89180/Merlin) in hopes of meeting with the king; however, he was confronted by [Hendricksen](https://anilist.co/character/86679/Hendricksen) who tried to kill him before [Meliodas](https://anilist.co/character/72921/Meliodas) came to his aide.

appearsIn.title: The Seven Deadly Sins: Four Knights of the Apocalypse

name: Chae-A Han
description: After serving a 7 year prison sentence for an attempted murder, Chae Ah works as a taxi driver.

name: Yun-Su Park
description: Yoonsoo Park is a cold-hearted vampire who also attends church every Sunday. He lives with a small child, [Geurim](https://anilist.co/character/305760/Geu-Rim).

name: Geu-Rim
description: Geurim is a child who attends church every Sunday with Park Yoonsoo.

name: Hae-Won Nam
description: Nam Haewon is Chae Ah's ex-boyfriend.

name: Abeoji
description: The main antagonist.

name: Shinsuke Hyoudou
description: Shinsuke was just a traveling ronin when he met Jinka and Tama. He was fascinated with their abilities and offered information to be able to follow them.

name: Tama Youko
description: A very ambitious and sassy several hundred year old fox katawara. Alongside her human brother, [Jinka](https://anilist.co/character/27221/Jinka-Yamato), she travels the lands in order to try and rid the world of humans and katawara committing evil deeds and spread peace and kindness.

name: Senya
description:
Senya is a demon hunter with his father Jinun.

Senya was experimented on and given 1000 demons inside of his body by the Dangaishu

name: Tsukiko
description:
Senya's partner. Tsukiko is a timid and reserved girl who harbors deep feelings for Senya. Often trying to help Senya she feels that she causes more trouble than actually stopping it.

(Source: MAL)

name: Mudo
description: Mudo is a dragon that loves battles.

name: Hanatora
description: Hanatora is the deity representing the land of Kyoto. She has the ability to instantly generate vines as well as flowers that can put people to sleep. One of her eccentricities is that she dislikes being clothed and walks around mostly naked, covered only by her long hair.

name: Nau
description: A water god that follows [Senya](https://anilist.co/character/146191) and [Tsukiko](https://anilist.co/character/146192). Nau can change it's appearance and become stronger when around water.

name: Resshin
description:
Resshin is violently insane and loves it, he enjoys killing more than anything else.
He has a body made out of curses, and carries around a bag that can spew out anything.

name: Rinzu
description: Rinzu is the maid and disciple of the [mountain goddess](https://anilist.co/character/146620). She felt a platonic love for [Jinka](https://anilist.co/character/27221) at first sight.

name: Akira  Shiroyanagi
description:
__Ability__: Possesses whichever ability the other person thinks he has.

Akira Shiroyanagi is a high schooler who loves games and Konpeito. He is bored with his everyday life and hence tries out many games hoping to find something to challenge him. This changes when he suddenly is dragged into a battlefield by a mysterious girl who calls herself Mion. The participants are told that they were "erased from the family register, involved in an experiment, and gained certain powers." They then have to compete against each other in varying matches.

name: Yuuri Amagake
description:
__Ability__: Quintuple her physical abilities

She is a second year high school student.

name: Naoharu Kamui
description:
__Ability__: To cause chemical changes in things around your hand.

Member of the Red Team.

name: Yuuto Shirasagi
description:
__Ability__: To conduct peaceful negotiations with the other party.

Shirasagi is the leader of the Green Team.

name: Ichi Oogami
description:
__Ability__: The ability to quintuple your physical abilities.

The leader of the Red Team.

name: Takakiyo Chaen
description: __Ability__: To tranform a toy into a real thing.

name: Masaya Kuroiwa
description:
__Ability__: To collect debts owed to you in the form of commands which must be obeyed.

Oogami's right hand man.

name: Masakado Rindou
description:
__Ability__: To turn a stick into a sword that can slice through anything.

Member of the Red Team.

name: Rin Kashii
description:
__Ability__: To create torture instruments out of her body fluid.

Rin Kashii is a character in Battle in 5 Seconds After Meeting series. She was previously an Office Lady.

name: Minako
description: Yuuri's mother.

name: Yukina Himuro
description: Yukina Himuro has always been feared by other students in her classes because of her sharp eyes and cold skin temperature. She is secretly a cell phone novelist by the name of "Yupina", whose cell phone novel made it very popular, that is until Yukina hears from two other girls that her novels are getting boring due to the lack of "romance". Worried about her novel, Yukina doesn't know what to do until, the famous student council president Shigure Kitami comes along and accidentally drops his student handbook. Yukina picks it up to give back to him, but when she sees what is inside, she finds out that he writes the names of the girls in his classes, when they confessed. She then haves this idea to blackmail him to "love act" with her for her novel. She has a fear of being seen directly without her glasses; a fear in which Shigure Kitami uses once, leaving Yukina alone and allowing her to be surrounded by other girls and frightening her.

name: Shigure Kitami
description: Shigure Kitami is the student body president and the most popular guy in school. His father is the director of a big hospital. He owns a student notebook that lists every girl in his 9th grade class and puts checks next to each girl that confesses their love to him and also writes the method they used to confess to him and he turns them down each and every time. One day he drops this notebook and Yukina Himuro, the heroine of the story, finds it, and uses it to blackmail him into teaching her about love to help her write her cell phone novel. In the novel, he is the Count. Yukina uses Shigure by giving him "missions", like holding her hand, embracing her, and step-by-step, a relationship starts. Shigure hates the missions given to him by Yukina in the beginning, and tells her that he'd never fall in love with her, but several times he attempts to kiss her because he does not enjoy watching Akira Shimotsuki, Yukina's cousin, steal her away. Their missions are interrupted by the sudden appearance of Mami Mizuno, Shigure's childhoood friend who Shigure seems to be close to. In the first few chapters, Shigure never showed much interest in Yukina but jealous reactions to Akira and Yukina's relationship indicate that he really does like her and wants to be romantically involved with her.      Sakurai Takahiro voices Shigure in Drama CD

name: Mami Mizuno
description: Mami Mizuno is Shigure Kitami's childhood friend and seems to be quite possessive about him as she seems to get angry whenever she sees his shy expressions when Yukina Himuro's around. She seems to know about Shigure's secret of carrying a student notebook which includes names of the girls in his class and which he uses to keep track of how many girls have confessed to him and what methods have been used by them. Mami doesn't seem to like Yukina much as she is able to bring about real feelings of like and love from Shigure, which again indicates that Mami likes Shigure.    Mami is also known to have a weak body and acts cute around everybody even though in reality she is evil. She even acts extra-friendly with Yukina.

name: Akira Shimotsuki
description: Akira Shimotsuki is Himuro Yukina's cousin. His parents died in a fatal accident when he was still a young child. He seemes to have a strong devotion towards his cousin Yukina because his life was saved by Yukina when he almost got hit by a car right after he heard his parents were no longer coming home. Akira is one of the only people who knows that Yukina is disguised as a cellphone novelist, Yupina. Akira is almost always seen eating food besides Yukina, such as melon bread.  Being Yukina's cousin doesn't stop him from being in love with her. He's never been apart from her since they were children. Yukina saved him from being hit by a car, therefore Akira has a strong devotion towards her, where she then promised they'd be together always. Ever since, Akira has long wished to be with his cousin, not in a cousin-love way, but a lover way. He wanted Yukina to see him as a man as well, which she soon does. He seems to sometimes be protective of her when Shigure is around. He often tells her that he does not want her to be around him anymore. He also has confessed that he is jealous also.     Yuki Kaji voices Akira in drama CD.

name: Hisame Kitami
description: He is Shigure's little brother. It seems he has feelings for Mami.   In chapter 49, Hisame rained Yukina flowers hinting us that he might as well have feelings for Yukina.

name: Aria Pokoteng
description:
Amongst the undine companies, it's a tradition to keep a blue-eyed cat (breed is not a problem here) as mascot for good luck.

President Aria is the Aria Company's mascot, a male Aqua breed feline (common trait are bigger than Earth breed and human-level intelligence). He is smart enough to understand human speech. President Aria was a stray cat before being taken in by Grandma twenty years ago and has been the company's mascot ever since.

He really loves to eat - coupled with [Alicia](https://anilist.co/character/379/Florence-Alicia) and [Akari](https://anilist.co/character/378/Mizunashi-Akari) doting on him - making him really chubby.

He has a crush on [President Hime](https://anilist.co/character/10712/Granzchesta-Hime) and is mortally afraid of [President Maa](https://anilist.co/character/8803/Maa) and her tendency to latch her jaw on to his sizable stomach.

name: Namihei Anno
description: He is one of the postmen working on planet Aqua. He was the first person Akari Mizunashi met when she came to the planet, and also the one who brought her then sleeping self over to Aria company when he learned she would start working there.

name: Akatsuki Izumo
description: Akari's first customer as a Single. He is a tall, impatient young man who calls Akari "Pigtails" (momiko) to tease her. He works as an apprentice Salamander, someone who helps maintain Aqua's climate in the floating buildings that tethered overhead. Although drawn like a typical bishonen, his constant scowl combined with a loose-fitting robe usually cover up his more "attractive" features, which he rarely displays. Akatsuki has an older brother who takes great pleasure giving him a hard time. He's also Woody's childhood friend, and also knows Al the gnome, and is occasionally seen in the company of Woody and sometimes Al. (The latter much to Aika's consternation, since she doesn't like Akatsuki much, but loves Al.)    Akatsuki has a rather heavy crush on Alicia, often calling the Aria company phone just to hear her away voice message. He's not adverse to spending time with Akari either if the mood strikes him, or demand of her to help him with various things, like carrying the many roses he bought for the Boccolo festival.

name: Hime Granzchesta
native: 姫・M・グランチェスタ
description:
President of Himeya Company, a small, delicate, black female cat from Manhome. 

She is the target of President Aria's obvious crush (and sometimes lack of manners), wherein she makes it a point to ignore him for the most part.

name: Aileen Dautriche
native: アイリーン・ローレン・ドートリシュ
description: A villainess who remembered her past life. However, her incomplete memories are making it very hard for her to avoid doom.

appearsIn.title: I'm the Villainess, So I'm Taming the Final Boss

name: Claude Elmir
native: クロード・ジャンヌ・エルメイア
description: The demon king and oldest prince of Imperial Ellmeyer. The source of Aileen's death flags.

appearsIn.title: I'm the Villainess, So I'm Taming the Final Boss

name: Cedric Elmir
native: セドリック・ジャンヌ・エルメイア
description: The hero of the first game. Breaks off his engagement to Aileen.

appearsIn.title: I'm the Villainess, So I'm Taming the Final Boss

name: Belzebuth
description: A demon who idolizes Claude and has pledged to obey him.

appearsIn.title: I'm the Villainess, So I'm Taming the Final Boss

name: Lilia Rainworth
native: リリア・レインワーズ
description: Lilia is the heroine of the first game. She's the holy sword maiden and Cedric's beloved.

appearsIn.title: I'm the Villainess, So I'm Taming the Final Boss

name: Keith Eigrid
native: キース・エイグリッド
description: Claude's childhood friend and human attendant.

appearsIn.title: I'm the Villainess, So I'm Taming the Final Boss

name: Hagumi Hanamoto
description:
__Height__: 142 cm (4'6")

A supremely gifted artist, Hagu's immense talents are esteemed by all who witness her works, catching the eye of numerous professional artists who insistently urge her to submit her work to exhibitions to heighten her publicity (which she seems to find daunting). She is 18 years of age at the beginning of the series and her appearance is that of a child, and she conveniently behaves as one. Raised in a largely sheltered and obscure home by her irritable grandmother, her sociability is below average. It is whilst living in that home that Hagu develops her skill in drawing and painting, her only past-time, though she finds nothing to sketch save for the never-changing view she has from her porch, varying only in seasons. Hagu is from Azumino city, Nagano-ken.

name: Takumi Mayama
description:
__Height__: 183 cm (6")

Takumi is a 4th year student at the start of the series and is from Kanazawa, Ishikawa-ken and an architecture student at the art institute. He lives in the same complex as Takemoto and Morita. He occupies room 101, sharing the floor with an unknown individual and formerly Lohmeyer-senpai. He acts as a senior to Takemoto and tries to help Morita get up for early morning classes. At one point, Takemoto and Morita are seen sleeping alongside him in his futon. Morita also borrows Mayama's shirts from time to time because it's more comfortable. Mayama also hates being left out of the activities that the group holds, even going to the furthest extent to join them.  Mayama also used to help Rika out with various errands while Rika was disabled due to the accident that left her husband dead. It is during that time that Mayama develops feelings for Rika. It is unknown whether Rika fully reciprocates the feelings that Mayama has for her, but various flashbacks imply that Mayama and Rika have 'fooled around', or Mayama took advantage of Rika's disability to fulfill his desires, although this is cleared up later as not being the case. Rika suggested that Mayama find another job so that she wouldn't have to continue hurting him, as she realizes how much he cares for her, and is unable (and perhaps unwilling at that point) to allow him to enter into her life.  Mayama eventually landed a job at Fujiwara Design.

name: Shinobu Morita
description:
__Height__: 175 cm (5'8")
__Specialty__: Sculptures


A 6th year student in the beginning of the series, Morita occupies room 203, his floormates being Takemoto and Hasegawa. Morita is unable to graduate, as he can never wake up on time to go to classes. This is mainly due to the work that he does, which forces him to go missing for periods of time. What he does for work though remains a mystery. When Morita comes back from his mysterious job, he immediately falls asleep for at least 48 hours, due to the amount of work he does. He also returns with a large sum of money in his back-pocket and brings a food item to share with his flat mates. Although the flat mates believe he does it to mock them, such as when he brings a bag of croquettes instead of meat, Morita does care deeply for his friends such as Takemoto.  Morita is a very mysterious person. He does many random, crazy things for his personal enjoyment, such as creating a twister game with too many colors, which resulted in horrific pain for him and Takemoto. Morita is a perceptive individual, but tactless and often states the truth, such as how Mayama secretly stalks Rika outside her apartment, when nobody wants to hear it. He also expresses his love for Hagu in weird and quirky ways, such as forcing Hagu to dress up as a mouse. Morita's obsession with Hagu stems from a fondness of cute things during his childhood, such as causing a cat to become neurotic after cuddling it too much.

name: Yuuta Takemoto
description:
__Height__: 170 cm (5'7")

Yuuta Takemoto is a second-year student at the art college. He is from Annaka city, Gunma-ken. He lives in the same apartment complex as Mayama and Morita in room 202. His floormates are Morita and Hasegawa. Takemoto studies architecture, but has little certainty as to what he wishes to do upon graduating; his decision to attend art college was because he liked to build things with his hands, like he had with his father.  Takemoto is one of the more mellow characters in the series. He falls in love with Hagu immediately after being introduced by his professor and keeps his feelings to himself throughout most of the series. His love for Hagu and his inability to act upon his feelings as freely as Morita causes some internal problems for Takemoto. For example, when Hagu received a bird brooch that was made for her as an anonymous present, Takemoto couldn't bring himself to say that Morita was the one who had made it for her. Instead of acting on his feelings, Takemoto decides to be more of a brother figure to Hagu, giving her friendly support when needed. For example, Takemoto accepts Hagu's requests to build her sophisticated dollhouses and the like. Takemoto is very close to her.  His relationship with his family also contributes to his mellow mood. His father died when he was still young. Also, his mother works at a hospital as a nurse, so Takemoto would usually spend a lot of his time there, even his Christmas holidays.

name: Ayumi Yamada
description:
__Height__: 165 cm (5'5")

Yamada is well known by her peers at the art college. Due to her good looks, she also catches the attention of her male friends/coworkers at the shopping district she works with.  She and Hagu seem to be very close, like siblings. While Hagu addresses the three young men by their last names, she calls Yamada by her first name. Yamada really cares for Hagu like a younger sister. She offers to stay with her while Shuji is gone. Although not shown as much as her relationship with Hagu, she is close friends with Takemoto and Morita.
Yamada is deeply in love with one of her friends, Mayama. Mayama, however, doesn't return her feelings, asking her why she is in love with him and encouraging her to go find someone else.

name: Shuuji Hanamoto
description: Shuuji is a professor at a Tokyo art university, and Hagumi's overprotective cousin. Growing up together, Shuuji was the only real father figure Hagu had, and he took to his role, becoming highly devoted to making sure Hagu was happy, and taking pride in her amazing artistic talent. As for his teaching, Shuuji used to be a student at the college, and although he wasn't a talented artist at all, his talented friends and roomates, Rika and Harada, always came to him for help with their classwork. Shuuji is a wise man, able to give out good advice when he's called upon, but also becomes quite nervous at times and stutters.

name: Rika Harada
description:
__Height__: 167 cm (5'6") 

Rika is the founder and manager of Harada Design; she ran it with her husband until he died in a car accident that happened on the opening night of one of the stores they designed. This accident left her badly scarred (both mentally and physically), and has damaged her legs so she is unable to walk for long periods without the help of a cane and medicine. She is good friends with Shūji, for they, along with her late husband, were all very good friends in the past. It was her husband that befriended both her and Shūji, having joined both of them in their apartment.

name: Tsukasa Morita
description: Shinobu and Kaoru's father, Tsukasa Morita was a brilliant engineer. His personality was very similar to Shinobu's, as he too was a man who could do anything he tried very well, and was constantly the center of attention.

name: Kaoru Morita
description: Morita's older brother who seems to have a mysterious agenda in earning ridiculously large amounts of money. It is later revealed that he and Morita are working together to buy back his father's company which was purchased by an electrical company when they were kids.    From Wikipedia

name: Takumi Nomiya
description: He, along with Yamazaki and Miwako, is first introduced on episode 14 of season 1. He is the type of guy who could "throw a cellphone in the sea full of women's numbers, without caring at all" as said by Mayama.    Nomiya is Mayama's former boss at Fujiwara Design. He also likes Yamada, and tries to visit her whenever he can, although he is aware of Yamada's feelings for Mayama. Mayama tries to act as the middleman as much as he can in order to protect Yamada, as he considers Nomiya a playboy. However, later in the series, Nomiya comes to realize that he himself has truly fallen in love with Yamada.

name: Seiichi Aramiya
description:
__Eye color:__ Black
__Hair color:__ Black
__Occupation:__ Student
__Debut:__ Chapter 1 (Manga) / Volume 1 (Light Novel)

Seiichi Aramiya is the main male protagonist of [Real no Heroine wa Irimasen!](https://anilist.co/manga/99461/). 

_Appearance:_ Seiichi is a high school boy with black hair and light blue eyes.

name: Kiyomi Aramiya
description:
__Eye color:__ Blue
__Hair color:__ Light Brown
__Occupation:__ Student
__Debut:__ Volume 1 Chapter 1 (Light Novel)

Kiyomi Aramya is the younger sister of Seiichi Aramiya. 

_Appearance:_ Kiyomi has brown hair and blue eyes. 

_Personality:_ Kiyomi is a openly rude and dismissive who dislikes her brother as she thinks of his as a nerdy loser. At the same time, she looks up to [Kotoko Ayame](https://anilist.co/character/139934/) and she doesn't understand why she hangs out with Seiichi.

name: Yuuka Hatsushiba
description:
__Eye color:__ Green
__Hair color:__ Black
__Occupation:__ Student / Voice Actress

Yuuka is a voice actress and a classmate of Seiichi Aramiya and [Kotoko Ayame](https://anilist.co/character/139934/).

name: Kiriko Kotani
description:
__Eye color:__ Brown
__Hair color:__ Black
__Occupation:__ Teacher
__Debut:__ Chapter 2 (Manga)

Kiriko Kotani is the cousin/teacher of Seiichi Aramiya.

name: Sonomi Ohara
description:
__Eye color:__ Brown
__Hair color:__ Brown
__Occupation:__ Student

Sonomi Ohara is a supporting character from [Real no Heroine wa Irimasen!](https://anilist.co/manga/99461/).

name: Ryoma Saitani
description:
__Eye color:__ Brown
__Hair color:__ Brown
__Occupation:__ Student

Ryoma Saitani is a supporting character from [Real no Heroine wa Irimasen!](https://anilist.co/manga/99461/). 

_Appearance:_ Despite being male, Ryoma is extremely feminine looking and it doesn't help that his sister sometimes makes him dress in woman's clothing.

_Personality:_ Ryoma is a shy and timid boy who looks up to Seiichi Aramiya.

name: Eve Suwama
description:
__Eye color:__ Pink
__Hair color:__ Blonde
__Occupation:__ Student
__Debut:__ Chapter 22 (Manga) / Volume 2 (Light Novel)

Eve Suwama is Seiichi Aramiya's childhood friend who transfers to his class.

_Appearance:_ Eve has blonde hair that is tied in two high wavy pigtails by two pink and blue hairclips with bangs swept to the right side and pink eyes. In her initial appearance, her skin was tanned, she had green and pink highlights in her hair and she wore heavy makeup, but she later removes it. 

_Personality:_ Eve is shown to have a bold and somewhat bubbly personality who is described as someone who can get along with everybody. She also appears to be very gullible, as she believed the lies of her friend Ako for several years. She's very clingy with Seiichi Aramiya, even despite his clear animosity towards her. She is shown to enjoy messing with Seiichi, such as pranking him when they we're children, or blackmailing him into showing her around school. Despite this, she truly considers Seiichi her friend and values his opinion, changing her appearance after he told her that he doesn't like how she looks.

name: Keita Tozaki
description:
__Eye color:__ Brown
__Hair color:__ Brown
__Occupation:__ Student

Keita Tozaki is the best friend of Seiichi Aramiya. 

_Personality:_ Keita has an easygoing personality who is jealous that Seiichi Aramiya seems to be getting close to multiple women.

name: Airi Yaotani
description:
__Eye color:__ Dark Blue
__Hair color:__ Black
__Occupation:__ Student / Student Council President

Airi Yaotani is the student council president at Milage High School. 

_Personality:_ Airi is noted to prefer female student over male, being rude and demeaning to male students and switching to kind and understanding with female ones.

name: Helvi
description: A is a demon summoned by Theo Asper. She joins his team and is infatuated with him. In the first chapter, the main character wants her to marry him.

name: Aoi Asada
description: A 2nd year and the Vice-president of the Newspaper Club. She was Fujimaru's father's apprentice in karate. She seems to have a slight crush on Fujimaru.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Otoya Kujou
description: A 3rd year and the President of the Newspaper Club. He is Fujimaru's childhood friend. He is also, Fujimaru's "back up." He was the only one that knew about Fujimaru's supreme hacking skills, and was the one that told the Newspaper Club (with Fujimaru's permission) about the Takagis' work. Lately, it was revealed that he likes Fujimaru's younger sister, Haruka.    (source: Wikipedia)

name: Maya Orihara
description: She purchased a virus in Russia. She is currently undercover as Maya Orihara, a biology teacher in Mishiro Academy High School. Under her facade she shows others she is a cold and calculating killer who doesn't care who has to die to achieve her objective and even plans to kill Fujimaru's friends at the first chance she gets.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Fujimaru Takagi
description: A 2nd year high school student and a member of the Newspaper Club. Unknown to everyone (but his father, the PSIA, and the Newspaper Club), he is also Falcon, a hacker prodigy who hacks into corrupt people's computers and brings their crimes to light. When he goes into "Falcon Mode" his pupils become slits. It appears to be inherited, as his father also does this when fighting.    Source: wikipedia    In the live-action drama he is portrayed by Miura Haruma in both seasons.

name: Ikuma Kanou
description: Also member of the THIRD-I. He's good with fire arms.

name: Jun Kanzaki
description: The 3rd in command of the cult after Simon and "K", also known as the "star of wisdom, he is a very intelligent person that seems to know alot about human psychology and always seems to be a few steps ahead of his opponents. He doesn't seem to show any emotion either and always has a smile on his face.   Hi is the tenth child of Kamishima Simon. He has a subconcious habit observing people and biting his nail when stressed. He has an unbalanced habit and desires freedom the most.  He is also Kujou Otoya's younger half-brother.

name: Gorou Kirishima
description: Also a memeber of the THIRD-i

name: Kaoru Minami
description: Third-I member, new guard assigned to Fujimura, after Houshou was killed.

name: Mako Anzai
description: A 1st year and a member of the Newspaper Club. She is a fan of the hacker Falcon. After discovering that Fujimaru was him, she gained a slight crush, more of an obsession with him.         (Source:Wikipedia)

name: Hide Tachikawa
description: A 2nd year and a member of the Newspaper Club. He seems to be naive and the least intelligent of the club, but he tries to help Fujimaru in anyway he can. He lives with his father, stepmother, and stepbrother. It turns out that his stepmother is a spy for the enemy.     (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Shuuko Yakumo
description: A 28-year-old widow who, after her husband died, kept accidentally making too much food. She then begins sharing the leftovers with her neighbor, the highschooler Yamato Shouhei.

name: Yamato Shouhei
description:
A highschooler who is part of his school's baseball team. He lives next-door to Shuuko Yakumo and starts eating meals with her after she began offering him her leftovers.
He has very healthy appetite.

name: Hana Nonomura
description:
Hana Nonomura is a normal sixteen-year old high school girl from an average income family. Hana's sister boycotted an unavoidable marriage meeting with Takane Saibara, so Hana was forced attend the meeting in her place.

Hana likes practical things.

name: Takane Saibara
description:
A scion and the grandson of the Takaba company's president. He has an arrogant personality and dislikes the commoner's lifestyle. Despite his personality, he is surprisingly an intelligent and capable office worker.

He loves home-cooked or top-quality dishes and dislikes pre-packaged food. Takane enjoys being on high places, such as tall buildings.

name: Souma Okamoto
description: Hana's childhood friend

name: Nicola Luciano
description: Nicola is the heir to an Italian company. He met Takane when they went to the same college for graduate school in America. Nicola later frequents Okamon's family's restaurant. He is often seen with many women around him and has an extroverted and fun personality. Despite seeming to carefree, he cares for Takane and often looks after him.

name: Angela
description:
As a child, she was a runaway slave, and after being liberated she lived in a rural village. Because she knew how to read and write, she used to help the village residents. 

She secretly wrote a fanfic about the first prince 'The Prince Among the Roses' which became a huge hit. Self proclaimed No. 1 Rayburn fan.

name: Rayburn Espelindo
description: A falsely accused prince with a tarnished image. Rumor has it that he loves bloodshed and is always craving for action. In reality, he's a calm person who was roped into royal family politics.

name: Chancellor Schwandell
description: A general of the Schwandel family and Ferderic's maternal uncle. He keeps Rayburn in check and abuses Ferderik, using him as a puppet.

name: Eldridge
description: Maid working in Rayburn's mansion, she is assigned as the maid of Angela.

name: Mano
description:
Bodyguard of Rayburn Espelindo, he possesses excellent swordsmanship and combat abilities. He has brown hair and a cross scar on his face. 
He was also originally a commoner, but through great effort he became a knight and was chosen by Rayburn.

name: Garnet
description: First princess from Vess, engaged to Ferderic Schwandell.

name: Bourbon
description: Bodyguard of Ferderic Schwandell.

name: Blan
description:
As the famous Prince Rayburn paparazzi, he drew paparazzi pictures of the Prince for over 5 years even on battlefields. 
His infiltration skills are so excellent that he trespasses into the imperial palace and Rayburn's Mansion, which are said to have strict guard.

appearsIn.title: The Holy Power of Modern Medicine

name: Touya Senji
description: A student at the First High School affiliated with a certain national university. He is an extremely hard worker, studying and training until late at night, and always placing in the top 100 in national mock exams. Having grown up being compared to his genius older brother, he craves "talent" and feels intense jealousy towards "those who possess talent."

name: Albert Einstein
native: アルバート アインシュタイン
aliases: A. Einstein (A・アインシュタイン)
description:
__Talent:__ The ability to teleport by swapping spaces. However, there is a restriction that teleportation is only possible within the range of coordinates registered by the user.

One of the original members of the Forest of Great Men. She is mainly in charge of combat and movement, and is considered one of the "two strongest" along with [Newton](https://anilist.co/character/214621/Newton). She intensely dislikes men, even objecting to other women interacting with them.

name: Haito Le Buffett
description:
__Talent:__ A talent enabling the wielding of swordsmanship reaching beyond human limits. Two blades—the “Kubi-gari” and the “Hara sogi”—materialize, awakening superhuman strength and dynamic visual acuity.

She is [Touya's](https://anilist.co/character/214623/Touya-Senji) classmate, but doesn't attend school often. She was invited to join the Kendo club as a scholarship student, and is a master swordsman feared by those around her. She has a bright and combative personality, and sometimes enjoys fighting.

name: John V. Neumann
description:
__Talent:__ A talent for quantifying all information and predicting the future. This awakens incredible calculation and thinking abilities, resulting in accuracy so high that it is said to be able to predict the future.

A girl who always sits in a wheelchair. She is the leader of the Forest of Great Men, a group of people who aim for "world peace," and one of its original members. In contrast to her young appearance, she is always calm, collected, and rational, and is the sole leader of the chain of command for her companions.

name: Newton
description:
__Talent:__ A talent for manipulating gravity. He can generate apple-shaped objects and levitate or crush anything within a 4m radius around them.

One of the original members of the Forest of Great Men. Not only does he use his talent in combat, but he also has a calm decisiveness, making him one of the two strongest, along with [Einstein](https://anilist.co/character/214619/Albert-Einstein). Whenever he gets punched, he shouts out the name of the apple variety.

name: Yu Xiang
description: Kouu transmigrated from unnamed man. His talent is Omnireceptacle which allows him to control and use everything as a weapon with his battle aura. He was one of founding members of Forest of the Greats.

name: Charlotte Corday
native: シャルロット・コルデー
description: Charlotte Corday (シャルロット・コルデー, Sharurotto Korudē) is one of the founding members of Sinners. She is mostly seen next to Kouu. Her talent is Angel of Assasination.

name: Pol Pot
description: Pol Pot is a founding member of Sinners. His talent is Fruit of Corruption which rots anything that the wave of aura touches.

name: Nostradamus
aliases: M. Nostradamus (M・ノストラダムス)
description: Nostradamus (ノストラダムス, Nosutoradamusu) is an onlooker who acts as the counselor of the Sinners. His talent The Great Prophecy allows him to give accurate predictions.

name: Gaius Julius Caesar
native: ガイウス・ユリウス・カエサル
description: Caesar (カエサル, Kaesaru) is a returner transmigrated from an unnamed man. He is one of the founding members of Sinners. His talent, The Heroes Testament , grants him the ability to summon any and all kinds of weapons.

name: Hikari Wanda
description:
First-year member of the dance club. Hikari loves dancing. Not very muscular, but has excellent physical intuition. 

The artist that inspired her into dancing was Michael Jackson and she wants to become a dancer like him.

name: Kaboku Kotani
description: First-year member of the dance club. Has trouble talking in front of people because of his stutter. It was Wanda who drew him into the dance club.

name: On Miyao
description: A third year and the president of Ichirin High School's Dance Club. She has a tendency to verbalize sound effects when teaching. She's been dancing for 10 years and is highly admired by the people in the club. For her future career she wants to become a Theater Director. The artist that inspired her into dancing was Ne-Yo.

name: Iori Itsukushima
description: A second year and a member of Ichirin High School's Dance Club. His skills are excellent but he's a ghost member.

name: Gaku Kabeya
description: He's a b-boy.

name: Konata
description: Konata is a mysterious high school girl who confined a mangaka in his (The mangaka's) own room.

appearsIn.title: Mishiranu Joshikousei ni Kankinsareta Mangaka no Hanashi

name: Keirean La Monique
aliases: Commander of the Second Knights Division Corps
description: Aristia's father and Jeremia's husband. Since Keirean belongs to House Monique, he is bound by the vow of loyalty to the Imperial family

name: Shuusei Kugayama
description: Shuusei is the prince of the school. Due to an accident, he starts living together with Aoi. Throughout the series he continuously teases her.

name: Aoi Nishimori
description: At first Aoi finds Shuusei annoying and arrogant, though throughout the course of the story, she starts warming up to him. She is very good at cooking and often cooks the meals at the house.

name: Shouta Komine
description: Aoi's junior. He was a member of Shuusei's basketball club in middle school and has a crush on Aoi.

name: Kaede Igarashi
description: A girl in Aoi and Shuusei's class in their third year. She is Haru's best friend.

name: Moe Shibuya
description: Moe is Aoi's best friend and the reason that Aoi first makes contact with Shuusei. She confessed to Shuusei prior to the start of the manga and she was rejected.

name: Kento Nishimori
description: Aoi's younger brother. He discovers that Aoi and Shuusei are living together.

name: Wataru Sanjo
description: Lives in the same apartment complex as Aoi and Shuusei. He is skilled in cooking and often gives cooking lessons to the characters.

name: Haru Oonu
description: A girl in Aoi and Shuusei's class in third year. Initially it appears that she hates Shuusei but it is revealed that she in fact has a crush on him since middle school.

name: Loki
description: Loki is Nakaba's servant. He is half animal and half human. He hates Caesar, and is plotting to assassinate him. He asks Nakaba to go along with it, but she is unsure. He frequently rescues Nakaba from Caesar and cares for her a great deal. He is her personal servant and took care of her since she was young.

name: Nakaba
description: Nakaba, is the now married to Caesar the prince of Belquat, in a marriage of convenience to keep her family and his, from feuding on the single island in which they live. She is disgusted by him, but cannot find the heart to kill him and is torn between assassinating him and letting him live. Her personal servant is Loki. She is frowned upon because of her red hair. Royals, have distinguished black hair. Caesar frequently reminds her of her place in his castle and as his wife, by means of lust, control and commands, that she cannot refuse.

name: Caesar
description:
Caesar is the prince of Belquat. He has an odd relationship with Nakaba, and frequently uses lust against her, to show her position as a subordinate. He puts on an act toward his people as a kind person who tolerates her, despite the colour of her hair and her sub-human and half animal servant, Loki.

All the royals, have black hair, and Caesar thinks that since he is a prince and has black hair, that he is above them. He is commanding, arrogant and likes to be in control. Later on though, he develops real feelings towards Nakaba.

name: Ahkil
description: The fifth prince of Lithuanel, the neighboring country. He wears a huge robe with sleeves that cover his hands. He knows a lot about Nakaba's time arcana ability.

name: Cain
description: Caesar's older brother.

name: Ririto Ibusuki
description: The first love of [Tarou](https://anilist.co/character/174329/Kurume-Tarou), from when they were in the same English class ten years ago. When Ibusuki left to go overseas Tarou forgot about their time together, until Tarou is hit in the head with a baseball. Three days later, out of the blue Ibusuki is a new transfer student in Tarou's class, looking a bit different to how he remembered.

name: Tarou Kurume
description: Wakasanomiya class 1-2. Childhood friends with Ebino Mei and Yatsuhiro Ryuu. Tarou believes in "energy-saving" and initially has no interest in love-related matters.

name: Mei Ebino
description: Tarou's childhood friend and neighbor. She attends the same school as him and is responsible for the injury that causes him to see the First Love Zombies.

name: Eve
description:
Kurume Tarou's first love zombie based off his expectations of what Ririsu Ibusuki would look like at 15 years old. Unlike most other zombies, Eve is self-aware and able to interact with her owner.

She often appears floating above Tarou's head wearing sparkly flowing pink hair with a hair accessory, and a white sailor uniform.

name: Kazuki Kurume
description: Tarou's sister.

name: Delice Kaleid
description: Archduke of the Delpais Empire. Called the 'Reincarnation of Evil'.

description: A 17-year-old girl who works at a factory run by an alien, who she hates. In fact, she hates all of the aliens that are now living in Japan.

name: Seiran Kitami
description: Nomamoto's co-worker. Kitami has a massive grudge against the alien race for killing his family in a car accident that the perpetrator got away with. He and Nomamoto join forces in an alien-killing journey.

name: Soyo Kitami
description: Seiran's younger sister. Died in a traffic accident involving aliens.

name: Yuka Ishiodori
description: Soyo Kitami's best friend and an idol with the stage name Odori.

name: Iglaskar

name: Ji-Hu Min

name: Seo-Ha Kim
description: The only child of a wealthy family. She's been well-off her whole life and never really worried about her future. She had a bit of a lonely childhood though.

name: Allen
description: Allen lives in a small, nameless pioneer village. His status is serf. Although he is ostensibly without talent, he actually has the world's only "Summoner" class. In fact, he was an enthusiastic gamer in his previous life, and with his experience and enthusiasm of clearing unreasonably high-difficulty games, he challenges the "hell mode" of another world.

appearsIn.title: Hell Mode: The Hardcore Gamer Dominates Another World with Garbage Balancing - Summoner of the Beginning

name: Krena
description: A serf girl with an innocent personality. Her natural class is "Sword Lord" - while her skills with swordplay already outpaced an adult's when she was five years old, she'd not good with using her head. Loves to fight and plays knights with her childhood friend Allen.

appearsIn.title: Hell Mode: The Hardcore Gamer Dominates Another World with Garbage Balancing - Summoner of the Beginning

name: Cecil Granvelle
native: セシル・グランヴェル
description: The willful young heiress of the Granvelle family, who own and lord over Allen's hometown. Her class is "Wizardess". She usually plays the role of a graceful daughter to her family, but shows her selfish side to her closest friends.

appearsIn.title: Hell Mode: The Hardcore Gamer Dominates Another World with Garbage Balancing - Summoner of the Beginning

name: Dogora
description: The son of an arms dealer in Granvelle Village, Dogora is considered the bratty general of the kids there. He has a competitive personality and wears his heart on his sleeve. His natural talent is wielding axes. He loves to tease Allen, who he considers lower than himself.

name: Fuuma Monou
description:
The primary antagonist and Kamui's dear friend. Fuuma is initially kind and gentle. He helps his father dutifully and dotes upon his younger sister Kotori, and excels at high-school sports. After Nataku attacks Kyogo and steals the first Shinken, Fuuma's dying father tells him that he is Kamui's twin star. 

In __Tsubasa: Reservoir Chronicle__

name: Kamui Shirou
description:
__Powers:__ Powerful psychic, demonstrating telekinetic ability, the proverbial "power (authority) of God"
__Kekkai (barrier field):__ Perfect sphere (anime only)
__Relatives:__ Shirou Tooru / Magami Tooru (mother; deceased), Magami Tokiko
__Romantic Interests:__ Monou Kotori
__Closer Friends:__ Monou Fuma

When the audience is first introduced to Kamui at the very beginning of X, he appears to be nothing more than a brooding and somewhat cocky fifteen year old from Okinawa who is gifted with extraordinary telekinetic powers. He has returned to the place where he spent his early childhood, Tokyo, for the first time in six years, prompted to do so by the mysterious dying words of his mother, Shirou Tooru, that his destiny awaited him in Tokyo.   

__Tsubasa: Reservoir Chronicle:__

name: Akira Ijuuin
description: A 4th grader and the Elementary School Board Treasurer. Akira is a first-class chef, a trait he inherited from his father. He lives with his two mothers and has also inherited his father's legacy as the notorious thief 20 Masks. Akira also appears in Clamp's Man of Many Faces, Duklyon: Clamp School Defenders, Tsubasa: Reservoir Chronicle and X/1999.

name: Yuzuriha Nekoi
description: One of the dragons of Heaven, a fourteen-year-old schoolgirl descended from the keepers of Mitsumine Jinja, masters of inugami (dog-spirits), Yuzuriha is exceedingly energetic, often diffusing latent tension between Kamui and the rest of the Ten no Ryū. Yuzuriha is attended by her own personal inugami, Inuki, who can transform into anything she desires and who only others with occult powers can see. She was teased throughout much of her childhood as her classmates believed Inuki was her imaginary friend. Because of this, Yuzuriha made a vow that she would never fall in love with (or even date) a man who could not see Inuki. However, the first person outside of her family that she meets who can see Inuki is Shiyū Kusanagi—a Dragon of Earth. Yuzuriha falls in love with Kusanagi, regardless of their conflicting fates.     __In Tsubasa Reservoir Chronicle__

name: Suou Takamura
description: A 5th grader and the Elementary School Board Secretary. Suoh is a martial arts expert, with a 3rd dan blackbelt in Karate, Judo, Aikido, and Kendo (he would have gone higher, but he ran out of competition), he's also good in kyūdō. He is also the descendant of a Japanese ninja clan, and has sworn to protect Nokoru though anything. He is also responsible for making sure the chairman does all of his paperwork on time.

name: Nokoru Imonoyama
description: A 6th grade student and the Elementary School Board Chairman. The youngest son of the Imonoyama zaibatsu, the founders of Clamp School, he has inherited the family fondness of doing absurd things just for the sake of doing them. Nokoru has one of the top IQs in a school full of geniuses and NASA has been vying for the mind of the elementary schooler. He also has the unique ability to detect a lady in distress from two kilometers away. For this reason, he established the Clamp School Detective Agency, although this was also an incentive to get out of his Chairman duties. He is also the only one out of the three young detectives that doesn't play a sport.

name: Daisuke Saiki
description: Seiichiro's nephew Saiki Daisuke is also a wind magician, though not of Seiichiro's calibre. Saiki and Kamui initially do not get along very well, as the stoic and strictly by-the-rules Saiki was not completely convinced that Kamui was the one on which the fate of humanity rested; later, they understand each other better and become friends. Saiki lives to protect Hinoto, for whom he seems to have affections. In the manga, he is brutally decapitated by Fuuma while protecting Hinoto; in the anime, he's crushed to death under rubble.

name: Satsuki Yatouji
description:
One of the Dragons of earth, a complex and ingenious young woman with utter contempt for humans, and a love for the digital world.

Even though being usually cold and emotionless, she develops feelings for Yuuto.

 __In Tsubasa Reservoir Chronicle:__

name: Inuki
description: Inuki is a god-dog given to Yuzuriha Nekoi when she was a kid. He is her best friend and companion. Inuki can transform himself into several thing including the shape of a sword where he helps Yuzuriha fighting. He can't be seen by ordinary people, and this made Yuzuriha really sad when she was young - people used to call her a lier for her telling that he was at her side, and nobody saw him.

name: Karen Kasumi
description: A dragon of heaven, Karen is a  Soapland call girl and devout Catholic, she was abused by her fundamentalist mother when her power to manipulate fire manifested in her childhood. She comes to admire Aoki.      __In Tsubasa Reservoir Chronicle__

name: Credos
description:
Level 666

A college student, who transmigrated into the final boss of the game "Paladin of Blood". Thinking if he lived like this, he would be killed by the warriors he raised, Kim Jang-Cheol, a graduate student and slave to the agricultural department, uses his knowledge of agriculture to survive the starving demon invasion.

appearsIn.title: What a Bountiful Harvest, Demon Lord!
