name: Shin Kim
description:
__Height:__ 183 cm

Kim Shin is a legend in Russia. He is the top hitman in the country, known as Amur Tigro by those who live there. After one last mission, he has decided to go back to Korea and settle his score with Castle, the supreme criminal conglomerate that governs the entirety of the Korean underworld. With a past closely tied to Castle's own and a plan, built and prepared for through many years, Shin is finally ready to take down Castle, building his own forces along the way.

name: Jin-Tae Seo
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm

Jin-Tae, much like [Kim Shin](https://anilist.co/character/334237/Shin-Kim), [Pi Woo-Jin](https://anilist.co/character/334229/WooJin-Pi) and [Kim Dae-Geon](https://anilist.co/character/334230/DaeGeon-Kim), was one of the trainees under Kang Min-Seung, but much of his past is unknown. He is, however, immensely loyal to Shin and his right-hand man, the one who is most loyal to him and the one who most commonly keeps him company and aids him in both combat and in difficult times. A natural jokester, good-humoured and flirtatious man, many do not take Jin-Tae seriously until it is too late, when they fully realize that he is also one of Iskra's deadliest killers.

name: Young Pyo
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm

The leader of Pinout, Busan's most widely known and feared gang, he is a rebellious youth who wanders the area aimlessly, beating down any attempts of organized crime to form within his area whenever possible. An unquenchable fury burns on him from being abandoned twice, by both his biological and adoptive parents, and the killing and maiming of those he had dearest by the hands of Oh Do-Hwa.

name: Woo-Jin Pi
description:
__Height:__ 184 cm

One of the discilpes of Kang Min-Seong alongside [Kim Shin](https://anilist.co/character/334237/Shin-Kim) and [Kim Dae-Geon](https://anilist.co/character/334230/DaeGeon-Kim), Woo-Jin is a notable fellow of the Hoeam area who once opposed the takeover of the area by the Hasung group, alongside his peer Dae-Geon, but eventually failed and, since then, recluded himself to the shadows, drinking and sulking his life away, apparently having given up at everything. However, Shin hasn't forgotten the old bond between the two of them, and one of the first things he did upon arriving in Korea was contacting him, and as he observes Shin's progress, the more he doubts his choices, and gains hope to, maybe, finally make things right.

name: Dae-Geon Kim
description:
__Height:__ 182 cm

One of Min-Seong's disciples alongside [Kim Shin](https://anilist.co/character/334237/Shin-Kim), [Pi Woo-Jin](https://anilist.co/character/334229/WooJin-Pi) and [Seo Jin-Tae](https://anilist.co/character/334228/JinTae-Seo), Dae-Geon's story is one of self-sacrifice. Alongside Woo-Jin, he once opposed Hasung's takeover on the Hoeam region, until an incident in which Dae-Geon and Woo-Jin directly assaulted the cornerstone of Hasung at the time and Dae-Geon confronted Deok-Su by himself. After that, Dae-Geon seemingly betrayed those of Hoeam and joined the Hasung group, but in truth, he did so in a pact with Deok-Su: In exchange of his fealty, they would leave his friends alone and let them live well. For a long time, Dae-Geon served the group dutifully, although jaded and a cynic with low self-worth, but eventually, upon meeting Shin and becoming his first serious opponent, he starts to undergo a change of heart.

__Height:__ 180 cm

One of Castle's greatest cleaners, their epithet for professional killers, Tae-Jin is a man of contradiction. One of their best assassins, yet he despises killing; a criminal who has committed atrocities in life and serves monsters, yet is a religious person who attempts to atone every day. Tae-Jin kills because that is what he is good at and the only way he sees himself able to change the world, but has grown jaded and lost, donating much of what he gains to charities and churces to atone for his deeds.

name: Estevan Ermaneau

name: Pycifica Donovan
description: She is Oscar's biological mother and the former wife of Estevan. After a strategic marriage arranged by Estevan's father, she gave birth to Oscar and then went through an agreed-upon divorce. She became the Duchess of Donovan.

name: Si-Won Yoon

name: Choco
description: Choco is a disabled werewolf that despite having one leg missing, is strong and keeps going.

name: Thor
description: Besides loving food, Thor is a werewolf who will do anything to please his master. He is one of Haru's friends and is dating a shy werewolf named Lammy.

name: Song-I Han
description:
She is an intelligent student who may seem like all she cares about is grades, however she is a caring girl who will lend a helping hand to others. She is Choco's master. 

(Source: Webtoon Wiki)

name: Pring
description:
Pring is seen as the calm, fancy werewolf who becomes slightly famous among the other werewolves. He attracts a lot of ladies at school. He hates exercising and would rather take selfies.

(Source: Webtoon Wiki)

description: Melvin is the father of Raul and the head of House Ashton, one of the five esteemed families of the Ruben Kingdom

appearsIn.title: The Count's Youngest Son is a Gamer

name: Geon Jeon
description: He is the second son of the Hunan Jang family. Circumstances eventually led him to leave his family behind and walk a new path as a vagabond, dedicating himself to recreating the martial arts he had only imagined in his previous life.

name: Lilith May
description:
Main character of the novel 'Lovers in Atlanta'. The novel describes her to be easygoing, angelic and to have a pleasant disposition. She was raised in the countryside as the only child of Baron and Baroness May.

Sasha is shocked when the two first meet, as Lilith acts nothing like she does in the original story.

name: Rebecca Aertsen
description:
Rebecca was the main Antagonist of the novel, 'Lovers in Atlanta'.  She is the fiance of the Crown Prince and only child of Duke Aertsen. House Aertsen is one of the country's founding families, and the closest family to the royals.

From a young age, Rebecca was raised to be the perfect crown princess and wife of Prince Johannes. She is described to have unmatched beauty, temperament, perfection and family status.

Rebecca favours Sasha, has her live at the Aertsen estate and showers her with gifts. When Sasha stated that she thought knights were 'cool', Rebecca started learning swordsmanship. Sasha encourages Rebecca to stand up for herself against Johannes.

While Rebecca has no way of breaking her engagement, she plans to stall the marriage for as long as possible.

Rebecca is confident and states, _"I've yet to meet a man in this kingdom who comes close to being on the same level as me"._

name: Naska
description:
One of the four love interest in the 'Lovers in Atlanta' novel. He becomes part of the Aertsen household at request of Sasha. After joining the household, he becomes Sasha's escort and bodyguard.

Sasha knows he is a dragon, but Naska does not know she knows. As a dragon, he frequently looks down on humans and questions their logic. Sasha tries her best to teach him human etiquette.

He pretends to be a powerful sorcerer, which allows people to dismiss his social aloofness. 

Naska likes Candy Floss and fried chicken.

name: Arth Klein
description:
Prince Johanne's aide and 

He graduated Mulansa Academy, the kingdom's most prestigious learning institute, within two years and is recognized as one of the kingdom's smartest. He takes orders directly from the king. Arth is an avid reader and always carries a book with him.

In 'Lovers in Atlanta' he is the key character in Rebecca's downfall and one of the four love interests.

His mother was a commoner that was plagued with an inferiority complex and his father was an alcoholic. His half-commoner blood led him to be scorned by other aristocrats.

name: Johannes Carolousse
description:
Johannes was the main love interest in the 'Lovers in Atlanta' novel. He is the Crown Prince and known 'Womanizer' despite being engaged to Rebecca Von Aertsen.

He ignores Rebecca's requests for loyalty and uses the excuse "I must enjoy myself before marriage". Johannes promises he will be loyal to Rebecca only after marriage. Johannes and Rebecca frequently fight and have a strained relationship.

He does not like Sasha, as he believes her to be the cause of Rebecca's change in attitude and neglect towards him.

name: Evie
description:
Betrothed to Prince Claude and friend of Sasha. She is described in the novel to be _"Soft-hearted to the point of naivety and easygoing for a noble"_. In the novel, the protagonist dislikes the 'snobbish nature' of high society, and so becomes friends with Evie who is not snobbish.

Evie gifts her lesser used items to her maids and plays the violin for her parents.

name: Ahura Masda
description: Sultan of Kanakta.

name: Kalia
description:
Lead Guard for the delegation from Kanakta. Payne states he heard Kalia had been trained as a warrior from a young age and had a more intense training than anyone else.

Her mother was part of the royal concubine. Her mother was also deemed to be too tall for a woman, so her feet were cut off at the ankles as punishment. Kalia swore that she wouldn't follow her mother lifestyle.

She does not follow noble etiquette, which leads her to being rude when speaking to superiors and nobles in Atlanta. She says not even the Sultan can change her way of speech.

Despite her skill, she is frequently belittled for being a woman.

name: Payne Carolousse
description:
Second Prince of Atlanta and the kingdom's best knight. In the novel, 'Lovers in Atlanta', Payne asked the king to think of him of a knight rather than a son. The Royal Family calls him a 'war-crazed maniac' and royal servants believe him to be cursed.

He rarely makes appearances at parties and social gatherings as he is usually away on battlefields.

Payne also works with foreign ambassadors as he knows multiple languages and knows the affairs of other countries.

name: Harin Lee
description:
Lee Harin (이하린 ihalin) is the main female protagonist of the korean webtoons, Flow. She is currently the president of the school Yun Lee-Rang transferred to. Lee Harin is considered as one of the strongest anima user in the manhwa and is noted to have 'the strongest destructive ability' after the Four Animal Gods.Harin is shown as an elegant, graceful student at first, where Lee-Rang thought she was a 'Sheep', however, she was then shown as a tomboy who likes to tie her hair into a ponytail and uses her school uniform in the first arc of the manhwa. After the meeting with Hyun Moo, she started letting her hair go and was shown to use a variety or dresses, shirt, pants and skirts depending on the event.

Harin is a beautiful girl with crimson-magenta hair which was always curling naturally right below her breasts. She also has the same colored eyes as her hair, just like the other characters in the manhwa. She has ivory skin and is quite tall, being slightly shorter than Hong Ryun. Her figure is slim and curved in the right places, Harin has perfect long slender neck, heart shaped face and sharp chin.

name: Lee-Rang Yun
description: Yun Lee-Rang (윤이랑 yun-ilang) is the main protagonist of the manhwa series, Flow. He has two very close childhood friends, Suh Yul-Bi and Hong Ryun. Lee-Rang has burgundy hair that matches his eyes. His hair is medium length that reaches to the back of his neck and most of the time, he ties his hair into a pony tail at the back. He isn't quite tall but he's definitely taller than most of the girls in the school that he's met so far.

name: Han-Jun Park
description: He fought against the nationwide high school gangster Nexus, headed by Kim Chun-soo, but was sued and lost in court. After selling the gym run by Park Han-joon's father, he vows not to fight.

name: Jun-Woo Oh
description: Korea's youngest self-made conglomerate and chairman of OJ Group. He suggests that Park Han-jun join him because he too experienced something from Kim Cheon-soo.

name: Seo-Hyeon Choi
description: Choi Seo-Hyeon is a SNS star with 570,000 followers on Instagram. According to Oh Jun-woo, her position is an informant. She is said to be in agreement with taking down Nexus.

name: Dong-Hyun Kim
description:
Former No. 1 at Dongyeon High School. When Park Han-jun waged war against Nexus, he fought with Park Han-jun until the end. However, because of that, his knees were injured.

After that, he was having a hard time because of bullies + he couldn't get proper treatment due to lack of money, but when Park Han-jun transferred to his school and fought against the bullies, he fought alongside him.

name: Cheon-Soo Kim
description: No. 1 member of the crime syndicate Nexus. He is known to the public as a professional gamer, but in reality, he is a villain who commits all kinds of crimes on behalf of the Nexus organization.

name: In-Soo Nam
description:
Incheon branch manager.

Unlike the other branch managers who dress up according to their own tastes, he wears a suit and has a large scar over his left eye.

name: Naviah Agnus
description: An orphan adopted into the Agnus family to serve as a stand-in for the Duke's sick daughter, who was to be engaged to the crown prince. After trying and failing so many times to be loved by her new family (resulting in her death each time), she resolves to use her 'final' life for her own sake.

name: Lark Ethelred
description: The head of the Ethelred family and the catalyst for its recent decline and reputation as a garbage dump. He adopts Naviah and Creed.

name: Creed
description: Formerly from the royal family, he becomes the foster child and successor of the Ethelred family.

name: Diana Dufman
description: Empress and mother to Crown Prince Ares.

name: Margaret Romanov
description: The head manager of House Ethelred. A renowned war hero.

name: Eudes Agnus
description: Son and successor to Duke Agnus. Bullies Naviah due to her low status.

name: Minverva Hart
description: The family doctor of Ethelred.

name: Nikan Agnus
description: Head of the Agnus family.

name: Schuleman Zenegar
description: Lark's aide, a renowned magician who made a name for himself as a war hero alongside Margaret.

name: Joon Go
description: Go Joon is a ghost living in the same apartment as Yeori. He died there three years ago but still cannot move on. Having to deal with the death of his parents from a young age, he tried to build as many relationships with people as possible when he was alive in order to fill the loneliness his parents left in his heart. Aside from that, he had to accept death and start living as a ghost which was extremely difficult, painful, and lonely...

name: Eun-Taek Gwon
description:
__Studies__: 2nd year Business Administration
__Height__: 184 cm 
__Family__: parents, three older sisters

name: Taker
description: **Species:** Angel

name: Naerim Shin
description:
Hair Colour: Black
Eye Colour: Brown
Nationality: Korean

The daughter of a shaman who's a social outcast and the victim of bullying in her school. Her luck changes when she comes across Fetechou and accidentally contracts with him; as their relationship develops, Naerim learns to be more open and gains the strength to change her situation. Unbeknownst to her, she's also fated to bear the burden of being a shaman herself and must learn to be a strong spiritual leader like her mother.

name: Fetechou Vlad
description:
Hair Colour: Blue (Petrol)
Eye Colour: Red & Yellow
Species: Western Vampire

A vampire over five hundred years old whom Naerim accidentally binds to herself in a magical contract. Although a vampire, he turns out to be quite friendly and tends to mostly feed on animal blood, only wanting Naerim's blood because drinking the blood of a witch will turn him human. Over time Naerim learns that there's quite a lot of darkness beneath his cheerful facade.

name: So Ri Jeon
description: A deaf woman who is currently living with Min Geun Soo, a popular manhwa artist, who became blind from overworking.

appearsIn.title: Can't See Can't Hear But Love

name: Geun Soo Min
description: The main male protagonist of the story. He is a man who used to be a manhwaga but recently had to quit his job due to his quickly dropping eyesight that results in blindness. As he struggles to live his once-normal daily life, he receives help from Sori, a deaf girl.

appearsIn.title: Can't See Can't Hear But Love

name: Yun-Jeong
description: Her mother forced her to dance ballet as a child even though Yun-Jeong hated it. Her mother never listen when she said she wanted to be a manhwaga. Yun-Jeong got so desperate that she tried to kill herself, but her mother was still persistent. While in the hospital she received a copy of Geon Soo's manhua which gave her hope to live. She disowned her mother and now works as Geon Soo's assistant. She loves Geon Soo and is desperate to get Sori out of the picture. source: I read the manhwa

appearsIn.title: Can't See Can't Hear But Love

name: San
description:
San is an attractive Android with an hourglass figure. She is quite tall, having a height of 181cm. She has long silvery-white hair which is usually combed back and the trademark Android red eyes. She also has a tattoo just below her left eye, saying "+BEAUTY+". San wears black leather gloves when fighting, to stop the skin on her hands from tearing.

According to Milo, San and Nano are the only Androids that he has found truly beautiful.

(Source: Nano List Wiki)

name: Do-Jin Ahn
description:
Milo Ahn is the current owner of androids San and Nano. He is Maddie Ahn's younger brother and has nanomachines in his body because of his sister.Student and weak.

(Soure: Nano List wiki)

name: Nano
description:
Her appearance is similar to that of a child as she is often described as "young" and "small". She has short dark hair that stops at her neck and her height is petite compared to other androids. She was first seen wearing a ribbon so that she could be distinguished by Milo as his 17th birthday present. She is often described as 'lovely' and 'cute' which was how Dr. Maddie Ahn wanted her to be.

(Source: Nano List wiki)

name: Chacha
description:
Chacha is a MSA Android who intends to use the Nano List technology to subjugate humans. Chacha enjoys a position of influence at MSA and employs other Androids to help realise her schemes. According to Dr. Ahn she is under the protection of the head of MSA.

(Source: Nano List wiki

name: Do-Hwa Ahn
description:
Dr. Maddie Ahn was Milo's elder sister. She was a leading expert in Android Production who created Nano in collaboration with MSA. Maddie was a brilliant researcher and the only one who succeeded incorporating the nanomachine manipulation program into an Android.

(Source: Nano List wiki)

description:
Name: Zavi
Race: Android
Android Type: RepairZavi is a repair android who once took care of Samuel Min.

(Source: Nano List wiki)

name: Quingshan Gu
description: As a military Supreme Commander in his past life, he sacrificed himself in the war against the Demons but found himself set back 10+ years in time instead of dying, given a chance to re-do his life again.

name: Che Yun
description:
Yun Che (云澈) is the main protagonist of Against the Gods. He was cornered at Cloud's End Cliff on the Azure Cloud Continent by his enemies, who came after him for the Sky Poison Pearl. Left with no choice, Yun Che decided to swallow the Sky Poison Pearl to prevent his enemies from gaining possession of it and jumped off of Cloud's End Cliff to his death.

Afterwards, Yun Che woke up to find out that he isn't dead but had transmigrated into a dead body with the name Xiao Che, who had been killed by the Murdering Heart Powder and was to be married that same day. The Sky Poison Pearl had also merged with his left hand and the same "silver pendant" he had in his past life was still strapped around his neck.

name: Hong'er
description: Hong'er is able to instantly transform into her second form which is a gigantic crimson red heavy sword. She was technically not a weapon but a unique existence connected to Yun Che's soul and willpower.

name: Yue Cang
description: Cang Yue, also known as Lan Xueruo, is the seventh child of the Emperor and only Princess of the Blue Wind Empire. She went around Blue Wind looking for talents to represent the Blue Wind Profound Palace in the Blue Wind Ranking Tournament. She used the Monarch Heart Secret Art to search for talents and found Yun Che. She later ascended the throne as Empress after her father was assassinated and Blue Wind faced destruction after being invaded by Divine Phoenix Empire.

name: Xue'er Feng
description: Feng Xue'er is the only princess of the Divine Phoenix Empire. Since her youth, she was heavily protected by the Divine Phoenix Sect as their hidden trump card. She is the complete inheritor of the Phoenix God that was the deity and protector of the Sect. Due to her divine body and her immense beauty, she attracted unwanted and perverted attention from her royal brothers and members of the Sacred Grounds. Her beauty is high enough for her to be deemed as the Number One beauty of the Profound Sky Continent.

name: Tong Xing
description: Xing Tong, also known as Jasmine, is the crown princess of the Star God Realm.[2] At a young age, she inherited the strength of one of the Twelve Star Gods, the Heavenly Slaughter Star God.

name: Yuechan Chu
description:
Chu Yuechan was the First Fairy of Frozen Cloud Asgard's Frozen Cloud Seven Fairies, until her affair with Yun Che became known, and led to her being expelled from Frozen Cloud Asgard.

After being expelled, Xuanyuan Yufeng sent three men from Mighty Heavenly Sword Region to attack and kill her, but it ended in failure, as she escaped into the Snow Region of Extreme Ice and found a snow phoenix which she rode to safety and the 3 men became lost in the snowstorm. After she escaped no news concerning her and her child has been found.

name: Xi Shen
description: Shen Xi was the (fake) Dragon Queen of the Dragon God Realm. She used to live in seclusion in the Forbidden Land of Samsara.

name: Mu Xuanyin
description: Mu Xuanyin was the former Realm King of the Snow Song Realm and former Sect Master of the Divine Ice Phoenix Sect. The soul of the Ice Phoenix resides in her body and she is the first person in the history of Snow Song Realm to cultivate the Ice Phoenix God Investiture Canon to its completion. She is capable of sealing wide areas of land in ice with just a flick of her fingers.

name: Chi Wuyao
description: Chi Wuyao is the Great Realm King of the Soul Stealing Realm. She's technically also one of Yun Che's masters. Since his master Mu Xuanyin had 10% of Chi Wuyao's Nirvana Devil Emperor soul planted within her and was partially influenced by Chi Wuyao.

name: Yun Qianying
description: Yun Qianying/Qianye Ying'er is the daughter of the Brahma Monarch God Emperor. She is well-known in the Realm of the Gods as the Brahma Monarch Goddess due to her supreme beauty that is able to captivate the hearts of all men. She has a deep desire to become the strongest and rule over the entire God Realm.

name: Hu-Jun
description:
A famous Hallyu singer. He is easily nervous and he is sometimes picky. His name is a pseudonym and birthday is fake. 

According to Who-Jun, he has been quietly doing what the company told him to do for 7 years.

name: Nam Kang
description: Nam Kang lost his parents from a fire and has turned blind from the incident. He wasn't able to see anything but a hallucination called Kkamjang.

name: Geon Kang
description: He is [Nam](https://anilist.co/character/163993/Gangnam)'s elder brother.

description: The main character in this manhwa who is the bully that wrecks the life of the other main character who is weak and nerdy.

description: Student in the fashion department at Guntae University and a former idol.

name: Taerin Yang
description: Fashion student at Guntae University.

name: Yoonsik Bong
description: Student in the music department (composition) at Guntae University.

name: Jiho Shin
description:
Jiho Shin is the leading male protagonist of the LINE Webtoons webcomic unTouchable. He is a human and at first has an irrational fear of physical contact due to his extreme mysophobia.

(Source: UnTOUCHable Wiki)

name: Sia Lee
description:
Sia Lee is the main female character of the webtoon. She is a model who is actually a vampire that feeds on human energy by touching them. She is attracted to Jiho Shion's energy and thinks he is one of a kind and struggles to aid him heal from mysophobia so that she can touch (feed on) him.

(Source: UnTOUCHable)

name: Baryu
description:
Baryu is a rockstar who is originally a vampire in human disguise. He is the main vocalist of the popular idol group, O'Rnij. Using his popularity as an idol, he takes the opportunity of touching fans to absorb their energy. Baryu is Sia and Sihwan's childhood friend.

(Source: UnTOUCHable Wiki)

name: Sihwan Yun
description:
Sihwan is Sia and Baryu's childhood friend. He is a human who knows about the vampires. He is Baryu's companion and also serves as his 'emergency food'.

(Source: UnTOUCHable Wiki)

name: Na-Ri Oh
description: Nari  is the main protagonist of Odd Girl Out and is currently a first-year student at C.H. High. Nari is a kind and pure-hearted girl who is loved by everyone.

name: Mi-Rae Seo
description: Mirae Seo is one of the main protagonists of Odd Girl Out and is currently a first-year student at C.H. High. Even though she appears to be cheerful she actually has low self-esteem and has been taking antidepressants for years which she stopped taking recently.

name: Seon-Ji Im
description: Seon-Ji is one of the main protagonists of Odd Girl Out and is currently a first-year student at C.H. High. She is very sweet and kind.

name: Yu-Na Im
description: Yuna Lim is one of the main protagonists of Odd Girl Out and is currently a first-year student at C.H. High. She appears to be very cold-hearted and rude but she is actually a kind, caring friend towards Mirae and Seonji and especially towards Nari.

name: Chan-Yang Ju
description: Chanyang is a new character who started appearing in Season Two, and he is in the same class as Nari, Mirae, and Seonji. He takes the seat next to Nari in the beginning of the school year.

name: Seung-Ha Kwon
description: Seungha Kwon is the male lead character of Odd Girl Out and is currently a second-year student at C.H. High. He is one of the two most handsome boys in the 2nd grade, along with Chanyang for his handsome appearance, and is very popular among the students.

name: U-Gyeong Jeong
description: Wookyung Jung is a male character from Odd Girl Out. He is a famous actor had Starred in the show Children's village with Mirae Seo when they were kids

name: Sammy
description: Sammy is a minor character of Odd Girl Out and is the pet of Yuna Lim.

name: Yeo-Jin Im
description: Yeojin Im is a minor character from Odd Girl Out. She is the mother of Yuna Im.

name: Aisha
description:
Daughter of Gwen and Norma.
Stepdaughter of Sylvia

description: Son of Sylvia who fell inlove with Ayesha

name: Sylvia
description: Married Gwen, Ayesha's father.

name: Nemo
description: Son of Sylvia who loves painting.

name: Kaisar Adelman
description: Count Kaisar Adelman. Rubenio Seiah sends him to protect his daughter, Ninenya.

name: Valhyle Rumares
description: Commander-in-chief of the Rohaneim army.

name: Zeline Meredyth
description: The eighth princess of the Roymund kingdom and the 14th generation descendant of Vumaha.

name: Min-Gyeom Park
description: Likes sweet things such as chocolates and cookies, meat and egg. Good with his studies. His mother passed away while giving him birth. Has daddy issues as his father uses him for his own purpose. He has a step little sister as well with whom he has a better relation than the rest of the family members. Min-Gyeom has too much blood in his body which gets recovered quickly and thats why he can feed Chun-Sam.

name: Chun-Sam Kim
description: He is a vampire. At first he was pretty weak as he couldn't get enough blood, but after meeting Min-Gyeom and feeding on his blood, Chun-Sam becomes healthier. He is tall, good at sports, kind and good natured. Can't handle human food.

name: Linley Baruch
description:
Linley Baruch is a tall (190 cm in height) handsome man with long brown hair and light brown eyes.

Linley was born on the 1st of January, year 9982 of the Yulan calendar, on the Yulan Plane, as a descendant to the declining Baruch Clan. As a youth, his father taught him the history of their Dragonblood Clan and he obtained the Coiling Dragon Ring, which contained the spirit of Delin/Doehring Cowart, a saint-level magus who would become Linley's mentor.

Linley is an extremely focused individual always striving to improve himself and intending to one day become the greatest. This has been proven again and again to be his strongest trait even when reaching a powerful status he still chooses to meditate and train over spending time with his friends and family. However, it should be noted that Linley does love his family and friends, and regards them above all else. In fact, his love far exceeds his ambition, as he was willing to sacrifice his strongest and most powerful instruments for the chance to help his family.

name: Bebe
description: Bebe is a magical beast, a shadowmouse and the companion of Linley Baruch.

name: Liuxiang Shui
description: Youngest daughter of the Shui Family. She is Chu Xingyun's childhood friend, second love interest, and first wife.

name: Ji-Tae Yu
description: He is the strongest human in the world, but when four young dragons are forced to come to Earth due to interference from the mastermind, the Earth is destroyed.

name: Bom Yu
description: A green dragon with the power of prophecy, and the eldest of four sisters.

name: Yeo-Reum Yu
description: A red dragon of the warrior race, the second eldest of four sisters. She has a strong obsession with strength.

name: Ga-Eul Yu
description: A gold dragon and the third of four sisters. She has a strong obsession with beauty and human attention.

name: Gyeo-Ul Yu
description: A blue dragon, the polar opposite of the red dragon, and the youngest of four sisters.

name: Won-Yeong Ji
description: Height: 176cm

name: Tae-Jun Yun
description: Height: 188cm

name: Lu Fan
description: Student at the Dragon Kingdom Third School, he awakened one of three secret classes: Dragon Tamer.

appearsIn.title: National Job Change: I'm Stuck As the Weakest Dragon Tamer?!

name: Qingzhu Ling
description: She has a cold, demeanor attitude towards anyone.This is due to her being the successor of her clan, which in turn, turned her into someone who only cares about talent and result, making her heart unable to reason with others.

name: Dong Lin
description: Lin Dong is a smart person who is kind to who he sees as friends. However he is ruthless towards the ones he sees as enemies. He is not afraid to take risks and challenge strong opponents if they did him wrong. Early in the series he was unskilled and was bullied a lot by Lin Shan. However he was diligent in his training and didn't lose faith when encountering a setback. He challenged Lin Shan multiple times just to see his progress.

name: Langtian Lin
description: He participated in the Ten-Year Clan Gathering of the Lin Clan. In the first round he won against Lin Xiao. After winning without mercy he used his Yuan force to ravage the insides of Lin Xiao's body. This crippled him and lost his Heavenly Yuan Stage of strength en returned to Earthly Yuan Stage. He is strong and talented as he was able to defeat Lin Xiao. He is however cruel and doesn't know mercy.

name: Zhentian Lin
description: He once belonged to the inner circle of the Lin Clan. However he was banished after he failed a mission. This caused a huge loss for the Lin Clan. As punishment he was banished to Qingyang Town. There he established the Lin Family. Here he tried for over ten years to go back to the inner circle of his clan. However this proves to be hard as his accomplishments aren't even worth mentioning.

name: Xiao Lin
description: Once prideful outstanding genius of the Lin Family. After being crippled he felt unworthy. Even sick he went into the dangerous mountains in order to get resources to aid his son in his cultivation.

name: Tan Qing
description: Qing Tan is an orphan who was adopted by Liu Yan. She is also Lin Dong's sister. She is happy that Liu Yan adopted her. Therefore, she is willing to put her life in danger to get elixirs for Lin Dong.

name: Shan Lin
description: He bullies Lin Dong because his father brought shame to the Lin Family because he lost in the first round in the Ten-Year Clan Gathering of the Lin Clan.[14] He also is a liar as he once promised Qing Tan that he wouldn't beat Lin Dong if she gave him the Scarlet Sun Grass. After which he attacked Lin Dong anyway.

name: Benson Moretti

description: Giselle Rozevin is a villainess from The Poison Apple, a novel where she's doomed to an early death. After a sudden accident, the protagonist wakes up in Giselle's body. Despite several assassination attempts, she discovers that not only do the poisons fail to kill her, but she can also distinguish them by taste, sparking an unexpected fight for survival.

appearsIn.title: I Will Become the Villain's Poison Taster

name: Viola Vellatoux
aliases: The Lady of Ten Thousand Kills
description: Viola is a savage orphan born under the killing star and adopted by Heron Vellatoux into the ducal house of blood and iron. With misgivings about the novel's original ending, she aims to use her special knowledge and natural skills in Viola's body for a new ending where this cold family can have a happy ending.

name: Louise Sweeny
description: The main female lead. In the original novel, "Akademiui Gajjayeonin" she was the villain, however the lead was reincarnated as her and wants to change her fate, starting with not falling in love with the prince.

name: Na-Ra Lee
description:
Na-Ra is a quiet and brusque person who has a Korean mother and an English father. At the beginning of school year, no one spoke with her because they thought she couldn't speak Korean fluently. This and her attitude results in her spending most of the time by herself.

She does really well in training and has an excellent shot.

She has no idea Chi-Yeol has a crush on her.

name: Su-A Heo
description: Heo Su-A was born into a poor family and sold to the Yeo household to work as a maid at five years old. When she grew older, she became Yeo Yunhwa's handmaiden.

name: Rim Lee
description: Lee Rim is a chef who lost his sense of taste in a car accident a year ago. As a last ditch effort he decided to play a game called [Real] which is a VRMMO; in this game he regains his senses. Using his regained senses he adventures and cooks inside the game and regains the courage to work in a kitchen once again in reality.

name: Yilin Fan
description: An ordinary girl in her second year of high school. She's a good student, kind and outgoing, trusting of other people.

name: Ruoxi Lan
description: She colors her hair red for a special reason. Member of the Martial Arts Club. Playful with her friends, she is reliable and strong.

name: Ziyun Xu
description: President of the Drama Club and a good friend of Fan Yiling. Talkative and outgoing, she is always the life of the party.

name: Fan Gao
description: President of the Martial Arts Club and a childhood friend of Lan Ruoxi.

name: Xiaojie Dai
description: Former delinquent who reformed after she met Lan Ruoxi. Being from a rich family, she is generous to her friends.

name: Xiao Che
description: Yilin's friend after timeskip. They work together in radio and the girl joins the college friend group. She appears right from the S2 chapter 1.

appearsIn.title: Reincarnation of the Strongest Sword God

name: Gabriel
description: The player-guiding angel in the game God's Domain.

appearsIn.title: Reincarnation of the Strongest Sword God

name: Su Lüxia
description:
Su Lüxia is the main character of the story and she's known to have a mission success of 100% with the Second Female Lead Counterattack System.

Her mission is to change the fate of the second female leads in multiple mediums (such as novels or dramas) which have their own world/setting, and who ended up being crushed by either the main male lead or the main female lead. She gets a "remuneration" each time she completes a mission with the Second Female Lead Counterattack System, earning small props through the system's lottery.

Su Lüxia always makes sure to gather all the necessary information about the story beforehand, as such she is an extremely cunning and calculative individual, who knows what decision to make in advance. In specific situations during her mission, she will use special items given to her by the system that allows her to successfully change the tide in her favor.

name: Evan Linnaeus Icardes
description: The one and only heir of Duke Icardes. Laria's husband.

name: Gang-Sik Choi
description: Choi Gang-Sik was the cameraman of Yu Il-Am, a superhuman. While abandoned by Yu Il-Am on a hunt, he survived the monster's attacks by fighting wisely. He awakened his powers and realized that the more gods followed him, the stronger he became. In this way, he succeeded in kill the creature. He created a channel called CY cameraman to control his own private broadcast and continued his monster hunting broadcasts.

name: Hana Kang
description: The protagonist and a kindhearted orphan who, after losing her job and apartment, ends up reluctantly becoming involved with the charity organization RFA. She eventually takes on the role as their party planner.

name: Hyun Ryu
description:
__Height:__ 182 cm (6'0")

A semi-successful actor/dancer/singer. He can come across as narcissistic about his looks, often posting selfies and exclaiming how handsome he is. However, while it may seem he cares about his appearance the most, he wants to be recognized and appreciated first and foremost for his career skills.

On the surface, Zen is known for being a very eccentric and flirtatious character. He will often talk about his looks, praising and complimenting himself for how attractive he is, as well as how talented he is when it comes to singing and acting. Zen tends to compare others to himself when it comes to looks, frequently telling [Yoosung](https://anilist.co/character/165614/Kim-Yu-Seong) to work out to look half as good as he does. Despite this, Zen can become very loyal and caring, especially to those he cares about. In conjunction, deep down Zen self doubts himself, wondering if people only see him for his looks, rather than his talents. He can be easily upset if something affects his career, almost entering a depressive state.

He is known for pursuing larger and better musicals, offering up smaller ones or turning them down if the opportunity presents itself.

name: Luciel Choi
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm (5'9")

A hacker who can quickly find information on anything he can get his hands on.



For the most part, Seven displays a happy-go-lucky, outgoing, and very bizarre personality. He frequently plays pranks on [Yoosung](https://anilist.co/character/165614/Kim-Yu-Seong) and teases and makes fun of the other members (and himself), and, in response to just about anything, will respond with a series of "lol"s. He's your typical jokester who loves cars (he owns multiple) and holds a passion for hacking. However, the player's first impression of Seven is not the "real" him. Outside the chat room, and behind the humorous front he puts up, Seven is actually quite depressed and serious, and he refuses to believe that anything good can happen to him. This is due to his past and his profession, as he thinks that he will endanger anyone he gets close to. It's also mentioned that he's Catholic and later in his route he shows his religious values.

name: Ju-Min Han
description:
__Height:__ 184 cm (6'0")

The son of a wealthy family and the heir of the C&R International company. He is always on business trips and only talks about work or mature topics, which is why he doesn't know about youth slang or commoner food. Jumin loves to talk about and dote on his cat, Elizabeth 3rd, and how beautiful she is. Because of his past, Jumin is emotionally closed off and is distrustful of women.

Jumin is a quiet, serious, and cautious man who prefers to act mature. Despite this, he is interested in young slang and loves to talk about cats, especially his own, Elizabeth 3rd. In fact, in his own way, his general cadence will give off that of a child's. He also enjoys teasing [Zen](https://anilist.co/character/165617/Ryu-Hyun) about his cat allergy in the chat room. He is often surrounded by rumors concerning his sexuality because of his complete lack of interest in women, leading the press and other RFA members to tease him for possibly being gay. He views situations objectively, and wants others to be like him. He is a workaholic and disregards others' opinions of him, so he lives his life how he thinks is right.

Jumin doesn't care for relationships because he thinks they aren't worth it, preferring to focus on his work and cat instead. This gives him the impression to others of a cold man or even a robot. He also keeps his work relationships strictly professional, believing that his employees will do anything as long as they are paid to.

name: Yu-Seong Kim
description:
__Height:__ 171 cm (5'7")

A sophomore college student who plays a game called LOLOL and invests too much time into it. Because of that, he does not spend as much time studying for college and neglects his studies. Yoosung is also the cousin of Rika and cannot fully bring himself to believe that she is not alive anymore.

Yoosung is a really nice and lovable person, and is described by the other RFA members as 'a real puppy'. Yoosung cares about people a lot and loves to spend time with others. He is naive and believes things that are told to him more often than not. Despite his somewhat naive and lighthearted nature, Yoosung is severely depressed after Rika's death, as he had a very close relationship with her and idolized her. After her death, Yoosung lost all interest in his studies and becomes a shut in, rarely leaving for classes and opting instead to play LOLOL in order to cope with the crippling sadness.

name: Jae-Hui Kang
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm (5'4")

The chief secretary in the C&R International company and works as Jumin Han's assistant. She is the only female character with a route in the game.

Even though Jaehee is a fairly serious and independent business woman, she is very caring. She has her own sense of humour and knows how to have a good chuckle at herself and others. That being said, she likes things to be organized and kept in line (one of the reasons she doesn't like taking care of cats; the one hair she misses while cleaning up after them drives her mad). It's very frustrating to her when things do not go according to schedule or if she is saddled with unexpected extra work. But ever the responsible one, she always comes through and deals the best she can despite the challenges her boss and friend Jumin always throws at her both in work and personal life. Jaehee is also a big fan of Zen and often fangirls over him.

(Source: Mystic Messenger Wiki)

name: Ji-Hyeon Kim
description:
__Height:__ 179 cm (5'10")

Kim Jihyun, commonly known as V, is the current head of the RFA, however, he is often offline because of his trips as a photographer and his blindness. He was the fiance of Rika, and fell into a state of depression after her death, but did not show it.

V is a person who respects one's privacy. This can be seen when he did not know Rika's password even though the apartment was under his name. He is also the type who keeps everything to himself, to the point where he would rather live with the burden of all his secrets than tell the other RFA members. He did not tell Seven all his secrets until he had no choice. Also, Zen says that although V is famous within the photography industry, he is not well-known amongst the public since he does not like being talked about.

name: Rika Kim
description:
__Height:__ 159 cm (5'2")


Rika is a secondary character in Mystic Messenger who founded the RFA and the girlfriend/fiance of V. Tragically, she died 18 months before the events of the game.

Rika is a kind, caring, bright, strong-willed and charismatic person on the outside as described by the RFA members. She is said to care deeply for others and wanted to help them achieve happiness, which is the sole reason for her creating the RFA and she is also capable of inviting many people to her parties, mainly due to her great influence on others.





(Source: Mystic Messenger Wikia)

name: Vanderwood
description: Vanderwood is a side character who appears in 707's route and Another story. He is an informant and he is currently assigned to be 707's handler.

name: Yuhao Huo
description:
Huo Yuhao was born as the son of the Duke of the White Tiger Clan and his personal maid. Following the Duke's departure to the on-going war, the Duchess took over the reins of the manor and, being jealous and seeing Huo Yuhao as a threat to her children, secluded him and his mother in a shack making up stories that she contracted an infectious disease. This plus the malnourishment caused Huo Yuhao's mother, who already had a weak constitution, to fall sick and die when Huo Yuhao was 10 years old. He vowed to become a great Spirit Master and take revenge.

At the age of 6 he awakened his spirit, an extremely rare variant body spirit known as Spirit Eyes. However at the time of awakening his Spirit Power was only at rank 1 and it took him 5 years to get to rank 10 which is 2 years more than what people usually take.

name: Serin
description: A young, yet powerful, demon of Chaos and the one responsible for Jae Hyuk's death. She killed him while fighting, when Jae Hyuk was trying to bring his ill brother to the hospital. Feeling slightly guilty, she asks him "Do you want to live?", to which Jae Hyuk answers yes. She brings him from the dead, making him an undead, much to his disbelief, and ends up dragging him back to her world, the world of Chaos.

name: Jae Hyuk Chae
description: A normal human that does some part time work to pay the rent and treat his sickly younger brother. One night he was killed by Demon Necromancer Serin and brought back as an undead. Due the traits of a zombie, sucking life force out of beings near him, he is forced to move out of the human world, joining Serin in the world of "Chaos". Vowing one day to return to the human world to the side of his little brother, Jae Jyuk has to earn the right to possess the "Goblin Fire", which can open the door to the human world. For one to obtain the rights, one must've attained a rightful amount of power. Now, Jae Hyuk is looking for ways to obtain power, so he can one day meet his little brother again in the human world.

name: Mok-Jin Lee
description:
Lee Mok-Jin is protagonist of the story, who was found by Se-Ryeong and her partners in the desolated Earth. After awaking from his long isolated sleep, he travels beyond Earth with them into space.
It is known that around 2000 years ago he voluntarily sealed himself in an underground Stone Chamber of the Mount Tai Star System on Earth. He was unmatched in his era being the Supreme Heavenly Demon.

name: Se-Ryeong
description:
Se-Ryeong is the leader of a group of bounty hunters known as S-Devil. When they reach Earth, they go into the underground to search for any living signals. She finds the ancient underground stone where Lee Mok-Jin resided. 
She is the female main character beside Lee Mok-Jin and her team. She has impressive martial skills for her age and is known to have connections throughout the Space.

He is a former sergeant of the Northern Galaxy Combat Unit’s Special Tactical Division.

name: Feng Liu
description:
A young man named Liu Feng gains the ability to travel between our world and another world once a day. Using this ability he is able to make a good living selling items from our world to this one. Discovering that he needs a living area to continue his business, he decides to buy a small bar that is out of the way. By pure chance, a Baron spending time in said bar overhears him and gives him an offer he can't (and won't let him) refuse, buying his city of Xi Yang as well as grant him a noble title of Baron.

After this city, which is quite run down, is sold to him. Liu Feng goes about using his knowledge and access to tech from our world to greatly improve the city and its citizens, while dealing with the jealously of other nobles.

description:
Loves to eat, as when they first met she ate a months worth of rice. Liu Feng even calls her a glutton at one point. When she barely ate her meal one time, Liu Feng took it as a Out-of-Character Moment
She is a proud member of the Cat Tribe.Her maid outfit has the top of her breast exposed.She gets noticeably jealous anytime she sees one of the other girls make a move on Liu Feng. In a relationship with Liu Feng, a human.She takes great care of the outfits that Liu Feng give her. When a bandit damaged it, she got very mad.ot technically the strongest, but there are very few humans or beastman that can hold their own against her.

name: Baroona
description: He was involved with the Temple Mercenaries at the same time as Ares and  participated in the same examination of entry. He passes the test in an original way since he dodged his opponents' attacks until the time was up.  Like Ares, Baroona is quick to promote and seems not like the other mercenaries. He uses a unique weapon: two daggers linked  by a rope-like cable that is resistant to steel  It is revealed to us that Baroona was the champion of the gladiators in the country of Daraak, of which he escaped to rejoin Stopwatches. He keeps track of his previous life through the affixed tattoo on the back of all the gladiators of Daraak. Baroona fights in the war against the Daraak Empire, which is part of the Raddnik alliance, on the side of the Chronosians as part of the Temple Mercenaries.  Baroona is a calm, kind and may be perceived as the personage "plug" in the middle of his two friends. Constant smoker, he fights calmly and intelligently. He is the same age as Ares, 18 years, and has a strong resentment against the Daraak Empire who took away his freedom.

name: Ares
description: The title character of the manhwa, Ares, is the apprentice of Kiron, the famous Master Swordsman of Chronos. His birth name is Sebastion, but he suffered amnesia after jumping off of a cliff to escape the assassin Alamoot "The Quick". After the now retired and wandering Kiron saved him and took him as an apprentice Sebastion gave himself the name Ares, the name of the Greek God of war. After 6 years of training, Kirberos, the Red-Eyed Swordsman, tracked down Kiron and killed him to collect his sword. Ares lost his right eye to Kirberos during this fight and vowed vengeance.    Ares is light-hearted and friendly in normal situations. He is goofy, cracks jokes, and behaves as if he is simple-minded. For example, he joins Temple Mercenaries because they provide meals for their members.    Although he is only 18 years old, Ares is deadly in battle. As expected of Kiron's apprentice, few can stand against his fighting ability. He fights with a sword, but he will eliminate weaker opponents with only kicks or elbow strikes. His swordplay and fighting style incorporate quick, hard strikes and acrobatic maneuvers to both evade enemy attacks and enhance the momentum of his own. He makes good use of his environment - launching off walls, dropping chandeliers on enemies, taking swords from fallen soldiers if his own breaks. Temple Mercenaries gave him B-Rank status after his first skirmish.

name: Michael Gracio
description: A companion of Ares and of Baroona, he participated in the same Temple mercenary entrance exam as them. He distinguished himself there through the time he took to send his opponent to the ground: a second. Everyone understood that they had seen someone with great talent.  He had a major role in the fight waged by the army of Chronos (which, led by the General-and-later-King Icarus, bought the services of the Temple mercenaries) to the point that he become highly esteemed by his comrades-in-arms as well as by Icarus himself. The latter proposed for him to become one of his generals after an impressive fight against a terrible opponent; Michael declined the offer.  He always has a leaf in the mouth, which is enough for him to be recognized (and addressed) by this characteristic. On the other hand, it is rather funny to see it systematically having to be put back in his mouth because it was pulled out at some point in the fight.  With the passing of chapters, one notices that Michael hides something of his identity and his true intentions. Silent, he only speaks up to say precise things, which are often threatening. His personage is, following the example of Sasuke in the anime Naruto, completely ambiguous and difficult to get a handle on. He is cruel, not leaving any survivor behind him. That contrasts with the behavior of Ares who seems to like Michael to the point of considering him a true friend.

name: Kiron
description: Master swordman of Chronos, also known under the name of the swordman of the wind. He is the most powerful fighter of the history of the manhwa of Ryu Kum Chel. His nickname originates from the noise that his blade produces when it splits the air. After taking the armies of Chronos to victory, he withdrew himself. He took advantage of the encounter with Ares to make Ares his apprentice and break his solitude. Although cold and silent, he was nevertheless very attached to his student and will do all to protect Ares when his life will be threatened. Some years after taking Ares as student, his sight progressively worsened, until his blindness became total. At that very moment, the red eyes swordsman, hunter of heads of big swordsmen and collector of their weapons, appeared. Despite his infirmity, Kiron defended himself with fervor and even took over the fight. His opponent used sly stratagems, such as the presence of Ares, to complete his ends while killing the master swordsman of Chronos. Even today, the simple mention of the name of Kiron makes men tremble.

name: Kirus
description: Kirus is the first disciple of the red eyed swordsman and reputably the strongest of them, as is shown in his first major appearance where he decimates an army that is in his way.

The Perfect Plan for a Fairy-Tale Ending

name: Na-Rae Lee
description: A descendant of hunters who finds herself entangled with ghosts, animals-turned-humans, and a fox spirit swearing vengeance on her lineage. She befriends a boy named Gyeon-U, after being saved by him.

name: Gyeon-U Nam
description: A boy in Na-Rae's class, and a descendant of the animals who became half-humans. He saves Nara from a fox spirit attempting to take her soul, and afterwards he protects her as she becomes entangled in the supernatural world.

name: Tae-Ri Sin
description: She's one of the top players in the country, known as Shadow Assassin.

name: Ji-Ho Seong

name: Bai Long
description: Bai Long is the wife of Tian and one of the last surviving Ancient Gods.

name: Zhen Chan
description: Zhen Chan is one of the five Sage Kings who fought against the Dark Ones and Humans who entered the Gods' Domain. He was later defeated by Zi Yu and left the Gods' Domain after the war to preach his ideals in human's domain.

name: ZongHeng TianXia
description: ZongHeng TianXia was one of the Great Generals of the Dark Ones under NiTian ErXing. He became the Officer of Armament of the Dark Ones' City, being tasked with training the city's soldiers. He was formerly known as the Nomad of Hell.

name: Feng Chu
description: Chu Feng is the main protagonist of the novel Martial God Asura. He is a member of the Chu Heavenly Clan of the Great Chiliocosm Upper Realm located in Ancestral Martial Starfield of the Holy Light Galaxy.

name: Jude
description: Main Character of Warble. A Cloud of mysteries surround him. He has a special ability to memorize anything - be It language, abilities, how to play an instrument etc. upon seeing It once. He saves a young girl who he then makes her his servant.

name: Burner
description:
(Flashback), 18 (pre time skip), 21 (post time skip) 
Race: Human
Eye Color: Orange
Birthday: October 12, 
Relatives: 
Pound (Adoptive Father)
Berry (Adoptive Mother)
 

Affiliations: 
Occupation:
Street Fighter (Formerly)
Revolutionary
-----------------------------------------------------

Initially, Burner was like any regular citizen in Block 5, poor, homeless, and living in constant fear of Great. Dreaming of one day leaving Block 5 and living a better life, she endured abuse from the rich for money and ran from any sign of trouble. However, after a child she saved from an anteater is killed by Great and fighting him as a result, Burner's personality changes. All the rage, sorrow, and aggression she built up during her life made Burner become a more daring, short tempered, and confident person. Resolving to defeat Great instead dying pathetically, she joins the XEVOLZ in order to become stronger and find her father. 

As a child Burner was like a normal kid, happy, liked stuffed animals, and enjoyed spending time with her parents. However, even as child Burner knew violence, and due to her father's training she wasn't afraid to use it when necessary.

Burner was taught martial arts by her father Pound, who is considered the strongest martial artist of his time. Her style is based on accelerating to target vitals, and uses a particular stance that bring her a half-step closer than other martial artists.

name: Eidia
description: Chief Medical Officer of revolutionary group XEVOLTZ. She has a strong desire to keep anyone on either side of the revolution from getting hurt, hence her still keeping her position as a government doctor while she moonlights as a XEVOLTZ operative.

name: Roy
description: Former Vatican Battle Priest, current member of the revolutionary group XEVOLTZ. He has the appearance of a humanoid dog, causing him to feel like an outcast. He wields a large cross made of multiple firearms in battle.

name: Ivan
description: Engineer of the revolutionary group XEVOLTZ specializing in robotics and all kinds of technology. He is quite short, and has a very large nose and equally impressive moustache.

name: Robert
description: The swordsman of revolutionary group XEVOLTZ. One of the , making him among the strongest swordsmen in the world. He wears a mask during battle.

name: Kai De Anecdote
description: Young leader of revolutionary group XEVOLTZ. He runs the group with the Raison d'etre of not killing anyone under any cirsumstance, as he believes that is the only way to change Graymark for the better. His Authority ability allows him to bend others to his will at the cost of a lot of stamina.

name: Great
description:
Great is the administrator of block 5 and a sword saint that hold one of the 3 great swords, "Black Blood". Great has a extremely radicalized view of how the law should be upheld and practised. Because of this ideology Great kills everyone indescriminetaly that breaks the law regardless of its severity, and for such actions is seen as a demon by some. 

Great and Burner regard each other as enemies after their first encounter.

name: Do-Yun Lee
description: Also known as his username Psychopomp, Do-Yun is a timid, ordinary schoolboy. He doesn't have a gaming computer, used to play on laggy American servers, but still managed to beat everyone at PSI BOND, despite barely knowing anything about the game. His primary position is attack (DPS) but he plays best as a sniper.

name: Ju-Ri Yun
description: She has a big crush on Su-Ho and will do anything to hang out with him, but he keeps blowing her off for Do-Yun. She is the most popular girl in the school thanks to her looks but she still remains hung up on Su-Ho. She volunteers to, and eventually becomes team manager of team Deathperado along with Bonnie.

name: Su-Ho Kang
description: Su-Ho is a Grandmaster rank at this online game called PSI BOND. He sneaks away in the middle of school to play it in the computer lab, and notices another mysterious student doing the same thing. This kid is a far lower level than he is, so Su-Ho believes that he will easily beat the new kids in a few rounds. When he loses 0 to 10, he begins to realize that there is something special about this kid. That kid, is Do-Yoon Lee.

name: Myeong Yu
description: The main protagonist, and a struggling actor with a cleaning side job. Unbeknownst to her, Myeong was the muse of the photographer Eunmil, who is now declared dead. As his muse, she was called 明 (myeong). This launches her into worldwide fame, giving her the opportunity to be cast in her first significant role.

name: Yu-Han Eun
description: Myeong’s manager.

name: Hyeon-Jae U
description: Myeong's boyfriend at the start of the story, and an aspiring director. In college, they promised each other that Myeong will star in Hyeonjae's directorial debut. Hyeonjae is very focused on his work and fulfilling their promise, to the point that he and Myeong grow distant.

name: Ye-Na Ban
description: Myeong's younger colleague who has become a star actress. The two used to have an amicable relationship, but now she schemes against Myeong.

name: Seong Yu
description: [Myeong's](https://anilist.co/character/322911/Myeong-Yu) Father

name: Un Go
description: [Myeong's](https://anilist.co/character/322911/Myeong-Yu) school friend. He wanted to be a cartoonist, but now he is a devoted father of two and runs a convenience store.

name: Jinyup
description: The director of the school, and the Heavenly Five Paths master of fire. He was an old friend of Lightning Tiger's, as he was the one who reassembled the pieces of his arm. They split when Fire Dragon chose to side with Yuri in her quest to become a god. He could be the one who killed Lightning Tiger, as the bones of the arm were charred. He recently tried to attack Vera and Earth Beast. It is revealed in volume 8 that the person that killed Lighting Tiger, was Yuri Linus.    In volume 9 Fire Dragon attacks Madoka and Hayato, after they protest of the training (lethal) given to Kombengi; Rud and Shin interfere and attack Fire Dragon, they are helped latter by Yuhwa, but still are no match, Gangryong appears and also attacks Fire Dragon (The only one of the fighters to land a hit on him), after Gangryong dispels a fire vortex and Vera appears, Fire Dragon calmly leaves the place. Later is shown that while he was moving and walking normally after the fight, he was injured to the point of vomiting blood. It is to be noted the immense power of Fire Dragon, to be able to sustain a combined attack from some of the most powerful students in the school (Against five members of the Student Council and Gangryong) easily neutralizing Shin, Madoka, Hayato and Rud at the same time.    (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Gu Honse
description: Leader of the Nine Dragons Faction. Gangryong was put in the care of Gu Honse by friends Rud and Jeeha. On the surface, he is as a cowardly man who doesn't like getting mixed up with Gangryong's messes. However, beneath his foolish persona, he is very dangerous.   He was, at one point, the third-strongest student at the school. In addition, he is a shrewd tactician who developed many techniques, some of which were specifically designed to counter the fighting style of Reunion such as "Half-step", he also helped Rud learn "Sharpened Sword force".

name: Shin Jeeha
description: Rud's friend, who is also a traditional successor and the Third Dragon of the Nine Dragons. He likes to antagonize Shinra by expressing his undying affection for her, and referencing a relationship they used to have. His martial arts style has not yet been shown. It has been stated that if Rud didn't help him in the past, Shinra would have stolen his art. Understanding bodily principles is his specialty. He is shown in volume 9 to have an enormous speed that allows him to run on the walls, and several powerful spinning kicks attacks. It was stated in a flashback in chapter 38, Jeeha had apparently been badly injured due to all three of his matches had each been fought with a member from the student council (the ones that had lost in the tournament at that time in the flashback were Shinra, Paul, Madoka, Guesong, Yuhwa, and Hayato), however he had won all three matches so it is safe to assume that Shin is very powerful to accomplish such a feat. In fact in what commented that Shin had destroyed the order of how the council had planned for to win in the tournament further indicating his prowess to be very high.

name: Vera Linus
description: The student council president. An outwardly cold girl, she is the most powerful student at the school. Her sister, Yuri, is the head of Reunion. Her initial impression of Gangryong is that he is useless. In the past, she fought Lightning Tiger, and the incident left a scar and a strong impression. Though he was her enemy, she regards him almost as a former lover. She fights using the Arts of Heaven's Rich Strength. What she seeks can't be obtained by Reunion or the council and she actually hold no interest in them. She fights Guesong after he interfered in her goal and kills him, afterward Rud challenges her to a formal match next year. But then she kills everu student in the school except Rud's company and few who escaped earlier. After that she makes Rud die in exchange of his friends' lifes.    Techniques:    Special Void Fist - Is a traditional martial art skill that is only used by the main bloodline of Art o Heaven's Riches.Used by gathering the user's Ki into their palms and are directed towards their opponent's heart to cause extreme internal damage.     Void Strike Class - A technique that can constrict an opponent's heart from a medium (approximately 5-10m) distance away. Fire Dragon claims the counter technique was pioneered by Lightning Tiger himself.     Vacuum Strike - A blast that expands the emptiness in a distance.   (source: wikipedia)

name: Gangryong Ma
description: The main protagonist in the series. Gangryong is 18 years-old and the sole remaining practitioner of the Enlightenment Of Thunder and Lightning (EOTL). Though fairly dense, he shows an aptitude for battle and street smarts that seem well-suited to his underdog status at the Reunion school, he once even fought with both arms broken and one broken leg. Mouthy and disrespectful, he has a penchant for making enemies which to date has served him only to win less than a handful of actual fights with him usually ending up unconscious. He usually has flashbacks of Lightning Tiger's teachings and his fighting style is Dog Fighting and since he started his training later than most, his Ki channels are very clogged, so he has very limited amount of Ki but it's highly refined, so much so that after being hit with "Life wish" his body began releasing it like an electric eel, nearly killing him. He is extremely knowledgeable about fighting and at Rud's request is aiming for one of the council seats. He is only capable of close ranged EOTL techniques as of current. In volume 8 he fights against Hayato and loses due to Hayato having learned Northern Broad Strike and  aquired a move that countered Gangryong's EOTL.

name: Han Rud
description: A member of the council who is opposed to Vera. Rud was a very frail child with little potential for fighting. His life was once saved by a girl named Anichella, who taught him basic martial arts techniques and arranges for his arrival at the school. She also provides him with information on the Feline Claws fighting style, which he pursues despite its inherent weakness. He develops a strong grudge against Guhoo after he kills Anichella in battle, and uses this motivation to rise to the top of the school. He and Jeeha have taken Gangryong under their wing, as they are also traditional successors. They seem to have a plan for revenge against Vera and her friends.

name: Yuhwa
description: A female student who also helped Guesong defeat Honse. She has long, black hair, and wear unusual knee socks with black and white stripes. Her Yardplay art is the "Puppeteer" allowing her to control other people like puppets through invisible threads, even though this technique has the same name a the art of another female character of yardplay faction, they are completely different. She assisted Mu Young with his intensive training in subterranean conditions beneath underground with medical assistance, bandaging and care. However both were unknowingly being targeted by Paul whom had been largely bribed by Director Fire Dragon, to prevent them from returning to the school for the last test for the seat in the Student Council and assisting and supporting Vera with reaching her goal. She was extremely angry with Mu Young, when he injures Paul critically, and threaten Mu Young with removing the power she helped him acquire, if he doesn't behave. Later she is seen apparently helping Kombengi against a black dummy, and fighting Fire Dragon alongside other students. She returns with Mu Young to the school, but is shocked upon finding it burned down.

name: Eunhwa Lee
description: The ex-girlfriend of Do-Hyup Bae. She used him for his family's secrets in order to gain more power. She helps Do-Hyup defeat Gangryong, and then defeats Du-Hyup in a formal battle. She uses palm combat styles developed by Reunion, as well as being able to use shadows to bind opponents. Though she has a high power level, she is a poor fighter who lacks toughness, and is defeated by Gangryong.

name: Do-Hyup Bae
description: The former boyfriend of Eunhwa. A lazy man who gets tricked into revealing his family secrets to Eunhwa, who then uses them to gain more power. He first fights Gangryong, who he can't defeat on his own, and then he challenges Eunhwa in order to take revenge for her betrayal. He is the successor to his family's traditional martial art, but he is too lazy to master it properly, and he institutes some of Reunion's skills, making it less effective. After his defeat, he gives Gangryong all of his family's secrets and leaves the school.

name: Guhoo Li
description: Another student allied with Vera in the school. Guhoo uses the Iron Spirit technique that was created by Reunion. It allows him to harden his skin to incredible levels, and eventually makes him impervious to pain. He uses very few actual fighting moves. He is in a relationship with Shinra, and has a history of conflict with Rud which led to the recent fight and him getting his arm cut off. He has been sentenced to 4 months of isolation training for fighting Rud after his arm was reattached.

name: Lapis
description: A magician who hides her identity and infiltrates the Area Academy as an apprentice knight.

name: Calla
description: The Dark Lord who was accidentally released from her seal by Lapis and unintentionally confessed to by the latter.

name: Jiu Feng
description:
Feng Jiu is an young genius who was betrayed by the leader of the poison clan. She was reincarnated with the purpose to kill her murderer and restore her former glory as the daughter of the Patriarch of the Feng family. Her new body has a low level of cultivation and such Feng Jiu starts an adventure to regain her skill set. to pursue her future goals.

 

(Source: The Ghostly Doctor Wiki)

He comes from a well-off family. His day job is in IT, but he also co-owns a bar with his friend.

name: Ragnar
description: A former assassin who befriends Daphne. He was the original heir to the Benedito family in the original novel.

name: Chloe Benedito
description: The head of a merchant company and Daphne's adoptive mother.

name: Axelius Chainard
description: A paladin from the temple who has unrequited feelings for Chloe. He's also the grand duke of the Clemence Kingdom and the uncle of its crown prince, Simon. He initially assumes Daphne is his unacquainted child whom Chloe had bore in secret due to the girl having similar gold eyes and white hair to him and Chloe, respectively. Received the nickname "Crying Man" from the Benedito family from to his tendency to cry a lot.

name: Rose Dupré
description: The main protagonist of the webtoon, she is described as being always lonely and a girl who cries often. She is the daughter of Léa Dupré.

name: Léa Dupré
description: Mother of Rose. She's kind, tender and beautiful like a noblewoman. Some people say she's a witch.

description: In order to prevent the role of OOC, he plays the male villain who is vicious on the surface and follow the spirit of the drama in the script. However, Qin Xian had already seen his inner thoughts clearly.

appearsIn.title: I Want to Be a Big Baddie

name: Ma-Ru Kang
description:
Football player. He wasn't always interested in football, but when he was in 5th year of primary school, he watched a documentary on the 2002 Korea-Japan World Cup with his father, and he got into football every since. 

Ma-Ru is hard-working and never skips a day of practice. His pass and technique are described as being very good.

name: Ash
description:
Born and raised in South Korea. While cooking ramen at home, she suddenly wakes up as a maid, during the birth of a prince. Ash has no memories of her current body's past, let alone her own name. All she knows is that the Queen she serves will come to a bad end, and the palace she works in is prone to death if she doesn't act well.

Ash isn't described as being particularly eye catching, though her personality is quite charming. She doesn't feel any particular alliances nor is she attached to children, but she is diligent and works hard / dutifully with what she is given.

name: Yurigel
description: Yurigel is lovely in every way with a gentle and loving heart. Despite being a commoner, every male character in the story falls in love with him, particularly the King.

name: Mio Zodiac
description:
A talented Swordsman who is assigned as the baby Prince's bodyguard. In the Novel "The Escape", Mio loves Yurigel one sidedly, to the point he would whisper brainwashing words to the baby at night, turning the prince against his mother the Queen.

In the current timeline, he is a stoic and stuffy young man. Although always disagreeable, he seems to get dragged along by Ash's whims. He's also quite thoughtful and tender sometimes, though his actions are often dismissed by Ash who knows he is still in love with Yurigel.

name: Klein Capella
description: Duke Capella, the current Swordmaster and the one and only good friend of King Evans. Unlike most characters in the novel world, Klein seems to really dislike Yurigel. He was against going to war, even if he would reluctantly lead it, and returned in failure.

name: Ciel Copperfield
description:
A grand mage who suffers from severe PTSD. His desertion during the war causes it to end in failure. He is still allowed to bless the baby prince at the banquet and has been skulking about in the Library ever since.



Ciel is described as having a similar demeanor to Yurigel, and really loves children. He brightens up completely around Prince Mikael but his aggressive PTSD causes Ash to feel concerned.

name: Evans
description: The primary love interest in the novel. Despite his marriage to the queen, his love for Yurigel is met with fanfare and unanimous agreement throughout the land. He is incredibly protective of Yurigel and extremely handsome.

His wife is Gu Yuena and their child is Tang Xuanyu/Lan Xuanyu. He holds the position of God of Destruction given to him by his dad Tang San. His sister is Tang Wutong the Butterfly Goddess and his brother-in-law is the God of Emotion Huo Yuhao.! ~

description: A hard-working employee, she began working at Joyple part-time after failing her civil servant exam for the fifth time. Now that she's thirty though, she's determined that it's now or never and her sixth attempt will be her last go at it!

name: Deok-Hu Oh
description:
Deok-hoo is a programmer and CEO of a gaming company. He is somewhat shy and awkward when it comes to communicating with people.

He is also obsessed with nerd culture and can get carried away when talking about his passions.

name: Urek Mazino
description:
__Species:__ Human
__Born:__ Outside
__Height:__ 195 cm
__Rank:__ Irregular, High Ranker #4 (Currently)
__Position:__ Fisherman
__Occupation:__ Wolhaiksong (Vice Captain)

Urek Mazino is an Irregular, currently 4th in Rank. He was the strongest active Ranker before [Jahad](https://anilist.co/character/126030/Jahad) became active once again. He is also the most recent person to be part of the Top 5 High Rankers inside the Tower.

He is considered to be on the same level as Phantaminum by weaker Rankers, however, his true rank is almost impossible to determine in terms of the Top 4 ranks because the top 2 Rankers are inactive and thus, cannot be compared with Urek. He mentioned to [Bam](https://anilist.co/character/84769/TwentyFifth-Bam) on the 43rd Floor that they would meet again later on the 77th Floor, then left the floor. His current location is unknown.

Urek is said to have a ruthless personality, leading him to be respected by all those who dare call themselves men and at the same time seems to be disliked by seemingly every woman he meets. He is also shown to be extremely confident to the point of arrogance, often ridiculing the efforts of those who were no match for him. Despite his ruthlessness and boastful nature, he still wants to help others and friends in need. He will also help strangers if he thinks they are "worthy" to be helped. He presents his ideas and opinions in a logical and pragmatic manner, but his goals and desires themselves are not understood. He is perfectly willing to manipulate dozens of lives and create the nucleus of civil unrest to attain his mysterious goal.

Although most Administrators normally stay on their Floors, Headon seems to be the only Administrator with the ability to visit other Floors of the Tower. It is said that Headon is the most experienced Administrator of the Tower. Although that only means he was the first Administrator Zahard met and therefore the first one to carry out the roles of a Administrator, that doesn't mean he's the oldest.
